<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
// ============================================================
// STATE
// ============================================================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

let state = 'title'; // title, playing, gameover, win
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let frame = 0;
let enemies = [];
let bullets = [];
let particles = [];
let wizard = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, w: 32, h: 40, vx: 0, vy: 0, invuln: 0 };
let crown = null; // the goal object
let crownTimer = 0;
let stars = [];
let clouds = [];

// Generate background stars
for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H * 0.7,
    size: Math.random() < 0.3 ? 2 : 1,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Generate clouds
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  clouds.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: 40 + Math.random() * 120,
    w: 40 + Math.random() * 50,
    speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3
  });
}

// Spawn enemy
function spawnEnemy() {
  const type = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 'bat' : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'ghost' : 'fireball');
  const x = 30 + Math.random() * (W - 60);
  const y = -30;
  enemies.push({
    type, x, y,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
    vy: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1,
    w: type === 'bat' ? 28 : type === 'ghost' ? 24 : 20,
    h: type === 'bat' ? 20 : type === 'ghost' ? 28 : 16,
    hp: type === 'ghost' ? 2 : 1,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    color: type === 'bat' ? '#4a2060' : type === 'ghost' ? '#80c0ff' : '#ff6020'
  });
}

// Spawn crown (the goal)
function spawnCrown() {
  crown = {
    x: W / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100,
    y: 60 + Math.random() * 100,
    w: 36, h: 24,
    bob: 0
  };
  crownTimer = 300; // frames before it disappears
}

// Reset game
function resetGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  enemies = [];
  bullets = [];
  particles = [];
  wizard = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, w: 32, h: 40, vx: 0, vy: 0, invuln: 0 };
  crown = null;
  crownTimer = 0;
  frame = 0;
  spawnCrown();
  state = 'playing';
}

// ============================================================
// INPUT
// ============================================================
const keys = {};

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (state === 'title' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    resetGame();
  }
  if ((state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    resetGame();
  }
  if (state === 'playing' && e.code === 'Space') {
    // Fire bullet
    bullets.push({
      x: wizard.x,
      y: wizard.y - wizard.h / 2,
      vx: 0,
      vy: -4,
      w: 6, h: 10,
      color: '#ffff40'
    });
    // Particle burst
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: wizard.x,
        y: wizard.y - wizard.h / 2,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
        vy: -Math.random() * 2,
        life: 15,
        color: '#ffff80'
      });
    }
  }
  if (state === 'playing' && e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
    // Jump / dash
    wizard.vy = -6;
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
  keys[e.code] = false;
});

// Touch / click for mobile
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tx = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  const ty = (e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  if (state === 'title' || state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') {
    resetGame();
  } else {
    bullets.push({ x: wizard.x, y: wizard.y - wizard.h / 2, vx: 0, vy: -4, w: 6, h: 10, color: '#ffff40' });
  }
});

// ============================================================
// UPDATE
// ============================================================
function update() {
  frame++;

  // Clouds drift
  for (let c of clouds) {
    c.x += c.speed;
    if (c.x > W + c.w) c.x = -c.w;
  }

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Wizard movement
  const speed = 3;
  wizard.vx = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) wizard.vx = -speed;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) wizard.vx = speed;
  wizard.x += wizard.vx;
  wizard.x = Math.max(wizard.w / 2, Math.min(W - wizard.w / 2, wizard.x));

  // Gravity for wizard
  wizard.vy += 0.25;
  wizard.y += wizard.vy;
  if (wizard.y > H - 20) {
    wizard.y = H - 20;
    wizard.vy = 0;
  }
  if (wizard.invuln > 0) wizard.invuln--;

  // Spawn enemies
  if (frame % Math.max(40, 120 - Math.floor(score / 50)) === 0) {
    spawnEnemy();
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.phase += 0.05;
    e.x += e.vx + Math.sin(e.phase) * 0.5;
    e.y += e.vy;
    if (e.x < e.w / 2) { e.x = e.w / 2; e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx); }
    if (e.x > W - e.w / 2) { e.x = W - e.w / 2; e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx); }
    if (e.y > H + 20) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Check collision with wizard
    if (wizard.invuln <= 0) {
      const dx = Math.abs(e.x - wizard.x);
      const dy = Math.abs(e.y - wizard.y);
      if (dx < (e.w + wizard.w) / 2 - 4 && dy < (e.h + wizard.h) / 2 - 4) {
        lives--;
        wizard.invuln = 90;
        for (let p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: wizard.x, y: wizard.y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
            life: 20, color: '#ff4040'
          });
        }
        if (lives <= 0) state = 'gameover';
      }
    }
  }

  // Update bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.y < -20) { bullets.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    // Check hit enemies
    let hit = false;
    for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = enemies[j];
      const dx = Math.abs(b.x - e.x);
      const dy = Math.abs(b.y - e.y);
      if (dx < (b.w + e.w) / 2 && dy < (b.h + e.h) / 2) {
        e.hp--;
        hit = true;
        for (let p = 0; p < 6; p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: e.x, y: e.y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
            life: 15, color: e.color
          });
        }
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          score += e.type === 'ghost' ? 30 : 20;
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    if (hit) bullets.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update crown
  if (crown) {
    crown.bob += 0.08;
    crownTimer--;
    // Check collection
    const dx = Math.abs(crown.x - wizard.x);
    const dy = Math.abs(crown.y + Math.sin(crown.bob) * 6 - wizard.y);
    if (dx < (crown.w + wizard.w) / 2 && dy < (crown.h + wizard.h) / 2) {
      score += 100;
      for (let p = 0; p < 20; p++) {
        particles.push({
          x: crown.x, y: crown.y,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5,
          life: 30, color: '#ffd700'
        });
      }
      crown = null;
      // Win condition: collect 5 crowns
      if (score >= 500) {
        state = 'win';
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => { if (state === 'playing') spawnCrown(); }, 2000);
      }
    }
    if (crownTimer <= 0 && crown) {
      crown = null;
      setTimeout(() => { if (state === 'playing') spawnCrown(); }, 1500);
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ============================================================
// DRAW
// ============================================================
function drawBackground() {
  // Night sky gradient
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a0a3e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a1050');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0a30');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const twinkle = Math.sin(s.twinkle + frame * 0.03) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, ${200 + Math.floor(twinkle * 55)}, ${0.4 + twinkle * 0.6})`;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(s.x), Math.floor(s.y), s.size, s.size);
  }

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe8c0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 60, 70, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a3e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 52, 64, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#150828';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const mx = i * 90 - 20;
    const mh = 60 + Math.sin(i * 1.5) * 25;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx, H);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 45, H - mh);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 90, H);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Mid mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1f0e3a';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const mx = i * 110 + 20;
    const mh = 40 + Math.cos(i * 2) * 15;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx, H);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 55, H - mh);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 110, H);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Clouds
  for (const c of clouds) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120, 80, 180, 0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x), Math.floor(c.y), Math.floor(c.w), 12);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(c.x + 8), Math.floor(c.y - 6), Math.floor(c.w * 0.6), 10);
  }

  // Ground
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1050';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - 20, W, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2060';
  for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 16) {
    ctx.fillRect(i, H - 20, 12, 4);
  }
}

function drawWizard() {
  if (wizard.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(frame / 4) % 2 === 0) return; // blink

  const x = Math.floor(wizard.x);
  const y = Math.floor(wizard.y);

  // Robe (purple)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6030a0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 10, 28, 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#502890';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 2, 32, 16);

  // Robe trim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8050c0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 8, 28, 4);

  // Head (skin)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d0a0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 22, 16, 14);

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#202040';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 5, y - 18, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 18, 3, 3);

  // Beard (white)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8f0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y - 10, 12, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 4, 8, 6);

  // Hat (dark purple, pointy)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#402070';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y - 30, 24, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#351860';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 38, 16, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 5, y - 44, 10, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 48, 6, 6);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 50, 3, 4);

  // Hat brim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#503080';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 24, 28, 4);

  // Staff

  ctx.fillRect(x + 13, y - 34, 6, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#80ff90';

  // Belt

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = Math.floor(e.x);
  const y = Math.floor(e.y);

  if (e.type === 'bat') {
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a2060';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 6, 16, 12);

    const wingFlap = Math.sin(e.phase * 3) * 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1850';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 4 + wingFlap, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 8, y - 4 - wingFlap, 8, 8);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4040';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 3, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 3, 3, 3);
    // Fangs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y + 3, 2, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 3, 2, 3);
  } else if (e.type === 'ghost') {
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#80c0ff';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y - 12, 20, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#60a0e0';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y + 4, 16, 8);
    // Wavy bottom
    ctx.fillStyle = '#80c0ff';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y + 8, 4, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + 8, 4, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 8, 4, 6);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#204060';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 5, y - 8, 4, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 8, 4, 5);
    // Mouth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#204060';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, 5, 3);
  } else if (e.type === 'fireball') {
    // Outer glow
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4020';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y - 8, 20, 16);
    // Core
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8030';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 7, y - 5, 14, 10);
    // Center
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc40';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 3, 8, 6);
    // Trail
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4020';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y + 8, 6, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8030';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + 12, 4, 4);
  }
}

function drawCrown() {
  if (!crown) return;
  const x = Math.floor(crown.x);
  const y = Math.floor(crown.y + Math.sin(crown.bob) * 6);

  // Glow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2)';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 24, y - 20, 48, 40);

  // Crown base
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 2, 28, 10);

  // Crown points
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 6, 6, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 10, 8, 14);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 8, y - 6, 6, 10);

  // Crown tips
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffed40';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y - 8, 3, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 12, 4, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y - 8, 3, 4);

  // Gems
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4060';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 11, y + 4, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#40ff80';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y + 4, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4080ff';
  ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 4, 3, 3);

  // Sparkle
  const sparkle = Math.sin(frame * 0.15) * 0.5 + 0.5;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 200, ${sparkle})`;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 14, 2, 2);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 10, 2, 2);
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    const x = Math.floor(b.x);
    const y = Math.floor(b.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff40';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 5, 6, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff80';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y - 4, 4, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 2, 2, 4);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(p.x) - 2, Math.floor(p.y) - 2, 4, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 10, 24);

  // Goal
  ctx.fillStyle = '#80ff80';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('GOAL: 500', 10, 42);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6060';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
    ctx.fillRect(W - 20 - i * 20, 14, 14, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8080';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 18 - i * 20, 16, 10, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6060';
  }

  // Crown count
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('CROWNS: ' + Math.floor(score / 100) + '/5', W / 2, 24);
}

function drawTitle() {
  // Darken
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText("WIZARD'S", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
  ctx.fillText('CROWN', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);

  // Subtitle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#80c0ff';

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4040';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff40';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  }
}

function drawWin() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#80ff80';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('The Wizard\'s Crown is yours!', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);

  // Draw a big crown
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2 + 80;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 20, cy + 4, 40, 14);
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 20, cy - 8, 8, 14);
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 5, cy - 14, 10, 20);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 12, cy - 8, 8, 14);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffed40';
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 17, cy - 10, 4, 5);
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 2, cy - 16, 5, 5);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 15, cy - 10, 4, 5);

  if (Math.floor(frame / 30) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff40';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', W / 2, H / 2 + 130);
  }
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  if (state === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }

  // Draw enemies
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);

  // Draw crown
  drawCrown();

  // Draw bullets
  drawBullets();

  // Draw wizard
  drawWizard();

  // Draw particles
  drawParticles();

  // Draw HUD
  drawHUD();

  if (state === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
  if (state === 'win') drawWin();
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN LOOP
// ============================================================
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();

  spawnEnemy('ghost', 100, 190);

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (state === 'title' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {

function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  gameTime += 1/60;

  // Player movement
  player.vx = 0;

  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) { player.vx = 2; player.facing = 1; }

        e.x += e.patrolDir * 0.8;

        e.x += e.patrolDir * 0.6;

        e.vy += 0.35;

    ctx.fillText("'N GHOSTS", W/2, 98);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W/2, 140);
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS/WASD: MOVE', W/2, 165);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE/W: JUMP', W/2, 178);
    ctx.fillText('X/Z/F: SWORD', W/2, 191);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // Game over
  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, 100);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, 130);
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO CONTINUE', W/2, 160);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // Win screen
  if (state === 'win') {
    winTimer++;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, 90);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, 120);
    ctx.fillText('THE GHOULS ARE DEFEATED!', W/2, 140);
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO CONTINUE', W/2, 170);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    // Confetti
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      let cx = (i * 37 + winTimer * 2) % W;
      let cy = (i * 23 + winTimer * 3) % H;
      let colors = ['#ff3333', '#ffcc00', '#33cc33', '#3333ff', '#ff33ff'];
      ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
      ctx.fillRect(cx, cy, 4, 4);
    }
  }
}

// =============== GAME LOOP ===============
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Initialize
buildLevel();
loop();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>B.C.'s Quest for Tires</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: monospace;
  }
  canvas {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    border: 4px solid #333;
    background: #87CEEB;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="240"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = 320, H = 240;
  const TILE = 16;
  const COLS = W / TILE;   // 20
  const ROWS = H / TILE;   // 15

  // ---------- COLORS (6 solid colors) ----------
  const COL = {
    sky:      "#87CEEB",
    ground:   "#4CAF50",
    dirt:     "#8B4513",
    bc:       "#2E8B57",
    bcSkin:   "#F5DEB3",
    tire:     "#333333",
    rock:     "#708090",
    water:    "#1E90FF",
    white:    "#FFFFFF",
    black:    "#000000",
    red:      "#E74C3C",
    yellow:   "#FFD700",
    brown:    "#8B4513",
    darkGreen:"#2E7D32",
    lightGreen:"#66BB6A",
  };

  // ---------- LEVEL (built with a short loop) ----------
  // 0 = air, 1 = ground, 2 = rock, 3 = water
  const level = [];
  function buildLevel() {
    level.length = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      const row = [];
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        row.push(0);
      }
      level.push(row);
    }
    // ground: bottom 3 rows
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      level[ROWS - 1][c] = 1;
      level[ROWS - 2][c] = 1;
      level[ROWS - 3][c] = 1;
    }
    // rock platforms (a few)
    const platforms = [
      [3, 4, 10],  // row 3, cols 4-10
      [5, 12, 16], // row 5, cols 12-16
      [2, 1, 3],   // row 2, cols 1-3
      [6, 6, 8],   // row 6, cols 6-8
      [4, 17, 19], // row 4, cols 17-19
    ];
    for (const [r, c1, c2] of platforms) {
      for (let c = c1; c <= c2 && c < COLS; c++) {
        if (r >= 0 && r < ROWS) level[r][c] = 2;
      }
    }
    // water pools on ground
    for (let c = 7; c <= 9; c++) {
      level[ROWS - 3][c] = 3;
      level[ROWS - 2][c] = 3;
    }
  }
  buildLevel();

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  const state = {
    screen: "title", // title, play, win, lose
    score: 0,
    tires: 0,
    tiresTotal: 0,
    time: 0,
    frame: 0,
  };

  const player = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: 12, h: 20,
    onGround: false,
    facing: 1, // 1 right, -1 left
    walkFrame: 0,
    alive: true,
  };

  const tires = [];
  const rocks = [];
  const clouds = [];

  function spawnTires() {
    tires.length = 0;
    const spots = [
      [5, 10], [7, 14], [3, 2], [8, 7], [5, 18],
      [4, 6], [6, 13], [2, 15],
    ];
    for (const [c, r] of spots) {
      tires.push({ x: c * TILE + 2, y: r * TILE + 2, w: 12, h: 12, collected: false });
    }
    state.tiresTotal = tires.length;
  }

  function spawnClouds() {
    clouds.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: 10 + Math.random() * 30,
        w: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
        speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGame() {
    player.x = 2 * TILE;
    player.y = (ROWS - 4) * TILE;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.facing = 1;
    player.walkFrame = 0;
    player.alive = true;
    state.score = 0;
    state.tires = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    state.frame = 0;
    spawnTires();
    spawnClouds();
  }

  resetGame();

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  const keys = {};
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space") {
      if (state.screen === "title") {
        state.screen = "play";
        resetGame();
      } else if (state.screen === "win" || state.screen === "lose") {
        state.screen = "title";
      }
    }
    // prevent scroll
    if (["ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","Space"].includes(e.code)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("keyup", function(e) {
    keys[e.code] = false;
  });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  const GRAVITY = 0.35;
  const JUMP_VEL = -6.5;
  const MOVE_SPEED = 1.8;
  const FRICTION = 0.85;

  function isSolid(c, r) {
    if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return true;
    const t = level[r][c];
    return t === 1 || t === 2;
  }

  function isWater(c, r) {
    if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return false;
    return level[r][c] === 3;
  }

  function update() {
    state.frame++;
    if (state.screen !== "play") return;

    state.time++;

    // cloud movement
    for (const cl of clouds) {
      cl.x += cl.speed;
      if (cl.x > W + cl.w) cl.x = -cl.w;
    }

    if (!player.alive) return;

    // horizontal input
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["KeyA"]) {
      player.vx = -MOVE_SPEED;
      player.facing = -1;
    } else if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["KeyD"]) {
      player.vx = MOVE_SPEED;
      player.facing = 1;
    } else {
      player.vx *= FRICTION;
      if (Math.abs(player.vx) < 0.1) player.vx = 0;
    }

    // jump
    if ((keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["KeyW"] || keys["Space"]) && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = JUMP_VEL;
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // gravity
    player.vy += GRAVITY;
    if (player.vy > 8) player.vy = 8;

    // move X
    player.x += player.vx;
    resolveX();

    // move Y
    player.y += player.vy;
    player.onGround = false;
    resolveY();

    // clamp to screen
    if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
    if (player.x > W - player.w) player.x = W - player.w;

    // walk animation
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.3 && player.onGround) {
      player.walkFrame += 0.15;
    } else {
      player.walkFrame = 0;
    }

    // check tire collection
    for (const t of tires) {
      if (t.collected) continue;
      if (player.x < t.x + t.w &&
          player.x + player.w > t.x &&
          player.y < t.y + t.h &&
          player.y + player.h > t.y) {
        t.collected = true;
        state.tires++;
        state.score += 100;
        if (state.tires >= state.tiresTotal) {
          state.screen = "win";
          state.score += 500;
        }
      }
    }

    // check water - fall in water = lose
    const pc = Math.floor((player.x + player.w / 2) / TILE);
    const pr = Math.floor((player.y + player.h / 2) / TILE);
    if (isWater(pc, pr)) {
      player.alive = false;
      state.screen = "lose";
    }

    // fall off bottom
    if (player.y > H) {
      player.alive = false;
      state.screen = "lose";
    }
  }

  function resolveX() {
    const left = Math.floor(player.x / TILE);
    const right = Math.floor((player.x + player.w - 1) / TILE);
    const top = Math.floor(player.y / TILE);
    const bottom = Math.floor((player.y + player.h - 1) / TILE);
    for (let r = top; r <= bottom; r++) {
      if (player.vx > 0 && isSolid(right, r)) {
        player.x = right * TILE - player.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
      if (player.vx < 0 && isSolid(left, r)) {
        player.x = (left + 1) * TILE;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  function resolveY() {
    const left = Math.floor(player.x / TILE);
    const right = Math.floor((player.x + player.w - 1) / TILE);
    const top = Math.floor(player.y / TILE);
    const bottom = Math.floor((player.y + player.h - 1) / TILE);
    for (let c = left; c <= right; c++) {
      if (player.vy > 0 && isSolid(c, bottom)) {
        player.y = bottom * TILE - player.h;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.onGround = true;
      }
      if (player.vy < 0 && isSolid(c, top)) {
        player.y = (top + 1) * TILE;
        player.vy = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawTile(c, r) {
    const x = c * TILE;
    const y = r * TILE;
    const t = level[r][c];
    if (t === 0) return;

    if (t === 1) {
      // ground - green top, brown below
      const isTopRow = (r === ROWS - 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = isTopRow ? COL.ground : COL.dirt;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      // texture dots
      if (isTopRow) {
        ctx.fillStyle = COL.lightGreen;
        ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 5, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 9, 2, 2);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = COL.brown;
        ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 3, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 8, 2, 2);
      }
    } else if (t === 2) {
      // rock
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.rock;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#5A6A7A";
      ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, 5, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 6, 4, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8898A8";
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 8, 3, 3);
    } else if (t === 3) {
      // water
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.water;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
      // wave lines
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4AB3FF";
      const waveOffset = Math.floor(state.frame / 20) % 2;
      ctx.fillRect(x + waveOffset, y + 3, 8, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 8 - waveOffset, y + 9, 6, 2);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // sky
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
    ctx.fillRect(W - 40, 15, 20, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFF176";
    ctx.fillRect(W - 38, 17, 16, 16);

    // clouds
    for (const cl of clouds) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
      const cx = Math.floor(cl.x);
      const cy = Math.floor(cl.y);
      ctx.fillRect(cx, cy + 4, cl.w, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(cx + 4, cy, cl.w - 8, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(cx + 2, cy + 2, cl.w - 4, 4);
    }

    // distant hills
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.darkGreen;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const hx = i * 70 + 10;
      const hy = ROWS * TILE - 60;
      ctx.fillRect(hx, hy, 50, 60);
      ctx.fillRect(hx + 10, hy - 15, 30, 15);
      ctx.fillRect(hx + 20, hy - 25, 15, 10);
    }
  }

  function drawTire(t) {
    if (t.collected) return;
    const x = Math.floor(t.x);
    const y = Math.floor(t.y);
    // outer
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, 12, 12);
    // inner
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 3, 6, 6);
    // center
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 5, 2, 2);
    // tread marks
    ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 1, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 9, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y + 9, 2, 2);
  }

  function drawBC() {
    const x = Math.floor(player.x);
    const y = Math.floor(player.y);
    const f = player.facing;
    const wf = player.walkFrame;
    const legOffset = Math.sin(wf * Math.PI) * 3;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y + player.h - 2, player.w + 2, 3);

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.brown;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 14, 3, 6 + (f === 1 ? legOffset : -legOffset));
    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y + 14, 3, 6 + (f === 1 ? -legOffset : legOffset));

    // body (loincloth)
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bc;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 8, 10, 7);

    // skin (torso)
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bcSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 4, 8, 5);

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bcSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y, 6, 6);

    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 1, 8, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y, 2, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 9, y, 2, 4);

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    if (f === 1) {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 2, 2, 2);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 2, 2, 2);
    }

    // mouth
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.red;
    ctx.fillRect(x + (f === 1 ? 6 : 4), y + 4, 2, 1);

    // club (in hand)
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.brown;
    const clubX = f === 1 ? x + 10 : x - 2;
    ctx.fillRect(clubX, y + 6, 3, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(clubX - 1, y + 4, 5, 4);
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.font = "bold 10px monospace";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + state.score, 4, 4);

    // tires
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.fillText("TIRES: " + state.tires + "/" + state.tiresTotal, W - 80, 4);

    // time
    const secs = Math.floor(state.time / 60);
    ctx.fillText("TIME: " + secs + "s", W - 80, 16);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    // background scene
    drawBackground();
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        drawTile(c, r);
      }
    }
    for (const t of tires) drawTire(t);

    // dark overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // title
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
    ctx.font = "bold 16px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("B.C.'s Quest", W / 2, 70);
    ctx.fillText("for Tires", W / 2, 90);

    ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
    ctx.font = "10px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Arrow keys / WASD to move", W / 2, 130);
    ctx.fillText("Up / W / Space to jump", W / 2, 145);
    ctx.fillText("Collect all tires to win!", W / 2, 160);
    ctx.fillText("Avoid the water!", W / 2, 175);

    // blinking prompt
    if (Math.floor(state.frame / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
      ctx.font = "bold 12px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO START", W / 2, 205);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawWin() {
    drawBackground();
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++)
        drawTile(c, r);
    for (const t of tires) drawTire(t);
    drawBC();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
    ctx.font = "bold 18px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
    ctx.font = "12px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("All tires collected!", W / 2, 110);
    ctx.fillText("Final Score: " + state.score, W / 2, 130);
    ctx.fillText("Time: " + Math.floor(state.time / 60) + "s", W / 2, 150);

    if (Math.floor(state.frame / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
      ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO CONTINUE", W / 2, 190);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawLose() {
    drawBackground();
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++)
        drawTile(c, r);
    for (const t of tires) drawTire(t);

    // draw BC fallen
    const x = Math.floor(player.x);
    const y = Math.floor(player.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bcSkin;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 10, 8, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bc;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 12, 10, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.black;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 8, 6, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.red;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 10, 2, 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = COL.red;
    ctx.font = "bold 18px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = COL.white;
    ctx.font = "12px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("BC fell in the water!", W / 2, 110);
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + state.score, W / 2, 130);
    ctx.fillText("Tires: " + state.tires + "/" + state.tiresTotal, W / 2, 150);

    if (Math.floor(state.frame / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COL.yellow;
      ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER TO RESTART", W / 2, 190);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (state.screen === "title") {
      drawTitle();
      return;
    }
    if (state.screen === "win") {
      drawWin();
      return;
    }
    if (state.screen === "lose") {
      drawLose();
      return;
    }

    // play screen
    drawBackground();
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        drawTile(c, r);
      }
    }
    for (const t of tires) drawTire(t);
    drawBC();
    drawHUD();
  }

  // ---------- GAME LOOP ----------
  function loop() {
    state.frame++;
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Elevator Action</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #05070f; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.2/dist/pixi.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ============================ STATE ============================
  const W = 960, H = 600;
  const GROUND = H - 56;
  const GRAV = 0.7, MOVE = 3.4, JUMP = -13.5, FIRE_CD = 11;

  const state = {
    scene: "start",
    score: 0,
    hi: 0,
    time: 0,
    shake: 0,
    player: {
      x: 120, y: GROUND, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      onGround: true, facing: 1, fireCd: 0,
      w: 28, h: 44, hurt: 0
    },
    bullets: [],
    enemies: [],
    parts: [],
    spawnTimer: 0,
    wave: 0,
    winTimer: 0
  };

  const keys = {};

  // ============================ PIXI SETUP ============================
  const app = new PIXI.Application({
    width: W, height: H,
    backgroundColor: 0x05070f,
    antialias: true,
    resolution: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2),
    autoDensity: true
  });
  document.getElementById("game").appendChild(app.view);

  function fit() {
    const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H);
    const c = app.view;
    c.style.width = (W * s) + "px";
    c.style.height = (H * s) + "px";
    c.style.position = "absolute";
    c.style.left = ((window.innerWidth - W * s) / 2) + "px";
    c.style.top = ((window.innerHeight - H * s) / 2) + "px";
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);
  fit();

  const world = new PIXI.Container();
  const bg = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const mid = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const ground = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const fx = new PIXI.Container();
  const hud = new PIXI.Container();
  const overlay = new PIXI.Container();

  world.addChild(bg, mid, ground, fx, hud);
  app.stage.addChild(world, overlay);

  // ============================ BACKGROUND (drawn once) ============================
  const skyline = [];
  (function buildSkyline() {
    let x = -20;
    while (x < W + 40) {
      const bw = 40 + Math.random() * 70;
      const bh = 90 + Math.random() * 220;
      skyline.push({ x, y: GROUND - bh, w: bw, h: bh,
        win: [] });
      // window lights
      for (let wy = 14; wy < bh - 10; wy += 18) {
        for (let wx = 8; wx < bw - 8; wx += 16) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.35) skyline[skyline.length - 1].win.push([wx, wy]);
        }
      }
      x += bw + 6;
    }
  })();

  function drawBackground() {
    // sky gradient
    bg.clear();
    const stops = [
      [0, 0x0a1024],
      [1, 0x14214a],
      [2, 0x2a3a6e],
      [3, 0x5a4a7e],
      [4, 0x9a5a6e],
      [5, 0xd97f5a],
      [6, 0xf2a868]
    ];
    const n = stops.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
      const y0 = (H * i) / n, y1 = (H * (i + 1)) / n;
      bg.beginFill(stops[i][1]).drawRect(0, y0, W, y1 - y0 + 1);
    }
    // stars
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 137) % W, sy = (i * 89) % (H * 0.4);
      bg.beginFill(0xffffff, 0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.15)
        .drawCircle(sx, sy, 0.6 + (i % 2) * 0.6).endFill();
    }
    // moon
    bg.beginFill(0xf4e6c0).drawCircle(W - 140, 90, 34).endFill();
    bg.beginFill(0xd9c79a, 0.5).drawCircle(W - 128, 82, 9).drawCircle(W - 150, 100, 6).endFill();
    // clouds
    bg.beginFill(0x3a4a80, 0.5);
    bg.drawRoundedRect(80, 150, 150, 26, 13);
    bg.drawRoundedRect(520, 110, 190, 24, 12);
    bg.drawRoundedRect(300, 210, 120, 20, 10);
    bg.endFill();
    // skyline
    for (const b of skyline) {
      bg.beginFill(0x0c1330).drawRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h).endFill();
      bg.beginFill(0x1a2547).drawRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, 8).endFill();
      for (const w of b.win) {
        bg.beginFill(0xffd27a, 0.85).drawRect(b.x + w[0], b.y + w[1], 6, 8).endFill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawMid() {
    mid.clear();
    // mid buildings (closer, darker, fewer windows)
    let x = -30;
    let seed = 7;
    function rnd() { seed = (seed * 9301 + 49297) % 233280; return seed / 233280; }
    while (x < W + 40) {
      const bw = 60 + rnd() * 80;
      const bh = 140 + rnd() * 180;
      const y = GROUND - bh;
      mid.beginFill(0x070b1c).drawRect(x, y, bw, bh).endFill();
      mid.beginFill(0x0f1730).drawRect(x, y, bw, 10).endFill();
      for (let wy = 20; wy < bh - 14; wy += 22) {
        for (let wx = 10; wx < bw - 10; wx += 20) {
          if (rnd() > 0.6) {
            mid.beginFill(rnd() > 0.5 ? 0xffb35a : 0x7fd0ff, 0.9)
              .drawRect(x + wx, y + wy, 7, 9).endFill();
          }
        }
      }
      x += bw + 8;
    }
  }

  function drawGround() {
    ground.clear();
    // ground base
    ground.beginFill(0x141a2e).drawRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND).endFill();
    ground.beginFill(0x232c48).drawRect(0, GROUND, W, 8).endFill();
    // street line
    ground.beginFill(0x3a4568).drawRect(0, GROUND + 30, W, 4).endFill();
    // crosswalk stripes
    ground.beginFill(0x556089);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) ground.drawRect(300 + i * 22, GROUND + 36, 12, 40);
    ground.endFill();
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawMid();
  drawGround();

  // ============================ PLAYER ============================
  const player = new PIXI.Container();
  const pBody = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const pLegs = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const pArm = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const pHead = new PIXI.Graphics();
  player.addChild(pLegs, pBody, pArm, pHead);
  fx.addChild(player);

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = state.player;
    const run = p.onGround && (Math.abs(p.vx) > 0.2) ? Math.sin(state.time * 0.4) : 0;
    // legs
    pLegs.clear();
    pLegs.beginFill(0x1f2a44);
    pLegs.drawRect(-10, 22, 8, 22 + run * 4);
    pLegs.drawRect(2, 22, 8, 22 - run * 4);
    pLegs.endFill();
    // boots
    pLegs.beginFill(0x0d1220);
    pLegs.drawRect(-12, 42 + run * 4, 12, 6);
    pLegs.drawRect(0, 42 - run * 4, 12, 6);
    pLegs.endFill();
    // body / jacket
    pBody.clear();
    pBody.beginFill(0x2f6df0).drawRoundedRect(-13, -8, 26, 32, 5).endFill();
    pBody.beginFill(0x1c47b0).drawRoundedRect(-13, 14, 26, 10, 4).endFill();
    // chest badge
    pBody.beginFill(0xffd27a).drawRoundedRect(p.facing > 0 ? 3 : -9, -2, 6, 8, 2).endFill();
    // shoulder
    pBody.beginFill(0x2456c8).drawRoundedRect(-13, -8, 26, 8, 4).endFill();
    // arm + gun
    pArm.clear();
    const ax = p.facing > 0 ? 8 : -14;
    pArm.beginFill(0x2f6df0).drawRoundedRect(ax, 0, 6, 16, 3).endFill();
    // gun
    pArm.beginFill(0x2b2f3a).drawRect(p.facing > 0 ? 12 : -22, 6, 10, 5).endFill();
    pArm.beginFill(0x11141c).drawRect(p.facing > 0 ? 20 : -22, 5, 4, 7).endFill();
    // head
    pHead.clear();
    pHead.beginFill(0xf2c79a).drawCircle(0, -16, 9).endFill();
    // cap
    pHead.beginFill(0x1c2a4a).drawRoundedRect(-10, -27, 20, 9, 4).endFill();
    pHead.beginFill(0x1c2a4a).drawRect(p.facing > 0 ? 0 : -12, -20, 12, 3).endFill();
    // eye
    pHead.beginFill(0x1a1a22).drawCircle(p.facing > 0 ? 4 : -4, -16, 1.6).endFill();
    if (p.hurt > 0) {
      pBody.alpha = 0.5;
    } else pBody.alpha = 1;
  }

  // ============================ ENEMIES ============================
  function makeEnemy(x, fromRight) {
    const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    const e = {
      x, y: GROUND, vy: 0, onGround: true,
      w: 30, h: 40, hp: 3, t: Math.random() * 100,
      fireCd: 30 + Math.random() * 40, g
    };
    drawEnemy(e);
    fx.addChild(g);
    state.enemies.push(e);
  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {
    const g = e.g;
    g.clear();
    const hop = e.onGround ? Math.abs(Math.sin(e.t * 0.25)) * 3 : 0;
    // legs
    g.beginFill(0x3a1010);
    g.drawRect(-10, 20, 8, 20 + hop);
    g.drawRect(2, 20, 8, 20 - hop);
    g.endFill();
    // body
    g.beginFill(0x7a1f2a).drawRoundedRect(-13, -8, 26, 30, 5).endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x5a121c).drawRoundedRect(-13, 12, 26, 8, 4).endFill();
    // spikes
    g.beginFill(0x2a0810);
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) g.drawPolygon([i * 8 - 4, -10, i * 8 + 4, -10, i * 8, -20]);
    g.endFill();
    // head
    g.beginFill(0xc98a5a).drawCircle(0, -14, 9).endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x2a0810).drawRoundedRect(-9, -24, 18, 8, 3).endFill();
    // angry eyes
    g.beginFill(0xffe06a).drawCircle(-3, -14, 2).drawCircle(3, -14, 2).endFill();
    // gun
    g.beginFill(0x2b2f3a).drawRect(-18, 4, 10, 5).endFill();
  }

  // ============================ BULLETS ============================
  function fireBullet(x, y, dir, color, isPlayer) {
    const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    g.beginFill(color).drawRoundedRect(-5, -2, 10, 4, 2).endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff, 0.8).drawRoundedRect(-2, -1, 4, 2, 1).endFill();
    g.x = x; g.y = y;
    fx.addChild(g);
    state.bullets.push({ x, y, vx: dir * 10, vy: 0, g, isPlayer, life: 120 });
  }

  // ============================ PARTICLES ============================
  function burst(x, y, color, n, spd) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
      const s = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
      g.beginFill(color, 0.9).drawCircle(0, 0, s).endFill();
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const v = (0.5 + Math.random()) * (spd || 4);
      g.x = x; g.y = y;
      fx.addChild(g);
      state.parts.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * v, vy: Math.sin(a) * v - 2, g, life: 20 + Math.random() * 20, max: 40 });
    }
  }

  // ============================ HUD ============================
  const scoreTxt = new PIXI.Text("SCORE 0", {
    fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 26, fill: 0xffd27a, fontWeight: "bold"
  });
  const hiTxt = new PIXI.Text("HI 0", {
    fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 18, fill: 0x8fb0ff
  });
  const waveTxt = new PIXI.Text("", {
    fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 18, fill: 0xff8a5a
  });
  const hpBarBg = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const hpBar = new PIXI.Graphics();
  hud.addChild(scoreTxt, hiTxt, waveTxt, hpBarBg, hpBar);

  function drawHud() {
    scoreTxt.text = "SCORE " + state.score;
    hiTxt.text = "HI " + state.hi;
    waveTxt.text = state.scene === "playing" ? "ENEMIES " + state.enemies.length : "";
    scoreTxt.x = 20; scoreTxt.y = 16;
    hiTxt.x = 20; hiTxt.y = 46;
    waveTxt.x = W - 20; waveTxt.y = 16; waveTxt.anchor.set(1, 0);
    // health bar
    hpBarBg.clear();
    hpBarBg.beginFill(0x000000, 0.5).drawRoundedRect(W / 2 - 120, 18, 240, 18, 9).endFill();
    const hp = Math.max(0, state.player.hp);
    hpBar.clear();
    hpBar.beginFill(hp > 4 ? 0x4fd07a : (hp > 2 ? 0xffd27a : 0xff5a4a))
      .drawRoundedRect(W / 2 - 116, 21, 232 * (hp / 8), 12, 6).endFill();
  }
  state.player.hp = 8;

  // ============================ OVERLAY (text screens) ============================
  function makeText(str, size, color, y, weight) {
    const t = new PIXI.Text(str, {
      fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: size, fill: color, fontWeight: weight || "bold"
    });
    t.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);
    t.x = W / 2; t.y = y;
    return t;
  }
  const titleT = makeText("ELEVATOR ACTION", 54, 0xffd27a, 150);
  const subT = makeText("a rooftop firefight", 22, 0x8fb0ff, 200, "normal");
  const startT = makeText("PRESS  [ SPACE ]  TO START", 26, 0xffffff, 300);
  const ctrlT = makeText("MOVE  A/D  or  ARROWS      JUMP  W / UP / SPACE      FIRE  SPACE", 18, 0x7a86b0, 360, "normal");
  const winT = makeText("YOU CLEARED THE ROOFTOP", 40, 0x4fd07a, 200);
  const loseT = makeText("YOU WERE OVERRUN", 40, 0xff5a4a, 200);
  const endScore = makeText("", 30, 0xffffff, 270);
  const againT = makeText("PRESS  [ SPACE ]  TO PLAY AGAIN", 24, 0xffffff, 340);

  const startGroup = new PIXI.Container();
  startGroup.addChild(titleT, subT, startT, ctrlT);
  const winGroup = new PIXI.Container();
  winGroup.addChild(winT, endScore, againT);
  const loseGroup = new PIXI.Container();
  loseGroup.addChild(loseT, endScore, againT);
  overlay.addChild(startGroup, winGroup, loseGroup);

  function showOverlay() {
    startGroup.visible = state.scene === "start";
    winGroup.visible = state.scene === "win";
    loseGroup.visible = state.scene === "lose";
  }

  // ============================ INPUT ============================
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if ([" ", "arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright"].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    if (state.scene === "start" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) {
      resetGame();
    } else if ((state.scene === "win" || state.scene === "lose") && (k === " " || k === "enter")) {
      resetGame();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  // ============================ GAME FLOW ============================
  function resetGame() {
    state.scene = "playing";
    state.score = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    state.spawnTimer = 60;
    state.wave = 0;
    state.winTimer = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    const p = state.player;
    p.x = 120; p.y = GROUND; p.vx = 0; p.vy = 0;
    p.onGround = true; p.facing = 1; p.fireCd = 0; p.hurt = 0; p.hp = 8;
    // clear old
    state.bullets.forEach(b => b.g.destroy());
    state.enemies.forEach(e => e.g.destroy());
    state.parts.forEach(pt => pt.g.destroy());
    state.bullets = []; state.enemies = []; state.parts = [];
    showOverlay();
  }

  function damagePlayer() {
    const p = state.player;
    if (p.hurt > 0) return;
    p.hp -= 1;
    p.hurt = 45;
    state.shake = 10;
    burst(p.x, p.y - 10, 0xff5a4a, 10, 5);
    if (p.hp <= 0) {
      state.scene = "lose";
      state.hi = Math.max(state.hi, state.score);
      endScore.text = "SCORE  " + state.score;
      showOverlay();
    }
  }

  // ============================ UPDATE ============================
  function update(dt) {
    if (state.scene !== "playing") return;
    state.time += dt;
    const p = state.player;

    // --- input / movement ---
    let move = 0;
    if (keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"]) move -= 1;
    if (keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"]) move += 1;
    p.vx = move * MOVE;
    if (move !== 0) p.facing = move;

    const wantJump = keys["w"] || keys["arrowup"];
    if (wantJump && p.onGround) {
      p.vy = JUMP;
      p.onGround = false;
      burst(p.x, p.y, 0x8fb0ff, 6, 3);
    }

    // gravity
    p.vy += GRAV;
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.y >= GROUND) {
      if (!p.onGround) burst(p.x, GROUND, 0x556089, 5, 3);
      p.y = GROUND; p.vy = 0; p.onGround = true;
    }
    p.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, p.x));
    if (p.fireCd > 0) p.fireCd -= dt;
    if (p.hurt > 0) p.hurt -= dt;

    // fire
    if ((keys[" "] || keys["j"]) && p.fireCd <= 0) {
      const bx = p.x + p.facing * 20;
      fireBullet(bx, p.y - 10, p.facing, 0xffe06a, true);
      p.fireCd = FIRE_CD;
      state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3);
      burst(bx, p.y - 10, 0xffe06a, 3, 2);
    }

    // --- spawn enemies ---
    state.spawnTimer -= dt;
    const maxEnemies = 4 + Math.floor(state.score / 150);
    if (state.spawnTimer <= 0 && state.enemies.length < Math.min(maxEnemies, 7)) {
      const fromRight = Math.random() > 0.5;
      makeEnemy(fromRight ? W + 30 : -30, fromRight);
      state.spawnTimer = Math.max(40, 110 - state.score * 0.05);
    }

    // --- enemies AI ---
    for (let i = state.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = state.enemies[i];
      e.t += dt;
      const dir = p.x > e.x ? 1 : -1;
      // approach player
      if (Math.abs(p.x - e.x) > 120) {
        e.x += dir * 1.4;
      } else {
        // keep a little distance, small jitter
        e.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
      }
      // fire at player
      e.fireCd -= dt;
      if (e.fireCd <= 0 && Math.abs(p.x - e.x) < 420) {
        fireBullet(e.x - dir * 18, e.y - 10, -dir, 0xff5a4a, false);
        e.fireCd = 55 + Math.random() * 45;
      }
      // collide with player
      if (Math.abs(p.x - e.x) < 26 && Math.abs((p.y - 22) - (e.y - 20)) < 40) {
        damagePlayer();
        e.x += dir * -10;
      }
      drawEnemy(e);
      e.g.x = e.x; e.g.y = e.y - 20;
    }

    // --- bullets ---
    for (let i = state.bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = state.bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx; b.life -= dt;
      b.g.x = b.x; b.g.y = b.y;
      let dead = b.life <= 0 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20;
      if (!dead && b.isPlayer) {
        for (let j = state.enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          const e = state.enemies[j];
          if (Math.abs(b.x - e.x) < 20 && Math.abs(b.y - (e.y - 20)) < 24) {
            e.hp -= 1;
            burst(b.x, b.y, 0xffe06a, 6, 4);
            dead = true;
            if (e.hp <= 0) {
              state.score += 50;
              state.wave += 1;
              state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 5);
              burst(e.x, e.y - 20, 0xff5a4a, 16, 6);
              burst(e.x, e.y - 20, 0xffd27a, 10, 5);
              e.g.destroy();
              state.enemies.splice(j, 1);
              // win check: cleared after enough kills
              if (state.wave >= 12) {
                state.scene = "win";
                state.hi = Math.max(state.hi, state.score);
                endScore.text = "SCORE  " + state.score;
                showOverlay();
              }
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      } else if (!dead && !b.isPlayer) {
        if (Math.abs(b.x - p.x) < 16 && Math.abs(b.y - (p.y - 22)) < 26) {
          damagePlayer();
          dead = true;
        }
      }
      if (dead) {
        b.g.destroy();
        state.bullets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // --- particles ---
    for (let i = state.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const pt = state.parts[i];
      pt.vy += 0.3;
      pt.x += pt.vx; pt.y += pt.vy;
      pt.life -= dt;
      pt.g.x = pt.x; pt.g.y = pt.y;
      pt.g.alpha = Math.max(0, pt.life / pt.max);
      if (pt.life <= 0 || pt.y > GROUND + 20) {
        pt.g.destroy();
        state.parts.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // player position
    player.x = p.x;
    player.y = p.y - 22;
    drawPlayer();
    drawHud();

    // shake
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      state.shake -= dt * 0.6;
      world.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
      world.y = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
    } else {
      world.x = 0; world.y = 0;
    }
  }

  // ============================ LOOP ============================
  app.ticker.add((dt) => {
    update(dt);
  });

  showOverlay();
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>TIE Fighter</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; background: #04060d; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Courier New", monospace;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh;
    image-rendering: auto;
    background: #04060d;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- CANVAS ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  const STATE = { TITLE: 0, PLAYING: 1, WIN: 2, LOSE: 3 };
  let state = STATE.TITLE;

  const GOAL = 10;          // kills to win
  const MAX_LIVES = 3;

  let player, enemies, bullets, enemyBullets, particles, stars, nebula;
  let score, kills, lives, time, shake, titlePulse;
  let fireCooldown = 0;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 1.4;

  function makeStars() {
    const arr = [];
    const n = 160;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      arr.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        z: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
        r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.3
      });
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function makeNebula() {
    const arr = [];
    const cols = ["#2a3a7a", "#5a2a6a", "#1a5a5a", "#3a2a7a", "#6a2a3a"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      arr.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        r: 220 + Math.random() * 260,
        c: cols[i % cols.length],
        a: 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.12,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05
      });
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function reset() {
    player = {
      x: W / 2, y: H * 0.82,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: 14,
      inv: 0,
      tilt: 0
    };
    enemies = [];
    bullets = [];
    enemyBullets = [];
    particles = [];
    stars = makeStars();
    nebula = makeNebula();
    score = 0; kills = 0; lives = MAX_LIVES;
    time = 0; shake = 0; titlePulse = 0;
    fireCooldown = 0;
    spawnTimer = 0.6;
    spawnInterval = 1.4;
  }

  function startGame() {
    reset();
    state = STATE.PLAYING;
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(e.key.toLowerCase()) || e.key === " ") {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (state === STATE.TITLE && (k === "enter" || k === " " || k === "p")) {
      startGame();
    } else if ((state === STATE.WIN || state === STATE.LOSE) && (k === "r" || k === "enter" || k === " " || k === "p")) {
      startGame();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -40 : W + 40;
    const y = rand(H * 0.08, H * 0.5);
    const speed = rand(90, 150) + Math.min(kills * 6, 120);
    const dir = fromLeft ? 1 : -1;
    enemies.push({
      x, y,
      vx: dir * speed,
      vy: rand(-20, 20),
      r: 18,
      hp: 1,
      fire: rand(0.6, 1.8),
      wob: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      wobAmp: rand(0, 40)
    });
  }

  function explode(x, y, color, big) {
    const n = big ? 34 : 16;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = rand(40, big ? 320 : 200);
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        life: rand(0.4, big ? 1.1 : 0.7),
        max: big ? 1.1 : 0.7,
        r: rand(1.5, big ? 4 : 3),
        c: color
      });
    }
    // flash
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, life: 0.2, max: 0.2, r: big ? 60 : 30, c: "#fff2c0", flash: true });
    shake = Math.max(shake, big ? 14 : 8);
  }

  function addScore(pts, x, y) {
    score += pts;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: 0, vy: -30, life: 0.9, max: 0.9, r: 0, c: "#ffd34d", text: "+" + pts, text: true });
  }

  function playerHit() {
    if (player.inv > 0) return;
    lives--;
    explode(player.x, player.y, "#8fd0ff", true);
    player.inv = 2.2;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = STATE.LOSE;
    } else {
      player.x = W / 2; player.y = H * 0.82;
      player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    titlePulse += dt;
    shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt); // decay
    if (shake < 0.2) shake = 0;

    // stars + nebula always drift
    for (const s of stars) {
      s.y += s.z * 12 * dt;
      if (s.y > H + 2) { s.y = -2; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
    }
    for (const nb of nebula) {
      nb.x += nb.vx * 60 * dt;
      nb.y += nb.vy * 60 * dt;
      if (nb.x < -nb.r) nb.x = W + nb.r;
      if (nb.x > W + nb.r) nb.x = -nb.r;
      if (nb.y < -nb.r) nb.y = H + nb.r;
      if (nb.y > H + nb.r) nb.y = -nb.r;
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      if (!p.flash) {
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
        p.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt);
        p.vy *= Math.pow(0.2, dt);
      }
    }

    if (state !== STATE.PLAYING) return;

    // ---- player ----
    const acc = 900;
    let ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) ax -= acc;
    if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) ax += acc;
    if (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) ay -= acc;
    if (keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) ay += acc;
    player.vx += ax * dt;
    player.vy += ay * dt;
    // friction
    player.vx *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    player.vy *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;
    player.tilt += ((player.vx / 400) - player.tilt) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
    // clamp
    player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(30, Math.min(H - 24, player.y));
    if (player.inv > 0) player.inv -= dt;

    // fire
    fireCooldown -= dt;
    if ((keys[" "] || keys["p"] || keys["z"]) && fireCooldown <= 0) {
      bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 18, vx: 0, vy: -620, r: 4 });
      fireCooldown = 0.16;
      // muzzle spark
      particles.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 20, vx: rand(-20,20), vy: -120, life: 0.15, max: 0.15, r: 5, c: "#fff0a0", flash: true });
    }

    // ---- spawn enemies ----
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
      // ramp difficulty
      spawnInterval = Math.max(0.55, spawnInterval - 0.02);
    }

    // ---- enemies ----
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      e.wob += dt * 2;
      e.y += Math.sin(e.wob) * e.wobAmp * dt;
      e.x += e.vx * dt;
      e.y += e.vy * dt;
      // remove if off screen
      if ((e.vx > 0 && e.x > W + 60) || (e.vx < 0 && e.x < -60)) {
        enemies.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // enemy fire
      e.fire -= dt;
      if (e.fire <= 0 && e.x > 30 && e.x < W - 30) {
        const dx = player.x - e.x, dy = player.y - e.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = 260;
        enemyBullets.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: dx / d * sp, vy: dy / d * sp, r: 4 });
        e.fire = rand(1.1, 2.4);
      }
    }

    // ---- player bullets ----
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt;
      if (b.y < -20 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20) { bullets.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      // hit enemy
      let hit = false;
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const e = enemies[j];
        if (dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y) < e.r + b.r) {
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
          explode(e.x, e.y, "#ff7a3c", true);
          kills++;
          addScore(100, e.x, e.y);
          hit = true;
          if (kills >= GOAL) { state = STATE.WIN; }
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hit) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // ---- enemy bullets ----
    for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt;
      if (b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20) { enemyBullets.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      if (dist(b.x, b.y, player.x, player.y) < player.r + b.r) {
        enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
        playerHit();
      }
    }

    // ---- enemy body collision ----
    for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = enemies[j];
      if (dist(e.x, e.y, player.x, player.y) < e.r + player.r) {
        enemies.splice(j, 1);
        explode(e.x, e.y, "#ff7a3c", true);
        playerHit();
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // deep space gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#05060f");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#0a0d22");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#04060d");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // nebula blobs
    for (const nb of nebula) {
      const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(nb.x, nb.y, 0, nb.x, nb.y, nb.r);
      rg.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(nb.c, nb.a));
      rg.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(nb.c, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle = rg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(nb.x, nb.y, nb.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + s.z * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = s.z > 0.7 ? "#ffffff" : "#cfe0ff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function hexToRgba(hex, a) {
    const h = hex.replace("#", "");
    const r = parseInt(h.substring(0, 2), 16);
    const g = parseInt(h.substring(2, 4), 16);
    const b = parseInt(h.substring(4, 6), 16);
    return "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + a + ")";
  }

  // ---- TIE Fighter (enemy) ----
  function drawTIE(x, y, facing) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    if (facing < 0) ctx.scale(-1, 1); // face travel direction
    // panels (hexagons)
    const panel = (cx, cy) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = Math.PI / 6 + i * Math.PI / 3;
        const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * 16;
        const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * 16;
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2f3a";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a6478";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
      // inner grid
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1c2029";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 12, cy + i * 6); ctx.lineTo(cx + 12, cy + i * 6); ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + i * 6, cy - 12); ctx.lineTo(cx + i * 6, cy + 12); ctx.stroke();
      }
    };
    panel(-30, -22);
    panel(-30, 22);
    // struts
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#454c5c";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, -22); ctx.lineTo(-2, -6); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18, 22); ctx.lineTo(-2, 6); ctx.stroke();
    // central sphere
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-4, -4, 2, 0, 0, 20);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "#3a4150");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "#1a1e28");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a6478"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    // cockpit windows
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0d14";
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(2, i * 7, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    // engine glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,180,255,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-16, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- X-Wing (player) ----
  function drawXWing(x, y, tilt) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(tilt);
    // wings (4)
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d8dde6";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a93a3";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    const wing = (sx, sy) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(sx * 26, sy * 30);
      ctx.lineTo(sx * 20, sy * 36);
      ctx.lineTo(sx * 4, sy * 8);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    };
    wing(-1, -1); wing(1, -1); wing(-1, 1); wing(1, 1);
    // laser cannons
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6b7488"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const sy of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx * 6, sy * 6); ctx.lineTo(sx * 24, sy * 32); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9d0dc";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -16); ctx.lineTo(8, 4); ctx.lineTo(0, 20); ctx.lineTo(-8, 4); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = "#20304a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -2, 4, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // engine glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,190,90,0.7)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 22, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullets() {
    // player bullets
    for (const b of bullets) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, 10);
      g.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
      g.addColorStop(0.4, "#ffe27a");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,180,60,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    // enemy bullets
    for (const b of enemyBullets) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, 10);
      g.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
      g.addColorStop(0.4, "#7ad0ff");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(80,160,255,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#dff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const t = p.life / p.max;
      if (p.flash) {
        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.r);
        g.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(p.c, t * 0.9));
        g.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(p.c, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      } else if (p.text) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = t;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
        ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Courier New', monospace";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      } else {
        ctx.globalAlpha = t;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * t + 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, 20, 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fd0ff";
    ctx.fillText("KILLS  " + kills + " / " + GOAL, 20, 60);
    // lives
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6a6a";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("SHIPS  ", W - 20, 34);
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8f6a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(W - 130 + i * 22, 28, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    drawBackground();
    // decorative TIE
    const t = Math.sin(titlePulse * 0.8) * 10;
    drawTIE(W * 0.5, H * 0.4 + t, 1);
    // title
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(64, W * 0.09) + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("TIE FIGHTER", W / 2, H * 0.62);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fd0ff";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Defeat " + GOAL + " Imperial TIE fighters to win.", W / 2, H * 0.68);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("ARROWS / WASD to move   •   SPACE to fire", W / 2, H * 0.74);
    const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
      ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  START", W / 2, H * 0.82);
    }
  }

  function drawEnd(won) {
    drawBackground();
    drawParticles();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? "#7affb0" : "#ff6a6a";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(56, W * 0.08) + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(won ? "VICTORY" : "DEFEAT", W / 2, H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Final Score  " + score, W / 2, H * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fd0ff";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Kills  " + kills + " / " + GOAL, W / 2, H * 0.55);
    const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS  R  TO  REPLAY", W / 2, H * 0.64);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (state === STATE.TITLE) {
      drawTitle();
      return;
    }
    if (state === STATE.WIN || state === STATE.LOSE) {
      drawEnd(state === STATE.WIN);
      return;
    }

    // playing
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawBullets();
    for (const e of enemies) drawTIE(e.x, e.y, e.vx >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
    if (player.inv <= 0 || Math.floor(time * 12) % 2 === 0) {
      drawXWing(player.x, player.y, player.tilt);
    }
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  reset();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<style>

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  var state = 'title';
  var player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: 100, mag: 100, atkCd: 0, hit: 0, swing: 0 };
  var cam = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  var enemies = [];
  var projectiles = [];
  var particles = [];
  var score = 0;
  var wave = 0;
  var spawnTimer = 0;
  var shake = 0;
  var time = 0;
  var keys = {};
  var mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, down: false };
  var stars = [];
  var titleAlpha = 0;
  var won = false;

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (state === 'title' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) startGame();
    if (state === 'over' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'r')) { state = 'title'; titleAlpha = 0; }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = e.clientX - r.left; mouse.y = e.clientY - r.top;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === 'title') startGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

  function startGame() {
    state = 'play';
    player = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: 100, mag: 100, atkCd: 0, hit: 0, swing: 0 };
    enemies = []; projectiles = []; particles = [];
    score = 0; wave = 0; spawnTimer = 0.6; shake = 0; won = false;
    cam.x = player.x; cam.y = player.y;

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    var side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
    var x, y;
    if (side === 0) { x = player.x - W * 0.6; y = player.y + rand(-H * 0.5, H * 0.5); }
    else if (side === 1) { x = player.x + W * 0.6; y = player.y + rand(-H * 0.5, H * 0.5); }
    else if (side === 2) { x = player.x + rand(-W * 0.5, W * 0.5); y = player.y - H * 0.6; }
    else { x = player.x + rand(-W * 0.5, W * 0.5); y = player.y + H * 0.6; }
    var boss = (wave >= 5 && Math.random() < 0.25);
    enemies.push({
      x: x, y: y, hp: boss ? 90 : 34, max: boss ? 90 : 34,
      r: boss ? 34 : 22, speed: boss ? 55 : rand(70, 110),
      boss: boss, wob: rand(0, 6.28), hit: 0, dmg: boss ? 22 : 10
    });
  }

  function addParticles(x, y, color, n, spd) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = rand(0, 6.28), s = rand(0.3, 1) * spd;
      particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: rand(0.4, 1), max: 1, color: color, r: rand(2, 5) });
    }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (state !== 'play') { titleAlpha = Math.min(1, titleAlpha + dt * 0.8); return; }

    // player movement
    var ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) ay -= 1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) ay += 1;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) ax -= 1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) ax += 1;
    var m = Math.hypot(ax, ay) || 1;
    var speed = 240;

    player.vy += (ay / m) * speed * dt * 8;

    player.x += player.vx * dt; player.y += player.vy * dt;
    player.mag = clamp(player.mag + dt * 8, 0, 100);
    if (player.atkCd > 0) player.atkCd -= dt;
    if (player.hit > 0) player.hit -= dt;
    if (player.swing > 0) player.swing -= dt;

    // camera
    cam.x += (player.x - cam.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
    cam.y += (player.y - cam.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);

    // attack
    if (mouse.down && player.atkCd <= 0) {
      player.atkCd = 0.35; player.swing = 0.25;
      var dx = mouse.x - W / 2, dy = mouse.y - H / 2;

        var e = enemies[i];
        var ex = e.x - player.x, ey = e.y - player.y;

        player.mag -= 18;

          vy: Math.sin(aim) * 520, life: 2, r: 9 });

    for (var p = projectiles.length - 1; p >= 0; p--) {

      for (var q = enemies.length - 1; q >= 0; q--) {

    for (var k = enemies.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {

      if (e2.hit > 0) e2.hit -= dt;
      var ddx = player.x - e2.x, ddy = player.y - e2.y;
      var dd = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy) || 1;
      e2.x += (ddx / dd) * e2.speed * dt;
      e2.y += (ddy / dd) * e2.speed * dt;

      }
    }

    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {

      for (var s = 0; s < count; s++) spawnEnemy();

    }

    // particles
