    let fogY = 200 + i * 80 + Math.sin(state.ambient + i) * 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(30, 20, 50, ${0.1 + i * 0.05})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, fogY, 800, 40);
  }

  // The Black Gate
  let gx = 320, gy = 100, gw = 160, gh = 250;
  // Gate frame
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1020';
  ctx.fillRect(gx - 10, gy - 10, gw + 20, gh + 20);
  // Gate inner
  let grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx + gw/2, gy + gh/2, 10, gx + gw/2, gy + gh/2, 100);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#2a0a3a');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#050510');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, gw, gh);

  // Gate glow
  let glow = 0.3 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 2) * 0.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 50, 200, ${glow})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(gx, gy, gw, gh);

  // Gate runes
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 80, 255, ${glow + 0.2})`;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    let rx = gx + 20 + (i % 3) * 50;
    let ry = gy + 30 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 80;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rx, ry, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Title text
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a844';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('ULTIMA VII', 400, 420);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6a3a';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('THE BLACK GATE', 400, 455);

  // Prompt
  let promptAlpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 3) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 180, 120, ${promptAlpha})`;
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO BEGIN', 400, 530);

  // Decorative ground
  ctx.fillStyle = '#12101a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 500, 800, 100);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0e0c14';
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    ctx.fillRect(i * 40, 510 + Math.sin(i * 0.5) * 5, 35, 80);
  }
}

function drawScene() {
  // Sky / background
  let skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 600);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0818');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#1a1030');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#0f0d1a');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#080610');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#151225';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 200);
  for (let x = 0; x <= 800; x += 40) {
    ctx.lineTo(x, 160 + Math.sin(x * 0.01 + 1) * 30 + Math.cos(x * 0.02) * 15);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(800, 200);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Ground
  let groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 300, 0, 600);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1520');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0810');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 300, 800, 300);

  // Ground texture - cracks and stones
  ctx.fillStyle = '#221a2a';
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    let sx = (i * 53 + 20) % 800;
    let sy = 320 + (i * 37) % 250;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, 8 + (i % 5) * 3, 4 + (i % 3) * 2, i * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // The Black Gate
  drawGate();

  // Crystals
  for (let c of state.crystals) {
    if (c.collected) continue;
    let pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(c.pulse) * 0.3;
    // Glow
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(68, 255, 170, ${pulse * 0.2})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Crystal shape
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(68, 255, 170, ${pulse + 0.3})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y - 15);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + 8, c.y);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y + 15);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x - 8, c.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Inner highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 255, 230, ${pulse * 0.5})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y - 8);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + 4, c.y);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x - 4, c.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Enemies (dark spirits)
  for (let e of state.enemies) {
    let flicker = 0.4 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 4 + e.x) * 0.2;
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${e.hue}, 60%, 25%, ${flicker})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, e.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${e.hue + 20}, 80%, 50%, ${flicker + 0.3})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x - 5, e.y - 3, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x + 5, e.y - 3, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Wispy trail
    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${e.hue}, 50%, 30%, ${flicker * 0.5})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y + e.size);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(e.x + Math.sin(state.ambient * 3) * 10, e.y + e.size + 15, e.x - 5, e.y + e.size + 25);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Player (Avatar)
  drawPlayer();

  // Particles
  for (let p of state.particles) {
    let alpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Dark mist overlay
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(5, 5, 15, ${state.darkMist * 0.3})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
}

function drawGate() {
  let gx = state.gateX - state.gateWidth / 2;
  let gy = state.gateY;
  let gw = state.gateWidth;
  let gh = state.gateHeight;

  // Gate outer frame
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1025';
  ctx.fillRect(gx - 15, gy - 15, gw + 30, gh + 30);

  // Gate pillars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a35';
  ctx.fillRect(gx - 15, gy - 15, 15, gh + 30);
  ctx.fillRect(gx + gw, gy - 15, 15, gh + 30);

  // Gate lintel
  ctx.fillRect(gx - 15, gy - 15, gw + 30, 15);

  // Gate interior
  let gateGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx + gw/2, gy + gh/2, 5, gx + gw/2, gy + gh/2, gw/2);
  if (state.blackGateOpen) {
    let progress = state.gateProgress;
    gateGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${100 + progress * 155}, ${50 + progress * 100}, ${200 + progress * 55}, ${0.5 + progress * 0.5})`);
    gateGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${20 + progress * 50}, ${10 + progress * 30}, ${50 + progress * 80}, 0.8)`);
  } else {
    gateGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a30');
    gateGrad.addColorStop(1, '#050510');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = gateGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, gw, gh);

  // Gate runes
  let runeAlpha = state.blackGateOpen ? 0.8 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 5) * 0.2 : 0.3 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 2) * 0.15;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(150, 80, 255, ${runeAlpha})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    let rx = gx + 15 + (i % 4) * 25;
    let ry = gy + 20 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 60;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(rx, ry - 6);
    ctx.lineTo(rx + 5, ry);
    ctx.lineTo(rx, ry + 6);
    ctx.lineTo(rx - 5, ry);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Gate glow when open
  if (state.blackGateOpen) {
    let glowAlpha = state.gateProgress * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${glowAlpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(gx + gw/2, gy + gh/2, gw * (0.5 + state.gateProgress * 0.5), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  let p = state.player;
  if (p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(p.invuln * 10) % 2 === 0) return;

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y + 18, 12, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body (robe)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a4a6a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.x - 10, p.y + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x - 8, p.y - 5);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + 8, p.y - 5);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + 10, p.y + 15);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a878';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - 12, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Hood
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a5a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - 14, 8, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Staff
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a6a3a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.x + 12, p.y + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(p.x + 15, p.y - 20);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Staff crystal
  let staffGlow = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 4) * 0.3;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${staffGlow})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x + 15, p.y - 22, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Staff glow
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${staffGlow * 0.2})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x + 15, p.y - 22, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Top bar
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 8, 20, 0.8)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 40);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a844';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, 15, 26);

  // Crystals collected
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44ffaa';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`CRYSTALS: ${state.collected}/${state.crystalCount}`, 400, 26);

  // Timer
  let timeColor = state.timer < 20 ? '#ff4444' : '#aabbcc';
  ctx.fillStyle = timeColor;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`TIME: ${Math.ceil(state.timer)}s`, 785, 26);

  // Gate status
  if (state.blackGateOpen) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${0.7 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 5) * 0.3})`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('THE BLACK GATE OPENS...', 400, 55);
  }
}

function drawWin() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 5, 20, 0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#44ffaa';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('THE BLACK GATE IS OPENED', 400, 250);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a844';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`FINAL SCORE: ${state.score}`, 400, 310);

  let alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 3) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 180, 120, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RETURN', 400, 400);
}

function drawLose() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 5, 5, 0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('THE DARKNESS CONSUMED YOU', 400, 250);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a844';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, 400, 310);

  let alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.ambient * 3) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 180, 120, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RETURN', 400, 400);
}

// ===== GAME LOOP =====
let lastTime = 0;

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  let dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
  if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  }

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
/* ============================== STATE ============================== */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W = 0, H = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0;
let running = false, started = false, gameOver = false, win = false;
let score = 0, lives = 3;

const SIDES = 6;
const LEVELS = 5;
const RING_STEP = 0.09;
const BASE_R = 0.22;
const TILT = 0.62;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

let shipAngle = 0;
let player = { alive: true, respawn: 0, invuln: 0, ring: 0, side: 0, pos: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 } };
let enemies = [];
let bullets = [];
let enemyShots = [];
let particles = [];
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 0.9;
let currentLevel = 0;
let levelIntro = 0;
let time = 0;
let shake = 0;

const keys = { left: false, right: false, fire: false };

/* ============================== HELPERS ============================== */
function ringRadius(r) { return BASE_R + r * RING_STEP; }
function sideCenter(r, s) {
  const a = (s + 0.5) * TAU / SIDES;
  const R = ringRadius(r);
  return { x: Math.cos(a) * R, y: Math.sin(a) * R, z: 0 };
}
function project(x, y, z) {
  const z1 = z + 1;
  const px = cx + (x / z1) * W * 0.5;
  const py = cy + (y / z1) * H * 0.5;
  const s = W * 0.5 / z1;
  return { x: px, y: py, scale: s };
}
function sideMidpoint(r, s) {
  const a1 = (s + 0.5) * TAU / SIDES;
  const a2 = ((s + 1.5) % SIDES) * TAU / SIDES;
  const R = ringRadius(r);
  const mx = (Math.cos(a1) + Math.cos(a2)) / 2 * R;
  const my = (Math.sin(a1) + Math.sin(a2)) / 2 * R;
  return { x: mx, y: my, z: 0 };
}
function enemyTarget(e) {
  const R = ringRadius(e.ring);
  const a = (e.side + 0.5) * TAU / SIDES;
  return { x: Math.cos(a) * R, y: Math.sin(a) * R, z: 0 };
}
function spawnParticles(x, y, z, color, n, spread) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * TAU;
    const sp = (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2) * spread;
    particles.push({
      x, y, z,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp, vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread,
      life: 1, color
    });
  }
}
function spawnEnemy(ring, side) {
  const c = sideCenter(ring, side);
  enemies.push({
    x: c.x, y: c.y, z: c.z,
    vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0,
    ring, side,
    hp: 1,
    fireTimer: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
    moveTimer: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
    moving: false,
    color: '#ff5a3c'
  });
}

/* ============================== INPUT ============================== */
function handleKey(e, down) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { keys.left = down; if (down) e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { keys.right = down; if (down) e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (k === ' ' || k === 'spacebar') { keys.fire = down; if (down) e.preventDefault(); }
  else if (k === 'enter') { if (down && !started) startGame(); }
  else if (k === 'r') { if (down && (gameOver || win)) startGame(); }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => handleKey(e, true));
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => handleKey(e, false));
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!started) startGame(); });

function startGame() {
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  enemies = []; bullets = []; enemyShots = []; particles = [];
  currentLevel = 0;
  levelIntro = 2.0;
  spawnTimer = 0;
  player.alive = true;
  player.respawn = 0;
  player.invuln = 2.0;
  player.ring = 0; player.side = 0;
  shipAngle = 0;
  gameOver = false; win = false;
  started = true;
  running = true;
  spawnInterval = 0.9;
}

/* ============================== UPDATE ============================== */
function updatePlayer(dt) {
  if (!player.alive) {
    player.respawn -= dt;
    if (player.respawn <= 0) {
      player.alive = true;
      player.invuln = 2.0;
      player.ring = 0; player.side = 0;
      const c = sideCenter(0, 0);
      player.pos = { x: c.x, y: c.y, z: c.z };
    }
    return;
  }
  player.invuln = Math.max(0, player.invuln - dt);
  if (keys.left) { player.side = (player.side + SIDES - 1) % SIDES; }
  if (keys.right) { player.side = (player.side + 1) % SIDES; }
  if (keys.fire && player.invuln <= 0.0) {
    const c = sideCenter(player.ring, player.side);
    const t = enemyTarget({ ring: player.ring, side: player.side });
    const dx = t.x - c.x, dy = t.y - c.y, dz = t.z - c.z;
    const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) || 1;
    bullets.push({ x: c.x, y: c.y, z: c.z, vx: dx/len, vy: dy/len, vz: dz/len, life: 1.5 });
    keys.fire = false;
  }
  const c = sideCenter(player.ring, player.side);
  player.pos = c;
}

function updateEnemies(dt) {
  for (const e of enemies) {
    const t = enemyTarget(e);
    const dx = t.x - e.x, dy = t.y - e.y, dz = t.z - e.z;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
    if (dist > 0.005) {
      e.x += dx / dist * 0.5 * dt;
      e.y += dy / dist * 0.5 * dt;
      e.z += dz / dist * 0.5 * dt;
    }
    e.moveTimer -= dt;
    if (e.moveTimer <= 0) {
      if (e.moving) {
        e.moving = false;
        e.moveTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;
      } else {
        e.moving = true;
        const nr = (Math.random() < 0.5) ? (e.ring + 1) : (e.ring - 1);
        const ns = (Math.random() < 0.5) ? (e.side + 1) % SIDES : (e.side + SIDES - 1) % SIDES;
        if (nr >= 0 && nr < LEVELS) e.ring = nr;
        e.side = ns;
        e.moveTimer = 0.6;
      }
    }
    e.fireTimer -= dt;
    if (e.fireTimer <= 0 && player.alive) {
      const px = player.pos.x, py = player.pos.y, pz = player.pos.z;
      const dx = px - e.x, dy = py - e.y, dz = pz - e.z;
      const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz) || 1;
      enemyShots.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, z: e.z, vx: dx/len, vy: dy/len, vz: dz/len, life: 3.0 });
      e.fireTimer = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5;
    }
  }
}

function updateBullets(dt) {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    b.x += b.vx * dt * 3.0;
    b.y += b.vy * dt * 3.0;
    b.z += b.vz * dt * 3.0;
    b.life -= dt;
  }
  bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.life > 0);
}
function updateEnemyShots(dt) {
  for (const s of enemyShots) {
    s.x += s.vx * dt * 2.0;
    s.y += s.vy * dt * 2.0;
    s.z += s.vz * dt * 2.0;
    s.life -= dt;
  }
  enemyShots = enemyShots.filter(s => s.life > 0);
}

function dist2(a, b) {
  const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y, dz = a.z - b.z;
  return dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz;
}

function checkCollisions() {
  // bullets vs enemies
  for (const b of bullets) {
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (dist2(b, e) < 0.0016) {
        e.hp -= 1;
        b.life = 0;
        spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, e.z, e.color, 8, 0.4);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          score += 100;
          spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, e.z, '#ffffff', 14, 0.6);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0);

  // enemy shots vs player
  if (player.alive && player.invuln <= 0) {
    for (const s of enemyShots) {
      if (dist2(s, player.pos) < 0.0012) {
        s.life = 0;
        killPlayer();
        break;
      }
    }
    // enemy body vs player
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (dist2(e, player.pos) < 0.0016) {
        killPlayer();
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

function killPlayer() {
  player.alive = false;
  player.respawn = 2.0;
  lives -= 1;
  shake = 0.5;
  spawnParticles(player.pos.x, player.pos.y, player.pos.z, '#33e0ff', 20, 0.8);
  if (lives <= 0) {
    gameOver = true;
    running = false;
  }
}

function updateSpawner(dt) {
  if (levelIntro > 0) { levelIntro -= dt; return; }
  const maxEnemies = 6 + currentLevel * 3;
  if (enemies.length < maxEnemies) {
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      const ring = Math.floor(Math.random() * (currentLevel + 1));
      const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * SIDES);
      spawnEnemy(ring, side);
      spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
    }
  }
}

function checkWin() {
  if (enemies.length === 0 && levelIntro <= 0) {
    currentLevel += 1;
    if (currentLevel >= LEVELS) {
      win = true;
      running = false;
    } else {
      levelIntro = 2.0;
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnInterval = Math.max(0.4, 0.9 - currentLevel * 0.1);
    }
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.z += p.vz * dt;
    p.life -= dt * 1.2;
  }
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  if (!running) return;
  updateSpawner(dt);
  updatePlayer(dt);
  updateEnemies(dt);
  updateBullets(dt);
  updateEnemyShots(dt);
  checkCollisions();
  updateParticles(dt);
  checkWin();
}

/* ============================== DRAW ============================== */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1a0533');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0220');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#000000');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const sx = (Math.sin(i * 127.1) * 0.5 + 0.5) * W;
    const sy = (Math.cos(i * 311.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * H;
    const tw = (Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5);
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.7;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawTempest() {
  const lines = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < LEVELS; r++) {
    for (let s = 0; s < SIDES; s++) {
      const a1 = (s + 0.5) * TAU / SIDES;
      const a2 = ((s + 1.5) % SIDES) * TAU / SIDES;
      const R = ringRadius(r);
      const p1 = project(Math.cos(a1) * R, Math.sin(a1) * R, 0);
      const p2 = project(Math.cos(a2) * R, Math.sin(a2) * R, 0);
      lines.push({ p1, p2, r, s, type: 'side' });
      // ring edges
      const b1 = project(Math.cos(a1) * R, Math.sin(a1) * R, 0);
      const b2 = project(Math.cos(a1) * ringRadius(r+1), Math.sin(a1) * ringRadius(r+1), 0);
      if (r < LEVELS - 1) lines.push({ p1: b1, p2: b2, r, s, type: 'radial' });
    }
  }
  for (const L of lines) {
    const z1 = 1; // depth from ring index
    const depth = 1 - (L.r / LEVELS) * 0.6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(120, 200, 255, ${0.35 * depth})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, 2.5 * depth);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(L.p1.x, L.p1.y);
    ctx.lineTo(L.p2.x, L.p2.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawEnemies() {
  for (const e of enemies) {
    const p = project(e.x, e.y, e.z);
    const size = 14 * p.scale * 0.06;
    const pulse = Math.sin(time * 4 + e.side) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate(time * 0.5 + e.side);
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    // diamond shape
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -size);
    ctx.lineTo(size * 0.7, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, size);
    ctx.lineTo(-size * 0.7, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, size * 0.25, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    const p = project(b.x, b.y, b.z);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33e0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, Math.max(2, 5 * p.scale * 0.05), 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  for (const s of enemyShots) {
    const p = project(s.x, s.y, s.z);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3355';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, Math.max(2, 4 * p.scale * 0.05), 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (!player.alive) return;
  const p = project(player.pos.x, player.pos.y, player.pos.z);
  const size = Math.max(10, 20 * p.scale * 0.05);
  if (player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(time * 10) % 2 === 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33e0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -size);
  ctx.lineTo(size * 0.8, size * 0.6);
  ctx.lineTo(0, size * 0.3);
  ctx.lineTo(-size * 0.8, size * 0.6);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -size * 0.2, size * 0.2, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const pr = project(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(pr.x - 2, pr.y - 2, 4, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33e0ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 20, 36);
  ctx.fillText('LEVEL ' + (currentLevel + 1) + '/' + LEVELS, 20, 64);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + lives, W - 20, 36);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('← → MOVE   SPACE FIRE', W/2, H - 20);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33e0ff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('TEMPEST 2000', W/2, H/2 - 60);
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or CLICK to start', W/2, H/2 + 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('← → to move between sides · SPACE to fire', W/2, H/2 + 44);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3355';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Press R to restart', W/2, H/2 + 50);
}

function drawWin() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33ff88';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('All levels cleared! Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Press R to play again', W/2, H/2 + 50);
}

function drawLevelIntro() {
  if (levelIntro > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(51,224,255,0.8)';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('LEVEL ' + (currentLevel + 1), W/2, H/2);
  }
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 20, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 20);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawTempest();
  drawEnemies();
  drawBullets();
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();
  if (started) drawHUD();
  if (!started) drawStartScreen();
  if (gameOver) drawGameOver();
  if (win) drawWin();
  if (levelIntro > 0 && started) drawLevelIntro();
}

/* ============================== RESIZE + LOOP ============================== */
function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  cx = W / 2;
  cy = H / 2;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  car.y = H / 2;
  car.angle = 0;
  car.speed = 0;
  score = 0;
  time = 0;
  crashTimer = 0;
  particles = [];
  spawnObstacles();
}

function update() {
  if (STATE.menu === STATE.menu) {
    return;
  }
  if (STATE.menu === STATE.gameover) {
    return;
  }

  time++;

  if (crashTimer > 0) {
    crashTimer--;
    if (crashTimer === 0) {
      STATE.menu = STATE.gameover;
      if (score > highScore) highScore = score;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (keys.up) {
    car.speed += car.accel;
  } else if (keys.down) {
    car.speed -= car.accel * 0.7;
  } else {
    car.speed *= car.friction;
  }

  if (car.speed > car.maxSpeed) car.speed = car.maxSpeed;
  if (car.speed < -car.maxSpeed * 0.5) car.speed = -car.maxSpeed * 0.5;

  const turnFactor = Math.min(Math.abs(car.speed) / car.maxSpeed, 1);
  if (keys.left) {
    car.angle -= car.turnSpeed * turnFactor;
  }
  if (keys.right) {
    car.angle += car.turnSpeed * turnFactor;
  }

  car.x += Math.cos(car.angle) * car.speed;
  car.y += Math.sin(car.angle) * car.speed;

  if (car.x < 0) { car.x = W; }
  if (car.x > W) { car.x = 0; }
  if (car.y < 0) { car.y = H; }
  if (car.y > H) { car.y = 0; }

  for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
    const o = obstacles[i];
    o.x += o.vx;
    o.y += o.vy;
    o.rotation += o.rotSpeed;

    if (o.x < -100) o.x = W + 50;
    if (o.x > W + 100) o.x = -50;
    if (o.y < -100) o.y = H + 50;
    if (o.y > H + 100) o.y = -50;

    if (checkCollision(car.x, car.y, o.x, o.y, o.size)) {
      crashTimer = CRASH_TIME;
      explode(car.x, car.y, o.color);
      explode(car.x, car.y, "#ff4500");
      explode(car.x, car.y, "#ffff00");
      car.speed = 0;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (time % 10 === 0) {
    score++;
  }

  const speed = Math.abs(car.speed);
  if (speed > 2) {
    const bx = car.x - Math.cos(car.angle) * car.w / 2;
    const by = car.y - Math.sin(car.angle) * car.w / 2;
    createParticle(bx, by, "#555");
  }

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.95;
    p.vy *= 0.95;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#1a0e2e");
  grad.addColorStop(0.3, "#2d1b4e");
  grad.addColorStop(0.6, "#4a2060");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#6b2fa0");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + time * 0.3) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89) % H;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 100, 200, 0.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const y = (i * 90 + time * 0.5) % H;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const x = (i * 110 + time * 0.3) % W;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H, 0, W / 2, H, H * 0.8);
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 50, 100, 0.06)");
  glowGrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 50, 100, 0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawObstacle(o) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(o.x, o.y);
  ctx.rotate(o.rotation);

  ctx.shadowColor = o.color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 15;

  if (o.type === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = o.size;
    ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.8, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, s);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.8, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.4, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.4, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (o.type === 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
    const s = o.size;
    ctx.fillRect(-s, -s, s * 2, s * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.6, -s * 0.6, s * 1.2, s * 1.2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(-s, -s, s * 2, s * 2);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = o.size;
    const sides = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * s;
      const py = Math.sin(a) * s;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * s * 0.5;
      const py = Math.sin(a) * s * 0.5;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCar() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(car.x, car.y);
  ctx.rotate(car.angle);

  ctx.shadowColor = "#ff4444";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#cc2222";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-car.w / 2, -car.h / 2, car.w, car.h, 5);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5555";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-car.w / 2 + 4, -car.h / 2 + 3, car.w - 8, car.h - 6, 3);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-car.w / 2 + 6, -car.h / 2 + 5, car.w * 0.35, car.h - 10, 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#87ceeb";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-car.w / 2 + 8, -car.h / 2 + 6, car.w * 0.3, car.h - 12, 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(car.w / 2 - car.w * 0.3 - 4, -car.h / 2 + 5, car.w * 0.25, car.h - 10, 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#87ceeb";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(car.w / 2 - car.w * 0.3 - 2, -car.h / 2 + 6, car.w * 0.2, car.h - 12, 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffdd00";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(car.w / 2, -car.h / 2 + 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(car.w / 2, car.h / 2 - 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3333";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-car.w / 2, -car.h / 2 + 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-car.w / 2, car.h / 2 - 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  if (Math.abs(car.speed) > 3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 200, 50, 0.4)";
    const trailLen = Math.abs(car.speed) * 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-car.w / 2, -car.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-car.w / 2 - trailLen, -car.h / 2 - car.h / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(-car.w / 2 - trailLen, car.h / 2 + car.h / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(-car.w / 2, car.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(15, 15, 200, 50, 10);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff66aa";
  ctx.font = "bold 14px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE", 30, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText(String(score), 30, 58);

  const speedPct = Math.abs(car.speed) / car.maxSpeed;
  const barW = 150;
  const barH = 12;
  const barX = 15;
  const barY = 75;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW + 20, barH + 10, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX + 10, barY + 5, barW, barH, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  const speedColor = speedPct > 0.7 ? "#ff4444" : speedPct > 0.4 ? "#ffaa00" : "#44ff44";
  ctx.fillStyle = speedColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX + 10, barY + 5, barW * speedPct, barH, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "10px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("SPEED", barX + barW + 15, barY + 14);

  if (crashTimer > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.font = "bold 48px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("CRASHED!", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.font = "24px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
    ctx.fillText("Game Over", W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMenu() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4488";
  ctx.font = "bold 64px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("PARADISE RUSH", W / 2, 200);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa44";
  ctx.font = "24px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("A high-speed arcade racing game", W / 2, 250);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Use Arrow Keys to drive", W / 2, 330);
  ctx.fillText("Dodge the obstacles to survive", W / 2, 365);
  ctx.fillText("The longer you last, the higher your score", W / 2, 400);

  if (highScore > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffdd00";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
    ctx.fillText("High Score: " + highScore, W / 2, 450);
  }

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 100, 150, " + pulse + ")";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Press ENTER to Start", W / 2, 530);

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
  ctx.font = "bold 56px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, 220);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 36px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, 300);

  if (score >= highScore && score > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffdd00";
    ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
    ctx.fillText("NEW HIGH SCORE!", W / 2, 350);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#aaa";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
    ctx.fillText("High Score: " + highScore, W / 2, 350);
  }

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(100, 255, 100, " + pulse + ")";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Segoe UI', Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Press ENTER to Play Again", W / 2, 440);

  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawBackground();

  for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
    drawObstacle(obstacles[i]);
  }

  drawCar();
  drawParticles();

  if (STATE.menu === STATE.playing) {
    drawHUD();
  } else if (STATE.menu === STATE.menu) {
    drawMenu();
  } else if (STATE.menu === STATE.gameover) {
    drawHUD();
    drawGameOver();
  }
}

function gameLoop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
  switch (e.key) {
    case "ArrowUp": case "w": case "W":
      keys.up = true;
      if (STATE.menu === STATE.menu) {
        STATE.menu = STATE.playing;
        resetGame();
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case "ArrowDown": case "s": case "S":
      keys.down = true;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case "ArrowLeft": case "a": case "A":
      keys.left = true;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case "ArrowRight": case "d": case "D":
      keys.right = true;
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
    case "Enter":
      if (STATE.menu === STATE.menu || STATE.menu === STATE.gameover) {
        STATE.menu = STATE.playing;
        resetGame();
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      break;
  }
});

document.addEventListener("keyup", function(e) {
  switch (e.key) {
    case "ArrowUp": case "w": case "W":
      keys.up = false;
      break;
    case "ArrowDown": case "s": case "S":
      keys.down = false;
      break;
    case "ArrowLeft": case "a": case "A":
      keys.left = false;
      break;
    case "ArrowRight": case "d": case "D":
      keys.right = false;
      break;
  }
});

spawnObstacles();
gameLoop();

</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mother 3 - The Forest</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border: 4px solid #e6c85c;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(230, 200, 92, 0.3);
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

let state = 'title'; // title, playing, win, lose
let score = 0;
let timer = 0;
let maxTime = 60;

const player = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: H / 2,
  w: 24,
  h: 32,
  dir: 'down',
  speed: 2.5,
  moving: false,
  animFrame: 0,
  animTimer: 0
};

const keys = {};
let enemies = [];
let items = [];
let particles = [];
let trees = [];
let rocks = [];
let flowers = [];
let clouds = [];
let waterTiles = [];
let grassPatches = [];
let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
let enemySpawnInterval = 3;
let maxEnemies = 5;
let winScore = 15;
let loseLives = 3;
let lives = loseLives;
let invulnTimer = 0;
let screenShake = 0;
let titlePulse = 0;
let dayPhase = 0;

// Create trees
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
  let tx = Math.random() * (W - 60) + 30;
  let ty = Math.random() * (H - 60) + 30;
  if (Math.abs(tx - W/2) > 80 || Math.abs(ty - H/2) > 60) {
    trees.push({ x: tx, y: ty, size: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.8, sway: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
  }
}

// Create rocks
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
  let rx = Math.random() * (W - 50) + 25;
  let ry = Math.random() * (H - 50) + 25;
  if (Math.abs(rx - W/2) > 60 || Math.abs(ry - H/2) > 50) {
    rocks.push({ x: rx, y: ry, size: Math.random() * 8 + 8, shade: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.5 });
  }
}

// Create flowers
for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
  flowers.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    color: ['#ff6b9d', '#ffd93d', '#c084fc', '#67e8f9', '#f97316'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)],
    size: Math.random() * 3 + 2,
    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Create clouds
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  clouds.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * 80 + 10,
    w: Math.random() * 60 + 40,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
  });
}

// Water tiles
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  waterTiles.push({
    x: Math.random() * (W - 80) + 40,
    y: Math.random() * (H - 60) + 30,
    w: Math.random() * 50 + 30,
    h: Math.random() * 30 + 20
  });
}

// Grass patches
for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
  grassPatches.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    blades: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 3
  });
}

// === INPUT ===
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (state === 'title' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    timer = maxTime;
    lives = loseLives;
    enemies = [];
    items = [];
    particles = [];
    enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    invulnTimer = 0;
    screenShake = 0;
  }
  if ((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && e.key === 'Enter') {
    state = 'title';
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
  keys[e.code] = false;
});

// === UPDATE ===
function update(dt) {
  titlePulse += dt * 2;
  dayPhase += dt * 0.05;

  clouds.forEach(c => {
    c.x += c.speed;
    if (c.x > W + c.w) c.x = -c.w;
  });

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  timer -= dt;
  if (timer <= 0) {
    state = 'lose';
    return;
  }

  if (invulnTimer > 0) invulnTimer -= dt;
  if (screenShake > 0) screenShake -= dt * 10;

  // Player movement
  player.moving = false;
  let dx = 0, dy = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) { dy = -1; player.dir = 'up'; }
  if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS']) { dy = 1; player.dir = 'down'; }
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) { dx = -1; player.dir = 'left'; }
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) { dx = 1; player.dir = 'right'; }

  if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
    player.moving = true;
    const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    player.x += (dx / len) * player.speed;
    player.y += (dy / len) * player.speed;
    player.animTimer += dt;
    if (player.animTimer > 0.15) {
      player.animTimer = 0;
      player.animFrame = (player.animFrame + 1) % 4;
    }
  }

  player.x = Math.max(15, Math.min(W - 15, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(15, Math.min(H - 15, player.y));

  // Enemy spawning
  enemySpawnTimer += dt;
  if (enemySpawnTimer >= enemySpawnInterval && enemies.length < maxEnemies) {
    enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    enemySpawnInterval = Math.max(1.5, enemySpawnInterval - 0.1);
    const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    let ex, ey;
    if (edge === 0) { ex = -20; ey = Math.random() * H; }
    else if (edge === 1) { ex = W + 20; ey = Math.random() * H; }
    else if (edge === 2) { ex = Math.random() * W; ey = -20; }
    else { ex = Math.random() * W; ey = H + 20; }
    enemies.push({
      x: ex, y: ey,
      w: 20, h: 20,
      speed: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8,
      hp: 1,
      type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'slime' : 'ghost',
      animFrame: 0,
      animTimer: 0,
      hitFlash: 0
    });
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    const pdx = player.x - e.x;
    const pdy = player.y - e.y;
    const pdist = Math.sqrt(pdx*pdx + pdy*pdy);
    if (pdist > 0) {
      e.x += (pdx / pdist) * e.speed;
      e.y += (pdy / pdist) * e.speed;
    }
    e.animTimer += dt;
    if (e.animTimer > 0.2) {
      e.animTimer = 0;
      e.animFrame = (e.animFrame + 1) % 4;
    }
    if (e.hitFlash > 0) e.hitFlash -= dt;

    // Check collision with player
    if (invulnTimer <= 0) {
      const dx2 = player.x - e.x;
      const dy2 = player.y - e.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx2*dx2 + dy2*dy2) < 20) {
        lives--;
        invulnTimer = 1.5;
        screenShake = 0.5;
        for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: player.x, y: player.y,
            vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*4, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*4,
            life: 0.5, color: '#ff4444', size: 3
          });
        }
        if (lives <= 0) {
          state = 'lose';
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove if far off screen
    if (e.x < -100 || e.x > W+100 || e.y < -100 || e.y > H+100) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Player attack
  if (keys['KeyZ'] || keys['KeyJ'] || keys['Space']) {
    if (!player._attacking) {
      player._attacking = true;
      const range = 40;
      let hitAny = false;
      enemies.forEach((e, idx) => {
        const dx3 = player.x - e.x;
        const dy3 = player.y - e.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx3*dx3 + dy3*dy3);
        if (dist < range) {
          e.hp--;
          e.hitFlash = 0.3;
          hitAny = true;
          for (let p = 0; p < 5; p++) {
            particles.push({
              x: e.x, y: e.y,
              vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*3, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*3,
              life: 0.4, color: '#ffd93d', size: 2
            });
          }
          if (e.hp <= 0) {
            enemies.splice(idx, 1);
            score++;
            screenShake = 0.2;
            for (let p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
              particles.push({
                x: e.x, y: e.y,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*5, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*5,
                life: 0.6, color: '#ffffff', size: 3
              });
            }
          }
        }
      });
      if (score >= winScore) {
        state = 'win';
      }
    }
  } else {
    player._attacking = false;
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// === DRAW ===
function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  const brightness = 0.8 + Math.sin(dayPhase) * 0.2;
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.floor(135*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(200*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(235*brightness)})`);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgb(${Math.floor(180*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(220*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(200*brightness)})`);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.floor(120*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(180*brightness)}, ${Math.floor(100*brightness)})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Ground
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5a9e3c');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3d7a28');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Grass texture patches
  grassPatches.forEach(g => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80, 140, 50, 0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(g.x, g.y, 15, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100, 160, 60, 0.4)';
    for (let b = 0; b < g.blades; b++) {
      const bx = g.x + (b - g.blades/2) * 5;
      const by = g.y - 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx, by);
      ctx.lineTo(bx - 2, by + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(bx + 2, by + 8);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Water
  waterTiles.forEach(w => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(70, 150, 220, 0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(w.x, w.y, w.w/2, w.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100, 180, 240, 0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(w.x - 5, w.y - 3, w.w/3, w.h/3, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Flowers
  flowers.forEach(f => {
    const sway = Math.sin(titlePulse + f.phase) * 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a8c2a';
    ctx.fillRect(f.x - 1, f.y, 2, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    for (let p = 0; p < 5; p++) {
      const angle = (p / 5) * Math.PI * 2 + sway;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x + Math.cos(angle) * f.size, f.y + Math.sin(angle) * f.size, f.size * 0.6, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.size * 0.4, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Rocks
  rocks.forEach(r => {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(140*r.shade+60)}, ${Math.floor(130*r.shade+50)}, ${Math.floor(120*r.shade+40)}, 0.8)`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.size, r.size * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(160*r.shade+70)}, ${Math.floor(150*r.shade+60)}, ${Math.floor(140*r.shade+50)}, 0.6)`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(r.x - r.size*0.2, r.y - r.size*0.2, r.size*0.5, r.size*0.35, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Clouds
  clouds.forEach(c => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w/2, c.w/4, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w*0.3, c.y - 5, c.w/3, c.w/5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x - c.w*0.2, c.y + 3, c.w/4, c.w/6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawTree(t) {
  const sway = Math.sin(titlePulse * 0.5 + t.sway) * 2;
  // Trunk
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6b4226';
  ctx.fillRect(t.x - 5*t.size, t.y, 10*t.size, 20*t.size);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5030';
  ctx.fillRect(t.x - 3*t.size, t.y, 6*t.size, 20*t.size);
  // Leaves
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2d6b1e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway, t.y - 10*t.size, 25*t.size, 20*t.size, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3d8b2e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway - 5*t.size, t.y - 15*t.size, 18*t.size, 15*t.size, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4da03a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(t.x + sway + 3*t.size, t.y - 8*t.size, 15*t.size, 12*t.size, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (invulnTimer > 0 && Math.floor(invulnTimer * 10) % 2 === 0) return;

  const px = player.x;
  const py = player.y;
  const bob = player.moving ? Math.sin(player.animFrame * Math.PI / 2) * 2 : 0;

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(px, py + 16, 12, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3355aa';
  ctx.fillRect(px - 8, py - 5 + bob, 16, 18);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py - 12 + bob, 10, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Hair
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py - 15 + bob, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(px - 10, py - 15 + bob, 20, 5);

  // Eyes
  if (player.dir === 'down') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(px - 4, py - 12 + bob, 3, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 1, py - 12 + bob, 3, 4);
  }

  // Attack effect
  if (player._attacking) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 100, 0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 35, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 50, 0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 30, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const flash = e.hitFlash > 0;
  const bob = Math.sin(e.animFrame * Math.PI / 2) * 2;

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(e.x, e.y + 12, 10, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  if (e.type === 'slime') {
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ffffff' : '#66cc44';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(e.x, e.y + bob, 12, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#dddddd' : '#44aa22';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(e.x, e.y - 3 + bob, 8, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x - 4, e.y - 2 + bob, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(e.x + 4, e.y - 2 + bob, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x - 4, e.y - 2 + bob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(e.x + 4, e.y - 2 + bob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    // Ghost
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ffffff' : 'rgba(200, 200, 255, 0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x, e.y - 5 + bob, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(e.x - 10, e.y - 5 + bob, 20, 15);
    // Wavy bottom
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(e.x - 10, e.y + 10 + bob);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(e.x - 10 + i*5 + 2.5, e.y + 14 + bob, e.x - 10 + (i+1)*5, e.y + 10 + bob);
    }
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x - 4, e.y - 5 + bob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(e.x + 4, e.y - 5 + bob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Mouth
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(e.x, e.y + bob, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / 0.6;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 200, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score} / ${winScore}`, 20, 32);

  // Timer
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(W - 120, 10, 110, 35);
  ctx.fillStyle = timer < 10 ? '#ff4444' : '#fff';
  ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timer)}s`, W - 110, 32);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(10, 50, 150, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  let heartsStr = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < loseLives; i++) {
    heartsStr += i < lives ? '♥ ' : '♡ ';
  }
  ctx.fillText(heartsStr, 20, 70);

  // Controls hint
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.font = '11px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('WASD/Arrows: Move | Z/Space: Attack', W/2 - 150, H - 15);
}

function drawTitle() {
  // Dark overlay
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Title
  const pulse = Math.sin(titlePulse) * 5;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e6c85c';
  ctx.font = `bold ${48 + pulse}px Courier New`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('MOTHER 3', W/2, H/2 - 60);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('The Forest', W/2, H/2 - 20);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 3) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to Start', W/2, H/2 + 40);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Defeat 15 enemies before time runs out!', W/2, H/2 + 80);
  ctx.fillText('WASD/Arrows to move | Z/Space to attack', W/2, H/2 + 105);

  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawWin() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,50,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score} | Time Left: ${Math.ceil(timer)}s`, W/2, H/2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 3) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to return to title', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawLose() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(50,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score} / ${winScore}`, W/2, H/2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 3) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to return to title', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (screenShake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 10,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 10
    );
  }

  drawBackground();

  // Draw trees (sorted by y for depth)
  const allObjects = [...trees.map(t => ({...t, type: 'tree'})), ...enemies.map(e => ({...e, type: 'enemy'}))];
  allObjects.push({...player, type: 'player'});
  allObjects.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

  allObjects.forEach(obj => {
    if (obj.type === 'tree') drawTree(obj);
    else if (obj.type === 'enemy') drawEnemy(obj);
    else if (obj.type === 'player') drawPlayer();
  });

  drawParticles();

  ctx.restore();

  if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();
  if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
  if (state === 'win') drawWin();
  if (state === 'lose') drawLose();
}

// === MAIN LOOP ===
let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="900" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// === STATE ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const G = 0.6;
const STAGE_LEFT = 100;
const STAGE_RIGHT = W - 100;
const STAGE_TOP = 300;

const state = {
  running: false,
  score: 0,
  time: 0,
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0,
  shake: 0
};

const player = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: STAGE_TOP,
  vx: 0,
  vy: 0,
  onGround: false,
  facing: 1,
  attackCooldown: 0,
  hitFlash: 0,
  combo: 0
};

const enemies = [];
const particles = [];
const stars = [];
const powerUps = [];

// Create stars for background
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H * 0.5,
    size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// === INPUT ===
const keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space') e.preventDefault();
  if (e.code === 'KeyZ' || e.code === 'KeyX') {
    if (state.running) {
      if (player.attackCooldown <= 0) {
        doAttack(e.code === 'KeyZ' ? 'punch' : 'kick');
      }
    }
  }
  if (e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
    if (state.running && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = -12;
      player.onGround = false;
      spawnParticles(player.x, player.y + 20, 5, '#ffffff');
    }
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.code] = false;
});

// === ENEMY SPAWNING ===
function spawnEnemy() {
  const side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
  const types = ['melee', 'ranged', 'fast'];
  const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
  const base = {
    x: side === 1 ? STAGE_LEFT - 30 : STAGE_RIGHT + 30,
    y: STAGE_TOP,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    facing: side === 1 ? 1 : -1,
    hp: 1,
    type: type,
    attackTimer: Math.random() * 60 + 30,
    color: type === 'melee' ? '#ff6b35' : type === 'ranged' ? '#4ecdc4' : '#ffe66d',
    size: type === 'melee' ? 22 : type === 'ranged' ? 18 : 16
  };
  enemies.push(base);
}

// === ATTACK ===
function doAttack(type) {
  const range = type === 'punch' ? 40 : 55;
  const damage = type === 'punch' ? 1 : 1;
  const knockback = type === 'punch' ? 8 : 12;
  const dir = player.facing;

  player.attackCooldown = 20;
  state.shake = 4;

  // Check hit on enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    const dx = e.x - player.x;
    const dy = e.y - player.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < range + e.size && (dx * dir > 0 || Math.abs(dx) < 20)) {
      // Hit!
      const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      e.vx = Math.cos(angle) * knockback * (dir > 0 ? 1 : -1);
      e.vy = Math.sin(angle) * knockback * 0.5 - 5;
      e.onGround = false;
      state.score += e.type === 'fast' ? 15 : e.type === 'ranged' ? 10 : 5;
      player.combo++;
      state.message = player.combo > 1 ? player.combo + 'x COMBO!' : '';
      state.messageTimer = 30;
      spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, 12, e.color);
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Hit power-ups
  for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerUps[i];
    const dx = p.x - player.x;
    const dy = p.y - player.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < range + 15) {
      p.vx = dir * 10;
      p.vy = -6;
      p.onGround = false;
      state.score += 25;
      spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, 15, '#ffd700');
      powerUps.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

// === PARTICLES ===
function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
      maxLife: 50,
      color: color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

// === POWER-UP SPAWN ===
function spawnPowerUp() {
  powerUps.push({
    x: STAGE_LEFT + Math.random() * (STAGE_RIGHT - STAGE_LEFT),
    y: -20,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    color: '#ffd700',
    size: 14
  });
}

// === UPDATE ===
function update() {
  if (!state.running) return;

  state.time++;

  // Player movement
  const speed = 4;
  if (keys['KeyA'] || keys['ArrowLeft']) {
    player.vx = -speed;
    player.facing = -1;
  } else if (keys['KeyD'] || keys['ArrowRight']) {
    player.vx = speed;
    player.facing = 1;
  } else {
    player.vx *= 0.7;
  }

  // Apply gravity
  player.vy += G;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // Ground collision
  if (player.y >= STAGE_TOP) {
    player.y = STAGE_TOP;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = true;
  } else {
    player.onGround = false;
  }

  // Keep in bounds horizontally (soft)
  if (player.x < 20) player.x = 20;
  if (player.x > W - 20) player.x = W - 20;

  // Cooldowns
  if (player.attackCooldown > 0) player.attackCooldown--;
  if (player.hitFlash > 0) player.hitFlash--;
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) {
    state.messageTimer--;
    if (state.messageTimer <= 0) state.message = '';
  }
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.8;

  // Enemy AI
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.vy += G;

    // Move toward player
    const dx = player.x - e.x;
    const moveSpeed = e.type === 'fast' ? 3.5 : e.type === 'melee' ? 2.5 : 1.5;
    e.vx = Math.sign(dx) * moveSpeed;
    e.facing = Math.sign(dx) || 1;

    e.x += e.vx;
    e.y += e.vy;

    // Ground
    if (e.y >= STAGE_TOP) {
      e.y = STAGE_TOP;
      e.vy = 0;
      e.onGround = true;
    } else {
      e.onGround = false;
    }

    // Attack timer
    e.attackTimer--;
    if (e.attackTimer <= 0) {
      e.attackTimer = e.type === 'fast' ? 40 : e.type === 'melee' ? 50 : 70;
      // Check if close enough to hit player
      const dist = Math.sqrt((player.x - e.x) ** 2 + (player.y - e.y) ** 2);
      const range = e.type === 'ranged' ? 150 : 35;
      if (dist < range) {
        player.hitFlash = 10;
        state.shake = 6;
        player.vx = Math.sign(player.x - e.x) * 8;
        player.vy = -5;
        player.onGround = false;
        player.combo = 0;
        state.message = 'HIT!';
        state.messageTimer = 20;
        spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, 8, '#ff0000');
      }
    }

    // Off screen = removed
    if (e.y > H + 50 || e.x < -50 || e.x > W + 50) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Power-ups
  for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerUps[i];
    p.vy += G;
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.y >= STAGE_TOP) {
      p.y = STAGE_TOP;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.onGround = true;
    }
    if (p.y > H + 50 || p.x < -50 || p.x > W + 50) {
      powerUps.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Spawn enemies
  const spawnRate = Math.max(30, 90 - Math.floor(state.time / 200));
  if (state.time % spawnRate === 0) {
    spawnEnemy();
  }

  // Spawn power-ups
  if (state.time % 300 === 0) {
    spawnPowerUp();
  }
}

// === DRAW ===
function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a1a4e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a2a6e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a3e');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const twinkle = Math.sin(state.time * 0.05 + s.twinkle) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.3 + twinkle * 0.7})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e68c';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 100, 60, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a2e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 90, 55, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#151530';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, STAGE_TOP);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 200);
  ctx.lineTo(100, 250);
  ctx.lineTo(200, 180);
  ctx.lineTo(350, 220);
  ctx.lineTo(500, 160);
  ctx.lineTo(650, 210);
  ctx.lineTo(800, 170);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 230);
  ctx.lineTo(W, STAGE_TOP);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Nearer hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a40';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, STAGE_TOP);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 260);
  ctx.lineTo(150, 290);
  ctx.lineTo(300, 250);
  ctx.lineTo(450, 280);
  ctx.lineTo(600, 240);
  ctx.lineTo(750, 270);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 250);
  ctx.lineTo(W, STAGE_TOP);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawStage() {
  // Main platform
  const platGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, STAGE_TOP, 0, STAGE_TOP + 40);
  platGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a4a8a');
  platGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a2a5a');
  ctx.fillStyle = platGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_LEFT, STAGE_TOP, STAGE_RIGHT - STAGE_LEFT, 40);

  // Platform top highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6a6aaa';
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_LEFT, STAGE_TOP, STAGE_RIGHT - STAGE_LEFT, 4);

  // Platform edges
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a7a';
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_LEFT, STAGE_TOP, 6, 40);
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_RIGHT - 6, STAGE_TOP, 6, 40);

  // Grid lines on platform
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 100, 180, 0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = STAGE_LEFT + 30; x < STAGE_RIGHT; x += 30) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, STAGE_TOP);
    ctx.lineTo(x, STAGE_TOP + 40);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Void below
  const voidGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, STAGE_TOP + 40, 0, H);
  voidGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.5)');
  voidGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5, 5, 20, 0.9)');
  ctx.fillStyle = voidGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, STAGE_TOP + 40, W, H - STAGE_TOP - 40);

  // Edge glow
  ctx.shadowColor = '#e94560';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_LEFT, STAGE_TOP, 3, 40);
  ctx.fillRect(STAGE_RIGHT - 3, STAGE_TOP, 3, 40);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const px = player.x;
  const py = player.y;
  const f = player.facing;
  const flash = player.hitFlash > 0 && Math.floor(state.time / 3) % 2 === 0;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px, py);

  if (flash) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
  }

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff4444' : '#3498db';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-12, -25, 24, 30, 5);
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff6666' : '#f5c6a0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -35, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Hair
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff2222' : '#2c3e50';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -38, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(f * 3, -35, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(f * 4, -35, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Arms
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff4444' : '#2980b9';
  const armSwing = Math.sin(state.time * 0.1) * 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-16, -20 + armSwing, 6, 18, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(10, -20 - armSwing, 6, 18, 3);
  ctx.fill();

  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff4444' : '#1a5276';
  const legSwing = player.onGround ? Math.sin(state.time * 0.15) * 4 : 0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-10, 3 + legSwing, 8, 14, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(2, 3 - legSwing, 8, 14, 3);
  ctx.fill();

  // Attack effect
  if (player.attackCooldown > 14) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 100, 0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f * 30, -10, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f * 30, -10, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);

  const s = e.size;
  const f = e.facing;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-s * 0.6, -s, s * 1.2, s * 1.3, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = e.type === 'melee' ? '#ff8855' : e.type === 'ranged' ? '#66e0d8' : '#ffe66d';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -s * 1.3, s * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(f * s * 0.15, -s * 1.3, s * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Type indicator
  if (e.type === 'ranged') {
    // Ranged - has a weapon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
    ctx.fillRect(f * s * 0.5, -s * 0.8, f * s * 0.8, 3);
  } else if (e.type === 'fast') {
    // Fast - speed lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-f * s, -s * 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(-f * s * 1.5, -s * 0.5);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-f * s, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-f * s * 1.3, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    // Melee - fists
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6633';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f * s * 0.8, -s * 0.3, s * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPowerUp(p) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);

  const glow = Math.sin(state.time * 0.1) * 3;

  // Glow
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.3 + glow * 0.05})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size + glow, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Star shape
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const angle = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
    const outerR = p.size;
    const innerR = p.size * 0.4;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(angle) * outerR, Math.sin(angle) * outerR);
    else ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle) * outerR, Math.sin(angle) * outerR);
    const innerAngle = angle + Math.PI / 5;
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(innerAngle) * innerR, Math.sin(innerAngle) * innerR);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 20, 35);

  // Combo
  if (player.combo > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(player.combo + 'x COMBO', W / 2, 35);
  }

  // Message
  if (state.message) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state.message, W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
  }

  // Controls hint
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
  ctx.font = '12px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('A/D Move | W Jump | Z Punch | X Kick', W / 2, H - 15);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Screen shake
  if (state.shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake
    );
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawStage();

  // Draw power-ups
  for (const p of powerUps) drawPowerUp(p);

  // Draw enemies
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);

  // Draw player
  drawPlayer();

  // Draw particles
  drawParticles();

  // Draw HUD
  drawHUD();

  ctx.restore();

  // Start screen overlay
  if (!state.running) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SMASH BROS.', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('BRAWL', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Final Destination', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = '18px Arial';
    const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) > 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('A/D: Move | W: Jump | Z: Punch | X: Kick', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);
    ctx.fillText('Knock enemies off the stage to score!', W / 2, H / 2 + 135);
  }
}

// === GAME LOOP ===
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Start with space
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space' && !state.running) {
    state.running = true;
    state.score = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    enemies.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    powerUps.length = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = STAGE_TOP;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.combo = 0;
  }
});

// Polyfill for roundRect
if (!ctx.roundRect) {
  CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function (x, y, w, h, r) {
    if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
    const [tl, tr, br, bl] = Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r, r, r, r];
    this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
    this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
    this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
    this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
    this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
    this.closePath();
    return this;
  };
}

loop();
</script>
</body>
