<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Isaac's Basement</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #0a0a0a;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border: 3px solid #3a2020;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(120,40,40,0.4);
    background: #1a1212;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  STATE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const TILE = 40;
const COLS = 20;
const ROWS = 15;

let gameState = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'dead', 'won'
let frame = 0;

let player = {
  x: 0, y: 0,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  w: 24, h: 24,
  hp: 6, maxHp: 6,
  speed: 3,
  facing: 0, // 0=up 1=right 2=down 3=left
  invincible: 0
};

let projectiles = [];
let enemies = [];
let rooms = [];
let currentRoom = 0;
let keys = {};
let score = 0;
let totalRooms = 5;
let shakeX = 0;
let shakeY = 0;

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  ROOM GENERATION
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function generateRoom(idx) {
  const tiles = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    tiles[r] = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      tiles[r][c] = 0; // 0 = floor, 1 = wall
    }
  }
  // Outer walls
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (r === 0 || r === ROWS-1 || c === 0 || c === COLS-1) {
        tiles[r][c] = 1;
      }
    }
  }
  // Random internal walls
  const wallCount = 8 + idx * 4;
  for (let i = 0; i < wallCount; i++) {
    const r = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (ROWS - 4));
    const c = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (COLS - 4));
    if (tiles[r][c] === 0) {
      tiles[r][c] = 1;
      if (Math.random() < 0.4 && c+1 < COLS-1) tiles[r][c+1] = 1;
      if (Math.random() < 0.4 && r+1 < ROWS-1) tiles[r+1][c] = 1;
    }
  }
  // Ensure spawn area is clear
  const sx = Math.floor(COLS/2);
  const sy = Math.floor(ROWS/2);
  for (let dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
    for (let dc = -1; dc <= 1; dc++) {
      const rr = sy+dr, cc = sx+dc;
      if (rr > 0 && rr < ROWS-1 && cc > 0 && cc < COLS-1) tiles[rr][cc] = 0;
    }
  }
  return { tiles, enemies: [], items: [] };
}

function placeEnemies(room, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    let placed = false;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50 && !placed; attempt++) {
      const r = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (ROWS-4));
      const c = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (COLS-4));
      if (room.tiles[r][c] === 0) {
        const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'fly' : 'gaper';
        room.enemies.push({
          x: c * TILE + TILE/2,
          y: r * TILE + TILE/2,
          vx: 0, vy: 0,
          w: 20, h: 20,
          hp: type === 'fly' ? 2 : 4,
          type: type,
          speed: type === 'fly' ? 1.2 : 0.8,
          angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          hitTimer: 0
        });
        placed = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

function buildAllRooms() {
  rooms = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < totalRooms; i++) {
    const room = generateRoom(i);
    const enemyCount = 3 + i * 2;
    placeEnemies(room, enemyCount);
    rooms.push(room);
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  buildAllRooms();
  currentRoom = 0;
  score = 0;
  player.x = COLS/2 * TILE;
  player.y = ROWS/2 * TILE;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
  player.hp = 6;
  player.maxHp = 6;
  player.invincible = 0;
  projectiles = [];
  enemies = rooms[currentRoom].enemies;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  INPUT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (gameState === 'start' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    gameState = 'playing';
    resetGame();
  }
  if ((gameState === 'dead' || gameState === 'won') && e.key === 'Enter') {
    gameState = 'start';
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  UPDATE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function isWall(px, py) {
  const c = Math.floor(px / TILE);
  const r = Math.floor(py / TILE);
  if (r < 0 || r >= ROWS || c < 0 || c >= COLS) return true;
  return rooms[currentRoom].tiles[r][c] === 1;
}

function circleWall(cx, cy, radius) {
  const points = [
    [cx - radius, cy], [cx + radius, cy],
    [cx, cy - radius], [cx, cy + radius],
    [cx - radius*0.7, cy - radius*0.7], [cx + radius*0.7, cy + radius*0.7],
    [cx - radius*0.7, cy + radius*0.7], [cx + radius*0.7, cy - radius*0.7]
  ];
  for (const p of points) {
    if (isWall(p[0], p[1])) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function update() {
  frame++;

  if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  let dx = 0, dy = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) dx = -1;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) dx = 1;
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) dy = -1;
  if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) dy = 1;

  if (dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) {
    const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    dx /= len; dy /= len;
  }

  player.vx = dx * player.speed;
  player.vy = dy * player.speed;

  if (dx < -0.1) player.facing = 3;
  else if (dx > 0.1) player.facing = 1;
  else if (dy < -0.1) player.facing = 0;
  else if (dy > 0.1) player.facing = 2;

  const newX = player.x + player.vx;
  const newY = player.y + player.vy;

  if (!circleWall(newX, player.y, 12)) player.x = newX;
  if (!circleWall(player.x, newY, 12)) player.y = newY;

  if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;

  // Shoot
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['ArrowDown'] ||
      keys['a'] || keys['d'] || keys['w'] || keys['s']) {
    if (frame % 15 === 0) {
      let sx = 0, sy = 0;
      if (player.facing === 0) sy = -1;
      if (player.facing === 1) sx = 1;
      if (player.facing === 2) sy = 1;
      if (player.facing === 3) sx = -1;
      projectiles.push({
        x: player.x, y: player.y,
        vx: sx * 5, vy: sy * 5,
        life: 60
      });
    }
  }

  // Update projectiles
  for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = projectiles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0 || isWall(p.x, p.y)) {
      projectiles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Hit enemies
    for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = enemies[j];
      const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.y - e.y);
      if (dist < 18) {
        e.hp--;
        e.hitTimer = 8;
        projectiles.splice(i, 1);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
          score += e.type === 'fly' ? 10 : 20;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    if (e.hitTimer > 0) e.hitTimer--;

    const dxp = player.x - e.x;
    const dyp = player.y - e.y;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dxp, dyp);

    if (e.type === 'fly') {
      e.angle += 0.08;
      const wobble = Math.sin(e.angle) * 0.5;
      const nx = dxp / (dist || 1) + wobble * dyp / (dist || 1);
      const ny = dyp / (dist || 1) - wobble * dxp / (dist || 1);
      const len = Math.hypot(nx, ny) || 1;
      const tx = e.x + (nx/len) * e.speed;
      const ty = e.y + (ny/len) * e.speed;
      if (!circleWall(tx, ty, 10)) { e.x = tx; e.y = ty; }
    } else {
      const nx = dxp / (dist || 1);
      const ny = dyp / (dist || 1);
      const tx = e.x + nx * e.speed;
      const ty = e.y + ny * e.speed;
      if (!circleWall(tx, ty, 10)) { e.x = tx; e.y = ty; }
    }

    // Hit player
    if (player.invincible <= 0) {
      const hitDist = Math.hypot(player.x - e.x, player.y - e.y);
      if (hitDist < 22) {
        player.hp--;
        player.invincible = 60;
        shakeX = 8;
        shakeY = 8;
        if (player.hp <= 0) {
          gameState = 'dead';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Check room clear
  if (enemies.length === 0) {
    if (currentRoom < totalRooms - 1) {
      currentRoom++;
      enemies = rooms[currentRoom].enemies;
      player.x = COLS/2 * TILE;
      player.y = ROWS/2 * TILE;
    } else {
      gameState = 'won';
    }
  }

  // Screen shake decay
  if (shakeX > 0) { shakeX *= 0.8; if (shakeX < 0.5) shakeX = 0; }
  if (shakeY > 0) { shakeY *= 0.8; if (shakeY < 0.5) shakeY = 0; }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  DRAW
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1212';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Floor tiles
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      const x = c * TILE;
      const y = r * TILE;
      if (rooms[currentRoom] && rooms[currentRoom].tiles[r] && rooms[currentRoom].tiles[r][c] === 0) {
        const shade = ((r + c) % 2 === 0) ? '#2a1e1e' : '#251a1a';
        ctx.fillStyle = shade;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
        // Subtle floor lines
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,35,35,0.3)';
        ctx.strokeRect(x+1, y+1, TILE-2, TILE-2);
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawWalls() {
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (rooms[currentRoom].tiles[r][c] === 1) {
        const x = c * TILE;
        const y = r * TILE;
        // Base wall
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2525';
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
        // Top highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3030';
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, TILE, 4);
        // Brick lines
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a1a1a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, y + TILE/2);
        ctx.lineTo(x + TILE, y + TILE/2);
        ctx.moveTo(x + TILE/2, y);
        ctx.lineTo(x + TILE/2, y + TILE/2);
        ctx.moveTo(x + TILE/4, y + TILE/2);
        ctx.lineTo(x + TILE/4, y + TILE);
        ctx.moveTo(x + TILE*3/4, y + TILE/2);
        ctx.lineTo(x + TILE*3/4, y + TILE);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Blood drips on some walls
        if ((r * 7 + c * 3) % 5 === 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5a1515';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(x + TILE/2, y + TILE*0.3, 3, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const px = player.x;
  const py = player.y;
  const blink = player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible / 4) % 2 === 0;
  if (blink) return;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5e6d0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(px, py, 12, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Face
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5e6d0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py - 4, 10, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  const eyeOffX = player.facing === 1 ? 2 : player.facing === 3 ? -2 : 0;
  const eyeOffY = player.facing === 0 ? -2 : player.facing === 2 ? 2 : 0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px - 4 + eyeOffX, py - 4 + eyeOffY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px + 4 + eyeOffX, py - 4 + eyeOffY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Sad mouth
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py + 2, 4, Math.PI * 0.2, Math.PI * 0.8);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Hair
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c4a882';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py - 8, 9, Math.PI * 1.1, Math.PI * 1.9);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const blink = e.hitTimer > 0;
  const bodyColor = blink ? '#ffffff' : (e.type === 'fly' ? '#4a6a4a' : '#8a5a3a');
  const x = e.x;
  const y = e.y;

  if (e.type === 'fly') {
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 10, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Wings
    const wingFlap = Math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,200,220,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - 8, y - 6 + wingFlap, 7, 4, -0.3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + 8, y - 6 + wingFlap, 7, 4, 0.3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 1, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 3, y - 1, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    // Gaper body
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 12, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = blink ? '#ffffff' : '#9a6a4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 6, 9, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Mouth - big open
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a0a0a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y - 3, 5, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Teeth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d8c0';
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      ctx.fillRect(x + i * 2 - 1, y - 8, 2, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + i * 2 - 1, y + 2, 2, 3);
    }
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 4, y - 8, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 4, y - 8, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawProjectiles() {
  for (const p of projectiles) {
    // Tear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6ab0d8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0d8f0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x - 1, p.y - 1, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Heart bar
  const heartSize = 18;
  const startX = 20;
  const startY = 20;
  for (let i = 0; i < player.maxHp; i++) {
    const hx = startX + i * (heartSize + 6);
    const hy = startY;
    const filled = i < player.hp;
    ctx.fillStyle = filled ? '#cc2222' : '#3a1a1a';
    // Heart shape
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(hx + heartSize/2, hy + heartSize * 0.85);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx - heartSize*0.15, hy + heartSize*0.5, hx - heartSize*0.15, hy, hx + heartSize/2, hy + heartSize*0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx + heartSize*1.15, hy, hx + heartSize*1.15, hy + heartSize*0.5, hx + heartSize/2, hy + heartSize*0.85);
    ctx.fill();
    if (filled) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,100,0.3)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hx + heartSize*0.35, hy + heartSize*0.3, heartSize*0.2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a060';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W - 20, 35);

  // Room indicator
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7060';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Room ' + (currentRoom + 1) + ' / ' + totalRooms, W/2, 30);

  // Room name
  const roomNames = ['The Basement', 'The Crypt', 'The Caves', 'The Depths', 'The Womb'];
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6a5a4a';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(roomNames[currentRoom] || '', W/2, 48);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,5,5,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Title
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3333';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText("ISAAC'S", W/2, H/2 - 80);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aa2222';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('BASEMENT', W/2, H/2 - 35);

  // Isaac face
  const cx = W/2;
  const cy = H/2 + 40;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5e6d0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 30, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx - 10, cy - 5, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + 10, cy - 5, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy + 12, 8, Math.PI * 0.15, Math.PI * 0.85);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c4a882';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy - 22, 22, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a060';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  const pulse = Math.sin(frame * 0.05) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play', W/2, H/2 + 110);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.fillStyle = '#7a6a5a';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrows to move & shoot', W/2, H/2 + 145);
  ctx.fillText('Clear all 5 rooms to win', W/2, H/2 + 165);
}

function drawDeadScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,5,5,0.8)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('YOU DIED', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a060';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7060';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const pulse = Math.sin(frame * 0.05) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to retry', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawWonScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,20,5,0.8)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44cc44';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('YOU SURVIVED', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a060';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7060';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const pulse = Math.sin(frame * 0.05) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shakeX > 0 || shakeY > 0) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeX,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeY
    );
  }

  if (gameState === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawWalls();
  drawProjectiles();
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();

  if (gameState === 'dead') drawDeadScreen();
  if (gameState === 'won') drawWonScreen();

  ctx.restore();
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MAIN LOOP
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function gameLoop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

buildAllRooms();
gameLoop();
</script>

<script>
(function () {

  // ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
  const W = 960;

  (function buildScenery() {

    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      mountains.push({ x: i * 180 - 60, w: 260 + Math.random() * 80, h: 120 + Math.random() * 90, c: i % 2 });
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      trees.push({ x: 60 + i * 100 + Math.random() * 30, h: 60 + Math.random() * 40 });
    }
  })();

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  const keys = {};
  const pressed = {};

  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (["arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"," "].includes(e.key.toLowerCase()) || e.code === "Space") {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (!keys[k]) { pressed[k] = true; }
    keys[k] = true;

    if (state === "start" && (k === "enter" || k === " ")) {
      startGame();
    } else if ((state === "won" || state === "lost") && (k === "enter" || k === "r")) {
      startGame();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    score = 0;
    timeLeft = 180;
    frame = 0;
    shake = 0;
    player.x = 200; player.y = GROUND_Y; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.facing = 1; player.onGround = true;

    particles.length = 0;
    slashFx.length = 0;
  }

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function spawnEnemy() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -40 : W + 40;
    enemies.push({
      x: x, y: GROUND_Y, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      facing: fromLeft ? 1 : -1,
      hp: ENEMY_HP, onGround: true,
      attackCd: 0, walkPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      hitFlash: 0, dead: false
    });
  }

  function addParticles(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
      particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 2, life: 30 + Math.random() * 20, color: color, r: Math.random() * 3 + 1 });
    }
  }

  function addSlashFx(x, y, dir) {
    slashFx.push({ x: x, y: y, dir: dir, life: 8, max: 8 });
  }

  function rectHit(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
    return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
  }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update() {
    frame++;
    if (shake > 0) shake -= 0.6;

    if (state === "playing") {

        player.vx = player.facing * DASH_SPEED;

      // jump
      if ((pressed["w"] || pressed["arrowup"] || pressed[" "]) && player.onGround) {

      player.vy += GRAVITY;

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function draw() {

  function drawSky() {

  function drawMountains() {
    for (let i = 0; i < mountains.length; i++) {

      ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w * 0.5, baseY - m.h);

      ctx.beginPath();

  function drawPlayer() {

    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#20203a";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c8202a";
    ctx.fillRect(px - 10, py - 34, 20, 5);

    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#2a2a44";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py - 60, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a14";
    ctx.fillRect(px - 7, py - 63, 14, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(px + (f === 1 ? 1 : -5), py - 62, 3, 2);

      ctx.moveTo(px, py - 45);

  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {

    const f = e.facing;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px, GROUND_Y + 6, 20, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.strokeStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#3a1a1a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py - 20); ctx.lineTo(px + 5 - ls, py); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#7a1f1f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(px - 9, py - 48, 18, 30, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#a83030";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px, py - 30, 7, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#8a2525";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py - 55, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#e0d0a0";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px - 5, py - 60); ctx.lineTo(px - 9, py - 68); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe040";
    ctx.fillRect(px + (f === 1 ? -3 : -1), py - 57, 3, 3);

    // weapon (club)
    ctx.strokeStyle = flash ? "#fff" : "#4a2a1a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px + f * 8, py - 42);
    ctx.lineTo(px + f * 22, py - 34);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawSlash(s) {
    const t = s.life / s.max;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = t;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#dfe6ff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const r = 30 + (1 - t) * 20;
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r, (s.dir === 1 ? -0.6 : Math.PI - 0.6), (s.dir === 1 ? 0.6 : Math.PI + 0.6));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, r * 0.7, (s.dir === 1 ? -0.5 : Math.PI - 0.5), (s.dir === 1 ? 0.5 : Math.PI + 0.5));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticle(p) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, 20, 32);

    // timer
    ctx.fillStyle = timeLeft <= 30 ? "#ff5544" : "#cfe0ff";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("TIME " + timeLeft, W / 2, 32);

    // health bar
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe0ff";
    ctx.fillText("HP", W - 200, 32);
    const bw = 150, bx = W - 190, by = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a0a0a";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 14);
    const ratio = player.hp / player.maxHp;
    ctx.fillStyle = ratio > 0.4 ? "#c8202a" : "#ff4020";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * ratio, 14);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, 14);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawStart() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3030";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("NINJA GAIDEN", W / 2, 190);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("( 2004 )", W / 2, 225);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe0ff";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Defeat the demon horde before time runs out.", W / 2, 285);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa8c8";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("A / D  or  Arrows  =  Move      W / Up / Space  =  Jump", W / 2, 330);
    ctx.fillText("J / X  =  Slash      K / Shift  =  Dash", W / 2, 356);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    const blink = Math.floor(frame / 30) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  BEGIN", W / 2, 420);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawEnd(won) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? "#5aff8a" : "#ff4040";
    ctx.font = "bold 56px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(won ? "VICTORY" : "DEFEAT", W / 2, 200);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "26px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("FINAL SCORE  " + score, W / 2, 260);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe0ff";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    if (won) ctx.fillText("The demons are vanquished. The village is safe.", W / 2, 310);
    else ctx.fillText("The ninja has fallen. The horde prevails.", W / 2, 310);
    const blink = Math.floor(frame / 30) % 2 === 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    if (blink) ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  OR  R  TO  REPLAY", W / 2, 380);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Space Channel 5</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Arial Black", Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #000;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px #ff00cc;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = 640;
  const H = 400;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";

  const COLORS = {
    bgTop: "#1a0533",
    bgBottom: "#3d0a5c",
    floor: "#2a0d4a",
    floorLine: "#ff00cc",
    player: "#00e5ff",
    playerDark: "#0077aa",
    playerHair: "#ff00ff",
    playerEye: "#ffffff",
    playerPupil: "#000000",
    enemy: "#ff3300",
    enemyDark: "#991100",
    enemyEye: "#ffff00",
    bullet: "#00ffff",
    enemyBullet: "#ff0000",
    score: "#ffffff",
    text: "#00ffcc",
    heart: "#ff0055",
    star: "#ffff00",
    ring: "#ff00ff"
  };

  const state = {
    mode: "title",
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    wave: 0,
    waveTimer: 0,
    message: "",
    messageTimer: 0,
    shake: 0,
    combo: 0,
    comboTimer: 0,
    player: { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 1, invuln: 0, fireCd: 0, jump: false, onGround: true },
    bullets: [],
    enemies: [],
    enemyBullets: [],
    particles: [],
    stars: [],
    rings: [],
    time: 0
  };

  function initStars() {
    state.stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      state.stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * (H - 100),
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
      });
    }
  }

  function initRings() {
    state.rings = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      state.rings.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * (H - 150) + 20,
        r: Math.random() * 20 + 15,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        speed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGame() {
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.wave = 0;
    state.waveTimer = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.comboTimer = 0;
    state.message = "";
    state.messageTimer = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.player = { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 1, invuln: 0, fireCd: 0, jump: false, onGround: true };
    state.bullets = [];
    state.enemies = [];
    state.enemyBullets = [];
    state.particles = [];
    initStars();
    initRings();
    startWave();
  }

  function startWave() {
    state.wave++;
    state.waveTimer = 0;
    state.message = "WAVE " + state.wave;
    state.messageTimer = 90;
    const count = 3 + state.wave;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const x = 80 + (W - 160) * (i / Math.max(count - 1, 1));
      const y = -40 - Math.random() * 60;
      state.enemies.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        hp: 2 + Math.floor(state.wave / 3),
        maxHp: 2 + Math.floor(state.wave / 3),
        fireCd: Math.random() * 120 + 60,
        wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        size: 22
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
      state.particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
        life: Math.random() * 30 + 15,
        maxLife: Math.random() * 30 + 15,
        color: color,
        size: Math.random() * 3 + 1
      });
    }
  }

  function fireBullet() {
    const p = state.player;
    if (p.fireCd > 0) return;
    p.fireCd = 12;
    const bx = p.x + p.facing * 20;
    const by = p.y - 5;
    state.bullets.push({ x: bx, y: by, vx: p.facing * 9, vy: 0, life: 80 });
    spawnParticles(bx, by, COLORS.bullet, 3);
  }

  function enemyFire(e) {
    const p = state.player;
    const dx = p.x - e.x;
    const dy = p.y - e.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist === 0) return;
    const speed = 3 + state.wave * 0.3;
    const vx = (dx / dist) * speed;
    const vy = (dy / dist) * speed;
    state.enemyBullets.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: vx, vy: vy, life: 120 });
  }

  function damagePlayer() {
    const p = state.player;
    if (p.invuln > 0) return;
    state.lives--;
    p.invuln = 90;
    state.shake = 10;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.comboTimer = 0;
    spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, COLORS.player, 15);
    if (state.lives <= 0) {
      state.mode = "gameover";
      state.message = "GAME OVER";
      state.messageTimer = 999;
    }
  }

  function update() {
    state.time++;
    if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer--;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.85;
    if (state.comboTimer > 0) { state.comboTimer--; if (state.comboTimer === 0) state.combo = 0; }

    // Update stars
    for (const s of state.stars) {
      s.y += s.speed;
      if (s.y > H - 60) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
    }

    // Update rings
    for (const r of state.rings) {
      r.rot += r.speed;
    }

    if (state.mode === "title") return;
    if (state.mode === "gameover") return;

    const p = state.player;

    // Player movement
    const speed = 4;
    p.vx = 0;
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"]) { p.vx = -speed; p.facing = -1; }
    if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"]) { p.vx = speed; p.facing = 1; }
    if ((keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["w"] || keys[" "]) && p.onGround) {
      p.vy = -10;
      p.onGround = false;
      p.jump = true;
    }
    p.vy += 0.5;
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.x < 20) p.x = 20;
    if (p.x > W - 20) p.x = W - 20;
    if (p.y > H - 70) { p.y = H - 70; p.vy = 0; p.onGround = true; p.jump = false; }
    if (p.invuln > 0) p.invuln--;
    if (p.fireCd > 0) p.fireCd--;

    // Fire
    if (keys["z"] || keys["f"] || keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["w"]) {
      fireBullet();
    }

    // Update bullets
    for (let i = state.bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = state.bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      b.life--;
      if (b.life <= 0 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20) {
        state.bullets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Update enemy bullets
    for (let i = state.enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = state.enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      b.life--;
      if (b.life <= 0 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20) {
        state.enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // Hit player
      const dx = b.x - p.x;
      const dy = b.y - p.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < 18) {
        damagePlayer();
        state.enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Update enemies
    state.waveTimer++;
    for (let i = state.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = state.enemies[i];
      e.wobble += 0.05;
      // Move toward player
      const dx = p.x - e.x;
      const dy = (H - 100) - e.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist > 0) {
        const moveSpeed = 0.8 + state.wave * 0.1;
        e.x += (dx / dist) * moveSpeed;
        e.y += (dy / dist) * moveSpeed;
      }
      // Wobble
      e.x += Math.sin(e.wobble) * 0.5;

      // Fire
      e.fireCd--;
      if (e.fireCd <= 0) {
        enemyFire(e);
        e.fireCd = Math.random() * 100 + 60 - state.wave * 5;
        if (e.fireCd < 30) e.fireCd = 30;
      }

      // Check collision with player
      const cdx = e.x - p.x;
      const cdy = e.y - p.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(cdx * cdx + cdy * cdy) < e.size + 15) {
        damagePlayer();
      }

      // Check bullets hitting enemy
      for (let j = state.bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const b = state.bullets[j];
        const bdx = b.x - e.x;
        const bdy = b.y - e.y;
        if (Math.sqrt(bdx * bdx + bdy * bdy) < e.size) {
          e.hp--;
          state.bullets.splice(j, 1);
          spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, COLORS.enemy, 5);
          if (e.hp <= 0) {
            state.enemies.splice(i, 1);
            state.score += 100 * (1 + state.combo);
            state.combo++;
            state.comboTimer = 120;
            state.shake = 5;
            spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, COLORS.enemy, 20);
            spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, COLORS.star, 10);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Update particles
    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const pt = state.particles[i];
      pt.x += pt.vx;
      pt.y += pt.vy;
      pt.vy += 0.1;
      pt.life--;
      if (pt.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Wave complete
    if (state.enemies.length === 0 && state.messageTimer <= 0) {
      state.score += 500;
      state.message = "WAVE " + state.wave + " CLEAR!";
      state.messageTimer = 120;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (state.mode === "play") startWave();
      }, 2000);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, COLORS.bgTop);
    grad.addColorStop(0.7, COLORS.bgBottom);
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#1a0533");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars
    for (const s of state.stars) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.3 + s.size * 0.3) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Floating rings
    for (const r of state.rings) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
      ctx.rotate(r.rot);
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.ring;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r, r.r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Floor
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.floor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 60, W, 60);
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.floorLine;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const y = H - 60 + i * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    // Floor top line
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.floorLine;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H - 60);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H - 60);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = state.player;
    if (p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(state.time / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.scale(p.facing, 1);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.player;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 14, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Dark accent
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerDark;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-4, 5, 8, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffddbb";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -22, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerHair;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -26, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Hair strands
    ctx.fillRect(-10, -26, 4, 12);
    ctx.fillRect(6, -26, 4, 12);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerEye;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(3, -22, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerPupil;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(4, -22, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Arm / gun
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.player;
    ctx.fillRect(10, -5, 12, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(20, -7, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bullet;
    ctx.fillRect(27, -5, 3, 4);

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerDark;
    ctx.fillRect(-8, 15, 6, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(2, 15, 6, 10);

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(-9, 24, 8, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(1, 24, 8, 4);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.enemy;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.size, e.size * 0.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Dark bottom
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.enemyDark;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 4, e.size * 0.7, e.size * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.enemyEye;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-6, -4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(6, -4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Pupils
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-5, -4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(7, -4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#000";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 4, 6, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Antennae
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.enemy;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-5, -e.size * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, -e.size * 0.7 - 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(5, -e.size * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(10, -e.size * 0.7 - 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    // HP bar
    if (e.hp < e.maxHp) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
      ctx.fillRect(-e.size, -e.size - 8, e.size * 2, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f0";
      ctx.fillRect(-e.size, -e.size - 8, (e.hp / e.maxHp) * e.size * 2, 4);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullets() {
    for (const b of state.bullets) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bullet;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,255,255,0.3)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (const b of state.enemyBullets) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.enemyBullet;
      ctx.beginPath();

/* world */
const GROUND_Y = 430;

/* ============================ HELPERS ============================ */
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

function spawnParticle(x, y, color, vx, vy, life, size) {

}

function spawnEnemy() {

/* ============================ UPDATE ============================ */
function update(dt) {

  const pad = 8;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), cellH() * 0.9);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(cellH() * 0.5) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const players = units.filter(u => u.team === 'player' && u.alive).length;
  const enemies = units.filter(u => u.team === 'enemy' && u.alive).length;
  ctx.fillText('JA2  MERCENARY SQUAD  |  Team ' + players + '  vs  Enemy ' + enemies, pad, cellH() * 0.55);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb4d0';
  ctx.fillText(state.message, W() - pad, cellH() * 0.55);
}

function drawBanner(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.82)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H() * 0.14) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(title, W() / 2, H() * 0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cdd8ea'; ctx.font = Math.floor(H() * 0.045) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W() / 2, H() * 0.52);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H() * 0.05) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click to ' + (title === 'MISSION FAILED' ? 'Retry' : 'Play Again'), W() / 2, H() * 0.66);
}

function drawStart() {
  drawTerrain();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H() * 0.11) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('JAGGED ALLIANCE 2', W() / 2, H() * 0.32);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb4d0'; ctx.font = Math.floor(H() * 0.05) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('THE MERCENARY\'S GAMBIT', W() / 2, H() * 0.42);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cdd8ea'; ctx.font = Math.floor(H() * 0.038) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Select a merc, click to move or shoot, press P to pass the turn.', W() / 2, H() * 0.56);
  ctx.fillText('Destroy all enemies to win. Lose if your squad falls.', W() / 2, H() * 0.62);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5ad16a'; ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H() * 0.05) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('CLICK TO START', W() / 2, H() * 0.75);
}

/* ---------- Draw ---------- */
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W(), H());
  if (state.phase === 'start') { drawStart(); return; }
  drawTerrain();
  drawHighlights();
  for (const u of units) if (u.alive) drawUnit(u);
  drawShots();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  if (state.phase === 'win') drawBanner('MISSION COMPLETE', 'All hostiles eliminated. The contract is fulfilled.', '#5ad16a');
  if (state.phase === 'lose') drawBanner('MISSION FAILED', 'Your mercenary squad has been wiped out.', '#ff4d4d');
}

/* ---------- Main loop ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>ActRaiser</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#1a1a2e;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;overflow:hidden}
  #game{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="640" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ===== State =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

let state = 'title';
let score = 0;
let level = 1;
let maxLevel = 5;
let shake = 0;
let time = 0;
let message = '';
let messageTimer = 0;
let particles = [];
let clouds = [];
let stars = [];

// Player
const player = {
  x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
  w: 20, h: 24,
  onGround: false,
  facing: 1,
  fireCooldown: 0,
  invuln: 0
};

// Bullets
let bullets = [];

// Enemies
let enemies = [];

// Level geometry
let groundY = 0;
let platforms = [];
let goal = null;

// Input
const keys = {};

// ===== Init =====
function init() {
  player.x = W / 2;
  player.y = 0;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
  player.facing = 1;
  player.invuln = 0;
  bullets = [];
  enemies = [];
  particles = [];
  score = 0;
  level = 1;
  generateLevel();
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    clouds.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: 30 + Math.random() * 60, w: 40 + Math.random() * 50, speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3 });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * (H * 0.4), r: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5 });
  }
}

// ===== Level Generation =====
function generateLevel() {
  groundY = H - 50;
  platforms = [];
  enemies = [];
  goal = null;

  // Ground segments (with gaps)
  const gapCount = Math.min(level, 4);
  const gapWidth = 40 + level * 10;
  let x = 0;
  const segments = [];
  const totalW = W;
  const segCount = gapCount + 1;
  const segW = (totalW - gapCount * gapWidth) / segCount;

  for (let i = 0; i < segCount; i++) {
    segments.push({ x: x, w: segW });
    x += segW + gapWidth;
  }
  platforms.push(...segments.map(s => ({ x: s.x, y: groundY, w: s.w, h: H - groundY })));

  // Floating platforms
  const platCount = 3 + level;
  for (let i = 0; i < platCount; i++) {
    const px = 60 + Math.random() * (W - 180);
    const py = groundY - 60 - Math.random() * 120;
    const pw = 50 + Math.random() * 40;
    platforms.push({ x: px, y: py, w: pw, h: 12 });
  }

  // Enemies
  const enemyCount = 2 + level * 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < enemyCount; i++) {
    const ex = 80 + Math.random() * (W - 160);
    const ey = groundY - 30;
    enemies.push({
      x: ex, y: ey, vx: (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (0.5 + level * 0.15),
      w: 22, h: 20, hp: 1 + Math.floor(level / 3),
      type: i % 3 === 0 ? 'flying' : 'walker',
      flyY: groundY - 80 - Math.random() * 60,
      flyPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  // Goal at right edge
  goal = { x: W - 60, y: groundY - 50, w: 30, h: 50 };

  player.x = 40;
  player.y = groundY - player.h;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
}

// ===== Input =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (state === 'title' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    state = 'playing';
    init();
  }
  if (state === 'gameover' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    state = 'title';
  }
  if (state === 'win' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    state = 'title';
  }
  if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
});

// ===== Update =====
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  if (shake > 0) shake -= dt * 10;

  // Clouds
  clouds.forEach(c => {
    c.x += c.speed;
    if (c.x > W + c.w) c.x = -c.w;
  });

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  const speed = 3;
  const jumpPower = -10;
  const gravity = 0.45;

  if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) {
    player.vx = -speed;
    player.facing = -1;
  } else if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) {
    player.vx = speed;
    player.facing = 1;
  } else {
    player.vx *= 0.8;
  }

  if ((keys['w'] || keys['arrowup'] || keys[' ']) && player.onGround) {
    player.vy = jumpPower;
    player.onGround = false;
  }

  player.vy += gravity;
  if (player.vy > 12) player.vy = 12;

  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // Clamp to screen
  if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
  if (player.x + player.w > W) player.x = W - player.w;

  // Collision with platforms
  player.onGround = false;
  platforms.forEach(p => {
    if (player.x + player.w > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.w) {
      // Landing on top
      if (player.vy >= 0 && player.y + player.h > p.y && player.y + player.h < p.y + p.h + player.vy + 2) {
        player.y = p.y - player.h;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.onGround = true;
      }
      // Hitting from below
      if (player.vy < 0 && player.y < p.y + p.h && player.y > p.y - 2) {
        player.y = p.y + p.h;
        player.vy = 0;
      }
    }
    // Side collision
    if (player.y + player.h > p.y + 4 && player.y < p.y + p.h - 4) {
      if (player.vx > 0 && player.x + player.w > p.x && player.x + player.w < p.x + 10) {
        player.x = p.x - player.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
      if (player.vx < 0 && player.x < p.x + p.w && player.x > p.x + p.w - 10) {
        player.x = p.x + p.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      }
    }
  });

  // Fall in pit
  if (player.y > H + 50) {
    state = 'gameover';
    message = 'You fell into the abyss!';
    messageTimer = 3;
  }

  // Fire
  if (player.fireCooldown > 0) player.fireCooldown -= dt;
  if ((keys['j'] || keys['z'] || keys['x']) && player.fireCooldown <= 0) {
    bullets.push({
      x: player.x + (player.facing > 0 ? player.w : -10),
      y: player.y + player.h / 2 - 4,
      vx: player.facing * 6,
      w: 10, h: 6
    });
    player.fireCooldown = 0.25;
  }

  // Update bullets
  bullets.forEach(b => { b.x += b.vx; });
  bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20);

  // Update enemies
  enemies.forEach(en => {
    if (en.type === 'flying') {
      en.flyPhase += dt * 2;
      en.y = en.flyY + Math.sin(en.flyPhase) * 20;
      en.x += en.vx;
      if (en.x < 20 || en.x + en.w > W - 20) en.vx *= -1;
    } else {
      en.x += en.vx;
      if (en.x < 20 || en.x + en.w > W - 20) en.vx *= -1;
      // Simple gravity for walkers
      let onPlat = false;
      platforms.forEach(p => {
        if (en.x + en.w > p.x && en.x < p.x + p.w && en.y + en.h >= p.y && en.y + en.h <= p.y + p.h + 5) {
          en.y = p.y - en.h;
          onPlat = true;
        }
      });
      if (!onPlat) en.y += 2;
    }

    // Bullet hit
    bullets.forEach(b => {
      if (b.x + b.w > en.x && b.x < en.x + en.w && b.y + b.h > en.y && b.y < en.y + en.h) {
        en.hp--;
        b.x = -100;
        spawnParticles(en.x + en.w / 2, en.y + en.h / 2, '#ff6644', 5);
        if (en.hp <= 0) {
          score += 100 * level;
          spawnParticles(en.x + en.w / 2, en.y + en.h / 2, '#ffaa00', 10);
          shake = 3;
        }
      }
    });
    enemies = enemies.filter(en => en.hp > 0);

    // Player collision
    if (player.invuln <= 0) {
      if (player.x + player.w > en.x && player.x < en.x + en.w &&
          player.y + player.h > en.y && player.y < en.y + en.h) {
        player.invuln = 1.5;
        player.vy = -6;
        player.vx = (player.x < en.x) ? -3 : 3;
        score = Math.max(0, score - 50);
        shake = 5;
        spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#ff4444', 8);
      }
    }
  });

  if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;

  // Goal check
  if (goal) {
    if (player.x + player.w > goal.x && player.x < goal.x + goal.w &&
        player.y + player.h > goal.y && player.y < goal.y + goal.h) {
      score += 500 * level;
      if (level >= maxLevel) {
        state = 'win';
        message = 'You have raised the kingdom!';
        messageTimer = 5;
      } else {
        level++;
        message = 'Level ' + level + ' - The kingdom grows!';
        messageTimer = 2;
        generateLevel();
      }
    }
  }

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life -= dt;
  });
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

  if (messageTimer > 0) messageTimer -= dt;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 1,
      life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
      color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
    });
  }
}

// ===== Draw =====
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  }

  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a3e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#2d1b69');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#4a2c8a');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#6b3fa0');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  stars.forEach(s => {
    const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 0.5 + s.x));
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe4b5';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 80, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a3e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - 70, 45, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1555';
  drawMountain(0, groundY, 80, 120);
  drawMountain(100, groundY, 100, 150);
  drawMountain(250, groundY, 90, 100);
  drawMountain(380, groundY, 110, 140);
  drawMountain(500, groundY, 85, 110);

  // Clouds
  clouds.forEach(c => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,180,255,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y, c.w / 2, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w / 3, c.y - 5, c.w / 3, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // Platforms / Ground
  platforms.forEach(p => {
    if (p.h > 20) {
      // Ground
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3d2b1f';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a8a3a';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a7a2a';
      for (let gx = p.x; gx < p.x + p.w; gx += 8) {
        ctx.fillRect(gx, p.y - 2, 3, 4);
      }
    } else {
      // Floating platform
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6b4423';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8b6433';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a1a';
      ctx.fillRect(p.x + 2, p.y + p.h - 3, p.w - 4, 3);
    }
  });

  // Goal / Temple
  if (goal) {
    const gx = goal.x, gy = goal.y;
    // Base
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8a85a';
    ctx.fillRect(gx - 5, gy + goal.h - 10, goal.w + 10, 10);
    // Tower
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4b86a';
    ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, goal.w, goal.h);
    // Roof
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a2a2a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx - 10, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + goal.w / 2, gy - 25);
    ctx.lineTo(gx + goal.w + 10, gy);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Door
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a2a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(gx + goal.w / 2 - 6, gy + goal.h - 20, 12, 20);
    // Glow
    const glowAlpha = 0.3 + 0.2 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,220,100,${glowAlpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(gx + goal.w / 2, gy + goal.h / 2, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Banner
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a6a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(gx + goal.w / 2 - 3, gy - 20, 6, 15);
  }

  // Enemies
  enemies.forEach(en => {
    if (en.type === 'flying') {
      // Bat
      const wingFlap = Math.sin(time * 8 + en.flyPhase) * 8;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6a2a8a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(en.x + en.w / 2, en.y + en.h / 2, en.w / 2, en.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Wings
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8a3aaa';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(en.x + 2, en.y + en.h / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x - 10, en.y + en.h / 2 - wingFlap);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + 5, en.y + en.h / 2 + 3);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(en.x + en.w - 2, en.y + en.h / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + en.w + 10, en.y + en.h / 2 - wingFlap);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + en.w - 5, en.y + en.h / 2 + 3);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      // Eyes
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + en.w / 2 - 4, en.y + en.h / 2 - 3, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + en.w / 2 + 2, en.y + en.h / 2 - 3, 3, 3);
    } else {
      // Walker / Demon
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8a3a2a';
      ctx.fillRect(en.x, en.y, en.w, en.h);
      // Head
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aa4a3a';
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + 2, en.y - 6, en.w - 4, 10);
      // Horns
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ddaa66';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(en.x + 4, en.y - 6);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + 1, en.y - 14);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + 7, en.y - 6);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(en.x + en.w - 4, en.y - 6);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + en.w - 1, en.y - 14);
      ctx.lineTo(en.x + en.w - 7, en.y - 6);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      // Eyes
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + en.w / 2 - 5, en.y - 3, 4, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + en.w / 2 + 2, en.y - 3, 4, 3);
      // Legs
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6a2a1a';
      const legOffset = Math.sin(time * 6) * 3;
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + 3, en.y + en.h - 4, 5, 4 + legOffset);
      ctx.fillRect(en.x + en.w - 8, en.y + en.h - 4, 5, 4 - legOffset);
    }
  });

  // Bullets
  bullets.forEach(b => {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 2, b.y + 1, b.w - 4, b.h - 2);
    // Trail
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,50,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - (b.vx > 0 ? 8 : -8), b.y + 1, 8, b.h - 2);
  });

  // Player
  if (player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(player.invuln * 10) % 2 === 0) {
    // Flash - skip draw
  } else {
    drawPlayer();
  }

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.life * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  if (state === 'playing') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 10, 18);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('LEVEL ' + level + '/' + maxLevel, W / 2, 18);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('ENEMIES: ' + enemies.length, W - 10, 18);
  }

  // Message
  if (messageTimer > 0 && message) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 150, H / 2 - 30, 300, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd88';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(message, W / 2, H / 2);
  }

  // Title screen
  if (state === 'title') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('ACT RAISER', W / 2, 120);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaacc';
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Raise the kingdom. Defeat the demons.', W / 2, 170);
    ctx.fillText('Clear all ' + maxLevel + ' levels to win.', W / 2, 195);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('A/D or Arrow Keys - Move', W / 2, 240);
    ctx.fillText('W / Up / Space - Jump', W / 2, 260);
    ctx.fillText('J / Z / X - Fire', W / 2, 280);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    const blink = Math.sin(time * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to start', W / 2, 340);
  }

  // Game over
  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, 150);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 200);
    const blink = Math.sin(time * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to return', W / 2, 280);
  }

  // Win
  if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,40,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('VICTORY!', W / 2, 130);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ff88';
    ctx.font = '20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('The kingdom is raised in glory!', W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 220);
    const blink = Math.sin(time * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to return', W / 2, 300);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMountain(x, baseY, w, h) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, baseY);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, baseY - h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const px = player.x, py = player.y, pw = player.w, ph = player.h;
  const f = player.facing;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5aaa';
  ctx.fillRect(px + 3, py + 8, pw - 6, ph - 8);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
  ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py, pw - 8, 10);

  // Hair / Headband
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  ctx.fillRect(px + 3, py + 2, pw - 6, 3);

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
  if (f > 0) {
    ctx.fillRect(px + pw - 10, py + 4, 3, 3);
  } else {
    ctx.fillRect(px + 7, py + 4, 3, 3);
  }

  // Cape
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aa2244';
  const capeWave = Math.sin(time * 5) * 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + (f > 0 ? 2 : pw - 2), py + 10);
  ctx.lineTo(px + (f > 0 ? -4 : pw + 4), py + ph - 4 + capeWave);
  ctx.lineTo(px + (f > 0 ? 6 : pw - 6), py + ph - 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a6a';
  const legAnim = Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? Math.sin(time * 10) * 4 : 0;
  ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + ph - 6, 5, 6 + legAnim);
  ctx.fillRect(px + pw - 9, py + ph - 6, 5, 6 - legAnim);

  // Sword / staff
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ccaa44';
  const swordX = f > 0 ? px + pw - 2 : px - 6;
  ctx.fillRect(swordX, py + 6, 4, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(swordX + 1, py + 2, 2, 5);
}

// ===== Game Loop =====
let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Start
init();
state = 'title';
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Aliens vs Predator</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #05070b;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Arial", sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #05070b;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = 960;
  const H = 540;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  function resize(){
    const maxW = window.innerWidth;
    const maxH = window.innerHeight;
    const scale = Math.min(maxW / W, maxH / H, 1);
    canvas.style.width = (W * scale) + "px";
    canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + "px";
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- state ----------
  let state = "start";   // start | playing | won | lost
  let score = 0;
  let kills = 0;
  let frame = 0;
  const goal = 8;

  const player = {
    x: 120, y: 300,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    hp: 100,
    facing: 1,
    walk: 0,
    shootCd: 0,
    muzzle: 0
  };

  const bullets = [];
  const aliens = [];
  const particles = [];
  const keys = {};

  // ---------- input ----------
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (state === "start" && (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter")) startGame();
    else if ((state === "won" || state === "lost") && (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter")) startGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", function(e){
    keys[e.code] = false;
  });

  function startGame(){
    state = "playing";
    score = 0;
    kills = 0;
    frame = 0;
    bullets.length = 0;
    aliens.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    player.x = 120; player.y = 300;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.hp = 100;
    player.facing = 1;
    player.shootCd = 0;
    player.muzzle = 0;
  }

  // ---------- spawn helpers ----------
  function spawnAlien(){
    const fromTop = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = 60 + Math.random() * (W - 120);
    const y = fromTop ? -30 : H + 30;
    aliens.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      hp: 30,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      hit: 0
    });
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count){
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++){
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
        max: 40,
        color: color,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(){
    if (state !== "playing") return;
    frame++;

    // player movement
    const speed = 3.4;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    if (keys["KeyA"] || keys["ArrowLeft"])  { player.vx -= speed; player.facing = -1; }
    if (keys["KeyD"] || keys["ArrowRight"]) { player.vx += speed; player.facing = 1; }
    if (keys["KeyW"] || keys["ArrowUp"])    player.vy -= speed;
    if (keys["KeyS"] || keys["ArrowDown"])  player.vy += speed;

    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;
    player.x = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(50, Math.min(H - 30, player.y));
    if (player.vx !== 0 || player.vy !== 0) player.walk += 0.25;

    if (player.shootCd > 0) player.shootCd--;
    if (player.muzzle > 0) player.muzzle--;

    // shooting
    if ((keys["KeyJ"] || keys["KeyK"] || keys["Space"]) && player.shootCd === 0){
      player.shootCd = 14;
      player.muzzle = 5;
      const dir = player.facing;
      bullets.push({
        x: player.x + dir * 20,
        y: player.y - 6,
        vx: dir * 9,
        vy: 0,
        life: 120
      });
    }

    // spawn aliens
    const maxAliens = 5;
    if (aliens.length < maxAliens && frame % 90 === 0) spawnAlien();

    // bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      b.life--;
      if (b.life <= 0 || b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10){
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // hit aliens
      for (let j = aliens.length - 1; j >= 0; j--){
        const a = aliens[j];
        if (Math.abs(b.x - a.x) < 18 && Math.abs(b.y - a.y) < 24){
          a.hp -= 12;
          a.hit = 6;
          spawnParticles(b.x, b.y, "#ff5a2a", 6);
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          if (a.hp <= 0){
            spawnParticles(a.x, a.y, "#4fd66a", 18);
            aliens.splice(j, 1);
            kills++;
            score += 100;
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // aliens
    for (let i = aliens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const a = aliens[i];
      a.phase += 0.15;
      if (a.hit > 0) a.hit--;
      // move toward player
      const dx = player.x - a.x;
      const dy = player.y - a.y;
      const d = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) || 1;
      const spd = 1.5;
      a.vx = (dx / d) * spd;
      a.vy = (dy / d) * spd;
      a.x += a.vx + Math.sin(a.phase) * 0.6;
      a.y += a.vy;

      // attack
      if (d < 34 && frame % 25 === 0){
        player.hp -= 10;
        spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, "#ff3b3b", 8);
        if (player.hp <= 0){
          player.hp = 0;
          state = "lost";
        }
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // win
    if (kills >= goal){
      state = "won";
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    // sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#1a1030");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#241838");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#0a0a14");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++){
      const sx = (i * 137) % W;
      const sy = (i * 89) % (H * 0.5);
      const tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.05 + i);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.3 + tw * 0.5) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
    }

    // distant mountains
    ctx.fillStyle = "#140f24";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 320);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 60){
      const h = 320 - (Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 40 + 30);
      ctx.lineTo(x, h);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 340, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, "#2a2038");
    gg.addColorStop(1, "#0c0a16");
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 340, W, H - 340);

    // ground grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,90,180,0.15)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++){
      const y = 350 + i * 20;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const x = player.x;
    const y = player.y;
    const f = player.facing;
    const bob = Math.sin(player.walk) * 2;

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3f4a";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y + 10 + bob, 6, 14);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 10 - bob, 6, 14);

    // body / armor
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6478";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y - 10, 24, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a869c";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y - 10, 24, 8);

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a94a8";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 18, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // visor
    ctx.fillStyle = "#22d3ee";
    ctx.fillRect(x + (f > 0 ? 0 : -10), y - 20, 10, 4);

    // gun
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2f3a";
    ctx.fillRect(x + (f > 0 ? 8 : -22), y - 4, 14, 5);

    // muzzle flash
    if (player.muzzle > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.9)";
      const mx = x + (f > 0 ? 24 : -24);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mx, y - 2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawAlien(a){
    const x = a.x;
    const y = a.y;
    const flap = Math.sin(a.phase) * 4;
    const tint = a.hit > 0 ? "#ffffff" : "#3f8f4f";

    // tail
    ctx.strokeStyle = tint;
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + 12);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 14, y + 20, x + 22, y + 10 + flap);
    ctx.stroke();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = tint;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 12, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y - 18, 10, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3b3b";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 4, y - 20, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 4, y - 20, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // claws
    ctx.strokeStyle = tint;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 10, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 18, y + flap);
    ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 18, y - flap);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawBullets(){
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14d";
    for (let i = 0; i < bullets.length; i++){
      const b = bullets[i];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // trail
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,200,60,0.4)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x - b.vx, b.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14d";
    }
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++){
      const p = particles[i];
      const alpha = p.life / p.max;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size/2, p.y - p.size/2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    // health bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(16, 16, 200, 22);
    ctx.fillStyle = player.hp > 30 ? "#4fd66a" : "#ff5a2a";
    ctx.fillRect(18, 18, (196 * player.hp / 100), 18);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a94a8";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(16, 16, 200, 22);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("HEALTH", 24, 32);

    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14d";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, W - 180, 34);

    // progress
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a94a8";
    ctx.font = "14px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("ALIENS: " + kills + " / " + goal, W - 180, 56);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, color, sub){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 48px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "20px Arial";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a94a8";
    ctx.font = "16px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to start", W/2, H/2 + 50);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function draw(){
    drawBackground();
    drawParticles();
    for (let i = 0; i < aliens.length; i++) drawAlien(aliens[i]);
    drawBullets();
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") drawOverlay("ALIENS vs PREDATOR", "#ff5a2a", "Defeat " + goal + " aliens to win");
    else if (state === "won") drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "#4fd66a", "Score: " + score);
    else if (state === "lost") drawOverlay("GAME OVER", "#ff3b3b", "Score: " + score);
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
