let lastTime = 0;
let gameOverTime = 0;

// ===== INPUT =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true; });
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
  mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
  if (state === 'start') { state = 'playing'; startWave(1); return; }
  if (state === 'dead') { resetGame(); return; }
  mouse.down = true;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouse.down = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());

// ===== HELPERS =====
function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

function startWave(n) {
  wave = n;
  waveTimer = 120;
  waveEnemiesToSpawn = 3 + n * 2;
  waveEnemiesSpawned = 0;
  waveEnemiesAlive = 0;
}

function spawnEnemy() {
  const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  let ex, ey;
  if (side === 0) { ex = Math.random() * W; ey = -30; }
  else if (side === 1) { ex = W + 30; ey = Math.random() * H; }
  else if (side === 2) { ex = Math.random() * W; ey = H + 30; }
  else { ex = -30; ey = Math.random() * H; }
  const isHeavy = wave >= 3 && Math.random() < 0.25;
  const isFast = wave >= 2 && Math.random() < 0.3;
  enemies.push({
    x: ex, y: ey,
    hp: isHeavy ? 80 : (isFast ? 30 : 50),
    maxHp: isHeavy ? 80 : (isFast ? 30 : 50),
    speed: isFast ? 2.8 : (isHeavy ? 1.2 : 2.0),
    radius: isHeavy ? 20 : (isFast ? 10 : 14),
    type: isHeavy ? 'heavy' : (isFast ? 'fast' : 'normal'),
    fireCooldown: 60 + Math.random() * 60,
    angle: 0
  });
  waveEnemiesSpawned++;
  waveEnemiesAlive++;
}

function fireBullet(x, y, angle, speed, fromEnemy) {
  bullets.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, fromEnemy, life: 120 });
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 20 + Math.random() * 20, color });
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  score = 0; kills = 0;
  player.hp = player.maxHp;
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H/2;
  bullets = []; enemies = []; particles = [];
  startWave(1);
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  let dx = 0, dy = 0;
  if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) dy -= 1;
  if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) dy += 1;
  if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) dx -= 1;
  if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) dx += 1;
  if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    player.x += (dx / len) * player.speed;
    player.y += (dy / len) * player.speed;
  }
  player.x = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(W - player.radius, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(H - player.radius, player.y));

  // Player shooting
  if (player.fireCooldown > 0) player.fireCooldown--;
  if (mouse.down && player.fireCooldown <= 0) {
    const angle = Math.atan2(mouse.y - player.y, mouse.x - player.x);
    fireBullet(player.x + Math.cos(angle) * 20, player.y + Math.sin(angle) * 20, angle, 8, false);
    player.fireCooldown = player.fireRate;
    muzzleFlash = 6;
    screenShake = 3;
  }
  if (muzzleFlash > 0) muzzleFlash--;
  if (screenShake > 0) screenShake *= 0.85;
  if (screenShake < 0.5) screenShake = 0;

  // Wave spawning
  if (waveTimer > 0) waveTimer--;
  else if (waveEnemiesSpawned < waveEnemiesToSpawn) {
    if (waveEnemiesAlive < 5) spawnEnemy();
  } else if (waveEnemiesAlive <= 0) {
    startWave(wave + 1);
  }

  // Bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy; b.life--;
    if (b.life <= 0 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20) {
      bullets.splice(i, 1); continue;
    }
    if (!b.fromEnemy) {
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const e = enemies[j];
        if (dist(b, e) < e.radius + 4) {
          e.hp -= 15;
          spawnParticles(b.x, b.y, '#ff4444', 4);
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          if (e.hp <= 0) {
            spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, '#ff6600', 12);
            spawnParticles(e.x, e.y, '#ffaa00', 8);
            enemies.splice(j, 1);
            kills++;
            score += e.type === 'heavy' ? 300 : (e.type === 'fast' ? 150 : 200);
            waveEnemiesAlive--;
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    } else {
      if (dist(b, player) < player.radius + 4) {
        player.hp -= 10;
        spawnParticles(b.x, b.y, '#ff2222', 6);
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        screenShake = 5;
        if (player.hp <= 0) {
          player.hp = 0;
          state = 'dead';
          gameOverTime = 0;
          spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff0000', 20);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    const angle = Math.atan2(player.y - e.y, player.x - e.x);
    e.angle = angle;
    const d = dist(e, player);
    if (d > e.radius + player.radius + 20) {
      e.x += Math.cos(angle) * e.speed;
      e.y += Math.sin(angle) * e.speed;
    }
    if (e.fireCooldown > 0) e.fireCooldown--;
    if (e.fireCooldown <= 0 && d < 350) {
      const spread = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
      fireBullet(e.x + Math.cos(angle) * (e.radius + 5), e.y + Math.sin(angle) * (e.radius + 5), angle + spread, 5, true);
      e.fireCooldown = e.type === 'heavy' ? 90 : (e.type === 'fast' ? 50 : 70);
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.95; p.vy *= 0.95;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function drawBackground() {
  // Night sky gradient
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#0a1628');
  bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#142030');
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#0d1a1a');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89 + 20) % (H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }

  // Distant city skyline
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a1018';
  const buildings = [
    {x:0,w:60,h:120},{x:60,w:40,h:90},{x:100,w:70,h:150},{x:170,w:50,h:100},
    {x:220,w:80,h:130},{x:300,w:45,h:110},{x:345,w:65,h:140},{x:410,w:55,h:95},
    {x:465,w:75,h:155},{x:540,w:50,h:105},{x:590,w:60,h:125},{x:650,w:45,h:90},
    {x:695,w:70,h:145},{x:765,w:55,h:115},{x:820,w:80,h:135}
  ];
  for (const b of buildings) {
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, H * 0.35 - b.h, b.w, b.h);
  }
  // Windows on buildings
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,50,0.5)';
  for (const b of buildings) {
    for (let wy = H * 0.35 - b.h + 10; wy < H * 0.35 - 10; wy += 18) {
      for (let wx = b.x + 8; wx < b.x + b.w - 8; wx += 14) {
        if ((wx * 7 + wy * 3) % 5 < 2) {
          ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 5, 7);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Ground - dark concrete / urban floor
  const ground = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.35, 0, H);
  ground.addColorStop(0, '#1a2520');
  ground.addColorStop(0.3, '#1e2a25');
  ground.addColorStop(1, '#151f1a');
  ctx.fillStyle = ground;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.35, W, H * 0.65);

  // Grid lines on ground
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,60,50,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let gx = 0; gx < W; gx += 60) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx, H * 0.35); ctx.lineTo(gx, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let gy = H * 0.35; gy < H; gy += 45) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, gy); ctx.lineTo(W, gy); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Cracks / debris
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,40,35,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(100, H * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(180, H * 0.55); ctx.lineTo(220, H * 0.52);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(600, H * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(680, H * 0.65); ctx.lineTo(720, H * 0.62);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Debris / rubble
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3530';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(150, H * 0.7, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#253028';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(700, H * 0.55, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#283328';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(450, H * 0.75, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Barricade / wall segments
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4540';
  ctx.fillRect(200, H * 0.4, 80, 15);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#354038';
  ctx.fillRect(550, H * 0.45, 70, 15);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4540';
  ctx.fillRect(350, H * 0.8, 90, 15);

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,210,230,0.15)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W * 0.8, H * 0.12, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,230,250,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W * 0.8, H * 0.12, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const px = player.x, py = player.y;
  const aimAngle = Math.atan2(mouse.y - py, mouse.x - px);

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py + 12, 18, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Body (operator in tactical gear)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a2a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Tactical vest
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4a35';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, player.radius - 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Head / helmet
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1e2e1e';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Visor / face
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4a6a5a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + Math.cos(aimAngle) * 3, py + Math.sin(aimAngle) * 3, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Gun (points toward mouse)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px, py);
  ctx.rotate(aimAngle);
  // Gun barrel
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(8, -3, 22, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a';
  ctx.fillRect(8, -2, 18, 4);
  // Muzzle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(26, -4, 5, 8);
  // Muzzle flash
  if (muzzleFlash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,50,${muzzleFlash / 6})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(33, 0, 8 + muzzleFlash, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,200,${muzzleFlash / 8})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(33, 0, 4 + muzzleFlash * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const ex = e.x, ey = e.y;
  const colors = {
    normal: { body: '#5a3030', vest: '#6a3a35', head: '#3a2020' },
    fast:   { body: '#5a5030', vest: '#6a5a35', head: '#3a3520' },
    heavy:  { body: '#4a2a3a', vest: '#5a3a45', head: '#2a1a2a' }
  };
  const c = colors[e.type];

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ex, ey + e.radius * 0.8, e.radius + 4, e.radius * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = c.body;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Vest
  ctx.fillStyle = c.vest;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e.radius - 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = c.head;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e.radius * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Eyes (red glow)
  const eyeOff = e.radius * 0.2;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex + Math.cos(e.angle) * eyeOff - Math.sin(e.angle) * eyeOff * 0.5, ey + Math.sin(e.angle) * eyeOff + Math.cos(e.angle) * eyeOff * 0.5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex + Math.cos(e.angle) * eyeOff + Math.sin(e.angle) * eyeOff * 0.5, ey + Math.sin(e.angle) * eyeOff - Math.cos(e.angle) * eyeOff * 0.5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Gun
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(ex, ey);
  ctx.rotate(e.angle);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(5, -2, 14, 4);
  ctx.restore();

  // Health bar
  const barW = e.radius * 2;
  const barH = 4;
  const barX = ex - barW / 2;
  const barY = ey - e.radius - 12;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  const hpPct = e.hp / e.maxHp;
  ctx.fillStyle = hpPct > 0.5 ? '#44cc44' : (hpPct > 0.25 ? '#ccaa22' : '#cc3333');
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * hpPct, barH);
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    if (b.fromEnemy) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8888';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffaa';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / 40;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2 + alpha * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Health bar
  const hpW = 200, hpH = 20;
  const hpX = 20, hpY = H - 40;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(hpX - 2, hpY - 2, hpW + 4, hpH + 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.fillRect(hpX, hpY, hpW, hpH);
  const hpPct = player.hp / player.maxHp;
  const hpColor = hpPct > 0.5 ? '#44cc44' : (hpPct > 0.25 ? '#ccaa22' : '#cc3333');
  ctx.fillStyle = hpColor;
  ctx.fillRect(hpX, hpY, hpW * hpPct, hpH);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('HP ' + Math.ceil(player.hp) + '/' + player.maxHp, hpX + 5, hpY + 15);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 20, 35);

  // Wave
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaccff';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + wave, 20, 60);

  // Kills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.fillText('KILLS: ' + kills, 20, 85);

  // Wave progress
  const total = waveEnemiesToSpawn;
  const remaining = total - waveEnemiesSpawned + waveEnemiesAlive;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '13px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Enemies: ' + remaining + '/' + total, 20, 108);

  // Crosshair
  const cx = mouse.x, cy = mouse.y;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,50,50,0.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 15, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx - 5, cy); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + 5, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + 15, cy); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - 15); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - 5); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + 5); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + 15); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('MODERN WARFARE 2', W/2, H/2 - 80);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('NIGHT RAID', W/2, H/2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaccff';
  ctx.font = '16px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Defend the position. Survive the waves.', W/2, H/2 + 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#88aa88';
  ctx.font = '14px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrow Keys — Move', W/2, H/2 + 50);
  ctx.fillText('Mouse — Aim | Click / Hold — Fire', W/2, H/2 + 75);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('[ CLICK TO START ]', W/2, H/2 + 130);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawDeathScreen() {
  gameOverTime++;
  const alpha = Math.min(0.8, gameOverTime / 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(40,0,0,${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (gameOverTime > 30) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('K.I.A.', W/2, H/2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaccff';
    ctx.font = '18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Kills: ' + kills + '  |  Wave Reached: ' + wave, W/2, H/2 + 45);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText('[ CLICK TO RESTART ]', W/2, H/2 + 100);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (screenShake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2, (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  drawBullets();
  if (state === 'playing') drawPlayer();

  ctx.restore();

  if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();
  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'dead') drawDeathScreen();
}

// ===== GAME LOOP =====
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Phantasy Star III: Generations of Doom</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #1a0f2e 0%, #050308 70%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #game {
    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(120,60,200,0.5), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
    border: 2px solid #2a1a4a;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="640" height="360"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  const STATE = { TITLE:0, PLAY:1, WIN:2, LOSE:3 };
  let gameState = STATE.TITLE;
  let score = 0;
  let kills = 0;
  const KILLS_TO_WIN = 12;
  let time = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  const player = {
    x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 10,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    hp: 5, maxHp: 5,
    invuln: 0,
    fireCd: 0,
    angle: 0
  };

  const bullets = [];
  const enemies = [];
  const particles = [];
  const stars = [];
  const powerups = [];

  const keys = {};

  // ---------- INIT HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }

  function makeStars(){
    stars.length = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<120;i++){
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H,
        z: Math.random()*0.8 + 0.2,
        tw: Math.random()*TAU
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGame(){
    score = 0; kills = 0;
    player.x = W/2; player.y = H/2;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.hp = player.maxHp;
    player.invuln = 1.5;
    player.fireCd = 0;
    bullets.length = 0; enemies.length = 0; particles.length = 0; powerups.length = 0;
    makeStars();
    spawnEnemy('grunt', 0, 0);
    spawnEnemy('grunt', 0, 0);
  }

  function spawnEnemy(type, fx, fy){
    let e = {
      type: type,
      x: 0, y: 0, r: 14,
      hp: 2, maxHp: 2,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      fireCd: rand(1,3),
      angle: 0,
      t: Math.random()*TAU,
      phase: rand(0, TAU)
    };
    // spawn at edge
    const side = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
    if(side===0){ e.x = -20; e.y = rand(0,H); }
    else if(side===1){ e.x = W+20; e.y = rand(0,H); }
    else if(side===2){ e.x = rand(0,W); e.y = -20; }
    else { e.x = rand(0,W); e.y = H+20; }
    if(type==='brute'){ e.hp = e.maxHp = 5; e.r = 20; }
    if(type==='wisp'){ e.hp = e.maxHp = 1; e.r = 9; }
    enemies.push(e);
  }

  function spawnPowerup(x,y){
    powerups.push({ x:x, y:y, t:0, type: 'hp' });
  }

  function burst(x,y,color,n,spd){
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a = Math.random()*TAU;
      const s = rand(0.5, spd);
      particles.push({
        x:x, y:y,
        vx: Math.cos(a)*s, vy: Math.sin(a)*s,
        life: rand(0.4,0.9), maxLife: 0.9,
        color: color, r: rand(1,3)
      });
    }
  }

  function fireBullet(x,y,angle,spd,color){
    bullets.push({ x:x, y:y, vx:Math.cos(angle)*spd, vy:Math.sin(angle)*spd, color:color, r:3, life:2.5, mine:true });
  }

  function enemyFire(x,y,angle,spd){
    bullets.push({ x:x, y:y, vx:Math.cos(angle)*spd, vy:Math.sin(angle)*spd, color:'#ff5a3c', r:3, life:3, mine:false });
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if(e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter'){
      if(gameState === STATE.TITLE){ resetGame(); gameState = STATE.PLAY; }
      else if(gameState === STATE.WIN || gameState === STATE.LOSE){ gameState = STATE.TITLE; }
    }
    if(e.code === 'Space') e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[e.code] = false; });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt){
    time += dt;
    if(shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt*30);

    // stars always drift
    for(const s of stars){
      s.x -= s.z * dt * 12;
      s.tw += dt*2;
      if(s.x < 0){ s.x += W; }
    }

    if(gameState !== STATE.PLAY){
      updateParticles(dt);
      return;
    }

    // player movement
    let ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if(keys['KeyW'] || keys['ArrowUp']) ay -= 1;
    if(keys['KeyS'] || keys['ArrowDown']) ay += 1;
    if(keys['KeyA'] || keys['ArrowLeft']) ax -= 1;
    if(keys['KeyD'] || keys['ArrowRight']) ax += 1;
    const mag = Math.hypot(ax,ay);
    if(mag > 0){ ax/=mag; ay/=mag; }
    const acc = 600;
    player.vx += ax*acc*dt;
    player.vy += ay*acc*dt;
    // friction
    player.vx *= Math.pow(0.0008, dt);
    player.vy *= Math.pow(0.0008, dt);
    const maxSpd = 240;
    const sp = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
    if(sp > maxSpd){ player.vx = player.vx/sp*maxSpd; player.vy = player.vy/sp*maxSpd; }
    player.x += player.vx*dt;
    player.y += player.vy*dt;
    player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W-player.r, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H-player.r, player.y));

    if(player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;
    if(player.fireCd > 0) player.fireCd -= dt;

    // aim: toward mouse-ish (use last movement direction or fixed up)
    // We'll aim toward the nearest enemy for auto-target feel
    let aim = player.angle;
    let best = null, bestD = 1e9;
    for(const e of enemies){
      const d = Math.hypot(e.x-player.x, e.y-player.y);
      if(d < bestD){ bestD = d; best = e; }
    }
    if(best){ aim = Math.atan2(best.y-player.y, best.x-player.x); }
    player.angle = aim;

    // firing
    if((keys['KeyJ'] || keys['KeyK'] || keys['KeyF'] || keys['KeyX'] || keys['Space']) && player.fireCd <= 0){
      fireBullet(player.x + Math.cos(aim)*14, player.y + Math.sin(aim)*14, aim, 520, '#7ff0ff');
      player.fireCd = 0.18;
      shake = Math.max(shake, 2);
    }

    // update bullets
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt; b.life -= dt;
      if(b.life <= 0 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W+20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H+20){
        bullets.splice(i,1); continue;
      }
      if(b.mine){
        // hit enemies
        for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
          const e = enemies[j];
          if(Math.hypot(e.x-b.x, e.y-b.y) < e.r + b.r){
            e.hp -= 1;
            burst(b.x, b.y, '#7ff0ff', 6, 120);
            bullets.splice(i,1);
            if(e.hp <= 0){
              kills++;
              score += (e.type==='brute'?300: e.type==='wisp'?150:200);
              burst(e.x, e.y, e.type==='brute'?'#ff7a3c':e.type==='wisp'?'#c07fff':'#ff5a3c', 20, 200);
              if(Math.random() < 0.25 && player.hp < player.maxHp){ spawnPowerup(e.x, e.y); }
              enemies.splice(j,1);
              if(kills >= KILLS_TO_WIN){ gameState = STATE.WIN; }
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      } else {
        // hit player
        if(player.invuln <= 0 && Math.hypot(player.x-b.x, player.y-b.y) < player.r + b.r){
          player.hp -= 1;
          player.invuln = 1.2;
          shake = 8;
          burst(player.x, player.y, '#ff3030', 14, 180);
          bullets.splice(i,1);
          if(player.hp <= 0){ gameState = STATE.LOSE; }
        }
      }
    }

    // update enemies
    for(const e of enemies){
      e.t += dt;
      const dx = player.x - e.x, dy = player.y - e.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
      e.angle = Math.atan2(dy,dx);
      let sp = e.type==='wisp' ? 150 : e.type==='brute' ? 70 : 100;
      // wisp strafes
      if(e.type==='wisp'){
        const strafe = Math.cos(e.t*2 + e.phase);
        e.x += (dx/d*sp + (-dy/d)*strafe*120)*dt;
        e.y += (dy/d*sp + (dx/d)*strafe*120)*dt;
      } else {
        e.x += (dx/d*sp)*dt;
        e.y += (dy/d*sp)*dt;
      }
      // keep in bounds loosely
      e.x = Math.max(-40, Math.min(W+40, e.x));
      e.y = Math.max(-40, Math.min(H+40, e.y));

      // fire
      e.fireCd -= dt;
      if(e.fireCd <= 0 && d < 320){
        if(e.type==='brute'){
          for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){ enemyFire(e.x, e.y, e.angle + k*0.25, 220); }
          e.fireCd = rand(1.8,2.6);
        } else {
          enemyFire(e.x, e.y, e.angle, e.type==='wisp'?300:240);
          e.fireCd = e.type==='wisp' ? rand(0.8,1.2) : rand(1.4,2.2);
        }
      }

      // contact damage
      if(player.invuln <= 0 && Math.hypot(player.x-e.x, player.y-e.y) < player.r + e.r){
        player.hp -= 1;
        player.invuln = 1.2;
        shake = 8;
        burst(player.x, player.y, '#ff3030', 14, 180);
        if(player.hp <= 0){ gameState = STATE.LOSE; }
      }
    }

    // spawn more enemies over time
    const targetCount = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor(kills/3));
    if(enemies.length < targetCount && Math.random() < dt*1.2){
      const r = Math.random();
      const type = r < 0.5 ? 'grunt' : r < 0.8 ? 'wisp' : 'brute';
      spawnEnemy(type, 0, 0);
    }

    // powerups
    for(let i=powerups.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = powerups[i];
      p.t += dt;
      if(Math.hypot(player.x-p.x, player.y-p.y) < player.r + 10){
        player.hp = Math.min(player.maxHp, player.hp + 2);
        burst(p.x, p.y, '#5fff9f', 12, 150);
        powerups.splice(i,1);
      } else if(p.t > 8){ powerups.splice(i,1); }
    }

    updateParticles(dt);
  }

  function updateParticles(dt){
    for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
      p.vx *= Math.pow(0.02, dt); p.vy *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
      p.life -= dt;
      if(p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake > 0){
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));
    }

    // background gradient (outer space)
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#0a0518');
    bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#160a2e');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#050310');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);

    // stars
    for(const s of stars){
      const a = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
      ctx.globalAlpha = a * s.z;
      ctx.fillStyle = s.z > 0.7 ? '#ffffff' : '#9fb0ff';
      const r = s.z*1.6;
      ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, r, r);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // a distant planet (Alma) - big circle lower right
    drawPlanet(W*0.82, H*0.78, 70);

    // nebula glow
    drawNebula();

    // grid floor (subtle)
    drawGrid();

    if(gameState === STATE.PLAY || gameState === STATE.WIN || gameState === STATE.LOSE){
      // powerups
      for(const p of powerups) drawPowerup(p);
      // enemies
      for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
      // bullets
      for(const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
      // player
      drawPlayer();
    }

    // particles
    for(const p of particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life/p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.restore();

    // HUD / screens
    if(gameState === STATE.TITLE) drawTitle();
    else if(gameState === STATE.PLAY) drawHUD();
    else if(gameState === STATE.WIN) drawEnd(true);
    else if(gameState === STATE.LOSE) drawEnd(false);
  }

  function drawPlanet(x,y,r){
    // glow
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,r*0.5, x,y,r*1.6);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,80,200,0.35)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,80,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r*1.6,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    // body
    const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x-r,y-r,x+r,y+r);
    pg.addColorStop(0, '#6a4bb0');
    pg.addColorStop(0.5, '#3a2a6e');
    pg.addColorStop(1, '#1c1440');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    // bands
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU); ctx.clip();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,150,0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x-r, y + i*16);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + i*16 + 6, x+r, y + i*16);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // terminator shadow
    const sh = ctx.createLinearGradient(x,y-r,x,y+r);
    sh.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    sh.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sh;
    ctx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);
    ctx.restore();
    // ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,150,255,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,r*1.5,r*0.45, -0.4, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawNebula(){
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    const n1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.25,H*0.3,10, W*0.25,H*0.3,140);
    n1.addColorStop(0,'rgba(200,80,220,0.5)');
    n1.addColorStop(1,'rgba(200,80,220,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = n1; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const n2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.6,H*0.6,10, W*0.6,H*0.6,160);
    n2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(80,120,255,0.4)');
    n2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(80,120,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = n2; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawGrid(){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,90,220,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const off = (time*20) % 40;
    for(let x=-off; x<W; x+=40){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for(let y=-off; y<H; y+=40){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const p = player;
    const blink = p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(time*20)%2===0;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate(p.angle);
    if(!blink){
      // engine glow
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,240,255,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-14,0,8,4,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      // body (ship)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a5a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(16,0);
      ctx.lineTo(-8,-9);
      ctx.lineTo(-4,0);
      ctx.lineTo(-8,9);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // hull highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7ff0ff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16,0); ctx.lineTo(-2,-4); ctx.lineTo(-2,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // cockpit
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd76a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4,0,2.5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      // wing accents
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c04040';
      ctx.fillRect(-8,-9,4,2);
      ctx.fillRect(-8,7,4,2);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    ctx.rotate(e.angle);
    if(e.type==='grunt'){
      // red drone
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a1a1a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a3c';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r*0.6,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.35,0,e.r*0.25,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      // spikes
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8a2a1a';
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
        const a = i/4*TAU;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*e.r, Math.sin(a)*e.r);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*(e.r+6), Math.sin(a)*(e.r+6));
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a+0.3)*e.r, Math.sin(a+0.3)*e.r);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
    } else if(e.type==='wisp'){
      // purple ghost
      const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(e.t*6)*0.15;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(192,127,255,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r*pulse,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a4a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.3,-2,2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.3,2,2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // brute - big armored
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1a0a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7a3c';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r*0.7,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      // armor plates
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7a3a1a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-e.r,0); ctx.lineTo(0,-e.r*0.8); ctx.lineTo(e.r,0); ctx.lineTo(0,e.r*0.8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // core
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff0a0';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.3,0,e.r*0.2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // hp bar
    if(e.hp < e.maxHp){
      const bw = e.r*2;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x-bw/2, e.y-e.r-8, bw, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a3c';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x-bw/2, e.y-e.r-8, bw*(e.hp/e.maxHp), 3);
    }
  }

  function drawBullet(b){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x,b.y);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,b.r*3);
    g.addColorStop(0, b.color);
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,b.r*3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,b.r*0.6,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPowerup(p){
    const bob = Math.sin(p.t*4)*3;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y + bob);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,255,159,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,14,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fff9f';
    ctx.fillRect(-2,-7,4,14);
    ctx.fillRect(-7,-2,14,4);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,3,15,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ff0ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(score).padStart(6,'0'), 12, 14);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd76a';
    ctx.fillText('KILLS ' + kills + ' / ' + KILLS_TO_WIN, W/2, 14);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a3c';
    ctx.fillText('HP', W-90, 14);
    // hp pips
    for(let i=0;i<player.maxHp;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle = i < player.hp ? '#ff3030' : 'rgba(255,48,48,0.2)';
      ctx.fillRect(W-78 + i*14, 8, 10, 12);
    }
  }

  function drawTitle(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,3,15,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    // title
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px Courier New';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ff0ff';
    ctx.fillText('PHANTASY STAR III', W/2, H*0.28);
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd76a';
    ctx.fillText('GENERATIONS OF DOOM', W/2, H*0.28 + 30);
    // subtitle
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c07fff';
    ctx.fillText('Defend Alma from the Void. Destroy 12 invaders.', W/2, H*0.55);
    // controls
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb0ff';
    ctx.fillText('MOVE: WASD / ARROWS', W/2, H*0.65);
    ctx.fillText('FIRE: SPACE / F / X  (auto-aims at nearest foe)', W/2, H*0.70);
    // blink prompt
    if(Math.floor(time*2)%2===0){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO BEGIN', W/2, H*0.85);
    }
  }

  function drawEnd(win){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,3,15,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Courier New';
    ctx.fillStyle = win ? '#5fff9f' : '#ff3030';
    ctx.fillText(win ? 'ALMA IS SAVED' : 'YOU HAVE FALLEN', W/2, H*0.4);
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd76a';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE: ' + score, W/2, H*0.52);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb0ff';
    ctx.fillText('KILLS: ' + kills + ' / ' + KILLS_TO_WIN, W/2, H*0.58);
    if(Math.floor(time*2)%2===0){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE / ENTER TO RETURN', W/2, H*0.72);
    }
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- START ----------
  makeStars();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Miner 2048er</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    background: #04070f;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", Verdana, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 55px rgba(40, 130, 200, .25), inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(120,180,255,.12);
    cursor: pointer;
    max-width: 96vw;
    max-height: 96vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="840" height="620"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ============================================================
  // 1. CONSTANTS
  // ============================================================
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const GRID = 24;
  const COLS = 24;
  const ROWS = 16;
  const ORIGIN_X = (W - COLS * GRID) / 2;
  const ORIGIN_Y = (H - ROWS * GRID) / 2;

  const MAX = 2048;
  const POWER = 4;
  const WIN = 2048;
  const TIME_PER = 1.4;
  const START_TIME = 60;
  const BEST_KEY = "miner2048er.best";

  const TILE = {
    2:    { bg: "#f2f7fb", fg: "#33506b" },
    4:    { bg: "#ffe3a0", fg: "#7a4a00" },
    8:    { bg: "#ffb45c", fg: "#5a2c00" },
    16:   { bg: "#ff8f3c", fg: "#3a1800" },
    32:   { bg: "#ff6a3c", fg: "#2a0d00" },
    64:   { bg: "#ff4747", fg: "#ffffff" },
    128:  { bg: "#b06bff", fg: "#ffffff" },
    256:  { bg: "#7d5cff", fg: "#ffffff" },
    512:  { bg: "#37a6ff", fg: "#ffffff" },
    1024: { bg: "#22d3ee", fg: "#05303a" },
    2048: { bg: "#ffd23f", fg: "#5a3a00" }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // 2. STATE
  // ============================================================
  let state = "start";
  let grid = [];
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let timeLeft = START_TIME;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let moveCount = 0;
  let particles = [];
  let floaters = [];
  let shake = 0;
  let winTimer = 0;
  let loseTimer = 0;
  let combo = 0;
  let comboTimer = 0;

  try { best = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY) || "0", 10) || 0; } catch (e) { best = 0; }

  // ============================================================
  // 3. HELPERS
  // ============================================================
  function tileColor(v) { return TILE[v] || { bg: "#ff3b6b", fg: "#ffffff" }; }
  function cellCenter(c, r) {
    return { x: ORIGIN_X + (c + 0.5) * GRID, y: ORIGIN_Y + (r + 0.5) * GRID };
  }
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function fontFor(v) {
    if (v < 100) return "bold " + Math.floor(GRID * 0.55) + "px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    if (v < 1000) return "bold " + Math.floor(GRID * 0.44) + "px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    return "bold " + Math.floor(GRID * 0.36) + "px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 4. GAME LOGIC
  // ============================================================
  function newGame() {
    grid = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) { grid.push(new Array(COLS).fill(0)); }
    score = 0;
    timeLeft = START_TIME;
    moveCount = 0;
    particles = [];
    floaters = [];
    shake = 0;
    winTimer = 0;
    loseTimer = 0;
    combo = 0;
    comboTimer = 0;
    spawnTile();
    spawnTile();
    state = "play";
  }

  function emptyCells() {
    const out = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++)
        if (grid[r][c] === 0) out.push({ c, r });
    return out;
  }

  function spawnTile() {
    const e = emptyCells();
    if (!e.length) return;
    const cell = e[(Math.random() * e.length) | 0];
    const v = Math.random() < 0.9 ? 2 : 4;
    grid[cell.r][cell.c] = v;
    const p = cellCenter(cell.c, cell.r);
    spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, tileColor(v).bg, 10, 1.2);
  }

  function canMove() {
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        if (grid[r][c] === 0) return true;
        if (c < COLS - 1 && grid[r][c] === grid[r][c + 1]) return true;
        if (r < ROWS - 1 && grid[r][c] === grid[r + 1][c]) return true;
      }
    return false;
  }

  function doMove(dir) {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const moved = slide(dir);
    if (moved) {
      spawnTile();
      moveCount++;
      timeLeft += TIME_PER;
      combo = 0;
      comboTimer = 0;
      if (!canMove()) { state = "lose"; loseTimer = 0; }
    }
  }

  // Slide + merge in the direction of travel.
  function slide(dir) {
    const horizontal = (dir === "left" || dir === "right");
    const reverse = (dir === "right" || dir === "down");
    let moved = false;
    let merged = 0;

    const lines = [];
    const count = horizontal ? ROWS : COLS;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const line = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < (horizontal ? COLS : ROWS); j++) {
        const c = horizontal ? (reverse ? COLS - 1 - j : j) : i;
        const r = horizontal ? i : (reverse ? ROWS - 1 - j : j);
        line.push(grid[r][c]);
      }
      lines.push(line);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const line = lines[i];
      const nz = [];
      for (let v of line) if (v !== 0) nz.push(v);

      const out = [];
      let k = 0;
      while (k < nz.length) {
        if (k + 1 < nz.length && nz[k] === nz[k + 1]) {
          const sum = nz[k] * 2;
          out.push(sum);
          score += sum;
          timeLeft += (sum === WIN) ? 5 : 0;
          merged++;
          const p = cellCenter(reverse ? COLS - 1 - (out.length - 1) : (out.length - 1),
                               horizontal ? i : (reverse ? ROWS - 1 - (out.length - 1) : (out.length - 1)));
          spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, tileColor(sum).bg, 16, 2);
          floaters.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, text: "+" + sum, life: 1 });
          k += 2;
        } else {
          out.push(nz[k]);
          k++;
        }
      }

      const full = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < (horizontal ? COLS : ROWS); j++) full.push(j < out.length ? out[j] : 0);

      for (let j = 0; j < full.length; j++) {
        const c = horizontal ? (reverse ? COLS - 1 - j : j) : i;
        const r = horizontal ? i : (reverse ? ROWS - 1 - j : j);
        if (grid[r][c] !== full[j]) moved = true;
        grid[r][c] = full[j];
      }
    }

    if (merged > 0) {
      combo += merged;
      comboTimer = 1;
      shake = Math.min(10, merged * 2);
    }
    return moved;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 5. PARTICLES / FLOATERS
  // ============================================================
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, n, speed) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = speed * (0.5 + Math.random());
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 1,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt * 60;
      p.y += p.vy * dt * 60;
      p.vy += 0.08 * dt * 60;
      p.life -= dt * 1.4;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = floaters[i];
      f.y -= dt * 40;
      f.life -= dt * 0.8;
      if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 6. INPUT
  // ============================================================
  const keyMap = {
    ArrowUp: "up", ArrowDown: "down", ArrowLeft: "left", ArrowRight: "right",
    w: "up", s: "down", a: "left", d: "right",
    W: "up", S: "down", A: "left", D: "right"
  };

  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    const dir = keyMap[e.key];
    if (dir) { e.preventDefault(); doMove(dir); }
    else if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") { if (state === "play" || state === "lose" || state === "win") newGame(); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state === "start") newGame();
      else if (state === "win") newGame();
      else if (state === "lose") newGame();
    }
  });

  let touchStart = null;
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    const t = e.changedTouches[0];
    touchStart = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY };
  }, { passive: true });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", function (e) {
    if (!touchStart) return;
    const t = e.changedTouches[0];
    const dx = t.clientX - touchStart.x;
    const dy = t.clientY - touchStart.y;
    const adx = Math.abs(dx), ady = Math.abs(dy);
    if (Math.max(adx, ady) < 24) {
      if (state === "start" || state === "win" || state === "lose") newGame();
    } else if (adx > ady) {
      doMove(dx > 0 ? "right" : "left");
    } else {
      doMove(dy > 0 ? "down" : "up");
    }
    touchStart = null;
  }, { passive: true });

  canvas.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state === "start") newGame();
    else if (state === "win") newGame();
    else if (state === "lose") newGame();
  });

  // ============================================================
  // 7. UPDATE
  // ============================================================
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === "play") {
      timeLeft -= dt;
      if (timeLeft <= 0) { timeLeft = 0; state = "lose"; loseTimer = 0; }
    }
    if (state === "win") {
      winTimer += dt;
      if (winTimer > 1.6) state = "play";
    }
    if (state === "lose") loseTimer += dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
    if (comboTimer > 0) comboTimer = Math.max(0, comboTimer - dt);
    updateParticles(dt);
    if (score > best) { best = score; try { localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(best)); } catch (e) {} }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 8. DRAW
  // ============================================================
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0a1830");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#0a2540");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#05101f");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // deep cave glow
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.9, 20, W / 2, H * 0.9, W * 0.7);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,150,60,0.12)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,150,60,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // rock strata
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.02)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const y = 40 + i * 130;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) ctx.lineTo(x, y + Math.sin(x * 0.02 + i) * 12);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y + 40);
      ctx.lineTo(0, y + 40);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // floating dust
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,200,255,0.25)";
    const t = performance.now() * 0.0002;
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const x = (i * 97 + Math.sin(t + i) * 30) % W;
      const y = (i * 53 + Math.cos(t * 1.3 + i) * 25) % H;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 1 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBoard() {
    // board panel
    const bx = ORIGIN_X - 10, by = ORIGIN_Y - 10;
    const bw = COLS * GRID + 20, bh = ROWS * GRID + 20;
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,16,30,0.75)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,160,230,0.35)";
    ctx.stroke();

    // cells
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const x = ORIGIN_X + c * GRID, y = ORIGIN_Y + r * GRID;
        roundRect(x + 1.5, y + 1.5, GRID - 3, GRID - 3, 5);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawTiles() {
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const v = grid[r][c];
        if (!v) continue;
        const x = ORIGIN_X + c * GRID, y = ORIGIN_Y + r * GRID;
        const col = tileColor(v);
        const pad = 2.5;

        // glow for high tiles
        if (v >= 128) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = col.bg;
          ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
          roundRect(x + pad, y + pad, GRID - pad * 2, GRID - pad * 2, 6);
          ctx.fillStyle = col.bg;
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        } else {
          roundRect(x + pad, y + pad, GRID - pad * 2, GRID - pad * 2, 6);
          ctx.fillStyle = col.bg;
          ctx.fill();
        }
        // top highlight
        roundRect(x + pad + 2, y + pad + 2, GRID - pad * 2 - 4, (GRID - pad * 2) * 0.35, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.22)";
        ctx.fill();

        // number
        ctx.fillStyle = col.fg;
        ctx.font = fontFor(v);
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        const cc = cellCenter(c, r);
        ctx.fillText(String(v), cc.x, cc.y + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    for (const f of floaters) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, f.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.font = "bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // left panel: score
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb4d6";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE", 26, 44);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 24, 84);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb4d6";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BEST", 26, 124);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(String(best), 24, 156);

    // right panel: timer
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb4d6";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("TIME", W - 26, 44);
    const t = Math.ceil(timeLeft);
    const urgent = timeLeft < 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? "#ff5a5a" : "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(String(t), W - 24, 84);

    // timer bar
    const barW = 200, barH = 10, barX = W - 26 - barW, barY = 100;
    roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)";
    ctx.fill();
    const frac = Math.max(0, timeLeft / (START_TIME + 10));
    if (frac > 0) {
      roundRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, barH, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? "#ff5a5a" : "#37c0ff";
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // combo
    if (comboTimer > 0 && combo > 1) {
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.globalAlpha = comboTimer;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";

    }

    // controls hint
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,190,230,0.55)";
    ctx.font = "13px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Arrows / WASD to move  •  R to restart  •  Merge to 2048", W / 2, H - 14);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state === "start") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,10,20,0.82)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
      ctx.font = "bold 64px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("MINER 2048ER", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe4f5";
      ctx.font = "20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Merge the ore, race the clock, dig to 2048.", W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb4d6";
      ctx.font = "16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Arrow keys or WASD to move tiles.", W / 2, H / 2 + 26);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Click or press Enter to start", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
      return;
    }

    if (state === "lose") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,10,20,0.85)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a5a";
      ctx.font = "bold 58px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("CAVE IN!", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Time ran out — final score: " + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
      ctx.font = "18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Best: " + best, W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb4d6";
      ctx.font = "16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Click or press Enter to try again", W / 2, H / 2 + 84);
      return;
    }

    if (state === "win" && winTimer < 1.6) {
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, winTimer * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
      ctx.font = "bold 72px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("2048!", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("You struck the motherlode!", W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }
    drawBackground();
    if (state !== "start") {
      drawBoard();
      drawTiles();
      drawParticles();
      drawHUD();
    }
    drawOverlay();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // 9. MAIN LOOP
  // ============================================================
  function loop(now) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = now;
    let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The House of the Dead</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #game {
    background: #000;
    display: block;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  let state = "start";
  let score = 0;
  let ammo = 8;
  let reloadTimer = 0;
  let mouseX = W / 2;
  let mouseY = H / 2;
  let shakeTimer = 0;
  let shakeMag = 0;
  let time = 0;

  let zombies = [];
  let bullets = [];
  let particles = [];
  let flashTimer = 0;
  let wave = 1;
  let waveTimer = 0;
  let spawnTimer = 0;

  const zombieTypes = [
    { name: "walker", speed: 0.4, hp: 1, color: "#4a6a3a", size: 30 },
    { name: "runner", speed: 0.9, hp: 1, color: "#6a3a3a", size: 28 },
    { name: "brute", speed: 0.25, hp: 3, color: "#3a3a5a", size: 45 }
  ];

  function spawnZombie() {
    const t = zombieTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * zombieTypes.length)];
    const x = Math.random() * W;
    const y = -50 - Math.random() * 100;
    zombies.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      type: t,
      hp: t.hp,
      hitTimer: 0,
      walkPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  function spawnWave() {
    const count = 3 + wave * 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      setTimeout(() => spawnZombie(), i * 400);
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    score = 0;
    ammo = 8;
    reloadTimer = 0;
    zombies = [];
    bullets = [];
    particles = [];
    wave = 1;
    waveTimer = 0;
    spawnWave();
  }

  function addParticle(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
        life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
        color: color,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
      });
    }
  }

  function shoot() {
    if (state !== "playing") return;
    if (ammo <= 0) {
      if (reloadTimer <= 0) {
        reloadTimer = 90;
      }
      return;
    }
    ammo--;
    flashTimer = 8;
    shakeTimer = 4;
    shakeMag = 3;
    bullets.push({ x: mouseX, y: mouseY, life: 20 });
    for (let i = 0; i < zombies.length; i++) {
      const z = zombies[i];
      const dx = z.x - mouseX;
      const dy = z.y - mouseY;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      const threshold = z.type.size * 0.8;
      if (dist < threshold) {
        z.hp--;
        z.hitTimer = 10;
        addParticle(z.x, z.y, "#aa2222", 8);
        if (z.hp <= 0) {
          addParticle(z.x, z.y, "#664422", 15);
          zombies.splice(i, 1);
          score += z.type.name === "brute" ? 300 : 100;
          i--;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function update() {
    time++;

    if (state !== "playing") return;

    if (reloadTimer > 0) {
      reloadTimer--;
      if (reloadTimer <= 0) {
        ammo = 8;
      }
    }

    if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer--;
    if (shakeTimer > 0) shakeTimer--;

    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      bullets[i].life--;
      if (bullets[i].life <= 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = zombies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const z = zombies[i];
      z.y += z.type.speed;
      z.walkPhase += 0.05;
      if (z.hitTimer > 0) z.hitTimer--;
      if (z.y > H - 40) {
        state = "gameover";
        return;
      }
    }

    if (zombies.length === 0) {
      waveTimer++;
      if (waveTimer > 120) {
        wave++;
        waveTimer = 0;
        spawnWave();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#0a0a15");
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a1020");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#2a1515");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Fog layers
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const fogY = 100 + i * 100 + Math.sin(time * 0.005 + i) * 20;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#443355";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(W / 2 + Math.sin(time * 0.003 + i * 2) * 100, fogY, 300, 60, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Ground
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1210";
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 80, W, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#251a15";
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
      ctx.fillRect(x, H - 80, 30, 5);
    }

    // Distant buildings silhouettes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0d0d18";
    const buildings = [
      { x: 50, w: 80, h: 200 },
      { x: 160, w: 60, h: 280 },
      { x: 250, w: 100, h: 180 },
      { x: 380, w: 70, h: 320 },
      { x: 480, w: 90, h: 220 },
      { x: 600, w: 80, h: 260 },
      { x: 710, w: 60, h: 190 }
    ];
    for (const b of buildings) {
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, H - 80 - b.h, b.w, b.h);
      // Windows
      ctx.fillStyle = "#332211";
      for (let wy = 0; wy < b.h - 20; wy += 25) {
        for (let wx = 10; wx < b.w - 15; wx += 20) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.3 || time % 200 < 100) {
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + wx, H - 80 - b.h + wy + 10, 8, 12);
          }
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0d0d18";
    }

    // Moon
    ctx.fillStyle = "#eeddaa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(650, 80, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ddd0aa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(640, 75, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(660, 90, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawZombie(z) {
    const s = z.type.size;
    const bobY = Math.sin(z.walkPhase) * 3;
    const x = z.x;
    const y = z.y + bobY;
    const c = z.hitTimer > 0 ? "#ffffff" : z.type.color;

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + s, s * 0.5, s * 0.15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, s * 0.4, s * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - s * 0.5, s * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - s * 0.12, y - s * 0.55, s * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + s * 0.12, y - s * 0.55, s * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Arms
    const armSwing = Math.sin(z.walkPhase) * 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = c;
    ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.12;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.3, y - s * 0.1);
    ctx.lineTo(x - s * 0.6, y + s * 0.3 + armSwing * s);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + s * 0.3, y - s * 0.1);
    ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.6, y + s * 0.3 - armSwing * s);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Legs
    ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.15, y + s * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(x - s * 0.2, y + s * 0.8 + Math.sin(z.walkPhase) * 5);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + s * 0.15, y + s * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.2, y + s * 0.8 - Math.sin(z.walkPhase) * 5);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawBullet(b) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffff88";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,136,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticle(p) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawCrosshair() {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouseX, mouseY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX - 25, mouseY);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX - 8, mouseY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX + 8, mouseY);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX + 25, mouseY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX, mouseY - 25);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX, mouseY - 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX, mouseY + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX, mouseY + 25);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, 20, 35);

    // Wave
    ctx.fillStyle = "#aa88ff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("WAVE: " + wave, 20, 60);

    // Ammo
    ctx.fillStyle = ammo > 0 ? "#ffcc44" : "#ff4444";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    if (reloadTimer > 0) {
      ctx.fillText("RELOADING...", W - 20, 35);
    } else {
      ctx.fillText("AMMO: " + ammo + "/8", W - 20, 35);
    }

    // Ammo bar
    const barW = 150;
    const barX = W - 20 - barW;
    const barY = 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = ammo > 0 ? "#ffcc44" : "#ff4444";
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * (ammo / 8), 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#666";
    ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, 12);

    // Danger line
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,50,50,0.3)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 5]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H - 80);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H - 80);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,50,50,0.5)";
    ctx.font = "14px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("DANGER LINE", W / 2, H - 85);
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.font = "bold 48px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("THE HOUSE", W / 2, H / 2 - 80);
    ctx.fillText("OF THE DEAD", W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#aaa";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Move mouse to aim. Click to shoot.", W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.fillText("Don't let zombies reach the danger line!", W / 2, H / 2 + 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc44";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(time * 0.05) * 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText("CLICK TO START", W / 2, H / 2 + 120);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc44";
    ctx.font = "bold 32px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, W / 2, H / 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#aaa";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("You reached Wave " + wave, W / 2, H / 2 + 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc44";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(time * 0.05) * 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText("CLICK TO RESTART", W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    if (shakeTimer > 0) {
      const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeMag * 2;
      const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeMag * 2;
      ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    drawBackground();

    // Sort zombies by y for proper overlap
    const sorted = zombies.slice().sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
    for (const z of sorted) {
      drawZombie(z);
    }

    for (const b of bullets) {
      drawBullet(b);
    }

    for (const p of particles) {
      drawParticle(p);
    }

    if (flashTimer > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,200," + (flashTimer / 16) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    ctx.restore();

    if (state === "playing") {
      drawCrosshair();
      drawHUD();
    } else if (state === "start") {
      drawStartScreen();
    } else if (state === "gameover") {
      drawGameOver();
    }
  }

  function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (state === "start") {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === "gameover") {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === "playing") {
      shoot();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", function(e) {
    if (state === "playing") {
      shoot();
    }
  });

  gameLoop();
</script>

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 200 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
  for (let i = sparks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = sparks[i];
    s.x += s.vx * dt;
    s.y += s.vy * dt;
    s.life -= dt;
    if (s.life <= 0) sparks.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color.replace('1)', `${alpha})`);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  for (const s of sparks) {
    const alpha = s.life / s.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.color.replace('1)', `${alpha})`);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function checkSlashHit(attacker, defender) {
  const dist = Math.abs(attacker.x - defender.x);
  const inRange = dist < 120;
  const slashActive = attacker.slashTimer > 0 && attacker.slashTimer < attacker.slashDuration * 0.6;
  return inRange && slashActive;
}

function applyHit(target, attacker) {
  target.hp--;
  state.shake = 0.3;
  state.flash = 0.15;

  const hitX = (target.x + attacker.x) / 2;
  const hitY = target.y;

  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 100 + Math.random() * 200;
    createSpark(hitX, hitY, 'rgba(255,200,50,1)', angle, speed);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 100;
    createParticle(hitX, hitY, 'rgba(200,50,50,1)',
      Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed - 50, 0.5);
  }

  if (target.hp <= 0) {
    if (target === enemy) {
      state.score += 100;
      state.message = 'Enemy Defeated!';
      state.messageTimer = 1.5;
      if (state.round >= state.maxRounds) {
        state.phase = 'gameover';
      } else {
        state.round++;
        setTimeout(() => {
          enemy.hp = 3;
          player.hp = 3;
          enemy.x = 720;
          player.x = 180;
          state.phase = 'countdown';
          state.countdown = 3;
          state.message = '';
        }, 1500);
      }
    } else {
      state.message = 'You Were Slain!';
      state.messageTimer = 1.5;
      state.phase = 'gameover';
    }
  } else {
    state.message = target === enemy ? 'Hit!' : 'You Were Hit!';
    state.messageTimer = 0.8;
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (state.phase === 'title' || state.phase === 'gameover') return;

  state.timer += dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake -= dt;
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash -= dt;
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer -= dt;

  if (state.phase === 'countdown') {
    state.countdown -= dt;
    if (state.countdown <= 0) {
      state.phase = 'playing';
      enemy.attackTimer = 0;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  // Player slash timer
  if (player.slashTimer > 0) {
    player.slashTimer -= dt;
    if (player.slashTimer <= 0) {
      player.slashTimer = 0;
      state.slashCooldown = player.cooldown;
    }
  }
  if (state.slashCooldown > 0) state.slashCooldown -= dt;

  // Enemy AI
  enemy.attackTimer += dt;
  if (enemy.attackTimer >= enemy.attackInterval) {
    enemy.attackTimer = 0;
    enemy.slashTimer = enemy.slashDuration;
    enemy.moveDir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    enemy.moveTimer = 0.5;
  }

  // Enemy movement
  if (enemy.moveTimer > 0) {
    enemy.moveTimer -= dt;
    enemy.x += enemy.moveDir * 60 * dt;
    enemy.x = Math.max(300, Math.min(800, enemy.x));
  }

  if (enemy.slashTimer > 0) {
    enemy.slashTimer -= dt;
    if (enemy.slashTimer <= 0) enemy.slashTimer = 0;
  }

  // Check hits
  if (player.slashTimer > 0 && !state.playerHit) {
    if (checkSlashHit(player, enemy)) {
      state.playerHit = true;
      applyHit(enemy, player);
    }
  }
  if (player.slashTimer <= 0) state.playerHit = false;

  if (enemy.slashTimer > 0 && !state.enemyHit) {
    if (checkSlashHit(enemy, player)) {
      state.enemyHit = true;
      applyHit(player, enemy);
    }
  }
  if (enemy.slashTimer <= 0) state.enemyHit = false;

  updateParticles(dt);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  if (state.shake > 0) {
    const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 20;
    const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 20;
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
  }

  if (state.phase === 'title') {
    drawTitleScreen();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
    const won = player.hp > 0;
    drawGameOverScreen(won);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  drawBackground();

  // Draw characters
  drawSamurai(player.x, player.y, player.facing, '#2a4a6a', '#c09020', player.slashTimer, player.slashDuration);
  drawSamurai(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.facing, '#6a2a2a', '#c04020', enemy.slashTimer, enemy.slashDuration);

  // Flash effect
  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${state.flash * 3})`;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }

  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();

  ctx.restore();
}

let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function resetGame() {

function playerSlash() {

}

  function burst(x, y, color, n) {

      const sp = 1 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,

      const ay = player.y;
      for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
        const e = enemies[i];
        const dx = e.x - ax;

  function update(dt) {

      wave++;

    }

    // Player movement
    const speed = 3.4;
    let mx = 0, my = 0;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) mx -= 1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) mx += 1;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) my -= 1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) my += 1;
    if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0) {
      const len = Math.hypot(mx, my);
      player.vx = (mx / len) * speed;
      player.vy = (my / len) * speed;
      if (mx !== 0) player.facing = mx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    } else {
      player.vx *= 0.7;
      player.vy *= 0.7;
    }
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;
    player.x = Math.max(40, Math.min(W - 40, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(110, Math.min(H - 40, player.y));

    if (player.attackCooldown > 0) player.attackCooldown -= dt;
    if (player.attacking) {
      player.attackTimer -= dt;
      if (player.attackTimer <= 0) player.attacking = false;
    }
    if (player.hurt > 0) player.hurt -= dt;

    // Spawn
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
    }

    // Enemies
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      const dx = player.x - e.x;
      const dy = player.y - e.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      if (e.type === 'shooter') {
        if (d > 200) { e.vx += (dx / d) * 0.15; e.vy += (dy / d) * 0.15; }
        else { e.vx -= (dx / d) * 0.1; e.vy -= (dy / d) * 0.1; }
        e.fireTimer -= dt;
        if (e.fireTimer <= 0 && d < 520) {
          spawnBullet(e.x, e.y, (dx / d) * 6, (dy / d) * 6, '#ff5252', false);
          e.fireTimer = e.fireRate;
        }
      } else {
        e.vx += (dx / d) * 0.2;
        e.vy += (dy / d) * 0.2;
      }
      const sp = Math.hypot(e.vx, e.vy);
      if (sp > e.speed) { e.vx = (e.vx / sp) * e.speed; e.vy = (e.vy / sp) * e.speed; }
      e.x += e.vx;
      e.y += e.vy;
      if (e.hit > 0) e.hit -= dt;

      // Contact damage
      if (Math.abs(dx) < e.size + 20 && Math.abs(dy) < e.size + 20) {
        player.hp -= 30 * dt;
        player.hurt = 0.3;
        shake = 4;
      }

      if (e.hp <= 0) {
        score += e.score;
        burst(e.x, e.y, e.color, 14);
        enemies.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20) {
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const dx = player.x - b.x;
      const dy = player.y - b.y;
      if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 26) {
        player.hp -= 12;
        player.hurt = 0.3;
        burst(b.x, b.y, '#ff5252', 6);
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.1;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (player.hp <= 0) {
      player.hp = 0;
      state = STATE.LOSE;
    }

  function drawRing() {

    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#1a1030');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a1a4a');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#0d0820');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const cx = (i * 97) % W;

      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

    // Ring floor
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2a5a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(60, 130);
    ctx.lineTo(W - 60, 130);
    ctx.lineTo(W - 30, H - 60);
    ctx.lineTo(30, H - 60);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd54a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
      const t = i / 4;
      const y1 = 130 + (H - 190) * t;
      const xL = 60 + (30 - 60) * t;
      const xR = (W - 60) + ((W - 30) - (W - 60)) * t;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xL, y1);
      ctx.lineTo(xR, y1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // NWO banner
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 20, W, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('N W O   R E V E N G E', W / 2, 50);
  }

  function drawWrestler(x, y, size, color, facing, attacking, hurt) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    if (hurt > 0) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 40) * 0.3;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, size * 0.9, size * 0.7, size * 0.25, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.35, size * 0.2, size * 0.25, size * 0.7);
    ctx.fillRect(size * 0.1, size * 0.2, size * 0.25, size * 0.7);

    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-size * 0.45, -size * 0.3, size * 0.9, size * 0.7, 8);
