    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c8a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -size * 0.55, size * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -size * 0.65, size * 0.32, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = size * 0.22;

      ctx.lineTo(facing * size * 0.95, -size * 0.1);
    } else {

  function drawEnemy(e) {

    const bw = e.size * 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(e.x - bw / 2, e.y - e.size * 1.15, bw, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5252';

  function draw() {

    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);

    for (let i = 0; i < bullets.length; i++) {

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {

      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

    drawWrestler(player.x, player.y, 34, '#2e86de', player.facing, player.attacking, player.hurt > 0);

    if (state === STATE.START) drawOverlay('NWO REVENGE', 'Enter the ring. Defeat the NWO.', 'Press SPACE to start', '#ffd54a');
    else if (state === STATE.WIN) drawOverlay('VICTORY', 'You crushed the NWO!', 'Press SPACE to play again', '#2ecc71');
    else if (state === STATE.LOSE) drawOverlay('K.O.', 'The NWO got you...', 'Press SPACE to retry', '#ff5252');
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Health
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(20, H - 40, 220, 20);
    const hpw = 220 * (player.hp / player.maxHp);
    const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(20, 0, 240, 0);
    hg.addColorStop(0, '#2ecc71');
    hg.addColorStop(1, '#27ae60');
    ctx.fillStyle = hg;
    ctx.fillRect(20, H - 40, hpw, 20);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(20, H - 40, 220, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('HEALTH', 20, H - 46);

    // Score
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54a';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, W - 20, H - 24);
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + wave + '  ·  GOAL ' + (goal * wave), W - 20, H - 50);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, hint, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 15);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText(hint, W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

    if (keys["Space"]) firePlayer();

    // --- spawning ---
    if (toSpawn > 0) {
      spawnTimer -= dt;
      if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
        spawnEnemy();
        toSpawn--;
        spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
      }
    } else if (enemies.length === 0) {
      if (wave >= WAVE_GOAL) {
        state = "gameover";
        return;
      }
      startWave();
    }

    // --- enemies ---
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const en = enemies[i];
      const d = dist(en.x, en.y, player.x, player.y);
      en.angle = Math.atan2(player.y - en.y, player.x - en.x);
      if (d > ENEMY_MIN) {
        en.x += Math.cos(en.angle) * ENEMY_SPEED * dt;
        en.y += Math.sin(en.angle) * ENEMY_SPEED * dt;
      } else if (d < ENEMY_MAX) {
        en.x -= Math.cos(en.angle) * ENEMY_SPEED * 0.4 * dt;
        en.y -= Math.sin(en.angle) * ENEMY_SPEED * 0.4 * dt;
      }
      en.cd -= dt;
      if (en.cd <= 0 && d < ENEMY_RANGE) {

        en.cd = ENEMY_CD * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6);
      }
    }

    for (let i = playerBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = playerBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.life -= dt;
      let hit = false;
      if (b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20 || b.life <= 0) hit = true;
      if (!hit) {
        for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          const en = enemies[j];
          if (dist(b.x, b.y, en.x, en.y) < en.r + b.r) {
            en.hp -= b.dmg;
            spawnBlood(en.x, en.y, "#c0182a", 8);
            shake = Math.max(shake, 4);
            hit = true;
            if (en.hp <= 0) {
              enemies.splice(j, 1);
              score += 100;
              spawnBlood(en.x, en.y, "#7a0f1a", 16);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (hit) playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // --- enemy bullets ---
    for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.life -= dt;
      let hit = false;
      if (b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20 || b.life <= 0) hit = true;
      if (!hit && dist(b.x, b.y, player.x, player.y) < player.r + b.r) {
        player.hp -= b.dmg;
        spawnBlood(player.x, player.y, "#e02030", 10);
        shake = Math.max(shake, 6);
        hit = true;
      }
      if (hit) enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // --- particles ---
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.92;
      p.vy *= 0.92;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 30);

    if (player.hp <= 0) {
      player.hp = 0;
      state = "gameover";
    }

  // ===================== DRAW =====================
  function drawBackground() {
    // floor
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#141826");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#0a0d16");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80,120,200,0.08)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const step = 60;
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += step) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += step) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // center glow
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 40, W/2, H/2, 420);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(60,90,160,0.18)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // border
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,180,255,0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(4, 4, W - 8, H - 8);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate(p.angle);

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2e6df0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a3f9e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-4, 0, p.r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // visor
    ctx.fillStyle = "#bfe9ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(6, 0, p.r * 0.4, -1.1, 1.1);
    ctx.fill();

    // gun
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0c0f18";
    ctx.fillRect(p.r - 4, -4, 20, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4660";
    ctx.fillRect(p.r + 12, -3, 6, 6);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(en) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(en.x, en.y);
    ctx.rotate(en.angle);

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d23b2e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, en.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a1410";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-3, 0, en.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(8, -5, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(8, 5, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // gun
    ctx.fillStyle = "#140808";
    ctx.fillRect(en.r - 4, -3, 18, 6);

    ctx.restore();

    // hp bar
    const w = 30;
    const frac = en.hp / en.maxHp;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(en.x - w/2, en.y - en.r - 12, w, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = frac > 0.4 ? "#ff5a3c" : "#ff2222";
    ctx.fillRect(en.x - w/2, en.y - en.r - 12, w * frac, 4);
  }

  function drawBullet(b, color, glow) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = clamp(p.life / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // health bar
    const bw = 260, bh = 18, bx = 20, by = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx - 3, by - 3, bw + 6, bh + 6);
    const frac = clamp(player.hp / player.maxHp, 0, 1);
    const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + bw, 0);
    hg.addColorStop(0, "#39d0ff");
    hg.addColorStop(1, "#1f7fd0");
    ctx.fillStyle = hg;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * frac, bh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180,220,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf6ff";
    ctx.font = "bold 12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("INTEGRITY " + Math.ceil(player.hp) + "%", bx, by + bh + 16);

    // wave + score
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.fillText("WAVE " + wave + " / " + WAVE_GOAL, W - 20, 38);
    ctx.font = "bold 16px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fdcff";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, W - 20, 62);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a5a";
    ctx.fillText("ENEMIES " + enemies.length, W - 20, 84);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,6,14,0.78)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    if (state === "start") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4d4d";
      ctx.font = "bold 58px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("LETHAL ENFORCERS", W/2, H/2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe6ff";
      ctx.font = "20px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("Hold the line. Survive " + WAVE_GOAL + " waves.", W/2, H/2 + 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb6e0";
      ctx.font = "16px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("WASD / Arrows to move · Mouse to aim · Click or Space to fire", W/2, H/2 + 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("CLICK TO START", W/2, H/2 + 90);
    } else if (state === "gameover") {
      const win = wave >= WAVE_GOAL;
      ctx.fillStyle = win ? "#5aff8a" : "#ff4d4d";
      ctx.font = "bold 54px Arial";
      ctx.fillText(win ? "SECTOR CLEARED" : "YOU DIED", W/2, H/2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
      ctx.font = "bold 26px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("FINAL SCORE " + score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb6e0";
      ctx.font = "18px Arial";
      ctx.fillText(win ? "You survived all " + WAVE_GOAL + " waves." : "Reached wave " + wave + ".", W/2, H/2 + 44);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe6ff";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
      ctx.fillText("CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN", W/2, H/2 + 92);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }
    drawBackground();

    for (const en of enemies) drawEnemy(en);
    if (player && state !== "gameover") drawPlayer();
    for (const b of playerBullets) drawBullet(b, "#ffe08a", "#ff9a2e");
    for (const b of enemyBullets) drawBullet(b, "#ff5a5a", "#ff2222");
    drawParticles();

    ctx.restore();

    if (state === "playing") drawHUD();
    if (state === "start" || state === "gameover") drawOverlay();
  }

  // ===================== LOOP =====================
  function loop(t) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
    let dt = (t - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = t;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

});

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Screen shake
  if (shakeTime > 0) {
    const s = shakeTime * 20;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
  }

  // Background
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d1035');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#080820');

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  for (const e of enemies) {
    if (!e.alive) {

      ctx.fillStyle = '#888';

      ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.radius + 5, player.y + player.radius);

      ctx.fill();

      ctx.moveTo(player.x + player.radius, player.y + player.radius);
      ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.radius + 8, player.y + player.radius + 5);

    ctx.lineTo(lx + 7, ly + 6);

}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, prompt, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;

  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.5;

  ctx.fillText(prompt, W/2, H/2 + 50);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrows to move  |  SPACE / J to shoot', W/2, H/2 + 90);
}

// ===================== GAME LOOP =====================
let lastTime = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

    ctx.fillStyle = healthColor;
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * healthPct, barH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial Black';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('HEALTH: ' + state.health + '%', W / 2, barY + 15);
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    drawBackground();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff1493';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial Black';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SAINTS ROW', W / 2, H / 2 - 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial Black';
    ctx.fillText('THE THIRD', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff69b4';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial Black';
    ctx.fillText('STILWATER STREET SHOOTOUT', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('A: Move Left    D: Move Right    SPACE: Jump    J: Shoot', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    ctx.fillText('Eliminate ' + state.totalKills + ' enemies to win. Don\'t let your health hit zero!', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial Black';
    const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 160);
    }
  }

  function drawEndScreen() {
    drawBackground();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';

    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial Black';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial Black';
    const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 2;
      const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 2;
      ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    if (state.mode === 'start') {
      drawStartScreen();
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }

    if (state.mode === 'won' || state.mode === 'lost') {

    for (const en of enemies) drawEnemy(en);
    drawPlayer();
    for (const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
    for (const p of particles) drawParticle(p);
    for (const ft of floatTexts) drawFloatText(ft);

    drawHUD();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ===== CANVAS & DIMENSIONS =====
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = 320;
const H = 480;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// ===== CONSTANTS =====
const SHOT_SPEED = 7;
const ENEMY_SPEED = 1.2;
const ENEMY_FIRE_INTERVAL = 60;
const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
const BULLET_SPEED = 2.5;
const HITBOX_RADIUS = 2;
const SHOT_RADIUS = 3;
const ENEMY_RADIUS = 8;
const MAX_LIVES = 3;
const WIN_ENEMIES = 40;

// ===== STATE =====
let state = "title"; // title, playing, win, lose
let score = 0;
let lives = MAX_LIVES;
let enemiesKilled = 0;
let frameCount = 0;
let invincible = 0;

// ===== PLAYER =====
const player = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: H - 40,
  w: 16,
  h: 20
};

// ===== INPUT =====
let keys = {};
let mouseX = W / 2;
let mouseY = H - 40;
let mouseDown = false;
let useMouse = false;

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
    if (state === "title") startGame();
    else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { state = "title"; }
  }
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.key] = false; });

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
  mouseY = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  useMouse = true;
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  mouseDown = true;
  if (state === "title") startGame();
  else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { state = "title"; }
});
canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { mouseDown = false; });

// ===== ARRAYS =====
let playerShots = [];
let enemyBullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];

// Pre-create stars
for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 1.5,
    size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
    hue: Math.random() * 60 + 180
  });
}

// ===== GAME FUNCTIONS =====
function startGame() {
  state = "playing";
  score = 0;
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  enemiesKilled = 0;
  frameCount = 0;
  invincible = 0;
  player.x = W / 2;
  player.y = H - 40;
  playerShots = [];
  enemyBullets = [];
  enemies = [];
  particles = [];
}

function spawnEnemy() {
  const x = 20 + Math.random() * (W - 40);
  const type = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  enemies.push({
    x: x,
    y: -15,
    w: 16,
    h: 14,
    type: type,
    hp: type === 2 ? 3 : 1,
    fireTimer: Math.random() * ENEMY_FIRE_INTERVAL,
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
    color: ["#ff4466", "#44aaff", "#ffaa22"][type]
  });
}

function firePlayerShot() {
  playerShots.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - player.h / 2, vy: -SHOT_SPEED });
}

function fireEnemyBullet(enemy) {
  const dx = player.x - enemy.x;
  const dy = player.y - enemy.y;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
  const speed = BULLET_SPEED;
  enemyBullets.push({
    x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + enemy.h / 2,
    vx: (dx / dist) * speed,
    vy: (dy / dist) * speed,
    radius: 4
  });
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 2;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
      maxLife: 40,
      color: color,
      size: 1 + Math.random() * 2
    });
  }
}

function checkCollision(ax, ay, ar, bx, by, br) {
  const dx = ax - bx;
  const dy = ay - by;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  return dist < ar + br;
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update() {
  if (state !== "playing") return;
  frameCount++;

  // Player movement
  if (useMouse) {
    player.x += (mouseX - player.x) * 0.3;
    player.y += (mouseY - player.y) * 0.3;
    if (mouseDown) firePlayerShot();
  } else {
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"]) player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
    if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"]) player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
    if (keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["w"]) player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED;
    if (keys["ArrowDown"] || keys["s"]) player.y += PLAYER_SPEED;
    if (keys[" "] || keys["z"]) firePlayerShot();
  }

  // Clamp player
  player.x = Math.max(player.w / 2, Math.min(W - player.w / 2, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(player.h / 2, Math.min(H - player.h / 2, player.y));

  // Invincibility timer
  if (invincible > 0) invincible--;

  // Spawn enemies
  const spawnRate = Math.max(30, 80 - enemiesKilled);
  if (frameCount % spawnRate === 0) spawnEnemy();

  // Update player shots
  for (let i = playerShots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    playerShots[i].y += playerShots[i].vy;
    if (playerShots[i].y < -10) {
      playerShots.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Check collision with enemies
    for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const en = enemies[j];
      if (checkCollision(playerShots[i].x, playerShots[i].y, SHOT_RADIUS, en.x, en.y, ENEMY_RADIUS)) {
        en.hp--;
        playerShots.splice(i, 1);
        if (en.hp <= 0) {
          addParticles(en.x, en.y, en.color, 8);
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
          score += 100;
          enemiesKilled++;
          if (enemiesKilled >= WIN_ENEMIES) {
            state = "win";
          }
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const en = enemies[i];
    en.y += ENEMY_SPEED;
    en.x += en.vx;
    if (en.x < en.w / 2) { en.x = en.w / 2; en.vx = -en.vx; }
    if (en.x > W - en.w / 2) { en.x = W - en.w / 2; en.vx = -en.vx; }
    en.fireTimer++;
    if (en.fireTimer >= ENEMY_FIRE_INTERVAL) {
      en.fireTimer = 0;
      fireEnemyBullet(en);
    }
    if (en.y > H + 20) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update enemy bullets
  for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = enemyBullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10 || b.y < -10 || b.y > H + 10) {
      enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Check collision with player
    if (invincible <= 0 && checkCollision(b.x, b.y, b.radius, player.x, player.y, HITBOX_RADIUS)) {
      enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      lives--;
      invincible = 90;
      addParticles(player.x, player.y, "#ffffff", 12);
      if (lives <= 0) {
        state = "lose";
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update stars
  for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
    stars[i].y += stars[i].speed;
    if (stars[i].y > H) {
      stars[i].y = -5;
      stars[i].x = Math.random() * W;
    }
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function drawBackground() {
  // Gradient sky
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#0a0020");
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a0040");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#0a0020");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
    const s = stars[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${s.hue}, 80%, 70%, ${0.3 + s.speed * 0.3})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (invincible > 0 && Math.floor(invincible / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

  const x = player.x;
  const y = player.y;

  // Engine glow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.3)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y + player.h / 2 + 4, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body - fighter jet shape
  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - player.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x + player.w / 2, y + player.h / 3);
  ctx.lineTo(x + player.w / 4, y + player.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x - player.w / 4, y + player.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x - player.w / 2, y + player.h / 3);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Wings
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0088cc";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - player.w / 2, y + player.h / 3);
  ctx.lineTo(x - player.w, y + player.h / 2 + 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x - player.w / 2, y + player.h / 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + player.w / 2, y + player.h / 3);
  ctx.lineTo(x + player.w, y + player.h / 2 + 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x + player.w / 2, y + player.h / 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Hitbox indicator
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff0000";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, HITBOX_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawEnemy(en) {
  const x = en.x;
  const y = en.y;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = en.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - en.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x + en.w / 2, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + en.w / 3, y + en.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x - en.w / 3, y + en.h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(x - en.w / 2, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 1, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 3, y - 1, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Pupils
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 1, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 3, y - 1, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // HP indicator for multi-hp enemies
  if (en.hp > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffff00";
    for (let i = 0; i < en.hp; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x - 6 + i * 6, y + en.h / 2 + 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawShot(s) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, SHOT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, SHOT_RADIUS * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBullet(b) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4488";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa00";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawParticle(p) {
  const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, 8, 18);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";

  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 8 - (lives - i) * 14, 14, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Progress bar
  ctx.fillStyle = "#333355";
  ctx.fillRect(8, H - 16, W - 16, 8);
  const progress = Math.min(1, enemiesKilled / WIN_ENEMIES);
  const barGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(8, 0, 8 + (W - 16) * progress, 0);
  barGrad.addColorStop(0, "#ff4466");
  barGrad.addColorStop(1, "#ffaa22");

  ctx.fillRect(8, H - 16, (W - 16) * progress, 8);

  ctx.font = "9px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(enemiesKilled + " / " + WIN_ENEMIES, W / 2, H - 9);
}

function drawTitle() {
  drawBackground();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("DoDonPachi", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
  ctx.font = "14px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Bullet Hell Shooter", W / 2, H / 2 - 15);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa22";
  ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("ARROWS / WASD - Move", W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  ctx.fillText("SPACE / Z / CLICK - Fire", W / 2, H / 2 + 38);
  ctx.fillText("MOUSE - Move & Fire", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
  ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START", W / 2, H / 2 + 90);

  // Draw decorative enemies
  const t = Date.now() / 1000;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const ex = W / 2 + Math.cos(t + i * Math.PI * 2 / 5) * 80;
    const ey = H / 2 + Math.sin(t + i * Math.PI * 2 / 5) * 50;
    drawEnemy({ x: ex, y: ey, w: 16, h: 14, color: ["#ff4466", "#44aaff", "#ffaa22"][i % 3], hp: 1 });
  }
}

function drawWin() {
  drawBackground();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa22";
  ctx.font = "bold 32px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillText("Enemies Destroyed: " + enemiesKilled, W / 2, H / 2 + 35);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
  ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO CONTINUE", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
}

function drawLose() {
  drawBackground();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
  ctx.font = "bold 32px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillText("Enemies Destroyed: " + enemiesKilled + " / " + WIN_ENEMIES, W / 2, H / 2 + 35);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ccff";
  ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
  const blink = Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText("PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO CONTINUE", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
}

function draw() {
  if (state === "title") {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }
  if (state === "win") {
    drawWin();
    return;
  }
  if (state === "lose") {
    drawLose();
    return;
  }

  // Playing state
  drawBackground();

  // Draw enemies
  for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
    drawEnemy(enemies[i]);
  }

  // Draw player shots
  for (let i = 0; i < playerShots.length; i++) {
    drawShot(playerShots[i]);
  }

  // Draw enemy bullets
  for (let i = 0; i < enemyBullets.length; i++) {
    drawBullet(enemyBullets[i]);
  }

  // Draw particles
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    drawParticle(particles[i]);
  }

  // Draw player
  drawPlayer();

  // Draw HUD
  drawHUD();
}

// ===== MAIN LOOP =====
function gameLoop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Lurking Horror</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100%;
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #000;
    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(20, 40, 20, 0.4);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- State ----------
  const STATE = { START: 0, PLAYING: 1, WIN: 2, LOSE: 3 };
  let state = STATE.START;

  // Player
  let player = { x: 400, y: 500, r: 10, speed: 160, hp: 100, invuln: 0, facing: 0 };

  // Entities
  let creatures = [];       // wandering shadow monsters
  let lights = [];          // lanterns the player can light
  let particles = [];       // dust / ember particles
  let door = { x: 400, y: 60, w: 70, h: 90, open: false, progress: 0 };

  // Lighting / camera
  let flicker = 0;
  let darkness = 1.0;      // 0 = fully lit, 1 = fully dark
  let time = 0;

  // Input
  const keys = {};

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }

  // ---------- Level build (short loop) ----------
  function buildLevel() {
    creatures = [];
    lights = [];
    particles = [];

    // Lanterns scattered around the room
    const lanternPos = [
      { x: 150, y: 200 },
      { x: 650, y: 200 },
      { x: 150, y: 420 },
      { x: 650, y: 420 },
      { x: 400, y: 300 },
      { x: 250, y: 120 },
      { x: 550, y: 120 }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < lanternPos.length; i++) {
      lights.push({
        x: lanternPos[i].x,
        y: lanternPos[i].y,
        lit: false,
        radius: 90,
        flick: 0
      });
    }

    // Creatures — they avoid light
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      creatures.push({
        x: rand(80, W - 80),
        y: rand(120, H - 120),
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        r: 14,
        speed: rand(40, 70),
        wander: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
        aggro: false
      });
    }

    // Ambient dust
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: rand(0, W),
        y: rand(0, H),
        vx: rand(-4, 4),
        vy: rand(-2, 2),
        life: rand(0.5, 2),
        max: 2
      });
    }

    door.open = false;
    door.progress = 0;
    player.hp = 100;
    player.x = 400;
    player.y = 500;
    player.invuln = 0;
    darkness = 1.0;
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;

    if (state === STATE.START && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) {
      buildLevel();
      state = STATE.PLAYING;
    }
    if ((state === STATE.WIN || state === STATE.LOSE) && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) {
      buildLevel();
      state = STATE.PLAYING;
    }

    // Light a lantern near the player
    if (state === STATE.PLAYING && k === 'f') {
      for (let i = 0; i < lights.length; i++) {
        if (!lights[i].lit && dist(player.x, player.y, lights[i].x, lights[i].y) < 50) {
          lights[i].lit = true;
          // burst of ember particles
          for (let j = 0; j < 14; j++) {
            particles.push({
              x: lights[i].x,
              y: lights[i].y,
              vx: rand(-40, 40),
              vy: rand(-60, -10),
              life: rand(0.4, 1.0),
              max: 1.0,
              ember: true
            });
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    flicker = Math.sin(time * 8) * 0.05 + Math.sin(time * 17) * 0.03;

    if (state !== STATE.PLAYING) {
      updateParticles(dt);
      return;
    }

    // --- Player movement ---
    let mx = 0, my = 0;
    if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) mx -= 1;
    if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) mx += 1;
    if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) my -= 1;
    if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) my += 1;

    if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0) {
      const len = Math.hypot(mx, my);
      mx /= len; my /= len;
      player.x += mx * player.speed * dt;
      player.y += my * player.speed * dt;
      player.facing = Math.atan2(my, mx);
    }
    player.x = clamp(player.x, player.r, W - player.r);
    player.y = clamp(player.y, player.r, H - player.r);
    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;

    // --- Darkness: lit lanterns reduce global darkness ---
    let litCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < lights.length; i++) if (lights[i].lit) litCount++;
    const targetDark = clamp(1.0 - litCount * 0.13, 0.15, 1.0);
    darkness += (targetDark - darkness) * Math.min(1, dt * 2);

    // --- Creatures ---
    for (let i = 0; i < creatures.length; i++) {
      const c = creatures[i];

      // In light? Flee. In dark? Aggro toward player.
      let inLight = false;
      for (let j = 0; j < lights.length; j++) {
        if (lights[j].lit && dist(c.x, c.y, lights[j].x, lights[j].y) < lights[j].radius) {
          inLight = true;
          // flee from that lantern
          const a = Math.atan2(c.y - lights[j].y, c.x - lights[j].x);
          c.vx += Math.cos(a) * 60 * dt;
          c.vy += Math.sin(a) * 60 * dt;
        }
      }

      if (inLight) {
        c.aggro = false;
      } else {
        // aggro: move toward player
        const a = Math.atan2(player.y - c.y, player.x - c.x);
        c.vx += Math.cos(a) * c.speed * dt;
        c.vy += Math.sin(a) * c.speed * dt;
        c.aggro = true;
      }

      // light also pushes player slightly? no.

      // damp
      c.vx *= 0.92;
      c.vy *= 0.92;
      const sp = Math.hypot(c.vx, c.vy);
      const maxSp = inLight ? 120 : c.speed;
      if (sp > maxSp) {
        c.vx = c.vx / sp * maxSp;
        c.vy = c.vy / sp * maxSp;
      }
      c.x += c.vx * dt;
      c.y += c.vy * dt;
      c.x = clamp(c.x, c.r, W - c.r);
      c.y = clamp(c.y, c.r, H - c.r);

      // collision with player
      if (player.invuln <= 0 && dist(c.x, c.y, player.x, player.y) < c.r + player.r) {
        player.hp -= 20;
        player.invuln = 1.0;
        // knockback
        const a = Math.atan2(player.y - c.y, player.x - c.x);
        player.x += Math.cos(a) * 30;
        player.y += Math.sin(a) * 30;
        if (player.hp <= 0) {
          player.hp = 0;
          state = STATE.LOSE;
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Door: opens when enough lights are lit ---
    if (litCount >= 5) {
      door.open = true;
      door.progress = clamp(door.progress + dt * 0.6, 0, 1);
    } else {
      door.open = false;
      door.progress = clamp(door.progress - dt * 0.6, 0, 1);
    }

    // win if player reaches open door
    if (door.open && door.progress >= 0.99) {
      const dx = Math.abs(player.x - door.x);
      const dy = player.y - (door.y + door.h);
      if (dx < door.w / 2 && dy < 40 && dy > -20) {
        state = STATE.WIN;
      }
    }

    updateParticles(dt);
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      if (p.ember) p.vy += 40 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
        // respawn ambient dust
        if (!p.ember && particles.length < 40) {
          particles.push({
            x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H),
            vx: rand(-4, 4), vy: rand(-2, 2),
            life: rand(0.5, 2), max: 2
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function draw() {
    // Background: dark stone room
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0d0a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Floor
    const floorGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 50, W/2, H/2, 500);
    floorGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1f1a');
    floorGrad.addColorStop(1, '#050705');
    ctx.fillStyle = floorGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Floor tiles (subtle)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,50,40,0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const tile = 80;
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += tile) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += tile) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Walls (top band)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e120e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,40,30,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 38, W, 4);

    // Door at top center
    drawDoor();

    // Lights (lanterns)
    for (let i = 0; i < lights.length; i++) {
      drawLantern(lights[i]);
    }

    // Creatures
    for (let i = 0; i < creatures.length; i++) {
      drawCreature(creatures[i]);
    }

    // Player
    drawPlayer();

    // Particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const a = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      if (p.ember) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,60,' + a + ')';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,180,' + (a * 0.4) + ')';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // Darkness overlay with light cutouts
    drawDarkness();

    // Vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 200, W/2, H/2, 520);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (0.5 + darkness * 0.4) + ')');
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    drawHUD();

    // Overlays
    if (state === STATE.START) drawStart();
    else if (state === STATE.WIN) drawWin();
    else if (state === STATE.LOSE) drawLose();
  }

  function drawDoor() {
    const d = door;
    const x = d.x - d.w / 2;
    const y = d.y;
    // frame
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2418';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 8, d.w + 16, d.h + 16);
    // door body
    const openW = d.w * (1 - d.progress * 0.7);
    const offset = (d.w - openW) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = d.open ? '#3a3020' : '#1a1408';
    ctx.fillRect(x + offset, y, openW, d.h);
    // glow when open
    if (d.open) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(d.x, y + d.h, 10, d.x, y + d.h, 120);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,120,' + (0.5 * d.progress) + ')');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,120,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 60, y, d.w + 120, d.h + 120);
    }
    // door handle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7a4a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + d.w - 14, y + d.h / 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawLantern(l) {
    // pole
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3530';
    ctx.fillRect(l.x - 2, l.y, 4, 30);
    // base
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2520';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y + 30, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // lantern body
    if (l.lit) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(l.x, l.y, 5, l.x, l.y, l.radius);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,90,0.9)');
      g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,160,50,0.3)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,40,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, l.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf6a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff0c0';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4540';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2520';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawCreature(c) {
    // shadowy blob
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 2, c.x, c.y, c.r + 6);
    g.addColorStop(0, c.aggro ? 'rgba(120,20,20,0.95)' : 'rgba(30,30,40,0.95)');
    g.addColorStop(0.6, c.aggro ? 'rgba(60,10,10,0.6)' : 'rgba(15,15,25,0.5)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = c.aggro ? '#5a1010' : '#1a1a25';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    const eyeCol = c.aggro ? '#ff3030' : '#5566aa';
    ctx.fillStyle = eyeCol;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x - 4, c.y - 3, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x + 4, c.y - 3, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // tentacles
    ctx.strokeStyle = c.aggro ? 'rgba(90,16,16,0.7)' : 'rgba(26,26,37,0.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + time * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
      ctx.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(a) * (c.r + 8), c.y + Math.sin(a) * (c.r + 8));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    const blink = p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(time * 12) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) return;

    // glow around player
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 2, p.x, p.y, 40);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200,220,255,0.35)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,220,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8d0e0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // head highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eef2ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - 3, p.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // facing indicator
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8899cc';
    const fx = p.x + Math.cos(p.facing) * p.r;
    const fy = p.y + Math.sin(p.facing) * p.r;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx, fy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawDarkness() {
    // A dark layer with holes for lights
    const d = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 100, W/2, H/2, 600);
    d.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (darkness * 0.55) + ')');
    d.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (darkness * 0.92) + ')');
    ctx.fillStyle = d;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Cut light circles (destination-out)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
    for (let i = 0; i < lights.length; i++) {
      const l = lights[i];
      if (!l.lit) continue;
      const r = l.radius * (1 + flicker);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(l.x, l.y, 5, l.x, l.y, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.9)');
      g.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(l.x, l.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    // player small light
    const pr = 60 * (1 + flicker * 0.5);
    const pg = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, 5, player.x, player.y, pr);
    pg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)');
    pg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;

    ctx.restore();

  function drawHUD() {
    // HP bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf6a';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Lanterns: ' + lit + ' / ' + lights.length + '  (need 5)', W - 214, H - 25);
  }

  function overlayText(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 25);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawStart() {
    overlayText('THE LURKING HORROR',
      'Light 5 lanterns to open the door. Avoid the shadows. [WASD / Arrows] move, [F] light lantern.',
      '#c83030');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to begin', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawWin() {
    overlayText('YOU ESCAPED', 'The door swallowed the dark. You are free.', '#5ac85a');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to play again', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawLose() {
    overlayText('THE DARK TOOK YOU', 'Your light faded. The shadows close in.', '#c83030');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to try again', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big frames
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Init
  buildLevel();
  state = STATE.START;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// State
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let gameTime = 0;
let dragonX = 400;
let dragonY = 350;
let dragonVX = 0;
let dragonVY = 0;
let dragonAngle = 0;
let dragonWing = 0;
let invincible = 0;
let shootCooldown = 0;
let particles = [];
let enemies = [];
let enemyTimer = 0;
let stars = [];
let mountains = [];
let clouds = [];
let shakeX = 0;
let shakeY = 0;

// Create stars
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({ x: Math.random() * 800, y: Math.random() * 250, size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5, twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
}

// Create mountains
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
  mountains.push({ x: i * 80 - 40, h: 60 + Math.random() * 100, w: 50 + Math.random() * 40 });
}

// Create clouds
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
  clouds.push({ x: Math.random() * 800, y: 180 + Math.random() * 80, w: 60 + Math.random() * 80, speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3 });
}

// Input
let keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
    if (state === 'start') { state = 'playing'; score = 0; lives = 3; gameTime = 0; enemies = []; particles = []; }
    else if (state === 'gameover') { state = 'start'; }
    else if (state === 'win') { state = 'start'; }
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Update
function update(dt) {
  gameTime += dt;
  dragonWing += dt * 8;

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // Dragon movement
  let ax = 0, ay = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) ax -= 400;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) ax += 400;
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) ay -= 300;
  if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS']) ay += 300;

  dragonVX += ax * dt;
  dragonVY += ay * dt;
  dragonVX *= 0.92;
  dragonVY *= 0.92;
  dragonX += dragonVX * dt;
  dragonY += dragonVY * dt;

  dragonX = Math.max(30, Math.min(770, dragonX));
  dragonY = Math.max(60, Math.min(470, dragonY));

  dragonAngle = Math.atan2(dragonVY, dragonVX) * 0.15;

  // Shooting
  shootCooldown -= dt;
  if ((keys['Space'] || keys['KeyZ']) && shootCooldown <= 0) {
    shootCooldown = 0.2;
    particles.push({
      x: dragonX + Math.cos(dragonAngle) * 30,
      y: dragonY + Math.sin(dragonAngle) * 30,
      vx: Math.cos(dragonAngle) * 500,
      vy: Math.sin(dragonAngle) * 500,
      life: 1,
      type: 'bullet',
      size: 4
    });
  }

  // Enemy spawning
  enemyTimer -= dt;
  if (enemyTimer <= 0) {
    enemyTimer = Math.max(0.5, 2 - gameTime * 0.02);
    let side = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    enemies.push({
      x: side > 0 ? 820 : -20,
      y: 50 + Math.random() * 400,
      vx: side > 0 ? -(80 + Math.random() * 60) : (80 + Math.random() * 60),
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
      hp: 1,
      type: Math.random() > 0.3 ? 'drone' : 'tank',
      size: Math.random() > 0.3 ? 20 : 30
    });
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let e = enemies[i];
    e.x += e.vx * dt;
    e.y += e.vy * dt;
    e.vy += Math.sin(gameTime * 3 + i) * 20 * dt;
    if (e.x < -50 || e.x > 850) enemies.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt * (p.type === 'bullet' ? 0.5 : 1.5);
    if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }

    if (p.type === 'bullet') {
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        let e = enemies[j];
        let dx = p.x - e.x, dy = p.y - e.y;
        if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < e.size + p.size) {
          enemies.splice(j, 1);
          particles.splice(i, 1);
          score += e.type === 'tank' ? 200 : 100;
          for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            particles.push({
              x: e.x, y: e.y,
              vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*300, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*300,
              life: 0.6, type: 'explosion', size: 3 + Math.random()*3
            });
          }
          shakeX = (Math.random()-0.5)*8;
          shakeY = (Math.random()-0.5)*8;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Collision with enemies
  if (invincible <= 0) {
    for (let e of enemies) {
      let dx = dragonX - e.x, dy = dragonY - e.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < e.size + 20) {
        lives--;
        invincible = 2;
        shakeX = (Math.random()-0.5)*15;
        shakeY = (Math.random()-0.5)*15;
        for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
          particles.push({
            x: dragonX, y: dragonY,
            vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*400, vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*400,
            life: 0.8, type: 'explosion', size: 4
          });
        }
        if (lives <= 0) state = 'gameover';
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  invincible -= dt;

  // Win condition
  if (score >= 5000) state = 'win';

  // Shake decay
  shakeX *= 0.85;
  shakeY *= 0.85;
}

// Draw
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

  // Sky gradient
  let skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 500);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a2a5e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a4a7e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3a6a9e');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);

  // Stars
  for (let s of stars) {
    let alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(gameTime * 2 + s.twinkle);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e0d0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(650, 80, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a2e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(665, 75, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Mountains (far)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2a4e';
  for (let m of mountains) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(m.x - m.w, 350);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x, 350 - m.h);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w, 350);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Mountains (near)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a5e';
  for (let i = 0; i < mountains.length; i++) {
    let m = mountains[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(m.x - m.w * 0.8 + 40, 400);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x + 40, 400 - m.h * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w * 0.8 + 40, 400);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Ground
  let groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 380, 0, 500);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a4a3e');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a3a2e');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 380, 800, 120);

  // Ground lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a5a4e';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    let y = 390 + i * 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(800, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Clouds
  for (let c of clouds) {
    c.x += c.speed;
    if (c.x > 850) c.x = -100;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,210,230,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w, 15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.3, c.y - 5, c.w * 0.6, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Enemies
  for (let e of enemies) {
    if (e.type === 'drone') {
      // Small red drone
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3333';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y - e.size);
      ctx.lineTo(e.x + e.size, e.y);
      ctx.lineTo(e.x, e.y + e.size);
      ctx.lineTo(e.x - e.size, e.y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, e.size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Engine glow
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,50,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.x - Math.sign(e.vx) * e.size, e.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // Larger tank
      ctx.fillStyle = '#884422';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x - e.size, e.y - e.size * 0.6, e.size * 2, e.size * 1.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aa6633';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, e.size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Turret
      ctx.fillStyle = '#663311';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x - 5, e.y - e.size * 0.8, 10, e.size * 0.4);
      // Engine glow
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,150,50,0.6)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(e.x - Math.sign(e.vx) * e.size, e.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    if (p.type === 'bullet') {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100,200,255,${p.life})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,240,255,${p.life * 0.5})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      let r = 255, g = Math.floor(150 * p.life), b = 50;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${p.life})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Dragon (Panzer Dragoon)
  if (state === 'playing' || state === 'start') {
    let dx = dragonX, dy = dragonY;
    if (state === 'start') { dx = 400; dy = 300; }
    let wingOffset = Math.sin(dragonWing) * 15;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(dx, dy);
    ctx.rotate(dragonAngle);

    // Wings
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2244aa';
    // Left wing
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-5, -5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-35, -30 - wingOffset, -55, -10 - wingOffset * 0.5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-35, 5, -5, 5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Right wing
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-5, 5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-35, 30 + wingOffset, -55, 10 + wingOffset * 0.5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-35, -5, -5, -5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Wing membrane
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3366cc';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, -20 - wingOffset * 0.7, -45, -5 - wingOffset * 0.4);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, 3, -10, 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, 3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, 20 + wingOffset * 0.7, -45, 5 + wingOffset * 0.4);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, -3, -10, -3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3355bb';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 25, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5577dd';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(5, -3, 15, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4466cc';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(25, 0, 12, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Snout
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5577dd';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(35, -3);
    ctx.lineTo(45, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(35, 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Eye
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(28, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8800';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(28, -2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Horns
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aabbdd';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(20, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(25, -18);
    ctx.lineTo(28, -8);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(15, -7);
    ctx.lineTo(18, -15);
    ctx.lineTo(21, -7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Tail
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3355bb';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-25, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-45, Math.sin(gameTime * 5) * 10, -60, Math.sin(gameTime * 3) * 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-60, Math.sin(gameTime * 3) * 8);
    ctx.lineTo(-68, Math.sin(gameTime * 3) * 8 - 5);
    ctx.lineTo(-65, Math.sin(gameTime * 3) * 8 + 5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5577dd';
    ctx.fill();

    // Legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3355bb';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(5, 10);
    ctx.lineTo(10, 20);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-5, 10);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, 20);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();

    // Invincibility flash
    if (invincible > 0 && Math.floor(invincible * 10) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(dx, dy, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // UI
  if (state === 'playing') {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 20, 30);

    // Lives
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(20 + i * 25, 55, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Progress bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(20, 75, 200, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
    ctx.fillRect(20, 75, 200 * Math.min(1, score / 5000), 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '10px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('GOAL: 5000', 20, 95);
  }

  // Start screen
  if (state === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('PANZER DRAGOON', 400, 150);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('II ZWEI', 400, 210);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('A Dragon Rider\'s Journey', 400, 260);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('ARROW KEYS / WASD - Move', 400, 320);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE / Z - Fire', 400, 345);
    ctx.fillText('Destroy enemies. Reach 5000 points to win.', 400, 370);

    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(gameTime * 3)})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', 400, 430);
  }

  // Game Over
  if (state === 'gameover') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', 400, 200);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, 400, 260);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(gameTime * 3)})`;
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE', 400, 340);
  }

  // Win
  if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,50,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 500);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('VICTORY!', 400, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('The dragon rider has triumphed.', 400, 240);
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 400, 280);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('The world is safe once more.', 400, 330);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(gameTime * 3)})`;
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RESTART', 400, 400);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// Game loop
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(timestamp) {
  let dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
