<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Skool Daze</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#101418;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}
  #game{display:block;margin:0 auto;background:#000;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- constants ----------
  const W = 800, H = 480;
  const GROUND = 360;      // floor y
  const MAXHP = 5;
  const MAXSTAM = 100;
  const GRAV = 0.8;
  const MOVE = 3.2;
  const JUMP = -13;
  const PUNCH_RANGE = 34;
  const PUNCH_DMG = 1;
  const PUNCH_CD = 0.28;
  const PUNCH_ACTIVE = 0.14;
  const PUNCH_KNOCK = 7;
  const DODGE_CD = 0.5;
  const DODGE_TIME = 0.32;
  const INVULN = 0.9;
  const WAVE_DELAY = 2.2;
  const ENEMY_BASE = 1.4;

  const SKIN = ["#f2c9a0", "#e0b48c", "#c69a6b", "#f7d3b0"];
  const SHIRT = ["#e74c3c", "#2980b9", "#27ae60", "#f39c12", "#8e44ad", "#16a085"];
  const PANTS = ["#2c3e50", "#34495e", "#5d4037", "#37474f"];
  const HAIR  = ["#2b1d12", "#5a3a1a", "#111", "#7a4a1f", "#8a8a8a"];

  // ---------- state ----------
  let canvas, ctx;
  let player, enemies, particles;
  let score, wave, waveTimer, state, shake;
  let keys = {}, kJust = {};
  let last = 0;
  let hudFont = "16px Arial";

  function makePlayer(){
    return {
      x: 200, y: GROUND, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      facing: 1, onGround: true,
      hp: MAXHP, stamina: MAXSTAM,
      punching: false, punchT: 0, punchCd: 0,
      dodging: false, dodgeT: 0, dodgeCd: 0,
      invuln: 0,
      skin: SKIN[0], shirt: "#e74c3c", pants: "#2c3e50", hair: HAIR[0]
    };
  }

  function makeEnemy(x, y, difficulty){
    return {
      x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      facing: -1, onGround: true,
      hp: 3 + Math.floor(difficulty / 3),
      maxhp: 3 + Math.floor(difficulty / 3),
      speed: ENEMY_BASE + Math.min(1.6, difficulty * 0.06),
      attackCd: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8,
      hitCd: 0, hitFlash: 0,
      skin: SKIN[(Math.random() * SKIN.length) | 0],
      shirt: SHIRT[(Math.random() * SHIRT.length) | 0],
      pants: PANTS[(Math.random() * PANTS.length) | 0],
      hair: HAIR[(Math.random() * HAIR.length) | 0]
    };
  }

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function clamp(v, a, b){ return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function rand(a, b){ return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function aabb(a, b){
    return Math.abs((a.x + 13) - (b.x + 13)) < 26 &&
           Math.abs((a.y - 34) - (b.y - 34)) < 60;
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, n){
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: rand(-3, 3), vy: rand(-5, 0),
        life: rand(0.3, 0.7), color: color, r: rand(2, 4)
      });
    }
  }

  function startGame(){
    player = makePlayer();
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    score = 0;
    wave = 0;
    waveTimer = 1.2;
    state = "playing";
    shake = 0;
    keys = {}; kJust = {};
  }

  function nextWave(){
    wave++;
    const n = Math.min(7, 2 + wave);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      const x = 460 + i * 95 + rand(-15, 15);
      enemies.push(makeEnemy(x, GROUND, wave));
    }
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  function onKey(e, down){
    const c = e.code;
    if (["Space","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","KeyA","KeyD","KeyW","KeyS","KeyJ","KeyK","Enter"].indexOf(c) >= 0){
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (down){
      if (!keys[c]) kJust[c] = true;
      keys[c] = true;
    } else {
      keys[c] = false;
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if (state === "start"){
      if (kJust["Enter"] || kJust["Space"]) startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state === "over"){
      if (kJust["Enter"] || kJust["Space"]) startGame();
      return;
    }

    // timers
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 30);
    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;
    if (player.punchCd > 0) player.punchCd -= dt;
    if (player.dodgeCd > 0) player.dodgeCd -= dt;

    // punch
    if (player.punching){
      player.punchT += dt;
      if (player.punchT >= PUNCH_ACTIVE){
        player.punching = false;
      }
    }

    // movement
    let dir = 0;
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["KeyA"]) dir -= 1;
    if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["KeyD"]) dir += 1;

    if (player.dodging){
      player.dodgeT -= dt;
      if (player.dodgeT <= 0) player.dodging = false;
    } else if (dir !== 0){
      player.vx = dir * MOVE;
      player.facing = dir;
    } else {
      player.vx = 0;
    }

    // jump
    if ((kJust["ArrowUp"] || kJust["KeyW"] || kJust["KeyK"]) && player.onGround && !player.dodging){
      player.vy = JUMP;
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // dodge
    if ((kJust["KeyS"] || kJust["ArrowDown"]) && !player.dodging && player.dodgeCd <= 0 && player.stamina >= 25){
      player.dodging = true;
      player.dodgeT = DODGE_TIME;
      player.dodgeCd = DODGE_CD;
      player.stamina -= 25;
      player.invuln = Math.max(player.invuln, DODGE_TIME);
    }

    // punch
    if (kJust["KeyJ"] && !player.punching && player.punchCd <= 0 && !player.dodging){
      player.punching = true;
      player.punchT = 0;
      player.punchCd = PUNCH_CD;
    }

    // physics
    player.vy += GRAV;
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;
    if (player.y >= GROUND){
      player.y = GROUND;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    }
    player.x = clamp(player.x, 20, W - 40);

    // stamina
    if (player.dodging){
      player.stamina = Math.max(0, player.stamina - dt * 10);
    } else {
      player.stamina = Math.min(MAXSTAM, player.stamina + dt * 22);
    }

    // punch hit detection
    if (player.punching && player.punchT < PUNCH_ACTIVE){
      for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
        const e = enemies[i];
        const dx = (e.x + 13) - (player.x + 13);
        if (Math.abs(dx) < PUNCH_RANGE && player.facing * dx > 0 &&
            Math.abs((e.y - 34) - (player.y - 34)) < 60){
          e.hp -= PUNCH_DMG;
          e.hitFlash = 0.15;
          e.vx = player.facing * PUNCH_KNOCK;
          e.vy = -3;
          spawnParticles(e.x + 13, e.y - 34, "#ffd54a", 8);
          score += 10;
          shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
          if (e.hp <= 0){
            spawnParticles(e.x + 13, e.y - 34, e.shirt, 14);
            enemies.splice(i, 1);
            score += 40;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // enemies
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const e = enemies[i];
      if (e.hitFlash > 0) e.hitFlash -= dt;
      if (e.hitCd > 0) e.hitCd -= dt;
      if (e.attackCd > 0) e.attackCd -= dt;

      const dx = player.x - e.x;
      const adx = Math.abs(dx);

      if (e.vy === 0 && e.onGround){
        if (adx > 30){
          e.vx = (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1) * e.speed;
          e.facing = dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        } else {
          e.vx = 0;
          e.facing = dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
          if (e.attackCd <= 0){
            e.attackCd = 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.6;
            if (player.invuln <= 0 && !player.dodging && aabb(player, e)){
              player.hp -= 1;
              player.invuln = INVULN;
              player.vx = (player.x > e.x ? 1 : -1) * 5;
              player.vy = -4;
              spawnParticles(player.x + 13, player.y - 34, "#ff5b5b", 10);
              shake = Math.max(shake, 9);
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        e.vx *= 0.9;
      }

      e.vy += GRAV;
      e.x += e.vx;
      e.y += e.vy;
      if (e.y >= GROUND){
        e.y = GROUND;
        e.vy = 0;
        e.onGround = true;
      }
      e.x = clamp(e.x, 20, W - 40);
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.vy += GRAV * 0.5;
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // wave management
    if (enemies.length === 0){
      waveTimer -= dt;
      if (waveTimer <= 0){
        nextWave();
        waveTimer = WAVE_DELAY;
      }
    }

    // lose
    if (player.hp <= 0){
      player.hp = 0;
      state = "over";
    }

    kJust = {};
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GROUND);
    sky.addColorStop(0, "#8ec5ff");
    sky.addColorStop(1, "#d6ecff");
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, GROUND);

    // clouds
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    const clouds = [[120,70],[420,50],[650,90]];
    for (let i = 0; i < clouds.length; i++){
      const cx = clouds[i][0], cy = clouds[i][1];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(cx + 26, cy + 6, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(cx - 24, cy + 8, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 90, 70, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // building
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9a27a";
    ctx.fillRect(40, 150, 300, GROUND - 150);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b58a5f";
    ctx.fillRect(40, 150, 300, 18);
    // roof
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5a3a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(30, 150);
    ctx.lineTo(190, 96);
    ctx.lineTo(350, 150);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // windows
    ctx.fillStyle = "#bfe3ff";
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++){
      for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++){
        ctx.fillRect(70 + c * 65, 190 + r * 55, 40, 34);
      }
    }
    // door
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3a22";
    ctx.fillRect(160, GROUND - 70, 60, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.fillRect(205, GROUND - 40, 6, 6);
    // "SCHOOL" sign
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a2f1a";
    roundRect(120, 168, 140, 26, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("S C H O O L", 190, 186);

    // ground
    const gr = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND, 0, H);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "#7a9e5a");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "#5c7f43");
    ctx.fillStyle = gr;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);
    // sidewalk
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b8b0a4";
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, 26);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8f887c";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 60){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND);
      ctx.lineTo(x, GROUND + 26);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // bushes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3f6b34";
    for (let bx = 60; bx < W; bx += 150){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, GROUND + 14, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(bx + 20, GROUND + 16, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawCharacter(c, isPlayer){
    const x = c.x, y = c.y, f = c.facing;
    const bob = c.onGround && c.vx !== 0 ? Math.sin(Date.now() / 60) * 2 : 0;
    const bodyY = y - 34 + bob;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.22)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + 13, y + 2, 20, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = c.pants;
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    const step = c.onGround && c.vx !== 0 ? Math.sin(Date.now() / 60) * 6 : 0;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 8, bodyY + 22);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6 + step, y);
    ctx.moveTo(x + 18, bodyY + 22);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 20 - step, y);
    ctx.stroke();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = c.shirt;
    roundRect(x + 2, bodyY, 22, 24, 5);
    ctx.fill();

    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = c.shirt;
    ctx.lineWidth = 7;
    if (isPlayer && c.punching){
      const ext = Math.min(1, c.punchT / PUNCH_ACTIVE) * 22;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 12, bodyY + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 12 + f * (10 + ext), bodyY + 8);
      ctx.stroke();
      // fist
      ctx.fillStyle = c.skin;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + 12 + f * (10 + ext), bodyY + 8, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c.shirt;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 12, bodyY + 10);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 12 - f * 6, bodyY + 18);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + 4, bodyY + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 2, bodyY + 20);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 22, bodyY + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 24, bodyY + 20);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = c.skin;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 13, bodyY - 8, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = c.hair;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 13, bodyY - 11, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // face
    ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 13 + f * 4, bodyY - 8, 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#222";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 13 + f * 3, bodyY - 3, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();

    // hit flash
    if (c.hitFlash > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
      roundRect(x + 2, bodyY - 20, 22, 46, 6);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // player invuln blink
    if (isPlayer && c.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(Date.now() / 80) % 2 === 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      roundRect(x + 2, bodyY - 20, 22, 46, 6);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++){
      const p = particles[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life / 0.5));
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHud(){
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.font = hudFont;
    // hearts
    for (let i = 0; i < MAXHP; i++){
      const hx = 20 + i * 26, hy = 22;
      const full = i < player.hp;
      ctx.fillStyle = full ? "#e74c3c" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hx + 6, hy + 6, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(hx + 16, hy + 6, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.moveTo(hx + 2, hy + 9);
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy + 20);
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 20, hy + 9);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // stamina bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    roundRect(20, 44, 120, 12, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#37d0a0";
    roundRect(20, 44, 120 * (player.stamina / MAXSTAM), 12, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "11px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("STAMINA", 22, 68);

    // score + wave
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, W - 20, 30);
    ctx.font = "16px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.fillText("WAVE " + wave, W - 20, 54);

    // remaining enemies
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "14px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("LEFT: " + enemies.length, W / 2, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawStart(){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,15,25,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.font = "bold 56px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("SKOOL DAZE", W / 2, 150);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "20px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("The hall is full of bullies. Take them all out.", W / 2, 195);
    ctx.font = "16px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe3ff";
    ctx.fillText("MOVE  A / D  or  ARROWS", W / 2, 250);
    ctx.fillText("JUMP  W  or  ARROW-UP  or  K", W / 2, 275);
    ctx.fillText("PUNCH  J", W / 2, 300);
    ctx.fillText("DODGE  S  or  ARROW-DOWN", W / 2, 325);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#37d0a0";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  START", W / 2, 390);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,15,25,0.78)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5b5b";
    ctx.font = "bold 54px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("WASTED", W / 2, 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "22px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("You reached wave " + wave + "  with a score of " + score, W / 2, 210);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#37d0a0";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  RETRY", W / 2, 300);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0){
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++){
      drawCharacter(enemies[i], false);
    }
    drawCharacter(player, true);
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHud();
    if (state === "start") drawStart();
    if (state === "over") drawOver();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(t){
    if (!last) last = t;
    let dt = (t - last) / 1000;
    last = t;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- init ----------
  function init(){
    canvas = document.getElementById("game");
    ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
    window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ onKey(e, true); });
    window.addEventListener("keyup", function(e){ onKey(e, false); });
    startGame();
    state = "start";
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Spare Change</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #12121a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #stage {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 0 3px #2a2a3a;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #20202f;
    display: block;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="480" height="720"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
  const W = 480, H = 720;
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  let state = "title";
  let score = 0;
  let coins = 0;
  const GOAL = 10;

  const player = {
    x: W / 2,
    y: 0,
    r: 24,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    baseR: 24,
    glow: 0,
    trail: []
  };

  const coinsArr = [];
  const particles = [];
  const texts = [];
  const bgCoins = [];

  let time = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;
  let winTimer = 0;
  let loseTimer = 0;
  let best = 0;

  const keys = {};

  const canvas = document.getElementById("stage");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function randInt(a, b) { return Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1)); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
  function dist2(x1, y1, x2, y2) { const dx = x1 - x2, dy = y1 - y2; return dx * dx + dy * dy; }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawCoin(cx, cy, radius, face, spin) {
    const sx = Math.max(0.12, Math.abs(Math.cos(spin)));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.scale(sx, 1);

    // outer ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b8860b";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = radius * 0.12;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a6508";
    ctx.stroke();

    // inner face
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, radius * 0.82, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = face;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = radius * 0.06;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    ctx.stroke();

    // highlight
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-radius * 0.28, -radius * 0.34, radius * 0.3, radius * 0.18, -0.5, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
    ctx.fill();

    // center mark
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.35)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, radius * 0.14, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function spawnParticle(x, y, color, n, spread) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * TAU;
      const s = rand(1, spread);
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: rand(20, 45),
        max: 45,
        color,
        r: rand(2, 5)
      });
    }
  }

  function addText(x, y, str, color, size) {
    texts.push({ x, y, str, color, size, life: 60, max: 60, vy: -0.8 });
  }

  function resetGame() {
    state = "play";
    score = 0;
    coins = 0;
    winTimer = 0;
    loseTimer = 0;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H * 0.72;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.r = player.baseR;
    player.glow = 0;
    player.trail = [];
    coinsArr.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    texts.length = 0;
    spawnCoin();
    spawnCoin();
    spawnCoin();
  }

  function spawnCoin() {
    if (coinsArr.length >= 6) return;
    const face = Math.random() < 0.5 ? "#e8c34a" : "#d9a441";
    const x = rand(50, W - 50);
    const y = rand(70, H * 0.4);
    const c = {
      x, y,
      r: rand(18, 26),
      face,
      spin: Math.random() * TAU,
      spinSpeed: rand(0.03, 0.09) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
      bob: Math.random() * TAU,
      bobSpeed: rand(0.02, 0.05),
      drift: rand(-0.3, 0.3),
      driftY: rand(-0.2, 0.2)
    };
    coinsArr.push(c);
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  function pressKey(k) {
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state === "title" && (k === "Enter" || k === " ")) {
      resetGame();
    } else if (state === "win" && (k === "Enter" || k === " ")) {
      state = "title";
    } else if (state === "lose" && (k === "Enter" || k === " ")) {
      resetGame();
    }
  }
  function releaseKey(k) { keys[k] = false; }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (["ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight"," "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    pressKey(k);
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", e => { releaseKey(e.key); });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update() {
    time++;

    // background coins drift
    for (const b of bgCoins) {
      b.y -= b.speed;
      b.spin += b.spinSpeed;
      if (b.y < -40) { b.y = H + 40; b.x = rand(0, W); }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // floating texts
    for (let i = texts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = texts[i];
      t.y += t.vy;
      t.life--;
      if (t.life <= 0) texts.splice(i, 1);
    }

    shake *= 0.85;
    flash *= 0.9;

    if (state === "play") {
      // movement
      const speed = 4.2;
      let mx = 0, my = 0;
      if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"] || keys["A"]) mx -= 1;
      if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"] || keys["D"]) mx += 1;
      if (keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["w"] || keys["W"]) my -= 1;
      if (keys["ArrowDown"] || keys["s"] || keys["S"]) my += 1;
      if (mx && my) { mx *= 0.7071; my *= 0.7071; }
      player.vx = mx * speed;
      player.vy = my * speed;
      player.x = clamp(player.x + player.vx, player.r, W - player.r);
      player.y = clamp(player.y + player.vy, player.r, H - player.r);

      // trail
      player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, r: player.r, life: 14 });
      if (player.trail.length > 20) player.trail.shift();
      for (const tr of player.trail) tr.life--;

      player.glow = lerp(player.glow, (mx || my) ? 1 : 0, 0.2);

      // coins drift + spin
      for (const c of coinsArr) {
        c.spin += c.spinSpeed;
        c.bob += c.bobSpeed;
        c.x += c.drift;
        c.y += c.driftY + Math.sin(c.bob) * 0.2;
        if (c.x < c.r || c.x > W - c.r) c.drift *= -1;
        if (c.y < c.r || c.y > H - c.r) c.driftY *= -1;
      }

      // collision: collect
      for (let i = coinsArr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const c = coinsArr[i];
        const rr = player.r + c.r;
        if (dist2(player.x, player.y, c.x, c.y) < rr * rr) {
          coinsArr.splice(i, 1);
          coins++;
          score += 100;
          player.r = Math.min(player.baseR + coins * 2.5, player.baseR + 40);
          player.glow = 1;
          shake = 6;
          flash = 0.5;
          spawnParticle(c.x, c.y, c.face, 18, 5);
          addText(c.x, c.y - 10, "+100", "#ffe98a", 20);
          if (coins >= GOAL) {
            state = "win";
            winTimer = 0;
            best = Math.max(best, score);
            shake = 12;
            spawnParticle(player.x, player.y, "#ffe98a", 40, 7);
          } else {
            spawnCoin();
          }
        }
      }

      // spawn more if running low
      if (coinsArr.length < 3 && Math.random() < 0.05) spawnCoin();

    } else if (state === "win") {
      winTimer++;
      if (winTimer % 8 === 0) {
        spawnParticle(rand(0, W), rand(0, H * 0.5), Math.random() < 0.5 ? "#ffe98a" : "#d9a441", 10, 4);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#1a1a2e");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#23233a");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#141422");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft radial glow center
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.4, 40, W/2, H*0.4, 400);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,210,120,.10)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,210,120,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // faint grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.03)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke(); }

    // background floating coins
    for (const b of bgCoins) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.alpha;
      drawCoin(b.x, b.y, b.r, b.face, b.spin);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    // trail
    for (const tr of player.trail) {
      const a = tr.life / 14;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y, tr.r * (0.6 + 0.4 * a), 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,200,90," + (a * 0.25) + ")";
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // glow
    if (player.glow > 0.05) {
      const gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, player.r * 0.5, player.x, player.y, player.r * 2.4);
      gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,120," + (0.5 * player.glow) + ")");
      gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,120,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = gr;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r * 2.4, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // body
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(time * 0.1) * 0.03;
    ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, player.r, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4c542";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9961f";
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, player.r * 0.78, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe07a";
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2a3a";
    const eyeOff = player.r * 0.32;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-eyeOff, -player.r*0.1, player.r*0.13, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(eyeOff, -player.r*0.1, player.r*0.13, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();

    // mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2a3a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, player.r*0.15, player.r*0.28, 0.15*Math.PI, 0.85*Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCoins() {
    for (const c of coinsArr) {
      const bobY = c.y + Math.sin(c.bob) * 4;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(c.x, bobY);
      ctx.scale(1, 1);
      ctx.translate(-c.x, -bobY);
      ctx.restore();
      drawCoin(c.x, bobY, c.r, c.face, c.spin);
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const a = p.life / p.max;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * a, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawTexts() {
    for (const t of texts) {
      const a = t.life / t.max;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.font = "bold " + t.size + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.fillText(t.str, t.x, t.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.35)";
    roundRect(12, 12, W - 24, 46, 10);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe98a";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE", 26, 30);
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 26, 52);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe98a";
    ctx.fillText("COINS", W - 26, 30);
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText(coins + " / " + GOAL, W - 26, 52);

    // coin progress dots
    const dotY = H - 24;
    const spacing = 34;
    const startX = W / 2 - (GOAL - 1) * spacing / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < GOAL; i++) {
      const x = startX + i * spacing;
      const filled = i < coins;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, dotY, 9, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = filled ? "#f4c542" : "rgba(255,255,255,.15)";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = filled ? "#c9961f" : "rgba(255,255,255,.2)";
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color, btn) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,10,20,.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 46px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.4);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H * 0.4 + 40);

    const blink = Math.floor(time / 30) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe98a";
      ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText(btn, W / 2, H * 0.58);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }

    drawBackground();

    if (state === "title") {
      // decorative coins
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const cx = W/2 + Math.cos(time*0.02 + i*1.3) * 120;
        const cy = H*0.42 + Math.sin(time*0.025 + i*1.7) * 60;
        drawCoin(cx, cy, 20, i % 2 ? "#e8c34a" : "#d9a441", time*0.05 + i);
      }
      drawOverlay("SPARE CHANGE", "Collect 10 coins to win", "#ffe98a", "PRESS ENTER TO START");
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.5)";
      ctx.font = "14px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("Move: Arrows or WASD", W/2, H*0.66);
      if (best > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe98a"; ctx.fillText("Best: " + best, W/2, H*0.7); }
    } else {
      drawCoins();
      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawTexts();
      drawHUD();

      if (state === "win") {
        drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "Score: " + score, "#ffe98a", "PRESS ENTER FOR TITLE");
      } else if (state === "lose") {
        drawOverlay("GAME OVER", "Score: " + score, "#ff6b6b", "PRESS ENTER TO RETRY");
      }
    }

    // flash
    if (flash > 0.05) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,180," + flash + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- INIT ----------
  function initBg() {
    bgCoins.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      bgCoins.push({
        x: rand(0, W),
        y: rand(0, H),
        r: rand(10, 22),
        face: i % 2 ? "#e8c34a" : "#d9a441",
        spin: Math.random() * TAU,
        spinSpeed: rand(0.02, 0.06),
        speed: rand(0.2, 0.7),
        alpha: rand(0.08, 0.2)
      });
    }
  }
  initBg();

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
  // ==================== STATE ====================
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  let state = 'menu';       // 'menu', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
  let score = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let frame = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  const player = {
    x: W / 2,
    y: H - 70,
    w: 36,
    h: 46,
    vx: 0,
    speed: 4.6,
    facing: 0,
    invuln: 0
  };

  const keys = {};
  const mouse = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, down: false };

  let bullets = [];
  let enemyBullets = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let particles = [];
  let stars = [];

  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 90;
  let killTarget = 30;
  let wave = 1;

  // ==================== HELPERS ====================
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }

  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    frame = 0;
    shake = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - 70;
    player.invuln = 0;
    bullets = [];
    enemyBullets = [];
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = 90;
    killTarget = 30;
    wave = 1;
  }

  // ==================== INPUT ====================
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (state === 'menu' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
      resetGame();
      state = 'playing';
    }
    if ((state === 'won' || state === 'lost') && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
      resetGame();
      state = 'playing';
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === 'menu') { resetGame(); state = 'playing'; }
    else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') { resetGame(); state = 'playing'; }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === 'menu') { resetGame(); state = 'playing'; }
    else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') { resetGame(); state = 'playing'; }
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { mouse.down = false; });

  // ==================== SPAWNING ====================
  function spawnEnemy() {
    const type = Math.random() < 0.25 ? 'heavy' : 'grunt';
    const ex = rand(60, W - 60);
    const enemy = {
      x: ex,
      y: -40,
      w: type === 'heavy' ? 46 : 34,
      h: type === 'heavy' ? 46 : 34,
      vx: rand(-1.4, 1.4),
      vy: type === 'heavy' ? rand(0.7, 1.0) : rand(1.0, 1.6),
      hp: type === 'heavy' ? 3 : 1,
      type: type,
      fireTimer: rand(30, 90),
      fireRate: type === 'heavy' ? rand(70, 110) : rand(90, 140),
      wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2)
    };
    enemies.push(enemy);
  }

  // ==================== PARTICLES ====================
  function explode(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const s = rand(1, 5);
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: rand(20, 45),
        maxLife: 45,
        color: color,
        size: rand(2, 5)
      });
    }
  }

  // ==================== UPDATE ====================
  function update() {
    frame++;
    if (shake > 0) shake -= 0.5;

    // stars always move
    for (let s of stars) {
      s.y += s.speed;
      if (s.y > H) { s.y = -2; s.x = rand(0, W); }
    }

    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // --- player movement ---
    let mx = 0;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) mx -= 1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) mx += 1;
    player.x += mx * player.speed;
    player.x = Math.max(player.w / 2, Math.min(W - player.w / 2, player.x));
    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln--;

    // aim
    player.facing = Math.atan2(mouse.y - player.y, mouse.x - player.x);

    // --- shooting ---
    if (mouse.down && frame % 7 === 0) {
      const a = player.facing;
      bullets.push({
        x: player.x + Math.cos(a) * 22,
        y: player.y + Math.sin(a) * 22,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * 9,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * 9,
        r: 4
      });
      // muzzle flash
      particles.push({
        x: player.x + Math.cos(a) * 26,
        y: player.y + Math.sin(a) * 26,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * 2, vy: Math.sin(a) * 2,
        life: 8, maxLife: 8, color: '#ffdd66', size: 7
      });
    }

    // --- update bullets ---
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10 || b.y < -10 || b.y > H + 10) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // --- update enemy bullets ---
    for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10 || b.y < -10 || b.y > H + 10) enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      // hit player
      if (player.invuln <= 0 && dist(b.x, b.y, player.x, player.y) < player.w / 2 + b.r) {
        enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
        loseLife();
      }
    }

    // --- update enemies ---
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      e.wobble += 0.08;
      e.x += e.vx + Math.sin(e.wobble) * 0.6;
      e.y += e.vy;
      if (e.x < e.w / 2) { e.x = e.w / 2; e.vx *= -1; }
      if (e.x > W - e.w / 2) { e.x = W - e.w / 2; e.vx *= -1; }

      // fire
      e.fireTimer--;
      if (e.fireTimer <= 0 && e.y > 0 && e.y < H - 100) {
        const a = Math.atan2(player.y - e.y, player.x - e.x);
        const sp = e.type === 'heavy' ? 4.5 : 3.6;
        enemyBullets.push({
          x: e.x, y: e.y + e.h / 2,
          vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
          r: e.type === 'heavy' ? 5 : 4
        });
        e.fireTimer = e.fireRate;
      }

      // reached bottom
      if (e.y > H + 20) {
        enemies.splice(i, 1);
        loseLife();
        continue;
      }

      // bullet hits enemy
      for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const b = bullets[j];
        if (dist(b.x, b.y, e.x, e.y) < e.w / 2 + b.r) {
          bullets.splice(j, 1);
          e.hp--;
          explode(b.x, b.y, '#ffaa33', 5);
          if (e.hp <= 0) {
            explode(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'heavy' ? '#ff5522' : '#66ddff', 18);
            enemies.splice(i, 1);
            score += e.type === 'heavy' ? 50 : 20;
            shake = 6;
            if (score >= killTarget) {
              state = 'won';
            }
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // --- spawn enemies ---
    spawnTimer++;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnEnemy();
      // ramp up
      if (spawnInterval > 35) spawnInterval -= 2;
    }

    // --- update particles ---
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      p.vx *= 0.96; p.vy *= 0.96;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    player.invuln = 90;
    shake = 14;
    explode(player.x, player.y, '#ff3355', 20);
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = 'lost';
    }
  }

  // ==================== DRAW ====================
  function drawBackground() {
    // sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0520');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a0a35');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#2a0a20');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (let s of stars) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.3 + s.bright) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // distant planet
    const pg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W - 160, 120, 10, W - 160, 120, 80);
    pg.addColorStop(0, '#ff8855');
    pg.addColorStop(0.6, '#cc3355');
    pg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,20,60,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 160, 120, 80, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // ground / base
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 30, W, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a45';
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 5, H - 22, 30, 6);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a60';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 32, W, 4);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);

    // invulnerability flicker
    if (p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(frame / 4) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
    }

    // engine glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,200,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, p.h / 2 + 4, 10, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2288cc';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-p.w / 2, p.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-p.w / 2 + 6, -p.h / 2 + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(p.w / 2 - 6, -p.h / 2 + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(p.w / 2, p.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ddff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -p.h / 2 + 14, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // wings
    ctx.fillStyle = '#115588';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-p.w / 2, p.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-p.w / 2 - 12, p.h / 2 + 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-p.w / 2 + 2, p.h / 2 - 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.w / 2, p.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(p.w / 2 + 12, p.h / 2 + 4);
    ctx.lineTo(p.w / 2 - 2, p.h / 2 - 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // gun barrel
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#aaddff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(p.facing) * 26, Math.sin(p.facing) * 26);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    const heavy = e.type === 'heavy';
    const c1 = heavy ? '#cc2244' : '#44aaff';
    const c2 = heavy ? '#881133' : '#2266aa';

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = c1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-e.w / 2, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2 + 6, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2 - 6, e.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // top
    ctx.fillStyle = c2;
    ctx.fillRect(-e.w / 2 + 4, -e.h / 2 - 6, e.w - 8, 8);

    // eye / core
    ctx.fillStyle = heavy ? '#ffcc00' : '#ff6688';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 2, heavy ? 9 : 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // spikes
    ctx.fillStyle = c2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-e.w / 2 - 6, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2 - 14, e.h / 2 + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2 + 2, e.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(e.w / 2 + 6, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2 + 14, e.h / 2 + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2 - 2, e.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullets() {
    for (let b of bullets) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffee66';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,100,0.4)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (let b of enemyBullets) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,80,100,0.4)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (let p of particles) {
      const a = p.life / p.maxLife;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 20, 34);

    // target
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('TARGET: ' + killTarget, 20, 56);

    // progress bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(20, 64, 200, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.fillRect(20, 64, Math.min(200, (score / killTarget) * 200), 8);

    // lives
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6688';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    let hearts = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += '\u2665 ';
    ctx.fillText(hearts, W - 20, 34);

    // wave
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + wave, W - 20, 56);

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawOverlay(text, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to play', W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawMenu() {
    drawBackground();
    // title
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3355';
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('CROSSFIRE', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Defend the base. Destroy 30 enemies.', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('A / D or Arrows to move - Mouse to aim & shoot', W / 2, H / 2 + 45);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 85);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }

    if (state === 'menu') {
      drawMenu();
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawParticles();
    drawBullets();
    for (let e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === 'won') drawOverlay('VICTORY!', 'Score: ' + score, '#ffdd44');
    if (state === 'lost') drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: ' + score, '#ff3355');

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ==================== INIT ====================
  function initStars() {
    stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: rand(0, W),
        y: rand(0, H),
        speed: rand(0.3, 1.5),
        size: rand(0.5, 2),
        bright: rand(0, 0.5)
      });
    }
  }
  initStars();

  // ==================== LOOP ====================
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width = 800;
  const H = canvas.height = 600;

  // ========================
  // STATE
  // ========================
  let gameState = 'menu';
  let score = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let timer = 0;
  let frameCount = 0;

  const player = {
    x: 100,
    y: 300,
    w: 30,
    h: 40,
    speed: 4,
    facing: 1,

    invincible: 0
  };

  let bullets = [];

  const keys = {};

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {

    }
    if (gameState === 'gameover' && e.key === 'Enter') {

  // ========================
  // LEVEL GENERATION
  // ========================
  function buildLevel() {
    enemies = [];
    powerups = [];

    const enemyCount = 12;
    for (let i = 0; i < enemyCount; i++) {
      const ex = 500 + i * 220 + Math.random() * 80;
      const ey = 60 + Math.random() * (LEVEL_H - 120);
      enemies.push({
        x: ex,
        y: ey,
        w: 30,
        h: 40,
        hp: 3,
        speed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8,
        dir: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1,
        shootTimer: 60 + Math.random() * 120,
        alive: true,
        type: i % 3 === 0 ? 'heavy' : 'soldier'
      });
    }

    const powerupCount = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < powerupCount; i++) {
      powerups.push({
        x: 400 + i * 550 + Math.random() * 100,
        y: 80 + Math.random() * (LEVEL_H - 160),
        w: 24,
        h: 24,
        type: i % 2 === 0 ? 'health' : 'ammo',
        collected: false
      });
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    gameState = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    frameCount = 0;
    player.x = 100;
    player.y = 300;
    player.alive = true;
    player.invincible = 0;
    bullets = [];
    particles = [];
    buildLevel();
  }

  // ========================
  // UPDATE
  // ========================
  function update() {
    frameCount++;

    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

    // Player movement
    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) {
      player.x -= player.speed;
      player.facing = -1;
    }
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) {
      player.x += player.speed;
      player.facing = 1;
    }
    if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) {
      player.y -= player.speed;
    }
    if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) {
      player.y += player.speed;
    }

    player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(LEVEL_W - player.w, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(LEVEL_H - player.h, player.y));

    if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;

    // Shooting
    if (keys[' '] || keys['f'] || keys['F']) {
      if (frameCount % 15 === 0) {
        bullets.push({
          x: player.x + (player.facing > 0 ? player.w : 0),
          y: player.y + player.h / 2 - 3,
          vx: player.facing * 10,
          w: 12,
          h: 6,
          from: 'player'
        });
      }
    }

    // Update bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      if (b.x < -20 || b.x > LEVEL_W + 20) {
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      if (b.from === 'player') {
        for (let j = 0; j < enemies.length; j++) {
          const e = enemies[j];
          if (!e.alive) continue;
          if (b.x + b.w > e.x && b.x < e.x + e.w &&
              b.y + b.h > e.y && b.y < e.y + e.h) {
            e.hp--;
            bullets.splice(i, 1);
            spawnParticles(b.x, b.y, '#ff4444', 5);
            if (e.hp <= 0) {
              e.alive = false;
              score += e.type === 'heavy' ? 300 : 100;
              spawnParticles(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, '#ff6600', 15);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (player.invincible <= 0) {
          if (b.x + b.w > player.x && b.x < player.x + player.w &&
              b.y + b.h > player.y && b.y < player.y + player.h) {
            bullets.splice(i, 1);
            lives--;
            player.invincible = 90;
            spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#ff0000', 12);
            if (lives <= 0) {
              player.alive = false;
              gameState = 'gameover';
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Update enemies
    for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      if (!e.alive) continue;

      // Move toward player
      const dx = player.x - e.x;
      const dy = player.y - e.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      if (dist > 150) {
        e.x += (dx / dist) * e.speed;
        e.y += (dy / dist) * e.speed;
      }

      // Shoot
      e.shootTimer--;
      if (e.shootTimer <= 0 && dist < 500) {
        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        bullets.push({
          x: e.x + e.w / 2,
          y: e.y + e.h / 2,
          vx: Math.cos(angle) * 6,
          w: 10,
          h: 5,
          from: 'enemy'
        });
        e.shootTimer = 80 + Math.random() * 80;
      }

      // Contact damage
      if (player.invincible <= 0) {
        if (player.x + player.w > e.x && player.x < e.x + e.w &&
            player.y + player.h > e.y && player.y < e.y + e.h) {
          lives--;
          player.invincible = 90;
          spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#ff0000', 10);
          if (lives <= 0) {
            player.alive = false;
            gameState = 'gameover';
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Powerups
    for (let i = 0; i < powerups.length; i++) {
      const p = powerups[i];
      if (p.collected) continue;
      if (player.x + player.w > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.w &&
          player.y + player.h > p.y && player.y < p.y + p.h) {
        p.collected = true;
        if (p.type === 'health') {
          lives = Math.min(5, lives + 1);
        } else {

        }
        spawnParticles(p.x + p.w / 2, p.y + p.h / 2, '#00ff88', 8);
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.3;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Camera
    const targetCam = player.x - W / 2 + player.w / 2;
    camX += (targetCam - camX) * 0.1;
    camX = Math.max(0, Math.min(LEVEL_W - W, camX));

    // Win check
    const aliveEnemies = enemies.filter(function (e) { return e.alive; });
    if (aliveEnemies.length === 0) {
      gameState = 'win';
      score += 1000;
    }
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6 - 2,
        life: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  // ========================
  // DRAW
  // ========================
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (gameState === 'menu') {
      drawMenu();
      return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'gameover' || gameState === 'win') {
      drawScene();
      drawEndScreen();
      return;
    }

    drawScene();
    drawHUD();
  }

  function drawScene() {
    const sx = -camX;

    // Background - castle interior
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1218';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stone wall pattern
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2028';
    for (let row = 0; row < 15; row++) {
      for (let col = 0; col < 20; col++) {
        const bx = (col * 80 + (row % 2) * 40) + sx;
        const by = row * 40;
        if (bx > -80 && bx < W + 80) {
          ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, by + 2, 76, 36);
        }
      }
    }

    // Archways in background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0a0f';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const ax = (i * 550 + 200) + sx;
      if (ax > -100 && ax < W + 100) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ax, 500);
        ctx.lineTo(ax, 200);
        ctx.arc(ax + 50, 200, 50, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(ax + 100, 500);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#050308';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ax + 15, 500);
        ctx.lineTo(ax + 15, 220);
        ctx.arc(ax + 50, 220, 35, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(ax + 85, 500);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0a0f';
      }
    }

    // Floor
    ctx.fillStyle = '#221a22';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 480, W, 120);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#332833';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const fx = (i * 80) + sx;
      if (fx > -80 && fx < W + 80) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(fx, 480);
        ctx.lineTo(fx - 30, H);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 520);
    ctx.lineTo(W, 520);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 560);
    ctx.lineTo(W, 560);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Torches
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const tx = (i * 450 + 100) + sx;
      if (tx > -50 && tx < W + 50) {
        drawTorch(tx, 150);
      }
    }

    // Powerups
    for (let i = 0; i < powerups.length; i++) {
      const p = powerups[i];
      if (p.collected) continue;
      const px = p.x + sx;
      if (px > -30 && px < W + 30) {
        if (p.type === 'health') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3355';
          ctx.fillRect(px, p.y, p.w, p.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.fillRect(px + 9, p.y + 4, 6, 16);
          ctx.fillRect(px + 4, p.y + 9, 16, 6);
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
          ctx.fillRect(px, p.y, p.w, p.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
          ctx.fillText('A', px + 7, p.y + 17);
        }
      }
    }

    // Enemies
    for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
      const e = enemies[i];
      if (!e.alive) continue;
      const ex = e.x + sx;
      if (ex > -50 && ex < W + 50) {
        drawEnemy(e, ex);
      }
    }

    // Bullets
    for (let i = 0; i < bullets.length; i++) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      const bx = b.x + sx;
      if (bx > -20 && bx < W + 20) {
        if (b.from === 'player') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
          ctx.fillRect(bx, b.y, b.w, b.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, b.y + 1, b.w - 4, b.h - 2);
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
          ctx.fillRect(bx, b.y, b.w, b.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
          ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, b.y + 1, b.w - 4, b.h - 2);

      }
    }

    // Player
    if (player.alive) {

      if (player.invincible <= 0 || Math.floor(frameCount / 4) % 2 === 0) {
        drawPlayer(px);
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const ppx = p.x + sx;
      if (ppx > -10 && ppx < W + 10) {
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 40;
        ctx.fillRect(ppx, p.y, 4, 4);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    }

    // Vignette
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 200, W / 2, H / 2, 500);
    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawTorch(x, y) {
    // Torch bracket
    ctx.fillStyle = '#443322';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y, 6, 30);
    ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y + 25, 16, 8);

    // Flame
    const flicker = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.3) * 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 8, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + flicker, y - 25, x + 8, y);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 5, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + flicker * 0.5, y - 15, x + 5, y);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff66';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 3, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + flicker * 0.3, y - 8, x + 3, y);
    ctx.fill();

    // Glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,150,0,0.08)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 5, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPlayer(x) {
    const y = player.y;
    const f = player.facing;

    // Body - military uniform
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3d5c3a';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 12, 22, 22);

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d4a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 34, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 16, y + 34, 8, 8);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c8a0';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y, 16, 14);

    // Cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d4a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y - 2, 20, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 4, 20, 3);

    // Cap emblem
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cccc00';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 13, y - 1, 4, 4);

    // Gun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555555';
    if (f > 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 22, y + 18, 14, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 34, y + 16, 4, 8);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y + 18, 14, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y + 16, 4, 8);
    }

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
    if (f > 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 17, y + 5, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 12, y + 5, 3, 3);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 5, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 15, y + 5, 3, 3);
    }
  }

  function drawEnemy(e, x) {
    const y = e.y;
    const isHeavy = e.type === 'heavy';
    const bodyColor = isHeavy ? '#5c2d2d' : '#4a3d2d';
    const headColor = '#d4b090';
    const capColor = isHeavy ? '#2d1a1a' : '#2d2d1a';

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 12, 22, 22);

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = isHeavy ? '#3d1d1d' : '#3d3d2d';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 34, 8, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 16, y + 34, 8, 8);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = headColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 7, y, 16, 14);

    // Cap
    ctx.fillStyle = capColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y - 2, 20, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 4, 20, 3);

    // Cap emblem - swastika-like cross (simplified as a cross for the game)
    ctx.fillStyle = isHeavy ? '#ff4444' : '#ffaa00';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 13, y - 1, 4, 4);

    // Gun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#444444';
    ctx.fillRect(x + (e.dir > 0 ? -6 : 22), y + 18, 14, 4);

    // Eyes - angry
    ctx.fillStyle = '#880000';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 5, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 17, y + 5, 3, 3);

    // HP bar
    const hpRatio = e.hp / 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333333';
    ctx.fillRect(x, y - 10, 30, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = hpRatio > 0.5 ? '#44cc44' : '#ff4444';
    ctx.fillRect(x, y - 10, 30 * hpRatio, 4);
  }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 36);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';

    // Enemy count
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    const aliveEnemies = enemies.filter(function (e) { return e.alive; });
    ctx.fillText('ENEMIES: ' + aliveEnemies.length, W / 2, 24);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {

      ctx.fillRect(bx + 10, H - bh - 145, 50, 5);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(650, 80, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0808';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(670, 70, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Title
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('BEYOND CASTLE', W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('WOLFENSTEIN', W / 2, 240);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('A First-Person-Style Side Scrolling Shooter', W / 2, 280);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
    ctx.font = '15px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrow Keys to Move', W / 2, 340);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE or F to Shoot', W / 2, 365);
    ctx.fillText('Defeat all enemies to win', W / 2, 390);

    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,68,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START', W / 2, 460);

    // Decorative line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#442222';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(200, 310);
    ctx.lineTo(600, 310);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawEndScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (gameState === 'win') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff88';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('VICTORY!', W / 2, 200);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
      ctx.font = '20px monospace';

      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 310);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, 200);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
      ctx.font = '20px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('The enemy has prevailed.', W / 2, 260);
      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 310);
    }

    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,68,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO RETURN', W / 2, 400);
  }

  // ========================
  // GAME LOOP
  // ========================
  function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

})();

    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(120,200,255,0.35), inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    background: #000;
  }
</style>
