<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ============ CANVAS / STATE ============ */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0;
const RES = 512;

function resize() {
  const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  canvas.width = s;
  canvas.height = s;
  W = canvas.width; H = canvas.height;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

const G = {
  state: 'start',       // start | playing | win | lose
  score: 0,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  msg: '',
  msgTimer: 0,
  rescueCount: 0,
  totalRescues: 3,
  danger: 0            // 0..1 rising danger meter
};

/* ============ PLAYER ============ */
const player = {
  x: RES/2, y: RES*0.72,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  r: 12,
  speed: 2.4,
  thrust: 0.16,
  friction: 0.92,
  glow: 0,
  facing: 0
};

/* ============ RESCUE TARGETS (lost drones) ============ */
let rescues = [];
function makeRescues() {
  rescues = [];
  const spots = [
    { x: RES*0.22, y: RES*0.30 },
    { x: RES*0.72, y: RES*0.26 },
    { x: RES*0.50, y: RES*0.55 }
  ];
  for (const s of spots) {
    rescues.push({
      x: s.x, y: s.y,
      baseX: s.x, baseY: s.y,
      r: 10,
      phase: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
      bob: 0,
      saved: false,
      spin: 0
    });
  }
}

/* ============ HAZARDS (fractal shards) ============ */
let shards = [];
function makeShards() {
  shards = [];
  const n = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = (i/n)*Math.PI*2;
    shards.push({
      x: RES/2 + Math.cos(a)*RES*0.32,
      y: RES/2 + Math.sin(a)*RES*0.32,
      r: 16 + Math.random()*10,
      spin: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
      spinSpeed: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.04,
      orbit: 0.30 + Math.random()*0.14,
      angle: a,
      angleSpeed: (Math.random()<0.5?1:-1)*(0.003+Math.random()*0.004)
    });
  }
}

/* ============ PARTICLES ============ */
let particles = [];
function spawnBurst(x, y, color, count, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const sp = speed*(0.4+Math.random());
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*sp, vy: Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life: 1, decay: 0.02+Math.random()*0.03,
      color, size: 2+Math.random()*3
    });
  }
}

/* ============ INPUT ============ */
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (k === 'arrowup'||k==='arrowdown'||k==='arrowleft'||k==='arrowright'||k===' ') e.preventDefault();
  if (G.state === 'start' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) startGame();
  else if ((G.state === 'win' || G.state === 'lose') && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) startGame();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startGame() {
  G.state = 'playing';
  G.score = 0;
  G.time = 0;
  G.shake = 0;
  G.rescueCount = 0;
  G.danger = 0;
  G.msg = '';
  G.msgTimer = 0;
  player.x = RES/2; player.y = RES*0.72;
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  player.glow = 0;
  particles = [];
  makeRescues();
  makeShards();
}

/* ============ UPDATE ============ */
function update() {
  G.time += 1;
  if (G.shake > 0) G.shake *= 0.85;
  if (G.msgTimer > 0) G.msgTimer -= 1;

  if (G.state !== 'playing') {
    // gentle idle motion for menu
    updateParticles();
    return;
  }

  // --- player movement (8-way) ---
  let ax = 0, ay = 0;
  if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ax -= 1;
  if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ax += 1;
  if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) ay -= 1;
  if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) ay += 1;
  if (ax || ay) {
    const m = Math.hypot(ax, ay);
    ax /= m; ay /= m;
    player.facing = Math.atan2(ay, ax);
    player.vx += ax * player.thrust;
    player.vy += ay * player.thrust;
    player.glow = Math.min(1, player.glow + 0.1);
  } else {
    player.glow *= 0.9;
  }
  player.vx *= player.friction;
  player.vy *= player.friction;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // keep in bounds
  if (player.x < player.r) { player.x = player.r; player.vx *= -0.4; }
  if (player.x > RES-player.r) { player.x = RES-player.r; player.vx *= -0.4; }
  if (player.y < player.r) { player.y = player.r; player.vy *= -0.4; }
  if (player.y > RES-player.r) { player.y = RES-player.r; player.vy *= -0.4; }

  // --- shards orbit + spin ---
  G.danger = Math.min(1, G.danger + 0.0006);
  for (const s of shards) {
    s.angle += s.angleSpeed * (1 + G.danger*1.5);
    s.spin += s.spinSpeed * (1 + G.danger);
    const rad = s.orbit * RES * (1 + Math.sin(G.time*0.01)*0.05);
    s.x = RES/2 + Math.cos(s.angle)*rad;
    s.y = RES/2 + Math.sin(s.angle)*rad;
  }

  // --- shard collision (lose) ---
  for (const s of shards) {
    const d = Math.hypot(player.x - s.x, player.y - s.y);
    if (d < (player.r + s.r*0.7)) {
      G.state = 'lose';
      G.shake = 20;
      G.msg = 'SHATTERED!';
      G.msgTimer = 999;
      spawnBurst(player.x, player.y, '#ff5566', 40, 4);
      return;
    }
  }

  // --- rescue pickups ---
  for (const r of rescues) {
    if (r.saved) continue;
    r.bob += 0.05;
    r.x = r.baseX + Math.cos(r.bob)*4;
    r.y = r.baseY + Math.sin(r.bob*1.3)*4;
    r.spin += 0.03;
    const d = Math.hypot(player.x - r.x, player.y - r.y);
    if (d < (player.r + r.r)) {
      r.saved = true;
      G.rescueCount += 1;
      G.score += 100;
      G.shake = 8;
      spawnBurst(r.x, r.y, '#5cff9e', 30, 3.5);
      if (G.rescueCount >= G.totalRescues) {
        G.state = 'win';
        G.msg = 'ALL DRONES RESCUED!';
        G.msgTimer = 999;
        G.score += Math.max(0, Math.floor(500 - G.time*0.5));
        spawnBurst(RES/2, RES/2, '#ffd24a', 60, 5);
      } else {
        G.msg = 'DRONE RESCUED!';
        G.msgTimer = 70;
      }
    }
  }

  updateParticles();
}

function updateParticles() {
  for (let i = particles.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.95; p.vy *= 0.95;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

/* ============ DRAW ============ */
function draw() {
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const scale = W/RES;
  let ox = 0, oy = 0;
  if (G.shake > 0.5) {
    ox = (Math.random()-0.5)*G.shake;
    oy = (Math.random()-0.5)*G.shake;
  }
  ctx.setTransform(scale,0,0,scale, ox*scale, oy*scale);

  drawBackground();
  drawShards();
  drawRescues();
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  if (G.state === 'start') drawOverlay('RESCUE ON FRACTALUS', 'Save the 3 lost drones.', 'avoid the spinning fractal shards', 'PRESS  SPACE  TO  LAUNCH');
  else if (G.state === 'win') drawOverlay('MISSION COMPLETE', 'You rescued every drone.', 'SCORE  '+G.score, 'PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY');
  else if (G.state === 'lose') drawOverlay('MISSION FAILED', 'Your ship was shattered.', 'SCORE  '+G.score, 'PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY');
}

function drawBackground() {
  // deep space gradient
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(RES/2, RES/2, 40, RES/2, RES/2, RES*0.8);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1a2547');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0e1330');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#05060f');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,RES+40,RES+40);

  // fractal nebula rings (Sierpinski-ish triangles)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.10;
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const cx = RES/2 + Math.cos(G.time*0.005 + i)*30;
    const cy = RES/2 + Math.sin(G.time*0.005 + i)*30;
    drawFractalTriangle(cx, cy, RES*0.45 - i*40, 3, i===1?'#66ffcc':'#88aaff');
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // stars
  ctx.save();
  for (let i=0;i<60;i++){
    const sx = (i*97.3) % RES;
    const sy = (i*53.7) % RES;
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(G.time*0.05 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw*0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = i%3===0 ? '#bfe6ff' : '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.5, 1.5);
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // boundary glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(4,4,RES-8,RES-8);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFractalTriangle(cx, cy, size, depth, color) {
  if (depth === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - size);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + size*0.866, cy + size*0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - size*0.866, cy + size*0.5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    return;
  }
  const s = size/2;
  drawFractalTriangle(cx, cy - s, s, depth-1, color);
  drawFractalTriangle(cx + s*0.866, cy + s*0.5, s, depth-1, color);
  drawFractalTriangle(cx - s*0.866, cy + s*0.5, s, depth-1, color);
}

function drawShards() {
  for (const s of shards) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
    ctx.rotate(s.spin);
    // glow
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,80,120,0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    // jagged shard polygon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3b5c';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd0da';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const pts = 5;
    for (let i=0;i<pts;i++){
      const a = (i/pts)*Math.PI*2;
      const rr = s.r * (0.7 + 0.3*Math.sin(i*2.3));
      const px = Math.cos(a)*rr, py = Math.sin(a)*rr;
      if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    // inner core
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8aa0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,s.r*0.35,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawRescues() {
  for (const r of rescues) {
    if (r.saved) continue;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.rotate(r.spin);
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(92,255,158,0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
    // drone body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2fd07a';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c8ffe0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,r.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    // rotor arms
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c8ffe0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const a = (i/4)*Math.PI*2 + Math.PI/4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0,0);
      ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*r.r*1.4, Math.sin(a)*r.r*1.4);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2a18';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,r.r*0.3,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  ctx.rotate(player.facing);
  // engine glow
  if (player.glow > 0.05) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = player.glow;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,180,60,0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffb03a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-player.r, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-player.r-10, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(-player.r-10, 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // ship body
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.8)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4fc3ff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d6f0ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(player.r*1.3, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-player.r*0.8, player.r*0.9);
  ctx.lineTo(-player.r*0.4, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-player.r*0.8, -player.r*0.9);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  // cockpit
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2a44';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(player.r*0.2, 0, player.r*0.35, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
  const pad = 14;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,44);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#bfe6ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px Courier New';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+G.score, pad, 22);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5cff9e';
  ctx.fillText('RESCUED  '+G.rescueCount+'/'+G.totalRescues, W/2-40, 22);
  // danger meter
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8899bb';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('DANGER', W-pad-52, 22);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  ctx.fillRect(W-pad-48, 14, 48, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = G.danger>0.7 ? '#ff3b5c' : '#ffb03a';
  ctx.fillRect(W-pad-48, 14, 48*G.danger, 16);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  if (G.msgTimer > 0 && G.state === 'playing') {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5cff9e';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(G.msg, W/2, 70);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawOverlay(title, line1, line2, prompt) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,18,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  // title
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.9)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf4ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(W*0.055) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - W*0.12);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc6ff';
  ctx.font = Math.floor(W*0.028) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(line1, cx, cy - W*0.02);
  ctx.fillText(line2, cx, cy + W*0.04);
  // prompt blinking
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(G.time*0.1);
  ctx.globalAlpha = blink;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5cff9e';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(W*0.03) + 'px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(prompt, cx, cy + W*0.14);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============ MAIN LOOP ============ */
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
makeRescues();
makeShards();
loop();

</script>

<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const TILE = 40;
const COLS = 19;
const ROWS = 13;
const MW = COLS * TILE;
const MH = ROWS * TILE;
const OX = Math.floor((W - MW) / 2);
const OY = Math.floor((H - MH) / 2);

const DIR = {
  none: { x: 0, y: 0 },
  up:   { x: 0, y: -1 },
  down: { x: 0, y: 1 },
  left: { x: -1, y: 0 },
  right:{ x: 1, y: 0 }
};

const WALL = 1;
const EMPTY = 0;
const TUNNEL = 2;

const mapStrings = [
  "###################",
  "#o........#...#o#",
  "#.###.###.#.#.###",
  "#.................#",
  "#.###.###.#.#.###",
  "#........#...#...#",
  "###.###.#####.###",
  "#...#........#...#",
  "#.###.##.##.###.#",
  "#o........#...#o#",
  "#.###.###.#.#.###",
  "#.................#",
  "###################"
];

const grid = [];
for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
  const row = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    const ch = mapStrings[r][c];
    if (ch === "#") row.push(WALL);
    else if (ch === ".") row.push(EMPTY);
    else if (ch === "o") row.push(TUNNEL);
    else row.push(EMPTY);
  }
  grid.push(row);
}

const dots = [];
for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    if (grid[r][c] === EMPTY) {
      dots.push({
        x: OX + c * TILE + TILE / 2,
        y: OY + r * TILE + TILE / 2,
        eaten: false
      });
    }
  }
}

function cellAt(px, py) {
  const c = Math.floor((px - OX) / TILE);
  const r = Math.floor((py - OY) / TILE);
  if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return EMPTY;
  return grid[r][c];
}

function isWall(px, py) {
  return cellAt(px, py) === WALL;
}

function canMove(x, y, dir) {
  const d = DIR[dir];
  const probe = 14;
  const cx = x + d.x * probe;
  const cy = y + d.y * probe;
  if (isWall(cx - 12, cy)) return false;
  if (isWall(cx + 12, cy)) return false;
  if (isWall(cx, cy - 12)) return false;
  if (isWall(cx, cy + 12)) return false;
  return true;
}

function distToDot(x, y, d) {
  const dx = x - d.x;
  const dy = y - d.y;
  return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

const state = {
  mode: "start",
  score: 0,
  dotsLeft: dots.length,
  time: 0,
  message: "",
  messageTimer: 0
};

const player = {
  x: OX + 9 * TILE + TILE / 2,
  y: OY + 5 * TILE + TILE / 2,
  dir: "none",
  nextDir: "none",
  speed: 150,
  radius: 15
};

const ghosts = [];
const ghostColors = ["#ff3b3b", "#ff8bd6", "#4bd8ff", "#c6ff4b"];
const ghostNames = ["Blinky", "Pinkie", "Inky", "Clyde"];
const spawnPoints = [
  { c: 9, r: 5 },
  { c: 7, r: 5 },
  { c: 11, r: 5 },
  { c: 9, r: 3 }
];
for (let i = 0; i < spawnPoints.length; i++) {
  const sp = spawnPoints[i];
  ghosts.push({
    x: OX + sp.c * TILE + TILE / 2,
    y: OY + sp.r * TILE + TILE / 2,
    dir: "down",
    speed: 100 + i * 8,
    radius: 14,
    color: ghostColors[i],
    name: ghostNames[i],
    bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

function resetGame() {
  player.x = OX + 9 * TILE + TILE / 2;
  player.y = OY + 5 * TILE + TILE / 2;
  player.dir = "none";
  player.nextDir = "none";
  for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) dots[i].eaten = false;
  state.dotsLeft = dots.length;
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  state.message = "";
  state.messageTimer = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ghosts.length; i++) {
    const sp = spawnPoints[i];
    ghosts[i].x = OX + sp.c * TILE + TILE / 2;
    ghosts[i].y = OY + sp.r * TILE + TILE / 2;
    ghosts[i].dir = "down";
  }
}

function setMessage(msg, t) {
  state.message = msg;
  state.messageTimer = t;
}

function wrapX(x) {
  if (x < OX) x = OX + MW;
  if (x > OX + MW) x = OX;
  return x;
}

// --- input ---
let keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (state.mode === "start") {
    if (k === " " || k === "enter") {
      resetGame();
      state.mode = "playing";
      setMessage("GO!", 1.0);
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  if (state.mode === "won" || state.mode === "lost") {
    if (k === "r" || k === " " || k === "enter") {
      resetGame();
      state.mode = "playing";
      setMessage("GO!", 1.0);
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  if (state.mode === "playing") {
    if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w") player.nextDir = "up";
    else if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") player.nextDir = "down";
    else if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") player.nextDir = "left";
    else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") player.nextDir = "right";
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = false;
});

// --- update ---
function updatePlayer(dt) {
  if (player.nextDir !== "none") {
    if (canMove(player.x, player.y, player.nextDir)) {
      player.dir = player.nextDir;
    }
  }
  if (player.dir !== "none") {
    if (!canMove(player.x, player.y, player.dir)) {
      player.dir = "none";
    } else {
      const d = DIR[player.dir];
      player.x += d.x * player.speed * dt;
      player.y += d.y * player.speed * dt;
      player.x = wrapX(player.x);
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
    const d = dots[i];
    if (d.eaten) continue;
    const dx = player.x - d.x;
    const dy = player.y - d.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 22 * 22) {
      d.eaten = true;
      state.dotsLeft--;
      state.score += 10;
      if (state.dotsLeft <= 0) {
        state.mode = "won";
        state.score += 1000;
        setMessage("YOU WIN!", 9999);
      }
    }
  }
}

function updateGhosts(dt) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ghosts.length; i++) {
    const g = ghosts[i];
    g.bob += dt * 6;

    const d = DIR[g.dir];
    if (!canMove(g.x, g.y, g.dir)) {
      const options = [];
      if (canMove(g.x, g.y, "up")) options.push("up");
      if (canMove(g.x, g.y, "down")) options.push("down");
      if (canMove(g.x, g.y, "left")) options.push("left");
      if (canMove(g.x, g.y, "right")) options.push("right");
      if (options.length === 0) {
        g.dir = "none";
        continue;
      }
      let best = null;
      let bestScore = -Infinity;
      for (let j = 0; j < options.length; j++) {
        const od = DIR[options[j]];
        let score = 0;
        const ndx = g.x + od.x * TILE;
        const ndy = g.y + od.y * TILE;
        const pdx = player.x - ndx;
        const pdy = player.y - ndy;
        score += (pdx * od.x + pdy * od.y) * 1.0;
        score += Math.random() * 30;
        if (score > bestScore) {
          bestScore = score;
          best = options[j];
        }
      }
      g.dir = best;
    }

    const dd = DIR[g.dir];
    g.x += dd.x * g.speed * dt;
    g.y += dd.y * g.speed * dt;
    g.x = wrapX(g.x);

    const dx = g.x - player.x;
    const dy = g.y - player.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (g.radius + player.radius) * (g.radius + player.radius)) {
      state.mode = "lost";
      setMessage("GAME OVER", 9999);
    }
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer -= dt;
  if (state.mode === "playing") {
    updatePlayer(dt);
    if (state.mode === "playing") updateGhosts(dt);
  }
}

// --- draw ---
function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#0d0d24");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#05050f");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#11112e";
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c] === EMPTY || grid[r][c] === TUNNEL) {
        ctx.fillRect(OX + c * TILE, OY + r * TILE, TILE, TILE);
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawWalls() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b6cff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c] !== WALL) continue;
      const x = OX + c * TILE;
      const y = OY + r * TILE;
      const up = r > 0 && grid[r - 1][c] === WALL;
      const down = r < ROWS - 1 && grid[r + 1][c] === WALL;
      const left = c > 0 && grid[r][c - 1] === WALL;
      const right = c < COLS - 1 && grid[r][c + 1] === WALL;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (!up) { ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + TILE, y); }
      if (!down) { ctx.moveTo(x, y + TILE); ctx.lineTo(x + TILE, y + TILE); }
      if (!left) { ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + TILE); }
      if (!right) { ctx.moveTo(x + TILE, y); ctx.lineTo(x + TILE, y + TILE); }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawDots() {
  for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
    const d = dots[i];
    if (d.eaten) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe9a8";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPacMan() {
  const x = player.x;
  const y = player.y;
  const r = player.radius;
  const d = DIR[player.dir];
  let angle = 0;
  if (player.dir === "right") angle = 0;
  else if (player.dir === "down") angle = Math.PI / 2;
  else if (player.dir === "left") angle = Math.PI;
  else if (player.dir === "up") angle = -Math.PI / 2;

  const mouth = 0.35 + Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time * 10)) * 0.25;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(angle);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
  ctx.arc(0, 0, r, mouth, Math.PI * 2 - mouth);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(r * 0.55, -r * 0.45, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGhost(g) {
  const x = g.x;
  const y = g.y + Math.sin(g.bob) * 3;
  const r = g.radius;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  ctx.fillStyle = g.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -r * 0.1, r, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(r, r * 0.7);
  const waves = 4;
  for (let i = 0; i < waves; i++) {
    const x1 = r - (i + 1) * (2 * r / waves);
    ctx.lineTo(x1 + (r / waves), r * 0.45);
    ctx.lineTo(x1, r * 0.7);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  const d = DIR[g.dir];
  const ex = d.x * 3;
  const ey = d.y * 3;
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(side * r * 0.4, -r * 0.15, r * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(side * r * 0.4 + ex, -r * 0.15 + ey, r * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE " + state.score, OX, OY - 12);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8be9ff";
  ctx.fillText("DOTS " + state.dotsLeft, OX + MW, OY - 12);
}

function drawMessage() {
  if (state.messageTimer <= 0) return;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 48px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
  ctx.fillText(state.message, W / 2, H / 2);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("JR. PAC-MAN", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8be9ff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Eat all the dots. Avoid the ghosts.", W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8bd6";
  ctx.fillText("Arrow keys or WASD to move", W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to start", W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
}

function drawEndScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
  if (state.mode === "won") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe14a";
    ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3b3b";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "24px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8be9ff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Press R to play again", W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawWalls();
  drawDots();
  for (let i = 0; i < ghosts.length; i++) drawGhost(ghosts[i]);
  drawPacMan();
  drawHUD();
  drawMessage();
  if (state.mode === "start") drawStartScreen();
  if (state.mode === "won" || state.mode === "lost") drawEndScreen();
}

// --- loop ---
let lastTime = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
  lastTime = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bump 'n' Jump</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #101018;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 96vw;
    height: calc(96vw * 0.75);
    max-width: calc(96vh * 1.3333);
    max-height: 96vh;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    background: #0b0b12;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ============================================================
  //  BUMP 'n' JUMP  —  a single playable scene
  //  Bounce on the trampoline, clear the rising spike, and
  //  catch the coins. 12 coins to win; 3 misses and you're out.
  //  Controls:  Arrow keys / A,D to move, Space / Up / W to jump
  //  (a tap = small hop, hold = big jump). On touch, tap = jump.
  // ============================================================

  // ---------- canvas & constants ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  const W = 800, H = 600;
  const GROUND_Y = 500;
  const TRAMPOLINE = { x: 250, y: GROUND_Y, w: 300, h: 34 };
  const TRAMP_X0 = TRAMPOLINE.x, TRAMP_X1 = TRAMPOLINE.x + TRAMPOLINE.w;
  const SPIKE = { x: 590, y: GROUND_Y, w: 90, h: 150 };
  const SPIKE_X0 = SPIKE.x, SPIKE_X1 = SPIKE.x + SPIKE.w;
  const JUMP_V = 15;
  const GRAVITY = 0.6;
  const MOVE_SPEED = 5;
  const MAX_COINS = 12;
  const MAX_MISSES = 3;
  const TRAMP_MIN = 0.5, TRAMP_MAX = 2.5;

  // ---------- state ----------
  let state = "start";
  let frame = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let misses = 0;
  let coins = [];
  let particles = [];
  let shake = 0;
  let jumpHeld = false;
  let player = { x: 300, y: GROUND_Y, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: true, facing: 1 };

  // ---------- input ----------
  const keys = { left: false, right: false, jump: false };

  function setKey(name, val) {
    if (name === "jump") jumpHeld = val;
    keys[name] = val;
  }

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") { setKey("left", true); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") { setKey("right", true); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === " " || k === "arrowup" || k === "w") {
      if (!keys.jump) {
        if (state === "start") { startGame(); }
        else if (state === "over") { resetGame(); }
        else if (state === "playing" && player.onGround) { player.vy = -JUMP_V; player.onGround = false; }
      }
      setKey("jump", true); e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (k === "enter") {
      if (state === "start") startGame();
      else if (state === "over") resetGame();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") setKey("left", false);
    else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") setKey("right", false);
    else if (k === " " || k === "arrowup" || k === "w") setKey("jump", false);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === "start") startGame();
    else if (state === "over") resetGame();
    else if (state === "playing" && player.onGround) { player.vy = -JUMP_V; player.onGround = false; }
    jumpHeld = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { jumpHeld = false; });

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    resetGame();
  }
  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    misses = 0;
    frame = 0;
    coins = [];
    particles = [];
    shake = 0;
    player = { x: 300, y: GROUND_Y, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: true, facing: 1 };
    state = "playing";
  }
  function spawnCoin() {
    if (coins.length >= 4) return;
    const x = 220 + Math.random() * 260;
    const y = 150 + Math.random() * 240;
    coins.push({ x, y, r: 15, bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, spin: Math.random() * Math.PI });
  }
  function burst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 30 + Math.random() * 20, max: 50, color, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
    }
  }
  function bump(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI * (0.15 + Math.random() * 0.7);
      const s = 3 + Math.random() * 5;
      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 25 + Math.random() * 15, max: 40, color, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update() {
    frame++;
    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;

    // coins
    if (state === "playing") {
      if (frame % 55 === 0) spawnCoin();
      for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const c = coins[i];
        c.bob += 0.05;
        c.spin += 0.15;
        const dx = player.x - c.x;
        const dy = player.y - 26 - c.y;
        if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 34) {
          coins.splice(i, 1);
          score++;
          bump(c.x, c.y, "#ffd23f");
          if (score >= MAX_COINS) { state = "win"; }
        }
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vy += 0.15; p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (state !== "playing") return;

    // horizontal movement
    player.vx = 0;
    if (keys.left) { player.vx = -MOVE_SPEED; player.facing = -1; }
    else if (keys.right) { player.vx = MOVE_SPEED; player.facing = 1; }

    // gravity + jump
    player.vy += GRAVITY;
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // keep on screen
    if (player.x < 24) player.x = 24;
    if (player.x > W - 24) player.x = W - 24;

    // ground / trampoline collision
    if (player.y >= GROUND_Y) {
      if (player.onGround) {
        // resting
        player.y = GROUND_Y;
        player.vy = 0;
      } else {
        player.y = GROUND_Y;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.onGround = true;
      }
    } else {
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // trampoline bounce (only when falling onto it)
    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y >= TRAMPOLINE.y - 2 && player.y <= GROUND_Y + 10) {
      if (player.x >= TRAMP_X0 && player.x <= TRAMP_X1) {
        const power = TRAMP_MIN + (TRAMP_MAX - TRAMP_MIN) * (jumpHeld ? 1 : 0.35);
        player.vy = -JUMP_V * power;
        player.onGround = false;
        bump(player.x, TRAMPOLINE.y, "#5fe0c8");
        shake = 5;
      }
    }

    // spike collision (must clear it)
    const py = player.y;
    const px = player.x;
    if (px >= SPIKE_X0 && px <= SPIKE_X1) {
      // spike top is at GROUND_Y - SPIKE.h
      if (py > GROUND_Y - SPIKE.h) {
        // hit the spike
        misses++;
        shake = 12;
        burst(px, py, "#ff5566", 18);
        player.vy = -JUMP_V * 0.8;
        player.onGround = false;
        if (misses >= MAX_MISSES) { state = "over"; }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#2b2350");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#3a2f6e");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#1c1836");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 97) % W;
      const sy = (i * 53) % (H * 0.5);
      const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(frame * 0.03 + i));
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4e9c8";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 130, 90, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e6d6ac";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 145, 80, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(W - 115, 100, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // distant hills
    ctx.fillStyle = "#241f4a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(150, GROUND_Y - 90, 320, GROUND_Y - 30);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(520, GROUND_Y - 120, 700, GROUND_Y - 40);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(780, GROUND_Y - 70, W, GROUND_Y - 20);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, "#3d2f63");
    gg.addColorStop(1, "#241b40");
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a4a8a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawTrampoline() {
    const t = TRAMPOLINE;
    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2440";
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(t.x + 15, t.y); ctx.lineTo(t.x + 5, H);
    ctx.moveTo(t.x + t.w - 15, t.y); ctx.lineTo(t.x + t.w - 5, H);
    ctx.stroke();
    // frame
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a3f7a";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
    // mat
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.1);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5fe0c8";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + 4, t.y + 4, t.w - 8, t.h - 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.15 + pulse * 0.2) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + 4, t.y + 4, t.w - 8, 6);
    // springs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2440";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const sx = t.x + 20 + i * ((t.w - 40) / 5);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, t.y + t.h);
      ctx.lineTo(sx, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawSpike() {
    const s = SPIKE;
    const top = GROUND_Y - s.h;
    const danger = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.15);
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,85,102," + (0.15 + danger * 0.2) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(s.x - 12, top - 12, s.w + 24, s.h + 12);
    // body
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, GROUND_Y);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#ff8a94");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#c0273a");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s.x, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.w / 2, top);
    ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.w, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // stripes
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const yy = GROUND_Y - (s.h * i) / 4;
      const hw = (s.w / 2) * (1 - i / 4);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(s.x + s.w / 2 - hw, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.w / 2 + hw, yy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawCoin(c) {
    const bobY = c.y + Math.sin(c.bob) * 6;
    const squash = Math.abs(Math.cos(c.spin));
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,63,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, bobY, c.r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // coin
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, bobY, c.r * squash, c.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9971a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    // inner
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe98a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, bobY, c.r * squash * 0.55, c.r * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    const x = p.x;
    const y = p.y;
    const squash = p.onGround ? 1 : 0.9;
    const stretch = p.onGround ? 1 : 1.1;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, GROUND_Y + 4, 22, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(p.facing * squash, stretch);

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7a4d";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-16, -44, 32, 44, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    // belly
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9c4";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-10, -30, 20, 24, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // feet
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e0552f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-9, 0, 8, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.ellipse(9, 0, 8, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8a5c";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -56, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // ears
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-12, -68, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(12, -68, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // face
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1a12";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-5, -58, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(5, -58, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a1a12";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -52, 5, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,16,40,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 54);

    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("COINS  " + score + " / " + MAX_COINS, 24, 34);

    // misses (hearts)
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_MISSES; i++) {
      const hx = W - 30 - i * 30;
      const filled = i < (MAX_MISSES - misses);
      ctx.fillStyle = filled ? "#ff5566" : "#4a3f5a";
      drawHeart(hx, 26, 11);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawHeart(x, y, s) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - s, y - s, x - s, y + s * 0.5, x, y + s);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + s, y + s * 0.5, x + s, y - s, x, y + s * 0.3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,24,0.75)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 54px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d8d2ee";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, H / 2 + 26);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9a92c0";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE / click to play", W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawTrampoline();
    drawSpike();
    for (const c of coins) drawCoin(c);
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") drawOverlay("BUMP 'n' JUMP", "Bounce, clear the spike, grab 12 coins!", "#5fe0c8");
    else if (state === "over") drawOverlay("GAME OVER", "You hit the spike 3 times. Try again!", "#ff5566");
    else if (state === "win") drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "All 12 coins collected — amazing!", "#ffd23f");
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Keys of Acheron</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #05050a;
    font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  var W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W;
    canvas.height = H;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ==================== STATE ====================

  var STATE = 'menu'; // menu | playing | win | lose
  var score = 0;
  var keysCollected = 0;
  var totalKeys = 5;
  var player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 14, facing: 1 };
  var keys = [];
  var gates = [];
  var particles = [];
  var flames = [];
  var time = 0;
  var shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0, shakeMag = 0;
  var winTimer = 0;
  var loseTimer = 0;
  var lastKeyTime = 0;
  var keyPickupFlash = 0;

  // ==================== LEVEL GENERATION ====================

  function buildLevel() {
    keys = [];
    gates = [];
    particles = [];
    flames = [];
    keysCollected = 0;
    score = 0;
    time = 0;
    winTimer = 0;
    loseTimer = 0;
    keyPickupFlash = 0;

    var margin = 60;
    var playW = W - margin * 2;
    var playH = H - margin * 2;

    // Place 5 keys in distinct positions
    var positions = [
      { x: margin + playW * 0.15, y: margin + playH * 0.2 },
      { x: margin + playW * 0.85, y: margin + playH * 0.25 },
      { x: margin + playW * 0.5,  y: margin + playH * 0.55 },
      { x: margin + playW * 0.2,  y: margin + playH * 0.8 },
      { x: margin + playW * 0.8,  y: margin + playH * 0.75 },
    ];

    for (var i = 0; i < totalKeys; i++) {
      keys.push({
        x: positions[i].x,
        y: positions[i].y,
        r: 16,
        collected: false,
        bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        glow: 0
      });
    }

    // The Gate of Acheron at the top center
    gates.push({
      x: W / 2,
      y: margin - 10,
      w: 120,
      h: 50,
      open: false,
      openAnim: 0
    });

    // Player starts bottom center
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - margin - 30;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.facing = 1;

    // Initialize ambient flames
    for (var f = 0; f < 20; f++) {
      flames.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 8,
        speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        hue: 20 + Math.random() * 30
      });
    }
  }

  // ==================== INPUT ====================

  var keysDown = {};

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    keysDown[e.code] = true;
    if (STATE === 'menu' && (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space')) {
      STATE = 'playing';
      buildLevel();
    }
    if ((STATE === 'win' || STATE === 'lose') && (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space')) {
      STATE = 'menu';
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    keysDown[e.code] = false;
  });

  // ==================== UPDATE ====================

  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;

    // Update flames
    for (var i = 0; i < flames.length; i++) {
      var fl = flames[i];
      fl.phase += fl.speed * dt * 3;
      fl.y -= fl.speed * dt * 30;
      if (fl.y < -20) {
        fl.y = H + 20;
        fl.x = Math.random() * W;
      }
    }

    // Update particles
    for (var p = particles.length - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
      var pt = particles[p];
      pt.x += pt.vx * dt;
      pt.y += pt.vy * dt;
      pt.life -= dt;
      if (pt.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(p, 1);
      }
    }

    // Shake decay
    shakeMag *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    if (shakeMag < 0.5) shakeMag = 0;
    shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeMag;
    shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeMag;

    if (STATE !== 'playing') {
      if (STATE === 'win') winTimer += dt;
      if (STATE === 'lose') loseTimer += dt;
      return;
    }

    // Player movement
    var speed = 200;
    var ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keysDown['KeyA'] || keysDown['ArrowLeft'])  { ax = -1; player.facing = -1; }
    if (keysDown['KeyD'] || keysDown['ArrowRight']) { ax =  1; player.facing =  1; }
    if (keysDown['KeyW'] || keysDown['ArrowUp'])    { ay = -1; }
    if (keysDown['KeyS'] || keysDown['ArrowDown'])  { ay =  1; }

    if (ax !== 0 && ay !== 0) {
      ax *= 0.7071;
      ay *= 0.7071;
    }

    player.vx = ax * speed;
    player.vy = ay * speed;
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;

    // Clamp to bounds
    var m = 30;
    if (player.x < m) player.x = m;
    if (player.x > W - m) player.x = W - m;
    if (player.y < m) player.y = m;
    if (player.y > H - m) player.y = H - m;

    // Key collection
    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
      var key = keys[k];
      if (key.collected) continue;
      key.bob += dt * 2;
      key.glow = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3 + k);
      var dx = player.x - key.x;
      var dy = player.y - key.y;
      var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < player.r + key.r) {
        key.collected = true;
        keysCollected++;
        score += 100;
        keyPickupFlash = 0.5;
        shakeMag = 8;
        lastKeyTime = time;
        // Spawn particles
        for (var sp = 0; sp < 12; sp++) {
          var angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          var spd = 50 + Math.random() * 100;
          particles.push({
            x: key.x, y: key.y,
            vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd,
            life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
            maxLife: 1,
            color: 'hsl(' + (30 + Math.random() * 40) + ', 100%, 60%)',
            size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
          });
        }
        // Check if all keys collected -> open gate
        if (keysCollected >= totalKeys) {
          gates[0].open = true;
        }
      }
    }

    // Gate interaction
    if (gates[0].open) {
      gates[0].openAnim = Math.min(1, gates[0].openAnim + dt * 2);
      var g = gates[0];
      var gdx = player.x - g.x;
      var gdy = player.y - (g.y + g.h);
      var gdist = Math.sqrt(gdx * gdx + gdy * gdy);
      if (gdist < player.r + 30 && player.y < g.y + g.h + 20) {
        STATE = 'win';
        score += 500;
        winTimer = 0;
        shakeMag = 15;
        for (var wp = 0; wp < 30; wp++) {
          var wangle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          var wspd = 80 + Math.random() * 200;
          particles.push({
            x: g.x, y: g.y + g.h / 2,
            vx: Math.cos(wangle) * wspd,
            vy: Math.sin(wangle) * wspd,
            life: 1 + Math.random(),
            maxLife: 2,
            color: 'hsl(' + (180 + Math.random() * 60) + ', 80%, 70%)',
            size: 3 + Math.random() * 5
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Key pickup flash decay
    if (keyPickupFlash > 0) keyPickupFlash -= dt;
  }

  // ==================== DRAW ====================

  function drawBackground() {
    // Dark gradient
    var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 0, W/2, H/2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a2e');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d0515');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#05050a');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Distant hellish glow at bottom
    var hellGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.7, 0, H);
    hellGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(180, 40, 10, 0)');
    hellGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180, 40, 10, 0.15)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hellGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.7, W, H * 0.3);

    // Floating ember particles (flames)
    for (var i = 0; i < flames.length; i++) {
      var fl = flames[i];
      var alpha = 0.15 + 0.15 * Math.sin(fl.phase);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + fl.hue + ', 100%, 50%, ' + alpha + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fl.x, fl.y, fl.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Cracked ground lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80, 30, 10, 0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (var c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
      var cx = (c / 8) * W + Math.sin(time * 0.2 + c) * 10;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, H * 0.85);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 30, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawKey(key) {
    if (key.collected) return;
    var bobY = Math.sin(key.bob) * 6;
    var x = key.x;
    var y = key.y + bobY;
    var glowAlpha = 0.3 + 0.3 * key.glow;

    // Glow
    var glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 40);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 50, ' + glowAlpha + ')');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 200, 50, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Key body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#b8860b';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;

    // Key head (circle)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 8, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Inner circle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 8, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Key shaft
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y, 4, 16);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#b8860b';
    ctx.strokeRect(x - 2, y, 4, 16);

    // Key teeth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 10, 6, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 14, 4, 3);
  }

  function drawGate() {
    var g = gates[0];
    var x = g.x - g.w / 2;
    var y = g.y;
    var open = g.openAnim;

    // Gate frame
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a3a';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a2a6a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;

    // Pillars
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2050';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y, 15, g.h + 20);
    ctx.fillRect(x + g.w - 5, y, 15, g.h + 20);
    ctx.strokeRect(x - 10, y, 15, g.h + 20);
    ctx.strokeRect(x + g.w - 5, y, 15, g.h + 20);

    // Top arch
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2050';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 10, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(g.x, y - 30, x + g.w + 5, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + g.w + 5, y + 10);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(g.x, y - 20, x - 10, y + 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Gate doors
    if (open < 1) {
      var doorW = (g.w / 2) * (1 - open);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + 5, doorW, g.h);
      ctx.fillRect(x + g.w - doorW, y + 5, doorW, g.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a2a6a';
      ctx.strokeRect(x, y + 5, doorW, g.h);
      ctx.strokeRect(x + g.w - doorW, y + 5, doorW, g.h);

      // Lock symbol
      if (!g.open) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(g.x, y + g.h / 2, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
        ctx.fillRect(g.x - 3, y + g.h / 2, 6, 10);
      }
    } else {
      // Open glow
      var openGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(g.x, y + g.h / 2, 0, g.x, y + g.h / 2, 60);
      openGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.5)');
      openGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = openGlow;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(g.x, y + g.h / 2, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Rune markings on pillars
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150, 100, 200, 0.5)';
    for (var r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
      ctx.font = '10px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('ᚱ', x - 5, y + 20 + r * 15);
      ctx.fillText('ᚱ', x + g.w, y + 20 + r * 15);
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    var x = player.x;
    var y = player.y;
    var r = player.r;

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + r + 4, r * 0.8, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    var bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y - 4, 0, x, y, r);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e0e8ff');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#6080c0');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#203060');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Cloak / lower body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2050';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.8, y + r * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r * 1.5);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.8, y + r * 0.3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d0d8f0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - r * 0.6, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6040';
    var eyeOff = player.facing * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - 4 + eyeOff, y - r * 0.65, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + 4 + eyeOff, y - r * 0.65, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    // Key count indicator (small keys around player)
    if (keysCollected > 0) {

  function drawParticles() {
    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      var pt = particles[i];
      var alpha = pt.life / pt.maxLife;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = pt.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 35);

    // Keys
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Keys: ' + keysCollected + ' / ' + totalKeys, 20, 60);

    // Key icons
    for (var i = 0; i < totalKeys; i++) {
      var kx = 20 + i * 25;
      var ky = 75;
      if (i < keysCollected) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      }
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(kx, ky, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(kx - 1.5, ky, 3, 10);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 5, 10, 0.85)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(48, W * 0.06) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('THE KEYS OF ACHERON', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8090b0';
    ctx.font = Math.min(18, W * 0.025) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Collect all five keys to open the Gate of Acheron', W / 2, H * 0.38);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#607090';
    ctx.font = Math.min(15, W * 0.02) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('WASD or Arrow Keys to move', W / 2, H * 0.5);
    ctx.fillText('Touch each golden key to collect it', W / 2, H * 0.55);
    ctx.fillText('Reach the glowing gate to escape', W / 2, H * 0.6);

    // Start prompt
    var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 50, ' + (0.5 + 0.5 * pulse) + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(22, W * 0.03) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or SPACE to begin', W / 2, H * 0.72);

    // Decorative key
    var kx = W / 2;
    var ky = H * 0.85;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(kx, ky - 15, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(kx, ky - 15, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillRect(kx - 3, ky - 3, 6, 25);
    ctx.fillRect(kx + 3, ky + 8, 10, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(kx + 3, ky + 14, 7, 4);
  }

  function drawWin() {
    var alpha = Math.min(0.85, winTimer * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 20, 40, ' + alpha + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#60d0ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(42, W * 0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('YOU HAVE ESCAPED ACHERON', W / 2, H * 0.35);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = Math.min(24, W * 0.03) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H * 0.45);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8090b0';
    ctx.font = Math.min(16, W * 0.02) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('The keys of the underworld are yours', W / 2, H * 0.52);

    var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 50, ' + (0.5 + 0.5 * pulse) + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(18, W * 0.025) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to return', W / 2, H * 0.65);
  }

  function drawLose() {
    var alpha = Math.min(0.85, loseTimer * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30, 5, 5, ' + alpha + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4040';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(42, W * 0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('CONSUMED BY THE FLAMES', W / 2, H * 0.35);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = Math.min(24, W * 0.03) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2, H * 0.45);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8090b0';
    ctx.font = Math.min(16, W * 0.02) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('You collected ' + keysCollected + ' of ' + totalKeys + ' keys', W / 2, H * 0.52);

    var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 50, ' + (0.5 + 0.5 * pulse) + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(18, W * 0.025) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to try again', W / 2, H * 0.65);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

    drawBackground();

    if (STATE === 'playing' || STATE === 'win' || STATE === 'lose') {
      drawGate();
      for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        drawKey(keys[i]);
      }
      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawHUD();
    }

    ctx.restore();

    if (STATE === 'menu') {
      drawMenu();
    }
    if (STATE === 'win') {
      drawWin();
    }
    if (STATE === 'lose') {
      drawLose();
    }
  }

  // ==================== GAME LOOP ====================

  var lastTime = 0;

  function loop(timestamp) {
    var dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.016; // clamp
    lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(function (ts) {
    lastTime = ts;
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  });

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pleiads</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0a0a1a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
// ── Canvas setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resize() {
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const COLS = 10;
const ROWS = 9;
const STAR_COLORS = ['#ff6b6b', '#ffd93d', '#6bcb77', '#4d96ff', '#ff9ff3', '#f368e0'];
const COMET_COLORS = ['#ffffff', '#ffe066', '#66ffcc', '#ff99cc', '#99ccff'];
const COMET_SPEED = 1.2;
const STAR_SIZE_FACTOR = 0.35;

// ── Game state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let grid = [];
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let gamePhase = 'start'; // 'start' | 'playing' | 'gameover'
let comets = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let frameCount = 0;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let shakeIntensity = 0;
let flashTimer = 0;
let flashColor = '#ffffff';
let comboCount = 0;
let comboTimer = 0;
let bestScore = 0;

// ── Utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function randInt(min, max) {
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
}

function randFloat(min, max) {
  return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
}

function pick(arr) {
  return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
}

// ── Grid helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function createGrid() {
  grid = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    grid[r] = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      grid[r][c] = {
        color: pick(STAR_COLORS),
        alive: true,
        pulse: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        scale: 1,
        dying: false,
        deathTimer: 0
      };
    }
  }
}

function getCellSize() {
  const maxW = canvas.width * 0.7;
  const maxH = canvas.height * 0.6;
  const cw = maxW / COLS;
  const ch = maxH / ROWS;
  return Math.min(cw, ch);
}

function getGridOrigin() {
  const cs = getCellSize();
  const gw = cs * COLS;
  const gh = cs * ROWS;
  return {
    x: (canvas.width - gw) / 2,
    y: (canvas.height - gh) / 2 - canvas.height * 0.05
  };
}

function screenToGrid(px, py) {
  const cs = getCellSize();
  const origin = getGridOrigin();
  const c = Math.floor((px - origin.x) / cs);
  const r = Math.floor((py - origin.y) / cs);
  if (r >= 0 && r < ROWS && c >= 0 && c < COLS) {
    return { r, c };
  }
  return null;
}

// ── Flood fill for group detection ────────────────────────────────
function findGroup(r, c) {
  if (r < 0 || r >= ROWS || c < 0 || c >= COLS) return [];
  const cell = grid[r][c];
  if (!cell.alive) return [];
  const color = cell.color;
  const visited = new Set();
  const group = [];
  const stack = [[r, c]];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const [cr, cc] = stack.pop();
    const key = cr * COLS + cc;
    if (visited.has(key)) continue;
    if (cr < 0 || cr >= ROWS || cc < 0 || cc >= COLS) continue;
    const cell = grid[cr][cc];
    if (!cell.alive || cell.color !== color) continue;
    visited.add(key);
    group.push([cr, cc]);
    stack.push([cr - 1, cc], [cr + 1, cc], [cr, cc - 1], [cr, cc + 1]);
  }
  return group;
}

// ── Remove group and spawn comets ────────────────────────────────
function removeGroup(group) {
  const color = grid[group[0][0]][group[0][1]].color;
  const n = group.length;
  const points = n * 10 + Math.max(0, n - 4) * 5;
  score += points;
  comboCount++;
  comboTimer = 120;

  const origin = getGridOrigin();
  const cs = getCellSize();

  group.forEach(([r, c]) => {
    const cell = grid[r][c];
    cell.dying = true;
    cell.deathTimer = 30;
    const cx = origin.x + c * cs + cs / 2;
    const cy = origin.y + r * cs + cs / 2;
    spawnExplosion(cx, cy, color);
  });

  const cometCount = Math.min(n, 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < cometCount; i++) {
    const [r, c] = group[randInt(0, group.length - 1)];
    const cx = origin.x + c * cs + cs / 2;
    const cy = origin.y + r * cs + cs / 2;
    const angle = randFloat(-Math.PI, 0);
    comets.push({
      x: cx,
      y: cy,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * COMET_SPEED * randFloat(1.5, 3),
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * COMET_SPEED * randFloat(1.5, 3),
      color: pick(COMET_COLORS),
      trail: [],
      alive: true,
      size: randFloat(4, 8)
    });
  }

  if (score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
}

// ── Spawn explosion particles ─────────────────────────────────────
function spawnExplosion(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const angle = randFloat(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const speed = randFloat(1, 4);
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: randInt(20, 40),
      maxLife: 40,
      color,
      size: randFloat(2, 5)
    });
  }
}

// ── Check if comets hit grid ─────────────────────────────────────
function checkCometHits() {
  const origin = getGridOrigin();
  const cs = getCellSize();
  const gridTop = origin.y;
  const gridBottom = origin.y + cs * ROWS;
  const gridLeft = origin.x;
  const gridRight = origin.x + cs * COLS;

  comets.forEach(comet => {
    if (!comet.alive) return;
    if (comet.y >= gridTop && comet.y <= gridBottom &&
        comet.x >= gridLeft && comet.x <= gridRight) {
      const g = screenToGrid(comet.x, comet.y);
      if (g) {
        const cell = grid[g.r][g.c];
        if (cell.alive && !cell.dying) {
          cell.alive = false;
          cell.dying = true;
          cell.deathTimer = 30;
          spawnExplosion(comet.x, comet.y, cell.color);
          comet.alive = false;
          lives--;
          shakeTimer = 15;
          shakeIntensity = 6;
          flashTimer = 10;
          flashColor = '#ff4444';
          if (lives <= 0) {
            gamePhase = 'gameover';
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ── Check if comets leave screen ─────────────────────────────────
function checkCometOffscreen() {
  comets.forEach(comet => {
    if (!comet.alive) return;
    if (comet.y < -20 || comet.x < -20 || comet.x > canvas.width + 20) {
      comet.alive = false;
    }
  });
}

// ── Check for cascading groups after removal ─────────────────────
function checkCascades() {
  let found = false;
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c].alive && !grid[r][c].dying) {
        const group = findGroup(r, c);
        if (group.length >= 4) {
          removeGroup(group);
          found = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return found;
}

// ── Input ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function handleClick(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const px = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const py = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (gamePhase === 'start') {
    gamePhase = 'playing';
    createGrid();
    comets = [];
    particles = [];
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    comboCount = 0;
    comboTimer = 0;
    return;
  }

  if (gamePhase === 'gameover') {
    gamePhase = 'start';
    return;
  }

  if (gamePhase === 'playing') {
    const g = screenToGrid(px, py);
    if (g) {
      const cell = grid[g.r][g.c];
      if (cell.alive && !cell.dying) {
        const group = findGroup(g.r, g.c);
        if (group.length >= 4) {
          removeGroup(group);
          shakeTimer = 8;
          shakeIntensity = 3;
        } else {
          // Small feedback for invalid click
          const origin = getGridOrigin();
          const cs = getCellSize();
          const cx = origin.x + g.c * cs + cs / 2;
          const cy = origin.y + g.r * cs + cs / 2;
          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            const angle = randFloat(0, Math.PI * 2);
            particles.push({
              x: cx, y: cy,
              vx: Math.cos(angle) * 1.5,
              vy: Math.sin(angle) * 1.5,
              life: 15, maxLife: 15,
              color: '#888888',
              size: 2
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

canvas.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {

// ── Update ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function update() {
  frameCount++;

  // Update particles
  particles = particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life--;
    return p.life > 0;
  });

  if (gamePhase !== 'playing') return;

  // Update comets
  comets = comets.filter(c => {
    if (!c.alive) return false;
    c.trail.push({ x: c.x, y: c.y });
    if (c.trail.length > 12) c.trail.shift();
    c.x += c.vx;
    c.y += c.vy;
    return true;
  });

  checkCometHits();
  checkCometOffscreen();

  // Update dying cells
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      const cell = grid[r][c];
      if (cell.dying) {
        cell.deathTimer--;
        cell.scale = Math.max(0, cell.deathTimer / 30);
        if (cell.deathTimer <= 0) {
          cell.dying = false;
          cell.scale = 1;
        }
      }
      if (cell.alive) {
        cell.pulse += 0.05;
      }
    }
  }

  // Check cascades
  checkCascades();

  // Combo timer
  if (comboTimer > 0) {
    comboTimer--;
    if (comboTimer === 0) comboCount = 0;
  }

  // Shake
  if (shakeTimer > 0) shakeTimer--;

  // Flash
  if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer--;

  // Spawn new comets periodically
  if (frameCount % 180 === 0 && comets.length < 8) {
    const side = randInt(0, 2);
    let x, y, vx, vy;
    if (side === 0) {
      // From left
      x = randFloat(-10, canvas.width * 0.3);
      y = randFloat(canvas.height * 0.1, canvas.height * 0.4);
      vx = randFloat(1, 3);
      vy = randFloat(0.5, 2);
    } else if (side === 1) {
      // From right
      x = randFloat(canvas.width * 0.7, canvas.width + 10);
      y = randFloat(canvas.height * 0.1, canvas.height * 0.4);
      vx = randFloat(-3, -1);
      vy = randFloat(0.5, 2);
    } else {
      // From top
      x = randFloat(canvas.width * 0.2, canvas.width * 0.8);
      y = randFloat(-10, canvas.height * 0.1);
      vx = randFloat(-1.5, 1.5);
      vy = randFloat(1.5, 3);
    }
    comets.push({
      x, y, vx, vy,
      color: pick(COMET_COLORS),
      trail: [],
      alive: true,
      size: randFloat(4, 8)
    });
  }
}

// ── Draw background stars ─────────────────────────────────────────
function initBackgroundStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
      y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
      size: randFloat(0.5, 2),
      brightness: randFloat(0.3, 1),
      twinkleSpeed: randFloat(0.01, 0.05),
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}
initBackgroundStars();

function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2, 0,
    canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2, Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.7
  );
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0f0f2a');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#050510');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  stars.forEach(s => {
    const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frameCount * s.twinkleSpeed + s.phase);
    const alpha = s.brightness * twinkle;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

// ── Draw grid cells ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawGrid() {
  const cs = getCellSize();
  const origin = getGridOrigin();
  const gap = cs * 0.08;

  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      const cell = grid[r][c];
      const x = origin.x + c * cs;
      const y = origin.y + r * cs;
      const cx = x + cs / 2;
      const cy = y + cs / 2;
      const radius = cs / 2 - gap;

      if (!cell.alive && !cell.dying) continue;

      const scale = cell.dying ? cell.scale : 1;
      const pulse = cell.alive ? 0.9 + 0.1 * Math.sin(cell.pulse) : 1;
      const r2 = radius * scale * pulse;

      if (r2 <= 0) continue;

      // Glow
      const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r2 * 0.2, cx, cy, r2 * 1.5);
      glowGrad.addColorStop(0, cell.color + '66');
      glowGrad.addColorStop(1, cell.color + '00');
      ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r2 * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Main star body
      const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r2 * 0.2, cy - r2 * 0.2, r2 * 0.1, cx, cy, r2);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, cell.color);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, cell.color + 'aa');
      ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Inner highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx - r2 * 0.25, cy - r2 * 0.25, r2 * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Cross flare
      if (cell.alive && !cell.dying) {
        const flareLen = r2 * 0.8 * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(cell.pulse * 1.5));
        ctx.strokeStyle = cell.color + '88';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx - flareLen, cy);
        ctx.lineTo(cx + flareLen, cy);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - flareLen);
        ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + flareLen);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Draw comets ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawComets() {
  comets.forEach(comet => {
    if (!comet.alive) return;

    // Trail
    for (let i = 0; i < comet.trail.length; i++) {
      const t = comet.trail[i];
      const alpha = (i / comet.trail.length) * 0.6;
      const size = comet.size * (i / comet.trail.length) * 0.7;
      ctx.fillStyle = comet.color + Math.floor(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, Math.max(1, size), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Head glow
    const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(comet.x, comet.y, 0, comet.x, comet.y, comet.size * 3);
    glowGrad.addColorStop(0, comet.color + 'cc');
    glowGrad.addColorStop(0.5, comet.color + '44');
    glowGrad.addColorStop(1, comet.color + '00');
    ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(comet.x, comet.y, comet.size * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(comet.x, comet.y, comet.size * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

// ── Draw particles ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color + Math.floor(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

// ── Draw HUD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawHUD() {
  const pad = 20;
  const fontSize = Math.max(16, canvas.width * 0.02);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${score}`, pad, pad + fontSize);

  // Best
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
  ctx.font = `${fontSize * 0.8}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`BEST: ${bestScore}`, pad, pad + fontSize * 2);

  // Lives as small stars
  const lifeSize = fontSize * 0.6;
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
    const lx = canvas.width - pad - (lives - 1 - i) * (lifeSize * 2.5) - lifeSize;
    const ly = pad + fontSize * 0.5;
    drawMiniStar(lx + lifeSize, ly + lifeSize, lifeSize, '#ff6b6b');
  }

  // Combo
  if (comboCount > 1 && comboTimer > 0) {
    const comboAlpha = Math.min(1, comboTimer / 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${comboAlpha})`;
    ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize * 1.2}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`COMBO x${comboCount}!`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height * 0.12);
  }
}

function drawMiniStar(cx, cy, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const angle = (i * 4 * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * size;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * size;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

// ── Draw start screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;
  const fontSize = Math.max(24, canvas.width * 0.04);

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize * 1.5}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('PLEIADS', cx, cy - fontSize * 2);

  // Decorative stars around title
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + frameCount * 0.01;
    const dist = fontSize * 2.5;
    const sx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
    const sy = cy - fontSize * 2 + Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.5;
    drawMiniStar(sx, sy, fontSize * 0.2, pick(STAR_COLORS));
  }

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
  ctx.font = `${fontSize * 0.7}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('Click groups of 4+ same-color stars to clear them', cx, cy);
  ctx.fillText('Beware the comets falling from above!', cx, cy + fontSize);

  // Start prompt
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${pulse})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('CLICK TO START', cx, cy + fontSize * 2.5);
}

// ── Draw game over screen ─────────────────────────────────────────
function drawGameOverScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;
  const fontSize = Math.max(24, canvas.width * 0.04);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize * 1.3}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', cx, cy - fontSize);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, cx, cy + fontSize * 0.5);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
  ctx.font = `${fontSize * 0.8}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText(`Best: ${bestScore}`, cx, cy + fontSize * 1.5);

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${pulse})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize * 0.9}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN', cx, cy + fontSize * 3);
}

// ── Draw flash overlay ────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawFlash() {
  if (flashTimer <= 0) return;
  const alpha = flashTimer / 10 * 0.3;
  ctx.fillStyle = flashColor + Math.floor(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
}

// ── Main draw ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Apply screen shake
  if (shakeTimer > 0) {
    const dx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity;
    const dy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity;
    ctx.translate(dx, dy);
  }

  drawBackground();

  if (gamePhase === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
  } else {
    drawGrid();
    drawComets();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();

    if (gamePhase === 'gameover') {
      drawGameOverScreen();
    }
  }

  drawFlash();

  ctx.restore();
}

// ── Game loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function gameLoop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ── Initialize and start ──────────────────────────────────────────
createGrid();
gameLoop();
</script>

const TILE = 32;

  state.lives = 3;
