function resetLevel() {
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {

function update() {
  if (state.screen !== 'play') return;

  let dx = 0, dy = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) { dx = -1; player.dir = 3; }
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) { dx = 1; player.dir = 1; }
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) { dy = -1; player.dir = 0; }

}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = e.x;
  const y = e.y;
  const colors = ['#FF0000', '#FF8C00', '#9400D3'];
  const color = colors[e.type];
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + TILE / 2, y + TILE / 2, TILE / 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + TILE / 2 - 5, y + TILE / 2 - 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + TILE / 2 + 5, y + TILE / 2 - 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Pupils
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + TILE / 2 - 5, y + TILE / 2 - 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + TILE / 2 + 5, y + TILE / 2 - 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Mouth
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(x + TILE / 2 - 4, y + TILE / 2 + 4, 8, 3);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 8, 16);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('LEVEL: ' + state.level, W / 2, 16);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES: ' + state.lives, W - 8, 16);
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4500';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('DIG DUG II', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / WASD to move', W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.fillText('SPACE / ENTER to place bomb', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = state.won ? '#00FF00' : '#FF0000';
  ctx.font = 'bold 32px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(state.won ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
  ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
}

function draw() {
  if (state.screen === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }

  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0f08';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Tiles
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      drawTile(c, r);
    }
  }

  // Player
  drawPlayer();

  // Enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    drawEnemy(e);
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Game over overlay
  if (state.screen === 'gameover') {
    drawGameOver();
  }
}

// ===== LOOP =====
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

resetGame();
state.screen = 'title';
loop();

<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Nebulus</title>

  html, body {

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = 800, H = 600;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// --- STATE ---
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let frame = 0;
let ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 80, w: 40, h: 20, speed: 5 };
let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let nebulae = [];
let keys = {};
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 90;
let difficulty = 0;

// --- INIT STARS ---
function initStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
      speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1,
      brightness: Math.random()
    });
  }
}

// --- INIT NEBULAE ---
function initNebulae() {
  nebulae = [];
  const colors = [
    { r: 100, g: 50, b: 180 },
    { r: 50, g: 100, b: 200 },
    { r: 180, g: 50, b: 100 },
    { r: 50, g: 180, b: 150 }
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const c = colors[i % colors.length];
    nebulae.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 120 + 60,
      color: c,
      alpha: Math.random() * 0.08 + 0.03,
      drift: Math.random() * 0.2 + 0.05,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

// --- SPAWN ENEMY ---
function spawnEnemy() {
  const types = ['drone', 'striker', 'heavy'];
  const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(types.length, 1 + difficulty))];
  const baseX = Math.random() * (W - 60) + 30;
  let e;
  if (type === 'drone') {
    e = { x: baseX, y: -30, w: 30, h: 20, type: 'drone', hp: 1, speed: 1.5 + difficulty * 0.3, score: 10, color: '#ff6644', fireRate: 0, fireTimer: 0, wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  } else if (type === 'striker') {
    e = { x: baseX, y: -30, w: 35, h: 25, type: 'striker', hp: 2, speed: 2 + difficulty * 0.4, score: 25, color: '#ffaa22', fireRate: 120, fireTimer: 0, wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  } else {
    e = { x: baseX, y: -40, w: 50, h: 35, type: 'heavy', hp: 5, speed: 0.8 + difficulty * 0.2, score: 50, color: '#cc44ff', fireRate: 80, fireTimer: 0, wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  }
  enemies.push(e);
}

// --- FIRE BULLET ---
function fireBullet(x, y, vy, isEnemy) {
  bullets.push({ x: x, y: y, vy: vy, r: isEnemy ? 4 : 3, isEnemy: isEnemy, life: 300 });
}

// --- EXPLODE ---
function explode(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      r: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
      color: color,
      life: Math.random() * 30 + 20,
      maxLife: 50
    });
  }
}

// --- INPUT ---
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (state === 'start' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    state = 'play';
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    bullets = [];
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = 90;
    difficulty = 0;
    ship.x = W / 2;
    ship.y = H - 80;
  }
  if (state === 'gameover' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    state = 'start';
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// --- UPDATE ---
function update() {
  frame++;

  // Stars
  for (let s of stars) {
    s.y += s.speed;
    if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
  }

  // Nebulae drift
  for (let n of nebulae) {
    n.phase += 0.005;
    n.x += Math.sin(n.phase) * n.drift * 0.3;
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.98;
    p.vy *= 0.98;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state !== 'play') return;

  // Difficulty ramp
  difficulty = Math.floor(frame / 1800);
  spawnInterval = Math.max(30, 90 - difficulty * 8);

  // Ship movement
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
  ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(W - ship.w / 2, ship.x));

  // Fire
  if (keys[' '] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
    if (frame % 10 === 0) {
      fireBullet(ship.x, ship.y - ship.h / 2, -6, false);
    }
  }

  // Spawn enemies
  spawnTimer++;
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnEnemy();
  }

  // Update bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.y += b.vy;
    b.life--;
    if (b.y < -10 || b.y > H + 10 || b.life <= 0) {
      bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.y += e.speed;
    e.wobble += 0.05;
    e.x += Math.sin(e.wobble) * 0.5;

    // Enemy fire
    if (e.fireRate > 0) {
      e.fireTimer++;
      if (e.fireTimer >= e.fireRate) {
        e.fireTimer = 0;
        fireBullet(e.x, e.y + e.h / 2, 3.5, true);
      }
    }

    // Reached bottom
    if (e.y > H + 40) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // Collision with ship
    const dx = Math.abs(e.x - ship.x);
    const dy = Math.abs(e.y - ship.y);
    if (dx < (e.w + ship.w) / 2 && dy < (e.h + ship.h) / 2) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#44ddff', 20);
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        state = 'gameover';
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Bullet hits enemy
    for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const b = bullets[j];
      if (b.isEnemy) continue;
      const bdx = Math.abs(b.x - e.x);
      const bdy = Math.abs(b.y - e.y);
      if (bdx < (e.w + b.r * 2) / 2 && bdy < (e.h + b.r * 2) / 2) {
        e.hp--;
        bullets.splice(j, 1);
        if (e.hp <= 0) {
          score += e.score;
          explode(e.x, e.y, e.color, 15);
          enemies.splice(i, 1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Enemy bullets hit ship
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    if (!b.isEnemy) continue;
    const dx = Math.abs(b.x - ship.x);
    const dy = Math.abs(b.y - ship.y);
    if (dx < (ship.w + b.r * 2) / 2 && dy < (ship.h + b.r * 2) / 2) {
      bullets.splice(i, 1);
      explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#44ddff', 20);
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) {
        state = 'gameover';
      }
    }
  }
}

// --- DRAW ---
function drawBackground() {
  // Deep space gradient
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#050510');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0a25');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#0f0a20');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Nebulae
  for (let n of nebulae) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(n.x, n.y, 0, n.x, n.y, n.r);
    const a = n.alpha * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(n.phase));
    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${n.color.r},${n.color.g},${n.color.b},${a})`);
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(n.x - n.r, n.y - n.r, n.r * 2, n.r * 2);
  }

  // Stars
  for (let s of stars) {
    const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.05 + s.brightness * 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.3 + twinkle * 0.7})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawShip() {
  const { x, y, w, h } = ship;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);

  // Engine glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, h / 2, 0, 0, h / 2, 15);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(68,221,255,0.6)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(68,221,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.fillRect(-15, h / 2 - 5, 30, 20);

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44ddff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(-w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(-w / 4, h / 3);
  ctx.lineTo(w / 4, h / 3);
  ctx.lineTo(w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Wings
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2299bb';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(-w / 2 - 5, h / 2 + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(-w / 4, h / 3);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.lineTo(w / 2 + 5, h / 2 + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(w / 4, h / 3);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);

  if (e.type === 'drone') {
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa66';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (e.type === 'striker') {
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 4, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 4, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd88';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2, e.h / 4);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 3, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 3, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2, e.h / 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ee88ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff88ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-e.w / 3, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 3, -e.h / 2 - 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(e.w / 3, -e.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(e.w / 3, -e.h / 2 - 8);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (let b of bullets) {
    if (b.isEnemy) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,100,0.3)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ffcc';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(68,255,204,0.3)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (let p of particles) {
    const a = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${score}`, 20, 30);

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`LIVES: ${'♥'.repeat(lives)}${'♡'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - lives))}`, W - 20, 30);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`WAVE ${difficulty + 1}`, W / 2, 30);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#44ddff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('NEBULUS', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaacc';
  ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Navigate the nebula. Destroy all hostiles.', W / 2, H / 2);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#6688aa';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('← → or A/D to move', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
  ctx.fillText('SPACE or W to fire', W / 2, H / 2 + 75);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.08);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 140);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawGameOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaacc';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText(`Waves Survived: ${difficulty + 1}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 45);

  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frame * 0.08);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  drawBullets();
  for (let e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  if (state === 'play') drawShip();

  if (state === 'play') drawHUD();
  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
}

// --- MAIN LOOP ---
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

initStars();
initNebulae();
loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Shufflepuck Cafe</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #24303a 0%, #0d1218 100%);
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    touch-action: none; cursor: crosshair;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* =========================================================
   ShUFFLEPUCK  CAFE  —  one famous scene
   A neon cafe table. Slide the puck around, knock the
   cups into the trash, don't let the cups fall off.
   Score = cups banked. Win = all cups in the trash.
   Lose = 3 cups drop off the table.
   ========================================================= */

// ---------- Canvas setup ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---------- Table geometry (recomputed on resize) ----------
let table = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, r: 18,
              trashX: 0, trashY: 0, trashR: 34,
              cx: 0, cy: 0 };
function computeTable() {
  const margin = Math.max(40, Math.min(W, H) * 0.06);
  const tw = W - margin * 2;
  const th = H - margin * 2;
  table.x = margin; table.y = margin;
  table.w = tw; table.h = th;
  table.cx = margin + tw / 2; table.cy = margin + th / 2;
  table.trashX = margin + tw * 0.82;
  table.trashY = margin + th * 0.5;
  table.trashR = Math.max(24, Math.min(tw, th) * 0.07);
  table.r = Math.min(table.trashR * 1.2, 26);
}
computeTable();
window.addEventListener("resize", computeTable);

// ---------- Palette ----------
const COL = {
  felt:      "#2f6f5f",
  feltDark:  "#22544a",
  feltLight: "#3f8a76",
  wood:      "#7a4a26",
  woodDark:  "#5a3418",
  woodLight: "#9a6534",
  puck:      "#e8433f",
  puckEdge:  "#a8231f",
  puckHi:    "#ff8a7a",
  cup:       "#ffd23f",
  cupEdge:   "#c99a12",
  cupHi:     "#fff0a0",
  trash:     "#3a4a5a",
  trashHi:   "#5a7088",
  line:      "#dfeaf0",
  text:      "#f4f7f9",
  danger:    "#ff5a5a",
  accent:    "#4fd6c4",
  accent2:   "#ff9f43"
};

// ---------- Game state ----------
const state = {
  phase: "start",        // start | playing | win | lose
  score: 0,
  dropped: 0,
  maxDropped: 3,
  totalCups: 0,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  flashColor: COL.danger
};

const puck = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 16, rot: 0 };
let cups = [];
const CUP_R = 15;

function resetGame() {
  state.score = 0;
  state.dropped = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  puck.x = table.x + table.w * 0.22;
  puck.y = table.cy;
  puck.vx = 0; puck.vy = 0; puck.rot = 0;
  cups = [];
  const cols = 4, rows = 3;
  const gapX = Math.min(table.w * 0.09, 60);
  const gapY = Math.min(table.h * 0.16, 70);
  const startX = table.x + table.w * 0.5;
  const startY = table.cy - (rows - 1) * gapY / 2;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      cups.push({
        x: startX + c * gapX,
        y: startY + r * gapY,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        r: CUP_R,
        alive: true,
        inTrash: false,
        wob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }
  }
  state.totalCups = cups.length;
}

// ---------- Input ----------
let pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, down: false, id: null };
function toLocal(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
}
function onDown(e) {
  const p = toLocal(e);
  pointer.x = p.x; pointer.y = p.y;
  if (state.phase === "start") { startPlay(); return; }
  if (state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") {
    resetGame(); state.phase = "playing"; return;
  }
  pointer.down = true;
  pointer.id = (e.pointerId !== undefined) ? e.pointerId : 0;
  e.preventDefault();
}
function onMove(e) {
  const p = toLocal(e);
  pointer.x = p.x; pointer.y = p.y;
}
function onUp(e) {
  pointer.down = false;
  if (state.phase === "playing") launchPuck();
}
function startPlay() {
  resetGame();
  state.phase = "playing";
}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });

// ---------- Physics helpers ----------
const FRICTION = 0.985;
const MAX_SPEED = 22;
const WALL_BOUNCE = 0.82;

function launchPuck() {
  // aim from puck toward pointer
  let dx = pointer.x - puck.x;
  let dy = pointer.y - puck.y;
  let len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (len < 1) return;
  const power = Math.min(len / 40, 1) * MAX_SPEED;
  puck.vx = (dx / len) * power;
  puck.vy = (dy / len) * power;
}

function clampToTable(obj) {
  const m = table.r;
  if (obj.x < table.x + m) { obj.x = table.x + m; obj.vx = -obj.vx * WALL_BOUNCE; }
  if (obj.x > table.x + table.w - m) { obj.x = table.x + table.w - m; obj.vx = -obj.vx * WALL_BOUNCE; }
  if (obj.y < table.y + m) { obj.y = table.y + m; obj.vy = -obj.vy * WALL_BOUNCE; }
  if (obj.y > table.y + table.h - m) { obj.y = table.y + table.h - m; obj.vy = -obj.vy * WALL_BOUNCE; }
}

function collide(a, b) {
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const min = a.r + b.r;
  if (dist === 0 || dist >= min) return;
  const nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist;
  const overlap = min - dist;
  // separate
  a.x -= nx * overlap * 0.5; a.y -= ny * overlap * 0.5;
  b.x += nx * overlap * 0.5; b.y += ny * overlap * 0.5;
  // relative velocity along normal
  const rvx = b.vx - a.vx, rvy = b.vy - a.vy;
  const vn = rvx * nx + rvy * ny;
  if (vn > 0) return; // already separating
  const e = 0.9;
  const j = -(1 + e) * vn;
  a.vx -= nx * j; a.vy -= ny * j;
  b.vx += nx * j; b.vy += ny * j;
  state.shake = Math.min(state.shake + 4, 14);
}

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  state.shake *= 0.85;
  state.flash *= 0.9;

  if (state.phase !== "playing") return;

  // puck
  puck.x += puck.vx;
  puck.y += puck.vy;
  puck.vx *= FRICTION;
  puck.vy *= FRICTION;
  puck.rot += Math.hypot(puck.vx, puck.vy) * 0.05;
  clampToTable(puck);
  if (Math.hypot(puck.vx, puck.vy) < 0.05) { puck.vx = 0; puck.vy = 0; }

  // cups
  for (const c of cups) {
    if (!c.alive) continue;
    c.x += c.vx; c.y += c.vy;
    c.vx *= FRICTION; c.vy *= FRICTION;
    c.wob += dt * 3;
    if (Math.hypot(c.vx, c.vy) < 0.05) { c.vx = 0; c.vy = 0; }

    // off the table?
    if (c.x < table.x - c.r || c.x > table.x + table.w + c.r ||
        c.y < table.y - c.r || c.y > table.y + table.h + c.r) {
      c.alive = false;
      state.dropped++;
      state.flash = 1; state.flashColor = COL.danger;
      if (state.dropped >= state.maxDropped) { state.phase = "lose"; }
      continue;
    }
    clampToTable(c);

    // in the trash?
    const d = Math.hypot(c.x - table.trashX, c.y - table.trashY);
    if (d < table.trashR * 0.7 && !c.inTrash) {
      c.inTrash = true;
      c.alive = false;
      state.score++;
      state.flash = 1; state.flashColor = COL.accent;
      if (state.score >= state.totalCups) { state.phase = "win"; }
    }
  }

  // collisions: puck vs cups
  for (const c of cups) {
    if (c.alive) collide(puck, c);
  }
  // cup vs cup
  for (let i = 0; i < cups.length; i++) {
    if (!cups[i].alive) continue;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < cups.length; j++) {
      if (!cups[j].alive) continue;
      collide(cups[i], cups[j]);
    }
  }
}

// ---------- Draw: background ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(table.cx, table.cy, 40, table.cx, table.cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2c3a45");
  g.addColorStop(0.6, "#1a242e");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#0a0f15");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // soft ambient glow behind table
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(table.cx, table.cy, 20, table.cx, table.cy, table.w * 0.9);
  glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(79,214,196,0.10)");
  glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(79,214,196,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

// ---------- Draw: table ----------
function drawTable() {
  const { x, y, w, h, r } = table;
  // wood frame (outer)
  ctx.save();
  roundRect(x - 10, y - 10, w + 20, h + 20, r + 8);
  const wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
  wg.addColorStop(0, COL.woodLight);
  wg.addColorStop(0.5, COL.wood);
  wg.addColorStop(1, COL.woodDark);
  ctx.fillStyle = wg;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = COL.woodDark; ctx.stroke();

  // felt (inner)
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + w * 0.4, y + h * 0.35, 30, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.5, Math.max(w, h) * 0.8);
  fg.addColorStop(0, COL.feltLight);
  fg.addColorStop(0.7, COL.felt);
  fg.addColorStop(1, COL.feltDark);
  ctx.fillStyle = fg;
  ctx.fill();

  // felt texture: faint concentric lines
  ctx.save();
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const inset = 30 + i * Math.min(w, h) * 0.06;
    roundRect(x + inset, y + inset, w - inset * 2, h - inset * 2, Math.max(4, r - inset * 0.3));
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // subtle center circle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.5, Math.min(w, h) * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ---------- Draw: trash bin ----------
function drawTrash() {
  const { trashX: tx, trashY: ty, trashR: tr } = table;
  // shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(tx, ty + tr * 0.5, tr * 1.05, tr * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  ctx.fill();

  // bin body (slightly 3D)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(tx, ty);
  const body = ctx.createLinearGradient(-tr, 0, tr, 0);
  body.addColorStop(0, COL.trash);
  body.addColorStop(0.5, COL.trashHi);
  body.addColorStop(1, COL.trash);
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, tr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"; ctx.stroke();

  // open mouth (darker hole)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -tr * 0.05, tr * 0.62, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#161d25";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"; ctx.stroke();

  // "TRASH" label
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent;
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.max(10, tr * 0.42) + "px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("TRASH", 0, tr * 0.55);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: cup ----------
function drawCup(c) {
  if (!c.alive && !c.inTrash) return; // dropped off table
  const bob = c.inTrash ? 0 : Math.sin(c.wob) * 1.5;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(c.x, c.y + bob);

  // shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, c.r * 0.9, c.r * 0.95, c.r * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
  ctx.fill();

  // body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-c.r, 0, c.r, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, COL.cupEdge);
  g.addColorStop(0.5, COL.cup);
  g.addColorStop(1, COL.cupEdge);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = COL.cupEdge; ctx.stroke();

  // highlight
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-c.r * 0.35, -c.r * 0.35, c.r * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.cupHi;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // coffee top
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -c.r * 0.05, c.r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3418";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a2210"; ctx.stroke();
  // swirl
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(c.r * 0.12, -c.r * 0.05, c.r * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 1.5);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,160,0.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: puck ----------
function drawPuck() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(puck.x, puck.y);
  ctx.rotate(puck.rot);

  // shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, puck.r * 0.6, puck.r * 1.05, puck.r * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  ctx.fill();

  // body
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-puck.r * 0.3, -puck.r * 0.3, 4, 0, 0, puck.r);
  g.addColorStop(0, COL.puckHi);
  g.addColorStop(0.6, COL.puck);
  g.addColorStop(1, COL.puckEdge);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, puck.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = COL.puckEdge; ctx.stroke();

  // inner ring
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, puck.r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

  // center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, puck.r * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: aim line ----------
function drawAim() {
  if (state.phase !== "playing") return;
  const dx = pointer.x - puck.x, dy = pointer.y - puck.y;
  const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (len < 4) return;
  const nx = dx / len, ny = dy / len;
  const power = Math.min(len / 40, 1);
  const lineLen = 60 + power * 120;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.setLineDash([10, 8]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(puck.x, puck.y);
  ctx.lineTo(puck.x + nx * lineLen, puck.y + ny * lineLen);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // arrow head
  const ax = puck.x + nx * lineLen, ay = puck.y + ny * lineLen;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
  ctx.lineTo(ax - nx * 14 - ny * 8, ay - ny * 14 + nx * 8);
  ctx.lineTo(ax - nx * 14 + ny * 8, ay - ny * 14 - nx * 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: HUD ----------
function drawHUD() {
  const pad = 18;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";

  // title
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent;
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("SHUFFLEPUCK", pad, pad);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent2;
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("CAFE", pad + ctx.measureText("SHUFFLEPUCK").width + 12, pad);

  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Cups banked: " + state.score + " / " + state.totalCups, pad, pad + 34);

  // dropped (lives)
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Dropped: ", W - pad, pad + 34);
  const dw = ctx.measureText("Dropped: ").width;
  const startX = W - pad - dw;
  for (let i = 0; i < state.maxDropped; i++) {
    const cx = startX + 14 + i * 22;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, pad + 44, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < state.dropped ? COL.danger : "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = i < state.dropped ? "#7a1010" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: overlay messages ----------
function drawOverlay() {
  if (state.phase === "playing") return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,12,18,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  const cx = table.cx, cy = table.cy;
  if (state.phase === "start") {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(54, W * 0.08) + "px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SHUFFLEPUCK CAFE", cx, cy - 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
    ctx.font = "22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Slide the puck. Knock every coffee cup into the TRASH.", cx, cy);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.danger;
    ctx.fillText("If 3 cups fall off the table, you lose.", cx, cy + 34);
    pulseButton("TAP TO START", cx, cy + 90);
  } else if (state.phase === "win") {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(54, W * 0.08) + "px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("CAREER!", cx, cy - 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
    ctx.font = "24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("You banked all " + state.totalCups + " cups!", cx, cy);
    pulseButton("TAP TO PLAY AGAIN", cx, cy + 80);
  } else if (state.phase === "lose") {
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.danger;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(54, W * 0.08) + "px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("CAFE CLOSED!", cx, cy - 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
    ctx.font = "24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Too many cups dropped. You banked " + state.score + ".", cx, cy);
    pulseButton("TAP TO RETRY", cx, cy + 80);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function pulseButton(text, x, y) {
  const s = 1 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.05;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(s, s);
  const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + 60;
  roundRect(-w / 2, -26, w, 52, 26);
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.accent;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1418";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(text, 0, 1);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Draw: flash & shake ----------
function applyShake() {
  if (state.shake < 0.3) return;
  const s = state.shake;
  ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
}
function drawFlash() {
  if (state.flash < 0.02) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.35;
  ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Main draw ----------
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  applyShake();
  drawBackground();
  drawTable();
  drawTrash();
  for (const c of cups) drawCup(c);
  drawPuck();
  drawAim();
  ctx.restore();
  drawFlash();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

// ---------- Loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- Boot ----------
resetGame();
state.phase = "start";
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sorcerer of Claymorgue Castle</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border: 3px solid #2a1f0e;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #0a0812;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(180,100,20,0.3), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    max-width: 95vw;
    max-height: 95vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// ============================================================
// SORCERER OF CLAYMORGUE CASTLE - Single Scene: The Tower
// Player is a sorcerer on a spiral tower. Enemies (skeleton
// warriors) descend the stairs. Player shoots fireballs to
// stop them before they reach the bottom.
// Win: survive 60 seconds. Lose: a skeleton reaches you.
// Controls: Left/Right arrows or A/D to move, Space to fire.
// ============================================================

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let gameState = 'title'; // 'title', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
let score = 0;
let timer = 0;
const WIN_TIME = 60;
let shake = 0;

// Player
let player = { x: W / 2, y: H - 80, w: 30, h: 50, speed: 3, cooldown: 0, facing: 0 };

// Projectiles (fireballs)
let fireballs = [];

// Enemies (skeleton warriors descending the tower)
let enemies = [];
let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
const ENEMY_INTERVAL = 2.0;
const ENEMY_SPEED = 40;

// Particles for effects
let particles = [];

// Decorative: floating candles
let candles = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
  candles.push({
    x: 40 + Math.random() * (W - 80),
    y: 30 + Math.random() * (H - 120),
    flicker: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Tower pillars (background)
let pillars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
  pillars.push({ x: 60 + i * 180, w: 20 });
}

// Input
let keys = {};

// ---------- INPUT ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (gameState === 'title' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if ((gameState === 'won' || gameState === 'lost') && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    gameState = 'title';
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

function startGame() {
  gameState = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  timer = 0;
  player.x = W / 2;
  player.y = H - 80;
  player.cooldown = 0;
  fireballs = [];
  enemies = [];
  particles = [];
  enemySpawnTimer = 0;
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

  // Timer
  timer += dt;
  if (timer >= WIN_TIME) {
    gameState = 'won';
    return;
  }

  // Shake decay
  if (shake > 0) shake -= dt * 30;

  // Player movement
  let dx = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) dx = -1;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) dx = 1;
  player.x += dx * player.speed * 60 * dt;
  player.x = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, player.x));
  player.facing = dx;

  // Shooting
  if (player.cooldown > 0) player.cooldown -= dt;
  if ((keys[' '] || keys['Spacebar']) && player.cooldown <= 0) {
    fireballs.push({
      x: player.x + player.facing * 15,
      y: player.y - 10,
      vx: player.facing * 500,
      vy: -200,
      life: 2
    });
    player.cooldown = 0.35;
  }

  // Update fireballs
  for (let i = fireballs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let f = fireballs[i];
    f.x += f.vx * dt;
    f.y += f.vy * dt;
    f.vy += 300 * dt; // slight gravity
    f.life -= dt;
    if (f.life <= 0 || f.x < -20 || f.x > W + 20 || f.y < -20 || f.y > H + 20) {
      fireballs.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Spawn enemies
  enemySpawnTimer += dt;
  if (enemySpawnTimer >= ENEMY_INTERVAL) {
    enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    let side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1;
    enemies.push({
      x: side === 0 ? 50 : W - 50,
      y: -30,
      w: 28,
      h: 40,
      speed: ENEMY_SPEED + Math.random() * 20,
      hp: 1,
      walkPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let e = enemies[i];
    e.y += e.speed * dt;
    e.x += (player.x - e.x) * 0.3 * dt; // slight homing
    e.walkPhase += dt * 8;

    // Check if enemy reached player level
    if (e.y >= player.y - 20) {
      gameState = 'lost';
      shake = 10;
      return;
    }

    // Check collision with fireballs
    for (let j = fireballs.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      let f = fireballs[j];
      if (Math.abs(f.x - e.x) < 20 && Math.abs(f.y - e.y) < 25) {
        e.hp--;
        fireballs.splice(j, 1);
        // Spawn particles
        for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: e.x, y: e.y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
            life: 0.5,
            color: `hsl(${30 + Math.random() * 20}, 100%, ${50 + Math.random() * 30}%)`
          });
        }
        break;
      }
    }

    if (e.hp <= 0) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      score += 10;
      shake = 5;
      // More particles
      for (let p = 0; p < 12; p++) {
        particles.push({
          x: e.x, y: e.y,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 250,
          vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 250,
          life: 0.7,
          color: `hsl(${0 + Math.random() * 30}, 100%, ${40 + Math.random() * 40}%)`
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 400 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Candle flicker
  for (let c of candles) {
    c.flicker += dt * 5;
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  }

  // Background: dark stone tower interior
  let bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0815');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1525');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d0a18');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stone wall texture - horizontal lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,50,80,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Vertical mortar lines
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    for (let x = ((y / 40) % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 50); x < W; x += 100) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + 40);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // Tower pillars
  for (let p of pillars) {
    let pillarGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p.x - p.w/2, 0, p.x + p.w/2, 0);
    pillarGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1525');
    pillarGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2d2540');
    pillarGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1525');
    ctx.fillStyle = pillarGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.w/2, 0, p.w, H);
    // Pillar capital
    ctx.fillStyle = '#352d4a';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.w/2 - 5, 0, p.w + 10, 15);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.w/2 - 5, H - 15, p.w + 10, 15);
  }

  // Floating candles
  for (let c of candles) {
    let flicker = Math.sin(c.flicker) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    // Glow
    let glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 0, c.x, c.y, 30 * flicker);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,180,50,${0.4 * flicker})`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,180,50,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 30, c.y - 30, 60, 60);
    // Candle body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5e6c8';
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 3, c.y - 5, 6, 15);
    // Flame
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${150 + flicker * 50},30,${flicker})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y - 8, 3, 6 * flicker, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Staircase (decorative, center)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,35,55,0.5)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    let sx = W/2 - 60 + i * 15;
    let sy = H/2 - 40 + i * 12;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 20, 12);
  }

  // Draw enemies (skeleton warriors)
  for (let e of enemies) {
    drawSkeleton(e);
  }

  // Draw fireballs
  for (let f of fireballs) {
    let fGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, 10);
    fGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,100,0.9)');
    fGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,120,20,0.7)');
    fGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,60,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = fGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Core
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8e0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life * 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Draw player (sorcerer)
  drawSorcerer();

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Overlays
  if (gameState === 'title') drawTitle();
  if (gameState === 'won') drawWon();
  if (gameState === 'lost') drawLost();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSkeleton(e) {
  let bob = Math.sin(e.walkPhase) * 3;
  let x = e.x, y = e.y + bob;

  // Body (ribcage)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4c8a0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 8, y - 5, 16, 20);
  // Ribs
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a7a55';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 8, y + r * 6);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 8, y + r * 6);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // Skull
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8dcc0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - 12, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Eye sockets
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 13, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 3, y - 13, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Jaw
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d4c8a0';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 7, 8, 3);
  // Arms (holding a sword)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d4c8a0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  let armSwing = Math.sin(e.walkPhase) * 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 8, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 14, y + 10 + armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 8, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 14, y + 10 - armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Sword in right hand
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 14, y + 10 - armSwing);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 20, y - 10 - armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Legs
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d4c8a0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 4, y + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 6, y + 25 + armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 4, y + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 25 - armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawSorcerer() {
  let x = player.x, y = player.y;
  let bob = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 2;

  // Robe (purple/magenta)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4a2060';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 15, y + 25);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 10, y - 10 + bob);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y - 10 + bob);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 15, y + 25);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Robe trim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6a3080';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y + 20, 24, 5);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d0a0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - 18 + bob, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Hat (pointed, dark purple)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1040';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 12, y - 22 + bob);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y - 45 + bob);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 12, y - 22 + bob);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // Hat brim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1850';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 24 + bob, 28, 4);

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 18 + bob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 3, y - 18 + bob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Staff
  let staffX = x + (player.facing >= 0 ? 12 : -12);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a3a1a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(staffX, y + 25);
  ctx.lineTo(staffX, y - 30 + bob);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Staff orb
  let orbGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(staffX, y - 32 + bob, 0, staffX, y - 32 + bob, 8);
  orbGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(100,200,255,0.8)');
  orbGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,200,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = orbGlow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(staffX, y - 32 + bob, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#80d0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(staffX, y - 32 + bob, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Arms
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a2060';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 8, y + bob);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 15, y + 10 + bob);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();

}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d080';

function drawWon() {

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Goal! Air Hockey</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="800"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const RAIL = 20;
  const TABLE_L = RAIL;
  const TABLE_R = W - RAIL;
  const TABLE_T = RAIL;
  const TABLE_B = H - RAIL;
  const MID = H / 2;

  const PADDLE_R = 34;
  const PUCK_R = 18;
  const WIN = 5;

  const AI_MAX_SPEED = 5.5;
  const AI_HIT_SPEED = 13;
  const PUCK_MAX = 16;

  let state = "start";
  let playerScore = 0;
  let aiScore = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let confetti = [];

  const player = { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.78, vx: 0, vy: 0, px: W / 2, py: H * 0.78 };
  const ai = { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.22, vx: 0, vy: 0, px: W / 2, py: H * 0.22 };
  const puck = { x: W / 2, y: MID, vx: 0, vy: 0, spin: 0 };

  function resetPuck() {
    puck.x = W / 2;
    puck.y = MID;
    puck.vx = 0;
    puck.vy = 0;
    puck.spin = 0;
    player.x = W / 2; player.y = H * 0.78;
    ai.x = W / 2; ai.y = H * 0.22;
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = "play";
    playerScore = 0;
    aiScore = 0;
    confetti = [];
    resetPuck();
  }

  function goalBy(who) {
    if (who === "player") playerScore++;
    else aiScore++;
    shake = 14;
    if (who === "player") {
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        confetti.push({
          x: W / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120,
          y: H * 0.1,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
          vy: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
          color: ["#ffd23f", "#ff5e7e", "#4ecdc4", "#a06cd5", "#ff9f43"][i % 5],
          life: 60 + Math.random() * 40,
          size: 4 + Math.random() * 5
        });
      }
    }
    if (playerScore >= WIN || aiScore >= WIN) {
      state = "end";
    } else {
      resetPuck();
    }
  }

  function clampPuckSpeed() {
    const sp = Math.hypot(puck.vx, puck.vy);
    if (sp > PUCK_MAX) {
      const k = PUCK_MAX / sp;
      puck.vx *= k;
      puck.vy *= k;
    }
  }

  function resolveCollision(pad) {
    const dx = puck.x - pad.x;
    const dy = puck.y - pad.y;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const minDist = PUCK_R + PADDLE_R;
    if (dist < minDist && dist > 0.0001) {
      const nx = dx / dist;
      const ny = dy / dist;
      const overlap = minDist - dist;
      puck.x += nx * overlap;
      puck.y += ny * overlap;
      const pvx = pad.x - pad.px;
      const pvy = pad.y - pad.py;
      const relX = puck.vx - pvx;
      const relY = puck.vy - pvy;
      const dot = relX * nx + relY * ny;
      if (dot < 0) {
        puck.vx -= 2 * dot * nx;
        puck.vy -= 2 * dot * ny;
        puck.vx += pvx * 0.6;
        puck.vy += pvy * 0.6;
        clampPuckSpeed();
      }
    }
  }

  function updatePlayer() {
    const tx = player.x;
    const ty = player.y;
    player.px = player.x;
    player.py = player.y;
    player.x = tx;
    player.y = ty;
    player.x = Math.max(TABLE_L + PADDLE_R, Math.min(TABLE_R - PADDLE_R, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(MID + PADDLE_R, Math.min(TABLE_B - PADDLE_R, player.y));
    player.vx = player.x - player.px;
    player.vy = player.y - player.py;
  }

  function updateAI() {
    ai.px = ai.x;
    ai.py = ai.y;
    const puckAbove = puck.y < MID;
    let targetX = W / 2;
    let targetY = H * 0.22;
    if (puckAbove && puck.vy < 0) {
      targetX = puck.x;
      targetY = Math.min(puck.y - 20, H * 0.4);
    } else {
      targetX = W / 2 + (puck.x - W / 2) * 0.3;
      targetY = H * 0.22;
    }
    const dx = targetX - ai.x;
    const dy = targetY - ai.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (d > 1) {
      let sp = AI_MAX_SPEED;
      const nearPuck = Math.hypot(puck.x - ai.x, puck.y - ai.y) < 140;
      if (nearPuck) sp = AI_HIT_SPEED;
      const step = Math.min(d, sp);
      ai.x += (dx / d) * step;
      ai.y += (dy / d) * step;
    }
    ai.x = Math.max(TABLE_L + PADDLE_R, Math.min(TABLE_R - PADDLE_R, ai.x));
    ai.y = Math.max(TABLE_T + PADDLE_R, Math.min(MID - PADDLE_R, ai.y));
    ai.vx = ai.x - ai.px;
    ai.vy = ai.y - ai.py;
  }

  function updatePuck() {
    const prevX = puck.x;
    const prevY = puck.y;
    puck.x += puck.vx;
    puck.y += puck.vy;
    puck.spin += puck.vx * 0.1;

    if (puck.x < TABLE_L + PUCK_R) { puck.x = TABLE_L + PUCK_R; puck.vx = Math.abs(puck.vx); }
    if (puck.x > TABLE_R - PUCK_R) { puck.x = TABLE_R - PUCK_R; puck.vx = -Math.abs(puck.vx); }

    if (puck.y < TABLE_T + PUCK_R) {
      if (prevY >= TABLE_T + PUCK_R && puck.y < TABLE_T + PUCK_R) {
        goalBy("player");
        return;
      }
      puck.y = TABLE_T + PUCK_R;
      puck.vy = Math.abs(puck.vy);
    }
    if (puck.y > TABLE_B - PUCK_R) {
      if (prevY <= TABLE_B - PUCK_R && puck.y > TABLE_B - PUCK_R) {
        goalBy("ai");
        return;
      }
      puck.y = TABLE_B - PUCK_R;
      puck.vy = -Math.abs(puck.vy);
    }

    resolveCollision(player);
    resolveCollision(ai);
  }

  function updateConfetti() {
    for (let i = confetti.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const c = confetti[i];
      c.x += c.vx;
      c.y += c.vy;
      c.vy += 0.15;
      c.life--;
      if (c.life <= 0 || c.y > H + 20) confetti.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function update() {
    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
    if (shake < 0.3) shake = 0;
    if (state === "play") {
      updatePlayer();
      updateAI();
      updatePuck();
    }
    updateConfetti();
  }

  function drawTable() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#16213e";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0f3460");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a5276");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#0f3460");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(TABLE_L, TABLE_T, TABLE_R - TABLE_L, TABLE_B - TABLE_T);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(TABLE_L + 4, TABLE_T + 4, TABLE_R - TABLE_L - 8, TABLE_B - TABLE_T - 8);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(TABLE_L, MID);
    ctx.lineTo(TABLE_R, MID);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, MID, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, MID, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff5e7e";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, TABLE_T, 70, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#4ecdc4";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, TABLE_B, 70, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawPaddle(p, color1, color2) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x - 8, p.y - 8, 4, p.x, p.y, PADDLE_R);
    grad.addColorStop(0, color2);
    grad.addColorStop(1, color1);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PADDLE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PADDLE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPuck() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(puck.x - 5, puck.y - 5, 2, puck.x, puck.y, PUCK_R);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    grad.addColorStop(0.6, "#e8e8e8");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#b0b0b0");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(puck.x, puck.y, PUCK_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff5e7e";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(puck.x, puck.y, PUCK_R - 5, puck.spin, puck.spin + Math.PI * 1.3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawScore() {
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5e7e";
    ctx.fillText(aiScore, W / 2, TABLE_T + 48);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4ecdc4";
    ctx.fillText(playerScore, W / 2, TABLE_B - 24);
    ctx.font = "16px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
    ctx.fillText("CPU", W / 2, TABLE_T + 20);
    ctx.fillText("YOU", W / 2, TABLE_B - 4);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,10,25,0.82)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

    if (state === "start") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
      ctx.font = "bold 44px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("GOAL!", W / 2, H * 0.32);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4ecdc4";
      ctx.font = "24px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Air Hockey", W / 2, H * 0.32 + 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "18px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Move your paddle with your", W / 2, H * 0.5);
      ctx.fillText("mouse or finger. Score " + WIN + " goals to win!", W / 2, H * 0.5 + 26);
      drawButton(W / 2, H * 0.68, "PLAY");
    } else if (state === "end") {
      const win = playerScore > aiScore;
      ctx.fillStyle = win ? "#4ecdc4" : "#ff5e7e";
      ctx.font = "bold 46px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(win ? "YOU WIN!" : "CPU WINS!", W / 2, H * 0.34);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "22px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(playerScore + "  -  " + aiScore, W / 2, H * 0.34 + 44);
      drawButton(W / 2, H * 0.6, "PLAY AGAIN");
    }
  }

  function drawButton(cx, cy, label) {
    const bw = 180;
    const bh = 56;
    const x = cx - bw / 2;
    const y = cy - bh / 2;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + bh);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#ffd23f");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#ff9f43");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    roundRect(x, y, bw, bh, 14);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    roundRect(x, y, bw, bh, 14);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#16213e";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(label, cx, cy + 9);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }
    drawTable();
    drawPaddle(ai, "#c0392b", "#ff7b6b");
    drawPaddle(player, "#16a085", "#4ecdc4");
    drawPuck();
    drawScore();
    for (const c of confetti) {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
      ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.size, c.size);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    if (state === "start" || state === "end") {
      drawOverlay();
    }
  }

  function getPos(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    const cy = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
    return {
      x: (cx - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
      y: (cy - rect.top) * (H / rect.height)
    };
  }

  function inButton(cx, cy) {
    const bw = 180, bh = 56;
    const bx = W / 2 - bw / 2;
    const by = (state === "start" ? H * 0.68 : H * 0.6) - bh / 2;
    return cx >= bx && cx <= bx + bw && cy >= by && cy <= by + bh;
  }

  function handleMove(e) {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const p = getPos(e);
    player.x = p.x;
    player.y = p.y;
    e.preventDefault();
  }

  function handleTap(e) {
    const p = getPos(e);
    if (state === "start" || state === "end") {
      if (inButton(p.x, p.y)) {
        startGame();
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMove);
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", handleMove, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", handleTap);
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", handleTap, { passive: false });

  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
