<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Skate Trick Line</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
    font-family: 'Arial Black', 'Impact', sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let W = 0;
  let H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  const GRAVITY = 2000;
  const JUMP_VY = -850;
  const SKATE_SPEED = 320;

  const state = {
    running: false,
    paused: false,
    score: 0,
    combo: 0,
    lives: 3,
    time: 0,
    trickTimer: 0,
    flash: 0,
    shake: 0,
    trickText: '',
    trickTextTimer: 0,
    particles: [],
    stars: []
  };

  const player = {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    vy: 0,
    onGround: true,
    rotation: 0,
    targetRotation: 0,
    trickCount: 0,
    landed: false
  };

  const obstacles = [];
  const obstaclesPool = [];
  const OBSTACLE_TYPES = ['ramp', 'rail', 'box', 'ledge'];
  const OBSTACLE_COLORS = ['#e74c3c', '#f39c12', '#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#9b59b6'];

  const keys = {};
  let jumpPressed = false;

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') {
      e.preventDefault();
      jumpPressed = true;
    }
    if (e.code === 'Enter' && !state.running) {
      startGame();
    }
    if (e.code === 'KeyP' && state.running) {
      state.paused = !state.paused;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = false;
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') {
      jumpPressed = false;
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!state.running) {
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    jumpPressed = true;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    jumpPressed = false;
  });

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b) {
    return a + Math.random() * (b - a);
  }

  function randInt(a, b) {
    return Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1));
  }

  function lerp(a, b, t) {
    return a + (b - a) * t;
  }

  function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
    return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
  }

  function dist(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    const dx = x2 - x1;
    const dy = y2 - y1;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  }

  // ---------- PARTICLES ----------
  function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color, spread, speed) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const spd = rand(speed * 0.5, speed);
      state.particles.push({
        x: x + rand(-spread, spread),
        y: y + rand(-spread, spread),
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - rand(50, 200),
        life: rand(0.3, 0.8),
        maxLife: rand(0.3, 0.8),
        size: rand(2, 6),
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = state.particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += GRAVITY * 0.3 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        state.particles.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of state.particles) {
      const alpha = clamp(p.life / p.maxLife, 0, 1);
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---------- STARS ----------
  function initStars() {
    state.stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      state.stars.push({
        x: rand(0, W),
        y: rand(0, H * 0.5),
        size: rand(1, 3),
        twinkle: rand(0, Math.PI * 2)
      });
    }
  }

  function drawStars() {
    for (const s of state.stars) {
      const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time * 2 + s.twinkle));
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---------- OBSTACLES ----------
  function createObstacle(x, type) {
    const width = rand(60, 120);
    const height = rand(40, 100);
    const color = OBSTACLE_COLORS[randInt(0, OBSTACLE_COLORS.length - 1)];
    return {
      x: x,
      y: 0,
      width: width,
      height: height,
      type: type,
      color: color,
      passed: false,
      scoreAwarded: false
    };
  }

  function groundY() {
    return H * 0.75;
  }

  function spawnObstacle() {
    const type = OBSTACLE_TYPES[randInt(0, OBSTACLE_TYPES.length - 1)];
    const x = W + rand(0, 200);
    const obs = createObstacle(x, type);
    obs.y = groundY() - obs.height;
    obstacles.push(obs);
  }

  function updateObstacles(dt) {
    const scrollSpeed = SKATE_SPEED * (1 + state.combo * 0.05);
    for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const o = obstacles[i];
      o.x -= scrollSpeed * dt;
      if (o.x + o.width < -50) {
        obstacles.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    if (obstacles.length < 6 && Math.random() < 0.03) {
      spawnObstacle();
    }
  }

  function drawObstacle(o) {
    const gy = groundY();
    ctx.save();

    if (o.type === 'ramp') {
      ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, gy - o.height);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, gy - o.height * 0.5);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(o.x, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, gy - o.height);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (o.type === 'rail') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, gy - o.height, 8, o.height);
      ctx.fillRect(o.x + o.width - 8, gy - o.height, 8, o.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
      ctx.fillRect(o.x - 5, gy - o.height, o.width + 10, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x - 5, gy - o.height, o.width + 10, 3);
    } else if (o.type === 'box') {
      ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, gy - o.height, o.width, o.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, gy - o.height, o.width, o.height * 0.3);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeRect(o.x, gy - o.height, o.width, o.height);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, gy - o.height, o.width, o.height);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, gy - o.height * 0.6, o.width, o.height * 0.4);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x + 5, gy - o.height + 5, o.width - 10, 4);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- PLAYER ----------
  function resetPlayer() {
    player.x = W * 0.2;
    player.y = groundY() - 30;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = true;
    player.rotation = 0;
    player.targetRotation = 0;
    player.trickCount = 0;
    player.landed = false;
  }

  function updatePlayer(dt) {
    const gy = groundY();
    const scrollSpeed = SKATE_SPEED * (1 + state.combo * 0.05);

    if (jumpPressed && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = JUMP_VY;
      player.onGround = false;
      player.trickCount = 0;
      spawnParticles(player.x, player.y + 20, 8, '#ffffff', 10, 100);
    }

    if (!player.onGround) {
      player.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      player.y += player.vy * dt;

      if (keys['KeyA'] || keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyD'] || keys['ArrowRight']) {
        player.trickCount++;
        player.targetRotation = player.trickCount * Math.PI * 2;
      }

      const feetY = player.y + 25;
      if (feetY >= gy) {
        player.y = gy - 25;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.onGround = true;

        const fullSpins = Math.floor(player.trickCount / 4);
        const partial = player.trickCount % 4;

        if (fullSpins > 0) {
          const points = fullSpins * 100 * (1 + state.combo * 0.5);
          state.score += Math.floor(points);
          state.combo++;
          state.trickText = fullSpins + 'x360!';
          state.trickTextTimer = 1.5;
          state.flash = 0.3;
          spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, 20, '#f1c40f', 20, 200);
        } else if (partial >= 2) {
          const points = partial * 30 * (1 + state.combo * 0.3);
          state.score += Math.floor(points);
          state.combo++;
          state.trickText = partial * 90 + '°';
          state.trickTextTimer = 1;
          spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, 10, '#3498db', 15, 150);
        } else {
          state.combo = 0;
        }

        player.rotation = 0;
        player.targetRotation = 0;
        player.trickCount = 0;
      }
    } else {
      player.y = gy - 25;
      if (player.rotation !== 0) {
        player.rotation = lerp(player.rotation, 0, dt * 10);
      }
    }

    player.rotation = lerp(player.rotation, player.targetRotation, dt * 8);

    for (const o of obstacles) {
      const px = player.x;
      const py = player.y;
      const feetY = py + 25;

      if (feetY >= o.y && py <= o.y + o.height &&
          px >= o.x - 15 && px <= o.x + o.width + 15) {
        if (!player.onGround) {
          state.combo = 0;
          state.trickText = 'BONK!';
          state.trickTextTimer = 1;
          state.shake = 0.2;
          state.lives--;
          player.vy = -300;
          player.onGround = false;
          spawnParticles(px, py, 15, '#e74c3c', 15, 150);
          if (state.lives <= 0) {
            gameOver();
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const px = player.x;
    const py = player.y;
    const rot = player.rotation;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(rot);

    // Board
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3e50';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 22, 25, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 22, 20, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Wheels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ecf0f1';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-15, 28, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(15, 28, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7f8c8d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-15, 28, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(15, 28, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2980b9';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 5, 10, 15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5cba7';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -15, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -18, 8, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(-8, -19, 16, 3);

    // Arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2980b9';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const armSwing = Math.sin(state.time * 8) * 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-8, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-15, 10 + armSwing * 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(15, 10 - armSwing * 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Hands
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5cba7';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-15, 10 + armSwing * 10, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(15, 10 - armSwing * 10, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#34495e';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-5, 15);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, 22);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(5, 15);
    ctx.lineTo(10, 22);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- BACKGROUND ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#1a1a4e');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#2d1b4e');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#4a2040');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1020');
    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawStars();

    // Moon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5e6c8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.85, H * 0.12, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d5b0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.85 + 8, H * 0.12 - 5, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.85 - 12, H * 0.12 + 10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // City skyline
    const gy = groundY();
    const buildingColors = ['#1a1a3a', '#252550', '#1e1e45', '#2a2a55'];
    const buildings = [];
    const numBuildings = Math.ceil(W / 80) + 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < numBuildings; i++) {
      const bw = rand(50, 100);
      const bh = rand(H * 0.15, H * 0.4);
      const bx = i * 80 - 40;
      buildings.push({ x: bx, w: bw, h: bh, color: buildingColors[randInt(0, buildingColors.length - 1)] });
    }
    for (const b of buildings) {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, gy - b.h, b.w, b.h);
      // Windows
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.6)';
      const cols = Math.floor(b.w / 15);
      const rows = Math.floor(b.h / 20);
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
          if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + 5 + c * 15, gy - b.h + 8 + r * 20, 6, 8);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Ground
    const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy, 0, H);
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2c2c3e');
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#1e1e2e');
    groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a15');
    ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, gy, W, H - gy);

    // Ground line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(W, gy);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Ground texture - dashes
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 40) {
      const offset = (state.time * SKATE_SPEED * 0.5) % 40;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(i - offset, gy + 10);
      ctx.lineTo(i - offset + 20, gy + 10);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // ---------- HUD ----------
  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 20, 20);

    // Combo
    if (state.combo > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + state.combo, 20, 55);
    }

    // Lives
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    let hearts = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) hearts += '♥ ';
    ctx.fillText(hearts.trim(), W - 20, 20);

    // Trick text
    if (state.trickTextTimer > 0) {
      const alpha = clamp(state.trickTextTimer, 0, 1);
      const scale = 1 + (1 - alpha) * 0.3;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = state.trickText === 'BONK!' ? '#e74c3c' : '#f1c40f';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(36 * scale) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(state.trickText, W / 2, H * 0.3);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Flash effect
    if (state.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (state.flash * 0.3) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
  }

  // ---------- START SCREEN ----------
  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(60, W * 0.06) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('SKATE TRICK LINE', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(24, W * 0.03) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or TAP to Start', W / 2, H * 0.45);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(18, W * 0.025) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SPACE / W / UP  -  Jump', W / 2, H * 0.55);
    ctx.fillText('A / D / LEFT / RIGHT  -  Spin in mid-air', W / 2, H * 0.62);
    ctx.fillText('P  -  Pause', W / 2, H * 0.69);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(16, W * 0.022) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Hit ramps, rails & boxes. Land clean for points. 3 bonks = game over.', W / 2, H * 0.8);
  }

  // ---------- GAME OVER SCREEN ----------
  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(50, W * 0.055) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(30, W * 0.04) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H * 0.45);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(22, W * 0.03) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best Combo: x' + state.maxCombo, W / 2, H * 0.55);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(20, W * 0.028) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or TAP to Play Again', W / 2, H * 0.7);
  }

  // ---------- PAUSE ----------
  function drawPause() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(40, W * 0.05) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('PAUSED', W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(20, W * 0.028) + 'px Arial Black, Impact, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press P to Resume', W / 2, H * 0.55);
  }

  // ---------- GAME FLOW ----------
  function startGame() {
    state.running = true;
    state.paused = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.maxCombo = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.time = 0;
    state.trickTimer = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.trickText = '';
    state.trickTextTimer = 0;
    state.particles = [];
    obstacles.length = 0;
    resetPlayer();
    initStars();
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      spawnObstacle();
    }
  }

  function gameOver() {
    state.running = false;
    state.maxCombo = Math.max(state.maxCombo, state.combo);
  }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (!state.running || state.paused) return;

    state.time += dt;
    state.trickTextTimer = Math.max(0, state.trickTextTimer - dt);
    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2);
    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3);

    updatePlayer(dt);
    updateObstacles(dt);
    updateParticles(dt);

    state.maxCombo = Math.max(state.maxCombo, state.combo);
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const sx = rand(-state.shake * 10, state.shake * 10);
      const sy = rand(-state.shake * 10, state.shake * 10);
      ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    drawBackground();

    for (const o of obstacles) {
      drawObstacle(o);
    }

    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if (!state.running && state.lives > 0) {
      drawStartScreen();
    }
    if (!state.running && state.lives <= 0) {
      drawGameOver();
    }
    if (state.paused && state.running) {
      drawPause();
    }
  }

  // ---------- MAIN LOOP ----------
  let lastTime = 0;

  function gameLoop(timestamp) {
    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // ---------- INIT ----------
  initStars();
  requestAnimationFrame((ts) => {
    lastTime = ts;
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  });

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ===== CONSTANTS =====
  const W = 960, H = 560;
  const GROUND_Y = 470;
  const GRAVITY = 1300;
  const TUBE_TOP = 355;
  const TUBE_BOTTOM = 452;
  const TUBE_R = 20;
  const RING_R = 34;
  const START_X = 150, START_Y = 300;
  const MAX_POWER = 1000;
  const WIN_SCORE = 3;
  const TOTAL_TURNS = 5;

  // ===== STATE =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let state = 'start'; // start | aiming | flying | settled | win | lose
  let score = 0;
  let turn = 0;
  let angle = -0.5;
  let power = 0;
  let charging = false;
  let lastTime = 0;

  const rings = [];
  const targets = [];
  const flags = [];
  const confetti = [];
  let message = '';
  let messageTimer = 0;

  // ===== SETUP: targets, flags, decorations =====
  function makeTarget(x, color, label) {
    return { x: x, color: color, label: label, base: 0 };
  }
  const targetXs = [560, 690, 820];
  const targetColors = ['#ff5252', '#ffd23f', '#3ec5ff'];
  const targetLabels = ['★ 1', '★ 2', '★ 3'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    targets.push(makeTarget(targetXs[i], targetColors[i], targetLabels[i]));
  }

  const flagColors = ['#ff5252', '#ffd23f', '#3ec5ff', '#7cff5c', '#ff7ad9'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    flags.push({
      x: 30 + i * 66,
      color: flagColors[i % flagColors.length],
      phase: i * 0.7
    });
  }

  const stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * 200, r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.4, tw: Math.random() * 6 });
  }

  // ===== INPUT =====
  function getPos(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX);
    const cy = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY);
    return { x: (cx - r.left) * (W / r.width), y: (cy - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
  }

  function startAim() {
    if (state === 'start') {
      state = 'aiming';
      turn = 0;
      score = 0;
      rings.length = 0;
      confetti.length = 0;
      message = '';
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') {
      state = 'start';
      rings.length = 0;
      confetti.length = 0;
      message = '';
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'aiming') {
      charging = true;
      power = 0;
    }
  }

  function moveAim(e) {
    if (state !== 'aiming') return;
    const p = getPos(e);
    const dx = p.x - START_X, dy = p.y - START_Y;
    let a = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    if (a > 0) a = 0; // keep pointing up-ish
    if (a < -1.45) a = -1.45;
    angle = a;
  }

  function release() {
    if (state === 'aiming' && charging) {
      const sp = 300 + (power / 100) * MAX_POWER;
      rings.push({
        x: START_X, y: START_Y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * sp,
        rot: 0,
        vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        scored: false,
        done: false,
        color: '#ff5252'
      });
      charging = false;
      power = 0;
      state = 'flying';
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', startAim);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', moveAim);
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', release);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); startAim(); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); moveAim(e); }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); release(); }, { passive: false });

  function checkScore(ring) {
    for (let i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
      const t = targets[i];
      const dx = Math.abs(ring.x - t.x);
      const dy = ring.y - TUBE_TOP;
      if (dx < TUBE_R && dy > 0 && dy < (TUBE_BOTTOM - TUBE_TOP)) {

          ring.scored = true;

      }
    }

  }

  function showMsg(txt, color) {
    message = txt;
    messageTimer = 1.4;
    messageColor = color || '#fff';
  }
  let messageColor = '#fff';

  function spawnConfetti(x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = Math.random() * 220 + 60;
      confetti.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 120,
        life: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.6,
        color: flagColors[(Math.random() * flagColors.length) | 0],
        size: Math.random() * 5 + 3,
        rot: Math.random() * 6
      });
    }
  }

  function endTurn() {
    turn += 1;
    if (score >= WIN_SCORE) {
      state = 'win';
      spawnConfetti(W / 2, 200);
      spawnConfetti(W / 2 - 150, 240);
      spawnConfetti(W / 2 + 150, 240);
    } else if (turn >= TOTAL_TURNS) {
      state = 'lose';
    } else {

    if (charging && state === 'aiming') {

    // rings
    for (let i = 0; i < rings.length; i++) {
      const r = rings[i];
      if (r.done) continue;
      r.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      r.x += r.vx * dt;
      r.y += r.vy * dt;
      r.rot += r.vr * dt;

      if (checkScore(r)) {

    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);

    ctx.lineWidth = 2;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();

  }

  function drawTent() {
    // big striped circus tent behind
    const cx = W / 2, top = 60, baseY = GROUND_Y, half = 300;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, top);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + half, baseY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - half, baseY);

      ctx.moveTo(cx, top);
      ctx.lineTo(x0, baseY);
      ctx.lineTo(x1, baseY);

    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

  function drawFlags() {

    const y = 40;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#caa06a';

    ctx.moveTo(0, y);

  function drawRing(r) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.rotate(r.rot);
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 9;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, RING_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, RING_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawAimer() {
    if (state !== 'aiming') return;
    // launcher base
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(START_X, START_Y + 10, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    const len = 60 + (power / 100) * 120;
    const ex = START_X + Math.cos(angle) * len;
    const ey = START_Y + Math.sin(angle) * len;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.setLineDash([8, 8]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(START_X, START_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // arrowhead
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ex, ey);
    ctx.rotate(angle);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, -7);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, 7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    drawRing({ x: START_X, y: START_Y, rot: 0, color: '#ff5252' });
    // power bar

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';

    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, pw, bh);

  function drawConfetti() {
    for (let i = 0; i < confetti.length; i++) {
      const c = confetti[i];

      ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '13px Trebuchet MS';

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {

    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);

    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);

    ctx.fillStyle = messageColor;

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Orbital Docking</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  #game { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- constants ----------
  const GAME_TIME = 60;
  const THETA = 0.05;
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const THRUST = 55;
  const FUEL_MAX = 100;
  const FUEL_RATE = 9;
  const RICHARDSON = 26;
  const CAPTURE_R = 30;
  const DOCK_R = 20;
  const SAFE_DIST = 240;
  const SPEED_TOL = 2.2;
  const ANGLE_TOL = 0.55;

  // ---------- state ----------
  const state = {
    phase: "start",
    time: GAME_TIME,
    score: 0,
    docks: 0,
    ship: { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, angle: 0, fuel: FUEL_MAX },
    station: { x: 0, y: 0, angle: 0, ports: [] },
    docked: false,
    dockTimer: 0,
    dockedId: -1,
    shake: 0,
    message: "",
    messageTimer: 0,
    flash: 0
  };

  // ---------- background stars ----------
  const stars = [];
  (function makeStars() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random(),
        r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.4,
        tw: Math.random() * TAU,
        sp: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5
      });
    }
  })();

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }
  function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
  function angleDiff(a, b) {
    let d = (a - b) % TAU;
    if (d > Math.PI) d -= TAU;
    if (d < -Math.PI) d += TAU;
    return d;
  }

  function reset() {
    const cx = W * 0.5, cy = H * 0.5;
    state.station.x = cx;
    state.station.y = cy;
    state.station.angle = 0;
    state.station.ports = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      state.station.ports.push({
        angle: i * (TAU / 4) + TAU / 8,
        docked: false,
        id: i
      });
    }
    state.ship.x = cx - 230;
    state.ship.y = cy + 120;
    state.ship.vx = 0;
    state.ship.vy = 0;
    state.ship.angle = 0;
    state.ship.fuel = FUEL_MAX;
    state.time = GAME_TIME;
    state.score = 0;
    state.docks = 0;
    state.docked = false;
    state.dockTimer = 0;
    state.dockedId = -1;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
    state.message = "";
    state.messageTimer = 0;
  }

  function startGame() {
    reset();
    state.phase = "play";
    state.message = "DOCK WITH THE STATION";
    state.messageTimer = 3;
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state.phase === "start" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) startGame();
    else if (state.phase === "over" && (k === "r" || k === " ")) startGame();
    if ([" ", "arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright"].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state.phase !== "play") return;

    // timer
    state.time -= dt;
    if (state.time <= 0) {
      state.time = 0;
      state.phase = "over";
      return;
    }
    if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer -= dt;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 6);
    if (state.flash > 0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2);

    const ship = state.ship;
    const st = state.station;

    // rotation
    if (keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"]) ship.angle -= THETA * dt;
    if (keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"]) ship.angle += THETA * dt;

    // thrust
    let thrusting = false;
    if (keys["w"] || keys["arrowup"]) {
      if (ship.fuel > 0 && !state.docked) {

        thrusting = true;
      }
    }
    // retro
    if (keys["s"] || keys["arrowdown"]) {
      if (ship.fuel > 0 && !state.docked) {
        ship.vx -= Math.cos(ship.angle) * THRUST * 0.7 * dt;
        ship.vy -= Math.sin(ship.angle) * THRUST * 0.7 * dt;
        ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - FUEL_RATE * 0.7 * dt);

      }

    if (!state.docked) {
      ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
      ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
    }

    ship.x = clamp(ship.x, 20, W - 20);
    ship.y = clamp(ship.y, 20, H - 20);

    st.angle += 0.05 * dt;

    if (state.docked) {

      const port = st.ports[state.dockedId];

      const py = st.y + Math.sin(port.angle + st.angle) * RICHARDSON;

    for (let i = 0; i < st.ports.length; i++) {

      if (port.docked) continue;

      const px = st.x + Math.cos(pa) * RICHARDSON;

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {

    ctx.stroke();

  function drawStart() {

    drawStation();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,6,14,0.55)";

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (state.phase === "start") { drawStart(); return; }
    if (state.phase === "over") { drawOver(); return; }

    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const m = state.shake * 6;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawStation();
    drawShip();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  reset();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bike Hill Climb</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #1e2a52; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ===== Canvas =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + "px"; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ===== Constants =====
  const GRAV = 2400;
  const ACCEL = 2600;
  const MAX_SPEED = 1500;
  const FRICTION = 0.995;
  const WHEEL_R = 26;
  const WHEELBASE = 96;
  const BODY_LEN = 150;
  const STEP = 1 / 60;
  const GROUND_Y = 0; // world ground baseline
  const WIN_DIST = 2200;

  // ===== Hill height function (procedural, no tile map) =====
  function hillY(x) {
    return 260 * Math.sin(x * 0.0016)
         + 150 * Math.sin(x * 0.0042 + 1.3)
         + 70 * Math.sin(x * 0.009 + 0.5);
  }
  function hillSlope(x) {
    const e = 1.5;
    return (hillY(x + e) - hillY(x - e)) / (2 * e);
  }

  // ===== State =====
  let state = "start"; // start, play, win, crash
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let t = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let particles = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let stars = [];
  let winFlash = 0;

  const bike = {
    x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    angle: 0, spin: 0,
    throttle: 0, brake: 0,
    airborne: false,
    flips: 0
  };

  // build decorative clouds & stars once
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    clouds.push({ x: Math.random() * 2400, y: 40 + Math.random() * 140, s: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.9, spd: 8 + Math.random() * 14 });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * 2400, y: 20 + Math.random() * 120, tw: Math.random() * 6 });
  }

  function reset() {
    bike.x = 0; bike.y = hillY(0); bike.vx = 0; bike.vy = 0;
    bike.angle = Math.atan(hillSlope(0)); bike.spin = 0;
    bike.throttle = 0; bike.brake = 0; bike.airborne = false; bike.flips = 0;
    score = 0; t = 0; particles = []; shake = 0; winFlash = 0;
  }

  // ===== Input =====
  const input = { gas: false, brake: false };
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w") { input.gas = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") { input.brake = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    if (k === " " || k === "enter") {
      if (state === "start") { state = "play"; }
      else if (state === "win" || state === "crash") { reset(); state = "play"; }
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w") input.gas = false;
    if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") input.brake = false;
  });

  // touch: left half = gas, right half = brake
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    if (state === "start") { state = "play"; return; }
    if (state === "win" || state === "crash") { reset(); state = "play"; return; }
    for (const tc of e.changedTouches) {
      if (tc.clientX < W / 2) input.gas = true; else input.brake = true;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchend", function (e) {
    for (const tc of e.changedTouches) {
      if (tc.clientX < W / 2) input.gas = false; else input.brake = false;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  // ===== Update =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== "play") {
      // keep clouds drifting for liveliness
      for (const c of clouds) { c.x += c.spd * dt; if (c.x > 2400) c.x -= 2400; }
      return;
    }

    t += dt;
    const slope = hillSlope(bike.x);
    const slopeAngle = Math.atan(slope);

    // ground contact?
    const groundY = hillY(bike.x);
    bike.airborne = bike.y < groundY - 2;

    if (!bike.airborne) {
      // drive along slope
      const dir = Math.sign(bike.vx) || 1;
      if (input.gas) bike.vx += ACCEL * Math.cos(slopeAngle) * dt * (Math.cos(slopeAngle) < 0 ? -1 : 1);
      if (input.brake) bike.vx -= Math.sign(bike.vx) * ACCEL * 0.9 * dt;
      // gravity along slope
      bike.vx += GRAV * Math.sin(slopeAngle) * Math.cos(slopeAngle) * dt;
      // friction
      bike.vx *= Math.pow(FRICTION, dt * 60);
      // clamp
      if (bike.vx > MAX_SPEED) bike.vx = MAX_SPEED;
      if (bike.vx < -MAX_SPEED) bike.vx = -MAX_SPEED;

      bike.x += bike.vx * dt;
      bike.y = hillY(bike.x);
      bike.vy = 0;
      bike.angle = slopeAngle;
    } else {
      // projectile
      bike.vy += GRAV * dt;
      bike.x += bike.vx * dt;
      bike.y += bike.vy * dt;
      bike.angle += (input.gas ? 2.2 : -2.2) * dt; // tilt in air
      // track flips
      const prev = bike.angle;
      if (Math.floor(prev / (Math.PI * 2)) !== Math.floor(bike.angle / (Math.PI * 2))) bike.flips++;
    }

    // wheel spin
    bike.spin += (bike.vx / WHEEL_R) * dt;

    // score = distance
    score = Math.max(score, Math.floor(bike.x / 10));

    // dust particles when moving on ground
    if (!bike.airborne && Math.abs(bike.vx) > 120 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
      particles.push({
        x: bike.x - 30, y: bike.y + WHEEL_R,
        vx: -bike.vx * 0.05 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
        vy: -40 - Math.random() * 40,
        life: 0.6, max: 0.6, r: 4 + Math.random() * 5
      });
    }

    // update particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 300 * dt; p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // crash: head hits ground (front of bike below ground too much)
    const frontX = bike.x + Math.cos(bike.angle) * (BODY_LEN / 2);
    const frontY = bike.y + Math.sin(bike.angle) * (BODY_LEN / 2);
    if (frontY < hillY(frontX) - 40 && !bike.airborne) {
      // flip over the front
      if (bike.angle > 1.2) { state = "crash"; shake = 18; }
    }
    if (state === "crash") shake = Math.max(shake - dt * 30, 0);

    // win
    if (bike.x >= WIN_DIST) {
      state = "win"; winFlash = 1;
      if (score > best) best = score;
    }

    // clouds
    for (const c of clouds) { c.x += c.spd * dt; if (c.x > 2400) c.x -= 2400; }
    if (winFlash > 0) winFlash = Math.max(winFlash - dt * 0.8, 0);
  }

  // ===== Draw helpers =====
  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#2b4a9e");
    g.addColorStop(0.45, "#5b86d6");
    g.addColorStop(0.8, "#a9d3f5");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#ffe6b0");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawSun() {
    const sx = W * 0.8, sy = H * 0.22;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff2a8";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawClouds() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    for (const c of clouds) {
      const sx = ((c.x - bike.x * 0.3) % 2400 + 2400) % 2400;
      const screenX = (sx / 2400) * W;
      const y = c.y;
      const s = c.s * 30;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(screenX, y, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(screenX + s, y + 6, s * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(screenX - s, y + 6, s * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawMountains() {
    ctx.save();
    // far mountains
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6f8fd0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.72);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
      const h = H * 0.72 - (60 + 50 * Math.sin(x * 0.008 + bike.x * 0.0002));
      ctx.lineTo(x, h);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // near hills
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb0e0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.8);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
      const h = H * 0.8 - (30 + 30 * Math.sin(x * 0.012 + bike.x * 0.0004 + 2));
      ctx.lineTo(x, h);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHill() {
    // sample terrain across screen
    const camX = bike.x - W * 0.4;
    ctx.save();
    // grass body
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.5, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#7ec850");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#3f8f3a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (let sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 8) {
      const wx = camX + sx;
      const wy = hillY(wx);
      const screenY = H * 0.55 + (wy - hillY(camX)) * 1.0;
      ctx.lineTo(sx, screenY);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // dirt under grass
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a5230";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (let sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 8) {
      const wx = camX + sx;
      const wy = hillY(wx);
      const screenY = H * 0.55 + (wy - hillY(camX)) * 1.0 + 22;
      ctx.lineTo(sx, screenY);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // grass edge line
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f6f2c";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 8) {
      const wx = camX + sx;
      const wy = hillY(wx);
      const screenY = H * 0.55 + (wy - hillY(camX)) * 1.0;
      if (sx === 0) ctx.moveTo(sx, screenY); else ctx.lineTo(sx, screenY);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // flowers
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const wx = camX + ((i * 137) % W);
      const wy = hillY(wx);
      const screenY = H * 0.55 + (wy - hillY(camX)) * 1.0 + 6;
      const sx = ((wx - camX) % W + W) % W;
      ctx.fillStyle = (i % 3 === 0) ? "#ff6fae" : (i % 3 === 1) ? "#ffd23f" : "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, screenY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawFlag() {
    const camX = bike.x - W * 0.4;
    const fx = WIN_DIST - camX;
    if (fx < -50 || fx > W + 50) return;
    const fy = H * 0.55 + (hillY(WIN_DIST) - hillY(bike.x)) * 1.0;
    ctx.save();
    // pole
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(fx, fy); ctx.lineTo(fx, fy - 90); ctx.stroke();
    // flag
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4d4d";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fx, fy - 90);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 44, fy - 78);
    ctx.lineTo(fx, fy - 66);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBike() {
    const camX = bike.x - W * 0.4;
    let sx = bike.x - camX;
    let sy = H * 0.55 + (bike.y - hillY(bike.x)) * 1.0;
    if (shake > 0) { sx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake; sy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake; }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    ctx.rotate(bike.angle);

    // shadow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = bike.airborne ? 0.15 : 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, WHEEL_R + 4, 70, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    const back = -WHEELBASE / 2;
    const front = WHEELBASE / 2;

    // wheels
    function wheel(cx, cy) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, WHEEL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f4f4f4";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, WHEEL_R - 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // spokes
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#888"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = bike.spin + (i * Math.PI) / 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
        ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (WHEEL_R - 8), cy + Math.sin(a) * (WHEEL_R - 8));
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c1a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    wheel(back, 0);
    wheel(front, 0);

    // frame
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff5a3c";
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(back, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -34);
    ctx.lineTo(front, -10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -34);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, 0);
    ctx.stroke();

    // seat
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-26, -44, 30, 9, 4); ctx.fill();
    // handlebar
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#333"; ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(front, -10); ctx.lineTo(front + 8, -30); ctx.stroke();

    // rider
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(2, -34);
    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b6cb0"; ctx.lineWidth = 9; ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(-6, 26); ctx.lineTo(-14, 30); ctx.stroke();
    // torso
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#e63946"; ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6, 24); ctx.lineTo(4, -14); ctx.stroke();
    // arm
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#e63946"; ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(4, -10); ctx.lineTo(front + 4, -30); ctx.stroke();
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9b3";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(8, -24, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // helmet
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(8, -26, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(-2, -26, 20, 4);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    const camX = bike.x - W * 0.4;
    ctx.save();
    for (const p of particles) {
      const sx = p.x - camX;
      const sy = H * 0.55 + (p.y - hillY(bike.x)) * 1.0;
      ctx.globalAlpha = (p.life / p.max) * 0.6;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c9b48a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    // score panel
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(16, 16, 230, 60, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2b4a9e";
    ctx.fillText("🏁 Distance: " + score + " m", 30, 30);
    ctx.font = "16px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a5230";
    ctx.fillText("Best: " + best + " m", 30, 58);

    // progress bar
    const bw = 300, bx = W / 2 - bw / 2, by = 24;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, 16, 8); ctx.fill();
    const prog = Math.min(bike.x / WIN_DIST, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7ec850";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw * prog, 16, 8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2b4a9e";
    ctx.font = "14px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Goal " + WIN_DIST + " m", W / 2, by + 22);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,30,60,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 54px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.34);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H * 0.44);
    ctx.font = "18px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE / tap to start", W / 2, H * 0.55);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawSky();
    drawSun();
    drawClouds();
    drawMountains();
    drawHill();
    drawFlag();
    drawParticles();
    drawBike();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") {
      drawOverlay("🚲 Bike Hill Climb!", "Pedal up the hills. Reach the flag to win!", "#7ec850");
    } else if (state === "win") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,215,0," + (0.2 + winFlash * 0.3) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.restore();
      drawOverlay("🎉 You made it!", "Distance: " + score + " m  •  Flips: " + bike.flips, "#ffd23f");
    } else if (state === "crash") {
      drawOverlay("💥 Whoops!", "You flipped over. Distance: " + score + " m", "#ff6b6b");
    }
  }

  // ===== Loop =====
  let last = performance.now();
  let acc = 0;
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
    acc += dt;
    while (acc >= STEP) {
      update(STEP);
      acc -= STEP;
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Draw the Path</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 50% 0%, #2a1b3d 0%, #14102a 55%, #0a0817 100%);
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- canvas setup ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
function distToSegment(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by) {
  const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
  const l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (l2 === 0) return Math.hypot(px - ax, py - ay);
  let t = ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / l2;
  t = clamp(t, 0, 1);
  const cx = ax + t * dx, cy = ay + t * dy;
  return Math.hypot(px - cx, py - cy);
}

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const WALL = 14;      // wall thickness
const BALL_R = 12;    // ball radius
const GOAL_R = 20;    // goal radius
const GRAVITY = 0.42;
const FRICTION = 0.992;
const MAX_SPEED = 15;
const MAX_STEPS = 5500;

let state = 'menu';   // 'menu' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
let ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
let start = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let goal = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let steps = 0;
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let path = [];        // committed wall points
let current = [];      // wall being drawn
let drawing = false;
let lastMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let particles = [];
let confetti = [];
let time = 0;

/* ---------- background stars ---------- */
const stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
  stars.push({ x: Math.random(), y: Math.random(), r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.4, tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5 });
}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
function layout() {
  const m = Math.min(W, H);
  start.x = W * 0.12;
  start.y = H * 0.32;
  goal.x = W * 0.86;
  goal.y = H * 0.68;
  ball.x = start.x;
  ball.y = start.y;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  steps = 0;
  path = [];
  current = [];
  particles = [];
  confetti = [];
}
layout();

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function getPos(e) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
}
function beginDraw(p) {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  if (Math.hypot(p.x - start.x, p.y - start.y) < BALL_R + 34) return; // don't start inside start
  drawing = true;
  current = [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }];
  lastMouse = p;
}
function moveDraw(p) {
  if (!drawing) return;
  const last = current[current.length - 1];
  const d = Math.hypot(p.x - last.x, p.y - last.y);
  if (d > 3) {
    current.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
    lastMouse = p;
  }
}
function endDraw() {
  if (!drawing) return;
  drawing = false;
  if (current.length > 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < current.length; i++) path.push(current[i]);
  }
  current = [];
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { const p = getPos(e); if (state === 'playing') beginDraw(p); });
window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => { const p = getPos(e); if (state === 'playing') moveDraw(p); });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { if (state === 'playing') endDraw(); });

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const p = { x: t.clientX - r.left, y: t.clientY - r.top };
  if (state === 'playing') beginDraw(p);
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const p = { x: t.clientX - r.left, y: t.clientY - r.top };
  if (state === 'playing') moveDraw(p);
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state === 'playing') endDraw();
}, { passive: false });

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (state === 'menu' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) { startGame(); }
  else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') { startGame(); }
  }
  else if (state === 'playing') {
    if (k === 'r') { resetBall(); }
    if (k === 'c') { path = []; current = []; }
  }
});

function startGame() {
  layout();
  state = 'playing';
}
function resetBall() {
  ball.x = start.x;
  ball.y = start.y;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
  steps = 0;
}

/* ---------- physics ---------- */
function update() {
  time += 1;

  // background particles drift
  if (state === 'playing' && Math.random() < 0.35) {
    particles.push({
      x: Math.random() * W, y: H + 10,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3, vy: -(0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8),
      r: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5, life: 1, hue: 180 + Math.random() * 60
    });
  }
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life -= 0.006;
    if (p.life <= 0 || p.y < -20) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state === 'won') {
    if (confetti.length < 160 && Math.random() < 0.7) {
      confetti.push({
        x: Math.random() * W, y: -10,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2, vy: 1 + Math.random() * 3,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        size: 5 + Math.random() * 8, hue: Math.random() * 360
      });
    }
    for (let i = confetti.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const c = confetti[i];
      c.x += c.vx; c.y += c.vy; c.vy += 0.05; c.rot += c.vr;
      if (c.y > H + 20) confetti.splice(i, 1);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // integrate
  ball.vy += GRAVITY;
  ball.vx *= FRICTION;
  ball.vy *= FRICTION;
  const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
  if (sp > MAX_SPEED) { const f = MAX_SPEED / sp; ball.vx *= f; ball.vy *= f; }

  const stepsN = 3;
  const dx = ball.vx / stepsN, dy = ball.vy / stepsN;
  for (let s = 0; s < stepsN; s++) {
    ball.x += dx;
    ball.y += dy;
    collide();
  }

  // bounds
  if (ball.x < BALL_R) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx) * 0.4; }
  if (ball.x > W - BALL_R) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx) * 0.4; }
  if (ball.y < BALL_R) { ball.y = BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy) * 0.4; }
  if (ball.y > H - BALL_R) { ball.y = H - BALL_R; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy) * 0.4; }

  steps++;
  if (steps > MAX_STEPS) {
    state = 'lost';
    return;
  }

  // win
  if (Math.hypot(ball.x - goal.x, ball.y - goal.y) < GOAL_R + BALL_R * 0.6) {
    score = Math.max(1, 10000 - steps * 3);
    if (score > best) best = score;
    state = 'won';
  }
}

function collide() {
  const all = path;
  if (current.length > 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < current.length; i++) all.push(current[i]);
  }
  const n = all.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    const a = all[i], b = all[i + 1];
    const d = distToSegment(ball.x, ball.y, a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
    const min = BALL_R + WALL * 0.5;
    if (d < min) {
      // push out
      let nx = ball.x, ny = ball.y;
      const segLen = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) || 1;
      let t = ((ball.x - a.x) * (b.x - a.x) + (ball.y - a.y) * (b.y - a.y)) / (segLen * segLen);
      t = clamp(t, 0, 1);
      const cx = a.x + t * (b.x - a.x);
      const cy = a.y + t * (b.y - a.y);
      let vx = ball.x - cx, vy = ball.y - cy;
      const dl = Math.hypot(vx, vy) || 1;
      nx = vx / dl; ny = vy / dl;
      ball.x = cx + nx * min;
      ball.y = cy + ny * min;
      // reflect velocity
      const dot = ball.vx * nx + ball.vy * ny;
      ball.vx -= 2 * dot * nx;
      ball.vy -= 2 * dot * ny;
      ball.vx *= 0.55;
      ball.vy *= 0.55;
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  // subtle vignette / floor glow
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,25,70,0.0)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,40,70,0.15)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const a = 0.35 + 0.4 * Math.sin(time * 0.02 * s.sp + s.tw);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,255,' + clamp(a, 0, 0.9) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // drifting particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + p.hue + ',80%,70%,' + (p.life * 0.5) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawWall(pts, live) {
  if (pts.length < 2) return;
  // glow
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = live ? 'rgba(255,210,120,0.35)' : 'rgba(120,200,255,0.30)';
  ctx.lineWidth = WALL * 2 + 10;
  trace(pts);
  // core
  ctx.strokeStyle = live ? '#ffd27a' : '#8fd0ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = WALL;
  trace(pts);
  // highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  trace(pts);
}
function trace(pts) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawStart() {
  const pulse = 1 + 0.1 * Math.sin(time * 0.08);
  const r = 26 * pulse;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(start.x, start.y, 2, start.x, start.y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,255,180,0.9)');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(60,200,150,0.35)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,200,150,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(start.x, start.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,255,200,0.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(start.x, start.y, 18 * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawGoal() {
  const pulse = 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(time * 0.1);
  const r = 34 * pulse;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(goal.x, goal.y, 2, goal.x, goal.y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,150,0.95)');
  g.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,180,60,0.4)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,150,40,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(goal.x, goal.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // rotating ring
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(goal.x, goal.y);
  ctx.rotate(time * 0.03);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.9)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 8]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, GOAL_R + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBall() {
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(ball.x, ball.y + BALL_R * 0.9, BALL_R * 0.9, BALL_R * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // glow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x, ball.y, 1, ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 2.2);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,120,80,0.5)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,80,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // body
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x - 4, ball.y - 4, 2, ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#ffe0c0');
  bg.addColorStop(0.5, '#ff8a5c');
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#d8482a');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // shine
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x - 4, ball.y - 5, BALL_R * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawConfetti() {
  for (const c of confetti) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
    ctx.rotate(c.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + c.hue + ',85%,60%)';
    ctx.fillRect(-c.size / 2, -c.size / 2, c.size, c.size * 0.6);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  // title
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  ctx.fillText('DRAW THE PATH', 20, 18);
  ctx.font = '13px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,230,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('Draw walls to guide the ball into the golden goal. Gravity pulls it down — build ramps!', 20, 46);

  // steps
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.fillText('Steps: ' + steps, 20, H - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,180,220,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '13px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('R = reset ball    C = clear walls', 20, H - 12);

  // best
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,140,0.9)';
  ctx.fillText('Best: ' + best, W - 20, H - 30);
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color, btn) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,6,20,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - 40);
  ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,230,250,0.85)';
  for (let i = 0; i < sub.length; i++) {
    ctx.fillText(sub[i], cx, cy + 8 + i * 26);
  }
  // button

<head>

  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  const state = {
    koi: [],
    food: [],
    ripples: [],
    score: 0,
    best: 0,
    started: false,
    time: 0
  };

  const K = 6;
  const KOLORS = [
    { body: '#e8442a', belly: '#f5c9a0', name: 'Orange' },
    { body: '#f5f0e8', belly: '#d4a574', name: 'White' },
    { body: '#1a1a2e', belly: '#555566', name: 'Black' },
    { body: '#e8442a', belly: '#f5f0e8', name: 'Kohaku' },
    { body: '#f5f0e8', belly: '#e8442a', name: 'Hakohaku' },
    { body: '#e8442a', belly: '#1a1a2e', name: 'Sanke' }
  ];

  function makeKoi() {
    const c = KOLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * KOLORS.length)];
    const x = W * 0.2 + Math.random() * W * 0.6;
    const y = H * 0.2 + Math.random() * H * 0.6;
    return {
      x, y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
      angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      speed: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5,
      size: 22 + Math.random() * 12,
      color: c,
      hunger: 0,
      tailPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      tailSpeed: 3 + Math.random() * 2,
      wander: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      target: null
    };
  }

  function initKoi() {
    state.koi = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < K; i++) state.koi.push(makeKoi());
  }
  initKoi();

  function addRipple(x, y, r) {
    state.ripples.push({ x, y, r: r || 4, maxR: 30 + Math.random() * 30, alpha: 0.6 });
  }

  function spawnFood(x, y) {
    const n = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      state.food.push({
        x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
        y: y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        vy: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.4,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 3,
        life: 8
      });

    addRipple(x, y);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!state.started) {
      state.started = true;
      state.score = 0;
      initKoi();
      return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    spawnFood(x, y);
  });

  function update(dt) {
    state.time += dt;

    state.ripples = state.ripples.filter(r => {
      r.r += dt * 40;
      r.alpha -= dt * 0.5;
      return r.alpha > 0 && r.r < r.maxR;
    });

    state.food = state.food.filter(f => {
      f.x += f.vx * dt * 30;
      f.y += f.vy * dt * 30;
      f.life -= dt;
      return f.life > 0 && f.y < H - 20;
    });

    for (let k of state.koi) {

        const dy = k.target.y - k.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < 12) {
          state.score += 10;
          if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;

          k.hunger = 0;

          k.vx = (dx / dist) * spd;
          k.vy = (dy / dist) * spd;

        const spd = k.speed;
        k.vx = Math.cos(k.wander) * spd;

      k.y += k.vy * dt * 30;

      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  function loop(t) {

      spawnSparks(cx, ballY, 16, "#ffe27a");

    // lose check

function drawBall() {

function draw() {
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  let sx = 0, sy = 0;

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
