  }

  if (p.grounded) {
    p.runFrame += G.speed * 0.15;
  }

  // Shake decay
  if (G.shake > 0) G.shake *= 0.9;
  if (G.hitFlash > 0) G.hitFlash -= dt * 3;

  // Scroll buildings
  for (let b of G.buildings) {
    b.x -= G.speed * 0.4;
    if (b.x + b.w < -50) {
      b.x = W + Math.random() * 100;
      b.w = 60 + Math.random() * 50;
      b.h = 80 + Math.random() * 200;
      b.color = `hsl(${220 + Math.random()*30}, 15%, ${12 + Math.random()*10}%)`;
      b.windows = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 3;
    }
  }

  // Scroll tunnel lights
  for (let tl of G.tunnelLights) {
    tl.x -= G.speed;
    if (tl.x < -30) {
      tl.x = W + Math.random() * 100;
    }
  }

  // Spawn obstacles
  const spawnInterval = Math.max(350, 900 - G.speed * 30);
  if (G.distance - G.lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
    G.lastSpawn = G.distance;
    const types = ['barrier', 'train', 'overhead'];
    const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
    spawnObstacle(W + 50, type);
    // Sometimes add a coin above
    if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
      spawnCoin(W + 50 + 30, GROUND_Y() - 80 - Math.random() * 40);
    }
  }

  // Spawn coins
  if (G.distance - G.lastCoin > 500 + Math.random() * 300) {
    G.lastCoin = G.distance;
    const cy = GROUND_Y() - 40 - Math.random() * 60;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      spawnCoin(W + 50 + i * 35, cy);
    }
  }

  // Move obstacles
  for (let i = G.obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const o = G.obstacles[i];
    o.x -= G.speed;
    if (o.x + o.w < -50) {
      G.obstacles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Collision
    const pBox = { x: p.x + 5, y: p.y + 5, w: p.w - 10, h: (p.ducking ? p.h * 0.5 : p.h) - 5 };
    const oBox = { x: o.x, y: o.y, w: o.w, h: o.h };
    if (pBox.x < oBox.x + oBox.w && pBox.x + pBox.w > oBox.x &&
        pBox.y < oBox.y + oBox.h && pBox.y + pBox.h > oBox.y) {
      G.state = 'lose';
      G.shake = 15;
      G.hitFlash = 1;
      return;
    }
  }

  // Move coins
  for (let i = G.coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const c = G.coins[i];
    c.x -= G.speed;
    c.bob += dt * 4;
    if (c.x < -30) { G.coins.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    // Collect
    const cx = p.x + p.w/2;
    const cy = p.y + p.h/2;
    const dx = cx - c.x;
    const dy = cy - (c.y + Math.sin(c.bob) * 5);
    if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < 35) {
      G.coins.splice(i, 1);
      G.score += 50;
      for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
        G.particles.push({
          x: c.x, y: c.y,
          vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*6,
          vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*6,
          life: 1, size: 3+Math.random()*3,
          color: 'rgba(255,215,0,0.8)'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = G.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const pt = G.particles[i];
    pt.x += pt.vx;
    pt.y += pt.vy;
    pt.vy += 0.1;
    pt.life -= dt * 2;
    if (pt.life <= 0) G.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ---- Draw ----
function draw() {
  const shakeX = G.shake > 0.5 ? (Math.random()-0.5) * G.shake : 0;
  const shakeY = G.shake > 0.5 ? (Math.random()-0.5) * G.shake : 0;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

  // Sky / background gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e1a');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#121830');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#1a2240');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d1225');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const sx = ((i * 137.5 + G.distance * 0.02) % W + W) % W;
    const sy = (i * 73.3) % (H * 0.35);
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }

  // Background buildings
  for (let b of G.buildings) {
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, GROUND_Y() - b.h, b.w, b.h);
    // Windows
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,100,0.15)';
    for (let wy = 0; wy < b.windows; wy++) {
      for (let wx = 0; wx < 3; wx++) {
        if ((wy + wx) % 3 !== 0) {
          ctx.fillRect(b.x + 8 + wx * 18, GROUND_Y() - b.h + 12 + wy * 22, 10, 14);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Ground / tunnel floor
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y(), 0, H);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a3050');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#1e2440');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#141828');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y(), W, H - GROUND_Y());

  // Track lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a4060';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y() + 15);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y() + 15);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a4060';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y() + 35);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y() + 35);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Sleepers
  ctx.fillStyle = '#252a45';
  const sleeperSpacing = 40;
  const offset = (G.distance * 1.5) % sleeperSpacing;
  for (let sx = -offset; sx < W + sleeperSpacing; sx += sleeperSpacing) {
    ctx.fillRect(sx, GROUND_Y() + 10, 8, 30);
  }

  // Tunnel lights (ceiling)
  for (let tl of G.tunnelLights) {
    const ly = H * 0.12;
    // Light glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(tl.x, ly, 0, tl.x, ly, 60);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,200,0.3)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(tl.x - 60, ly - 60, 120, 120);
    // Fixture
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
    ctx.fillRect(tl.x - 8, ly - 4, 16, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe8aa';
    ctx.fillRect(tl.x - 5, ly, 10, 5);
  }

  // Tunnel ceiling line
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a3050';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.08);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H * 0.08);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Obstacles
  for (let o of G.obstacles) {
    if (o.type === 'barrier') {
      // Yellow/black striped barrier
      ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
      for (let s = 0; s < o.h; s += 12) {
        if (Math.floor(s / 12) % 2 === 0) {
          ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y + s, o.w, 6);
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x + o.w/2 - 3, o.y - 10, 6, 10);
    } else if (o.type === 'train') {
      // Train car
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3333';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
      // Roof
      ctx.fillStyle = '#992222';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, 10);
      // Windows
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
      for (let wi = 0; wi < 4; wi++) {
        ctx.fillRect(o.x + 10 + wi * 28, o.y + 18, 20, 22);
      }
      // Bottom stripe
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y + o.h - 8, o.w, 8);
      // Wheels
      ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(o.x + 20, o.y + o.h + 5, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(o.x + o.w - 20, o.y + o.h + 5, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Headlight
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffcc';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(o.x + o.w - 5, o.y + o.h/2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (o.type === 'overhead') {
      // Overhead cable / sign
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x + 5, o.y + 5, o.w - 10, o.h - 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('STOP', o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2 + 5);
      // Support
      ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
      ctx.fillRect(o.x + o.w/2 - 4, o.y + o.h, 8, GROUND_Y() - o.y - o.h);
    }
  }

  // Coins
  for (let c of G.coins) {
    const bobY = c.y + Math.sin(c.bob) * 5;
    const coinGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, bobY, 0, c.x, bobY, c.r);
    coinGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff8aa');
    coinGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffd700');
    coinGrad.addColorStop(1, '#cc9900');
    ctx.fillStyle = coinGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, bobY, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#aa8800';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    // $ symbol
    ctx.fillStyle = '#886600';
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('$', c.x, bobY + 4);
  }

  // Player
  const p = G.player;
  const px = p.x;
  const py = p.y;
  const pw = p.w;
  const ph = p.ducking ? p.h * 0.5 : p.h;
  const pTop = p.ducking ? GROUND_Y() - ph : py;

  // Body
  const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(px, pTop, px, pTop + ph);
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3388ff');
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2266cc');
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(px + 6, pTop + 14, pw - 12, ph - 20);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px + pw/2, pTop + 10, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Cap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2255aa';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px + pw/2, pTop + 6, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(px + pw/2 - 10, pTop + 4, 20, 4);

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(px + pw/2 + 2, pTop + 8, 3, 3);

  // Arms (running animation)
  const armSwing = Math.sin(p.runFrame) * 0.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2266cc';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  // Left arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + 10, pTop + 22);
  ctx.lineTo(px + 4 + armSwing * 10, pTop + 38);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + pw - 10, pTop + 22);
  ctx.lineTo(px + pw - 4 - armSwing * 10, pTop + 38);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Legs (running animation)
  const legSwing = Math.sin(p.runFrame) * 0.4;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2244aa';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  // Left leg
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + pw/2 - 5, pTop + ph - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(px + pw/2 - 5 + legSwing * 15, GROUND_Y() - 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right leg
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px + pw/2 + 5, pTop + ph - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(px + pw/2 + 5 - legSwing * 15, GROUND_Y() - 2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  const footLX = px + pw/2 - 5 + legSwing * 15;
  const footRX = px + pw/2 + 5 - legSwing * 15;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(footLX, GROUND_Y() - 2, 8, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(footRX, GROUND_Y() - 2, 8, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Particles
  for (let pt of G.particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = pt.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = pt.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Hit flash
  if (G.hitFlash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,0,${G.hitFlash * 0.3})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // HUD
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${G.score}`, 20, 35);

  // Progress bar
  const barW = 200;
  const barH = 12;
  const barX = W - barW - 20;
  const barY = 25;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  const progress = Math.min(1, G.distance / G.winDist);
  const progGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
  progGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4444');
  progGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffcc00');
  progGrad.addColorStop(1, '#44ff44');
  ctx.fillStyle = progGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * progress, barH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`${Math.floor(progress * 100)}%`, barX + barW/2, barY + barH + 15);

  // Speed indicator
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff';
  ctx.fillText(`SPEED: ${G.speed.toFixed(1)}`, 20, 58);

  ctx.restore();

  // Overlays
  if (G.state === 'start') {
    drawOverlay('SUBWAY RUNNER', [
      'Run through the tunnel!',
      '',
      'SPACE / W / Up  - Jump (double jump!)',
      'S / Down        - Duck under signs',
      'Touch the screen: top = jump, bottom = duck',
      '',
      'Reach 100% to win. Avoid trains & barriers!',
      '',
      'Press SPACE or TAP to start'
    ], '#ffcc00');
  } else if (G.state === 'win') {
    drawOverlay('YOU MADE IT!', [
      `Final Score: ${G.score}`,
      '',
      'You outran the subway!',
      '',
      'Press SPACE or TAP to play again'
    ], '#44ff88');
  } else if (G.state === 'lose') {
    drawOverlay('WRECKED!', [
      `Score: ${G.score}`,
      `Distance: ${Math.floor(G.distance)} / ${G.winDist}`,
      '',
      'You hit an obstacle!',
      '',
      'Press SPACE or TAP to try again'
    ], '#ff4444');
  }
}

function drawOverlay(title, lines, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(48, W * 0.06)}px monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - lines.length * 14 - 20);

  ctx.font = `${Math.min(18, W * 0.025)}px monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    ctx.fillText(lines[i], cx, cy + i * 24);
  }

  // Blinking prompt
  if (Math.floor(G.time * 2) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(16, W * 0.02)}px monospace`;
    ctx.fillText('▸ READY ◂', cx, cy + lines.length * 24 + 20);
  }
}

// ---- Loop ----
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000);
  lastTime = timestamp;
  G.time += dt * (G.state === 'play' ? 1 : 0.5);

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Initialize
G.player.x = W * 0.18;
G.player.y = GROUND_Y() - G.player.h;
G.buildings = [];
G.tunnelLights = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
  G.buildings.push({
    x: i * 120 + Math.random() * 40,
    w: 60 + Math.random() * 50,
    h: 80 + Math.random() * 200,
    color: `hsl(${220 + Math.random()*30}, 15%, ${12 + Math.random()*10}%)`,
    windows: Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 3
  });
}
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
  G.tunnelLights.push({ x: i * 200 + Math.random() * 60 });
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lighthouse Flash Pattern</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #05122a; font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- Canvas ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- Timing ----------
const ROUND_MS = 1000;
const TOTAL_MS = 60000;

// ---------- Game state ----------
const state = {
  phase: 'start',        // start | showing | input | result
  pattern: [],           // array of 1 (flash) / 0 (off)
  round: 0,             // 0 = start, 1.. = current round
  cursor: 0,            // index within pattern
  roundStart: 0,        // ms timestamp when current round began
  lastBeep: 0,          // ms timestamp of last beep
  errors: 0,
  best: 0,
  t: 0                 // global elapsed ms
};

// ---------- Audio ----------
let audioCtx = null;
function ensureAudio() {
  if (!audioCtx) {
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (AC) audioCtx = new AC();
  }
  if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
}
function beep(freq, dur, vol, type) {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const t0 = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const g = audioCtx.createGain();
  o.type = type || 'sine';
  o.frequency.value = freq;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + 0.02);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  o.connect(g);
  g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  o.start(t0);
  o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
}

// ---------- Helpers ----------
function randPattern(len) {
  const a = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) a.push(Math.random() < 0.45 ? 1 : 0);
  return a;
}
function startRound() {
  state.round++;
  const len = Math.min(2 + state.round, 9);
  state.pattern = randPattern(len);
  state.cursor = 0;
  state.roundStart = state.t;
  state.lastBeep = -9999;
}
function startGame() {
  ensureAudio();
  state.phase = 'showing';
  state.errors = 0;
  state.round = 0;
  state.t = 0;
  startRound();
}
function endGame(won) {
  state.phase = 'result';
  state.won = won;
  if (won) {
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.round);
    beep(880, 0.18, 0.25, 'triangle');
  } else {
    beep(150, 0.5, 0.3, 'sawtooth');
  }
}

// ---------- Input ----------
function flashNow() {
  if (state.phase !== 'input') return;
  if (state.t - state.roundStart > TOTAL_MS) return;
  const want = state.pattern[state.cursor];
  if (want === 1) {
    // correct
    state.lastBeep = state.t;
    state.cursor++;
    beep(660 + state.cursor * 30, 0.09, 0.22, 'square');
    if (state.cursor >= state.pattern.length) {
      // round complete
      if (state.t - state.roundStart > TOTAL_MS) {
        endGame(false);
      } else {
        state.phase = 'showing';
        startRound();
      }
    }
  } else {
    // wrong: flashed during an "off" slot
    state.errors++;
    state.lastBeep = state.t;
    beep(140, 0.2, 0.28, 'sawtooth');
    if (state.errors >= 3) {
      endGame(false);
    }
  }
}
function onAction() {
  if (state.phase === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.phase === 'result') { state.phase = 'start'; return; }
  if (state.phase === 'input') { flashNow(); return; }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'KeyF') {
    e.preventDefault();
    onAction();
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  onAction();
});

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt) {
  state.t += dt;
  if (state.phase === 'showing') {
    const inRound = state.t - state.roundStart;
    // beep at each slot boundary
    const idx = Math.floor(inRound / ROUND_MS);
    if (idx < state.pattern.length && state.t - state.lastBeep >= ROUND_MS) {
      state.lastBeep = state.t;
      if (state.pattern[idx] === 1) beep(520, 0.25, 0.25, 'triangle');
      else beep(220, 0.12, 0.12, 'sine');
    }
    if (inRound >= state.pattern.length * ROUND_MS) {
      state.phase = 'input';
      state.roundStart = state.t;
      state.lastBeep = -9999;
    }
  } else if (state.phase === 'input') {
    if (state.t - state.roundStart > TOTAL_MS) {
      endGame(false);
    }
  }
}

// ---------- Drawing: background ----------
function drawSky() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1f44');
  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#123a63');
  g.addColorStop(0.72, '#2b5d86');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#3f7ba0');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  const seed = 7;
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    const x = ((i * 137.5 + seed * 31) % W);
    const y = ((i * 71.3) % (H * 0.55));
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.t * 0.001 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce9ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, (i % 5 === 0) ? 1.6 : 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // moon
  const mx = W * 0.82, my = H * 0.16;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f3f6ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9d4ee';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx - 8, my - 4, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + 6, my + 8, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawSea() {
  const horizon = H * 0.62;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizon, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1b4f74');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#123a5c');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0a2138');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, horizon, W, H - horizon);

  // moon reflection
  const mx = W * 0.82;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf1ff';
  for (let y = horizon; y < H; y += 8) {
    const w = 10 + 8 * Math.sin(state.t * 0.002 + y * 0.05);
    ctx.fillRect(mx - w / 2, y, w, 3);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // moving wave lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
    const y = horizon + 20 + r * ((H - horizon) / 6);
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 12) {
      const yy = y + Math.sin(x * 0.03 + state.t * 0.003 + r) * 4;
      if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, yy); else ctx.lineTo(x, yy);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

// ---------- Drawing: island + lighthouse ----------
function drawIsland() {
  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const baseY = H * 0.62;
  // rock
  ctx.fillStyle = '#26405a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - 120, baseY + 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - 90, baseY - 40, cx - 30, baseY - 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + 40, baseY - 50, cx + 90, baseY - 20);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + 130, baseY + 10, cx + 120, baseY + 40);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33516e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - 100, baseY + 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - 60, baseY - 20, cx, baseY - 10);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + 60, baseY - 30, cx + 100, baseY + 20);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawLighthouse() {
  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const baseY = H * 0.585;
  const towerH = H * 0.24;
  const towerW = Math.min(54, W * 0.06);
  const topY = baseY - towerH;

  // tower body (tapered)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f0e6';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - towerW * 0.5, baseY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - towerW * 0.32, topY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + towerW * 0.32, topY);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + towerW * 0.5, baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // red stripes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d8432f';
  const stripes = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < stripes; i++) {
    const t0 = i / stripes, t1 = (i + 0.5) / stripes;
    const y0 = baseY - towerH * t0;
    const y1 = baseY - towerH * t1;
    const w0 = towerW * (0.5 - 0.18 * t0);
    const w1 = towerW * (0.5 - 0.18 * t1);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - w0, y0);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - w1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + w1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + w0, y0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // gallery / lantern room
  const lanternW = towerW * 0.9;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2f3a';
  ctx.fillRect(cx - lanternW * 0.6, topY - 26, lanternW * 1.2, 26);
  // lantern glass
  const lit = currentFlashLevel() > 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = lit ? '#ffe9a8' : '#5b6b80';
  ctx.fillRect(cx - lanternW * 0.4, topY - 22, lanternW * 0.8, 18);
  // roof
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - lanternW * 0.55, topY - 26);
  ctx.lineTo(cx, topY - 44);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + lanternW * 0.55, topY - 26);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // finial
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, topY - 46, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  return { x: cx, y: topY - 20 };
}

// ---------- Flash level (0..1) ----------
function currentFlashLevel() {
  if (state.phase === 'showing') {
    const inRound = state.t - state.roundStart;
    const idx = Math.floor(inRound / ROUND_MS);
    if (idx >= state.pattern.length) return 0;
    const frac = (inRound % ROUND_MS) / ROUND_MS;
    if (state.pattern[idx] === 1) {
      // bright flash in first 40% of slot
      if (frac < 0.4) return 1 - frac / 0.4;
      return 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  if (state.phase === 'input') {
    // user-controlled: flash while holding / on press
    const since = state.t - state.lastBeep;
    if (since < 220) return 1 - since / 220;
    return 0;
  }
  return 0;
}

// ---------- Drawing: light beam ----------
function drawBeam(lh, level) {
  if (level <= 0.02) return;
  const a = level;
  const dir = Math.sin(state.t * 0.0012) * 0.5; // gentle sweep
  const baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + dir;
  const beamLen = Math.max(W, H) * 1.2;
  const spread = 0.14;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  // main beam
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(lh.x, lh.y, 4, lh.x, lh.y, beamLen);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,244,190,' + (0.95 * a) + ')');
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,230,150,' + (0.35 * a) + ')');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,120,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(lh.x, lh.y);
  ctx.lineTo(lh.x + Math.cos(baseAngle - spread) * beamLen, lh.y + Math.sin(baseAngle - spread) * beamLen);
  ctx.lineTo(lh.x + Math.cos(baseAngle + spread) * beamLen, lh.y + Math.sin(baseAngle + spread) * beamLen);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // glow at lantern
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(lh.x, lh.y, 2, lh.x, lh.y, 60 * (0.5 + a));
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,250,220,' + (0.9 * a) + ')');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,180,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(lh.x, lh.y, 60 * (0.5 + a), 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---------- Drawing: HUD ----------
function drawHUD() {
  // top bar
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,20,40,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 54);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf2ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Lighthouse Flash', 18, 27);

  // round / score
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd76b';
  ctx.fillText('Round ' + Math.max(1, state.round), W * 0.5, 27);

  // errors
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = state.errors > 0 ? '#ff7a6b' : '#9fb4cf';
  ctx.fillText('Mistakes: ' + state.errors + ' / 3', W - 18, 27);

  // timer bar
  let remaining = 0;
  if (state.phase === 'input') {
    remaining = Math.max(0, TOTAL_MS - (state.t - state.roundStart));
  } else {
    remaining = TOTAL_MS;
  }
  const barW = W * 0.4;
  const barX = (W - barW) / 2;
  const barY = H - 40;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,20,40,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX - 6, barY - 6, barW + 12, 22);
  const frac = remaining / TOTAL_MS;
  const col = frac > 0.4 ? '#5fd08a' : (frac > 0.2 ? '#ffd76b' : '#ff6b5c');
  ctx.fillStyle = col;
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe0f5';
  ctx.font = '13px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText((remaining / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's', W * 0.5, barY - 14);
}

function drawPatternDots() {
  const n = state.pattern.length;
  const dotR = Math.min(14, W * 0.012);
  const gap = dotR * 3;
  const totalW = n * dotR * 2 + (n - 1) * gap;
  let x = (W - totalW) / 2 + dotR;
  const y = H * 0.14;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let fill = '#22364e';
    let ring = 'rgba(120,160,210,0.4)';
    if (state.phase === 'showing') {
      const inRound = state.t - state.roundStart;
      const idx = Math.floor(inRound / ROUND_MS);
      if (i < idx) fill = '#3a5f85';
      else if (i === idx) fill = state.pattern[i] === 1 ? '#ffe9a8' : '#2a3f5a';
    } else if (state.phase === 'input') {
      if (i < state.cursor) fill = '#5fd08a';
      else if (i === state.cursor) fill = '#ffd76b';
    } else if (state.phase === 'result') {
      fill = state.pattern[i] === 1 ? '#ffe9a8' : '#2a3f5a';
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, dotR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = ring; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, dotR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    x += dotR * 2 + gap;
  }
}

// ---------- Overlays ----------
function overlayPanel(title, lines, hint) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,14,30,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(48, W * 0.06) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(title, W * 0.5, H * 0.34);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#dce9ff';
  ctx.font = Math.min(22, W * 0.03) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  let y = H * 0.46;
  for (const ln of lines) { ctx.fillText(ln, W * 0.5, y); y += 30; }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd0ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(20, W * 0.028) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(state.t * 0.005);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText(hint, W * 0.5, H * 0.72);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawOverlay() {
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    overlayPanel('Lighthouse Flash',
      ['Watch the beacon flash a pattern, then',
       'copy it back by pressing SPACE (or tap).',
       'Each round is longer. 3 mistakes = game over.',
       'You have 1 minute to copy as many as you can.'],
      'Press SPACE / Tap to start');
  } else if (state.phase === 'result') {
    const won = state.won;
    overlayPanel(won ? 'You beat the clock!' : 'Time is up',
      ['Rounds copied: ' + Math.max(0, state.round - (won ? 0 : 1)),
       'Best so far: ' + state.best],
      'Press SPACE / Tap to play again');
  }
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function draw() {
  drawSky();
  drawSea();
  drawIsland();
  const lh = drawLighthouse();
  const level = currentFlashLevel();
  drawBeam(lh, level);
  drawPatternDots();
  drawHUD();
  if (state.phase === 'start' || state.phase === 'result') drawOverlay();
}

// ---------- Loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = now - last;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 100) dt = 100;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Frisbee Accuracy — 60 Seconds</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #2a3a5f 0%, #14203a 70%, #0a1122 100%);
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    cursor: crosshair;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ============================ STATE ============================ */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;

const GAME_DURATION = 60;            // seconds
const TARGET_COUNT = 3;             // rings on screen at once
const THROW_COOLDOWN = 0.35;       // seconds between throws
const FLY_TIME = 0.5;              // seconds for a throw to resolve
const GRAVITY = 1500;             // px/s^2 vertical drop while flying
const MAX_FLIES = 12;

const state = {
  mode: 'start',                  // 'start' | 'playing' | 'over'
  timeLeft: GAME_DURATION,
  score: 0,
  best: 0,
  throws: 0,
  hits: 0,
  combo: 0,
  bestCombo: 0,
  lastThrow: -10,
  shake: 0,
  msg: '',
  msgTimer: 0,
  mouse: { x: 0, y: 0 }
};

let targets = [];    // array of target objects
let flies = [];      // array of in-flight frisbees
let particles = [];   // array of particle effects
let ringPulse = 0;

/* ============================ RESIZE ============================ */
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ============================ HELPERS ============================ */
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

function makeTarget() {
  // Place a target in the upper 2/3 of the field, away from the thrower.
  const margin = 70;
  const x = rand(margin, W - margin);
  const y = rand(margin + 40, H * 0.72);
  const r = rand(34, 52);
  return { x, y, r, hit: false, flash: 0, spawn: 0 };
}

function spawnTargets() {
  targets = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < TARGET_COUNT; i++) targets.push(makeTarget());
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, n, spread, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const s = rand(speed * 0.4, speed);
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * s - rand(0, 60),
      life: rand(0.4, 0.9),
      maxLife: 0.9,
      size: rand(2, 5),
      color
    });
  }
}

/* ============================ INPUT ============================ */
function pointerPos(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  let cx = e.clientX, cy = e.clientY;
  if (e.touches && e.touches.length) { cx = e.touches[0].clientX; cy = e.touches[0].clientY; }
  return { x: cx - rect.left, y: cy - rect.top };
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
  const p = pointerPos(e);
  state.mouse.x = p.x;
  state.mouse.y = p.y;
}

function onThrow(x, y) {
  if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;
  if (state.timeLeft <= 0) return;
  const now = performance.now() / 1000;
  if (now - state.lastThrow < THROW_COOLDOWN) return;
  state.lastThrow = now;
  state.throws++;

  // Determine if this throw hits a target.
  let hitTarget = null;
  for (const t of targets) {
    const d = Math.hypot(x - t.x, y - t.y);
    if (d <= t.r && !t.hit) { hitTarget = t; break; }
  }

  flies.push({
    x, y,
    tx: hitTarget ? hitTarget.x : x,
    ty: hitTarget ? hitTarget.y : y,
    t: 0,
    hit: !!hitTarget,
    target: hitTarget
  });
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
  const p = pointerPos(e);
  if (state.mode === 'start') {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (state.mode === 'over') {
    // restart on click
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  onThrow(p.x, p.y);
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', onPointerMove);
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const p = pointerPos(e);
  state.mouse.x = p.x; state.mouse.y = p.y;
  onPointerDown(e);
}, { passive: false });

window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
    if (state.mode !== 'playing') startGame();
  }
});

/* ============================ GAME FLOW ============================ */
function startGame() {
  state.mode = 'playing';
  state.timeLeft = GAME_DURATION;
  state.score = 0;
  state.throws = 0;
  state.hits = 0;
  state.combo = 0;
  state.bestCombo = 0;
  state.lastThrow = -10;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.msg = '';
  state.msgTimer = 0;
  flies = [];
  particles = [];
  spawnTargets();
}

function endGame() {
  state.mode = 'over';
  if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
}

/* ============================ UPDATE ============================ */
function update(dt) {
  ringPulse += dt;

  if (state.mode === 'playing') {
    state.timeLeft -= dt;
    if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
      state.timeLeft = 0;
      endGame();
    }
  }

  if (state.msgTimer > 0) state.msgTimer -= dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3);

  // Update targets
  for (const t of targets) {
    if (t.spawn < 1) t.spawn = Math.min(1, t.spawn + dt * 3);
    if (t.flash > 0) t.flash -= dt * 3;
  }

  // Update flies
  for (let i = flies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = flies[i];
    f.t += dt / FLY_TIME;
    if (f.t >= 1) {
      // Resolve the throw.
      if (f.hit && f.target) {
        f.target.hit = true;
        f.target.flash = 1;
        state.hits++;
        state.combo++;
        if (state.combo > state.bestCombo) state.bestCombo = state.combo;
        const base = 100;
        const comboBonus = (state.combo - 1) * 25;
        const points = base + comboBonus;
        state.score += points;
        state.shake = 1;
        state.msg = (state.combo > 1) ? ('COMBO x' + state.combo + '  +' + points) : ('HIT  +' + points);
        state.msgTimer = 1.2;
        addParticles(f.target.x, f.target.y, '#ffd24a', 22, 0, 220);
        addParticles(f.target.x, f.target.y, '#ffffff', 10, 0, 150);
        // Replace the hit target with a fresh one.
        const idx = targets.indexOf(f.target);
        if (idx >= 0) targets[idx] = makeTarget();
      } else {
        state.combo = 0;
        state.msg = 'MISS';
        state.msgTimer = 0.9;
        addParticles(f.x, f.y, '#8fa3c0', 8, 0, 90);
      }
      flies.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += GRAVITY * 0.25 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ============================ DRAW ============================ */
function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#1b2b4d');
  sky.addColorStop(0.45, '#274067');
  sky.addColorStop(0.7, '#33507e');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#3f6089');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Moon
  const mx = W * 0.82, my = H * 0.16;
  const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 4, mx, my, 70);
  mg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(240,240,220,0.9)');
  mg.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(220,225,200,0.35)');
  mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220,225,200,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = mg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f3f1dc';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 97.3) % W;
    const sy = (i * 53.7) % (H * 0.5);
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(ringPulse * 1.5 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.8;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22385c';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.62);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
    const y = H * 0.62 - Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 26 - Math.sin(x * 0.003) * 18;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // Grass field
  const grass = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.6, 0, H);
  grass.addColorStop(0, '#2f7d4f');
  grass.addColorStop(1, '#1f5a38');
  ctx.fillStyle = grass;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.66);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 30) {
    ctx.lineTo(x, H * 0.66 + Math.sin(x * 0.05) * 6);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // Mowing stripes (subtle)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const y = H * 0.68 + i * (H * 0.05);
    ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, H * 0.025);
  }

  // Goal posts in the distance
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9d2c0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  const px = W * 0.5, py = H * 0.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px - 40, py); ctx.lineTo(px - 40, py - 70);
  ctx.moveTo(px + 40, py); ctx.lineTo(px + 40, py - 70);
  ctx.moveTo(px - 40, py - 70); ctx.lineTo(px + 40, py - 70);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawTarget(t) {
  const scale = t.spawn;
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(ringPulse * 3) * 0.03;
  const r = t.r * scale * pulse;
  if (r <= 0) return;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(t.x, t.y);

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.55, r * 0.9, r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // Concentric rings (bullseye)
  const rings = [
    { f: 1.0, c: '#e63946' },
    { f: 0.72, c: '#f7f7f2' },
    { f: 0.48, c: '#e63946' },
    { f: 0.26, c: '#f7f7f2' },
    { f: 0.1, c: '#ffd24a' }
  ];
  for (const ring of rings) {
    ctx.fillStyle = ring.c;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r * ring.f, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // Flash on hit
  if (t.flash > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = t.flash;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r * 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFrisbee(x, y, spin) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(spin);
  // disc
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 18);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  g.addColorStop(0.6, '#e9eef5');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#b9c4d6');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 18, 9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#7d8ba3'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 18, 9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e63946';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 7, 3.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFlies() {
  for (const f of flies) {
    const p = f.t;
    // ease position
    const x = f.x + (f.tx - f.x) * p;
    const arc = Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 40;
    const y = f.y + (f.ty - f.y) * p - arc;
    const spin = p * Math.PI * 4;
    drawFrisbee(x, y, spin);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawThrower() {
  // A small figure at the bottom center, holding a frisbee, aiming at the mouse.
  const bx = W * 0.5, by = H * 0.9;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(bx, by);

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 34, 34, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3a55';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-16, -6, 32, 40, 8); ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8b98f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -18, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // cap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e63946';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -20, 12, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(-14, -22, 28, 5);

  // aiming arm toward mouse
  const dx = state.mouse.x - bx, dy = state.mouse.y - by;
  const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b3a55';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(10, 4);
  ctx.lineTo(10 + Math.cos(ang) * 26, 4 + Math.sin(ang) * 26);
  ctx.stroke();
  // hand + frisbee
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8b98f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(10 + Math.cos(ang) * 28, 4 + Math.sin(ang) * 28, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();

  // aim line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,210,74,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx + Math.cos(ang) * 40, by + 4 + Math.sin(ang) * 40);
  ctx.lineTo(state.mouse.x, state.mouse.y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Top-left: score
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE', 24, 24);
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.fillText(String(state.score), 24, 48);

  // Top-center: timer
  const t = Math.ceil(state.timeLeft);
  const urgent = state.timeLeft < 10;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillText('TIME', W / 2, 24);
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? '#e63946' : '#f7f7f2';
  ctx.fillText(String(t), W / 2, 46);

  // Timer bar
  const barW = Math.min(320, W * 0.5);
  const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2, barY = 100;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, 10, 5); ctx.fill();
  const frac = state.timeLeft / GAME_DURATION;
  ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? '#e63946' : '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, 10, 5); ctx.fill();

  // Top-right: accuracy + combo
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillText('ACCURACY', W - 24, 24);
  const acc = state.throws > 0 ? Math.round((state.hits / state.throws) * 100) : 0;
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd6a0';
  ctx.fillText(acc + '%', W - 24, 44);

  if (state.combo > 1) {
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + state.combo, W - 24, 82);
  }

  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  // Floating message
  if (state.msgTimer > 0 && state.msg) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

function drawStart() {

  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd6a0';

function drawOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,24,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 50px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('TIME UP!', W / 2, H * 0.3);

  ctx.font = 'bold 34px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb2cf';

  ctx.fillText('Best Combo: x' + state.bestCombo, W / 2, H * 0.55);

    ctx.fillText('NEW BEST!', W / 2, H * 0.62);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';

  ctx.globalAlpha = blink;

}

function draw() {

  }

  drawFlies();

  if (state.mode === 'playing') drawThrower();
  drawHUD();

  ctx.restore();

  if (state.mode === 'start') drawStart();
  if (state.mode === 'over') drawOver();
}

/* ============================ LOOP ============================ */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big frame gaps

<script>
"use strict";

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const MOON_R = 130;
const WIN_TARGET = 5;

const P1 = {
  name: "NEW MOON",
  color: "#3a5fc7",
  colorLight: "#8ba8ff",
  colorDark: "#1a2e6e",
  accent: "#6090ff",

};

  colorDark: "#6e5a1a",

  x: 0, y: 0,
  clicks: 0,
  rounds: 0,
  isWinner: false
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  STATE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
let canvas, ctx;
let W, H;

let phase = "start";
let round = 1;
let phaseName = "";
let phaseAngle = 0;
let phaseTarget = 0;
let phaseProgress = 0;
let countdown = 0;
let countdownTimer = 0;
let countdownDuration = 0;
let countdownLabel = "";
let winner = null;
let gameStartTime = 0;

let stars = [];
let particles = [];
let moonPulse = 0;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  INIT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function init() {
  canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  resize();
  generateStars();
  addEventListener("resize", resize);
  addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  addEventListener("touchstart", onTouch, { passive: false });
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  P1.x = W * 0.25;
  P1.y = H * 0.5;
  P2.x = W * 0.75;
  P2.y = H * 0.5;
}

function generateStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random(),
      y: Math.random(),
      size: Math.random() * 2.5 + 0.5,
      brightness: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3,
      twinkleSpeed: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
      twinkleOffset: Math.random() * TAU
    });
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  INPUT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function onDown(e) {
  handleAction(e.clientX, e.clientY);
}

function onTouch(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  handleAction(t.clientX, t.clientY);
}

function onKey(e) {
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleAction(W / 2, H / 2);
  }
}

function handleAction(mx, my) {
  if (phase === "start") {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (phase === "gameover") {
    resetGame();
    return;
  }
  if (phase === "play") {
    const d1 = Math.hypot(mx - P1.x, my - P1.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(mx - P2.x, my - P2.y);
    if (d1 < MOON_R + 30 && d1 < d2) {
      doClick(P1);
    } else if (d2 < MOON_R + 30) {
      doClick(P2);
    }
  }
}

function doClick(player) {
  player.clicks++;
  moonPulse = 1;
  spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, player.accent);
  checkPhaseComplete();
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  GAME LOGIC
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function startGame() {
  phase = "play";
  gameStartTime = performance.now();
  startRound(1);
}

function resetGame() {
  P1.clicks = 0;
  P1.rounds = 0;
  P1.isWinner = false;
  P2.clicks = 0;
  P2.rounds = 0;
  P2.isWinner = false;
  particles = [];
  phase = "start";
}

function startRound(r) {
  round = r;
  const target = 20 + (r - 1) * 15;
  const angle = (r - 1) * (TAU / 8) % TAU;
  phaseName = phaseNameFor(angle);
  phaseTarget = target;
  phaseAngle = angle;
  phaseProgress = 0;
  P1.clicks = 0;
  P2.clicks = 0;
  phase = "countdown";
  countdown = 3;
  countdownTimer = 0;
  countdownDuration = 0.8;
  countdownLabel = "ROUND " + r;
}

function checkPhaseComplete() {
  const total = P1.clicks + P2.clicks;
  if (total >= phaseTarget) {
    const p1Win = P1.clicks > P2.clicks;
    const p2Win = P2.clicks > P1.clicks;
    if (p1Win) {
      P1.rounds++;
      phase = "roundEnd";
      countdownLabel = P1.name + " WINS!";
    } else if (p2Win) {
      P2.rounds++;
      phase = "roundEnd";
      countdownLabel = P2.name + " WINS!";
    } else {
      phase = "roundEnd";
      countdownLabel = "DRAW!";
    }
    countdown = 2.5;
    countdownTimer = 0;
    countdownDuration = 0.8;

    if (P1.rounds >= WIN_TARGET) {
      winner = P1;
      P1.isWinner = true;
      phase = "gameover";
    } else if (P2.rounds >= WIN_TARGET) {
      winner = P2;
      P2.isWinner = true;
      phase = "gameover";
    }
  }
}

function phaseNameFor(angle) {
  const a = ((angle % TAU) + TAU) % TAU;
  const idx = Math.round((a / TAU) * 8) % 8;
  const names = [
    "New Moon",
    "Waxing Crescent",
    "First Quarter",
    "Waxing Gibbous",
    "Full Moon",
    "Waning Gibbous",
    "Last Quarter",
    "Waning Crescent"
  ];
  return names[idx];
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  PARTICLES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
    const speed = Math.random() * 200 + 80;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: Math.random() * 2 + 1.5,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
      color: color
    });
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 100 * dt;
    p.life -= p.decay * dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  UPDATE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
let lastTime = 0;

function update(dt) {
  moonPulse *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);

  if (phase === "countdown" || phase === "roundEnd") {
    countdownTimer += dt;
    if (countdownTimer >= countdownDuration) {
      countdownTimer -= countdownDuration;
      countdown--;
      if (countdown <= 0) {
        if (phase === "countdown") {
          phase = "play";
        } else if (phase === "roundEnd") {
          if (winner === null) {
            startRound(round + 1);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  updateParticles(dt);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  DRAW

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawBackground();

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.3, 0, W / 2, H * 0.3, H * 1.2);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0a1628");
  g.addColorStop(0.4, "#061020");

  const ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.3, H * 0.7, 0, W * 0.3, H * 0.7, 300);

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ng2.addColorStop(0, "#a06030");
  ng2.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
  ctx.fillStyle = ng2;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

}

function drawStars() {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  for (const s of stars) {
    const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * s.twinkleSpeed + s.twinkleOffset);
    const alpha = s.brightness * twinkle;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.size, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawGameplay() {

function drawMoon(player, angle) {
  const x = player.x;
  const y = player.y;
  const r = MOON_R;
  const pulse = 1 + moonPulse * 0.08;
  const rr = r * pulse;

  // glow
  ctx.save();
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, rr * 0.5, x, y, rr * 1.8);
  glow.addColorStop(0, player.colorLight + "40");
  glow.addColorStop(0.5, player.color + "20");
  glow.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, rr * 1.8, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // base moon circle
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, rr, 0, TAU);
  ctx.clip();

  // dark side
  ctx.fillStyle = player.colorDark;
  ctx.fillRect(x - rr, y - rr, rr * 2, rr * 2);

  // illuminated portion
  ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const litSide = (angle % TAU + TAU) % TAU;
  if (litSide < Math.PI / 2 || litSide > (TAU * 3) / 2) {
    // left-lit
    ctx.arc(x, y, rr, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, false);
  } else {
    // right-lit
    ctx.arc(x, y, rr, Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2, false);

  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // crescent shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = player.colorDark;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const shadowAngle = litSide + Math.PI;
  if (shadowAngle < Math.PI / 2 || shadowAngle > (TAU * 3) / 2) {
    ctx.arc(x, y, rr * 0.95, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, false);
  } else {
    ctx.arc(x, y, rr * 0.95, Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2, false);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // craters
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
  ctx.fillStyle = player.colorDark;
  const craters = [
    { dx: -0.3, dy: -0.2, cr: 0.12 },
    { dx: 0.2, dy: 0.3, cr: 0.08 },
    { dx: -0.1, dy: 0.4, cr: 0.1 },
    { dx: 0.35, dy: -0.3, cr: 0.07 },
    { dx: 0.0, dy: -0.4, cr: 0.09 }

  for (const c of craters) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + c.dx * rr, y + c.dy * rr, c.cr * rr, 0, TAU);

function drawPhaseIndicator() {

function drawParticles() {

    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life, 0);

function drawStartScreen() {

  const rules = [
    "Two players compete to fill the moon phase bar.",
    "P1 (blue) clicks the LEFT moon.",
    "P2 (gold) clicks the RIGHT moon.",
    "Most clicks when the bar fills wins the round.",
    "First to " + WIN_TARGET + " rounds wins the game!"
  ];
  ctx.font = "16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8899aa";
  for (let i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
    ctx.fillText(rules[i], cx, cy + 20 + i * 28);
  }

  // start button
  const btnW = 220;
  const btnH = 50;
  const btnY = cy + 20 + rules.length * 28 + 20;
  const pulse = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 500);

  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a4a8a";
  roundRect(ctx, cx - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#6090ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(ctx, cx - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("START GAME", cx, btnY + btnH / 2);

  ctx.font = "14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#667788";
  ctx.fillText("or press SPACE / ENTER", cx, btnY + btnH + 20);

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.4;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.fillStyle = winner.colorLight;
  ctx.font = "bold 56px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(winner.name + " WINS!", cx, cy - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "24px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(winner.rounds + " - " + (winner === P1 ? P2.rounds : P1.rounds), cx, cy + 20);

  const elapsed = ((performance.now() - gameStartTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
  ctx.font = "16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8899aa";
  ctx.fillText("Total time: " + elapsed + "s", cx, cy + 60);

  const btnW = 220;
  const btnH = 50;
  const btnY = cy + 100;
  const pulse = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 500);

  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = winner.colorDark;
  roundRect(ctx, cx - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = winner.color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(ctx, cx - btnW / 2, btnY, btnW, btnH, 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("PLAY AGAIN", cx, btnY + btnH / 2);

  ctx.font = "14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#667788";
  ctx.fillText("or press SPACE / ENTER", cx, btnY + btnH + 20);

  ctx.restore();
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  MAIN LOOP
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function loop(timestamp) {
  if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
  let dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
  if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  BOOT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
init();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Juggle Rush</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0b0e1a;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ===== Canvas =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ===== Game state =====
  const G = {
    phase: 'menu',        // 'menu' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
    timeLeft: 60,
    score: 0,
    balls: [],
    hand: { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 },
    trail: [],
    lastTime: 0,
    startT: 0,
    shake: 0
  };

  const BALL_COLORS = ['#ff5252', '#ffd740', '#40c4ff'];
  const GRAVITY = 1500;

  // ===== Ball factory =====
  function makeBall(i, x, y, vx, vy) {
    return {
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: vx, vy: vy,
      r: 22,
      color: BALL_COLORS[i],
      spin: 0,
      angle: 0,
      trail: []
    };
  }

  function initBalls() {
    G.balls = [];
    G.trail = [];
    const cx = W / 2;
    const cy = H * 0.45;
    // Start in a casual arc above the hand
    const positions = [
      { x: cx - 120, y: cy - 100, vx: 90,  vy: -350 },
      { x: cx,       y: cy - 200, vx: 0,   vy: -150 },
      { x: cx + 120, y: cy - 100, vx: -90, vy: -350 }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      G.balls.push(makeBall(i, positions[i].x, positions[i].y, positions[i].vx, positions[i].vy));
    }
    G.hand.x = G.hand.tx = cx;
    G.hand.y = G.hand.ty = H * 0.78;
    G.score = 0;
    G.timeLeft = 60;
  }

  // ===== Input =====
  function pointerPos(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let x, y;
    if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
      x = e.touches[0].clientX;
      y = e.touches[0].clientY;
    } else {
      x = e.clientX;
      y = e.clientY;
    }
    return { x: x - rect.left, y: y - rect.top };
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    const p = pointerPos(e);
    G.hand.tx = p.x;
    G.hand.ty = p.y;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = pointerPos(e);
    G.hand.tx = p.x;
    G.hand.ty = p.y;
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (G.phase === 'menu') startGame();
    else if (G.phase === 'won' || G.phase === 'lost') startGame();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (G.phase === 'menu') startGame();
    else if (G.phase === 'won' || G.phase === 'lost') startGame();
    else {
      const p = pointerPos(e);
      G.hand.tx = p.x;
      G.hand.ty = p.y;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  function startGame() {
    initBalls();
    G.phase = 'playing';
    G.startT = performance.now();
    G.lastTime = performance.now();
  }

  // ===== Update =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (G.phase !== 'playing') return;

    // Timer
    G.timeLeft -= dt;
    if (G.timeLeft <= 0) {
      G.timeLeft = 0;
      G.phase = 'won';
      return;
    }

    // Hand follows target with smoothing
    const hx = G.hand.tx, hy = G.hand.ty;
    G.hand.x += (hx - G.hand.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
    G.hand.y += (hy - G.hand.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);

    // Clamp hand
    G.hand.x = Math.max(40, Math.min(W - 40, G.hand.x));
    G.hand.y = Math.max(H * 0.35, Math.min(H - 40, G.hand.y));

    // Balls physics
    for (let i = 0; i < G.balls.length; i++) {
      const b = G.balls[i];
      b.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.angle += b.spin * dt;

      // Wall bounces
      if (b.x < b.r) { b.x = b.r; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.85; }
      if (b.x > W - b.r) { b.x = W - b.r; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * 0.85; }
      if (b.y < b.r) { b.y = b.r; b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy) * 0.6; }

      // Floor -> drop
      if (b.y > H - b.r) {
        G.phase = 'lost';
        G.shake = 12;
        return;
      }

      // Hand catch: if ball falls into hand area
      const dx = b.x - G.hand.x;
      const dy = b.y - G.hand.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < b.r + 38 && b.vy > 0) {
        // Catch! Give it a new upward velocity with a slight random spread
        const angle = -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
        const speed = 780 + Math.random() * 140;
        b.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
        b.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
        b.y = G.hand.y - b.r - 30;
        b.spin = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
        G.score += 10;
        G.shake = 4;

        // Spawn a little sparkle trail
        for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
          G.trail.push({
            x: b.x, y: b.y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200 - 60,
            life: 0.6,
            color: b.color
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Update trail particles
    for (let i = G.trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = G.trail[i];
      t.life -= dt;
      if (t.life <= 0) { G.trail.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      t.x += t.vx * dt;
      t.y += t.vy * dt;
      t.vy += 400 * dt;
    }

    // Decay shake
    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake *= 0.85;
  }

  // ===== Draw helpers =====
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#1a1f3a');
    sky.addColorStop(0.5, '#2b2f5e');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#1a1f3a');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stage floor
    const floor = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.85, 0, H);
    floor.addColorStop(0, '#2a2d4a');
    floor.addColorStop(1, '#15172a');
    ctx.fillStyle = floor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.85, W, H * 0.15);

    // Floor line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.85);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H * 0.85);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Spotlights
    const spot = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.2, 0, W/2, H*0.2, H*0.6);
    spot.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,100,0.12)');
    spot.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,100,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = spot;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Audience silhouettes
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const x = (i / 20) * W + 20;
      const y = H * 0.92;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 18, Math.PI, 0);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawHand() {
    const x = G.hand.x, y = G.hand.y;
    // Glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 60);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,100,0.25)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,100,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 60, y - 60, 120, 120);

    // Open palm (simple hand shape)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f4c98a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    // Palm
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 32, 28, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Fingers
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e0b070';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const fingers = [
      [-22, -22], [-8, -28], [8, -28], [22, -22]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < fingers.length; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + fingers[i][0] * 0.5, y - 18);
      ctx.lineTo(x + fingers[i][0], y + fingers[i][1]);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Thumb
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 25, y + 5);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 45, y - 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Catch zone indicator (subtle)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  function drawBall(b) {
    // Shadow on floor
    const floorY = H * 0.85;
    const shadowScale = Math.max(0.2, 1 - (floorY - b.y) / (H * 0.5));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(b.x, floorY, b.r * shadowScale, b.r * 0.3 * shadowScale, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Ball body
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x - b.r * 0.3, b.y - b.r * 0.3, b.r * 0.1, b.x, b.y, b.r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    grad.addColorStop(0.3, b.color);
    grad.addColorStop(1, shade(b.color, -40));
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Spin stripes
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.rotate(b.angle);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x - b.r * 0.3, b.y - b.r * 0.35, b.r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function shade(hex, amt) {
    let c = hex.replace('#', '');
    let r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16);
    let g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16);
    let b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16);
    r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r + amt));
    g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g + amt));
    b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b + amt));
    return '#' + r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0') + g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0') + b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  function drawTrail() {
    for (let i = 0; i < G.trail.length; i++) {
      const t = G.trail[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, t.life / 0.6) * 0.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 4 * (t.life / 0.6), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Timer
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(G.timeLeft));
    ctx.fillStyle = t <= 10 ? '#ff5252' : '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(t, W / 2, 60);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd740';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + G.score, 30, 50);

    // Timer bar
    const barW = W * 0.5;
    const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
    const barY = 80;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
    roundRect(barX, barY, barW, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    const frac = G.timeLeft / 60;
    ctx.fillStyle = frac > 0.3 ? '#40c4ff' : '#ff5252';
    roundRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawMenu() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd740';
    ctx.font = 'bold 56px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('JUGGLE RUSH', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Keep all 3 balls in the air for 60 seconds', W / 2, H * 0.42);
    ctx.fillText('Move your mouse (or finger) to catch them', W / 2, H * 0.5);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#40c4ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click / Tap to Start', W / 2, H * 0.65);

    // Decorative balls
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const bx = W / 2 + (i - 1) * 80;
      const by = H * 0.75;
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx - 6, by - 6, 2, bx, by, 22);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
      grad.addColorStop(0.3, BALL_COLORS[i]);
      grad.addColorStop(1, shade(BALL_COLORS[i], -40));
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawEnd(won) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#40c4ff' : '#ff5252';
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(won ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'DROPPED!', W / 2, H * 0.35);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd740';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + G.score, W / 2, H * 0.5);

    if (won) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = '24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('You juggled for a full minute!', W / 2, H * 0.6);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = '24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Time survived: ' + Math.floor(60 - G.timeLeft) + 's', W / 2, H * 0.6);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#40c4ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click / Tap to Play Again', W / 2, H * 0.75);
  }

  // ===== Draw =====
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (G.shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawTrail();
    drawHand();
    for (let i = 0; i < G.balls.length; i++) {
      drawBall(G.balls[i]);
    }

    if (G.phase === 'playing') {
      drawHUD();
    } else if (G.phase === 'menu') {
      drawMenu();
    } else if (G.phase === 'won') {
      drawHUD();
      drawEnd(true);
    } else if (G.phase === 'lost') {
      drawHUD();
      drawEnd(false);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ===== Loop =====
  function loop(now) {
    if (G.lastTime === 0) G.lastTime = now;

  const COLOR_NAMES = ["Pink", "Orange", "Green", "Blue"];

  // ---------- State ----------
  let state = "menu";

    }
    if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();

  function beep(freq, dur, type, vol) {
    if (!audioCtx) return;
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();

    o.frequency.value = freq;

    g.connect(audioCtx.destination);

    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.12, t + 0.02);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    o.start(t);
    o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
  }
  function sfxPlace() { beep(520 + selected * 40, 0.12, "triangle", 0.10); }
  function sfxWin() { [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => beep(f, 0.18, "triangle", 0.14), i * 90)); }
  function sfxLose() { [420, 300, 200].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => beep(f, 0.25, "sawtooth", 0.10), i * 120)); }

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function shuffle(a) {
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }
  function makePattern() {
    const counts = shuffle([1, 1, 2, 2]);
    const arr = [];
    counts.forEach((c, ci) => { for (let k = 0; k < c; k++) arr.push(ci); });

  }

        r: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
