  }

  function drawTargetBoard() {
    const m = boardMetrics();
    const tSize = m.size * 0.5;
    const tx = m.x + (m.size - tSize) / 2;
    const ty = m.y + (m.size - tSize) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9a7b85";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.035, 22) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Copy this", tx + tSize / 2, ty - 12);
    drawBoard(tx, ty, tSize, target, true);
  }

  function drawPlayerBoard() {
    const m = boardMetrics();
    const pSize = m.size * 0.5;
    const px = m.x + (m.size + pSize) / 2;
    const py = m.y + (m.size - pSize) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9a7b85";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.035, 22) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Your copy", px + pSize / 2, py - 12);
    drawBoard(px, py, pSize, player, true);

    if (state === "play" && hover >= 0) {
      const c = cellCenter(hover, pSize, px, py);
      const cell = pSize / GRID;
      const inset = cell * 0.08;
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS[selected];
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      roundRect(c.x - cell / 2 + inset, c.y - cell / 2 + inset, cell - inset * 2, cell - inset * 2, cell * 0.22);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawArrow() {
    const m = boardMetrics();
    const ax = m.x + m.size * 0.5;
    const ay = m.y + m.size * 0.5;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffb03a";
    const s = Math.min(W, H) * 0.03;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ax - s, ay - s * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(ax + s * 0.6, ay);
    ctx.lineTo(ax - s, ay + s * 0.6);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPalette() {
    const bw = Math.min(W * 0.7, 520);
    const bh = 64;
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const by = H * 0.80;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.12)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    const slot = bw / COLORS.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < COLORS.length; i++) {
      const cx = bx + slot * i + slot / 2;
      const cy = by + bh / 2;
      const r = Math.min(slot * 0.28, 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[i];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (i === selected) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#5b3b45";
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, r + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9a7b85";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = Math.min(W * 0.03, 16) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Pick a color, then tap a square", W / 2, by - 10);
  }

  function drawCheckButton() {
    const bw = Math.min(W * 0.5, 300);
    const bh = 56;
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const by = H * 0.72;
    const on = hover === 0;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? "#2bb583" : "#35c48f";
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.05, 26) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Check my copy", W / 2, by + bh / 2);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  }

  function drawStartButton() {
    const bw = Math.min(W * 0.5, 300);
    const bh = 56;
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const by = H * 0.72;
    const on = hover === 0;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? "#ff8a4d" : "#ffb03a";
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5b3b45";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.05, 26) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Play", W / 2, by + bh / 2);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  }

  function drawOverlayCard(title, subtitle, btnText, btnColor) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(40,25,30,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const cw = Math.min(W * 0.8, 420);
    const ch = Math.min(H * 0.6, 320);
    const cx = (W - cw) / 2;
    const cy = (H - ch) / 2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fffaf5";
    roundRect(cx, cy, cw, ch, 24);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5b3b45";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.07, 40) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, cy + ch * 0.32);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9a7b85";
    ctx.font = Math.min(W * 0.04, 22) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, cy + ch * 0.5);

    const bw = Math.min(cw * 0.6, 240);
    const bh = 50;
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const by = cy + ch * 0.66;
    const on = hover === 0;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? shade(btnColor, -12) : btnColor;
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 14);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(W * 0.045, 24) + "px Comic Sans MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(btnText, W / 2, by + bh / 2);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  }

  function shade(hex, amt) {
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    let r = (n >> 16) + amt, g = ((n >> 8) & 255) + amt, b = (n & 255) + amt;
    r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r));
    g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g));
    b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b));
    return "#" + ((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1);
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawConfetti() {
    for (const c of confetti) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, c.life);
      ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
      ctx.rotate(c.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = c.c;
      ctx.fillRect(-c.r / 2, -c.r / 2, c.r, c.r * 0.6);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawTitle();

    if (state === "play") {
      drawHud();
      drawTargetBoard();
      drawArrow();
      drawPlayerBoard();
      drawPalette();
      drawCheckButton();
      drawParticles();
    } else if (state === "menu") {
      drawParticles();
      drawStartButton();
    } else if (state === "win") {
      drawHud();
      drawConfetti();
      drawOverlayCard("You got it!", "Score: " + score, "Next pattern", "#35c48f");
    } else if (state === "over") {
      drawHud();
      drawConfetti();
      drawOverlayCard("Great try!", "You scored " + score, "Play again", "#ffb03a");
    }

    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = flashColor;
      ctx.globalAlpha = flash;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Rounded rect ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Best of Five!</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #222;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    background: #000;
    max-width: 100vw;
    max-height: 100vh;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
/* ====== STATE ====== */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const GAME = {
  state: 'start',        // 'start' | 'playing' | 'over'
  you: 0,
  cpu: 0,
  target: 3,            // first to 3 points wins the match
  winner: '',
  matchCount: 0,
  shake: 0,
  t: 0                 // global clock
};

const BALL = {
  x: W / 2, y: H / 2,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  r: 12,
  trail: []           // array of recent positions
};

const PADDLE_W = 20;
const PADDLE_H = 110;
const PADDLE_SPEED = 520;

const YOU = { y: H / 2 - PADDLE_H / 2, vy: 0, color: '#37c8ff' };
const CPU = { y: H / 2 - PADDLE_H / 2, vy: 0, color: '#ff5c8a' };

const STARS = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
  STARS.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H,
                s: Math.random() * 1.8 + 0.4, tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
}

const POP = [];        // floating score popups
const SPARKS = [];     // small celebration particles

/* ====== INPUT ====== */
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (GAME.state === 'start' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    startGame();
  } else if (GAME.state === 'over' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    startGame();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// Mouse / touch: move your paddle to follow the pointer's vertical position
function pointerY(clientY) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scale = H / rect.height;
  return (clientY - rect.top) * scale;
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    YOU.y = pointerY(e.clientY) - PADDLE_H / 2;
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    e.preventDefault();
    YOU.y = pointerY(e.touches[0].clientY) - PADDLE_H / 2;
  }
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (GAME.state === 'start' || GAME.state === 'over') startGame();
});

/* ====== HELPERS ====== */
function startGame() {
  GAME.you = 0;
  GAME.cpu = 0;
  GAME.winner = '';
  GAME.matchCount++;
  GAME.state = 'playing';
  GAME.shake = 0;
  YOU.y = H / 2 - PADDLE_H / 2;
  CPU.y = H / 2 - PADDLE_H / 2;
  POP.length = 0;
  SPARKS.length = 0;
  serve();
}

function serve() {
  BALL.x = W / 2;
  BALL.y = H / 2;
  const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
  const speed = 360;
  const ang = (Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25);
  BALL.vx = dir * Math.cos(ang) * speed;
  BALL.vy = Math.sin(ang) * speed;
  BALL.trail.length = 0;
}

function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }

function addPop(x, y, text, color) {
  POP.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 1 });
}

function burst(x, y, color, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = Math.random() * 220 + 60;
    SPARKS.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
                   life: 1, color });
  }
}

/* ====== UPDATE ====== */
function update(dt) {
  GAME.t += dt;

  // move your paddle with arrow keys / W-S
  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    let dy = 0;
    if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) dy -= 1;
    if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) dy += 1;
    YOU.y += dy * PADDLE_SPEED * dt;
  }

  // CPU paddle: tracks the ball with a little lag, only when ball is heading its way
  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    const target = (BALL.vx > 0) ? BALL.y : H / 2;
    const diff = target - (CPU.y + PADDLE_H / 2);
    const cpuSpeed = 300;
    CPU.y += clamp(diff, -cpuSpeed * dt, cpuSpeed * dt);
  }

  // keep paddles on screen
  YOU.y = clamp(YOU.y, 0, H - PADDLE_H);
  CPU.y = clamp(CPU.y, 0, H - PADDLE_H);

  // move the ball + record trail
  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    BALL.x += BALL.vx * dt;
    BALL.y += BALL.vy * dt;
    BALL.trail.push({ x: BALL.x, y: BALL.y });
    if (BALL.trail.length > 14) BALL.trail.shift();

    // top / bottom walls
    if (BALL.y - BALL.r < 0) { BALL.y = BALL.r; BALL.vy *= -1; }
    if (BALL.y + BALL.r > H) { BALL.y = H - BALL.r; BALL.vy *= -1; }

    // left paddle (you)
    const youX = 40;
    if (BALL.vx < 0 &&
        BALL.x - BALL.r <= youX + PADDLE_W &&
        BALL.x + BALL.r >= youX &&
        BALL.y >= YOU.y - BALL.r && BALL.y <= YOU.y + PADDLE_H + BALL.r) {
      BALL.x = youX + PADDLE_W + BALL.r;
      bounceOffPaddle(BALL, YOU, 1);
      GAME.shake = 8;
    }

    // right paddle (cpu)
    const cpuX = W - 40 - PADDLE_W;
    if (BALL.vx > 0 &&
        BALL.x + BALL.r >= cpuX &&
        BALL.x - BALL.r <= cpuX + PADDLE_W &&
        BALL.y >= CPU.y - BALL.r && BALL.y <= CPU.y + PADDLE_H + BALL.r) {
      BALL.x = cpuX - BALL.r;
      bounceOffPaddle(BALL, CPU, -1);
      GAME.shake = 8;
    }

    // scoring
    if (BALL.x + BALL.r < 0) {
      GAME.cpu++;
      addPop(W * 0.3, H / 2, 'CPU +1', CPU.color);
      burst(W * 0.3, H / 2, CPU.color, 24);
      GAME.shake = 14;
      checkWin();
      if (GAME.state === 'playing') serve();
    } else if (BALL.x - BALL.r > W) {
      GAME.you++;
      addPop(W * 0.7, H / 2, 'YOU +1', YOU.color);
      burst(W * 0.7, H / 2, YOU.color, 24);
      GAME.shake = 14;
      checkWin();
      if (GAME.state === 'playing') serve();
    }
  }

  // decay shake
  GAME.shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt);
  if (GAME.shake < 0.3) GAME.shake = 0;

  // update popups
  for (let i = POP.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    POP[i].life -= dt * 0.9;
    POP[i].y -= dt * 40;
    if (POP[i].life <= 0) POP.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // update sparks
  for (let i = SPARKS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = SPARKS[i];
    s.x += s.vx * dt;
    s.y += s.vy * dt;
    s.vy += dt * 200;
    s.life -= dt * 1.3;
    if (s.life <= 0) SPARKS.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function bounceOffPaddle(ball, paddle, dir) {
  // angle based on where the ball hits the paddle
  const rel = (ball.y - (paddle.y + PADDLE_H / 2)) / (PADDLE_H / 2);
  const maxAng = 0.9;
  const ang = rel * maxAng;
  const speed = Math.min(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.05, 780);
  ball.vx = dir * Math.cos(ang) * speed;
  ball.vy = Math.sin(ang) * speed;
}

function checkWin() {
  if (GAME.you >= GAME.target) { GAME.winner = 'YOU'; GAME.state = 'over'; }
  else if (GAME.cpu >= GAME.target) { GAME.winner = 'CPU'; GAME.state = 'over'; }
}

/* ====== DRAW ====== */
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (GAME.shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * GAME.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * GAME.shake);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawField();

  if (GAME.state === 'playing') {
    drawTrail();
    drawPaddle(40, YOU, YOU.color);
    drawPaddle(W - 40 - PADDLE_W, CPU, CPU.color);
    drawBall();
  }

  drawScoreboard();
  drawPopups();
  drawSparks();

  if (GAME.state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (GAME.state === 'over') drawOverScreen();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1b2a52');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a1e54');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#123a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // twinkling stars
  for (const st of STARS) {
    const a = 0.4 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(GAME.t * 2 + st.tw));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(st.x, st.y, st.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // soft glowing orb behind center
  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 20, W / 2, H / 2, 320);
  rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,90,220,0.25)');
  rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,90,220,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawField() {
  // play area border
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(20, 20, W - 40, H - 40);

  // dashed center line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.setLineDash([14, 16]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 24);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 24);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // center circle
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, 55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawPaddle(x, p, color) {
  const glow = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + PADDLE_W, 0);
  glow.addColorStop(0, color);
  glow.addColorStop(1, shade(color, -40));
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  roundRect(x, p.y, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  // highlight stripe
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
  roundRect(x + 4, p.y + 8, 5, PADDLE_H - 16, 3);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBall() {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(BALL.x - 4, BALL.y - 4, 2, BALL.x, BALL.y, BALL.r);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#ffd24a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(BALL.x, BALL.y, BALL.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawTrail() {
  for (let i = 0; i < BALL.trail.length; i++) {
    const t = BALL.trail[i];
    const a = (i / BALL.trail.length) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, BALL.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * i / BALL.trail.length), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawScoreboard() {
  // top center score
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = YOU.color;
  ctx.fillText(GAME.you, W / 2 - 55, 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('–', W / 2, 60);
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = CPU.color;
  ctx.fillText(GAME.cpu, W / 2 + 55, 60);

  // labels
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = YOU.color;
  ctx.fillText('YOU', W / 2 - 55, 95);
  ctx.fillStyle = CPU.color;
  ctx.fillText('CPU', W / 2 + 55, 95);

  // "best of five" dots (3 needed to win)
  drawDots(W / 2 - 55, 120, GAME.you, YOU.color);
  drawDots(W / 2 + 55, 120, GAME.cpu, CPU.color);
}

function drawDots(cx, y, count, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME.target; i++) {
    const x = cx - (GAME.target - 1) * 12 + i * 24;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = i < count ? color : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPopups() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  for (const p of POP) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life, 0, 1);
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawSparks() {
  for (const s of SPARKS) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(s.life, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  overlay(0.6);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const pulse = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(GAME.t * 3);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
  ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.fillText('BEST OF FIVE!', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('First to 3 points wins the match!', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);

  ctx.font = '20px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  ctx.fillText('Move with the mouse, or Arrow keys / W & S', W / 2, H / 2 + 65);

  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = YOU.color;
  ctx.fillText('Click or press SPACE to play!', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);
}

function drawOverScreen() {
  overlay(0.65);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  const win = GAME.winner === 'YOU';
  ctx.font = 'bold 60px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = win ? '#5dff9b' : '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.fillText(win ? 'YOU WIN! 🎉' : 'CPU WINS', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

  ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(GAME.you + '  –  ' + GAME.cpu, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

  ctx.font = '22px "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.fillText('Match #' + GAME.matchCount + '  •  Click or press SPACE to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);

  // little celebration sparks
  if (win && Math.random() < 0.3) {
    burst(Math.random() * W, Math.random() * H * 0.5, ['#ffd24a', '#5dff9b', '#37c8ff'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)], 6);
  }
}

function overlay(a) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,8,30,' + a + ')';
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
}

/* ====== SMALL UTILS ====== */
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function shade(hex, amt) {
  const c = hex.replace('#', '');
  const r = clamp(parseInt(c.substr(0, 2), 16) + amt, 0, 255);
  const g = clamp(parseInt(c.substr(2, 2), 16) + amt, 0, 255);
  const b = clamp(parseInt(c.substr(4, 2), 16) + amt, 0, 255);
  return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ')';
}

/* ====== MAIN LOOP ====== */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0c29';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('START', W / 2, 332);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawPlayingScreen() {
    drawBackground();

    // Score and lives
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 35);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
    let hearts = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += '\u2665 ';
    ctx.fillText(hearts, W - 20, 35);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0a0c0';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Puzzle ' + (totalSolved + 1) + ' of ' + TOTAL_TARGET, W / 2, 35);

    // Clue
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Clue: ' + currentWord.clue, W / 2, 95);

    // Slots
    const slotW = 60;
    const slotH = 60;
    const slotGap = 12;
    const totalSlotW = slots.length * slotW + (slots.length - 1) * slotGap;
    const slotStartX = (W - totalSlotW) / 2;
    const slotY = 140;

    for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
      const sx = slotStartX + i * (slotW + slotGap);
      const isSelected = (i === selectedSlot);

      if (isSelected) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
        roundRect(sx - 3, slotY - 3, slotW + 6, slotH + 6, 10);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = isSelected ? '#1a3a3a' : '#2a2a4a';
      roundRect(sx, slotY, slotW, slotH, 8);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.strokeStyle = isSelected ? '#4ecdc4' : '#555577';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      roundRect(sx, slotY, slotW, slotH, 8);
      ctx.stroke();

      if (slots[i].letter) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(slots[i].letter, sx + slotW / 2, slotY + slotH / 2 + 11);
      }
    }

    // Letter bank
    const bankW = 50;
    const bankH = 50;
    const bankGap = 10;
    const totalBankW = letterBank.length * bankW + (letterBank.length - 1) * bankGap;
    const bankStartX = (W - totalBankW) / 2;
    const bankY = 250;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0a0c0';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Letter Bank', W / 2, bankY - 15);

    for (let i = 0; i < letterBank.length; i++) {
      const bx = bankStartX + i * (bankW + bankGap);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a5a';
      roundRect(bx, bankY, bankW, bankH, 8);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#666688';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      roundRect(bx, bankY, bankW, bankH, 8);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
      ctx.font = 'bold 28px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(letterBank[i], bx + bankW / 2, bankY + bankH / 2 + 10);
    }

    // Message
    if (messageTimer > 0 && message) {
      ctx.fillStyle = messageColor;
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(message, W / 2, 350);
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
  }

  function drawGameOverScreen() {
    drawBackground();

    const won = totalSolved >= TOTAL_TARGET;

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#4ecdc4' : '#ff6b6b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText(won ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'GAME OVER', W / 2, 120);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e0ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillText('Puzzles Solved: ' + totalSolved + ' / ' + TOTAL_TARGET, W / 2, 215);

    if (won) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
      ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('You completed all ' + TOTAL_TARGET + ' puzzles!', W / 2, 255);
    }

    // Restart button
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#4ecdc4' : '#ff6b6b';
    roundRect(W / 2 - 100, 320, 200, 50, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0c29';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PLAY AGAIN', W / 2, 352);

    // Particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (gamePhase === 'start') {
      drawStartScreen();
    } else if (gamePhase === 'playing') {
      drawPlayingScreen();
    } else if (gamePhase === 'gameover') {
      drawGameOverScreen();
    }
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  gameLoop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hex Color Guesser</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
// ===================== STATE =====================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

let gameState = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'result'
let score = 0;
let timeLeft = 60;
let currentColor = null;
let lastTime = 0;
let particles = [];
let flashTimer = 0;
let flashColor = '#ffffff';
let hoverIndex = -1;
let message = '';
let messageTimer = 0;
let correctFlash = 0;
let wrongFlash = 0;
let combo = 0;
let bestCombo = 0;

const SWATCHES_PER_ROW = 4;
const SWATCHES_PER_GRID = 16;
const SWATCH_SIZE = 64;
const SWATCH_GAP = 12;
const GRID_X = (W - (SWATCHES_PER_ROW * (SWATCH_SIZE + SWATCH_GAP) - SWATCH_GAP)) / 2;
const GRID_Y = 200;

const swatchRects = [];
for (let i = 0; i < SWATCHES_PER_GRID; i++) {
  const row = Math.floor(i / SWATCHES_PER_ROW);
  const col = i % SWATCHES_PER_ROW;
  swatchRects.push({
    x: GRID_X + col * (SWATCH_SIZE + SWATCH_GAP),
    y: GRID_Y + row * (SWATCH_SIZE + SWATCH_GAP),
    w: SWATCH_SIZE,
    h: SWATCH_SIZE
  });
}

// ===================== HELPERS =====================
function randomHex() {
  const n = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x1000000);
  return '#' + n.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
}

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3), 16);
  const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5), 16);
  const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7), 16);
  return { r, g, b };
}

function rgbToHex(r, g, b) {
  return '#' + [r, g, b].map(v => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

function colorDistance(c1, c2) {
  const a = hexToRgb(c1);
  const b = hexToRgb(c2);
  return Math.sqrt((a.r-b.r)**2 + (a.g-b.g)**2 + (a.b-b.b)**2);
}

function lightenColor(hex, amount) {
  const c = hexToRgb(hex);
  return rgbToHex(c.r + amount, c.g + amount, c.b + amount);
}

function darkenColor(hex, amount) {
  return lightenColor(hex, -amount);
}

function generateSwatches(target) {
  const swatches = [];
  const c = hexToRgb(target);
  const used = [target];

  // Exact match
  swatches.push(target);

  // Near misses (small perturbations)
  for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    let s;
    do {
      const dr = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 15;
      const dg = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 15;
      const db = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) - 15;
      s = rgbToHex(c.r + dr, c.g + dg, c.b + db);
    } while (used.includes(s));
    used.push(s);
    swatches.push(s);
  }

  // Medium differences
  for (let i = 6; i < 10; i++) {
    let s;
    do {
      const dr = Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) - 40;
      const dg = Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) - 40;
      const db = Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) - 40;
      s = rgbToHex(c.r + dr, c.g + dg, c.b + db);
    } while (used.includes(s));
    used.push(s);
    swatches.push(s);
  }

  // Far colors
  for (let i = 10; i < SWATCHES_PER_GRID; i++) {
    let s;
    do {
      s = randomHex();
    } while (used.includes(s));
    used.push(s);
    swatches.push(s);
  }

  // Shuffle
  for (let i = swatches.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [swatches[i], swatches[j]] = [swatches[j], swatches[i]];
  }

  return swatches;
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 4;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.025,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 5,
      color
    });
  }
}

function newRound() {
  currentColor = randomHex();
  const swatches = generateSwatches(currentColor);
  swatchRects.forEach((rect, i) => {
    rect.color = swatches[i];
    rect.isCorrect = swatches[i] === currentColor;
  });
}

// ===================== INPUT =====================
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  hoverIndex = -1;
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    swatchRects.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (mx >= r.x && mx <= r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my <= r.y + r.h) {
        hoverIndex = i;
      }
    });
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);

  if (gameState === 'start') {
    gameState = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    timeLeft = 60;
    combo = 0;
    bestCombo = 0;
    particles = [];
    newRound();
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'result') {
    gameState = 'start';
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    swatchRects.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (mx >= r.x && mx <= r.x + r.w && my >= r.y && my <= r.y + r.h) {
        if (r.isCorrect) {
          score += 10;
          combo++;
          if (combo > bestCombo) bestCombo = combo;
          correctFlash = 1;
          message = 'Correct! +' + (10 + (combo > 1 ? combo * 2 : 0));
          messageTimer = 1.5;
          const cx = r.x + r.w / 2;
          const cy = r.y + r.h / 2;
          spawnParticles(cx, cy, r.color, 20);
          if (combo > 1) score += combo * 2;
          newRound();
        } else {
          combo = 0;
          wrongFlash = 1;
          message = 'Wrong!';
          messageTimer = 1;
          const cx = r.x + r.w / 2;
          const cy = r.y + r.h / 2;
          spawnParticles(cx, cy, '#ff4444', 10);
          newRound();
        }
      }
    });
  }
});

// ===================== UPDATE =====================
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    timeLeft -= dt;
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
      timeLeft = 0;
      gameState = 'result';
    }
  }

  if (messageTimer > 0) messageTimer -= dt;
  if (correctFlash > 0) correctFlash -= dt * 3;
  if (wrongFlash > 0) wrongFlash -= dt * 3;

  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= p.decay;
  });
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

// ===================== DRAW =====================
function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0f3460');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a2e');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle grid pattern
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Decorative circles
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const cx = 100 + i * 160;
    const cy = 50 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001 + i) * 20;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 30 + i * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = ['#ff6b6b','#feca57','#48dbfb','#ff9ff3','#54a0ff'][i];
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawTargetColor() {
  if (!currentColor) return;

  // Target label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Match this color:', W / 2, 40);

  // Target swatch
  const tw = 120, th = 70;
  const tx = W / 2 - tw / 2;
  const ty = 55;

  // Glow
  ctx.shadowColor = currentColor;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
  ctx.fillStyle = currentColor;
  roundRect(ctx, tx, ty, tw, th, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Border
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(ctx, tx, ty, tw, th, 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Hex code below target
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Click the matching swatch below', W / 2, ty + th + 22);
}

function drawSwatches() {
  swatchRects.forEach((r, i) => {
    const isHover = (i === hoverIndex);
    const scale = isHover ? 1.08 : 1;
    const cx = r.x + r.w / 2;
    const cy = r.y + r.h / 2;
    const sw = r.w * scale;
    const sh = r.h * scale;
    const sx = cx - sw / 2;
    const sy = cy - sh / 2;

    // Shadow
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = isHover ? 15 : 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = isHover ? 4 : 2;

    // Swatch fill
    ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
    roundRect(ctx, sx, sy, sw, sh, 10);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

    // Border
    ctx.strokeStyle = isHover ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isHover ? 3 : 1.5;
    roundRect(ctx, sx, sy, sw, sh, 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Inner highlight
    const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + sh * 0.4);
    ig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)');
    ig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = ig;
    roundRect(ctx, sx, sy, sw, sh * 0.4, 10);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 30, 45);

  // Timer bar
  const barW = 200;
  const barH = 14;
  const barX = W - barW - 30;
  const barY = 30;
  const pct = timeLeft / 60;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  roundRect(ctx, barX, barY, barW, barH, 7);
  ctx.fill();

  const timerColor = pct > 0.5 ? '#4ecdc4' : pct > 0.25 ? '#feca57' : '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  roundRect(ctx, barX, barY, barW * pct, barH, 7);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timeLeft) + 's', W - 30, barY + barH + 20);

  // Combo
  if (combo > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Combo x' + combo, 30, 75);
  }
}

function drawMessage() {
  if (messageTimer <= 0) return;
  const alpha = Math.min(1, messageTimer / 0.3);
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = message.startsWith('Correct') ? '#4ecdc4' : '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  const y = 170 - (1 - alpha) * 20;
  ctx.fillText(message, W / 2, y);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFlash() {
  if (correctFlash > 0) {

function hslToRgb(h, s, l) {

function gameLoop(timestamp) {

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sprite Sheet Clicker</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border: 3px solid #e94560;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: crosshair;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(233,69,96,0.3);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// ============ STATE ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let score = 0;
let combo = 0;
let maxCombo = 0;
let timeLeft = 30;
let gameState = 'start'; // start, playing, won, lost
let frames = [];
let particles = [];
let shakeAmount = 0;
let lastClickTime = 0;
let scoreDisplay = 0;
let targetScore = 50;
let flashAlpha = 0;
let framePulse = 0;

// Frame positions on the sheet
const FRAME_SIZE = 64;
const COLS = 8;
const ROWS = 5;
const SHEET_X = 100;
const SHEET_Y = 80;
const SHEET_W = COLS * FRAME_SIZE;
const SHEET_H = ROWS * FRAME_SIZE;

// Colors
const COLORS = {
  bg: '#1a1a2e',
  sheet: '#16213e',
  sheetBorder: '#0f3460',
  frame: '#e94560',
  frameHover: '#ff6b8a',
  frameHit: '#ffd93d',
  text: '#ffffff',
  accent: '#e94560',
  accent2: '#ffd93d',
  accent3: '#4ecdc4',
  accent4: '#a855f7',
  grid: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
  glow: 'rgba(233,69,96,0.2)'
};

// ============ FRAME OBJECTS ============
function createFrames() {
  frames = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      frames.push({
        x: SHEET_X + c * FRAME_SIZE,
        y: SHEET_Y + r * FRAME_SIZE,
        row: r,
        col: c,
        active: true,
        hitTime: 0,
        hover: false,
        color: getFrameColor(r, c),
        shape: (r + c) % 4
      });
    }
  }
}

function getFrameColor(r, c) {
  const palette = [COLORS.accent, COLORS.accent2, COLORS.accent3, COLORS.accent4];
  return palette[(r * COLS + c) % palette.length];
}

// ============ PARTICLES ============
function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
      color: color
    });
  }
}

// ============ INPUT ============
let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
  const cy = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);

  if (gameState === 'start') {
    gameState = 'playing';
    timeLeft = 30;
    score = 0;
    combo = 0;
    maxCombo = 0;
    createFrames();
    return;
  }

  if (gameState === 'won' || gameState === 'lost') {
    gameState = 'start';
    return;
  }

  if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - lastClickTime < 100) return;
  lastClickTime = now;

  // Check if click hit a frame
  let hit = false;
  for (let f of frames) {
    if (!f.active) continue;
    if (cx >= f.x && cx < f.x + FRAME_SIZE && cy >= f.y && cy < f.y + FRAME_SIZE) {
      f.active = false;
      f.hitTime = now;
      hit = true;
      combo++;
      maxCombo = Math.max(maxCombo, combo);
      const points = combo >= 5 ? 5 : combo >= 3 ? 3 : 1;
      score += points;
      flashAlpha = 0.3;
      shakeAmount = 3;
      spawnParticles(f.x + FRAME_SIZE / 2, f.y + FRAME_SIZE / 2, f.color, 8 + combo);
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!hit) {
    combo = 0;
    shakeAmount = 1;
  }

  // Check win
  if (score >= targetScore) {
    gameState = 'won';
    spawnParticles(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2, COLORS.accent2, 50);
  }
});

// ============ UPDATE ============
let lastTime = 0;
let timerAccum = 0;

function update(dt) {
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    timerAccum += dt;
    if (timerAccum >= 1) {
      timerAccum -= 1;
      timeLeft--;
      if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        timeLeft = 0;
        gameState = 'lost';
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Decay effects
  shakeAmount *= 0.85;
  flashAlpha *= 0.9;
  framePulse += dt * 3;

  // Score display lerp
  scoreDisplay += (score - scoreDisplay) * 0.15;

  // Hover detection
  for (let f of frames) {
    f.hover = f.active && mouseX >= f.x && mouseX < f.x + FRAME_SIZE && mouseY >= f.y && mouseY < f.y + FRAME_SIZE;
  }
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Shake
  if (shakeAmount > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate(
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount
    );
  }

  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(-10, -10, canvas.width + 20, canvas.height + 20);

  // Background grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.grid;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Flash overlay
  if (flashAlpha > 0.01) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(233,69,96,${flashAlpha})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  }

  // Draw sprite sheet
  drawSheet();

  // Draw particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Overlays
  if (gameState === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (gameState === 'won') drawWinScreen();
  if (gameState === 'lost') drawLoseScreen();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSheet() {
  // Sheet background
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.sheet;
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.sheetBorder;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  roundRect(SHEET_X - 8, SHEET_Y - 8, SHEET_W + 16, SHEET_H + 16, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Sheet title
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent3;
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('sprite_walk_01.png', SHEET_X, SHEET_Y - 16);

  // Draw frames
  for (let f of frames) {
    if (!f.active) {
      // Hit frame - show faded
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
      ctx.fillRect(f.x + 2, f.y + 2, FRAME_SIZE - 4, FRAME_SIZE - 4);
      continue;
    }

    const pulse = Math.sin(framePulse + f.row * 0.5 + f.col * 0.3) * 0.15;
    const baseAlpha = 0.6 + pulse + (f.hover ? 0.3 : 0);

    // Frame background
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = baseAlpha;
    ctx.fillRect(f.x + 2, f.y + 2, FRAME_SIZE - 4, FRAME_SIZE - 4);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Frame border
    ctx.strokeStyle = f.hover ? COLORS.frameHover : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = f.hover ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(f.x + 2, f.y + 2, FRAME_SIZE - 4, FRAME_SIZE - 4);

    // Draw simple character shape in each frame
    drawCharacter(f, baseAlpha);
  }
}

function drawCharacter(f, alpha) {
  const cx = f.x + FRAME_SIZE / 2;
  const cy = f.y + FRAME_SIZE / 2;
  const t = framePulse + f.row * 0.8 + f.col * 0.4;
  const bob = Math.sin(t) * 3;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy + bob);
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  const c = f.color;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.fillRect(-8, -4, 16, 20);

  // Head
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -12, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fillRect(-4, -14, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(2, -14, 3, 3);

  // Legs (animated)
  const legSwing = Math.sin(t * 2) * 5;
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.fillRect(-6, 16, 4, 10 + legSwing);
  ctx.fillRect(2, 16, 4, 10 - legSwing);

  // Arms
  const armSwing = Math.cos(t * 2) * 4;
  ctx.fillRect(-14, 0, 4, 12 + armSwing);
  ctx.fillRect(10, 0, 4, 12 - armSwing);

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + Math.round(scoreDisplay), 20, 40);

  // Target
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent2;
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('TARGET: ' + targetScore, 20, 62);

  // Timer
  ctx.fillStyle = timeLeft <= 5 ? COLORS.accent : COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('TIME: ' + timeLeft + 's', canvas.width - 20, 40);

  // Combo
  if (combo > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent3;
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + combo, canvas.width / 2, 40);

    if (combo >= 5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent2;
      ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('FRENZY!', canvas.width / 2, 58);
    }
  }

  // Progress bar
  const barW = 200;
  const barH = 12;
  const barX = canvas.width / 2 - barW / 2;
  const barY = canvas.height - 30;
  const progress = Math.min(score / targetScore, 1);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 6);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = progress >= 1 ? COLORS.accent2 : COLORS.accent;
  roundRect(barX, barY, barW * progress, barH, 6);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(Math.round(progress * 100) + '%', canvas.width / 2, barY - 5);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,26,46,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('SPRITE SHEET', canvas.width / 2, 160);
  ctx.fillText('CLICKER', canvas.width / 2, 210);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Click frames on the sprite sheet to score points.', canvas.width / 2, 280);
  ctx.fillText('Reach ' + targetScore + ' points before time runs out!', canvas.width / 2, 310);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent3;
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Chain hits for combo bonuses. Miss to reset combo.', canvas.width / 2, 350);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('[ CLICK TO START ]', canvas.width / 2, 420);
}

function drawWinScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,26,46,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', canvas.width / 2, 180);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2, 250);
  ctx.fillText('Max Combo: x' + maxCombo, canvas.width / 2, 285);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent3;
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Time remaining: ' + timeLeft + 's', canvas.width / 2, 330);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('[ CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN ]', canvas.width / 2, 420);
}

function drawLoseScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,26,46,0.85)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('TIME UP!', canvas.width / 2, 180);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score + ' / ' + targetScore, canvas.width / 2, 250);
  ctx.fillText('Max Combo: x' + maxCombo, canvas.width / 2, 285);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent3;
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('So close! Try again?', canvas.width / 2, 330);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) > 0;
  if (blink) ctx.fillText('[ CLICK TO RETRY ]', canvas.width / 2, 420);
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ============ GAME LOOP ============
createFrames();

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = lastTime ? (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000 : 0.016;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Torch in the Fog</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #05070d;
    font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', serif;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    cursor: none;

</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---------- constants ----------
  const GAME_TIME = 60;
  const TORCH_RADIUS = 130;
  const GEM_RADIUS = 16;
  const NUM_GEMS = 20;
  const GEM_COLORS = ["#ffd24a", "#4ad6ff", "#ff6a9a", "#9aff6a"];

  // ---------- state ----------
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  let state = "start";
  let timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
  let lastTs = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let torch = { x: 0, y: 0, fx: 0, fy: 0, flick: 0, flickSpd: 0 };
  let gems = [];
  let particles = [];
  let fog = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 0 };
  let vignette = null;
  let fogCanvas = null;
  let fogCtx = null;
  let fogPattern = null;
  let flash = 0;

  // ---------- resize ----------
  function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W;
    canvas.height = H;
    torch.x = torch.x || W / 2;
    torch.y = torch.y || H / 2;
    torch.fx = torch.x;
    torch.fy = torch.y;
    buildFog();
    buildVignette();
  }

  function buildFog() {
    fogCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    fogCanvas.width = W;
    fogCanvas.height = H;
    fogCtx = fogCanvas.getContext("2d");
    fogCtx.fillStyle = "#05070d";
    fogCtx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
      const x = Math.random() * W;
      const y = Math.random() * H;
      const r = 40 + Math.random() * 130;
      const g = fogCtx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
      const light = 18 + Math.random() * 22;
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + light + "," + (light + 4) + "," + (light + 12) + ",0.5)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      fogCtx.fillStyle = g;
      fogCtx.beginPath();
      fogCtx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fogCtx.fill();
    }
    fogPattern = ctx.createPattern(fogCanvas, "repeat");
  }

  function buildVignette() {
    vignette = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.2, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
    vignette.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vignette.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)");
  }

  // ---------- gems ----------
  function makeGem() {
    let x = Math.random() * W;
    let y = Math.random() * H;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const dx = x - torch.x;
      const dy = y - torch.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (TORCH_RADIUS * 0.6) ** 2) {
        x = Math.random() * W;
        y = Math.random() * H;
      } else break;
    }
    const col = GEM_COLORS[(Math.random() * GEM_COLORS.length) | 0];
    const size = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.7;
    return {
      x: x, y: y,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      spinSpd: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.2,
      bobAmp: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
      bobSpd: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2,
      color: col,
      size: size,
      taken: false
    };
  }

  function spawnGems() {
    gems = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_GEMS; i++) gems.push(makeGem());
  }

  // ---------- particles ----------
  function burst(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 1.5 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        max: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        color: color,
        r: 2 + Math.random() * 3
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  function setTorch(cx, cy) {
    torch.x = cx;
    torch.y = cy;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    setTorch(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    setTorch(t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    setTorch(t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") {
      if (state === "start") startGame();
      else if (state === "over") startGame();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state === "start" || state === "over") startGame();
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  // ---------- game flow ----------
  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
    score = 0;
    particles = [];
    spawnGems();
    torch.fx = torch.x;
    torch.fy = torch.y;
    torch.flick = 0;
    torch.flickSpd = 0;
    lastTs = performance.now();
  }

  function endGame() {
    state = "over";
    if (score > best) best = score;
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    torch.flick += dt * (6 + Math.random() * 4);
    const flick = 0.88 + Math.sin(torch.flick) * 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.04;
    const r = TORCH_RADIUS * flick;

    // smooth follow
    torch.fx += (torch.x - torch.fx) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
    torch.fy += (torch.y - torch.fy) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);

    fog.x = torch.fx;
    fog.y = torch.fy;
    fog.r = r;

    if (state === "playing") {
      timeLeft -= dt;
      if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        timeLeft = 0;
        endGame();
      }
    }

    // gems
    for (let i = 0; i < gems.length; i++) {
      const g = gems[i];
      if (g.taken) continue;
      const dx = g.x - fog.x;
      const dy = g.y - fog.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (fog.r * 0.55) ** 2) {
        g.taken = true;
        score++;
        burst(g.x, g.y, g.color);
        const ng = makeGem();
        gems[i] = ng;
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vx *= 0.94;
      p.vy *= 0.94;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (flash > 0) flash -= dt;
  }

  // ---------- draw helpers ----------
  function drawDiamond(g, t) {
    const sx = g.x;
    const sy = g.y + Math.sin(t * g.bobSpd + g.phase) * g.bobAmp;
    const size = GEM_RADIUS * g.size;
    const rot = g.spin + t * g.spinSpd;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    ctx.rotate(rot);

    // glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, size * 2.2);
    glow.addColorStop(0, g.color + "cc");
    glow.addColorStop(1, g.color + "00");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, size * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = g.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -size);
    ctx.lineTo(size * 0.8, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, size);
    ctx.lineTo(-size * 0.8, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -size);
    ctx.lineTo(size * 0.35, -size * 0.2);
    ctx.lineTo(-size * 0.2, -size * 0.2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawTorch(t) {
    const x = torch.fx;
    const y = torch.fy;
    const flick = 0.88 + Math.sin(torch.flick) * 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.04;
    const r = TORCH_RADIUS * flick;

    // outer light
    const outer = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    outer.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,190,90,0.5)");
    outer.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,140,50,0.18)");
    outer.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = outer;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // inner bright
    const inner = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r * 0.5);
    inner.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,200,0.9)");
    inner.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(255,200,120,0.4)");
    inner.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,180,80,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = inner;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // torch handle
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3a1e";
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 26);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a4a24";
    ctx.fillRect(-5, 22, 10, 8);

    // flame
    const fh = 22 + Math.sin(t * 9) * 3;
    const fw = 12 + Math.sin(t * 7) * 2;
    const flame = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -6, 0, 0, -6, fh);
    flame.addColorStop(0, "#fff6d8");
    flame.addColorStop(0.5, "#ffb347");
    flame.addColorStop(1, "#ff6a1a");
    ctx.fillStyle = flame;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-fw, -2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-fw * 0.4, -fh, 0, -fh - 6);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fw * 0.4, -fh, fw, -2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 6, -fw, -2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * a + 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // time bar
    const bw = Math.min(W * 0.5, 360);
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const by = 22;
    const bh = 14;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    const frac = timeLeft / GAME_TIME;
    const col = frac > 0.5 ? "#ffd24a" : frac > 0.25 ? "#ff8a3a" : "#ff3a3a";
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * frac, bh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh);

    // timer text
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.font = "16px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timeLeft) + "s", W / 2, by + bh + 20);

    // score
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.font = "22px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.fillText("Gems: " + score, 24, 40);

    // best
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.font = "16px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("Best: " + best, W - 24, 40);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "48px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText(state === "start" ? "Torch in the Fog" : "Time's Up", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.font = "20px Georgia, serif";
    if (state === "start") {
      ctx.fillText("Move your mouse (or finger) to sweep the torch through the fog.", W / 2, H / 2 + 4);
      ctx.fillText("Reveal and collect the glowing gems before the 60 seconds run out.", W / 2, H / 2 + 32);
    } else {
      ctx.fillText("You revealed " + score + " gems.", W / 2, H / 2 + 4);
      ctx.fillText("Best: " + best, W / 2, H / 2 + 32);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#9aff6a";
    ctx.font = "18px Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("Click or press Space to " + (state === "start" ? "begin" : "play again"), W / 2, H / 2 + 74);
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw(t) {
    // background
    ctx.fillStyle = "#05070d";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // fog
    if (fogPattern) {
      ctx.fillStyle = fogPattern;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    // gems
    for (let i = 0; i < gems.length; i++) {
      drawDiamond(gems[i], t);
    }

    // particles
    drawParticles();

    // torch
    drawTorch(t);

    // vignette
    ctx.fillStyle = vignette;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    if (state === "playing") drawHUD();

    // overlays
    if (state === "start" || state === "over") drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(ts) {
    if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
    let dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
    lastTs = ts;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

    update(dt);
    draw(ts / 1000);

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- init ----------
  resize();
  spawnGems();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = 900;
  const H = 600;
  const CX = W / 2;
  const CY = H / 2;

  const CYCLE = 4.0;
  const MAX_R = 150;
  const MIN_R = 26;

  const START = 'start';
  const PLAYING = 'playing';
  const WON = 'won';
  const LOST = 'lost';

  let state = START;
  let cycleT = 0;
  let hold = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let pointer = { x: CX, y: CY };
  let pointerDown = false;
  let time = 0;
  let particles = [];

  function resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }

  function bubbleRadius() {
    const phase = cycleT / CYCLE;
    const s = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(phase * Math.PI * 2);
    return MIN_R + (MAX_R - MIN_R) * s;
  }

  function spawnParticle(x, y, color, size, life, vx, vy) {
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: vx || 0, vy: vy || 0, life: life || 0.8, max: life || 0.8, size: size || 4, color });
  }

  function burst() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 44; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 120 + Math.random() * 260;
      spawnParticle(CX, CY, i % 3 === 0 ? '#d6f0ff' : (i % 3 === 1 ? '#8fd0ff' : '#5aa8e0'), 2 + Math.random() * 5, 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.6, Math.cos(a) * sp, Math.sin(a) * sp);
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    cycleT = 0;
    hold = 0;
    score = 0;
    particles = [];
    pointerDown = false;
  }

  function startGame() {
    reset();
    state = PLAYING;
  }

  function onDown(e) {
    if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX) - r.left;
    const y = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY) - r.top;
    pointer.x = x;
    pointer.y = y;
    if (state === START || state === WON || state === LOST) {
      startGame();
    } else {
      pointerDown = true;
    }
  }

  function onMove(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX) - r.left;
    const y = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY) - r.top;
    pointer.x = x;
    pointer.y = y;
  }

  function onUp() {
    pointerDown = false;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (state === PLAYING) {
      cycleT += dt;
      if (cycleT >= CYCLE) {
        cycleT -= CYCLE;
        score++;
        if (score > best) best = score;
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          spawnParticle(CX, CY, '#bfe6ff', 2 + Math.random() * 4, 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, Math.cos(a) * (60 + Math.random() * 120), Math.sin(a) * (60 + Math.random() * 120));
        }
      }
      const r = bubbleRadius();
      const dx = pointer.x - CX;
      const dy = pointer.y - CY;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist > r) {
        hold += dt;
        if (hold > 0.45) {
          state = LOST;
          burst();
        }
      } else {
        hold = Math.max(0, hold - dt * 2);
      }
    }
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.94;
      p.vy *= 0.94;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b1a2e');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#123049');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#0a1826');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY, 40, CX, CY, 420);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(90,160,220,0.22)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(90,160,220,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,180,230,0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(CX, CY, 120 + i * 90, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const a = i * 2.399 + time * (0.04 + (i % 5) * 0.02);
      const rad = 200 + (i % 7) * 40;
      const x = CX + Math.cos(a) * rad;
      const y = CY + Math.sin(a) * rad * 0.7;
      const s = 1 + (i % 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,' + (0.15 + 0.12 * Math.sin(time * 2 + i)) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBubble(r) {
    const pulse = 1 + 0.02 * Math.sin(time * 6);
    const R = r * pulse;

    const body = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX - R * 0.3, CY - R * 0.35, R * 0.1, CX, CY, R);
    body.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(210,240,255,0.85)');
    body.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(120,190,235,0.4)');
    body.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,130,190,0.12)');
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(CX, CY, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,245,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(CX, CY, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(CX, CY, R * 0.82, -2.4, -1.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(CX - R * 0.35, CY - R * 0.4, R * 0.18, R * 0.1, -0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(CX + R * 0.3, CY + R * 0.35, R * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHud() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6ff';
    ctx.font = '600 18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Cycles held', 28, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '700 40px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 28, 84);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6ff';
    ctx.font = '600 16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best', W - 28, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '700 30px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(String(best), W - 28, 72);

    const r = bubbleRadius();
    const phase = cycleT / CYCLE;
    const bx = CX;
    const by = CY + r + 46;
    const bw = 220;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(bx - bw / 2, by, bw, 10, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(bx - bw / 2, by, bw * phase, 10, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e6';
    ctx.font = '600 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('breathe · 4s', bx, by + 30);

    if (hold > 0 && state === PLAYING) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,120,120,' + Math.min(1, hold * 2) + ')';
      ctx.font = '700 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('drifting away…', CX, CY - r - 24);
    }
  }

  function drawCenterMessage(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,14,24,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = '800 52px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, CX, CY - 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dcecff';
    ctx.font = '500 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(sub, CX, CY + 34);
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    const r = bubbleRadius();
    if (state !== LOST) {
      drawBubble(r);
    }
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (state === PLAYING) {
      drawHud();
    } else if (state === START) {
      drawCenterMessage('Four-Second Bubble', 'keep your cursor inside the bubble · 1 click to begin', '#bfe6ff');
    } else if (state === WON) {
      drawCenterMessage('You held it', 'score ' + score + ' · click to breathe again', '#bfe6ff');
    } else if (state === LOST) {
      drawCenterMessage('The bubble burst', 'you held ' + score + ' cycles · click to try again', '#ff9a9a');
    }
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Kanban Duel</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #14152b; }
