<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const COLS = 3;
const COL_W = 280;
const GAP = 40;
const BOARD_TOP = 150;
const CARD_H = 64;
const CARD_GAP = 12;
const CARD_W = 232;
const CARD_PAD = 24;
const MAX_CARDS = 4;
const WIN_SCORE = 5;
const HOLD_DELAY = 350;

const COL_NAMES = ['TO DO', 'IN PROGRESS', 'DONE'];
const COL_COLORS = ['#ff8a5c', '#5cd6ff', '#8aff9e'];

let W = 0, H = 0, boardX = 0, colX = [], cardX = [];
let state = 'title';
let scores = [0, 0];
let board = [[], [], []];
let held = null;
let holdTimer = 0;
let time = 0;

function resize() {
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr;
  canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  boardX = (W - (COL_W * COLS + GAP * (COLS - 1))) / 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < COLS; i++) {
    colX[i] = boardX + i * (COL_W + GAP);
    cardX[i] = colX[i] + (COL_W - CARD_W) / 2;
  }
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

function makeCard() {
  return {
    id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase(),
    title: ['BUG', 'TASK', 'EPIC', 'FIX', 'SHIP', 'REVIEW', 'API', 'UI', 'LOGIC', 'TEST'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)],
    color: COL_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLS)]
  };
}

function initBoard() {
  board = [[], [], []];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) board[0].push(makeCard());
}

function startGame() {
  initBoard();
  scores = [0, 0];
  held = null;
  holdTimer = 0;
  state = 'play';
}

function findHeld() {
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++)
    for (let i = 0; i < board[c].length; i++)
      if (board[c][i] === held) return { c: c, i: i };
  return null;
}

function moveHeld(c, i) {
  const f = findHeld();
  if (!f) return;
  board[f.c].splice(f.i, 1);
  board[c].splice(i, 0, held);
}

function onHold(player) {
  const c = player === 0 ? 0 : 2;
  const cards = board[c];
  if (cards.length === 0) return;
  if (held === null) {
    held = cards[0];
    holdTimer = 0;
  } else {
    holdTimer += 50;
    if (holdTimer >= HOLD_DELAY) {
      if (c === 0) {
        if (cards.length < MAX_CARDS) {
          board[1].push(held);
          cards.shift();
        }
      } else {
        const f = findHeld();
        if (f && f.c === 2) {
          cards.splice(f.i, 1);
          scores[player]++;
          held = null;
          if (scores[player] >= WIN_SCORE) state = 'over';
        }
      }
      holdTimer = 0;
    }
  }
}

function onRelease(player) {
  if (held === null) return;
  if (player === 0) {
    const f = findHeld();
    if (f && f.c === 1) board[1].splice(f.i, 1);
  } else {
    const f = findHeld();
    if (f && f.c === 1) board[1].splice(f.i, 1);
  }
  held = null;
  holdTimer = 0;
}

function playerMove(player, key) {
  if (held !== null) {
    onRelease(player);
    return;
  }
  const c = player === 0 ? 0 : 2;
  const cards = board[c];
  if (cards.length === 0) return;
  if (key === 'up') {
    if (cards.length >= 2) {
      const last = cards.pop();
      cards.unshift(last);
    }
  } else if (key === 'down') {
    if (cards.length >= 2) {
      const first = cards.shift();
      cards.push(first);
    }
  } else if (key === 'left' && player === 0) {
    if (cards.length >= 1 && board[1].length < MAX_CARDS) {
      board[1].push(cards.shift());
    }
  } else if (key === 'right' && player === 1) {
    if (cards.length >= 1 && board[1].length < MAX_CARDS) {
      board[1].push(cards.shift());
    }
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (state === 'title') {
    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'over') {
    if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { state = 'title'; }
    return;
  }
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  if (e.repeat) return;
  if (k === 'ArrowUp') playerMove(0, 'up');
  else if (k === 'ArrowDown') playerMove(0, 'down');
  else if (k === 'ArrowLeft') playerMove(0, 'left');
  else if (k === 'ArrowRight') playerMove(0, 'right');
  else if (k === 'w') playerMove(1, 'up');
  else if (k === 's') playerMove(1, 'down');
  else if (k === 'a') playerMove(1, 'left');
  else if (k === 'd') playerMove(1, 'right');
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === 'ArrowRight') onRelease(0);
  else if (k === 'd') onRelease(1);
});

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1b1d3a');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#12132a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const x = (i * 137.5) % W;
    const y = (i * 89.3) % H;
    const r = 1 + (i % 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.05 + (i % 5) * 0.02) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawCard(x, y, card, highlight) {
  ctx.fillStyle = highlight ? '#ffffff' : '#26284a';
  roundRect(x, y, CARD_W, CARD_H, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  if (highlight) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = card.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = card.color;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y + 14, 6, CARD_H - 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eef0ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(card.title, x + CARD_PAD, y + CARD_H / 2 - 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a8fb5';
  ctx.font = '12px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('#' + card.id, x + CARD_PAD, y + CARD_H / 2 + 14);
}

function drawColumn(c) {
  const x = colX[c];
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
  roundRect(x, BOARD_TOP, COL_W, H - BOARD_TOP - 30, 14);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_COLORS[c];
  roundRect(x, BOARD_TOP, COL_W, 8, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd2f0';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText(COL_NAMES[c], x + COL_W / 2, BOARD_TOP + 34);
  const cards = board[c];
  for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
    const cy = BOARD_TOP + 50 + i * (CARD_H + CARD_GAP);
    drawCard(cardX[c], cy, cards[i], held === cards[i]);
  }
  if (cards.length === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.font = '13px Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('empty', x + COL_W / 2, BOARD_TOP + 120);
  }
}

function drawHeader() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('KANBAN DUEL', W / 2, 52);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a5c';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('P1  ' + scores[0], W / 2 - 150, 92);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5cd6ff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('P2  ' + scores[1], W / 2 + 150, 92);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a8fb5';
  ctx.font = '13px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('First to ' + WIN_SCORE + ' completed cards wins', W / 2, 118);
}

function drawControls() {
  const y = H - 24;
  ctx.font = '12px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a5c';
  ctx.fillText('P1  \u2190 \u2191 \u2193 \u2192  (hold \u2192 to complete)', 16, y);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5cd6ff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('P2  (a) (w) (s) (d)  (hold d to complete)', W - 16, y);
}

function drawTitle() {
  drawBackground();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('KANBAN DUEL', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a8fb5';
  ctx.font = '18px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('A two-player card-sorting showdown', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.5) + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6b6f95';
  ctx.font = '14px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('P1: arrows   \u2022   P2: W A S D', W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
}

function drawOver() {
  drawBackground();
  drawHeader();
  const winner = scores[0] > scores[1] ? 0 : 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = winner === 0 ? '#ff8a5c' : '#5cd6ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 56px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('PLAYER ' + (winner + 1) + ' WINS!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8a8fb5';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Final score  ' + scores[0] + ' \u2013 ' + scores[1], W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.5) + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER for title', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
}

function draw() {
  if (state === 'title') { drawTitle(); return; }
  if (state === 'over') { drawOver(); return; }
  drawBackground();
  drawHeader();
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) drawColumn(c);
  drawControls();

    padding: 0;

    font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;

  // ---------- Canvas setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Game state ----------
  let state = "start";   // start | playing | win
  let score = 0;
  let targetNum = 0, targetDen = 0;
  let options = [];
  let selected = -1;
  let feedback = null;    // { ok, text, t }
  let bubbles = [];
  const WIN_SCORE = 5;

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function gcd(a, b) {
    a = Math.abs(a); b = Math.abs(b);
    while (b) { const t = a % b; a = b; b = t; }
    return a || 1;
  }

  function newRound() {
    // choose a reduced target fraction
    let n, d;
    do {
      n = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9);
      d = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9);
    } while (gcd(n, d) !== 1);
    targetNum = n;
    targetDen = d;

    // build 3 choices: the reduced one + 2 fake ones
    const set = new Set();
    set.add(n + "," + d);
    while (set.size < 3) {
      const fakeNum = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9);
      const fakeDen = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9);
      if (fakeNum !== fakeDen && !(fakeNum === n && fakeDen === d)) {
        set.add(fakeNum + "," + fakeDen);
      }
    }
    const arr = Array.from(set);
    // shuffle
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const tmp = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = tmp;
    }
    options = arr.map(s => {
      const p = s.split(",");
      return { num: +p[0], den: +p[1] };
    });
    selected = -1;
    feedback = null;
  }

  function correctIndex() {
    for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      if (options[i].num === targetNum && options[i].den === targetDen) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function spawnBubbles(n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      bubbles.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: H + 20,
        r: 6 + Math.random() * 14,
        vy: 20 + Math.random() * 40,
        wob: Math.random() * 6.28
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function choose(i) {
    if (state !== "playing" || selected !== -1 || feedback) return;
    selected = i;
    const good = i === correctIndex();
    feedback = { ok: good, t: 0 };
    if (good) {
      score++;
      spawnBubbles(14);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (score >= WIN_SCORE) {
          state = "win";
          spawnBubbles(40);
        } else {
          newRound();
        }
      }, 900);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        newRound();
      }, 1100);
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    score = 0;
    bubbles = [];
    newRound();
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (state === "start") {
      if (pointInButton(x, y, startBtn())) startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state === "win") {
      if (pointInButton(x, y, playAgainBtn())) startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state === "playing") {
      for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
        if (pointInButton(x, y, optionBtn(i))) { choose(i); break; }
      }
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (state === "start" && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) { startGame(); return; }
    if (state === "win" && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) { startGame(); return; }
    if (state === "playing") {
      if (e.key === "1") choose(0);
      else if (e.key === "2") choose(1);
      else if (e.key === "3") choose(2);
    }
  });

  // ---------- Layout / buttons ----------
  function startBtn() {
    return { x: W / 2 - 110, y: H * 0.66, w: 220, h: 64 };
  }
  function playAgainBtn() {
    return { x: W / 2 - 130, y: H * 0.72, w: 260, h: 64 };
  }
  function optionBtn(i) {
    const bw = Math.min(220, (W - 60) / 3 - 20);
    const gap = 24;
    const total = bw * 3 + gap * 2;
    const startX = (W - total) / 2;
    const y = H * 0.52;
    return { x: startX + i * (bw + gap), y: y, w: bw, h: Math.min(120, H * 0.22) };
  }
  function pointInButton(x, y, b) {
    return x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h;
  }

  // ---------- Drawing helpers ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawButton(b, fill, stroke, text, tColor, fs) {
    ctx.save();
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 18);
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = tColor;
    ctx.font = "bold " + fs + "px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawFraction(x, y, num, den, scale, color) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(40 * scale) + "px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(String(num), x, y - 30 * scale);
    ctx.fillText(String(den), x, y + 30 * scale);
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, 5 * scale);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 34 * scale, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 34 * scale, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function update(dt) {
    if (feedback) {
      feedback.t += dt;
    }
    for (let i = bubbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bubbles[i];
      b.y -= b.vy * dt;
      b.wob += dt * 3;
      b.x += Math.sin(b.wob) * 0.6;
      if (b.y < -30) bubbles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function draw() {
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    sky.addColorStop(0, "#bfe9ff");
    sky.addColorStop(1, "#e8f9ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    const sx = W * 0.85, sy = H * 0.14;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd94a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffd94a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx + Math.cos(a) * 56, sy + Math.sin(a) * 56);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.cos(a) * 74, sy + Math.sin(a) * 74);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    drawCloud(W * 0.55, H * 0.2, 0.8);

    // grass

    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.82, W, H * 0.18);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6bbf59";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.82);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
      ctx.lineTo(x, H * 0.82 + Math.sin(x * 0.05) * 6);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // bubbles
    for (const b of bubbles) {

      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#cdeeff";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

    else if (state === "playing") drawPlaying();
    else if (state === "win") drawWin();
  }

  function drawCloud(x, y, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 26 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 30 * s, y + 6 * s, 32 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 66 * s, y, 24 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStart() {
    // title
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7043";
    ctx.fillText("Fraction Friends", W / 2, H * 0.28);
    ctx.font = "22px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a6f8f";
    ctx.fillText("Can you make the fraction the smallest it can be?", W / 2, H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillText("Tap the matching reduced fraction!", W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.restore();

    // sample fraction
    drawFraction(W / 2, H * 0.56, 4, 8, 1.1, "#5a3ea1");

    drawButton(startBtn(), "#ff9f43", "#e0821f", "PLAY", "#ffffff", 30);
  }

  function drawPlaying() {
    // score bar
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a6f8f";
    ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score + " / " + WIN_SCORE, 24, 34);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("Simplify it!", W - 24, 34);
    ctx.restore();

    // question text
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f5d7a";
    ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Which one is the simplest form?", W / 2, H * 0.22);
    ctx.restore();

    // the fraction to simplify
    drawFraction(W / 2, H * 0.38, 8, 12, 1.6, "#5a3ea1");

    // options
    const colors = ["#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#ffd94a"];

    for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
      const b = optionBtn(i);
      let fill = colors[i], stroke = strokes[i];
      if (selected === i && feedback) {
        if (feedback.ok) { fill = "#5fd07a"; stroke = "#3aa85a"; }
        else { fill = "#ff8f8f"; stroke = "#e05555"; }
      }
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 18);
      ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
      ctx.stroke();
      drawFraction(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, options[i].num, options[i].den, Math.min(1.1, b.h / 90), "#333");
    }

    // feedback message
    if (feedback) {
      const txt = feedback.ok ? "Yes! Great job! \u2728" : "Oops, try again! \u263a";
      ctx.save();
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.font = "bold 34px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillStyle = feedback.ok ? "#2f9e4f" : "#e05555";
      ctx.fillText(txt, W / 2, H * 0.88);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawWin() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "bold 56px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7043";
    ctx.fillText("You did it!", W / 2, H * 0.3);
    ctx.font = "28px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2f5d7a";
    ctx.fillText("You simplified " + WIN_SCORE + " fractions. You're a fraction star!", W / 2, H * 0.44);
    ctx.font = "24px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a6f8f";
    ctx.fillText("Final score: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.54);
    ctx.restore();

    drawButton(playAgainBtn(), "#4ecdc4", "#2fa39b", "PLAY AGAIN", "#ffffff", 30);
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

    floatTexts.push({
      x: cx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80,
      y: cy - 40,
      text: '+' + stepValue,
      life: 1,
      color: combo >= 5 ? '#ffdd44' : '#44ddff',
      size: Math.min(14 + combo, 28)
    });

    // Shake
    shakeTimer = 0.15;
    shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;
    shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;

    // Bob animation
    bobPhase = 0;

    // Check win
    if (steps >= GOAL) {
      state = 'won';
      winTimer = 0;
      // Big celebration particles
      for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
        particles.push({
          x: cx,
          y: cy,
          vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
          vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3,
          life: 1.5,
          color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 90%, 65%)`,
          size: Math.random() * 5 + 3
        });

// === UPDATE ===
function update(dt) {
  pulsePhase += dt * 2;

  if (state === 'playing') {
    timer -= dt;
    if (timer <= 0) {
      timer = 0;
      state = 'lost';
      loseTimer = 0;
    }

    // Combo decay
    if (comboTimer > 0) {
      comboTimer -= dt;
      if (comboTimer <= 0) {
        combo = 0;
      }
    }

    // Energy slowly regenerates
    energy = Math.min(energy + dt * 3, 100);

    // Bob animation
    bobPhase += dt * 8;

    // Shake decay
    if (shakeTimer > 0) {
      shakeTimer -= dt;
      shakeX *= 0.9;
      shakeY *= 0.9;
    } else {
      shakeX = 0;
      shakeY = 0;
    }
  }

  if (state === 'won') {
    winTimer += dt;
  }

  if (state === 'lost') {
    loseTimer += dt;
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= dt * 1.5;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update float texts
  for (let i = floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const ft = floatTexts[i];
    ft.y -= dt * 40;
    ft.life -= dt * 1.2;
    if (ft.life <= 0) {
      floatTexts.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update star twinkle
  for (let i = 0; i < bgStars.length; i++) {
    bgStars[i].twinkle += dt * 3;
  }
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Gradient sky
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0c29');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a3e');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#24243e');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < bgStars.length; i++) {
    const s = bgStars[i];
    const twinkleAlpha = s.alpha * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.twinkle));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${twinkleAlpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x * canvas.width, s.y * canvas.height, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Ground
  const groundY = canvas.height * 0.75;
  const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, canvas.height);
  groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a2a4a');
  groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a30');
  ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, canvas.width, canvas.height - groundY);

  // Ground line
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a3a5a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
  ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, groundY);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Path / track
  const pathY = canvas.height * 0.78;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222244';
  ctx.fillRect(canvas.width * 0.15, pathY, canvas.width * 0.7, 8);

  // Path dashes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#444466';
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const dx = canvas.width * 0.15 + (canvas.width * 0.7 / 10) * i + 5;
    ctx.fillRect(dx, pathY + 2, 15, 4);
  }
}

function drawCharacter() {

  // Left arm

  ctx.moveTo(cx - 18, y - 5);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - 30, y + 10 + armSwing);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx + 18, y - 5);

  ctx.moveTo(cx - 8, y + 30);

  // Right leg
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx + 8, y + 30);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + 12, y + 55 - legSwing);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Shoes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx - 12, y + 58 + legSwing, 10, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 12, y + 58 - legSwing, 10, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

}

function drawHUD() {
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;

  // Step counter - big number
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  // Glow effect

  // Progress bar
  const barW = Math.min(300, w * 0.5);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 7);

  // Bar fill
  const progress = Math.min(steps / GOAL, 1);
  const fillW = barW * progress;
  if (fillW > 0) {
    const barGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
    barGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44ddff');
    barGrad.addColorStop(1, '#44ffaa');
    ctx.fillStyle = barGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, fillW, barH, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Bar border
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a4a6a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 7);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Energy bar
  const eBarW = Math.min(200, w * 0.3);
  const eBarH = 10;
  const eBarX = (w - eBarW) / 2;
  const eBarY = h * 0.30;

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a4a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(eBarX, eBarY, eBarW, eBarH, 5);
  ctx.fill();

  const eProgress = Math.max(energy / 100, 0);
  const eFillW = eBarW * eProgress;
  if (eFillW > 0) {
    const eColor = energy > 50 ? '#44ff88' : energy > 25 ? '#ffdd44' : '#ff4444';
    ctx.fillStyle = eColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(eBarX, eBarY, eFillW, eBarH, 5);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#8888aa';
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(12, w * 0.018)}px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('ENERGY', w / 2, eBarY - 8);

  // Timer
  const timerColor = timer > 10 ? '#44ddff' : timer > 5 ? '#ffdd44' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(28, w * 0.04)}px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timer) + 's', w / 2, h * 0.36);

  // Combo display
  if (combo >= 3) {
    const comboScale = 1 + Math.sin(pulsePhase * 3) * 0.1;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(w / 2, h * 0.42);
    ctx.scale(comboScale, comboScale);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(24, w * 0.035)}px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillText(`COMBO x${combo}`, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloatTexts() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;

  drawFloatTexts();

  if (state === 'playing') {

  }

  if (state === 'start') {
    drawHUD();

  if (state === 'won') {

let shake = 0;

function initStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.4, p: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
  }
}
initStars();

function resetGame() {
  tilt = 0;
  p1 = { w: 0, flash: 0, x: 0, y: 0, r: 0 };
  p2 = { w: 0, flash: 0, x: 0, y: 0, r: 0 };
  winner = null;
  winReason = '';
  timeLeft = TIME_LIMIT;
  particles = [];
  shake = 0;
}

function startGame() {
  resetGame();
  state = 'playing';
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 40 + Math.random() * 150;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 40, life: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6, max: 1.3, color, r: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (state === 'start') {
    if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space') { startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state === 'over') {
    if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space') { startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if (e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') { p1.w = clamp(p1.w + 1, 0, MAX_W); p1.flash = 0.25; }
  if (e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') { p1.w = clamp(p1.w - 1, 0, MAX_W); p1.flash = 0.25; }
  if (e.code === 'KeyI') { p2.w = clamp(p2.w + 1, 0, MAX_W); p2.flash = 0.25; }
  if (e.code === 'KeyK') { p2.w = clamp(p2.w - 1, 0, MAX_W); p2.flash = 0.25; }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (state === 'playing') {
    if (e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') { p1.w = clamp(p1.w - 1, 0, MAX_W); p1.flash = 0.25; }
    if (e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') { p1.w = clamp(p1.w + 1, 0, MAX_W); p1.flash = 0.25; }
    if (e.code === 'KeyI') { p2.w = clamp(p2.w - 1, 0, MAX_W); p2.flash = 0.25; }
    if (e.code === 'KeyK') { p2.w = clamp(p2.w + 1, 0, MAX_W); p2.flash = 0.25; }
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'over') startGame();
});

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt) {
  clock += dt;
  for (const s of stars) s.p += dt;
  if (state === 'playing') {
    timeLeft -= dt;
    const target = clamp((p1.w - p2.w) / 24, -MAX_TILT, MAX_TILT);
    tilt += (target - tilt) * clamp(TILT_SPEED * dt, 0, 1);
    if (Math.abs(tilt) >= MAX_TILT - 0.002) shake = 0.25;
    if (Math.abs(tilt) >= MAX_TILT) {
      const w = tilt > 0 ? 'Player 2' : 'Player 1';
      endGame(w, 'crash');
    } else if (Math.abs(p1.w - p2.w) >= WIN_DIFF) {
      const w = p1.w > p2.w ? 'Player 1' : 'Player 2';
      endGame(w, 'balance');
    } else if (timeLeft <= 0) {
      timeLeft = 0;
      const d = p1.w - p2.w;
      if (d > 0) endGame('Player 1', 'time');
      else if (d < 0) endGame('Player 2', 'time');
      else endGame('Draw', 'time');
    }
  }
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
  p1.flash = Math.max(0, p1.flash - dt);
  p2.flash = Math.max(0, p2.flash - dt);
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.vy += 320 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function endGame(w, reason) {
  state = 'over';
  winner = w;
  winReason = reason;
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.42;
  spawnParticles(cx, cy, '#ffd36b', 26);
  spawnParticles(cx, cy, w === 'Player 1' ? P1.color : (w === 'Player 2' ? P2.color : '#ffffff'), 30);
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1b1738');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#241a44');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#120e22');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  for (const s of stars) {
    const a = 0.35 + 0.4 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.p * 2));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    circle(s.x, s.y, s.r, '#d9d2ff');
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.5, H * 0.45, 10, W * 0.5, H * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.55);
  rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,90,200,0.18)');
  rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawGround() {
  const y = H * 0.86;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#2a2148');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#15102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, H - y);
  line(0, y, W, y, 2, 'rgba(150,120,220,0.5)');
}

function drawBeam() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.42;
  const a = tilt;
  const len = Math.min(W * 0.34, 300);

  const ax = cx - Math.cos(a) * len;
  const ay = cy + Math.sin(a) * len;
  const bx = cx + Math.cos(a) * len;
  const by = cy - Math.sin(a) * len;

  // hangers
  line(ax, ay, ax, ay + HANG, 2, 'rgba(200,190,230,0.5)');
  line(bx, by, bx, by + HANG, 2, 'rgba(200,190,230,0.5)');

  // beam
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ax, ay, bx, by);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#b7a7e6');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#efe7ff');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#b7a7e6');
  ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
  ctx.lineWidth = 12;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
  ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';

  // pivot
  circle(cx, cy, 12, '#ffd36b');
  circle(cx, cy, 6, '#7a5a12');

  // trays
  drawTray(ax, ay + HANG, P1);
  drawTray(bx, by + HANG, P2);
}

function drawTray(x, y, p) {
  const tw = 120;
  ctx.fillStyle = p.dark;
  ctx.fillRect(x - tw / 2, y, tw, TRAY_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.fillRect(x - tw / 2, y, tw, 5);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.light;
  ctx.fillRect(x - tw / 2, y + TRAY_H - 3, tw, 3);

  // weights
  const count = Math.round(p.w / 5);
  const maxOnTray = 12;
  const drawCount = Math.min(count, maxOnTray);
  const spacing = tw / (maxOnTray + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < drawCount; i++) {
    const wx = x - tw / 2 + spacing * (i + 1);
    const r = 13;
    const wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(wx, y - TRAY_H - r, wx, y);
    wg.addColorStop(0, p.light);
    wg.addColorStop(1, p.dark);
    circle(wx, y - TRAY_H / 2 - r + 2, r, wg);
    circle(wx, y - TRAY_H / 2 - r + 2, r * 0.4, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)');
  }
  if (count > maxOnTray) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('+' + (count - maxOnTray), x, y - TRAY_H - 26);
  }

  // player label
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(p.key, x, y + TRAY_H + 18);

  // weight value
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(String(p.w), x, y + TRAY_H + 44);

  // flash ring
  if (p.flash > 0) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.light;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.flash / 0.25;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - TRAY_H / 2, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    circle(p.x, p.y, p.r, p.color);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  // timer
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(timeLeft));
  ctx.fillStyle = timeLeft < 10 ? '#ff5d73' : '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(t + 's', cx, 40);

  // controls
  ctx.font = '13px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('P1  W / S  (or Arrow Up / Down)', 16, H - 16);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('P2  I / K', W - 16, H - 16);
}

function drawStart() {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,8,20,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('BALANCE DUEL', cx, cy - 70);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Add weights to your side. First to lead by 22 wins.', cx, cy - 20);
  ctx.fillText('But if the beam tips fully, you crash and lose!', cx, cy + 6);

  ctx.fillStyle = P1.color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Player 1:  W (add)  S (remove)', cx, cy + 46);
  ctx.fillStyle = P2.color;
  ctx.fillText('Player 2:  I (add)  K (remove)', cx, cy + 70);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or click to start', cx, cy + 120);
}

function drawOver() {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,8,20,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  const col = winner === 'Player 1' ? P1.color : (winner === 'Player 2' ? P2.color : '#fff');
  ctx.fillStyle = col;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(winner === 'Draw' ? 'DRAW!' : winner + ' WINS!', cx, cy - 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '18px Arial';
  const reasonText = winReason === 'crash' ? 'The beam tipped too far!' :
                     winReason === 'balance' ? 'You led by 22!' :
                     'Time is up — closest to the edge wins.';
  ctx.fillText(reasonText, cx, cy + 4);
  ctx.fillText('Final:  ' + p1.w + '  vs  ' + p2.w, cx, cy + 34);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or click to play again', cx, cy + 90);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    const m = shake * 14;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawGround();
  drawBeam();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();
  if (state === 'start') drawStart();
  if (state === 'over') drawOver();
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Photo Align</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #12121a;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #000;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// ─── STATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const PHOTO_W = 300;
const PHOTO_H = 200;

// The "correct" center position for the photo
const TARGET_X = W / 2;
const TARGET_Y = H / 2;

// Photo position (player moves this)
let photoX = W / 2 + (Math.random() * 120 - 60);
let photoY = H / 2 + (Math.random() * 100 - 50);

let score = 0;
let aligned = false;
let gameWon = false;
let time = 0;
let startTime = Date.now();
const TIME_LIMIT = 30; // seconds

// Particles for celebration
let particles = [];

// Stars in background
let stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Mountain layers for the panorama scene
function generateMountains(offsetY, color, peaks) {
  const points = [];
  const seg = W / peaks;
  for (let i = 0; i <= peaks; i++) {
    const x = i * seg;
    const y = offsetY + Math.sin(i * 1.3 + 0.5) * 30 + Math.cos(i * 0.7) * 20;
    points.push({ x, y });
  }
  return { points, color };
}

const mountainLayers = [
  generateMountains(H * 0.55, '#1a2a3a', 8),
  generateMountains(H * 0.65, '#253d52', 6),
  generateMountains(H * 0.75, '#2f4f66', 5),
];

// Sun/moon position
const sunX = W * 0.75;
const sunY = H * 0.2;

// ─── INPUT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
let keys = {};

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') resetGame();
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

// Mouse / touch drag
let dragging = false;
let dragOffX = 0;
let dragOffY = 0;

function getPos(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scaleX = W / rect.width;
  const scaleY = H / rect.height;
  if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
    return { x: (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * scaleX, y: (e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top) * scaleY };
  }
  return { x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX, y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY };
}

function isOnPhoto(px, py) {
  const left = photoX - PHOTO_W / 2;
  const right = photoX + PHOTO_W / 2;
  const top = photoY - PHOTO_H / 2;
  const bottom = photoY + PHOTO_H / 2;
  return px >= left && px <= right && py >= top && py <= bottom;
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
  const p = getPos(e);
  if (isOnPhoto(p.x, p.y)) {
    dragging = true;
    dragOffX = p.x - photoX;
    dragOffY = p.y - photoY;
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  if (!dragging) return;
  const p = getPos(e);
  photoX = p.x - dragOffX;
  photoY = p.y - dragOffY;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
  if (dragging) {
    dragging = false;
    checkAlignment();
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const p = getPos(e);
  if (isOnPhoto(p.x, p.y)) {
    dragging = true;
    dragOffX = p.x - photoX;
    dragOffY = p.y - photoY;
  }
}, { passive: false });

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!dragging) return;
  const p = getPos(e);
  photoX = p.x - dragOffX;
  photoY = p.y - dragOffY;
}, { passive: false });

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (dragging) {
    dragging = false;
    checkAlignment();
  }
}, { passive: false });

function resetGame() {
  photoX = W / 2 + (Math.random() * 120 - 60);
  photoY = H / 2 + (Math.random() * 100 - 50);
  score = 0;
  aligned = false;
  gameWon = false;
  particles = [];
  startTime = Date.now();
}

// ─── UPDATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function checkAlignment() {
  const dx = photoX - TARGET_X;
  const dy = photoY - TARGET_Y;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (dist < 15 && !gameWon) {
    aligned = true;
    gameWon = true;
    score = Math.max(0, Math.floor(TIME_LIMIT - (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000)) * 100;
    spawnParticles();
  }
}

function spawnParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
    particles.push({
      x: photoX,
      y: photoY,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      color: ['#ff6b6b', '#ffd93d', '#6bcb77', '#4d96ff', '#ff9ff3'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)],
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  time += dt;

  // Keyboard movement
  const speed = 300 * dt;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) photoX -= speed;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) photoX += speed;
  if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) photoY -= speed;
  if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) photoY += speed;

  // Clamp
  photoX = Math.max(PHOTO_W / 2, Math.min(W - PHOTO_W / 2, photoX));
  photoY = Math.max(PHOTO_H / 2, Math.min(H - PHOTO_H / 2, photoY));

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life -= 0.02;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Check time
  if (!gameWon) {
    const elapsed = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
    if (elapsed >= TIME_LIMIT) {
      // Game over – just flash
      aligned = false;
    }
  }
}

// ─── DRAW ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawSky() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a1628');
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a3a5c');
  grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a5a7a');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a3040');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawStars() {
  for (const s of stars) {
    const alpha = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 0.5 + s.twinkle));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawSun() {
  // Glow
  const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 10, sunX, sunY, 80);
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,100,0.6)');
  glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,100,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 80, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Sun body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawMountains() {
  for (const layer of mountainLayers) {
    ctx.fillStyle = layer.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (const p of layer.points) {
      ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Water / lake
  const waterGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.8, 0, H);
  waterGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3a5a');
  waterGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f2535');
  ctx.fillStyle = waterGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.82, W, H * 0.18);

  // Water reflections
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const y = H * 0.84 + i * 8;
    const offset = Math.sin(time * 0.8 + i) * 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W * 0.2 + offset, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.8 + offset, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawTargetZone() {
  // Dashed rectangle showing where to place
  const tx = TARGET_X - PHOTO_W / 2;
  const ty = TARGET_Y - PHOTO_H / 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = aligned ? 'rgba(100,255,100,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(tx, ty, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H);
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Corner markers
  const cm = 15;
  ctx.strokeStyle = aligned ? '#66ff66' : '#ffffff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  // Top-left
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty + cm); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.lineTo(tx + cm, ty); ctx.stroke();
  // Top-right
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + PHOTO_W - cm, ty); ctx.lineTo(tx + PHOTO_W, ty); ctx.lineTo(tx + PHOTO_W, ty + cm); ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-left
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty + PHOTO_H - cm); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + PHOTO_H); ctx.lineTo(tx + cm, ty + PHOTO_H); ctx.stroke();
  // Bottom-right
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx + PHOTO_W - cm, ty + PHOTO_H); ctx.lineTo(tx + PHOTO_W, ty + PHOTO_H); ctx.lineTo(tx + PHOTO_W, ty + PHOTO_H - cm); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawPhoto() {
  const left = photoX - PHOTO_W / 2;
  const top = photoY - PHOTO_H / 2;

  // Shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(left + 4, top + 4, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H);

  // Photo border (white frame like a real photo)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(left - 4, top - 4, PHOTO_W + 8, PHOTO_H + 8);

  // Photo content – mini landscape
  const pGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(left, top, left, top + PHOTO_H);
  pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a3a5c');
  pGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a5a7a');
  pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a3040');
  ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(left, top, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H);

  // Mini sun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(left + PHOTO_W * 0.75, top + PHOTO_H * 0.2, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Mini mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = '#253d52';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(left, top + PHOTO_H * 0.6);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W * 0.2, top + PHOTO_H * 0.35);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W * 0.4, top + PHOTO_H * 0.55);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W * 0.6, top + PHOTO_H * 0.3);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W * 0.8, top + PHOTO_H * 0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W, top + PHOTO_H * 0.4);
  ctx.lineTo(left + PHOTO_W, top + PHOTO_H);
  ctx.lineTo(left, top + PHOTO_H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Mini water
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a5a';
  ctx.fillRect(left, top + PHOTO_H * 0.7, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H * 0.3);

  // Alignment indicator
  if (!gameWon) {
    const dx = photoX - TARGET_X;
    const dy = photoY - TARGET_Y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const closeness = Math.max(0, 1 - dist / 200);
    const hue = closeness * 120; // red to green
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 100%, 50%, 0.3)`;
    ctx.fillRect(left, top, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H);
  }

  if (gameWon) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,255,100,0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(left, top, PHOTO_W, PHOTO_H);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  const elapsed = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, TIME_LIMIT - elapsed);

  // Top bar
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('PHOTO ALIGN', 15, 26);

  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`Time: ${remaining.toFixed(1)}s`, W - 15, 26);

  // Bottom info
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.font = '13px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Drag the photo into the target zone  |  Arrow keys / WASD to move  |  R to reset', W / 2, H - 12);
}

function drawWinScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#66ff66';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('ALIGNED!', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 15);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '16px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press R to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
}

function drawLoseScreen() {
  const elapsed = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
  if (elapsed < TIME_LIMIT || gameWon) return;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('TIME UP', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Better luck next time!', W / 2, H / 2 + 15);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '16px Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press R to try again', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
}

function draw() {
  drawSky();
  drawStars();
  drawSun();
  drawMountains();
  drawTargetZone();
  drawPhoto();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  if (gameWon) drawWinScreen();
  else drawLoseScreen();
}

// ─── GAME LOOP ───────────────────────────────────────────
let lastTime = performance.now();

function loop(now) {
  const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
  lastTime = now;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Milk the Cow</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; }
  #gameCanvas { display: block; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ===== CONSTANTS ===== */
const W = 800, H = 500;
const BAR_Y = 370, BAR_X = 150, BAR_W = 500, BAR_H = 36;
const GREEN_X = BAR_X + BAR_W * 0.35, GREEN_W = BAR_W * 0.30;
const BUCKET_X = 400, BUCKET_Y = 290, BUCKET_W = 70, BUCKET_H = 50;
const COW_X = 400, COW_Y = 180;
const TARGET_MILK = 100;
const GAME_TIME = 45;

/* ===== STATE ===== */
let canvas, ctx;
let gameState = "start"; // start, playing, win, lose
let score = 0;
let milkInBucket = 0;
let timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
let barPos = 0;
let barDir = 1;
let barSpeed = 0.025;
let lastTime = 0;
let milkDrops = [];
let splashParticles = [];
let cowMood = 0; // 0 = happy, 1 = neutral, 2 = annoyed
let shakeTimer = 0;
let flashTimer = 0;
let flashColor = "#fff";

/* ===== INIT ===== */
function init() {
  canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  resetGame();
}

function resetGame() {
  score = 0;
  milkInBucket = 0;
  timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
  barPos = 0;
  barDir = 1;
  barSpeed = 0.025;
  milkDrops = [];
  splashParticles = [];
  cowMood = 0;
  shakeTimer = 0;
  flashTimer = 0;
}

function startGame() {
  resetGame();
  gameState = "playing";
}

/* ===== INPUT ===== */
function handleInput() {
  if (gameState === "start") {
    startGame();
  } else if (gameState === "playing") {
    tryMilk();
  } else if (gameState === "win" || gameState === "lose") {
    startGame();
  }
}

function tryMilk() {
  const inGreen = barPos >= GREEN_X && barPos <= GREEN_X + GREEN_W;
  if (inGreen) {
    const center = GREEN_X + GREEN_W / 2;
    const dist = Math.abs(barPos - center);
    const precision = 1 - (dist / (GREEN_W / 2));
    const milkAmount = Math.round(3 + precision * 7);
    milkInBucket += milkAmount;
    score += milkAmount * 10;
    cowMood = 0;
    flashTimer = 0.3;
    flashColor = "#4ade80";
    spawnMilkDrops(milkAmount);
    barSpeed += 0.003;
  } else {
    cowMood = Math.min(cowMood + 1, 2);
    shakeTimer = 0.3;
    flashTimer = 0.3;
    flashColor = "#ef4444";
    timeLeft -= 2;
    if (timeLeft < 0) timeLeft = 0;
  }
  if (milkInBucket >= TARGET_MILK) {
    gameState = "win";
  }
}

function spawnMilkDrops(amount) {
  for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
    milkDrops.push({
      x: BUCKET_X + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
      y: BUCKET_Y - 20,
      vy: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
      life: 1
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    splashParticles.push({
      x: BUCKET_X + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
      y: BUCKET_Y - 5,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
      vy: -2 - Math.random() * 3,
      life: 1
    });
  }
}

/* ===== UPDATE ===== */
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState !== "playing") return;

  // Move bar
  barPos += barDir * barSpeed * dt * 60;
  if (barPos >= BAR_X + BAR_W) { barPos = BAR_X + BAR_W; barDir = -1; }
  if (barPos <= BAR_X) { barPos = BAR_X; barDir = 1; }

  // Timer
  timeLeft -= dt;
  if (timeLeft <= 0) {
    timeLeft = 0;
    gameState = "lose";
  }

  // Milk drops
  for (let i = milkDrops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = milkDrops[i];
    d.y += d.vy;
    d.life -= dt * 0.8;
    if (d.life <= 0) milkDrops.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Splash particles
  for (let i = splashParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = splashParticles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life -= dt * 1.5;
    if (p.life <= 0) splashParticles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // Shake / flash decay
  if (shakeTimer > 0) shakeTimer -= dt;
  if (flashTimer > 0) flashTimer -= dt;
}

/* ===== DRAW ===== */
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shakeTimer > 0) {
    const s = shakeTimer * 8;
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*s, (Math.random()-0.5)*s);
  }

  drawSky();
  drawHills();
  drawFence();
  drawCow();
  drawBucket();
  drawMilkDrops();
  drawSplash();
  drawBar();
  drawHUD();

  if (flashTimer > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = flashTimer * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = flashColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  if (gameState === "start") drawOverlay("MILK THE COW!", "Press SPACE or CLICK to start", "#4ade80");
  if (gameState === "win") drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "Milked " + milkInBucket + " units! Score: " + score, "#4ade80");
  if (gameState === "lose") drawOverlay("TIME'S UP!", "Milked " + milkInBucket + " / " + TARGET_MILK + " | Score: " + score, "#ef4444");

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSky() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.6);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#87CEEB");
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#b3e0f7");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#e8f4fc");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.6);

  // Sun
  ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(680, 70, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,217,61,0.3)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(680, 70, 50, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Clouds
  drawCloud(100, 50, 1);
  drawCloud(300, 80, 0.7);
  drawCloud(500, 40, 0.9);
}

function drawCloud(x, y, scale) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 20*scale, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+25*scale, y-10*scale, 25*scale, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+50*scale, y, 20*scale, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+25*scale, y+5*scale, 18*scale, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHills() {
  // Far hill
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7ec87e";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H*0.55);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.25, H*0.35, W*0.5, H*0.5);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.75, H*0.38, W, H*0.52);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Near hill
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5aad5a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H*0.65);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.3, H*0.5, W*0.6, H*0.62);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.8, H*0.55, W, H*0.6);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Ground
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4a9e4a";
  ctx.fillRect(0, H*0.72, W, H*0.28);
}

function drawFence() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#8B6914";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  const fenceY = H * 0.62;
  // Horizontal rails
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(20, fenceY);
  ctx.lineTo(W - 20, fenceY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(20, fenceY + 20);
  ctx.lineTo(W - 20, fenceY + 20);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Vertical posts
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const px = 60 + i * 100;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6B4E0A";
    ctx.fillRect(px - 4, fenceY - 10, 8, 40);
  }
}

function drawCow() {
  const cx = COW_X, cy = COW_Y;
  const mood = cowMood;

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, 80, 50, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx - 30, cy - 10, 20, 15, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 25, cy + 15, 18, 12, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 5, cy - 20, 12, 10, 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 55, cy + 30, 14, 35);
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 25, cy + 35, 14, 30);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 15, cy + 35, 14, 30);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 45, cy + 30, 14, 35);
  // Hooves
  ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 55, cy + 60, 14, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 25, cy + 60, 14, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 15, cy + 60, 14, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(cx + 45, cy + 60, 14, 8);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 70, cy - 20, 30, 25, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Head spot
  ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 80, cy - 25, 12, 10, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ears
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 55, cy - 45, 12, 8, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 85, cy - 45, 12, 8, 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  if (mood === 0) {
    // Happy eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 62, cy - 25, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 80, cy - 25, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Smile
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#333";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 70, cy - 8, 10, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (mood === 1) {
    // Neutral
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 59, cy - 28, 8, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 77, cy - 28, 8, 4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#333";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 62, cy - 5);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 78, cy - 5);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    // Angry
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 62, cy - 25, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 80, cy - 25, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Angry brows
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#333";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 56, cy - 33);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 67, cy - 29);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 86, cy - 33);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 75, cy - 29);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Frown
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 70, cy + 2, 10, Math.PI + 0.3, -0.3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Muzzle
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f5c6c6";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx + 70, cy - 2, 14, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d4a0a0";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + 65, cy - 2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + 75, cy - 2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Udder
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f5c6c6";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 40, 20, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8a0a0";
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 12 + i * 8, cy + 48, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Tail
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - 75, cy - 10);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - 100, cy + 10, cx - 90, cy + 40);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx - 90, cy + 42, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBucket() {
  const bx = BUCKET_X, by = BUCKET_Y;
  const fillLevel = Math.min(milkInBucket / TARGET_MILK, 1);

  // Bucket body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#c0c0c0";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx - BUCKET_W/2, by);
  ctx.lineTo(bx + BUCKET_W/2, by);
  ctx.lineTo(bx + BUCKET_W/2 - 8, by + BUCKET_H);
  ctx.lineTo(bx - BUCKET_W/2 + 8, by + BUCKET_H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Bucket rim
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#888";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx - BUCKET_W/2, by);
  ctx.lineTo(bx + BUCKET_W/2, by);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Milk inside
  if (fillLevel > 0) {
    const milkH = BUCKET_H * fillLevel;
    const milkTop = by + BUCKET_H - milkH;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    const topW = BUCKET_W - 8;
    const botW = BUCKET_W - 16;
    const tFrac = (BUCKET_H - milkH) / BUCKET_H;
    const mTopW = botW + (topW - botW) * tFrac;
    ctx.moveTo(bx - mTopW/2, milkTop);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + mTopW/2, milkTop);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + BUCKET_W/2 - 8, by + BUCKET_H);
    ctx.lineTo(bx - BUCKET_W/2 + 8, by + BUCKET_H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Milk surface
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f0f0f0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(bx, milkTop, mTopW/2, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Handle
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#888";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by - 5, 25, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = "#555";
  ctx.font = "bold 11px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("MILK", bx, by + BUCKET_H - 5);
}

function drawMilkDrops() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  for (const d of milkDrops) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = d.life;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawSplash() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8f4ff";
  for (const p of splashParticles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawBar() {
  // Bar background
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
  roundRect(BAR_X - 4, BAR_Y - 4, BAR_W + 8, BAR_H + 8, 8);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#2d3748";
  roundRect(BAR_X, BAR_Y, BAR_W, BAR_H, 6);
  ctx.fill();

  // Green zone
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(74,222,128,0.4)";
  ctx.fillRect(GREEN_X, BAR_Y, GREEN_W, BAR_H);

  // Center line
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#4ade80";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(GREEN_X + GREEN_W/2, BAR_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(GREEN_X + GREEN_W/2, BAR_Y + BAR_H);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Moving indicator
  ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(barPos, BAR_Y - 8);
  ctx.lineTo(barPos - 8, BAR_Y - 20);
  ctx.lineTo(barPos + 8, BAR_Y - 20);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
  ctx.fillRect(barPos - 3, BAR_Y, 6, BAR_H);

  // Glow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,217,61,0.3)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(barPos, BAR_Y + BAR_H/2, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "bold 14px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE / CLICK to MILK!", BAR_X + BAR_W/2, BAR_Y + BAR_H + 22);
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  roundRect(15, 12, 180, 40, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
  ctx.font = "bold 18px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 25, 38);

  // Timer
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  roundRect(W - 195, 12, 180, 40, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  const timerColor = timeLeft > 10 ? "#4ade80" : "#ef4444";
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  ctx.font = "bold 18px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Time: " + Math.ceil(timeLeft) + "s", W - 25, 38);

  // Milk progress
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  roundRect(15, 60, 220, 35, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "bold 14px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Milk: " + milkInBucket + " / " + TARGET_MILK, 25, 83);

  // Progress bar
  const progW = 160;
  const progH = 8;
  const progX = 25, progY = 88;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
  roundRect(progX, progY, progW, progH, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  const fill = Math.min(milkInBucket / TARGET_MILK, 1);
  if (fill > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4ade80";
    roundRect(progX, progY, progW * fill, progH, 4);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold 48px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 30);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "20px Arial";
  ctx.fillText(subtitle, W/2, H/2 + 20);

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
  ctx.font = "16px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or CLICK to " + (gameState === "start" ? "play" : "play again"), W/2, H/2 + 60);
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

/* ===== GAME LOOP ===== */
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

/* ===== START ===== */
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleInput();
  }
});

window.addEventListener("click", () => {
  handleInput();
});

window.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  handleInput();
});

init();
lastTime = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Glass Blowing: The Perfect Bubble</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', cursive, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 150, 50, 0.3);
  }
</style>

<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// --- State ---
const state = {
  screen: 'start',
  heat: 0,
  heatTarget: 0,
  bubbleRadius: 0,
  bubbleMaxRadius: 140,
  bubbleMinRadius: 40,
  score: 0,
  perfectCount: 0,
  totalBubbles: 0,
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0,
  blowing: false,
  flameActive: false,
  flameIntensity: 0,
  particles: [],
  stars: [],
  time: 0,
  winThreshold: 3,
};

// Pre-create stars
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
  state.stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H * 0.5,
    size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// --- Input ---
const keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (state.screen === 'start' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if (state.screen === 'game' && e.key === ' ') {
    state.blowing = true;
  }
  if (state.screen === 'game' && (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F')) {
    state.flameActive = true;
  }
  if ((state.screen === 'win' || state.screen === 'lose') && (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R')) {
    startGame();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
  if (e.key === ' ') state.blowing = false;
  if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') state.flameActive = false;
});

// Touch / click support
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  if (state.screen === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.screen === 'win' || state.screen === 'lose') { startGame(); return; }
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  if (state.screen === 'game') {
    if (my > H * 0.7) { state.blowing = true; }
    else { state.flameActive = true; }
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { state.blowing = false; state.flameActive = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state.screen === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.screen === 'win' || state.screen === 'lose') { startGame(); return; }
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const touch = e.touches[0];
  const my = (touch.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
  if (state.screen === 'game') {
    if (my > H * 0.7) state.blowing = true;
    else state.flameActive = true;
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { state.blowing = false; state.flameActive = false; });

function startGame() {
  state.screen = 'game';
  state.heat = 0;
  state.bubbleRadius = 0;
  state.score = 0;
  state.perfectCount = 0;
  state.totalBubbles = 0;
  state.message = 'Heat the glass! Press F or tap the top!';
  state.messageTimer = 3;
  state.particles = [];
}

// --- Update ---
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;

  // Update stars twinkle
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    s.twinkle += dt * 2;
  }

  // Update message timer
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer -= dt;

  if (state.screen !== 'game') return;

  // Heat control
  if (state.flameActive) {
    state.flameIntensity = Math.min(1, state.flameIntensity + dt * 3);
    state.heat += dt * 40 * state.flameIntensity;
  } else {
    state.flameIntensity = Math.max(0, state.flameIntensity - dt * 2);
    state.heat -= dt * 15;
  }
  state.heat = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, state.heat));

  // Blowing
  if (state.blowing && state.heat > 20) {
    state.bubbleRadius += dt * 30 * (state.heat / 100);
  }

  // Check bubble state
  if (state.bubbleRadius > 0) {
    if (state.heat < 10) {
      // Too cold — bubble shrinks and pops
      state.bubbleRadius -= dt * 50;
      if (state.bubbleRadius <= 0) {
        popBubble('cold');
      }
    } else if (state.bubbleRadius >= state.bubbleMaxRadius) {
      // Too big — pops
      popBubble('big');
    }
  }

  // Spawn flame particles
  if (state.flameIntensity > 0.2) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      state.particles.push({
        x: 130 + Math.random() * 30 - 15,
        y: 380 + Math.random() * 20,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
        vy: -40 - Math.random() * 60,
        life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        maxLife: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        size: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
        type: 'flame'
      });
    }
  }

  // Spawn blow particles
  if (state.blowing && state.heat > 20) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      state.particles.push({
        x: 160 + Math.random() * 20,
        y: 300 + Math.random() * 20,
        vx: 30 + Math.random() * 40,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
        life: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        maxLife: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        type: 'air'
      });
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.type === 'flame') p.vy -= 20 * dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function popBubble(reason) {
  state.totalBubbles++;
  let msg = '';
  let color = '';

  if (reason === 'cold') {
    msg = 'Too cold! The bubble popped!';
    color = '#ff6b6b';
    state.score -= 5;
  } else if (reason === 'big') {
    if (state.bubbleRadius >= state.bubbleMaxRadius * 0.85 && state.bubbleRadius <= state.bubbleMaxRadius) {
      msg = 'PERFECT! Beautiful bubble!';
      color = '#ffd93d';
      state.score += 20;
      state.perfectCount++;
    } else {
      msg = 'Too big! It popped!';
      color = '#ff6b6b';
      state.score -= 5;
    }
  }

  state.bubbleRadius = 0;
  state.message = msg;
  state.messageTimer = 2.5;

  // Pop particles
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const angle = (i / 15) * Math.PI * 2;
    state.particles.push({
      x: 200,
      y: 300,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * 80,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * 80,
      life: 0.4,
      maxLife: 0.4,
      size: 5,
      type: 'pop'
    });
  }

  // Check win
  if (state.perfectCount >= state.winThreshold) {
    state.screen = 'win';
  }
  if (state.score < -30) {
    state.screen = 'lose';
  }
}

// --- Draw ---
function draw() {
  // Background gradient - workshop
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2d1b4e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0a2e');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    const alpha = 0.3 + 0.4 * Math.sin(s.twinkle);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 200, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Workshop elements
  drawWorkshop();

  if (state.screen === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
    return;
  }

  if (state.screen === 'game') {
    drawGame();
    return;
  }

  if (state.screen === 'win') {
    drawEndScreen('win');
    return;
  }

  if (state.screen === 'lose') {
    drawEndScreen('lose');
    return;
  }
}

function drawWorkshop() {
  // Back wall
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a3a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.6);

  // Shelves
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3d2b5a';
  ctx.fillRect(50, 80, 200, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(550, 80, 200, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(50, 160, 200, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(550, 160, 200, 8);

  // Jars on shelves
  const jarColors = ['#ff9f43', '#54a0ff', '#5f27cd', '#ee5253'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = jarColors[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    ctx.fillRect(70 + i * 45, 50, 30, 30);
    ctx.fillRect(570 + i * 45, 50, 30, 30);
    ctx.fillRect(70 + i * 45, 130, 30, 30);
    ctx.fillRect(570 + i * 45, 130, 30, 30);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // Workbench
  const benchGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.6, 0, H);
  benchGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a3060');
  benchGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3a');
  ctx.fillStyle = benchGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.6, W, H * 0.4);

  // Bench surface line
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4070';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.6, W, 4);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Glass Blowing', W / 2, 150);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9f43';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
  ctx.fillText('The Perfect Bubble', W / 2, 195);

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e0d0ff';
  ctx.font = '20px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
  const lines = [
    'Hold F (or tap top) to heat the glass',
    'Hold SPACE (or tap bottom) to blow air',
    'Make 3 perfect bubbles to win!',
    '',
    'Keep the glass warm while blowing,',
    'but not too hot or too big!'
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    ctx.fillText(lines[i], W / 2, 260 + i * 32);
  }

  // Start button
  const btnY = 500;
  const pulse = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(state.time * 4);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, btnY);

function drawGame() {

  drawBlowpipe();

  drawBubble();
  drawGauge();

}

function drawBlowpipe() {
  const pipeX = 100;
  const pipeY = 300;

  // Pipe body
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
  ctx.lineWidth = 12;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pipeX - 60, pipeY);
  ctx.lineTo(pipeX + 60, pipeY);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pipe mouthpiece
  ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(pipeX - 60, pipeY, 15, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Glass tip
  const glassColor = state.heat > 50 ? '#ff6b35' : state.heat > 20 ? '#ffaa55' : '#aaddff';
  ctx.fillStyle = glassColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(pipeX + 60, pipeY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Glow around glass tip
  if (state.heat > 20) {
    const glowAlpha = state.heat / 100 * 0.4;
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(pipeX + 60, pipeY, 5, pipeX + 60, pipeY, 40);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 150, 50, ${glowAlpha})`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 150, 50, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pipeX + 60, pipeY, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);

}

function drawFlame() {
  if (state.flameIntensity < 0.1) return;

  const flameX = 130;
  const flameY = 390;
  const intensity = state.flameIntensity;

  // Flame layers
  for (let i = 3; i >= 0; i--) {
    const colors = ['#ff4400', '#ff8800', '#ffcc00', '#ffff88'];
    const sizes = [30, 24, 18, 12];
    const flicker = Math.sin(state.time * 10 + i) * 3 * intensity;

    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 * intensity;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(
      flameX + flicker * 0.3,
      flameY - i * 8,
      sizes[i] * intensity,
      sizes[i] * 1.5 * intensity,
      flicker * 0.1,
      0, Math.PI * 2
    );
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Flame base
  ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(flameX, flameY + 20, 25, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBubble() {
  if (state.bubbleRadius <= 0) return;

  const bx = 200;
  const by = 300;
  const r = state.bubbleRadius;

  // Bubble glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, r * 0.5, bx, by, r * 1.5);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(150, 220, 255, 0.3)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150, 220, 255, 0)');

  const bubbleGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx - r * 0.3, by - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, bx, by, r);

  bubbleGrad.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(150, 220, 255, 0.5)');
  bubbleGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(100, 180, 255, 0.3)');
  bubbleGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(80, 150, 255, 0.2)');
  ctx.fillStyle = bubbleGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 240, 255, 0.6)';
