  // Highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(bx - r * 0.3, by - r * 0.3, r * 0.2, r * 0.15, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Rainbow reflection
  const rainbow = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx - r, by + r * 0.5, bx + r, by + r * 0.5);
  rainbow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.15)');
  rainbow.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255, 255, 100, 0.15)');
  rainbow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(100, 255, 100, 0.15)');
  rainbow.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.15)');
  rainbow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 100, 255, 0.15)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rainbow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, r * 0.8, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGauge() {
  const gx = 650;
  const gy = 250;
  const gr = 80;

  // Gauge background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a2e';

}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    if (p.type === 'flame') {
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.size);
      grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 200, 50, ${alpha})`);
      grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255, 100, 0, 0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === 'air') {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 230, 255, ${alpha * 0.5})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === 'pop') {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 220, 255, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, 30, 40);

  if (state.messageTimer > 0) {

    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state.message, W / 2, 50);

  if (state.bubbleRadius > 0) {
    const pct = state.bubbleRadius / state.bubbleMaxRadius;
    ctx.fillStyle = pct > 0.9 ? '#ee5253' : pct > 0.7 ? '#ff9f43' : '#2ecc71';
    ctx.font = '16px Comic Sans MS, cursive';

    ctx.fillText('Size: ' + Math.round(pct * 100) + '%', 200, 300 + state.bubbleRadius + 25);

}

function drawEndScreen(type) {
  // Dim background
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const isWin = type === 'win';
  const title = isWin ? 'You Did It!' : 'Oh No!';
  const titleColor = isWin ? '#ffd93d' : '#ee5253';
  const subtitle = isWin ? 'You made 3 perfect bubbles!' : 'The glass got too cold or too hot!';

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Comic Sans MS, cursive';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#e0d0ff';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px Comic Sans MS, cursive';

  ctx.translate(W / 2, 450);

  ctx.fillStyle = isWin ? '#2ecc71' : '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(-120, -25, 240, 50, 25);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Comic Sans MS, cursive';
  ctx.fillText('Press R to Try Again', 0, 8);
  ctx.restore();
}

// --- Game Loop ---
let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
  lastTime = t;
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
});

<script>
"use strict";

/* ============================================================
   STATE
   ============================================================ */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let W = 0, H = 0;
let state = "title";       // title | play | win | lose
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let round = 0;
const WIN_SCORE = 10;

let value = 0;             // the true numeric value of the current round
let unit = "in";          // "in" or "cm"
let options = [];          // { x, y, r, label, correct }

let flash = 0;            // feedback flash timer
let flashColor = "#ffffff";
let shake = 0;

   RESIZE

function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

/* ============================================================
   HELPERS
   ============================================================ */
function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
function pick(arr) { return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]; }

function fmt(n) {
  // trim trailing .0
  const r = Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  return (r % 1 === 0) ? String(r) : String(r);
}

function unitLabel(u) { return u === "in" ? "inches" : "cm"; }

/* Build a new round. value is chosen in the "display" unit.
   The player must click the option that equals it in the OTHER unit. */
function newRound() {
  round++;
  unit = (round % 2 === 0) ? "cm" : "in";
  // value range grows a little with rounds
  const lo = 2 + Math.floor(round / 2);
  const hi = 12 + Math.floor(round / 2);
  value = Math.round(rand(lo, hi) * 2) / 2;

  const other = unit === "in" ? "cm" : "in";
  const factor = unit === "in" ? 2.54 : 1 / 2.54;
  const correct = Math.round(value * factor * 100) / 100;

  // build 4 options: 1 correct + 3 wrong
  const set = new Set();
  set.add(correct);
  while (set.size < 4) {
    let off = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * rand(0.5, 3.5);
    let cand = Math.round((correct + off) * 100) / 100;
    if (cand <= 0) cand = Math.round((correct * rand(1.2, 1.9)) * 100) / 100;
    if (Math.abs(cand - correct) < 0.15) continue;
    set.add(cand);
  }

  const arr = Array.from(set);
  // shuffle
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const t = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = t;
  }

  // layout: 2x2 grid in lower area
  const gap = Math.min(W, H) * 0.05;
  const bw = Math.min(W * 0.34, 320);
  const bh = Math.min(H * 0.16, 120);
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.62;
  const cols = 2, rows = 2;
  const stepX = bw + gap;
  const stepY = bh + gap;

  options = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const col = i % cols;
    const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
    const x = cx + (col === 0 ? -stepX / 2 : stepX / 2);
    const y = cy + (row === 0 ? -stepY / 2 : stepY / 2);
    options.push({
      x, y,
      w: bw, h: bh,
      label: fmt(arr[i]),
      correct: Math.abs(arr[i] - correct) < 0.05
    });
  }
}

function startGame() {
  state = "play";
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  round = 0;

        p.y >= o.y - o.h / 2 && p.y <= o.y + o.h / 2) return o;
  }
  return null;
}

  const p = toLocal(e);
  pointer.x = p.x; pointer.y = p.y; pointer.down = true;

  if (state === "title") { startGame(); return; }
  if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { state = "title"; return; }

  if (state === "play") {
    const o = optionAt(p);

        flash = 0.5; flashColor = "#5fd08a"; shake = 0;

          best = Math.max(best, score);

        flash = 0.5; flashColor = "#e06a6a"; shake = 0.4;

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);

canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); onMove(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });

  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);

function drawBackground() {

  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);

function drawRuler(cx, cy, w, h, value, unit) {

    ctx.stroke();
    if (tall) {
      ctx.fillText(String(i), x, cy + h / 2 - h * 0.5);

  const mx = cx - inner / 2 + inner * (value / n);

  ctx.font = Math.min(W * 0.045, 32) + "px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";

function drawEnd(won) {

function draw() {

  else if (state === "play") drawPlay();
  else if (state === "win") drawEnd(true);

/* ============================================================
   LOOP

function loop(now) {

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

    ctx.ellipse(s.r * 0.7, -s.r * 0.5, s.r * 0.25, s.r * 0.15, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.r * 1.05, -s.r * 0.25, s.r * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.r * 1.08, -s.r * 0.25, s.r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a3a3a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s.r * 0.3, s.r * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(-s.r * 0.3, s.r * 0.9);

      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  function drawHerder(h) {

    ctx.translate(h.x, h.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, h.r + 4, h.r, h.r * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = h.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, h.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 40);
    // timer
    ctx.fillStyle = timeLeft < 10 ? "#ff6b6b" : "#fff";

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Time: " + Math.ceil(timeLeft) + "s", W / 2, 20);

    ctx.font = "bold 15px Georgia";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";

    ctx.fillText("Sheep 2 " + (sheep2.inPen ? "\u2713" : "\u25cb"), 130, 20);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4d35e";

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, hint) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.4);

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shake, (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * shake);

    drawSheep(sheep2, 1);
    drawHerder(herder1);
    drawHerder(herder2);
    drawConfetti();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") {
      drawOverlay("Sheep Herding", "Guide both sheep into the pen", "P1: WASD   P2: Arrow Keys   (Space to start)");
    } else if (state === "win") {
      drawOverlay("You Win!", "Score: " + score, "Press Space to play again");
    } else if (state === "lose") {
      drawOverlay("Time's Up!", messageSub, "Press Space to try again");
    }
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(now) {
    if (!last) last = now;
    var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<title>Fire Extinguisher Pass</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;

  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  // ===== STATE =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  let W = window.innerWidth;
  let H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  const STATE = {
    START: 0,
    PLAYING: 1,
    GAMEOVER: 2
  };

  let gameState = STATE.START;
  let score = 0;
  let timer = 60;
  let timerAccum = 0;
  const WIN_SCORE = 5;

  // Players
  let p1 = { x: W * 0.25, y: H * 0.65, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 28, color: "#4fc3f7", holding: false, facing: 1 };
  let p2 = { x: W * 0.75, y: H * 0.65, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 28, color: "#ff8a65", holding: false, facing: -1 };

  // Extinguisher (the ball)
  let ext = { x: W * 0.5, y: H * 0.3, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 18, active: false, owner: null };

  // Fire particles
  let fires = [];
  let fireTimer = 0;
  const FIRE_INTERVAL = 1.5;

  // Particles for effects
  let particles = [];

  // Input
  let keys = {};

  // ===== INPUT =====
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (gameState === STATE.START && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
      startGame();
    } else if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
      gameState = STATE.START;
      score = 0;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W;
    canvas.height = H;
  });

  // ===== HELPERS =====
  function startGame() {
    gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
    score = 0;
    timer = 60;
    timerAccum = 0;
    fires = [];
    particles = [];
    fireTimer = 0;
    p1.x = W * 0.25; p1.y = H * 0.65; p1.holding = false;
    p2.x = W * 0.75; p2.y = H * 0.65; p2.holding = false;
    ext.x = W * 0.5; ext.y = H * 0.3; ext.vx = 0; ext.vy = 0; ext.active = false; ext.owner = null;
  }

  function spawnFire() {
    const x = Math.random() * W;
    const y = H * 0.05 + Math.random() * H * 0.25;
    fires.push({ x, y, radius: 15 + Math.random() * 10, life: 8, maxLife: 8 });
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
        life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        maxLife: 1,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  // ===== UPDATE =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;

    // Timer
    timerAccum += dt;
    if (timerAccum >= 1) {
      timerAccum -= 1;
      timer--;
      if (timer <= 0) {
        timer = 0;
        gameState = STATE.GAMEOVER;
        return;
      }
    }

    // Fire spawning
    fireTimer += dt;
    if (fireTimer >= FIRE_INTERVAL) {
      fireTimer = 0;
      spawnFire();
    }

    // Player 1 (WASD)
    const speed = 300;
    let p1vx = 0, p1vy = 0;
    if (keys["a"]) p1vx = -speed;
    if (keys["d"]) p1vx = speed;
    if (keys["w"]) p1vy = -speed;
    if (keys["s"]) p1vy = speed;
    p1.x += p1vx * dt;
    p1.y += p1vy * dt;
    if (p1vx !== 0) p1.facing = p1vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    p1.x = Math.max(p1.radius, Math.min(W - p1.radius, p1.x));
    p1.y = Math.max(p1.radius, Math.min(H - p1.radius, p1.y));

    // Player 2 (Arrow keys)
    let p2vx = 0, p2vy = 0;
    if (keys["arrowleft"]) p2vx = -speed;
    if (keys["arrowright"]) p2vx = speed;
    if (keys["arrowup"]) p2vy = -speed;
    if (keys["arrowdown"]) p2vy = speed;
    p2.x += p2vx * dt;
    p2.y += p2vy * dt;
    if (p2vx !== 0) p2.facing = p2vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    p2.x = Math.max(p2.radius, Math.min(W - p2.radius, p2.x));
    p2.y = Math.max(p2.radius, Math.min(H - p2.radius, p2.y));

    // Extinguisher physics
    if (!ext.active) {
      // Attract to nearest player
      const d1 = Math.hypot(p1.x - ext.x, p1.y - ext.y);
      const d2 = Math.hypot(p2.x - ext.x, p2.y - ext.y);
      const target = d1 < d2 ? p1 : p2;
      const dx = target.x - ext.x;
      const dy = target.y - ext.y;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist > 5) {
        ext.x += (dx / dist) * 200 * dt;
        ext.y += (dy / dist) * 200 * dt;
      }
    } else {
      ext.x += ext.vx * dt;
      ext.y += ext.vy * dt;
      ext.vx *= 0.98;
      ext.vy *= 0.98;

      // Bounce off walls
      if (ext.x < ext.radius) { ext.x = ext.radius; ext.vx *= -0.8; }
      if (ext.x > W - ext.radius) { ext.x = W - ext.radius; ext.vx *= -0.8; }
      if (ext.y < ext.radius) { ext.y = ext.radius; ext.vy *= -0.8; }
      if (ext.y > H - ext.radius) { ext.y = H - ext.radius; ext.vy *= -0.8; }
    }

    // Pickup / throw logic
    // P1 press E to pick up or throw
    if (keys["e"]) {
      if (ext.owner === p1 && ext.active) {
        // Throw
        ext.owner = null;
        ext.active = true;
        ext.vx = p1.facing * 500;
        ext.vy = -100;
        spawnParticles(ext.x, ext.y, "#4fc3f7", 8);

      } else if (ext.owner === null && !ext.active) {
        const d = Math.hypot(p1.x - ext.x, p1.y - ext.y);
        if (d < p1.radius + ext.radius + 10) {
          ext.owner = p1;
          ext.active = false;
        }
      }
    }

    // P2 press / to pick up or throw
    if (keys["/"]) {
      if (ext.owner === p2 && ext.active) {
        ext.owner = null;
        ext.active = true;
        ext.vx = p2.facing * 500;
        ext.vy = -100;
        spawnParticles(ext.x, ext.y, "#ff8a65", 8);
        keys["/"] = false;
      } else if (ext.owner === null && !ext.active) {
        const d = Math.hypot(p2.x - ext.x, p2.y - ext.y);
        if (d < p2.radius + ext.radius + 10) {
          ext.owner = p2;
          ext.active = false;
        }
      }
    }

    // Extinguisher hits fire
    if (ext.active) {
      for (let i = fires.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const f = fires[i];
        const d = Math.hypot(ext.x - f.x, ext.y - f.y);
        if (d < ext.radius + f.radius) {

          spawnParticles(f.x, f.y, "#fff", 10);

      }

    for (let i = fires.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

      if (fires[i].life <= 0) {

      }
    }

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.life -= dt;

  }

  // ===== DRAW =====
  function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#1a1a2e");
    grad.addColorStop(0.4, "#16213e");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#0f3460");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const sy = (i * 73.3) % (H * 0.4);
      const sr = 1 + (i % 3) * 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Ground
    const groundY = H * 0.75;
    const gGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
    gGrad.addColorStop(0, "#2d5a27");
    gGrad.addColorStop(1, "#1a3a1a");
    ctx.fillStyle = gGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);

    // Ground line
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a7a32";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
    ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawFire(f) {
    const alpha = f.life / f.maxLife;
    const flicker = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.01 + f.x) * 3;

    // Outer glow
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 87, 34, ${alpha * 0.3})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Flame body
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 152, 0, ${alpha * 0.9})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y - f.radius * 1.5 + flicker);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(f.x + f.radius, f.y, f.x + f.radius * 0.5, f.y + f.radius * 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(f.x - f.radius * 0.5, f.y + f.radius * 0.5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(f.x - f.radius, f.y, f.x, f.y - f.radius * 1.5 + flicker);
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner flame
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 235, 59, ${alpha * 0.8})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y - f.radius * 0.8 + flicker * 0.5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(f.x + f.radius * 0.5, f.y, f.x + f.radius * 0.3, f.y + f.radius * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(f.x - f.radius * 0.3, f.y + f.radius * 0.3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(f.x - f.radius * 0.5, f.y, f.x, f.y - f.radius * 0.8 + flicker * 0.5);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPlayer(p) {
    const { x, y, radius, color, facing } = p;

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + radius * 0.8, radius * 0.8, radius * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - radius * 0.2, y - radius * 0.2, radius * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    const eyeOffset = facing * radius * 0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + eyeOffset - radius * 0.15, y - radius * 0.1, radius * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + eyeOffset + radius * 0.15, y - radius * 0.1, radius * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Pupils
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + eyeOffset - radius * 0.15 + facing * 2, y - radius * 0.1, radius * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + eyeOffset + radius * 0.15 + facing * 2, y - radius * 0.1, radius * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = `bold ${radius * 0.5}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(p === p1 ? "P1" : "P2", x, y + radius + radius * 0.5);
  }

  function drawExtinguisher() {
    const { x, y, radius } = ext;

    // Glow if active
    if (ext.active) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, radius * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Tank body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d32f2f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - radius * 0.6, y - radius, radius * 1.2, radius * 2, radius * 0.3);
    ctx.fill();

    // Tank highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x - radius * 0.4, y - radius * 0.8, radius * 0.3, radius * 1.2, radius * 0.1);
    ctx.fill();

    // Nozzle
    ctx.fillStyle = "#555";
    ctx.fillRect(x - radius * 0.15, y - radius * 1.3, radius * 0.3, radius * 0.4);

    // Handle
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(x - radius * 0.5, y - radius * 1.2, radius, radius * 0.15);

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = `bold ${radius * 0.4}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("FIRE", x, y + radius * 0.2);
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText(`Fires Extinguished: ${score} / ${WIN_SCORE}`, 20, 40);

    // Timer
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = timer <= 10 ? "#ff5722" : "#fff";
    ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timer}s`, W - 20, 40);

    // Controls hint
    ctx.font = "14px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("P1: WASD + E (pick/throw)", 20, H - 20);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("P2: Arrows + / (pick/throw)", W - 20, H - 20);
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(W, H) * 0.06}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("FIRE EXTINGUISHER PASS", W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.font = `${Math.min(W, H) * 0.03}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4fc3f7";
    ctx.fillText("P1: WASD to move, E to pick up / throw", W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8a65";
    ctx.fillText("P2: Arrow keys to move, / to pick up / throw", W / 2, H * 0.52);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText("Throw the extinguisher at fires to put them out!", W / 2, H * 0.62);
    ctx.fillText(`Extinguish ${WIN_SCORE} fires before time runs out!`, W / 2, H * 0.68);

    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(W, H) * 0.035}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffeb3b";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to start", W / 2, H * 0.8);
  }

  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const won = score >= WIN_SCORE;
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? "#4caf50" : "#ff5722";
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(W, H) * 0.06}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(won ? "YOU WIN!" : "TIME'S UP!", W / 2, H * 0.35);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = `${Math.min(W, H) * 0.035}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText(`Fires extinguished: ${score} / ${WIN_SCORE}`, W / 2, H * 0.5);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffeb3b";
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(W, H) * 0.03}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to play again", W / 2, H * 0.65);
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    // Draw fires
    for (const f of fires) {
      drawFire(f);
    }

    // Draw players
    drawPlayer(p1);
    drawPlayer(p2);

    // Draw extinguisher
    drawExtinguisher();

    // Draw particles
    drawParticles();

    // HUD
    if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING) {
      drawHUD();
    }

    // Overlays
    if (gameState === STATE.START) {
      drawStartScreen();
    } else if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) {
      drawGameOver();
    }
  }

  // ===== GAME LOOP =====
  let lastTime = performance.now();

  function gameLoop(currentTime) {
    const dt = Math.min((currentTime - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = currentTime;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Script Cue</title>
<style>
  html, body {

    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0d0d12;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---------- State ----------
  let W = 0, H = 0;
  let state = "title";       // "title" | "playing" | "gameover"
  let score = 0;
  let combo = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  let time = 0;

  const CUE_WINDOW = 0.6;   // seconds the cue stays on screen
  const HIT_RADIUS = 0.12;  // fraction of canvas width for a hit
  const PERFECT_RADIUS = 0.05;

  const lines = [
    "You can't be serious.",
    "Where is everyone going?",
    "Do you know who I am?",
    "This isn't over, is it?",
    "I need a minute, please.",
    "Nobody said it was easy.",
    "What did you just do?",
    "We're not the same anymore.",
    "I didn't ask for this.",
    "It's not that simple, you know.",
    "How long have you been here?",
    "I should've seen it coming.",
    "You're making a mistake.",
    "It was never about the money.",
    "I'm not afraid of you.",
    "This changes everything, doesn't it?",
    "Let's not do this, okay?",
    "I've had enough, believe me.",
    "You don't understand what's at stake.",
    "I'll be right here, waiting.",
    "There's no undo on this one.",
    "I don't remember asking for that.",
    "We'll figure it out, somehow.",
    "I was going to say exactly that.",
    "You really think I'd let you?",
    "It's not what it looks like.",
    "I'd rather not talk about it.",
    "You had one job, and one only.",
    "I'm counting on you, I hope.",
    "This is my last warning, I swear.",
    "I never did trust you, you know.",
    "We'll cross that bridge tomorrow.",
    "I'm done, I'm really done now.",
    "You're on your own, I'm out.",
    "I'll handle it, don't worry.",
    "It's not personal, it's business.",
    "I've got a hunch, and it's bad.",
    "Don't tell anyone, I'm begging you.",
    "I'm not leaving, not yet, anyway.",
    "You're the one who started this, remember?",
    "I've been waiting for this all along.",
    "It's a lot to take in, I know.",
    "I'm not angry, I'm just... disappointed.",
    "You're not going to get away with this, no.",
    "I've seen enough, I'm calling it a day.",
    "This is the moment, and I won't miss it.",
    "I don't know what to say, honestly, nothing.",
    "You've crossed a line, and there's no coming back.",
    "I'm going to need a new plan, and a new team, and time.",
    "It's a long story, and I don't have the time to tell it, not now."
  ];

  let cue = null;
  let particles = [];
  let flashes = [];
  let nextIndex = 0;

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function pickLine() {
    const l = lines[nextIndex % lines.length];
    nextIndex++;
    return l;
  }
  function spawnCue() {
    cue = {
      text: pickLine(),
      born: time,
      life: CUE_WINDOW,
      x: rand(W * 0.28, W * 0.72),
      y: rand(H * 0.30, H * 0.62),
      scale: 0,
      hit: false
    };
  }
  function burst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = rand(120, 520);
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: rand(0.35, 0.9),
        max: 0.9,
        r: rand(2, 6),
        color
      });
    }
  }
  function addFlash(x, y, color, text) {
    flashes.push({ x, y, color, text, life: 0.8, max: 0.8 });
  }
  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    combo = 0;
    best = 0;
    particles = [];
    flashes = [];
    cue = null;
    nextIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length);
    state = "playing";
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function handleTap(cx, cy) {
    if (state === "title") { resetGame(); return; }
    if (state === "gameover") { resetGame(); return; }
    if (state === "playing" && cue && !cue.hit) {
      const dx = cx - cue.x;
      const dy = cy - cue.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const r = W * HIT_RADIUS;
      const pr = W * PERFECT_RADIUS;
      if (d <= r) {
        cue.hit = true;
        const perfect = d <= pr;
        const pts = perfect ? 150 : 100;
        combo += 1;
        const bonus = Math.min(combo, 10) * 10;
        score += pts + bonus;
        if (score > best) best = score;
        const col = perfect ? "#ffe066" : "#7fd7ff";
        burst(cue.x, cue.y, col, perfect ? 40 : 26);
        addFlash(cue.x, cue.y, col, perfect ? "PERFECT +" + (pts + bonus) : "HIT +" + (pts + bonus));
      } else {
        // missed the cue
        combo = 0;
        burst(cx, cy, "#5a5a66", 8);
        addFlash(cx, cy, "#8a8a99", "MISS");
      }
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    handleTap(e.clientX - rect.left, e.clientY - rect.top);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = e.changedTouches[0];
    handleTap(t.clientX - rect.left, t.clientY - rect.top);
  }, { passive: false });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;

    if (state === "playing") {
      if (!cue) {
        spawnCue();
      } else if (!cue.hit) {
        const age = time - cue.born;
        // scale-in
        const tIn = Math.min(age / 0.12, 1);
        cue.scale = tIn;
        if (age > cue.life) {
          // missed the cue: it fades out
          combo = 0;
          burst(cue.x, cue.y, "#c05050", 18);
          addFlash(cue.x, cue.y, "#ff8a8a", "MISSED");
          cue = null;
        }
      } else {
        // hit: remove after a short beat
        if (time - cue.born > cue.life + 0.05) {
          cue = null;
        }
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 600 * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
    }

    // flashes
    for (let i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = flashes[i];
      f.life -= dt;
      if (f.life <= 0) { flashes.splice(i, 1); }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // stage floor gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#14141c");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#0f0f16");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#08080d");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft stage glow
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.42, 0, W / 2, H * 0.42, Math.max(W, H) * 0.6);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,150,255,0.10)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // spotlight beams
    drawBeam(W * 0.22, 0, "rgba(255,210,120,0.10)");
    drawBeam(W * 0.78, 0, "rgba(120,200,255,0.10)");
    drawBeam(W * 0.5, 0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)");
  }

  function drawBeam(x, yTop, color) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 20, yTop);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 20, yTop);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 160, H);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 160, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStage() {
    // floor line
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.82);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H * 0.82);
    ctx.stroke();

    // floor reflection
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,150,255,0.05)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.82, W, H * 0.18);

    // little stage lights (dots) along the top
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,150,0.5)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const lx = W * (0.1 + i * 0.1);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(lx, H * 0.06, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawCue() {
    if (!cue) return;
    const age = time - cue.born;
    const alpha = cue.hit ? Math.max(0, 1 - (age - cue.life) / 0.05) : 1;
    const scale = cue.scale * (cue.hit ? 1 + (age - cue.life) * 8 : 1);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cue.x, cue.y);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

    // speech bubble
    const text = cue.text;
    const fs = Math.max(16, Math.min(W * 0.028, 30));
    ctx.font = "bold " + fs + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
    const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
    const pad = 22;
    const bw = tw + pad * 2;
    const bh = fs * 2.4;

    // tail
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-bw * 0.3, bh / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-bw * 0.3 - 18, bh / 2 + 26);
    ctx.lineTo(-bw * 0.3 + 22, bh / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // bubble body
    roundRect(-bw / 2, -bh / 2, bw, bh, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.96)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = cue.hit ? "#ffe066" : "#3a7bff";
    ctx.stroke();

    // text
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a22";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, 0, 0);

    ctx.restore();

    // timing ring (only while not hit)
    if (!cue.hit) {
      const remain = 1 - (age / cue.life);
      const R = W * HIT_RADIUS;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cue.x, cue.y);
      // outer faint ring
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // shrinking ring
      const col = remain > 0.5 ? "#7fd7ff" : (remain > 0.25 ? "#ffe066" : "#ff7a7a");
      ctx.strokeStyle = col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, R * Math.max(remain, 0.02), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life / p.max, 0);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawFlashes() {

(function() {

  const state = {
    phase: 'start',
    score: 0,

    shakeX: 0,

  };

  const keys = {};
  const P1_SPEED = 220;
  const P2_SPEED = 220;
  const POTATO_SPEED = 180;
  const POTATO_R = 14;

  function resetRound() {
    state.potato.x = W / 2;
    state.potato.y = H / 2;
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    state.potato.vx = Math.cos(angle) * POTATO_SPEED;

    state.p1.x = W * 0.2;

    state.p2.y = H * 0.5;
    state.holder = null;
    state.fuseTime = 0;
    state.particles = [];
    state.winner = null;
    state.message = '';
    state.shakeX = 0;
    state.shakeY = 0;
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 30 + Math.random() * 80;
      state.particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        maxLife: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        color: color,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
      });
    }
  }

  function dist(a, b) {
    const dx = a.x - b.x;
    const dy = a.y - b.y;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  }

  function handleInput(dt) {
    if (state.phase === 'start') {
      if (keys[' '] || keys['Enter']) {
        state.phase = 'playing';
        state.score = 0;
        resetRound();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (state.phase === 'gameover') {
      if (keys[' '] || keys['Enter']) {
        state.phase = 'start';
        state.score = 0;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

    let dx1 = 0, dy1 = 0;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['ArrowUp']) dy1 -= 1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['ArrowDown']) dy1 += 1;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['ArrowLeft']) dx1 -= 1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['ArrowRight']) dx1 += 1;
    const len1 = Math.sqrt(dx1 * dx1 + dy1 * dy1);
    if (len1 > 0) {
      state.p1.x += (dx1 / len1) * P1_SPEED * dt;
      state.p1.y += (dy1 / len1) * P1_SPEED * dt;
    }

    let dx2 = 0, dy2 = 0;
    if (keys['ArrowUp']) dy2 -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowDown']) dy2 += 1;
    if (keys['ArrowLeft']) dx2 -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowRight']) dx2 += 1;
    const len2 = Math.sqrt(dx2 * dx2 + dy2 * dy2);

      state.p2.y += (dy2 / len2) * P2_SPEED * dt;

    state.p1.x = Math.max(state.p1.r, Math.min(W - state.p1.r, state.p1.x));

    state.p2.x = Math.max(state.p2.r, Math.min(W - state.p2.r, state.p2.x));
    state.p2.y = Math.max(state.p2.r, Math.min(H - state.p2.r, state.p2.y));

    const p = state.potato;
    if (state.holder === null) {
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      if (p.x < POTATO_R) { p.x = POTATO_R; p.vx = Math.abs(p.vx); }
      if (p.x > W - POTATO_R) { p.x = W - POTATO_R; p.vx = -Math.abs(p.vx); }

        state.fuseTime = 0;
        spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, '#4ecdc4', 8);
      }
    } else {
      if (state.holder === 'p1') {
        p.x = state.p1.x;
        p.y = state.p1.y;
      } else {
        p.x = state.p2.x;
        p.y = state.p2.y;
      }
      state.fuseTime += dt;
      state.shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.min(state.fuseTime * 4, 8);
      state.shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.min(state.fuseTime * 4, 8);

      if (state.fuseTime >= state.fuseMax) {
        if (state.holder === 'p1') {
          state.winner = 'p2';
          state.message = 'Player 2 Wins!';

          state.winner = 'p1';

  function drawPlayer(p, color, label) {

  function drawGameOver() {

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

      ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    else if (state.phase === 'roundEnd') drawRoundEnd();
    else if (state.phase === 'gameover') drawGameOver();
  }

  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function gameLoop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' '].includes(e.key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e) {
    keys[e.key] = false;
  });

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
})();

<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- setup ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

function resize() {
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ---------- constants ---------- */
const LANE_COUNT = 3;
const LANE_COLORS = ['#ff5d8f', '#ffd23f', '#4fc3f7'];
const LANE_GLOW  = ['#ff8fb0', '#ffe07a', '#8fd6ff'];
const SPAWN_LEAD = 1.7;      // seconds before a note reaches the hit line
const HIT_WINDOW = 0.16;     // seconds
const GOOD_WINDOW = 0.07;
const COMBO_STEP = 5;
const MAX_COMBO = 30;
const WIN_SCORE = 30;

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state = {
  phase: 'start',          // 'start' | 'play' | 'win' | 'lose'
  time: 0,
  last: 0,
  score: 0,
  combo: 0,
  maxCombo: 0,
  misses: 0,
  maxMisses: 5,
  laneFlash: [0, 0, 0],
  hitFx: [0, 0, 0],
  notes: [],
  particles: [],
  beat: 0,
  beatFlash: 0,
  nextSpawn: 0,
  shake: 0
};

const laneX = (i) => W * (0.22 + 0.28 * i);
const hitY  = () => H * 0.74;

/* ---------- audio ---------- */
let AC = null;
function audio() {
  if (!AC) {
    try { AC = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (e) {}
  }
  if (AC && AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume();
  return AC;
}
function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, when) {
  const ac = audio();
  if (!ac) return;
  const t = ac.currentTime + (when || 0);
  const o = ac.createOscillator();
  const g = ac.createGain();
  o.type = type || 'sine';
  o.frequency.value = freq;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.2, t + 0.012);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
  o.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
  o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.03);
}
function playLane(i) {
  const f = [392, 523.25, 659.25][i];
  tone(f, 0.22, 'triangle', 0.22, 0);
  tone(f * 2, 0.12, 'sine', 0.08, 0);
}
function playHit() {
  tone(880, 0.09, 'square', 0.10, 0);
}
function playMiss() {
  tone(150, 0.28, 'sawtooth', 0.14, 0);
}
function playWin() {
  [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((f, k) => tone(f, 0.35, 'triangle', 0.2, k * 0.12));
}
function playLose() {
  [392, 330, 262].forEach((f, k) => tone(f, 0.4, 'sine', 0.18, k * 0.18));
}

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function spawnNote() {
  const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * LANE_COUNT);
  const tHit = state.time + SPAWN_LEAD;
  state.notes.push({ lane: lane, tHit: tHit, done: false });
}

function startGame() {
  state.phase = 'play';
  state.time = 0;
  state.last = performance.now() / 1000;
  state.score = 0;
  state.combo = 0;
  state.maxCombo = 0;
  state.misses = 0;
  state.laneFlash = [0, 0, 0];
  state.hitFx = [0, 0, 0];
  state.notes = [];
  state.particles = [];
  state.beat = 0;
  state.beatFlash = 0;
  state.nextSpawn = 0.4;
  state.shake = 0;
  audio();
}

function burst(x, y, color, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 120 + Math.random() * 260;
    state.particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 40,
      life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5,
      age: 0,
      r: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
      color: color
    });
  }
}

function onLaneTap(i) {
  if (state.phase !== 'play') return;
  state.laneFlash[i] = 1;
  playLane(i);

  // find nearest note in this lane
  let best = null, bestD = 1e9;
  for (const n of state.notes) {
    if (n.lane !== i || n.done) continue;
    const d = Math.abs(state.time - n.tHit);
    if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = n; }
  }

  if (best && bestD <= HIT_WINDOW) {
    best.done = true;
    state.combo += 1;
    state.maxCombo = Math.max(state.maxCombo, state.combo);
    const good = bestD <= GOOD_WINDOW;
    state.score += good ? 2 : 1;
    state.hitFx[i] = 1;
    state.shake = good ? 0.5 : 0.3;
    playHit();
    burst(laneX(i), hitY(), LANE_GLOW[i], good ? 26 : 16);
    if (state.score >= WIN_SCORE) {
      state.phase = 'win';
      playWin();
    }
  } else {
    // tapped with nothing to hit: small penalty feel
    state.combo = 0;
    playMiss();
    state.shake = 0.25;
  }
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function handleTap(clientX, clientY) {
  if (state.phase === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') { startGame(); return; }
  // play: map x to nearest lane
  let idx = 0, bd = 1e9;
  for (let i = 0; i < LANE_COUNT; i++) {
    const d = Math.abs(clientX - laneX(i));
    if (d < bd) { bd = d; idx = i; }
  }
  onLaneTap(idx);
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  handleTap(e.clientX, e.clientY);
}, { passive: false });

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (state.phase === 'start' || state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') {
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === '1') onLaneTap(0);
  else if (e.key === '2') onLaneTap(1);
  else if (e.key === '3') onLaneTap(2);
});

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt) {
  // particles always animate
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.age += dt;
    if (p.age >= p.life) { state.particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    p.vy += 520 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
  }

  // decay flashes
  for (let i = 0; i < LANE_COUNT; i++) {
    state.laneFlash[i] = Math.max(0, state.laneFlash[i] - dt * 3);
    state.hitFx[i] = Math.max(0, state.hitFx[i] - dt * 4);
  }
  state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 2);
  state.beatFlash = Math.max(0, state.beatFlash - dt * 2);

  if (state.phase !== 'play') return;

  state.time += dt;

  // beat pulse (120 bpm)
  const beatDur = 0.5;
  const newBeat = Math.floor(state.time / beatDur);
  if (newBeat !== state.beat) {
    state.beat = newBeat;
    state.beatFlash = 1;
  }

  // spawn notes
  if (state.time >= state.nextSpawn) {
    spawnNote();
    state.nextSpawn += 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5;
  }

  // miss detection
  for (const n of state.notes) {
    if (n.done) continue;
    if (state.time > n.tHit + HIT_WINDOW) {
      n.done = true;
      n.missed = true;
      state.combo = 0;
      state.misses += 1;
      state.shake = 0.5;
      playMiss();
      burst(laneX(n.lane), hitY(), '#b06bff', 10);
      if (state.misses >= state.maxMisses) {
        state.phase = 'lose';
        playLose();
      }
    }
  }

  // cull old notes
  state.notes = state.notes.filter((n) => !n.done || state.time < n.tHit + 0.6);
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#2a2260');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#3a2f7a');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#1c1640');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // soft glowing circles
  const cols = ['#7b5cff', '#ff5d8f', '#4fc3f7', '#ffd23f'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const cx = W * (0.15 + 0.23 * i);
    const cy = H * (0.2 + 0.06 * Math.sin(state.time * 0.6 + i));
    const r = Math.min(W, H) * 0.16;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r);
    rg.addColorStop(0, cols[i] + '44');
    rg.addColorStop(1, cols[i] + '00');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // twinkling stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 97) % W;
    const sy = (i * 53) % (H * 0.5);
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time * 1.5 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.7;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawLanes() {
  const top = H * 0.08;
  const bottom = H * 0.9;
  for (let i = 0; i < LANE_COUNT; i++) {
    const x = laneX(i);
    const laneW = Math.min(W * 0.14, 120);
    const flash = state.laneFlash[i];

    // lane track
    const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, top, x, bottom);
    lg.addColorStop(0, LANE_COLORS[i] + '22');
    lg.addColorStop(1, LANE_COLORS[i] + '55');
    ctx.fillStyle = lg;
    roundRect(x - laneW / 2, top, laneW, bottom - top, laneW / 3);
    ctx.fill();

    // flash glow
    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = flash * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = LANE_GLOW[i];
      roundRect(x - laneW / 2, top, laneW, bottom - top, laneW / 3);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // hit line
    const hy = hitY();
    const pulse = 1 + state.beatFlash * 0.25 + state.hitFx[i] * 0.6;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = LANE_GLOW[i];
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24 * pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = LANE_GLOW[i];
    roundRect(x - laneW / 2, hy - 7 * pulse, laneW, 14 * pulse, 7 * pulse);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // hit target ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = LANE_GLOW[i];
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, hy, laneW * 0.32 * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawNotes() {
  const top = H * 0.08;
  const bottom = hitY();
  const span = bottom - top;
  for (const n of state.notes) {
    if (n.done) continue;
    const t = n.tHit - state.time;
    const y = top + (t / SPAWN_LEAD) * span;
    if (y < top - 40 || y > bottom + 40) continue;
    const x = laneX(n.lane);
    const r = Math.min(W * 0.05, 34);

    // glow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = LANE_GLOW[n.lane];
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = LANE_COLORS[n.lane];
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // inner highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // musical note glyph
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(r * 0.9) + 'px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('\u266A', x, y + 1);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const a = 1 - p.age / p.life;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, a);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (0.5 + a), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  // score
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.05) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(state.score + ' / ' + WIN_SCORE, cx, H * 0.02);

  // progress bar
  const barW = Math.min(W * 0.5, 320);
  const barX = cx - barW / 2;
  const barY = H * 0.075;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff22';
  roundRect(barX, barY, barW, 12, 6); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
  const frac = Math.min(1, state.score / WIN_SCORE);
  if (frac > 0) { roundRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, 12, 6); ctx.fill(); }

  // combo
  if (state.combo >= COMBO_STEP) {
    const scale = 1 + state.beatFlash * 0.15;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d8f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.06 * scale) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(state.combo + 'x COMBO', cx, H * 0.13);
  }

  // misses (hearts)
  const missY = H * 0.02;
  const missX = W - H * 0.05;
  for (let i = 0; i < state.maxMisses; i++) {
    const filled = i < state.maxMisses - state.misses;
    ctx.fillStyle = filled ? '#ff5d8f' : '#ffffff22';
    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.045) + 'px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('\u2665', missX, missY + i * H * 0.05);
  }
}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00000088';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.09) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - H * 0.06);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.035) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(subtitle, cx, cy + H * 0.03);

  const bob = 1 + Math.sin(state.time * 3) * 0.06;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
  ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.04 * bob) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Tap to Play', cx, cy + H * 0.12);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // shake
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    const s = state.shake * 8;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawLanes();
  drawNotes();
  drawParticles();

  if (state.phase === 'play') {
    drawHUD();
  } else if (state.phase === 'start') {
    drawOverlay('Bop the Beat', 'Tap the notes as they reach the glowing lines!', '#7b5cff');
  } else if (state.phase === 'win') {
    drawOverlay('You Rock! \u266A', 'You reached ' + WIN_SCORE + ' points!  Best combo: ' + state.maxCombo + 'x', '#4fc3f7');
  } else if (state.phase === 'lose') {
    drawOverlay('Out of Hearts', 'You scored ' + state.score + ' points.  Best combo: ' + state.maxCombo + 'x', '#ff5d8f');
  }
}

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
function loop(now) {
  const t = now / 1000;
  let dt = t - state.last;
  state.last = t;
  if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

state.last = performance.now() / 1000;
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

  }

  function makeParticle(x, y, vx, vy, color, life, size) {
    return { x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, color: color, life: life, maxLife: life, size: size };
  }

  function makePopup(x, y, text, color, size) {
    return { x: x, y: y, text: text, color: color, size: size, life: 1.4, vy: -34 };
  }

  function burst(x, y, n, color, spread, speed) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = speed * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8);
      state.particles.push(makeParticle(
        x, y,
        Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s - spread,
        color,
        0.5 + Math.random() * 0.6,
        2 + Math.random() * 4
      ));
    }
  }

  function dropRecord() {
    if (state.phase !== "playing") return;
    const x = PLATTER_CX + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 30;
    const rec = makeRecord(x, DROP_Y, 40, SPIN0 * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4));
    state.records.push(rec);
    state.dropCount++;
  }

  function onLand(rec) {
    const dx = rec.x - PLATTER_CX;
    const dy = rec.y - PLATTER_CY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const inPlatter = dist <= PLATTER_R;
    if (inPlatter) {
      state.combo++;
      const base = 100;
      const comboBonus = (state.combo - 1) * 25;
      const points = base + comboBonus;
      state.score += points;
      if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
      state.shake = Math.min(state.shake + 8, 18);
      state.flash = 0.5;
      burst(rec.x, rec.y, 18, "#7ee0d0", 60, 220);
      state.popups.push(makePopup(rec.x, rec.y - 30, "+" + points, "#ffe08a", 22));
      if (state.combo > 1) state.popups.push(makePopup(rec.x, rec.y - 58, "COMBO x" + state.combo, "#ff9d5c", 16));
      if (state.combo >= SCORE_LINES) {
        state.phase = "win";
        state.shake = 24;
        burst(PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY, 60, "#ffd36b", 120, 320);
        burst(PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY, 40, "#7ee0d0", 80, 260);
        state.popups.push(makePopup(PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY - 60, "TRACK COMPLETE!", "#ffffff", 30));
      }
    } else {
      state.combo = 0;
      state.shake = Math.min(state.shake + 14, 22);
      state.flash = 0.8;
      burst(rec.x, rec.y, 26, "#ff5566", 90, 280);
      state.popups.push(makePopup(rec.x, rec.y - 30, "MISS!", "#ff5566", 24));
      rec.dead = true;
    }

  function update(dt) {
    state.t += dt;
    state.spin += dt * 0.9;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 40);
    if (state.flash > 0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 1.6);

    for (let i = 0; i < state.records.length; i++) {
      const r = state.records[i];
      if (r.dead) {
        r.alpha -= dt * 2.2;
        r.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
        r.y += r.vy * dt;
        r.rot += r.spin * dt * 0.02;
        continue;
      }
      if (!r.landed) {
        r.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
        r.y += r.vy * dt;
        r.spin = Math.max(0, r.spin - dt * 10);
        r.rot += r.spin * dt * 0.05;
        if (r.y >= PLATTER_CY - 4) {
          r.y = PLATTER_CY - 4;
          r.vy = -r.vy * BOUNCE;
          if (Math.abs(r.vy) < REST_VY) {
            r.landed = true;
            r.spin = 0;
            onLand(r);
          }
        }
      } else {
        r.y += Math.sin(state.t * 3 + r.x) * 0.15;
      }
    }

    for (let i = state.records.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (state.records[i].alpha <= 0) state.records.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = state.particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) { state.particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      p.vy += GRAVITY * 0.35 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
    }

    for (let i = state.popups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const pp = state.popups[i];
      pp.life -= dt;
      if (pp.life <= 0) { state.popups.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      pp.y += pp.vy * dt;
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, VH);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#1a1430");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#241a3d");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#140f22");

    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY, PLATTER_R * 0.6, PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY, PLATTER_R * 1.7);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(126,224,208,0.10)");

  function drawPlatter() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(PLATTER_CX, PLATTER_CY);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#0d0a16";

    ctx.ellipse(0, 14, PLATTER_R + 22, PLATTER_R * 0.5 + 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    body.addColorStop(0.6, "#241f38");
    body.addColorStop(1, "#120e20");

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a4468";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, PLATTER_R + 20, PLATTER_R * 0.5 + 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    disc.addColorStop(0, "#2b2738");
    disc.addColorStop(0.55, "#1a1726");
    disc.addColorStop(1, "#0c0a14");
    ctx.fillStyle = disc;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, PLATTER_R, PLATTER_R * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const rr = PLATTER_R * (0.25 + i * 0.055);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.03 + (i % 2) * 0.02) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rr, rr * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    const sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(-PLATTER_R, -PLATTER_R * 0.5, PLATTER_R, PLATTER_R * 0.5);
    sheen.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    sheen.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(180,200,255,0.08)");
    sheen.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,255,255,0.14)");
    sheen.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(180,200,255,0.08)");
    sheen.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = sheen;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, PLATTER_R, PLATTER_R * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#e75480";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, PLATTER_R * 0.16, PLATTER_R * 0.08, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#120e20";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, PLATTER_R * 0.045, PLATTER_R * 0.022, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();

  function drawRecord(rec) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = rec.alpha;
    ctx.translate(rec.x, rec.y);
    ctx.rotate(rec.rot);

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";

    ctx.ellipse(0, 8, rec.r, rec.r * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    g.addColorStop(0.6, rec.groove);

    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, rec.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = rec.rim;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, rec.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, rec.r * (0.4 + i * 0.15), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = rec.labelColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, rec.r * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#120e20";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, rec.r * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold " + (rec.r * 0.34) + "px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(rec.label, 0, -rec.r * 0.02);

    ctx.restore();

  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < state.particles.length; i++) {
      const p = state.particles[i];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawPopups() {
    for (let i = 0; i < state.popups.length; i++) {

      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, pp.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = pp.color;
      ctx.font = "bold " + pp.size + "px Arial Black";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;

      ctx.fillText(pp.text, pp.x, pp.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9d5c";
    ctx.font = "bold 16px Arial Black";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fd0ff";
    ctx.font = "bold 14px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("BEST  " + state.best, VW - 24, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText(state.dropCount + " / " + SCORE_LINES, VW - 24, 58);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
    ctx.font = "14px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("Drop records onto the spinning platter. Land " + SCORE_LINES + " in a row to complete the track!", VW / 2, VH - 24);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,7,20,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#7ee0d0";
    ctx.font = "bold 56px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText("DROP IT!", VW / 2, VH * 0.34);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9d5c";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("A vinyl platter game", VW / 2, VH * 0.44);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.t * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 26px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  START", VW / 2, VH * 0.62);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.font = "16px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("Click / tap or press Space to drop a record.", VW / 2, VH * 0.72);
    ctx.fillText("Land it on the platter to score. Miss and your combo resets.", VW / 2, VH * 0.78);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawWin() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,7,20,0.78)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd36b";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText("TRACK COMPLETE!", VW / 2, VH * 0.36);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText("Final Score  " + state.score, VW / 2, VH * 0.48);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#7ee0d0";
    ctx.font = "bold 18px Arial";
    ctx.fillText("You dropped " + state.dropCount + " records onto the platter.", VW / 2, VH * 0.55);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.t * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9d5c";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px Arial Black";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  PLAY  AGAIN", VW / 2, VH * 0.68);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() * 2 - 1) * state.shake, (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * state.shake);
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawPlatter();
    for (let i = 0; i < state.records.length; i++) drawRecord(state.records[i]);
    drawParticles();
    drawPopups();
    if (state.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (state.flash * 0.18) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, VW + 40, VH + 40);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    if (state.phase === "playing") drawHUD();
    if (state.phase === "title") drawTitle();
    if (state.phase === "win") drawWin();
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.phase = "playing";
    state.score = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.dropCount = 0;
    state.records = [];
    state.particles = [];
    state.popups = [];
    state.shake = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
  }

  function onAction() {
    if (state.phase === "title") startGame();
    else if (state.phase === "win") startGame();
    else if (state.phase === "playing") dropRecord();
  }

  function onKeyDown(e) {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onAction();
    }
  }

  function onPointer(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    onAction();
  }

  document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointer);
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  resize();

  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    if (state.phase === "playing") update(dt);
    else { state.t += dt; }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width = 900;
canvas.height = 600;

let timeLeft = 60;
let lastTime = 0;

let targetTimer = 0;

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

      particles = [];
    }
    return;
  }
  if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

  let btnIdx = -1;
  if (key === 'A') btnIdx = 0;
  if (key === 'S') btnIdx = 1;
  if (key === 'D') btnIdx = 2;

  if (btnIdx === -1) return;
  handleButton(btnIdx);
});

function startGame() {
  gameState = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  timeLeft = 60;
  combo = 0;
  seqIndex = 0;
  particles = [];
  generateSequence();
}

function generateSequence() {
  if (seqIndex >= sequence.length) {
    sequence = [];
    const len = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      sequence.push(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3));
    }
    seqIndex = 0;
  }
  targetButton = sequence[seqIndex];
  targetDuration = Math.max(1.2, 3.0 - score * 0.05);
  targetTimer = 0;
}

function handleButton(btnIdx) {
  if (btnIdx === targetButton) {
    score += 10 + combo * 2;
    combo++;
    correctFlash = 0.3;
    seqIndex++;
    generateSequence();
    spawnParticles(200 + btnIdx * 250, 420, BTN_COLORS[btnIdx]);
  } else {
    combo = 0;
    wrongFlash = 0.3;
    timeLeft -= 3;
    if (timeLeft < 0) timeLeft = 0;
  }
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 2,
      life: 1.0,
      color: color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

// --- Update ---
function update(dt) {
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    timeLeft -= dt;
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
      timeLeft = 0;
      gameState = 'lost';
      return;
    }
    targetTimer += dt;
    if (targetTimer >= targetDuration) {
      seqIndex++;
      generateSequence();
    }
  }
  correctFlash = Math.max(0, correctFlash - dt);
  wrongFlash = Math.max(0, wrongFlash - dt);
  soundWave += dt * 4;

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life -= dt * 1.5;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function draw() {
  // Background
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d2b');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a3e');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a1a');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % canvas.width;
    const sy = (i * 97 + 20) % (canvas.height * 0.4);
    const twinkle = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(soundWave * 0.5 + i));
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 220, ${twinkle * 0.6})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1 + (i % 3) * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Radio cabinet
  drawRadioCabinet();

  // Sound waves from speaker
  drawSoundWaves();

  // Buttons
  drawButtons();

  // Target indicator
  if (gameState === 'playing') {
    drawTargetIndicator();
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // Particles
  drawParticles();

  // Overlays
  if (gameState === 'start') drawStartScreen();

  if (gameState === 'lost') drawEndScreen(false);
}

function drawRadioCabinet() {

    ctx.lineTo(gx, grilleY + grilleH - 10);

    ctx.lineTo(grilleX + grilleW - 10, gy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // VU Meter
  const vuX = panelX + panelW / 2 - 80;

  ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#cc2200';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(needleCx, needleCy);
  ctx.lineTo(needleCx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * 40, needleCy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * 40);
  ctx.stroke();

  // VU label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.font = '10px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('VU', vuX + vuW / 2, vuY + 12);

  // Decorative screws
  const screwPositions = [

    [panelX + panelW - 15, panelY + 15],
    [panelX + 15, panelY + panelH - 15],
    [panelX + panelW - 15, panelY + panelH - 15]
  ];
  screwPositions.forEach(([sx, sy]) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx - 2, sy);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + 2, sy);

  // Title on cabinet

function drawSoundWaves() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = 220;
  const numWaves = 5;

  for (let i = 0; i < numWaves; i++) {
    const radius = 30 + i * 25 + Math.sin(soundWave + i) * 5;
    const alpha = Math.max(0, 0.4 - i * 0.07);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 200, 50, ${alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, -Math.PI * 0.7, -Math.PI * 0.3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawButtons() {
  const btnY = 380;
  const btnW = 100;
  const btnH = 70;
  const gap = 40;
  const totalW = btnW * 3 + gap * 2;
  const startX = canvas.width / 2 - totalW / 2;

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const bx = startX + i * (btnW + gap);
    const by = btnY;
    const isTarget = gameState === 'playing' && i === targetButton;

    // Button shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    roundRect(bx + 4, by + 4, btnW, btnH, 12);

    // Button body
    let baseColor = BTN_COLORS[i];
    if (wrongFlash > 0 && i !== targetButton) {
      baseColor = '#666';
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = baseColor;
    roundRect(bx, by, btnW, btnH, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    // Button highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    roundRect(bx + 5, by + 5, btnW - 10, btnH / 2 - 5, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // Button border
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(bx, by, btnW, btnH, 12);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Target glow
    if (isTarget && gameState === 'playing') {
      const glowAlpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(soundWave * 3) * 0.15;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 100, ${glowAlpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      roundRect(bx - 4, by - 4, btnW + 8, btnH + 8, 15);

    }

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';

    // Key hint
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';

function drawTargetIndicator() {
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const y = 350;

  // Progress bar for current target
  const progress = Math.min(1, targetTimer / targetDuration);
  const barW = 200;
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = cx - barW / 2;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  roundRect(barX, y, barW, barH, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  const fillColor = progress > 0.7 ? '#ff4444' : '#44ff88';
  ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
  roundRect(barX, y, barW * progress, barH, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // Sequence dots
  const dotY = y + 25;
  const dotGap = 20;
  const totalDots = sequence.length;
  const dotsStartX = cx - (totalDots - 1) * dotGap / 2;

  for (let i = 0; i < totalDots; i++) {
    const dx = dotsStartX + i * dotGap;
    let color = '#555';
    if (i < seqIndex) color = '#2ecc71';
    else if (i === seqIndex) color = BTN_COLORS[sequence[i]];

    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(dx, dotY, i === seqIndex ? 7 : 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    if (i === seqIndex) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(dx, dotY, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';

  // Timer bar

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';

  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;

function drawParticles() {
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawEndScreen(won) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('The radio goes dark... for now.', canvas.width / 2, 400);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';

  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RESTART', canvas.width / 2, 460);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}
