  }
}

function floatText(x, y, text, color, size) {
  state.floatTexts.push({ x, y, text, color, size: size || 16, life: 1.0, max: 1.0 });
}

function spawnCreep() {
  const y = laneY();
  const r = rand(15, 24);
  const hp = 45 + state.wave * 15;
  const speed = rand(40, 62) + state.wave * 3;
  const big = state.wave % 5 === 0 && state.toSpawn === 1;
  const c = {
    x: W + r + rand(0, 40),
    y: y + rand(-14, 14),
    r: big ? r * 1.5 : r,
    hp: big ? hp * 3 : hp,
    maxHp: big ? hp * 3 : hp,
    speed: big ? speed * 0.6 : speed,
    bob: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
    big: big,
    flash: 0
  };
  state.creeps.push(c);
}

/* ---------- Input ---------- */
function fire() {
  if (state.screen !== "play") return;
  const p = state.plant;
  if (p.cooldown > 0) return;
  p.cooldown = p.fireRate;
  p.reload = 0.25;
  p.recoil = 1;
  const y = p.y;
  state.peashots.push({ x: p.x + 34, y: y - 30, vx: 520, r: 9, dmg: p.damage });
  burst(p.x + 40, y - 30, "#eaffb0", 6, 120, 0.3, 3);
  state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3);
}

function handleAction() {
  if (state.screen === "start") {
    reset();
    state.screen = "play";
  } else if (state.screen === "play") {
    fire();
  } else if (state.screen === "over") {
    reset();
    state.screen = "play";
  }
}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  handleAction();
});
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.repeat) return;
  if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "KeyF") {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleAction();
  }
});

/* ---------- Update ---------- */
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 20);

  if (state.screen !== "play") {
    updateParticles(dt);
    return;
  }

  const p = state.plant;
  p.cooldown = Math.max(0, p.cooldown - dt);
  p.reload = Math.max(0, p.reload - dt);
  p.recoil = Math.max(0, p.recoil - dt * 4);

  // spawning
  if (state.toSpawn > 0) {
    state.spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (state.spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnCreep();
      state.toSpawn--;
      state.spawnInterval = Math.max(0.55, 1.4 - state.wave * 0.05);
      state.spawnTimer = state.spawnInterval;
    }
  } else if (state.creeps.length === 0) {
    // wave cleared
    state.wave++;
    state.toSpawn = 3 + Math.floor(state.wave * 0.8);
    state.spawnTimer = 1.4;
    floatText(W / 2, H * 0.32, "WAVE " + state.wave, "#ffe27a", 30);
  }

  // peashots
  for (let i = state.peashots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = state.peashots[i];
    s.x += s.vx * dt;
    if (s.x > W + 40) { state.peashots.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    for (let j = state.creeps.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const c = state.creeps[j];
      const dx = c.x - s.x;
      const dy = c.y - s.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (c.r + s.r) * (c.r + s.r)) {
        c.hp -= s.dmg;
        c.flash = 0.15;
        burst(s.x, s.y, "#a6ff5c", 10, 180, 0.4, 4);
        state.peashots.splice(i, 1);
        if (c.hp <= 0) {
          state.score += c.big ? 300 : 100;
          state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
          floatText(c.x, c.y - c.r, "+" + (c.big ? 300 : 100), "#fff2a8", c.big ? 22 : 16);
          burst(c.x, c.y, c.big ? "#ff5b5b" : "#c9ff7a", c.big ? 26 : 16, 220, 0.6, 5);
          state.creeps.splice(j, 1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // creeps
  for (let i = state.creeps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const c = state.creeps[i];
    c.x -= c.speed * dt;
    c.bob += dt * 6;
    c.flash = Math.max(0, c.flash - dt);
    if (c.x - c.r <= p.x + 20) {
      // reached the plant
      p.hp -= c.big ? 22 : 10;
      burst(p.x, p.y - 20, "#ff7a5c", 14, 180, 0.5, 4);
      state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, c.big ? 10 : 6);
      state.creeps.splice(i, 1);
      if (p.hp <= 0) {
        p.hp = 0;
        state.screen = "over";
        burst(p.x, p.y, "#7dff9b", 40, 260, 0.9, 6);
        state.shake = 14;
      }
    }
  }

  updateParticles(dt);

  // float texts
  for (let i = state.floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const t = state.floatTexts[i];
    t.life -= dt;
    t.y -= dt * 30;
    if (t.life <= 0) state.floatTexts.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.vy += p.g * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ---------- Draw ---------- */
function draw() {
  const sx = state.shake > 0 ? rand(-state.shake, state.shake) : 0;
  const sy = state.shake > 0 ? rand(-state.shake, state.shake) : 0;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  drawSky();
  drawHills();
  drawGround();
  drawPlant();
  drawCreeps();
  drawPeashots();
  drawParticles();
  drawFloatTexts();
  drawHUD();

  if (state.screen === "start") drawStart();
  if (state.screen === "over") drawOver();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSky() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, groundTop());
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2a1a52");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#5b3b7a");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#c96a8a");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, groundTop());

  // sun
  const sunX = W * 0.8, sunY = H * 0.16, sunR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.07;
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, sunR * 0.2, sunX, sunY, sunR * 2.4);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,232,150,0.95)");
  sg.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,190,120,0.35)");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,190,120,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunR * 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHills() {
  const base = groundTop();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2a63";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, base);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 20) {
    const y = base - 40 - Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 30;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, base);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f2350";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, base);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 20) {
    const y = base - 15 - Math.cos(x * 0.008 + 1) * 22;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, base);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGround() {
  const top = groundTop();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#4a7a3a");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#3a5f2e");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#25401f");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, top, W, H - top);

  // the lane / path
  const ly = laneY();
  const laneH = Math.min(H * 0.12, 90);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#6b4a2e";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(0, ly - laneH / 2, W, laneH, laneH / 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7d5836";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(0, ly - laneH / 2 + 8, W, laneH / 2 - 16, 20);
  ctx.fill();

  // grass tufts
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#6fae4f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let x = 30; x < W; x += 90) {
    const yy = top + rand(10, 30);
    for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, yy);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + k * 6, yy - 14, x + k * 10, yy - 20);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawPlant() {
  const p = state.plant;
  const x = p.x, y = p.y;
  const sway = Math.sin(state.time * 2) * 4;
  const recoil = p.recoil * 8;

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y + 6, 46, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // stem
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f6b2f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + sway * 0.5, y - 40, x + sway - recoil * 0.3, y - 70);
  ctx.stroke();

  // leaves
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3f8f3f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x - 22, y - 34, 20, 10, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x + 22, y - 50, 20, 10, 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // head (pea launcher)
  const hx = x + sway - recoil, hy = y - 70;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#54b84a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#6fd05f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx - 6, hy - 6, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // barrel
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f7a2f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(hx + 14, hy - 10 + recoil * 0.4, 34, 20, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f521f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(hx + 40, hy - 7, 8, 14, 3);
  ctx.fill();

  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx + 4, hy - 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(hx + 16, hy - 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#20303a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx + 6, hy - 2, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(hx + 18, hy - 2, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // reload indicator ring
  if (p.cooldown > 0) {
    const frac = p.cooldown / p.fireRate;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(hx, hy, 34, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (1 - frac) * Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawCreeps() {
  for (const c of state.creeps) {
    const bobY = Math.sin(c.bob) * 4;
    const y = c.y + bobY;
    const r = c.r;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.22)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y + r * 0.8, r * 0.9, r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    const body = c.flash > 0 ? "#ffffff" : (c.big ? "#8a2f6b" : "#5a3a8a");
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // spikes
    ctx.fillStyle = c.flash > 0 ? "#ffe0ff" : (c.big ? "#c95aa0" : "#8a62c9");
    for (let a = 0; a < Math.PI * 2; a += Math.PI / 3) {
      const px = c.x + Math.cos(a) * r;
      const py = y + Math.sin(a) * r;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      ctx.lineTo(px + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.5, py + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(px + Math.cos(a + 0.4) * r * 0.4, py + Math.sin(a + 0.4) * r * 0.4);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.1, r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + r * 0.3, y - r * 0.1, r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1030";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x - r * 0.32, y - r * 0.1, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + r * 0.28, y - r * 0.1, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a1030";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, y + r * 0.2, r * 0.3, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // hp bar
    if (c.hp < c.maxHp) {
      const bw = r * 2;
      const bx = c.x - r;
      const by = y - r - 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
      ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 5);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5b5b";
      ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * clamp(c.hp / c.maxHp, 0, 1), 5);
    }
  }
}

function drawPeashots() {
  for (const s of state.peashots) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x - 3, s.y - 3, 1, s.x, s.y, s.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#f6ffcc");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#54b84a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x - 3, s.y - 3, s.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    const a = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloatTexts() {
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  for (const t of state.floatTexts) {
    const a = clamp(t.life / t.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.font = "bold " + t.size + "px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
    ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // top-left: wave
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
  ctx.fillText("WAVE " + state.wave, 20, 36);

  // top-right: score
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + state.score, W - 20, 38);
  ctx.font = "14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#b9a8e0";
  ctx.fillText("BEST  " + state.best, W - 20, 58);

  // plant HP bar (bottom-left)
  const p = state.plant;
  const bw = Math.min(W * 0.32, 320);
  const bx = 20, by = H - 40;
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.font = "bold 14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d7ffe0";
  ctx.fillText("PEA PLANT", bx, by - 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, 16, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  const frac = clamp(p.hp / p.maxHp, 0, 1);
  const hpColor = frac > 0.5 ? "#6fd05f" : (frac > 0.25 ? "#ffd24a" : "#ff5b5b");
  ctx.fillStyle = hpColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(bx, by, Math.max(8, bw * frac), 16, 8);
  ctx.fill();
}

function panel(x, y, w, h) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,14,34,0.72)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 20);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawStart() {
  const pw = Math.min(W * 0.8, 520);
  const ph = Math.min(H * 0.6, 340);
  const px = (W - pw) / 2;
  const py = (H - ph) / 2;
  panel(px, py, pw, ph);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
  ctx.font = "bold 42px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("PEA vs CREEPS", W / 2, py + 64);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#d9ccf5";
  ctx.font = "18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Defend the plant from a single lane of creeps.", W / 2, py + 104);
  ctx.fillText("Click / tap, or press SPACE to fire peas.", W / 2, py + 134);
  ctx.fillText("Survive the waves. If the plant falls, you lose.", W / 2, py + 164);

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(125,255,155," + pulse + ")";
  ctx.font = "bold 24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("TAP TO START", W / 2, py + ph - 40);
}

function drawOver() {
  const pw = Math.min(W * 0.8, 460);
  const ph = Math.min(H * 0.5, 280);
  const px = (W - pw) / 2;
  const py = (H - ph) / 2;
  panel(px, py, pw, ph);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7a7a";
  ctx.font = "bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("PLANT FELL", W / 2, py + 62);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Score  " + state.score, W / 2, py + 110);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#b9a8e0";
  ctx.font = "18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Reached Wave " + state.wave + "   •   Best " + state.best, W / 2, py + 142);

  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(125,255,155," + pulse + ")";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("TAP TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, py + ph - 36);
}

/* ---------- Loop ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

/* ---------- Boot ---------- */
resize();
reset();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #241a10 0%, #100a05 100%);
    font-family: 'Arial Black', 'Arial', sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    background: #1a1208;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
</style>
</head>

<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ============================================================
  //  CONSTANTS
  // ============================================================
  var canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var W = canvas.width;
  var H = canvas.height;

  var FLOOR_TOP = 250;
  var FLOOR_BOTTOM = 560;
  var HOOP_X = 905;
  var HOOP_Y = 175;
  var RIM_RADIUS = 22;
  var BALL_R = 11;
  var GRAVITY = 0.55;
  var MAX_SCORE = 21;
  var SHOT_COOLDOWN = 350;
  var PLAYER_SPEED = 3.4;
  var PLAYER_MIN_X = 200;
  var PLAYER_MAX_X = 830;
  var PLAYER_MIN_Y = FLOOR_TOP + 30;
  var PLAYER_MAX_Y = FLOOR_BOTTOM - 30;

  // ============================================================
  //  STATE
  // ============================================================
  var state = "start"; // "start" | "playing" | "over"
  var score = 0;
  var streak = 0;
  var bestStreak = 0;
  var lastShotTime = 0;
  var shakeTime = 0;
  var shakeMag = 0;
  var particles = [];
  var floatTexts = [];

  var player = {
    x: 480,
    y: 400,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    facing: 1,
    color: "#e63946",
    name: "DR. J"
  };

  var ball = {
    x: 480,
    y: 380,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    held: true,
    spin: 0
  };

  // ============================================================
  //  INPUT
  // ============================================================
  var keys = {};
  var mouse = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, down: false };

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (state === "start" && (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "Space")) {
      startGame();

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Game State ----------
  const state = {
    screen: 'start',        // 'start' | 'play' | 'over'
    temp: 25,              // current water temperature
    targetLow: 20,
    targetHigh: 30,
    ideal: 25,
    time: 0,               // elapsed seconds in play
    score: 0,             // points for staying in range
    streak: 0,
    best: 0,
    fish: [],
    bubbles: [],
    heat: 0,              // 0..1 heater glow
    cool: 0,              // 0..1 cooler glow
    shake: 0,
    flash: 0,
    flashColor: '#ffffff'
  };

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const HEAT_RATE = 3.2;   // deg/sec when heating
  const COOL_RATE = 3.2;   // deg/sec when cooling
  const DECAY = 0.55;      // passive drift toward ideal
  const WIN_TIME = 60;      // survive this many seconds to win
  const TANK_PAD = 0.06;

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }

  function tempColor(t) {
    // blue (cold) -> green (ideal) -> red (hot)
    if (t <= state.targetLow) {
      const k = clamp((t - 10) / (state.targetLow - 10), 0, 1);
      return mix([30, 120, 230], [40, 190, 150], k);
    } else if (t >= state.targetHigh) {
      const k = clamp((t - state.targetHigh) / (50 - state.targetHigh), 0, 1);
      return mix([40, 190, 150], [240, 60, 40], k);
    }
    const k = clamp((t - state.targetLow) / (state.targetHigh - state.targetLow), 0, 1);
    return mix([40, 190, 150], [40, 190, 150], k);
  }

  function mix(a, b, t) {
    return 'rgb(' + Math.round(a[0] + (b[0]-a[0])*t) + ',' +
                    Math.round(a[1] + (b[1]-a[1])*t) + ',' +
                    Math.round(a[2] + (b[2]-a[2])*t) + ')';
  }

  // ---------- Fish ----------
  function makeFish() {
    const palette = ['#ff7a5c', '#ffd24d', '#6ecbe0', '#c58bff', '#7ce0a0', '#ff9ec7'];
    const f = {
      x: rand(W*0.2, W*0.8),
      y: rand(H*0.3, H*0.75),
      vx: rand(-40, 40),
      vy: rand(-20, 20),
      size: rand(16, 30),
      color: palette[Math.floor(rand(0, palette.length))],
      phase: rand(0, Math.PI*2),
      tail: rand(0, Math.PI*2)
    };
    return f;
  }

  function initFish() {
    state.fish = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) state.fish.push(makeFish());
  }

  // ---------- Bubbles ----------
  function spawnBubble() {
    state.bubbles.push({
      x: rand(W*0.15, W*0.85),
      y: H * 0.85,
      r: rand(3, 9),
      vy: rand(-60, -120),
      life: rand(2, 4)
    });
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = {};
  const heating = () => keys['KeyD'] || keys['ArrowRight'];
  const cooling = () => keys['KeyA'] || keys['ArrowLeft'];

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.code;
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state.screen === 'start' && (k === 'Enter' || k === 'Space')) {
      startGame();
    } else if (state.screen === 'over' && (k === 'Enter' || k === 'Space')) {
      state.screen = 'start';
    }
    if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space'].indexOf(k) !== -1) e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    keys[e.code] = false;
  });

  // Touch / mouse: left half cools, right half heats
  function pointerActive(e) {
    if (state.screen === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
    if (state.screen === 'over') { state.screen = 'start'; return; }
    const x = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    if (x < W * 0.5) keys['KeyA'] = true; else keys['KeyD'] = true;
  }
  function pointerEnd() {
    keys['KeyA'] = false; keys['KeyD'] = false;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', pointerActive);
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', pointerEnd);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ pointerActive(e); e.preventDefault(); }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){ pointerActive(e); e.preventDefault(); }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', pointerEnd);

  // ---------- Game control ----------
  function startGame() {
    state.screen = 'play';
    state.temp = state.ideal;
    state.time = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.streak = 0;
    state.heat = 0;
    state.cool = 0;
    state.bubbles = [];
    initFish();
  }

  function endGame(won) {
    state.screen = 'over';
    state.won = won;
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state.screen !== 'play') return;

    state.time += dt;

    // temperature control
    if (heating()) {
      state.temp += HEAT_RATE * dt;
      state.heat = clamp(state.heat + dt * 2, 0, 1);
    } else {
      state.heat = clamp(state.heat - dt * 2, 0, 1);
    }
    if (cooling()) {
      state.temp -= COOL_RATE * dt;
      state.cool = clamp(state.cool + dt * 2, 0, 1);
    } else {
      state.cool = clamp(state.cool - dt * 2, 0, 1);
    }

    // passive drift toward ideal (keeps it from freezing/boiling instantly)
    state.temp += (state.ideal - state.temp) * DECAY * dt;

    // score while in range
    if (state.temp >= state.targetLow && state.temp <= state.targetHigh) {
      state.streak += dt;
      state.score += Math.round(dt * 10);
      if (Math.random() < dt * 3) spawnBubble();
    } else {
      state.streak = 0;
      // out of range builds danger
      const danger = state.temp < state.targetLow ?
        (state.targetLow - state.temp) : (state.temp - state.targetHigh);
      if (danger > 4) {
        state.shake = clamp(state.shake + dt * 6, 0, 1);
        if (Math.random() < dt * 6) spawnBubble();
      }
    }

    // lose if way out of range
    if (state.temp < 12 || state.temp > 42) {
      state.flash = 1;
      state.flashColor = state.temp < 12 ? '#7fd0ff' : '#ff6a52';
      endGame(false);
      return;
    }

    // win by surviving
    if (state.time >= WIN_TIME) {
      state.flash = 1;
      state.flashColor = '#7ce0a0';
      endGame(true);
      return;
    }

    // fish update
    for (let i = 0; i < state.fish.length; i++) {
      const f = state.fish[i];
      f.phase += dt * 3;
      f.tail += dt * (heating() || cooling() ? 14 : 6);
      f.x += f.vx * dt;
      f.y += f.vy * dt + Math.sin(f.phase) * 8 * dt;
      // bounce within tank
      const L = W * TANK_PAD, R = W * (1 - TANK_PAD);
      const T = H * 0.12, B = H * 0.82;
      if (f.x < L) { f.x = L; f.vx = Math.abs(f.vx); }
      if (f.x > R) { f.x = R; f.vx = -Math.abs(f.vx); }
      if (f.y < T) { f.y = T; f.vy = Math.abs(f.vy); }
      if (f.y > B) { f.y = B; f.vy = -Math.abs(f.vy); }
      // random wander
      if (Math.random() < dt * 0.5) {
        f.vx += rand(-30, 30);
        f.vy += rand(-20, 20);
        f.vx = clamp(f.vx, -70, 70);
        f.vy = clamp(f.vy, -40, 40);
      }
      // fish slow down when water is bad
      if (state.temp < state.targetLow || state.temp > state.targetHigh) {
        f.vx *= (1 - dt * 0.5);
        f.vy *= (1 - dt * 0.5);
      }
    }

    // bubbles update
    for (let i = state.bubbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = state.bubbles[i];
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.x += Math.sin(b.y * 0.05) * 20 * dt;
      b.life -= dt;
      if (b.life <= 0 || b.y < H * 0.12) state.bubbles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // decay shake / flash
    state.shake = clamp(state.shake - dt * 1.5, 0, 1);
    state.flash = clamp(state.flash - dt * 1.2, 0, 1);
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // room / wall behind tank
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0c3346');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a2735');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#05131d');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft light from above
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.1, 50, W/2, H*0.1, H*0.9);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,200,230,0.18)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawTank() {
    const L = W * TANK_PAD, R = W * (1 - TANK_PAD);
    const T = H * 0.10, B = H * 0.86;
    const water = tempColor(state.temp);

    // water body
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.rect(L, T, R - L, B - T);
    ctx.clip();

    const wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, T, 0, B);
    wg.addColorStop(0, water);
    wg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6,30,45,0.95)');
    ctx.fillStyle = wg;
    ctx.fillRect(L, T, R - L, B - T);

    // water surface line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = L; x <= R; x += 8) {
      const y = T + 6 + Math.sin((x + state.time * 60) * 0.05) * 4;
      if (x === L) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // caustic light streaks
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const sx = L + ((i * 97 + state.time * 30) % (R - L));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(sx, T + 30, 30, 90, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // sand
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c9a86a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(L, B);
    for (let x = L; x <= R; x += 20) {
      ctx.lineTo(x, B - 14 - Math.sin(x * 0.05) * 8);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(R, B);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // pebbles
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6f45';
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const px = L + ((i * 151) % (R - L));
      const py = B - 20 - (i % 3) * 6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(px, py, 8, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // plants
    drawPlant(L + 40, B - 20, '#3fae6a', 70);
    drawPlant(R - 60, B - 20, '#2f9e5e', 90);
    drawPlant(L + 120, B - 20, '#57c78a', 55);

    // bubbles
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    for (let i = 0; i < state.bubbles.length; i++) {
      const b = state.bubbles[i];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // fish
    for (let i = 0; i < state.fish.length; i++) {
      drawFish(state.fish[i]);
    }

    ctx.restore();

    // tank glass frame
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,230,255,0.5)';
    ctx.strokeRect(L, T, R - L, B - T);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.strokeRect(L + 4, T + 4, R - L - 8, B - T - 8);

    // heater (left) and cooler (right)
    drawHeater(L + 24, B - 120, state.heat);
    drawCooler(R - 24, B - 120, state.cool);
  }

  function drawPlant(x, baseY, color, h) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + i * 10, baseY);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + i * 25, baseY - h * 0.5, x + i * 8, baseY - h * 0.8, x + i * 20, baseY - h);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawFish(f) {
    const dir = f.vx >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(f.x, f.y);
    ctx.scale(dir, 1);
    const s = f.size;

    // tail
    const tw = Math.sin(f.tail) * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.7, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.4, -s * 0.5 + tw * s);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 1.4, s * 0.5 + tw * s);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s * 0.9, s * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // dorsal fin
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.3, -s * 0.9);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.5, -s * 0.4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s * 0.45, -s * 0.05, s * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s * 0.48, -s * 0.05, s * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHeater(x, y, glow) {
    ctx.save();
    // rod
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8d8e0';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y, 12, 110);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b0b0bc';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y, 4, 110);
    // heat glow
    if (glow > 0.02) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y + 55, 5, x, y + 55, 60);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,90,40,' + (0.5 * glow) + ')');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,90,40,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 60, y - 10, 120, 140);
    }
    // top cap
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7a3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCooler(x, y, glow) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8e0e8';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y, 12, 110);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b8c4d0';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y, 4, 110);
    if (glow > 0.02) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y + 55, 5, x, y + 55, 60);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60,160,255,' + (0.5 * glow) + ')');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,160,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 60, y - 10, 120, 140);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3ca0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawGauge() {
    // thermometer bar at the top
    const gx = W * 0.5;
    const gw = Math.min(W * 0.5, 520);
    const gx0 = gx - gw / 2;
    const gy = H * 0.028;
    const gh = 14;

    // scale background
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    roundRect(gx0, gy, gw, gh, 7);
    ctx.fill();

    // range bands
    const toX = (t) => gx0 + ((t - 10) / (50 - 10)) * gw;
    // cold zone
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,140,255,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(toX(10), gy, toX(state.targetLow) - toX(10), gh);
    // good zone
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,220,150,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(toX(state.targetLow), gy, toX(state.targetHigh) - toX(state.targetLow), gh);
    // hot zone
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,80,50,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(toX(state.targetHigh), gy, toX(50) - toX(state.targetHigh), gh);

    // marker
    const mx = toX(clamp(state.temp, 10, 50));
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx, gy - 6);
    ctx.lineTo(mx - 7, gy - 18);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 7, gy - 18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, gy + gh / 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = tempColor(state.temp);
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, gy + gh / 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // big temperature readout
    ctx.fillStyle = tempColor(state.temp);
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.05) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(state.temp.toFixed(1) + '°', gx, gy + gh + H * 0.045);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.02) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('KEEP THE FISH IN THE GREEN', gx, gy + gh + H * 0.075);
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    const fs = Math.floor(H * 0.032);
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + fs + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';

    // time / progress
    const remain = Math.max(0, WIN_TIME - state.time);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText('TIME  ' + Math.ceil(remain) + 's', W * TANK_PAD + 16, H * 0.12);

    // score
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24d';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, W * (1 - TANK_PAD) - 16, H * 0.12);

    // controls hint
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.02) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('A / ←  COOL   •   D / →  HEAT', W * 0.5, H * 0.90);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawStart() {
    drawBackground();
    drawTank();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,10,18,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const cx = W / 2;
    const cy = H / 2;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#7ce0a0';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.09) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('FISH TANK TEMPERATURE', cx, cy - H * 0.16);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.035) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Keep the water in the green zone for ' + WIN_TIME + ' seconds', cx, cy - H * 0.04);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.028) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('A / ← to COOL      D / → to HEAT', cx, cy + H * 0.04);
    ctx.fillText('If it gets too cold or too hot, you lose', cx, cy + H * 0.1);

    // pulsing start prompt
    const p = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,210,77,' + p + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.035) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START', cx, cy + H * 0.2);
  }

  function drawOver() {
    drawBackground();
    drawTank();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,10,18,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    if (state.won) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7ce0a0';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.1) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('YOU KEPT THE FISH HAPPY!', cx, cy - H * 0.14);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a52';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.1) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('THE TANK ' + (state.temp < 25 ? 'FROZE' : 'BOILED') + '!', cx, cy - H * 0.14);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.04) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, cx, cy);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24d';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.03) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('BEST  ' + state.best, cx, cy + H * 0.06);

    const p = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + p + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(H * 0.032) + 'px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN', cx, cy + H * 0.18);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const m = state.shake * 8;
      ctx.translate(rand(-m, m), rand(-m, m));
    }

    if (state.screen === 'start') {
      drawStart();
    } else if (state.screen === 'over') {
      drawOver();
    } else {
      drawBackground();
      drawTank();
      drawGauge();
      drawHUD();
    }

    // full-screen flash
    if (state.flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
      ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.35;
      ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    state.time += (state.screen === 'play' ? 0 : dt); // keep time for menus (start pulse)
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>One Share</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background: #070a12;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Courier New", ui-monospace, monospace;
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none;
  }
  #game { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="1000" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- canvas ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

/* ---------- constants ---------- */
const P0 = { x: 150,  y: 300, w: 30, h: 46, color: "#ff5d5d", name: "P1" };
const P1 = { x: 850,  y: 300, w: 30, h: 46, color: "#5db8ff", name: "P2" };
const START = 500;
const MAX_PRICE = 2500;
const MIN_PRICE = 50;
const HOLD_TIME = 3.5;

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state = {
  mode: "start",
  price: START,
  priceY: 0,
  time: 0,
  history: [],
  holdTimer: 0,
  players: [
    { x: P0.x, y: P0.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, bought: false, buyPrice: 0, shares: 0, score: 0, hold: 0, color: P0.color, name: P0.name },
    { x: P1.x, y: P1.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, bought: false, buyPrice: 0, shares: 0, score: 0, hold: 0, color: P1.color, name: P1.name }
  ],
  particles: [],
  winner: null
};

/* ---------- input ---------- */
const keys = {};
const playerKeys = [
  { up: "KeyW", down: "KeyS", left: "KeyA", right: "KeyD", buy: "KeyF" },
  { up: "ArrowUp", down: "ArrowDown", left: "ArrowLeft", right: "ArrowRight", buy: "ShiftRight" }
];

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (["ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","Space"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.code === "Enter" && state.mode === "start") startGame();
  if (e.code === "Enter" && state.mode === "end") startGame();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function priceToY(p) {
  const t = (p - MIN_PRICE) / (MAX_PRICE - MIN_PRICE);
  return 560 - t * 440;
}
function yToPrice(y) {
  const t = (560 - y) / 440;
  return MIN_PRICE + t * (MAX_PRICE - MIN_PRICE);
}
function fmt(n) { return "$" + Math.floor(n).toLocaleString(); }

function startGame() {
  state.mode = "play";
  state.price = START;
  state.priceY = priceToY(START);
  state.time = 0;
  state.history = [];
  state.holdTimer = 0;
  state.particles = [];
  state.winner = null;
  state.players[0].x = P0.x; state.players[0].y = P0.y;
  state.players[1].x = P1.x; state.players[1].y = P1.y;
  state.players.forEach(p => { p.vx = 0; p.vy = 0; p.bought = false; p.buyPrice = 0; p.shares = 0; p.score = 0; p.hold = 0; });
}

function tryBuy(p) {
  if (p.bought) return;
  const dy = Math.abs(p.y - state.priceY);
  if (dy < 30) {
    p.bought = true;
    p.buyPrice = state.price;
    p.shares = 1;
    p.hold = 0;
    spawnBurst(p.x, state.priceY, p.color);
  }
}

function spawnBurst(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = 40 + Math.random() * 120;
    state.particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 0.7, color });
  }
}

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;

  if (state.mode === "play") {
    // random walk
    state.price += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26;
    if (Math.random() < 0.02) state.price += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120;
    state.price = Math.max(MIN_PRICE, Math.min(MAX_PRICE, state.price));
    state.priceY = priceToY(state.price);

    // history
    if (state.history.length === 0 || state.time - state.history[state.history.length - 1].t > 0.08) {
      state.history.push({ t: state.time, y: state.priceY });
      if (state.history.length > 400) state.history.shift();
    }

    // players
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const p = state.players[i];
      const k = playerKeys[i];
      const speed = 260;
      p.vx = 0; p.vy = 0;
      if (keys[k.up]) p.vy -= speed;
      if (keys[k.down]) p.vy += speed;
      if (keys[k.left]) p.vx -= speed;
      if (keys[k.right]) p.vx += speed;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, p.x));
      p.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H - 20, p.y));
      if (keys[k.buy]) tryBuy(p);

      if (p.bought) {
        p.hold += dt;
        if (p.hold >= HOLD_TIME) {
          p.score += Math.floor((state.price - p.buyPrice));
          p.bought = false;
          p.shares = 0;
          spawnBurst(p.x, state.priceY, "#ffffff");
        }
      }
    }

    // end check
    const a = state.players[0], b = state.players[1];
    if (a.score >= 3000 || b.score >= 3000) {
      state.mode = "end";
      if (a.score > b.score) state.winner = a;
      else if (b.score > a.score) state.winner = b;
      else state.winner = null;
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const pt = state.particles[i];
    pt.x += pt.vx * dt;
    pt.y += pt.vy * dt;
    pt.vy += 200 * dt;
    pt.life -= dt;
    if (pt.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0a1020");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#05070f");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // faint grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,120,180,0.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 50) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 50) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPriceLine() {
  // current price dashed line
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,80,0.5)";
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, state.priceY);
  ctx.lineTo(W, state.priceY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // price tag on right
  const tagW = 90;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd94a";
  ctx.fillRect(W - tagW, state.priceY - 14, tagW, 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1200";
  ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(fmt(state.price), W - tagW + 8, state.priceY);

  // history line
  if (state.history.length > 1) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3fd07a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const t0 = state.history[0].t;
    const t1 = state.history[state.history.length - 1].t;
    const span = Math.max(0.001, t1 - t0);
    for (let i = 0; i < state.history.length; i++) {
      const h = state.history[i];
      const x = ((h.t - t0) / span) * W;
      const y = h.y;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // glowing head dot
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3fd07a";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#3fd07a";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W - tagW, state.priceY, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawPlayer(p) {

function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }
function dist(x1, y1, x2, y2) { return Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1); }

function makeTarget() {
  state.target[0] = Math.round(rand(-10, 10));
  state.target[1] = Math.round(rand(-10, 10));
  state.target[2] = Math.round(rand(-10, 10));
}

function resetGame() {
  state.eq = [0, 0, 0];
  makeTarget();
  state.timer = 0;
  state.score = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  state.dragging = -1;
}

function startGame() {
  if (!audioCtx) initAudio();
  if (audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
  resetGame();
  state.phase = "playing";
}

function checkWin() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (Math.abs(state.eq[i] - state.target[i]) > 1.5) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function applyEq() {
  if (!audioCtx) return;
  const hpf = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  hpf.type = "peaking";
  hpf.frequency.value = 100;
  hpf.Q.value = 1.2;
  hpf.gain.value = state.eq[0];

  const mdf = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  mdf.type = "peaking";
  mdf.frequency.value = 1000;
  mdf.Q.value = 1.2;
  mdf.gain.value = state.eq[1];

  const hpf2 = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  hpf2.type = "peaking";
  hpf2.frequency.value = 5000;
  hpf2.Q.value = 1.2;
  hpf2.gain.value = state.eq[2];

  // We rebuild the chain each frame is expensive, so we just
  // adjust the existing analyser input via a gain node.
  // Simpler: just store values; the visual is what matters.
  // The audio already plays; the knobs are visual + gameplay.
}

// ==================== INPUT ====================
function getKnobCenter(i) {
  const pad = Math.min(W * 0.08, 60);
  const areaW = W - pad * 2;
  const gap = areaW / 3;
  const cx = pad + gap * (i + 0.5);
  const cy = H * 0.58;
  return { x: cx, y: cy };
}

function knobRadius() {
  return Math.min(W, H) * 0.12;
}

function onPointerDown(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
  state.mouse.x = mx;
  state.mouse.y = my;

  if (state.phase === "start") {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (state.phase === "won" || state.phase === "lost") {
    startGame();
    return;
  }

  const r = knobRadius();
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const c = getKnobCenter(i);
    if (dist(mx, my, c.x, c.y) < r * 1.2) {
      state.dragging = i;
      return;
    }
  }
}

function onPointerMove(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  state.mouse.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  state.mouse.y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (state.dragging >= 0 && state.phase === "playing") {
    const c = getKnobCenter(state.dragging);
    const dx = state.mouse.x - c.x;
    const dy = state.mouse.y - c.y;
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    // Map angle to -12..+12, with 0 at top (12 o'clock)
    let a = angle + Math.PI / 2; // shift so top = 0
    if (a < 0) a += Math.PI * 2;
    if (a > Math.PI * 2) a -= Math.PI * 2;
    // a: 0 = top, PI = bottom
    let val = (a / Math.PI) * 12 - 6;
    val = clamp(val, -12, 12);
    state.eq[state.dragging] = val;
  }
}

function onPointerUp() {
  state.dragging = -1;
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", onPointerMove);
canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", onPointerUp);
canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", onPointerUp);
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); onPointerDown(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); onPointerMove(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener("touchend", onPointerUp);

// ==================== UPDATE ====================
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;

  if (state.phase === "playing") {
    state.timer += dt;

    if (checkWin()) {
      const bonus = Math.max(0, Math.floor(state.timeLimit - state.timer)) * 10;
      state.score += 100 + bonus;
      state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
      state.phase = "won";
      state.flash = 1;
      state.flashColor = "120, 255, 160";
      if (audioCtx) {
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        osc.type = "sine";
        osc.frequency.value = 880;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
        osc.connect(g);
        g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
      }
    }

    if (state.timer >= state.timeLimit) {
      state.phase = "lost";
      state.shake = 1;
      state.flash = 1;
      state.flashColor = "255, 80, 80";
      if (audioCtx) {
        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        osc.type = "sawtooth";
        osc.frequency.value = 110;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.6);
        osc.connect(g);
        g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.6);
      }
    }
  }

  state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 2);
  state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 1.5);
}

// ==================== DRAW ====================
function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#0a0e1a");
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#111828");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#0a0e1a");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60, 80, 120, 0.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const step = 40;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += step) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += step) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawSpectrum() {
  if (!analyser || !freqData) return;
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);

  const bars = 32;
  const barW = W / bars;
  const baseY = H * 0.35;
  const maxH = H * 0.25;

  for (let i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
    const val = freqData[i * 2] / 255;
    const h = val * maxH;
    const hue = 200 + (i / bars) * 120;
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 80%, ${40 + val * 30}%, 0.7)`;
    ctx.fillRect(i * barW + 1, baseY - h, barW - 2, h);
    // Glow
    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, 90%, ${50 + val * 20}%, 0.15)`;
    ctx.fillRect(i * barW, baseY - h - 4, barW, h + 8);
  }

  // Baseline
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(100, 140, 200, 0.3)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, baseY);
  ctx.lineTo(W, baseY);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawKnob(i) {
  const c = getKnobCenter(i);
  const r = knobRadius();
  const val = state.eq[i];
  const target = state.target[i];

  const colors = [
    { main: "#ff6b4a", glow: "255, 107, 74", label: "BASS" },
    { main: "#4ac8ff", glow: "74, 200, 255", label: "MID" },
    { main: "#a855f7", glow: "168, 85, 247", label: "TREBLE" }
  ];
  const col = colors[i];

  // Outer ring
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20, 25, 40, 0.9)";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.4)`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Tick marks
  for (let t = 0; t < 25; t++) {
    const a = (t / 24) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
    const inner = r * 0.88;
    const outer = r * 0.95;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x + Math.cos(a) * inner, c.y + Math.sin(a) * inner);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(a) * outer, c.y + Math.sin(a) * outer);
    ctx.strokeStyle = t % 4 === 0 ? `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.6)` : `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.2)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = t % 4 === 0 ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Target indicator (small triangle at target angle)
  const targetAngle = (target / 12 + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  const triR = r * 1.12;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(c.x + Math.cos(targetAngle) * triR, c.y + Math.sin(targetAngle) * triR);
  ctx.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(targetAngle + 0.3) * (triR + 10), c.y + Math.sin(targetAngle + 0.3) * (triR + 10));
  ctx.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(targetAngle - 0.3) * (triR + 10), c.y + Math.sin(targetAngle - 0.3) * (triR + 10));
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.5)`;
  ctx.fill();

  // Knob body
  const bodyR = r * 0.75;
  const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x - bodyR * 0.3, c.y - bodyR * 0.3, 0, c.x, c.y, bodyR);
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, "#3a4560");
  bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, "#1a2030");
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, bodyR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.5)`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pointer
  const pointerAngle = (val / 12 + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
  ctx.lineTo(c.x + Math.cos(pointerAngle) * bodyR * 0.9, c.y + Math.sin(pointerAngle) * bodyR * 0.9);
  ctx.strokeStyle = col.main;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = col.main;
  ctx.fill();

  // Value text
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(14, r * 0.28)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = col.main;
  const sign = val >= 0 ? "+" : "";
  ctx.fillText(`${sign}${val.toFixed(1)} dB`, c.x, c.y + r + 28);

  // Label
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(12, r * 0.22)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.8)`;
  ctx.fillText(col.label, c.x, c.y - r - 18);

  // Target value
  ctx.font = `${Math.max(11, r * 0.18)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, 0.5)`;
  const tSign = target >= 0 ? "+" : "";
  ctx.fillText(`target: ${tSign}${target.toFixed(1)}`, c.x, c.y + r + 46);

  // Match indicator
  const diff = Math.abs(val - target);
  if (diff <= 1.5) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${col.glow}, ${0.3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(state.time * 6)})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Timer bar
  const barW = W * 0.4;
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = (W - barW) / 2;
  const barY = H * 0.06;
  const pct = clamp(1 - state.timer / state.timeLimit, 0, 1);

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(30, 40, 60, 0.8)";
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  const timerColor = pct > 0.3 ? "#4ac8ff" : "#ff6b4a";
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * pct, barH);

  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(14, H * 0.02)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  ctx.fillText(`${Math.max(0, state.timeLimit - state.timer).toFixed(1)}s`, W / 2, barY - 8);

  // Score
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(16, H * 0.025)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4ac8ff";
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${state.score}`, W * 0.05, H * 0.08);

  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#a855f7";
  ctx.fillText(`BEST: ${state.best}`, W * 0.95, H * 0.08);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.85)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;

  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(28, H * 0.05)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4ac8ff";
  ctx.fillText("THREE-BAND EQ", cx, cy - H * 0.12);

  ctx.font = `${Math.max(16, H * 0.025)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6b4a";
  ctx.fillText("Match the target values on all three knobs", cx, cy - H * 0.04);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#a855f7";
  ctx.fillText("Drag the knobs to adjust. Beat the clock!", cx, cy + H * 0.02);

  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(74, 200, 255, ${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(state.time * 3)})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(18, H * 0.03)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillText("[ CLICK TO START ]", cx, cy + H * 0.1);
}

function drawEndScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = state.phase === "won" ? "rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.7)" : "rgba(60, 20, 20, 0.7)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;

  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(32, H * 0.06)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = state.phase === "won" ? "#78ff90" : "#ff5050";
  ctx.fillText(state.phase === "won" ? "MATCHED!" : "TIME'S UP", cx, cy - H * 0.08);

  ctx.font = `${Math.max(18, H * 0.03)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}  |  Best: ${state.best}`, cx, cy);

  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(state.time * 3)})`;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.max(16, H * 0.025)}px "Courier New", monospace`;
  ctx.fillText("[ CLICK TO RESTART ]", cx, cy + H * 0.08);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();

  // Screen shake
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 15;
    const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake * 15;
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawSpectrum();

  // Flash overlay
  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${state.flashColor}, ${state.flash * 0.3})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  if (state.phase === "playing") {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) drawKnob(i);
    drawHUD();
  }

  if (state.phase === "start") drawStartScreen();
  if (state.phase === "won" || state.phase === "lost") {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) drawKnob(i);
    drawHUD();
    drawEndScreen();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ==================== MAIN LOOP ====================
let lastTime = performance.now();

function loop(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = now;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<html_file>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Badge Swipe</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    background: #1a1a2e;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  function resizeCanvas() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resizeCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

  const GAME_DURATION = 60;
  const BADGE_COUNT = 30;
  const BADGE_MIN_SIZE = 28;
  const BADGE_MAX_SIZE = 55;

  const state = {
    screen: 'start',
    score: 0,
    timeLeft: GAME_DURATION,
    badges: [],
    lastTime: 0,
    mouseX: 0,
    mouseY: 0,
    swipeTrail: [],
    combo: 0,
    comboTimer: 0,
    bestScore: 0,
    flashAlpha: 0,
    flashColor: '#fff',
    shakeX: 0,
    shakeY: 0,
    particles: []
  };

  const badgeColors = [
    { bg: '#e74c3c', ring: '#f5b7b1', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#2ecc71', ring: '#a9dfbf', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#3498db', ring: '#aed6f1', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#f39c12', ring: '#fdebd0', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#9b59b6', ring: '#d7bde2', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#1abc9c', ring: '#a3e4d7', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#e67e22', ring: '#fad7a0', star: '#f9e79f' },
    { bg: '#fd79a8', ring: '#f8bbd0', star: '#f9e79f' }
  ];

  function createBadge() {
    const size = BADGE_MIN_SIZE + Math.random() * (BADGE_MAX_SIZE - BADGE_MIN_SIZE);
    const margin = size + 20;
    const x = margin + Math.random() * (canvas.width - margin * 2);
    const y = margin + Math.random() * (canvas.height - margin * 2);
    const colorSet = badgeColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * badgeColors.length)];
    return {
      x: x,
      y: y,
      size: size,
      color: colorSet,
      alive: true,
      spawnTime: performance.now(),
      wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      wobbleSpeed: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.04
    };
  }

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';

    const cx = canvas.width / 2;
    const cy = canvas.height / 2;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';

    ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';

    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(state.shakeX, state.shakeY);

    }

    if (state.screen === 'over') {
      drawOverScreen();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - state.lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
    state.lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  function drawCardFront(cx, cy, half, offset, fortune, isRevealed) {
    // Full card front
    const x = cx - half;
    const w = half * 2;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff8e7";
    ctx.fillRect(x, cy - half, w, half * 2);

    ctx.strokeStyle = fortune.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(x + 3, cy - half + 3, w - 6, half * 2 - 6);

    if (isRevealed) {
      // Show the fortune
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2d2d2d";
      ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(16, half * 0.22) + "px Georgia";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      // Emoji
      ctx.font = Math.min(40, half * 0.5) + "px serif";

      wrapText(fortune.text, cx, cy + half * 0.15, w - 20, Math.min(14, half * 0.18));

  function wrapText(text, x, y, maxW, lineH) {
    const words = text.split(" ");

    let ty = y;

  function drawStartScreen() {

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ccc";
    ctx.font = Math.min(18, W * 0.022) + "px Georgia";
    ctx.fillText("Two players take turns guessing the fortune shown on the card.", W / 2, H * 0.42);
    ctx.fillText("P1 uses keys 1-4, P2 uses keys 5-8.", W / 2, H * 0.48);
    ctx.fillText("First to 3 correct guesses wins!", W / 2, H * 0.54);

    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(22, W * 0.026) + "px Georgia";

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";

    ctx.font = Math.min(16, W * 0.019) + "px Georgia";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to play again", W / 2, H * 0.62);

  function drawGuessStatus() {
    if (state.phase !== "show") return;
    const y = H * 0.68;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.fillStyle = state.p1.color;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.min(14, W * 0.016) + "px Georgia";
    ctx.fillText(state.p1.last === null ? "P1: waiting..." : "P1: guessed " + (state.p1.last + 1), W * 0.25, y);

    ctx.fillStyle = state.p2.color;

  }

  // ===== Main draw =====
  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    if (!state.started) {
      drawStartScreen();

    }

    const cardSize = Math.min(W * 0.35, H * 0.4);
    const cardX = W / 2;
    const cardY = H * 0.42;

  // ===== Game loop =====
  let lastTime = 0;
  function loop(timestamp) {
    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(function (t) {
    lastTime = t;
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  });

<script>
// ===================== STATE =====================
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W = 0, H = 0;

const NUM_CELLS = 25;

let gameState = 'title'; // title, playing, won
let winner = null; // 'P1', 'P2', or null
let calledNumbers = [];
let currentCall = null;
let callIndex = 0;

// Player state
const players = {
  P1: { name: 'Player 1', color: '#e94560', colorLight: '#ff7096', colorDark: '#b32d4e',
         board: [], marked: [], score: 0, winLines: [] },
  P2: { name: 'Player 2', color: '#0f9b8e', colorLight: '#35c4b5', colorDark: '#0a6b62',
         board: [], marked: [], score: 0, winLines: [] }
};

// Confetti particles
let confetti = [];

// ===================== HELPERS =====================
function shuffle(arr) {
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];

}

function generateBoard() {
  const nums = shuffle(Array.from({length: 75}, (_, i) => i + 1));
  const board = nums.slice(0, 25);

function generateAllCalls() {

  return nums;
}

function makeConfetti(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 5;
    confetti.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3,
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
      color: color,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.012,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2

}

function checkWin(board, marked) {
  const lines = [];
  // Rows
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) row.push(marked[r * 5 + c]);
    if (row.every(v => v)) lines.push({ type: 'row', index: r });
  }
  // Cols
  for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {

  if (d2.every(v => v)) lines.push({ type: 'diag', index: 1 });

// ===================== INIT GAME =====================
function initGame() {
  calledNumbers = generateAllCalls();
  callIndex = 0;
  currentCall = null;
  winner = null;
  gameState = 'playing';
  confetti = [];

const keys = {};

// Track cursor positions

function markCell(playerKey) {

}

function drawWinLines(playerKey, x, y, size) {
  const p = players[playerKey];

  const cellSize = size / 5;
  const gap = Math.max(2, cellSize * 0.04);

  const boardY = y + gap / 2;

      ctx.lineTo(boardX + size, cy);

      const cx = boardX + c * cellSize + cellSize / 2;

      ctx.lineTo(cx, boardY + size);
    } else {
      // Diagonal
      if (line.index === 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(boardX, boardY);
        ctx.lineTo(boardX + size, boardY + size);

  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = 900, H = 600;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  function fitCanvas() {
    const scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H);
    canvas.style.width = (W * scale) + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitCanvas);
  fitCanvas();

  const GAME_DURATION = 60;

  const state = {
    mode: 'start',
    score: 0,
    timeLeft: GAME_DURATION,
    lastTime: 0,
    bellAngle: 0,
    bellSwing: 0,
    hammerAngle: 0,
    hammerSwing: 0,
    flash: 0,

    ripples: []
  };

  const BELL = { x: W / 2, y: 260, r: 55 };
  const HAMMER = { x: 170, y: 470, len: 150 };

  function getPointer(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX);
    const cy = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY);
    return { x: (cx - rect.left) / rect.width * W, y: (cy - rect.top) / rect.height * H };
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.mode = 'playing';
    state.score = 0;
    state.timeLeft = GAME_DURATION;
    state.lastTime = performance.now();
    state.particles = [];
    state.ripples = [];
  }

  function endGame() {
    state.mode = 'over';
  }

  function ringBell() {
    if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;
    state.score++;
    state.bellSwing = 1;
    state.hammerSwing = 1;
    state.flash = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      state.particles.push({
        x: BELL.x, y: BELL.y - BELL.r,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
        vy: -Math.random() * 4 - 2,
        life: 1,
        color: ['#ffd700', '#ff9800', '#fff176'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)]
      });
    }
    state.ripples.push({ x: BELL.x, y: BELL.y, r: BELL.r, life: 1 });
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    const p = getPointer(e);
    if (state.mode === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
    if (state.mode === 'over') { state.mode = 'start'; return; }
    if (state.mode === 'playing') {
      const dx = p.x - BELL.x, dy = p.y - BELL.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < BELL.r + 25) ringBell();
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = getPointer(e);
    if (state.mode === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
    if (state.mode === 'over') { state.mode = 'start'; return; }
    if (state.mode === 'playing') {
      const dx = p.x - BELL.x, dy = p.y - BELL.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < BELL.r + 25) ringBell();

  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (state.mode === 'start') startGame();
      else if (state.mode === 'over') state.mode = 'start';
      else if (state.mode === 'playing') ringBell();

  function update(dt) {
    if (state.mode === 'playing') {
      state.timeLeft -= dt;
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        state.timeLeft = 0;
        endGame();

    }
    state.bellSwing = Math.max(0, state.bellSwing - dt * 2);
    state.hammerSwing = Math.max(0, state.hammerSwing - dt * 2);

    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - 120, 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5d4037';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 130, 50, 260, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4e342e';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 135, 45, 270, 8);
  }

  function drawBell() {
    const swing = Math.sin(state.bellSwing * Math.PI * 3) * state.bellSwing * 0.3;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(BELL.x, 120);
    ctx.rotate(swing);
    ctx.translate(-BELL.x, -(120));

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#b0bec5';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(BELL.x, 120);

    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(BELL.x, BELL.y + BELL.r * 0.9, BELL.x + BELL.r - 5, BELL.y + BELL.r * 0.6);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.fillText('Click or tap the bell to ring it.', W / 2, 350);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';

    ctx.font = 'bold 64px Arial';

    drawBackground();

  function loop(now) {

    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);

      if(state.mode === 'start') startGame();
