      else if(state.mode === 'end') state.mode = 'start';
    }
  });

  function startGame(){
    state.mode = 'play';
    state.timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
    state.score = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
    state.particles = [];
    spawnTarget();
    state.lastTarget = 0;
  }

  // ============ UPDATE ============
  function update(dt){
    // shake decay
    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3.2);
    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 3.5);
    state.msgTime = Math.max(0, state.msgTime - dt);

    // stars twinkle
    for(const s of state.stars){
      s.tw += dt * s.sp;
    }

    // orbs orbit
    for(const o of state.orbs){
      o.a += dt * o.sp;
    }

    // particles
    for(let i=state.particles.length-1; i>=0; i--){
      const p = state.particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if(p.life <= 0){ state.particles.splice(i,1); continue; }
      p.vy += 220 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.98;
    }

    if(state.mode === 'play'){
      state.timeLeft -= dt;
      if(state.timeLeft <= 0){
        state.timeLeft = 0;
        state.mode = 'end';
        if(state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
      }
      // target lifetime
      state.lastTarget += dt;
      if(state.lastTarget > state.targetLife){
        // missed, reset combo
        state.combo = 0;
        spawnTarget();
        state.lastTarget = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  // ============ DRAW ============
  function drawBackground(){
    // deep gradient
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.4, 10, W/2, H*0.5, Math.max(W,H)*0.8);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#241448');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#120a28');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#050210');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // stars
    for(const s of state.stars){
      const a = 0.4 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(s.tw));
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cbb8ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // soft nebula glow
    const ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.3, H*0.25, 0, W*0.3, H*0.25, W*0.4);
    ng.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,80,200,0.18)');
    ng.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,80,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = ng;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    const ng2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.75, H*0.7, 0, W*0.75, H*0.7, W*0.35);
    ng2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(60,160,200,0.14)');
    ng2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,160,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = ng2;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  function drawOrbs(){
    const r = state.ballR;
    const cx = state.ballX, cy = state.ballY;
    for(const o of state.orbs){
      const rr = r * o.rad;
      const x = cx + Math.cos(o.a) * rr;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(o.a) * rr * 0.9;
      const sz = r * o.size;
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, sz);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsla(' + o.hue + ',90%,80%,0.9)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.6, 'hsla(' + o.hue + ',90%,60%,0.5)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsla(' + o.hue + ',90%,50%,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, sz, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBall(){
    const r = state.ballR;
    const cx = state.ballX, cy = state.ballY;

    // outer aura
    const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r*0.8, cx, cy, r*1.5);
    aura.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(150,120,255,0.35)');
    aura.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(120,90,220,0.12)');
    aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,90,220,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = aura;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r*1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // glass body
    const body = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r*0.35, cy - r*0.4, r*0.1, cx, cy, r);
    body.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(210,235,255,0.95)');
    body.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(150,190,255,0.7)');
    body.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(90,120,220,0.55)');
    body.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(50,60,150,0.6)');
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // inner swirls
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.clip();
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const off = (i/3)*Math.PI*2 + state.shake*2;
      const sx = cx + Math.cos(off)*r*0.4;
      const sy = cy + Math.sin(off)*r*0.4;
      const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, r*0.5);
      sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(180,220,255,0.25)');
      sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180,220,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = sg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, r*0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // highlight
    const hl = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r*0.4, cy - r*0.45, 0, cx - r*0.4, cy - r*0.45, r*0.5);
    hl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)');
    hl.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)');
    hl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hl;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx - r*0.4, cy - r*0.45, r*0.35, r*0.25, -0.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // rim
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, r*0.02);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,240,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // flash on hit
    if(state.flash > 0){
      const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r);
      fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (state.flash*0.6) + ')');
      fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = fg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawTarget(){
    if(state.mode !== 'play') return;
    const t = state.targetLife / state.targetMax;
    const pulse = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(performance.now()/150);
    const rr = state.targetR * pulse;

    // glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(state.targetX, state.targetY, 0, state.targetX, state.targetY, rr*1.8);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,255,220,0.7)');
    glow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(80,220,200,0.3)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(80,220,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(state.targetX, state.targetY, rr*1.8, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // ring
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, rr*0.12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,255,235,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(state.targetX, state.targetY, rr, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // inner dot
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(state.targetX, state.targetY, rr*0.28, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // life arc
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, rr*0.08);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(state.targetX, state.targetY, rr*1.25, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + Math.PI*2*t);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for(const p of state.particles){
      const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + p.hue + ',90%,75%,1)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * a, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    // timer
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W,H)*0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    const t = Math.ceil(state.timeLeft);
    const urgent = state.mode === 'play' && state.timeLeft < 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? '#ff7a6a' : '#e8d5ff';
    ctx.fillText(t + 's', W/2, Math.min(W,H)*0.09);

    // score
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W,H)*0.038) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a8e8ff';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W/2, Math.min(W,H)*0.15);

    // combo
    if(state.combo > 1){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W,H)*0.03) + 'px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Combo x' + state.combo, W/2, Math.min(W,H)*0.2);
    }

    // floating +N
    if(state.msgTime > 0){
      const a = Math.min(1, state.msgTime / 0.8);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c0ffe0';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(Math.min(W,H)*0.045) + 'px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText(state.msg, state.targetX, state.targetY - state.targetR*1.6);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawPanel(title, sub, lines, btn){
    // dim overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,2,16,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    const pw = Math.min(W*0.82, 560);
    const ph = Math.min(H*0.6, 420);
    const px = (W-pw)/2, py = (H-ph)/2;

    // panel
    const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(px, py, px, py+ph);
    pg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,25,80,0.95)');
    pg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,12,45,0.95)');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 20);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,150,255,0.6)';
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 20);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e6ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(pw*0.09) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, py + ph*0.22);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#b8a8e0';
    ctx.font = Math.floor(pw*0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, py + ph*0.36);

    // lines
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8c8ff';
    ctx.font = Math.floor(pw*0.045) + 'px Georgia';
    let y = py + ph*0.5;
    for(const ln of lines){
      ctx.fillText(ln, W/2, y);
      y += ph*0.09;
    }

    // button
    const bw = pw*0.5, bh = ph*0.14;
    const bx = (W-bw)/2, by = py + ph*0.82;
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, by, bx, by+bh);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#7a5cff');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#4a2fd0');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.floor(bh*0.5) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText(btn, W/2, by + bh*0.62);
  }

  function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y+h, x, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y+h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x+w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw(){
    // shake offset
    const sh = state.shake;
    const ox = (Math.random()-0.5) * sh * 18;
    const oy = (Math.random()-0.5) * sh * 18;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);

    drawBackground();
    drawOrbs();
    drawBall();
    drawTarget();
    drawParticles();

    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if(state.mode === 'start'){
      drawPanel(
        'Crystal Ball Shake',
        'Shake the orb to catch the glowing sigils',
        [
          'Tap, click, or press SPACE to shake',
          'Hit the glowing target inside the ball',
          'You have 60 seconds — chain hits for combos'
        ],
        'Start'
      );
    } else if(state.mode === 'end'){
      drawPanel(
        'Time’s Up',
        'Your final reading:',
        [
          'Score: ' + state.score,
          'Best: ' + state.best
        ],
        'Play Again'
      );
    }
  }

  // ============ LOOP ============
  function loop(ts){
    if(!state.lastTime) state.lastTime = ts;
    let dt = (ts - state.lastTime) / 1000;
    state.lastTime = ts;
    if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big gaps

    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- constants ----------
const W = 900, H = 560;
const TUBE_Y = 430;
const TUBE_H = 64;
const START_X = 150;
const GOAL_X = 770;
const START_SPEED = 240;
const MAX_SPEED = 660;
const ACCEL = 300;
const DECEL = 150;
const GRAV = 300;
const BALL_R = 17;
const WIN_SCORE = 3;
const AIR_COLOR = "#33406a";
const AIR_EDGE = "#556a9e";

// ---------- canvas ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// ---------- game state ----------
const state = {
  phase: "menu",
  score: 0,
  time: 0,
  ball: { x: START_X, y: TUBE_Y, vx: 0, vy: 0, spin: 0 },
  air: 0,
  airTarget: 0,
  airOn: false,
  burst: false,
  burstTimer: 0,
  puff: null,
  shake: 0,
  stars: [],
  confetti: [],
  lastMsg: "",
  lastMsgTime: -99,
  msg: "",
  msgTime: 0
};

// ---------- helpers ----------
function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }

function spawnPuff(x, y, strength) {
  const puffs = [];
  const n = 5;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.6;
    const sp = strength * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.7);
    puffs.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 30,
      r: 6 + Math.random() * 8,
      life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4,
      max: 0.9
    });
  }
  return puffs;
}

function spawnConfetti() {
  const c = [];
  const colors = ["#ff5c8a", "#ffd23f", "#4dd0e1", "#81c784", "#b388ff", "#ff8a65"];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    c.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: -20 - Math.random() * 200,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,
      vy: 60 + Math.random() * 120,
      r: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
      color: colors[i % colors.length],
      shape: Math.random() < 0.5 ? "rect" : "circle"
    });
  }
  return c;
}

function resetBall() {
  state.ball.x = START_X;
  state.ball.y = TUBE_Y;
  state.ball.vx = 0;
  state.ball.vy = 0;
  state.ball.spin = 0;
  state.air = 0;
  state.airTarget = 0;
  state.airOn = false;
  state.burst = false;
  state.burstTimer = 0;
  state.puff = null;
  state.shake = 0;
}

function startGame() {
  state.phase = "play";
  state.score = 0;
  resetBall();
  state.confetti = [];
  state.msg = "Send the parcel!";
  state.msgTime = state.time;
}

function winGame() {
  state.phase = "win";
  state.confetti = spawnConfetti();
}

function loseGame() {
  state.phase = "lose";
}

function burstBall() {
  state.burst = true;
  state.burstTimer = 0.9;
  state.shake = 14;
  state.puff = spawnPuff(state.ball.x, state.ball.y, 260);
  state.airOn = false;
}

// ---------- input ----------
function setAir(v) {
  if (state.phase === "play") {
    state.airOn = v;
    state.airTarget = v ? 1 : 0;
  }
}

window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === " " || k === "ArrowUp" || k === "w" || k === "W") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state.phase === "menu") { startGame(); }
    else if (state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") { startGame(); }
    else { setAir(true); }
  }
  if (k === "Enter") {
    if (state.phase === "menu" || state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") startGame();
  }
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === " " || k === "ArrowUp" || k === "w" || k === "W") {
    setAir(false);
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state.phase === "menu" || state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") {
    startGame();
  } else {
    setAir(true);
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  setAir(false);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
  setAir(false);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
});

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;

  // stars twinkle
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    s.tw += dt * (1 + s.spd);
  }

  // shake decay
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 40);

  // confetti
  for (const c of state.confetti) {
    c.x += c.vx * dt;
    c.y += c.vy * dt;
    c.vy += 40 * dt;
    c.rot += c.vr * dt;
  }
  state.confetti = state.confetti.filter(c => c.y < H + 40);

  // puff
  if (state.puff) {
    for (const p of state.puff) {
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 120 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
    }
    state.puff = state.puff.filter(p => p.life > 0);
    if (state.puff.length === 0) state.puff = null;
  }

  if (state.phase !== "play") return;

  // air pressure
  state.air += (state.airTarget - state.air) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);

  // burst countdown
  if (state.burst) {
    state.burstTimer -= dt;
    if (state.burstTimer <= 0) {
      loseGame();
      return;
    }
  }

  const b = state.ball;

  // gravity
  b.vy += GRAV * dt;

  // air acceleration
  if (state.airOn && !state.burst) {
    b.vx += ACCEL * state.air * dt;
  } else {
    // gentle drag
    b.vx -= b.vx * DECEL * dt * 0.05;
  }

  // clamp speed
  b.vx = clamp(b.vx, 0, MAX_SPEED);

  // move
  b.x += b.vx * dt;
  b.y += b.vy * dt;
  b.spin += b.vx * dt * 0.05;

  // tube walls
  const top = TUBE_Y - TUBE_H / 2 + BALL_R;
  const bot = TUBE_Y + TUBE_H / 2 - BALL_R;
  if (b.y < top) { b.y = top; b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy) * 0.4; }
  if (b.y > bot) { b.y = bot; b.vy = -Math.abs(b.vy) * 0.4; }

  // burst check
  if (state.air > 0.85 && !state.burst) {
    burstBall();
  }

  // goal
  if (b.x >= GOAL_X && !state.burst) {
    state.score += 1;
    if (state.score >= WIN_SCORE) {
      winGame();
    } else {
      resetBall();
      state.msg = "Delivered! " + state.score + "/" + WIN_SCORE;
      state.msgTime = state.time;
    }
  }
}

// ---------- drawing ----------
function drawBackground() {
  // sky gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#223057");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "#33457a");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#4a5f95");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  for (const s of state.stars) {
    const a = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#eaf2ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3d8";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(120, 90, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e6e2c4";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(108, 82, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(132, 100, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#2c3a63";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 360);

function drawHouse(x, y) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f4b860";
  ctx.fillRect(x, y - 40, 50, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d96b45";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 6, y - 40);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 25, y - 62);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 56, y - 40);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
  ctx.fillRect(x + 18, y - 26, 14, 14);
}

function drawTube() {
  const y = TUBE_Y;
  const h = TUBE_H;
  const x0 = 70, x1 = 830;

  // outer glass body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y - h/2, 0, y + h/2);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#cfe3ff");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#9fc0f0");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#6f93c9");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(x0, y - h/2, x1 - x0, h, 30);
  ctx.fill();

  // inner air
  ctx.fillStyle = AIR_COLOR;
  roundRect(x0 + 8, y - h/2 + 8, x1 - x0 - 16, h - 16, 22);
  ctx.fill();

  // air glow based on pressure
  if (state.air > 0.05) {
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x0 + 40, y, 5, x0 + 40, y, 60);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(150,220,255," + (0.4 * state.air) + ")");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(150,220,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(x0, y - h/2, x1 - x0, h);
  }

  // glass highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0 + 20, y - h/2 + 10);
  ctx.lineTo(x1 - 20, y - h/2 + 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  // metal edges
  ctx.strokeStyle = AIR_EDGE;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0, y - h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(x1, y - h/2);
  ctx.moveTo(x0, y + h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(x1, y + h/2);

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawLauncher(x) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6b95";
  ctx.fillRect(x, TUBE_Y - TUBE_H/2 - 14, 26, TUBE_H + 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7f93c4";
  ctx.fillRect(x + 4, TUBE_Y - TUBE_H/2 - 6, 18, TUBE_H + 12);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#33406a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 13, TUBE_Y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  const rot = state.time * (4 + state.air * 10);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#cfe3ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const a = rot + i * (Math.PI * 2 / 3);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 13, TUBE_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 13 + Math.cos(a) * 8, TUBE_Y + Math.sin(a) * 8);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawGoal(x) {
  // box
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8703a";
  ctx.fillRect(x, TUBE_Y - 46, 44, 92);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f4a05a";
  ctx.fillRect(x + 4, TUBE_Y - 42, 36, 84);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 22, TUBE_Y, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5c8a";
  ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 22, TUBE_Y - 78);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 44, TUBE_Y - 70);

  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBall() {
  const b = state.ball;
  if (state.burst) {

    return;

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(b.x, TUBE_Y + TUBE_H/2 - 6, 18, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // parcel
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x - 5, b.y - 5, 3, b.x, b.y, BALL_R);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#ffd98a");

  ctx.strokeStyle = "#f4c542";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(b.x - BALL_R, b.y);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x + BALL_R, b.y);
  ctx.moveTo(b.x, b.y - BALL_R);
  ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y + BALL_R);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";

  ctx.beginPath();

function drawPuff() {
  if (!state.puff) return;
  for (const p of state.puff) {
    const a = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe3ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawConfetti() {
  for (const c of state.confetti) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);
    ctx.rotate(c.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
    if (c.shape === "rect") {
      ctx.fillRect(-c.r/2, -c.r/2, c.r, c.r * 0.6);
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, c.r/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Delivered: " + state.score + " / " + WIN_SCORE, 24, 40);

  const mx = 24, my = 60, mw = 220, mh = 22;

  roundRect(mx, my, mw, mh, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4dd0e1";
  const fill = mw * state.air;
  if (fill > 0) {
    roundRect(mx, my, fill, mh, 8);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // danger zone
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5c8a";
  roundRect(mx + mw * 0.85, my, mw * 0.15, mh, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(mx, my, mw, mh, 8);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "13px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("AIR PRESSURE", mx, my + mh + 16);

  // controls hint
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
  ctx.font = "15px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Hold SPACE / tap to push  -  let go before the red zone!", W - 24, 34);

  // message
  if (state.time - state.msgTime < 2.2) {
    const a = clamp(2.2 - (state.time - state.msgTime), 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(state.msg, W/2, 130);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,16,35,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold 54px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.font = "24px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or tap to start", W/2, H/2 + 70);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawTube();
  drawBall();
  drawPuff();
  drawConfetti();
  ctx.restore();

  if (state.phase === "play") {
    drawHUD();
  }
  if (state.phase === "menu") {
    drawOverlay("Tube Delivery", "Send the parcel down the tube!", "#4dd0e1");
  } else if (state.phase === "win") {
    drawOverlay("You did it!", "All parcels delivered. Great job!", "#81c784");
  } else if (state.phase === "lose") {
    drawOverlay("POP!", "The parcel burst. Try again!", "#ff5c8a");
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let lastTime = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
  lastTime = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

    });

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  var W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ── STATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var state = "title";
  var score = 0;
  var lives = 3;
  var round = 1;
  var maxRound = 8;
  var doors = [];
  var correctDoor = 0;

  var doorAnim = 0;
  var shake = 0;
  var particles = [];
  var stars = [];
  var moonX = 0, moonY = 0;
  var time = 0;
  var titlePulse = 0;
  var winFlash = 0;

  // ── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function randInt(a, b) { return Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1)); }
  function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }

  function makeStars() {
    stars = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random() * 0.45,

        twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        speed: rand(0.5, 2)
      });
    }
  }

  function makeDoors() {
    doors = [];
    var doorW = W * 0.14;
    var doorH = H * 0.32;
    var totalW = doorW * 4 + (W * 0.04) * 3;
    var startX = (W - totalW) / 2;
    var doorY = H * 0.38;

    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      var x = startX + i * (doorW + W * 0.04);
      doors.push({
        x: x,
        y: doorY,
        w: doorW,
        h: doorH,
        open: 0,
        glow: 0,
        color: i % 2 === 0 ? "#8B4513" : "#6B2D10",
        frameColor: "#3a1a08",
        knobX: x + doorW * 0.85,
        knobY: doorY + doorH * 0.5,
        pumpkin: null
      });
    }
  }

  function placePumpkin() {
    correctDoor = randInt(0, 3);
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      doors[i].open = 0;
      doors[i].glow = 0;
      doors[i].pumpkin = null;
    }
    doors[correctDoor].pumpkin = {
      x: doors[correctDoor].x + doors[correctDoor].w / 2,
      y: doors[correctDoor].y + doors[correctDoor].h * 0.88,
      r: doors[correctDoor].w * 0.12
    };

  // ── UPDATE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function update(dt) {

    moonY = H * 0.1;

    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.9;
    if (winFlash > 0) winFlash *= 0.95;

  // ── DRAW ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a4a6a";
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

      var cy = H * (0.08 + i * 0.05);

    ctx.lineTo(0, H);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1a3a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.55);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.3, H * 0.45, W * 0.55, H * 0.53);

    grad.addColorStop(0, "#2a2a3a");

    ctx.setLineDash([20, 15]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W * 0.5, streetY);
    ctx.lineTo(W * 0.5, H);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

  function drawHouseBody() {
    var houseX = W * 0.08;
    var houseW = W * 0.84;
    var houseY = H * 0.22;
    var houseH = H * 0.5;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2a1a";
    ctx.fillRect(houseX, houseY, houseW, houseH);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a3a2a";
    for (var y = houseY + 20; y < houseY + houseH; y += 25) {
      for (var x = houseX; x < houseX + houseW; x += 50) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a1a0a";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(x, y, 50, 25);
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a4a3a";
    ctx.fillRect(houseX - 5, houseY - 5, houseW + 10, 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1a0a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(houseX - 20, houseY);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW / 2, houseY - H * 0.12);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW + 20, houseY);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(houseX - 25, houseY + 2);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW / 2, houseY - H * 0.125);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW + 25, houseY + 2);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW + 20, houseY);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX + houseW / 2, houseY - H * 0.12);
    ctx.lineTo(houseX - 20, houseY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

  function drawWindow(x, y, w, h, lit) {

    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);

      ctx.shadowColor = "#FFD700";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;

      ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6);

    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y + h);
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h / 2);

    ctx.ellipse(x, y, r, r * 0.85, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#E67300";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - r * 0.3, y, r * 0.5, r * 0.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + r * 0.3, y, r * 0.5, r * 0.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a6a1a";
    ctx.fillRect(x - r * 0.08, y - r * 0.95, r * 0.16, r * 0.25);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.35, y - r * 0.1);
    ctx.lineTo(x - r * 0.15, y - r * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(x - r * 0.05, y - r * 0.1);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r * 0.35, y - r * 0.1);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.15, y - r * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.05, y - r * 0.1);

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fill();

  function drawDoor(d, index) {

        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2a4a";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(d.x + 10, d.y + 10, d.w - 20, d.h - 20);
      }
    }

    if (doorW > 5) {

      ctx.strokeRect(doorX + doorW * 0.2, d.y + d.h * 0.55, panelW, panelH);

      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(doorX + doorW * 0.85, d.y + d.h * 0.5, doorW * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    var numY = d.y + d.h + 25;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(d.w * 0.25) + "px Courier New";

  }

      ctx.lineTo(lx, ly - H * 0.08);

      ctx.shadowColor = "#FFD700";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;

    ctx.fillStyle = lives > 1 ? "#FFD700" : "#FF4444";
    var hearts = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

  }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.08) + "px Courier New";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FF8C00";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#AAAAAA";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.028) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText("Click a door or press 1-4", W / 2, H * 0.6);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.04) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(titlePulse * 2);
    ctx.fillText("— CLICK TO START —", W / 2, H * 0.75);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawWon() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.shadowColor = "#FFD700";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 40;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD700";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.09) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FF8C00";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.04) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText("Final Score: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillText("All 8 rounds cleared!", W / 2, H * 0.55);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.035) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(titlePulse * 2);
    ctx.fillText("— CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN —", W / 2, H * 0.72);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawLost() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.75)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.shadowColor = "#FF3333";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FF4444";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.09) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FF8C00";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.04) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillText("You made it to round " + round, W / 2, H * 0.55);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.035) + "px Courier New";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(titlePulse * 2);
    ctx.fillText("— CLICK TO TRY AGAIN —", W / 2, H * 0.72);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }

    drawSky();
    drawStars();
    drawMoon();
    drawClouds();
    drawHills();
    drawStreet();
    drawHouseBody();

    var winW = W * 0.06;
    var winH = H * 0.08;
    var winY = H * 0.28;
    drawWindow(W * 0.12, winY, winW, winH, true);
    drawWindow(W * 0.38, winY, winW, winH, false);
    drawWindow(W * 0.58, winY, winW, winH, true);
    drawWindow(W * 0.82, winY, winW, winH, false);

    drawStreetLanterns();
    drawDoors();
    drawParticles();

    if (state === "playing") {
      drawHUD();
    } else if (state === "title") {
      drawTitle();
    } else if (state === "won") {
      drawHUD();
      drawWon();
    } else if (state === "lost") {
      drawHUD();
      drawLost();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ── LOOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  makeStars();
  makeDoors();

  var lastTime = performance.now();

  function loop(now) {
    var dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = now;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = 800;
  const H = 560;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  const GROUND_Y = H - 60;
  const GRAVITY = 0.45;
  const R1 = 30;
  const R2 = 42;
  const R3 = 54;

  const state = {
    phase: 'start',
    score: 0,
    winner: '',
    snowflakes: [],
    particles: [],
    p1: null,
    p2: null,
    keys: {},
    lastTime: 0
  };

  function makePlayer(id) {
    return {
      id,
      x: id === 1 ? 200 : 600,
      y: 120,
      vy: 0,
      current: null,
      stack: [],
      dropCooldown: 0,
      color: id === 1 ? '#4488ff' : '#ff6644',
      name: id === 1 ? 'P1' : 'P2'
    };
  }

  function resetGame() {
    state.score = 0;
    state.winner = '';
    state.particles = [];
    state.p1 = makePlayer(1);
    state.p2 = makePlayer(2);
    state.phase = 'play';
  }

  function initSnowflakes() {
    state.snowflakes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      state.snowflakes.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        r: 1 + Math.random() * 2.5,
        speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8,
        drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4
      });
    }
  }

  function stackTopY(p) {
    if (p.stack.length === 0) return GROUND_Y;
    const top = p.stack[p.stack.length - 1];
    return top.y - top.r;
  }

  function dropNext(p) {
    if (p.stack.length >= 3) return;
    const idx = p.stack.length;
    const r = idx === 0 ? R1 : idx === 1 ? R2 : R3;
    p.current = {
      x: p.x,
      y: 120,
      vy: 0,
      r: r,
      idx: idx,
      landed: false
    };
  }

  function addParticle(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
      state.particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 1,
        life: 30,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  function checkWin() {
    if (state.p1.stack.length >= 3) {
      state.phase = 'win';
      state.winner = 'P1';
      state.score = 3;
    } else if (state.p2.stack.length >= 3) {
      state.phase = 'win';
      state.winner = 'P2';
      state.score = 3;
    }
  }

  function updateSnowflakes() {
    for (const s of state.snowflakes) {
      s.y += s.speed;
      s.x += s.drift;
      if (s.y > H + 5) { s.y = -5; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
      if (s.x < -5) s.x = W + 5;
      if (s.x > W + 5) s.x = -5;
    }
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = state.particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function updatePlayer(pl) {
    if (pl.dropCooldown > 0) pl.dropCooldown--;

    const leftKey = pl.id === 1 ? 'a' : 'ArrowLeft';
    const rightKey = pl.id === 1 ? 'd' : 'ArrowRight';
    const dropKey = pl.id === 1 ? 'w' : 'ArrowUp';

    if (state.keys[rightKey]) pl.x += 3.5;

      dropNext(pl);
      pl.dropCooldown = 15;

  }

  function update() {
    updateSnowflakes();
    updateParticles();
    if (state.phase === 'play') {
      updatePlayer(state.p1);
      updatePlayer(state.p2);
    }
  }

  function drawSky() {

    grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a3050');

    for (const s of state.snowflakes) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.3;

      const bump = Math.sin(x * 0.02) * 5 + Math.cos(x * 0.05) * 3;

  function drawTree(x, baseY, size) {

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a5a3a';

      ctx.moveTo(x, ty - size * 0.3);

      ctx.lineTo(x + tw * 0.6, ty);

    }

  }

    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');

function draw() {

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  drawWater();
  drawSand();
  drawMessage();

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {

  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

  draw();

buildScene();

  function updateParticles(dt) {

    }

  let lastTime = 0;

    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(function (ts) {
    lastTime = ts;
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  });
})();

  flashAlpha: 0,
  flashColor: '#ffffff',
  // countdown
  countdownValue: 0,
  countdownTimer: 0,
  // score popup
  scorePopups: [],
  // star positions
  stars: [],
  // snowflakes
  snowflakes: [],
};

// Initialize stars
for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
  state.stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H * 0.4,
    size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3,
    twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
  });
}

// Initialize snowflakes
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
  state.snowflakes.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3,
    size: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
    drift: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.2
  });
}

// ==================== INPUT ====================
function handleStart() {
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    state.phase = 'countdown';
    state.countdownValue = 3;
    state.countdownTimer = 0;
  } else if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') {
    resetGame();
  }
}

canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (state.phase === 'start' || state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') {
    handleStart();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
    if (state.phase === 'start' || state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') {
      handleStart();
    }
  }
});

// ==================== RESET ====================
function resetGame() {
  state.phase = 'countdown';
  state.spins = 0;
  state.timer = 15;
  state.spinAngle = 0;
  state.isSpinning = false;
  state.spinSpeed = 0;
  state.particles = [];
  state.iceTrail = [];
  state.flashAlpha = 0;
  state.scorePopups = [];
  state.countdownValue = 3;
  state.countdownTimer = 0;
}

// ==================== UPDATE ====================
function update(dt) {
  // Update snowflakes
  for (let i = 0; i < state.snowflakes.length; i++) {
    const sf = state.snowflakes[i];
    sf.y += sf.speed;
    sf.drift += dt * 0.5;
    sf.x += Math.sin(sf.drift) * 0.3;
    if (sf.y > H + 10) {
      sf.y = -10;
      sf.x = Math.random() * W;
    }
  }

  // Update star twinkle
  for (let i = 0; i < state.stars.length; i++) {
    const s = state.stars[i];
    s.twinkle += dt * 2;
  }

  // Update flash
  if (state.flashAlpha > 0) {
    state.flashAlpha = Math.max(0, state.flashAlpha - dt * 2);
  }

  // Update score popups
  for (let i = state.scorePopups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const sp = state.scorePopups[i];
    sp.y -= dt * 30;
    sp.alpha -= dt * 0.8;
    if (sp.alpha <= 0) {
      state.scorePopups.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 100 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      state.particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Countdown phase
  if (state.phase === 'countdown') {
    state.countdownTimer += dt;
    if (state.countdownTimer >= 1) {
      state.countdownTimer = 0;
      state.countdownValue--;
      if (state.countdownValue <= 0) {
        state.phase = 'playing';
        state.lastTime = performance.now();
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

  // Timer countdown
  state.timer -= dt;
  if (state.timer <= 0) {
    state.timer = 0;
    state.phase = 'lose';
    return;
  }

  // Spin physics
  if (state.isSpinning) {
    state.spinSpeed += 5 * dt;
    if (state.spinSpeed > 12) state.spinSpeed = 12;
    state.spinAngle += state.spinSpeed * dt;

    // Count full rotations
    const prevSpins = Math.floor((state.spinAngle - state.spinSpeed * dt) / (Math.PI * 2));
    const currSpins = Math.floor(state.spinAngle / (Math.PI * 2));
    if (currSpins > prevSpins) {
      state.spins = currSpins;
      // Spawn particles on spin count
      spawnSpinParticles();
      state.flashAlpha = 0.3;
      state.flashColor = '#ffd700';
      state.scorePopups.push({
        x: state.skaterX,
        y: state.skaterY - 60,
        text: state.spins + '!',
        alpha: 1.0
      });

      // Check win
      if (state.spins >= state.targetSpins) {
        state.phase = 'win';
        spawnVictoryParticles();
        return;
      }
    }

    // Add ice trail
    const trailX = state.skaterX + Math.cos(state.spinAngle) * 20;
    const trailY = state.skaterY + Math.sin(state.spinAngle) * 10;
    state.iceTrail.push({ x: trailX, y: trailY, alpha: 0.6 });
    if (state.iceTrail.length > 30) {
      state.iceTrail.shift();
    }
    // Fade trail
    for (let i = 0; i < state.iceTrail.length; i++) {
      state.iceTrail[i].alpha -= dt * 0.5;
    }
  } else {
    // Slow down
    state.spinSpeed *= Math.pow(0.95, dt * 60);
    if (state.spinSpeed < 0.01) state.spinSpeed = 0;
    state.spinAngle += state.spinSpeed * dt;
  }

  // Auto-stop after 2 seconds of continuous spinning
  // (player must tap to continue)
}

function spawnSpinParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 80 + 40;
    state.particles.push({
      x: state.skaterX,
      y: state.skaterY,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 30,
      life: 0.6,
      maxLife: 0.6,
      color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#ffd700' : '#ff69b4',
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

function spawnVictoryParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 150 + 50;
    const colors = ['#ffd700', '#ff69b4', '#87ceeb', '#ffffff', '#ff4500'];
    state.particles.push({
      x: state.skaterX,
      y: state.skaterY,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 50,
      life: 1.5,
      maxLife: 1.5,
      color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
      size: Math.random() * 5 + 2
    });
  }
}

// ==================== DRAW ====================
function draw() {
  // --- Background: night sky gradient ---
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d1b2a');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1b2838');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a3a52');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a2436');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // --- Stars ---
  for (let i = 0; i < state.stars.length; i++) {
    const s = state.stars[i];
    const a = s.alpha * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.twinkle));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + a + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // --- Snowflakes ---
  for (let i = 0; i < state.snowflakes.length; i++) {
    const sf = state.snowflakes[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + sf.alpha + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sf.x, sf.y, sf.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // --- Ice rink surface ---
  const iceTop = H * 0.35;
  const iceGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, iceTop, 0, H);
  iceGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c8e8f8');
  iceGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#d4f0fc');
  iceGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#e0f5ff');
  iceGrad.addColorStop(1, '#d0ecf8');
  ctx.fillStyle = iceGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, iceTop + 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.25, iceTop - 10, W * 0.5, iceTop);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.75, iceTop + 10, W, iceTop + 30);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Ice shine lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const y = iceTop + 40 + i * 50;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W * 0.1, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.5, y - 15, W * 0.9, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // --- Rink border / boards ---
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a6a8a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, iceTop + 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.25, iceTop - 10, W * 0.5, iceTop);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.75, iceTop + 10, W, iceTop + 30);
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- Ice trail ---
  for (let i = 0; i < state.iceTrail.length; i++) {
    const t = state.iceTrail[i];
    if (t.alpha > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(135, 206, 235, ' + t.alpha * 0.5 + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // --- Shadow under skater ---
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(state.skaterX, state.skaterY + 35, 35, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // --- Draw the skater (rotating) ---
  drawSkater(state.skaterX, state.skaterY, state.spinAngle, state.isSpinning);

  // --- Particles ---
  for (let i = 0; i < state.particles.length; i++) {
    const p = state.particles[i];
    const a = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // --- Score popups ---
  for (let i = 0; i < state.scorePopups.length; i++) {
    const sp = state.scorePopups[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, ' + sp.alpha + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(sp.text, sp.x, sp.y);
  }

  // --- Flash overlay ---
  if (state.flashAlpha > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
    ctx.globalAlpha = state.flashAlpha;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // --- HUD ---
  drawHUD();

  // --- Phase overlays ---
  if (state.phase === 'start') {
    drawStartScreen();
  } else if (state.phase === 'countdown') {
    drawCountdown();
  } else if (state.phase === 'win') {
    drawWinScreen();
  } else if (state.phase === 'lose') {
    drawLoseScreen();
  }
}

function drawSkater(x, y, angle, spinning) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(angle);

  // --- Body (dress) ---
  const dressGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -10, 5, 0, -10, 45);
  dressGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff69b4');
  dressGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#e04080');
  dressGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c03060');
  ctx.fillStyle = dressGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -35);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30, -10, -25, 25);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-15, 35, 0, 38);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(15, 35, 25, 25);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(30, -10, 0, -35);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Dress sparkle
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-8, -5, 10, 15, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // --- Torso ---
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5d0c0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, -25, 8, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // --- Head ---
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5d0c0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -45, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // --- Hair (bun) ---
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4a2a1a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -52, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-3, -55, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // --- Arms (extended in spin) ---
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f5d0c0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  // Left arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-5, -22);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-25, -30, -35, -25);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(5, -22);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(25, -30, 35, -25);
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- Legs (one extended, one tucked) ---
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f5d0c0';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  // Left leg (extended)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-5, 20);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-15, 35, -20, 50);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Right leg (tucked)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(5, 20);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(10, 30, 8, 40);
  ctx.stroke();

  // --- Skates ---
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  // Left skate blade
  ctx.fillRect(-24, 50, 12, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c0c0c0';
  ctx.fillRect(-23, 53, 10, 2);
  // Right skate blade
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(4, 40, 12, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c0c0c0';
  ctx.fillRect(5, 43, 10, 2);

  // --- Motion blur effect when spinning ---
  if (spinning) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const r = 30 + i * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 1.5);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  if (state.phase === 'start' || state.phase === 'countdown') return;

  // --- Score panel ---
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(W / 2 - 120, 10, 240, 50, 10);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Spins: ' + state.spins + ' / ' + state.targetSpins, W / 2, 32);

  // Timer
  const timerColor = state.timer < 5 ? '#ff4444' : '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(state.timer) + 's', W / 2, 52);

  // --- Progress bar ---
  const barW = 200;
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
  const barY = 68;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  const progress = Math.min(1, state.spins / state.targetSpins);
  if (progress > 0) {
    const progGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
    progGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff69b4');
    progGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ffd700');
    ctx.fillStyle = progGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW * progress, barH, 4);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // --- Control hint (during play) ---
  if (state.phase === 'playing') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
    ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Click / Tap to spin  |  Click again to boost', W / 2, H - 15);
  }
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  // Overlay
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 36px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('FIGURE SKATE', W / 2, H * 0.25);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff69b4';
  ctx.fillText('SPIN COUNTER', W / 2, H * 0.25 + 40);

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Click or tap to make the skater spin.', W / 2, H * 0.45);
  ctx.fillText('Complete ' + state.targetSpins + ' full rotations before time runs out!', W / 2, H * 0.45 + 30);

  // Start prompt
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 500);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, ' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.5) + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Start', W / 2, H * 0.65);
}

function drawCountdown() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const scale = 1 + (1 - state.countdownTimer) * 0.5;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 80px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(state.countdownValue, 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawWinScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('PERFECT SPIN!', W / 2, H * 0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '22px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText(state.spins + ' rotations completed!', W / 2, H * 0.45);
  ctx.fillText('Time remaining: ' + Math.ceil(state.timer) + 's', W / 2, H * 0.45 + 30);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const sx = W / 2 - 60 + i * 30;
    const sy = H * 0.58;
    drawStar(sx, sy, 10, 5);
  }

  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 500);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, ' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.5) + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H * 0.75);
}

function drawLoseScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText("TIME'S UP!", W / 2, H * 0.3);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '22px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('You completed ' + state.spins + ' of ' + state.targetSpins + ' rotations.', W / 2, H * 0.45);

  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 500);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (0.5 + pulse * 0.5) + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Click to Try Again', W / 2, H * 0.65);
}

function drawStar(cx, cy, outerR, innerR) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const outerAngle = (i * 2 * Math.PI / 5) - Math.PI / 2;
    const innerAngle = outerAngle + Math.PI / 5;
    if (i === 0) {
      ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(outerAngle) * outerR, cy + Math.sin(outerAngle) * outerR);
    } else {
      ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(outerAngle) * outerR, cy + Math.sin(outerAngle) * outerR);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(innerAngle) * innerR, cy + Math.sin(innerAngle) * innerR);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

// ==================== GAME LOOP ====================
let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastFrameTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastFrameTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Handle click/tap for spinning
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
  if (state.phase === 'playing') {
    state.isSpinning = true;
    // Boost speed on click
    state.spinSpeed = Math.min(state.spinSpeed + 3, 12);
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
  // Keep spinning (player can click again to boost)
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state.phase === 'playing') {
    state.isSpinning = true;
    state.spinSpeed = Math.min(state.spinSpeed + 3, 12);
  } else {
    handleStart();
  }
}, { passive: false });

// Start the loop
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = 960, H = 600;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  function fit() {
    const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H, 1);
    canvas.style.width = (W * s) + "px";
    canvas.style.height = (H * s) + "px";
  }
  fit();
  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist(a, b) { const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y; return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); }
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- game state ----------
  const G = {
    mode: "start",          // start | playing | win | lose
    score: 0,
    correct: 0,
    wrong: 0,
    attempts: 0,
    maxWrong: 3,
    time: 0,
    shake: 0,
    msg: "",
    msgT: 0,
    msgCol: "#ffffff"
  };

  const storm = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    tx: 0, ty: 0,       // target
    speed: 120,
    r: 40,
    spin: 0,
    spinSpeed: 2.2,
    strength: 1,          // 1..5
    trail: []
  };

  // ---------- level (built with a short loop, no long map strings) ----------
  const WAYPOINTS = [];
  (function build() {
    const pts = [
      [110, 470], [200, 430], [300, 400],
      [410, 360], [520, 330], [630, 300],
      [730, 260], [800, 210], [850, 150]
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      WAYPOINTS.push({ x: pts[i][0], y: pts[i][1] });
    }
  })();

  const TARGETS = [];
  (function buildTargets() {
    const names = ["Port Sunny", "Bayview", "Coral Cove", "Windmill Town",
                   "Palm Harbor", "Cape Storm", "Lighthouse Bay", "Harbor City", "Fort Breeze"];
    for (let i = 0; i < WAYPOINTS.length; i++) {
      const wp = WAYPOINTS[i];
      TARGETS.push({
        x: wp.x, y: wp.y,
        name: names[i],
        hit: false,
        pulse: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }
  })();

  const CITIES = [];
  (function buildCities() {
    const c = [
      { x: 150, y: 300, n: "Meadow Town" },
      { x: 350, y: 200, n: "Greenwood" },
      { x: 560, y: 470, n: "Rivertown" },
      { x: 760, y: 420, n: "Hillside" },
      { x: 260, y: 520, n: "Lakeside" }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
      CITIES.push({ x: c[i].x, y: c[i].y, n: c[i].n });
    }
  })();

  const CLOUDS = [];
  (function buildClouds() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      CLOUDS.push({
        x: rand(0, W), y: rand(20, H * 0.7),
        s: rand(0.5, 1.2), v: rand(8, 22),
        puffs: 3 + Math.floor(rand(0, 3))
      });
    }
  })();

  const DOTS = [];
  (function buildDots() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
      DOTS.push({ x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H), a: rand(0.05, 0.25) });
    }
  })();

  function resetGame() {
    G.mode = "start";
    G.score = 0; G.correct = 0; G.wrong = 0; G.attempts = 0;
    G.time = 0; G.shake = 0; G.msg = ""; G.msgT = 0;
    storm.x = WAYPOINTS[0].x; storm.y = WAYPOINTS[0].y;
    storm.tx = WAYPOINTS[1].x; storm.ty = WAYPOINTS[1].y;
    storm.strength = 1; storm.spin = 0; storm.trail = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < TARGETS.length; i++) TARGETS[i].hit = false;
  }
  resetGame();

  // ---------- input ----------
  let mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, down: false };
  function toCanvas(e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), y: (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
    const p = toCanvas(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    const p = toCanvas(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.down = true;
    handleClick(p.x, p.y);
  });
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", function () { mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0]; const p = toCanvas(t);
    mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.down = true;
    handleClick(p.x, p.y);
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0]; const p = toCanvas(t);
    mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y;
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener("touchend", function () { mouse.down = false; });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") { resetGame(); }
    if (G.mode === "start" && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) startGame();
  });

  function startGame() {
    G.mode = "playing";
    G.score = 0; G.correct = 0; G.wrong = 0; G.attempts = 0;
    G.time = 0; G.shake = 0; G.msg = ""; G.msgT = 0;
    storm.x = WAYPOINTS[0].x; storm.y = WAYPOINTS[0].y;
    storm.tx = WAYPOINTS[1].x; storm.ty = WAYPOINTS[1].y;
    storm.strength = 1; storm.trail = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < TARGETS.length; i++) TARGETS[i].hit = false;
    G.msg = "Click the town where the storm is heading!";
    G.msgT = 3.5; G.msgCol = "#ffe08a";
  }

  function handleClick(x, y) {
    if (G.mode === "start") { startGame(); return; }
    if (G.mode === "win" || G.mode === "lose") { resetGame(); return; }
    if (G.mode !== "playing") return;

    // find nearest target
    let best = -1, bestD = 45;
    for (let i = 0; i < TARGETS.length; i++) {
      const d = dist({ x: x, y: y }, TARGETS[i]);
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
    }
    if (best < 0) return;

    const t = TARGETS[best];
    G.attempts++;
    const heading = nearestHeading();
    if (best === heading) {
      t.hit = true;
      G.correct++;
      G.score += 100 + Math.round(storm.strength * 30);
      G.msg = "Great tracking! +" + (100 + Math.round(storm.strength * 30));
      G.msgT = 2; G.msgCol = "#8affb0";
      G.shake = 6;
    } else {
      G.wrong++;
      G.msg = "Not quite — watch the path!";
      G.msgT = 2; G.msgCol = "#ff8f8f";
      G.shake = 3;
      if (G.wrong >= G.maxWrong) {
        G.mode = "lose";
      }
    }
  }

  function nearestHeading() {
    // index of the waypoint closest to the storm's current target
    let best = 0, bestD = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < TARGETS.length; i++) {
      const d = dist({ x: storm.tx, y: storm.ty }, TARGETS[i]);
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    G.time += dt;
    if (G.msgT > 0) G.msgT -= dt;
    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 22);

    // clouds always drift
    for (let i = 0; i < CLOUDS.length; i++) {
      const c = CLOUDS[i];
      c.x += c.v * dt;
      if (c.x > W + 90) { c.x = -90; c.y = rand(20, H * 0.7); }
    }

    if (G.mode !== "playing") return;

    // move storm toward target
    const dx = storm.tx - storm.x, dy = storm.ty - storm.y;
    const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d > 3) {
      const step = storm.speed * dt;
      storm.x += (dx / d) * step;
      storm.y += (dy / d) * step;
    } else {
      // reached target -> advance along waypoints
      let idx = nearestHeading();
      let next = idx + 1;
      if (next >= WAYPOINTS.length) {
        G.mode = "win";
        return;
      }
      storm.tx = WAYPOINTS[next].x;
      storm.ty = WAYPOINTS[next].y;
      // ramp up strength as it approaches land
      storm.strength = clamp(1 + next * 0.55, 1, 5);
      storm.speed = 90 + next * 10;
    }

    // trail
    storm.trail.push({ x: storm.x, y: storm.y });
    if (storm.trail.length > 220) storm.trail.shift();

    storm.spin += storm.spinSpeed * dt * (0.6 + storm.strength * 0.2);
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (G.shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-G.shake, G.shake), rand(-G.shake, G.shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawGrid();
    drawLand();
    drawTrail();
    drawPath();
    drawTargets();
    drawCities();
    drawStorm();
    drawClouds();
    drawHUD();
    drawMessage();
    if (G.mode === "start") drawStart();
    if (G.mode === "win") drawEnd(true);
    if (G.mode === "lose") drawEnd(false);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0b2b44");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#0e3a57");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#0a2233");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(-30, -30, W + 60, H + 60);

    // subtle ocean texture dots
    for (let i = 0; i < DOTS.length; i++) {
      const p = DOTS[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,190,220," + p.a + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, 2, 2);
    }
  }

  function drawGrid() {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,150,190,0.12)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // a couple of "lat/long" labels
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,200,230,0.35)";
    ctx.font = "11px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("24°N", 8, 20);
    ctx.fillText("22°N", 8, H - 40);
    ctx.fillText("88°W", 200, H - 8);
    ctx.fillText("84°W", 560, H - 8);
  }

  function drawLand() {
    // a couple of green landmasses so the map reads as a coast
    const blobs = [
      { x: 120, y: 360, rx: 90, ry: 120 },
      { x: 720, y: 380, rx: 130, ry: 90 },
      { x: 430, y: 150, rx: 70, ry: 60 }
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
      const b = blobs[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(46,120,80,0.55)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(b.x, b.y, b.rx, b.ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(70,150,95,0.45)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(b.x - b.rx * 0.2, b.y - b.ry * 0.2, b.rx * 0.7, b.ry * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawTrail() {
    if (storm.trail.length < 2) return;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let i = 1; i < storm.trail.length; i++) {
      const a = storm.trail[i - 1], b = storm.trail[i];
      const t = i / storm.trail.length;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,200,255," + (0.05 + t * 0.35) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2 + t * 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
      ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPath() {
    // dotted forecast line through all waypoints
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.55)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(WAYPOINTS[0].x, WAYPOINTS[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < WAYPOINTS.length; i++) {
      ctx.lineTo(WAYPOINTS[i].x, WAYPOINTS[i].y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  function drawTargets() {
    for (let i = 0; i < TARGETS.length; i++) {
      const t = TARGETS[i];
      const isHeading = (G.mode === "playing") && (i === nearestHeading());
      t.pulse += 0.05;
      const base = t.hit ? "#5fbf8a" : (isHeading ? "#ff8f4d" : "#ffd45e");
      const glow = t.hit ? "rgba(95,191,138,0.5)" : (isHeading ? "rgba(255,143,77,0.7)" : "rgba(255,212,94,0.5)");

      // pulse ring
      const ring = 10 + Math.sin(t.pulse) * 3 + (isHeading ? 6 : 0);
      ctx.strokeStyle = glow;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, ring, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      // pin
      ctx.fillStyle = base;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y - 8, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(t.x, t.y - 2);
      ctx.lineTo(t.x - 5, t.y - 9);
      ctx.lineTo(t.x + 5, t.y - 9);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#23303f";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y - 8, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // label
      ctx.font = "12px Trebuchet MS";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = t.hit ? "#9fe6c0" : "#eef6ff";
      ctx.fillText(t.name, t.x, t.y + 20);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";

      if (t.hit) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#8affb0";
        ctx.font = "14px Trebuchet MS";
        ctx.fillText("✓", t.x + 9, t.y - 10);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawCities() {
    for (let i = 0; i < CITIES.length; i++) {
      const c = CITIES[i];
      // a few little building blocks
      ctx.fillStyle = "#7fb0d6";
      ctx.fillRect(c.x - 8, c.y - 10, 6, 10);
      ctx.fillRect(c.x + 2, c.y - 14, 6, 14);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#5a8fb5";
      ctx.fillRect(c.x - 2, c.y - 6, 6, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe4f5";
      ctx.font = "11px Trebuchet MS";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(c.n, c.x, c.y + 16);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
  }

  function drawStorm() {
    const x = storm.x, y = storm.y;
    const R = 34 + storm.strength * 6;
    const col = storm.strength < 2 ? "#9fd6ff" : (storm.strength < 3.5 ? "#ffd45e" : "#ff7a5c");

    // outer wind bands
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(storm.spin);
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 3);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, R + 8, 0.2, Math.PI * 0.9);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // spiral arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      ctx.rotate(Math.PI * 2 / 3);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let a = 0; a < Math.PI * 1.6; a += 0.2) {
        const rr = 8 + a * (R / 5);
        const px = Math.cos(a) * rr, py = Math.sin(a) * rr;
        if (a === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // eye
    const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 2, x, y, R);
    eg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    eg.addColorStop(0.4, col);
    eg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(20,40,60,0.9)");
    ctx.fillStyle = eg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // clear eye
    ctx.fillStyle = "#123049";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // label
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 14px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("HURRICANE MIA", x, y - R - 12);
    ctx.font = "12px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.fillText("Category " + Math.round(storm.strength), x, y + R + 16);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawClouds() {
    for (let i = 0; i < CLOUDS.length; i++) {
      const c = CLOUDS[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,235,245,0.10)";
      for (let p = 0; p < c.puffs; p++) {
        const ox = (p - c.puffs / 2) * 22 * c.s;
        const oy = Math.sin(p) * 6 * c.s;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x + ox, c.y + oy, (18 + (p % 2) * 6) * c.s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,20,32,0.7)";
    roundRect(12, 12, 300, 58, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd45e";
    ctx.font = "bold 16px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("STORM TRACKER", 24, 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe4f5";
    ctx.font = "13px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + G.score, 24, 56);

    // right: lives (wrong clicks)
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,20,32,0.7)";
    roundRect(W - 210, 12, 198, 58, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe4f5";
    ctx.font = "12px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Wrong clicks:", W - 200, 32);
    for (let i = 0; i < G.maxWrong; i++) {
      const x = W - 195 + i * 26;
      const y = 48;
      ctx.fillStyle = i < G.wrong ? "#ff5a5a" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b4a63";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // bottom hint
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,20,32,0.6)";
    roundRect(12, H - 40, 360, 28, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fd0e8";
    ctx.font = "12px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Click the town the storm is about to reach.  (R to restart)", 24, H - 22);
  }

  function drawMessage() {
    if (G.msgT <= 0 || !G.msg) return;
    const a = clamp(G.msgT / 0.5, 0, 1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = G.msgCol;
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(G.msg, W / 2, 110);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function panel() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,16,26,0.85)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,30,45,0.9)";
    roundRect(W / 2 - 260, H / 2 - 150, 520, 300, 20);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffd45e";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    roundRect(W / 2 - 260, H / 2 - 150, 520, 300, 20);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawStart() {
    panel();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd45e";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("STORM TRACKER", W / 2, H / 2 - 90);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fd0e8";
    ctx.font = "18px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Help track Hurricane Mia across the map!", W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe4f5";
    ctx.font = "15px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Click each town just before the storm arrives.", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillText("Reach the last town to win. 3 wrong clicks = game over.", W / 2, H / 2 + 4);
    // play button
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8f4d";
    roundRect(W / 2 - 90, H / 2 + 40, 180, 46, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#20303f";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("PLAY  ▶", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  function drawEnd(won) {
    panel();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";

  }

  // ---------- main loop ----------

  function loop(now) {

  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
