<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Seventh Inning Stretch</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a1628;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="550"></canvas>
<script>
// ===== STATE =====
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = 900, H = 550;

const STAGE = { TITLE: 0, PLAYING: 1, WIN: 2, LOSE: 3 };
let stage = STAGE.TITLE;
let score = 0;
let combo = 0;
let bestCombo = 0;
let timer = 0;
const TOTAL_TIME = 12;
let nextNoteTime = 0;
let nextNoteSpeed = 0;
let nextNoteColor = 0;
let notes = [];
let particles = [];
let player = { x: 150, y: 0, w: 40, h: 50 };
let targetY = H / 2;
let playerY = H / 2;
let playerVel = 0;
const GRAVITY = 0.4;
const JUMP_VEL = -11;
const LANE_TOP = 160;
const LANE_BOTTOM = 420;
const NOTE_SPEED_BASE = 3.5;
const NOTE_COLORS = ['#ff4444', '#44aaff', '#ffcc22', '#44ff88'];

// ===== INPUT =====
function jump() {
  if (stage === STAGE.TITLE) {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (stage === STAGE.WIN || stage === STAGE.LOSE) {
    stage = STAGE.TITLE;
    return;
  }
  if (stage === STAGE.PLAYING && playerY >= LANE_BOTTOM - 5) {
    playerVel = JUMP_VEL;
  }
}

function startGame() {
  stage = STAGE.PLAYING;
  score = 0;
  combo = 0;
  bestCombo = 0;
  timer = TOTAL_TIME;
  nextNoteTime = 0.8;
  notes = [];
  particles = [];
  playerY = H / 2;
  playerVel = 0;
  targetY = H / 2;
}

function spawnNote() {
  const speed = NOTE_SPEED_BASE + Math.random() * 2;
  const colorIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * NOTE_COLORS.length);
  const laneY = LANE_TOP + Math.random() * (LANE_BOTTOM - LANE_TOP);
  notes.push({
    x: W + 20,
    y: laneY,
    r: 18,
    speed: speed,
    color: NOTE_COLORS[colorIdx],
    caught: false,
    missed: false
  });
}

function createParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const spd = 1 + Math.random() * 4;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd,
      life: 1,
      color: color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') {
    e.preventDefault();
    jump();
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', function() {
  jump();
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  jump();
});

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update(dt) {
  if (stage === STAGE.PLAYING) {
    timer -= dt;
    if (timer <= 0) {
      timer = 0;
      stage = score >= 5 ? STAGE.WIN : STAGE.LOSE;
      return;
    }

    nextNoteTime -= dt;
    if (nextNoteTime <= 0) {
      spawnNote();
      nextNoteTime = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
    }

    playerVel += GRAVITY;
    playerY += playerVel;
    if (playerY > LANE_BOTTOM) {
      playerY = LANE_BOTTOM;
      playerVel = 0;
    }
    if (playerY < LANE_TOP) {
      playerY = LANE_TOP;
      playerVel = 0;
    }

    const px = player.x;
    const py = playerY;

    for (let i = notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const n = notes[i];
      if (n.caught) continue;
      n.x -= n.speed;

      const dx = n.x - px;
      const dy = n.y - py;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      if (dist < n.r + 20 && !n.caught) {
        n.caught = true;
        score++;
        combo++;
        if (combo > bestCombo) bestCombo = combo;
        createParticles(n.x, n.y, n.color, 12);
        notes.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      if (n.x < -30 && !n.caught) {
        n.missed = true;
        combo = 0;
        notes.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= dt * 2;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function drawBackground() {
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a2a4a');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a4a7a');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a3a5a');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1b2e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 80);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W / 2, 120, 0, 80);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#152238';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 80);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W / 2, 120, W, 80);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 160);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 160);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const bx = 80 + i * 170;
    const bh = 40 + (i % 3) * 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1e3050';
    ctx.fillRect(bx, 160 - bh, 60, bh);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a4060';
    for (let wy = 0; wy < bh - 10; wy += 15) {
      for (let wx = 0; wx < 50; wx += 15) {
        ctx.fillRect(bx + 5 + wx, 160 - bh + 5 + wy, 8, 8);
      }
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f1f35';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 160);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 160);
  ctx.lineTo(W, LANE_TOP);
  ctx.lineTo(0, LANE_TOP);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3555';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, LANE_TOP);
  ctx.lineTo(W, LANE_TOP);
  ctx.lineTo(W, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.lineTo(0, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a5580';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(0, LANE_TOP, W, LANE_BOTTOM - LANE_TOP);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1a2e';
  ctx.fillRect(0, LANE_BOTTOM, W, H - LANE_BOTTOM);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#152540';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.lineTo(W, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a5580';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.lineTo(W, LANE_BOTTOM);
  ctx.stroke();

  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const sx = 50 + i * 110;
    const sh = 30 + (i % 4) * 15;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2e4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, LANE_BOTTOM);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + 30, LANE_BOTTOM - sh);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + 60, LANE_BOTTOM);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#223a5a';
    ctx.fillRect(sx + 10, LANE_BOTTOM - sh + 5, 10, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(sx + 35, LANE_BOTTOM - sh + 5, 10, 8);
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const px = player.x;
  const py = playerY;
  const isAirborne = py < LANE_BOTTOM - 5;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px, py);

  if (isAirborne) {
    ctx.rotate(-0.15);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 18, 22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#cccccc';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -5, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#333333';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-5, -8, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5, -8, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
  ctx.fillRect(-8, 18, 6, 10);
  ctx.fillRect(2, 18, 6, 10);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-12, -15);
  ctx.lineTo(-18, -25);
  ctx.lineTo(-8, -18);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, -15);
  ctx.lineTo(18, -25);
  ctx.lineTo(8, -18);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawNotes() {
  for (const n of notes) {
    if (n.caught) continue;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(n.x, n.y);

    ctx.fillStyle = n.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, n.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-4, -4, n.r * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('♪', 0, 0);

    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 50);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 25);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc22';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Combo: x' + combo, W / 2, 25);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(timer) + 's', W - 20, 25);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 100, 55, 200, 8);
  const timeFrac = timer / TOTAL_TIME;
  const barColor = timeFrac > 0.5 ? '#44ff88' : timeFrac > 0.25 ? '#ffcc22' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
  ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 100, 55, 200 * timeFrac, 8);
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('SEVENTH INNING', W / 2, 150);
  ctx.fillText('STRETCH', W / 2, 210);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc22';
  ctx.font = '24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Catch the notes before time runs out!', W / 2, 280);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE, W, UP, or CLICK to jump', W / 2, 340);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
  ctx.font = '18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Catch 5 notes to win the stretch!', W / 2, 390);

  const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.5;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('— CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO START —', W / 2, 460);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawEndScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const isWin = stage === STAGE.WIN;
  ctx.fillStyle = isWin ? '#44ff88' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(isWin ? 'STRETCH COMPLETE!' : 'TIME UP!', W / 2, 160);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '28px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 250);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc22';
  ctx.font = '22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Best Combo: x' + bestCombo, W / 2, 310);

  if (isWin) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Great stretch! The crowd is on its feet!', W / 2, 370);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Need 5 notes to win. Try again!', W / 2, 370);
  }

  const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.5;
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('— CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE —', W / 2, 450);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawNotes();
  drawPlayer();
  drawParticles();

  if (stage === STAGE.PLAYING) {
    drawHUD();
  }
  if (stage === STAGE.TITLE) {
    drawTitle();
  }
  if (stage === STAGE.WIN || stage === STAGE.LOSE) {
    drawEndScreen();
  }
}

// ===== GAME LOOP =====
let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

requestAnimationFrame(function(ts) {
  lastTime = ts;
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
});
</script>
</body>

  const R = Math.min(w, h) * 0.30;

let H = window.innerHeight;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

const mapW = 2000;
const mapH = 2000;

let cam = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let dragging = false;
let dragStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let camStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };

let foundX = 0;
let foundY = 0;
let found = false;
let foundTimer = 0;

// Map objects
let trees = [];
let rocks = [];
let flowers = [];
let river = [];
let houses = [];
let paths = [];

// ===== INIT MAP =====
function initMap() {
  trees = [];
  rocks = [];
  flowers = [];
  river = [];
  houses = [];
  paths = [];

  // Trees
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    trees.push({
      x: Math.random() * mapW,
      y: Math.random() * mapH,
      r: 12 + Math.random() * 18,
      shade: Math.random() * 0.3
    });
  }

  // Rocks
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    rocks.push({
      x: Math.random() * mapW,
      y: Math.random() * mapH,
      r: 6 + Math.random() * 12,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI
    });
  }

  // Flowers
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
    flowers.push({
      x: Math.random() * mapW,
      y: Math.random() * mapH,
      color: ['#ff6b9d','#ffd93d','#a8e6cf','#c3aed6','#ff9a8b'][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],
      r: 3 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }

  // River - a winding path
  let rx = 0, ry = mapH * 0.4;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    rx += 40 + Math.random() * 20;
    ry += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
    river.push({ x: rx, y: ry });
  }

  // Houses
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    houses.push({
      x: 100 + Math.random() * (mapW - 200),
      y: 100 + Math.random() * (mapH - 200),
      w: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
      h: 25 + Math.random() * 15,
      color: ['#e8c170','#d4a574','#c9b896'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)]
    });
  }

  // Paths between houses
  for (let i = 0; i < houses.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = houses[i];
    const b = houses[i + 1];
    paths.push({ x1: a.x, y1: a.y, x2: b.x, y2: b.y });
  }

  // Place the treasure
  foundX = 200 + Math.random() * (mapW - 400);
  foundY = 200 + Math.random() * (mapH - 400);
  found = false;
  foundTimer = 0;

  // Start camera at center
  cam.x = mapW / 2 - W / 2;
  cam.y = mapH / 2 - H / 2;
}

initMap();

// ===== INPUT =====
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  dragging = true;
  dragStart.x = e.clientX;
  dragStart.y = e.clientY;
  camStart.x = cam.x;
  camStart.y = cam.y;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (!dragging) return;
  cam.x = camStart.x - (e.clientX - dragStart.x);
  cam.y = camStart.y - (e.clientY - dragStart.y);
  clampCam();
});

canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  dragging = false;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
  dragging = false;
});

// Touch support
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const t = e.touches[0];
  dragging = true;
  dragStart.x = t.clientX;
  dragStart.y = t.clientY;
  camStart.x = cam.x;
  camStart.y = cam.y;
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!dragging) return;
  const t = e.touches[0];
  cam.x = camStart.x - (t.clientX - dragStart.x);
  cam.y = camStart.y - (t.clientY - dragStart.y);
  clampCam();
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
  dragging = false;
});

// Click to find treasure
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const mx = e.clientX + cam.x;
  const my = e.clientY + cam.y;
  const dist = Math.sqrt((mx - foundX) ** 2 + (my - foundY) ** 2);
  if (dist < 40 && !found) {
    found = true;
    foundTimer = 120;
  }
});

// Keyboard pan
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const speed = 20;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') cam.x -= speed;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') cam.x += speed;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') cam.y -= speed;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') cam.y += speed;
  clampCam();
});

function clampCam() {
  if (cam.x < 0) cam.x = 0;
  if (cam.y < 0) cam.y = 0;
  if (cam.x > mapW - W) cam.x = mapW - W;
  if (cam.y > mapH - H) cam.y = mapH - H;
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update() {
  if (found) {
    foundTimer--;
    if (foundTimer <= 0) {
      initMap();
    }
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw() {
  // Background - grass
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4a7c4f';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(-cam.x, -cam.y);

  // Draw map boundary
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2d5a30';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, mapW, mapH);

  // Draw paths
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c4a86b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  for (const p of paths) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x1, p.y1);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x2, p.y2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Draw river
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5dade2';
  ctx.lineWidth = 24;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  if (river.length > 1) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(river[0].x, river[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < river.length; i++) {
      ctx.lineTo(river[i].x, river[i].y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Draw river highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#85c1e9';
  ctx.lineWidth = 12;
  if (river.length > 1) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(river[0].x, river[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < river.length; i++) {
      ctx.lineTo(river[i].x, river[i].y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Draw flowers
  for (const f of flowers) {
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw rocks
  for (const r of rocks) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8e9eab';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.rotate(r.rot);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r, r.r * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b1c2';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-r.r * 0.2, -r.r * 0.2, r.r * 0.5, r.r * 0.35, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Draw houses
  for (const h of houses) {
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = h.color;
    ctx.fillRect(h.x - h.w/2, h.y - h.h/2, h.w, h.h);
    // Roof
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a0522d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(h.x - h.w/2 - 4, h.y - h.h/2);
    ctx.lineTo(h.x, h.y - h.h/2 - h.h * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(h.x + h.w/2 + 4, h.y - h.h/2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Door
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5c3a1e';
    ctx.fillRect(h.x - 4, h.y + h.h * 0.1, 8, h.h * 0.4);
    // Window
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffeaa7';
    ctx.fillRect(h.x + h.w * 0.2, h.y - h.h * 0.15, 6, 6);
  }

  // Draw trees
  for (const t of trees) {
    // Trunk
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6b4226';
    ctx.fillRect(t.x - 3, t.y, 6, t.r * 0.8);
    // Canopy
    const g = 100 + Math.floor(t.shade * 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(40, ${g}, 50)`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y - t.r * 0.3, t.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(60, ${g + 20}, 70)`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x - t.r * 0.25, t.y - t.r * 0.5, t.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw treasure (if not found)
  if (!found) {
    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 0.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(foundX, foundY, 20 * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8dc';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(foundX, foundY, 10 * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Sparkle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('★', foundX, foundY + 5);
  }

  // Found message
  if (found && foundTimer > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(mapW/2 - 150, mapH/2 - 40, 300, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('TREASURE FOUND!', mapW/2, mapH/2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('New treasure placed...', mapW/2, mapH/2 + 25);
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // UI overlay
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 200, 70);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('TINY MAP', 20, 32);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '11px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Drag to pan. Arrow keys too.', 20, 50);
  ctx.fillText('Click the gold star to find treasure!', 20, 68);

  // Mini-map
  const mmW = 100, mmH = 100;
  const mmX = W - mmW - 15, mmY = H - mmH - 15;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(mmX, mmY, mmW, mmH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(mmX, mmY, mmW, mmH);

  // Camera viewport on minimap
  const vx = (cam.x / mapW) * mmW;
  const vy = (cam.y / mapH) * mmH;
  const vw = (W / mapW) * mmW;
  const vh = (H / mapH) * mmH;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.fillRect(mmX + vx, mmY + vy, vw, vh);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.strokeRect(mmX + vx, mmY + vy, vw, vh);

  // Treasure dot on minimap
  if (!found) {
    const tx = (foundX / mapW) * mmW;
    const ty = (foundY / mapH) * mmH;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mmX + tx, mmY + ty, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

// ===== LOOP =====
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  clampCam();
});

loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<html_file>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>On-Deck Circle Timer</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #12324f; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  function resize(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- state ----------
  const state = {
    scene: 'title',     // 'title' | 'play' | 'result'
    score: 0,
    best: 0,
    round: 1,
    target: 0,          // seconds shown on the on-deck circle
    deadline: 0,        // timestamp when the round ends
    started: false,     // play button pressed
    stopped: false,     // STOP pressed
    result: null,       // 'win' | 'lose'
    resultMsg: '',
    now: 0,
    shake: 0,
    flash: 0,
    flashColor: '#ff5a5a',
    confetti: []
  };

  const ROUNDS = [3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 20];
  const MAX_ROUND = ROUNDS.length;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function pad2(n){ return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function fmtTime(ms){
    const t = Math.max(0, ms);
    const m = Math.floor(t / 60000);
    const s = Math.floor((t % 60000) / 1000);
    return pad2(m) + ':' + pad2(s);
  }
  function fmtClock(ms){
    const t = Math.max(0, ms);
    const s = Math.floor(t / 1000);
    const d = Math.floor((t % 1000) / 100);
    return (s < 10 ? '0' : '') + s + '.' + d;
  }
  function roundColor(frac){
    // frac 0 (plenty) -> 1 (tight). green -> orange -> red
    if (frac < 0.45) return '#37c26a';
    if (frac < 0.75) return '#f7a92b';
    return '#ff5a5a';
  }
  function easeOutBack(x){
    const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1;
    return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2);
  }

  // ---------- confetti ----------
  function spawnConfetti(n){
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 3 + Math.random() * 7;
      state.confetti.push({
        x: W/2, y: H*0.42,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 4,
        g: 0.18 + Math.random() * 0.1,
        size: 5 + Math.random() * 8,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI,
        vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        color: ['#ff5a5a','#f7a92b','#37c26a','#4fc3f7','#e57cd0','#ffd54f'][i % 6],
        life: 90 + Math.random() * 60
      });
    }
  }
  function updateConfetti(){
    for (let i = state.confetti.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const p = state.confetti[i];
      p.vy += p.g;
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vx *= 0.99;
      p.rot += p.vr;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0 || p.y > H + 40) state.confetti.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
  function drawConfetti(){
    for (const p of state.confetti){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.life / 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-p.size/2, -p.size/2, p.size, p.size * 0.6);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---------- game flow ----------
  function startGame(){
    state.scene = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.round = 1;
    state.started = false;
    state.stopped = false;
    state.result = null;
    state.confetti = [];
    beginRound();
  }
  function beginRound(){
    state.target = ROUNDS[state.round - 1];
    state.started = false;
    state.stopped = false;
    state.result = null;
    state.deadline = 0;
  }
  function startRound(){
    if (state.started || state.stopped) return;
    state.started = true;
    state.deadline = performance.now() + state.target * 1000;
  }
  function pressStop(){
    if (!state.started || state.stopped) return;
    state.stopped = true;
    const remaining = state.deadline - performance.now();
    const ms = Math.round(remaining);
    if (ms >= 0){
      state.result = 'win';
      state.resultMsg = 'Nailed it! ' + fmtClock(ms) + 's to spare.';
      state.score += state.round * 10;
      if (state.round >= MAX_ROUND){
        finishGame(true);
      } else {
        state.round++;
        beginRound();
      }
    } else {
      state.result = 'lose';
      state.resultMsg = 'Ouch! You were ' + fmtClock(-ms) + 's late.';
      finishGame(false);
    }
  }
  function finishGame(won){
    state.scene = 'result';
    if (won){
      state.result = 'win';
      state.resultMsg = 'You made it through every round!';
      spawnConfetti(120);
    } else {
      state.result = 'lose';
    }
    if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  function handleAction(e){
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    if (state.scene === 'title'){
      startGame();
    } else if (state.scene === 'play'){
      if (state.result){
        // result shown inside play; press to continue
        if (state.result === 'win'){
          // already advanced; ignore
        } else {
          // lost -> go to result scene
          finishGame(false);
        }
      } else if (!state.started){
        startRound();
      } else if (!state.stopped){
        pressStop();
      }
    } else if (state.scene === 'result'){
      startGame();
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.repeat) return;
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'W'){
      handleAction(e);
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { handleAction(e); });

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(){
    state.now = performance.now();
    updateConfetti();
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.85;
    if (state.flash > 0) state.flash -= 0.04;

    // auto-lose if the round timer runs out while playing
    if (state.scene === 'play' && state.started && !state.stopped){
      if (state.deadline - state.now < 0){
        state.stopped = true;
        state.result = 'lose';
        state.resultMsg = 'Time ran out! Better luck next round.';
        state.shake = 10;
        state.flash = 1;
        state.flashColor = '#ff5a5a';
        finishGame(false);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw: background ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#20486f');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#16324f');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#0f2438');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft glow behind center
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.45, 40, W/2, H*0.45, Math.max(W,H)*0.6);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,190,255,0.18)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,190,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // twinkling stars
    const t = state.now * 0.001;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++){
      const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const sy = (i * 89.3) % (H * 0.9);
      const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * (1 + (i % 5) * 0.3) + i));
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.7;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.2 + (i % 3) * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // ground
    const gy = H * 0.82;
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, '#2f7d4f');
    gg.addColorStop(1, '#1f5236');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, gy, W, H - gy);
    // grass blades
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 22){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(i, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(i + 6, gy - 10);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw: on-deck circle ----------
  function drawOnDeck(){
    const cx = W/2, cy = H * 0.44;
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.22;
    const remaining = state.deadline - state.now;
    const frac = state.started ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / (state.target * 1000))) : 1;
    const color = state.stopped
      ? (state.result === 'win' ? '#37c26a' : '#ff5a5a')
      : (state.started ? roundColor(1 - frac) : '#4fc3f7');

    // outer glow
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0.5){
      ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
    }

    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R*0.6, cx, cy, R*1.5);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R*1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // plate
    const plate = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - R*0.3, cy - R*0.3, R*0.2, cx, cy, R);
    plate.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    plate.addColorStop(1, '#dceaf5');
    ctx.fillStyle = plate;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(4, R*0.05);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a4a68';
    ctx.stroke();

    // progress ring (depletes clockwise)
    const ringW = Math.max(8, R*0.09);
    ctx.lineWidth = ringW;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(42,74,104,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - ringW*0.9, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R - ringW*0.9, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + Math.PI*2*frac, false);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineCap = 'butt';

    // "ON DECK" label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a4a68';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.12) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('ON DECK', cx, cy - R*0.42);

    // big number
    const numStr = state.started
      ? fmtClock(remaining)
      : state.target + 's';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.34) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(numStr, cx, cy + R*0.05);

    // sub label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a7690';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.09) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    const sub = state.started
      ? (state.stopped ? (state.result === 'win' ? 'CLEAN STOP!' : 'TOO LATE!') : 'Tap to STOP')
      : 'Tap to START';
    ctx.fillText(sub, cx, cy + R*0.4);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- draw: round / score HUD ----------
  function drawHUD(){
    // round chip
    const chipW = Math.min(W*0.34, 260);
    const chipH = 46;
    const cx = W/2, cy = 24 + chipH/2;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
    roundRect(cx - chipW/2, cy - chipH/2, chipW, chipH, chipH/2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a4a68';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('Round ' + state.round + ' / ' + MAX_ROUND, cx, cy);

    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, 18, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e8';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + state.best, 18, 66);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- draw: in-play result banner ----------
  function drawResultBanner(){
    if (!state.result) return;
    const win = state.result === 'win';
    const y = H * 0.68;
    const w = Math.min(W*0.8, 520), h = 90;
    ctx.fillStyle = win ? 'rgba(55,194,106,0.95)' : 'rgba(255,90,90,0.95)';
    roundRect(W/2 - w/2, y - h/2, w, h, 20);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(win ? 'Round ' + (state.round - 1) + ' cleared!' : 'Round over!', W/2, y - 14);
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(state.resultMsg, W/2, y + 18);
  }

  // ---------- draw: title scene ----------
  function drawTitle(){
    // big friendly circle (the on-deck badge)
    const cx = W/2, cy = H*0.4, R = Math.min(W,H)*0.16;
    const plate = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - R*0.3, cy - R*0.3, R*0.2, cx, cy, R);
    plate.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    plate.addColorStop(1, '#dceaf5');
    ctx.fillStyle = plate;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(4, R*0.06);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a4a68'; ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a5a';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.5) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('1', cx, cy - R*0.05);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a7690';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.16) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('ON DECK', cx, cy + R*0.42);

    // title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(Math.min(W*0.09, 54)) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('On-Deck Circle Timer', W/2, H*0.62);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e8';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(Math.min(W*0.04, 22)) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Watch the circle. Stop it before it empties!', W/2, H*0.68);

    // pulsing start button
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(state.now * 0.005);
    const bw = Math.min(W*0.5, 320), bh = 70;
    const by = H*0.78;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(79,195,247,' + (0.7 + pulse*0.3) + ')';
    roundRect(W/2 - bw/2, by - bh/2, bw, bh, bh/2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f2438';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('TAP TO START', W/2, by);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#6f93b5';
    ctx.font = 'bold 15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Tap / Space / Enter to play', W/2, H*0.9);
  }

  // ---------- draw: result scene ----------
  function drawResult(){
    const win = state.result === 'win';
    const cx = W/2, cy = H*0.42;
    const R = Math.min(W,H)*0.18;

    // medal circle
    ctx.fillStyle = win ? '#ffd54f' : '#ff5a5a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(4, R*0.06);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(R*0.6) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(win ? '★' : '!', cx, cy);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(Math.min(W*0.09, 52)) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(win ? 'You Win!' : 'Game Over', W/2, H*0.62);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(Math.min(W*0.05, 28)) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + state.score, W/2, H*0.68);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fc4e8';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(Math.min(W*0.035, 20)) + 'px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + state.best, W/2, H*0.73);

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(state.now * 0.005);
    const bw = Math.min(W*0.5, 320), bh = 70, by = H*0.83;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(79,195,247,' + (0.7 + pulse*0.3) + ')';
    roundRect(W/2 - bw/2, by - bh/2, bw, bh, bh/2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f2438';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PLAY AGAIN', W/2, by);
  }

  // ---------- draw: master ----------
  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackground();

    if (state.scene === 'title'){
      drawTitle();
    } else if (state.scene === 'play'){
      drawHUD();
      drawOnDeck();
      drawResultBanner();
    } else if (state.scene === 'result'){
      drawResult();
    }

    drawConfetti();

    // flash overlay
    if (state.flash > 0){
      ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.4;
      ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Light the Candles</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0a0a1a;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 180, 50, 0.15);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="700" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // State
  const NUM_CANDLES = 4;
  const candles = [];
  let litCount = 0;
  let gameOver = false;
  let won = false;
  let startTime = 0;
  let elapsed = 0;
  const TIME_LIMIT = 20;
  let particles = [];
  let messageAlpha = 0;
  let hoverIndex = -1;

  // Build candle data
  const candleSpacing = 90;
  const startX = W / 2 - (NUM_CANDLES - 1) * candleSpacing / 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < NUM_CANDLES; i++) {
    candles.push({
      x: startX + i * candleSpacing,
      y: 320,
      width: 22,
      height: 80,
      lit: false,
      flicker: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      glowRadius: 0
    });
  }

  // Particles array
  particles = [];

  // Input
  canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (gameOver) {
      resetGame();
      return;
    }
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
    for (let i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      const c = candles[i];
      const dx = mx - c.x;
      const dy = my - (c.y - c.height / 2);
      if (Math.abs(dx) < 30 && Math.abs(dy) < 60 && !c.lit) {
        c.lit = true;
        c.glowRadius = 0;
        litCount++;
        for (let p = 0; p < 12; p++) {
          particles.push({
            x: c.x,
            y: c.y - c.height,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
            vy: -Math.random() * 3 - 1,
            life: 1,
            size: Math.random() * 3 + 1
          });
        }
        if (litCount >= NUM_CANDLES) {
          won = true;
          gameOver = true;
          messageAlpha = 0;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
    hoverIndex = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      const c = candles[i];
      const dx = mx - c.x;
      const dy = my - (c.y - c.height / 2);
      if (Math.abs(dx) < 30 && Math.abs(dy) < 60 && !c.lit && !gameOver) {
        hoverIndex = i;
        break;
      }
    }
  });

  function resetGame() {
    for (let i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      candles[i].lit = false;
      candles[i].glowRadius = 0;
    }
    litCount = 0;
    gameOver = false;
    won = false;
    startTime = performance.now();
    elapsed = 0;
    particles = [];
    messageAlpha = 0;
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (!gameOver) {
      elapsed = (performance.now() - startTime) / 1000;
      if (elapsed >= TIME_LIMIT && litCount < NUM_CANDLES) {
        gameOver = true;
        won = false;
        messageAlpha = 0;
      }
    }

    // Update candle glow
    for (let i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      const c = candles[i];
      if (c.lit) {
        c.flicker += dt * 8;
        if (c.glowRadius < 60) {
          c.glowRadius += dt * 200;
        }
      }
    }

    // Update particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy -= 0.05;
      p.life -= dt * 1.5;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    if (gameOver) {
      messageAlpha = Math.min(1, messageAlpha + dt * 2);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // Night sky gradient
    const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d1025');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1535');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3a');
    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars
    const starSeed = 42;
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const sx = ((i * 137 + starSeed) % W);
      const sy = ((i * 97 + starSeed * 3) % (H * 0.5));
      const ss = (i % 3 === 0) ? 2 : 1;
      const alpha = 0.3 + (Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.001 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.4;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 230, ' + alpha + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, ss, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Floor / table surface
    const floorGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 80, 0, H);
    floorGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a2a4a');
    floorGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3a');
    ctx.fillStyle = floorGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 80, W, 80);

    // Table edge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3a5a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 82, W, 4);
  }

  function drawCandleBase() {
    // Draw the holder bar
    const barY = 370;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a6a3a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W / 2 - 200, barY, 400, 14, 7);
    ctx.fill();

    // Decorative ends
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a07a4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2 - 200, barY + 7, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2 + 200, barY + 7, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Small decorative dots on bar
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c09a5a';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const dx = W / 2 - 150 + i * 75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(dx, barY + 7, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawCandle(c, index) {
    const cx = c.x;
    const topY = c.y - c.height;
    const bottomY = c.y;

    // Candle body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - c.width / 2, 0, cx + c.width / 2, 0);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f5e8d0');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#fff8e8');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#fff8e8');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e8d8c0');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(cx - c.width / 2, topY, c.width, c.height, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // Wax drip
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e0c8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx - c.width / 4, topY + 8, 4, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Wick
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2a1a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, topY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, topY - 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Glow
    if (c.lit) {
      const flickerVal = Math.sin(c.flicker) * 0.15 + Math.cos(c.flicker * 1.3) * 0.1;
      const glowSize = 50 + flickerVal * 20;

      // Outer glow
      const glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, topY - 10, 0, cx, topY - 10, glowSize);
      glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.5)');
      glowGrad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 150, 50, 0.2)');
      glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 100, 30, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, topY - 10, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Flame
      const flameH = 20 + flickerVal * 5;
      const flameW = 8 + flickerVal * 2;

      // Outer flame
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 140, 30, 0.8)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, topY - 8 - flameH);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + flameW, topY - 8 - flameH * 0.5, cx + flameW * 0.6, topY - 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, topY - 4, cx - flameW * 0.6, topY - 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - flameW, topY - 8 - flameH * 0.5, cx, topY - 8 - flameH);
      ctx.fill();

      // Inner flame
      const innerH = flameH * 0.6;
      const innerW = flameW * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 230, 150, 0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, topY - 8 - innerH);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + innerW, topY - 8 - innerH * 0.4, cx + innerW * 0.5, topY - 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, topY - 5, cx - innerW * 0.5, topY - 8);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx - innerW, topY - 8 - innerH * 0.4, cx, topY - 8 - innerH);
      ctx.fill();

      // White core
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, topY - 10, 3, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // Unlit wick tip
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4a3a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, topY - 8, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Hover highlight
      if (hoverIndex === index) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.6)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(cx - c.width / 2 - 5, topY - 15, c.width + 10, c.height + 20, 6);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 80, ' + p.life + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score / progress
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e0c0';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Candles Lit: ' + litCount + ' / ' + NUM_CANDLES, W / 2, 35);

    // Timer bar
    if (!gameOver) {
      const timeLeft = Math.max(0, TIME_LIMIT - elapsed);
      const barW = 200;
      const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
      const barY = 50;
      const fill = timeLeft / TIME_LIMIT;

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, 8, 4);
      ctx.fill();

      const barColor = fill > 0.5 ? '#60c060' : (fill > 0.25 ? '#e0a030' : '#d04040');
      ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW * fill, 8, 4);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#c0b0a0';
      ctx.font = '13px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timeLeft) + 's', W / 2, barY + 24);
    }

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d0c0a0';
    ctx.font = 'italic 14px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Click each candle to light it before time runs out', W / 2, H - 30);
  }

  function drawGameOver() {
    if (!gameOver) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, ' + (0.5 * messageAlpha) + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.globalAlpha = messageAlpha;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    if (won) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe080';
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('All Candles Lit!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c0b0a0';
      ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Time: ' + elapsed.toFixed(1) + 's', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#a09080';
      ctx.font = '15px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8060';
      ctx.font = 'bold 32px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Time\'s Up!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c0b0a0';
      ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('You lit ' + litCount + ' of ' + NUM_CANDLES + ' candles', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#a09080';
      ctx.font = '15px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Click to try again', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackground();
    drawCandleBase();
    for (let i = 0; i < candles.length; i++) {
      drawCandle(candles[i], i);
    }
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
    drawGameOver();
  }

  // Main loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Polyfill roundRect if not available
  if (!ctx.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
      if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
      const [tl, tr, br, bl] = r;
      this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
      this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
      this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
      this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
      this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
      this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
      this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
      this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
      this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
      this.closePath();
    };
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Flight Simulator</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const state = {
    running: false,
    won: false,
    lost: false,
    score: 0,
    timer: 0
  };

  const plane = {
    x: 150,
    y: H / 2,
    vy: 0,
    angle: 0,
    thrust: 0
  };

  const terrain = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const stars = [];
  const particles = [];
  const mountains = [];

  const GRAVITY = 0.25;
  const LIFT = 0.35;
  const THROTTLE = 0.5;
  const MAX_SPEED = 8;
  const MIN_SPEED = 2;
  const TARGET_X = W - 200;
  const SPEED = 4;

  const keys = {
    up: false,
    down: false,
    left: false,
    right: false
  };

  function generateTerrain() {
    terrain.length = 0;
    const segments = 120;
    const segW = W / segments;
    let h = H * 0.65;
    for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
      const x = i * segW;
      const noise = Math.sin(i * 0.3) * 60 + Math.sin(i * 0.7) * 40 + Math.sin(i * 0.15) * 80;
      const base = H * 0.65 + noise;
      const y = Math.max(H * 0.35, Math.min(H * 0.9, base));
      terrain.push({ x, y });
    }
  }

  function generateMountains() {
    mountains.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
      mountains.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        w: 60 + Math.random() * 120,
        h: 80 + Math.random() * 200,
        color: `hsl(${200 + Math.random() * 30}, ${30 + Math.random() * 20}%, ${25 + Math.random() * 20}%)`
      });
    }
  }

  function generateClouds() {
    clouds.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
      clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: 50 + Math.random() * H * 0.4,
        r: 20 + Math.random() * 40,
        speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        opacity: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
    }
  }

  function generateStars() {
    stars.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H * 0.5,
        r: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
        twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }
  }

  function getTerrainYAtX(x) {
    if (terrain.length < 2) return H;
    const step = terrain[1].x - terrain[0].x;
    const idx = Math.floor(x / step);
    const i0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(terrain.length - 2, idx));
    const i1 = i0 + 1;
    const t = (x - terrain[i0].x) / (terrain[i1].x - terrain[i0].x);
    const clampedT = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    return terrain[i0].y + (terrain[i1].y - terrain[i0].y) * clampedT;
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x,
        y,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
        r: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
        color,
        life: 30 + Math.random() * 30
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function update() {
    if (!state.running || state.won || state.lost) return;

    state.timer++;
    state.score += 1;

    if (keys.up) plane.vy -= LIFT;
    if (keys.down) plane.vy += GRAVITY * 1.5;
    plane.vy += GRAVITY;
    plane.vy *= 0.98;
    plane.y += plane.vy;

    if (keys.right) plane.thrust = Math.min(plane.thrust + THROTTLE * 0.1, MAX_SPEED);
    else plane.thrust = Math.max(plane.thrust - 0.05, MIN_SPEED);

    plane.x += plane.thrust;
    plane.angle = Math.atan2(plane.vy, plane.thrust) * 0.5;

    if (keys.left) plane.x -= 2;

    const terrainY = getTerrainYAtX(plane.x);
    if (plane.y > terrainY - 15) {
      plane.y = terrainY - 15;
      plane.vy = 0;
      spawnParticles(plane.x, plane.y + 10, "#ff6b35", 8);
      if (Math.abs(plane.vy) > 3 || plane.thrust < 2) {
        state.lost = true;
        spawnParticles(plane.x, plane.y, "#ff0000", 20);
      }
    }

    if (plane.y < 30) {
      plane.y = 30;
      plane.vy = Math.max(plane.vy, 0);
    }

    if (plane.x >= TARGET_X) {
      state.won = true;
      spawnParticles(plane.x, plane.y, "#00ff88", 30);
    }

    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed;
      if (c.x < -c.r * 2) {
        c.x = W + c.r * 2;
        c.y = 50 + Math.random() * H * 0.4;
      }
    }

    for (const s of stars) {
      s.twinkle += 0.05;
    }

    updateParticles();
  }

  function drawSky() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#0a0a2e");
    grad.addColorStop(0.3, "#1a1a4e");
    grad.addColorStop(0.6, "#2d2d6e");
    grad.addColorStop(0.8, "#4a3a7a");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#6a4a8a");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawStars() {
    for (const s of stars) {
      const alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(s.twinkle) * 0.3;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawMountains() {
    for (const m of mountains) {
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(m.x - m.w / 2, H);
      ctx.lineTo(m.x, H - m.h);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fb8d8";
    ctx.fillText("Drop boxes to build the tallest stack", W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.fillText("Reach " + WIN_HEIGHT + "px to win", W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd166";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Click or press SPACE to start", W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
  } else if (phase === "gameover") {
    ctx.fillText("STACK COLLAPSED", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
    ctx.font = "24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillText("Final height: " + score + "px", W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd166";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Click or press SPACE to retry", W / 2, H / 2 + 70);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawWinLine();
  // draw boxes
  for (const b of boxes) drawBox(b, false);
  // ghost / current
  if (phase === "playing" && currentBox) {
    const g = currentBox;
    g.x = clamp(mouseX, g.w / 2 + 8, W - g.w / 2 - 8);
    g.y = DROP_Y;
    drawBox(g, true);
    // drop guide
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(g.x, g.y + g.h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(g.x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  ctx.restore();
  if (phase === "ready" || phase === "gameover") drawOverlay();
}

// ---------- loop ----------
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - lastT) / 1000;
  lastT = now;
  if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Metronome Rush</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #0a0e1a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ===== CONSTANTS =====
const BPM = 120;
const BEAT_MS = 60000 / BPM;
const TOTAL_BEATS = 32;
const WIN_BEATS = 24;
const HIT_WINDOW = 130;
const PERFECT_WINDOW = 55;
const APPROACH_BEATS = 3;

const COLORS = {
  bgTop: '#0d1021',
  bgBottom: '#1a1030',
  track: '#221838',
  trackBorder: '#3a2d5c',
  target: '#00e5ff',
  targetGlow: 'rgba(0,229,255,0.35)',
  note: '#ff6b35',
  noteGlow: 'rgba(255,107,53,0.4)',
  perfect: '#00ff9d',
  good: '#ffd23f',
  miss: '#ff3860',
  text: '#e8e6f0',
  dim: '#6a6580',
  accent: '#7c5cff',
  flash: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'
};

// ===== STATE =====
let canvas, ctx;
let W, H;
let state = 'title'; // 'title' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
let score = 0;
let combo = 0;
let maxCombo = 0;
let hits = 0;
let misses = 0;
let totalNotes = 0;
let currentBeat = 0;
let lastBeatTime = 0;
let gameStartTime = 0;
let notes = [];
let particles = [];
let hitFlash = 0;
let hitFlashColor = COLORS.perfect;
let shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0;
let titlePulse = 0;
let lastFrameTime = 0;

// ===== INPUT =====
let keysDown = {};

// ===== INIT =====
function init() {
  canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onTouch, { passive: false });
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
}

// ===== INPUT HANDLERS =====
function onKeyDown(e) {
  keysDown[e.code] = true;
  if (state === 'title') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
      startGame();
    }
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'KeyZ' || e.code === 'KeyX') {
      tryHit();
    }
  } else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
      resetToTitle();
    }
  }
}

function onKeyUp(e) {
  keysDown[e.code] = false;
}

function onPointer(e) {
  if (state === 'title') {
    startGame();
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    tryHit();
  } else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    resetToTitle();
  }
}

function onTouch(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (state === 'title') {
    startGame();
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    tryHit();
  } else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    resetToTitle();
  }
}

// ===== GAME LOGIC =====
function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  score = 0;
  combo = 0;
  maxCombo = 0;
  hits = 0;
  misses = 0;
  totalNotes = 0;
  currentBeat = 0;
  notes = [];
  particles = [];
  hitFlash = 0;
  gameStartTime = performance.now();
  lastBeatTime = gameStartTime;
  generateNotes();
}

function resetToTitle() {
  state = 'title';
  notes = [];
  particles = [];
  hitFlash = 0;
}

function generateNotes() {
  notes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < TOTAL_BEATS; i++) {
    if (i < 4) continue; // 4-beat lead-in
    // Create a note for each beat
    notes.push({
      beat: i,
      hit: false,
      missed: false,
      result: null
    });
    totalNotes++;
  }
}

function tryHit() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = now - gameStartTime;
  const currentBeatFloat = elapsed / BEAT_MS;

  // Find the closest unhit note
  let bestNote = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const n of notes) {
    if (n.hit || n.missed) continue;
    const dist = Math.abs(currentBeatFloat - n.beat);
    if (dist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = dist;
      bestNote = n;
    }
  }

  if (bestNote && bestDist * BEAT_MS <= HIT_WINDOW) {
    const msOff = bestDist * BEAT_MS;
    bestNote.hit = true;
    hits++;
    combo++;
    if (combo > maxCombo) maxCombo = combo;

    if (msOff <= PERFECT_WINDOW) {
      bestNote.result = 'perfect';
      score += 100 + combo * 10;
      hitFlash = 1;
      hitFlashColor = COLORS.perfect;
      spawnParticles(W * 0.5, targetY(), COLORS.perfect, 18);
    } else {
      bestNote.result = 'good';
      score += 50 + combo * 5;
      hitFlash = 0.7;
      hitFlashColor = COLORS.good;
      spawnParticles(W * 0.5, targetY(), COLORS.good, 10);
    }

    // Check win
    if (hits >= WIN_BEATS) {
      state = 'won';
    }
  } else {
    // Whiff
    combo = 0;
    hitFlash = 0.4;
    hitFlashColor = COLORS.miss;
    shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;
    shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;
  }
}

function checkMisses() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = now - gameStartTime;
  const currentBeatFloat = elapsed / BEAT_MS;

  for (const n of notes) {
    if (n.hit || n.missed) continue;
    if (currentBeatFloat > n.beat + HIT_WINDOW / BEAT_MS) {
      n.missed = true;
      n.result = 'miss';
      misses++;
      combo = 0;
      hitFlash = 0.5;
      hitFlashColor = COLORS.miss;
      shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
      shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
    }
  }

  // Check lose
  if (misses > 8) {
    state = 'lost';
  }

  // Check if all notes done and not won
  const allDone = notes.every(n => n.hit || n.missed);
  if (allDone && state === 'playing' && hits < WIN_BEATS) {
    state = 'lost';
  }
}

// ===== PARTICLES =====
function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + Math.random() * 0.3;
    const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 5;
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02,
      color: color,
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

// ===== DRAWING HELPERS =====
function targetY() {
  return H * 0.72;
}

function trackLeft() {
  return W * 0.35;
}

function trackRight() {
  return W * 0.65;
}

function noteY(beat) {
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = now - gameStartTime;
  const currentBeatFloat = elapsed / BEAT_MS;
  const dist = beat - currentBeatFloat;
  const t = 1 - dist / APPROACH_BEATS;
  if (t < 0) return -50;
  const topY = H * 0.08;
  const botY = targetY();
  return topY + (botY - topY) * t;
}

function drawBackground() {
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, COLORS.bgTop);
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#141028');
  grad.addColorStop(1, COLORS.bgBottom);
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(124,92,255,0.06)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const spacing = 60;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += spacing) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += spacing) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Floating ambient dots
  const t = performance.now() * 0.001;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const dx = W * 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.3 + i * 2.1) * W * 0.4;
    const dy = H * 0.5 + Math.cos(t * 0.2 + i * 1.7) * H * 0.35;
    const r = 2 + Math.sin(t + i) * 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(124,92,255,${0.08 + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i) * 0.04})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(dx, dy, Math.max(1, r), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTrack() {
  const left = trackLeft();
  const right = trackRight();
  const top = H * 0.08;
  const bottom = targetY() + 30;
  const w = right - left;
  const x = left;

  // Track background
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.track;
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.trackBorder;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(x, top, w, bottom - top, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();

  // Beat lane lines
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = now - gameStartTime;
  const currentBeatFloat = elapsed / BEAT_MS;

  for (let b = 0; b < TOTAL_BEATS; b++) {
    const y = noteY(b);
    if (y < top - 10 || y > bottom + 10) continue;
    const isCurrent = Math.abs(b - Math.round(currentBeatFloat)) < 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = isCurrent ? 'rgba(0,229,255,0.25)' : 'rgba(124,92,255,0.1)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isCurrent ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 4, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - 4, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Target line
  const ty = targetY();
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.target;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.shadowColor = COLORS.targetGlow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 4, ty);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - 4, ty);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Target diamonds
  drawDiamond(x + 15, ty, 8, COLORS.target);
  drawDiamond(x + w - 15, ty, 8, COLORS.target);
}

function drawDiamond(x, y, size, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - size);
  ctx.lineTo(x + size, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + size);
  ctx.lineTo(x - size, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawNotes() {
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = now - gameStartTime;
  const currentBeatFloat = elapsed / BEAT_MS;

  for (const n of notes) {
    if (n.hit || n.missed) continue;
    const y = noteY(n.beat);
    if (y < -20 || y > H + 20) continue;

    const cx = W * 0.5;
    const dist = n.beat - currentBeatFloat;
    const scale = Math.max(0.5, 1 - dist / (APPROACH_BEATS * 2));

    // Glow
    ctx.shadowColor = COLORS.noteGlow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20 * scale;

    // Note body - rounded diamond
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.note;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = 14 * scale;
    ctx.moveTo(cx, y - s);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + s * 0.7, y);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, y + s);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - s * 0.7, y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    const s2 = s * 0.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, y - s2);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + s2 * 0.7, y);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, y + s2);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - s2 * 0.7, y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  // Draw missed notes briefly
  for (const n of notes) {
    if (!n.missed || n.result !== 'miss') continue;
    const y = targetY();
    const cx = W * 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.miss;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = 10;
    ctx.moveTo(cx, y - s);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + s * 0.7, y);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, y + s);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - s * 0.7, y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHitFlash() {
  if (hitFlash <= 0) return;
  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const ty = targetY();
  const r = 60 * (1 + (1 - hitFlash) * 2);
  ctx.globalAlpha = hitFlash * 0.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = hitFlashColor;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, ty, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = hitFlash * 0.15;
  ctx.fillStyle = hitFlashColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, ty, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(28, W * 0.035)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE  ${score}`, 20, 40);

  // Combo
  if (combo > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(24, W * 0.03)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(`${combo}x COMBO`, W - 20, 40);
  }

  // Progress bar
  const barW = Math.min(300, W * 0.3);
  const barX = W * 0.5 - barW / 2;
  const barY = 16;
  const barH = 8;
  const progress = hits / WIN_BEATS;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  const progColor = progress >= 1 ? COLORS.perfect : COLORS.accent;
  ctx.fillStyle = progColor;
  roundRect(barX, barY, barW * Math.min(1, progress), barH, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(12, W * 0.015)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`${hits} / ${WIN_BEATS} hits needed`, W * 0.5, barY + barH + 16);

  // Miss counter
  ctx.fillStyle = misses > 5 ? COLORS.miss : COLORS.dim;
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(14, W * 0.018)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`Misses: ${misses} / 8`, 20, 65);

  // BPM indicator
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(`${BPM} BPM`, W - 20, 65);
}

function drawMetronomePendulum() {
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = state === 'playing' ? now - gameStartTime : now * 0.5;
  const beatPhase = (elapsed % BEAT_MS) / BEAT_MS;
  const angle = Math.sin(beatPhase * Math.PI * 2) * 0.4;

  const px = W * 0.08;
  const py = H * 0.35;
  const len = Math.min(80, H * 0.1);

  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px, py);
  ctx.lineTo(px + Math.sin(angle) * len, py + Math.cos(angle) * len);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Pivot
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Bob
  const bx = px + Math.sin(angle) * len;
  const by = py + Math.cos(angle) * len;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx, by, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(bx - 2, by - 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawTitle() {
  drawBackground();
  drawMetronomePendulum();

  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const cy = H * 0.4;

  titlePulse = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.003) * 0.1 + 1;

  // Title glow
  ctx.shadowColor = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30 * titlePulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(48, W * 0.06)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('METRONOME RUSH', cx, cy);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Subtitle
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(18, W * 0.025)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(`Hit the beat at ${BPM} BPM`, cx, cy + 35);

  // Instructions
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.good;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(16, W * 0.022)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE / TAP when notes hit the line', cx, cy + 80);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(14, W * 0.02)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(`Get ${WIN_BEATS} hits to win. 8 misses and you lose.`, cx, cy + 110);

  // Blinking prompt
  const blink = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.005) * 0.5 + 0.5;
  ctx.globalAlpha = blink;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.target;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(20, W * 0.028)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO START', cx, cy + 170);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Decorative notes floating
  const t = performance.now() * 0.001;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const nx = cx + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i * 1.3) * W * 0.3;
    const ny = H * 0.75 + Math.cos(t * 0.3 + i * 0.9) * H * 0.08;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,107,53,${0.15 + Math.sin(t + i) * 0.05})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = 8;
    ctx.moveTo(nx, ny - s);
    ctx.lineTo(nx + s * 0.7, ny);
    ctx.lineTo(nx, ny + s);
    ctx.lineTo(nx - s * 0.7, ny);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawEndScreen(won) {
  drawBackground();

  const cx = W * 0.5;
  const cy = H * 0.35;

  // Title
  ctx.shadowColor = won ? COLORS.perfect : COLORS.miss;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
  ctx.fillStyle = won ? COLORS.perfect : COLORS.miss;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(44, W * 0.055)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(won ? 'PERFECT RHYTHM!' : 'RHYTHM LOST', cx, cy);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Stats
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.text;
  ctx.font = `${Math.min(20, W * 0.028)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  const lines = [
    `Score: ${score}`,
    `Hits: ${hits} / ${totalNotes}`,
    `Max Combo: ${maxCombo}x`,
    `Misses: ${misses}`
  ];
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    ctx.fillText(line, cx, cy + 50 + i * 32);
  });

  // Grade
  const pct = hits / Math.max(1, totalNotes);
  let grade = 'F';
  if (pct >= 0.95) grade = 'S';
  else if (pct >= 0.85) grade = 'A';
  else if (pct >= 0.7) grade = 'B';
  else if (pct >= 0.5) grade = 'C';

  const gradeColor = grade === 'S' ? COLORS.perfect : grade === 'A' ? COLORS.good : grade === 'B' ? COLORS.accent : COLORS.miss;
  ctx.fillStyle = gradeColor;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(60, W * 0.08)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(grade, cx, cy + 50 + lines.length * 32 + 30);

  // Restart prompt
  const blink = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.005) * 0.5 + 0.5;
  ctx.globalAlpha = blink;
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.target;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.min(18, W * 0.025)}px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', cx, cy + 50 + lines.length * 32 + 80);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update(dt) {
  if (state === 'playing') {
    checkMisses();
  }
  updateParticles(dt);

  // Decay hit flash
  if (hitFlash > 0) {
    hitFlash -= dt * 0.004;
    if (hitFlash < 0) hitFlash = 0;
  }

  // Decay shake
  shakeX *= 0.85;
  shakeY *= 0.85;
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);

  if (state === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
  } else if (state === 'playing') {
    drawBackground();
    drawMetronomePendulum();
    drawTrack();
    drawNotes();
    drawParticles();
    drawHitFlash();
    drawHUD();
  } else if (state === 'won') {
    drawEndScreen(true);
    drawParticles();
  } else if (state === 'lost') {
    drawEndScreen(false);
    drawParticles();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

// ===== MAIN LOOP =====
function loop(timestamp) {
  if (!lastFrameTime) lastFrameTime = timestamp;
  const dt = Math.min(timestamp - lastFrameTime, 50);
  lastFrameTime = timestamp;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ===== START =====
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0d1b2a;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    background: #10203a;
    border: 3px solid #3a5a8a;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    max-width: 95vw;
    max-height: 95vh;
  }
</style>
