<canvas id="game" width="720" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }
  function overlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  // ---------- state ----------
  const state = {
    mode: 'start',   // start | play | win | lose
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    time: 0,
    shake: 0
  };

  const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 60, y: H - 40, w: 120, h: 14, speed: 560 };

  const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 360, stuck: true };

  const powerups = [];   // falling capsules
  const particles = [];   // sparks
  const stars = [];

  // ---------- bricks ----------
  const brickColors = ['#ff5e6c', '#ff9f43', '#ffd93d', '#4cd07d', '#4cc3ff', '#b07cff'];
  const bricks = [];
  function buildBricks() {
    bricks.length = 0;
    const cols = 10, rows = 6;
    const bw = 60, bh = 24, gap = 6;
    const totalW = cols * bw + (cols - 1) * gap;
    const startX = (W - totalW) / 2;
    const startY = 70;
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        const hp = r < 2 ? 2 : 1;
        bricks.push({
          x: startX + c * (bw + gap),
          y: startY + r * (bh + gap),
          w: bw, h: bh,
          hp: hp, max: hp,
          color: brickColors[r % brickColors.length]
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- starfield ----------
  function buildStars() {
    stars.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      stars.push({ x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H), s: rand(0.5, 2), tw: rand(0, Math.PI * 2) });
    }
  }

  // ---------- power-up types ----------
  const PU_TYPES = {
    widen:   { label: 'W',  color: '#4cc3ff' },
    slow:    { label: 'S',  color: '#ffd93d' },
    double:  { label: '2X', color: '#ff5e6c' },
    life:    { label: '+',  color: '#4cd07d' }
  };

  const effects = {
    widenUntil: 0,
    slowUntil: 0,
    doubleUntil: 0
  };

  function spawnPowerup(x, y) {
    if (Math.random() > 0.30) return;
    const keys = Object.keys(PU_TYPES);
    const k = keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)];
    powerups.push({ x: x, y: y, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 90, type: k, spin: 0 });
  }

  function burst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const sp = rand(60, 260);
      particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp, life: rand(0.3, 0.8), max: 0.8, color: color, s: rand(1.5, 3.5) });
    }
  }

  // ---------- reset / start ----------
  function resetBall() {
    ball.stuck = true;
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 2;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.mode = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.shake = 0;
    paddle.w = 120;
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    effects.widenUntil = 0;
    effects.slowUntil = 0;
    effects.doubleUntil = 0;
    powerups.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    buildBricks();
    resetBall();
  }

  function launch() {
    if (!ball.stuck) return;
    ball.stuck = false;
    const a = rand(-0.6, 0.6);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(a) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(a) * ball.speed;
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'a' || k === 'arrowleft') { keys.left = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === 'd' || k === 'arrowright') { keys.right = true; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') {
      if (state.mode === 'start') startGame();
      else if (state.mode === 'win' || state.mode === 'lose') startGame();
      else launch();
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'a' || k === 'arrowleft') keys.left = false;
    else if (k === 'd' || k === 'arrowright') keys.right = false;
  });

  let mouseActive = false;
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scale = canvas.width / rect.width;
    const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scale;
    paddle.x = clamp(mx - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
    mouseActive = true;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function () {
    if (state.mode === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state.mode === 'win' || state.mode === 'lose') startGame();
    else launch();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scale = canvas.width / rect.width;
    const mx = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * scale;
    paddle.x = clamp(mx - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
    if (state.mode === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state.mode === 'win' || state.mode === 'lose') startGame();
    else launch();
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  // ---------- apply power-up ----------
  function applyPowerup(pu) {
    const t = pu.type;
    if (t === 'widen') {
      paddle.w = Math.min(200, paddle.w + 40);
      effects.widenUntil = state.time + 10;
    } else if (t === 'slow') {
      effects.slowUntil = state.time + 8;
    } else if (t === 'double') {
      effects.doubleUntil = state.time + 12;
    } else if (t === 'life') {
      state.lives = Math.min(5, state.lives + 1);
    }
    state.score += 50 * (effects.doubleUntil > state.time ? 2 : 1);
    burst(pu.x + pu.w / 2, pu.y + pu.h / 2, PU_TYPES[t].color, 14);
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    state.time += dt;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 4);

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 400 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (state.mode !== 'play') return;

    // paddle movement (keyboard)
    if (keys.left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed * dt;
    if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * dt;
    paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w);

    // timed effects
    if (effects.widenUntil > 0 && state.time > effects.widenUntil) {
      paddle.w = Math.max(120, paddle.w - 40);
      paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w);
      effects.widenUntil = 0;
    }

    const slowed = effects.slowUntil > state.time;
    const effSpeed = slowed ? ball.speed * 0.6 : ball.speed;

    // ball
    if (ball.stuck) {
      ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 2;
    } else {
      ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
      ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

      // walls
      if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

      // paddle
      if (ball.vy > 0 && overlap({ x: ball.x - ball.r, y: ball.y - ball.r, w: ball.r * 2, h: ball.r * 2 }, paddle)) {
        const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
        const angle = hit * 0.9;
        ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * effSpeed;
        ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * effSpeed;
        ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
      }

      // bricks
      for (let i = bricks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const b = bricks[i];
        if (overlap({ x: ball.x - ball.r, y: ball.y - ball.r, w: ball.r * 2, h: ball.r * 2 }, b)) {
          const bcx = b.x + b.w / 2, bcy = b.y + b.h / 2;
          const dx = ball.x - bcx, dy = ball.y - bcy;
          if (Math.abs(dx) / (b.w / 2) > Math.abs(dy) / (b.h / 2)) {
            ball.vx = dx > 0 ? Math.abs(ball.vx) : -Math.abs(ball.vx);
          } else {
            ball.vy = dy > 0 ? Math.abs(ball.vy) : -Math.abs(ball.vy);
          }
          b.hp--;
          if (b.hp <= 0) {
            const pts = 20 * (effects.doubleUntil > state.time ? 2 : 1);
            state.score += pts;
            burst(bcx, bcy, b.color, 12);
            spawnPowerup(bcx, bcy);
            bricks.splice(i, 1);
          } else {
            state.score += 5;
            burst(ball.x, ball.y, '#ffffff', 4);
          }
          state.shake = 0.5;
          break;
        }
      }

      // powerups
      for (let i = powerups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const pu = powerups[i];
        pu.y += pu.vy * dt;
        pu.spin += dt * 3;
        if (overlap({ x: ball.x - ball.r, y: ball.y - ball.r, w: ball.r * 2, h: ball.r * 2 }, pu)) {
          applyPowerup(pu);
          powerups.splice(i, 1);
        } else if (overlap(pu, paddle)) {
          applyPowerup(pu);
          powerups.splice(i, 1);
        } else if (pu.y > H) {
          powerups.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }

      // fell off bottom
      if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
        state.lives--;
        state.shake = 1;
        if (state.lives <= 0) {
          state.mode = 'lose';
        } else {
          resetBall();
        }
      }
    }

    // win
    if (bricks.length === 0 && state.mode === 'play') {
      state.mode = 'win';
      burst(W / 2, H / 2, '#ffd93d', 40);
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0d1b2a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#10203a');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#16304f');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      const a = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time * 1.5 + s.tw));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
    }
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 5);
      ctx.fill();
      // top highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
      // cracked look for damaged
      if (b.hp < b.max) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.5, b.y + b.h);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.x, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#8fd3ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#2f7fc4');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x + 6, paddle.y + 3, paddle.w - 12, 3);
  }

  function drawBall() {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x - 3, ball.y - 3, 1, ball.x, ball.y, ball.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#bfe6ff');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawPowerups() {
    for (const pu of powerups) {
      const info = PU_TYPES[pu.type];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(pu.x + pu.w / 2, pu.y + pu.h / 2);
      ctx.rotate(Math.sin(pu.spin) * 0.3);
      ctx.fillStyle = info.color;
      roundRect(-pu.w / 2, -pu.h / 2, pu.w, pu.h, 6);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
      ctx.fillRect(-pu.w / 2 + 3, -pu.h / 2 + 2, pu.w - 6, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1b2a';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(info.label, 0, 1);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.s, p.s);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, 20, 18);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 20, 18);
    // hearts
    for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) {
      const hx = W - 30 - i * 24, hy = 44;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5e6c';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hx - 5, hy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(hx + 5, hy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx - 10, hy + 2);
      ctx.lineTo(hx, hy + 16);
      ctx.lineTo(hx + 10, hy + 2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawCenterText(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 54px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '22px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '16px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE / click to ' + (state.mode === 'start' ? 'start' : 'play again'), W / 2, H / 2 + 55);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const m = state.shake * 6;
      ctx.translate(rand(-m, m), rand(-m, m));
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawBricks();
    drawPowerups();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
    ctx.restore();

    if (state.mode === 'start') drawCenterText('BREAKOUT', 'Smash every brick. Catch the falling power-ups!', '#4cc3ff');
    else if (state.mode === 'win') drawCenterText('YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + state.score, '#4cd07d');
    else if (state.mode === 'lose') drawCenterText('GAME OVER', 'Final score: ' + state.score, '#ff5e6c');
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  buildStars();
  buildBricks();
  resetBall();

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  const state = {
    running: false,
    won: false,
    lost: false,
    score: 0,
    enemiesKilled: 0,
    totalEnemies: 14,
    spawnTimer: 0,
    shake: 0
  };

  const player = {
    x: W / 2,
    y: H - 90,
    w: 48,
    h: 40,
    speed: 340,
    hp: 100,
    maxHp: 100,
    cooldown: 0,
    fireRate: 0.22
  };

  const keys = {};
  const bullets = [];
  const enemies = [];
  const particles = [];
  const stars = [];

  // Pre-create the starfield before any loop reads it.
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.4,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      spd: Math.random() * 12 + 4
    });
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (e.key === " " || e.key.toLowerCase() === "w") e.preventDefault();
    if (e.key === "Enter") startGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  function startGame() {
    state.running = true;
    state.won = false;
    state.lost = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.enemiesKilled = 0;
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - 90;
    player.hp = player.maxHp;
    player.cooldown = 0;
    bullets.length = 0;
    enemies.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
  }

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function spawnEnemy() {
    const x = 60 + Math.random() * (W - 120);
    enemies.push({
      x: x,
      y: -40,
      w: 46,
      h: 40,
      hp: 3,
      maxHp: 3,
      vy: 70 + Math.random() * 40,
      wob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      wobAmp: 20 + Math.random() * 24,
      fireTimer: 1 + Math.random() * 2
    });
  }

  function addParticles(x, y, color, n, spd) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = Math.random() * spd + spd * 0.3;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 1,
        color: color,
        r: Math.random() * 3 + 1.5
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (!state.running) return;

    // Player movement
    let mx = 0;
    let my = 0;
    if (keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"]) mx -= 1;
    if (keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"]) mx += 1;
    if (keys["w"] || keys["arrowup"]) my -= 1;
    if (keys["s"] || keys["arrowdown"]) my += 1;
    const len = Math.hypot(mx, my);
    if (len > 0) {
      player.x += (mx / len) * player.speed * dt;
      player.y += (my / len) * player.speed * dt;
    }
    player.x = Math.max(player.w / 2, Math.min(W - player.w / 2, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(H / 2, Math.min(H - player.h / 2, player.y));

    // Shooting
    player.cooldown -= dt;
    if (keys[" "] && player.cooldown <= 0) {
      bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - player.h / 2, vy: -620, r: 5 });
      player.cooldown = player.fireRate;
    }

    // Bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      bullets[i].y += bullets[i].vy * dt;
      if (bullets[i].y < -20) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Spawn enemies
    if (state.enemiesKilled < state.totalEnemies) {
      state.spawnTimer -= dt;
      if (state.spawnTimer <= 0 && enemies.length < 5) {
        spawnEnemy();
        state.spawnTimer = 1.1;
      }
    }

    // Enemies
    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const en = enemies[i];
      en.wob += dt * 2;
      en.y += en.vy * dt;
      en.x += Math.sin(en.wob) * en.wobAmp * dt;
      en.x = Math.max(en.w / 2, Math.min(W - en.w / 2, en.x));

      // Enemy firing
      en.fireTimer -= dt;
      if (en.fireTimer <= 0 && en.y > 0) {
        const dx = player.x - en.x;
        const dy = player.y - en.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        bullets.push({ x: en.x, y: en.y + en.h / 2, vx: (dx / d) * 260, vy: (dy / d) * 260, r: 5, enemy: true });
        en.fireTimer = 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
      }

      // Reached bottom -> damage and remove
      if (en.y > H + 20) {
        player.hp -= 25;
        state.shake = 12;
        addParticles(en.x, H, "#ff5a5a", 14, 160);
        enemies.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
    }

    // Bullet vs enemy collisions
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      if (b.enemy) continue;
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const en = enemies[j];
        if (Math.abs(b.x - en.x) < en.w / 2 + b.r &&
            Math.abs(b.y - en.y) < en.h / 2 + b.r) {
          en.hp -= 1;
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          addParticles(b.x, b.y, "#ffd24a", 8, 150);
          if (en.hp <= 0) {
            enemies.splice(j, 1);
            state.enemiesKilled += 1;
            state.score += 100;
            state.shake = 8;
            addParticles(en.x, en.y, "#ff7a3c", 22, 220);
          }
          break;

      }
    }

    // Enemy bullets vs player
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];

          Math.abs(b.y - player.y) < player.h / 2 + b.r) {
        player.hp -= 12;
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        state.shake = 10;
        addParticles(player.x, player.y, "#ff5a5a", 14, 180);

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 60 * dt;
      p.life -= dt * 1.6;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);

    for (const s of stars) {
      s.y += s.spd * dt;
      s.tw += dt * 3;
      if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }

    // Shake decay
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 40);

    // Win / lose
    if (player.hp <= 0) {
      player.hp = 0;
      state.lost = true;
      state.running = false;
    }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);

      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, a));

  }

    ctx.lineTo(x - player.w / 2 + 8, y + player.h / 2 + 4);

    ctx.arc(x, y - 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawEnemy(en) {
    const x = en.x, y = en.y;
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c0392b";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + en.h / 2);

    ctx.fillRect(x - en.w / 2 + 4, y - en.h / 2, en.w - 8, 8);

  }

  function drawBullets() {
    for (const b of bullets) {
      if (b.enemy) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8a3c";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,226,122,0.4)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHealthBar() {
    const bw = 240;
    const bh = 20;
    const bx = W / 2 - bw / 2;
    const by = 18;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2a2a";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    const pct = Math.max(0, player.hp / player.maxHp);
    const col = pct > 0.5 ? "#4cd964" : pct > 0.25 ? "#ffd24a" : "#ff5a5a";
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * pct, bh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 13px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("HULL " + Math.ceil(player.hp) + "%", W / 2, by + bh + 18);
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    drawHealthBar();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + state.score, 20, 34);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("KILLS  " + state.enemiesKilled + " / " + state.totalEnemies, W - 20, 34);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.65)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 56px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "20px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fd0ff";
    ctx.font = "16px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Press ENTER to play", W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake);
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawParticles();
    drawBullets();
    for (const en of enemies) drawEnemy(en);
    if (!state.lost) drawPlayer();
    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if (!state.running && !state.won && !state.lost) {
      drawOverlay("STARFALL", "WASD / Arrows to move  ·  SPACE to shoot  ·  Clear " + state.totalEnemies + " raiders", "#7fd0ff");
    } else if (state.won) {
      drawOverlay("VICTORY", "All raiders destroyed  ·  Score " + state.score, "#4cd964");
    } else if (state.lost) {
      drawOverlay("SHIP DESTROYED", "You fell to the raiders  ·  Score " + state.score, "#ff5a5a");
    }
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pyramid Stacker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0a1420;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,200,90,0.15);
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="900"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ----------------------------- setup & constants ----------------------------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const GROUND_Y = 810;
const BASE_W = 250;
const BRICK_H = 30;
const MAX_ROWS = 10;
const SWEEP_SPEED = 2.5;
const BRICK_COLORS = ['#e07a3a','#e8b04b','#d9534f','#5aa9d6','#7ec96a','#c96fb0'];
const STAR_COLORS = ['#ffe08a','#ffd14a','#fff2b0'];

/* ----------------------------- state ----------------------------- */
let state = 'start';       // 'start' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
let bricks = [];           // placed bricks
let current = null;        // the brick being positioned
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let shakeTime = 0;
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let clouds = [];
let winTime = 0;
let loseTime = 0;
let lastTime = 0;
let mouseDown = false;

/* ----------------------------- helpers ----------------------------- */
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

function makeStar() {
  return {
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * (GROUND_Y - 140),
    r: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.6,
    ph: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    sp: 0.6 + Math.random() * 1.8
  };
}
function makeCloud() {
  return {
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: 90 + Math.random() * 200,
    s: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9,
    sp: 6 + Math.random() * 10
  };
}

function targetWidth(row) { return Math.max(56, BASE_W - row * 20); }

function spawnBrick(row) {
  const w = targetWidth(row);
  const left = (W - w) / 2;
  const right = (W + w) / 2;
  const y = GROUND_Y - (row + 1) * BRICK_H;
  return {
    x: left,
    y: y,
    w: w,
    h: BRICK_H,
    minX: left,
    maxX: right,
    dir: 1,
    color: BRICK_COLORS[row % BRICK_COLORS.length]
  };
}

function reset() {
  bricks = [];
  current = spawnBrick(0);
  score = 0;
  particles = [];
  shakeTime = 0;
}

function startGame() {
  reset();
  state = 'playing';
}

/* ----------------------------- particles ----------------------------- */
function spawnBurst(cx, cy, color, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 40 + Math.random() * 220;
    particles.push({
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 60,
      r: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
      life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      max: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      color: color
    });
  }
}
function spawnConfetti() {
  for (let i = 0; i < 140; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: -20 - Math.random() * 300,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80,
      vy: 120 + Math.random() * 180,
      r: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
      life: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
      max: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
      color: STAR_COLORS[i % STAR_COLORS.length]
    });
  }
}

/* ----------------------------- input ----------------------------- */
function placeCurrent() {
  if (state !== 'playing' || !current) return;
  const b = current;
  bricks.push({
    x: b.x, y: b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h,
    color: b.color,
    row: b.row
  });
  score++;
  const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
  spawnBurst(cx, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color, 16);
  if (score >= MAX_ROWS) {
    state = 'won';
    winTime = 0;
    spawnConfetti();
  } else {
    current = spawnBrick(score);
  }
}

function doLose() {
  state = 'lost';
  loseTime = 0;
  if (current) {
    const cx = current.x + current.w / 2;
    spawnBurst(cx, current.y + current.h / 2, '#d9534f', 40);
  }
  best = Math.max(best, score);
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
  mouseDown = true;
  e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { mouseDown = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
  mouseDown = true;
  if (state !== 'playing') startGame();
  else placeCurrent();
  e.preventDefault();
}, { passive: false });
window.addEventListener('touchend', function () { mouseDown = false; });
window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
    if (state === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state === 'playing') placeCurrent();
    else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') startGame();
    e.preventDefault();
  } else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') {
    if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') startGame();
  }
});

/* ----------------------------- update ----------------------------- */
function update(dt) {
  // clouds always drift
  for (const c of clouds) {
    c.x += c.sp * dt;
    if (c.x > W + 120) c.x = -140;
  }

  if (state === 'playing' && current) {
    current.x += current.dir * SWEEP_SPEED;
    if (current.x <= current.minX) { current.x = current.minX; current.dir = 1; }
    else if (current.x >= current.maxX) { current.x = current.maxX; current.dir = -1; }

    if (mouseDown) placeCurrent();
  }

  if (state === 'won') winTime += dt;
  if (state === 'lost') loseTime += dt;
  if (shakeTime > 0) shakeTime -= dt;

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.vy += 320 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ----------------------------- drawing ----------------------------- */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0e1f38');
  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#243c63');
  g.addColorStop(0.8, '#6f5a86');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#b56a58');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  for (const s of stars) {
    const a = 0.35 + 0.4 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * s.sp + s.ph));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2c8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // moon
  const mx = W - 130, my = 120;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f7efd0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(mx, my, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e2d6a8';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx - 14, my - 8, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + 16, my + 12, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + 4, my + 22, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // clouds
  for (const c of clouds) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
    const s = c.s;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, 26 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + 30 * s, c.y + 6 * s, 30 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(c.x + 64 * s, c.y, 24 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,52,84,0.85)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 640);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(180, 560, 360, 640);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(520, 700, 700, 620);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(780, 590, 800, 640);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(58,72,108,0.9)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 700);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(220, 640, 430, 700);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(620, 750, 800, 690);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0, '#5a4636');
  gg.addColorStop(1, '#33271d');
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawBrick(b, alpha) {
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha == null ? 1 : alpha;
  const x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
  const r = 6;

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)';
  roundRect(x + 3, y + 4, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();

  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();

  // top highlight
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + h);
  tg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)');
  tg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
  tg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)');
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  ctx.fill();

  // beveled edge
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  roundRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2, r - 1);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHud() {
  // score panel
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,20,32,0.55)';
  roundRect(20, 20, 240, 84, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,90,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  roundRect(20, 20, 240, 84, 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('HEIGHT', 38, 34);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(score + ' / ' + MAX_ROWS, 38, 58);

  // progress pips
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_ROWS; i++) {
    const px = W - 220 + i * 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < score ? BRICK_COLORS[i % BRICK_COLORS.length] : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, 40, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawStart() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,12,22,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('PYRAMID STACKER', W / 2, 250);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Stack ' + MAX_ROWS + ' bricks to finish the pyramid', W / 2, 320);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe3ff';
  ctx.font = '22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('A brick sweeps back and forth. Time your drop', W / 2, 380);
  ctx.fillText('so it lands inside the safe band below.', W / 2, 412);

  // demo brick
  const demo = { x: W / 2 - 90, y: 480, w: 180, h: 34, color: '#e07a3a' };
  drawBrick(demo);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(126,201,106,0.9)';
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - 60, 560); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 60, 560);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7ec96a';
  ctx.font = '18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('safe landing zone', W / 2, 590);

  // start button
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 400);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,224,138,' + (0.15 + pulse * 0.2) + ')';
  roundRect(W / 2 - 150, 650, 300, 70, 16);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe08a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  roundRect(W / 2 - 150, 650, 300, 70, 16);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE / TAP TO START', W / 2, 685);
}

function drawWon() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,12,22,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 60px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('PYRAMID COMPLETE!', W / 2, 250);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '28px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('You stacked all ' + MAX_ROWS + ' bricks.', W / 2, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe3ff';
  ctx.font = '22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Play again: press SPACE or R', W / 2, 380);
}

function drawLost() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,6,6,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a6b';
  ctx.font = 'bold 56px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('MISSED THE STACK', W / 2, 250);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '28px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('You reached height ' + score + ' of ' + MAX_ROWS + '.', W / 2, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe3ff';
  ctx.font = '22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Try again: press SPACE or R', W / 2, 380);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shakeTime > 0) {
    const m = shakeTime * 14;
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
  }

  drawBackground();

  // placed bricks
  for (const b of bricks) drawBrick(b);

  // current brick + guide
  if (state === 'playing' && current) {
    // support surface
    const supY = GROUND_Y - score * BRICK_H;
    const supW = score === 0 ? BASE_W : (bricks[score - 1] ? bricks[score - 1].w : BASE_W);
    const supX = (W - supW) / 2;

    // safe band
    const b = current;
    const tol = b.w * 0.22;
    const safeL = b.x - tol;
    const safeR = b.x + b.w + tol;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(126,201,106,0.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(safeL, supY - 6, safeR - safeL, BRICK_H + 6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(126,201,106,0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(safeL, supY - 6, safeR - safeL, BRICK_H + 6);

    // drop guide
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(b.x, b.y + b.h);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, supY);
    ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w, supY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    drawBrick(b);
  }

  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();

  if (state === 'playing') drawHud();
  if (state === 'start') drawStart();
  if (state === 'won') drawWon();
  if (state === 'lost') drawLost();
}

/* ----------------------------- init ----------------------------- */
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) stars.push(makeStar());
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) clouds.push(makeCloud());
reset();
state = 'start';

/* ----------------------------- main loop ----------------------------- */
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
  lastTime = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
lastTime = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tower Stack</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0b1020;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #14203a;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="360" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
  // ---- canvas ----
  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = canvas.width;
  var H = canvas.height;

  // ---- config ----
  var BASE_TOP = H - 90;
  var BLOCK_H = 34;
  var START_W = 150;
  var MIN_W = 30;
  var SPEED = 120;
  var COLORS = ['#ff6b6b','#f7c948','#5bd6a9','#4ea1ff','#b07cff','#ff9f43'];

  // ---- state ----
  var state = 'ready';
  var score = 0;
  var best = 0;
  var blocks = [];
  var current = null;
  var cameraY = 0;
  var targetCameraY = 0;
  var stars = [];
  var shake = 0;
  var flash = 0;
  var particles = [];
  var lastTime = 0;

  // ---- helpers ----
  function makeStars() {
    stars = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.4, tw: Math.random() * 6.28 });
    }
  }

  function makeBlock(x, w, y, color) {
    return { x: x, w: w, y: y, color: color };
  }

  function startGame() {
    score = 0;
    blocks = [];
    particles = [];
    cameraY = 0;
    targetCameraY = 0;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
    var base = makeBlock(W / 2, START_W, BASE_TOP, COLORS[0]);
    blocks.push(base);
    spawnNext();
    state = 'play';
  }

  function spawnNext() {
    var top = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
    var w = Math.max(MIN_W, top.w - 4);
    var color = COLORS[(score + 1) % COLORS.length];
    current = {
      x: -w,
      y: top.y - BLOCK_H,
      w: w,
      color: color,
      dir: 1
    };
  }

  function addParticle(x, y, color) {
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120,
      vy: -Math.random() * 120 - 30,
      life: 0.6,
      max: 0.6,
      color: color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }

  function drop() {
    if (state !== 'play' || !current) return;
    var top = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
    var left = Math.max(current.x, top.x);
    var right = Math.min(current.x + current.w, top.x + top.w);
    var overlap = right - left;

    if (overlap <= 0) {
      // missed entirely -> fall
      state = 'fall';
      current.fall = true;
      current.vy = 0;
      shake = 12;
      return;
    }

    score += 1;
    if (score > best) best = score;
    var color = current.color;
    var cx = left + overlap / 2;
    var cy = current.y + BLOCK_H / 2;
    for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) addParticle(cx, cy, color);

    var placed = makeBlock(left, overlap, current.y, color);
    blocks.push(placed);

    // keep the overhanging slice as a falling piece
    if (current.x < left) {
      var s = left - current.x;
      particles.push({ x: current.x + s / 2, y: current.y, vx: -40, vy: 0, life: 1.2, max: 1.2, color: color, size: s, fall: true });
    }
    if (right < current.x + current.w) {
      var s2 = current.x + current.w - right;
      particles.push({ x: right + s2 / 2, y: current.y, vx: 40, vy: 0, life: 1.2, max: 1.2, color: color, size: s2, fall: true });
    }

    // camera rises to keep the top in view
    var topY = placed.y;
    targetCameraY = Math.max(0, (BASE_TOP - BLOCK_H) - topY - 150);

    if (overlap < MIN_W) {
      state = 'fall';
      current.fall = true;
      current.vy = 0;
      shake = 12;
      return;
    }

    spawnNext();
  }

  function endGame() {
    state = 'over';
    flash = 0.4;
    if (score > best) best = score;
  }

  // ---- input ----
  function press() {
    if (state === 'ready') { startGame(); }
    else if (state === 'play') { drop(); }
    else if (state === 'over') { startGame(); }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); press(); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); press(); }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); press(); }
  });

  // ---- update ----
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'play' && current) {
      current.x += SPEED * dt * current.dir;
      if (current.x + current.w > W) { current.x = W; current.dir = -1; }
      else if (current.x < 0) { current.x = 0; current.dir = 1; }
    }

    if (state === 'fall' && current) {
      current.vy += 900 * dt;
      current.y += current.vy * dt;
      if (current.y > H + 200) endGame();
    }

    // camera eases toward target
    cameraY += (targetCameraY - cameraY) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);

    // decay shake + flash
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);

    // particles
    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.fall) {
        p.vy += 900 * dt;
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
      } else {
        p.vy += 400 * dt;
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        p.y += p.vy * dt;
      }
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---- draw ----
  function drawBackground() {
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b1020');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#14203a');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1e3357');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      var s = stars[i];
      var a = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.001 + s.tw));
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe3ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 6.283);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f4ecd0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 60, 70, 26, 0, 6.283);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,32,58,0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 52, 62, 22, 0, 6.283);
    ctx.fill();

    // distant hills
    ctx.fillStyle = '#22375f';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H - 130);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.3, H - 210, W * 0.55, H - 150);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.8, H - 90, W, H - 160);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2c4675';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H - 80);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.4, H - 150, W * 0.7, H - 90);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.9, H - 50, W, H - 100);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBlock(b, oy) {
    var y = b.y + oy;
    var h = BLOCK_H;
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    roundRect(b.x, y, b.w, h, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    // top highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    roundRect(b.x, y, b.w, 7, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    // bottom shade
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, y + h - 6, b.w, 6);
    // left edge light
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, y, 4, h);
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawGuide() {
    if (!current) return;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(current.x, current.y + BLOCK_H);
    ctx.lineTo(current.x, H);
    ctx.moveTo(current.x + current.w, current.y + BLOCK_H);
    ctx.lineTo(current.x + current.w, H);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      var p = particles[i];
      var a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      if (p.fall) {
        ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y, p.size, BLOCK_H);
      } else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, 6.283);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 20, 18);
    ctx.font = '13px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.fillText('BEST  ' + best, 20, 58);
  }

  function centerText(text, y, size, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + size + 'px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
  }

  function drawReady() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    centerText('TOWER STACK', H * 0.32, 40, '#ffffff');
    centerText('Drop blocks to build the tallest tower', H * 0.45, 15, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)');
    centerText('Keep the overlap alive — trim it each drop', H * 0.52, 14, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)');
    centerText('TAP  /  SPACE  to start', H * 0.68, 18, '#f7c948');
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    centerText('TOWER FELL', H * 0.34, 40, '#ff6b6b');
    centerText('Score  ' + score, H * 0.46, 26, '#ffffff');
    centerText('Best  ' + best, H * 0.53, 16, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)');
    centerText('TAP  /  SPACE  to play again', H * 0.68, 18, '#f7c948');
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    var ox = 0, oy = cameraY;
    if (shake > 0) {
      ox = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
      oy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);
    for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) drawBlock(blocks[i], 0);
    if (current) drawBlock(current, 0);
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();

    if (state === 'play') drawGuide();
    drawHUD();

    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,80,80,' + (flash * 0.4) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    if (state === 'ready') drawReady();
    if (state === 'over') drawOver();
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function loop(t) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
    var dt = (t - lastTime) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    lastTime = t;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  makeStars();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Star Catcher</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a1f;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', Verdana, sans-serif;
  }
  #gameCanvas { display: block; cursor: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---------- Canvas setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Game state ----------
  const GAME = {
    running: false,
    paused: false,
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    time: 0,
    best: 0,
    combo: 0
  };

  // ---------- Player (catcher) ----------
  const player = {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    w: 70,
    h: 50,
    speed: 420
  };

  // ---------- Star array ----------
  const stars = [];

  // ---------- Particle array (for catch/miss effects) ----------
  const particles = [];

  // ---------- Background stars ----------
  const bgStars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    bgStars.push({
      x: Math.random(),
      y: Math.random(),
      r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
      twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  // ---------- Input state ----------
  const keys = {
    left: false,
    right: false
  };
  let mouseX = W / 2;
  let useMouse = false;

  // ---------- Spawn timer ----------
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 1.2;

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const STAR_SPEED_BASE = 120;
  const STAR_SPEED_VAR = 60;
  const STAR_SIZE_MIN = 14;
  const STAR_SIZE_MAX = 28;
  const PARTICLE_LIFE = 0.8;
  const COMBO_TIMEOUT = 2.0;
  const STAR_COLORS = ['#FFD700', '#FFA500', '#FF69B4', '#00BFFF', '#90EE90', '#E8B4FF'];
  const RARE_COLOR = '#FF1493';
  const RARE_CHANCE = 0.1;

  // ---------- Utility ----------
  function rand(min, max) {
    return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
  }

  function randInt(min, max) {
    return Math.floor(rand(min, max + 1));
  }

  function lerp(a, b, t) {
    return a + (b - a) * t;
  }

  // ---------- Star factory ----------
  function createStar() {
    const size = rand(STAR_SIZE_MIN, STAR_SIZE_MAX);
    const isRare = Math.random() < RARE_CHANCE;
    const speed = STAR_SPEED_BASE + rand(0, STAR_SPEED_VAR) + GAME.time * 2;
    return {
      x: rand(40, W - 40),
      y: -size,
      size: size,
      speed: speed,
      color: isRare ? RARE_COLOR : STAR_COLORS[randInt(0, STAR_COLORS.length - 1)],
      rotation: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      rotSpeed: rand(-2, 2),
      wobblePhase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      wobbleAmp: rand(10, 30),
      isRare: isRare,
      points: isRare ? 50 : 10
    };
  }

  // ---------- Particle factory ----------
  function createParticle(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const speed = rand(50, 200);
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 50,
        size: rand(2, 6),
        color: color,
        life: PARTICLE_LIFE,
        maxLife: PARTICLE_LIFE
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Reset game ----------
  function resetGame() {
    GAME.running = true;
    GAME.paused = false;
    GAME.score = 0;
    GAME.lives = 3;
    GAME.time = 0;
    GAME.combo = 0;
    stars.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = 1.2;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - 80;
  }

  // ---------- Input: keyboard ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') {
      keys.left = true;
      useMouse = false;
    }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') {
      keys.right = true;
      useMouse = false;
    }
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (!GAME.running) {
        resetGame();
      } else if (GAME.paused) {
        GAME.paused = false;
      }
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && GAME.running) {
      GAME.paused = !GAME.paused;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') {
      keys.left = false;
    }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') {
      keys.right = false;
    }
  });

  // ---------- Input: mouse / touch ----------
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    useMouse = true;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
      mouseX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      useMouse = true;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!GAME.running) {
      resetGame();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    if (!GAME.running) {
      resetGame();
    }
    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
      mouseX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      useMouse = true;
    }
  });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (!GAME.running || GAME.paused) return;

    GAME.time += dt;

    // Difficulty scaling
    spawnInterval = Math.max(0.4, 1.2 - GAME.time * 0.01);

    // Player movement
    if (useMouse) {
      const targetX = mouseX;
      player.x = lerp(player.x, targetX, 0.15);
    } else {
      if (keys.left) player.x -= player.speed * dt;
      if (keys.right) player.x += player.speed * dt;
    }
    player.x = Math.max(player.w / 2, Math.min(W - player.w / 2, player.x));
    player.y = H - 80;

    // Spawn stars
    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      stars.push(createStar());
      // Occasionally spawn two at once later on
      if (GAME.time > 20 && Math.random() < 0.3) {
        stars.push(createStar());
      }
    }

    // Update stars
    for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = stars[i];
      s.y += s.speed * dt;
      s.rotation += s.rotSpeed * dt;
      s.wobblePhase += dt * 3;
      const wobbleX = Math.sin(s.wobblePhase) * s.wobbleAmp;

      // Check catch
      const dx = (s.x + wobbleX) - player.x;
      const dy = s.y - player.y;
      const catchDist = s.size + player.w / 2;

      if (dy > -player.h && dy < player.h && Math.abs(dx) < catchDist) {
        // Caught!
        GAME.combo++;
        const comboMultiplier = 1 + Math.floor(GAME.combo / 5) * 0.5;
        GAME.score += Math.floor(s.points * comboMultiplier);
        createParticle(s.x + wobbleX, s.y, s.color, s.isRare ? 20 : 12);
        stars.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      // Missed
      if (s.y > H + s.size) {
        GAME.lives--;
        GAME.combo = 0;
        createParticle(s.x, H - 20, '#FF4444', 8);
        stars.splice(i, 1);

        if (GAME.lives <= 0) {
          GAME.running = false;
          if (GAME.score > GAME.best) GAME.best = GAME.score;
        }
      }
    }

    // Combo timeout
    // (simplified: combo resets on miss, grows on catch)

    // Update particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 300 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: background ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // Night sky gradient
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a4e');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3e');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Twinkling background stars
    const t = performance.now() * 0.001;
    for (let i = 0; i < bgStars.length; i++) {
      const bs = bgStars[i];
      const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 1.5 + bs.twinkle));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + alpha + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bs.x * W, bs.y * H, bs.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Ground / horizon
    const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 60, 0, H);
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40, 20, 80, 0)');
    groundGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40, 20, 80, 0.6)');
    ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 60, W, 60);
  }

  // ---------- Draw: star shape ----------
  function drawStar(cx, cy, size, color, rotation, isRare) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(rotation);

    // Glow
    if (isRare) {
      ctx.shadowColor = color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    } else {
      ctx.shadowColor = color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    }

    // 5-pointed star
    ctx.beginPath();
    const outerR = size;
    const innerR = size * 0.4;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outerR : innerR;
      const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * r;
      const y = Math.sin(angle) * r;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner highlight
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const r = (i % 2 === 0 ? outerR : innerR) * 0.6;
      const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * r;
      const y = Math.sin(angle) * r;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: player (catcher) ----------
  function drawPlayer() {
    const px = player.x;
    const py = player.y;
    const pw = player.w;
    const ph = player.h;

    ctx.save();

    // Basket / catcher shape
    // Body (trapezoid)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px - pw / 2, py + ph / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(px - pw / 2 + 8, py - ph / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(px + pw / 2 - 8, py - ph / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(px + pw / 2, py + ph / 2);
    ctx.closePath();

    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(px - pw / 2, py, px + pw / 2, py);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90d9');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#5cb8ff');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4a90d9');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a6090';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Rim (top edge)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px - pw / 2 + 8, py - ph / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(px + pw / 2 - 8, py - ph / 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#80d0ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Shine line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px - pw / 4, py - ph / 4);
    ctx.lineTo(px - pw / 4, py + ph / 4);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: particles ----------
  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ---------- Draw: HUD ----------
  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();

    // Score
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + GAME.score, 20, 40);

    // Best
    ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + GAME.best, 20, 62);

    // Lives (star icons)
    for (let i = 0; i < GAME.lives; i++) {
      drawStar(W - 40 - i * 30, 30, 10, '#FF69B4', 0, false);
    }

    // Combo
    if (GAME.combo >= 3) {
      ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#00BFFF';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('x' + (1 + Math.floor(GAME.combo / 5) * 0.5) + ' combo!', W / 2, 40);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: start screen ----------
  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.save();

    // Dim overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    // Title
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#FFD700';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillText('Star Catcher', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText('Catch the falling stars!', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);

    // Controls
    ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / A D / Mouse to move', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    ctx.fillText('Miss 3 stars and you lose', W / 2, H / 2 + 55);

    // Start prompt
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.004);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: game over ----------
  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.save();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF69B4';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#FF69B4';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + GAME.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

    ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + GAME.best, W / 2, H / 2 + 45);

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.004);
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: pause ----------
  function drawPause() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Paused', W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.font = '18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText('Press Escape to resume', W / 2, H / 2 + 35);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Main draw ----------
  function draw() {
    drawBackground();

    if (GAME.running) {
      // Draw stars
      for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
        const s = stars[i];
        const wobbleX = Math.sin(s.wobblePhase) * s.wobbleAmp;
        drawStar(s.x + wobbleX, s.y, s.size, s.color, s.rotation, s.isRare);
      }

      drawPlayer();
      drawParticles();
      drawHUD();

      if (GAME.paused) {
        drawPause();
      }
    } else {
      // Still draw some ambient stars for the start screen
      const t = performance.now() * 0.001;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const sx = W * 0.2 + i * W * 0.15;
        const sy = H * 0.3 + Math.sin(t + i) * 20;
        drawStar(sx, sy, 18, STAR_COLORS[i % STAR_COLORS.length], t * 0.5 + i, false);
      }

      if (GAME.lives <= 0 && GAME.score > 0) {
        drawGameOver();
      } else {
        drawStartScreen();
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Game loop ----------
  let lastTime = 0;

  function loop(timestamp) {
    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let dartsLeft = 3;
  let aimAngle = 0;
  let power = 0;
  let charging = false;
  let mouseX = W / 2;
  let mouseY = H / 2;

  // ── Darts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const darts = [];

  class Dart {
    constructor(x, y, vx, vy) {
      this.x = x;
      this.y = y;
      this.vx = vx;
      this.vy = vy;
      this.stuck = false;
      this.stuckX = 0;
      this.stuckY = 0;
      this.score = 0;
      this.age = 0;
    }
  }

  // ── Board geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function boardCenter() { return { x: W / 2, y: H * 0.42 }; }
  function boardRadius() { return Math.min(W, H) * 0.30; }

  // ── Score zones ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function getScoreZone(dart) {
    const bc = boardCenter();
    const r = boardRadius();
    const dx = dart.x - bc.x;
    const dy = dart.y - bc.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist > r) return 0;

    const bullR = r * 0.08;
    const bullOuterR = r * 0.18;
    if (dist <= bullR) return 50;
    if (dist <= bullOuterR) return 25;

    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    const ring = Math.floor(dist / (r * 0.08));
    const sector = Math.floor(((angle + Math.PI) / (2 * Math.PI)) * 20);
    const ringVal = 10 - ring;
    const sectorVal = 1 + (sector % 10);
    return ringVal * sectorVal;
  }

  // ── Input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    if (state === 'start') {
      state = 'playing';
      score = 0;
      dartsLeft = 3;
      darts.length = 0;
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'over') {
      state = 'start';
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'playing' && dartsLeft > 0) {
      charging = true;
      power = 0;
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function () {
    if (state === 'playing' && charging && dartsLeft > 0) {
      throwDart();
      charging = false;
      power = 0;
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = t.clientX - rect.left;
    mouseY = t.clientY - rect.top;
    if (state === 'start') {
      state = 'playing';
      score = 0;
      dartsLeft = 3;
      darts.length = 0;
    } else if (state === 'over') {
      state = 'start';
    } else if (state === 'playing' && dartsLeft > 0) {
      charging = true;
      power = 0;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = t.clientX - rect.left;
    mouseY = t.clientY - rect.top;
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'playing' && charging && dartsLeft > 0) {
      throwDart();
      charging = false;
      power = 0;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // ── Throw logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function throwDart() {
    const bc = boardCenter();
    const r = boardRadius();
    const dx = mouseX - bc.x;
    const dy = mouseY - bc.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    const speed = 8 + power * 12;
    const normX = dist > 0 ? dx / dist : 0;
    const normY = dist > 0 ? dy / dist : 0;

    const startX = W / 2;
    const startY = H - 60;

    const dart = new Dart(
      startX,
      startY,
      normX * speed,
      normY * speed - 3
    );
    darts.push(dart);
    dartsLeft--;
  }

  // ── Update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'playing' && charging) {
      power = Math.min(1, power + dt * 1.2);
    }

    const bc = boardCenter();
    const r = boardRadius();

    for (let i = 0; i < darts.length; i++) {
      const d = darts[i];
      if (d.stuck) continue;
      d.age += dt;

      d.x += d.vx;
      d.y += d.vy;
      d.vy += 0.3;

      const dx = d.x - bc.x;
      const dy = d.y - bc.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      if (dist <= r) {
        d.stuck = true;
        d.stuckX = d.x;
        d.stuckY = d.y;
        d.score = getScoreZone(d);
        score += d.score;
        if (dartsLeft === 0) {
          setTimeout(function () { state = 'over'; }, 800);
        }
      }

      if (d.y > H + 50 || d.x < -50 || d.x > W + 50) {
        d.stuck = true;
        d.score = 0;
        if (dartsLeft === 0) {
          setTimeout(function () { state = 'over'; }, 800);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Draw helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#2d1810');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a0f0a');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#0d0705');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // wooden floor
    const floorY = H * 0.75;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3d2010';
    ctx.fillRect(0, floorY, W, H - floorY);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const y = floorY + i * ((H - floorY) / 8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // wall texture lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,30,15,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const y = i * (floorY / 6);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawBoard() {
    const bc = boardCenter();
    const r = boardRadius();

    // outer ring shadow
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fill();

    // wooden outer ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3018';
    ctx.fill();

    // black outer ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fill();

    // 20 sectors
    const sectorCount = 20;
    const sectorAngle = (2 * Math.PI) / sectorCount;

    for (let s = 0; s < sectorCount; s++) {
      const startA = s * sectorAngle - Math.PI / 2;
      const endA = (s + 1) * sectorAngle - Math.PI / 2;

      // 4 rings per sector: outer (10), middle (20), inner (30), bull area
      const rings = [
        { inner: r * 0.18, outer: r, val: 10 },
        { inner: r * 0.30, outer: r * 0.42, val: 20 },
        { inner: r * 0.42, outer: r * 0.54, val: 30 },
        { inner: r * 0.54, outer: r * 0.66, val: 40 }

      for (let ri = 0; ri < rings.length; ri++) {
        const ring = rings[ri];
        const isEven = (s + ri) % 2 === 0;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, ring.outer, startA, endA);
        ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, ring.inner, endA, startA, true);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = isEven ? '#c0392b' : '#1a1a1a';
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // double ring (outer)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fill();

    // triple ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.34, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fill();

    // inner ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.46, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fill();

    // outermost ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.54, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.58, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fill();

    // bull outer (25)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#27ae60';
    ctx.fill();

    // bull inner (50)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bc.x, bc.y, r * 0.08, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.fill();

    // sector numbers
    const numbers = [20, 1, 18, 4, 13, 6, 10, 15, 2, 17, 3, 19, 7, 16, 8, 11, 14, 9, 12, 5];
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(10, r * 0.05) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (let s = 0; s < sectorCount; s++) {
      const midA = (s + 0.5) * sectorAngle - Math.PI / 2;
      const numR = r * 0.62;
      const nx = bc.x + Math.cos(midA) * numR;
      const ny = bc.y + Math.sin(midA) * numR;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillText(numbers[s], nx, ny);
    }

    // board label
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.font = Math.max(12, r * 0.04) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('DARTBOARD', bc.x, bc.y + r + 25);
  }

  function drawDart(d) {
    if (d.stuck) {
      // stuck dart: small circle with needle
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.stuckX, d.stuckY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      // score popup
      if (d.score > 0) {
        const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - d.age * 0.5);
        if (alpha > 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + alpha + ')';
          ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(14, boardRadius() * 0.08) + 'px Arial';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('+' + d.score, d.stuckX, d.stuckY - 20 - d.age * 30);
        }
      }
    } else {
      // flying dart
      const angle = Math.atan2(d.vy, d.vx);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(d.x, d.y);
      ctx.rotate(angle);

      // dart body
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(-12, -3, 20, 6);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(18, -2);
      ctx.lineTo(18, 2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#bdc3c7';
      ctx.fill();

      // dart tail
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
      ctx.fillRect(-14, -4, 4, 8);

      ctx.restore();

  function drawAimIndicator() {
    if (state !== 'playing' || dartsLeft <= 0) return;

    const bc = boardCenter();
    const r = boardRadius();
    const dx = mouseX - bc.x;
    const dy = mouseY - bc.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const normX = dist > 0 ? dx / dist : 0;
    const normY = dist > 0 ? dy / dist : 0;

    // aim line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([8, 8]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, H - 60);
    ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + normX * 200, H - 60 + normY * 200);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // crosshair at mouse
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouseX, mouseY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX - 20, mouseY);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX + 20, mouseY);
    ctx.moveTo(mouseX, mouseY - 20);
    ctx.lineTo(mouseX, mouseY + 20);

    const barY = H - 30;
    const barW = 120;
    const barH = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
    const pw = barW * power;
    const pGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
    pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2ecc71');
    pGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#f1c40f');
    pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e74c3c');
    ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, pw, barH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
