    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Darts: ' + dartsLeft, 20, 30);

    // score
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W - 20, 30);
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(36, W * 0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('DART THROW', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = Math.max(16, W * 0.02) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Aim with your mouse, click and hold to charge, release to throw', W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillText('3 darts per round. Hit the bull for 50 points!', W / 2, H * 0.52);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(20, W * 0.025) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Start', W / 2, H * 0.65);
  }

  function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(36, W * 0.05) + 'px Georgia';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = Math.max(24, W * 0.03) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H * 0.45);

    let msg = '';
    if (score >= 150) msg = 'Incredible! You are a dart master!';
    else if (score >= 100) msg = 'Great game! Well thrown!';
    else if (score >= 50) msg = 'Not bad. Keep practicing!';
    else msg = 'Tough round. Try again!';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
    ctx.font = Math.max(18, W * 0.02) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, H * 0.55);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(20, W * 0.025) + 'px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', W / 2, H * 0.70);
  }

  // ── Draw ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBackground();
    drawBoard();

    for (let i = 0; i < darts.length; i++) {
      drawDart(darts[i]);
    }

    drawAimIndicator();

    if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
    if (state === 'over') drawGameOver();
  }

  // ── Game loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let lastTime = 0;

  function loop(timestamp) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = timestamp;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(function (ts) {
    lastTime = ts;
    loop(ts);
  });

})();

<!DOCTYPE html>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
  function resize(){
    dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + "px"; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  const rand = (a,b)=> a + Math.random()*(b-a);
  const clamp = (v,a,b)=> v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);
  const lerp = (a,b,t)=> a+(b-a)*t;
  function fmt(n){
    const neg = n<0; n = Math.abs(n);
    if(n>=1e6) return (neg?"-":"") + (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+"M";
    if(n>=1e3) return (neg?"-":"") + (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"k";
    return (neg?"-":"") + n.toFixed(0);
  }
  function fmtMoney(n){
    const neg = n<0; n = Math.abs(n);
    return (neg?"-":"") + "$" + (n>=1e6 ? (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+"M" : n.toLocaleString("en-US",{maximumFractionDigits:0}));
  }
  function fmtPct(n){
    return (n>=0?"+":"") + n.toFixed(2) + "%";
  }
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    r = Math.min(r, w/2, h/2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const START_CASH = 100000;
  const GOAL = 500000;
  const TICKS_PER_DAY = 120;
  const DAY_MS = 20000;
  const UP = "#33d17a", DOWN = "#ff5a5a", ACCENT = "#38bdf8", TEXT = "#e6edf3", MUTED = "#8b949e", BG = "#0d1117", PANEL = "#161b22", GRID = "#21262d";

  // ---------- State ----------
  const state = {
    mode: "start",
    cash: START_CASH,
    shares: 0,
    avgCost: 0,
    price: 100,
    prevPrice: 100,
    day: 1,
    tick: 0,
    t: 0,
    history: [],
    peak: START_CASH,
    news: [],
    newsTimer: 0,
    flash: 0,
    flashColor: UP,
    toast: "",
    toastTimer: 0,
    shake: 0,
    vol: 0.6
  };

  // ---------- News templates ----------
  const GOOD = [
    "Breakthrough product launches to rave reviews",
    "Analysts raise price target; strong earnings",
    "Major partnership announced with top firm",
    "Dividend surprise delights shareholders",
    "New CEO announces bold growth plan",
    "Buyback program boosts investor confidence"
  ];
  const BAD = [
    "Regulatory probe raises uncertainty",
    "Product recall hits the bottom line",
    "Key executive departs abruptly",
    "Supply chain disruption slows production",
    "Lawsuit filed over safety concerns",
    "Guidance cut; margins under pressure"
  ];
  const NEUTRAL = [
    "Quarterly report released; numbers in line",
    "Market holds steady on mixed signals",
    "No major headlines; trading range-bound",
    "Analysts split on valuation",
    "New product in development, no date yet",
    "Earnings call scheduled next week"
  ];

  // ---------- Level (short loop) ----------
  function makeNews(){
    const r = Math.random();
    let type, text, impact;
    if(r < 0.34){ type="good"; text = GOOD[(Math.random()*GOOD.length)|0]; impact = rand(0.02,0.055); }
    else if(r < 0.68){ type="bad"; text = BAD[(Math.random()*BAD.length)|0]; impact = rand(0.02,0.055); }
    else { type="neutral"; text = NEUTRAL[(Math.random()*NEUTRAL.length)|0]; impact = rand(-0.008,0.008); }
    state.news.push({type, text, impact, age:0, life:6});
    if(state.news.length > 4) state.news.shift();
  }

  function reset(){
    state.cash = START_CASH;
    state.shares = 0;
    state.avgCost = 0;
    state.price = 100;
    state.prevPrice = 100;
    state.day = 1;
    state.tick = 0;
    state.t = 0;
    state.history = [];
    state.peak = START_CASH;
    state.news = [];
    state.newsTimer = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
    state.toast = "";
    state.toastTimer = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.vol = 0.6;
    // seed initial history
    let p = 100;
    for(let i=0;i<120;i++){ p *= (1 + rand(-0.004,0.004)); state.history.push(p); }
    state.price = p; state.prevPrice = p;
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if(state.mode === "start"){
      if(k === "enter" || k === " "){ e.preventDefault(); startGame(); }
      return;
    }
    if(state.mode === "over"){
      if(k === "enter" || k === " "){ e.preventDefault(); reset(); state.mode = "play"; }
      return;
    }
    if(k === "a"){ buy(100); }
    else if(k === "s"){ sell(100); }
    else if(k === "w"){ buy(500); }
    else if(k === "z"){ sell(500); }
    else if(k === "d"){ buy(Math.floor(state.cash/state.price)); }
    else if(k === "f"){ sell(state.shares); }
    else if(k === "r"){ reset(); state.mode = "play"; }
    else if(k === "m" || k === "p"){
      state.mode = (state.mode === "play") ? "pause" : "play";
    }
    keys[k] = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("click", e=>{
    if(state.mode === "start"){ startGame(); }
    else if(state.mode === "over"){ reset(); state.mode = "play"; }
  });

  function startGame(){ reset(); state.mode = "play"; }

  function buy(n){
    if(state.mode !== "play") return;
    n = Math.floor(n);
    if(n <= 0) return;
    const max = Math.floor(state.cash / state.price);
    n = Math.min(n, max);
    if(n <= 0){ state.toast = "Not enough cash"; state.toastTimer = 1.4; return; }
    const cost = n * state.price;
    state.cash -= cost;
    state.shares += n;
    state.avgCost = (state.avgCost * (state.shares - n) + cost) / state.shares;
    state.flash = 1; state.flashColor = UP; state.shake = 4;
    state.toast = "Bought " + n + " @ " + state.price.toFixed(2);
    state.toastTimer = 1.4;
  }
  function sell(n){
    if(state.mode !== "play") return;
    n = Math.floor(n);
    if(n <= 0) return;
    n = Math.min(n, state.shares);
    if(n <= 0){ state.toast = "No shares to sell"; state.toastTimer = 1.4; return; }
    const gain = n * state.price;
    state.cash += gain;
    state.shares -= n;
    state.flash = 1; state.flashColor = DOWN; state.shake = 4;
    state.toast = "Sold " + n + " @ " + state.price.toFixed(2);
    state.toastTimer = 1.4;

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if(state.mode !== "play") return;
    state.t += dt;

    // price random walk with news impact
    const drift = 0.00005;
    const noise = (Math.random()-0.5) * 0.006 * state.vol;

    if(state.newsTimer <= 0){ makeNews(); state.newsTimer = rand(3,7); }

    const total = state.cash + state.shares * state.price;
    state.peak = Math.max(state.peak, total);

    else if(state.cash < 100 && state.shares === 0){ state.mode = "lose"; }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);

    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

  function drawChart(){
    const pad = 20;
    const chartW = W - pad*2;
    const chartH = H*0.42;
    const top = pad + 40;

    const data = state.history;

    let mn = Infinity, mx = -Infinity;
    for(const v of data){ if(v<mn) mn=v; if(v>mx) mx=v; }
    const range = (mx-mn) || 1;
    mn -= range*0.1; mx += range*0.1;

    const xAt = i => pad + (i/(data.length-1))*chartW;

  function drawPanel(x, y, w, h, title){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(22,27,34,0.72)";

  }

  function drawCash(){
    const x = 30 + (W-50)/2, y = H*0.42 + 60, w = (W-50)/2, h = H*0.34;
    drawPanel(x, y, w, h, "CASH & PORTFOLIO");

    const total = state.cash + state.shares*state.price;

    ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
    ctx.font = "12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;

    ctx.fillText(fmtMoney(total), cx+90, y+80);

    // progress to goal
    ctx.font = "12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;
    ctx.fillText("Goal: " + fmtMoney(GOAL), cx, y+118);
    const bw = w*0.7, bh = 14, bx = cx-bw/2, by = y+130;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(49,64,84,0.6)"; rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 7); ctx.fill();
    const pct = clamp(total/GOAL, 0, 1);
    const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx,0,bx+bw,0);
    pg.addColorStop(0, "#38bdf8"); pg.addColorStop(1, "#33d17a");
    ctx.fillStyle = pg; rr(bx, by, bw*pct, bh, 7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.font = "bold 13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = TEXT;
    ctx.fillText((pct*100).toFixed(0) + "%", cx, by+bh+18);
  }

  function drawNews(){
    const x = 20, y = H*0.42 + 60 + H*0.34 + 14, w = W-40, h = H - y - 130;
    if(h < 60) return;
    drawPanel(x, y, w, h, "MARKET NEWS");
    let yy = y + 40;
    ctx.textAlign="left"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    for(const n of state.news){
      const alpha = clamp(1 - (n.age/n.life), 0, 1);
      const col = n.type==="good"?UP : n.type==="bad"?DOWN : ACCENT;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      // dot
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+22, yy, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fill();
      ctx.font = "13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = TEXT;
      ctx.fillText(n.text, x+40, yy);
      // impact tag
      const tag = n.type==="good" ? "▲" : n.type==="bad" ? "▼" : "•";
      ctx.font = "bold 13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = col;
      ctx.textAlign="right";
      ctx.fillText(tag, x+w-18, yy);
      ctx.textAlign="left";
      yy += 22;
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawButtons(){
    const y = H - 96, bh = 54, gap = 12;
    const bw = (W - 40 - gap*3) / 4;
    const items = [
      {k:"A", label:"BUY 100", sub:"+100", color:UP, act:()=>buy(100)},
      {k:"S", label:"SELL 100", sub:"-100", color:DOWN, act:()=>sell(100)},
      {k:"D", label:"BUY MAX", sub:"all cash", color:UP, act:()=>buy(Math.floor(state.cash/state.price))},
      {k:"F", label:"SELL ALL", sub:"all shares", color:DOWN, act:()=>sell(state.shares)}
    ];
    items.forEach((it,i)=>{
      const x = 20 + i*(bw+gap);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(22,27,34,0.85)";
      rr(x, y, bw, bh, 10); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = it.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      // key badge
      ctx.fillStyle = it.color; rr(x+12, y+12, 30, 30, 6); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0d1117"; ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
      ctx.fillText(it.k, x+27, y+28);
      ctx.fillStyle = TEXT; ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign="left";
      ctx.fillText(it.label, x+54, y+20);
      ctx.fillStyle = MUTED; ctx.font = "11px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(it.sub, x+54, y+38);
      // store clickable
      it._x=x; it._y=y; it._w=bw; it._h=bh;
    });
    buttons = items;
  }
  let buttons = [];
  canvas.addEventListener("click", e=>{
    if(state.mode !== "play") return;
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top;
    for(const b of buttons){
      if(mx>=b._x && mx<=b._x+b._w && my>=b._y && my<=b._y+b._h){ b.act(); }
    }
  });

  function drawTopBar(){
    ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
    // left: title
    ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign="left";
    ctx.fillStyle = ACCENT;
    ctx.fillText("◈ MARKET SIM", 20, 30);
    // center: day
    ctx.font = "13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = MUTED; ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText("Day " + state.day, W/2, 30);
    // right: controls hint
    ctx.textAlign="right"; ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;
    ctx.fillText("M: pause   R: reset", W-20, 30);
  }

  function drawToast(){
    if(!state.toast || state.toastTimer<=0) return;
    const alpha = clamp(state.toastTimer/0.4, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.font = "bold 15px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    const w = ctx.measureText(state.toast).width + 40;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(13,17,23,0.9)";
    rr(W/2 - w/2, H-150, w, 34, 8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = state.flashColor; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
    ctx.fillText(state.toast, W/2, H-133);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawFlash(){
    if(state.flash <= 0) return;
    ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.18;
    ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, color, btnText){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,8,12,0.82)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
    // card
    const cw = Math.min(520, W-60), ch = 260;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(22,27,34,0.95)";
    rr(cx-cw/2, cy-ch/2, cw, ch, 16); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy-58);
    ctx.font = "16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = TEXT;
    ctx.fillText(subtitle, cx, cy-8);
    ctx.font = "13px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = MUTED;
    ctx.fillText("You started with " + fmtMoney(START_CASH) + " and aimed for " + fmtMoney(GOAL) + ".", cx, cy+26);
    // button
    const bw=180, bh=46, bx=cx-bw/2, by=cy+54;
    ctx.fillStyle = color; rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0d1117"; ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(btnText, cx, by+bh/2);
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(state.shake > 0){
      ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake, state.shake), rand(-state.shake, state.shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    if(state.mode === "start"){
      drawTopBar();
      drawChart();
      drawHolding();
      drawCash();
      drawNews();
      drawOverlay("MARKET SIM", "Trade virtual shares. Buy low, sell high, and grow your portfolio to $500,000. Don't run out of cash.", ACCENT, "PRESS ENTER TO START");
    } else if(state.mode === "pause"){
      drawTopBar(); drawChart(); drawHolding(); drawCash(); drawNews();
      drawOverlay("PAUSED", "Press M or P to resume.", ACCENT, "RESUME");
    } else if(state.mode === "win"){
      drawTopBar(); drawChart(); drawHolding(); drawCash(); drawNews();
      const total = state.cash + state.shares*state.price;
      drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "You reached " + fmtMoney(total) + " in " + state.day + " days. Time to cash out and enjoy the profits.", UP, "PLAY AGAIN");
    } else if(state.mode === "lose"){
      drawTopBar(); drawChart(); drawHolding(); drawCash(); drawNews();
      drawOverlay("BANKRUPT", "You ran out of cash and hold no shares. The market took you down.", DOWN, "TRY AGAIN");
    } else {
      drawTopBar();
      drawChart();
      drawHolding();
      drawCash();
      drawNews();
      drawButtons();
      drawToast();
      drawFlash();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    let dt = (now - last)/1000;
    last = now;
    if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  reset();
  state.mode = "start";
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pancake Stack</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    background: #1c2230;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    background: #243049;
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="720" height="900"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- constants ----------
  const GRAVITY = 2100;
  const BOUNCE = 0.28;
  const FLOOR_Y = H - 46;
  const PLATE_CX = W / 2;
  const PLATE_TOP = FLOOR_Y - 18;
  const PLATE_W = 300;
  const MIN_W = 44;
  const START_W = 235;
  const START_H = 30;
  const START_Y = 118;
  const SPEED0 = 250;
  const SPEED_MAX = 640;
  const SPEED_INC = 15;
  const WIN_HEIGHT = 12;
  const MAX_BOUNCE = 2;
  const TOL = 6;

  // ---------- state ----------
  const state = {
    mode: "start",
    score: 0,
    best: 0,
    message: "",
    messageTime: 0
  };

  const stack = [];
  const drops = [];
  let current = null;
  let t = 0;
  let last = 0;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function easeInOutCubic(x) {
    return x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2;
  }

  function makePancake() {
    const h = START_H;
    const w = Math.max(MIN_W, START_W - stack.length * 6);
    const x = rand(60, W - 60 - w);
    return { x: x, y: START_Y, w: w, h: h, vx: 0, vy: 0, bounces: 0, landed: false };
  }

  function topOfStack() {
    if (stack.length === 0) return PLATE_TOP;
    return stack[stack.length - 1].y;
  }

  function startGame() {
    stack.length = 0;
    drops.length = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.message = "";
    state.messageTime = 0;
    current = makePancake();
    state.mode = "play";
  }

  function dropCurrent() {
    if (state.mode !== "play" || !current) return;
    current.vy = 0;
    drops.push(current);
    current = makePancake();
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  function onAction() {
    if (state.mode === "start") { startGame(); }
    else if (state.mode === "play") { dropCurrent(); }
    else if (state.mode === "over") { startGame(); }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", onAction);
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onAction(); }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "KeyD") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onAction();
    }
  });

  // ---------- physics ----------
  function updatePancake(p, dt) {
    p.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;

    const top = topOfStack();
    if (p.y + p.h >= top) {
      const center = p.x + p.w / 2;
      const offset = Math.abs(center - PLATE_CX);
      if (offset <= PLATE_W / 2 + TOL) {
        p.y = top - p.h;
        if (p.vy > 0) {
          p.vy = -p.vy * BOUNCE;
          if (Math.abs(p.vy) < 45) {
            p.vy = 0;
            p.landed = true;
            stack.push(p);
            state.score++;
            if (state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
            if (state.score >= WIN_HEIGHT) {
              state.mode = "over";
              state.message = "YOU WIN!";
              state.messageTime = 0;
            }
          } else {
            p.bounces++;
          }
        }
      } else {
        p.y = FLOOR_Y - p.h;
        if (p.vy > 0) {
          p.vy = -p.vy * BOUNCE;
          if (Math.abs(p.vy) < 45) {
            p.vy = 0;
            p.landed = true;
            drops.push(p);
            state.mode = "over";
            state.message = "MISSED!";
            state.messageTime = 0;
          } else {
            p.bounces++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (p.y + p.h >= H + 60) {
      drops.push(p);
      state.mode = "over";
      state.message = "MISSED!";
      state.messageTime = 0;
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    t += dt;
    if (state.messageTime > 0) state.messageTime += dt;

    if (state.mode === "play") {
      const speed = Math.min(SPEED_MAX, SPEED0 + state.score * SPEED_INC);
      const period = (W - 120) / speed;
      const prog = (t % period) / period;
      const eased = easeInOutCubic(prog);
      const min = 60, max = W - 60 - current.w;
      current.x = min + eased * (max - min);
    }

    for (let i = drops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = drops[i];
      if (p.landed) continue;
      updatePancake(p, dt);
      if (p.landed) drops.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#2a3550");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#1c2436");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#33415e";
    ctx.fillRect(0, FLOOR_Y, W, H - FLOOR_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3f5078";
    ctx.fillRect(0, FLOOR_Y, W, 5);

    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const x = 40 + i * 60;
      const y = 120 + (i % 3) * 40 + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + i) * 8;
      const r = 2 + (i % 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 220, 150, 0.10)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPlate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9ccd4";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(PLATE_CX, FLOOR_Y, PLATE_W / 2, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e6e9ef";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(PLATE_CX, FLOOR_Y - 6, PLATE_W / 2 - 24, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b0b4bd";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(PLATE_CX, FLOOR_Y, PLATE_W / 2, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPancake(p, alpha) {
    const cx = p.x + p.w / 2;
    const cy = p.y + p.h / 2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a5a2b";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + p.h * 0.18, p.w / 2, p.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#e0a94f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, p.w / 2, p.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#f0c26a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - p.h * 0.08, p.w / 2 - 8, p.h / 2 - 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#c98f3a";
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const sx = cx - p.w * 0.32 + i * (p.w * 0.64 / 4);
      const sy = cy + Math.sin(i * 2.3) * p.h * 0.12;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStack() {
    for (let i = 0; i < stack.length; i++) {
      drawPancake(stack[i], 1);
    }
  }

  function drawDrops() {
    for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
      drawPancake(drops[i], 1);
    }
  }

  function drawCurrent() {
    if (current && state.mode === "play") {
      const cx = current.x + current.w / 2;
      const top = topOfStack();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, current.y + current.h);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, top);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      drawPancake(current, 1);

      const bob = Math.sin(t * 6) * 4;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd76b";
      const ay = current.y - 26 + bob;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 10, ay);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 10, ay);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, ay + 16);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd76b";
    ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("PANCAKE STACK", 24, 44);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#e9edf5";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("STACK: " + state.score + " / " + WIN_HEIGHT, 24, 78);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fb0cc";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BEST: " + state.best, 24, 104);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fb0cc";
    ctx.font = "15px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SPACE / CLICK / TAP  to drop", W - 24, 44);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state.mode === "start") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,14,24,0.55)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe9b0";
      ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("PANCAKE STACK", W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e9edf5";
      ctx.font = "22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Stack " + WIN_HEIGHT + " pancakes without a miss!", W / 2, H / 2 - 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd76b";
      ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  /  CLICK  TO  START", W / 2, H / 2 + 48);
    } else if (state.mode === "over") {
      const won = state.message === "YOU WIN!";
      ctx.fillStyle = won ? "rgba(20,40,20,0.55)" : "rgba(40,12,12,0.55)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillStyle = won ? "#b6f0a0" : "#ff9a8a";
      ctx.font = "bold 56px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(state.message, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e9edf5";
      ctx.font = "24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Pancakes stacked: " + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd76b";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  /  CLICK  TO  PLAY  AGAIN", W / 2, H / 2 + 64);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawPlate();
    drawStack();
    drawDrops();
    drawCurrent();
    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(now) {
    if (!last) last = now;
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }
  #game { background: #222; border: 3px solid #555; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
</style>

<canvas id="game" width="800" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
// === State ===
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

let state = 'start'; // start, playing, win, lose
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;

const paddle = { w: 120, h: 14, x: W/2 - 60, y: H - 40, speed: 7 };
const ball = { x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 5 };

const rows = 5, cols = 10;
const brickW = 60, brickH = 24, brickGap = 6, brickPad = 40;
let bricks = [];

function buildBricks() {
  bricks = [];
  const colors = ['#ff6b6b','#feca57','#48dbfb','#1dd1a1','#5f27cd'];
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      bricks.push({
        x: brickPad + c*(brickW+brickGap),
        y: brickPad + r*(brickH+brickGap),
        w: brickW, h: brickH,
        color: colors[r],
        alive: true
      });
    }
  }
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.x = W/2; ball.y = H/2;
  const angle = (Math.random()*0.6 - 0.3) * Math.PI;
  ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * ball.speed;
  ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * ball.speed;
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  paddle.x = W/2 - paddle.w/2;
  buildBricks();
  resetBall();
  state = 'playing';
}

// === Input ===
let left = false, right = false;
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') right = true;
  if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && state !== 'playing') startGame();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') right = false;
});
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { if (state !== 'playing') startGame(); });

// === Update ===
function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  if (left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed;
  if (right) paddle.x += paddle.speed;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;

  // walls
  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -ball.vx; }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = -ball.vy; }

  // paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y &&
      ball.y + ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h + 4 &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
    const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w/2)) / (paddle.w/2);
    const angle = rel * (Math.PI/3);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * ball.speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  }

  // bottom
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) state = 'lose';
    else resetBall();
  }

  // bricks
  for (let b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    if (ball.x + ball.r > b.x && ball.x - ball.r < b.x + b.w &&
        ball.y + ball.r > b.y && ball.y - ball.r < b.y + b.h) {
      b.alive = false;
      score += 10;
      // determine bounce side
      const prevX = ball.x - ball.vx, prevY = ball.y - ball.vy;
      if (prevX < b.x || prevX > b.x + b.w) ball.vx = -ball.vx;
      else ball.vy = -ball.vy;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) state = 'win';
}

// === Draw ===
function draw() {
  // background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // subtle gradient sky
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'#16213e');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'#0f3460');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // bricks
  for (let b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.strokeRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
  }

  // paddle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

  // ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 30);
  ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, W - 120, 30);

  // overlays
  if (state !== 'playing') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (state === 'start') {
      ctx.fillText('BREAKOUT', W/2, H/2 - 20);
      ctx.font = '20px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to start', W/2, H/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText('Use ← → or A D to move', W/2, H/2 + 50);
    } else if (state === 'win') {
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 20);
      ctx.font = '20px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W/2, H/2 + 50);
    } else if (state === 'lose') {
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 20);
      ctx.font = '20px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
      ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W/2, H/2 + 50);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

// === Loop ===
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
buildBricks();
resetBall();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Flappy Bird</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #1a2a3a;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    user-select: none;

</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ─── Canvas setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function resize() {
    const maxW = Math.min(window.innerWidth, 480);
    const maxH = window.innerHeight;
    const aspect = 480 / 640;
    let w = maxW, h = maxW / aspect;
    if (h > maxH) { h = maxH; w = h * aspect; }
    canvas.width = 480;
    canvas.height = 640;
    canvas.style.width = w + "px";
    canvas.style.height = h + "px";
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  // ─── Game state ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const G = {
    W: 480, H: 640,
    gravity: 0.38,
    flapPower: -6.8,
    pipeGap: 150,
    pipeWidth: 64,
    pipeSpeed: 2.4,
    pipeSpacing: 220,
    groundH: 80,
  };

  let state = "ready";   // ready | playing | gameover
  let score = 0;
  let bestScore = 0;
  let frameCount = 0;

  // Bird
  const bird = {
    x: 120, y: G.H / 2,
    vy: 0,
    r: 16,
    rot: 0,
    wingPhase: 0,
  };

  // Pipes array
  let pipes = [];

  // Stars for night
  const stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * G.W,
      y: Math.random() * G.H * 0.55,
      size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
      twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }

  // Clouds
  const clouds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * G.W,
      y: 40 + Math.random() * 120,
      w: 60 + Math.random() * 80,
      speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3,
    });
  }

  // ─── Day/Night cycle ─────────────────────────────────────────
  // t goes 0→1 over a full cycle; 0=midnight, 0.25=dawn, 0.5=noon, 0.75=dusk
  let dayT = 0.45; // start near morning
  const CYCLE_FRAMES = 3000; // ~50 sec at 60fps

  function getSkyColors(t) {
    // Return [top, bottom] colors for the sky
    // Key times: 0=midnight, 0.25=dawn, 0.5=noon, 0.75=dusk
    const stops = [
      { t: 0.00, top: [10, 15, 40],   bot: [20, 25, 55] },
      { t: 0.15, top: [15, 20, 50],   bot: [30, 35, 70] },
      { t: 0.25, top: [80, 50, 80],   bot: [200, 120, 80] },
      { t: 0.35, top: [100, 140, 200],bot: [220, 180, 140] },
      { t: 0.50, top: [80, 160, 240], bot: [150, 210, 255] },
      { t: 0.65, top: [100, 150, 220],bot: [200, 190, 160] },
      { t: 0.75, top: [180, 100, 60], bot: [240, 150, 80] },
      { t: 0.85, top: [60, 40, 80],   bot: [120, 60, 80] },
      { t: 1.00, top: [10, 15, 40],   bot: [20, 25, 55] },
    ];
    let a = stops[0], b = stops[stops.length - 1];
    for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i++) {
      if (t >= stops[i].t && t <= stops[i + 1].t) {
        a = stops[i]; b = stops[i + 1]; break;
      }
    }
    const f = (t - a.t) / (b.t - a.t || 1);
    const top = [
      Math.round(a.top[0] + (b.top[0] - a.top[0]) * f),
      Math.round(a.top[1] + (b.top[1] - a.top[1]) * f),
      Math.round(a.top[2] + (b.top[2] - a.top[2]) * f),
    ];
    const bot = [
      Math.round(a.bot[0] + (b.bot[0] - a.bot[0]) * f),
      Math.round(a.bot[1] + (b.bot[1] - a.bot[1]) * f),
      Math.round(a.bot[2] + (b.bot[2] - a.bot[2]) * f),
    ];
    return { top, bot };
  }

  function isNight(t) {
    return t < 0.2 || t > 0.85;
  }
  function isDawnDusk(t) {
    return (t > 0.18 && t < 0.35) || (t > 0.65 && t < 0.82);
  }

  // ─── Input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function flap() {
    if (state === "ready") {
      state = "playing";
      bird.vy = G.flapPower;
      return;
    }
    if (state === "playing") {
      bird.vy = G.flapPower;
    }
    if (state === "gameover") {
      resetGame();
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      flap();
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); flap(); });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); flap(); }, { passive: false });

  // ─── Reset ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function resetGame() {
    state = "ready";
    score = 0;
    frameCount = 0;
    bird.y = G.H / 2;
    bird.vy = 0;
    bird.rot = 0;
    pipes = [];
    dayT = 0.45;
  }

  // ─── Spawn pipes ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function spawnPipe() {
    const minTop = 60;
    const maxTop = G.H - G.groundH - G.pipeGap - 60;
    const topH = minTop + Math.random() * (maxTop - minTop);
    pipes.push({
      x: G.W + G.pipeWidth,
      topH: topH,
      scored: false,
    });
  }

  // ─── Update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function update() {
    frameCount++;
    dayT = (dayT + 1 / CYCLE_FRAMES) % 1;

    // Clouds always move
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed;
      if (c.x + c.w < 0) c.x = G.W + c.w;
    }

    if (state === "ready") {
      bird.y = G.H / 2 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05) * 12;
      bird.wingPhase += 0.15;
      return;
    }

    if (state === "gameover") {
      // Bird falls to ground
      if (bird.y < G.H - G.groundH - bird.r) {
        bird.vy += G.gravity;
        bird.y += bird.vy;
        bird.rot = Math.min(bird.rot + 0.05, Math.PI / 2);
      } else {
        bird.y = G.H - G.groundH - bird.r;
      }
      return;
    }

    // Playing
    bird.vy += G.gravity;
    bird.y += bird.vy;
    bird.wingPhase += 0.25;
    bird.rot = Math.max(-0.4, Math.min(Math.PI / 2, bird.vy * 0.06));

    // Ceiling
    if (bird.y < bird.r) { bird.y = bird.r; bird.vy = 0; }

    // Ground collision
    if (bird.y + bird.r >= G.H - G.groundH) {
      bird.y = G.H - G.groundH - bird.r;
      gameOver();
      return;
    }

    // Spawn pipes
    if (pipes.length === 0 || pipes[pipes.length - 1].x < G.W - G.pipeSpacing) {
      spawnPipe();
    }

    // Move pipes & check collision
    for (const p of pipes) {
      p.x -= G.pipeSpeed;

      // Score
      if (!p.scored && p.x + G.pipeWidth < bird.x) {
        p.scored = true;
        score++;
        if (score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
      }

      // Collision
      const bx = bird.x, by = bird.y, br = bird.r;
      const px = p.x, pw = G.pipeWidth;
      const topY = p.topH;
      const botY = G.H - G.groundH - (G.H - G.groundH - G.pipeGap - p.topH);
      const botTop = G.H - G.groundH - (G.H - G.groundH - G.pipeGap - p.topH);

      // Simplified: top pipe from 0 to p.topH, bottom pipe from (G.H - G.groundH - (G.H - G.groundH - G.pipeGap - p.topH)) to ground
      const bottomPipeTop = G.H - G.groundH - (G.pipeGap + (G.H - G.groundH - p.topH - G.pipeGap));
      // Let me redo: gap starts at p.topH + 0 (top pipe bottom) and gap ends at p.topH + G.pipeGap
      const gapBottom = p.topH + G.pipeGap;

      // Check if bird overlaps pipe x-range
      if (bx + br > px && bx - br < px + pw) {
        // In gap?
        if (by - br < p.topH || by + br > gapBottom) {
          gameOver();
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove off-screen pipes
    pipes = pipes.filter(p => p.x + G.pipeWidth > -20);
  }

  function gameOver() {
    state = "gameover";
    bird.vy = 2;
  }

  // ─── Draw helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function drawSky() {
    const colors = getSkyColors(dayT);
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, G.H - G.groundH);
    grad.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${colors.top[0]},${colors.top[1]},${colors.top[2]})`);
    grad.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${colors.bot[0]},${colors.bot[1]},${colors.bot[2]})`);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, G.W, G.H - G.groundH);
  }

  function drawStars() {
    if (!isNight(dayT)) return;
    const alpha = dayT < 0.2 ? (0.2 - dayT) / 0.2 : (dayT - 0.85) / 0.15;
    for (const s of stars) {
      const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.03 + s.twinkle);

  function drawSun() {
    if (isNight(dayT)) return;

    const t = dayT;
    if (t < 0.2 || t > 0.8) return;

    const sunX = 60 + progress * (G.W - 120);
    const sunY = G.H * 0.6 - Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * G.H * 0.4;

    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 220, 100, 0)");

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunR * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Sun body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX - 5, sunY - 5, sunR * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  function drawMoon() {
    if (!isNight(dayT)) return;

    if (t < 0.2) {
      progress = (t + 0.15) / 0.35;
    } else {
      progress = (t - 0.85) / 0.3;
    }

    const moonY = G.H * 0.55 - Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * G.H * 0.35;
    const moonR = 22;

    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(moonX, moonY, moonR * 0.5, moonX, moonY, moonR * 2);

    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(200, 210, 255, 0)");

    ctx.moveTo(0, G.H - G.groundH);
    for (let x = 0; x <= G.W; x += 4) {
      const y = G.H - G.groundH - 15 - Math.sin(x * 0.012 + 2) * 18;

    ctx.lineTo(G.W, G.H - G.groundH);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    const pipeBody = night ? "#2a6a3a" : "#3a8a4a";
    const pipeDark = night ? "#1a4a2a" : "#2a6a3a";

    ctx.moveTo(14, -1);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
    ctx.fillText("Tap / Space to flap", G.W / 2, G.H * 0.42);

    ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, G.W, G.H);

    ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", G.W / 2, G.H * 0.3);

    ctx.font = "28px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD93D";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, G.W / 2, G.H * 0.42);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8f8";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Best: " + bestScore, G.W / 2, G.H * 0.52);

    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("TAP TO RESTART", G.W / 2, G.H * 0.68);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ─── Draw ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, G.W, G.H);
    drawSky();
    drawStars();
    drawSun();
    drawMoon();
    drawClouds();
    drawHills();
    drawPipes();
    drawGround();
    drawBird();
    drawScore();
    if (state === "ready") drawReadyOverlay();
    if (state === "gameover") drawGameOverOverlay();
  }

  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

    // moon craters
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(210,190,150,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx - mr * 0.3, my - mr * 0.2, mr * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + mr * 0.25, my + mr * 0.3, mr * 0.13, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // distant hills
    drawHills(H * 0.72, "#2a2f6e", 0.06);
    drawHills(H * 0.8, "#20245a", 0.05);
  }

  function drawHills(baseY, color, amp) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, baseY);
    const step = W / 12;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
      const x = i * step;
      const y = baseY + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * H * amp;
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawGround() {
    const gy = H * 0.86;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#3a5a3a");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#1f3a24");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, gy, W, H - gy);
    // grass tufts
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,180,90,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let x = 10; x < W; x += 26) {
      const h = 8 + (x % 5) * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, gy + 4);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 3, gy + 4 - h);
      ctx.moveTo(x, gy + 4);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, gy + 4 - h);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawBasket() {
    const x = basket.x, y = basket.y, w = basket.w, h = basket.h;
    const tilt = Math.max(-0.18, Math.min(0.18, basket.vx * 0.0012));

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(tilt);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, h * 0.9, w * 0.55, h * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // basket body (trapezoid)
    const topW = w, botW = w * 0.7;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#c98a4a");
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#a5652f");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "#7a4520");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-topW / 2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(topW / 2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(botW / 2, h);
    ctx.lineTo(-botW / 2, h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // weave lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,30,10,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
      const yy = (h / 5) * i;
      const ww = topW - (topW - botW) * (yy / h);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-ww / 2, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(ww / 2, yy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(i * (topW / 6), 0);
      ctx.lineTo(i * (botW / 6), h);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // rim
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e0a35a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, topW / 2, h * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#6a3d18";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, topW / 2, h * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawCoin(c) {
    const sq = Math.abs(Math.cos(c.spin));
    const rx = Math.max(3, c.r * sq);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y);

    // glow
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,215,80,0.7)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;

    // outer edge
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c98a1e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx + 3, c.r + 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // face
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-rx * 0.3, -c.r * 0.3, 2, 0, 0, c.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#fff2b0");
    g.addColorStop(0.6, "#ffd24a");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#f0a51e");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx, c.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // inner ring + star mark
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180,120,20,0.7)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx * 0.7, c.r * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (sq > 0.4) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#b8791a";
      ctx.font = "bold " + Math.round(c.r * 0.9) + "px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("★", 0, 1);
    }

    // sparkle
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-rx * 0.35, -c.r * 0.35, rx * 0.16, c.r * 0.1, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score panel
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,14,30,0.55)";
    roundRect(14, 14, 210, 58, 12);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,210,80,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(14, 14, 210, 58, 12);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("COINS  " + state.score + " / " + WIN_SCORE, 28, 24);

    // progress bar
    const bw = 180, bx = 28, by = 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, 10, 5); ctx.fill();
    const fill = Math.min(1, state.score / WIN_SCORE);
    const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + bw, 0);
    pg.addColorStop(0, "#ffd24a");
    pg.addColorStop(1, "#ff9a2e");
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    roundRect(bx, by, Math.max(8, bw * fill), 10, 5); ctx.fill();

    // lives (hearts)
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6b6b";
    ctx.font = "22px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
    let hearts = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) hearts += (i < state.lives ? "♥" : "♡");
    ctx.fillText(hearts, W - 20, 22);
  }

  function drawPanel(title, titleColor, lines, button) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,10,25,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const pw = Math.min(520, W * 0.9), ph = 260;
    const px = (W - pw) / 2, py = (H - ph) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,26,55,0.95)";
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 20); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = titleColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 20); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
    ctx.font = "bold 40px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, py + 55);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#e9ecff";
    ctx.font = "19px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
    let ly = py + 105;
    for (const line of lines) {
      ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, ly);
      ly += 30;
    }

    // button
    const by = py + ph - 52, bh = 38, bw = 220;
    const bx = (W - bw) / 2;
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(state.time * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 * pulse + 0.2;
    roundRect(bx - 6, by - 6, bw + 12, bh + 12, 14); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#10132a";
    ctx.font = "bold 18px Trebuchet MS, Arial";
    ctx.fillText(button, W / 2, by + bh / 2);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const s = state.shake;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawGround();

    // coins behind basket
    for (const c of coins) drawCoin(c);
    drawBasket();
    drawParticles();

    ctx.restore();

    if (state.mode === "playing") drawHUD();
    else if (state.mode === "menu") {
      drawPanel("GOLDEN HARVEST", "#ffd24a",
        ["Catch the falling coins with your basket.",
         "Move: mouse, touch, or arrow keys / A D.",
         "Collect " + WIN_SCORE + " coins to win.",
         "Miss 3 coins and it's game over."],
        "▶  PLAY  (click or press Space)");
    } else if (state.mode === "won") {
      drawPanel("YOU WIN!", "#6be08a",
        ["You gathered all " + WIN_SCORE + " golden coins!",
         "The harvest is bountiful."],
        "↻  PLAY AGAIN  (Space / R)");
    } else if (state.mode === "lost") {
      drawPanel("GAME OVER", "#ff6b6b",
        ["You dropped too many coins.",
         "Final score: " + state.score + " / " + WIN_SCORE],
        "↻  TRY AGAIN  (Space / R)");
    }
  }

  // ============================== LOOP ==============================
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big gaps
    state.time += dt; // keep menu/panel animation alive
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Skyfall</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0b1020;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    display: block;
    background: #000;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- DOM ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---------- State ----------
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;
  let state = "start";
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let speed = 220;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let nextSpawn = 0.9;
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;
  let lastTime = 0;

  // ---------- Player ----------
  const player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, r: 15, alive: true, trail: [] };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };
  let pointerActive = false;
  let pointerTarget = 0;

  // ---------- World objects ----------
  const obstacles = [];
  const particles = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const stars = [];

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function setKey(code, down) {
    if (code === "ArrowLeft" || code === "KeyA") keys.left = down;
    else if (code === "ArrowRight" || code === "KeyD") keys.right = down;
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = "playing";
    score = 0;
    speed = 220;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    nextSpawn = 0.9;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
    obstacles.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H * 0.8;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.alive = true;
    player.trail.length = 0;
  }

  function gameOver() {
    if (state !== "playing") return;
    state = "over";
    player.alive = false;
    shake = 16;
    flash = 1;
    if (score > best) best = score;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) spawnParticle(player.x, player.y, "boom");
  }

  function spawnParticle(x, y, kind) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = kind === "boom" ? 60 + Math.random() * 220 : 30 + Math.random() * 120;
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * s - (kind === "boom" ? 40 : 0),
      life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      max: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      r: kind === "boom" ? 2 + Math.random() * 3 : 1.5 + Math.random() * 2,
      hue: kind === "boom" ? 18 + Math.random() * 30 : 190 + Math.random() * 40
    });
  }

  function spawnObstacle() {
    const type = Math.random() < 0.55 ? "block" : "bar";
    if (type === "block") {
      const r = 16 + Math.random() * 18;
      obstacles.push({
        type: "block",
        x: r + Math.random() * (W - r * 2),
        y: -r - 20,
        r: r,
        vy: 0,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI,
        spin: (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 1.4)
      });
    } else {
      const margin = 40;
      const gap = Math.max(120, W * 0.32);
      const gapX = margin + gap / 2 + Math.random() * (W - margin * 2 - gap);
      const barH = 14 + Math.random() * 10;
      const leftW = Math.max(0, gapX - gap / 2);
      const rightW = Math.max(0, W - (gapX + gap / 2));
      const bar = {
        type: "bar",
        x: 0,
        y: -barH - 20,
        vy: 0,
        rot: 0,
        spin: 0,
        r: barH,
        gap: gap,
        gapX: gapX,
        left: { x: 0, w: leftW },
        right: { x: gapX + gap / 2, w: rightW }
      };
      obstacles.push(bar);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === "playing") {
      score += dt * 12;
      speed += dt * 14;
      if (speed > 620) speed = 620;

      // Player horizontal control
      const accel = 2600;
      const maxV = 560;
      if (pointerActive) {
        const desired = (pointerTarget - player.x) * 14;
        player.vx += (Math.max(-maxV, Math.min(maxV, desired)) - player.vx) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
      } else {
        if (keys.left) player.vx -= accel * dt;
        if (keys.right) player.vx += accel * dt;
        if (!keys.left && !keys.right) player.vx *= Math.pow(0.0008, dt);
        player.vx = Math.max(-maxV, Math.min(maxV, player.vx));
      }
      player.x += player.vx * dt;

      // Bounds
      if (player.x < player.r) { player.x = player.r; player.vx = 0; }
      if (player.x > W - player.r) { player.x = W - player.r; player.vx = 0; }

      // Trail
      player.trail.unshift({ x: player.x, y: player.y });
      if (player.trail.length > 14) player.trail.pop();

      // Spawn
      spawnTimer += dt;
      if (spawnTimer >= nextSpawn) {

        spawnObstacle();

      }

      // Move obstacles
      for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const o = obstacles[i];
        o.y += speed * dt;
        if (o.type === "block") o.rot += o.spin * dt;
        if (o.y > H + o.r + 40) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
      }

      // Collision
      for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const o = obstacles[i];
        if (o.type === "block") {
          const dx = player.x - o.x;
          const dy = player.y - o.y;
          const rr = player.r + o.r * 0.92;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < rr * rr) { gameOver(); break; }
        } else {
          const inBand = Math.abs(player.y - o.y) < (player.r + o.r * 0.5);
          if (inBand) {
            const inGap = Math.abs(player.x - o.gapX) < (o.gap / 2 - player.r);
            if (!inGap) { gameOver(); break; }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Particles always update
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 260 * dt;

    const cloudSpeed = state === "playing" ? speed * 0.35 : 40;

  function drawBackground() {

      g.addColorStop(0.6, "#ff8f5a");
      g.addColorStop(1, "#c94f3a");

      for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
        const a = (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * o.r;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * o.r;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);

      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a2418";
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";

    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

      ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("SKYFALL", W / 2, H * 0.32);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "20px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Dodge the falling debris", W / 2, H * 0.42);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd98a";
      ctx.font = "18px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Move:  ← →  /  A D  /  drag", W / 2, H * 0.52);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";

    } else if (state === "over") {

      ctx.font = "bold 48px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H * 0.32);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Score:  " + Math.floor(score), W / 2, H * 0.45);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd98a";
      ctx.font = "20px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText("Best:  " + Math.floor(best), W / 2, H * 0.53);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif";

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (shake > 0) {

    drawBackground();
    for (const o of obstacles) drawObstacle(o);
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,120,90," + (flash * 0.5) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  function resize() {

    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {

        depth: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8

      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        depth: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.9
      });

  }

  // ---------- Events ----------
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.code === "Space") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state !== "playing") startGame();
      return;
    }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  function loop(t) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
    let dt = (t - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = t;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

  player.y = H * 0.8;

    const py = paddle.y - paddle.h / 2;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(px, py, px, py + paddle.h);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#4fc3f7');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#0288d1');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(px, py, paddle.w, paddle.h, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + 2, paddle.w - 8, 3);
  }

  function drawBall() {
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x - 2, ball.y - 2, 1, ball.x, ball.y, ball.r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff9800');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 30;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 15, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES: ' + '♥'.repeat(lives), W - 15, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Paddle width: ' + Math.round(paddle.w) + 'px', W / 2, 30);
  }

  function drawOverlay(text, sub) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    if (sub) {
      ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === 'start') {
      drawOverlay('BREAKOUT', 'Press SPACE or click to start');
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
      ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('Paddle narrows as you score!', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    } else if (state === 'ballLost') {
      drawOverlay('BALL LOST', lives > 0 ? 'Press SPACE or click to continue' : '');
    } else if (state === 'won') {
      drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + score + '  |  Press SPACE to play again');
    } else if (state === 'lost') {
      drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: ' + score + '  |  Press SPACE to try again');
    }
  }

  // --- Loop ---
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Initialize
  buildBricks();
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - paddle.h / 2 - ball.r - 1;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Tic Tac Toe</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 50%, #0f3460 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.3), 0 0 80px rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.15);
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="480" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
// ============ STATE ============
let board = ['', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''];
let playerMark = 'X';
let aiMark = 'O';
let currentPlayer = 'X';
let gameOver = false;
let winner = '';
let score = { X: 0, O: 0, draws: 0 };
let animFrame = 0;
let lastPlaced = -1;
let placedTime = 0;
let showAIThinking = false;
let aiThinkStart = 0;
const AI_THINK_TIME = 600;
let particles = [];

// ============ CANVAS ============
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// ============ BOARD GEOMETRY ============
const boardX = 60;
const boardY = 100;
const boardSize = 360;
const cellSize = boardSize / 3;

// ============ COLORS ============
const COLORS = {
  bg: '#1a1a2e',
  grid: '#e94560',
  gridGlow: 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.4)',
  x: '#48cae4',
  o: '#f4a261',
  text: '#eaeaea',
  dim: '#888',
  highlight: 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.15)',
  winLine: '#f4a261',
  particle1: '#e94560',
  particle2: '#48cae4',
  particle3: '#f4a261',
  title: '#e94560',
  sub: '#48cae4'
};

// ============ HELPERS ============
function checkWin(b) {
  const lines = [
    [0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],
    [0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],
    [0,4,8],[2,4,6]
  ];
  for (let line of lines) {
    if (b[line[0]] !== '' && b[line[0]] === b[line[1]] && b[line[1]] === b[line[2]]) {
      return { winner: b[line[0]], line: line };
    }
  }
  if (b.every(c => c !== '')) return { winner: 'draw', line: null };
  return null;
}

function isBoardFull(b) {
  return b.every(c => c !== '');
}

// ============ AI (MINIMAX) ============
function minimax(b, isMax, depth) {
  const result = checkWin(b);
  if (result) {
    if (result.winner === aiMark) return { score: 10 - depth };
    if (result.winner === playerMark) return { score: depth - 10 };
    return { score: 0 };
  }
  if (isMax) {
    let best = { score: -Infinity, move: -1 };
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      if (b[i] === '') {
        b[i] = aiMark;
        const res = minimax(b, false, depth + 1);
        b[i] = '';
        if (res.score > best.score) best = { score: res.score, move: i };
      }
    }
    return best;
  } else {
    let best = { score: Infinity, move: -1 };
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      if (b[i] === '') {
        b[i] = playerMark;
        const res = minimax(b, true, depth + 1);
        b[i] = '';
        if (res.score < best.score) best = { score: res.score, move: i };
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
}

function aiMove() {
  const result = minimax(board.slice(), true, 0);
  if (result.move >= 0) {
    board[result.move] = aiMark;
    lastPlaced = result.move;
    placedTime = Date.now();
    showAIThinking = false;
    const win = checkWin(board);
    if (win) {
      gameOver = true;
      winner = win.winner;
      if (winner === 'draw') score.draws++;
      else score[winner]++;
      spawnWinParticles(win.line);
    }
    currentPlayer = playerMark;
  }
}

// ============ PARTICLES ============
function spawnWinParticles(line) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const idx = line ? line[Math.floor(Math.random() * line.length)] : Math.floor(Math.random() * 9);
    const cx = boardX + (idx % 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    const cy = boardY + Math.floor(idx / 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    particles.push({
      x: cx, y: cy,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6 - 2,
      life: 60 + Math.random() * 40,
      maxLife: 100,
      color: [COLORS.particle1, COLORS.particle2, COLORS.particle3][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)],
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

function spawnClickParticles(x, y) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
      life: 20 + Math.random() * 15,
      maxLife: 35,
      color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? COLORS.x : COLORS.o,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
    });
  }
}

function updateParticles() {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.1;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ============ INPUT ============
canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  const my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);

  if (gameOver) {
    resetGame();
    return;
  }

  if (currentPlayer !== playerMark) return;

  const col = Math.floor((mx - boardX) / cellSize);
  const row = Math.floor((my - boardY) / cellSize);

  if (col < 0 || col >= 3 || row < 0 || row >= 3) return;
  const idx = row * 3 + col;

  if (board[idx] !== '') return;

  board[idx] = playerMark;
  lastPlaced = idx;
  placedTime = Date.now();
  const cx = boardX + col * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const cy = boardY + row * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  spawnClickParticles(cx, cy);

  const win = checkWin(board);
  if (win) {
    gameOver = true;
    winner = win.winner;
    if (winner === 'draw') score.draws++;
    else score[winner]++;
    spawnWinParticles(win.line);
    return;
  }

  currentPlayer = aiMark;
  showAIThinking = true;
  aiThinkStart = Date.now();
});

// ============ RESET ============
function resetGame() {
  board = ['', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''];
  currentPlayer = playerMark;
  gameOver = false;
  winner = '';
  lastPlaced = -1;
  showAIThinking = false;
  particles = [];
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle radial glow
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 50, W/2, H/2, 300);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.05)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Floating dots
  const t = animFrame * 0.01;
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const px = (i * 137 + Math.sin(t + i) * 30) % W;
    const py = (i * 97 + Math.cos(t * 0.7 + i) * 20) % H;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.15)';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.title;
  ctx.font = 'bold 32px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('TIC TAC TOE', W / 2, 40);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.sub;
  ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('You are X  ·  AI is O', W / 2, 65);
}

function drawScore() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Segoe UI, sans-serif';

  const y = 82;
  const spacing = 100;
  const startX = W / 2 - spacing;

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.x;
  ctx.fillText('X: ' + score.X, startX, y);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
  ctx.fillText('Draws: ' + score.draws, W / 2, y);

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.o;
  ctx.fillText('O: ' + score.O, startX + spacing * 2, y);
}

function drawBoard() {
  // Board background
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  ctx.fillRect(boardX, boardY, boardSize, boardSize);

  // Grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.grid;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.shadowColor = COLORS.gridGlow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;

  for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
    // Vertical
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(boardX + i * cellSize, boardY);
    ctx.lineTo(boardX + i * cellSize, boardY + boardSize);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Horizontal
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(boardX, boardY + i * cellSize);
    ctx.lineTo(boardX + boardSize, boardY + i * cellSize);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Cell highlights on hover (simple: highlight last placed)
  if (lastPlaced >= 0 && !gameOver) {
    const r = Math.floor(lastPlaced / 3);
    const c = lastPlaced % 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.highlight;
    ctx.fillRect(boardX + c * cellSize + 2, boardY + r * cellSize + 2, cellSize - 4, cellSize - 4);
  }
}

function drawX(cx, cy, size, alpha) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.x;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(72, 202, 228, 0.5)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;

  const s = size * 0.3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - s, cy - s);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + s, cy + s);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx + s, cy - s);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - s, cy + s);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawO(cx, cy, size, alpha) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.o;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.5)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMarks() {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    if (board[i] === '') continue;
    const r = Math.floor(i / 3);
    const c = i % 3;
    const cx = boardX + c * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
    const cy = boardY + r * cellSize + cellSize / 2;

    let alpha = 1;
    if (i === lastPlaced) {
      const elapsed = now - placedTime;
      const scale = Math.min(elapsed / 300, 1);
      alpha = 0.5 + scale * 0.5;
    }

    if (board[i] === 'X') drawX(cx, cy, cellSize, alpha);
    else drawO(cx, cy, cellSize, alpha);
  }
}

function drawWinLine() {
  if (!gameOver || winner === 'draw' || winner === '') return;
  const result = checkWin(board);
  if (!result || !result.line) return;

  const [a, b, c] = result.line;
  const ax = boardX + (a % 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const ay = boardY + Math.floor(a / 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const bx = boardX + (c % 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;
  const by = boardY + Math.floor(c / 3) * cellSize + cellSize / 2;

  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.winLine;
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.6)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 15;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
  ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawStatus() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  const statusY = boardY + boardSize + 30;

  if (gameOver) {
    if (winner === 'draw') {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText("It's a Draw!", W / 2, statusY);
    } else if (winner === playerMark) {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.x;
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('You Win! 🎉', W / 2, statusY);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.o;
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('AI Wins!', W / 2, statusY);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dim;
    ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click anywhere to play again', W / 2, statusY + 25);
  } else if (showAIThinking) {
    const dots = '.'.repeat(1 + (Math.floor((Date.now() - aiThinkStart) / 400) % 3));
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.o;
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('AI is thinking' + dots, W / 2, statusY);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.x;
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Your turn — place an X', W / 2, statusY);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * (p.life / p.maxLife), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update() {
  animFrame++;
  updateParticles();

  if (showAIThinking && Date.now() - aiThinkStart >= AI_THINK_TIME) {
    aiMove();
  }
}

// ============ MAIN LOOP ============
function loop() {
  update();

  drawBackground();
  drawTitle();
  drawScore();
  drawBoard();
  drawMarks();
  drawWinLine();
  drawStatus();
  drawParticles();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ============ START ============
loop();
</script>

<script>
// ============ STATE ============
let canvas, ctx;
let W, H;
let stars = [];
let particles = [];
let lastSecond = -1;
let pulse = 0;
let glowPhase = 0;

// ============ INIT ============
function init() {
  canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  initStars();
  initParticles();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}

function initStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
      a: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3,
      speed: Math.random() * 0.005 + 0.002,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

function initParticles() {
  particles = [];
}

function spawnPulseParticles() {
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H * 0.42;
  const r = Math.min(W, H) * 0.22;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
    particles.push({
      x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * r,
      y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * r,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.008,
      color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#00ffcc' : '#ff6699',
      size: Math.random() * 3 + 1
    });
  }
}

// ============ UPDATE ============
function update() {
  const now = new Date();
  const sec = now.getSeconds();
  if (sec !== lastSecond) {
    lastSecond = sec;
    pulse = 1;
    spawnPulseParticles();
  }
  pulse *= 0.92;
  glowPhase += 0.02;

  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.98;
    p.vy *= 0.98;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ============ DRAW ============
function draw() {
  const now = new Date();
  const hours = now.getHours();
  const mins = now.getMinutes();
  const secs = now.getSeconds();
  const ms = now.getMilliseconds();

  const ampmSize = Math.min(W, H) * 0.02;
