  ctx.fillStyle = hours < 12 ? 'rgba(0, 255, 200, 0.7)' : 'rgba(255, 100, 150, 0.7)';
  ctx.fillText(ampm, cx, cy - ringPulse * 0.55);

  const lineY = H * 0.82;
  const lineW = W * 0.3;
  const lineGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - lineW/2, 0, cx + lineW/2, 0);
  lineGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  lineGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(0, 255, 200, ${0.3 + pulse * 0.3})`);

function pad(n) {

// ============ LOOP ============

  // ---------- Level generation ----------
  function makeLevel() {

    const nColors = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3); // 3,4,5

    let bag = [];

      const count = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) bag.push(idx);

    for (let i = bag.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

      const bw = bucketWidth();
      for (let i = 0; i < COLS; i++) {
        const cx = bucketX(i);
        if (Math.abs(dragX - cx) < bw / 2) {
          const top = H - BUCKET_H;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 3;
          ctx.strokeRect(cx - bw*0.35, top - 8, bw*0.7, BUCKET_H);
          break;
        }
      }
      drawBall(dragX, dragY, dragBall.color, 1.05);
    }

    if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();

    if (state === 'start') {
      drawCenter('Ball Sort', 'Drag colored balls into matching buckets', '#f1c40f');
      ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.fillText('Click or tap anywhere to start', W/2, H/2 + 70);
    } else if (state === 'won') {
      drawCenter('You Win!', 'Score: ' + score + '  —  Click to play again', '#2ecc71');
    } else if (state === 'lost') {
      drawCenter('Stuck!', 'No moves left — Score: ' + score + '  —  Click to retry', '#e74c3c');
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  resize();
  makeLevel();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- canvas ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// ---------- game constants ----------
const SHIP_SPEED = 340;
const BULLET_SPEED = 720;
const BULLET_COOLDOWN = 0.13;
const ENEMY_BASE_SPEED = 95;
const ENEMY_FIRE = 210;
const ENEMY_BULLET_SPEED = 250;
const ENEMY_SCORE = 10;
const BOSS_SCORE = 500;
const WIN_SCORE = 400;
const BOSS_MAX_HP = 32;

// ---------- state ----------
const state = {
  mode: 'start',   // start | playing | win | lose
  score: 0,
  high: 0,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  boss: null,
  bossSpawned: false,
  bossWarn: 0,
  bossWarned: false

const ship = { x: W/2, y: H-120, w: 44, h: 44, hp: 3, maxHp: 3, inv: 0, fireCd: 0, thrust: 0 };

let bullets = [];
let ebullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let stars = [];
let enemyTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 1.1;

// ---------- input ----------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  if (state.mode === 'start' || state.mode === 'win' || state.mode === 'lose') {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') startGame();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// ---------- helpers ----------
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

function resetGame() {
  state.mode = 'playing';
  state.score = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.boss = null;
  state.bossSpawned = false;
  state.bossWarn = 0;
  state.bossWarned = false;
  ship.x = W/2; ship.y = H-120;
  ship.hp = ship.maxHp; ship.inv = 0; ship.fireCd = 0;
  bullets = []; ebullets = []; enemies = []; particles = [];
  enemyTimer = 0; spawnInterval = 1.1;
}

function startGame() { resetGame(); }

function spawnEnemy() {
  const x = rand(50, W-50);
  const speed = ENEMY_BASE_SPEED + state.time * 2 + rand(-15, 25);
  const type = Math.random() < 0.25 ? 'heavy' : 'light';
  enemies.push({
    x: x, y: -40,
    w: type === 'heavy' ? 52 : 40,
    h: type === 'heavy' ? 52 : 40,
    hp: type === 'heavy' ? 3 : 1,
    speed: speed,
    fireCd: rand(0.5, ENEMY_FIRE),
    type: type,
    wob: rand(0, Math.PI * 2)
  });
}

function spawnBoss() {
  state.boss = {
    x: W/2, y: -120,
    w: 150, h: 110,
    hp: BOSS_MAX_HP, maxHp: BOSS_MAX_HP,
    phase: 0, fireCd: 1.2, wob: 0, entered: false
  };
  state.bossSpawned = true;
}

function explode(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const s = rand(40, 260);
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
      life: rand(0.3, 0.9), max: 0.9,
      color: color, size: rand(2, 5)
    });
  }
}

function makeStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H),
      z: rand(0.2, 1),
      size: rand(0.5, 2.2)
    });
  }
}
makeStars();

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt) {
  // stars always drift
  for (const s of stars) {
    s.y += (30 + s.z * 90) * dt;
    if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = rand(0, W); }
  }

  if (state.mode !== 'playing') {
    // gentle idle motion on other screens
    return;
  }

  state.time += dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 30);

  // ship
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'])  ship.x -= SHIP_SPEED * dt;
  if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += SHIP_SPEED * dt;
  if (keys['ArrowUp'])    ship.y -= SHIP_SPEED * dt;
  if (keys['ArrowDown'])  ship.y += SHIP_SPEED * dt;
  ship.x = Math.max(24, Math.min(W-24, ship.x));
  ship.y = Math.max(40, Math.min(H-30, ship.y));
  ship.thrust = (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['ArrowRight']) ? 1 : 0;
  if (ship.inv > 0) ship.inv -= dt;

  // ship fire
  ship.fireCd -= dt;
  if ((keys[' '] || keys['z']) && ship.fireCd <= 0) {
    bullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y - 24, vy: -BULLET_SPEED });
    ship.fireCd = BULLET_COOLDOWN;
  }

  // bullets
  for (const b of bullets) b.y += b.vy * dt;
  bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.y > -20);

  // enemy spawn
  if (!state.bossSpawned) {
    enemyTimer -= dt;
    if (enemyTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      enemyTimer = spawnInterval;
      spawnInterval = Math.max(0.5, spawnInterval - 0.01);
    }
  }

  // boss spawn when score reached
  if (!state.bossSpawned && state.score >= WIN_SCORE) {
    state.bossWarn += dt;
    if (state.bossWarn > 2.2 && !state.bossWarned) {
      state.bossWarned = true;
      spawnBoss();
    }
  }

  // enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    e.wob += dt * 2;
    e.y += e.speed * dt;
    e.x += Math.sin(e.wob) * 20 * dt;
    e.fireCd -= dt;
    if (e.fireCd <= 0 && e.y > 0 && e.y < H - 200) {
      const dx = ship.x - e.x, dy = ship.y - e.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      ebullets.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y + 18, vx: dx/d * ENEMY_BULLET_SPEED, vy: dy/d * ENEMY_BULLET_SPEED });
      e.fireCd = rand(1.2, ENEMY_FIRE);
    }
  }
  enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.y < H + 60);

  // boss
  const boss = state.boss;
  if (boss) {
    if (!boss.entered) {
      boss.y += 120 * dt;
      if (boss.y >= 150) { boss.y = 150; boss.entered = true; }
    } else {
      boss.wob += dt;
      boss.x = W/2 + Math.sin(boss.wob * 0.8) * 180;
      boss.fireCd -= dt;
      if (boss.fireCd <= 0) {
        // spread shot
        const n = 5;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const a = Math.PI/2 + (i - (n-1)/2) * 0.35;
          ebullets.push({ x: boss.x, y: boss.y + 40, vx: Math.cos(a) * ENEMY_BULLET_SPEED, vy: Math.sin(a) * ENEMY_BULLET_SPEED });
        }
        boss.fireCd = 1.1;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets
  for (const b of ebullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; }

  // particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 60 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
  }
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

  // collisions: player bullets vs enemies
  for (const b of bullets) {
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (Math.abs(b.x - e.x) < e.w/2 && Math.abs(b.y - e.y) < e.h/2) {
        e.hp -= 1;
        b.y = -999;
        explode(b.x, b.y, '#ffcf6b', 4);

          explode(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'heavy' ? '#ff7a5c' : '#7ad0ff', 16);
          state.shake = 4;
          e.y = H + 999;
        }

      }
    }
    // player bullets vs boss
    if (boss && boss.entered && Math.abs(b.x - boss.x) < boss.w/2 && Math.abs(b.y - boss.y) < boss.h/2) {
      boss.hp -= 1;
      b.y = -999;
      explode(b.x, b.y, '#ffd24a', 5);
      state.shake = 3;
      if (boss.hp <= 0) {
        state.score += BOSS_SCORE;
        explode(boss.x, boss.y, '#ff5b8a', 60);
        state.shake = 14;
        state.boss = null;
        state.mode = 'win';
        state.high = Math.max(state.high, state.score);
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets vs ship
  if (ship.inv <= 0) {
    for (const b of ebullets) {
      if (Math.abs(b.x - ship.x) < ship.w/2 - 6 && Math.abs(b.y - ship.y) < ship.h/2 - 6) {
        ship.hp -= 1;
        b.y = H + 999;
        explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#ff5b5b', 20);
        state.shake = 8;
        ship.inv = 1.4;
        if (ship.hp <= 0) {
          state.mode = 'lose';
          state.high = Math.max(state.high, state.score);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    // enemy body vs ship
    for (const e of enemies) {
      if (Math.abs(e.x - ship.x) < (e.w + ship.w)/2 - 8 && Math.abs(e.y - ship.y) < (e.h + ship.h)/2 - 8) {
        ship.hp -= 1;
        e.y = H + 999;
        explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#ff5b5b', 20);
        state.shake = 8;
        ship.inv = 1.4;
        if (ship.hp <= 0) { state.mode = 'lose'; state.high = Math.max(state.high, state.score); }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1230');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0f26');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#04060f');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // nebula glow
  const n = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.3, H*0.25, 10, W*0.3, H*0.25, 260);
  n.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,80,220,0.25)');
  n.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,80,220,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = n; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const n2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.75, H*0.6, 10, W*0.75, H*0.6, 240);
  n2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,150,200,0.2)');
  n2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40,150,200,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = n2; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4 + s.z * 0.6;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.z > 0.7 ? '#ffffff' : '#a9c2ff';
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawShip() {
  const x = ship.x, y = ship.y;
  const flash = ship.inv > 0 && Math.floor(state.time * 20) % 2 === 0;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  if (flash) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;

  // thrust flame
  if (ship.thrust > 0) {
    const fl = 14 + Math.random() * 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9a3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-8, 20); ctx.lineTo(0, 20 + fl); ctx.lineTo(8, 20); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-4, 20); ctx.lineTo(0, 20 + fl*0.6); ctx.lineTo(4, 20); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2fd0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -24);
  ctx.lineTo(16, 8);
  ctx.lineTo(10, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(-10, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(-16, 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1688c9';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-16, 8); ctx.lineTo(-30, 18); ctx.lineTo(-14, 20); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16, 8); ctx.lineTo(30, 18); ctx.lineTo(14, 20); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eafcff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -4, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // nose
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b8a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -24); ctx.lineTo(4, -12); ctx.lineTo(-4, -12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
  const heavy = e.type === 'heavy';
  const body = heavy ? '#ff5b5b' : '#c96bff';
  const dark = heavy ? '#a83232' : '#7a3bb0';
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, e.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(e.w/2, -e.h/4);
  ctx.lineTo(e.w/4, -e.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-e.w/4, -e.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-e.w/2, -e.h/4);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // top
  ctx.fillStyle = dark;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-e.w/4, -e.h/2); ctx.lineTo(e.w/4, -e.h/2); ctx.lineTo(0, -e.h/2 - 8); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 2, heavy ? 8 : 6, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 2, heavy ? 3 : 2.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // hp pips
  if (heavy) {
    for (let i = 0; i < e.hp; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
      ctx.fillRect(-12 + i*9, e.h/2 + 6, 6, 4);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBoss() {
  const b = state.boss;
  if (!b) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
  // outer glow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,10,0,0,110);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,91,138,0.5)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,91,138,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-110,-110,220,220);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#b03a5e';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, b.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(b.w/2, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(b.w/3, -b.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-b.w/3, -b.h/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-b.w/2, 0);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // plates
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7a2440';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-b.w/3, -b.h/2); ctx.lineTo(b.w/3, -b.h/2); ctx.lineTo(0, -b.h/2 - 20); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // core
  const pulse = 12 + Math.sin(b.wob * 3) * 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b8a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 10, pulse, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 10, pulse*0.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-b.w/3, 8, 7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.w/3, 8, 7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  const bw = 300, bx = W/2 - bw/2, by = 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'; ctx.fillRect(bx-2, by-2, bw+4, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1420'; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b8a'; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * (b.hp / b.maxHp), 12);
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 10, 4, 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - 1, b.y - 8, 2, 10);
  }
  for (const b of ebullets) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b5b';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd0d0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eafcff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + state.score, 18, 34);
  ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7ad0ff';
  ctx.fillText('HIGH  ' + state.high, 18, 54);

  // progress to boss
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7ad0ff';
  ctx.font = '12px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('BOSS AT ' + WIN_SCORE, 18, 74);

  // hull pips
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eafcff';
  ctx.fillText('HULL', W - 18, 30);
  for (let i = 0; i < ship.maxHp; i++) {
    const on = i < ship.hp;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? '#2fd0ff' : '#2a3350';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 18 - (i+1) * 22, 40, 18, 12);
  }
}

function overlayText(title, color, sub) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,15,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eafcff';
  ctx.font = '20px "Courier New", monospace';
  if (sub) ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 14);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7ad0ff';
  ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO PLAY', W/2, H/2 + 60);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake, state.shake), rand(-state.shake, state.shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  if (state.mode === 'playing') {
    drawParticles();
    for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    drawBoss();
    drawBullets();
    drawShip();
    drawHUD();
    if (state.bossSpawned && !state.boss) { /* win handled by overlay */ }
    if (state.bossWarned && !state.boss) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b8a';
      ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('!! BOSS INCOMING !!', W/2, H*0.4);
    }
  } else if (state.mode === 'start') {
    // show a few drifting enemies for atmosphere
    for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    overlayText('STAR VANGUARD', '#2fd0ff', 'ARROWS TO MOVE  -  SPACE TO FIRE');
  } else if (state.mode === 'win') {
    drawParticles();
    overlayText('VICTORY!', '#2fd0ff', 'FINAL SCORE  ' + state.score);
  } else if (state.mode === 'lose') {
    drawParticles();
    overlayText('SHIP DESTROYED', '#ff5b5b', 'SCORE  ' + state.score);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #0b0e1a;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    user-select: none;
    height: 100%;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #0e1328;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(80,120,255,0.25);
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ---- Canvas setup ----
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width = 800;
  const H = canvas.height = 520;

  // ---- Game state ----
  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let level = 1;
  let maxLevel = 5;
  let ball = null;
  let paddle = null;
  let bricks = [];
  let particles = [];
  let stars = [];
  let mouseDown = false;
  let ballOnPaddle = true;
  let paddleTargetX = W / 2;
  let time = 0;

  const paddleW = 120;
  const paddleH = 16;
  const ballR = 8;
  const brickH = 24;
  const brickGap = 8;
  const brickTop = 70;
  const brickLeft = 40;
  const brickRight = W - 40;
  const paddleY = H - 40;

  // ---- Input ----
  function toCanvasX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    paddleTargetX = toCanvasX(e.clientX);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    mouseDown = true;
    if (state === 'start') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === 'playing' && ballOnPaddle) {
      launchBall();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => {
    mouseDown = false;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    paddleTargetX = toCanvasX(t.clientX);
    if (state === 'start') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === 'playing' && ballOnPaddle) {
      launchBall();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    paddleTargetX = toCanvasX(t.clientX);
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (state === 'start') {
        startGame();
      } else if (state === 'playing' && ballOnPaddle) {
        launchBall();
      }
    }
  });

  // ---- Ball helpers ----
  function makeBall() {
    return { x: W / 2, y: paddleY - ballR - 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 5 };
  }

  function launchBall() {
    if (!ball) return;
    ballOnPaddle = false;
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3) - Math.PI / 2;
    ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * ball.speed;
  }

  // ---- Level / bricks ----
  function buildLevel(lv) {
    bricks = [];
    const cols = 10;
    const bw = (brickRight - brickLeft - (cols - 1) * brickGap) / cols;
    let rows;
    if (lv === 1) rows = 3;
    else if (lv === 2) rows = 4;
    else if (lv === 3) rows = 5;
    else if (lv === 4) rows = 6;
    else rows = 7;

    const palette = [
      ['#ff5c5c', '#d93030'],
      ['#ff9e3d', '#e07a1a'],
      ['#ffe04a', '#d4b52a'],
      ['#7be56e', '#4bb840'],
      ['#4ec5f1', '#2a95c8'],
      ['#b070ff', '#8a45e0'],
      ['#ff7ac8', '#e045a0']
    ];

    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        const x = brickLeft + c * (bw + brickGap);
        const y = brickTop + r * (brickH + brickGap);
        const colorIdx = r % palette.length;
        bricks.push({
          x: x, y: y, w: bw, h: brickH,
          alive: true,
          hp: (lv >= 4 && r < 2) ? 2 : 1,
          color1: palette[colorIdx][0],
          color2: palette[colorIdx][1]
        });
      }
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    level = 1;
    paddle = { x: W / 2, y: paddleY, w: paddleW, h: paddleH };
    ball = makeBall();
    ballOnPaddle = true;
    paddleTargetX = W / 2;
    particles = [];
    buildLevel(level);
  }

  function nextLevel() {
    level++;
    if (level > maxLevel) {
      state = 'win';
      return;
    }
    buildLevel(level);
    ball = makeBall();
    ballOnPaddle = true;
    paddleTargetX = paddle.x;
  }

  function loseLife() {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) {
      state = 'lose';
    } else {
      ball = makeBall();
      ballOnPaddle = true;
      paddleTargetX = paddle.x;
    }
  }

  // ---- Particles ----
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
        life: 1,
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- Stars background ----
  function initStars() {
    stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
        tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        sp: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // Paddle
    paddle.x += (paddleTargetX - paddle.x) * 0.3;
    paddle.x = Math.max(paddle.w / 2, Math.min(W - paddle.w / 2, paddle.x));

    // Ball
    if (ballOnPaddle) {
      ball.x = paddle.x;
      ball.y = paddle.y - ballR - 2;
    } else {
      // Speed increases with level
      const speedMul = 1 + (level - 1) * 0.15;
      const mag = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || 1;
      const targetSpeed = 5 * speedMul;
      const scale = targetSpeed / mag;
      ball.vx *= scale;
      ball.vy *= scale;

      ball.x += ball.vx;
      ball.y += ball.vy;

      // Walls
      if (ball.x - ballR < 0) { ball.x = ballR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.x + ballR > W) { ball.x = W - ballR; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.y - ballR < 0) { ball.y = ballR; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

      // Bottom
      if (ball.y + ballR > H) {
        loseLife();
        return;
      }

      // Paddle collision
      if (
        ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ballR >= paddle.y &&
        ball.y + ballR <= paddle.y + paddle.h + 10 &&
        ball.x >= paddle.x - paddle.w / 2 - ballR &&
        ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w / 2 + ballR
      ) {
        const hit = (ball.x - paddle.x) / (paddle.w / 2);
        const angle = hit * (Math.PI / 3) - Math.PI / 2;
        const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
        ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * sp;
        ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * sp;
        ball.y = paddle.y - ballR;
      }

      // Bricks
      for (const b of bricks) {
        if (!b.alive) continue;
        if (
          ball.x + ballR > b.x &&
          ball.x - ballR < b.x + b.w &&
          ball.y + ballR > b.y &&
          ball.y - ballR < b.y + b.h
        ) {
          // Determine side
          const overlapLeft = (ball.x + ballR) - b.x;
          const overlapRight = (b.x + b.w) - (ball.x - ballR);
          const overlapTop = (ball.y + ballR) - b.y;
          const overlapBottom = (b.y + b.h) - (ball.y - ballR);
          const minOv = Math.min(overlapLeft, overlapRight, overlapTop, overlapBottom);

          if (minOv === overlapLeft || minOv === overlapRight) {
            ball.vx = -ball.vx;
          } else {
            ball.vy = -ball.vy;
          }

          b.hp--;
          if (b.hp <= 0) {
            b.alive = false;
            score += 10 * level;
            spawnParticles(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color1);
          } else {
            score += 5 * level;
            spawnParticles(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color1);
          }

          // Check if all bricks destroyed
          let remaining = 0;
          for (const bb of bricks) if (bb.alive) remaining++;
          if (remaining === 0) {
            nextLevel();
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.1;
      p.life -= 0.03;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function draw() {
    // Background gradient
    const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0b0e1a');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#121a35');
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * s.sp + s.tw));
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x, b.y + b.h);
      grad.addColorStop(0, b.color1);
      grad.addColorStop(1, b.color2);
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      if (b.hp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // Paddle
    if (paddle) {
      const px = paddle.x - paddle.w / 2;
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(px, paddle.y, px, paddle.y + paddle.h);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#60c0ff');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#2a7acc');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(px, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 8);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Ball
    if (ball) {
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        ball.x - ballR * 0.3, ball.y - ballR * 0.3, ballR * 0.1,
        ball.x, ball.y, ballR
      );
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#aaddff');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ballR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Particles
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 35);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, W - 20, 35);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + level + ' / ' + maxLevel, W / 2, 35);

    // Overlays
    if (state === 'start') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('BREAKOUT', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
      ctx.fillText('Move mouse to aim, click to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
      ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    } else if (state === 'lose') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5c5c';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
      ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    } else if (state === 'win') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7be56e';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
      ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
      ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    }
  }

  // ---- Game loop ----
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  initStars();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

    add(220, 180, 70, 20, 'platform');
    add(350, 130, 70, 20, 'platform');

    add(300, 140, 60, 20, 'platform');
    add(420, 100, 60, 20, 'platform');
    add(540, 160, 60, 20, 'platform');
    add(560, 250, 60, 20, 'platform');

      player.x + player.w > t.x &&
      player.y < t.y + t.h &&

        player.y = t.y + t.h;
        player.vy = 0;
      } else if (player.vx > 0 && player.x + player.w - player.vx <= t.x + 1) {
        player.x = t.x - player.w;
        player.vx = 0;
      } else if (player.vx < 0 && player.x - player.vx >= t.x + t.w - 1) {

      const dy = cy - c.y;

      }

    player.x < goal.x + goal.w &&
    player.x + player.w > goal.x &&
    player.y < goal.y + goal.h &&
    player.y + player.h > goal.y
  ) {

    if (levelIndex < levels.length - 1) {

  ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a5c3a';

    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8b6f47';
      ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6b5337';
      ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y + t.h - 5, t.w, 5);
    }
  }
}

function drawCoins() {
  for (const c of coins) {

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#daa520';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r - 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

  ctx.lineTo(goal.x + goal.w / 2 + 3, goal.y + 20);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlayer() {
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e63946';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd5b3';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x + 3, player.y - 2, player.w - 6, 10);
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x + 6, player.y + 1, 3, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(player.x + player.w - 9, player.y + 1, 3, 3);
  // feet
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y + player.h - 4, 8, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(player.x + player.w - 8, player.y + player.h - 4, 8, 4);
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 16);
  ctx.fillText('Level: ' + (levelIndex + 1) + '/' + levels.length, W - 100, 16);
}

function drawOverlay(text, sub) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawBackground();
  drawTiles();
  drawCoins();
  drawGoal();
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();

    drawOverlay('PIXEL PEAK', 'Press Enter or Space to start');

    drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', msg);
  } else if (state === 'lose') {
    drawOverlay('GAME OVER', msg);
  }
}

// ====== LOOP ======
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {

        if (!n.done && n.y > hitY + 60) {
          n.missed = true; n.done = true;
          misses++; combo = 0;
          const cx = fieldX + (n.lane + 0.5) * laneW;
          burst(cx, hitY, '#666', 8);

    }

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];

      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);

  // ---------- Drawing helpers ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e1a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d1424');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#131a2e');

    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,220,255,' + (0.10 + bgPulse * 0.18) + ')');
    rg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,0,170,' + (0.05 + bgPulse * 0.08) + ')');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90,120,200,0.10)';

      ctx.moveTo(x, horizon);
      ctx.lineTo(x, H);

      const t = i / (rows - 1);
      const y = horizon + (H - horizon) * t * t;

      ctx.moveTo(fieldX, y);
      ctx.lineTo(fieldX + fieldW, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    for (let l = 0; l < 4; l++) {

    ctx.font = '600 15px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('or press SPACE / ENTER', W / 2, by + bh + 28);

    drawCenter('NEON BEAT', '#00e0ff',

      'PLAY');

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  function loop(t) {
    if (!last) last = t;

  slow:    "#b39ddb",
  extra:   "#ff8a65"
};

const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

// ---------- state ----------
let state = "start";
let score = 0;
let lives = MAX_LIVES;
let level = 0;

const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 60, y: PADDLE_Y, w: 120, h: 14, targetX: W / 2 - 60 };
const balls = [];
const bricks = [];
const powerups = [];
const particles = [];

const effects = {
  expand: 0,
  slow: 0,
  paddleSpeed: 7
};

const keys = { left: false, right: false };

// ---------- helpers ----------
function rand(min, max) {
  return min + Math.random() * (max - min);
}

function makeBall(x, y, angle) {
  const speed = LEVELS[level].speed;
  return {
    x: x, y: y,
    vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
    vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed
  };
}

function spawnPowerup(x, y) {
  const roll = Math.random();
  let type;
  if (roll < 0.4) type = "expand";
  else if (roll < 0.7) type = "multiball";
  else if (roll < 0.9) type = "slow";
  else type = "extra";
  powerups.push({ x: x, y: y, type: type, vy: 2.4, r: 11 });
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
    const sp = rand(1, 4);
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      life: rand(20, 40),
      color: color
    });
  }
}

// ---------- level building ----------
function buildLevel(n) {
  const cfg = LEVELS[n];
  bricks.length = 0;
  powerups.length = 0;
  particles.length = 0;
  balls.length = 0;

  const totalW = W - 40;
  const brickW = (totalW - (COLS - 1) * BRICK_GAP) / COLS;

  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      let keep = true;
      if (cfg.layout === "checker" && (r + c) % 2 === 1) keep = false;
      if (!keep) continue;

      const x = 20 + c * (brickW + BRICK_GAP);
      const y = BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP);
      const hp = (ROWS - r) + 1;
      bricks.push({ x: x, y: y, w: brickW, h: BRICK_H, hp: hp, maxHp: hp });
    }
  }

  paddle.w = cfg.paddleW;
  paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
  paddle.targetX = paddle.x;

  effects.expand = 0;
  effects.slow = 0;

  const startBall = makeBall(W / 2, H - 90, -Math.PI / 2);
  balls.push(startBall);
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  level = 0;
  buildLevel(0);
  state = "playing";
}

function nextLevel() {
  level++;
  if (level >= LEVELS.length) {
    state = "win";
    return;
  }
  buildLevel(level);
  state = "playing";
}

function loseLife() {
  lives--;
  if (lives <= 0) {
    state = "gameover";
    return;
  }
  buildLevel(level);
}

// ---------- input ----------
window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "a") keys.left = true;
  if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "d") keys.right = true;
  if (state === "start" && (k === " " || k === "Enter")) startGame();
  else if (state === "gameover" && (k === " " || k === "Enter")) startGame();
  else if (state === "win" && (k === " " || k === "Enter")) startGame();
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) {
  const k = e.key;
  if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "a") keys.left = false;
  if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "d") keys.right = false;
});

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
  paddle.targetX = mx - paddle.w / 2;
});

canvas.addEventListener("click", function () {
  if (state === "start" || state === "gameover" || state === "win") startGame();
});

// ---------- update ----------
function update() {
  if (state !== "playing") return;

  // paddle
  if (keys.left) paddle.targetX -= effects.paddleSpeed;
  if (keys.right) paddle.targetX += effects.paddleSpeed;
  paddle.targetX = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.targetX));
  paddle.x += (paddle.targetX - paddle.x) * 0.35;

  // effect timers
  if (effects.expand > 0) {
    effects.expand--;
    if (effects.expand === 0) {
      paddle.w = LEVELS[level].paddleW;
      paddle.targetX = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.targetX));
    }
  }
  if (effects.slow > 0) effects.slow--;

  const timeScale = effects.slow > 0 ? 0.55 : 1;

  // balls
  for (let i = balls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = balls[i];
    b.x += b.vx * timeScale;
    b.y += b.vy * timeScale;

    // walls
    if (b.x < BALL_R) { b.x = BALL_R; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx); }
    if (b.x > W - BALL_R) { b.x = W - BALL_R; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx); }
    if (b.y < BALL_R) { b.y = BALL_R; b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy); }

    // paddle
    if (b.vy > 0 &&
        b.y + BALL_R >= paddle.y &&
        b.y - BALL_R <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        b.x >= paddle.x && b.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = (b.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
      const angle = hit * (Math.PI / 3);
      const speed = Math.hypot(b.vx, b.vy);
      b.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
      b.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
      b.y = paddle.y - BALL_R;
    }

    // bricks
    for (let j = bricks.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const br = bricks[j];
      if (b.x + BALL_R > br.x && b.x - BALL_R < br.x + br.w &&
          b.y + BALL_R > br.y && b.y - BALL_R < br.y + br.h) {
        const overlapX = Math.min(b.x + BALL_R - br.x, br.x + br.w - (b.x - BALL_R));
        const overlapY = Math.min(b.y + BALL_R - br.y, br.y + br.h - (b.y - BALL_R));
        if (overlapX < overlapY) b.vx = -b.vx;
        else b.vy = -b.vy;

        br.hp--;
        if (br.hp <= 0) {
          addParticles(br.x + br.w / 2, br.y + br.h / 2, brickColor(br.maxHp), 10);
          bricks.splice(j, 1);
          score += br.maxHp * 10;
          if (Math.random() < LEVELS[level].powers) {
            spawnPowerup(br.x + br.w / 2, br.y + br.h / 2);
          }
        }
        break;
      }
    }

    // bottom
    if (b.y - BALL_R > H) {
      balls.splice(i, 1);
      if (balls.length === 0) loseLife();
    }
  }

  // powerups
  for (let i = powerups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = powerups[i];
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.y - p.r > H) { powerups.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    if (p.y + p.r >= paddle.y && p.y - p.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        p.x >= paddle.x && p.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      applyPowerup(p.type);
      powerups.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const pt = particles[i];
    pt.x += pt.vx;
    pt.y += pt.vy;
    pt.vy += 0.08;
    pt.life--;
    if (pt.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // win check
  if (bricks.length === 0) nextLevel();
}

function applyPowerup(type) {
  if (type === "expand") {
    paddle.w = Math.min(220, paddle.w + 60);
    effects.expand = 480;
    score += 50;
  } else if (type === "multiball") {
    for (const b of balls) {
      const n1 = makeBall(b.x, b.y, Math.atan2(b.vy, b.vx) + 0.5);
      const n2 = makeBall(b.x, b.y, Math.atan2(b.vy, b.vx) - 0.5);
      balls.push(n1, n2);
    }
    score += 50;
  } else if (type === "slow") {
    effects.slow = 300;
    score += 50;
  } else if (type === "extra") {
    lives = Math.min(MAX_LIVES + 2, lives + 1);
    score += 100;
  }
}

function brickColor(maxHp) {
  if (maxHp >= 5) return "#ef5350";
  if (maxHp >= 4) return "#ffa726";
  if (maxHp >= 3) return "#ffee58";
  if (maxHp >= 2) return "#66bb6a";
  return "#26c6da";
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#10263f");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#0a1626");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,120,170,0.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const br of bricks) {
    const col = brickColor(br.maxHp);
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.fillRect(br.x, br.y, br.w, br.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
    ctx.fillRect(br.x, br.y, br.w, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.fillRect(br.x, br.y + br.h - 4, br.w, 4);
    if (br.hp < br.maxHp) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(br.x + br.w * 0.3, br.y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(br.x + br.w * 0.5, br.y + br.h - 3);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#7ec8ff");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#3a7bd5");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 6);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBalls() {
  for (const b of balls) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,180,255,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x - 2, b.y - 2, BALL_R * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPowerups() {
  for (const p of powerups) {
    ctx.fillStyle = POWER_COLORS[p.type];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0d1b2a";
    ctx.font = "bold 12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const label = { expand: "E", multiball: "M", slow: "S", extra: "+" }[p.type];
    ctx.fillText(label, p.x, p.y + 1);
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const pt of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, pt.life / 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = pt.color;
    ctx.fillRect(pt.x - 2, pt.y - 2, 4, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 20px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 16, 16);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("Level " + (level + 1) + " / " + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 16);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  let hearts = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += "\u2665 ";
  ctx.fillText(hearts.trim(), W - 16, 16);
}

function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,15,25,0.78)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold 46px Arial";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe0f0";
  ctx.font = "20px Arial";
  ctx.fillText(subtitle, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  drawBalls();
  drawPowerups();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "start") {
    drawOverlay("BREAKOUT", "Press Space or Click to Play", "#7ec8ff");
  } else if (state === "gameover") {
    drawOverlay("GAME OVER", "Final Score: " + score + "  \u2014  Press Space to Retry", "#ef5350");
  } else if (state === "win") {
    drawOverlay("YOU WIN!", "All levels cleared \u2014 Score: " + score + "  \u2014  Press Space to Play Again", "#66bb6a");
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

buildLevel(0);
state = "start";
loop();

    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Ball glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(ballX, ballY, 0, ballX, ballY, BALL_R * 3);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0.5)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 220, 100, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ballX, ballY, BALL_R * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ballX, ballY, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ballX - 2, ballY - 2, BALL_R * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Paddle 1 (left) - cyan
  drawPaddle(30, p1Y, '#00ffcc', '#00cc99');

  // Paddle 2 (right) - orange
  drawPaddle(W - 30 - PADDLE_W, p2Y, '#ff6644', '#cc4422');

  // Particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Scores
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.8)';
  ctx.fillText(p1Score, W / 4, 55);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 102, 68, 0.8)';
  ctx.fillText(p2Score, 3 * W / 4, 55);

  // Player labels
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 204, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillText('P1  [W/S]', W / 4, 75);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 102, 68, 0.5)';
  ctx.fillText('P2  [↑/↓]', 3 * W / 4, 75);
}

function drawPaddle(x, y, color, darkColor) {
  // Glow
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + PADDLE_W / 2, y + PADDLE_H / 2, 0, x + PADDLE_W / 2, y + PADDLE_H / 2, PADDLE_H);
  glow.addColorStop(0, color + '44');
  glow.addColorStop(1, color + '00');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + PADDLE_W / 2, y + PADDLE_H / 2, PADDLE_H, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Paddle body
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + PADDLE_W, y);
  grad.addColorStop(0, darkColor);
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, color);
  grad.addColorStop(1, darkColor);
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // Highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x + 2, y + 4, 4, PADDLE_H - 8, 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  // Title
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  const titleGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 150, 0, W / 2 + 150, 0);
  titleGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffcc');
  titleGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffffff');
  titleGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff6644');

  ctx.fillText('PONG', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);

  // Subtitle
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.fillText('TWO-PLAYER MODE', W / 2, H / 2 - 25);

  // Instructions
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
  ctx.fillText('Player 1:  W / S', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
  ctx.fillText('Player 2:  ↑ / ↓', W / 2, H / 2 + 45);

  // First to 7
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
  ctx.fillText('First to 7 points wins', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);

  // Blinking prompt
  const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() / 400) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 120);
  }

  // Decorative paddles
  drawPaddle(60, H / 2 - 40, '#00ffcc', '#00cc99');
  drawPaddle(W - 72, H / 2 - 40, '#ff6644', '#cc4422');

  // Decorative ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2 - 100, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGameOver() {
  const winner = p1Score >= WIN_SCORE ? 'PLAYER 1' : 'PLAYER 2';
  const winColor = p1Score >= WIN_SCORE ? '#00ffcc' : '#ff6644';

  ctx.font = 'bold 56px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = winColor;
  ctx.fillText(winner + ' WINS!', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

  ctx.font = '24px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText(p1Score + '  —  ' + p2Score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);

  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';

// ===== LOOP =====
function loop() {

  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// Polyfill roundRect if needed
if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {

    this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
    this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
    this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
    this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ball Sort</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f0c29 0%, #302b63 50%, #24243e 100%);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.3);
  }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  // === CONSTANTS ===
  const CANVAS_W = 900;
  const CANVAS_H = 560;
  const BALL_R = 22;
  const BIN_W = 90;
  const BIN_H = 110;
  const BIN_Y = CANVAS_H - BIN_H - 20;
  const MAX_BALLS_PER_BIN = 5;
  const COLORS = [
    { name: 'Red',    r: 230, g: 55,  b: 55  },
    { name: 'Blue',   r: 55,  g: 120, b: 230 },
    { name: 'Green',  r: 60,  g: 200, b: 90  },
    { name: 'Yellow', r: 240, g: 210, b: 50  },
    { name: 'Purple', r: 160, g: 70,  b: 200 },
    { name: 'Orange', r: 240, g: 140, b: 40  }
  ];
  const NUM_BINS = COLORS.length;
  const NUM_BALLS = 30;
  const START_X = 60;
  const START_Y = 60;
  const BALL_SPACING_X = 60;
  const BALL_SPACING_Y = 60;

  // === CANVAS SETUP ===
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width = CANVAS_W;
  canvas.height = CANVAS_H;

  // === GAME STATE ===
  let balls = [];
  let bins = [];
  let draggedBall = null;
  let mouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let score = 0;
  let totalBalls = 0;
  let gamePhase = 'start'; // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
  let timer = 0;
  let maxTime = 60;
  let timeLeft = maxTime;
  let particles = [];
  let shakeAmount = 0;
  let message = '';
  let messageTimer = 0;

  // === INITIALIZATION ===
  function initBalls() {
    balls = [];
    let colorIdx = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_BALLS; i++) {
      const col = i % 5;
      const row = Math.floor(i / 5);
      balls.push({
        id: i,
        colorIdx: colorIdx % NUM_BINS,
        x: START_X + col * BALL_SPACING_X,
        y: START_Y + row * BALL_SPACING_Y,
        homeX: START_X + col * BALL_SPACING_X,
        homeY: START_Y + row * BALL_SPACING_Y,
        inBin: false,
        binIdx: -1,
        inBinRow: -1,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        targetX: START_X + col * BALL_SPACING_X,
        targetY: START_Y + row * BALL_SPACING_Y,
        animating: false,
        scale: 1
      });
      colorIdx++;
    }
    // Shuffle
    for (let i = balls.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const tmp = balls[i];
      balls[i] = balls[j];
      balls[j] = tmp;
    }
    // Reassign positions after shuffle
    for (let i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      const col = i % 5;
      const row = Math.floor(i / 5);
      balls[i].homeX = START_X + col * BALL_SPACING_X;
      balls[i].homeY = START_Y + row * BALL_SPACING_Y;
      balls[i].x = balls[i].homeX;
      balls[i].y = balls[i].homeY;
      balls[i].targetX = balls[i].homeX;
      balls[i].targetY = balls[i].homeY;
      balls[i].inBin = false;
      balls[i].binIdx = -1;
      balls[i].inBinRow = -1;
      balls[i].animating = false;
    }
    totalBalls = balls.length;
  }

  function initBins() {
    bins = [];
    const startX = (CANVAS_W - NUM_BINS * (BIN_W + 15)) / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_BINS; i++) {
      bins.push({
        x: startX + i * (BIN_W + 15),
        y: BIN_Y,
        w: BIN_W,
        h: BIN_H,
        colorIdx: i,
        count: 0,
        balls: []
      });
    }
  }

  function resetGame() {
    initBins();
    initBalls();
    score = 0;
    timeLeft = maxTime;
    gamePhase = 'playing';
    draggedBall = null;
    particles = [];
    shakeAmount = 0;
    message = '';
    messageTimer = 0;
  }

  // === INPUT HANDLING ===
  function getCanvasPos(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
    const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
    const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
    return {
      x: (clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
      y: (clientY - rect.top) * scaleY
    };
  }

  function findBallAt(x, y) {
    for (let i = balls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = balls[i];
      if (b.inBin) continue;
      const dx = x - b.x;
      const dy = y - b.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (BALL_R + 8) * (BALL_R + 8)) {
        return b;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findBinAt(x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < bins.length; i++) {
      const bin = bins[i];
      if (x >= bin.x && x <= bin.x + bin.w && y >= bin.y && y <= bin.y + bin.h) {
        return bin;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    const pos = getCanvasPos(e);
    if (gamePhase === 'start') {
      resetGame();
      return;
    }
    if (gamePhase === 'won' || gamePhase === 'lost') {
      gamePhase = 'start';
      return;
    }
    const ball = findBallAt(pos.x, pos.y);
    if (ball && !ball.inBin && !ball.animating) {
      draggedBall = ball;
      ball.scale = 1.15;
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
    const pos = getCanvasPos(e);
    mouse.x = pos.x;
    mouse.y = pos.y;
    if (draggedBall) {
      draggedBall.x = pos.x;
      draggedBall.y = pos.y;
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function(e) {
    if (draggedBall) {
      const pos = getCanvasPos(e);
      const bin = findBinAt(pos.x, pos.y);
      if (bin) {
        if (bin.colorIdx === draggedBall.colorIdx && bin.count < MAX_BALLS_PER_BIN) {
          // Correct bin
          bin.count++;
          bin.balls.push(draggedBall);
          draggedBall.inBin = true;
          draggedBall.binIdx = bin.colorIdx;
          draggedBall.inBinRow = bin.count - 1;
          draggedBall.animating = true;
          draggedBall.targetX = bin.x + bin.w / 2 + (bin.count % 2 === 0 ? -12 : 12);
          draggedBall.targetY = bin.y + bin.h - 30 - Math.floor((bin.count - 1) / 2) * 35;
          score++;
          spawnParticles(draggedBall.x, draggedBall.y, COLORS[draggedBall.colorIdx]);
          if (score === totalBalls) {
            gamePhase = 'won';
          }
        } else {
          // Wrong bin or full
          shakeAmount = 8;
          message = bin.count >= MAX_BALLS_PER_BIN ? 'Bin full!' : 'Wrong bin!';
          messageTimer = 1.5;
          draggedBall.targetX = draggedBall.homeX;
          draggedBall.targetY = draggedBall.homeY;
          draggedBall.animating = true;
        }
      } else {
        // Dropped outside any bin
        draggedBall.targetX = draggedBall.homeX;
        draggedBall.targetY = draggedBall.homeY;
        draggedBall.animating = true;
      }
      draggedBall.scale = 1;
      draggedBall = null;
    }
  });

  // Touch support
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const fakeEvent = { clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY, touches: [touch] };
    canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', fakeEvent));
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    const fakeEvent = { clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY, touches: [touch] };
    canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', fakeEvent));
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
    const fakeEvent = { clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY, touches: [touch] };
    canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', fakeEvent));
  }, { passive: false });

  // === PARTICLES ===
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
        life: 1,
        decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02,
        r: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles() {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.life -= p.decay;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // === UPDATE ===
  function update(dt) {
    if (gamePhase === 'playing') {
      timeLeft -= dt;
      if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        timeLeft = 0;
        gamePhase = 'lost';
      }
    }

    // Animate balls
    for (let i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      const b = balls[i];
      if (b.animating) {
        const dx = b.targetX - b.x;
        const dy = b.targetY - b.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (dist < 2) {
          b.x = b.targetX;
          b.y = b.targetY;
          b.animating = false;
        } else {
          const speed = 12;
          b.x += (dx / dist) * speed;
          b.y += (dy / dist) * speed;
        }
      }
    }

    updateParticles();

    // Shake decay
    if (shakeAmount > 0) {
      shakeAmount *= 0.85;
      if (shakeAmount < 0.3) shakeAmount = 0;
    }

    // Message timer
    if (messageTimer > 0) {
      messageTimer -= dt;
    }
  }

  // === DRAW HELPERS ===
  function drawBall(x, y, r, colorIdx, scale, highlight) {
    const c = COLORS[colorIdx];
    const s = scale || 1;
    const radius = r * s;

    // Shadow
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + radius * 0.7, radius * 0.8, radius * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.fill();

    // Main ball
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - radius * 0.3, y - radius * 0.3, radius * 0.1, x, y, radius);
    grad.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.min(255, c.r + 60)},${Math.min(255, c.g + 60)},${Math.min(255, c.b + 60)})`);
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgb(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b})`);
    grad.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.max(0, c.r - 60)},${Math.max(0, c.g - 60)},${Math.max(0, c.b - 60)})`);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Highlight
    if (highlight) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, radius + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Specular
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - radius * 0.25, y - radius * 0.3, radius * 0.2, radius * 0.15, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBin(bin) {
    const c = COLORS[bin.colorIdx];
    const x = bin.x;
    const y = bin.y;
    const w = bin.w;
    const h = bin.h;

    // Bin body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b},0.25)`);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b},0.5)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // Bin border
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b},0.8)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Bin label
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(c.name, x + w / 2, y + 18);

    // Count
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '11px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(bin.count + ' / ' + MAX_BALLS_PER_BIN, x + w / 2, y + h - 8);

    // Draw balls inside bin
    for (let i = 0; i < bin.balls.length; i++) {
      const b = bin.balls[i];
      drawBall(b.x, b.y, BALL_R * 0.7, b.colorIdx, 0.85, false);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // Stars
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % CANVAS_W;
      const sy = (i * 89 + 20) % (CANVAS_H * 0.4);
      const size = 1 + (i % 3);
      const alpha = 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(timer * 2 + i);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.max(0.1, alpha)})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Grid lines (subtle)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,100,200,0.06)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let gx = 0; gx < CANVAS_W; gx += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(gx, CANVAS_H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let gy = 0; gy < CANVAS_H; gy += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(CANVAS_W, gy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score + ' / ' + totalBalls, 20, 35);

    // Timer
    const timerColor = timeLeft > 15 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' : 'rgba(255,80,80,0.9)';
    ctx.fillStyle = timerColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(timeLeft) + 's', CANVAS_W - 20, 35);

    // Timer bar
    const barW = 200;
    const barH = 8;
    const barX = CANVAS_W - 20 - barW;
    const barY = 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, barW, barH, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    const fillW = (timeLeft / maxTime) * barW;
    const barColor = timeLeft > 15 ? 'rgb(100,200,255)' : 'rgb(255,80,80)';
    ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(barX, barY, fillW, barH, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // Message
    if (messageTimer > 0 && message) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,100,0.9)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(message, CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 - 40);
    }
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Ball Sort', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 - 60);

    ctx.font = '20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.fillText('Drag colored balls into matching bins', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2);
    ctx.fillText('Sort all ' + totalBalls + ' balls before time runs out!', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 + 30);

    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,255,0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Start', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 + 80);

    // Draw sample balls
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_BINS; i++) {
      drawBall(CANVAS_W / 2 + (i - NUM_BINS / 2 + 0.5) * 50, CANVAS_H / 2 + 130, 18, i, 1, false);
    }
  }

  function drawEndScreen(won) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (won) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,255,150,0.95)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 52px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('You Win!', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 - 50);
      ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
      ctx.fillText('All balls sorted in ' + Math.ceil(maxTime - timeLeft) + ' seconds!', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 + 10);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,100,0.95)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 52px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText("Time's Up!", CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 - 50);
      ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
      ctx.fillText('You sorted ' + score + ' of ' + totalBalls + ' balls', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 + 10);
    }

    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,255,0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again', CANVAS_W / 2, CANVAS_H / 2 + 70);
  }

  // === MAIN DRAW ===
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // Apply shake
    if (shakeAmount > 0) {
      const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount * 2;
      const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmount * 2;
      ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(-10, -10, CANVAS_W + 20, CANVAS_H + 20);

    // Background
    drawBackground();

    // Bins
    for (let i = 0; i < bins.length; i++) {
      drawBin(bins[i]);
    }

    // Balls (non-dragged first, dragged on top)
    for (let i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      const b = balls[i];
      if (b === draggedBall) continue;
      const isHover = !b.inBin && !b.animating &&
        Math.abs(mouse.x - b.x) < BALL_R + 8 &&
        Math.abs(mouse.y - b.y) < BALL_R + 8;
      drawBall(b.x, b.y, BALL_R, b.colorIdx, b.scale, isHover);
    }
    if (draggedBall) {
      drawBall(draggedBall.x, draggedBall.y, BALL_R, draggedBall.colorIdx, draggedBall.scale, true);
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const c = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${c.r},${c.g},${c.b})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // HUD
    if (gamePhase === 'playing') {
      drawHUD();
    }

    // Overlays
    if (gamePhase === 'start') {
      drawStartScreen();
    } else if (gamePhase === 'won') {
      drawEndScreen(true);
    } else if (gamePhase === 'lost') {
      drawEndScreen(false);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // === GAME LOOP ===
  let lastTime = 0;
  function gameLoop(timestamp) {
    const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastTime = timestamp;
    timer += dt;

    update(dt);
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // === INIT ===
  initBins();
  initBalls();
  gamePhase = 'start';

  requestAnimationFrame(function(ts) {
    lastTime = ts;
    gameLoop(ts);
  });
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Prince of Persia</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}

<canvas id="c" width="320" height="200"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var cv=document.getElementById('c');
var ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
var W=320,H=200;
function fit(){var s=Math.min(window.innerWidth/W,window.innerHeight/H);cv.style.width=(W*s|0)+'px';cv.style.height=(H*s|0)+'px';}
window.addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();

/* palette */
var PAL={
  sky:'#3a2f52', sky2:'#241d38', ground:'#7a5a30', ground2:'#5b401f',
  prince:'#d7c79a', prince2:'#8a6a3a', sword:'#c9c9c9',
  guard:'#8a2a2a', guard2:'#d7c79a',
  lamp:'#e8b23a', lamp2:'#f7e08a',
  text:'#f2e6c0', dark:'#140f08'
};

/* level: one short loop of ground and a couple of pits */
var LEVEL=[
  {x:0,w:96,ground:152},
  {x:96,w:24,ground:184},
  {x:120,w:128,ground:152},
  {x:248,w:24,ground:184},
  {x:272,w:48,ground:152}
];
var GOAL_X=304;

/* state */
var player={x:12,y:120,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,face:1,frame:0,frameT:0,dead:false};
var guards=[];
var lamp={x:292,y:132,frame:0,frameT:0};
var score=0;
var state='title';
var spawnTimer=0;
var time=0;

/* input */
var keys={};
function key(e){
  var c=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(c==='arrowleft'||c==='a')keys.left=true;
  else if(c==='arrowright'||c==='d')keys.right=true;
  else if(c==='arrowup'||c==='w'||c===' ')keys.jump=true;
  else if(c==='x'||c==='k')keys.atk=true;
  if(['arrowleft','arrowright','arrowup','arrowdown',' '].indexOf(e.key.toLowerCase())>=0)e.preventDefault();
}
function keyup(e){
  var c=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(c==='arrowleft'||c==='a')keys.left=false;
  else if(c==='arrowright'||c==='d')keys.right=false;
  else if(c==='arrowup'||c==='w'||c===' ')keys.jump=false;
  else if(c==='x'||c==='k')keys.atk=false;
}
window.addEventListener('keydown',key);
window.addEventListener('keyup',keyup);

function groundAt(x){
  for(var i=0;i<LEVEL.length;i++){var L=LEVEL[i];if(x>=L.x&&x<L.x+L.w)return L.ground;}
  return 184;
}

function spawnGuard(){
  guards.push({x:324,y:120,vx:-1.1,vy:0,frame:0,frameT:0,atk:0,atkT:0,dead:false,done:false});
}

function reset(){
  player={x:12,y:120,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,face:1,frame:0,frameT:0,dead:false};
  guards=[];
  spawnGuard();
  score=0;
  state='play';
  spawnTimer=0;
}

/* update */
function update(dt){
  time+=dt;
  if(state==='play'){
    updatePlayer(dt);
    spawnTimer+=dt;
    if(spawnTimer>3.4){spawnTimer=0;spawnGuard();}
    updateGuards(dt);
    updateLamp(dt);
  } else if(state==='title'||state==='win'||state==='lose'){
    updateLamp(dt);
  }
}

function updatePlayer(dt){
  if(player.dead)return;
  var speed=1.5;
  if(keys.left){player.vx=-speed;player.face=-1;}
  else if(keys.right){player.vx=speed;player.face=1;}
  else player.vx=0;
  if(keys.jump&&player.onGround){player.vy=-5.2;player.onGround=false;}
  player.vy+=0.32;
  player.x+=player.vx;
  player.y+=player.vy;
  if(player.x<4)player.x=4;
  if(player.x>W-14)player.x=W-14;
  var g=groundAt(player.x);
  if(player.y>=g){
    if(player.y>180){player.dead=true;state='lose';return;}
    player.y=g;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true;
  } else player.onGround=false;
  if(player.onGround&&Math.abs(player.vx)>0.1){player.frameT+=dt;if(player.frameT>0.14){player.frameT=0;player.frame=(player.frame+1)%4;}}
  else if(player.onGround)player.frame=0;
  /* reach the lamp */
  if(player.x>GOAL_X-14){
    state='win';
    score+=100;
  }
}

function updateGuards(dt){
  for(var i=0;i<guards.length;i++){
    var G=guards[i];
    if(G.dead){G.vy+=0.32;G.y+=G.vy;G.x+=G.vx;G.done=true;continue;}
    G.x+=G.vx;
    G.y=groundAt(G.x);
    G.frameT+=dt;if(G.frameT>0.14){G.frameT=0;G.frame=(G.frame+1)%4;}
    var dx=player.x-G.x,dy=player.y-G.y;
    if(!player.dead&&Math.abs(dx)<12&&Math.abs(dy)<18){
      if(G.atk<=0){G.atk=1;G.atkT=0.5;}
      else{player.dead=true;state='lose';}
    }
    if(G.atk>0){G.atk-=dt;if(G.atk<=0)G.atk=0;}
    /* player attack */
    if(keys.atk&&!player.dead){
      var reach=player.face>0?14:14;
      var ax=player.x+player.face*10;
      if((player.face>0&&G.x>player.x&&G.x<player.x+18)||(player.face<0&&G.x<player.x&&G.x>player.x-18)){
        if(!G.dead){G.dead=true;G.vy=-3.5;G.vx=player.face*1.5;score+=25;}
      }
    }
    if(G.x<-24)G.done=true;
  }
  for(var j=guards.length-1;j>=0;j--){if(guards[j].done)guards.splice(j,1);}
}

function updateLamp(dt){
  lamp.frameT+=dt;if(lamp.frameT>0.2){lamp.frameT=0;lamp.frame=(lamp.frame+1)%2;}
}

/* draw */
function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawLevel();
  if(state!=='title')drawPlayer();
  for(var i=0;i<guards.length;i++)drawGuard(guards[i]);
  drawLamp();
  if(state==='title')drawTitle();
  else if(state==='win')drawWin();
  else if(state==='lose')drawLose();
  drawHUD();
}

function drawBackground(){
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.sky2;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,120);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.sky;
  for(var i=0;i<12;i++){
    var bx=(i*37+ (time*4)%37)%W;
    ctx.fillRect(bx,10+(i%3)*16,26,10);
  }
  /* moon */
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.lamp2;ctx.fillRect(250,22,20,20);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.sky;ctx.fillRect(256,26,14,14);
  /* distant palace silhouette */
  ctx.fillStyle='#1c1626';
  ctx.fillRect(0,96,W,24);
  for(var p=0;p<6;p++)ctx.fillRect(p*58+10,72,26,24);
  ctx.fillRect(150,54,40,42);
  ctx.fillRect(158,44,24,12);
}

function drawLevel(){
  for(var i=0;i<LEVEL.length;i++){
    var L=LEVEL[i];
    ctx.fillStyle=PAL.ground;ctx.fillRect(L.x,L.ground,L.w,H-L.ground);
    ctx.fillStyle=PAL.ground2;
    for(var s=L.x;s<L.x+L.w;s+=16)ctx.fillRect(s,L.ground+10,16,4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9a7648';ctx.fillRect(L.x,L.ground,L.w,4);
  }
}

function drawPlayer(){
  var x=player.x|0,y=player.y|0,f=player.frame,face=player.face;
  var jumping=!player.onGround;
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.prince2;
  if(jumping){
    ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+10,4,6);ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+8,4,6);
  } else {
    var off=(f===1||f===3)?1:0;
    ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+12-off,4,5);ctx.fillRect(x+8,y+12+off,4,5);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.prince;
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+2,10,8);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.prince2;
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+8,10,3);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.prince;
  ctx.fillRect(x+3,y+0,8,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.prince2;
  ctx.fillRect(x+3,y+0,8,2);
  /* sword */
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.sword;
  if(keys.atk){
    if(face>0)ctx.fillRect(x+12,y+5,10,3);else ctx.fillRect(x-2,y+5,10,3);
  } else {
    if(face>0)ctx.fillRect(x+12,y+4,3,8);else ctx.fillRect(x-1,y+4,3,8);
  }
}

function drawGuard(G){
  var x=G.x|0,y=G.y|0,f=G.frame,dead=G.dead;
  if(dead){
    ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard;ctx.fillRect(x,y+12,14,5);
    ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard2;ctx.fillRect(x+3,y+12,8,4);
    return;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard2;
  var off=(f===1||f===3)?1:0;
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+12-off,4,5);ctx.fillRect(x+9,y+12+off,4,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard;
  ctx.fillRect(x+1,y+2,13,9);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard2;
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+0,11,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.guard;
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+0,11,2);
  /* sword */
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.sword;
  if(G.atk>0){ctx.fillRect(x-6,y+5,10,3);}
  else{ctx.fillRect(x-2,y+4,3,8);}
}

function drawLamp(){
  var x=lamp.x,y=lamp.y;
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.lamp2;
  var s=lamp.frame?5:4;
  ctx.fillRect(x-2,y-18-s,6,6);
  ctx.fillRect(x-4,y-14,10,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.lamp;
  ctx.fillRect(x-3,y-10,8,10);
  ctx.fillRect(x-5,y-4,12,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.lamp2;
  ctx.fillRect(x-1,y-12,4,3);
}

function text(t,x,y,size,col){
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.font='bold '+size+'px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(t,x,y);
}

function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,4,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  text('PRINCE OF PERSIA',W/2,58,16,PAL.text);
  text('A 8-BIT TRIBUTE',W/2,76,8,PAL.lamp);
  text('ARROWS / WASD to move',W/2,110,8,PAL.text);
  text('X to attack the guard',W/2,124,8,PAL.text);
  text('reach the lamp to win',W/2,138,8,PAL.text);
  if((time*2|0)%2===0)text('PRESS  SPACE  TO  START',W/2,164,9,PAL.lamp2);
}
function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,4,0.5)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  text('YOU REACHED THE LAMP',W/2,84,12,PAL.lamp2);
  text('SCORE  '+score,W/2,104,9,PAL.text);
  text('PRESS  SPACE  TO  PLAY  AGAIN',W/2,130,9,PAL.lamp);
}
function drawLose(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,4,4,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  text('THE GUARD HAS YOU',W/2,84,12,PAL.guard);
  text('SCORE  '+score,W/2,104,9,PAL.text);
  text('PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY',W/2,130,9,PAL.lamp);
}

function drawHUD(){
  if(state==='title')return;
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.dark;ctx.fillRect(2,2,90,12);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.text;ctx.font='bold 9px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,6,11);
}

/* restart on space for non-title states */
window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key===' '){
    if(state==='title')reset();
    else if(state==='win'||state==='lose')reset();
  }
});

/* main loop */
var last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  var dt=(now-last)/1000;last=now;
  if(dt>0.05)dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
