      vx:0, vy:0,
      w:16, h:16,
      hp:1,
      maxHp:1,
      speed:1.6,
      dir:-1
    });
  }
  // boss
  addMover({
    type:'boss',
    x:360, y:GROUND_Y-70,
    vx:0, vy:0,
    w:44, h:60,
    hp:12,
    maxHp:12,
    speed:0.6,
    dir:-1,
    attackTimer:0,
    attackCd:0
  });
}

// ---------- input ----------
const keys={};
let whipPressed=false;
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(k==='z'||k==='x'||k===' '||k==='j'){
    if(!keys._whipHeld){ whipPressed=true; keys._whipHeld=true; }
  }
  if(k==='enter'){
    if(state==='title'||state==='dead'||state==='won'){
      startGame();
    }
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=false;
  if(k==='z'||k==='x'||k===' '||k==='j'){ keys._whipHeld=false; }
});

// ---------- game flow ----------
function startGame(){
  state='play';
  score=0;
  lives=3;
  player.x=80; player.y=GROUND_Y-player.h; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
  player.facing=1; player.attack=0; player.invuln=0; player.dead=0;
  buildLevel();
}

function playerDie(){
  lives--;
  if(lives<=0){
    state='dead';
  } else {
    player.x=80; player.y=GROUND_Y-player.h; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
    player.invuln=120;
  }
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(){
  time++;
  if(shake>0) shake--;

  if(state!=='play'){
    // still animate movers a bit
    updateMovers();
    return;
  }

  // player input
  const left=keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'];
  const right=keys['d']||keys['arrowright'];
  const up=keys['w']||keys['arrowup'];

  if(player.dead>0){
    player.dead++;
    if(player.dead>60){
      playerDie();
      if(state==='play'){ player.dead=0; }
    }
  } else {
    const speed=2.4;
    if(left){ player.vx=-speed; player.facing=-1; }
    else if(right){ player.vx=speed; player.facing=1; }
    else { player.vx*=0.7; }

    if(up && player.onGround){
      player.vy=-7.5;
      player.onGround=false;
    }

    // whip
    if(whipPressed && player.attack<=0){
      player.attack=22;
      player.attackDir=player.facing;
      player.whipX=player.x+player.w/2;
      player.whipY=player.y+player.h/2;
    }
    whipPressed=false;
    if(player.attack>0) player.attack--;
    if(player.invuln>0) player.invuln--;
    player.anim++;
  }

  // physics
  player.vy+=0.35;
  if(player.vy>9) player.vy=9;
  player.x+=player.vx;
  player.y+=player.vy;

  // bounds
  if(player.x<0){ player.x=0; player.vx=0; }
  if(player.x>W-player.w){ player.x=W-player.w; player.vx=0; }
  if(player.y<0){ player.y=0; player.vy=0; }

  // ground
  const feet=player.y+player.h;
  if(feet>=GROUND_Y){
    player.y=GROUND_Y-player.h;
    player.vy=0;
    player.onGround=true;
  } else {
    player.onGround=false;
  }

  // update movers
  updateMovers();

  // collisions
  handleCollisions();

  // win: boss dead
  const boss=movers.find(m=>m.type==='boss' && !m.dead);
  if(!boss){
    state='won';
  }
}

function updateMovers(){
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];
    if(m.dead) continue;
    m.timer++;
    m.life++;
    if(m.hitFlash>0) m.hitFlash--;

    if(m.type==='bat'){
      m.bob += m.bobSpeed;
      const bobY=Math.sin(m.bob)*10;
      m.x += m.speed*m.dir;
      if(m.x<20) { m.x=20; m.dir=1; }
      if(m.x>W-40) { m.x=W-40; m.dir=-1; }
      m.y = 60 + (m.id*100 % 60) + bobY;
    }
    else if(m.type==='fireball'){
      m.x += m.speed*m.dir;
      if(m.x<20) { m.x=20; m.dir=1; }
      if(m.x>W-30) { m.x=W-30; m.dir=-1; }
      m.y = 120 + (m.id*100 % 80) + Math.sin(m.timer*0.05)*15;
    }
    else if(m.type==='boss'){
      m.attackCd--;
      // move toward player
      const dx=player.x-m.x;
      if(Math.abs(dx)>60){
        m.x += m.speed*Math.sign(dx);
        m.dir=Math.sign(dx);
      }
      // attack
      if(m.attackCd<=0){
        m.attackCd=140;
        // spawn a fireball
        addMover({
          type:'fireball',
          x:m.x+m.w/2, y:m.y+20,
          vx:0, vy:0,
          w:14, h:14,
          hp:1, maxHp:1,
          speed:2.2,
          dir:Math.sign(player.x-m.x)||1,
          maxLife:300
        });
      }
      m.bob += 0.04;
      m.y = GROUND_Y-m.h + Math.sin(m.bob)*3;
    }

    // expire
    if(m.maxLife && m.life>m.maxLife) m.dead=true;
  }
  // remove dead
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(movers[i].dead) movers.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function rectsOverlap(a,b){
  return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y;
}

function handleCollisions(){
  if(player.dead>0) return;
  if(player.invuln>0) return;

  // whip hit
  if(player.attack>0){
    const whipLen=46;
    const whipBox={
      x: player.facing>0 ? player.x+player.w : player.x-whipLen,
      y: player.y+8,
      w: whipLen,
      h: 14
    };
    for(const m of movers){
      if(m.dead) continue;
      if(rectsOverlap(whipBox,m)){
        m.hp--;
        m.hitFlash=8;
        if(m.hp<=0){
          m.dead=true;
          if(m.type==='bat') score+=50;
          else if(m.type==='fireball') score+=30;
          else if(m.type==='boss') score+=500;
          shake=8;
        } else {
          shake=3;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy contact
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.dead) continue;
    if(rectsOverlap(player,m)){
      if(player.invuln<=0){
        player.dead=1;
        player.invuln=0;
        shake=10;
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}

// ---------- draw helpers ----------
function px(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h); }

function drawBackground(){
  // sky gradient (two bands)
  px(0,0,W,H/2,PAL.sky1);
  px(0,H/2,W,H/2,PAL.sky2);

  // stars
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
    const sx=(i*73)%W;
    const sy=(i*41)%(H/2);
    if((i+((time/30)|0))%3===0) continue;
    px(sx,sy,2,2,PAL.moon);
  }

  // moon
  const mx=W-70, my=50;
  for(let dy=-18;dy<=18;dy++){
    for(let dx=-18;dx<=18;dx++){
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=324){
        px(mx+dx,my+dy,2,2,PAL.moon);
      }
    }
  }
  // moon craters
  px(mx-6,my-4,4,3,PAL.sky1);
  px(mx+4,my+6,5,3,PAL.sky1);

  // castle silhouette
  drawCastle();

  // ground
  px(0,GROUND_Y,W,H-GROUND_Y,PAL.stone);
  // ground top highlight
  px(0,GROUND_Y,W,4,PAL.wallLight);
  // ground texture
  for(let i=0;i<W/16;i++){
    px(i*16+4,GROUND_Y+10,4,4,PAL.wallDark);
    px(i*16+10,GROUND_Y+24,4,4,PAL.wallDark);
  }
}

function drawCastle(){
  const baseY=H-120;
  // main tower
  px(W/2-40,baseY,80,120,PAL.wall);
  px(W/2-40,baseY,80,8,PAL.wallLight);
  // tower roof
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    px(W/2-40+i, baseY-i, 80-i*2, 4, PAL.wallDark);
  }
  // side towers
  px(W/2-90,baseY+20,40,100,PAL.wall);
  px(W/2+50,baseY+20,40,100,PAL.wall);
  // side roofs
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
    px(W/2-90+i, baseY+20-i, 40-i*2, 3, PAL.wallDark);
    px(W/2+50+i, baseY+20-i, 40-i*2, 3, PAL.wallDark);
  }
  // windows
  px(W/2-12,baseY+30,10,14,PAL.gold);
  px(W/2+2,baseY+50,10,14,PAL.gold);
  px(W/2-70,baseY+50,10,14,PAL.gold);
  px(W/2+62,baseY+50,10,14,PAL.gold);
}

function drawPlayer(){
  if(player.dead>0){
    // dead: lying down
    const x=player.x, y=player.y+player.h-14;
    px(x,y,player.w,10,PAL.black);
    px(x+2,y-2,12,4,PAL.skin);
    return;
  }
  const x=player.x, y=player.y;
  const f=player.facing;
  const bobY = player.onGround ? Math.sin(player.anim*0.2)*1 : 0;
  const yy = y+bobY;

  // body (cape)
  px(x+2,yy+8,16,18,PAL.black);
  // head
  px(x+4,yy,12,10,PAL.skin);
  // hair
  px(x+3,yy,14,4,PAL.black);
  // eyes
  if(f>0){ px(x+12,yy+4,2,2,PAL.black); }
  else { px(x+6,yy+4,2,2,PAL.black); }
  // legs
  const step = player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx)>0.5 ? Math.sin(player.anim*0.4)*3 : 0;
  px(x+4,yy+24,4,6,PAL.black);
  px(x+12,yy+24+step,4,6,PAL.black);

  // whip
  if(player.attack>0){
    const t=player.attack/22;
    const ext = (1-t)*46;
    const wy = yy+14;
    const x0 = f>0 ? x+player.w : x;
    const x1 = f>0 ? x0+ext : x0-ext;
    // rope
    ctx.strokeStyle=PAL.rope; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0,wy);
    ctx.lineTo(x1,wy);
    ctx.stroke();
    // tip
    const tip = f>0 ? x1-4 : x1;
    px(tip,wy-4,8,8,PAL.sword);
    px(tip+2,wy-2,4,4,PAL.swordDark);
  }
}

function drawMover(m){
  if(m.dead) return;
  const x=m.x, y=m.y;
  const flash = m.hitFlash>0;
  if(m.type==='bat'){
    const flap = Math.sin(m.bob*2)*4;
    // body
    px(x+8,y+4,8,8,flash?PAL.white:PAL.bat);
    // wings
    px(x,y+4+flap,8,4,flash?PAL.white:PAL.batWing);
    px(x+16,y+4-flap,8,4,flash?PAL.white:PAL.batWing);
    // eyes
    px(x+10,y+6,2,2,PAL.gold);
    px(x+12,y+6,2,2,PAL.gold);
  }
  else if(m.type==='fireball'){
    const r=8;
    for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++){
      for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){
        if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=r*r){
          const d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)/r;
          let c = d<0.4?PAL.fireLight : d<0.7?PAL.fire : PAL.fireDark;
          if(flash) c=PAL.white;
          px(x+r+dx,y+r+dy,2,2,c);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  else if(m.type==='boss'){
    // big demon
    const bx=x, by=y;
    // body
    px(bx+8,by+16,28,30,flash?PAL.white:PAL.blood);
    // head
    px(bx+12,by+4,20,16,flash?PAL.white:PAL.blood);
    // horns
    px(bx+10,by,4,10,PAL.black);
    px(bx+30,by,4,10,PAL.black);
    // eyes
    px(bx+16,by+10,4,4,PAL.fire);
    px(bx+24,by+10,4,4,PAL.fire);
    // mouth
    px(bx+16,by+16,12,4,PAL.black);
    // arms
    px(bx+2,by+22,6,16,PAL.blood);
    px(bx+36,by+22,6,16,PAL.blood);
    // legs
    px(bx+12,by+46,8,14,PAL.blood);
    px(bx+24,by+46,8,14,PAL.blood);
    // hp bar
    const hpw = 40;
    px(bx-8,by-10,hpw,5,PAL.black);
    px(bx-8,by-10,hpw*(m.hp/m.maxHp),5,PAL.heart);
  }
}

function drawHUD(){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.gold;
  ctx.font='bold 14px "Courier New",monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score, 10, 8);

  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
    // small heart
    const hx=10+i*18, hy=28;
    px(hx,hy,6,6,PAL.heart);
    px(hx+8,hy,6,6,PAL.heart);
    px(hx+2,hy+4,10,4,PAL.heart);
    px(hx+4,hy+8,6,3,PAL.heart);
  }

  // title
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.white;
  ctx.font='bold 11px "Courier New",monospace';
  ctx.fillText("DEMON'S CASTLE", W-110, 8);
}

function drawOverlay(text,sub){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.gold;
  ctx.font='bold 28px "Courier New",monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, W/2, H/2-20);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.white;
  ctx.font='14px "Courier New",monospace';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2+18);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL.moon;
  ctx.font='12px "Courier New",monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W/2, H/2+44);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

function draw(){
  // screen shake
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
  }

  drawBackground();
  for(const m of movers){
    if(!m.dead) drawMover(m);
  }
  drawPlayer();

  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();

  if(state==='title'){
    drawOverlay("CASTLEVANIA", "DEMON'S CASTLE");
  } else if(state==='dead'){
    drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: '+score);
  } else if(state==='won'){
    drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', 'Score: '+score);
  }
}

// ---------- main loop ----------
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// init
buildLevel();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  // belt
  r(x+2,y+12,6,1,C.red);
  // legs
  r(x+2,y+14,2,4,C.yellow);
  r(x+6,y+14,2,4,C.yellow);
  // arms
  if(p.punch>0){
    const ax = f===1 ? x+8 : x-8;
    r(ax,y+7,8,3,C.white);
    r(ax+(f===1?6:-2),y+6,4,5,C.white);
  } else {
    r(x+(f===1?7:0),y+7,3,5,C.white);
  }
  if(p.inv>0 && (frame&2)) { /* flicker: skip redraw handled by alpha */ }
}

function drawEnemy(m){
  const x=m.x, y=m.y, f=m.face;
  // body (red robe)
  r(x+1,y+5,10,11,C.red);
  // head
  r(x+3,y,6,5,C.white);
  // hair
  r(x+3,y,6,2,C.black);
  // belt
  r(x+1,y+11,10,1,C.yellow);
  // legs
  r(x+2,y+14,3,4,C.red);
  r(x+7,y+14,3,4,C.red);
  // arm
  r(x+(f===1?9:0),y+7,3,5,C.white);
}

function drawProj(m){
  r(m.x,m.y,m.w,m.h,C.yellow);
  r(m.x+1,m.y+1,m.w-2,1,C.white);
}

function drawMovers(){
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.kind==='enemy') drawEnemy(m);
    else if(m.kind==='proj') drawProj(m);
  }
}

function drawHUD(){
  r(0,0,canvas.width,12,C.black);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow; ctx.font='10px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,4,2);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.red;
  ctx.fillText('GOAL 100',canvas.width-52,2);
}

function drawOverlay(){
  if(start){
    r(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height,'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)');
    ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow; ctx.font='16px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('YIE AR KUNG-FU',canvas.width/2,80);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.white; ctx.font='10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS = MOVE / JUMP',canvas.width/2,110);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE = PUNCH',canvas.width/2,124);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.green;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO FIGHT',canvas.width/2,150);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
  if(win||lose){
    r(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height,'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)');
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.font='18px monospace';
    if(win){ ctx.fillStyle=C.green; ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!',canvas.width/2,90); }
    else { ctx.fillStyle=C.red; ctx.fillText('K.O.',canvas.width/2,90); }
    ctx.fillStyle=C.white; ctx.font='10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,canvas.width/2,120);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.yellow;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RESTART',canvas.width/2,145);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawMovers();
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

// ---- loop ----
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Bomb Jack</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#000;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;}
  canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;background:#000;border:3px solid #223;box-shadow:0 0 22px #000;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var cv = document.getElementById('c');
  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  var W = 480, H = 400, TS = 16;
  var COLS = W / TS, ROWS = H / TS;

  // --- solid 8-bit palette ---
  var C = {
    bg:'#000000', wall:'#123a63', wallHi:'#2f6fb0',
    player:'#f4e11a', playerDark:'#8f7c00',
    enemy:'#e23b2e', enemyDark:'#7c1a12',
    bomb:'#000000', bombHi:'#555555',
    flame:'#ff7a1a', flameHi:'#ffe14d',
    text:'#ffffff', textDim:'#8fb4d8',
    floor:'#0b1622', floorHi:'#14283c'
  };

  // --- state ---
  var state = 'title'; // title | play | win | lose
  var score = 0, hi = 0, lives = 3, bombs = 1;
  var player = null;
  var movers = [];
  var particles = [];
  var bombsLeft = 0;
  var shake = 0;
  var frame = 0;
  var msg = '';
  var msgT = 0;

  function R(a,b){ return a + Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1)); }

  function buildLevel(){
    movers = [];
    particles = [];
    bombsLeft = 4;
    // player
    player = { x:2*TS, y:5*TS, w:12, h:12, vx:0, vy:0, face:1, step:0 };
    // enemies — each is one object with x,y,vx,vy
    var e = 4*TS;
    movers.push({ x:e, y:1*TS, w:14, h:14, vx:1.1, vy:0, kind:'walker', phase:R(0,6) });
    movers.push({ x:5*TS, y:6*TS, w:14, h:14, vx:1.3, vy:0, kind:'walker', phase:R(0,6) });
    movers.push({ x:3*TS, y:3*TS, w:14, h:14, vx:0, vy:0, kind:'floater', t:R(0,6), home:{x:3*TS,y:3*TS} });
    movers.push({ x:6*TS, y:4*TS, w:14, h:14, vx:0, vy:0, kind:'floater', t:R(0,6), home:{x:6*TS,y:4*TS} });
  }

  function startGame(){
    score = 0; lives = 3; bombs = 1;
    buildLevel();
    state = 'play';
    msg = ''; msgT = 0;
  }

  function die(){
    lives--;
    if(lives <= 0){
      state = 'lose';
      if(score > hi) hi = score;
    } else {
      buildLevel();
      msg = 'OUCH!'; msgT = 60;
    }
  }

  function win(){
    state = 'win';
    if(score > hi) hi = score;
  }

  function explode(x,y,rad){
    shake = 10;
    for(var i=0;i<26;i++){
      var a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sp = 0.5 + Math.random()*3;
      particles.push({ x:x, y:y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp - 0.5,
        life: 24 + Math.random()*20, col: Math.random()<0.5?C.flame:C.flameHi });
    }
    // remove any enemy inside the blast
    for(var j=movers.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      var m = movers[j];
      var dx = (m.x + m.w/2) - x, dy = (m.y + m.h/2) - y;
      if(dx*dx + dy*dy < rad*rad){
        score += 100;
        movers.splice(j,1);
      }
    }
  }

  // --- input ---
  var keys = {};
  var pressed = {};
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var k = e.key;
    if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' ','w','a','s','d','Enter'].indexOf(k) !== -1) e.preventDefault();
    if(!keys[k]) pressed[k] = true;
    keys[k] = true;
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[e.key] = false; });

  function inWall(x,y){
    if(x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= W || y >= H) return true;
    var cx = Math.floor(x/TS), cy = Math.floor(y/TS);
    return walls[cx + ',' + cy] === true;
  }
  function moveObj(o, nx, ny){
    // resolve axis by axis against walls
    if(!inWall(nx, o.y) && !inWall(nx + o.w, o.y) &&
       !inWall(nx, o.y + o.h) && !inWall(nx + o.w, o.y + o.h)) o.x = nx;
    if(!inWall(o.x, ny) && !inWall(o.x + o.w, ny) &&
       !inWall(o.x, ny + o.h) && !inWall(o.x + o.w, ny + o.h)) o.y = ny;
  }
  function overlap(a,b){
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  // --- level: build a short pattern of walls (a few blocks, not a tile map) ---
  var walls = {};
  (function buildWalls(){
    // top and bottom border
    for(var x=0;x<COLS;x++){ walls[x+',0']=true; walls[x+','+(ROWS-1)]=true; }
    for(var y=0;y<ROWS;y++){ walls['0,'+y]=true; walls[(COLS-1)+','+y]=true; }
    // a few interior blocks, generated by a short loop
    var blocks = [
      [3,2,3,1],[9,3,2,2],[14,2,2,1],[5,5,1,2],
      [11,5,3,1],[16,4,2,2],[2,6,2,1],[18,6,2,1]
    ];
    for(var i=0;i<blocks.length;i++){
      var b = blocks[i];
      for(var bx=b[0];bx<b[0]+b[2];bx++){
        for(var by=b[1];by<b[1]+b[3];by++){
          walls[bx+','+by]=true;
        }
      }
    }
  })();

  // --- update ---
  function update(){
    frame++;
    if(msgT > 0) msgT--;
    if(shake > 0) shake--;
    if(state !== 'play'){
      if(pressed['Enter'] || pressed[' ']){
        if(state === 'title') startGame();
        else { state = 'title'; }
      }
      return;
    }

    // player movement
    var sp = 2.1;
    var mx = 0, my = 0;
    if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']) mx -= 1;
    if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']) mx += 1;
    if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']) my -= 1;
    if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']) my += 1;
    if(mx !== 0 && my !== 0){ mx *= 0.707; my *= 0.707; }
    player.vx = mx * sp; player.vy = my * sp;
    if(mx !== 0) player.face = mx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    if((mx !== 0 || my !== 0) && frame % 8 === 0) player.step = 1 - player.step;
    moveObj(player, player.x + player.vx, player.y + player.vy);

    // drop bombs
    if(pressed[' ']){
      if(bombs > 0){
        bombs--;
        bombsLeft++;
        movers.push({ x:player.x + player.w/2 - 5, y:player.y + player.h/2 - 5,
          w:10, h:10, vx:0, vy:0, kind:'bomb', fuse:70 });
      }
    }

    // movers: move them, drop the ones that are done, then draw
    for(var i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var m = movers[i];
      if(m.kind === 'bomb'){
        m.fuse--;
        if(m.fuse <= 0){
          explode(m.x + m.w/2, m.y + m.h/2, 34);
          bombsLeft--;
          movers.splice(i,1);
          continue;
        }
      } else if(m.kind === 'walker'){
        m.x += m.vx;
        // bounce off walls / edges
        if(inWall(m.x, m.y) || inWall(m.x + m.w, m.y)){
          m.x -= m.vx; m.vx = -m.vx;
        }
        if(inWall(m.x, m.y + m.h) || inWall(m.x + m.w, m.y + m.h)){
          m.vx = -m.vx;
        }
      } else if(m.kind === 'floater'){
        m.t += 0.05;
        m.x = m.home.x + Math.cos(m.t) * 26;
        m.y = m.home.y + Math.sin(m.t * 1.3) * 20;
      }
      // enemy touches player => die
      if(m.kind === 'walker' || m.kind === 'floater'){
        if(overlap(m, player)){
          die();
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // particles
    for(var p=particles.length-1;p>=0;p--){
      var pt = particles[p];
      pt.x += pt.vx; pt.y += pt.vy; pt.vy += 0.12; pt.life--;
      if(pt.life <= 0) particles.splice(p,1);
    }

    // win: all enemies gone and no bombs pending
    var enemies = 0;
    for(var k=0;k<movers.length;k++){
      if(movers[k].kind === 'walker' || movers[k].kind === 'floater') enemies++;
    }
    if(enemies === 0 && bombsLeft === 0){
      score += 500;
      win();
    }

    // clear one-frame press flags
    pressed = {};
  }

  // --- draw helpers ---
  function rect(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h); }

  function drawBackground(){
    rect(0,0,W,H,C.bg);
    // floor grid (subtle)
    for(var x=0;x<COLS;x++){
      for(var y=0;y<ROWS;y++){
        if(walls[x+','+y]) continue;
        if((x+y) % 2 === 0) rect(x*TS, y*TS, TS, TS, C.floor);
        else rect(x*TS, y*TS, TS, TS, C.floorHi);
      }
    }
    // walls
    for(var x2=0;x2<COLS;x2++){
      for(var y2=0;y2<ROWS;y2++){
        if(!walls[x2+','+y2]) continue;
        var px = x2*TS, py = y2*TS;
        rect(px, py, TS, TS, C.wall);
        rect(px, py, TS, 2, C.wallHi);
        rect(px, py, 2, TS, C.wallHi);
        rect(px+TS-2, py, 2, TS, C.wallDark||C.wall);
        // little rivets
        rect(px+4, py+4, 2, 2, C.wallHi);
        rect(px+10, py+10, 2, 2, C.wallHi);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    if(!player) return;
    var x = Math.round(player.x), y = Math.round(player.y);
    // legs (bob)
    var leg = player.step ? 1 : 0;
    rect(x+2, y+10, 3, 2+leg, C.playerDark);
    rect(x+7, y+10, 3, 2+(1-leg), C.playerDark);
    // body
    rect(x+2, y+5, 8, 6, C.player);
    rect(x+2, y+5, 8, 2, C.playerDark);
    // head
    rect(x+3, y+1, 6, 5, C.player);
    rect(x+3, y+1, 6, 1, C.playerDark);
    // eyes
    var ex = player.face > 0 ? x+7 : x+3;
    rect(ex, y+3, 2, 2, C.bg);
    // little antenna
    rect(x+5, y-1, 2, 2, C.player);
  }

  function drawEnemy(m){
    var x = Math.round(m.x), y = Math.round(m.y);
    if(m.kind === 'floater'){
      // winged floater
      var wob = (Math.floor(frame/6) % 2) ? 1 : 0;
      rect(x-2, y+3+wob, 4, 3, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+m.w-2, y+3+wob, 4, 3, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+2, y+2, m.w-4, m.h-4, C.enemy);
      rect(x+3, y+3, m.w-6, 2, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+4, y+6, 3, 3, C.bg);
      rect(x+m.w-7, y+6, 3, 3, C.bg);
    } else {
      // walker: body + eyes + feet
      var step = (Math.floor(frame/8) % 2) ? 1 : 0;
      rect(x+2, y+m.h-3, 4, 3, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+m.w-6, y+m.h-3, 4, 3, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+2, y+2, m.w-4, m.h-5, C.enemy);
      rect(x+2, y+2, m.w-4, 2, C.enemyDark);
      rect(x+4, y+6, 3, 3, C.bg);
      rect(x+m.w-7, y+6, 3, 3, C.bg);
      rect(x+4, y+6, 1, 1, C.flame);
      rect(x+m.w-7, y+6, 1, 1, C.flame);
    }
  }

  function drawBomb(m){
    var x = Math.round(m.x), y = Math.round(m.y);
    rect(x+1, y+2, m.w-2, m.h-3, C.bomb);
    rect(x+1, y+2, m.w-2, 2, C.bombHi);
    rect(x+3, y, 4, 3, C.bombHi);
    // fuse spark
    if(Math.floor(frame/4) % 2 === 0){
      rect(x+5, y-2, 2, 2, C.flameHi);
    }
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){
      var p = particles[i];
      rect(Math.round(p.x), Math.round(p.y), 3, 3, p.col);
    }
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    // top bar
    rect(0,0,W,14,C.bg);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.text; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(score).padStart(5,'0'), 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.textDim;
    ctx.fillText('HI '+String(hi).padStart(5,'0'), 150, 3);
    // lives
    ctx.fillStyle = C.text;
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', 250, 3);
    for(var i=0;i<lives;i++) rect(292 + i*12, 3, 8, 8, C.player);
    // bombs
    ctx.fillStyle = C.text;
    ctx.fillText('BOMBS', 350, 3);
    for(var b=0;b<bombs;b++) rect(392 + b*12, 3, 8, 8, C.bombHi);
  }

  function centerText(t, y, c, size){
    ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.font = (size||14)+'px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(t, W/2, y); ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawOverlay(){
    if(state === 'title'){
      rect(0,0,W,H,'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)');
      centerText('BOMB JACK', 120, C.player, 34);
      centerText('THE CLASSIC 8-BIT BLASTER', 158, C.textDim, 12);
      centerText('BOMB THE ENEMIES. DON\u2019T GET BOMBED.', 190, C.text, 11);
      centerText('ARROWS / WASD  -  MOVE', 230, C.text, 12);
      centerText('SPACE  -  DROP BOMB', 250, C.text, 12);
      if(Math.floor(frame/20) % 2 === 0) centerText('PRESS ENTER TO START', 300, C.flameHi, 14);
    } else if(state === 'win'){
      rect(0,0,W,H,'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)');
      centerText('YOU CLEARED THE LEVEL!', 130, C.flameHi, 20);
      centerText('FINAL SCORE  '+score, 175, C.text, 16);
      if(Math.floor(frame/20) % 2 === 0) centerText('PRESS ENTER FOR TITLE', 250, C.text, 12);
    } else if(state === 'lose'){
      rect(0,0,W,H,'rgba(0,0,0,0.78)');
      centerText('GAME OVER', 130, C.enemy, 30);
      centerText('SCORE  '+score+'    HI  '+hi, 180, C.text, 15);
      if(Math.floor(frame/20) % 2 === 0) centerText('PRESS ENTER FOR TITLE', 250, C.text, 12);
    }
    if(state === 'play' && msgT > 0){
      centerText(msg, 60, C.flameHi, 18);
    }
  }

  function draw(){
    var ox = 0, oy = 0;
    if(shake > 0){ ox = R(-shake,shake); oy = R(-shake,shake); }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);
    drawBackground();
    for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      var m = movers[i];
      if(m.kind === 'bomb') drawBomb(m);
      else drawEnemy(m);
    }
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();
  }

  // --- main loop ---
  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Meteor Mission 2</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04050d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  #c{image-rendering:pixelated;width:min(96vw,92vh);height:auto;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #123,0 0 40px #000;cursor:none;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="320" height="240"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=320,H=240,GROUND=214;
const C={sky:'#0a1030',star:'#cfe6ff',ground:'#33344f',ground2:'#191a30',
  ship:'#f2f2f2',wing:'#ff9a2e',engine:'#ff5a2e',ex:'#ffe6a8',
  meteor:'#8a5a30',meteor2:'#5a3a1e',text:'#ffffff'};
const KEY={left:['ArrowLeft','a','A'],right:['ArrowRight','d','D'],
  jump:[' ','w','W','ArrowUp','z','Z'],fire:['x','X','j','J']};
const inSet=(s,c)=>s.indexOf(c)>=0;
const key=(s)=>{for(const c of s)if(keys[c])return true;return false;};

// ---------- state ----------
let state='title',frame=0,shake=0,flash=0;
const keys={};
const player={x:120,y:GROUND-24,vx:0,vy:0,w:22,h:24,onGround:true,cool:0,inv:0,
  face:1,thrust:0,aim:0,aimx:0,aimy:0};
const movers=[];
const bullets=[];
const stars=[];
const clouds=[];
const meteors=[];
const particles=[];
const HUD={score:0,life:3,meteor:3,meteorTimer:150};

// ---------- init ----------
function init(){
  movers.length=0;bullets.length=0;particles.length=0;
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++)stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H*0.7,
    s:Math.random()<0.25?2:1,tw:Math.random()*6});
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++)clouds.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:30+Math.random()*70,
    w:40+Math.random()*40,spd:0.15+Math.random()*0.2});
  HUD.score=0;HUD.life=3;HUD.meteor=3;HUD.meteorTimer=150;
  resetPlayer();
}
function resetPlayer(){
  player.x=120;player.y=GROUND-24;player.vx=0;player.vy=0;
  player.onGround=true;player.cool=0;player.inv=0;player.face=1;
  player.thrust=0;player.aim=0;
}
function startGame(){
  init();
  state='play';
  spawnMover();
}

// ---------- spawners ----------
function spawnMover(){
  const fromLeft=Math.random()<0.5;
  const x=fromLeft?-24:W+24;
  const y=24+Math.random()*120;
  const dir=fromLeft?1:-1;
  const vx=dir*(1.2+Math.random()*1.2);
  const vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.6;
  const r=13+Math.random()*10;
  movers.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,kind:'mover',t:Math.random()*6,
    spin:0,spinv:0.05+Math.random()*0.08,
    pts:[{x:1,y:0.2},{x:0.5,y:0.8},{x:-0.4,y:0.7},{x:-0.9,y:0.1},
         {x:-0.7,y:-0.5},{x:0,y:-0.85},{x:0.7,y:-0.4}]});
}
function spawnMeteors(){
  const n=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const x=20+Math.random()*(W-40);
    meteors.push({x,y:-20-Math.random()*30,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.8,
      vy:2.4+Math.random()*1.6,r:10+Math.random()*8,rot:Math.random()*6,
      spin:0.15+Math.random()*0.15,
      pts:[{x:1,y:0},{x:0.4,y:0.8},{x:-0.5,y:0.7},{x:-0.9,y:0},
           {x:-0.5,y:-0.8},{x:0.4,y:-0.85}]});
  }
}
function spawnExplosion(x,y,n,base){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.2832,sp=0.5+Math.random()*2.5;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-0.5,
      life:20+Math.random()*20,max:40,c:Math.random()<0.5?base:'#ffe6a8'});
  }
}
function fireBullet(){
  const a=player.aim;
  const px=player.x+player.face*12,py=player.y-2;
  bullets.push({x:px,y:py,vx:Math.cos(a)*5,vy:Math.sin(a)*5,life:80});
  player.cool=10;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    particles.push({x:px,y:py,vx:Math.cos(a)*2+(Math.random()-0.5),
      vy:Math.sin(a)*2+(Math.random()-0.5),life:8,max:8,c:C.engine});
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if(e.key==='Enter'&&state!=='play')startGame();
  if(e.key==='r'&&state==='gameover')startGame();
  if(inSet(KEY.jump,e.key)||inSet(KEY.left,e.key)||inSet(KEY.right,e.key)||
     inSet(KEY.fire,e.key))e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{for(const k in keys)keys[k]=false;});
cv.addEventListener('mousedown',()=>{
  if(state!=='play')startGame();
  else fireBullet();
});

// ---------- update ----------
function update(){
  frame++;
  if(shake>0)shake-=0.6;
  if(flash>0)flash--;
  // stars twinkle + clouds drift (always)
  for(const s of stars)s.tw+=0.15;
  for(const c of clouds){c.x+=c.spd;if(c.x>W+c.w)c.x=-c.w;}
  // particles always
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.08;p.life--;
    if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);
  }
  if(state==='title'){
    // gentle demo meteors
    if(frame%120===0)spawnMeteors();
    updateMeteors();
    return;
  }
  if(state==='gameover'){
    updateMeteors();
    return;
  }
  // ---- PLAY ----
  // player horizontal
  const L=key(KEY.left),R=key(KEY.right),J=key(KEY.jump),F=key(KEY.fire);
  let ax=0;
  if(L)ax-=0.55;
  if(R)ax+=0.55;
  player.vx+=ax;
  player.vx*=0.82;
  if(player.vx>3.4)player.vx=3.4;
  if(player.vx<-3.4)player.vx=-3.4;
  if(ax>0)player.face=1;else if(ax<0)player.face=-1;
  // jump
  if(J&&player.onGround){player.vy=-6.4;player.onGround=false;
    spawnExplosion(player.x,player.y+12,6,C.ex);}
  // gravity
  player.vy+=0.32;
  if(player.vy>7)player.vy=7;
  // integrate
  player.x+=player.vx;
  player.y+=player.vy;
  if(player.x<14){player.x=14;player.vx=0;}
  if(player.x>W-14){player.x=W-14;player.vx=0;}
  if(player.y>GROUND-12){player.y=GROUND-12;player.vy=0;player.onGround=true;}
  else player.onGround=false;
  if(player.cool>0)player.cool--;
  if(player.inv>0)player.inv--;
  // aim
  const mv=nearestMover();
  if(mv){
    const dx=mv.x-player.x,dy=mv.y-(player.y-2);
    const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    player.aim=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
    player.aimx=dx/d;player.aimy=dy/d;
    player.thrust=1;
  }else{player.thrust=0;}
  // fire
  if(F&&player.cool<=0)fireBullet();
  // bullets
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bullets[i];b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;b.life--;
    if(b.life<=0||b.x<-8||b.x>W+8||b.y<-8||b.y>H+8){bullets.splice(i,1);continue;}
    let hit=false;
    for(let j=movers.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const m=movers[j];
      if(Math.hypot(b.x-m.x,b.y-m.y)<m.r){
        spawnExplosion(m.x,m.y,16,C.meteor2);
        movers.splice(j,1);
        HUD.score+=100;
        shake=6;flash=4;
        hit=true;break;
      }
    }
    if(hit)bullets.splice(i,1);
  }
  // movers
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];m.x+=m.vx;m.y+=m.vy;m.spin+=m.spinv;m.t++;
    if(m.y<14)m.vy+=0.03;
    if(m.y>H-14)m.vy-=0.03;
    // collide player
    if(player.inv<=0&&Math.hypot(m.x-player.x,m.y-player.y)<m.r+11){
      player.inv=60;shake=8;
      HUD.life--;
      spawnExplosion(player.x,player.y,14,C.wing);
      if(HUD.life<=0){state='gameover';}
      else{resetPlayer();}
    }
    // off screen
    if(m.x<-40||m.x>W+40||m.y<-40||m.y>H+40)movers.splice(i,1);
  }
  // spawn next mover
  if(movers.length===0){
    if(HUD.meteor>0){
      spawnMeteors();
      HUD.meteor--;
      HUD.meteorTimer=0;
    }else{
      spawnMover();
    }
  }
  // meteor timer
  HUD.meteorTimer++;
  if(HUD.meteorTimer>180)HUD.meteorTimer=0;
  // meteors
  updateMeteors();
  // meteor hits player
  for(const mt of meteors){
    if(player.inv<=0&&Math.hypot(mt.x-player.x,mt.y-player.y)<mt.r+10){
      player.inv=60;shake=8;HUD.life--;
      spawnExplosion(player.x,player.y,14,C.engine);
      if(HUD.life<=0)state='gameover';else resetPlayer();
    }
  }
}
function updateMeteors(){
  for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=meteors[i];m.x+=m.vx;m.y+=m.vy;m.rot+=m.spin;
    if(m.y>GROUND){
      spawnExplosion(m.x,GROUND-4,10,C.engine);
      meteors.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function nearestMover(){
  let best=null,bd=1e9;
  for(const m of movers){const d=Math.hypot(m.x-player.x,m.y-player.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=m;}}
  return best;
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
  // sky
  ctx.fillStyle=C.sky;ctx.fillRect(-10,-10,W+20,H+20);
  // stars
  for(const s of stars){
    const a=0.4+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
    ctx.globalAlpha=a;
    ctx.fillStyle=C.star;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(s.x),Math.round(s.y),s.s,s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // clouds
  for(const c of clouds){
    ctx.fillStyle='#1b2450';
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(c.x),Math.round(c.y),Math.round(c.w),10);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(c.x+8),Math.round(c.y-6),Math.round(c.w*0.6),8);
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(c.x+14),Math.round(c.y+8),Math.round(c.w*0.5),6);
  }
  // ground
  ctx.fillStyle=C.ground;ctx.fillRect(-10,GROUND,W+20,H-GROUND+10);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.ground2;
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=16)ctx.fillRect(x,GROUND+10,10,4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3d3e60';
  for(let x=8;x<W;x+=24)ctx.fillRect(x,GROUND+18,14,3);
  // meteors
  for(const m of meteors){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);ctx.rotate(m.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.meteor;
    for(const p of m.pts)ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x*m.r)-2,Math.round(p.y*m.r)-2,5,5);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.meteor2;
    for(const p of m.pts)ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x*m.r*0.5)-1,Math.round(p.y*m.r*0.5)-1,3,3);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // movers
  for(const m of movers){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);ctx.rotate(m.spin);
    // engine flame (behind, opposite vx)
    const fx=-Math.sign(m.vx)*m.r;
    ctx.fillStyle=C.engine;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(fx)-3,Math.round(-2),6,5);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(fx)-2,Math.round(-1),4,3);
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle=C.meteor;
    for(const p of m.pts)ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x*m.r)-3,Math.round(p.y*m.r)-3,7,7);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.meteor2;
    for(const p of m.pts)ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x*m.r*0.55)-2,Math.round(p.y*m.r*0.55)-2,5,5);
    ctx.fillStyle='#3a2412';
    ctx.fillRect(-2,-2,5,5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // bullets
  for(const b of bullets){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.engine;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(b.x)-2,Math.round(b.y)-2,5,5);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(b.x)-1,Math.round(b.y)-1,3,3);
  }
  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.c;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(p.x)-1,Math.round(p.y)-1,3,3);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // player
  if(state!=='gameover')drawPlayer();
  // flash
  if(flash>0){ctx.globalAlpha=flash/4*0.5;ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(-10,-10,W+20,H+20);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
  ctx.restore();
  // HUD / overlays
  if(state==='play')drawHUD();
  if(state==='title')drawTitle();
  if(state==='gameover')drawGameOver();
}
function drawPlayer(){
  const p=player;
  const x=Math.round(p.x),y=Math.round(p.y);
  const f=p.face;
  if(p.inv>0&&Math.floor(frame/4)%2===0)return;
  // engine flame (behind)
  const ex=x-f*12;
  ctx.fillStyle=C.engine;ctx.fillRect(ex-3,y-2,6,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;ctx.fillRect(ex-2,y-1,4,3);
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle=C.wing;
  ctx.fillRect(x-11,y-2,7,10);
  ctx.fillRect(x+4,y-2,7,10);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=C.ship;
  ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-12,12,24);
  ctx.fillRect(x-9,y-4,18,14);
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a3a6a';
  ctx.fillRect(x+f*1-4,y-9,8,6);
  ctx.fillStyle='#7fd0ff';
  ctx.fillRect(x+f*1-3,y-8,6,4);
  // gun barrel toward aim
  const gx=x+Math.round(p.aimx*12),gy=y-2+Math.round(p.aimy*8);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.ship;
  ctx.fillRect(gx-2,gy-2,5,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.wing;
  ctx.fillRect(gx-1,gy-1,3,3);
  // thrust glow when aiming
  if(p.thrust>0){
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;
    ctx.fillRect(x-2,y-14,4,3);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text;
  ctx.font='12px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(HUD.score).padStart(5,'0'),8,8);
  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<HUD.life;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.wing;ctx.fillRect(150+i*16,8,10,10);
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ship;ctx.fillRect(152+i*16,6,6,6);
  }
  // meteor counter
  ctx.fillStyle=C.meteor;
  for(let i=0;i<HUD.meteor;i++)ctx.fillRect(250+i*14,8,10,10);
  // timer bar
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f55';ctx.fillRect(8,22,120,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.wing;
  ctx.fillRect(8,22,Math.min(120,HUD.meteorTimer/180*120),5);
}
function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,5,13,0.72)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.wing;ctx.font='bold 26px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('METEOR MISSION 2',W/2,70);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text;ctx.font='12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('MOVE  A/D or ARROWS',W/2,110);
  ctx.fillText('JUMP  SPACE / W',W/2,128);
  ctx.fillText('FIRE  X / J (auto-aims at movers)',W/2,146);
  ctx.fillText('BLAST EVERY METEOR. 3 HITS = GAME OVER',W/2,164);
  if(Math.floor(frame/20)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;ctx.font='bold 14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START',W/2,196);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function drawGameOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,5,13,0.78)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle=C.engine;ctx.font='bold 28px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,90);
  ctx.fillStyle=C.text;ctx.font='14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+HUD.score,W/2,130);
  if(Math.floor(frame/20)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle=C.ex;ctx.font='bold 13px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS R OR ENTER TO RETRY',W/2,165);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

// ---------- loop ----------
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
init();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Alter Ego</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #111;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    border: 4px solid #444;
    background: #000;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="320"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

// ---- palette (six solid colors + a couple of accents) ----
const C = {
  bg:   '#1a1a2e',
  ink:  '#0d0d1a',
  white:'#f2f2f2',
  red:  '#e63946',
  blue:  '#3d5afe',
  amber: '#f4a261',
  green: '#2ec4b6',
  grey:  '#555a7a',
  dark:  '#0a0a12',
};

// ---- state ----
let state = 'start';   // start | play | win | lose
let score = 0;
let frame = 0;

const player = {
  x: 240, y: 150, w: 22, h: 30,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  speed: 2.4,
  facing: 1,
  alive: true,
};

// one array for every mover (enemies, bullets, particles)
let movers = [];

function addMover(o) { movers.push(o); }

function spawnEnemy() {
  const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  let x, y, vx, vy;
  const sp = 1.0 + Math.random() * 1.2;
  if (side === 0)      { x = -20; y = Math.random() * 320; vx = sp; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6; }
  else if (side === 1)  { x = 500; y = Math.random() * 320; vx = -sp; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6; }
  else if (side === 2)  { x = Math.random() * 480; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6; vy = sp; }
  else                  { x = Math.random() * 480; y = 340; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6; vy = -sp; }
  addMover({ type: 'enemy', x, y, vx, vy, w: 20, h: 20, life: 0, spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
}

function fireBullet() {
  const dir = player.facing;
  addMover({ type: 'bullet', x: player.x + player.w / 2 + dir * 14, y: player.y + player.h / 2, vx: dir * 5, vy: 0, w: 8, h: 4, life: 0 });
}

function burst(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = 1 + Math.random() * 2.5;
    addMover({ type: 'spark', x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, w: 3, h: 3, life: 0, max: 20 + Math.random() * 15, color });
  }
}

function reset() {
  score = 0;
  frame = 0;
  movers = [];
  player.x = 240; player.y = 150; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0; player.facing = 1; player.alive = true;
}

// ---- input ----
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(e.key.toLowerCase()) || e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();

  if (state === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { reset(); state = 'play'; }
  else if ((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { reset(); state = 'play'; }

  if (state === 'play') {
    if (k === ' ' && player.alive) fireBullet();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---- update ----
function update() {
  frame++;

  if (state === 'play') {
    // player movement
    let ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keys['arrowleft']  || keys['a']) { ax -= 1; player.facing = -1; }
    if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) { ax += 1; player.facing = 1; }
    if (keys['arrowup']    || keys['w']) ay -= 1;
    if (keys['arrowdown']  || keys['s']) ay += 1;
    const m = Math.hypot(ax, ay) || 1;
    player.x += (ax / m) * player.speed;
    player.y += (ay / m) * player.speed;
    player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(480 - player.w, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(320 - player.h, player.y));

    // spawn enemies
    if (frame % 55 === 0) spawnEnemy();
    if (frame > 300 && frame % 40 === 0) spawnEnemy();

    // move movers
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const o = movers[i];
      o.x += o.vx;
      o.y += o.vy;
      o.life++;
      if (o.type === 'spark') o.vy += 0.05;

      let done = false;
      if (o.type === 'enemy') {
        if (o.x < -40 || o.x > 520 || o.y < -40 || o.y > 360) done = true;
        // collision with player
        if (player.alive &&
            o.x < player.x + player.w && o.x + o.w > player.x &&
            o.y < player.y + player.h && o.y + o.h > player.y) {
          player.alive = false;
          burst(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, C.red);
          done = true;
          setTimeout(() => { state = 'lose'; }, 400);
        }
      } else if (o.type === 'bullet') {
        if (o.x < -20 || o.x > 500) done = true;
        for (let j = movers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          const e = movers[j];
          if (e.type !== 'enemy') continue;
          if (o.x < e.x + e.w && o.x + o.w > e.x &&
              o.y < e.y + e.h && o.y + o.h > e.y) {
            burst(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, C.amber);
            movers.splice(j, 1);
            score += 10;
            done = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      } else if (o.type === 'spark') {
        if (o.life >= o.max) done = true;
      }
      if (done) movers.splice(i, 1);
    }

    if (!player.alive && state === 'play') { /* handled above */ }
  }
}

// ---- draw helpers (chunky rectangles, no per-pixel sprites) ----
function drawBackground() {
  // sky
  ctx.fillStyle = C.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 480, 320);
  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = C.grey;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const x = (i * 97 + 13) % 480;
    const y = (i * 53 + 7) % 200;
    const tw = ((i + frame) % 60) < 30 ? 2 : 1;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, tw, tw);
  }
  // ground grid (retro floor)
  ctx.fillStyle = C.ink;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 250, 480, 70);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.dark;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    ctx.fillRect(i * 44, 250, 2, 70);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = C.grey;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 250, 480, 2);
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (!player.alive) return;
  const x = player.x, y = player.y;
  // body (suit)
  ctx.fillStyle = C.blue;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 10, 16, 16);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y, 12, 12);
  // mask / eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = C.red;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 4, 4, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 12, y + 4, 4, 3);
  // belt
  ctx.fillStyle = C.amber;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 22, 16, 3);
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle = C.grey;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y + 26, 5, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 12, y + 26, 5, 4);
  // arm / gun
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  if (player.facing > 0) ctx.fillRect(x + 16, y + 14, 8, 4);
  else ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + 14, 8, 4);
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  const x = e.x, y = e.y;
  // diamond-shaped flying drone
  ctx.fillStyle = C.red;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y, 8, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 4, 12, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 16, 8, 4);
  // core
  ctx.fillStyle = C.amber;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 8, y + 8, 4, 4);
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle = C.grey;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y + 6, 4, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 16, y + 6, 4, 8);
}

function drawBullet(b) {
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.amber;
  ctx.fillRect(b.x + (b.vx > 0 ? b.w - 3 : 0), b.y, 3, b.h);
}

function drawSpark(s) {
  const a = Math.max(0, 1 - s.life / s.max);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
  ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + String(score).padStart(5, '0'), 10, 8);
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = C.ink;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 480, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 480, 320);

  // big title
  ctx.fillStyle = C.red;
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('ALTER EGO', 240, 110);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.amber;
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('— 8-BIT —', 240, 150);

  // controls
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.font = '13px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD  MOVE', 240, 200);
  ctx.fillText('SPACE  FIRE', 240, 222);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.green;
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', 240, 265);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawEnd(win) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 480, 320);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = win ? C.green : C.red;
  ctx.font = 'bold 34px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText(win ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'GAME OVER', 240, 140);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.white;
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  ' + score, 240, 185);
  ctx.fillStyle = C.amber;
  ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN', 240, 230);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// ---- draw ----
function draw() {
  if (state === 'start') { drawTitle(); return; }

  drawBackground();
  for (const o of movers) {
    if (o.type === 'enemy') drawEnemy(o);
    else if (o.type === 'bullet') drawBullet(o);
    else if (o.type === 'spark') drawSpark(o);
  }
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === 'win') drawEnd(true);
  if (state === 'lose') drawEnd(false);
}

// ---- loop ----
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Batman: The Movie</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#05050f;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;background:#05050f;border:4px solid #2a2a55;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="320" height="200"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
var cv = document.getElementById('c');
var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
var W = cv.width, H = cv.height;
var GROUND = 164;

var COL = {
  sky:'#0a0a24', hill:'#16163f', moon:'#e9e9d0',
  bat:'#f2c230', batline:'#7a5a10',
  batskin:'#33334a', batsuit:'#111122', batcape:'#1c1c3a',
  batbelt:'#f2c230', batcowl:'#111122',
  jskin:'#6a3a24', jsuit:'#20202a', jhair:'#3a2410',
  jarm:'#1a1a24',
  brick:'#3a2418', brickdark:'#241610',
  win:'#f2c230', winoff:'#1a1a2a',
  text:'#f2c230', text2:'#e9e9d0',
  red:'#b03030', green:'#40c070'
};

var state = {
  screen:'title',
  score:0,
  lives:3,
  t:0,
  shake:0,
  winT:0,
  loseT:0,
  winFlash:0
};

var player = { x:60, y:GROUND-24, w:16, h:24, vx:0, vy:0, onGround:true, facing:1, throwCd:0, invuln:0, blink:0, alive:true };

var movers = [];
var bullets = [];
var particles = [];
var stars = [];
var buildings = [];

var keys = {};
var throwPressed = false;

for (var i=0;i<40;i++){
  stars.push({ x:(Math.random()*W)|0, y:(Math.random()*120)|0, s:Math.random()<0.5?1:2, tw:Math.random()*6 });
}

function makeBuildings(){
  buildings.length = 0;
  var x = 0;
  while (x < W){
    var bw = 28 + ((Math.random()*26)|0);
    var bh = 46 + ((Math.random()*70)|0);
    var b = { x:x, w:bw, h:bh, y:GROUND-bh, wins:[] };
    for (var wy=b.y+8; wy<GROUND-10; wy+=14){
      for (var wx=b.x+5; wx<b.x+bw-6; wx+=12){
        if (Math.random()<0.55) b.wins.push({x:wx,y:wy,on:Math.random()<0.7});
      }
    }
    buildings.push(b);
    x += bw + 2;
  }
}
makeBuildings();

function spawnJoker(){
  var fromLeft = Math.random()<0.5;
  movers.push({
    type:'joker',
    x: fromLeft? -24 : W+8,
    y: GROUND-26,
    w:16, h:26,
    vx: fromLeft? 0.55 : -0.55,
    vy: 0,
    alive:true,
    shootCd: 60 + ((Math.random()*90)|0),
    face: fromLeft? 1 : -1
  });
}
function spawnBat(){
  movers.push({
    type:'bat',
    x: 20 + ((Math.random()*(W-40))|0),
    y: 10 + ((Math.random()*40)|0),
    w:14, h:8,
    vx: (Math.random()<0.5? -1:1) * (1.0 + Math.random()*0.8),
    vy: (Math.random()<0.5? -0.5:0.5),
    alive:true,
    life: 9999
  });
}
function spawnBatSignal(){
  movers.push({
    type:'signal',
    x: 20 + ((Math.random()*(W-40))|0),
    y: 20 + ((Math.random()*60)|0),
    w:12, h:12,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    alive:true,
    life: 420
  });
}
function spawnBatSignalWin(){
  movers.push({
    type:'signal',
    x: (W/2)|0,
    y: 60,
    w:12, h:12,
    vx:0, vy:0,
    alive:true,
    life: 9999,
    win:true
  });
}

function addParticle(x,y,vx,vy,color,life){
  particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:vx,vy:vy,color:color,life:life,max:life});
}
function burst(x,y,color,n){
  for (var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    var sp = 0.5 + Math.random()*1.6;
    addParticle(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp-0.5,color,20+((Math.random()*20)|0));
  }
}

function resetGame(){
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = 3;
  state.t = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.winT = 0;
  state.loseT = 0;
  state.winFlash = 0;
  player.x = 60; player.y = GROUND-24; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
  player.onGround=true; player.facing=1; player.throwCd=0; player.invuln=0; player.alive=true;
  movers.length = 0;
  bullets.length = 0;
  particles.length = 0;
  for (var i=0;i<3;i++) spawnJoker();
  for (var j=0;j<3;j++) spawnBat();
}

function startGame(){
  resetGame();
  state.screen = 'play';
}

function hurtPlayer(){
  if (player.invuln>0 || !player.alive) return;
  state.lives--;
  player.invuln = 90;
  state.shake = 8;
  burst(player.x+player.w/2, player.y+player.h/2, COL.batskin, 10);
  if (state.lives<=0){
    player.alive=false;
    state.screen='lose';
    state.loseT=0;
  }
}

function killJoker(m){
  if (!m.alive) return;
  m.alive=false;
  state.score += 100;
  burst(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, COL.jskin, 14);
  burst(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, COL.green, 6);
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].indexOf(k)>=0) e.preventDefault();
  if (state.screen==='title'){
    if (k==='enter' || k===' ') startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (state.screen==='win' || state.screen==='lose'){
    if (k==='enter' || k===' ' || k==='r'){
      if (state.screen==='win' && state.winT>60) startGame();
      else if (state.screen==='lose' && state.loseT>60) startGame();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (k===' ' || k==='z') throwPressed = true;
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
});

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(){
  state.t++;

  // particles always
  for (var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vy += 0.05; p.life--;
    if (p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
  if (state.shake>0) state.shake--;

  if (state.screen==='title'){
    if (state.t % 40 === 0) spawnBat();
    return;
  }
  if (state.screen==='win'){
    state.winT++;
    if (state.winT % 12 === 0) burst(20+((Math.random()*(W-40))|0), 30+((Math.random()*80)|0), COL.bat, 8);
    return;
  }
  if (state.screen==='lose'){
    state.loseT++;
    return;
  }

  // ---- PLAY ----
  if (player.invuln>0) player.invuln--;
  if (player.throwCd>0) player.throwCd--;
  player.blink++;

  // horizontal
  var left = keys['arrowleft']||keys['a'];
  var right = keys['arrowright']||keys['d'];
  var speed = 1.7;
  if (left && !right){ player.vx = -speed; player.facing = -1; }
  else if (right && !left){ player.vx = speed; player.facing = 1; }
  else player.vx = 0;

  // jump
  if ((keys['arrowup']||keys['w']) && player.onGround){
    player.vy = -3.6;
    player.onGround = false;
  }

  // gravity
  player.vy += 0.22;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;
  if (player.x < 2) player.x = 2;
  if (player.x > W-player.w-2) player.x = W-player.w-2;
  if (player.y + player.h >= GROUND){
    player.y = GROUND - player.h;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = true;
  } else player.onGround = false;

  // throw batarang
  if (throwPressed){
    if (player.throwCd<=0){
      bullets.push({ x: player.x + (player.facing>0? player.w:0), y: player.y+8,
        vx: player.facing*3.4, vy:0, r:3, spin:0, life: 90 });
      player.throwCd = 22;
    }
    throwPressed = false;
  } else throwPressed = false;

  // bullets
  for (var b=bullets.length-1;b>=0;b--){
    var bl = bullets[b];
    bl.x += bl.vx; bl.y += bl.vy; bl.spin += 0.4; bl.life--;
    if (bl.life<=0 || bl.x<-10 || bl.x>W+10){ bullets.splice(b,1); continue; }
    for (var m=0;m<movers.length;m++){
      var mv = movers[m];
      if (mv.alive && mv.type==='joker'){
        if (bl.x > mv.x-2 && bl.x < mv.x+mv.w+2 && bl.y > mv.y-2 && bl.y < mv.y+mv.h+2){
          killJoker(mv);
          bullets.splice(b,1);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // movers
  for (var k=movers.length-1;k>=0;k--){
    var m = movers[k];
    if (m.type==='joker'){
      if (!m.alive){ movers.splice(k,1); continue; }
      // approach player
      var dir = (player.x > m.x) ? 1 : -1;
      m.vx = dir * 0.55;
      m.face = dir;
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.shootCd--;
      if (m.shootCd<=0){
        bullets.push({ x: m.x + (m.face>0? m.w:0), y: m.y+10,
          vx: m.face*2.4, vy:0, r:3, spin:0, life: 120, enemy:true });
        m.shootCd = 90 + ((Math.random()*80)|0);
      }
      // touch player
      if (player.alive && player.invuln<=0){
        if (m.x < player.x+player.w && m.x+m.w > player.x &&
            m.y < player.y+player.h && m.y+m.h > player.y){
          hurtPlayer();
        }
      }
    }
    else if (m.type==='bat'){
      m.x += m.vx; m.y += m.vy;
      m.life--;
      if (m.x < -20 || m.x > W+20 || m.y < -20 || m.y > H+20 || m.life<=0){
        movers.splice(k,1); continue;
      }
      if (player.alive && player.invuln<=0){
        if (m.x < player.x+player.w && m.x+m.w > player.x &&
            m.y < player.y+player.h && m.y+m.h > player.y){
          hurtPlayer();
          movers.splice(k,1);
        }
      }
    }
    else if (m.type==='signal'){
      m.life--;
      if (m.life<=0){ movers.splice(k,1); continue; }
      if (player.alive){
        var cx = player.x+player.w/2, cy = player.y+player.h/2;
        if (cx > m.x && cx < m.x+m.w && cy > m.y && cy < m.y+m.h){
          if (m.win){
            state.score += 500;
            state.winFlash = 30;
            burst(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, COL.bat, 16);
            state.screen='win'; state.winT=0;
            movers.splice(k,1);
          } else {
            state.score += 50;
            burst(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, COL.bat, 10);
            movers.splice(k,1);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets hit player
  for (var e=bullets.length-1;e>=0;e--){
    var eb = bullets[e];
    if (eb.enemy && player.alive && player.invuln<=0){
      if (eb.x > player.x-2 && eb.x < player.x+player.w+2 &&
          eb.y > player.y-2 && eb.y < player.y+player.h+2){
        hurtPlayer();
        bullets.splice(e,1);
      }
    }
  }

  // spawning
  var jokers = 0, bats = 0, signals = 0;
  for (var q=0;q<movers.length;q++){
    if (movers[q].alive){
      if (movers[q].type==='joker') jokers++;
      else if (movers[q].type==='bat') bats++;
      else if (movers[q].type==='signal') signals++;
    }
  }
  if (jokers < 3 && state.t % 160 === 0) spawnJoker();
  if (bats < 3 && state.t % 220 === 0) spawnBat();
  if (signals < 2 && state.t % 300 === 0) spawnBatSignal();

  // win condition: collect 10 bat signals
  if (state.score >= 1000 && state.winFlash>0){
    // handled when grabbing win signal
  }
  if (state.winFlash>0) state.winFlash--;
  if (state.score >= 1000){
    spawnBatSignalWin();
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function px(x,y,w,h,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.fillRect(x|0,y|0,w,h); }

function drawBackground(){
  px(0,0,W,H,COL.sky);
  // moon
  px(248,22,26,26,COL.moon);
  px(252,26,6,6,COL.sky);
  px(264,34,5,5,COL.sky);
  // stars
  for (var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
    var s = stars[i];
    var tw = (state.t + s.tw) % 40;
    if (tw < 30) px(s.x,s.y,s.s,s.s, tw<15? COL.moon : COL.sky);
  }
  // hills
  for (var x=0;x<W;x+=8){
    var h = 18 + Math.round(10*Math.sin(x*0.05));
    px(x, GROUND-h, 8, h, COL.hill);
  }
  // buildings
  for (var b=0;b<buildings.length;b++){
    var B = buildings[b];
    px(B.x, B.y, B.w, B.h, COL.brick);
    px(B.x, B.y, B.w, 3, COL.brickdark);
    px(B.x, B.y, 2, B.h, COL.brickdark);
    for (var w=0;w<B.wins.length;w++){
      var wn = B.wins[w];
      if (wn.on) px(wn.x, wn.y, 6, 8, COL.win);
      else px(wn.x, wn.y, 6, 8, COL.winoff);
    }
  }
  // ground
  px(0, GROUND, W, H-GROUND, COL.brickdark);
  px(0, GROUND, W, 3, COL.brick);
  for (var gx=0; gx<W; gx+=16){
    px(gx, GROUND+6, 1, H-GROUND-6, COL.brick);
  }
}

function drawBatman(){
  var x = player.x, y = player.y;
  var f = player.facing;
  if (player.invuln>0 && (state.t>>2)%2===0) return; // blink
  // cape
  px(x+2, y+4, 12, 18, COL.batcape);
  px(x+1, y+10, 14, 10, COL.batcape);
  // body
  px(x+4, y+6, 8, 14, COL.batsuit);
  // belt
  px(x+4, y+16, 8, 2, COL.batbelt);
  // head
  px(x+5, y, 6, 7, COL.batskin);
  // cowl
  px(x+4, y, 8, 3, COL.batcowl);
  px(x+4, y+3, 2, 3, COL.batcowl);
  px(x+10, y+3, 2, 3, COL.batcowl);
  // ears
  px(x+5, y-3, 1, 3, COL.batcowl);
  px(x+9, y-3, 1, 3, COL.batcowl);
  // eyes
  px(x+6, y+4, 1, 1, COL.text2);
  px(x+9, y+4, 1, 1, COL.text2);
  // arms
  if (player.onGround && player.vx!==0){
    px(x+ (f>0? 11 : 3), y+9, 3, 6, COL.batsuit);
  } else {
    px(x+2, y+9, 2, 6, COL.batsuit);
    px(x+12, y+9, 2, 6, COL.batsuit);
  }
  // legs
  var step = player.onGround && player.vx!==0 ? (Math.floor(state.t/6)%2) : 0;
  if (step){
    px(x+5, y+20, 2, 4, COL.batsuit);
    px(x+9, y+20, 2, 3, COL.batsuit);
  } else {
    px(x+5, y+20, 2, 3, COL.batsuit);
    px(x+9, y+20, 2, 4, COL.batsuit);
  }
}

function drawJoker(m){
  var x=m.x, y=m.y, f=m.face;
  // hair
  px(x+2, y, 12, 3, COL.jhair);
  px(x+1, y+1, 2, 4, COL.jhair);
  px(x+13, y+1, 2, 4, COL.jhair);
  // face
  px(x+4, y+3, 8, 8, COL.jskin);
  // green hair streak
  px(x+3, y+2, 2, 3, COL.green);
  px(x+11, y+2, 2, 3, COL.green);
  // eyes
  px(x+5, y+5, 2, 2, COL.text2);
  px(x+9, y+5, 2, 2, COL.text2);
  px(x+5, y+5, 1, 1, COL.red);
  px(x+10, y+5, 1, 1, COL.red);
  // smile
  px(x+5, y+8, 6, 1, COL.red);
  px(x+5, y+7, 1, 1, COL.red);
  px(x+10, y+7, 1, 1, COL.red);
  // body
  px(x+3, y+11, 10, 10, COL.jsuit);
  px(x+5, y+13, 6, 4, COL.green);
  // arms
  px(x+ (f>0? 12 : 1), y+13, 3, 6, COL.jsuit);
  px(x+ (f>0? 13 : 1), y+13, 1, 6, COL.jarm);
  // legs
  px(x+4, y+21, 3, 5, COL.jsuit);
  px(x+9, y+21, 3, 5, COL.jsuit);
}

function drawBat(m){
  var x=m.x, y=m.y;
  // wings
  px(x, y+2, 5, 4, COL.batskin);
  px(x+9, y+2, 5, 4, COL.batskin);
  px(x+1, y, 3, 3, COL.batskin);
  px(x+10, y, 3, 3, COL.batskin);
  // body
  px(x+5, y+3, 4, 4, COL.batskin);
  // ears
  px(x+5, y+1, 1, 2, COL.batskin);
  px(x+8, y+1, 1, 2, COL.batskin);
  // eyes
  px(x+6, y+4, 1, 1, COL.red);
  px(x+7, y+4, 1, 1, COL.red);
}

function drawSignal(m){
  var x=m.x, y=m.y;
  var pulse = (state.t>>2)%2;
  if (m.win){
    px(x-3, y-3, 18, 18, COL.bat);
    px(x, y, 12, 12, COL.batline);
    px(x+2, y+2, 8, 8, COL.bat);
  } else {
    px(x, y, 12, 12, pulse? COL.bat : COL.batline);
    px(x+2, y+2, 8, 8, pulse? COL.batline : COL.bat);
  }
  // bat emblem
  px(x+3, y+4, 1, 3, COL.batskin);
  px(x+8, y+4, 1, 3, COL.batskin);
  px(x+5, y+5, 2, 2, COL.batskin);
}

function drawBullet(b){
  if (b.enemy){
    px(b.x-2, b.y-2, 4, 4, COL.red);
    px(b.x-1, b.y-1, 2, 2, COL.text2);
  } else {
    // spinning batarang
    var s = (b.spin|0)%2;
    px(b.x-3, b.y-1, 6, 2, COL.batskin);
    px(b.x-1, b.y-3, 2, 6, COL.batskin);
    px(b.x-1, b.y-1, 2, 2, COL.bat);
  }
}

function drawParticle(p){
  var a = p.life/p.max;
  var sz = a>0.5?2:1;
  px(p.x, p.y, sz, sz, p.color);
}

function drawHUD(){
  px(0,0,W,14, COL.brickdark);
  px(0,13,W,1, COL.brick);
  // lives
  for (var i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    px(6+i*10, 4, 6, 6, COL.batskin);
    px(7+i*10, 3, 1, 2, COL.batskin);
    px(10+i*10, 3, 1, 2, COL.batskin);
  }
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.text;
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  var txt = 'SCORE '+String(state.score).padStart(4,'0');
  ctx.fillText(txt, W-ctx.measureText(txt).width-6, 3);
}

function drawTextLine(txt, y, size, color, center){
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = size+'px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  var w = ctx.measureText(txt).width;
  var x = center? (W-w)/2 : 8;
  ctx.fillText(txt, x, y);
}

function drawTitle(){
  px(0,0,W,H,COL.sky);
  // moon
  px(150,20,60,60,COL.moon);
  px(165,35,12,12,COL.sky);
  px(185,55,10,10,COL.sky);
  // skyline
  for (var x=0;x<W;x+=20){
    var h = 40 + ((x*7)%30);
    px(x, GROUND-h, 20, h, COL.brick);
    px(x, GROUND-h, 20, 3, COL.brickdark);
  }
  px(0, GROUND, W, H-GROUND, COL.brickdark);
  // big bat signal
  px(120,30,80,80,COL.bat);
  px(128,38,64,64,COL.batline);
  px(136,46,48,48,COL.bat);
  // bat emblem
  px(148,60,4,18,COL.batskin);
  px(168,60,4,18,COL.batskin);
  px(152,66,16,10,COL.batskin);
  px(150,56,2,6,COL.batskin);
  px(168,56,2,6,COL.batskin);
  // title
  drawTextLine('BATMAN', 120, 24, COL.bat, true);
  drawTextLine('THE MOVIE', 140, 12, COL.text2, true);
  if ((state.t>>4)%2===0){
    drawTextLine('PRESS ENTER TO START', 168, 10, COL.text, true);
  }
  drawTextLine('ARROWS: MOVE  UP: JUMP  SPACE: BATARANG', 184, 8, COL.text2, true);
}

function drawWin(){
  drawBackground();
  drawTextLine('VICTORY!', 60, 22, COL.bat, true);
  drawTextLine('THE CITY IS SAFE', 84, 11, COL.text2, true);
  drawTextLine('FINAL SCORE '+state.score, 104, 12, COL.text, true);
  if (state.winT>60 && (state.t>>3)%2===0){
    drawTextLine('PRESS ENTER FOR REMATCH', 150, 10, COL.text, true);
  }
}

function drawLose(){
  drawBackground();
  px(0,0,W,H, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
  drawTextLine('GAME OVER', 60, 22, COL.red, true);
  drawTextLine('THE JOKER WINS', 84, 11, COL.text2, true);
  drawTextLine('SCORE '+state.score, 104, 12, COL.text, true);
  if (state.loseT>60 && (state.t>>3)%2===0){
    drawTextLine('PRESS ENTER TO RETRY', 150, 10, COL.text, true);
  }
}

function draw(){
  if (state.screen==='title'){ drawTitle(); return; }
  if (state.screen==='win'){ drawWin(); return; }
  if (state.screen==='lose'){ drawLose(); return; }

  // play
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake>0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()*3-1.5)|0, (Math.random()*3-1.5)|0);
  }
  drawBackground();
  for (var s=0;s<movers.length;s++){
    var m = movers[s];
    if (m.type==='signal') drawSignal(m);
    else if (m.type==='bat') drawBat(m);
    else if (m.type==='joker' && m.alive) drawJoker(m);
  }
  for (var b=0;b<bullets.length;b++) drawBullet(bullets[b]);
  drawBatman();
  for (var p=0;p<particles.length;p++) drawParticle(particles[p]);
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Centipede</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#0a0e1a; height:100%; overflow:hidden; }
  body { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:monospace; }
  canvas { image-rendering:pixelated; box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.2/dist/pixi.min.js"></script>
<script>
// ====== STATE ======
const app = new PIXI.Application({ width:640, height:480, backgroundColor:0x0d1424, antialias:false });
document.body.appendChild(app.view);

const W = 640, H = 480;
const BG = 0x0d1424, GRID = 0x16223c, FLOOR = 0x2a4a2a, FLOOR2 = 0x356035,
      P1 = 0xffd23f, P2 = 0xff8c1a, SHOT = 0xfff2b0,
      HEAD = 0xff3b30, BODY = 0x2ec27e, WING = 0x9be7ff,
      SCORE = 0xffffff, RED = 0xff5555;

let state = 'start';   // 'start' | 'play' | 'over'
let score = 0, lives = 3, wave = 1;
let bullets = [];
let centipede = [];
let mushrooms = [];
let fly = null;
let player = { x: W/2, y: H-40, speed: 320 };
let keys = {};
let fireCd = 0;

// ====== BUILD THE SCENE (drawn once, static) ======
const bg = new PIXI.Graphics();
bg.beginFill(BG, 1); bg.drawRect(0,0,W,H); bg.endFill();
for (let x=0; x<W; x+=40){ bg.beginFill(GRID,0.5); bg.drawRect(x,0,1,H); bg.endFill(); }
for (let y=0; y<H; y+=40){ bg.beginFill(GRID,0.5); bg.drawRect(0,y,W,1); bg.endFill(); }
// floor strip
bg.beginFill(FLOOR,1); bg.drawRect(0,H-24,W,24); bg.endFill();
bg.beginFill(FLOOR2,1); bg.drawRect(0,H-24,W,3); bg.endFill();
app.stage.addChild(bg);

const layers = {
  mush: new PIXI.Graphics(),
  ent:  new PIXI.Graphics(),
  player: new PIXI.Graphics(),
  shot: new PIXI.Graphics(),
  text: new PIXI.Graphics()
};
app.stage.addChild(layers.mush, layers.ent, layers.player, layers.shot, layers.text);

// ====== HELPERS ======
function clearLayer(g){ g.clear(); }
function hitRect(a, b){ return a.x < b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h > b.y; }

function buildMushrooms(){
  mushrooms = [];
  const cols = 12;
  for (let i=0; i<14; i++){
    const x = 40 + Math.floor(Math.random()*cols)*44 + Math.random()*20;
    const y = 40 + Math.random()*240;
    mushrooms.push({ x, y, w:22, h:22, alive:true });
  }
}

function spawnCentipede(){
  centipede = [];
  const count = 6 + Math.min(wave-1, 6);
  const startX = 60 + Math.random()*(W-120);
  for (let i=0; i<count; i++){
    const x = startX + (i%2 ? -18 : 18);
    const y = 24 + Math.floor(i/2)*20;
    centipede.push({ x, y, w:22, h:18, dir:1, alive:true, head:i===0 });
  }
}

function spawnFly(){
  if (fly) return;
  fly = { x: Math.random()<0.5 ? 20 : W-20, y: 30 + Math.random()*120,
           vx: (Math.random()<0.5?1:-1)*(70+wave*8), vy: 0, alive:true, t:0 };
}

function reset(){
  score = 0; lives = 3; wave = 1;
  bullets = [];
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H-40;
  buildMushrooms();
  spawnCentipede();
  fly = null;
  spawnFly();
}

// ====== INPUT ======
addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter'){
    if (state==='start'){ reset(); state='play'; }
    else if (state==='over'){ state='start'; }
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ====== UPDATE ======
function update(dt){
  if (state!=='play') return;

  // player move
  if (keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'])  player.x -= player.speed*dt;
  if (keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) player.x += player.speed*dt;
  player.x = Math.max(16, Math.min(W-16, player.x));

  // fire
  fireCd -= dt;
  if ((keys['w']||keys['arrowup']||keys[' ']) && fireCd<=0){
    bullets.push({ x:player.x-3, y:player.y-14, w:6, h:12, vy:-560 });
    fireCd = 0.16;
  }

  // bullets
  for (let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.y += b.vy*dt;
    if (b.y < -20){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    let removed = false;
    // hit mushroom
    for (const m of mushrooms){
      if (m.alive && hitRect(b, m)){
        m.alive=false; score += 5; removed=true; break;
      }
    }
    if (!removed){
      for (const c of centipede){
        if (c.alive && hitRect(b, c)){
          c.alive=false; score += c.head?50:20; removed=true; break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!removed && fly && fly.alive && hitRect(b, fly)){
      fly.alive=false; score += 25; removed=true;
    }
    if (removed) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // centipede move + mushroom eating
  for (const c of centipede){
    if (!c.alive) continue;
    c.x += c.dir * (60 + wave*6) * dt;
    if (c.x < 12){ c.x = 12; c.dir = 1; }
    else if (c.x > W-12-c.w){ c.x = W-12-c.w; c.dir = -1; }
    // eat mushroom below
    for (const m of mushrooms){
      if (m.alive && c.y+c.h > m.y-2 && c.y < m.y+m.h && Math.abs(c.x-m.x)<20){
        m.alive=false;
      }
    }
  }
  // if all centipede dead, drop a new wave
  if (centipede.every(c=>!c.alive)){
    wave++;
    spawnCentipede();
  }

  // fly
  if (!fly || !fly.alive){ if (Math.random()<0.004) spawnFly(); }
  else {
    fly.x += fly.vx*dt;
    fly.y += Math.sin(fly.t*4)*20*dt;
    fly.t += dt;
    if (fly.x < 10){ fly.x=10; fly.vx*=-1; }
    if (fly.x > W-10){ fly.x=W-10; fly.vx*=-1; }
  }

  // collisions: player vs centipede / fly
  const pr = { x:player.x-12, y:player.y-14, w:24, h:26 };
  let dead = false;
  for (const c of centipede){ if (c.alive && hitRect(pr,c)) dead=true; }
  if (!dead && fly && fly.alive && hitRect(pr,{x:fly.x-10,y:fly.y-8,w:20,h:16})) dead=true;
  if (dead){
    lives--;
    if (lives<=0){ state='over'; }
    else { player.x=W/2; player.y=H-40; }
  }
}

// ====== DRAW ======
function drawMush(){
  const g = layers.mush; clearLayer(g);
  for (const m of mushrooms){
    if (!m.alive) continue;
    g.beginFill(0xf5f0e6,1); g.drawRect(m.x+7, m.y+10, 8, 12); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xd94b2a,1); g.drawRect(m.x, m.y, 22, 10); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff,1); g.drawRect(m.x+4, m.y+2, 4, 4); g.endFill();

    // distant nebula bands
    bg.beginFill(0x101030); bg.drawRect(0, 60, W, 40); bg.endFill();

      app.stage.addChild(s);

  })();

  // ---------- HUD ----------

  hud.x = 14; hud.y = 10;

  // ---------- PLAYER ----------
  player = new PIXI.Graphics();
  function drawPlayer(g, x, y){
    // base
    g.beginFill(0x22cc66); g.drawRect(x-24, y+8, 48, 10); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x119944); g.drawRect(x-30, y+14, 60, 6); g.endFill();

    g.beginFill(0x33dd77); g.drawRect(x-16, y-2, 32, 12); g.endFill();

  resetPlayer();

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------

    var g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    g.beginFill(color); g.drawRect(x, y, 4, 14); g.endFill();
    return g;
  }

  function makeInvader(x, y, type, frame){
    var g = new PIXI.Graphics();
    if (type === 0){ // squid - pink
      g.beginFill(0xff55aa);
      g.drawRect(x-14, y, 28, 6);
      g.drawRect(x-10, y+6, 20, 8);
      g.drawRect(x-14, y+14, 28, 4);
      // eyes
      g.beginFill(0xffffff);
      g.drawRect(x-8, y+8, 5, 5);
      g.drawRect(x+3, y+8, 5, 5);

        g.drawRect(x-12, y+18, 4, 6);

        g.drawRect(x+8, y+18, 4, 6);

        g.drawRect(x-14, y+18, 4, 6);
        g.drawRect(x+10, y+18, 4, 6);
      }
    } else if (type === 1){ // crab - green
      g.beginFill(0x55ff66);
      g.drawRect(x-16, y, 32, 6);
      g.drawRect(x-12, y+6, 24, 8);
      g.drawRect(x-16, y+14, 32, 4);
      g.beginFill(0xffffff);
      g.drawRect(x-9, y+7, 5, 5);

      g.drawRect(x+6, y+9, 2, 2);

        g.drawRect(x+14, y+10, 4, 6);

        g.drawRect(x-18, y+6, 4, 6);
        g.drawRect(x+14, y+6, 4, 6);

      g.beginFill(0xffcc33);
      g.drawRect(x-14, y, 28, 5);
      g.drawRect(x-10, y+5, 20, 10);
      g.drawRect(x-14, y+15, 28, 5);
      g.beginFill(0xffffff);
      g.drawRect(x-8, y+8, 5, 5);
      g.drawRect(x+3, y+8, 5, 5);
      g.beginFill(0x332200);
      g.drawRect(x-6, y+10, 2, 2);
      g.drawRect(x+5, y+10, 2, 2);
      g.beginFill(0xffcc33);
      if (frame === 0){
        g.drawRect(x-13, y+20, 4, 5);
        g.drawRect(x-3, y+20, 4, 5);
        g.drawRect(x+9, y+20, 4, 5);

        g.drawRect(x-15, y+20, 4, 5);

  function spawnWave(){

    for (var i = 0; i < invaders.length; i++){

    }
    invaders = [];
    invaderDir = 1;
    invaderStep = 14;
    invaderDrop = 22;
    invaderSpeed = 0.02 + (wave-1)*0.006;
    invaderFrame = 0;

    var rows = 4, cols = 8;
    var startX = 70, startY = 70;
    var gapX = 64, gapY = 44;
    for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++){
      for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++){
        var type = r === 0 ? 0 : (r < 3 ? 1 : 2);
        var x = startX + c*gapX;
        var y = startY + r*gapY;
        var g = makeInvader(x, y, type, 0);
        g.x = x; g.y = y;
        app.stage.addChild(g);
        invaders.push({ g:g, x:x, y:y, type:type, alive:true });
      }

  }

  function startGame(){

    for (var i = 0; i < bullets.length; i++){ if (bullets[i].parent) bullets[i].parent.removeChild(bullets[i]); }
    bullets = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < enemyBullets.length; j++){ if (enemyBullets[j].parent) enemyBullets[j].parent.removeChild(enemyBullets[j]); }
    enemyBullets = [];

    spawnWave();
    state = "playing";
  }

  function updateHud(){
    hud.text = "SCORE " + score + "   WAVE " + wave + "   LEFT " + invaderCount;
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){

  function update(dt){

      stars[i].alpha = 0.4 + Math.random()*0.6;
    }

    if (state !== "playing") return;

    // player movement
    var px = player.x;
    var speed = 320 * dt;
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"] || keys["A"]) px -= speed;
    if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"] || keys["D"]) px += speed;
    px = Math.max(30, Math.min(W-30, px));

    // player shoot

      lastShot = 0.22;
      var b = makeBullet(px-2, H-70, 0xffff66);
      app.stage.addChild(b);
      bullets.push({ g:b, x:px-2, y:H-70 });

      bb.g.x = bb.x; bb.g.y = bb.y;

        if (bb.g.parent) bb.g.parent.removeChild(bb.g);

        continue;
      }
      // hit invaders
      for (var ii = 0; ii < invaders.length; ii++){
        var iv = invaders[ii];
        if (!iv.alive) continue;
        if (Math.abs(bb.x - iv.x) < 20 && bb.y < iv.y+20 && bb.y+14 > iv.y-4){
          iv.alive = false;
          if (iv.g.parent) iv.g.parent.removeChild(iv.g);
          invaderCount--;
          score += iv.type === 0 ? 30 : (iv.type === 1 ? 20 : 10);
          if (bb.g.parent) bb.g.parent.removeChild(bb.g);
          bullets.splice(bi,1);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // enemy bullets move down
    for (var ei = enemyBullets.length-1; ei >= 0; ei--){
      var eb = enemyBullets[ei];
      eb.y += 260*dt;
      eb.g.x = eb.x; eb.g.y = eb.y;
      if (eb.y > H+20){
        if (eb.g.parent) eb.g.parent.removeChild(eb.g);
        enemyBullets.splice(ei,1);
        continue;
      }
      // hit player
      if (playerInvulnerable <= 0){
        if (Math.abs(eb.x - px) < 24 && eb.y > H-70 && eb.y < H-30){
          if (eb.g.parent) eb.g.parent.removeChild(eb.g);
          enemyBullets.splice(ei,1);
          state = "gameover";
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // invader movement
    var moved = false;
    var minx = 1e9, maxx = -1e9, maxy = -1e9;
    for (var k = 0; k < invaders.length; k++){
      if (!invaders[k].alive) continue;
      if (invaders[k].x < minx) minx = invaders[k].x;
      if (invaders[k].x > maxx) maxx = invaders[k].x;
      if (invaders[k].y > maxy) maxy = invaders[k].y;
    }
    if (invaderCount > 0){
      var step = invaderStep * invaderDir;
      if ((invaderDir > 0 && maxx + step > W-40) || (invaderDir < 0 && minx + step < 40)){
        invaderDir *= -1;
        for (var m = 0; m < invaders.length; m++){
          if (!invaders[m].alive) continue;
          invaders[m].y += invaderDrop;
          invaders[m].g.y = invaders[m].y;
        }
        maxy += invaderDrop;
      } else {
        for (var n = 0; n < invaders.length; n++){
          if (!invaders[n].alive) continue;
          invaders[n].x += step;
          invaders[n].g.x = invaders[n].x;
        }
      }

      invaderFrame = 1 - invaderFrame;
      for (var f = 0; f < invaders.length; f++){
        if (!invaders[f].alive) continue;

        makeInvaderInto(invaders[f].g, invaders[f].x, invaders[f].y, invaders[f].type, invaderFrame);

      if (maxy > H-70){
        state = "gameover";
        return;

      if (alive.length > 0){
        var shooter = alive[Math.floor(Math.random()*alive.length)];
        var eb2 = makeBullet(shooter.x-2, shooter.y+20, 0xff5555);
        app.stage.addChild(eb2);
        enemyBullets.push({ g:eb2, x:shooter.x-2, y:shooter.y+20 });
      }

    lastEnemyShot -= dt;

    // wave clear
    if (invaderCount <= 0){
      state = "waveclear";
      wave++;
