  function makeInvaderInto(g, x, y, type, frame){
    // draw centered at 0,0 then set position
    if (type === 0){
      g.beginFill(0xff55aa);
      g.drawRect(-14, 0, 28, 6);
      g.drawRect(-10, 6, 20, 8);
      g.drawRect(-14, 14, 28, 4);
      g.beginFill(0xffffff);
      g.drawRect(-8, 8, 5, 5);
      g.drawRect(3, 8, 5, 5);
      g.beginFill(0x220033);
      g.drawRect(-6, 10, 2, 2);
      g.drawRect(5, 10, 2, 2);
      g.beginFill(0xff55aa);
      if (frame === 0){ g.drawRect(-12,18,4,6); g.drawRect(-2,18,4,6); g.drawRect(8,18,4,6); }
      else { g.drawRect(-14,18,4,6); g.drawRect(10,18,4,6); }

  // ---------- DRAW OVERLAYS ----------
  var overlay = new PIXI.Text("", { fontFamily:"monospace", fontSize:30, fill:0xffffff, align:"center" });
  overlay.x = W/2; overlay.y = H/2;

  function drawOverlay(){

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Mr. Do!</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#101020; height:100%; overflow:hidden; }
  body { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  canvas { display:block; border:4px solid #222; border-radius:8px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.2/dist/pixi.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ================= STATE ================= */
const TILE = 40;
const COLS = 16;
const ROWS = 12;
const W = COLS * TILE;   // 640
const H = ROWS * TILE;   // 480
const MAX_BUBBLES = 120;
const BUBBLE_SPEED = 1.7;
const MAX_LIVES = 3;

let grid = [];
let bubbles = [];
let particles = [];
let dox = { x: 0, y: 0, facing: 1, moving: false, frame: 0 };
let lives = MAX_LIVES;
let score = 0;
let state = 'start';   // 'start' | 'play' | 'win' | 'lose'
let keys = {};

const app = new PIXI.Application({ width: W, height: H, backgroundColor: 0x08080f, antialias: true });
document.body.appendChild(app.view);

/* ================= BUILD LEVEL (short loop) ================= */
// 0 = wall, 1 = empty
function makeGrid() {
  grid = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      row.push((r === 0 || c === 0 || r === ROWS - 1 || c === COLS - 1) ? 0 : 1);
    }
    grid.push(row);
  }
  // central island (a few shapes, no long map)
  grid[5][7] = 0; grid[5][8] = 0;
  grid[6][7] = 0; grid[6][8] = 0;
  grid[7][7] = 0; grid[7][8] = 0;
}
makeGrid();

function spawnBubbles() {
  bubbles = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BUBBLES; i++) {
    const c = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (COLS - 2));
    const r = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (ROWS - 2));
    if (grid[r][c] === 1) {
      bubbles.push({ x: c * TILE + TILE / 2, y: r * TILE + TILE / 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, phase: Math.random() * 6.28 });
    }
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  makeGrid();
  spawnBubbles();
  dox = { x: 2 * TILE + TILE / 2, y: 2 * TILE + TILE / 2, facing: 1, moving: false, frame: 0 };
  lives = MAX_LIVES;
  score = 0;
  particles = [];
}

/* ================= INPUT ================= */
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright') e.preventDefault();
  if (state === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { resetGame(); state = 'play'; }
  else if ((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { resetGame(); state = 'play'; }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

/* ================= UPDATE ================= */
function isWall(x, y) {
  const c = Math.floor(x / TILE);
  const r = Math.floor(y / TILE);
  if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return true;
  return grid[r][c] === 0;
}

function tryMove(dx, dy) {
  dox.x += dx;
  dox.y += dy;
  const pad = 12;
  if (isWall(dox.x, dox.y - pad) || isWall(dox.x, dox.y + pad) ||
      isWall(dox.x - pad, dox.y) || isWall(dox.x + pad, dox.y)) {
    dox.x -= dx;
    dox.y -= dy;
  }
}

function updateDox() {
  let moved = false;
  if (keys['arrowleft'])  { tryMove(-2, 0); dox.facing = -1; moved = true; }
  if (keys['arrowright']) { tryMove(2, 0); dox.facing = 1; moved = true; }
  if (keys['arrowup'])    { tryMove(0, -2); moved = true; }
  if (keys['arrowdown'])  { tryMove(0, 2); moved = true; }
  dox.moving = moved;
  if (moved) dox.frame += 0.2;
}

function updateBubbles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < bubbles.length; i++) {
    const b = bubbles[i];
    b.phase += 0.05;
    if (b.vx === 0 && b.vy === 0) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.02) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        b.vx = Math.cos(a) * BUBBLE_SPEED;
        b.vy = Math.sin(a) * BUBBLE_SPEED;
      }
    } else {
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      const pad = 10;
      const hitX = isWall(b.x, b.y - pad) || isWall(b.x, b.y + pad);
      const hitY = isWall(b.x - pad, b.y) || isWall(b.x + pad, b.y);
      if (hitX && hitY) { b.vx = -b.vx; b.vy = -b.vy; }
      else if (hitX) { b.vx = -b.vx; }
      else if (hitY) { b.vy = -b.vy; }
    }
    // pop on dox
    const dx = b.x - dox.x;
    const dy = b.y - dox.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 16 * 16) {
      bubbles.splice(i, 1);
      i--;
      score += 10;
      spawnPop(b.x, b.y);
    }
  }
}

function spawnPop(x, y) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * 2.5, vy: Math.sin(a) * 2.5, life: 24, color: 0xffe066 });
  }
}

function updateParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); i--; }
  }
}

function update() {
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  updateDox();
  updateBubbles();
  updateParticles();
  if (bubbles.length === 0) state = 'win';
}

/* ================= DRAW ================= */
function drawBackground(g) {
  g.beginFill(0x0b0b16);
  g.drawRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.endFill();
  // subtle floor tint inside the maze
  g.beginFill(0x141426);
  g.drawRect(TILE, TILE, (COLS - 2) * TILE, (ROWS - 2) * TILE);
  g.endFill();
}

function drawWalls(g) {
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c] === 0) {
        const x = c * TILE, y = r * TILE;
        g.beginFill(0x5a3bd0);
        g.drawRect(x, y, TILE, TILE);
        g.endFill();
        g.beginFill(0x7a55f0);
        g.drawRect(x + 3, y + 3, TILE - 6, 6);
        g.endFill();
        g.beginFill(0x3a2590);
        g.drawRect(x + 3, y + TILE - 9, TILE - 6, 6);
        g.endFill();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawBubbles(g) {
  for (let i = 0; i < bubbles.length; i++) {
    const b = bubbles[i];
    const wob = Math.sin(b.phase) * 1.5;
    const x = b.x + wob, y = b.y;
    g.beginFill(0x22d3ee);
    g.drawCircle(x, y, 11);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x9be9ff);
    g.drawCircle(x - 3, y - 3, 4);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x0e7490);
    g.drawCircle(x + 3, y + 4, 2);
    g.endFill();
  }
}

function drawDox(g) {
  const x = dox.x, y = dox.y;
  const bob = dox.moving ? Math.sin(dox.frame) * 2 : 0;
  // shadow
  g.beginFill(0x000000);
  g.drawEllipse(x, y + 16, 14, 5);
  g.endFill();
  // body
  g.beginFill(0xff5a3c);
  g.drawEllipse(x, y + bob, 16, 18);
  g.endFill();
  // belly
  g.beginFill(0xffd27a);
  g.drawEllipse(x, y + 6 + bob, 10, 11);
  g.endFill();
  // eyes (look toward facing)
  const off = dox.facing * 2;
  g.beginFill(0xffffff);
  g.drawCircle(x - 5 + off, y - 5 + bob, 4);
  g.drawCircle(x + 5 + off, y - 5 + bob, 4);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x1a1a1a);
  g.drawCircle(x - 5 + off + dox.facing, y - 5 + bob, 2);
  g.drawCircle(x + 5 + off + dox.facing, y - 5 + bob, 2);
  g.endFill();
  // mouth
  g.beginFill(0x7a1f10);
  g.drawEllipse(x + off, y + 3 + bob, 4, 2);
  g.endFill();
}

function drawParticles(g) {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    g.beginFill(p.color);
    g.drawCircle(p.x, p.y, Math.max(1, p.life / 6));
    g.endFill();
  }
}

function drawHUD(g) {
  g.beginFill(0x000000);
  g.drawRect(0, 0, W, 26);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0xffe066);
  g.drawCircle(16, 13, 6);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0xff5a3c);
  g.drawCircle(16, 13, 4);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0xffffff);
  g.drawRect(28, 8, 150, 10);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x111111);
  g.drawRect(28, 8, 150, 10);
  g.endFill();
}

function drawCenterBox(g, lines, color) {
  g.beginFill(0x000000);
  g.drawRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x141426);
  g.drawRect(W / 2 - 200, H / 2 - 80, 400, 160);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(color);
  g.drawRect(W / 2 - 200, H / 2 - 80, 400, 4);
  g.endFill();
}

function draw() {
  const g = new PIXI.Graphics();
  drawBackground(g);
  drawWalls(g);
  drawBubbles(g);
  drawDox(g);
  drawParticles(g);
  drawHUD(g);

  if (state === 'start') {
    drawCenterBox(g, null, 0xff5a3c);
    g.beginFill(0xff5a3c);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 160, H / 2 - 60, 320, 30);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 150, H / 2 - 52, 300, 14);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x9be9ff);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 120, H / 2 + 5, 240, 10);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffe066);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 100, H / 2 + 30, 200, 8);
    g.endFill();
  } else if (state === 'win') {
    drawCenterBox(g, null, 0x22d3ee);
    g.beginFill(0x22d3ee);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 150, H / 2 - 55, 300, 28);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 130, H / 2 - 48, 260, 12);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffe066);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 110, H / 2 + 25, 220, 8);
    g.endFill();
  } else if (state === 'lose') {
    drawCenterBox(g, null, 0xff5a3c);
    g.beginFill(0xff5a3c);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 150, H / 2 - 55, 300, 28);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 130, H / 2 - 48, 260, 12);
    g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffe066);
    g.drawRect(W / 2 - 110, H / 2 + 25, 220, 8);
    g.endFill();
  }

  app.stage.addChild(g);
}

/* ================= LOOP ================= */
app.ticker.add((delta) => {
  update();
  app.stage.removeChildren();
  draw();
});
</script>

<title>Pac-Land</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#101828; }
  body { display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height:100vh; }
  canvas { display:block; image-rendering:pixelated; }

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.2/dist/pixi.min.js"></script>

<script>
// ---------- State ----------
const app = new PIXI.Application({ width:640, height:480, background:0x0a1428 });
document.body.appendChild(app.view);

const W = 640, H = 480;
const GRAV = 0.55, MOVE = 2.7, JUMP = 11.2, MAXFALL = 15;
const GROUNDY = 400;
const PW = 30, PH = 24;
const PW2 = PW/2, PH2 = PH/2;
const PWALL = 20, PH22 = 12;
const STARTX = 70;

const state = {
  status:'ready',
  score:0,
  collected:0,
  total:0,
  time:0,
  t:0,
  lastT:0,
  shake:0,
  pac:{ x:STARTX, y:GROUNDY-PH2, vx:0, vy:0, onGround:true, face:1, blink:0 },
  ghosts:[],
  pellets:[],
  walls:[],
  clouds:[],
  stars:[],
  msg:'',
  msgT:0
};

const keys = {};
let jumpQueued = false;

function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v); }

// ---------- Build level (short loop, no big maps) ----------
function buildLevel(){
  state.score = 0;
  state.collected = 0;
  state.time = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.msg = '';
  state.msgT = 0;
  state.pac = { x:STARTX, y:GROUNDY-PH2, vx:0, vy:0, onGround:true, face:1, blink:0 };

  state.pellets = [];
  state.walls = [];
  state.ghosts = [];

  let n = 0;
  for(let x=40; x<=600; x+=34){
    if(Math.abs(x-STARTX) < 26) continue;
    state.pellets.push({x:x, y:GROUNDY-12, r:4, taken:false, phase:n*0.6});
    n++;
  }
  state.total = state.pellets.length;

  const plats = [[150,300,250],[300,420,190],[430,540,150]];
  for(const p of plats){
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      state.walls.push({ x:p[0]+i*PWALL, y:p[2], w:PWALL, h:PH22 });
    }
    for(let x=p[0]+8; x<=p[1]-8; x+=26){
      state.pellets.push({x:x, y:p[2]-12, r:4, taken:false, phase:Math.random()*6});
    }
  }
  state.total = state.pellets.length;

  const gcols = [0xff5555,0x55ddff,0xff55dd];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    state.ghosts.push({ x:300+i*130, y:120, vx:0, vy:0, color:gcols[i], phase:Math.random()*6 });
  }

  state.clouds = [];
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    state.clouds.push({ x:rand(0,W), y:rand(40,150), w:rand(70,130), speed:rand(0.15,0.5) });
  }
  state.stars = [];
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    state.stars.push({ x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,300), r:rand(0.6,1.8), tw:rand(0,6) });
  }
}

// ---------- Input ----------
addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(k===' ' || k==='arrowup' || k==='w'){ jumpQueued = true; if(e.key===' '||e.key==='ArrowUp') e.preventDefault(); }
  if(k==='enter' && state.status!=='playing'){
    buildLevel();
    state.status = 'playing';
    state.lastT = state.t;
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt){
  if(state.status!=='playing') return;
  const p = state.pac;

  state.time += dt;
  const speed = 1 + Math.min(0.7, state.time*0.02);

  if(keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']){ p.vx = -MOVE; p.face = -1; }
  else if(keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']){ p.vx = MOVE; p.face = 1; }
  else { p.vx *= 0.7; if(Math.abs(p.vx)<0.1) p.vx = 0; }

  if(jumpQueued && p.onGround){ p.vy = -JUMP; p.onGround = false; }
  jumpQueued = false;

  p.vy += GRAV;
  if(p.vy > MAXFALL) p.vy = MAXFALL;

  p.x += p.vx;
  if(p.x < PW2){ p.x = PW2; p.vx = 0; }
  if(p.x > W-PW2){ p.x = W-PW2; p.vx = 0; }

  const prevBottom = p.y + PH2;
  p.y += p.vy;
  p.onGround = false;
  if(p.y + PH2 >= GROUNDY){ p.y = GROUNDY-PH2; p.vy = 0; p.onGround = true; }
  for(const wl of state.walls){
    const cx = p.x, ctop = p.y-PH2, cbot = p.y+PH2;
    if(cx+PW2 > wl.x && cx-PW2 < wl.x+wl.w){
      if(prevBottom <= wl.y + 0.5 && cbot >= wl.y){
        p.y = wl.y-PH2; p.vy = 0; p.onGround = true;
      } else if(cbot > wl.y && ctop < wl.y+wl.h && prevBottom > wl.y+0.5){
        if(p.x < wl.x+wl.w/2){ p.x = wl.x-PW2; p.vx = 0; }
        else { p.x = wl.x+wl.w+PW2; p.vx = 0; }
      }
    }
  }

  for(const pel of state.pellets){
    if(pel.taken) continue;
    const dx = p.x-pel.x, dy = p.y-pel.y;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy < 20*20){
      pel.taken = true; state.collected++; state.score += 10; state.shake = 3;
    }
  }

  for(const gh of state.ghosts){
    gh.x += Math.sin(state.t*0.0016 + gh.phase) * 1.3 * speed;
    gh.y += Math.cos(state.t*0.0012 + gh.phase) * 0.7 * speed;
    if(gh.x < 30) gh.x = 30;
    if(gh.x > W-30) gh.x = W-30;
    if(gh.y < 50) gh.y = 50;
    if(gh.y > GROUNDY-24) gh.y = GROUNDY-24;
    const dx = p.x-gh.x, dy = p.y-gh.y;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy < 24*24){
      state.status = 'gameover';
      state.msg = 'CAUGHT!';
      state.msgT = state.t;
      state.shake = 12;
    }
  }

  for(const cl of state.clouds){
    cl.x += cl.speed;
    if(cl.x > W+40) cl.x = -cl.w;
  }

  if(state.shake > 0){ state.shake -= dt*40; if(state.shake<0) state.shake=0; }

  if(state.collected >= state.total){
    state.status = 'win';
    state.msg = 'YOU WIN!';
    state.msgT = state.t;
    state.shake = 8;
  }
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function draw(){
  app.stage.removeChildren();
  const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

  let ox = 0, oy = 0;
  if(state.shake > 0){ ox = (Math.random()*2-1)*state.shake; oy = (Math.random()*2-1)*state.shake; }
  g.beginFill(0x0a1428); g.drawRect(0,0,W,H); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x122445); g.drawRect(0,150,W,250); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x1c3563); g.drawRect(0,300,W,100); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x0e1f3d); g.drawRect(0,360,W,120); g.endFill();

  for(const s of state.stars){
    const a = 0.4 + Math.abs(Math.sin(state.t*0.002 + s.tw))*0.6;
    g.beginFill(0xffffff, a); g.drawRect(s.x-1, s.y-1, 2, 2); g.endFill();
  }

  g.beginFill(0xffd24a); g.arc(560,70,26,0,Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0xffe58a); g.arc(560,70,18,0,Math.PI*2); g.endFill();

  for(const cl of state.clouds){
    g.beginFill(0xdfe8ff, 0.85);
    g.arc(cl.x, cl.y, 16, 0, Math.PI*2);
    g.arc(cl.x+20, cl.y-4, 20, 0, Math.PI*2);
    g.arc(cl.x+44, cl.y, 15, 0, Math.PI*2);
    g.arc(cl.x+24, cl.y+6, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
    g.endFill();
  }

  g.beginFill(0x2f7d3a); g.drawRect(0,GROUNDY,W,H-GROUNDY); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x47a255); g.drawRect(0,GROUNDY,W,8); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x256b31); g.drawRect(0,GROUNDY+40,W,H-GROUNDY-40); g.endFill();

  for(const wl of state.walls){
    g.beginFill(0x8a5a2b); g.drawRect(wl.x, wl.y, wl.w, wl.h); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x5c3d1c); g.drawRect(wl.x, wl.y+wl.h-3, wl.w, 3); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x5c3d1c); g.drawRect(wl.x+wl.w-3, wl.y, 3, wl.h); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xc79a5f); g.drawRect(wl.x, wl.y, wl.w, 3); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xc79a5f); g.drawRect(wl.x, wl.y, 3, wl.h); g.endFill();
  }

  for(const pel of state.pellets){
    if(pel.taken) continue;
    const pulse = 0.5 + Math.abs(Math.sin(state.t*0.004 + pel.phase))*0.5;
    g.beginFill(0xffe066, pulse); g.arc(pel.x, pel.y, pel.r, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff, pulse); g.arc(pel.x, pel.y, pel.r*0.4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
  }

  for(const gh of state.ghosts){
    const bob = Math.sin(state.t*0.005 + gh.phase)*3;
    const gx = gh.x, gy = gh.y + bob;
    g.beginFill(gh.color); g.arc(gx, gy-4, 14, Math.PI, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(gh.color); g.drawRect(gx-14, gy-4, 28, 14); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(gh.color); g.arc(gx-10, gy+10, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(gh.color); g.arc(gx, gy+12, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(gh.color); g.arc(gx+10, gy+10, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff); g.arc(gx-5, gy-6, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0xffffff); g.arc(gx+5, gy-6, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x202040); g.arc(gx-5, gy-5, 2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
    g.beginFill(0x202040); g.arc(gx+5, gy-5, 2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
  }

  const p = state.pac;
  const bob = p.onGround ? Math.abs(Math.sin(state.t*0.006))*1.5 : 0;
  const px = p.x, py = p.y - bob;
  const mouth = 0.15 + Math.abs(Math.sin(state.t*0.012))*0.4;
  const dir = p.face < 0 ? 1 : 0;
  g.beginFill(0xffe23a);
  g.arc(px, py, 15, Math.PI*(0.5+mouth), Math.PI*(1.5-mouth), dir);
  g.arc(px, py, 15, Math.PI*(1.5+mouth), Math.PI*(2.5-mouth), dir);
  g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0xffffff); g.arc(px + (p.face<0? -3:3), py-5, 4.5, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();
  g.beginFill(0x1a1a2e); g.arc(px + (p.face<0? -4:4), py-5, 2.2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.endFill();

  const c1 = new PIXI.Text('PAC-LAND', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:30, fontWeight:'bold', fill:0xffe23a });
  c1.x = 16; c1.y = 14; app.stage.addChild(c1);

  const c2 = new PIXI.Text('SCORE '+state.score+'   '+state.collected+'/'+state.total, { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:18, fill:0xffffff });
  c2.x = 16; c2.y = 50; app.stage.addChild(c2);

  const c3 = new PIXI.Text('TIME '+state.time.toFixed(1)+'s', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:16, fill:0x9fd0ff });
  c3.x = W-160; c3.y = 50; app.stage.addChild(c3);

  if(state.status === 'ready'){
    const o1 = new PIXI.Text('PAC-LAND', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:56, fontWeight:'bold', fill:0xffe23a });
    o1.anchor.set(0.5); o1.x = W/2; o1.y = H/2 - 40; app.stage.addChild(o1);
    const o2 = new PIXI.Text('Eat every pellet. Avoid the ghosts!', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:20, fill:0xffffff });
    o2.anchor.set(0.5); o2.x = W/2; o2.y = H/2 + 10; app.stage.addChild(o2);
    const o3 = new PIXI.Text('A / D or Arrow Keys to move, Space / W / Up to jump', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:16, fill:0x9fd0ff });
    o3.anchor.set(0.5); o3.x = W/2; o3.y = H/2 + 44; app.stage.addChild(o3);
    const o4 = new PIXI.Text('Press ENTER to start', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:22, fill:0x7CFC00 });
    o4.anchor.set(0.5); o4.x = W/2; o4.y = H/2 + 92; app.stage.addChild(o4);
  } else if(state.status === 'gameover'){
    const o1 = new PIXI.Text('CAUGHT!', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:48, fontWeight:'bold', fill:0xff5555 });
    o1.anchor.set(0.5); o1.x = W/2; o1.y = H/2 - 30; app.stage.addChild(o1);
    const o2 = new PIXI.Text('Score '+state.score, { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:22, fill:0xffffff });
    o2.anchor.set(0.5); o2.x = W/2; o2.y = H/2 + 14; app.stage.addChild(o2);
    const o3 = new PIXI.Text('Press ENTER to try again', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:18, fill:0x7CFC00 });
    o3.anchor.set(0.5); o3.x = W/2; o3.y = H/2 + 50; app.stage.addChild(o3);
  } else if(state.status === 'win'){
    const o1 = new PIXI.Text('YOU WIN!', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:48, fontWeight:'bold', fill:0x7CFC00 });
    o1.anchor.set(0.5); o1.x = W/2; o1.y = H/2 - 30; app.stage.addChild(o1);
    const o2 = new PIXI.Text('Score '+state.score+'   in '+state.time.toFixed(1)+'s', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:22, fill:0xffffff });
    o2.anchor.set(0.5); o2.x = W/2; o2.y = H/2 + 14; app.stage.addChild(o2);
    const o3 = new PIXI.Text('Press ENTER to play again', { fontFamily:'monospace', fontSize:18, fill:0x9fd0ff });
    o3.anchor.set(0.5); o3.x = W/2; o3.y = H/2 + 50; app.stage.addChild(o3);
  }

  app.stage.addChild(g);
}

// ---------- Loop ----------
buildLevel();
app.ticker.add(function(delta){
  const dt = Math.min(50, delta*16.6667);
  state.t += dt;
  update(dt);
  draw();
});
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Final Fantasy X — Zanarkand Duel</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #243b52 0%, #0d1826 60%, #060c14 100%);
    font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(60,120,180,0.35), 0 0 120px rgba(30,60,110,0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(120,170,220,0.3);
    border-radius: 4px;
    max-width: 96vw; max-height: 92vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const PLAYER = { x: 150, y: 430, w: 40, h: 64, speed: 320, color: '#e8b84b', accent: '#c8391f' };
  const ENEMY  = { x: 770, y: 430, w: 52, h: 78, speed: 120, color: '#5a6b7a', accent: '#2a3a4a' };
  const GROUND_Y = 470;
  const GROUND_H = H - GROUND_Y;

  // ---------- State ----------
  let state = 'title';      // 'title' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
  let score = 0;
  let time = 0;
  let hitFlash = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  const player = {
    x: PLAYER.x, y: PLAYER.y, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: PLAYER.w, h: PLAYER.h,
    hp: 100, maxHp: 100,
    facing: 1,
    attackCd: 0,
    invuln: 0,
    onGround: false
  };

  const enemy = {
    x: ENEMY.x, y: ENEMY.y, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: ENEMY.w, h: ENEMY.h,
    hp: 60, maxHp: 60,
    facing: -1,
    state: 'idle',       // 'idle' | 'windup' | 'attack' | 'recover'
    stateT: 0,
    atkCd: 0
  };

  // The single array of movers — every moving object lives here.
  let movers = [];

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'arrowup' || k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright') e.preventDefault();

    if (state === 'title' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) {
      startGame();
    } else if ((state === 'won' || state === 'lost') && (k === 'enter' || k === 'r')) {
      startGame();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  function startGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    time = 0;
    hitFlash = 0;
    shake = 0;
    player.x = PLAYER.x; player.y = PLAYER.y; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.hp = player.maxHp; player.attackCd = 0; player.invuln = 0;
    enemy.x = ENEMY.x; enemy.y = ENEMY.y; enemy.vx = 0; enemy.vy = 0;
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp; enemy.state = 'idle'; enemy.stateT = 0; enemy.atkCd = 0;
    movers = [];
  }

  // ---------- Helper: add a mover ----------
  function addMover(o) {
    movers.push(o);
  }

  function makeParticle(x, y, vx, vy, life, color, size, kind) {
    return {
      x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy,
      life: life, maxLife: life,
      color: color, size: size,
      kind: kind || 'dot',
      done: false
    };
  }

  // ---------- Spawn effects ----------
  function spawnAttackFx(x, y, dir) {
    // A glowing crescent slash
    addMover({
      x: x, y: y, vx: dir * 520, vy: 0,
      life: 0.28, maxLife: 0.28,
      color: '#ffd87a', size: 30,
      kind: 'slash',
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnHitBurst(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 14 + Math.random() * 0.4;
      const sp = 120 + Math.random() * 220;
      addMover(makeParticle(x, y, Math.cos(a) * sp, Math.sin(a) * sp, 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4, color, 3 + Math.random() * 4, 'dot'));
    }
    // a ring
    addMover({
      x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      life: 0.35, maxLife: 0.35,
      color: color, size: 8,
      kind: 'ring',
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnEnemyAttackFx(x, y, dir) {
    addMover({
      x: x, y: y, vx: dir * 420, vy: 0,
      life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4,
      color: '#ff5a3a', size: 24,
      kind: 'ball',
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnAmbient() {
    // floating light motes (Yun's world)
    addMover(makeParticle(
      Math.random() * W,
      H + 10,
      (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
      -(20 + Math.random() * 30),
      4 + Math.random() * 4,
      'rgba(120,190,255,0.5)',
      1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5,
      'mote'
    ));
  }

  // ---------- Collision ----------
  function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
    return (
      a.x < b.x + b.w &&
      a.x + a.w > b.x &&
      a.y < b.y + b.h &&
      a.y + a.h > b.y
    );
  }

  function circleRect(cx, cy, r, rect) {
    const nx = Math.max(rect.x, Math.min(cx, rect.x + rect.w));
    const ny = Math.max(rect.y, Math.min(cy, rect.y + rect.h));
    const dx = cx - nx, dy = cy - ny;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r;
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  let ambientTimer = 0;

  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (hitFlash > 0) hitFlash -= dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 30);

    // ambient motes
    ambientTimer -= dt;
    if (ambientTimer <= 0) {
      spawnAmbient();
      ambientTimer = 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    }

    if (state === 'playing') {
      updatePlayer(dt);
      updateEnemy(dt);
    }

    // Move every mover, drop the done ones.
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.life -= dt;

      if (m.kind === 'dot') {
        m.vy += 320 * dt; // gravity on particles
      }

      // Check interactions
      if (m.kind === 'slash') {
        if (rectsOverlap({ x: m.x - m.size, y: m.y - m.size, w: m.size * 2, h: m.size * 2 }, enemy)) {
          if (enemy.hp > 0) {
            enemy.hp -= 12;
            spawnHitBurst(enemy.x + enemy.w / 2, enemy.y + enemy.h / 2, '#ffd87a');
            score += 12;
            shake = 6;
            if (enemy.hp <= 0) {
              enemy.hp = 0;
              state = 'won';
              spawnHitBurst(enemy.x + enemy.w / 2, enemy.y + enemy.h / 2, '#ffe9a8');
            }
          }
          m.life = 0;
        }
      } else if (m.kind === 'ball') {
        if (circleRect(m.x, m.y, m.size, player) && player.invuln <= 0) {
          player.hp -= 10;
          player.invuln = 0.6;
          hitFlash = 0.25;
          spawnHitBurst(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#ff5a3a');
          shake = 8;
          m.life = 0;
          if (player.hp <= 0) {
            player.hp = 0;
            state = 'lost';
          }
        }
      }

      if (m.life <= 0) {
        m.done = true;
      }
    }
    movers = movers.filter(function (m) { return !m.done; });
  }

  function updatePlayer(dt) {
    // horizontal
    let mx = 0;
    if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) mx -= 1;
    if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) mx += 1;
    player.vx = mx * PLAYER.speed;
    if (mx !== 0) player.facing = mx > 0 ? 1 : -1;

    // jump
    if ((keys['arrowup'] || keys['w'] || keys[' ']) && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = -520;
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // gravity
    player.vy += 1400 * dt;

    // integrate
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;

    // ground
    if (player.y + player.h >= GROUND_Y) {
      player.y = GROUND_Y - player.h;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    } else {
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // bounds
    if (player.x < 20) player.x = 20;
    if (player.x + player.w > W - 20) player.x = W - 20 - player.w;

    // cooldowns
    if (player.attackCd > 0) player.attackCd -= dt;
    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;

    // attack
    if ((keys['x'] || keys['k']) && player.attackCd <= 0) {
      player.attackCd = 0.4;
      const dir = player.facing;
      const sx = player.x + (dir > 0 ? player.w : 0) + dir * 20;
      const sy = player.y + player.h * 0.45;
      spawnAttackFx(sx, sy, dir);
    }
  }

  function updateEnemy(dt) {
    if (enemy.hp <= 0) return;
    if (enemy.atkCd > 0) enemy.atkCd -= dt;

    const pcx = player.x + player.w / 2;
    const ecx = enemy.x + enemy.w / 2;
    const dist = Math.abs(pcx - ecx);
    enemy.facing = pcx < ecx ? -1 : 1;

    // face the player
    if (enemy.state === 'idle') {
      // approach until in range
      const range = 220;
      if (dist > range) {
        enemy.x += enemy.facing * ENEMY.speed * dt;
      }
      if (enemy.atkCd <= 0 && dist < range) {
        enemy.state = 'windup';
        enemy.stateT = 0.5;
      }
    } else if (enemy.state === 'windup') {
      enemy.stateT -= dt;
      if (enemy.stateT <= 0) {
        enemy.state = 'attack';
        enemy.stateT = 0.35;
        spawnEnemyAttackFx(enemy.x + (enemy.facing > 0 ? enemy.w : 0) + enemy.facing * 20, enemy.y + enemy.h * 0.5, enemy.facing);
      }
    } else if (enemy.state === 'attack') {
      enemy.stateT -= dt;
      if (enemy.stateT <= 0) {
        enemy.state = 'recover';
        enemy.stateT = 0.5;
        enemy.atkCd = 1.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
      }
    } else if (enemy.state === 'recover') {
      enemy.stateT -= dt;
      if (enemy.stateT <= 0) {
        enemy.state = 'idle';
      }
    }

    // keep on ground
    if (enemy.y + enemy.h > GROUND_Y) enemy.y = GROUND_Y - enemy.h;
    if (enemy.x < 20) enemy.x = 20;
    if (enemy.x + enemy.w > W - 20) enemy.x = W - 20 - enemy.w;
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawGround();

    // movers behind characters
    for (const m of movers) drawMover(m);

    if (state !== 'title') {
      drawEnemy();
      drawPlayer();
      drawHud();
    }

    ctx.restore();

    if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
    if (state === 'won') drawEnd(true);
    if (state === 'lost') drawEnd(false);

    if (hitFlash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,40,' + (hitFlash * 0.8) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GROUND_Y);
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#12233a');
    sky.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a4a6b');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#5a7a9a');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, GROUND_Y);

    // moon
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8f5';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 160, 110, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,220,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 150, 100, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(W - 175, 120, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // clouds
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,215,235,0.12)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const cx = ((i * 260 + time * 12) % (W + 200)) - 100;
      const cy = 70 + i * 35;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, 90, 22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Zanarkand towers in the distance
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,45,65,0.85)';
    const towers = [
      { x: 120, w: 40, h: 200 },
      { x: 200, w: 30, h: 260 },
      { x: 300, w: 55, h: 170 },
      { x: 430, w: 34, h: 230 },
      { x: 560, w: 48, h: 190 },
      { x: 690, w: 36, h: 250 },
      { x: 820, w: 50, h: 180 }
    ];
    for (const t of towers) {
      const top = GROUND_Y - t.h;
      ctx.fillRect(t.x, top, t.w, t.h);
      // pointed roof
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(t.x - 4, top);
      ctx.lineTo(t.x + t.w / 2, top - 34);
      ctx.lineTo(t.x + t.w + 4, top);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      // lit windows
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,110,0.55)';
      for (let wy = top + 20; wy < GROUND_Y - 20; wy += 34) {
        for (let wx = t.x + 8; wx < t.x + t.w - 6; wx += 18) {
          if ((wx * 7 + wy * 3) % 5 < 3) {

          }
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,45,65,0.85)';
    }
  }

  function drawGround() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#3a5570');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#20303f');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, GROUND_H);

    // glowing seam line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,190,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.stroke();

    // perspective grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,180,230,0.18)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
      const x = (W / 10) * i;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y);
      ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + (x - W / 2) * 1.6, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let j = 1; j <= 4; j++) {
      const y = GROUND_Y + (GROUND_H / 4) * j;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    const blink = p.invuln > 0 && (Math.floor(time * 20) % 2 === 0);
    ctx.save();
    if (blink) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;

    const cx = p.x + p.w / 2;
    const fy = p.y + p.h; // feet

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, GROUND_Y + 4, p.w * 0.7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a52';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 6, fy - 26, 10, 26);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + p.w - 16, fy - 26, 10, 26);

    // body / gi (Yun's blue-white)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8eef5';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 4, p.y + 18, p.w - 8, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = PLAYER.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 4, p.y + 18, p.w - 8, 8);

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c9a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, p.y + 10, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a3a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, p.y + 7, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // arm + weapon (blades)
    const armY = p.y + 26;
    const dir = p.facing;
    ctx.strokeStyle = PLAYER.accent;
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, armY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + dir * 26, armY + 6);
    ctx.stroke();
    // blade
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cfd8e5';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + dir * 26, armY + 6);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + dir * 46, armY - 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy() {
    const e = enemy;
    const cx = e.x + e.w / 2;
    const fy = e.y + e.h;
    const wind = e.state === 'windup';

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, GROUND_Y + 4, e.w * 0.7, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 4, e.y + 24, e.w - 8, e.h - 40);
    // armor plates
    ctx.fillStyle = e.accent;
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 4, e.y + 24, e.w - 8, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 10, e.y + 44, e.w - 20, 8);

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a95a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, e.y + 14, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // glowing eyes

    ctx.arc(cx - 5, e.y + 14, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 5, e.y + 14, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // horn
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4552';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - 8, e.y + 4);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, e.y - 16);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 8, e.y + 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = e.accent;
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 8, fy - 18, 12, 18);
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + e.w - 20, fy - 18, 12, 18);
  }

  function drawMover(m) {
    ctx.save();
    const t = m.maxLife > 0 ? m.life / m.maxLife : 0;

    if (m.kind === 'dot') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = t;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.size * t, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (m.kind === 'mote') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, t * 1.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (m.kind === 'slash') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = t;
      ctx.strokeStyle = m.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 6 * t + 2;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      const dir = m.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x - dir * m.size * 0.5, m.y, m.size * (1.4 - t * 0.4), dir > 0 ? -1.2 : Math.PI - 1.2, dir > 0 ? 1.2 : Math.PI + 1.2);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (m.kind === 'ball') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = t;
      const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 2, m.x, m.y, m.size);
      grd.addColorStop(0, '#fff2d0');
      grd.addColorStop(1, m.color);
      ctx.fillStyle = grd;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (m.kind === 'ring') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = t;
      ctx.strokeStyle = m.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.size + (1 - t) * 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHud() {
    // Player HP
    drawBar(24, 24, 240, 20, player.hp / player.maxHp, '#4aa0ff', 'YUN');
    // Enemy HP
    drawBar(W - 24 - 240, 24, 240, 20, enemy.hp / enemy.maxHp, '#ff5a3a', 'SHINRA');

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8f5';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Score  ' + score, W / 2, 40);
  }

  function drawBar(x, y, w, h, pct, color, label) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 3, w + 6, h + 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2530';
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * Math.max(0, pct), h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,235,250,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8f5';
    ctx.font = '12px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(label, x + 4, y + h - 5);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,12,20,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8b84b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL FANTASY X', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8f5';
    ctx.font = '22px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('Zanarkand Duel', W / 2, H / 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,235,250,0.8)';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('← → / A D  move      ↑ / W / Space  jump', W / 2, H / 2 + 46);
    ctx.fillText('X / K  attack', W / 2, H / 2 + 72);
    ctx.fillText('Defeat Shinra to win', W / 2, H / 2 + 104);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8b84b';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press  ENTER  to begin', W / 2, H / 2 + 150);
  }

  function drawEnd(won) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,12,20,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#e8b84b' : '#ff5a3a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText(won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dce8f5';
    ctx.font = '22px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score  ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,235,250,0.8)';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press  ENTER  or  R  to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 64);
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();

<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Command & Conquer: Red Alert</title>

  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #05070b; }

  #game { display: block; margin: 0 auto; background: #10141c; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ===== Canvas =====
  var canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

  // ===== Tuning constants =====
  var PLAYER_SPEED = 150, ENEMY_SPEED = 100;
  var PLAYER_HP = 100, ENEMY_HP = 55;
  var PLAYER_DMG = 26, ENEMY_DMG = 14;
  var PLAYER_CD = 0.55, ENEMY_CD = 0.9;
  var PLAYER_RANGE = 300, ENEMY_RANGE = 200;
  var BULLET_SPEED = 460;
  var ENEMY_COUNT = 6, BASE_HP = 300;
  var WIN_KILLS = 20;

  // ===== State (all movers live in one array of {x,y,vx,vy,...}) =====
  var movers = [];
  var state = "start";
  var kills = 0;
  var base = { x: 120, y: H / 2, hp: BASE_HP, max: BASE_HP };
  var player = { x: 250, y: H / 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: PLAYER_HP, max: PLAYER_HP, cd: 0, facing: 1 };
  var keys = {};
  var time = 0;
  var msg = "";
  var msgT = 0;

  // ===== Level: built with a short loop (no long tile map) =====
  var obstacles = [];
  (function buildObstacles() {
    var n = 5, i, x, y, w, h;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      x = 340 + i * 105;
      y = 90 + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 150;
      w = 46; h = 96;
      if (i % 2 === 1) { w = 96; h = 46; }
      obstacles.push({ x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h });
    }
  })();

  // ===== Helpers =====
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { var dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); }
  function rectC(cx, cy, w, h) { return { x: cx - w / 2, y: cy - h / 2, w: w, h: h }; }
  function circlesOverlap(ax, ay, ar, bx, by, br) { var dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return dx * dx + dy * dy < (ar + br) * (ar + br); }
  function circleRect(cx, cy, r, rx, ry, rw, rh) {
    var nx = clamp(cx, rx, rx + rw), ny = clamp(cy, ry, ry + rh);
    var dx = cx - nx, dy = cy - ny;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r;
  }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    movers.push({
      type: "enemy",
      x: W + 30,
      y: 50 + Math.random() * (H - 100),
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      hp: ENEMY_HP, max: ENEMY_HP,
      cd: Math.random() * ENEMY_CD,
      radius: 14,
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnBullet(x, y, tx, ty, dmg, fromPlayer, color) {
    var d = dist(x, y, tx, ty) || 1;
    movers.push({
      type: "bullet",
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: (tx - x) / d * BULLET_SPEED,
      vy: (ty - y) / d * BULLET_SPEED,
      dmg: dmg,
      fromPlayer: fromPlayer,
      color: color,
      radius: 4,
      life: 2.2,
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnExplosion(x, y, big) {
    movers.push({
      type: "explosion",
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      radius: big ? 26 : 16,
      maxR: big ? 60 : 34,
      life: big ? 0.6 : 0.4,
      maxLife: big ? 0.6 : 0.4,
      color: big ? "#ff5a2a" : "#ffd24a",
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnSpark(x, y, color) {
    movers.push({
      type: "spark",
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 130,
      vy: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 130,
      life: 0.35,
      maxLife: 0.35,
      color: color,
      radius: 2,
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnMuzzle(x, y, dir) {
    movers.push({
      type: "muzzle",
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      life: 0.09,
      maxLife: 0.09,
      color: "#fff2a8",
      radius: 8,
      done: false
    });
  }

  function reset() {
    movers = [];
    kills = 0;
    base = { x: 120, y: H / 2, hp: BASE_HP, max: BASE_HP };
    player = { x: 250, y: H / 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: PLAYER_HP, max: PLAYER_HP, cd: 0, facing: 1 };
    msg = ""; msgT = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < ENEMY_COUNT; i++) spawnEnemy();
    state = "playing";
  }

  // ===== Input =====
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state === "start" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) reset();
    else if ((state === "win" || state === "lose") && (k === "r" || k === "enter")) reset();
    if (["arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright", " "].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (state === "start") reset();
    else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") reset();
  });

  // ===== Update =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== "playing") return;

    // Player movement
    var dx = 0, dy = 0;
    if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) dx -= 1;
    if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) dx += 1;
    if (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) dy -= 1;
    if (keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) dy += 1;
    var m = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (m > 0) { dx /= m; dy /= m; player.vx = dx * PLAYER_SPEED; player.vy = dy * PLAYER_SPEED; }
    else { player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0; }
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;
    player.x = clamp(player.x, 30, W - 30);
    player.y = clamp(player.y, 30, H - 30);
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 2) player.facing = player.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;

    // Player cooldown
    player.cd -= dt;

    // Targeting + firing
    var target = null, best = 1e9;
    for (var i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
      var mo = movers[i];
      if (mo.type === "enemy" && !mo.done) {
        var d = dist(player.x, player.y, mo.x, mo.y);
        if (d < best) { best = d; target = mo; }

    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      movers.push({ type: "spark", x: m.x, y: m.y, vx: Math.cos(a) * rand(60, 320), vy: Math.sin(a) * rand(60, 320), r: 4, life: rand(0.5, 1.2) });
    }
    state = "win";
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
//  UPDATE
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
  if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2);

  // stars always drift
  for (const s of stars) {
    s.y += s.z * 120 * dt;
    if (s.y > H) { s.y = -5; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
  }

  if (state !== "play") return;

  // --- player movement ---
  let mx = 0, my = 0;
  if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) mx -= 1;
  if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) mx += 1;
  if (keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) my -= 1;
  if (keys["arrowdown"] || keys["s"]) my += 1;
  if (mx && my) { mx *= 0.7071; my *= 0.7071; }
  player.x += mx * player.speed * dt;
  player.y += my * player.speed * dt;
  player.x = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(HORIZON + 30, Math.min(H - 30, player.y));
  player.fireCooldown -= dt;
  if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;
  if (keys[" "] || keys["j"]) firePlayer();

  // --- wave / boss spawn logic ---
  if (!bossActive) {
    if (waveKills < waveTarget) {
      if (Math.random() < dt * 1.4) spawnEnemy();
    } else {
      // wave cleared -> boss
      spawnBoss();
    }
  }

  // --- the mover loop: move, then drop the done ones ---
  for (const m of movers) {
    m.x += m.vx * dt;
    m.y += m.vy * dt;
    if (m.life !== undefined) m.life -= dt;

    if (m.type === "enemy") {
      m.wob += dt * 3;
      m.x += Math.sin(m.wob) * 30 * dt;
      m.fireT -= dt;
      if (m.fireT <= 0 && m.y > HORIZON && m.y < H - 60) {
        enemyFire(m);
        m.fireT = rand(1.2, 2.6);
      }
    } else if (m.type === "boss") {
      if (bossEnter > 0) {
        bossEnter -= dt * 0.6;
        if (bossEnter < 0) bossEnter = 0;
      } else {
        // hover + sway
        m.y = 150 + Math.sin(time * 1.2) * 24;
        m.x = W / 2 + Math.sin(time * 0.7) * 120;
      }
      m.fireT -= dt;
      if (m.fireT <= 0 && bossEnter <= 0) {
        bossFire(m);
        bossPattern = 1 - bossPattern;
        m.fireT = bossPattern === 0 ? 1.3 : 1.7;
      }
    } else if (m.type === "spark") {
      m.vx *= (1 - dt * 2);
      m.vy *= (1 - dt * 2);
    }

    // --- collisions ---
    if (m.type === "pbullet") {
      for (const e of movers) {
        if (e === m || e.dead) continue;
        if (e.type === "enemy" || e.type === "boss") {
          if (Math.hypot(e.x - m.x, e.y - m.y) < e.r + m.r) {
            m.dead = true;
            if (e.type === "boss") {
              bossHP -= 1;
              if (bossHP <= 0) killMover(e, true);
            } else {
              killMover(e, true);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (m.type === "ebullet") {
      if (Math.hypot(player.x - m.x, player.y - m.y) < player.r + m.r) {
        m.dead = true;
        hitPlayer();
      }
    } else if (m.type === "enemy") {
      if (Math.hypot(player.x - m.x, player.y - m.y) < player.r + m.r) {
        m.dead = true;
        hitPlayer();
      }
    } else if (m.type === "boss") {
      if (bossEnter <= 0 && Math.hypot(player.x - m.x, player.y - m.y) < player.r + m.r * 0.7) {
        hitPlayer();
      }
    }
  }

  // --- drop the done movers (off screen / expired / killed) ---
  for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = movers[i];
    if (m.dead ||
        m.life <= 0 ||
        m.y > H + 60 ||
        m.y < -160 ||
        m.x < -60 ||
        m.x > W + 60) {
      movers.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
//  DRAW
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
function drawBackground() {
  // deep space gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0a0f2e");
  g.addColorStop(0.3, "#141a45");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "#2a1e55");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#05060f");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // nebula glows
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
  const n1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.25, H * 0.2, 10, W * 0.25, H * 0.2, 220);
  n1.addColorStop(0, "#7a3cff");
  n1.addColorStop(1, "rgba(122,60,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = n1;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const n2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.8, H * 0.35, 10, W * 0.8, H * 0.35, 240);
  n2.addColorStop(0, "#ff5ca8");
  n2.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,92,168,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = n2;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const size = s.z * 2.2;
    const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(time * 3 + s.tw);
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.z > 0.7 ? "#ffffff" : "#bcd0ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  drawCorridor();
}

function drawCorridor() {
  // perspective tunnel walls converging to a vanishing point
  const cx = W / 2;
  const vx = W / 2;
  const vy = HORIZON * 0.55;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const t = i / 5;
    const alpha = 0.15 + t * 0.25;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,150,255," + alpha + ")";
    // left wall
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vx, vy);
    ctx.lineTo(-40 + i * 30, H);
    ctx.stroke();
    // right wall
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vx, vy);
    ctx.lineTo(W + 40 - i * 30, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // floor grid lines scrolling toward viewer
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80,140,255,0.18)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const p = ((time * 0.6 + i / 8) % 1);
    const y = vy + (H - vy) * (p * p);
    const half = 40 + (W / 2 - 40) * (p * p);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - half, y);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + half, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // glowing horizon line
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,180,255,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, HORIZON);
  ctx.lineTo(W, HORIZON);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawArwing(x, y, scale) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  // engine glow
  const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 26, 2, 0, 26, 26);
  eg.addColorStop(0, "#fff2a0");
  eg.addColorStop(0.5, "#ff8a3c");
  eg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = eg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 26, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // main fuselage (white)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eef2ff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -26);
  ctx.lineTo(12, 6);
  ctx.lineTo(12, 22);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, 22);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, 6);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // wings (blue)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f6bd6";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-12, 6);
  ctx.lineTo(-34, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(-14, 24);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, 6);
  ctx.lineTo(34, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(14, 24);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // cockpit (red)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3b4d";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, -8, 5, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(m) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4a6b";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -18);
  ctx.lineTo(18, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 20);
  ctx.lineTo(-18, 0);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2b45";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-18, 0); ctx.lineTo(-30, 10); ctx.lineTo(-14, 14); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(18, 0); ctx.lineTo(30, 10); ctx.lineTo(14, 14); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5c5c";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBoss(b) {
  const s = 1 + (1 - bossEnter) * 0; // scale stable
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
  // aura
  const ag = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 20, 0, 0, 130);
  ag.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,60,90,0.35)");
  ag.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,60,90,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = ag;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 130, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // big hull
  ctx.fillStyle = "#20263f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -70);
  ctx.lineTo(70, -10);
  ctx.lineTo(50, 55);
  ctx.lineTo(-50, 55);
  ctx.lineTo(-70, -10);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // side pods
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f6bd6";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-70, -10); ctx.lineTo(-100, 20); ctx.lineTo(-60, 45); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(70, -10); ctx.lineTo(100, 20); ctx.lineTo(60, 45); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // central core
  const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 5, 3, 0, 5, 30);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "#fff2a0");
  cg.addColorStop(0.5, "#ff8a3c");
  cg.addColorStop(1, "#c02030");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 5, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // eye ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff5c5c";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 5, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMover(m) {
  if (m.type === "pbullet") {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 1, m.x, m.y, m.r * 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#fff6c0");
    g.addColorStop(0.6, "#ffb02e");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,40,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (m.type === "ebullet") {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 1, m.x, m.y, m.r * 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#ffd0e0");
    g.addColorStop(0.6, "#ff3b6b");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,59,107,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (m.type === "enemy") {
    drawEnemy(m);
  } else if (m.type === "boss") {
    drawBoss(m);
  } else if (m.type === "spark") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, m.life / 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd27a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, 24, 34);
  ctx.font = "16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9fb4ff";
  if (!bossActive) {
    ctx.fillText("WAVE " + wave + "   " + waveKills + "/" + waveTarget, 24, 58);
  }
  // boss health bar
  if (bossActive) {
    const bw = 360, bx = W / 2 - bw / 2, by = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx - 4, by - 4, bw + 8, 22);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a0d18";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 14);
    const pct = Math.max(0, bossHP / bossMaxHP);
    const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + bw, 0);
    hg.addColorStop(0, "#ff5c5c");
    hg.addColorStop(1, "#ff2d6b");
    ctx.fillStyle = hg;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * pct, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 14px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("DOOMED FORTRESS", W / 2, by + 34);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,6,15,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = "bold 54px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cdd8ff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 26);
  ctx.font = "16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fa0d0";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO " + (state === "start" ? "LAUNCH" : "RE-FLY"), W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
  }
  drawBackground();

  // draw movers
  for (const m of movers) drawMover(m);

  // draw player (blink when invulnerable)
  const blink = player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(time * 20) % 2 === 0;
  if (!blink) drawArwing(player.x, player.y, 1);

  ctx.restore();

  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (flash * 0.5) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  if (state === "play") drawHUD();
  if (state === "start") drawOverlay("STAR FOX 64", "Fly the Arwing. Clear the wave. Take down the fortress.", "#7db4ff");
  if (state === "win") drawOverlay("MISSION COMPLETE", "Final score: " + score, "#7dffb0");
  if (state === "lose") drawOverlay("ARWING DOWN", "Score: " + score, "#ff7d7d");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
//  MAIN LOOP
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp big frame gaps
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Whale Road</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04070d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;overflow:hidden}
  #game{display:block;box-shadow:0 0 70px rgba(0,0,0,.85);border:1px solid #12203a;border-radius:3px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const G = 0.24;
const HORIZON = 322;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let frame = 0;
let shake = 0;
let player = null;
let movers = [];
const stars = [];
const rain = [];

function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }

function initStars(){
  stars.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<130;i++) stars.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,HORIZON-40), r:rand(0.4,1.6), a:rand(0.25,0.95), tw:rand(0,TAU)});
}
function initRain(){
  rain.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<95;i++) rain.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,H), v:rand(7,15), len:rand(9,22)});
}
function resetPlayer(){
  player = {x:150, y:300, vx:0, vy:0, r:14, facing:1, onGround:false, coyote:0, jumpBuf:0, invuln:0};
}
function reset(){
  movers.length = 0;
  score = 0;
  frame = 0;
  shake = 0;
  resetPlayer();
  state = 'play';
}

function spawnMover(){
  const type = Math.random() < 0.32 ? 'bullet' : 'dagger';
  const x = W + 40;
  const y = rand(150, 470);
  const speed = type === 'bullet' ? rand(5,8) : rand(3.4,5);
  movers.push({type, x, y, vx:-speed, vy:0, r:type==='bullet'?10:13, spin:0, alive:true});
}

function addParticles(x,y,n,base){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = rand(0,TAU);
    const sp = rand(1,5);
    movers.push({type:'spark', x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-1, r:rand(1.5,3), life:rand(20,45), max:45, base, alive:true});
  }
}

function start(){
  initStars();
  initRain();
  reset();
}

function end(win){
  state = win ? 'win' : 'over';
  shake = 16;
}

function collide(a, b){
  const dx = a.x-b.x, dy = a.y-b.y;
  const rr = a.r + b.r;
  return (dx*dx + dy*dy) < rr*rr;
}

function updatePlayer(){
  const p = player;
  if(p.invuln > 0) p.invuln--;
  if(p.jumpBuf > 0) p.jumpBuf--;
  if(p.coyote > 0) p.coyote--;

  if(keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) p.vx = -3.6;
  else if(keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) p.vx = 3.6;
  else p.vx *= 0.78;

  p.vy += G;
  if(p.vy > 13) p.vy = 13;

  if((keys['w'] || keys['arrowup'] || keys[' ']) && p.jumpBuf === 0) p.jumpBuf = 8;

  if(p.jumpBuf > 0 && (p.onGround || p.coyote > 0)){
    p.vy = -9.6;
    p.onGround = false;
    p.coyote = 0;
    p.jumpBuf = 0;
    addParticles(p.x, p.y+p.r, 6, 'rgba(200,220,255,0.7)');
  }

  p.x += p.vx;
  p.y += p.vy;

  if(p.x < p.r){ p.x = p.r; p.vx = 0; }
  if(p.x > W-p.r){ p.x = W-p.r; p.vx = 0; }

  if(p.y > H - p.r - 24){
    if(p.vy > 4) addParticles(p.x, H-24, 4, 'rgba(150,180,210,0.5)');
    p.y = H - p.r - 24;
    p.vy = 0;
    if(!p.onGround) p.coyote = 8;
    p.onGround = true;
  } else {
    p.onGround = false;
  }

  if(p.vx > 0.2) p.facing = 1; else if(p.vx < -0.2) p.facing = -1;
}

function updateMovers(){
  for(let i=movers.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.type === 'spark'){
      m.vy += G*0.5;
      m.life--;
      if(m.life <= 0) movers.splice(i,1);
      continue;
    }
    m.x += m.vx;
    m.y += m.vy;
    if(m.type === 'dagger') m.spin += 0.25;
    if(m.x < -60 || m.y > H+40){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(state === 'play' && player.invuln <= 0 && collide(player, m)){
      addParticles(player.x, player.y, 22, 'rgba(255,120,90,0.9)');
      shake = 14;
      player.invuln = 90;
      player.vy = -6;
      player.vx = (player.x < m.x ? -4 : 4);
      end(false);
    }
  }
}

function update(){
  frame++;
  if(shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
  if(state === 'play'){
    if(frame % 55 === 0) spawnMover();
    updatePlayer();
  }
  updateMovers();
  for(let i=0;i<rain.length;i++){
    const r = rain[i];
    r.y += r.v; r.x -= r.v*0.35;
    if(r.y > H){ r.y = -20; r.x = rand(0,W); }
  }
}

function drawSky(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#050912');
  g.addColorStop(0.45,'#0c1a30');
  g.addColorStop(0.75,'#16283f');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0a1420');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  for(let i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
    const s = stars[i];
    const a = s.a*(0.55 + 0.45*Math.sin(frame*0.03 + s.tw));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,225,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }

  const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(720,110,10,720,110,190);
  mg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(180,200,255,0.55)');
  mg.addColorStop(0.4,'rgba(120,150,220,0.18)');
  mg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,150,220,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = mg; ctx.fillRect(530,-80,380,380);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e9efff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(720,110,46,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,170,210,0.5)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(705,100,9,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(735,125,6,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
}

function drawSea(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,HORIZON,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#13263d');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#060f1a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,HORIZON,W,H-HORIZON);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,170,210,0.10)';
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    const y = HORIZON + 8 + i*16;
    const w = 60 + (i%3)*30;
    const x = ((frame*0.3 + i*130) % (W+200)) - 100;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 2);
  }
}

function drawSkyline(){
  const base = HORIZON;
  const towers = [
    {x:120,w:46,h:150},{x:250,w:34,h:210},{x:430,w:56,h:120},
    {x:560,w:40,h:180},{x:690,w:60,h:140},{x:820,w:36,h:195}
  ];
  for(let i=0;i<towers.length;i++){
    const t = towers[i];
    const y = base - t.h;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#08101d';
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, y, t.w, t.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0c1a2c';
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, y, t.w, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,205,120,0.55)';
    for(let wy=y+10; wy<base-6; wy+=14){
      for(let wx=t.x+6; wx<t.x+t.w-4; wx+=12){
        if(((wx*7 + wy*3 + i) % 5) < 2) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 4, 5);
      }
    }
  }
  const sx = 360, sw = 12, sy = base - 250;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#08101d';
  ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, sw, 250);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx-8, sy); ctx.lineTo(sx+sw+8, sy); ctx.lineTo(sx+sw/2, sy-40); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,205,120,0.6)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx+sw/2, sy-40); ctx.lineTo(sx+sw/2, sy-58); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawWhale(){
  const bx = 560, by = 250, s = 1.4;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx,by,10,bx,by,120);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,150,200,0.25)');
  g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,150,200,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(bx-120,by-120,240,240);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a1524';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(bx, by, 95*s, 34*s, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx+70*s, by);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx+130*s, by-55*s, bx+150*s, by-10*s);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx+120*s, by+10*s, bx+80*s, by+8*s);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bx+40*s, by-18*s);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx+70*s, by-70*s, bx+95*s, by-40*s);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx+70*s, by-25*s, bx+45*s, by-15*s);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx-55*s, by-8*s, 3.5*s, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,230,255,0.5)';
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx-20*s + i*10*s, by-24*s, 2.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawRain(){
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,190,225,0.28)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for(let i=0;i<rain.length;i++){
    const r = rain[i];
    ctx.moveTo(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.lineTo(r.x - r.len*0.35, r.y + r.len);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawMovers(){
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.type === 'spark'){
      const a = Math.max(0, m.life/m.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.base.replace(/[\d.]+\)$/, (a*0.9).toFixed(2)+')');
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      continue;
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    if(m.type === 'bullet'){
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,1,0,0,20);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,180,80,0.9)');
      g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,120,40,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,20,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,7,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2cf';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-2,-2,3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.rotate(m.spin);
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-14,0,14,0);
      g.addColorStop(0,'#7fe0ff');
      g.addColorStop(1,'#1f6fb0');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-14,-3); ctx.lineTo(10,-3); ctx.lineTo(14,0); ctx.lineTo(10,3); ctx.lineTo(-14,3);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2540';
      ctx.fillRect(-16,-4,5,8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,-2); ctx.lineTo(9,-2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  if(state === 'play' && p.invuln > 0 && (frame>>2) % 2 === 0) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
  ctx.scale(p.facing, 1);
  const leg = Math.sin(frame*0.35)* (p.onGround ? 4 : 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1220';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, p.r+2, 16, 5, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2740';
  ctx.fillRect(-9, 4, 6, 12+leg);
  ctx.fillRect(3, 4, 6, 12-leg);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#243456';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -2, 12, 15, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#152238';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,-6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-22,-2,-16,10); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-10,4,-8,-4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3d63';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(2, -16, 9, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#101a2c';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6,-22); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(2,-30,12,-22); ctx.lineTo(12,-18); ctx.lineTo(-6,-18); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5,-16,2.2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,14,24,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(14,14,190,34);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a';
  ctx.font = '12px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE', 28, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eef3ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText(String(score), 28, 34);
}

function drawOverlay(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,6,12,0.62)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Georgia';
  if(state === 'start'){
    ctx.fillText('WHALE ROAD', W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b9c6e0';
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('The whale rises. The Wardens\' bolts fall from the dark.', W/2, H/2 + 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fa2c4';
    ctx.font = '15px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('A / D or Arrow Keys to move   ·   W / Space / Up to leap', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eef3ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press  SPACE  to begin', W/2, H/2 + 84);
  } else if(state === 'win'){
    ctx.fillText('THE WHALE IS FREE', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eef3ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fa2c4';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press  SPACE  to sail again', W/2, H/2 + 52);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9a7a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('TAKEN', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eef3ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fa2c4';
    ctx.font = '16px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('Press  SPACE  to try again', W/2, H/2 + 52);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake > 0.5) ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));
  drawSky();
  drawSkyline();
  drawWhale();
  drawSea();
  drawRain();
  drawMovers();
  if(state !== 'start') drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();
  ctx.restore();
  if(state !== 'play') drawOverlay();
}

const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(k === ' ') e.preventDefault();
  if(state === 'start' && k === ' ') reset();
  else if((state === 'win' || state === 'over') && k === ' ') reset();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
});

function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

start();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
