<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Stanley Parable — The Office</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #14110f;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    image-rendering: auto;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ---------- canvas setup ---------- */
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  /* ---------- constants ---------- */
  const GRAVITY = 1900;
  const WALK_SPEED = 240;
  const WALK_ACCEL = 2400;
  const JUMP_SPEED = 620;
  const COYOTE = 0.09;
  const JUMP_BUFFER = 0.12;
  const PLAYER_W = 22;
  const PLAYER_H = 44;
  const FLOOR_COLOR = '#b9a98f';
  const FLOOR_DARK  = '#8f7d63';
  const WALL_COLOR  = '#d9cdb4';
  const SKY_COLOR   = '#2b2622';

  /* ---------- state ---------- */
  let state = 'title';   // 'title' | 'playing' | 'win' | 'lose'
  let score = 0;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let winTime = 0;
  let loseTime = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  const player = {
    x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H,
    onGround: false,
    coyote: 0,
    jumpBuffer: 0,
    facing: 1,
    walkPhase: 0
  };

  /* ---------- world (short loop, no tilemap) ---------- */
  // One office scene: a floor, a couple of walls, a desk, and a door.
  // Movers are all kept in a single array; each has x, y, vx, vy.
  const movers = [];

  const platforms = [];   // static, non-moving
  const door = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 60, h: 90, open: false };

  function buildWorld() {
    movers.length = 0;
    platforms.length = 0;

    const floorY = H * 0.78;
    const ground = {
      x: -200, y: floorY, w: W + 400, h: H,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      kind: 'ground'
    };

    // a raised ledge to the right
    const ledge = {
      x: W * 0.55, y: floorY - 90, w: W * 0.35, h: 24,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      kind: 'ledge'
    };

    // a small floating step in the middle
    const step = {
      x: W * 0.32, y: floorY - 60, w: 90, h: 20,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      kind: 'step'
    };

    // a moving platform that shuttles left/right
    const shuttle = {
      x: W * 0.12, y: floorY - 130, w: 120, h: 18,
      vx: 70, vy: 0,
      kind: 'shuttle',
      minX: W * 0.08,
      maxX: W * 0.5
    };

    platforms.push(ground, ledge, step, shuttle);

    // The desk (a mover that sits still)
    const desk = {
      x: W * 0.22, y: floorY - 54, w: 110, h: 54,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      kind: 'desk'
    };
    movers.push(desk);

    // A falling paper that drifts down and gets dropped
    const paper = {
      x: W * 0.4, y: H * 0.1, w: 16, h: 16,
      vx: 24, vy: 40,
      kind: 'paper',
      spin: 0
    };
    movers.push(paper);

    // The door on the far right
    door.x = W * 0.9;
    door.y = floorY - door.h;
  }

  /* ---------- input ---------- */
  const keys = {
    left: false, right: false, jump: false
  };
  let jumpPressed = false;

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { keys.left = true; }
    if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { keys.right = true; }
    if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w' || k === ' ') {
      if (!keys.jump) { keys.jump = true; jumpPressed = true; }
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (state === 'title' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) {
      startGame();
    }
    if ((state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && k === 'r') {
      startGame();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') { keys.left = false; }
    if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') { keys.right = false; }
    if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w' || k === ' ') { keys.jump = false; }
  });

  // mouse / touch to start
  canvas.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (state === 'title') startGame();
    else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') startGame();
  });

  function startGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    elapsed = 0;
    buildWorld();
    player.x = W * 0.06;
    player.y = H * 0.78 - player.h;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = false;
    player.facing = 1;
    player.walkPhase = 0;
    door.open = false;
  }

  /* ---------- helpers ---------- */
  function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w &&
           a.x + a.w > b.x &&
           a.y < b.y + b.h &&
           a.y + a.h > b.y;
  }

  /* ---------- update ---------- */
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'playing') {
      updatePlayer(dt);
      updateMovers(dt);
      updatePlatforms(dt);
      checkWinLose();
      elapsed += dt;
      score += dt * 4;
    } else if (state === 'win') {
      updateMovers(dt);
      winTime += dt;
    } else if (state === 'lose') {
      updateMovers(dt);
      loseTime += dt;
    }
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 30);
  }

  function updatePlayer(dt) {
    // horizontal
    let ax = 0;
    if (keys.left) { ax -= WALK_ACCEL; player.facing = -1; }
    if (keys.right) { ax += WALK_ACCEL; player.facing = 1; }
    player.vx += ax * dt;
    if (ax === 0) {
      // friction
      player.vx *= Math.pow(0.0009, dt);
      if (Math.abs(player.vx) < 4) player.vx = 0;
    }
    player.vx = Math.max(-WALK_SPEED, Math.min(WALK_SPEED, player.vx));

    // gravity
    player.vy += GRAVITY * dt;

    // jump buffer & coyote
    if (jumpPressed) { player.jumpBuffer = JUMP_BUFFER; jumpPressed = false; }
    else player.jumpBuffer = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuffer - dt);

    if (player.onGround) player.coyote = COYOTE;
    else player.coyote = Math.max(0, player.coyote - dt);

    if (player.jumpBuffer > 0 && player.coyote > 0) {
      player.vy = -JUMP_SPEED;
      player.onGround = false;
      player.coyote = 0;
      player.jumpBuffer = 0;
    }

    // integrate
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;

    // collide with platforms (simple AABB, resolve per axis)
    player.onGround = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
      const p = platforms[i];
      if (rectsOverlap(player, p)) {
        // determine penetration
        const overlapX = Math.min(player.x + player.w - p.x, p.x + p.w - player.x);
        const overlapY = Math.min(player.y + player.h - p.y, p.y + p.h - player.y);
        if (overlapY < overlapX) {
          if (player.y < p.y) {
            // landed on top
            player.y = p.y - player.h;
            if (player.vy > 0) player.vy = 0;
            player.onGround = true;
            // ride moving shuttle
            if (p.kind === 'shuttle') player.x += p.vx * dt;
          } else {
            // hit from below
            player.y = p.y + p.h;
            if (player.vy < 0) player.vy = 0;
          }
        } else {
          if (player.x < p.x) {
            player.x = p.x - player.w;
            if (player.vx > 0) player.vx = 0;
          } else {
            player.x = p.x + p.w;
            if (player.vx < 0) player.vx = 0;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // walk animation phase
    if (player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 8) {
      player.walkPhase += dt * 12;
    }

    // fell off the world
    if (player.y > H + 200) {
      state = 'lose';
      loseTime = 0;
      shake = 6;
    }
  }

  function updateMovers(dt) {
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.kind === 'paper') {
        m.vy += GRAVITY * 0.15 * dt;
        m.spin += dt * 2;
        // drift
        m.vx += Math.sin(elapsed * 3 + i) * 6 * dt;
        if (m.y > H + 60) { movers.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      }
      if (m.kind === 'desk') {
        // sits still; clamp to floor
      }
    }
  }

  function updatePlatforms(dt) {
    for (let i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
      const p = platforms[i];
      if (p.kind === 'shuttle') {
        p.x += p.vx * dt;
        if (p.x < p.minX) { p.x = p.minX; p.vx = Math.abs(p.vx); }
        if (p.x + p.w > p.maxX + p.w) { /* noop */ }
        if (p.x + p.w > p.maxX + p.w) {}
        if (p.x + p.w >= p.maxX + p.w) {
          // reached right bound
        }
        if (p.x + p.w > p.maxX + p.w) {}
        // simpler bound check
        if (p.x < p.minX) { p.x = p.minX; p.vx = Math.abs(p.vx); }
        if (p.x + p.w > p.maxX + p.w) { p.x = p.maxX + p.w - p.w; p.vx = -Math.abs(p.vx); }
      }
    }
  }

  function checkWinLose() {
    const doorBox = { x: door.x, y: door.y, w: door.w, h: door.h };
    if (rectsOverlap(player, doorBox)) {
      state = 'win';
      winTime = 0;
      shake = 3;
    }
  }

  /* ---------- draw ---------- */
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      const s = shake;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawRoom();
    drawPlatforms();
    drawMovers();
    drawDoor();
    drawPlayer();
    drawForeground();

    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();
    if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
    if (state === 'win') drawWin();
    if (state === 'lose') drawLose();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // gradient sky
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#241f1b');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#2f2823');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1c1815');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // distant wall with a window
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a332c';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.15, W, H * 0.45);

    // window
    const wx = W * 0.5, wy = H * 0.2, ww = W * 0.2, wh = H * 0.22;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6b7a';
    ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, ww, wh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2c2620';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(wx, wy, ww, wh);
    // window panes
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(wx + ww / 2, wy); ctx.lineTo(wx + ww / 2, wy + wh);
    ctx.moveTo(wx, wy + wh / 2); ctx.lineTo(wx + ww, wy + wh / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // light through window
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,200,0.06)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(wx, wy + wh);
    ctx.lineTo(wx + ww, wy + wh);
    ctx.lineTo(wx + ww + 80, H * 0.78);
    ctx.lineTo(wx - 80, H * 0.78);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawRoom() {
    // floor
    const floorY = H * 0.78;
    const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, floorY, 0, H);
    fg.addColorStop(0, FLOOR_COLOR);
    fg.addColorStop(1, FLOOR_DARK);
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, floorY, W, H - floorY);

    // floor plank lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 80) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(i, floorY);
      ctx.lineTo(i - 40, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // baseboard
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6f614c';
    ctx.fillRect(0, floorY - 6, W, 6);

    // rug
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,60,50,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.3, floorY + 30, W * 0.3, H * 0.12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,180,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(W * 0.3 + 10, floorY + 40, W * 0.3 - 20, H * 0.12 - 20);
  }

  function drawPlatforms() {
    for (let i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
      const p = platforms[i];
      if (p.kind === 'ground') continue; // already drawn as floor
      if (p.kind === 'ledge' || p.kind === 'step') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a08e72';
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a6a52';
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y + p.h - 5, p.w, 5);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
      }
      if (p.kind === 'shuttle') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7a5f';
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5f5240';
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y + p.h - 4, p.w, 4);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
        // little handles
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3f3527';
        ctx.fillRect(p.x + 6, p.y - 6, 8, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(p.x + p.w - 14, p.y - 6, 8, 6);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawMovers() {
    for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
      const m = movers[i];
      if (m.kind === 'desk') {
        // desk top
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6b4a2f';
        ctx.fillRect(m.x, m.y, m.w, 12);
        // legs
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4f3826';
        ctx.fillRect(m.x + 6, m.y + 12, 8, m.h - 12);
        ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w - 14, m.y + 12, 8, m.h - 12);
        // monitor
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
        ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w / 2 - 22, m.y - 34, 44, 30);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a5a7a';
        ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w / 2 - 18, m.y - 30, 36, 22);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
        ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w / 2 - 6, m.y - 4, 12, 6);
      }
      if (m.kind === 'paper') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2);
        ctx.rotate(m.spin);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f0e6';
        ctx.fillRect(-m.w / 2, -m.h / 2, m.w, m.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-m.w / 2 + 3, -m.h / 2 + 4 + l * 3);
          ctx.lineTo(m.w / 2 - 3, -m.h / 2 + 4 + l * 3);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawDoor() {
    const d = door;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3f28';
    ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6e4e30';
    ctx.fillRect(d.x + 6, d.y + 6, d.w - 12, d.h - 12);
    // panel
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(d.x + 14, d.y + 18, d.w - 28, d.h - 40);
    // knob
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8b45a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x + d.w - 14, d.y + d.h / 2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // "EXIT" sign above
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f5a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(d.x + d.w / 2 - 26, d.y - 30, 52, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eafbe9';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('EXIT', d.x + d.w / 2, d.y - 20);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    const cx = p.x + p.w / 2;
    const top = p.y;
    const bob = Math.sin(p.walkPhase) * 2;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, H * 0.78 + 4, p.w * 0.9, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs
    const legSwing = Math.sin(p.walkPhase) * 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2f2a26';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - 4, top + p.h - 14);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - 4 + legSwing, top + p.h);
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 4, top + p.h - 14);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 4 - legSwing, top + p.h);
    ctx.stroke();

    // body (suit)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b3b45';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, top + 14 + bob, p.w, p.h - 24);
    // shirt
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e4da';
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 4, top + 16 + bob, 8, p.h - 30);
    // tie
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a2b2b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, top + 18 + bob);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 3, top + 22 + bob);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, top + 34 + bob);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - 3, top + 22 + bob);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e6c39c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, top + 8, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2e24';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, top + 5, 9, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // arm
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3b3b45';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    const armSwing = Math.cos(p.walkPhase) * 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + p.facing * 6, top + 20 + bob);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + p.facing * 12, top + 30 + bob + armSwing);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawForeground() {
    // subtle vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.3, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.8);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)');

  function overlayBase(alpha) {

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    overlayBase(0.55);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ead6';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(64, W * 0.07) + 'px Georgia, serif';

  function drawWin() {
    const a = Math.min(0.7, winTime * 1.5);
    overlayBase(a);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eafbe9';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(56, W * 0.06) + 'px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('YOU LEFT THE OFFICE', W / 2, H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c9b896';
    ctx.font = '20px Georgia, serif';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,220,0.7)';

  }

  function drawLose() {

    overlayBase(a);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(50, W * 0.055) + 'px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('STANLEY FELL THROUGH THE FLOOR', W / 2, H * 0.4);

    ctx.font = '18px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), W / 2, H * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,245,220,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press R or click to try again', W / 2, H * 0.62);
  }

  /* ---------- main loop ---------- */
  function loop(t) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
    let dt = (t - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = t;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;   // clamp big frame gaps
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // initial build so the scene is drawn even on the title screen

})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Adventure</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b1020;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;}

<canvas id="c" width="900" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
const GROUND=H-90;

// ---------- State ----------
const keys={};
let score=0, lives=3, state='start';
let frame=0;
const player={x:W/2,y:GROUND,vx:0,vy:0,w:34,h:44,inv:0,face:1};
const movers=[];

// ---------- Level (built in a short loop, no big tile map) ----------
function buildLevel(){
  movers.length=0;
  const plats=[
    {x:80,y:GROUND-90,w:150},
    {x:300,y:GROUND-160,w:150},
    {x:520,y:GROUND-100,w:150},
    {x:690,y:GROUND-210,w:120},
    {x:360,y:GROUND-260,w:120}
  ];
  plats.forEach(p=>movers.push({type:'platform',x:p.x,y:p.y,w:p.w,h:16,vx:0,vy:0,done:false}));
  const coins=[[200,GROUND-150],[375,GROUND-220],[595,GROUND-160],[750,GROUND-270],[420,GROUND-320]];
  coins.forEach(c=>movers.push({type:'coin',x:c[0],y:c[1],vx:0,vy:0,done:false,phase:Math.random()*6}));
  const enemies=[[250,GROUND-160,300,450],[560,GROUND-100,520,670],[720,GROUND-210,690,810]];
  enemies.forEach(e=>movers.push({type:'enemy',x:e[0],y:e[1],minx:e[2],maxx:e[3],vx:0,vy:0,done:false,dir:1,spd:1.6}));
}
function resetPlayer(){player.x=W/2;player.y=GROUND;player.vx=0;player.vy=0;player.inv=0;player.face=1;}
function startGame(){score=0;lives=3;buildLevel();resetPlayer();state='play';}

// ---------- Input ----------
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if(e.key===' '||e.key==='ArrowUp')e.preventDefault();
  if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&state!=='play')startGame();
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(){
  frame++;
  if(state!=='play')return;

  // Player
  const L=keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a'];
  const R=keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d'];
  const J=keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||keys[' '];
  const accel=0.9, max=5, fric=0.82, jump=13.5, grav=0.62;
  if(L){player.vx-=accel;player.face=-1;}
  if(R){player.vx+=accel;player.face=1;}
  if(!L&&!R)player.vx*=fric;
  player.vx=Math.max(-max,Math.min(max,player.vx));
  if(J&&player.y>=GROUND-0.5){player.vy=-jump;}
  player.vy+=grav;
  if(player.vy>16)player.vy=16;
  player.x+=player.vx;
  if(player.x<player.w/2)player.x=player.w/2;
  if(player.x>W-player.w/2)player.x=W-player.w/2;
  player.y+=player.vy;
  if(player.y>=GROUND){player.y=GROUND;player.vy=0;}
  if(player.inv>0)player.inv--;

  // Movers: move, drop done, then draw
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const o=movers[i];
    if(o.done){movers.splice(i,1);continue;}
    if(o.type==='enemy'){
      o.x+=o.dir*o.spd;
      if(o.x<o.minx){o.x=o.minx;o.dir=1;}
      if(o.x>o.maxx){o.x=o.maxx;o.dir=-1;}
    }
    if(o.type==='coin')o.phase+=0.15;
  }
  // Collisions
  for(const o of movers){
    if(o.type==='coin'){
      const dx=player.x-o.x, dy=(player.y-player.h/2)-o.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<34*34){score+=10;o.done=true;}
    }
    if(o.type==='enemy'){
      const dx=player.x-o.x, dy=(player.y-player.h/2)-o.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<30*30){
        if(player.vy>0&&player.y<o.y+10){player.vy=-8;score+=20;o.done=true;}
        else if(player.inv<=0){lives--;player.inv=70;resetPlayer();if(lives<=0)state='over';}
      }
    }
  }
  // Win
  if(movers.filter(o=>o.type==='coin').length===0)state='win';
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function drawBG(){
  const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#7ec8ff');sky.addColorStop(1,'#cdeeff');
  ctx.fillStyle=sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // sun
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe27a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W-110,90,44,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,226,122,0.35)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W-110,90,66,0,7);ctx.fill();
  // clouds
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  const clouds=[[150,80,1],[380,120,0.8],[640,70,1.1]];
  clouds.forEach(c=>{
    const x=c[0]+Math.sin(frame*0.01+c[1])*12;
    for(let k=0;k<4;k++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+k*26-30,c[1],26*c[2],0,7);ctx.fill();}
  });
  // hills
  ctx.fillStyle='#5bbf6a';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(180,GROUND+120,200,Math.PI,0);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#4aa95c';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(640,GROUND+150,260,Math.PI,0);ctx.fill();
  // ground
  ctx.fillStyle='#7a4a2b';ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND);
  ctx.fillStyle='#5fbf4a';ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,14);
  ctx.fillStyle='#4aa03a';
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=22)ctx.fillRect(x,GROUND+14,10,6);
}
function drawMovers(){
  for(const o of movers){
    if(o.type==='platform'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#8a5a34';ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h);
      ctx.fillStyle='#a9713f';ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,5);
      ctx.fillStyle='#6b4426';for(let x=o.x+8;x<o.x+o.w;x+=18)ctx.fillRect(x,o.y+6,3,o.h-8);
    }
    if(o.type==='coin'){
      const wob=Math.sin(o.phase)*3;
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y+wob,13,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff2b0';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x-4,o.y+wob-4,4,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#e0a800';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y+wob,13,0,7);ctx.stroke();
    }
    if(o.type==='enemy'){
      const hop=Math.abs(Math.sin(frame*0.15))*4;
      ctx.fillStyle='#c9302c';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y-hop,16,Math.PI,0);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(o.x-16,o.y-8-hop,32,10);
      ctx.fillStyle='#2b2b2b';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x-6,o.y-12-hop,3,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x+6,o.y-12-hop,3,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x-6,o.y-12-hop,1.4,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x+6,o.y-12-hop,1.4,0,7);ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayer(){
  if(player.inv>0&&Math.floor(frame/4)%2===0)return;
  const x=player.x,y=player.y,h=player.h;
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f6fd0';ctx.fillRect(x-11,y-22,22,22); // legs
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a82e0';ctx.fillRect(x-14,y-40,28,20); // torso
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2c49a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-50,10,0,7);ctx.fill(); // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#20242c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-54,10,Math.PI,0);ctx.fill(); // cap
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2c49a';ctx.fillRect(x+(player.face>0?4:-12),y-52,8,5); // brim
  ctx.fillStyle='#20242c';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+player.face*4,y-50,1.6,0,7);ctx.fill();
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,44);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 20px system-ui';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,18,22);
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText('LIVES',W-18,22);
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){ctx.fillStyle='#e0483f';ctx.beginPath();
    const hx=W-70-i*24,hy=22;
    ctx.moveTo(hx,hy+6);ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-10,hy-6,hx-2,hy-12,hx,hy-4);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+2,hy-12,hx+10,hy-6,hx,hy+6);ctx.fill();}
}
function overlay(title,sub,col){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.font='bold 52px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(title,W/2,H/2-24);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='20px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText(sub,W/2,H/2+24);
}
function draw(){
  drawBG();
  drawMovers();
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==='start')overlay('ADVENTURE','Press ENTER to start  •  ← → move  •  ↑ / SPACE jump','#ffd23a');
  if(state==='win')overlay('YOU WIN!','Score '+score+'  •  Press ENTER to play again','#7ef08a');
  if(state==='over')overlay('GAME OVER','Score '+score+'  •  Press ENTER to retry','#ff7a6e');
}

// ---------- Loop ----------
function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
buildLevel();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  var m={x:col*TILE,y:row*TILE,vx:vx,vy:vy,kind:kind,val:val,
    w:kind==='gold'?10:18, h:kind==='gold'?12:18,
    dir:1, phase:Math.random()*6.28, grounded:false, climbing:false, dead:false,
    homeX:col*TILE, homeY:row*TILE, patrol:kind==='enemy'?2.4:0,
    speed:kind==='enemy'?1.1:0, t:0};
  movers.push(m);
  if(kind==='enemy') enemies.push(m);
  return m;
}
function tileAt(col,row){
  if(col<0||col>=COLS) return 0;
  if(row<0||row>=ROWS) return 0;
  var r=row;
  if(r===20||r===21) return 1;
  if(r===12) return (col>=6&&col<=25)?1:0;
  if(r===10) return (col>=8&&col<=20)?1:0;
  if(r===5) return (col>=10&&col<=24)?1:0;
  if(r===2) return (col>=12&&col<=26)?1:0;
  if(r===3) return (col===4)?2:0;
  if(r===4) return (col===4||col===25)?2:0;
  if(r===6) return (col===11||col===23)?2:0;
  if(r===7) return (col===13)?2:0;
  if(r===8) return (col===15||col===21)?2:0;
  if(r===9) return (col===9)?2:0;
  if(r===11) return (col===7||col===17||col===24)?2:0;
  if(r===13) return (col===10)?2:0;
  if(r===14) return (col===14)?2:0;
  if(r===15) return (col===19)?2:0;
  if(r===16) return (col===12)?2:0;
  if(r===17) return (col===6||col===20)?2:0;
  if(r===18) return (col===16)?2:0;
  if(r===19) return (col===22)?2:0;
  return 0;
}
function solidAt(x,y){
  var c=Math.floor(x/TILE), r=Math.floor(y/TILE);
  if(c<0||c>=COLS||r<0||r>=ROWS) return 0;
  var t=tileAt(c,r);
  return t===1?1:0;
}
function ladderAt(x,y){
  var c=Math.floor(x/TILE), r=Math.floor(y/TILE);
  if(c<0||c>=COLS||r<0||r>=ROWS) return 0;
  return tileAt(c,r)===2?1:0;
}
function overlap(a,b){
  return a.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w>b.x && a.y<b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h>b.y;
}
function rectOf(m){
  return {x:m.x-m.w/2, y:m.y-m.h, w:m.w, h:m.h};
}
function updateMover(m,dt,canDie){
  var r=rectOf(m);
  if(m.climbing){
    if(input.down) m.vy=CLIMB;
    else if(input.up) m.vy=-CLIMB;
    else m.vy=0;
    m.vx=0;
    if(!ladderAt(m.x, m.y-1) && !ladderAt(m.x, m.y)) m.climbing=false;
  } else {
    if(input.left){ m.vx=-MOVE; m.dir=-1; }
    else if(input.right){ m.vx=MOVE; m.dir=1; }
    else m.vx=0;
    if(!m.grounded && !ladderAt(m.x,m.y)) m.vy=Math.min(m.vy+GRAVITY,MAXFALL);
    if(m.grounded && input.jumpEdge){ m.vy=JUMP; m.grounded=false; }
    if(input.downEdge && ladderAt(m.x, m.y)){ m.climbing=true; m.vy=0; }
  }
  var nx=m.x+m.vx, ny=m.y+m.vy;
  if(m.vx>0){ if(solidAt(nx+m.w/2, m.y-m.h*0.5)) nx=m.x; }
  else if(m.vx<0){ if(solidAt(nx-m.w/2, m.y-m.h*0.5)) nx=m.x; }
  if(m.vy>0){
    var prev=m.y; ny=m.y+m.vy;
    if(solidAt(nx-m.w*0.3,ny)||solidAt(nx,m.y+m.vy)||solidAt(nx+m.w*0.3,ny)){
      ny=Math.floor(ny/TILE)*TILE; m.vy=0; m.grounded=true;
    } else m.grounded=false;
  } else if(m.vy<0){
    ny=m.y+m.vy;
    if(solidAt(nx,ny-m.h)){ ny=m.y; m.vy=0; }
  } else m.grounded=false;
  m.x=nx; m.y=ny;
  if(m.y>H+40) m.dead=true;
  if(canDie && m.kind==='enemy'){
    for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      if(movers[i].kind==='player' && movers[i].dead) continue;
      if(overlap(rectOf(m), rectOf(movers[i]))){ m.dead=true; spawnBurst(m.x,m.y-m.h/2,'#ff6a4a',14); score+=25; break; }
    }
  }
}
function updatePlayer(dt){
  var p=player, r=rectOf(p);
  if(p.climbing){
    if(input.down) p.vy=CLIMB;
    else if(input.up) p.vy=-CLIMB;
    else p.vy=0;
    p.vx=0;
    if(!ladderAt(p.x,p.y-1) && !ladderAt(p.x,p.y)) p.climbing=false;
  } else {
    if(input.left){ p.vx=-MOVE; p.facing=-1; }
    else if(input.right){ p.vx=MOVE; p.facing=1; }
    else p.vx=0;
    if(!p.grounded && !ladderAt(p.x,p.y)) p.vy=Math.min(p.vy+GRAVITY,MAXFALL);
    if(p.grounded && input.jumpEdge){ p.vy=JUMP; p.grounded=false; }
    if(input.downEdge && ladderAt(p.x,p.y)){ p.climbing=true; p.vy=0; }
  }
  var nx=p.x+p.vx, ny=p.y+p.vy;
  if(p.vx>0){ if(solidAt(nx+p.w/2, p.y-p.h*0.5)) nx=p.x; }
  else if(p.vx<0){ if(solidAt(nx-p.w/2, p.y-p.h*0.5)) nx=p.x; }
  if(p.vy>0){
    ny=p.y+p.vy;
    if(solidAt(nx-p.w*0.3,ny)||solidAt(nx,ny)||solidAt(nx+p.w*0.3,ny)){ ny=Math.floor(ny/TILE)*TILE; p.vy=0; p.grounded=true; }
    else p.grounded=false;
  } else if(p.vy<0){
    ny=p.y+p.vy;
    if(solidAt(nx,ny-p.h)){ ny=p.y; p.vy=0; }
  } else p.grounded=false;
  p.x=nx; p.y=ny;
  if(p.y>H+40){ p.dead=true; lose=true; loseT=0; }
  if(p.inv>0) p.inv-=dt;
  for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
    var m=movers[i];
    if(m.kind==='gold' && overlap(rectOf(p),rectOf(m))){ m.dead=true; score+=50; spawnBurst(m.x,m.y-m.h/2,'#ffe27a',12); }
    if(m.kind==='enemy' && p.inv<=0 && overlap(rectOf(p),rectOf(m))){ p.dead=true; lose=true; loseT=0; shake=14; spawnBurst(p.x,p.y-p.h/2,'#ff5a4a',20); }
  }
}
function updateEnemyAI(m,dt){
  m.t+=dt;
  if(m.climbing){
    m.vy = (m.y>12*TILE)?-CLIMB:CLIMB;
    if(m.y<2.2*TILE && m.y>2.0*TILE){ m.climbing=false; }
  } else {
    m.vy=0;
    var pc=Math.floor(player.x/TILE), mc=Math.floor(m.x/TILE);
    var see = Math.abs(player.y-m.y)<2.5*TILE && Math.abs(player.x-m.x)<7*TILE;
    var target;
    if(see) target=pc; else target=Math.round(m.homeX/TILE);
    if(mc<target) m.dir=1; else if(mc>target) m.dir=-1; else m.dir=0;
    m.vx=m.dir*m.speed;
    if(m.vx>0 && solidAt(m.x+m.w/2+2, m.y-6)) m.vx=0;
    if(m.vx<0 && solidAt(m.x-m.w/2-2, m.y-6)) m.vx=0;
    if(m.vy>0){
      if(solidAt(m.x-m.w*0.3,m.y+m.vy)||solidAt(m.x,m.y+m.vy)||solidAt(m.x+m.w*0.3,m.y+m.vy)){ m.vy=0; m.grounded=true; } else m.grounded=false;
    } else m.grounded=false;
    if(!m.grounded && !ladderAt(m.x,m.y)) m.vy=Math.min(m.vy+GRAVITY,MAXFALL);
    if(m.grounded && ladderAt(m.x,m.y) && (m.y>12*TILE || m.y<2.6*TILE)){ m.climbing=true; }
  }
}
function spawnBurst(x,y,color,n){
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var a=Math.random()*6.28, s=1+Math.random()*3.5;
    particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s-1,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.4,max:0.9,color:color,size:1.5+Math.random()*2});
  }
}
function updateParticles(dt){
  for(var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var p=particles[i]; p.vy+=0.15; p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}
function update(dt){
  if(state==='start'){
    for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].kind==='enemy') updateEnemyAI(movers[i],dt); }
    return;
  }
  if(state==='over'){
    updateParticles(dt);
    if(lose) loseT+=dt; else winT+=dt;
    if(lose && loseT>1.4) state='dead';
    if(win && winT>1.6) state='won';
    return;
  }
  if(state==='playing'){
    time+=dt;
    for(var j=0;j<movers.length;j++){
      var m=movers[j];
      if(m.kind==='enemy') updateEnemyAI(m,dt);
      updateMover(m,dt,true);
    }
    updatePlayer(dt);
    updateParticles(dt);
    var alive=0;
    for(var k=0;k<movers.length;k++){ if(!movers[k].dead && movers[k].kind==='gold') alive++; }
    if(alive===0 && !player.dead){ win=true; state='over'; }
  }
}
function drawBackground(){
  var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,BG1); g.addColorStop(0.55,BG2); g.addColorStop(1,BG3);
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();
  for(var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
    var s=stars[i]; s.tw+=0.02*s.sp;
    var a=0.35+0.35*Math.sin(s.tw);
    ctx.globalAlpha=a; ctx.fillStyle='#cdd8ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.82,H*0.16,40,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.82,H*0.16,26,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
}
function drawTile(c,r,t){
  var x=c*TILE, y=r*TILE;
  if(t===1){
    ctx.fillStyle=WALL; ctx.fillRect(x,y,TILE,TILE);
    ctx.fillStyle=WALL_HI; ctx.fillRect(x,y,TILE,3);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.28)'; ctx.fillRect(x,y+TILE-4,TILE,4);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(x+6,y+6,2,2); ctx.fillRect(x+13,y+11,2,2);
  } else if(t===2){
    ctx.fillStyle=LAD; ctx.fillRect(x+6,y,3,TILE); ctx.fillRect(x+11,y,3,TILE);
    ctx.fillStyle=LAD_HI;
    for(var i=0;i<4;i++) ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+2+i*6,12,2);
  }
}
function drawWorld(){
  for(var r=0;r<ROWS;r++) for(var c=0;c<COLS;c++){
    var t=tileAt(c,r);
    if(t) drawTile(c,r,t);
  }
}
function drawGold(m){
  var x=m.x, y=m.y-m.h/2;
  var bob=Math.sin(time*3+m.phase)*1.5;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,220,90,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  ctx.fillStyle=GOLD;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y+bob,5,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle=GOLD_HI;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-1.5,y+bob-1.5,1.8,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawEnemy(m){
  var x=m.x, y=m.y;
  ctx.fillStyle=ENEMY2; ctx.fillRect(x-8,y-14,16,14);
  ctx.fillStyle=ENEMY; ctx.fillRect(x-8,y-16,16,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=ENEMY_HI; ctx.fillRect(x-8,y-16,16,1);
  ctx.fillStyle='#0b0e16'; ctx.fillRect(x-5,y-13,3,3); ctx.fillRect(x+2,y-13,3,3);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a4a'; ctx.fillRect(x-4.5,y-12.5,2,2); ctx.fillRect(x+2.5,y-12.5,2,2);
  ctx.fillStyle=ENEMY2; ctx.fillRect(x-7,y,14,4);
}
function drawPlayer(p){
  var x=p.x, y=p.y;
  if(p.inv>0 && Math.floor(p.inv*20)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL; ctx.fillRect(x-7,y-18,14,14);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL2; ctx.fillRect(x-7,y-18,14,3);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL3; ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-16,12,2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#0b0e16'; ctx.fillRect(x-4,y-15,3,3); ctx.fillRect(x+1,y-15,3,3);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL4; ctx.fillRect(x-3.5,y-14.5,2,2); ctx.fillRect(x+1.5,y-14.5,2,2);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL; ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-4,4,4); ctx.fillRect(x+2,y-4,4,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=PAL2; ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-4,4,1); ctx.fillRect(x+2,y-4,4,1);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawMovers(){
  for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
    var m=movers[i];
    if(m.dead) continue;
    if(m.kind==='gold') drawGold(m);
    else if(m.kind==='enemy') drawEnemy(m);
  }
  if(!player.dead) drawPlayer(player);
}
function drawParticles(){
  for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){
    var p=particles[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-p.size/2,p.y-p.size/2,p.size,p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,26);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe27a'; ctx.font='bold 14px ui-monospace,monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score, 12, 14);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fd0ff';
  ctx.fillText('TIME '+Math.floor(time)+'s', W-12, 14);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a';
  var goldLeft=0; for(var i=0;i<movers.length;i++) if(!movers[i].dead && movers[i].kind==='gold') goldLeft++;
  ctx.fillText('GOLD '+goldLeft, W/2, 14);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function centerText(text,y,font,color){
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.font=font; ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.fillText(text, W/2, y);
}
function drawOverlays(){
  if(state==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,15,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    centerText('LODE RUNNER', H*0.32, 'bold 40px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ffe27a');
    centerText('Grab every gold bar. Dodge the grey guards.', H*0.42, '15px ui-monospace,monospace', '#cdd8ff');
    centerText('Move: Arrow Keys / WASD', H*0.52, '14px ui-monospace,monospace', '#9fd0ff');
    centerText('Jump: Space / Up   ·   Ladders: Up & Down', H*0.58, '14px ui-monospace,monospace', '#9fd0ff');
    if(Math.floor(time*2)%2===0)
      centerText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  START', H*0.70, 'bold 18px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ff7a6a');
  }
  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,15,'+Math.min(0.7,winT*0.5)+')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    if(win) centerText('LEVEL CLEARED!', H*0.42, 'bold 34px ui-monospace,monospace', '#7dff9a');
    else centerText('YOU DIED', H*0.42, 'bold 34px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ff5a4a');
    centerText('Score '+score+'   ·   Time '+Math.floor(time)+'s', H*0.52, '16px ui-monospace,monospace', '#cdd8ff');
  }
  if(state==='dead'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,15,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    centerText('GAME OVER', H*0.4, 'bold 34px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ff5a4a');
    centerText('Score '+score, H*0.5, '16px ui-monospace,monospace', '#cdd8ff');
    centerText('Press ENTER to retry', H*0.6, 'bold 16px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ffe27a');
  }
  if(state==='won'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,15,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    centerText('YOU WIN!', H*0.4, 'bold 36px ui-monospace,monospace', '#7dff9a');
    centerText('Score '+score+'   ·   Time '+Math.floor(time)+'s', H*0.5, '16px ui-monospace,monospace', '#cdd8ff');
    centerText('Press ENTER to play again', H*0.6, 'bold 16px ui-monospace,monospace', '#ffe27a');
  }
}
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0){ ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake); shake*=0.85; if(shake<0.5) shake=0; }
  drawBackground();
  drawWorld();
  drawMovers();
  drawParticles();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlays();
}
function readInput(){
  input.left=held.left; input.right=held.right; input.up=held.up; input.down=held.down;
  input.jumpEdge=keys[' ']||keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||keys['W'];
  input.downEdge=keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']||keys['S'];
  input.upEdge=keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||keys['W'];
}
function updateHeld(){
  held.left=keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']||keys['A'];
  held.right=keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']||keys['D'];
  held.up=keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||keys['W'];
  held.down=keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']||keys['S'];
}
function startGame(){
  reset();
  state='playing';
}
function handleStart(){
  if(state==='start') startGame();
  else if(state==='dead'||state==='won') startGame();
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  var k=e.key;
  if(k==='Enter'){ handleStart(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
  if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown',' '].indexOf(k)>=0) e.preventDefault();
  keys[k]=true;
  updateHeld();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
  keys[e.key]=false;
  updateHeld();
});
function touchDir(e){
  if(e.touches.length===0){ held.left=held.right=held.up=held.down=false; return; }
  var t=e.touches[0], r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x=(t.clientX-r.left)/r.width, y=(t.clientY-r.top)/r.height;
  held.left=x<0.34; held.right=x>0.66; held.up=y<0.34; held.down=y>0.66;
  if(x>=0.34&&x<=0.66&&y>=0.34&&y<=0.66){ held.left=held.right=held.up=held.down=false; if(state==='start') startGame(); }
}
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', touchDir, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', touchDir, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', touchDir, {passive:false});

var last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  var dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  readInput();
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Marble Madness — The Gauntlet</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ====== STATE ======
const canvas = document.getElementById("gameCanvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

const G = 0.35;
const FRICTION = 0.997;
const MARBLE_R = 10;
const MARBLE_COLOR = "#00e5ff";
const MARBLE_GLOW = "#0066ff";
const MARBLE_HIGHLIGHT = "#ffffff";

let marble = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false, spin: 0 };
let state = "title"; // title, playing, won, lost
let score = 0;
let winTimer = 0;
let loseTimer = 0;
let particles = [];
let bgStars = [];

// Create bgStars before any draw
for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
  bgStars.push({
    x: Math.random() * 2000,
    y: Math.random() * 1200,
    r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
    brightness: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3
  });
}

function resetMarble() {
  marble.x = W * 0.12;
  marble.y = H * 0.12;
  marble.vx = 0;
  marble.vy = 0;
  marble.onGround = false;
  marble.spin = 0;
}

function resetGame() {
  resetMarble();
  score = 0;
  winTimer = 0;
  loseTimer = 0;
  particles = [];
  state = "playing";
}

function startGame() {
  state = "title";
  resetMarble();
}

startGame();

// ====== INPUT ======
let keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (state === "title" && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
    resetGame();
  }
  if ((state === "won" || state === "lost") && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
    resetGame();
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

// ====== MOVERS (single array of objects with x, y, vx, vy) ======
const movers = [];

function buildMovers() {
  movers.length = 0;
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;

  // Rotating cross — center
  movers.push({ x: cx, y: cy, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "cross", angle: 0, angSpeed: 0.02, size: 60, color: "#ff4444" });

  // Rotating bar — upper left
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.3, y: H * 0.3, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "bar", angle: 0, angSpeed: 0.03, len: 120, color: "#ff8800" });

  // Rotating bar — lower right
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.7, y: H * 0.7, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "bar", angle: 0, angSpeed: -0.025, len: 100, color: "#ff2266" });

  // Oscillating platform — left
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.15, y: H * 0.55, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "platform", baseX: W * 0.15, baseY: H * 0.55, phase: 0, freq: 0.03, amp: 40, w: 80, h: 12, color: "#22ff88" });

  // Oscillating platform — right
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.85, y: H * 0.45, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "platform", baseX: W * 0.85, baseY: H * 0.45, phase: Math.PI, freq: 0.025, amp: 50, w: 70, h: 12, color: "#44ccff" });

  // Vertical oscillator — bottom center
  movers.push({ x: cx, y: H * 0.8, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "platform", baseX: cx, baseY: H * 0.8, phase: 0, freq: 0.035, amp: 30, w: 90, h: 12, color: "#ffcc00" });

  // Spinning star — upper right
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.65, y: H * 0.2, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "star", angle: 0, angSpeed: 0.04, size: 35, color: "#cc44ff" });

  // Spinning star — lower left
  movers.push({ x: W * 0.25, y: H * 0.75, vx: 0, vy: 0, type: "star", angle: 0, angSpeed: -0.035, size: 30, color: "#ff6644" });
}
buildMovers();

// ====== STATIC PLATFORMS ======
const platforms = [];
function buildPlatforms() {
  platforms.length = 0;
  const cx = W / 2;
  const cy = H / 2;

  // Starting ledge
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.05, y: H * 0.15, w: W * 0.2, h: 10, color: "#8888cc" });

  // Bridge to center
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.22, y: H * 0.35, w: W * 0.15, h: 10, color: "#8888cc" });

  // Center landing
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.35, y: H * 0.5, w: W * 0.3, h: 10, color: "#9999dd" });

  // Right bridge
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.62, y: H * 0.35, w: W * 0.15, h: 10, color: "#8888cc" });

  // Goal ledge
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.8, y: H * 0.15, w: W * 0.15, h: 10, color: "#88ff88" });

  // Extra step
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.45, y: H * 0.65, w: W * 0.1, h: 10, color: "#7777bb" });

  // Bottom catch
  platforms.push({ x: W * 0.3, y: H * 0.85, w: W * 0.4, h: 10, color: "#6666aa" });
}
buildPlatforms();

// ====== GOAL ======
const goal = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 20 };
function updateGoal() {
  goal.x = W * 0.88;
  goal.y = H * 0.12;
}
updateGoal();

// ====== PARTICLES ======
function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.02,
      color: color,
      size: Math.random() * 4 + 2
    });
  }
}

// ====== COLLISION HELPERS ======
function pointInRotatedRect(px, py, rx, ry, rw, rh, angle) {
  const dx = px - rx;
  const dy = py - ry;
  const cos = Math.cos(-angle);
  const sin = Math.sin(-angle);
  const lx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
  const ly = dx * sin + dy * cos;
  return Math.abs(lx) <= rw / 2 && Math.abs(ly) <= rh / 2;
}

function pointInRotatedBar(px, py, bx, by, blen, bang, bwidth) {
  const dx = px - bx;
  const dy = py - by;
  const cos = Math.cos(-bang);
  const sin = Math.sin(-bang);
  const lx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
  const ly = dx * sin + dy * cos;
  return Math.abs(lx) <= blen / 2 && Math.abs(ly) <= bwidth / 2;
}

function pointInRotatedStar(px, py, sx, sy, sSize, sAngle, sPoints) {
  const dx = px - sx;
  const dy = py - sy;
  const cos = Math.cos(-sAngle);
  const sin = Math.sin(-sAngle);
  const lx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
  const ly = dx * sin + dy * cos;
  const dist = Math.sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly);
  if (dist > sSize) return false;
  const angle = Math.atan2(ly, lx);
  const step = Math.PI * 2 / (sPoints * 2);
  const idx = Math.floor(angle / step + sPoints) % (sPoints * 2);
  const isOuter = idx % 2 === 0;
  const r = isOuter ? sSize : sSize * 0.5;
  return dist <= r;
}

function pointInRotatedCross(px, py, cx2, cy2, cSize, cAngle) {
  const dx = px - cx2;
  const dy = py - cy2;
  const cos = Math.cos(-cAngle);
  const sin = Math.sin(-cAngle);
  const lx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
  const ly = dx * sin + dy * cos;
  const armW = cSize * 0.3;
  return (Math.abs(lx) <= cSize && Math.abs(ly) <= armW) ||
         (Math.abs(ly) <= cSize && Math.abs(lx) <= armW);
}

// ====== UPDATE ======
let tick = 0;

function update() {
  tick++;

  // Update movers
  for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
    const m = movers[i];
    if (m.type === "cross" || m.type === "bar" || m.type === "star") {
      m.angle += m.angSpeed;
    } else if (m.type === "platform") {
      m.phase += m.freq;
      m.x = m.baseX + Math.cos(m.phase) * m.amp;
      m.y = m.baseY + Math.sin(m.phase) * m.amp * 0.5;
    }
  }

  // Drop done particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  if (state !== "playing") {
    if (state === "won") winTimer++;
    if (state === "lost") loseTimer++;
    return;
  }

  // Marble physics
  const left = keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"] || keys["A"];
  const right = keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"] || keys["D"];
  const up = keys["ArrowUp"] || keys["w"] || keys["W"] || keys[" "];

  const accel = 0.3;
  if (left) marble.vx -= accel;
  if (right) marble.vx += accel;
  if (up && marble.onGround) {
    marble.vy = -7;
    marble.onGround = false;
    spawnParticles(marble.x, marble.y + MARBLE_R, 5, "#ffffff");
  }

  marble.vy += G;
  marble.vx *= FRICTION;
  marble.x += marble.vx;
  marble.y += marble.vy;
  marble.spin += marble.vx * 0.05;

  // Check platform collisions
  marble.onGround = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
    const p = platforms[i];
    if (
      marble.x + MARBLE_R > p.x &&
      marble.x - MARBLE_R < p.x + p.w &&
      marble.y + MARBLE_R > p.y &&
      marble.y + MARBLE_R < p.y + p.h + 5 &&
      marble.vy >= 0
    ) {
      marble.y = p.y - MARBLE_R;
      marble.vy = 0;
      marble.onGround = true;
    }
  }

  // Check mover collisions (kill zone)
  for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
    const m = movers[i];
    let hit = false;
    if (m.type === "cross") {
      hit = pointInRotatedCross(marble.x, marble.y, m.x, m.y, m.size, m.angle);
    } else if (m.type === "bar") {
      hit = pointInRotatedBar(marble.x, marble.y, m.x, m.y, m.len, m.angle, 12);
    } else if (m.type === "platform") {
      hit = pointInRotatedRect(marble.x, marble.y, m.x, m.y, m.w, m.h, 0);
    } else if (m.type === "star") {
      hit = pointInRotatedStar(marble.x, marble.y, m.x, m.y, m.size, m.angle, 5);
    }
    if (hit) {
      state = "lost";
      loseTimer = 0;
      spawnParticles(marble.x, marble.y, 30, "#ff4444");
      spawnParticles(marble.x, marble.y, 20, "#ffaa00");
      return;
    }
  }

  // Goal check
  const dx = marble.x - goal.x;
  const dy = marble.y - goal.y;
  if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < goal.r + MARBLE_R) {
    state = "won";
    winTimer = 0;
    score = Math.max(0, 10000 - tick);
    spawnParticles(goal.x, goal.y, 40, "#00ff88");
    spawnParticles(goal.x, goal.y, 30, "#ffff00");
    spawnParticles(goal.x, goal.y, 20, "#00e5ff");
    return;
  }

  // Fall off bottom
  if (marble.y > H + 50) {
    state = "lost";
    loseTimer = 0;
    spawnParticles(marble.x, H, 25, "#ff4444");
    return;
  }

  // Fall off left/right
  if (marble.x < -50 || marble.x > W + 50) {
    state = "lost";
    loseTimer = 0;
    spawnParticles(marble.x, marble.y, 25, "#ff4444");
    return;
  }
}

// ====== DRAW ======
function drawBg() {
  // Gradient sky
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "#0a0a2e");
  grad.addColorStop(0.4, "#1a1a4e");
  grad.addColorStop(0.7, "#2a1a3e");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "#0a0a1e");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < bgStars.length; i++) {
    const s = bgStars[i];
    const sx = s.x % W;
    const sy = s.y % H;
    const flicker = s.brightness + Math.sin(tick * 0.02 + i) * 0.15;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${flicker})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Distant mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a3a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.6);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) {
    ctx.lineTo(x, H * 0.6 - Math.sin(x * 0.01) * 40 - Math.cos(x * 0.005) * 25);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, H);
  ctx.lineTo(0, H);
  ctx.fill();

  // Grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(100,100,200,0.15)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 50) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, H * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = H * 0.6; y < H; y += 30) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPlatforms() {
  for (let i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
    const p = platforms[i];
    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + 3, p.y + 3, p.w, p.h);
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
    // Top highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 3);
    // Bottom shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y + p.h - 3, p.w, 3);
  }
}

function drawMovers() {
  for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
    const m = movers[i];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.angle || 0);

    if (m.type === "cross") {
      const s = m.size;
      const armW = s * 0.3;
      // Glow
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      // Horizontal arm
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-s, -armW, s * 2, armW * 2);
      // Vertical arm
      ctx.fillRect(-armW, -s, armW * 2, s * 2);
      // Center circle
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, armW * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else if (m.type === "bar") {
      const l = m.len;
      const w = 12;
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-l / 2, -w / 2, l, w);
      // End caps
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-l / 2, 0, w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(l / 2, 0, w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else if (m.type === "platform") {
      const w = m.w;
      const h = m.h;
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
      ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, 3);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else if (m.type === "star") {
      const s = m.size;
      const points = 5;
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let j = 0; j < points * 2; j++) {
        const r = j % 2 === 0 ? s : s * 0.5;
        const a = (j * Math.PI) / points - Math.PI / 2;
        const px = Math.cos(a) * r;
        const py = Math.sin(a) * r;
        if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      // Center
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawGoal() {
  const pulse = Math.sin(tick * 0.05) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  // Outer glow
  ctx.shadowColor = "#00ff88";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30 * pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,136,${0.3 * pulse})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(goal.x, goal.y, goal.r + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#00ff88";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(goal.x, goal.y, goal.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Inner
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,136,${0.5 * pulse})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(goal.x, goal.y, goal.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Checkmark
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(goal.x - 8, goal.y);
  ctx.lineTo(goal.x - 2, goal.y + 7);
  ctx.lineTo(goal.x + 10, goal.y - 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawMarble() {
  const x = marble.x;
  const y = marble.y;
  const r = MARBLE_R;

  // Glow
  ctx.shadowColor = MARBLE_GLOW;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = MARBLE_COLOR;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  // Highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = MARBLE_HIGHLIGHT;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Spin indicator
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  const sa = marble.spin;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(sa) * r * 0.7, y + Math.sin(sa) * r * 0.7);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("TIME: " + Math.floor(tick / 60) + "s", 15, 30);

  // Marble count
  ctx.fillText("MARBLE: 1", 15, 55);

  // Controls hint
  if (state === "playing") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
    ctx.font = "12px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("← → move | ↑ / SPACE jump", W - 15, H - 15);
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#00e5ff";
  ctx.font = "bold 48px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#0066ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.fillText("MARBLE MADNESS", W / 2, H * 0.3);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("— THE GAUNTLET —", W / 2, H * 0.38);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
  ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Dodge the spinning obstacles. Reach the green goal!", W / 2, H * 0.5);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc00";
  ctx.font = "14px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("← → / A D  to move", W / 2, H * 0.58);
  ctx.fillText("↑ / W / SPACE  to jump", W / 2, H * 0.63);

  const blink = Math.sin(tick * 0.08) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00ff88";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE OR ENTER TO START", W / 2, H * 0.75);
  }
}

function drawWon() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#00ff88";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#00ff88";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
  ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, H * 0.35);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "24px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.48);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc00";
  ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("Time: " + Math.floor(tick / 60) + " seconds", W / 2, H * 0.56);

  const blink = Math.sin(tick * 0.08) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00e5ff";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE OR ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, H * 0.7);
  }
}

function drawLost() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4444";
  ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#ff0000";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
  ctx.fillText("MARBLE LOST!", W / 2, H * 0.35);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("You hit a hazard or fell off the track.", W / 2, H * 0.48);

  const blink = Math.sin(tick * 0.08) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00e5ff";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE OR ENTER TO RETRY", W / 2, H * 0.65);
  }
}

function draw() {
  drawBg();
  drawPlatforms();
  drawMovers();
  drawGoal();
  drawMarble();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();

  if (state === "title") drawTitle();
  else if (state === "won") drawWon();
  else if (state === "lost") drawLost();
}

// ====== MAIN LOOP ======
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Call of Duty — Operation: Nightfall</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0a0f14;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;}

<canvas id="c" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var canvas=document.getElementById('c');
var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
var W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
var G=1600;
var groundY=H-58;
var player={x:150,y:groundY-32,vx:0,vy:0,w:26,h:32};
var bullets=[];
var enemies=[];
var particles=[];
var keys={};
var mouse={x:W/2,y:H/2};
var score=0;
var health=100;
var state='start';
var lastShot=0;
var spawnTimer=0;
var shake=0;

function clamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);}
function rand(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}

function addMover(arr,o){o.x=o.x||0;o.y=o.y||0;o.vx=o.vx||0;o.vy=o.vy||0;arr.push(o);return o;}

function shoot(){
  var now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastShot<150)return;
  lastShot=now;
  var dx=mouse.x-player.x,dy=mouse.y-(player.y+6);
  var d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  addMover(bullets,{x:player.x,y:player.y+6,vx:dx/d*1100,vy:dy/d*1100,life:1.2,kind:'bullet'});
  addMover(particles,{x:player.x+dx/d*20,y:player.y+6+dy/d*20,vx:dx/d*120,vy:dy/d*120-40,life:0.12,kind:'flash',size:10});
  shake=Math.max(shake,2);
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  var fromLeft=Math.random()<0.5;
  addMover(enemies,{x:fromLeft?-30:W+30,y:groundY-34,vx:(fromLeft?1:-1)*rand(70,120),vy:0,
    kind:'enemy',hp:2,flash:0});
}

function explode(x,y){
  for(var i=0;i<14;i++){
    addMover(particles,{x:x,y:y,vx:rand(-260,260),vy:rand(-320,40),life:rand(.4,.9),kind:'spark',size:rand(2,5)});
  }
  addMover(particles,{x:x,y:y,vx:0,vy:-40,life:0.35,kind:'smoke',size:18});
  shake=Math.max(shake,5);
}

function hitEnemy(e,dmg){
  e.hp-=dmg;e.flash=0.12;
  if(e.hp<=0){
    score+=100;
    explode(e.x,e.y);
  }
}

function moveMovers(arr,dt,gravity){
  for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
    var o=arr[i];
    if(gravity)o.vy+=G*dt;
    o.x+=o.vx*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt;
    if(o.life!=null)o.life-=dt;
  }
}

function update(dt){
  if(state==='play'){
    var sp=340;
    player.vx=(keys['d']?sp:0)-(keys['a']?sp:0);
    player.x=clamp(player.x+player.vx*dt,20,W-20);
    if(keys['w']&&player.y+player.h>=groundY-1){player.vy=-620;}
    player.vy+=G*dt;
    player.y+=player.vy*dt;
    if(player.y+player.h>groundY){player.y=groundY-player.h;player.vy=0;}
    spawnTimer-=dt;
    if(spawnTimer<=0){spawnEnemy();spawnTimer=rand(0.8,1.6);}
    moveMovers(bullets,dt,true);
    moveMovers(enemies,dt,false);
    moveMovers(particles,dt,true);
    for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){
      var e=enemies[i];
      if(e.x>player.x-22&&e.x<player.x+22&&Math.abs(e.y+16-(player.y+16))<34){
        health-=35;e.hp=0;explode(e.x,e.y);
        if(health<=0){health=0;state='over';}
      }
    }
    for(var j=0;j<bullets.length;j++){
      var b=bullets[j];
      for(var k=0;k<enemies.length;k++){
        var en=enemies[k];

          hitEnemy(en,1);b.life=0;break;
        }

    }
    enemies=enemies.filter(function(e){return e.hp>0&&e.x>-60&&e.x<W+60;});
    bullets=bullets.filter(function(b){return b.life>0&&b.x>-20&&b.x<W+20&&b.y<H+20;});
    particles=particles.filter(function(p){return p.life>0;});
    shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*30);
  }
}

function drawBackground(){
  var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1220');g.addColorStop(.55,'#14202e');g.addColorStop(1,'#0d141c');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.5)';
  for(var i=0;i<40;i++){var sx=(i*137)%W,sy=(i*53)%200;ctx.globalAlpha=.2+.4*Math.abs(Math.sin(i));ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,1.4,1.4);}
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,210,225,.06)';
  for(var b=0;b<7;b++){var bx=(b*170+40)%W;ctx.fillRect(bx,150,60,200);}
  ctx.fillStyle='#0b1017';
  for(var t=0;t<10;t++){var tx=t*100+20;ctx.fillRect(tx,300,20,120);ctx.fillRect(tx-6,290,32,14);}
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0e13';ctx.fillRect(0,groundY,W,H-groundY);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(90,120,140,.25)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(var l=0;l<14;l++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(l*70,groundY);ctx.lineTo(l*70-40,H);ctx.stroke();}
}

function drawSoldier(x,y,w,h,face,flash){
  ctx.save();
  if(flash>0)ctx.filter='brightness(2.2)';
  var legC='#2b3a2c',coatC='#3c4a34',vestC='#2a3324',skin='#c9a583',helmet='#2f3a28';
  ctx.fillStyle=legC;ctx.fillRect(x-9,y+18,7,14);ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+18,7,14);
  ctx.fillStyle='#141414';ctx.fillRect(x-10,y+30,9,4);ctx.fillRect(x+1,y+30,9,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=coatC;ctx.fillRect(x-11,y-4,22,24);
  ctx.fillStyle=vestC;ctx.fillRect(x-8,y-2,16,15);
  ctx.fillStyle='#20261a';ctx.fillRect(x-8,y+2,16,3);
  ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-18,12,12);
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a1a';ctx.fillRect(x-6,y-14,12,5);
  ctx.fillStyle=helmet;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-18,8,Math.PI,0);ctx.fill();ctx.fillRect(x-8,y-19,16,3);
  ctx.fillStyle='#10151c';ctx.fillRect(x-4,y-2,2,2);ctx.fillRect(x+2,y-2,2,2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f36';ctx.fillRect(x+(face>0?4:-14),y-6,10,5);
  ctx.fillStyle='#1b1f24';ctx.fillRect(x+(face>0?12:-16),y-5,4,3);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0)ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake),rand(-shake,shake));
  drawBackground();
  for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){var e=enemies[i];drawSoldier(e.x,e.y,26,32,-1,e.flash>0);}
  if(state==='play'||state==='over')drawSoldier(player.x,player.y,26,32,1,0);
  for(var b=0;b<bullets.length;b++){var bl=bullets[b];
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,220,120,.5)';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(bl.x-bl.vx*0.012,bl.y-bl.vy*0.012);ctx.lineTo(bl.x,bl.y);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe9a8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bl.x,bl.y,3,0,7);ctx.fill();}
  for(var p=0;p<particles.length;p++){var pt=particles[p];
    if(pt.kind==='spark'){ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(pt.life,0,1);ctx.fillStyle='#ffb347';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.size,0,7);ctx.fill();}
    else if(pt.kind==='smoke'){ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(pt.life*1.4,0,1)*.5;ctx.fillStyle='#888';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.size,0,7);ctx.fill();}
    else if(pt.kind==='flash'){ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle='#fff2c0';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.size,0,7);ctx.fill();}}
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==='start')drawOverlay('start');
  if(state==='over')drawOverlay('over');

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.55)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,44);

  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillStyle='#e0e6ee';ctx.fillText('OBJECTIVE: SURVIVE THE NIGHT',W-20,22);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillStyle='#555';ctx.fillRect(20,50,220,14);
  ctx.fillStyle=health>30?'#5fd06a':'#e05548';ctx.fillRect(20,50,220*(health/100),14);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#888';ctx.strokeRect(20,50,220,14);
  ctx.fillStyle='#cdd4dd';ctx.font='11px Arial';ctx.fillText('INTEGRITY',20,74);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8a94a0';ctx.font='11px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('A / D  MOVE    W  JUMP    CLICK  FIRE',20,H-16);
}

function drawOverlay(kind){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,8,12,.78)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  if(kind==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#e8b24a';ctx.font='bold 52px Arial';ctx.fillText('CALL OF DUTY',W/2,H/2-70);
    ctx.fillStyle='#cdd4dd';ctx.font='22px Arial';ctx.fillText('Operation: Nightfall',W/2,H/2-30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8a94a0';ctx.font='15px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Hold the line. Move with A / D, jump with W, fire with your mouse.',W/2,H/2+10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#5fd06a';ctx.font='bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('— CLICK TO DEPLOY —',W/2,H/2+50);
  }else{
    ctx.fillStyle='#e05548';ctx.font='bold 54px Arial';ctx.fillText('K.I.A.',W/2,H/2-60);
    ctx.fillStyle='#cdd4dd';ctx.font='22px Arial';ctx.fillText('Final Score: '+score,W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8a94a0';ctx.font='15px Arial';ctx.fillText('The night claimed another soldier.',W/2,H/2+25);
    ctx.fillStyle='#5fd06a';ctx.font='bold 20px Arial';ctx.fillText('— CLICK TO REDEPLOY —',W/2,H/2+65);
  }
}

function reset(){
  score=0;health=100;
  bullets.length=0;enemies.length=0;particles.length=0;
  player.x=150;player.y=groundY-32;player.vy=0;
  spawnTimer=1;lastShot=0;
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){var k=e.key.toLowerCase();keys[k]=true;
  if(k==='w'||k===' ')e.preventDefault();});
window.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);mouse.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);});

});
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',function(e){e.preventDefault();});

var last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  var dt=Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05);last=now;
  update(dt);draw();

}
