<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Spacewar!</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    height: 100%; width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #04050f;
    font-family: "Courier New", ui-monospace, monospace;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Canvas + geometry
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0;

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tunable constants
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const THRUST = 130;        // engine acceleration
const TURN = 3.4;          // radians / second
const MAX_SPEED = 230;
const FRICTION = 0.985;
const SHIP_SIZE = 15;
const BULLET_SPEED = 430;
const MAX_SHOTS = 3;
const BULLET_LIFE = 2.2;   // seconds
const STAR_SIZE = 55;      // radius
const STAR_PULL = 1200;    // gravity strength
const STAR_KILL = 55;      // radius that destroys a ship
const STAR_BOUNCE = 15;    // radius that reflects bullets
const HYPERSPACE_CHANCE = 0.15;
const HYPERSPACE_DIST = 260;
const WARP = 0.9;          // velocity retained after hyperspace
const SCORE_WIN = 100;     // points to win

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// World state
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const world = {
  running: false,
  over: false,
  winner: null,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  flashColor: "255,255,255",
  stars: []
};

const player  = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, angle: -Math.PI/2, thrusting: false, alive: true, score: 0 };
const enemy   = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, angle: Math.PI/2,  thrusting: false, alive: true, score: 0, ai: { turn: 0, fireCd: 0, warpCd: 0, strafe: 1 } };

// The single movers array. Every ship / bullet / explosion / star lives here.
const movers = [];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (k === " " || k === "arrowup" || k === "arrowdown" || k === "arrowleft" || k === "arrowright") e.preventDefault();
  if (!world.running && !world.over) startGame();
  if (world.over && (k === "r" || k === " ")) startGame();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function angleDiff(a, b) {
  let d = (b - a) % (Math.PI * 2);
  if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
}

function addMover(m) { movers.push(m); }

function spawnExplosion(x, y, color, big) {
  const n = big ? 22 : 14;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = (big ? 200 : 130) * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.9);
    addMover({
      type: "explosion",
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6,
      maxLife: 1.2,
      color
    });
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Game setup / reset
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function startGame() {
  movers.length = 0;
  world.running = true;
  world.over = false;
  world.winner = null;
  world.time = 0;
  world.shake = 0;
  world.flash = 0;

  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const off = Math.min(W, H) * 0.28;
  player.x = cx;      player.y = cy + off;
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  player.angle = -Math.PI / 2; player.thrusting = false; player.alive = true; player.score = 0;

  enemy.x = cx;       enemy.y = cy - off;
  enemy.vx = 0; enemy.vy = 0;
  enemy.angle = Math.PI / 2; enemy.thrusting = false; enemy.alive = true; enemy.score = 0;
  enemy.ai = { turn: 0, fireCd: 1, warpCd: 0, strafe: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1 };

  // One central star
  addMover({ type: "star", x: cx, y: cy, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: STAR_SIZE, spin: 0 });

  // A few small decorative asteroids
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const d = Math.min(W, H) * (0.32 + Math.random() * 0.18);
    addMover({
      type: "asteroid",
      x: cx + Math.cos(a) * d,
      y: cy + Math.sin(a) * d,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
      r: 10 + Math.random() * 8,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI,
      spin: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5
    });
  }

  // Background starfield
  world.stars.length = 0;
  const count = Math.floor((W * H) / 9000);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    world.stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      z: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Shooting
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function fireShip(ship) {
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type === "bullet" && m.owner === ship) return; // already 3 in flight
  }
  const dx = Math.cos(ship.angle), dy = Math.sin(ship.angle);
  const nx = ship.x + dx * (SHIP_SIZE + 4);
  const ny = ship.y + dy * (SHIP_SIZE + 4);
  addMover({
    type: "bullet",
    x: nx, y: ny,
    vx: ship.vx + dx * BULLET_SPEED,
    vy: ship.vy + dy * BULLET_SPEED,
    life: BULLET_LIFE, maxLife: BULLET_LIFE,
    owner: ship,
    color: ship === player ? "#9fe8ff" : "#ff9a5c"
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hyperspace
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function hyperspace(ship, score) {
  if (Math.random() < HYPERSPACE_CHANCE) {
    // killed by the jump
    ship.alive = false;
    spawnExplosion(ship.x, ship.y, ship === player ? "#7fe0ff" : "#ff7a3c", true);
    world.shake = Math.max(world.shake, 14);
    world.flash = 0.5;
    world.flashColor = ship === player ? "127,224,255" : "255,122,60";
    checkEnd();
  } else {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const d = Math.random() * HYPERSPACE_DIST;
    let nx = ship.x + Math.cos(a) * d;
    let ny = ship.y + Math.sin(a) * d;
    // keep inside screen
    nx = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, nx));
    ny = Math.max(30, Math.min(H - 30, ny));
    ship.x = nx; ship.y = ny;
    ship.vx *= WARP; ship.vy *= WARP;
    score += 5;
    world.shake = Math.max(world.shake, 6);
    world.flash = 0.25;
    world.flashColor = ship === player ? "160,255,255" : "255,200,150";
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AI (enemy)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function updateEnemy(dt) {
  const e = enemy;
  if (!e.alive) return;
  const ai = e.ai;

  const other = player;
  const dx = other.x - e.x, dy = other.y - e.y;
  const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const targetAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  const diff = angleDiff(e.angle, targetAngle);

  // Strafe a little so it doesn't just charge straight in
  const desired = targetAngle + ai.strafe * 0.35;

  // Turn toward desired heading
  const turnStep = TURN * dt;
  if (diff > turnStep) {
    e.angle += turnStep;
    e.thrusting = Math.abs(diff) > 0.5;
  } else if (diff < -turnStep) {
    e.angle -= turnStep;
    e.thrusting = Math.abs(diff) > 0.5;
  } else {
    e.angle += diff;
    e.thrusting = dist > 140;
  }

  // Occasional strafe direction flip
  if (Math.random() < dt * 0.4) ai.strafe *= -1;

  // Fire when roughly aligned and at a reasonable range
  ai.fireCd -= dt;
  if (ai.fireCd <= 0 && Math.abs(angleDiff(e.angle, targetAngle)) < 0.25 && dist < 520) {
    fireShip(e);
    ai.fireCd = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
  }

  // Desperate hyperspace when the player is very close
  ai.warpCd -= dt;
  if (dist < 90 && ai.warpCd <= 0) {
    hyperspace(e, e.score);
    ai.warpCd = 2;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Ship physics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function moveShip(ship, dt) {
  if (ship.thrusting) {
    ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * THRUST * dt;
    ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * THRUST * dt;
  }
  // friction
  ship.vx *= FRICTION;
  ship.vy *= FRICTION;
  // clamp speed
  const sp = Math.hypot(ship.vx, ship.vy);
  if (sp > MAX_SPEED) {
    ship.vx = ship.vx / sp * MAX_SPEED;
    ship.vy = ship.vy / sp * MAX_SPEED;
  }
  ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
  ship.y += ship.vy * dt;

  // wrap around edges
  if (ship.x < -SHIP_SIZE) ship.x += W + SHIP_SIZE * 2;
  if (ship.x > W + SHIP_SIZE) ship.x -= W + SHIP_SIZE * 2;
  if (ship.y < -SHIP_SIZE) ship.y += H + SHIP_SIZE * 2;
  if (ship.y > H + SHIP_SIZE) ship.y -= H + SHIP_SIZE * 2;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Update
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function update(dt) {
  if (!world.running || world.over) return;
  world.time += dt;

  // --- player input ---
  const p = player;
  if (p.alive) {
    if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) { p.angle -= TURN * dt; }
    if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) { p.angle += TURN * dt; }
    p.thrusting = !!(keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]);
    if (keys[" "] || keys["x"]) { fireShip(p); keys[" "] = false; keys["x"] = false; }
    if (keys["e"]) { hyperspace(p, p.score); keys["e"] = false; }
  }

  // --- enemy AI ---
  updateEnemy(dt);

  // --- move ships ---
  if (p.alive) moveShip(p, dt);
  if (enemy.alive) moveShip(enemy, dt);

  // --- move all movers ---
  const toRemove = [];
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type === "star") {
      m.spin += dt;
      continue;
    }
    if (m.type === "asteroid") {
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.rot += m.spin * dt;
      // wrap
      if (m.x < -m.r) m.x += W + m.r * 2;
      if (m.x > W + m.r) m.x -= W + m.r * 2;
      if (m.y < -m.r) m.y += H + m.r * 2;
      if (m.y > H + m.r) m.y -= H + m.r * 2;
      continue;
    }

    m.x += m.vx * dt;
    m.y += m.vy * dt;

    if (m.type === "bullet") {
      m.life -= dt;
      if (m.life <= 0) { toRemove.push(m); continue; }

      // bullet vs star (bounce)
      for (const s of movers) {
        if (s.type === "star") {
          const d = Math.hypot(m.x - s.x, m.y - s.y);
          if (d < STAR_BOUNCE + 3) {
            const nx = (m.x - s.x) / d, ny = (m.y - s.y) / d;
            const dot = m.vx * nx + m.vy * ny;
            m.vx -= 2 * dot * nx;
            m.vy -= 2 * dot * ny;
            m.x = s.x + nx * (STAR_BOUNCE + 4);
            m.y = s.y + ny * (STAR_BOUNCE + 4);
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      // bullet vs ships
      const foe = m.owner === player ? enemy : player;
      if (foe.alive) {
        if (Math.hypot(m.x - foe.x, m.y - foe.y) < SHIP_SIZE + 3) {
          foe.alive = false;
          m.owner.score += 100;
          spawnExplosion(foe.x, foe.y, foe === player ? "#7fe0ff" : "#ff7a3c", true);
          world.shake = Math.max(world.shake, 16);
          world.flash = 0.5;
          world.flashColor = foe === player ? "127,224,255" : "255,122,60";
          toRemove.push(m);
          checkEnd();
          continue;
        }
      }
      // bullet vs bullet
      for (const o of movers) {
        if (o === m || o.type !== "bullet") continue;
        if (o.owner === m.owner) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(m.x - o.x, m.y - o.y) < 7) {
          spawnExplosion((m.x + o.x) / 2, (m.y + o.y) / 2, "#ffffff", false);
          toRemove.push(m);
          toRemove.push(o);
          break;
        }
      }
      if (toRemove.includes(m)) continue;
    }

    if (m.type === "explosion") {
      m.life -= dt;
      m.vx *= 0.94;
      m.vy *= 0.94;
      if (m.life <= 0) toRemove.push(m);
    }
  }

  // --- star destroys ships ---
  for (const s of movers) {
    if (s.type !== "star") continue;
    for (const ship of [player, enemy]) {
      if (!ship.alive) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(ship.x - s.x, ship.y - s.y) < STAR_KILL) {
        ship.alive = false;
        spawnExplosion(ship.x, ship.y, ship === player ? "#7fe0ff" : "#ff7a3c", true);
        world.shake = Math.max(world.shake, 18);
        world.flash = 0.6;
        world.flashColor = ship === player ? "127,224,255" : "255,122,60";
        checkEnd();
      }
    }
  }

  // --- drop finished movers ---
  for (const m of toRemove) {
    const i = movers.indexOf(m);
    if (i >= 0) movers.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // --- decay effects ---
  world.shake *= 0.85;
  world.flash *= 0.9;
}

function checkEnd() {
  if (world.over) return;
  if (!player.alive && !enemy.alive) {
    world.over = true;
    world.winner = player.score > enemy.score ? "player" : (enemy.score > player.score ? "enemy" : "draw");
  } else if (!player.alive) {
    world.over = true;
    world.winner = "enemy";
  } else if (!enemy.alive) {
    world.over = true;
    world.winner = "player";
  }
  // win by score
  if (player.score >= SCORE_WIN) { world.over = true; world.winner = "player"; }
  if (enemy.score >= SCORE_WIN) { world.over = true; world.winner = "enemy"; }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Drawing
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function drawShip(ship, color, glow) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
  ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
  const s = SHIP_SIZE;

  // thrust flame
  if (ship.thrusting && ship.alive) {
    const flick = 6 + Math.random() * 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.7, -s * 0.28);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7 - flick, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7, s * 0.28);
    ctx.closePath();
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-s * 0.7, 0, -s * 0.7 - flick, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, glow);
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // hull
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(s, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7, s * 0.7);
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.35, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7, -s * 0.7);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
  ctx.stroke();

  // cockpit
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s * 0.15, 0, s * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  // background
  ctx.fillStyle = "#04050f";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // screen shake
  ctx.save();
  if (world.shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * world.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * world.shake);
  }

  // starfield
  for (const s of world.stars) {
    const tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(world.time * 2 + s.tw);
    ctx.globalAlpha = s.z * (0.4 + tw * 0.6);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe3ff";
    const r = s.z * 1.6;
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, r, r);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // subtle nebula glow behind the star
  const star = movers.find((m) => m.type === "star");
  if (star) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(star.x, star.y, 0, star.x, star.y, Math.min(W, H) * 0.4);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,180,90,0.18)");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(120,60,200,0.08)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // draw all movers
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type === "star") {
      const pulse = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(world.time * 3);
      const r = m.r * pulse;
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, r * 3);
      g.addColorStop(0, "#fff6d8");
      g.addColorStop(0.3, "#ffd27a");
      g.addColorStop(0.7, "#ff8a3c");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,80,40,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fffdf0";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (m.type === "asteroid") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
      ctx.rotate(m.rot);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const a = (i / 7) * Math.PI * 2;
        const rr = m.r * (0.8 + 0.3 * Math.sin(i * 3));
        const px = Math.cos(a) * rr, py = Math.sin(a) * rr;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#6b7280";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#3b4252";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (m.type === "bullet") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, m.life / m.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (m.type === "explosion") {
      const t = m.life / m.maxLife;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, t);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.shadowColor = m.color;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      const r = 2 + (1 - t) * 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // ships
  if (player.alive) drawShip(player, "#5fd0ff", "#bff4ff");
  if (enemy.alive) drawShip(enemy, "#ff6a3c", "#ffd0a0");

  ctx.restore(); // end shake

  // flash overlay
  if (world.flash > 0.02) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${world.flashColor},${world.flash * 0.35})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  drawHUD();
}

  ctx.save();

  if (!world.running && !world.over) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";

    const blink = Math.sin(world.time * 4) > 0;
    if (blink) ctx.fillText("— PRESS ANY KEY TO START —", cx, cy + 50);
  }

    if (world.winner === "player") { msg = "YOU WIN!"; color = "#5fd0ff"; }
    else if (world.winner === "enemy") { msg = "CPU WINS"; color = "#ff6a3c"; }

let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {

  update(dt);
  draw();
  drawOverlay();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

    }
    // normalize to positive
    let minX = 99, minY = 99;
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      if (cx < minX) minX = cx;
      if (cy < minY) minY = cy;
    }
    return cells.map(([cx, cy]) => [cx - minX, cy - minY]);
  }

  function canPlace(px, py, rot, type){
    const cells = rotatedCells(type, rot);
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      const gx = px + cx;
      const gy = py + cy;
      if (gx < 0 || gx >= COLS || gy >= ROWS) return false;
      if (gy >= 0 && grid[gy][gx]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function lockPiece(){
    const cells = rotatedCells(current.type, current.rot);
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      const gx = current.x + cx;
      const gy = current.y + cy;
      if (gy >= 0){
        grid[gy][gx] = current.type;
      }
    }
    clearLines();
    spawn();
  }

  function clearLines(){
    let cleared = 0;
    for (let r = ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--){
      if (grid[r].every(v => v !== null)){
        grid.splice(r, 1);
        const newRow = [];
        for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) newRow.push(null);
        grid.unshift(newRow);
        cleared++;
        // spawn celebratory movers along the board
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++){
          movers.push({
            x: BOARD_X + Math.random() * BOARD_W,
            y: BOARD_Y + r * CELL,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
            vy: -2 - Math.random() * 3,
            life: 1,
            color: COLORS[randomType()]
          });
        }
      }
    }
    if (cleared > 0){
      score += [0, 100, 300, 500, 800][cleared] * level;
      lines += cleared;
      level = 1 + Math.floor(lines / 5);
      dropInterval = Math.max(0.12, 0.8 - (level - 1) * 0.06);
      shake = 8 * cleared;
      flash = 0.5;
    }
  }

  // ---- input ----
  function moveLeft(){ if (state === 'playing' && canPlace(current.x - 1, current.y, current.rot, current.type)) current.x--; }
  function moveRight(){ if (state === 'playing' && canPlace(current.x + 1, current.y, current.rot, current.type)) current.x++; }
  function rotateCW(){
    if (state !== 'playing') return;
    const newRot = (current.rot + 1) % 4;
    // try simple, then wall kicks
    const kicks = [[0,0],[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[-1,-1],[1,-1]];
    for (const [kx, ky] of kicks){
      if (canPlace(current.x + kx, current.y + ky, newRot, current.type)){
        current.x += kx; current.y += ky; current.rot = newRot;
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  function softDrop(){
    if (state !== 'playing') return;
    if (canPlace(current.x, current.y + 1, current.rot, current.type)){
      current.y++;
      score += 1;
      dropTimer = 0;
    } else {
      lockPiece();
    }
  }
  function hardDrop(){
    if (state !== 'playing') return;
    let d = 0;
    while (canPlace(current.x, current.y + 1, current.rot, current.type)){
      current.y++; d++;
    }
    score += d * 2;
    lockPiece();
  }
  function startGame(){
    resetGrid();
    movers = [];
    score = 0; lines = 0; level = 1;
    dropInterval = 0.8;
    nextType = randomType();
    spawn();
    state = 'playing';
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    const k = e.key;
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'gameover'){
      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' '){ startGame(); }
      return;
    }
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'a') moveLeft();
    else if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd') moveRight();
    else if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'w' || k === 'x') rotateCW();
    else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 's') softDrop();
    else if (k === ' ') hardDrop();
    else if (k === 'p' || k === 'P'){ state = (state === 'playing') ? 'paused' : 'playing'; }
    if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  });

  // ---- update ----
  function update(dt){
    if (state === 'playing'){
      dropTimer += dt;
      if (dropTimer >= dropInterval){
        dropTimer = 0;
        if (canPlace(current.x, current.y + 1, current.rot, current.type)){
          current.y++;
        } else {
          lockPiece();
        }
      }
    }
    // update movers
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      m.vy += 0.15; // gravity
      m.life -= dt * 0.8;
      if (m.life <= 0 || m.y > BOARD_Y + BOARD_H + 40){
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    // decay shake and flash
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
  }

  // ---- draw helpers ----
  function drawCell(x, y, color, alpha){
    const px = BOARD_X + x * CELL;
    const py = BOARD_Y + y * CELL;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(px + PAD, py + PAD, CELL - PAD * 2, CELL - PAD * 2);
    // highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(px + PAD, py + PAD, CELL - PAD * 2, 4);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawGhost(){
    if (!current) return;
    let gy = current.y;
    while (canPlace(current.x, gy + 1, current.rot, current.type)) gy++;
    const cells = rotatedCells(current.type, current.rot);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      const gx = current.x + cx;
      const gyy = gy + cy;
      if (gyy >= 0 && gyy < ROWS){
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[current.type];
        ctx.fillRect(BOARD_X + gx * CELL + PAD, BOARD_Y + gyy * CELL + PAD, CELL - PAD * 2, CELL - PAD * 2);
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawBoard(){
    // board background
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 5, 40, 0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(BOARD_X, BOARD_Y, BOARD_W, BOARD_H);
    // grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 90, 255, 0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let c = 0; c <= COLS; c++){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(BOARD_X + c * CELL, BOARD_Y);
      ctx.lineTo(BOARD_X + c * CELL, BOARD_Y + BOARD_H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let r = 0; r <= ROWS; r++){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(BOARD_X, BOARD_Y + r * CELL);
      ctx.lineTo(BOARD_X + BOARD_W, BOARD_Y + r * CELL);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // placed cells
    for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++){
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++){
        const t = grid[r][c];
        if (t) drawCell(c, r, COLORS[t], 1);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawCurrent(){
    if (!current) return;
    drawGhost();
    const cells = rotatedCells(current.type, current.rot);
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      const gx = current.x + cx;
      const gy = current.y + cy;
      if (gy >= 0 && gy < ROWS) drawCell(gx, gy, COLORS[current.type], 1);
    }
  }

  function drawMovers(){
    for (const m of movers){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, m.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawSidePanel(){
    const x = BOARD_X + BOARD_W + 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120, 90, 255, 0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(x, BOARD_Y, 140, 200);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('NEXT', x + 12, BOARD_Y + 28);
    // next piece preview
    const cells = SHAPES[nextType];
    const scale = 14;
    const ox = x + 30, oy = BOARD_Y + 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[nextType];
    for (const [cx, cy] of cells){
      ctx.fillRect(ox + cx * scale, oy + cy * scale, scale, scale);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe23a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', x + 12, BOARD_Y + 110);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(String(score), x + 12, BOARD_Y + 140);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#34e07a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('LINES', x + 12, BOARD_Y + 170);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText(String(lines), x + 60, BOARD_Y + 170);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b565ff';
    ctx.fillText('LEVEL', x + 12, BOARD_Y + 195);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText(String(level), x + 60, BOARD_Y + 195);
  }

  function drawOverlay(text, sub, color){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 2, 20, 0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(BOARD_X, BOARD_Y, BOARD_W, BOARD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(text, BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2, BOARD_Y + BOARD_H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText(sub, BOARD_X + BOARD_W / 2, BOARD_Y + BOARD_H / 2 + 20);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // background gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a3a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0520');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#050212');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#19c8ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, Arial';
    ctx.fillText('TETRIS', 20, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4a6d';
    ctx.fillText('EFFECT', 90, 28);

    // shake offset
    let ox = 0, oy = 0;
    if (shake > 0){
      ox = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
      oy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake;
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ox, oy);

    drawBoard();
    if (state === 'playing') drawCurrent();
    drawMovers();

    ctx.restore();

    drawSidePanel();

    if (flash > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, ' + (flash * 0.4) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(BOARD_X, BOARD_Y, BOARD_W, BOARD_H);
    }

    if (state === 'start'){
      drawOverlay('TETRIS EFFECT', 'Press Enter to play', '#19c8ff');
    } else if (state === 'gameover'){
      drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score: ' + score + '  —  Press Enter to restart', '#ff4a6d');
    } else if (state === 'paused'){
      drawOverlay('PAUSED', 'Press P to resume', '#ffe23a');
    }
  }

  // ---- main loop ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // init
  resetGrid();
  nextType = randomType();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>DuckTales: Scrooge's Money Vault</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#08160f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;}
  canvas{background:#0d2418;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);max-width:98vw;max-height:98vh;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const cv=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width, H=cv.height;

// ---- constants ----
const G=2200, MOVE=330, JUMP=880, SHOT=1050, COYOTE=0.09, JBUF=0.12;
const MAXDROP=16, MAXFALL=1300;

// ---- helpers ----
function clamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:v>b?b:v;}
function rrect(x,y,w,h,r){
  r=Math.min(r,Math.abs(w)/2,Math.abs(h)/2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function coin(x,y,r){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,7);ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a';ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle='#b8860b';ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#7a5200';ctx.font='bold '+(r*1.15)+'px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('$',x,y+1);
}

// ---- level (short loop) ----
function buildLevel(){
  const P=[],E=[];
  P.push({x:0,y:480,w:240,h:60});
  E.push({x:300,y:480,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:520,y:430,w:150,h:60});
  P.push({x:740,y:380,w:160,h:60});
  E.push({x:980,y:480,w:220,h:60});
  E.push({x:1260,y:420,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:1480,y:350,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:1700,y:300,w:150,h:60});
  P.push({x:1920,y:480,w:280,h:60});
  E.push({x:2280,y:420,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:2500,y:350,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:2720,y:300,w:150,h:60});
  P.push({x:2940,y:240,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:3160,y:300,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:3380,y:360,w:150,h:60});
  E.push({x:3600,y:420,w:150,h:60});
  P.push({x:3820,y:480,w:1200,h:60});
  return {P:P,E:E};
}

// ---- movers ----
function spawnMovers(){
  const M=[];
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++) M.push({type:'coin',x:380+i*105,y:250,vy:0,rot:0,alive:true});
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const bx=1150+i*300, by=330, spd=110+i*22, ph=i*1.7;
    M.push({type:'duck',x:bx,y:by,baseY:by,spd:spd,ph:ph,dir:1,alive:true});
    M.push({type:'coin',x:bx,y:by-64,vy:0,rot:0,alive:true});
  }
  return M;
}

// ---- state ----
let level, movers, score, coinsTotal, coinsLeft, duckCount, duckKills;
let camX=0, camY=0, shake=0, time=0;
let player, state, winT, loseT, camTargetX;

function reset(){
  level=buildLevel();
  movers=spawnMovers();
  score=0;
  coinsTotal=0; coinsLeft=0; duckCount=0; duckKills=0;
  for(const m of movers){ if(m.type==='coin') coinsTotal++; else if(m.type==='duck') duckCount++; }
  coinsLeft=coinsTotal;
  player={x:70,y:400,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,face:1,coyote:0,jbuf:0,shootCd:0,inv:0};
  state='start'; winT=0; loseT=0; shake=0;
  camX=player.x-W*0.32; camY=player.y-H*0.55;
}

// ---- input ----
const keys={};
let jumpQueued=false;
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  if(!keys[k]) {
    if(k==='arrowup'||k==='w') jumpQueued=true;
    if(k==='enter'){
      if(state==='start') state='play';
      else if(state==='win') reset(), state='start';
      else if(state==='lose') reset(), state='start';
    }
    if(k==='r') reset();
  }
  keys[k]=true;
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; });

// ---- update ----
function update(dt){
  if(state==='start'){ time+=dt; return; }
  if(state==='win'){ time+=dt; winT+=dt; updateMovers(dt); return; }
  if(state==='lose'){ time+=dt; loseT+=dt; updateMovers(dt); return; }

  const p=player;
  // horizontal
  let dir=0;
  if(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']) dir-=1;
  if(keys['arrowright']||keys['d']) dir+=1;
  if(dir!==0) p.face=dir;
  p.vx=dir*MOVE;
  // jump (with buffer + coyote)
  if(jumpQueued){ p.jbuf=JBUF; jumpQueued=false; }
  p.jbuf-=dt; p.coyote-=dt;
  if(p.jbuf>0 && (p.onGround||p.coyote>0)){
    p.vy=-JUMP; p.onGround=false; p.coyote=0; p.jbuf=0;
  }
  // gravity
  p.vy+=G*dt; if(p.vy>MAXFALL) p.vy=MAXFALL;
  // integrate
  p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt;
  if(p.x<0){ p.x=0; p.vx=0; }
  // shoot
  p.shootCd-=dt; p.inv-=dt;
  if((keys['z']||keys['x']||keys['j']) && p.shootCd<=0){
    movers.push({type:'shot',x:p.x+p.face*20,y:p.y-10,vx:p.face*SHOT,vy:0,life:1.2,alive:true});
    p.shootCd=0.22;
  }
  // platform collision
  const wasAir=!p.onGround;
  p.onGround=false;
  for(const pl of level.P){
    if(p.x>pl.x-16 && p.x<pl.x+pl.w+16 && p.y>pl.y-6 && p.y<pl.y+pl.h){
      if(p.vy>=0 && (p.y-16)<pl.y){
        p.y=pl.y-16; p.vy=0; p.onGround=true;
      }
    }
  }
  if(wasAir && p.onGround) p.coyote=COYOTE;
  // fall death
  if(p.y>H+200){ state='lose'; loseT=0; shake=12; }
  // camera
  camTargetX=clamp(p.x-W*0.32,0,3940-W);
  camX+=(camTargetX-camX)*Math.min(1,dt*8);
  const cy=clamp(p.y-H*0.55,-300,100);
  camY+=(cy-camY)*Math.min(1,dt*8);
  shake*=0.86;
  updateMovers(dt);
  // player vs movers
  for(const m of movers){
    if(!m.alive) continue;
    if(m.type==='coin'){
      if(Math.hypot(m.x-p.x,m.y-(p.y-16))<40){
        m.alive=false; score+=25; coinsLeft--;
        if(coinsLeft<=0){ state='win'; winT=0; }
      }
    } else if(m.type==='duck'){
      if(p.inv<=0 && Math.abs(m.x-p.x)<34 && Math.abs((m.y-14)-(p.y-16))<34){
        state='lose'; loseT=0; shake=12;
      }
    }
  }
}

function updateMovers(dt){
  for(const m of movers){
    if(!m.alive) continue;
    if(m.type==='duck'){
      m.x+=m.spd*m.dir*dt;
      if(m.x<m.baseX-150) m.dir=1;
      if(m.x>m.baseX+150) m.dir=-1;
      m.y=m.baseY+Math.sin(time*3+m.ph)*14;
    } else if(m.type==='shot'){
      m.x+=m.vx*dt; m.life-=dt;
      if(m.life<=0) m.alive=false;
      for(const d of movers){
        if(d.type==='duck' && Math.abs(d.x-m.x)<34 && Math.abs(d.y-m.y)<34){
          d.alive=false; m.alive=false; duckKills++; score+=100;
          for(let i=0;i<6;i++) movers.push({type:'spark',x:d.x,y:d.y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*320,vy:-Math.random()*260,life:0.5,alive:true});
          break;
        }
      }
    } else if(m.type==='spark'){
      m.x+=m.vx*dt; m.y+=m.vy*dt; m.vy+=G*0.4*dt; m.life-=dt;
      if(m.life<=0) m.alive=false;
    } else if(m.type==='coin'){
      m.rot+=dt*4;
    }
  }
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];
    if(!m.alive || m.y>H+160 || (m.type==='shot' && (m.x<camX-200 || m.x>camX+W+200))) movers.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// ---- draw ----
function draw(){
  const sx=(Math.random()*2-1)*shake, sy=(Math.random()*2-1)*shake;
  const ox=-camX+sx, oy=-camY+sy;
  // sky
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#123a5c'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#2f6f97'); g.addColorStop(1,'#7fb3d5');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ const x=(i*97)%W, y=(i*53)%150; ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+0.4*Math.abs(Math.sin(time+i)); ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2); }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle='#f7f2d8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120,90,46,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(180,180,160,0.4)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-100,80,10,0,7); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-135,105,7,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // far hills (parallax)
  ctx.fillStyle='#1c4a3a';
  for(let i=-1;i<14;i++){ const bx=i*220-camX*0.3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx,470,120,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill(); }
  ctx.fillStyle='#256b4a';
  for(let i=-1;i<14;i++){ const bx=i*180+90-camX*0.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx,490,90,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill(); }
  // world
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(ox,oy);
  drawVault();
  for(const pl of level.P) drawPlatform(pl);
  for(const e of level.E) drawEnemyPlatform(e);
  for(const m of movers){ if(m.alive) drawMover(m); }
  if(state!=='lose') drawPlayer();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==='start') drawStart();
  if(state==='win') drawWin();
  if(state==='lose') drawLose();
}

function drawVault(){
  const x=4560,y=300;
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f3a'; ctx.fillRect(x-40,y-40,240,260);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a4150'; ctx.fillRect(x,y,160,180);
  ctx.fillStyle='#c9a227';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+80,y+90,58,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#8a6d16';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+80,y+90,40,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8c24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+80,y+90,26,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a4510'; ctx.fillRect(x+74,y+64,12,52);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f3a';
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+80,y+90,34,0,7); ctx.lineWidth=6; ctx.strokeStyle='#20242e'; ctx.stroke(); }
  coin(x+80,y+90,10);
}

function drawPlatform(pl){
  ctx.fillStyle='#2c5a3a'; ctx.fillRect(pl.x,pl.y,pl.w,pl.h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#5aa564'; ctx.fillRect(pl.x,pl.y,pl.w,12);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3f7a4d';
  for(let x=pl.x+10;x<pl.x+pl.w-6;x+=26){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,pl.y); ctx.lineTo(x+7,pl.y-10); ctx.lineTo(x+14,pl.y); ctx.fill(); }
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(pl.x,pl.y+pl.h-8,pl.w,8);
}
function drawEnemyPlatform(e){
  ctx.fillStyle='#4a3524'; ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.w,e.h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#6b4a2c'; ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.w,10);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let x=e.x+20;x<e.x+e.w;x+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,e.y+10); ctx.lineTo(x,e.y+e.h); ctx.stroke(); }
}

function drawMover(m){
  if(m.type==='coin'){
    const s=Math.cos(m.rot);
    const rx=Math.max(4,18*Math.abs(s));
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y); ctx.scale(rx/18,1);
    coin(0,0,18); ctx.restore();
  } else if(m.type==='duck'){
    drawDuck(m.x,m.y,m.dir);
  } else if(m.type==='shot'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe27a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x-3,m.y-3,3,0,7); ctx.fill();
  } else if(m.type==='spark'){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,m.life/0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}

function drawDuck(x,y,dir){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(dir,1);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#c23b2e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-2,-8,22,16,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // wing
  ctx.fillStyle='#a52a20'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-6,-6,12,8,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#c23b2e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(16,-20,12,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // bill
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2a01e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24,-22); ctx.lineTo(40,-19); ctx.lineTo(24,-15); ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(18,-22,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(19,-22,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // feet
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2a01e'; ctx.fillRect(-14,6,10,4); ctx.fillRect(4,6,10,4);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p=player; const x=p.x, y=p.y;
  ctx.save();
  if(p.inv>0 && Math.floor(time*20)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.4;
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2a01e'; ctx.fillRect(-10,10,8,6); ctx.fillRect(2,10,8,6);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f6fb0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-4,16,18,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f2fb'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,2,12,10,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-22,14,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // bill
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2a01e'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(p.face*10,-24); ctx.lineTo(p.face*30,-20); ctx.lineTo(p.face*10,-15); ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.face*5,-24,2.6,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // hat
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f6fb0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-32,13,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#244f80'; ctx.fillRect(-15,-33,30,4);
  // arm + gun
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f6fb0'; ctx.fillRect(p.face>0?6:-20,-10,14,7);
  ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.fillRect(p.face>0?16:-30,-11,14,5);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; rrect(14,12,230,34,10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 20px system-ui'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score, 26, 36);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; rrect(W-230,12,216,34,10); ctx.fill();
  coin(W-212,29,12);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px system-ui'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(coinsLeft+' / '+coinsTotal+'  COINS', W-194, 35);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,15,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 52px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('DUCKTALES', W/2, 150);
  ctx.fillStyle='#7fd0ff'; ctx.font='22px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText("Scrooge's Money Vault", W/2, 188);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='18px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('← →  or  A D  to move', W/2, 250);
  ctx.fillText('↑  or  W  to jump', W/2, 278);
  ctx.fillText('Z  or  X  to shoot', W/2, 306);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fe0a0'; ctx.font='16px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('Grab every coin to reach the vault. Avoid the ducks!', W/2, 344);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 24px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  START', W/2, 400);
}

function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,15,0.7)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 48px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('VAULT REACHED!', W/2, 180);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='24px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+score, W/2, 240);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fe0a0'; ctx.font='18px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('Ducks defeated: '+duckKills, W/2, 274);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 22px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  PLAY  AGAIN', W/2, 340);
}

function drawLose(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(40,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a4a'; ctx.font='bold 48px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('OOPS!', W/2, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='20px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('Score: '+score+'   ·   Coins left: '+coinsLeft, W/2, 250);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd21a'; ctx.font='bold 22px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  RETRY', W/2, 320);
}

// ---- loop ----
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.033,(now-last)/1000); last=now;
  update(dt); draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
reset();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wing Commander: Vengeance of the Kilrathi</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #05070d;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #000;
    cursor: crosshair;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="1024" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------------- STATE ----------------
  const state = {
    phase: 'start',
    score: 0,
    time: 0,
    shipX: 512,
    shipY: 520,
    shipTilt: 0,
    mouse: { x: 512, y: 300, down: false },
    keys: {},
    kills: 0,
    targetKills: 25,
    lastSpawn: 0,
    spawnInterval: 1200,
    shake: 0
  };

  const movers = [];
  const stars = [];
  const nebulae = [];

  // ---------------- INPUT ----------------
  function mousePos(e){
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width),
      y: (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height)
    };
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
    const p = mousePos(e);
    state.mouse.x = p.x;
    state.mouse.y = p.y;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
    state.mouse.down = true;
    if (state.phase === 'start') {
      state.phase = 'play';
      state.score = 0;
      state.kills = 0;
      state.time = 0;
      state.lastSpawn = 0;
      movers.length = 0;
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ state.mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const p = mousePos(t);
    state.mouse.x = p.x; state.mouse.y = p.y; state.mouse.down = true;
    if (state.phase === 'start'){
      state.phase='play'; state.score=0; state.kills=0; state.time=0;
      state.lastSpawn=0; movers.length=0;
    }
  }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const p = mousePos(t);
    state.mouse.x = p.x; state.mouse.y = p.y;
  }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function(){ state.mouse.down = false; });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    state.keys[e.key] = true;
    if (state.phase === 'start' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
      state.phase='play'; state.score=0; state.kills=0; state.time=0;
      state.lastSpawn=0; movers.length=0;
    }
    if ((state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') && (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R')) {
      state.phase='play'; state.score=0; state.kills=0; state.time=0;
      state.lastSpawn=0; movers.length=0;
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ state.keys[e.key] = false; });

  // ---------------- SPAWNS ----------------
  function spawnKilrathian(){
    const x = 80 + Math.random() * (W - 160);
    const y = -40;
    const vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
    const vy = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.5 + state.time * 0.00002;
    const kind = Math.random() < 0.35 ? 'big' : 'small';
    movers.push({
      type: 'kilrathian',
      kind: kind,
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: vx, vy: vy,
      hp: kind === 'big' ? 3 : 1,
      w: kind === 'big' ? 70 : 40,
      h: kind === 'big' ? 55 : 34,
      t: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      color: kind === 'big' ? '#7a1f1f' : '#5a1515'
    });
  }

  function spawnMissile(){
    const src = movers.filter(m => m.type === 'kilrathian');
    if (src.length === 0) return;
    const s = src[Math.floor(Math.random() * src.length)];
    const dx = state.shipX - s.x;
    const dy = state.shipY - s.y;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const sp = 3.4;
    movers.push({
      type: 'missile',
      x: s.x, y: s.y + 10,
      vx: (dx/d) * sp,
      vy: (dy/d) * sp,
      w: 8, h: 16,
      t: 0
    });
  }

  function spawnPlayerShot(){
    movers.push({
      type: 'laser',
      x: state.shipX,
      y: state.shipY - 30,
      vx: 0,
      vy: -11,
      w: 3, h: 22,
      t: 0
    });
  }

  function spawnExplosion(x, y, big){
    const n = big ? 22 : 12;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = (big ? 3 : 2) * (0.4 + Math.random());
      movers.push({
        type: 'spark',
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        w: 3, h: 3,
        life: 40 + Math.random() * 30,
        max: 70,
        color: Math.random() < 0.5 ? '#ffcf5a' : '#ff6a2a'
      });
    }
    movers.push({
      type: 'flash',
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      w: big ? 120 : 70,
      h: big ? 120 : 70,
      life: 14, max: 14
    });
  }

  // ---------------- UPDATE ----------------
  function update(dt){
    state.time += dt;
    if (state.phase !== 'play') return;

    // Player position follows mouse
    const tx = state.mouse.x;
    const ty = Math.min(state.mouse.y, 560);
    state.shipX += (tx - state.shipX) * 0.25;
    state.shipY += (ty - state.shipY) * 0.25;
    state.shipTilt = (tx - state.shipX) * 0.003;

    // Firing
    if (state.mouse.down && state.time - (state.lastShot || 0) > 90){
      state.lastShot = state.time;
      spawnPlayerShot();
    }

    // Spawning
    if (state.time - state.lastSpawn > state.spawnInterval){
      state.lastSpawn = state.time;
      spawnKilrathian();
      if (Math.random() < 0.35 + state.time * 0.00005) spawnMissile();
      state.spawnInterval = Math.max(500, state.spawnInterval - 15);
    }

    // Move movers

    if (m.kind === "particle") {
      m.vx *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
      m.vy *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
      if (m.age >= m.life) { removeMover(i); continue; }
    }
    else if (m.kind === "bullet") {
      if (m.age >= m.life) { removeMover(i); continue; }
    }
    else {
      // enemies steer
      if (m.kind === "chaser" && player.alive) {
        const dx = player.x - m.x, dy = player.y - m.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = 95 + Math.min(70, state.time);
        m.vx += (dx / d) * sp * 1.5 * dt;
        m.vy += (dy / d) * sp * 1.5 * dt;
        const cs = Math.hypot(m.vx, m.vy);
        if (cs > sp) { m.vx = m.vx / cs * sp; m.vy = m.vy / cs * sp; }
      } else if (m.kind === "wanderer") {
        m.angle += m.spin * dt;
        const sp = Math.hypot(m.vx, m.vy) || 1;
        m.vx = Math.cos(m.angle) * sp;
        m.vy = Math.sin(m.angle) * sp;
      } else if (m.kind === "splitter") {
        m.angle += m.spin * dt * 0.5;
      }

      // bounce off walls
      if (m.x < m.size) { m.x = m.size; m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx); }
      if (m.x > W - m.size) { m.x = W - m.size; m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx); }
      if (m.y < m.size) { m.y = m.size; m.vy = Math.abs(m.vy); }
      if (m.y > H - m.size) { m.y = H - m.size; m.vy = -Math.abs(m.vy); }
    }
  }

  // ---- collisions: bullets vs enemies ----
  for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = movers[i];
    if (b.kind !== "bullet") continue;
    let hit = false;
    for (let j = movers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = movers[j];
      if (e.kind === "bullet" || e.kind === "particle") continue;
      const dx = b.x - e.x, dy = b.y - e.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (e.size + b.size) * (e.size + b.size)) {
        killEnemy(j, e);
        hit = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (hit) removeMover(i);
  }

  // ---- collisions: player vs enemies ----
  if (player.alive && player.inv <= 0) {
    for (let j = movers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = movers[j];
      if (e.kind === "bullet" || e.kind === "particle") continue;
      const dx = player.x - e.x, dy = player.y - e.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (e.size + player.radius) * (e.size + player.radius)) {
        killEnemy(j, e);
        loseLife();
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

function killEnemy(index, e) {
  const pts = e.kind === "splitter" ? 150 : e.kind === "wanderer" ? 80 : 50;
  state.score += pts;
  state.shake = Math.min(18, state.shake + e.size * 0.4);
  burst(e.x, e.y, e.color, 14, 260, 0.9);
  burst(e.x, e.y, "#ffffff", 5, 160, 0.5);
  if (e.kind === "splitter") {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      spawnEnemy(e.x, e.y, "chaser", rand(10, 14), neon(), Math.random() * Math.PI * 2);
    }
  }
  removeMover(index);
}

function loseLife() {
  state.lives--;
  state.shake = 22;
  state.flash = 1;
  burst(player.x, player.y, "#ff2d95", 30, 340, 1.2);
  if (state.lives <= 0) {
    player.alive = false;
    state.screen = "over";
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
    state.message = "";
  } else {
    player.inv = 2;
    resetPlayer();
  }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#05060f";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // subtle radial glow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(40,20,80,0.35)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(5,6,15,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // scrolling neon grid
  const spacing = 46;
  const t = state.time * 0.6;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,229,255,0.10)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  const ox = (t * spacing) % spacing;
  for (let x = -spacing + ox; x < W + spacing; x += spacing) {
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H);
  }
  const oy = (t * spacing) % spacing;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,45,149,0.08)";
  for (let y = -spacing + oy; y < H + spacing; y += spacing) {
    ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // border frame
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,229,255,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(8, 8, W - 16, H - 16);
}

function drawPlayer() {
  if (!player.alive) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
  ctx.rotate(player.angle);
  const blink = player.inv > 0 && (Math.floor(state.time * 12) % 2 === 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = blink ? 0.35 : 1;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  ctx.shadowColor = "#00e5ff";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#00e5ff";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,229,255,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(18, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(-6, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-12, 12);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(4, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
  ctx.rotate(e.angle);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
  ctx.shadowColor = e.color;
  ctx.strokeStyle = e.color;
  ctx.fillStyle = e.color + "33";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  const s = e.size;
  if (e.kind === "chaser") {
    // triangle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7, s * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.7, -s * 0.7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  } else if (e.kind === "wanderer") {
    // diamond
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
    ctx.lineTo(s, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, s);
    ctx.lineTo(-s, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    // splitter: hexagon
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = i / 6 * Math.PI * 2;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * s, py = Math.sin(a) * s;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMovers() {
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.kind === "particle") {
      const a = 1 - m.age / m.life;
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(a, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.size * a + 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    } else if (m.kind === "bullet") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
      ctx.rotate(m.angle);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
      ctx.shadowColor = "#ffffff";
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(-4, -3);
      ctx.lineTo(-4, 3);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      drawEnemy(m);
    }
  }
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#00e5ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12; ctx.shadowColor = "#00e5ff";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE " + state.score, 22, 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd21f";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#ffd21f";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("BEST " + Math.max(state.best, state.score), W - 22, 20);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  // lives
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff2d95";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#ff2d95";
  ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Courier New', monospace";
  let livesTxt = "LIVES ";
  for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) livesTxt += "◆ ";
  ctx.fillText(livesTxt, 22, H - 34);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCenterText(lines, size, color) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  const total = lines.length * size * 1.5;
  let y = H / 2 - total / 2 + size * 0.7;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    ctx.font = "bold " + size + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = color[i] || color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
    ctx.shadowColor = ctx.fillStyle;
    ctx.fillText(lines[i], W / 2, y);
    y += size * 1.5;
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake, state.shake), rand(-state.shake, state.shake));
  }
  drawBackground();

  if (state.screen === "play") {
    drawMovers();
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();
    if (state.flash > 0.02) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,45,149," + (state.flash * 0.4) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(-40, -40, W + 80, H + 80);
    }
  } else if (state.screen === "start") {
    drawMovers();
    drawCenterText(
      ["GEOMETRY WARS", "RETRO EVOLVED 2"],
      46, ["#00e5ff", "#ff2d95"]
    );
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b6ff3d";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowColor = "#b6ff3d";
    const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE  OR  CLICK  TO  START", W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8899bb";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillText("WASD / ARROWS  to move   •   MOUSE  to aim & fire", W / 2, H / 2 + 120);
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (state.screen === "over") {
    drawMovers();
    drawCenterText(
      ["GAME  OVER", "SCORE  " + state.score],
      44, ["#ff2d95", "#00e5ff"]
    );
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#b6ff3d";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowColor = "#b6ff3d";
    const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE  OR  CLICK  TO  PLAY  AGAIN", W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- main loop ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Duck Hunt</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #12331f;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
  }
  #game {
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border: 6px solid #2a4a2a;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #6fb8e8;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="420"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;
  const GROUND_Y = H - 60;
  const GRAVITY = 0.12;
  const BIRD_SPEED = 3.2;
  const BIRD_ACCEL = 0.18;
  const MAX_BIRDS = 5;
  const SHOT_COOLDOWN = 22;
  const SHOT_LIFE = 10;

  const state = {
    mode: 'start',
    score: 0,
    timeLeft: 60,
    frame: 0,
    cooldown: 0,
    message: '',
    messageTimer: 0
  };

  const movers = [];
  const keys = {};
  const mouse = { x: W/2, y: H/2, down: false };

  const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));

  function makeBird(){
    const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const x = side < 0 ? -40 : W + 40;
    const y = rand(40, GROUND_Y - 120);
    const vx = (side < 0 ? 1 : -1) * rand(1.5, 3);
    const vy = rand(-1, 1);
    return {
      type: 'bird',
      x, y, vx, vy,
      dir: side < 0 ? 1 : -1,
      flap: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      alive: true,
      done: false,
      life: 0
    };
  }

  function makeShot(x, y){
    return { type: 'shot', x, y, vx: 0, vy: -14, alive: true, done: false, life: SHOT_LIFE };
  }

  function makeFeather(x, y){
    return {
      type: 'feather', x, y,
      vx: rand(-1.5, 1.5), vy: rand(-1, 0.5),
      alive: true, done: false, life: 40
    };
  }

  function fireShot(){
    if (state.cooldown > 0) return;
    movers.push(makeShot(mouse.x, mouse.y));
    state.cooldown = SHOT_COOLDOWN;
  }

  function onBirdHit(bird, x, y){
    bird.alive = false;
    bird.done = true;
    bird.vx = 0;
    bird.vy = 1.5;
    state.score += 10;
    state.message = '+10';
    state.messageTimer = 40;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){
      movers.push(makeFeather(x + rand(-10,10), y + rand(-10,10)));
    }
  }

  function spawnBird(){
    const aliveBirds = movers.filter(m => m.type === 'bird' && !m.done).length;
    if (aliveBirds < MAX_BIRDS && Math.random() < 0.03){
      movers.push(makeBird());
    }
  }

  function update(){
    state.frame++;

    if (state.cooldown > 0) state.cooldown--;
    if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer--;

    if (state.mode === 'play'){
      state.timeLeft -= 1/60;
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0){
        state.timeLeft = 0;
        state.mode = 'over';
      }
      spawnBird();
    }

    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const m = movers[i];

      if (m.type === 'bird'){
        if (!m.done){
          m.flap += 0.35;
          if (m.alive){
            m.vy += GRAVITY;
            m.vy = clamp(m.vy, -3, 3);
            m.x += m.vx;
            m.y += m.vy;
            m.life++;

            if (m.y > GROUND_Y - 20){
              m.y = GROUND_Y - 20;
              m.vy = -rand(2, 4);
            }
            if (m.y < 30){
              m.y = 30;
              m.vy = Math.abs(m.vy) * 0.5;
            }
            if (m.x < -60 || m.x > W + 60){
              m.done = true;
            }
          } else {
            m.vy += GRAVITY * 1.4;
            m.y += m.vy;
            m.x += m.vx * 0.3;
            if (m.y > GROUND_Y - 10){
              m.y = GROUND_Y - 10;
              m.done = true;
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'shot'){
        m.y += m.vy;
        m.life--;
        if (m.life <= 0 || m.y < -20){
          m.done = true;
        } else {
          for (let j = movers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--){
            const b = movers[j];
            if (b.type === 'bird' && b.alive && !b.done){
              const dx = b.x - m.x;
              const dy = b.y - m.y;
              if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 22*22){
                onBirdHit(b, b.x, b.y);
                m.done = true;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'feather'){
        m.vy += 0.05;
        m.x += m.vx;
        m.y += m.vy;
        m.life--;
        if (m.life <= 0 || m.y > GROUND_Y){
          m.done = true;
        }
      }

      if (m.done) movers.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GROUND_Y);
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#8fd0f0');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#cfeaf5');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, GROUND_Y);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(90, 60, 26, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++){
      const cx = 200 + i * 90;
      const cy = 50 + (i % 2) * 25;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 18, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx + 22, cy + 4, 14, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.arc(cx - 20, cy + 5, 13, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a8f3a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.3, GROUND_Y - 40, W*0.55, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.8, GROUND_Y - 30, W, GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5ea34a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y + 15);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W*0.4, GROUND_Y - 15, W, GROUND_Y + 15);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){
      const gx = 30 + i * 85;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a7a2a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx, GROUND_Y + 20);
      ctx.lineTo(gx, GROUND_Y + 34);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a9a3a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(gx, GROUND_Y + 28);
      ctx.lineTo(gx - 6, GROUND_Y + 22);
      ctx.moveTo(gx, GROUND_Y + 28);
      ctx.lineTo(gx + 6, GROUND_Y + 22);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawBird(b){
    const flap = Math.sin(b.flap);
    const falling = !b.alive;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
    if (falling){
      ctx.rotate(b.vx * 0.1 + Math.PI * 0.15);
    } else {
      ctx.scale(b.dir, 1);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#2e7d32';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-6, 2, 16, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#43a047';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(8, -2, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1b5e20';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-2, -2, 11, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6f00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(15, -3);
    ctx.lineTo(27, -1);
    ctx.lineTo(15, 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(11, -5, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(12, -5, 1.4, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1b5e20';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-4, 0, 9, 6 + flap * 5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawShot(s){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,80,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawFeather(f){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(f.x, f.y, 5, 2.5, f.life * 0.2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawCrosshair(){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,40,40,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 14, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x - 20, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x - 8, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x + 8, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x + 20, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 20); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 8);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 8); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 20);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,40,40,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 2, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + state.score, 14, 23);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = state.timeLeft < 10 ? '#ff5555' : '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('TIME ' + Math.ceil(state.timeLeft), W - 14, 23);
  }

  function drawCenterText(lines, yStart){
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    let y = yStart;
    for (const line of lines){
      ctx.font = line.font;
      ctx.fillStyle = line.color;
      ctx.fillText(line.text, W/2, y);
      y += line.gap;
    }
  }

  function draw(){
    drawBackground();

    for (const m of movers){
      if (m.type === 'bird') drawBird(m);
      else if (m.type === 'shot') drawShot(m);
      else if (m.type === 'feather') drawFeather(m);
    }

    if (state.mode === 'play'){
      drawHUD();
      drawCrosshair();
      if (state.messageTimer > 0){
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
        ctx.fillText(state.message, mouse.x, mouse.y - 24);
      }
    }

    if (state.mode === 'start'){
      drawCenterText([
        { text: 'DUCK HUNT', font: 'bold 40px Courier New', color: '#1b5e20', gap: 50 },
        { text: 'Shoot the ducks before time runs out', font: '16px Courier New', color: '#333', gap: 26 },
        { text: 'Move mouse to aim, click to shoot', font: '14px Courier New', color: '#555', gap: 40 },
        { text: 'CLICK TO START', font: 'bold 20px Courier New', color: '#c62828', gap: 0 }
      ], H/2 - 30);
    }

    if (state.mode === 'over'){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      drawCenterText([
        { text: 'TIME UP!', font: 'bold 42px Courier New', color: '#fff', gap: 44 },
        { text: 'FINAL SCORE  ' + state.score, font: 'bold 24px Courier New', color: '#ffd54f', gap: 40 },
        { text: 'CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN', font: 'bold 18px Courier New', color: '#ff8a8a', gap: 0 }
      ], H/2 - 20);
    }
  }

  function resetGame(){
    state.mode = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.timeLeft = 60;
    state.cooldown = 0;
    state.message = '';
    state.messageTimer = 0;
    movers.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) movers.push(makeBird());
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state.mode === 'start'){
      resetGame();
    } else if (state.mode === 'over'){
      resetGame();
    } else if (state.mode === 'play'){
      fireShot();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (e.key === ' '){
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state.mode === 'start' || state.mode === 'over') resetGame();
      else if (state.mode === 'play') fireShot();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){
    keys[e.key] = false;
  });

  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  loop();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
