<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>The Last Express</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05070d;overflow:hidden;
    font-family:"Courier New",ui-monospace,monospace;
    -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none;}
  #game{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;cursor:crosshair;
    box-shadow:inset 0 0 220px rgba(0,0,0,.85);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');

  // ---- sizing ----
  let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
  function resize(){
    DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
    W=window.innerWidth;H=window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);
    canvas.style.width=W+'px';canvas.style.height=H+'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
  resize();

  // ---- helpers ----
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function txt(t,x,y,size,color,align){
    ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.textAlign=align||'center';
    ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.font='bold '+size+'px "Courier New",monospace';
    ctx.fillText(t,x,y);
  }

  // ---- state ----
  let state='title';
  let score=0, best=0;
  let elapsed=0, shake=0, time=0;
  let trainX=-160, trainVy=0;
  let railY=0, railH=54;
  let last=0;
  let stars=[];
  let movers=[];

  function makeStars(){
    const n=Math.floor(W*H/15000);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H*0.6,
        r:Math.random()*1.5+0.4,p:Math.random()*6.28,s:0.5+Math.random()*2});
    }
  }
  makeStars();

  function reset(){
    movers=[];
    score=0;
    elapsed=0;
    trainX=-160;
    trainVy=0;
    state='play';
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    const k=e.key;
    if(k===' '||k==='Enter'){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(state==='title') reset();
      else if(state==='over') reset();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(state==='title') reset();
    else if(state==='over') reset();
  });

  // ---- movers: spawn ----
  function spawn(){
    const t=elapsed;
    const type=(Math.random()<0.55)?'bomb':'box';
    const r=type==='bomb'?16:18;
    const x=W+40;
    const y=railY-railH/2-r-20-Math.random()*90;
    const speed=180+Math.min(t*5,340)+Math.random()*120;
    movers.push({
      x:x,y:y,
      vx:-speed,
      vy:(Math.random()*2-1)*30,
      r:r,type:type,
      spin:Math.random()*6.28,
      spinV:(Math.random()*2-1)*3,
      done:false
    });
  }

  function spawnBurst(x,y,n,colors,spd){
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a=Math.random()*6.28;
      const v=spd*(0.4+Math.random());
      movers.push({
        x:x,y:y,
        vx:Math.cos(a)*v,
        vy:Math.sin(a)*v,
        r:2+Math.random()*3,
        type:'part',
        life:0.5+Math.random()*0.6,
        color:colors[(Math.random()*colors.length)|0],
        done:false
      });
    }
  }

  function explode(x,y){
    spawnBurst(x,y,20,['#ffd27a','#ff9d3c','#ff5b3c','#ffffff'],260);
    movers.push({x:x,y:y,vx:0,vy:-10,r:22,type:'flash',life:0.3,done:false});
    shake=Math.min(shake+10,22);
  }

  // ---- update ----
  function update(dt){
    time+=dt;
    if(state==='play'){
      elapsed+=dt;
      // difficulty ramp
      const interval=Math.max(0.55,1.55-elapsed*0.02);
      if(movers.filter(m=>m.type==='bomb'||m.type==='box').length<
         Math.floor(elapsed/interval)+1){
        spawn();
      }
      // train physics
      const targetX=W*0.28;
      const acc=(targetX-trainX)*2.4;
      trainVy+=acc*dt;
      trainVy*=0.86;
      trainX+=trainVy*dt;
    }

    // move every mover
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m=movers[i];
      m.x+=m.vx*dt;
      m.y+=m.vy*dt;
      if(m.type==='bomb'||m.type==='box'){
        m.spin+=m.spinV*dt;
      }
      if(m.type==='part'||m.type==='flash'){
        m.life-=dt;
        if(m.type==='part') m.vy+=300*dt;
        if(m.life<=0) m.done=true;
      }
      // collisions
      if(state==='play'){
        const dx=m.x-trainX, dy=m.y-(railY-railH/2);
        const hitR=(m.type==='part')?0:(m.r+22);
        if(m.type==='bomb'){
          if(dx*dx+dy*dy<hitR*hitR){
            explode(m.x,m.y);
            score+=15;
            m.done=true;
          }
        }else if(m.type==='box'){
          if(dx*dx+dy*dy<hitR*hitR){
            score+=5;
            spawnBurst(m.x,m.y,8,['#8fb0d0','#cfe0f2','#5f80a2'],180);
            m.done=true;
          }
        }
      }
      // off screen
      if(m.x<-70||m.x>W+90||m.y>H+70) m.done=true;
      if(m.done){
        movers[i]=movers[movers.length-1];
        movers.pop();
      }
    }

    if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*40);
  }

  // ---- draw ----
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0){
      ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*shake,(Math.random()*2-1)*shake);
    }
    drawSky();
    drawCity();
    drawRails();
    drawTrain();
    drawMovers();
    drawHUD();
    if(state==='title') drawTitle();
    if(state==='over') drawOver();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSky(){
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1024');
    g.addColorStop(0.55,'#1b2440');
    g.addColorStop(0.85,'#3a2f4a');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#12101c');
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    ctx.fillRect(-40,-40,W+80,H+80);

    // moon
    const mx=W*0.8,my=H*0.2,mr=Math.min(W,H)*0.06;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.9;
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4ead0';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(mx,my,mr,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#0a1024';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(mx-mr*0.4,my-mr*0.15,mr*0.9,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // stars
    for(const s of stars){
      const a=0.4+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(time*s.s+s.p));
      ctx.globalAlpha=a;
      ctx.fillStyle='#dfe8ff';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }

  function drawCity(){
    const base=railY;
    ctx.fillStyle='#0c1226';
    ctx.fillRect(-40,base-120,W+80,120);
    // buildings
    let x=-20;
    let i=0;
    while(x<W+40){
      const bw=40+((i*37)%60);
      const bh=50+((i*53)%120);
      ctx.fillStyle='#101a33';
      ctx.fillRect(x,base-bh,bw,bh);
      // windows
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffcf7a';
      for(let wy=base-bh+10;wy<base-8;wy+=16){
        for(let wx=x+8;wx<x+bw-6;wx+=16){
          if(((wx*7+wy*3+i)%5)<2){
            ctx.globalAlpha=0.7;
            ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,5,7);
          }
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
      x+=bw+8;
      i++;
    }
  }

  function drawRails(){
    railY=H*0.82;
    railH=54;
    const top=railY-railH/2, bot=railY+railH/2;
    // ground
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,bot-6,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#241a2c');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0810');
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    ctx.fillRect(-40,bot-6,W+80,H-bot+40);

    // sleepers
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a2036';
    for(let x=-20;x<W+40;x+=44){
      ctx.fillRect(x,bot-14,26,10);
    }
    // rails
    ctx.fillStyle='#5a6577';
    ctx.fillRect(-40,bot-12,W+80,4);
    ctx.fillRect(-40,bot-2,W+80,4);
    // glow line
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,170,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(-40,bot-14,W+80,14);
  }

  function drawTrain(){
    const cy=railY-railH/2;
    const x=trainX;
    const w=150,h=96;
    const top=cy-h/2-6;
    // headlight beam
    const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(x+w/2,0,x+w/2+220,0);
    grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,240,180,0.5)');
    grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,240,180,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+w/2-10,cy-10);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w/2+220,cy-70);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w/2+220,cy+70);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w/2-10,cy+10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    const bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,top,0,top+h);
    bg.addColorStop(0,'#3b4a63');
    bg.addColorStop(0.5,'#26324a');
    bg.addColorStop(1,'#141c2c');
    ctx.fillStyle=bg;
    rr(x-w/2,top,w,h,14);
    ctx.fill();
    // roof
    ctx.fillStyle='#1a2234';
    rr(x-w/2+10,top-8,w-20,14,8);
    ctx.fill();
    // windows
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe6a0';
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const wx=x-w/2+22+i*30;
      rr(wx,top+16,20,26,5);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // front light
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff6cf';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+w/2-8,cy,9,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8a3c';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+w/2-8,cy,4,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    // wheels
    ctx.fillStyle='#0d1119';
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const wx=x-w/2+30+i*45;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(wx,bot(railY),12,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#39445a';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(wx,bot(railY),5,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#0d1119';
    }
    function bot(y){return y-6;}
  }

  function drawMovers(){
    for(const m of movers){
      if(m.type==='bomb'){
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
        ctx.rotate(m.spin);
        // body
        ctx.fillStyle='#20242c';
        rr(-14,-14,28,28,8);
        ctx.fill();
        // stripe
        ctx.fillStyle='#ff5b3c';
        ctx.fillRect(-14,-3,28,6);
        // fuse
        ctx.strokeStyle='#c9a24a';
        ctx.lineWidth=3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0,-14);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6,-24,2,-30);
        ctx.stroke();
        // spark
        ctx.fillStyle='#fff2a0';
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(2,-30,3+Math.random()*2,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }else if(m.type==='box'){
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
        ctx.rotate(m.spin);
        ctx.fillStyle='#7f97b4';
        rr(-16,-16,32,32,6);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle='#cfe0f2';
        ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.strokeRect(-16,-16,32,32);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-16,0);ctx.lineTo(16,0);
        ctx.moveTo(0,-16);ctx.lineTo(0,16);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }else if(m.type==='part'){
        ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,m.life/0.9);
        ctx.fillStyle=m.color;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha=1;
      }else if(m.type==='flash'){
        const a=Math.max(0,m.life/0.3);
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,150,'+a.toFixed(2)+')';
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    if(state==='play'||state==='over'){
      txt('SCORE  '+score,18,26,20,'#ffe6a0','left');
      if(best>0) txt('BEST  '+best,18,50,14,'#8fb0d0','left');
      // distance meter
      const pct=Math.min(1,elapsed/30);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
      ctx.fillRect(W-220,20,200,10);
      ctx.fillStyle='#5fd0ff';
      ctx.fillRect(W-220,20,200*pct,10);
      txt('DISTANCE',W-120,44,12,'#8fb0d0','center');
    }
  }

  function drawTitle(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,13,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(-40,-40,W+80,H+80);
    const cx=W/2, cy=H*0.4;
    txt('THE LAST EXPRESS',cx,cy,Math.min(52,W*0.07),'#ffe6a0');
    txt('a midnight train across the rails',cx,cy+40,18,'#8fb0d0');
    txt('SPACE / TAP  —  start',cx,H*0.6,22,'#ffffff');
    txt('catch the crates, dodge the bombs',cx,H*0.6+34,16,'#cfe0f2');
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,7,13,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(-40,-40,W+80,H+80);
    const cx=W/2, cy=H*0.42;
    txt('THE EXPRESS IS LOST',cx,cy,Math.min(44,W*0.06),'#ff6a4a');
    txt('you reached '+Math.floor(elapsed)+' seconds',cx,cy+44,20,'#cfe0f2');
    txt('FINAL SCORE  '+score,cx,cy+84,26,'#ffe6a0');
    if(best>0) txt('BEST  '+best,cx,cy+118,16,'#8fb0d0');
    txt('SPACE / TAP  —  run it again',cx,H*0.72,20,'#ffffff');
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function frame(ts){
    if(!last) last=ts;
    let dt=(ts-last)/1000;
    last=ts;
    if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    if(state==='over'){
      if(score>best) best=score;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Micro Machines</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#080d1a;overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
  #game{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById("game");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
let W=0,H=0,SCALE=1;
const DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);

function resize(){
  W=window.innerWidth; H=window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR); canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);
  canvas.style.width=W+"px"; canvas.style.height=H+"px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  SCALE=Math.min(W/1200,H/720);
}
window.addEventListener("resize",resize); resize();

const carW=22, carH=34;
const player={x:0,y:0,vx:0,vy:0,angle:0,alive:true};
const cars=[];
const movers=[];
const keys={left:false,right:false,up:false,down:false,brake:false,space:false,shift:false};
const mouse={x:W/2,y:H/2,down:false};
const state={phase:"start",score:0,best:0,combo:0,comboTimer:0,shake:0,overAt:0,overReason:""};
const TAU=Math.PI*2;
const rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const randInt=(a,b)=>Math.floor(rnd(a,b+1));
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const angDiff=(a,b)=>((a-b+Math.PI*3)%TAU)-Math.PI;
const dist=(ax,ay,bx,by)=>Math.hypot(ax-bx,ay-by);

function resetPlayer(){
  player.x=W/2; player.y=H/2; player.vx=0; player.vy=0; player.angle=-Math.PI/2; player.alive=true;
}
function reset(){
  resetPlayer();
  cars.length=0; movers.length=0;
  state.score=0; state.combo=0; state.comboTimer=0; state.shake=0;
}
function startGame(){ reset(); state.phase="play"; }
function gameOver(reason){
  if(state.phase!=="play")return;
  state.phase="over"; state.overReason=reason; state.overAt=performance.now();
  if(state.score>state.best)state.best=state.score;
  state.shake=12;
}

function addMover(x,y,vx,vy,life,kind,r,rot,vr,grav){
  movers.push({x,y,vx,vy,life,maxLife:life,kind,r,rot:rot||0,vr:vr||0,grav:grav||0});
}
function spawnEnemy(){
  let x,y,tries=0;
  do{ x=rnd(60,W-60); y=rnd(60,H-60); tries++; }while(dist(x,y,player.x,player.y)<230 && tries<20);
  const c={x,y,vx:0,vy:0,angle:rnd(0,TAU),hp:1,alive:true,flash:0,
    turn:rnd(0,TAU), turnTimer:rnd(0.4,1.4),
    color:Math.random()<0.5?"#ff5545":"#45c8ff",
    glow:Math.random()<0.5?"#ff8a5a":"#5ad0ff"};
  cars.push(c);
}
function explode(x,y,color,glow){
  state.shake=10;
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){ const a=rnd(0,TAU),s=rnd(40,260); addMover(x,y,Math.cos(a)*s,Math.sin(a)*s,rnd(0.4,0.9),"spark",rnd(1,2.4),0,0,0); }
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ const a=rnd(0,TAU),s=rnd(10,90); addMover(x,y,Math.cos(a)*s,Math.sin(a)*s,rnd(0.7,1.3),"debris",rnd(2,4),rnd(0,TAU),rnd(-12,12),0); }
  addMover(x,y,0,0,0.5,"flash",14,0,0,0);
  addMover(x,y,0,0,0.7,"ring",10,0,0,0);
}
function fireBullet(){
  const a=player.angle, sp=560, mx=player.x+Math.cos(a)*22, my=player.y+Math.sin(a)*22;
  addMover(mx,my,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,1.4,"bullet",3,0,0,0);
  addMover(mx,my,0,0,0.15,"flash",8,0,0,0);
  state.shake=Math.max(state.shake,3);
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{
  if(state.phase==="start"){ startGame(); return; }
  if(state.phase==="over"){ startGame(); return; }
  mouse.down=true;
});
window.addEventListener("mouseup",()=>{ mouse.down=false; });
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{ const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); mouse.x=e.clientX-r.left; mouse.y=e.clientY-r.top; });
window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k==="arrowleft"||k==="a")keys.left=true;
  else if(k==="arrowright"||k==="d")keys.right=true;
  else if(k==="arrowup"||k==="w")keys.up=true;
  else if(k==="arrowdown"||k==="s")keys.down=true;
  else if(k===" ")keys.space=true;
  else if(k==="shift")keys.shift=true;
  else if(k==="enter"){ if(state.phase!=="play")startGame(); }
  else if(k==="b")keys.brake=true;
  if(["arrowleft","arrowright","arrowup","arrowdown"," "].includes(k))e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener("keyup",e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k==="arrowleft"||k==="a")keys.left=false;
  else if(k==="arrowright"||k==="d")keys.right=false;
  else if(k==="arrowup"||k==="w")keys.up=false;
  else if(k==="arrowdown"||k==="s")keys.down=false;
  else if(k===" ")keys.space=false;
  else if(k==="shift")keys.shift=false;
  else if(k==="b")keys.brake=false;
});
canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu",e=>e.preventDefault());
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{
  const t=e.touches[0]; const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=t.clientX-r.left; mouse.y=t.clientY-r.top; mouse.down=true;
  if(state.phase!=="play")startGame();
  e.preventDefault();
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{
  const t=e.touches[0]; const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=t.clientX-r.left; mouse.y=t.clientY-r.top; e.preventDefault();
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchend",e=>{ mouse.down=false; e.preventDefault(); },{passive:false});

function circleHit(ax,ay,ar,bx,by,br){ const dx=ax-bx,dy=ay-by; return dx*dx+dy*dy < (ar+br)*(ar+br); }
function damagePlayer(d){
  if(state.phase!=="play")return;
  player.vx+=Math.cos(player.angle+Math.PI)*d; player.vy+=Math.sin(player.angle+Math.PI)*d;
  if(player.x<carW/2){player.x=carW/2;player.vx=Math.abs(player.vx)*0.5;}
  if(player.x>W-carW/2){player.x=W-carW/2;player.vx=-Math.abs(player.vx)*0.5;}
  if(player.y<carH/2){player.y=carH/2;player.vy=Math.abs(player.vy)*0.5;}
  if(player.y>H-carH/2){player.y=H-carH/2;player.vy=-Math.abs(player.vy)*0.5;}
}
function killCar(c){
  c.alive=false;
  explode(c.x,c.y,c.color,c.glow);
  state.combo++; state.comboTimer=2.0;
  const pts=50*Math.max(1,state.combo);
  state.score+=pts;
  addMover(c.x,c.y-10,0,-34,1.1,"text","+"+pts,0,0,0);
}

function update(dt){
  if(state.phase==="play" && player.alive){
    const aim=keys.up?Math.atan2(mouse.y-player.y,mouse.x-player.x):player.angle;
    player.angle=lerp(player.angle,aim,Math.min(1,12*dt));
    const boost=keys.shift?1.8:1.0;
    const acc=720*boost, maxSp=430*boost, fr=3.2;
    let ax=0,ay=0;
    if(keys.left)ax+=Math.cos(player.angle-Math.PI/2);
    if(keys.right)ax+=Math.cos(player.angle+Math.PI/2);
    if(keys.up)ay+=Math.cos(player.angle);
    if(keys.down)ay-=Math.cos(player.angle);
    player.vx+=ax*acc*dt; player.vy+=ay*acc*dt;
    if(keys.brake){ player.vx*=Math.max(0,1-4*dt); player.vy*=Math.max(0,1-4*dt); }
    player.vx-=player.vx*fr*dt; player.vy-=player.vy*fr*dt;
    const sp=Math.hypot(player.vx,player.vy);
    if(sp>maxSp){ player.vx*=maxSp/sp; player.vy*=maxSp/sp; }
    if(sp>20 && !keys.brake){
      const px=player.x, py=player.y;
      player.x+=player.vx*dt; player.y+=player.vy*dt;
      const ang=player.angle+Math.PI;
      const bx=player.x+Math.cos(ang)*carW*0.5, by=player.y+Math.sin(ang)*carH*0.5;

  // update movers
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];
    m.t=(m.t||0)+dt;
    m.life-=dt;
    if(m.type==="rival"){
      // steer toward track centre
      const cdx=track.cx*W-m.x, cdy=track.cy*H-m.y;
      const cang=Math.atan2(cdy,cdx);
      let diff=cang-m.angle;
      while(diff>Math.PI) diff-=TAU;
      while(diff<-Math.PI) diff+=TAU;
      m.angle+=clamp(diff,-1,1)*1.4*dt;
      const target=m.boost?360:230;
      m.spd=(m.spd||0)+ (target-(m.spd||0))*1.5*dt;
      if(m.spd==null) m.spd=target;
      const ox=m.x,oy=m.y;
      m.x+=Math.cos(m.angle)*m.spd*dt;
      m.y+=Math.sin(m.angle)*m.spd*dt;
      m.vx=(m.x-ox)/dt; m.vy=(m.y-oy)/dt;
      if(m.boost && Math.random()<0.5) spawnPuff(m.x-Math.cos(m.angle)*12,m.y-Math.sin(m.angle)*12);
      if(m.life<=0){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
      // collision with player
      if(player.inv<=0 && player.crash<=0 &&
         Math.hypot(m.x-player.x,m.y-player.y)<26){
        S.score=Math.max(0,S.score-2);
        S.flash=0.4; S.flashCol="255,60,40";
        S.msg="Crash!"; S.msgSub=""; S.msgT=1.0;
        player.crash=0.8; player.inv=1.2;
        player.spd*=0.3;
        S.shake=10;
        const a=Math.atan2(player.y-m.y,player.x-m.x);
        burst(player.x,player.y,14,a);
        movers.splice(i,1);
        continue;
      }
    } else if(m.type==="coin"){
      m.phase=(m.phase||0)+dt*4;
      if(m.life<=0){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
      if(Math.hypot(m.x-player.x,m.y-player.y)<24){
        S.score+=1; if(S.score>S.best) S.best=S.score;
        S.flash=0.2; S.flashCol="255,210,80";
        spawnText(m.x,m.y-14,"+1");
        for(let k=0;k<6;k++) spawnSpark(m.x,m.y,Math.random()*TAU,120+Math.random()*120,"255,210,80",0.4);
        movers.splice(i,1);
        continue;
      }
    } else if(m.type==="spark"){
      m.x+=m.vx*dt; m.y+=m.vy*dt;
      m.vx*=0.92; m.vy*=0.92;
      if(m.life<=0){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
    } else if(m.type==="text"){
      m.y+=m.vy*dt;
      if(m.life<=0){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
    } else if(m.type==="puff"){
      if(m.life<=0){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }
    }
  }

  // exhaust puffs from player
  if(player.thrust && Math.random()<0.6){
    const bx=player.x-Math.cos(player.angle)*16;
    const by=player.y-Math.sin(player.angle)*16;
    spawnPuff(bx,by);
  }

  S.shake=Math.max(0,S.shake-30*dt);
  S.flash=Math.max(0,S.flash-dt);
  S.msgT=Math.max(0,S.msgT-dt);
}

// ---------- drawing ----------
function drawTrack(){
  const cx=track.cx*W, cy=track.cy*H;
  const r=track.rx*W, ry=track.ry*H;
  // outer grass ring
  ctx.fillStyle="#12331f";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,r*1.5,ry*1.5,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // asphalt
  ctx.fillStyle="#2b2f36";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,r,ry,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // inner infield
  const ir=r-track.w*W/2, iyr=ry-track.w*H/2;
  ctx.fillStyle="#12331f";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,Math.max(10,ir),Math.max(10,iyr),0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // infield detail
  ctx.fillStyle="#1c4a2c";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,Math.max(6,ir*0.55),Math.max(6,iyr*0.55),0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // edge lines
  ctx.lineWidth=4; ctx.strokeStyle="#e9e9e9";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,r,ry,0,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,Math.max(10,ir),Math.max(10,iyr),0,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
  // dashed centre line
  ctx.setLineDash([14,18]); ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  const mr=(r+Math.max(10,ir))/2, myr=(ry+Math.max(10,iyr))/2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,mr,myr,0,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // finish line
  const fx=cx+r*Math.cos(track.finish), fy=cy+ry*Math.sin(track.finish);
  const fa=Math.atan2(ry*Math.cos(track.finish), -r*Math.sin(track.finish));
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(fx,fy); ctx.rotate(fa+Math.PI/2);
  const cols=10, cw=4, ch=4;
  for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
      ctx.fillStyle=((i+j)%2)?"#fff":"#111";
      ctx.fillRect(-cols*cw/2+i*cw, -3*ch/2+j*ch, cw, ch);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCar(x,y,angle,w,h,hue,thrust,boosting){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(angle);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,3,w*0.55,h*0.6,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle="hsl("+hue+",70%,55%)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(w*0.55,0);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w*0.5,-h*0.5,0,-h*0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(-w*0.5,-h*0.5);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-w*0.6,-h*0.2,-w*0.6,0);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-w*0.6,h*0.2,-w*0.5,h*0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(0,h*0.5);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w*0.5,h*0.5,w*0.55,0);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // nose highlight
  ctx.fillStyle="hsl("+hue+",70%,70%)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w*0.55,0); ctx.lineTo(w*0.2,-h*0.35); ctx.lineTo(w*0.2,h*0.35); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle="#0d1420";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-w*0.05,0,w*0.18,h*0.32,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // rear wing
  ctx.fillStyle="hsl("+hue+",60%,40%)";
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.62,-h*0.55,w*0.12,h*1.1);
  // wheels
  ctx.fillStyle="#111";
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.35,-h*0.6,w*0.22,h*0.22);
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.35,h*0.38,w*0.22,h*0.22);
  ctx.fillRect(w*0.12,-h*0.6,w*0.22,h*0.22);
  ctx.fillRect(w*0.12,h*0.38,w*0.22,h*0.22);
  // headlights
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff7c0";
  ctx.fillRect(w*0.45,-h*0.3,w*0.08,h*0.12);
  ctx.fillRect(w*0.45,h*0.18,w*0.08,h*0.12);
  // exhaust
  if(thrust){
    ctx.fillStyle=boosting?"rgba(255,140,40,0.9)":"rgba(255,200,90,0.7)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-w*0.6,-h*0.1);
    ctx.lineTo(-w*0.6-10-Math.random()*8,0);
    ctx.lineTo(-w*0.6,h*0.1);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMover(m){
  if(m.type==="rival"){
    drawCar(m.x,m.y,m.angle,m.w,m.h,m.hue,m.spd>260,m.boost);
  } else if(m.type==="coin"){
    const s=12+Math.sin(m.phase)*2;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,4,s*0.6,s*0.35,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffcf3a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,s,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff2b0";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-s*0.25,-s*0.25,s*0.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  } else if(m.type==="spark"){
    const a=clamp(m.life/m.life0,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba("+m.col+","+a+")";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,2+a*3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  } else if(m.type==="text"){
    const a=clamp(m.life/1.1,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+a+")";
    ctx.font="bold 20px Arial"; ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText(m.txt,m.x,m.y);
  } else if(m.type==="puff"){
    const a=clamp(m.life/m.life0,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(200,200,210,"+(a*0.4)+")";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,(1-a)*10+3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0c1016"); g.addColorStop(1,"#05070a");
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // faint grid
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.03)"; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  const step=64;
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=step){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for(let y=0;y<H;y+=step){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke(); }
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
  ctx.fillRect(14,14,190,96);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"; ctx.strokeRect(14,14,190,96);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a"; ctx.font="bold 30px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("LAP "+S.score, 26, 50);
  ctx.fillStyle="#9fd0ff"; ctx.font="16px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("BEST "+S.best, 26, 76);
  ctx.fillStyle="#8fbf9a"; ctx.font="13px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("TIME "+S.time.toFixed(1)+"s", 26, 98);

  // speed bar
  const bw=150, bx=W-bw-20, by=H-30;
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.45)"; ctx.fillRect(bx-8,by-22,bw+16,34);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"; ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw,12);
  const frac=clamp(player.spd/720,0,1);
  ctx.fillStyle=player.boosting?"#ff7a2a":"#5ad0ff";
  ctx.fillRect(bx,by,bw*frac,12);
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff"; ctx.font="12px Arial"; ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillText("SPEED", bx, by-6);

  // boost meter
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"; ctx.fillRect(bx,by+18,bw,6);
  const bf=1-clamp(player.cool/1.3,0,1);
  ctx.fillStyle=bf>0.95?"#ffe27a":"#7a8290";
  ctx.fillRect(bx,by+18,bw*bf,6);

  // controls hint
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)"; ctx.font="13px Arial"; ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillText("WASD / Arrows to drive  ·  SHIFT or hold pointer to boost", W/2, H-12);

  if(S.msgT>0){
    const a=clamp(S.msgT/1.1,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+a+")";
    ctx.font="bold 44px Arial"; ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText(S.msg, W/2, H*0.3);
  }
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(5,8,12,0.72)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a"; ctx.font="bold "+Math.min(90,W*0.14)+"px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("GRAND PRIX 2", W/2, H*0.32);
  ctx.fillStyle="#9fd0ff"; ctx.font="20px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Drive the loop. Cross the finish line for laps. Grab gold coins.", W/2, H*0.44);
  ctx.fillStyle="#8fbf9a"; ctx.font="18px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("Avoid rival cars and stay on the asphalt.", W/2, H*0.50);
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff"; ctx.font="bold 26px Arial";
  const pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(S.time*4);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+pulse+")";
  ctx.fillText("Press ENTER / SPACE or tap to start", W/2, H*0.62);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.font="15px Arial";
  ctx.fillText("WASD / Arrows drive  ·  SHIFT or hold pointer boosts", W/2, H*0.68);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(S.shake>0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*S.shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawTrack();
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].type==="coin") drawMover(movers[i]); }
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].type==="rival") drawMover(movers[i]); }
  // player
  if(player.inv>0 && Math.floor(S.time*20)%2===0){
    // blink
  } else {
    drawCar(player.x,player.y,player.angle,player.w,player.h,0,player.thrust,player.boosting);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].type==="spark") drawMover(movers[i]); }
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].type==="puff") drawMover(movers[i]); }
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){ if(movers[i].type==="text") drawMover(movers[i]); }
  ctx.restore();

  if(S.flash>0){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba("+S.flashCol+","+(S.flash*0.5)+")";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  if(S.phase==="playing") drawHUD();
  if(S.phase==="start") drawStart();
}

// ---------- main loop ----------
function frame(now){
  if(!last) last=now;
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Falcon 3.0</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04070d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  #game{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.8);border-radius:6px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;
  const G=0.18;

  // ---- state ----
  let state='start';
  let score=0;
  let best=0;
  let kills=0;
  let time=0;
  let shake=0;
  let lastMsg='';
  let msgT=0;

  const keys={};
  const mouse={x:W/2,y:H/2};

  const player={x:120,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:26,cool:0,aim:0};
  const movers=[];
  const targets=[];
  const bullets=[];
  const parts=[];

  const TGT=[
    {name:'MISSILE', r:11, color:'#ff5b4d', pts:10, hp:1},
    {name:'HELICOPTER', r:16, color:'#ffd24a', pts:15, hp:2},
    {name:'BOMBER', r:20, color:'#8fd0ff', pts:25, hp:3}
  ];

  function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}
  function clamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:v>b?b:v;}

  function spawnTarget(){
    const t=TGT[(Math.random()*TGT.length)|0];
    const y=rnd(70,H-70);
    const vx=-rnd(1.4,3.2);
    movers.push({x:W+40,y:y,vx:vx,vy:0,r:t.r,color:t.color,pts:t.pts,hp:t.hp,kind:'target',name:t.name,sway:rnd(0,6.28)});
  }
  function spawnMissile(){
    const y=rnd(60,H-60);
    movers.push({x:W+30,y:y,vx:-rnd(4.2,6.2),vy:0,r:9,color:'#ff9a3d',pts:0,hp:1,kind:'missile',name:'MISSILE'});
  }
  function spawnBullet(){
    const a=player.aim;
    bullets.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*30,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*30,vx:Math.cos(a)*11,vy:Math.sin(a)*11,r:4,life:200});
  }
  function spawnParts(x,y,color,n){
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const a=rnd(0,6.28), s=rnd(1,5);
      parts.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,r:rnd(2,5),color:color,life:rnd(18,40),max:40});
    }
  }
  function boom(x,y,color){
    spawnParts(x,y,color,18);
    shake=8;
  }
  function reset(){
    score=0; kills=0; time=0; shake=0;
    movers.length=0; targets.length=0; bullets.length=0; parts.length=0;
    player.x=120; player.y=H/2; player.vx=0; player.vy=0; player.cool=0; player.aim=0;
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k]=true;
    if(k===' '||k==='w'||k==='a'||k==='s'||k==='d')e.preventDefault();
    if((k===' '||k==='enter') && state!=='playing'){
      reset(); state='playing';
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);
    mouse.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    if(state!=='playing'){reset(); state='playing'; return;}
    if(player.cool<=0){spawnBullet(); player.cool=9;}
  });

  // ---- update ----
  function update(){
    if(state!=='playing')return;
    time++;
    if(shake>0)shake*=0.85;

    // player
    const sp=4.2;
    let ax=0,ay=0;
    if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup'])ay-=1;
    if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown'])ay+=1;
    if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'])ax-=1;
    if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright'])ax+=1;
    const l=Math.hypot(ax,ay)||1;
    player.vx=player.vx*0.8+(ax/l)*sp;
    player.vy=player.vy*0.8+(ay/l)*sp;
    player.x=clamp(player.x+player.vx,30,W-30);
    player.y=clamp(player.y+player.vy,30,H-30);
    player.aim=Math.atan2(mouse.y-player.y,mouse.x-player.x);
    if(player.cool>0)player.cool--;

    // spawn
    if(time%36===0)spawnTarget();
    if(time>120 && time%150===0)spawnMissile();

    // movers
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m=movers[i];
      if(m.kind==='target'){
        m.sway+=0.05;
        m.y+=Math.sin(m.sway)*0.7;
      }
      m.x+=m.vx; m.y+=m.vy;
      if(m.x<-60){
        if(m.kind==='target'){
          score-=2; lastMsg='MISS  -2'; msgT=60;
        }
        movers.splice(i,1);
      }
    }

    // bullets
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=bullets[i];
      b.x+=b.vx; b.y+=b.vy; b.life--;
      if(b.life<=0||b.x<0||b.x>W||b.y<0||b.y>H){bullets.splice(i,1); continue;}
      let hit=false;
      for(let j=movers.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const m=movers[j];
        if(Math.hypot(b.x-m.x,b.y-m.y)<m.r+b.r){
          m.hp--;
          if(m.hp<=0){
            boom(m.x,m.y,m.color);
            if(m.kind==='target'){score+=m.pts; kills++; lastMsg=m.name+'  +'+m.pts; msgT=60;}
            movers.splice(j,1);
          }
          hit=true; break;
        }
      }
      if(hit)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }

    // player collision
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m=movers[i];
      if(Math.hypot(player.x-m.x,player.y-m.y)<player.r+m.r){
        boom(m.x,m.y,m.color);
        movers.splice(i,1);
        state='over'; best=Math.max(best,score);
      }
    }

    // particles
    for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const p=parts[i];
      p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy+=G*0.4; p.life--;
      if(p.life<=0)parts.splice(i,1);
    }
    if(msgT>0)msgT--;
  }

  // ---- draw helpers ----
  function drawBackground(){
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#243a5c');
    g.addColorStop(0.5,'#54718f');
    g.addColorStop(0.82,'#8fa6b6');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#c9d3d8');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,244,214,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-150,110,46,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,244,214,0.18)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-150,110,72,0,6.28); ctx.fill();

    // distant clouds
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const cx=((i*260 - time*0.3)%(W+200))-100, cy=90+i*38;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,70,18,0,0,6.28);
      ctx.ellipse(cx+45,cy+6,50,15,0,0,6.28);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // ground
    const gg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H-70,0,H);
    gg.addColorStop(0,'#7d8f52'); gg.addColorStop(1,'#4e5f34');
    ctx.fillStyle=gg; ctx.fillRect(0,H-70,W,70);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,H-70); ctx.lineTo(W,H-70); ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawFalcon(){
    const p=player;
    const a=p.aim;
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y+p.r*0.9,20,7,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(a);
    // wings (swept)
    ctx.fillStyle='#1f2a38';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-4,-14); ctx.lineTo(-22,-2); ctx.lineTo(-12,6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-4,14); ctx.lineTo(-22,2); ctx.lineTo(-12,-6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // tail
    ctx.fillStyle='#2b3a4d';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-22,0); ctx.lineTo(-34,-9); ctx.lineTo(-30,0); ctx.lineTo(-34,9); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle='#3a4a5e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(28,0); ctx.lineTo(2,-11); ctx.lineTo(-22,-11); ctx.lineTo(-22,11); ctx.lineTo(2,11); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // canopy
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fd6ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16,0); ctx.lineTo(6,-6); ctx.lineTo(-4,-6); ctx.lineTo(-4,0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // nose highlight
    ctx.fillStyle='#556b82';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(28,0); ctx.lineTo(14,-3); ctx.lineTo(14,3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // crosshair
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,80,60,0.9)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x-14,mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x-5,mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x+5,mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x+14,mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x,mouse.y-14); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x,mouse.y-5);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x,mouse.y+5); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x,mouse.y+14);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mouse.x,mouse.y,3,0,6.28); ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawTarget(m){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y); ctx.rotate(m.sway*0.2);
    ctx.fillStyle=m.color;
    if(m.name==='MISSILE'){
      ctx.fillRect(-m.r,-m.r*0.5,m.r*2,m.r);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-m.r,-m.r*0.5); ctx.lineTo(-m.r-8,0); ctx.lineTo(-m.r,m.r*0.5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#c0392b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.r,-m.r*0.5); ctx.lineTo(m.r+8,0); ctx.lineTo(m.r,m.r*0.5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    } else if(m.name==='HELICOPTER'){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,m.r,m.r*0.7,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.fillRect(-m.r-10,-2,m.r*0.6,4);
      ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-m.r*0.7,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#222'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-m.r-14,-m.r*0.7); ctx.lineTo(m.r+14,-m.r*0.7); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,m.r,m.r*0.5,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#5a7f9c'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.r,0); ctx.lineTo(m.r+10,0); ctx.lineTo(m.r,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(-m.r*0.4,-m.r*0.55,m.r*0.5,6);
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // hp pips
    for(let i=0;i<m.hp;i++){
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x-(m.hp-1)*6+i*12, m.y-m.r-10, 3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawMissile(m){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle=m.color;
    ctx.fillRect(-m.r,-4,m.r*2,8);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-m.r,-4); ctx.lineTo(-m.r-8,0); ctx.lineTo(-m.r,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff5b4d'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.r,-4); ctx.lineTo(m.r+7,0); ctx.lineTo(m.r,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x-14,m.y,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBullet(b){
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff2a8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x-b.vx*0.6,b.y-b.vy*0.6,b.r*0.5,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticle(p){
    ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    ctx.fillRect(14,14,210,58);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,200,255,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.strokeRect(14,14,210,58);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a'; ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE',28,34);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 26px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText(String(score),28,60);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff'; ctx.font='11px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('KILLS '+kills,150,34);
    ctx.fillText('BEST '+best,150,50);

    if(msgT>0){
      ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(msgT/60,0,1);
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px system-ui'; ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText(lastMsg,W/2,90);
      ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    }
  }

  function drawOverlay(title,sub,accent){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,8,15,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle=accent; ctx.font='bold 54px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText(title,W/2,H/2-40);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='18px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText(sub,W/2,H/2+4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fd6ff'; ctx.font='15px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('W A S D / arrows to move   •   mouse to aim   •   click / space to fire',W/2,H/2+40);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a'; ctx.font='bold 16px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  START',W/2,H/2+78);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }

  // ---- draw ----
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0.5)ctx.translate(rnd(-shake,shake),rnd(-shake,shake));
    drawBackground();
    for(const p of parts)drawParticle(p);
    for(const b of bullets)drawBullet(b);
    for(const m of movers){ if(m.kind==='missile')drawMissile(m); else drawTarget(m); }
    if(state!=='start')drawFalcon();
    ctx.restore();
    if(state==='playing')drawHUD();
    if(state==='start')drawOverlay('FALCON 3.0','Intercept the incoming threats.  Don\'t get hit.','#8fd0ff');
    if(state==='over')drawOverlay('MISSION  FAILED','Final score: '+score+'   •   Targets down: '+kills,'#ff6b5b');
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function frame(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Paper Mario — Paper World</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#241a2e;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{display:block;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55);border-radius:6px;max-width:96vw;max-height:92vh}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

  // ---- constants ----
  const GROUND_Y=430;
  const GRAVITY=0.6;
  const MARIO_JUMP=-13.5;
  const MARIO_SPEED=4.2;
  const COIN_VAL=100;
  const WIN_COINS=20;

  // ---- state ----
  let mario={x:120,y:GROUND_Y-34,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:true,dir:1,inv:0};
  let movers=[];
  let score=0, coins=0, lives=3, state='start';
  let t=0, flash=0, shake=0;
  const keys={};

  // ---- helpers ----
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function overlap(a,b){
    return a.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w>b.x && a.y<b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h>b.y;
  }
  function spawnCoin(x,y){ movers.push({type:'coin',x:x,y:y,vx:0,vy:-2.5,age:0,dead:false}); }
  function spawnPokey(x,dir){ movers.push({type:'pokey',x:x,y:GROUND_Y-34,vx:dir*1.4,vy:0,age:0,dead:false}); }
  function spawnGoomba(x,dir){ movers.push({type:'goomba',x:x,y:GROUND_Y-30,vx:dir*1.1,vy:0,age:0,dead:false}); }
  function spawnStar(x,y){ movers.push({type:'star',x:x,y:y,vx:0,vy:0,age:0,dead:false}); }

  function reset(){
    mario={x:120,y:GROUND_Y-34,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:true,dir:1,inv:0};
    movers=[]; score=0; coins=0; lives=3; state='play';
    spawnCoin(320,GROUND_Y-150); spawnCoin(520,GROUND_Y-150); spawnCoin(720,GROUND_Y-150);
    spawnPokey(420,1); spawnGoomba(640,-1); spawnStar(150,GROUND_Y-170);
  }

  // ---- input ----
  addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
    if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    keys[k]=true;
    if(state==='start' && (k==='enter'||k===' ')){ reset(); }
    else if(state==='over' && k==='enter'){ reset(); }
    else if(state==='win' && k==='enter'){ state='start'; }
  });
  addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; });

  // ---- update ----
  function update(){
    if(state!=='play') return;
    t++;

    // mario
    if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']){ mario.vx=-MARIO_SPEED; mario.dir=-1; }
    else if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']){ mario.vx=MARIO_SPEED; mario.dir=1; }
    else { mario.vx*=0.8; if(Math.abs(mario.vx)<0.1) mario.vx=0; }

    if((keys['w']||keys['arrowup']||keys[' ']) && mario.onGround){ mario.vy=MARIO_JUMP; mario.onGround=false; }

    mario.vy+=GRAVITY;
    mario.x+=mario.vx;
    mario.y+=mario.vy;
    if(mario.x<20) mario.x=20;
    if(mario.x>W-20) mario.x=W-20;

    const mBox={x:mario.x-15,y:mario.y-32,w:30,h:32};
    if(mario.y>=GROUND_Y){ mario.y=GROUND_Y; mario.vy=0; mario.onGround=true; }
    else mario.onGround=false;

    if(mario.inv>0) mario.inv--;
    if(flash>0) flash--;
    if(shake>0) shake--;

    // movers
    for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      const m=movers[i];
      if(m.dead) continue;
      m.age++;

      if(m.type==='coin'){
        m.vy+=GRAVITY*0.6;
        m.x+=m.vx; m.y+=m.vy;
        if(m.y>=GROUND_Y-12){ m.y=GROUND_Y-12; m.vy*=-0.45; }
        if(m.age>240) m.dead=true;
        if(overlap(mBox,m)){
          m.dead=true; coins++; score+=COIN_VAL;
          if(coins>=WIN_COINS) state='win';
        }
      }
      else if(m.type==='pokey'){
        m.vy+=GRAVITY; m.y+=m.vy;
        if(m.y>=GROUND_Y-34){ m.y=GROUND_Y-34; m.vy=0; }
        m.x+=m.vx;
        if(m.x<24){ m.x=24; m.vx=Math.abs(m.vx); }
        if(m.x>W-24){ m.x=W-24; m.vx=-Math.abs(m.vx); }
        if(overlap(mBox,m)){
          if(!mario.onGround && mario.vy>0){
            m.dead=true; score+=200; mario.vy=-8;
          } else if(mario.inv<=0){
            lives--; flash=18; shake=10; mario.inv=90;
            if(lives<=0) state='over';
          }
        }
      }
      else if(m.type==='goomba'){
        m.vy+=GRAVITY; m.y+=m.vy;
        if(m.y>=GROUND_Y-30){ m.y=GROUND_Y-30; m.vy=0; }
        m.x+=m.vx;
        if(m.x<24){ m.x=24; m.vx=Math.abs(m.vx); }
        if(m.x>W-24){ m.x=W-24; m.vx=-Math.abs(m.vx); }
        if(overlap(mBox,m)){
          if(!mario.onGround && mario.vy>0){
            m.dead=true; score+=200; mario.vy=-8;
          } else if(mario.inv<=0){
            lives--; flash=18; shake=10; mario.inv=90;
            if(lives<=0) state='over';
          }
        }
      }
      else if(m.type==='star'){
        const bob=Math.sin(m.age*0.06)*6;
        if(overlap({x:m.x-16,y:m.y-16+bob,w:32,h:32},mBox)){
          m.dead=true; score+=500;
          if(coins>=WIN_COINS) state='win';
        }
      }
    }
    movers=movers.filter(m=>!m.dead);
  }

  // ---- drawing ----
  function drawSky(){
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#8ec5ff'); g.addColorStop(0.6,'#cdeaff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#eaf6ff');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  function drawCloud(x,y,s){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,22*s,0,7); ctx.arc(x+26*s,y-8*s,26*s,0,7);
    ctx.arc(x+58*s,y,22*s,0,7); ctx.arc(x+30*s,y+10*s,26*s,0,7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  function drawSun(){
    const sx=W-120, sy=90;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,150,0.35)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,60,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,34,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,224,102,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
      const a=i/12*Math.PI*2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx+Math.cos(a)*40, sy+Math.sin(a)*40);
      ctx.lineTo(sx+Math.cos(a)*54, sy+Math.sin(a)*54); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  function drawHills(){
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fd07f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(140,300,280,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(420,320,560,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(700,290,840,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(900,320,W,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#8cc56e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(200,340,400,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(620,350,820,GROUND_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  function drawFlower(x,y){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#5aa05a'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x,y-22); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff7eb6';
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ const a=i/5*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+Math.cos(a)*7, y-22+Math.sin(a)*7,5,0,7); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24d'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-22,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }
  function drawGround(){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7a4a2b'; ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y,W,H-GROUND_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle='#6a3f24';
    for(let x=0;x<W;x+=40) ctx.fillRect(x,GROUND_Y+14,20,8);
    ctx.fillStyle='#5aa05a'; ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y-10,W,12);
    ctx.fillStyle='#6fbf68';
    for(let x=0;x<W;x+=26){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,GROUND_Y-10);
      ctx.lineTo(x+8,GROUND_Y-20); ctx.lineTo(x+16,GROUND_Y-10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND_Y); ctx.lineTo(W,GROUND_Y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  function drawMario(){
    const x=mario.x, y=mario.y;
    if(mario.inv>0 && Math.floor(mario.inv/4)%2===0) return;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(mario.dir,1);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,2,20,6,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#3b6fd6'; rr(-12,-14,24,15,4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2b57b0'; ctx.fillRect(-12,-3,24,4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e63946'; rr(-13,-30,26,18,5); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4c79a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-34,11,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#e63946'; rr(-13,-46,26,12,5); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(12,-42,6,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2b2b2b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5,-35,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#6b3a1e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(9,-30,5,2.5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4c79a'; ctx.fillRect(-11,-16,7,9); ctx.fillRect(5,-16,7,9);
    ctx.fillStyle='#2b2b2b'; rr(-13,0,12,6,2); ctx.fill(); rr(2,0,12,6,2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawCoin(m){
    const squish=Math.abs(Math.cos(m.age*0.15));
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e0a800'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,10*Math.max(squish,0.2),12,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24d'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-2,-2,7*Math.max(squish,0.2),9,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff3b0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-4,-4,2,3,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawPokey(m){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,34,16,5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; rr(-13,-14,26,30,6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#333'; ctx.lineWidth=2; rr(-13,-14,26,30,6); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5,-2,3,0,7); ctx.arc(5,-2,3,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#e63946'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,10,4,6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,13,-4,6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawGoomba(m){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.15)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,30,16,5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#8a5a34'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-2,16,13,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f2e2c4'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,4,12,7,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-5,-2,4,5,0,0,7); ctx.ellipse(5,-2,4,5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#333'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5,-1,2,0,7); ctx.arc(5,-1,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f2e2c4'; rr(-13,10,10,7,2); ctx.fill(); rr(3,10,10,7,2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawStar(m){
    const bob=Math.sin(m.age*0.06)*6;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y+bob); ctx.rotate(m.age*0.02);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,80,0.3)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,22,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24d'; ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
      const r=i%2===0?14:6; const a=i/10*Math.PI*2-Math.PI/2;
      const px=Math.cos(a)*r, py=Math.sin(a)*r;
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#e0a800'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-3,-2,2,0,7); ctx.arc(3,-2,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawMovers(){
    for(const m of movers){
      if(m.type==='coin') drawCoin(m);
      else if(m.type==='pokey') drawPokey(m);
      else if(m.type==='goomba') drawGoomba(m);
      else if(m.type==='star') drawStar(m);
    }
  }
  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; rr(14,12,210,30,8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px system-ui,Arial';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score, 26, 33);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; rr(236,12,150,30,8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.fillText('COINS  '+coins+'/'+WIN_COINS, 248, 33);
    ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a6a';
    for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
      const hx=W-20-i*26, hy=28;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx,hy+8);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-14,hy-6,hx-8,hy-16,hx,hy-6);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+8,hy-16,hx+14,hy-6,hx,hy+8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  function overlay(title,sub,btn,accent){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,14,30,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle=accent; ctx.font='bold 52px system-ui,Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2-30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='20px system-ui,Arial';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2+8);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.font='bold 22px system-ui,Arial';
    ctx.fillText(btn, W/2, H/2+48);
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0) ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*shake*0.5, (Math.random()*2-1)*shake*0.5);
    drawSky();
    drawSun();
    drawCloud(180,110,1); drawCloud(420,70,1.2); drawCloud(700,150,0.9);
    drawHills();
    drawFlower(260,GROUND_Y); drawFlower(500,GROUND_Y); drawFlower(800,GROUND_Y);
    drawGround();
    drawMovers();
    drawMario();
    ctx.restore();
    if(flash>0){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,40,40,'+(flash/18*0.5)+')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }
    drawHUD();
    if(state==='start') overlay('PAPER MARIO','Collect '+WIN_COINS+' coins to win. Stomp enemies. Avoid them on the ground!','Press ENTER to start','#ffe066');
    else if(state==='over') overlay('GAME OVER','You ran out of lives. Score: '+score,'Press ENTER to retry','#ff5a6a');
    else if(state==='win') overlay('YOU WIN!','All '+WIN_COINS+' coins collected. Score: '+score,'Press ENTER for title','#7dffa0');
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<html_file>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Mafia</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0a0c12;overflow:hidden;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
  #game{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block;cursor:crosshair}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, bg = null, vign = null;
function resize(){
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px'; canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  makeBG();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// ---------- background ----------
function makeBG(){
  bg = document.createElement('canvas');
  bg.width = W; bg.height = H;
  const g = bg.getContext('2d');
  const sky = g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#10131f');
  sky.addColorStop(0.55,'#171a29');
  sky.addColorStop(0.82,'#2a2333');
  sky.addColorStop(1,'#3a2f3a');
  g.fillStyle = sky; g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  for(let i=0;i<140;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*W, y=Math.random()*H*0.5, r=Math.random()*1.1+0.2;
    g.globalAlpha = Math.random()*0.6+0.2;
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x,y,r,0,6.283); g.fill();
  }
  g.globalAlpha = 1;
  const moon = g.createRadialGradient(W*0.78,H*0.2,5,W*0.78,H*0.2,W*0.22);
  moon.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,250,235,0.55)');
  moon.addColorStop(0.4,'rgba(255,245,220,0.12)');
  moon.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,245,220,0)');
  g.fillStyle = moon; g.beginPath(); g.arc(W*0.78,H*0.2,W*0.22,0,6.283); g.fill();
  g.fillStyle = '#e9e4d2'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(W*0.78,H*0.2,W*0.05,0,6.283); g.fill();
  g.fillStyle = '#141622';
  const base = H*0.55;
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const bx = i*(W/26)+Math.random()*10-5;
    const bw = W/26+Math.random()*20;
    const bh = Math.random()*H*0.22+H*0.05;
    g.fillRect(bx, base-bh, bw, bh+H);
  }
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,150,0.5)';
  for(let i=0;i<120;i++){
    const x=Math.random()*W, y=base-Math.random()*H*0.24;
    if(Math.random()<0.5) g.fillRect(x,y,3,4);
  }
  const ground = g.createLinearGradient(0,base,0,H);
  ground.addColorStop(0,'#0c0e16');
  ground.addColorStop(1,'#05060b');
  g.fillStyle = ground; g.fillRect(0,base,W,H-base);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,170,0.05)'; g.lineWidth = 1;
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
    const y = base + (H-base)*(i/20);
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0,y); g.lineTo(W,y); g.stroke();
  }
  vign = document.createElement('canvas');
  vign.width = W; vign.height = H;
  const v = vign.getContext('2d');
  const rg = v.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,H*0.2,W/2,H/2,Math.max(W,H)*0.75);
  rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)');
  v.fillStyle = rg; v.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}

// ---------- state ----------
const state = {
  running:false, over:false,
  score:0, lives:3,
  time:0, shake:0,
  nextWave:0,
  lastHit:0,
  aimX:0, aimY:0
};
const player = { x:0, y:0, r:26, angle:0, recoil:0, muzzle:0 };
const movers = [];
const enemies = [];
const bullets = [];
const parts = [];
const texts = [];
const keys = {};

function reset(){
  movers.length=0; enemies.length=0; bullets.length=0; parts.length=0; texts.length=0;
  state.score=0; state.lives=3; state.time=0; state.shake=0;
  state.nextWave=1.2; state.lastHit=0; state.over=false; state.running=true;
  player.x=W/2; player.y=H*0.72; player.angle=-Math.PI/2; player.recoil=0; player.muzzle=0;
  pushText('MAFIA', W/2, H*0.32, 64, '#ffcf6b', 2.2, 1.0);
  pushText('survive the night', W/2, H*0.32+52, 20, '#c9c2b2', 2.2, 0.8);
  pushText('mouse: aim  •  hold: shoot  •  space: dash', W/2, H*0.32+86, 15, '#8a8578', 3.0, 0.7);
}

// ---------- spawn helpers ----------
function pushText(str,x,y,size,color,life,vel){
  texts.push({str,x,y,size,color,life,max:life,vel:vel||0});
}
function spawnEnemy(){
  const side = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  let x,y,vx,vy;
  if(side===0){ x=-40; y=Math.random()*H; vx=(1.6+Math.random()*1.4); vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.6; }
  else if(side===1){ x=W+40; y=Math.random()*H; vx=-(1.6+Math.random()*1.4); vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.6; }
  else if(side===2){ x=Math.random()*W; y=-40; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.6; vy=(1.6+Math.random()*1.4); }
  else { x=Math.random()*W; y=H+40; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.6; vy=-(1.6+Math.random()*1.4); }
  const r = 20+Math.random()*10;
  enemies.push({ x,y,vx,vy,r, hp:3+Math.floor(Math.random()*3), hit:0, flash:0,
    tint: Math.random()<0.5 ? '#26324a' : '#3a2a3a',
    gun: 0.5+Math.random()*0.8 });
}
function spawnMuzzle(x,y,ang){
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const a = ang + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.5;
    const s = 2+Math.random()*3;
    parts.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:2+Math.random()*3,
      life:0.25, max:0.25, color:'#ffcf6b', grav:0, kind:'spark' });
  }
}
function spawnHit(x,y,color){
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.283;
    const s = 1.5+Math.random()*4;
    parts.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:1.5+Math.random()*2.5,
      life:0.5, max:0.5, color, grav:0, kind:'spark' });
  }
}
function spawnDeath(x,y){
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.283;
    const s = 1+Math.random()*5;
    parts.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:2+Math.random()*4,
      life:0.8, max:0.8, color: Math.random()<0.5?'#8a1f1f':'#3a2a2a', grav:0.05, kind:'smoke' });
  }
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.283;
    const s = 2+Math.random()*5;
    parts.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:1.5+Math.random()*2,
      life:0.4, max:0.4, color:'#ffcf6b', grav:0, kind:'spark' });
  }
}
function spawnDash(x,y){
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.283;
    const s = 1+Math.random()*3;
    parts.push({ x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:3+Math.random()*4,
      life:0.5, max:0.5, color:'#5a6b8a', grav:0, kind:'smoke' });
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
let mouse = { x:0, y:0, down:false };
let dashCd = 0;
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x = e.clientX - r.left; mouse.y = e.clientY - r.top;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e=>{ mouse.down = true; });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', ()=>{ mouse.down = false; });
window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(k===' '){ e.preventDefault(); tryDash(); }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e=> e.preventDefault());

function tryDash(){
  if(!state.running || state.over) return;
  if(dashCd > 0) return;
  let dx=0, dy=0;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) dy-=1;
  if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) dy+=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) dx-=1;
  if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) dx+=1;
  if(dx===0 && dy===0){ dx = Math.cos(player.angle); dy = Math.sin(player.angle); }
  const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
  player.x += (dx/len)*130; player.y += (dy/len)*130;
  player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W-player.r, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H-player.r, player.y));
  spawnDash(player.x, player.y);
  state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 4);
  dashCd = 0.7;
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;
  dashCd = Math.max(0, dashCd - dt);
  player.recoil = Math.max(0, player.recoil - dt*6);
  player.muzzle = Math.max(0, player.muzzle - dt);
  state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*30);

  // aim
  player.angle = Math.atan2(mouse.y - player.y, mouse.x - player.x);

  // move
  let dx=0, dy=0;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) dy-=1;
  if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) dy+=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) dx-=1;
  if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) dx+=1;
  const sp = 260;
  if(dx!==0 || dy!==0){
    const l = Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    player.x += (dx/l)*sp*dt;
    player.y += (dy/l)*sp*dt;
  }
  player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W-player.r, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H-player.r, player.y));

  // shooting
  if(mouse.down){
    const bx = player.x + Math.cos(player.angle)*player.r;
    const by = player.y + Math.sin(player.angle)*player.r;
    const bs = 900;
    bullets.push({ x:bx, y:by, vx:Math.cos(player.angle)*bs, vy:Math.sin(player.angle)*bs,
      r:4, life:1.2, from:'player' });
    player.recoil = 1;
    player.muzzle = 0.06;
    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 2);
    spawnMuzzle(bx, by, player.angle);
    state.lastHit = state.time;
  }

  // spawn waves
  state.nextWave -= dt;
  if(state.nextWave <= 0){
    const n = 1 + Math.floor(state.time/15);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++) spawnEnemy();
    state.nextWave = Math.max(0.8, 2.4 - state.time*0.02);
  }

  // build movers: all enemies + all bullets
  movers.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<enemies.length;i++) movers.push(enemies[i]);
  for(let i=0;i<bullets.length;i++) movers.push(bullets[i]);

  // move movers
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.hp !== undefined){
      // enemy: steer toward player
      const ax = player.x - m.x, ay = player.y - m.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(ax,ay) || 1;
      const want = 220;
      m.vx += (ax/d)*want*dt;
      m.vy += (ay/d)*want*dt;
      const vm = Math.hypot(m.vx,m.vy);
      if(vm > 260){ m.vx = m.vx/vm*260; m.vy = m.vy/vm*260; }
      m.hit = Math.max(0, m.hit - dt);
      m.flash = Math.max(0, m.flash - dt);
      // enemy gun
      m.gun -= dt;
      if(m.gun <= 0 && d < 520){
        m.gun = 0.6 + Math.random()*0.9;
        const ex = m.x + Math.cos(player.angle)*0; // aim at player
        const aa = Math.atan2(player.y-m.y, player.x-m.x);
        const gx = m.x + Math.cos(aa)*m.r, gy = m.y + Math.sin(aa)*m.r;
        bullets.push({ x:gx, y:gy, vx:Math.cos(aa)*420, vy:Math.sin(aa)*420, r:4, life:2.0, from:'enemy' });
        spawnMuzzle(gx, gy, aa);
      }
    } else {
      // bullet
      m.life -= dt;
    }
    m.x += m.vx*dt;
    m.y += m.vy*dt;
  }

  // collisions: bullets vs targets
  for(let i=0;i<bullets.length;i++){
    const b = bullets[i];
    if(b.dead) continue;
    if(b.from === 'player'){
      for(let j=0;j<enemies.length;j++){
        const e = enemies[j];
        if(e.dead) continue;
        if(Math.hypot(e.x-b.x, e.y-b.y) < e.r + b.r){
          e.hp -= 1; e.hit = 0.15; e.flash = 0.15;
          b.dead = true;
          spawnHit(b.x, b.y, '#ffcf6b');
          if(e.hp <= 0){
            e.dead = true;
            state.score += 10;
            state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 5);
            spawnDeath(e.x, e.y);
            pushText('+10', e.x, e.y - e.r, 20, '#ffcf6b', 0.9, -20);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    } else {
      if(Math.hypot(player.x-b.x, player.y-b.y) < player.r + b.r){
        b.dead = true;
        state.lives -= 1;
        state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 12);
        spawnHit(player.x, player.y, '#ff5a4a');
        pushText('-1', player.x, player.y - player.r, 24, '#ff5a4a', 1.0, -24);
        if(state.lives <= 0){
          state.over = true;
          state.running = false;
          pushText('YOU WERE SHOT', W/2, H*0.4, 52, '#ff5a4a', 3, 0);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy touches player
  for(let j=0;j<enemies.length;j++){
    const e = enemies[j];
    if(e.dead) continue;
    if(Math.hypot(e.x-player.x, e.y-player.y) < e.r + player.r){
      e.dead = true;
      state.lives -= 1;
      state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 10);
      spawnDeath(e.x, e.y);
      spawnHit(player.x, player.y, '#ff5a4a');
      if(state.lives <= 0){
        state.over = true;
        state.running = false;
        pushText('YOU WERE SHOT', W/2, H*0.4, 52, '#ff5a4a', 3, 0);
      }
    }
  }

  // drop done movers
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    if(b.dead || b.life <= 0 || b.x < -60 || b.x > W+60 || b.y < -60 || b.y > H+60)
      bullets.splice(i,1);
  }
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(enemies[i].dead) enemies.splice(i,1);
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = parts[i];
    p.life -= dt;
    p.vy += (p.grav||0)*dt*30;
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.94; p.vy *= 0.94;
    if(p.life <= 0) parts.splice(i,1);
  }

  // texts
  for(let i=texts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const t = texts[i];
    t.life -= dt;
    t.y += (t.vel||0)*dt;
    if(t.life <= 0) texts.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawEnemy(e){
  const ang = Math.atan2(player.y-e.y, player.x-e.x);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
  ctx.rotate(ang);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, e.r*0.7, e.r*0.9, e.r*0.35, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
  // body
  const flash = e.flash > 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ff8a5a' : e.tint;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = flash ? '#ffd0a0' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.stroke();
  // hat
  ctx.fillStyle = '#11141f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r*0.7,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0c14';
  ctx.fillRect(-e.r*0.7, -e.r*0.15, e.r*1.4, e.r*0.3);
  // gun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c0e16';
  ctx.fillRect(e.r*0.5, -3, e.r*0.8, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2f3d';
  ctx.fillRect(e.r*0.9, -2, e.r*0.5, 4);
  ctx.restore();
  // hp pips
  const maxHp = 3+3; // approximate
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y - e.r - 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(-e.r, -4, e.r*2, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a4a';
  ctx.fillRect(-e.r, -4, e.r*2*(e.hp/6), 6);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, p.r*0.8, p.r*0.95, p.r*0.35, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
  ctx.rotate(p.angle);
  const rec = p.recoil * 6;
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3550';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-rec,0,p.r,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffcf6b'; ctx.stroke();
  // inner
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2238';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-rec,0,p.r*0.62,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  // hat
  ctx.fillStyle = '#11141f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-rec,0,p.r*0.5,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0c14';
  ctx.fillRect(-rec - p.r*0.5, -p.r*0.12, p.r*1.0, p.r*0.24);
  // gun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c0e16';
  ctx.fillRect(p.r*0.4 - rec, -4, p.r*0.9, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4258';
  ctx.fillRect(p.r*0.9 - rec, -3, p.r*0.5, 6);
  // muzzle flash
  if(p.muzzle > 0){
    const mx = p.r*1.4 - rec;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,207,107,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx,0);
    ctx.lineTo(mx+18, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(mx+12, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(mx+18, 8);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake > 0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
  }
  ctx.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);

  // enemies
  for(let i=0;i<enemies.length;i++) drawEnemy(enemies[i]);

  // player
  if(!state.over) drawPlayer();

  // bullets
  for(let i=0;i<bullets.length;i++){
    const b = bullets[i];
    const col = b.from === 'player' ? '#ffcf6b' : '#ff5a4a';
    ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = b.r; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x - b.vx*0.02, b.y - b.vy*0.02);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r*0.7,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=0;i<parts.length;i++){
    const p = parts[i];
    const a = Math.max(0, p.life/p.max);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.283); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // texts
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  for(let i=0;i<texts.length;i++){
    const t = texts[i];
    const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t.life/t.max));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.font = 'bold '+t.size+'px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillText(t.str, t.x+2, t.y+2);
    ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
    ctx.fillText(t.str, t.x, t.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.restore();

  // vignette
  ctx.drawImage(vign,0,0,W,H);

  // HUD
  ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(18,18,190,120);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf6b';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE', 30, 28);
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillText(String(state.score), 30, 52);
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9c2b2';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', 30, 104);
  for(let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    const hx = 90 + i*22, hy = 112;
    ctx.moveTo(hx, hy+4);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx, hy, hx-6, hy, hx-6, hy+4);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-6, hy+9, hx, hy+12, hx, hy+14);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx, hy+12, hx+6, hy+9, hx+6, hy+4);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+6, hy, hx, hy, hx, hy+4);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // timer
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9c2b2';
  ctx.fillText('TIME', W-20, 24);
  ctx.font = 'bold 30px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf6b';
  const mm = Math.floor(state.time/60), ss = Math.floor(state.time%60);
  ctx.fillText((mm<10?'0':'')+mm+':'+(ss<10?'0':'')+ss, W-20, 44);

  // dash cooldown
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.font = '13px Georgia, serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = dashCd > 0 ? '#6a6558' : '#8fd08f';
  ctx.fillText(dashCd > 0 ? 'dash: '+dashCd.toFixed(1)+'s' : 'dash: ready', 20, H-28);

  // game over
  if(state.over){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a4a';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H*0.42);
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf6b';
    ctx.fillText('Final score: '+state.score, W/2, H*0.52);
    ctx.font = '18px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c9c2b2';
    ctx.fillText('press R or click to run it back', W/2, H*0.58);
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000;
  last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  if(state.running) update(dt);
  draw();
  if(state.over){
    if(keys['r'] || mouse.down){
      // small guard so a single click doesn't instantly restart
      if(!loop._rearm){ loop._rearm = now; }
      else if(now - loop._rearm > 300){ reset(); loop._rearm = 0; }
    } else { loop._rearm = 0; }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---------- start ----------
resize();
reset();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
