<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Master of Orion</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  body { background: #04060f; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(90,140,255,0.35); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ===== canvas setup =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width = 960;
  const H = canvas.height = 600;

  // ===== constants =====
  const MAX_LIVES = 3;
  const WIN_KILLS = 20;
  const SPAWN_START = 1100;
  const SPAWN_MIN = 520;
  const SPAWN_DROP = 45;
  const SHIP_SPEED = 380;
  const BULLET_SPEED = 640;
  const FIRE_COOLDOWN = 200;

  // ===== state =====
  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let kills = 0;
  let lives = MAX_LIVES;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = SPAWN_START;
  let fireCooldown = 0;
  let ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 16, hit: 0 };
  let movers = [];
  let stars = [];
  let keys = {};

  // ===== stars (background) =====
  for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.3, tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
  }

  // ===== input =====
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'arrowup' || k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright') e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'start' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) startGame();
    else if (state === 'over' && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) resetGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state === 'over') resetGame();
  });

  function startGame() {
    state = 'play';
    score = 0;
    kills = 0;
    lives = MAX_LIVES;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = SPAWN_START;
    fireCooldown = 0;
    ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 16, hit: 0 };
    movers = [];
  }
  function resetGame() { state = 'start'; movers = []; }

  function addMover(m) { movers.push(m); }

  function spawnEnemy() {
    const x = 60 + Math.random() * (W - 120);
    addMover({
      type: 'enemy',
      x: x,
      y: -30,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 90,
      vy: 60 + Math.random() * 90,
      r: 16,
      hp: 1,
      wob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  function fire() {
    if (fireCooldown > 0) return;
    fireCooldown = FIRE_COOLDOWN;
    addMover({ type: 'bullet', x: ship.x, y: ship.y - ship.r, vx: 0, vy: -BULLET_SPEED, r: 5 });
  }

  function explode(x, y, color) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 60 + Math.random() * 180;
      addMover({ type: 'part', x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, r: 2 + Math.random() * 3, life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, color: color });
    }
  }

  // ===== update =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== 'play') return;

    // ship movement
    const ax = (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright'] ? 1 : 0) - (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft'] ? 1 : 0);
    const ay = (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown'] ? 1 : 0) - (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup'] ? 1 : 0);
    ship.vx = ax * SHIP_SPEED;
    ship.vy = ay * SHIP_SPEED;
    ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
    ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
    ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(W - ship.r, ship.x));
    ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(H - ship.r, ship.y));
    if (ship.hit > 0) ship.hit -= dt;

    if (keys[' '] || keys['j'] || keys['z']) fire();
    if (fireCooldown > 0) fireCooldown -= dt * 1000;

    // spawn enemies
    spawnTimer -= dt * 1000;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnEnemy();
      spawnInterval = Math.max(SPAWN_MIN, spawnInterval - SPAWN_DROP);
      spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
    }

    // move movers
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.type === 'enemy') {
        m.wob += dt * 3;
        m.x += (m.vx + Math.sin(m.wob) * 30) * dt;
        m.y += m.vy * dt;
      } else if (m.type === 'part') {
        m.x += m.vx * dt;
        m.y += m.vy * dt;
        m.vx *= 0.92;
        m.vy *= 0.92;
        m.life -= dt;
      } else {
        m.x += m.vx * dt;
        m.y += m.vy * dt;
      }
    }

    // collisions
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      if (m.type === 'bullet') {
        for (let j = movers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          const e = movers[j];
          if (e.type === 'enemy') {
            const dx = m.x - e.x, dy = m.y - e.y;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (m.r + e.r) * (m.r + e.r)) {
              e.hp -= 1;
              movers.splice(i, 1);
              if (e.hp <= 0) {
                movers.splice(j, 1);
                score += 100;
                kills += 1;
                explode(e.x, e.y, '#ff6a3c');
              } else {
                explode(m.x, m.y, '#ffd24a');
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'enemy') {
        const dx = m.x - ship.x, dy = m.y - ship.y;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (m.r + ship.r) * (m.r + ship.r)) {
          movers.splice(i, 1);
          explode(m.x, m.y, '#ff6a3c');
          lives -= 1;
          ship.hit = 0.5;
          if (lives <= 0) { state = 'over'; }
        }
      }
    }

    // remove finished movers
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      if (m.type === 'part') { if (m.life <= 0) movers.splice(i, 1); }
      else if (m.type === 'bullet') { if (m.y < -20 || m.y > H + 20 || m.x < -20 || m.x > W + 20) movers.splice(i, 1); }
      else if (m.type === 'enemy') { if (m.y > H + 40) movers.splice(i, 1); }
    }

    // win check
    if (kills >= WIN_KILLS) state = 'over';
  }

  // ===== draw helpers =====
  function drawShip() {
    const s = ship;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
    // glow
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, s.r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(90,180,255,0.18)';
    ctx.fill();
    // engine flame
    const flick = 6 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 40) * 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-6, s.r);
    ctx.lineTo(0, s.r + flick + 8);
    ctx.lineTo(6, s.r);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,150,50,0.9)';
    ctx.fill();
    // wings
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s.r, s.r * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(-s.r * 0.5, -s.r * 0.2);
    ctx.lineTo(s.r * 0.5, -s.r * 0.2);
    ctx.lineTo(s.r, s.r * 0.6);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3f74c9';
    ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -s.r * 1.4);
    ctx.lineTo(s.r * 0.55, s.r * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(-s.r * 0.55, s.r * 0.7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd0ff';
    ctx.fill();
    // cockpit
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -s.r * 0.1, s.r * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1830';
    ctx.fill();
    if (s.hit > 0) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, s.r + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,80,80,' + (s.hit * 1.5) + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    ctx.rotate(e.wob * 0.4);
    // body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, e.r);
    ctx.lineTo(e.r, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -e.r);
    ctx.lineTo(-e.r, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff8a5c';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    // eye
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, e.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullet(b) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2b0';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.35)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticle(p) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life * 2));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1030');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#070a20');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#03040c');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // nebula blobs
    const blobs = [
      { x: W * 0.25, y: H * 0.3, r: 200, c: 'rgba(120,60,180,0.10)' },
      { x: W * 0.75, y: H * 0.6, r: 240, c: 'rgba(40,120,200,0.10)' },
      { x: W * 0.55, y: H * 0.15, r: 160, c: 'rgba(200,80,120,0.08)' }
    ];
    for (const b of blobs) {

      rg.addColorStop(0, b.c);
      rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = rg;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x - b.r, b.y - b.r, b.r * 2, b.r * 2);
    }
    // stars
    const t = performance.now() / 1000;
    for (const s of stars) {
      const a = 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 2 + s.tw) * 0.4;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.15, a);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#dfeaff';
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,30,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 46);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#bcd6ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, 18, 24);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('KILLS  ' + kills + ' / ' + WIN_KILLS, W / 2, 24);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES  ', W - 90, 24);
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(W - 70 + i * 20, 24, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd0ff';
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function centerText(text, y, size, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + size + 'px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
  }

  function drawStart() {
    centerText('MASTER OF ORION', H * 0.34, 52, '#8fd0ff');
    centerText('Defend the ship. Destroy the invaders.', H * 0.46, 20, '#cdd8ff');
    centerText('Move  A D  (or arrows)      Fire  Space', H * 0.56, 18, '#9fb0d8');
    centerText('Destroy ' + WIN_KILLS + ' enemies to win. 3 lives.', H * 0.64, 18, '#9fb0d8');
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 300) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    centerText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  START', H * 0.78, 26, '#ffffff');
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,4,12,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const won = kills >= WIN_KILLS;
    centerText(won ? 'GALAXY SECURED' : 'SHIP DESTROYED', H * 0.38, 50, won ? '#7dffb0' : '#ff8a5c');
    centerText('Final Score: ' + score, H * 0.52, 26, '#cdd8ff');
    centerText('Kills: ' + kills, H * 0.6, 22, '#9fb0d8');
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 300) * 0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    centerText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  PLAY  AGAIN', H * 0.74, 24, '#ffffff');
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.type === 'enemy') drawEnemy(m);
      else if (m.type === 'bullet') drawBullet(m);
      else if (m.type === 'part') drawParticle(m);
    }
    if (state === 'play' || state === 'over') drawShip();
    if (state === 'play') drawHUD();
    if (state === 'start') drawStart();
    if (state === 'over') drawOver();
  }

  // ===== main loop =====
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {

    background: #05070f;

    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
  }

<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 900, H = 560;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  // ---------- State ----------
  let state = 'start';      // 'start' | 'playing' | 'over'
  let score = 0;
  let health = 100;
  let shake = 0;
  let muzzle = 0;           // muzzle flash timer
  let flash = 0;            // red damage flash timer
  let time = 0;
  let lastShot = 0;
  const HORIZON = 250;      // y of the horizon line
  const PLAYER_Y = 470;     // player gun baseline
  const PLAYER_X = W / 2;
  const MAX_BULLETS = 4;

  // ---------- Mover arrays (all movers live here) ----------
  let movers = [];          // {x, y, vx, vy, type, ...}
  let bullets = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let particles = [];

  // ---------- Player aim ----------
  let aimX = PLAYER_X;
  let aimY = HORIZON;
  let mouseDown = false;

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function toCanvas(e){
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), y: (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const p = toCanvas(e);
    aimX = p.x;
    aimY = Math.max(HORIZON - 40, Math.min(PLAYER_Y, p.y));
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'start') { state = 'playing'; return; }
    if (state === 'over') { reset(); state = 'playing'; return; }
    mouseDown = true;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouseDown = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = toCanvas(e.touches[0]);
    aimX = p.x; aimY = Math.max(HORIZON - 40, Math.min(PLAYER_Y, p.y));
    if (state === 'start') { state = 'playing'; return; }
    if (state === 'over') { reset(); state = 'playing'; return; }
    mouseDown = true;
  }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = toCanvas(e.touches[0]);
    aimX = p.x; aimY = Math.max(HORIZON - 40, Math.min(PLAYER_Y, p.y));
  }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { mouseDown = false; });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      if (state === 'start') state = 'playing';
      else if (state === 'over') { reset(); state = 'playing'; }
    }
  });

  // ---------- Reset ----------
  function reset(){
    score = 0; health = 100; shake = 0; muzzle = 0; flash = 0;
    movers = []; bullets = []; enemies = []; particles = [];
    spawnTimer = 1.2;
  }

  // ---------- Spawning ----------
  let spawnTimer = 1.2;
  function spawnEnemy(){
    // pick a lane (left/center/right) with slight jitter
    const lanes = [W*0.22, W*0.5, W*0.78];
    const lane = lanes[Math.floor(Math.random()*lanes.length)];
    const jx = (Math.random()-0.5)*120;
    const startX = lane + jx;
    // enemies come from the horizon and move down toward the player (vx,vy)
    const speed = 2.0 + Math.random()*2.2;
    const dirY = 1;
    const dirX = (PLAYER_X - startX) * 0.0006;
    const e = {
      x: startX, y: HORIZON + 4,
      vx: dirX * speed, vy: dirY * speed,
      type: 'enemy',
      size: 34,
      hp: 1,
      walk: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
      color: Math.random() < 0.5 ? '#c0392b' : '#8e44ad'
    };
    movers.push(e);
    enemies.push(e);
  }

  function spawnBullet(){
    const angle = Math.atan2(aimY - PLAYER_Y, aimX - PLAYER_X);
    const speed = 14;
    const b = {
      x: PLAYER_X, y: PLAYER_Y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle)*speed, vy: Math.sin(angle)*speed,
      type: 'bullet', life: 2
    };
    movers.push(b);
    bullets.push(b);
    muzzle = 0.06;
  }

  function spawnParticle(x, y, color){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const s = 1 + Math.random()*4;
    movers.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*s, vy: Math.sin(a)*s - 1,
      type: 'particle', life: 0.5 + Math.random()*0.5,
      color, size: 2 + Math.random()*3
    });
    particles.push(movers[movers.length-1]);
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt){
    time += dt;
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // spawn enemies
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0){
      spawnEnemy();
      const interval = Math.max(0.45, 1.4 - score*0.01);
      spawnTimer = interval;
    }

    // shooting
    if (mouseDown && time - lastShot > 0.14){
      if (bullets.length < MAX_BULLETS) { spawnBullet(); lastShot = time; }
    }

    // move every mover in one pass
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt * 60;
      m.y += m.vy * dt * 60;

      if (m.type === 'enemy'){
        m.walk += dt * 8;
        // reached player -> damage
        if (m.y >= PLAYER_Y - 6){
          health -= 18;
          flash = 0.25;
          shake = 10;
          removeMover(i);
          continue;
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'bullet'){
        m.life -= dt;
        if (m.life <= 0 || m.y < HORIZON - 30){ removeMover(i); continue; }
        // hit test vs enemies
        for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--){
          const e = enemies[j];
          if (Math.abs(m.x - e.x) < e.size*0.7 && Math.abs(m.y - e.y) < e.size*0.7){
            e.hp -= 1;
            if (e.hp <= 0){
              score += 10;
              for (let k=0;k<10;k++) spawnParticle(e.x, e.y, '#ff5533');
              shake = 5;
              removeMover(i);
              removeEnemy(j);
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'particle'){
        m.vy += 0.3;
        m.life -= dt;
        if (m.life <= 0){ removeMover(i); }
      }
    }

    // timers
    if (muzzle > 0) muzzle -= dt;
    if (flash > 0) flash -= dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt*40);

    // lose condition
    if (health <= 0){ health = 0; state = 'over'; }
  }

  function removeMover(i){
    const m = movers[i];
    movers.splice(i,1);
    if (m.type === 'bullet') bullets.splice(bullets.indexOf(m),1);
    if (m.type === 'enemy') enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(m),1);
    if (m.type === 'particle') particles.splice(particles.indexOf(m),1);
  }
  function removeEnemy(j){ enemies.splice(j,1); }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0){
      ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawStreet();

    // draw enemies (sorted by y so nearer ones on top)
    const sorted = enemies.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y);
    for (const e of sorted) drawEnemy(e);

    // draw particles
    for (const p of particles) drawParticle(p);

    // draw bullets
    for (const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);

    drawPlayer();

    if (flash > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,' + (flash*0.6) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }

    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if (state === 'start') drawStart();
    if (state === 'over') drawOver();
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    // sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,HORIZON);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#0b1026');
    g.addColorStop(0.55,'#20123a');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#7a2d5a');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,HORIZON);

    // sun / neon glow
    const sx = W*0.5, sy = HORIZON - 30;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,5,sx,sy,120);
    rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,150,90,0.9)');
    rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,150,90,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,HORIZON);

    // distant city skyline (simple rects)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#120a24';
    const buildings = [
      [0,120,70],[70,90,55],[125,150,60],[185,110,45],
      [230,170,70],[300,100,50],[350,140,55],[405,90,40],
      [445,160,65],[510,120,50],[560,180,70],[630,100,45],
      [675,150,60],[735,110,50],[785,170,65],[850,120,50]
    ];
    for (const b of buildings){
      const h = b[1], w = b[2], x = b[0];
      ctx.fillRect(x, HORIZON - h, w, h);
      // lit windows
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,120,0.5)';
      for (let wy = HORIZON - h + 8; wy < HORIZON - 8; wy += 14){
        for (let wx = x + 6; wx < x + w - 6; wx += 12){
          if ((wx + wy) % 3 === 0) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 4, 5);
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#120a24';
    }
  }

  function drawStreet(){
    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,HORIZON,0,H);
    gg.addColorStop(0,'#1a1626');
    gg.addColorStop(1,'#0a0812');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,HORIZON,W,H-HORIZON);

    // converging road lines (perspective)
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    const cx = W/2;
    for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i++){
      const xTop = cx + i*30;
      const xBot = cx + i*140;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xTop, HORIZON);
      ctx.lineTo(xBot, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // horizontal speed lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
    for (let y = HORIZON+20; y < H; y += 40){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    const s = e.size;
    const bob = Math.sin(e.walk)*3;
    const y = e.y + bob;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, y);
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, s*0.55, s*0.5, s*0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.fillRect(-s*0.32, -s*0.1, s*0.64, s*0.6);
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c9a0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -s*0.35, s*0.22, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // angry eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(-s*0.14, -s*0.4, s*0.08, s*0.05);
    ctx.fillRect(s*0.06, -s*0.4, s*0.08, s*0.05);
    // legs (walking)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const l1 = Math.sin(e.walk)*s*0.18;
    const l2 = Math.cos(e.walk)*s*0.18;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s*0.12, s*0.5); ctx.lineTo(-s*0.12 + l1, s*0.85);
    ctx.moveTo(s*0.12, s*0.5); ctx.lineTo(s*0.12 + l2, s*0.85);
    ctx.stroke();
    // gun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
    ctx.fillRect(-s*0.05, s*0.05, s*0.35, s*0.08);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullet(b){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffcc00';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticle(p){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life*2));
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size/2, p.y - p.size/2, p.size, p.size);
    ctx.restore();
  }

    // first-person arms + gun
    ctx.save();
    const gy = PLAYER_Y;
    // left arm
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3a55';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(PLAYER_X - 90, H);

    ctx.lineTo(PLAYER_X - 5, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(PLAYER_X - 70, H);

    ctx.fill();
    // right arm
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(PLAYER_X + 90, H);
    ctx.lineTo(PLAYER_X + 30, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(PLAYER_X + 5, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(PLAYER_X + 70, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // hands
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8c9a0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(PLAYER_X - 18, gy - 4, 9, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(PLAYER_X + 18, gy - 4, 9, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // gun body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(PLAYER_X - 26, gy - 14, 52, 22);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(PLAYER_X - 20, gy - 20, 40, 8);
    // barrel
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
    ctx.fillRect(PLAYER_X - 5, gy - 18, 10, 30);
    // muzzle flash
    if (muzzle > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,230,120,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(PLAYER_X, gy - 20, 14, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(12, 12, 200, 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00e5ff';

    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 24, 32);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(String(score), 24, 62);
    // health bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(W-212, 12, 200, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00e5ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('HEALTH', W-200, 26);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(W-200, 32, 176, 14);
    const hpw = 176 * (health/100);
    const hcol = health > 50 ? '#2ecc71' : (health > 25 ? '#f1c40f' : '#e74c3c');
    ctx.fillStyle = hcol;
    ctx.fillRect(W-200, 32, hpw, 14);
  }

  function drawStart(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00e5ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('VIRTUA COP', W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5533';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('SHOOT THE INCOMING HOSTILES', W/2, H/2 + 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('MOVE MOUSE TO AIM  •  CLICK / HOLD TO FIRE', W/2, H/2 + 36);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('CLICK TO START', W/2, H/2 + 72);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  function drawOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
    ctx.font = 'bold 56px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('MISSION FAILED', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';

    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('CLICK TO RESTART', W/2, H/2 + 56);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const PIVOT_X = W / 2;
  const PIVOT_Y = 150;
  const GRAVITY = 1400;
  const BEAM_HALF = 230;
  const CATCH_HALF = 22;
  const MAX_TILT = 0.42;
  const WIN_SCORE = 5;
  const MAX_PARTICLES = 400;

  // ---------- State ----------
  let state = 'start';
  let beamAngle = 0;
  let beamVel = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let combo = 0;
  let maxCombo = 0;
  let lastCatchTime = 0;
  let pointerX = W / 2;
  let pointerY = H * 0.6;
  let power = 0;
  let chargeDir = 1;
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;
  let flashColor = '255,255,255';
  let lastTime = 0;
  let time = 0;

  // ---------- Arrays (created before any loop reads them) ----------
  let movers = [];
  let particles = [];
  let stars = [];
  let floaters = [];
  let shots = [];

  // ---------- Helper: clamp ----------
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }

  // ---------- Build the starfield background ----------
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.4,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      sp: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5
    });
  }

  // ---------- Launch a ball from the beam tip ----------
  function launchBall() {
    const tipX = PIVOT_X + Math.sin(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;
    const tipY = PIVOT_Y + Math.cos(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;
    const tx = pointerX - tipX;
    const ty = pointerY - tipY;
    const d = Math.hypot(tx, ty) || 1;
    const speed = 220 + power * 560;
    movers.push({
      x: tipX,
      y: tipY,
      vx: (tx / d) * speed,
      vy: (ty / d) * speed,
      r: 9,
      hue: 180 + Math.random() * 120,
      spin: 0,
      life: 12,
      kind: 'ball',
      trail: []
    });
    power = 0;
    chargeDir = 1;
    // muzzle flash
    flash = 0.5;
    flashColor = '120,200,255';
  }

  // ---------- Spawn catch particles ----------
  function spawnBurst(x, y, hue, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 60 + Math.random() * 260;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40,
        r: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        hue: hue,
        life: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        max: 1.1
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Floating score text ----------
  function addFloater(x, y, text, color) {
    floaters.push({ x: x, y: y, text: text, color: color, life: 1.1 });
  }

  // ---------- Reset for a new run ----------
  function startGame() {
    movers = [];
    particles = [];
    floaters = [];
    shots = [];
    score = 0;
    combo = 0;
    maxCombo = 0;
    beamAngle = 0;
    beamVel = 0;
    power = 0;
    chargeDir = 1;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
    state = 'play';
  }

  // ---------- Input: pointer (mouse + touch) ----------
  function toCanvas(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX);
    const cy = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY);
    return {
      x: (cx - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
      y: (cy - rect.top) * (H / rect.height)
    };
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    const p = toCanvas(e);
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerY = p.y;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    const p = toCanvas(e);
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerY = p.y;
    if (state === 'play') {
      launchBall();
    } else if (state === 'start') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === 'over') {
      startGame();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = toCanvas(e);
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerY = p.y;
    if (state === 'play') {
      launchBall();
    } else if (state === 'start') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === 'over') {
      startGame();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const p = toCanvas(e);
    pointerX = p.x;
    pointerY = p.y;
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      if (state === 'play') launchBall();
      else if (state === 'start') startGame();
      else if (state === 'over') startGame();
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;

    // power oscillation (only while playing)
    if (state === 'play') {
      power += chargeDir * dt * 1.4;
      if (power > 1) { power = 1; chargeDir = -1; }
      if (power < 0) { power = 0; chargeDir = 1; }
    }

    // decay effects
    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 3);
    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2.2);

    // ---- Move movers, apply gravity, handle catch ----
    const catchY = H * 0.72;
    const beamTipX = PIVOT_X + Math.sin(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;
    const beamTipY = PIVOT_Y + Math.cos(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;

    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.spin += dt * (m.vx > 0 ? 6 : -6);
      m.life -= dt;

      // trail
      m.trail.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y });
      if (m.trail.length > 10) m.trail.shift();

      // catch: near the beam tip
      const dx = m.x - beamTipX;
      const dy = m.y - beamTipY;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist < (CATCH_HALF + m.r) && m.vy > 0) {
        // caught!
        const offset = clamp(dx / BEAM_HALF, -1, 1);
        beamVel += offset * 3.2;
        const now = time;
        if (now - lastCatchTime < 1.4) {
          combo += 1;
        } else {
          combo = 1;
        }
        lastCatchTime = now;
        maxCombo = Math.max(maxCombo, combo);
        const gained = combo;
        score += gained;
        addFloater(m.x, m.y - 20, '+' + gained, '120,230,255');
        spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, m.hue, 24);
        shake = Math.min(shake + 0.4, 1.2);
        flash = Math.max(flash, 0.35);
        flashColor = '120,220,255';
        movers.splice(i, 1);
        if (score >= WIN_SCORE) {
          state = 'over';
        }
        continue;
      }

      // drop if it leaves the screen or expires
      if (m.y > H + 60 || m.x < -60 || m.x > W + 60 || m.life <= 0) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // ---- Beam physics: gravity torque from off-center weight, spring to center, damping ----
    if (state === 'play' || state === 'over') {
      // torque from the beam's own tilt (pendulum-ish) plus damping
      const gravityTorque = Math.sin(beamAngle) * 1.6;
      const spring = -beamAngle * 4.0;
      const damping = -beamVel * 2.2;
      beamVel += (gravityTorque + spring + damping) * dt;
      beamAngle += beamVel * dt;
      beamAngle = clamp(beamAngle, -MAX_TILT, MAX_TILT);
    }

    // ---- Particles ----
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.vy += GRAVITY * 0.35 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
    if (particles.length > MAX_PARTICLES) {
      particles.splice(0, particles.length - MAX_PARTICLES);
    }

    // ---- Floaters ----
    for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = floaters[i];
      f.y -= dt * 40;
      f.life -= dt;
      if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // ---- Star twinkle ----
    for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      stars[i].tw += dt * stars[i].sp;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: background ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0f24');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#101a3a');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#05070f');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // nebula glow
    const n1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.25, H * 0.3, 0, W * 0.25, H * 0.3, 260);
    n1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,70,200,0.25)');
    n1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,70,200,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = n1;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const n2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.78, H * 0.6, 0, W * 0.78, H * 0.6, 300);
    n2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,140,180,0.22)');
    n2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40,140,180,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = n2;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      const s = stars[i];
      const a = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(2) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: the beam (the "Power") ----------
  function drawBeam() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(PIVOT_X, PIVOT_Y);
    ctx.rotate(beamAngle);

    // beam body
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-BEAM_HALF, 0, BEAM_HALF, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#2a4d8f');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#5f8fe0');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#2a4d8f');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,200,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(-BEAM_HALF, -7, BEAM_HALF * 2, 14, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // beam glow
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,180,255,0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,180,255,0.25)';
    roundRect(-BEAM_HALF, -11, BEAM_HALF * 2, 22, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // tip node (catch point)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(BEAM_HALF, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(BEAM_HALF, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();

    // pivot hub
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(PIVOT_X, PIVOT_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2540';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,200,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5f8fe0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: movers (balls) ----------
  function drawMovers() {
    for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
      const m = movers[i];
      // trail
      for (let t = 0; t < m.trail.length; t++) {
        const tr = m.trail[t];
        const a = (t / m.trail.length) * 0.35;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + m.hue + ',80%,65%,' + a.toFixed(2) + ')';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y, m.r * (0.3 + t / m.trail.length * 0.7), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // ball
      const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x - m.r * 0.3, m.y - m.r * 0.3, 1, m.x, m.y, m.r);
      bg.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',90%,80%)');
      bg.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',70%,45%)');
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x - m.r * 0.3, m.y - m.r * 0.35, m.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: particles ----------
  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      const a = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + p.hue + ',90%,65%,' + a.toFixed(2) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: floaters ----------
  function drawFloaters() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    for (let i = 0; i < floaters.length; i++) {
      const f = floaters[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + f.color + ',' + clamp(f.life, 0, 1).toFixed(2) + ')';
      ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw: reticle / aim ----------
  function drawReticle() {
    if (state !== 'play') return;
    const tipX = PIVOT_X + Math.sin(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;
    const tipY = PIVOT_Y + Math.cos(beamAngle) * BEAM_HALF;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,200,255,0.25)';
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
    ctx.lineTo(pointerX, pointerY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // power ring at pointer
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pointerX, pointerY, 14 + power * 12, 0, Math.PI * 2 * power);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ---------- Draw: HUD ----------
  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,225,255,0.9)';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score + ' / ' + WIN_SCORE, 24, 40);

    if (combo > 1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.95)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + combo, 24, 68);
    }

    // power meter
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,225,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('POWER', W - 190, 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 190, 40, 166, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.9)';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 190, 40, 166 * power, 10);
  }

  // ---------- Draw: overlays (start / game over) ----------
  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state === 'play') return;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,7,15,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (state === 'start') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8fc4ff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 52px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('BALANCE OF POWER', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,235,255,0.85)';
      ctx.font = '20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Aim with your pointer, click to fire orbs at the beam tip.', W / 2, H / 2 + 8);
      ctx.fillText('Keep the beam balanced. Reach ' + WIN_SCORE + ' to win!', W / 2, H / 2 + 36);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.95)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('— CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO START —', W / 2, H / 2 + 84);
    } else if (state === 'over') {
      const won = score >= WIN_SCORE;
      ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#9dffb0' : '#ff9d9d';
      ctx.font = 'bold 52px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(won ? 'BALANCE ACHIEVED' : 'GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,235,255,0.9)';
      ctx.font = '22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 12);
      ctx.fillText('Best Combo: x' + maxCombo, W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.95)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('— CLICK OR PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN —', W / 2, H / 2 + 96);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Rounded rectangle helper ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- Master draw ----------
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    // screen shake
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 8, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 8);
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawBeam();
    drawMovers();
    drawParticles();
    drawFloaters();
    drawReticle();
    drawHUD();
    ctx.restore();

    // flash
    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + flashColor + ',' + (flash * 0.4).toFixed(2) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  function loop(ts) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = ts;
    let dt = (ts - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = ts;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

    } else {
      a = randInt(10, 25); b = randInt(2, 9); ans = a - b;

    ctx.font = "22px 'Courier New', monospace";

    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fe8ff";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";

  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawMovers();
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();
    if (state === "play") drawQuestion();
    if (state === "start") drawStart();
    if (state === "over") drawOver();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function frame(t) {
    if (!last) last = t;
    let dt = (t - last) / 1000;
    last = t;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();

  }

  function applyPhysics(m, dt) {
    m.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
    m.x += m.vx * dt;
    m.y += m.vy * dt;
    m.onGround = false;

    // ground
    if (m.y + m.h >= GROUND_Y) {
      m.y = GROUND_Y - m.h;
      m.vy = 0;
      m.onGround = true;
    }
    // platforms
    for (var i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
      var p = platforms[i];
      if (m.vy > 0 &&
          m.x + m.w > p.x && m.x < p.x + p.w &&
          m.y + m.h > p.y && m.y + m.h < p.y + p.h + m.vy * dt + 4) {
        m.y = p.y - m.h;
        m.vy = 0;
        m.onGround = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== "playing") return;

    elapsed += dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);

    // player input
    var left = keys["a"] || keys["arrowleft"];
    var right = keys["d"] || keys["arrowright"];
    if (left) { player.vx = -RUN_SPEED; player.facing = -1; }
    else if (right) { player.vx = RUN_SPEED; player.facing = 1; }
    else { player.vx = 0; }

    if (jumpQueued && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = JUMP_VY;
      player.onGround = false;
    }
    jumpQueued = false;

    if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln -= dt;

    applyPhysics(player, dt);

    // keep player in bounds horizontally
    if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
    if (player.x + player.w > W) player.x = W - player.w;

    // spawn enemies
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      if (movers.length < MAX_ENEMIES) spawnEnemy();
      spawnTimer = SPAWN_COOLDOWN;
    }

    // move all movers, drop the done ones
    for (var i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var m = movers[i];
      applyPhysics(m, dt);
      m.life += dt;

      // off-screen horizontally -> done
      if (m.x + m.w < -60 || m.x > W + 60) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      // collision with player
      if (player.invuln <= 0 && rectOverlap(player, m)) {
        state = "lose";
        shake = 12;
        return;
      }
    }

    // coins
    for (var c = coins.length - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
      var coin = coins[c];
      var dx = (player.x + player.w / 2) - coin.x;
      var dy = (player.y + player.h / 2) - coin.y;
      if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < 34) {
        score += 100;
        coins.splice(c, 1);
      }
    }

    // passive score for surviving
    score += Math.floor(dt * 5);

    if (score >= WIN_SCORE) {
      state = "win";
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawSky() {
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0a1428");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#16243f");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#2a3550");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4e6b8";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.82, H * 0.16, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d9c78f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.82 + 14, H * 0.16 + 8, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // stars
    for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
      var st = stars[i];
      st.tw += 0.05;
      var a = 0.4 + Math.sin(st.tw) * 0.3;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(st.x, st.y, st.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBuildings() {
    for (var i = 0; i < buildings.length; i++) {
      var b = buildings[i];
      var top = GROUND_Y - b.h;
      ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(" + b.hue + ", 30%, 22%)";
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, top, b.w, b.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(" + b.hue + ", 30%, 15%)";
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, top, b.w, 8);
      // windows
      ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(45, 80%, 65%)";
      for (var wy = top + 22; wy < GROUND_Y - 14; wy += 34) {
        for (var wx = b.x + 12; wx < b.x + b.w - 14; wx += 30) {
          if ((Math.floor(wx) + Math.floor(wy)) % 3 === 0) {
            ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 14, 18);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function drawGround() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1c2740";
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2b3a5c";
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, 6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#101a2e";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (var x = 0; x < W; x += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y + 6);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 30, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPlatforms() {
    for (var i = 0; i < platforms.length; i++) {
      var p = platforms[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4a6e";
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#556a94";
      ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 5);
    }
  }

  function drawCoins() {
    for (var i = 0; i < coins.length; i++) {
      var c = coins[i];
      var bob = Math.sin(elapsed * 4 + i) * 3;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f2c14e";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(c.x, c.y + bob, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(c.x - 3, c.y + bob - 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#a9771f";
      ctx.font = "bold 12px Courier New";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("$", c.x, c.y + bob + 4);
    }
  }

  function drawSpy(m, isPlayer) {
    var x = m.x, y = m.y, w = m.w, h = m.h;
    var f = m.facing || 1;
    var flash = (isPlayer && m.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(m.invuln * 12) % 2 === 0);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + w / 2, GROUND_Y - 2, w * 0.5, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    if (flash) return;

    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#10131a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    var step = Math.sin(elapsed * 12) * (Math.abs(m.vx) > 10 ? 8 : 0);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.35, y + h * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.35 + step, y + h);
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.65, y + h * 0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.65 - step, y + h);
    ctx.stroke();

    // coat / body
    ctx.fillStyle = isPlayer ? "#1b2436" : "#2a1b1b";
    ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * 0.28, w, h * 0.36);

    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = isPlayer ? "#1b2436" : "#2a1b1b";
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.4);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.5 + f * 10, y + h * 0.55);
    ctx.stroke();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e8c39e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.18, w * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // fedora
    ctx.fillStyle = isPlayer ? "#0e1320" : "#1a0f0f";
    ctx.fillRect(x + w * 0.12, y + h * 0.02, w * 0.76, h * 0.08);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.05, w * 0.34, h * 0.05, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // sunglasses
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
    ctx.fillRect(x + w * 0.28, y + h * 0.14, w * 0.44, h * 0.05);

    // tie
    ctx.fillStyle = isPlayer ? "#3a7bd5" : "#c0392b";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.42, y + h * 0.55);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.58, y + h * 0.55);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,12,22,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 54);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f2c14e";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px Courier New";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, 18, 34);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#8fd0ff";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("GOAL  " + WIN_SCORE, W - 18, 34);

    // progress bar
    var bw = 240, bx = W / 2 - bw / 2, by = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#20304a";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a7bd5";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw * Math.min(1, score / WIN_SCORE), 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#556a94";
    ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, 12);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,8,15,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 52px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cdd6e6";
    ctx.font = "20px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f2c14e";
    ctx.font = "16px Courier New";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE / ENTER  TO  START", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }
    drawSky();
    drawBuildings();
    drawGround();
    drawPlatforms();
    drawCoins();

    for (var i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
      drawSpy(movers[i], false);
    }
    drawSpy(player, true);

    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") {
      drawOverlay("SPY vs SPY", "ROOFTOP CHASE  —  don't get caught", "#3a7bd5");
    } else if (state === "win") {
      drawOverlay("MISSION COMPLETE", "you escaped with  " + score + "  points", "#5fd08a");
    } else if (state === "lose") {
      drawOverlay("CAUGHT!", "score  " + score + "  —  the other spy got you", "#e05548");
    }
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(now) {
    var dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- boot ----------
  buildLevel();
  resetPlayer();
  requestAnimationFrame(function (t) {
    lastTime = t;
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>MDK</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#07121c;overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
  #c{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 900, H = 560;
let dpr = 1, scale = 1, ox = 0, oy = 0;
function resize(){
  dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = window.innerWidth + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = window.innerHeight + 'px';
  scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H);
  ox = (window.innerWidth - W * scale) / 2;
  oy = (window.innerHeight - H * scale) / 2;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- State ----------
const state = { mode:'start', score:0, best:0, level:1, shake:0, msg:'', msgT:0 };
const player = { x:0, y:0, vx:0, vy:0, r:12, dead:false };
const movers = [];
const keys = { left:false, right:false, up:false, down:false };

function resetPlayer(){
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H - 70; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0; player.dead = false;
}
function clearMovers(){ movers.length = 0; }
function level1(){
  resetPlayer(); clearMovers();
  const y = H - 150;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++) movers.push({ x: 120 + i*160, y: y, vx:0, vy:0, r:22, type:'block', phase:i*0.9, done:false });
  movers.push({ x: W/2, y: H - 300, vx:0, vy:0, r:15, type:'goal', done:false });
}
function startGame(){
  state.mode='play'; state.score=0; state.level=1; state.shake=0;
  level1();
}
function nextLevel(){
  state.level++; state.shake=0;
  const y = H - 150;
  resetPlayer(); clearMovers();
  const n = 5 + state.level;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const x = 90 + i * ((W-180)/Math.max(1,n-1));
    movers.push({ x, y, vx:0, vy:0, r:22, type:'block', phase:i*0.9, done:false });
  }
  movers.push({ x: W/2, y: H - 320, vx:0, vy:0, r:15, type:'goal', done:false });
}
function win(){
  state.mode='win';
  if(state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
}
function die(){
  player.dead = true;
  state.mode='over';
  if(state.score > state.best) state.best = state.score;
  state.shake = 14;
}

// ---------- Input ----------
function setKey(e, on){
  const k = e.key;
  if(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='a'||k==='A') keys.left = on;
  else if(k==='ArrowRight'||k==='d'||k==='D') keys.right = on;
  else if(k==='ArrowUp'||k==='w'||k==='W'||k===' ') keys.up = on;
  else if(k==='ArrowDown'||k==='s'||k==='S') keys.down = on;
}
function press(e){
  const k = e.key;
  if(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='a'||k==='A'||k==='ArrowRight'||k==='d'||k==='D'||k==='ArrowUp'||k==='w'||k==='W'||k==='ArrowDown'||k==='s'||k==='S'||k===' ') e.preventDefault();
  setKey(e, true);
  if(state.mode==='start' && (k==='Enter'||k===' ')) startGame();
  else if(state.mode==='over' && (k==='Enter'||k===' '||k==='r'||k==='R')) startGame();
  else if(state.mode==='win' && (k==='Enter'||k===' '||k==='r'||k==='R')) startGame();
}
function release(e){ setKey(e, false); }
window.addEventListener('keydown', press);
window.addEventListener('keyup', release);

let touch = { left:false, right:false, up:false };
function handlePointer(e, on){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = (e.clientX - rect.left - ox) / scale;
  const sy = (e.clientY - rect.top - oy) / scale;
  if(on){
    if(sy > H*0.55){
      touch.left = sx < W/2;
      touch.right = sx >= W/2;
      touch.up = false;
    } else {
      touch.left = false; touch.right = false; touch.up = true;
    }
    if(state.mode==='start') startGame();
    else if(state.mode==='over') startGame();
    else if(state.mode==='win') startGame();
  } else {
    touch.left = false; touch.right = false; touch.up = false;
  }
}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); handlePointer(e, true); });
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { if(e.buttons) handlePointer(e, true); });
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', e => handlePointer(e, false));
canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', e => handlePointer(e, false));

// ---------- Update ----------
function update(dt){
  const left = keys.left || touch.left;
  const right = keys.right || touch.right;
  const up = keys.up || touch.up;
  const down = keys.down;

  const accel = 1500, maxv = 240, fric = 220;
  if(left){ player.vx -= accel*dt; }
  if(right){ player.vx += accel*dt; }
  if(!left && !right){
    if(player.vx > 0) player.vx = Math.max(0, player.vx - fric*dt);
    else if(player.vx < 0) player.vx = Math.min(0, player.vx + fric*dt);
  }
  player.vx = Math.max(-maxv, Math.min(maxv, player.vx));

  const g = 1400, jump = -580;
  player.vy += g*dt;
  if(up && player.y > H - 80){ player.vy = jump; }
  if(down && player.vy > 0){ player.vy += 900*dt; }

  player.x += player.vx*dt;
  player.y += player.vy*dt;

  if(player.x < player.r){ player.x = player.r; player.vx = 0; }
  if(player.x > W - player.r){ player.x = W - player.r; player.vx = 0; }
  if(player.y < player.r){ player.y = player.r; player.vy = 0; }

  const groundY = H - 40;
  if(player.y > groundY - player.r){ player.y = groundY - player.r; player.vy = 0; }

  // Movers
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.type==='block'){
      m.y = (H - 150) + Math.sin(performance.now()/500 + m.phase)*22;
      const dx = player.x - m.x;
      const dy = player.y - m.y;
      if(dx*dx + dy*dy < 22000){
        if(dy < -8){ player.y = m.y - 22 - player.r; player.vy = 0; }
        else if(dy > 8){ player.y = m.y + 22 + player.r; player.vy = Math.max(0, player.vy); }
        else {
          player.x += (dx < 0 ? -1 : 1)*10;
          player.vx = (dx < 0 ? -1 : 1)*120;
        }
      }
    } else if(m.type==='goal'){
      const dx = player.x - m.x;
      const dy = player.y - m.y;
      if(dx*dx + dy*dy < 2300){
        state.score += 100;
        state.msg = 'GATE CLEARED  +100';
        state.msgT = 1.4;
        nextLevel();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  if(player.y > H + 60) die();
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1a2b');
  g.addColorStop(0.55,'#123049');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#1c4a5e');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;

  ctx.fillStyle='#333';ctx.fillRect(W-250,20,232,18);
  var hc=health>50?'#39d353':(health>25?'#ffd23a':'#ff2e63');
  ctx.fillStyle=hc;ctx.fillRect(W-250,20,232*(health/100),18);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(W-250,20,232,18);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='bold 11px Arial';ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('HP',W-20,34);
}
function overlay(title,sub,btn){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,6,15,0.72)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a';ctx.font='bold 56px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(title,W/2,H/2-40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(sub,W/2,H/2+4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#39d353';ctx.font='bold 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(btn,W/2,H/2+46);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*shake,(Math.random()*2-1)*shake);
  drawBg();
  drawArena();
  drawMovers();
  if(state!=='over')drawPlayer();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==='start')overlay('WWF WAR ZONE','Grab stars, dodge the bolts. Don\'t let the enemies touch you!','[ PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START ]');
  else if(state==='over')overlay('GAME OVER','Final score: '+score+'   Best: '+hi,'[ PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO RETRY ]');
}

function loop(t){
  if(!last)last=t;
  var dt=(t-last)/1000;
  last=t;
  if(dt>0.05)dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Hobbit — A Journey to the Lonely Mountain</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #1a2438 0%, #05080f 100%);
    font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #game {
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 120px rgba(60,90,140,0.25);
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: crosshair;
    display: block;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
  const W = 900, H = 560;
  const GROUND_Y = 452;
  const GRAVITY = 0.5;
  const WIN_X = 26000;
  const PLAYER_H = 54;
  const PLAYER_W = 30;
  const MAX_VX = 5.5;
  const MAX_VY = 13;
  const JUMP_V = -12;
  const START_X = 120;

  // ---------- CANVAS ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  let state = "title";
  let score = 0;
  let time = 0;
  let camX = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let player = null;
  let movers = [];
  let hills = [];
  let clouds = [];
  let stars = [];
  let keys = { left: false, right: false, up: false };

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function dist2(ax, ay, bx, by) { const dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return dx * dx + dy * dy; }

  // ---------- LEVEL (built with short loops, no long strings) ----------
  function makeHills() {
    const arr = [];
    for (let x = -200; x < WIN_X + 1000; x += 220) {
      arr.push({ x: x, w: rand(160, 300), h: rand(60, 150), tone: rand(0, 1) });
    }
    return arr;
  }
  function makeClouds() {
    const arr = [];
    for (let x = -200; x < WIN_X + 800; x += rand(260, 460)) {
      arr.push({ x: x, y: rand(40, 150), s: rand(0.7, 1.4), spd: rand(0.15, 0.5) });
    }
    return arr;
  }
  function makeStars() {
    const arr = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) arr.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H * 0.55, r: rand(0.5, 1.6), tw: rand(0, Math.PI * 2) });
    return arr;
  }
  function makeMovers() {
    const arr = [];
    // Gold piles
    for (let x = 1400; x < WIN_X; x += 1100) {
      arr.push({ type: "gold", x: x, y: GROUND_Y - 24, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 20, done: false, seed: Math.random() });
    }
    // Gold near the mountain
    for (let x = WIN_X - 900; x < WIN_X - 100; x += 120) {
      arr.push({ type: "gold", x: x, y: GROUND_Y - 24, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 20, done: false, seed: Math.random() });
    }
    // Balrogs
    for (let x = 2600; x < WIN_X; x += 3400) {
      arr.push({ type: "balrog", x: x, y: GROUND_Y - 30, vx: -1.4, vy: 0, w: 70, h: 96, done: false, t: Math.random() * 10 });
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function reset() {
    player = {
      x: START_X, y: GROUND_Y - PLAYER_H,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      onGround: false,
      facing: 1,
      walk: 0,
      dead: false
    };
    movers = makeMovers();
    score = 0;
    time = 0;
    shake = 0;
    camX = 0;
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  function onKey(e, down) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === "a" || k === "arrowleft") { keys.left = down; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === "d" || k === "arrowright") { keys.right = down; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (k === "w" || k === "arrowup" || k === " ") { keys.up = down; e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (down && (k === "enter" || k === "r")) {
      if (state === "title") { state = "playing"; }
      else if (state === "won" || state === "lost") { reset(); state = "playing"; }
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { onKey(e, true); });
  document.addEventListener("keyup", function (e) { onKey(e, false); });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", function () {
    if (state === "title") state = "playing";
    else if (state === "won" || state === "lost") { reset(); state = "playing"; }
  });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update() {
    time += 1;
    if (state !== "playing") return;

    // Player horizontal
    const ax = (keys.right ? 0.9 : 0) - (keys.left ? 0.9 : 0);
    player.vx += ax;
    if (ax === 0) player.vx *= 0.82;
    player.vx = clamp(player.vx, -MAX_VX, MAX_VX);
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.3) player.facing = player.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;

    // Jump
    if (keys.up && player.onGround) { player.vy = JUMP_V; player.onGround = false; }

    // Gravity + integrate
    player.vy += GRAVITY;
    player.vy = clamp(player.vy, -MAX_VY, MAX_VY);
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;
    if (player.x < 40) { player.x = 40; player.vx = 0; }

    // Ground
    if (player.y + PLAYER_H >= GROUND_Y) {
      player.y = GROUND_Y - PLAYER_H;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
      player.walk += Math.abs(player.vx) * 0.12;
    } else {
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    // Camera
    const target = player.x - W * 0.38;
    camX += (target - camX) * 0.12;
    if (camX < 0) camX = 0;

    // Movers
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      if (m.type === "balrog") {
        m.t += 0.08;
        m.y = GROUND_Y - m.h + Math.sin(m.t) * 6;
        // bounce at edges of its roaming band
        if (m.x < m.x - 900) m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx);
        if (m.x > m.x + 900) m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx);
      }
      // Gold pickup
      if (m.type === "gold" && !m.done) {
        if (dist2(player.x + PLAYER_W / 2, player.y + PLAYER_H / 2, m.x, m.y) < 45 * 45) {
          m.done = true;
          score += 10;
        }
      }
      // Balrog collision
      if (m.type === "balrog" && !m.done && !player.dead) {
        const px = player.x + PLAYER_W / 2, py = player.y + PLAYER_H / 2;
        const cx = clamp(px, m.x, m.x + m.w);
        const cy = clamp(py, m.y, m.y + m.h);
        if (dist2(px, py, cx, cy) < 26 * 26) {
          player.dead = true;
          state = "lost";
          shake = 14;
        }
      }
      if (m.done) movers.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Win
    if (player.x >= WIN_X) {
      state = "won";
      score += 500;
    }

    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0a1330");
    g.addColorStop(0.4, "#22345c");
    g.addColorStop(0.72, "#5a6a94");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#c98a5a");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  function drawStars() {
    ctx.save();
    for (const s of stars) {
      const a = 0.35 + Math.sin(time * 0.05 + s.tw) * 0.3;
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(a, 0.05, 0.9);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e8f0ff";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawMoon() {
    const x = W - 150, y = 90;
    ctx.save();
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 10, x, y, 90);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(230,240,255,0.5)");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(230,240,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 90, y - 90, 180, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#eef2ff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c8d2ea";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 8, y - 6, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 10, y + 8, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawHillLayer(list, baseY, colorA, colorB, parallax, snow) {
    const off = camX * parallax;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-off, 0);
    for (const h of list) {
      const sx = h.x;
      const peakY = baseY - h.h;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx - h.w, baseY);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, peakY, sx + h.w, baseY);
      ctx.closePath();
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, peakY, 0, baseY);
      g.addColorStop(0, colorA);
      g.addColorStop(1, colorB);
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fill();
      if (snow && h.h > 100) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(235,240,250,0.85)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx - h.w * 0.18, peakY + h.h * 0.14);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, peakY, sx + h.w * 0.18, peakY + h.h * 0.14);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, peakY + h.h * 0.3, sx - h.w * 0.18, peakY + h.h * 0.14);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawGround() {
    const off = camX;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-off, 0);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#3f6b3a");
    g.addColorStop(0.3, "#2f5230");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#17301c");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, WIN_X + 2000, H - GROUND_Y);
    // grass tufts
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,180,90,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let x = 0; x < WIN_X + 2000; x += 46) {
      const hgt = 8 + (Math.sin(x * 0.3) * 3 + 3);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, GROUND_Y - hgt);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawTree(x, y, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4a3524";
    ctx.fillRect(-5, -46, 10, 46);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2e5a34";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -58, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a6f40";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-14, -48, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(14, -50, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawScene() {
    // trees (parallax 0.85)
    const toff = camX * 0.85;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-toff, 0);
    for (let x = 300; x < WIN_X + 1500; x += 640) {
      drawTree(x, GROUND_Y, rand(0.8, 1.3));
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawGold(m) {
    const x = m.x, y = m.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 26);
    glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,120,0.6)");
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,120,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(-26, -26, 52, 52);
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + m.seed;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * 10, py = Math.sin(a) * 6 + 4;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff2b0";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px - 1.5, py - 1.5, 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawBalrog(m) {
    const x = m.x, y = m.y, w = m.w, h = m.h;
    ctx.save();
    // fire aura
    const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.5, 5, x + w / 2, y + h * 0.5, h * 0.9);
    aura.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,120,40,0.35)");
    aura.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = aura;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 30, y - 30, w + 60, h + 60);
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = "#16120f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - 6, y + h * 0.4, x + w * 0.2, y + h * 0.25);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w * 0.5, y, x + w * 0.8, y + h * 0.25);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + 6, y + h * 0.4, x + w, y + h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#241a14";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.2, w * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // glowing eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3b1f";
    ctx.shadowColor = "#ff5a2a"; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * 0.42, y + h * 0.18, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * 0.58, y + h * 0.18, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    // sword
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9c9d6"; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.85, y + h * 0.55);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.85 + 26, y + h * 0.55 - 46);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff5a2a"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + w * 0.85 + 24, y + h * 0.55 - 40);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.85 + 28, y + h * 0.55 - 48);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawMover(m) {
    if (m.type === "gold") drawGold(m);
    else if (m.type === "balrog") drawBalrog(m);
  }
  function drawPlayer() {
    const p = player;
    const x = p.x, y = p.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x + PLAYER_W / 2, y + PLAYER_H);
    ctx.scale(p.facing, 1);
    const bob = p.onGround ? Math.sin(p.walk) * 2 : 0;
    ctx.translate(0, bob);
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 16, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a2c1e"; ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.lineCap = "round";
    const leg = p.onGround ? Math.sin(p.walk) * 6 : 0;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4, -16); ctx.lineTo(-6 + leg, 0); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(4, -16); ctx.lineTo(6 - leg, 0); ctx.stroke();
    // torso (clothes)
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a7a9a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-11, -34, 22, 22, 6); ctx.fill();
    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a7a9a"; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-9, -30); ctx.lineTo(-14, -14); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(9, -30); ctx.lineTo(15, -14); ctx.stroke();
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f2d9b8";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -40, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // pointy ears
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f2d9b8";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-9, -42); ctx.lineTo(-16, -46); ctx.lineTo(-8, -38); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(9, -42); ctx.lineTo(16, -46); ctx.lineTo(8, -38); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a5230";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -43, 9, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95); ctx.fill();
    // face
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2a2a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(3, -40, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2a2a"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(3, -36, 3, 0.1, Math.PI * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(14, 14, 190, 40, 8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px Palatino, Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("Gold: " + score, 28, 41);
    // progress bar
    const prog = clamp(player.x / WIN_X, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(W - 260, 18, 246, 30, 8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a5a3a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(W - 256, 22, 238, 22, 6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7ecf5a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(W - 256, 22, 238 * prog, 22, 6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "13px Palatino, Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("To the Lonely Mountain", W - 250, 38);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawOverlay(title, lines, accent) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,10,20,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 52px Palatino, Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.36);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e8e2d0";
    ctx.font = "20px Palatino, Georgia, serif";
    let y = H * 0.5;
    for (const ln of lines) { ctx.fillText(ln, W / 2, y); y += 30; }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.font = "18px Palatino, Georgia, serif";
    ctx.fillText("Press ENTER or click to continue", W / 2, H * 0.85);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0.5) ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    drawSky();
    drawStars();
    drawMoon();
    drawHillLayer(hills, 360, "#5a6a94", "#2f3a5a", 0.25, false);
    drawHillLayer(hills, 400, "#3a4a6a", "#222c44", 0.5, true);
    drawScene();
    drawGround();
    for (const m of movers) drawMover(m);
    if (player && !player.dead) drawPlayer();
    ctx.restore();

    if (state === "playing") drawHUD();
    if (state === "title") drawOverlay("The Hobbit",
      ["Bilbo Baggins sets out for the Lonely Mountain.",
       "Arrow keys / A D to run, W or Space to jump.",
       "Gather the gold and dodge the Balrogs.",
       "Reach the mountain to win."], "#7ecf5a");
    if (state === "won") drawOverlay("You reached the Lonely Mountain!",
      ["The treasure of the dwarves is yours.",
       "Final gold collected: " + score], "#ffe08a");
    if (state === "lost") drawOverlay("The Balrog caught you!",
      ["Your journey ends in the dark.",
       "Gold collected: " + score], "#ff5a3a");
  }

  // ---------- INIT & LOOP ----------
  hills = makeHills();
  clouds = makeClouds();
  stars = makeStars();
  reset();

  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>
