<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Turmoil</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    height: 100%; width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a0f;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
  }
  #game { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  TURMOIL — one playable scene
//  You are a glowing orb. Dodge the swarm.
//  Survive 30 seconds to win. 3 hits and you're done.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// --- State ---
let W, H, cx, cy;
let player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 14, lives: 3, invuln: 0 };
let movers = [];        // every moving entity: player + enemies
let score = 0;
let elapsed = 0;
let state = 'title';    // 'title' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
let shake = 0;
let titlePulse = 0;

const WIN_TIME = 30;
const MAX_LIVES = 3;

// --- Resize ---
function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  cx = W / 2;
  cy = H / 2;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// --- Input ---
let keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// Click / tap to start
canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state === 'title' || state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
    startGame();
  }
});

// --- Helpers ---
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }

function startGame() {
  state = 'playing';
  elapsed = 0;
  score = 0;
  shake = 0;
  player.x = cx; player.y = cy;
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  player.lives = MAX_LIVES;
  player.invuln = 0;
  movers = [];
  spawnMovers();
}

function spawnMovers() {
  // Clear all movers, then rebuild
  movers = [];
  // Player
  movers.push({
    type: 'player',
    x: player.x, y: player.y,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    r: player.r,
    lives: MAX_LIVES,
    invuln: 0,
    color: '#00e5ff',
    glow: 20
  });
  // Enemies
  const count = 14;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + rand(-0.3, 0.3);
    const dist2 = rand(180, Math.min(W, H) * 0.45);
    const speed = rand(1.2, 2.8);
    movers.push({
      type: 'enemy',
      x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist2,
      y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist2,
      vx: Math.cos(angle + rand(-0.5, 0.5)) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle + rand(-0.5, 0.5)) * speed,
      r: rand(8, 18),
      hue: rand(0, 360),
      spin: rand(-0.04, 0.04),
      wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      color: '',
      glow: 12
    });
  }
}

function hitPlayer() {
  const p = movers.find(m => m.type === 'player');
  if (!p || p.invuln > 0) return;
  p.lives--;
  p.invuln = 90; // frames of invulnerability
  shake = 12;
  score = Math.max(0, score - 5);
  if (p.lives <= 0) {
    state = 'lost';
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  UPDATE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function update(dt) {
  if (state !== 'playing') {
    titlePulse += dt * 0.05;
    return;
  }

  elapsed += dt / 60;
  score = Math.floor(elapsed * 10);

  if (elapsed >= WIN_TIME) {
    state = 'won';
    return;
  }

  if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;

  // --- Move every mover ---
  for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = movers[i];

    if (m.type === 'player') {
      const speed = 5;
      let ax = 0, ay = 0;
      if (keys['ArrowLeft']  || keys['a']) ax -= 1;
      if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ax += 1;
      if (keys['ArrowUp']    || keys['w']) ay -= 1;
      if (keys['ArrowDown']  || keys['s']) ay += 1;
      const len = Math.hypot(ax, ay);
      if (len > 0) { ax /= len; ay /= len; }
      m.vx = ax * speed;
      m.vy = ay * speed;
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      // Clamp to screen
      m.x = Math.max(m.r, Math.min(W - m.r, m.x));
      m.y = Math.max(m.r, Math.min(H - m.r, m.y));
      if (m.invuln > 0) m.invuln--;

    } else if (m.type === 'enemy') {
      m.wobble += 0.03;
      // Steer toward player
      const p = movers.find(q => q.type === 'player');
      if (p) {
        const dx = p.x - m.x;
        const dy = p.y - m.y;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const steer = 0.06;
        m.vx += (dx / d) * steer;
        m.vy += (dy / d) * steer;
      }
      // Wobble
      m.vx += Math.sin(m.wobble) * 0.08;
      m.vy += Math.cos(m.wobble * 1.3) * 0.08;
      // Speed cap
      const spd = Math.hypot(m.vx, m.vy);
      const maxSpd = 3.5;
      if (spd > maxSpd) { m.vx = (m.vx / spd) * maxSpd; m.vy = (m.vy / spd) * maxSpd; }
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      // Bounce off walls
      if (m.x < m.r)       { m.x = m.r;       m.vx *= -1; }
      if (m.x > W - m.r)   { m.x = W - m.r;   m.vx *= -1; }
      if (m.y < m.r)       { m.y = m.r;       m.vy *= -1; }
      if (m.y > H - m.r)   { m.y = H - m.r;   m.vy *= -1; }
      // Update color
      m.hue = (m.hue + m.spin * 100) % 360;
      m.color = 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',80%,55%)';

      // Collision with player
      const p2 = movers.find(q => q.type === 'player');
      if (p2 && p2.invuln <= 0 && dist(m, p2) < m.r + p2.r) {
        hitPlayer();
      }
    }

    // Drop if done (not really needed here but the pattern)
    // if (m.done) movers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  DRAW
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  // Screen shake
  if (shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
  }

  // Background
  drawBackground();

  // Movers
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type === 'player') drawPlayer(m);
    else if (m.type === 'enemy') drawEnemy(m);
  }

  // HUD
  if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();

  // Overlays
  if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
  if (state === 'won')   drawEnd(true);
  if (state === 'lost')  drawEnd(false);

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground() {
  // Dark gradient
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#12121f');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0a14');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#050508');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // Grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,40,80,0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const step = 60;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += step) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += step) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Ambient particles
  const t = titlePulse * 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const px = ((i * 137.5 + t * 20) % W);
    const py = ((i * 97.3 + Math.sin(t + i) * 40) % H);
    const sz = 1.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i) * 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,100,200,' + (0.15 + Math.sin(t + i) * 0.1) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, Math.max(0.5, sz), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer(m) {
  const blink = m.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(m.invuln / 5) % 2 === 0;
  if (blink) return;

  // Glow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, m.r * 3);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,229,255,0.5)');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,150,255,0.15)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,100,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00e5ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Inner highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x - m.r * 0.25, m.y - m.r * 0.25, m.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawEnemy(m) {
  // Glow
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, m.r * 2.5);
  const rgb = hslToRgb(m.hue, 80, 55);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0.4)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Spiky body
  ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const spikes = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i < spikes * 2; i++) {
    const angle = (i / (spikes * 2)) * Math.PI * 2 + m.wobble * 0.5;
    const rad = (i % 2 === 0) ? m.r : m.r * 0.55;
    const sx = m.x + Math.cos(angle) * rad;
    const sy = m.y + Math.sin(angle) * rad;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
    else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Core
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function hslToRgb(h, s, l) {
  s /= 100; l /= 100;
  const k = n => (n + h / 30) % 12;
  const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
  const f = n => l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, Math.min(9 - k(n), 1)));
  return [Math.round(f(0)*255), Math.round(f(8)*255), Math.round(f(4)*255)].join(',');
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Timer bar
  const barW = Math.min(300, W * 0.5);
  const barH = 8;
  const barX = cx - barW / 2;
  const barY = 20;
  const pct = Math.min(1, elapsed / WIN_TIME);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
  ctx.fillStyle = pct > 0.8 ? '#ff4444' : '#00e5ff';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * pct, barH);

  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, cx, barY + barH + 24);

  // Time remaining
  const remain = Math.max(0, WIN_TIME - elapsed);
  ctx.font = '14px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.fillText(remain.toFixed(1) + 's remaining', cx, barY + barH + 44);

  // Lives
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LIVES; i++) {
    const lx = cx - (MAX_LIVES - 1) * 18 + i * 36;
    const ly = H - 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < player.lives ? '#00e5ff' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx, ly, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(titlePulse * 3) * 0.05;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy - 40);
  ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

  ctx.font = 'bold 72px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00e5ff';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#00e5ff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillText('TURMOIL', 0, 0);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.restore();

  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Dodge the swarm. Survive 30 seconds.', cx, cy + 30);
  ctx.fillText('WASD or Arrow Keys to move', cx, cy + 58);

  const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 5) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('— CLICK TO START —', cx, cy + 110);
  }
}

function drawEnd(won) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.font = 'bold 56px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#44ff88' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.shadowColor = won ? '#44ff88' : '#ff4444';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
  ctx.fillText(won ? 'YOU SURVIVED' : 'WIPED OUT', cx, cy - 30);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, cx, cy + 20);

  const blink = Math.sin(titlePulse * 5) > 0;
  if (blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('— CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN —', cx, cy + 70);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//  MAIN LOOP
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(time) {
  const dt = Math.min(3, (time - lastTime) / 16.67);
  lastTime = time;

  update(dt);
  draw();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Gun Fight</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0c0e13;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
  canvas{background:#0c0e13;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);max-width:100%;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const GROUND_Y = H - 92;
const PLAYER_W = 42, PLAYER_H = 74;
const ENEMY_W = 40, ENEMY_H = 70;
const BULLET_W = 14, BULLET_H = 5;
const BULLET_SPEED = 560;
const MAX_HEALTH = 5;
const FIRE_CD = 0.26;

const state = {
  phase: 'start',
  score: 0,
  wave: 1,
  toSpawn: 0,
  spawnTimer: 0,
  fireCd: 0,
  time: 0,
  msg: '',
  msgTimer: 0
};

const player = { x: W/2 - PLAYER_W/2, y: GROUND_Y - PLAYER_H, vx:0, vy:0, w:PLAYER_W, h:PLAYER_H, facing:1, health:MAX_HEALTH, inv:0, dead:false };

const movers = [];
const keys = {};
const mouse = { x: W/2, y: H/2, down:false };

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
  const x = fromLeft ? -ENEMY_W : W;
  const e = {
    x, y: GROUND_Y - ENEMY_H,
    vx: (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * (55 + state.wave*6),
    vy: 0,
    w: ENEMY_W, h: ENEMY_H,
    facing: fromLeft ? 1 : -1,
    health: 1,
    fireCd: 0.8 + Math.random()*1.4,
    done: false
  };
  movers.push(e);
}

function spawnBullet(x, y, vx, vy, fromPlayer){
  movers.push({ x, y, vx, vy, w:BULLET_W, h:BULLET_H, fromPlayer, done:false });
}

function spawnParticle(x, y, vx, vy, life, color){
  movers.push({ x, y, vx, vy, w:6, h:6, fromPlayer:null, life, maxLife:life, color, done:false });
}

function burst(x, y, color, n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const s = 60 + Math.random()*160;
    spawnParticle(x, y, Math.cos(a)*s, Math.sin(a)*s, 0.4 + Math.random()*0.4, color);
  }
}

function overlap(a, b){
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function startGame(){
  state.phase = 'play';
  state.score = 0;
  state.wave = 1;
  state.toSpawn = 3;
  state.spawnTimer = 0.5;
  state.fireCd = 0;
  player.x = W/2 - PLAYER_W/2;
  player.y = GROUND_Y - PLAYER_H;
  player.facing = 1;
  player.health = MAX_HEALTH;
  player.inv = 0;
  player.dead = false;
  movers.length = 0;
}

function nextWave(){
  state.wave++;
  state.toSpawn = 2 + state.wave;
  state.spawnTimer = 1.0;
  state.msg = 'WAVE ' + state.wave;
  state.msgTimer = 1.6;
}

function hurtPlayer(){
  if(player.inv > 0 || player.dead) return;
  player.health--;
  player.inv = 1.0;
  burst(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h/2, '#ff6b57', 10);
  if(player.health <= 0){
    player.dead = true;
    state.phase = 'over';
    state.msg = '';
    state.msgTimer = 0;
  }
}

function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;

  if(state.phase === 'play'){
    // player movement
    let move = 0;
    if(keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) move -= 1;
    if(keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) move += 1;
    player.x += move * 280 * dt;
    player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - player.w, player.x));
    player.facing = (mouse.x >= player.x + player.w/2) ? 1 : -1;

    if(player.inv > 0) player.inv -= dt;
    if(state.fireCd > 0) state.fireCd -= dt;

    if(mouse.down && state.fireCd <= 0){
      state.fireCd = FIRE_CD;
      const px = player.x + player.w/2;
      const py = player.y + player.h*0.4;
      const dx = mouse.x - px, dy = mouse.y - py;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      spawnBullet(px, py, dx/len*BULLET_SPEED, dy/len*BULLET_SPEED, true);
      spawnParticle(px + player.facing*22, py, player.facing*40, -20, 0.12, '#ffe27a');
    }

    // spawn
    if(state.toSpawn > 0){
      state.spawnTimer -= dt;
      if(state.spawnTimer <= 0){
        spawnEnemy();
        state.toSpawn--;
        state.spawnTimer = Math.max(0.5, 1.5 - state.wave*0.08);
      }
    } else if(movers.every(m => m.fromPlayer === null && (m.w !== ENEMY_W))){
      // no enemies left
      if(movers.every(m => m.w !== ENEMY_W)){
        nextWave();
      }
    }
  }

  if(state.msgTimer > 0) state.msgTimer -= dt;

  // move movers
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.done) continue;
    m.x += m.vx * dt;
    m.y += m.vy * dt;

    if(m.w === ENEMY_W){
      // keep on screen horizontally, clamp
      if(m.x < 0){ m.x = 0; m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx); m.facing = 1; }
      if(m.x + m.w > W){ m.x = W - m.w; m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx); m.facing = -1; }
      m.facing = (player.x + player.w/2 > m.x + m.w/2) ? 1 : -1;
      if(state.phase === 'play'){
        m.fireCd -= dt;
        if(m.fireCd <= 0 && Math.abs(m.y - player.y) < 120){
          m.fireCd = 1.2 + Math.random()*1.2;
          const ex = m.x + m.w/2, ey = m.y + m.h*0.4;
          const dx = (player.x + player.w/2) - ex;
          const dy = (player.y + player.h*0.4) - ey;
          const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
          spawnBullet(ex, ey, dx/len*BULLET_SPEED*0.7, dy/len*BULLET_SPEED*0.7, false);
        }
        if(overlap(m, player)) hurtPlayer();
      }
      if(m.x < -80 || m.x + m.w > W + 80) m.done = true;
    } else if(m.fromPlayer !== null){
      if(m.x < -40 || m.x + m.w > W + 40 || m.y < -40 || m.y + m.h > H + 40) m.done = true;
    } else if(m.color){
      m.life -= dt;
      m.vy += 300 * dt;
      if(m.life <= 0) m.done = true;
    }
  }

  // collisions: player bullets vs enemies
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.done || !m.fromPlayer) continue;
    for(const e of movers){
      if(e.done || e.w !== ENEMY_W) continue;
      if(overlap(m, e)){
        e.health--;
        m.done = true;
        if(e.health <= 0){
          e.done = true;
          state.score += 100;
          burst(e.x + e.w/2, e.y + e.h/2, '#ffd23f', 14);
        } else {
          burst(m.x, m.y, '#fff', 4);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  // enemy bullets vs player
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.done || m.fromPlayer !== false) continue;
    if(overlap(m, player)){
      m.done = true;
      hurtPlayer();
    }
  }

  // drop done
  for(let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    if(movers[i].done) movers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  const cx = p.x + p.w/2;
  const bob = Math.sin(state.time*6) * 2;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, p.y + p.h/2 + bob);
  ctx.scale(p.facing, 1);
  ctx.translate(-p.w/2, -p.h/2);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(p.w/2, p.h+4, p.w*0.6, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2f3a';
  roundRect(6, p.h-24, 12, 24, 4); ctx.fill();
  roundRect(p.w-18, p.h-24, 12, 24, 4); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3f7d4e';
  roundRect(4, p.h*0.32, p.w-8, p.h*0.4, 8); ctx.fill();
  // chest strap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b5a39';
  ctx.fillRect(4, p.h*0.5, p.w-8, 6);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c9a0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.w/2, p.h*0.2, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // cap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22303f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.w/2, p.h*0.16, 13, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(p.w/2-13, p.h*0.16-2, 26, 5);
  // gun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1b1f28';
  roundRect(p.w*0.5, p.h*0.42, 26, 8, 3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(p.w*0.5+22, p.h*0.42-2, 5, 12);
  ctx.restore();

  if(p.inv > 0 && Math.floor(state.time*20) % 2 === 0){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h, 8); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  const cx = e.x + e.w/2;
  const bob = Math.sin(state.time*7 + e.x) * 2;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, e.y + e.h/2 + bob);
  ctx.scale(e.facing, 1);
  ctx.translate(-e.w/2, -e.h/2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(e.w/2, e.h+4, e.w*0.6, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#241a1a';
  roundRect(5, e.h-22, 11, 22, 4); ctx.fill();
  roundRect(e.w-16, e.h-22, 11, 22, 4); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7a2f2f';
  roundRect(3, e.h*0.34, e.w-6, e.h*0.38, 8); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e7b48f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.w/2, e.h*0.2, 11, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a1414';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.w/2, e.h*0.16, 12, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(e.w/2-12, e.h*0.16-2, 24, 5);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10141b';
  roundRect(e.w*0.45, e.h*0.44, 24, 7, 3); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  // sky
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#182436');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#26374f');
  g.addColorStop(0.75,'#3a4a5f');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#242a34');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4ecd0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.8, 90, 34, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.8, 90, 50, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // far hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3a52';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  for(let x=0; x<=W; x+=40){
    const y = GROUND_Y - 40 - Math.sin(x*0.01)*30;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // mid hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22304a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
  for(let x=0; x<=W; x+=30){
    const y = GROUND_Y - 20 - Math.cos(x*0.015)*22;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0,'#3a2f28');
  gg.addColorStop(1,'#241d18');
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H-GROUND_Y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y); ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y); ctx.stroke();
  // ground texture dashes
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for(let x=10; x<W; x+=60){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND_Y+30); ctx.lineTo(x+25, GROUND_Y+30); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // movers
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.w === ENEMY_W) drawEnemy(m);
    else if(m.fromPlayer !== null){
      const col = m.fromPlayer ? '#ffe27a' : '#ff6b57';
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      const ang = Math.atan2(m.vy, m.vx);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(m.x + m.w/2, m.y + m.h/2);
      ctx.rotate(ang);
      ctx.shadowColor = col; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      roundRect(-m.w/2, -m.h/2, m.w, m.h, 3); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(m.color){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, m.life / m.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  if(state.phase !== 'over') drawPlayer();

  // crosshair
  if(state.phase === 'play'){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 10, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x-16, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x-5, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x+5, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x+16, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y-16); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y-5);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y+5); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y+16);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + state.score, 20, 18);
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd0ff';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + state.wave, 20, 48);

  // hearts
  for(let i=0;i<MAX_HEALTH;i++){
    const hx = W - 30 - i*34, hy = 26;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < player.health ? '#ff5a5a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(hx, hy+6);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-10, hy-6, hx-10, hy+10, hx, hy+18);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+10, hy+10, hx+10, hy-6, hx, hy+6);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // wave message
  if(state.msgTimer > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H*0.32, W, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe27a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state.msg, W/2, H*0.34);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // overlays
  if(state.phase === 'start'){
    overlay('GUN FIGHT', 'Aim with the mouse. Click to shoot. Move with A / D (or arrow keys).', 'Click to Start');
  } else if(state.phase === 'over'){
    overlay('YOU DIED', 'Final Score: ' + state.score + '   —   Wave ' + state.wave, 'Click to Retry');
  }
}

function overlay(title, sub, btn){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,15,.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe27a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8e6';
  ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 8);
  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time*4)*0.4;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + pulse + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(btn, W/2, H/2 + 56);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// input
function toLocal(e){
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x:(e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width), y:(e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { const p = toLocal(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { const p = toLocal(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.down = true; if(state.phase !== 'play') startGame(); });
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouse.down = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { mouse.down = false; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); const t = e.touches[0]; const p = toLocal(t); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.down = true; if(state.phase !== 'play') startGame(); }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); const t = e.touches[0]; const p = toLocal(t); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { mouse.down = false; });
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { const k = e.key.toLowerCase(); keys[k] = true; if(['arrowleft','arrowright','arrowup','arrowdown',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault(); });
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Steel Slug 3</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #gameCanvas {
    border: 3px solid #444;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #222;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
// ─── STATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const state = {
  mode: 'title',
  score: 0,
  kills: 0,
  goal: 10,
  playerHP: 100,
  maxHP: 100,
  spawnTimer: 0,
  spawnInterval: 90,
  time: 0
};

const player = {
  x: W / 2,
  y: H - 100,
  vx: 0,
  vy: 0,
  w: 32,
  h: 48,
  facing: 1,
  onGround: false,
  invuln: 0,
  shootCooldown: 0
};

const keys = {};
const bullets = [];
const enemies = [];
const particles = [];
const platforms = [];

// ─── LEVEL: build platforms in a short loop ─────────────────────────────
function buildLevel() {
  platforms.length = 0;
  // ground
  platforms.push({ x: 0, y: H - 50, w: W, h: 50 });
  // floating platforms
  const positions = [
    { x: 80,  y: H - 160, w: 180 },
    { x: 350, y: H - 220, w: 150 },
    { x: 620, y: H - 160, w: 180 },
    { x: 200, y: H - 320, w: 140 },
    { x: 550, y: H - 320, w: 140 },
    { x: 380, y: H - 420, w: 200 }
  ];
  for (const p of positions) {
    platforms.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.w, h: 14 });
  }
}

function resetGame() {
  state.score = 0;
  state.kills = 0;
  state.playerHP = state.maxHP;
  state.spawnTimer = 0;
  state.spawnInterval = 90;
  state.time = 0;
  player.x = W / 2;
  player.y = H - 100;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
  player.facing = 1;
  player.invuln = 0;
  player.shootCooldown = 0;
  bullets.length = 0;
  enemies.length = 0;
  particles.length = 0;
  buildLevel();
}

// ─── INPUT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') e.preventDefault();
  if (state.mode === 'title' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    state.mode = 'playing';
    resetGame();
  }
  if ((state.mode === 'won' || state.mode === 'lost') && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    state.mode = 'title';
  }
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  keys[e.code] = false;
});

// ─── HELPERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function overlap(a, b) {
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
         a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function spawnEnemy() {
  const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  const ex = side < 0 ? -40 : W + 40;
  const types = ['walker', 'runner', 'jumper'];
  const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
  const e = {
    x: ex,
    y: H - 100,
    vx: (side < 0 ? 1 : -1) * (type === 'runner' ? 3 : type === 'jumper' ? 1.5 : 1),
    vy: 0,
    w: 30,
    h: 44,
    hp: type === 'jumper' ? 2 : 1,
    type: type,
    jumpTimer: 0,
    onGround: false
  };
  enemies.push(e);
}

function addParticles(x, y, count, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      life: 20 + Math.random() * 20,
      color: color
    });
  }
}

function addBullet(x, y, vx, fromPlayer) {
  bullets.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: 0, w: 8, h: 4, fromPlayer: fromPlayer });
}

// ─── UPDATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function update() {
  state.time++;

  if (state.mode !== 'playing') return;

  // Player movement
  const speed = 4;
  player.vx = 0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) { player.vx = -speed; player.facing = -1; }
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) { player.vx = speed; player.facing = 1; }
  if ((keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space']) && player.onGround) {
    player.vy = -12;
    player.onGround = false;
  }

  // Gravity
  player.vy += 0.6;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // Clamp horizontal
  if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
  if (player.x + player.w > W) player.x = W - player.w;

  // Platform collision
  player.onGround = false;
  const pBox = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: player.w, h: player.h };
  for (const plat of platforms) {
    if (pBox.x < plat.x + plat.w && pBox.x + pBox.w > plat.x &&
        pBox.y + pBox.h > plat.y && pBox.y + pBox.h < plat.y + plat.h + 10 &&
        player.vy >= 0) {
      player.y = plat.y - player.h;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    }
  }

  // Shoot
  player.shootCooldown--;
  if (player.shootCooldown <= 0 && (keys['KeyX'] || keys['KeyJ'] || keys['KeyZ'])) {
    const bx = player.facing === 1 ? player.x + player.w : player.x - 8;
    const by = player.y + 18;
    addBullet(bx, by, player.facing * 10, true);
    player.shootCooldown = 12;
  }

  // Invulnerability
  if (player.invuln > 0) player.invuln--;

  // Spawn enemies
  state.spawnTimer++;
  if (state.spawnTimer >= state.spawnInterval) {
    spawnEnemy();
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    // Speed up
    if (state.spawnInterval > 40) state.spawnInterval--;
  }

  // Update enemies
  for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = enemies[i];
    e.vy += 0.5;
    e.x += e.vx;
    e.y += e.vy;

    // Platform collision for enemies
    e.onGround = false;
    const eBox = { x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.w, h: e.h };
    for (const plat of platforms) {
      if (eBox.x < plat.x + plat.w && eBox.x + eBox.w > plat.x &&
          eBox.y + eBox.h > plat.y && eBox.y + eBox.h < plat.y + plat.h + 10 &&
          e.vy >= 0) {
        e.y = plat.y - e.h;
        e.vy = 0;
        e.onGround = true;
      }
    }

    // Jumper behavior
    if (e.type === 'jumper' && e.onGround) {
      e.jumpTimer++;
      if (e.jumpTimer > 60) {
        e.vy = -10;
        e.jumpTimer = 0;
      }
    }

    // Remove if off screen
    if (e.x < -100 || e.x > W + 100 || e.y > H + 100) {
      enemies.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    // Check collision with player
    if (player.invuln <= 0) {
      const pBox2 = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: player.w, h: player.h };
      if (overlap(pBox2, eBox)) {
        state.playerHP -= 15;
        player.invuln = 60;
        player.vy = -6;
        player.x += (player.x < e.x ? -20 : 20);
        addParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, 8, '#ff4444');
        if (state.playerHP <= 0) {
          state.playerHP = 0;
          state.mode = 'lost';
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Update bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx;
    if (b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20) {
      bullets.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    if (b.fromPlayer) {
      // Check hit enemies
      for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const e = enemies[j];
        const eBox = { x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.w, h: e.h };
        const bBox = { x: b.x, y: b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h };
        if (overlap(bBox, eBox)) {
          e.hp--;
          addParticles(b.x, b.y, 6, '#ffaa00');
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          if (e.hp <= 0) {
            addParticles(e.x + e.w / 2, e.y + e.h / 2, 15, '#ff6600');
            enemies.splice(j, 1);
            state.kills++;
            state.score += 100;
            if (state.kills >= state.goal) {
              state.mode = 'won';
            }
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.15;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ─── DRAW ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function draw() {
  // Sky gradient
  const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0a2e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#2d1b4e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#4a2c6e');
  skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a2e');
  ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + state.time * 0.1) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89) % (H * 0.5);
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }

  // Distant buildings silhouette
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0d1a';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const bx = i * 130 - 20;
    const bh = 80 + (i * 37) % 100;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, H - 50 - bh, 100, bh);
    // Windows
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    for (let wy = 0; wy < bh - 20; wy += 25) {
      for (let wx = 10; wx < 90; wx += 30) {
        if ((i + wx + wy) % 3 === 0) {
          ctx.fillRect(bx + wx, H - 50 - bh + wy + 10, 12, 14);
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0d1a';
  }

  // Mid-ground structures
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a33';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const mx = i * 220 + 30;
    const mh = 60 + (i * 53) % 60;
    ctx.fillRect(mx, H - 50 - mh, 160, mh);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a44';
    ctx.fillRect(mx + 20, H - 50 - mh + 15, 40, 30);
    ctx.fillRect(mx + 80, H - 50 - mh + 15, 40, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a33';
  }

  // Platforms
  for (const plat of platforms) {
    if (plat.h > 20) {
      // Ground
      const gGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, plat.y, 0, plat.y + plat.h);
      gGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a3a55');
      gGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222238');
      ctx.fillStyle = gGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.w, plat.h);
      // Top edge
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5a5a77';
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.w, 4);
      // Cracks
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a2e';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let cx = plat.x + 40; cx < plat.x + plat.w; cx += 80) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx, plat.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(cx + 10, plat.y + plat.h);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    } else {
      // Floating platform
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4a6a';
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.w, plat.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6a6a8a';
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.w, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a55';
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x + 4, plat.y + plat.h - 3, plat.w - 8, 3);
      // Support brackets
      ctx.fillStyle = '#555577';
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x + 10, plat.y + plat.h, 6, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(plat.x + plat.w - 16, plat.y + plat.h, 6, 8);
    }
  }

  // Bullets
  for (const b of bullets) {
    if (b.fromPlayer) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffee44';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 2, b.y + 1, b.w - 4, b.h - 2);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    }
  }

  // Enemies
  for (const e of enemies) {
    const ex = e.x, ey = e.y;
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = e.type === 'runner' ? '#cc3333' : e.type === 'jumper' ? '#9944cc' : '#66aa44';
    ctx.fillRect(ex + 4, ey + 10, e.w - 8, e.h - 20);
    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = e.type === 'runner' ? '#dd5555' : e.type === 'jumper' ? '#bb66dd' : '#88cc66';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex + e.w / 2, ey + 8, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w / 2 - 5, ey + 4, 4, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w / 2 + 1, ey + 4, 4, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w / 2 - 4, ey + 5, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w / 2 + 2, ey + 5, 2, 2);
    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333344';
    const legOffset = Math.sin(state.time * 0.2) * 4;
    ctx.fillRect(ex + 8, ey + e.h - 12, 6, 12 + legOffset);
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w - 14, ey + e.h - 12, 6, 12 - legOffset);
    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = e.type === 'runner' ? '#aa2222' : e.type === 'jumper' ? '#7733aa' : '#448833';
    ctx.fillRect(ex, ey + 16, 5, 14);
    ctx.fillRect(ex + e.w - 5, ey + 16, 5, 14);
  }

  // Player
  const px = player.x, py = player.y;
  const blink = player.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(state.time / 4) % 2 === 0;
  if (!blink) {
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3388cc';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 14, player.w - 12, player.h - 28);
    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 10, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Helmet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2266aa';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 7, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(px + player.w / 2 - 10, py + 5, 20, 4);
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
    const eyeX = player.facing === 1 ? px + player.w / 2 + 1 : px + player.w / 2 - 4;
    ctx.fillRect(eyeX, py + 8, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(eyeX + (player.facing === 1 ? 4 : -4), py + 8, 3, 3);
    // Gun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555566';
    const gunX = player.facing === 1 ? px + player.w - 4 : px - 12;
    ctx.fillRect(gunX, py + 20, 16, 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#777788';
    ctx.fillRect(gunX + (player.facing === 1 ? 10 : 0), py + 19, 6, 7);
    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#225588';
    const pLegOff = Math.sin(state.time * 0.25) * 3;
    if (player.vx !== 0) {
      ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + player.h - 14, 7, 14 + pLegOff);
      ctx.fillRect(px + player.w - 15, py + player.h - 14, 7, 14 - pLegOff);
    } else {
      ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + player.h - 14, 7, 14);
      ctx.fillRect(px + player.w - 15, py + player.h - 14, 7, 14);
    }
    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
    ctx.fillRect(px + (player.facing === 1 ? player.w - 2 : -2), py + 18, 5, 12);
  }

  // Particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / 40;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, alpha);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 2, p.y - 2, 4, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // HUD
  if (state.mode === 'playing') {
    // HP bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(15, 15, 210, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 200, 18);
    const hpRatio = state.playerHP / state.maxHP;
    const hpColor = hpRatio > 0.5 ? '#44cc44' : hpRatio > 0.25 ? '#ccaa22' : '#cc3333';
    ctx.fillStyle = hpColor;
    ctx.fillRect(20, 20, 200 * hpRatio, 18);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('HP', 24, 34);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(W - 220, 15, 205, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, W - 25, 35);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Kill progress
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(15, 50, 210, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('KILLS: ' + state.kills + ' / ' + state.goal, 20, 67);
    // Progress bar
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(120, 55, 100, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8844';
    ctx.fillRect(120, 55, 100 * (state.kills / state.goal), 12);
  }

  // Title screen
  if (state.mode === 'title') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('STEEL SLUG 3', W / 2, H / 2 - 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6644';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('A FAN-MADE TRIBUTE', W / 2, H / 2 - 45);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
    ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
    const lines = [
      'ARROWS / WASD  —  MOVE & JUMP',
      'X / J / Z  —  SHOOT',
      'KILL 10 ENEMIES TO WIN',
      "DON'T LET YOUR HP HIT ZERO"
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      ctx.fillText(lines[i], W / 2, H / 2 + 10 + i * 28);
    }

    // Blinking start prompt
    if (Math.floor(state.time / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 140);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // Win screen
  if (state.mode === 'won') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff88';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('MISSION COMPLETE!', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('You eliminated all ' + state.goal + ' enemies.', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    if (Math.floor(state.time / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  // Lose screen
  if (state.mode === 'lost') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('You were overwhelmed by the enemy forces.', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    if (Math.floor(state.time / 30) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE FOR TITLE', W / 2, H / 2 + 100);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

// ─── MAIN LOOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

buildLevel();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

Make a complete working version of WWF WrestleMania 2000. Hard part: keep every mover in one array of objects with x, y, vx, and vy. In update, move them and drop the ones that are done. Then draw. After that loop, close the script and end with </html> and </html_file>.

Complete HTML game file with canvas/script.
</think>
<html_file>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>WWF WrestleMania 2000</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#05050a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;font-family:'Arial Black',Arial,sans-serif;}
  #c{box-shadow:0 0 40px #000,inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:4px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width, H=cv.height;

// ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
const FLOOR=430;
const GRAV=0.7;
const P1COL='#e8254a', P2COL='#2f8fff';
const P1NAME='STEVE OCEAN', P2NAME='STEEL STEEL';
const MAXHP=100, MAXMETER=100;
const WIN_TIME=99;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let phase='title';      // title | playing | over
let winner=null;
let timeLeft=WIN_TIME;
let frame=0;
let shake=0;

const players=[
  {name:P1NAME, col:P1COL, x:W*0.32, y:FLOOR, vx:0, vy:0,
   facing:1, hp:MAXHP, meter:0, onGround:true,
   state:'idle', stateT:0, combo:0,
   controls:{left:'KeyA', right:'KeyD', up:'KeyW', down:'KeyS',
             light:'KeyJ', heavy:'KeyK', special:'KeyL'}},
  {name:P2NAME, col:P2COL, x:W*0.68, y:FLOOR, vx:0, vy:0,
   facing:-1, hp:MAXHP, meter:0, onGround:true,
   state:'idle', stateT:0, combo:0,
   controls:{left:'ArrowLeft', right:'ArrowRight', up:'ArrowUp', down:'ArrowDown',
             light:'Key1', heavy:'Key2', special:'Key3'}}
];

// ---------- MOVERS (one array of {x,y,vx,vy,done,draw}) ----------
const movers=[];

function addMover(o){ movers.push(o); }
function spark(x,y,col,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s=2+Math.random()*4;
    addMover({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s-1, life:20,
      done:false, draw(c){ c.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,this.life/20);
        c.fillStyle=col; c.beginPath(); c.arc(this.x,this.y,3,0,7); c.fill(); c.globalAlpha=1; }});
  }
}
function dust(x,y){
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    addMover({x:x+(Math.random()*20-10), y, vx:Math.random()*1.4-0.7, vy:-Math.random()*1.5,
      life:22, done:false, draw(c){ c.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,this.life/22)*0.5;
        c.fillStyle='#c9b98f'; c.beginPath(); c.arc(this.x,this.y,4,0,7); c.fill(); c.globalAlpha=1; }});
  }
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
const keys={};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(e.code==='Enter'){
    if(phase==='title') startGame();
    else if(phase==='over') startGame();
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

// ---------- GAME FLOW ----------
function startGame(){
  players[0].x=W*0.32; players[0].y=FLOOR; players[0].vx=0; players[0].vy=0;
  players[0].hp=MAXHP; players[0].meter=0; players[0].facing=1; players[0].state='idle'; players[0].stateT=0; players[0].combo=0;
  players[1].x=W*0.68; players[1].y=FLOOR; players[1].vx=0; players[1].vy=0;
  players[1].hp=MAXHP; players[1].meter=0; players[1].facing=-1; players[1].state='idle'; players[1].stateT=0; players[1].combo=0;
  movers.length=0;
  timeLeft=WIN_TIME; frame=0; winner=null; shake=0;
  phase='playing';
}

function damage(att,def,amount){
  if(def.state==='ko'||def.state==='hit') return;
  def.hp=Math.max(0,def.hp-amount);
  def.state='hit'; def.stateT=0;
  def.vx=att.facing*(amount*0.5);
  def.vy=-3; def.onGround=false;
  att.meter=Math.min(MAXMETER,att.meter+amount*1.2);
  att.combo++;
  shake=Math.min(14,shake+amount*0.35);
  spark(def.x,def.y-40,att.col,8);
  if(def.hp<=0){
    def.state='ko'; def.stateT=0; def.vy=-6; def.vx=att.facing*5;
    winner=att;
    phase='over';
  }
}

function special(att,def){
  if(att.meter<MAXMETER) return;
  if(def.state==='ko') return;
  att.meter=0;
  att.state='special'; att.stateT=0;
  shake=18;
  spark(def.x,def.y-40,'#ffd23a',22);
  damage(att,def,34);
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function updatePlayer(p,opp){
  if(p.state==='ko'){
    p.stateT++;
    return;
  }
  const c=p.controls;
  const busy = p.state==='hit'||p.state==='attack'||p.state==='special';

  if(!busy){
    let move=0;
    if(keys[c.left]) move-=1;
    if(keys[c.right]) move+=1;
    p.vx=move*4.2;
    if(move!==0) p.facing=move;
    if(keys[c.up] && p.onGround){ p.vy=-13; p.onGround=false; }
    if(keys[c.down] && p.onGround){ p.state='crouch'; }
    else if(p.state==='crouch') p.state='idle';
  }

  // attacks (only when not busy and not crouching)
  if(!busy && p.state!=='crouch'){
    if(keys[c.light]){
      p.state='attack'; p.stateT=0; p.attackKind='light';
      keys[c.light]=false;
    } else if(keys[c.heavy]){
      p.state='attack'; p.stateT=0; p.attackKind='heavy';
      keys[c.heavy]=false;
    } else if(keys[c.special]){
      special(p,opp);
      keys[c.special]=false;
    }
  }

  // state timers
  if(p.state==='attack'){
    p.stateT++;
    const reach = p.attackKind==='heavy'?70:55;
    const hitFrame = p.attackKind==='heavy'?8:5;
    if(p.stateT===hitFrame){
      const dx=opp.x-p.x;
      if((p.facing===1 && dx>0 && dx<reach) || (p.facing===-1 && dx<0 && dx>-reach)){
        damage(p,opp, p.attackKind==='heavy'?14:7);
      }
    }
    if(p.stateT>18) p.state='idle';
  } else if(p.state==='special'){
    p.stateT++;
    if(p.stateT>22) p.state='idle';
  } else if(p.state==='hit'){
    p.stateT++;
    if(p.stateT>14) p.state='idle';
  }
}

function update(){
  if(shake>0) shake*=0.85;
  frame++;
  if(phase!=='playing') return;

  // timer
  if(frame%60===0){
    timeLeft--;
    if(timeLeft<=0){
      const a=players[0].hp, b=players[1].hp;
      winner = a===b ? null : (a>b?players[0]:players[1]);
      phase='over';
    }
  }

  // players
  updatePlayer(players[0],players[1]);
  updatePlayer(players[1],players[0]);

  // physics + bounds
  for(const p of players){
    if(p.state!=='ko'){
      p.vy+=GRAV;
      p.x+=p.vx;
      p.y+=p.vy;
      if(p.y>=FLOOR){
        if(!p.onGround && p.vy>4){ dust(p.x,FLOOR); }
        p.y=FLOOR; p.vy=0; p.onGround=true;
        if(p.state==='hit'&&p.stateT>6) p.state='idle';
      } else p.onGround=false;
      if(p.x<40) p.x=40;
      if(p.x>W-40) p.x=W-40;
    } else {
      // KO falls and lies
      p.vy+=GRAV; p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy;
      if(p.y>=FLOOR){ p.y=FLOOR; p.vy=0; p.vx*=0.8; }
      if(p.x<40) p.x=40; if(p.x>W-40) p.x=W-40;
    }
  }

  // push apart if overlapping
  const dx=players[1].x-players[0].x;
  if(Math.abs(dx)<40 && players[0].state!=='ko' && players[1].state!=='ko'){
    const push=(40-Math.abs(dx))/2 * (dx>=0?1:-1);
    players[0].x-=push; players[1].x+=push;
  }

  // movers
  for(const m of movers){
    m.x+=m.vx; m.y+=m.vy;
    if(m.vy!==undefined && (m.life!==undefined)) m.vy+=0.15;
    if(m.life!==undefined){ m.life--; if(m.life<=0) m.done=true; }
  }
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(movers[i].done) movers.splice(i,1); }
}

// ---------- DRAW HELPERS ----------
function drawRope(x1,x2,yy){
  ctx.strokeStyle='#e8e2d0'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1,yy); ctx.lineTo(x2,yy); ctx.stroke();
}
function drawPost(x){
  ctx.fillStyle='#222'; ctx.fillRect(x-6,FLOOR-150,12,150);
  ctx.fillStyle='#c9a227'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,FLOOR-150,8,0,7); ctx.fill();
}
function drawRing(){
  // apron
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a1030'; ctx.fillRect(60,FLOOR,W-120,70);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a1a4a'; ctx.fillRect(60,FLOOR,W-120,14);
  // mat
  ctx.fillStyle='#d8d2c4'; ctx.fillRect(70,FLOOR-6,W-140,6);
  // canvas
  ctx.fillStyle='#c9c2b2'; ctx.fillRect(80,FLOOR-40,W-160,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#b7b0a0'; ctx.fillRect(80,FLOOR-40,W-160,8);
  // center logo
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,30,60,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2,FLOOR-24,42,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // ropes
  const rx1=90, rx2=W-90;
  drawRope(rx1,rx2,FLOOR-70);
  drawRope(rx1,rx2,FLOOR-105);
  drawRope(rx1,rx2,FLOOR-140);
  drawPost(90); drawPost(W-90);
}
function drawCrowd(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#140a24'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,150);
  for(let r=0;r<3;r++){
    const y=40+r*38;
    for(let x=10;x<W;x+=26){
      const hue=(x*7+r*40+frame*0.5)%360;
      ctx.fillStyle='hsl('+hue+',55%,'+(35+r*4)+'%)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}
function drawSign(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0614'; ctx.fillRect(W/2-190,8,380,64);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(W/2-190,8,380,64);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='900 30px Arial'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('WRESTLEMANIA 2000', W/2, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8254a'; ctx.font='900 14px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('THE ULTIMATE CHAMPIONSHIP', W/2, 60);
}
function bar(x,y,w,h,frac,col){
  ctx.fillStyle='#000'; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(x,y,w*frac,h);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#fff'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.strokeRect(x,y,w,h);
}
function drawHUD(){
  // p1
  ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='900 18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(players[0].name, 30, 30);
  bar(30,40,260,16,players[0].hp/MAXHP,P1COL);
  bar(30,62,200,10,players[0].meter/MAXMETER,'#ffd23a');
  // p2
  ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText(players[1].name, W-30, 30);
  bar(W-290,40,260,16,players[1].hp/MAXHP,P2COL);
  bar(W-230,62,200,10,players[1].meter/MAXMETER,'#ffd23a');
  // timer
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='900 40px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(String(Math.max(0,timeLeft)), W/2, 55);
}
function drawWrestler(p){
  const x=p.x, y=p.y, f=p.facing;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,2,26,7,0,0,7); ctx.fill();

  let lean=0, crouch=0, armUp=0;
  if(p.state==='crouch') crouch=10;
  if(p.state==='hit') lean=-f*0.5;
  if(p.state==='attack') armUp=1;
  if(p.state==='special') armUp=2;
  if(p.state==='ko') lean=1.5;

  ctx.rotate(lean*0.3);
  const topY=-70+crouch;

  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle='#20242c'; ctx.lineWidth=11; ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6,-30); ctx.lineTo(-10,0); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(6,-30); ctx.lineTo(10,0); ctx.stroke();
  // boots
  ctx.fillStyle='#0e1116';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-10,0,9,5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(10,0,9,5,0,0,7); ctx.fill();

  // trunks
  ctx.fillStyle=p.col;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,-52); ctx.lineTo(14,-52); ctx.lineTo(10,-26); ctx.lineTo(-10,-26); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(-12,-50,24,4);

  // torso
  ctx.fillStyle=p.col;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-13,-52); ctx.lineTo(13,-52); ctx.lineTo(11,-84); ctx.lineTo(-11,-84); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(-11,-84,6,32);

  // arms
  ctx.strokeStyle=p.col; ctx.lineWidth=9;
  const ax=10*f;
  if(armUp){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ax,-70); ctx.lineTo(ax+f*14, topY-14); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-ax,-70); ctx.lineTo(-ax-f*6, topY+6); ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ax,-70); ctx.lineTo(ax+f*12,-46); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-ax,-70); ctx.lineTo(-ax-f*8,-48); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // fists
  ctx.fillStyle='#e7c9a8';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax+f*(armUp?14:12), armUp?topY-14:-46,5,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-ax-f*(armUp?6:8), armUp?topY+6:-48,5,0,7); ctx.fill();

  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#e7c9a8';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f*2, topY-4, 13, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  // hair
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a1a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f*2, topY-9, 13, Math.PI, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // headband
  ctx.fillStyle=p.col; ctx.fillRect(f*2-13, topY-12, 26, 5);
  // face
  ctx.fillStyle='#111';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f*6, topY-4, 1.6, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();

  // special aura
  if(p.state==='special'){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,210,58,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-45,40+Math.sin(frame*0.5)*4,0,7); ctx.stroke();
  }
}
function drawMovers(){
  for(const m of movers) m.draw(ctx);
}
function overlayTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='900 54px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('WRESTLEMANIA 2000', W/2, 150);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8254a'; ctx.font='900 20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('THE ULTIMATE CHAMPIONSHIP', W/2, 185);

  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='900 18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('PLAYER 1  —  STEVE OCEAN', W/2, 250);
  ctx.font='700 15px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle='#cfcfcf';
  ctx.fillText('Move: A / D    Jump: W    Crouch: S', W/2, 280);
  ctx.fillText('Light: J    Heavy: K    Special: L (needs full meter)', W/2, 305);

  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='900 18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('PLAYER 2  —  STEEL STEEL', W/2, 355);
  ctx.font='700 15px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle='#cfcfcf';
  ctx.fillText('Move: ← / →    Jump: ↑    Crouch: ↓', W/2, 385);
  ctx.fillText('Light: 1    Heavy: 2    Special: 3 (needs full meter)', W/2, 410);

  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='900 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  FIGHT', W/2, 470);
}
function overlayOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='900 50px Arial';
  if(winner) ctx.fillText(winner.name+'  WINS!', W/2, 200);
  else ctx.fillText('DRAW', W/2, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='900 22px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  REMATCH', W/2, 300);
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0.5) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake);

  // background
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0614'); g.addColorStop(1,'#1a1030');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  drawCrowd();
  drawSign();

  // stage floor behind ring
  ctx.fillStyle='#0c0818'; ctx.fillRect(0,FLOOR+60,W,H-(FLOOR+60));
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=60) ctx.fillRect(x,FLOOR+60,2,H);

  drawRing();

  // movers behind/around
  drawMovers();

  // wrestlers (draw the one not in special first so aura reads on top)
  const order=[0,1];
  drawWrestler(players[order[0]]);
  drawWrestler(players[order[1]]);

  if(phase==='playing') drawHUD();
  ctx.restore();

  if(phase==='title') overlayTitle();
  if(phase==='over') overlayOver();
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Amplitude</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;
    background: #07070e; overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block; margin: 0 auto;
    background: #07070e;
    box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(120,80,255,.25);
    max-width: 100%;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const BASE_Y = H * 0.56;
const PLAYER_X = 120;
const PLAYER_R = 14;
const MAX_HP = 5;
const NOTE_MIN = 100;
const NOTE_MAX = 900;
const HIT_X = PLAYER_X + PLAYER_R + 4;
const HIT_Y = BASE_Y - 4;
const HIT_W = 26;
const HIT_H = 52;

const NOTE_COLORS = ['#43d6ff', '#ff5db1', '#ffd23f', '#7dffb0', '#b06bff'];

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let hp = MAX_HP;
let combo = 0;
let best = 0;
let time = 0;
let beat = 0;
let beatCount = 0;
let bpm = 120;
let beatInterval = 60 / bpm;
let shake = 0;
let flash = 0;
let playerPulse = 0;
let beatPulse = 0;
let hitFlash = 0;

const movers = [];
const notes = [];
const particles = [];
const stars = [];
const rings = [];
const textPopups = [];
const gridPulse = [];

// ---------- INIT ----------
function initStars() {
  stars.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.4 + 0.3,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      sp: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
    });
  }
}

function initGrid() {
  gridPulse.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) gridPulse.push(0);
}

initStars();
initGrid();

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }

function noteColor(f) {
  const i = Math.floor(clamp(f, NOTE_MIN, NOTE_MAX) / 150) % NOTE_COLORS.length;
  return NOTE_COLORS[i];
}

// ---------- SPAWN ----------
function spawnNote(f, x) {
  const col = noteColor(f);
  notes.push({
    x: x,
    y: HIT_Y,
    vx: -(W - x) / 3.0,
    vy: 0,
    r: 12,
    f: f,
    col: col,
    alive: true,
    age: 0
  });
}

function spawnObstacle(x) {
  movers.push({
    x: x,
    y: HIT_Y,
    vx: -(W - x) / 3.4,
    vy: 0,
    r: 16,
    type: 'obstacle',
    alive: true,
    age: 0
  });
}

function spawnParticle(x, y, col, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = rand(1.5, 5);
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      r: rand(1.5, 3.5),
      col: col,
      life: 1
    });
  }
}

function spawnRing(x, y, col) {
  rings.push({ x: x, y: y, r: 10, life: 1, col: col });
}

function popup(x, y, text, col) {
  textPopups.push({ x: x, y: y, text: text, col: col, life: 1 });
}

// ---------- GAME FLOW ----------
function startGame() {
  state = 'play';
  score = 0;
  hp = MAX_HP;
  combo = 0;
  time = 0;
  beat = 0;
  beatCount = 0;
  bpm = 120;
  beatInterval = 60 / bpm;
  shake = 0;
  flash = 0;
  playerPulse = 0;
  beatPulse = 0;
  hitFlash = 0;
  notes.length = 0;
  movers.length = 0;
  particles.length = 0;
  rings.length = 0;
  textPopups.length = 0;
  initGrid();
}

function onHit() {
  combo++;
  const mult = 1 + Math.floor(combo / 5);
  const pts = 100 * mult;
  score += pts;
  if (score > best) best = score;
  playerPulse = 1;
  hitFlash = 1;
  spawnParticle(HIT_X, HIT_Y, '#ffffff', 10);
  spawnRing(HIT_X, HIT_Y, '#ffffff');
  if (combo > 0 && combo % 5 === 0) {
    popup(HIT_X, HIT_Y - 40, 'x' + mult, '#ffd23f');
    spawnParticle(HIT_X, HIT_Y, '#ffd23f', 14);
  }
  popup(HIT_X + 30, HIT_Y, '+' + pts, '#7dffb0');
}

function onMiss() {
  combo = 0;
  hp--;
  shake = 12;
  flash = 0.5;
  popup(HIT_X, HIT_Y - 30, 'MISS', '#ff5db1');
  if (hp <= 0) {
    state = 'over';
    spawnParticle(PLAYER_X, BASE_Y, '#ff5db1', 30);
    spawnRing(PLAYER_X, BASE_Y, '#ff5db1');
  }
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
let keyDown = false;
function press() {
  if (state === 'start') { startGame(); return; }
  if (state === 'over') { state = 'start'; return; }
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  let hitAny = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
    const n = notes[i];
    if (n.alive && Math.abs(n.x - HIT_X) < HIT_W) {
      n.alive = false;
      onHit();
      hitAny = true;
    }
  }
  if (!hitAny) {
    combo = 0;
    popup(HIT_X, HIT_Y - 30, 'x', '#6a6a9a');
  }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    keyDown = true;
    press();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
  if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') keyDown = false;
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  press();
});

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;

  // beat clock
  if (state === 'play') {
    beat += dt;
    if (beat >= beatInterval) {
      beat -= beatInterval;
      beatCount++;
      beatPulse = 1;
      // difficulty ramp
      if (beatCount % 16 === 0 && bpm < 170) {
        bpm += 6;
        beatInterval = 60 / bpm;
      }
      // spawn on beat
      const beatMod = beatCount % 4;
      const baseX = W + 40;
      if (beatMod === 0) spawnNote(rand(NOTE_MIN, NOTE_MAX), baseX);
      if (beatMod === 2) spawnNote(rand(NOTE_MIN, NOTE_MAX), baseX);
      if (beatMod === 1 && bpm > 135 && Math.random() < 0.5) spawnNote(rand(NOTE_MIN, NOTE_MAX), baseX);
      if (beatMod === 3 && bpm > 150 && Math.random() < 0.4) spawnObstacle(baseX);
    }
  }

  // decay pulses
  beatPulse = Math.max(0, beatPulse - dt * 3);
  playerPulse = Math.max(0, playerPulse - dt * 4);
  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2);
  hitFlash = Math.max(0, hitFlash - dt * 4);
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);

  // update all movers (notes + obstacles)
  for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = movers[i];
    m.x += m.vx * dt * 60;
    m.y += m.vy * dt * 60;
    m.age += dt;
    if (m.type === 'note') {
      // check if it passed the hit zone without being hit
      if (m.alive && m.x < HIT_X - HIT_W) {
        m.alive = false;
        onMiss();
      }
    } else if (m.type === 'obstacle') {
      // if it reaches the player without being avoided, it's a hit
      if (m.alive && m.x < HIT_X + 6 && m.x > HIT_X - HIT_W) {
        // obstacles must be dodged: if player "pressed" on it it's bad,
        // but we treat reaching the line as a miss/damage
        m.alive = false;
        onMiss();
      }
    }
    if (m.x < -40 || !m.alive) movers.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // notes array mirrors movers for drawing clarity
  notes.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
    if (movers[i].type === 'note') notes.push(movers[i]);
  }

  // particles
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt * 60;
    p.y += p.vy * dt * 60;
    p.vy += 0.05 * dt * 60;
    p.life -= dt * 1.5;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // rings
  for (let i = rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const r = rings[i];
    r.r += dt * 120;
    r.life -= dt * 1.5;
    if (r.life <= 0) rings.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // text popups
  for (let i = textPopups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const t = textPopups[i];
    t.y -= dt * 40;
    t.life -= dt * 1.2;
    if (t.life <= 0) textPopups.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // grid pulse
  for (let i = 0; i < gridPulse.length; i++) {
    gridPulse[i] = Math.max(0, gridPulse[i] - dt * 2);
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground() {
  // vertical gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a1a');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#120a24');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#070710');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
    const s = stars[i];
    const a = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * s.sp + s.tw));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fb0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // perspective grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,80,255,0.18)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const horizon = BASE_Y - 60;
  // horizontal lines
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const t = i / 12;
    const y = lerp(horizon, H, t * t);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // radial lines
  const cx = W / 2;
  for (let i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
    const x = cx + i * 90;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, horizon);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // glowing horizon
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, horizon - 30, 0, horizon + 30);
  hg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,80,255,0)');
  hg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(180,120,255,0.35)');
  hg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,80,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, horizon - 30, W, 60);
}

function drawHitZone() {
  const x = HIT_X;
  const y = HIT_Y;
  const w = HIT_W;
  const h = HIT_H;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * beatPulse;
  // glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,220,255,' + (0.4 + 0.4 * pulse) + ')';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20 + 20 * pulse;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,' + (0.5 + 0.5 * pulse) + ')';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
  ctx.restore();
  // inner
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.08)';
  ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
  // hit flash
  if (hitFlash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + hitFlash * 0.5 + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const x = PLAYER_X;
  const y = BASE_Y;
  const pulse = playerPulse;
  const r = PLAYER_R + pulse * 6;
  // outer glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,93,177,0.8)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30 + pulse * 30;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r * 2);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  g.addColorStop(0.4, '#ff5db1');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,93,177,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  // core
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,93,177,0.9)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawMovers() {
  for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) {
    const m = movers[i];
    if (m.type === 'note') {
      // glow
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = m.col;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      ctx.fillStyle = m.col;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      // inner
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // frequency label
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.font = '10px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(m.f + 'Hz', m.x, m.y + m.r + 12);
    } else if (m.type === 'obstacle') {
      // warning diamond
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
      ctx.rotate(time * 2);
      ctx.shadowColor = '#ff3b3b';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3b3b';
      const s = m.r;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
      ctx.lineTo(s, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s);
      ctx.lineTo(-s, 0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px Courier New';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('!', m.x, m.y + 4);
    }
  }
}

function drawRings() {
  for (let i = 0; i < rings.length; i++) {
    const r = rings[i];
    ctx.strokeStyle = r.col;
    ctx.globalAlpha = r.life;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    const p = particles[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawTextPopups() {
  for (let i = 0; i < textPopups.length; i++) {
    const t = textPopups[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, t.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = t.col;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 20, 34);
  // best
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,210,63,0.8)';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('BEST ' + best, 20, 52);
  // combo
  if (combo > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7dffb0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('COMBO x' + combo, W / 2, 34);
  }
  // bpm
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.8)';
  ctx.font = '12px Courier New';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(bpm + ' BPM', W - 20, 34);
  // hp
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_HP; i++) {
    const x = W - 20 - i * 22;
    const y = 54;
    const on = i < hp;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? '#ff5db1' : 'rgba(255,93,177,0.2)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7,7,14,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#43d6ff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('AMPLITUDE', W / 2, H * 0.35);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('Hit notes on the beat. Dodge the red warnings.', W / 2, H * 0.48);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('SPACE / TAP to strike', W / 2, H * 0.55);
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + blink + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('— PRESS TO START —', W / 2, H * 0.68);
}

function drawOverScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7,7,14,0.8)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5db1';
  ctx.font = 'bold 52px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('SIGNAL LOST', W / 2, H * 0.38);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = '22px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, W / 2, H * 0.5);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
  ctx.font = '16px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('BEST ' + best, W / 2, H * 0.56);
  const blink = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + blink + ')';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('— PRESS TO RESTART —', W / 2, H * 0.68);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) {
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawHitZone();
  drawMovers();
  drawRings();
  drawParticles();
  drawPlayer();
  drawTextPopups();
  drawHUD();
  ctx.restore();

  // full-screen damage flash
  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,59,59,' + flash * 0.25 + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  if (state === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (state === 'over') drawOverScreen();
}

// ---------- MAIN LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
