<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Operation Whirlwind</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b1020;overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
  #c{display:block;margin:0 auto;background:#12203c}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0;
function resize(){ W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth; H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ---------- state ----------
const G = {
  state: 'title',
  score: 0,
  wind: 0,
  windTarget: 0,
  windTimer: 0,
  time: 0,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  lastScore: 0,
  lastTime: 0
};
const keys = { left: false, right: false, boost: false };

const player = {
  x: 0, y: 0,
  vx: 0, vy: 0,
  w: 40, h: 40,
  alive: true
};

const movers = [];
let nextId = 1;
function makeMover(x, y, vx, vy, kind, r){
  return { id: nextId++, x, y, vx, vy, kind, r, rot: 0, spin: (Math.random()*2-1)*2.5, life: 0, dead: false };
}

function reset(){
  G.state = 'play';
  G.score = 0;
  G.wind = 0; G.windTarget = 0; G.windTimer = 0;
  G.time = 0; G.shake = 0; G.flash = 0;
  G.lastScore = 0; G.lastTime = 0;
  movers.length = 0;
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H*0.62;
  player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0; player.alive = true;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x = W*(0.12 + Math.random()*0.76);
    const y = -20 - Math.random()*120;
    const r = 15 + Math.random()*20;
    movers.push(makeMover(x, y, (Math.random()*2-1)*30, 30 + Math.random()*40, 'balloon', r));
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
function onKey(e, down){
  const k = e.key;
  if(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='a'||k==='A') keys.left = down;
  else if(k==='ArrowRight'||k==='d'||k==='D') keys.right = down;
  else if(k===' '||k==='ArrowUp'||k==='w'||k==='W') keys.boost = down;
  else if((k==='Enter') && down){
    if(G.state==='title') reset();
    else if(G.state==='over') reset();
  }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => onKey(e, true));
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => onKey(e, false));
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
  if(G.state==='title' || G.state==='over') reset();
});

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  G.time += dt;
  G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt*40);
  G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt*3);

  if(G.state === 'title'){
    // ambient balloons
    if(movers.length < 14 && Math.random() < 0.05){
      movers.push(makeMover(Math.random()*W, -30, (Math.random()*2-1)*20, 20+Math.random()*30, 'balloon', 12+Math.random()*16));
    }
    for(const m of movers){
      m.x += m.vx*dt;
      m.y += m.vy*dt;
      m.rot += m.spin*dt;
    }
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m = movers[i];
      if(m.y > H + 60 || m.x < -80 || m.x > W+80){ movers.splice(i,1); }
    }
    return;
  }

  if(G.state === 'over'){
    for(const m of movers){
      m.x += m.vx*dt;
      m.y += m.vy*dt;
      m.rot += m.spin*dt;
    }
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m = movers[i];
      if(m.y > H + 60){ movers.splice(i,1); }
    }
    return;
  }

  // play
  G.lastTime += dt;
  G.lastScore = G.score;

  // wind
  G.windTimer -= dt;
  if(G.windTimer <= 0){
    G.windTarget = (Math.random()*2-1) * (60 + G.time*4);
    G.windTimer = 1.5 + Math.random()*2.5;
  }
  G.wind += (G.windTarget - G.wind) * Math.min(1, dt*1.5);

  // player
  const accel = 1500, maxVX = 320, drag = 4;
  if(keys.left) player.vx -= accel*dt;
  if(keys.right) player.vx += accel*dt;
  player.vx += G.wind*dt;
  player.vx -= player.vx*drag*dt;
  player.vx = Math.max(-maxVX, Math.min(maxVX, player.vx));
  let targetVY = -160;
  if(keys.boost) targetVY = -560;
  player.vy += (targetVY - player.vy) * Math.min(1, dt*3);
  player.x += player.vx*dt;
  player.y += player.vy*dt;
  player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W-20, player.x));
  player.y = Math.max(30, Math.min(H-30, player.y));

  // spawning
  if(G.lastTime > 0.9){
    G.lastTime = 0;
    const r = 14 + Math.random()*18;
    const x = 40 + Math.random()*(W-80);
    movers.push(makeMover(x, -20, (Math.random()*2-1)*40, 40 + Math.random()*50, 'balloon', r));
    if(G.time > 8 && Math.random() < 0.55){
      const r2 = 12 + Math.random()*12;
      movers.push(makeMover(40 + Math.random()*(W-80), -20, (Math.random()*2-1)*30, 30 + Math.random()*30, 'spark', r2));
    }
    if(G.time > 20 && Math.random() < 0.35){
      const r3 = 13 + Math.random()*10;
      movers.push(makeMover(40 + Math.random()*(W-80), -20, (Math.random()*2-1)*20, 25 + Math.random()*25, 'cloud', r3));
    }
  }

  // move movers, detect collisions
  for(const m of movers){
    m.x += (m.vx + G.wind*0.4)*dt;
    m.y += m.vy*dt;
    m.rot += m.spin*dt;
    m.life += dt;
    const dx = m.x - player.x, dy = m.y - player.y;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const minD = m.r + player.w*0.5;
    if(dist < minD){
      m.dead = true;
      if(m.kind === 'balloon'){
        G.score += 10;
        G.shake = 6; G.flash = 0.6;
        for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
          const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sp = 60 + Math.random()*120;
          movers.push(makeMover(m.x, m.y, Math.cos(a)*sp, Math.sin(a)*sp, 'spark', 3));
        }
      } else if(m.kind === 'spark'){
        G.score += 5;
        G.flash = 0.5;
      } else if(m.kind === 'cloud'){
        G.score -= 20;
        G.shake = 10; G.flash = 0.8;
      }
    }
  }

  // drop done movers
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.dead || m.y > H + 80 || m.x < -100 || m.x > W+100){
      movers.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // win / lose
  if(G.score >= 1000){
    G.state = 'over';
    G.won = true;
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#12203c');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#20355e');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#3a5a86');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // sun / moon
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,190,0.9)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W*0.78, H*0.2, 46, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,190,0.15)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W*0.78, H*0.2, 80, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // distant clouds (parallax)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x = ((i*W/5 + G.time*12) % (W+300)) - 150;
    const y = H*0.25 + i*30;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 90, 26, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x+50, y+8, 60, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H-120,0,H);
  gg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(60,90,60,0)');
  gg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(40,70,45,0.6)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0,H-120,W,120);
}

function drawMover(m){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
  ctx.rotate(m.rot);
  if(m.kind === 'balloon'){
    // string
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, m.r);
    ctx.lineTo(0, m.r + 22);
    ctx.stroke();
    // balloon body
    const hues = ['#ff5d6c','#ffb14e','#5dd3ff','#7ee787','#c98bff'];
    ctx.fillStyle = hues[(m.id) % hues.length];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, m.r, m.r*1.15, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-m.r*0.35, -m.r*0.35, m.r*0.28, m.r*0.4, -0.4, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // knot
    ctx.fillStyle = hues[(m.id) % hues.length];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, m.r*1.1);
    ctx.lineTo(-4, m.r*1.35);
    ctx.lineTo(4, m.r*1.35);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  } else if(m.kind === 'spark'){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3b0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,m.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,m.r*1.7,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,190,210,0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0,0,m.r*1.4,m.r*0.8,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(m.r*0.8,m.r*0.2,m.r,m.r*0.6,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.lineTo(x + pw, y - 26);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-2, -6, 10, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d6c';
  ctx.fillRect(-22, 4, 44, 4);

  ctx.moveTo(-22, -2);
  ctx.lineTo(-34, -12);
  ctx.lineTo(-30, 4);

  ctx.fillRect(cx - w/2, cy - 6, w, 12);

  ctx.fillStyle = ratio >= 0 ? '#5dd3ff' : '#ffb14e';
  if(ratio >= 0) ctx.fillRect(cx, cy - 6, ratio * (w/2), 12);
  else ctx.fillRect(cx + ratio * (w/2), cy - 6, -ratio * (w/2), 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  ctx.font = '12px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('WIND', cx, cy + 22);
}

function drawOverlay(){
  if(G.state === 'title'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,24,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d6c';
    ctx.font = 'bold 56px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('OPERATION WHIRLWIND', W/2, H*0.3);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8eef5';
    ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Pilot the plane. Pop balloons. Dodge clouds.', W/2, H*0.42);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('← / → or A / D  :  steer', W/2, H*0.52);
    ctx.fillText('Space / W / ↑  :  boost', W/2, H*0.56);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5dd3ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to start', W/2, H*0.66);
  } else if(G.state === 'over'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,24,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = G.won ? '#7ee787' : '#ff5d6c';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(G.won ? 'MISSION COMPLETE' : 'MISSION FAILED', W/2, H*0.38);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8eef5';
    ctx.font = '24px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + G.score, W/2, H*0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5dd3ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Enter to play again', W/2, H*0.6);
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(G.shake > 0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*G.shake, (Math.random()*2-1)*G.shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  for(const m of movers) drawMover(m);
  if(G.state === 'play') drawPlayer();
  if(G.flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (G.flash*0.35) + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  if(G.state === 'play') drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

(function(){

    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY', W/2, H/2+64);
  } else if(state==='win'){

    ctx.fillStyle='#eaf2ff'; ctx.font='20px monospace';

function draw(){

function loop(t){

  last=t;
  dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(3,dt));
  for(var s=0;s<Math.round(dt);s++) update();

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Cutthroats</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b0e1a;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{display:block;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:2px solid #2b3550;border-radius:6px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="820" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  const cv=document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
  const W=cv.width, H=cv.height;

  // ---------- constants ----------
  const G=0.42, FLOOR=H-44;
  const PW=34, PH=50;
  const GRAV=0.42;
  const JUMP=-13.2;
  const MOVE=3.5, MAXFALL=13;
  const KILL=3;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);
  const rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
  const overlap=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w && a.x+a.w>b.x && a.y<b.y+b.h && a.y+a.h>b.y;

  // ---------- state ----------
  let state='start';           // start | playing | win | lose
  let score=0, lives=3, kills=0;
  let timer=0;
  let spawnTimer=1.0;
  const spawnInterval=1.05;
  let shake=0;
  let flash=0;
  const player={x:0,y:0,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:false,face:1,inv:0};
  const movers=[];
  const platforms=[];
  const keys={};
  const stars=[];

  // ---------- build the scene (short loop, no long maps) ----------
  function build(){
    platforms.length=0;
    platforms.push({x:0,y:FLOOR,w:W,h:H-FLOOR,ground:true});
    const defs=[[150,430,180],[470,430,180],[300,300,220],[80,210,150],[600,210,150],[330,150,160]];
    for(const d of defs) platforms.push({x:d[0],y:d[1],w:d[2],h:16,ground:false});
    for(let i=0;i<70;i++) stars.push({x:rnd(0,W),y:rnd(0,250),r:rnd(.5,1.6),p:rnd(0,6)});
  }
  build();

  function resetPlayer(){
    player.x=W/2-PW/2; player.y=FLOOR-PH; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
    player.onGround=false; player.face=1; player.inv=1.2;
  }
  resetPlayer();

  // ---------- input ----------
  function key(e){
    const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
    if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    keys[k]=true;
    if(state==='start' && (k==='enter'||k===' ')) startGame();
    else if((state==='win'||state==='lose') && (k==='enter'||k==='r')) startGame();
  }
  function unkey(e){ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; }
  window.addEventListener('keydown',key);
  window.addEventListener('keyup',unkey);

  function startGame(){
    state='playing'; score=0; lives=3; kills=0;
    movers.length=0; spawnTimer=1.0; shake=0; flash=0;
    resetPlayer();
  }

  function spawn(){
    const fromLeft=Math.random()<0.5;
    const type=Math.random()<0.45?'bat':'dude';
    const x=fromLeft?-40:W+40;
    const y=rnd(120,340);
    const s=type==='bat'?rnd(2.2,3.4):rnd(1.6,2.4);
    const vx=fromLeft? s : -s;
    const vy=type==='bat'?0:0;
    const w=type==='bat'?42:30, h=type==='bat'?28:46;
    movers.push({type,x,y,vx,vy,w,h,phase:rnd(0,6),hop:0});
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if(state!=='playing') return;
    timer+=dt;

    // player movement
    let ax=0;
    if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) ax-=1;
    if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) ax+=1;
    if(ax!==0) player.face=ax;
    player.vx=ax*MOVE;
    if((keys['w']||keys['arrowup']||keys[' ']) && player.onGround){
      player.vy=JUMP; player.onGround=false;
    }
    player.vy+=GRAV; if(player.vy>MAXFALL) player.vy=MAXFALL;

    player.x+=player.vx;
    if(player.x<0) player.x=0;
    if(player.x>W-PW) player.x=W-PW;

    player.y+=player.vy;
    player.onGround=false;
    for(const p of platforms){
      if(!overlap({x:player.x,y:player.y,w:PW,h:PH},p)) continue;
      const prevB=player.y+PH-player.vy;
      if(player.vy>0 && prevB<=p.y+1){
        player.y=p.y-PH; player.vy=0; player.onGround=true;
      } else if(player.vy<0 && (player.y-player.vy)>=p.y+p.h-1){
        player.y=p.y+p.h; player.vy=0;
      }
    }
    if(player.inv>0) player.inv-=dt;

    // spawn
    spawnTimer-=dt;
    if(spawnTimer<=0){ spawn(); spawnTimer=spawnInterval; }

    // movers: move, drop done ones
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const m=movers[i];
      m.phase+=dt*10;
      if(m.type==='bat') m.vy=Math.sin(m.phase)*1.4;
      else {
        m.hop+=dt;
        if(m.hop>0.55){ m.vy=-7.5; m.hop=0; }
        m.vy+=GRAV; if(m.vy>MAXFALL) m.vy=MAXFALL;
      }
      m.x+=m.vx; m.y+=m.vy;

      if(m.x<-120||m.x>W+120||m.y>H+120){ movers.splice(i,1); continue; }

      // collision with player
      if(player.inv<=0 && overlap({x:player.x,y:player.y,w:PW,h:PH},{x:m.x,y:m.y,w:m.w,h:m.h})){
        const kx=(player.x+PW/2)-(m.x+m.w/2);
        const ky=(player.y+PH/2)-(m.y+m.h/2);
        const kx2=kx*kx, ky2=ky*ky;
        if(ky2<kx2){ // vertical: landed on top
          if(ky<0){
            player.y=m.y-PH; player.vy=-2;
            kill(m,i);
          } else {
            hurt();
          }
        } else { // horizontal: side hit
          hurt();
        }
      }
    }

    if(player.y>H+80){ lose(); }
    if(shake>0) shake-=dt*40;
    if(flash>0) flash-=dt*3;
  }

  function kill(m,i){
    movers.splice(i,1);
    kills++;
    score+=100;
    shake=6; flash=1;
  }
  function hurt(){
    if(player.inv>0) return;
    lives--;
    player.inv=1.4;
    shake=10;
    if(lives<=0) lose();
  }
  function win(){ state='win'; }
  function lose(){ state='lose'; }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0) ctx.translate(rnd(-shake,shake),rnd(-shake,shake));

    // sky
    const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    sky.addColorStop(0,'#0d1330');
    sky.addColorStop(.5,'#1a2150');
    sky.addColorStop(.85,'#3a2550');
    sky.addColorStop(1,'#5a2f4a');
    ctx.fillStyle=sky; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);

    // stars
    for(const s of stars){
      const tw=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(timer*2+s.p);
      ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+0.6*tw;
      ctx.fillStyle='#cfe0ff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle='#f4ecd0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-140,110,42,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#e2d7b4';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-150,100,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-128,120,6,0,7); ctx.fill();

    // far hills
    ctx.fillStyle='#241a3d';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,FLOOR);
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=40) ctx.lineTo(x,FLOOR-60-Math.sin(x*0.02)*40);
    ctx.lineTo(W,FLOOR); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    // platforms
    for(const p of platforms){
      if(p.ground){
        ctx.fillStyle='#2b2436'; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.w,p.h);
        ctx.fillStyle='#3a3048'; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.w,6);
        ctx.fillStyle='#201a2c';
        for(let x=p.x+10;x<p.x+p.w;x+=40){
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,p.y); ctx.lineTo(x+18,p.y+10); ctx.lineTo(x-18,p.y+10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        }
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle='#5a4638'; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.w,p.h);
        ctx.fillStyle='#7a5f48'; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.w,5);
        ctx.fillStyle='#3a2c22'; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y+p.h-3,p.w,3);
      }
    }

    // movers
    for(const m of movers) drawMover(m);

    // player
    if(!(player.inv>0 && Math.floor(timer*20)%2===0)) drawPlayer();

    ctx.restore();

    // flash
    if(flash>0){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,180,'+(flash*0.5)+')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }

    drawHUD();
    if(state!=='playing') drawOverlay();
  }

  function drawMover(m){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x+m.w/2,m.y+m.h/2);
    if(m.type==='bat'){
      const flap=Math.sin(m.phase)*0.6;
      ctx.fillStyle='#2a1f45';
      // wings
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-4,0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-26,-14-flap*10,-30,6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-18,4,-4,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(4,0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(26,-14-flap*10,30,6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18,4,4,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // body
      ctx.fillStyle='#3b2b58';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,9,11,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
      // ears
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,-9); ctx.lineTo(-8,-18); ctx.lineTo(-1,-10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(4,-9); ctx.lineTo(8,-18); ctx.lineTo(1,-10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff5b5b';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-3,-2,2,0,7); ctx.arc(3,-2,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      const dir=m.vx>0?1:-1;
      ctx.scale(dir,1);
      const bob=Math.sin(m.phase)*2;
      // legs
      ctx.fillStyle='#20304a';
      ctx.fillRect(-9,8,7,20); ctx.fillRect(2,8,7,20);
      // coat
      ctx.fillStyle='#33507a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,-8+bob); ctx.lineTo(12,-8+bob); ctx.lineTo(15,12); ctx.lineTo(-15,12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // head
      ctx.fillStyle='#e7c9a8';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-16+bob,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
      // hat
      ctx.fillStyle='#1c2740';
      ctx.fillRect(-11,-26+bob,22,5);
      ctx.fillRect(-8,-34+bob,16,9);
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle='#c0392b';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4,-17+bob,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(player.x+PW/2, player.y+PH/2);
    const f=player.face;
    const run=player.onGround && (player.vx!==0);
    const step=Math.sin(timer*14)* (run?4:0);
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a2f4a';
    ctx.fillRect(-10,8,8,20); ctx.fillRect(2,8,8,20);
    // torso
    ctx.fillStyle='#3f5a86';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,-10); ctx.lineTo(12,-10); ctx.lineTo(15,12); ctx.lineTo(-15,12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // arm / knife
    ctx.fillStyle='#3f5a86';
    ctx.fillRect(f>0?6:-14,-4,8,16);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(f*18,2); ctx.rotate(f*0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle='#d8dde6'; ctx.fillRect(-2,-2,16,4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8a5a2a'; ctx.fillRect(-6,-3,5,6);
    ctx.restore();
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle='#e7c9a8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-18,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
    // hat
    ctx.fillStyle='#22304f';
    ctx.fillRect(-12,-28,24,5);
    ctx.fillRect(-9,-37,18,9);
    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle='#20304a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f*3,-19,2,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.textBaseline='top';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,40);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f2e7c9';
    ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score,18,9);
    ctx.fillText('KILLS  '+kills,230,9);
    // lives as hearts
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const hx=W-170+i*40, hy=20;
      ctx.fillStyle=i<lives?'#e0455a':'#3a2530';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx,hy+4);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx-9,hy-6,hx-9,hy+10,hx,hy+14);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx+9,hy+10,hx+9,hy-6,hx,hy+4);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawOverlay(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,8,20,.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    const cx=W/2, cy=H/2;
    if(state==='start'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8b74a'; ctx.font='bold 64px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('CUTTHROATS',cx,cy-90);
      ctx.fillStyle='#cfd8ea'; ctx.font='24px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Stomp the bats and cutthroats from above.',cx,cy-20);
      ctx.fillText('A / D or \u2190 \u2192  to move      W / \u2191 / Space  to jump',cx,cy+18);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8b74a'; ctx.font='22px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play',cx,cy+70);
    } else if(state==='win'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#7ee08a'; ctx.font='bold 54px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!',cx,cy-60);
      ctx.fillStyle='#cfd8ea'; ctx.font='26px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Final score: '+score+'    Kills: '+kills,cx,cy);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8b74a'; ctx.font='22px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again',cx,cy+60);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle='#e0455a'; ctx.font='bold 54px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',cx,cy-60);
      ctx.fillStyle='#cfd8ea'; ctx.font='26px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Score: '+score+'    Kills: '+kills,cx,cy);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e8b74a'; ctx.font='22px Georgia';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or R to retry',cx,cy+60);
    }
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last=performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
    if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Dragonworld</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05060f;overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
  #game{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W*DPR); canvas.height = Math.floor(H*DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W+"px"; canvas.style.height = H+"px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---- state ----
let state = "start";       // start | playing | win | lose
let score = 0;
const TARGET = 5;          // dragons to slay to win
let lives = 3;
let time = 0;
let spawnT = 0;
const spawnGap = 1.6;
let fireCd = 0;
const fireRate = 0.16;
let hurtCd = 0;

// ---- movers: one array, each has x,y,vx,vy ----
const movers = [];
function addMover(m){ movers.push(m); }
function clearMovers(){ movers.length = 0; }

const mouse = { x:0, y:0, down:false, has:false };

// ---- input ----
function toLocal(e){
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", e=>{ const p = toLocal(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.has = true; });
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", e=>{ const p = toLocal(e); mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y; mouse.has = true; mouse.down = true; handleTap(); });
canvas.addEventListener("mouseup", ()=>{ mouse.down = false; });
canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", ()=>{ mouse.down = false; });
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", e=>{ e.preventDefault(); const t = e.changedTouches[0]; const p = toLocal(t); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.has=true; mouse.down=true; handleTap(); }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e=>{ e.preventDefault(); const t = e.changedTouches[0]; const p = toLocal(t); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.has=true; }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchend", e=>{ e.preventDefault(); mouse.down=false; }, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k===" "||k==="enter"){
    if(state==="start") startGame();
    else if(state==="win"||state==="lose") startGame();
    else handleTap();
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  if(k==="r" && (state==="win"||state==="lose")) startGame();
});

function handleTap(){
  if(state==="start"||state==="win"||state==="lose"){ startGame(); return; }
  if(fireCd<=0){ fire(); fireCd = fireRate; }
}

function startGame(){
  clearMovers();
  state = "playing"; score = 0; lives = 3; time = 0; spawnT = 0; fireCd = 0; hurtCd = 0;
  spawnDragon();
}

function fire(){
  const dx = mouse.x - 0, dy = mouse.y - (H-46);
  const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
  addMover({ kind:"fire", x:0, y:H-46, vx:dx/d*920, vy:dy/d*920, life:1.6, r:5, done:false });
}

function spawnDragon(){
  const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
  const speed = 70 + Math.random()*70 + score*4;
  const y = 120 + Math.random()*Math.max(60,(H-300));
  const x = fromLeft ? -60 : W+60;
  const vx = fromLeft ? speed : -speed;
  addMover({ kind:"dragon", x, y, vx, vy:0,
              baseY:y, amp:26+Math.random()*30,
              phase:Math.random()*6.28, freq:2+Math.random()*1.5,
              r:30, hp:2, wing:Math.random()*6.28,
              color: pickColor(), done:false });
}

function pickColor(){
  const c = ["#3fb0ff","#ff5a5a","#ffcf4a","#7CFFB2"];
  return c[(Math.random()*c.length)|0];
}

// ---- update ----
function update(dt){
  time += dt;
  if(state!=="playing") return;
  spawnT += dt;
  if(spawnT >= spawnGap){ spawnT = 0; spawnDragon(); }
  if(fireCd>0) fireCd -= dt;
  if(hurtCd>0) hurtCd -= dt;

  const M = movers;
  for(let i=M.length-1; i>=0; i--){
    const m = M[i];
    if(m.kind==="dragon"){
      m.x += m.vx*dt;
      m.phase += m.freq*dt;
      m.y = m.baseY + Math.sin(m.phase)*m.amp;
      m.wing += dt*9;
      if(m.x < -90 || m.x > W+90){
        if(m.hp>0){ lives--; hurtCd = 0.5; }
        M.splice(i,1);
        if(lives<=0){ state="lose"; }
        continue;
      }
    } else if(m.kind==="fire"){
      m.x += m.vx*dt;
      m.y += m.vy*dt;
      m.life -= dt;
      if(m.life<=0 || m.x<-30 || m.x>W+30 || m.y<-30 || m.y>H+30){
        M.splice(i,1); continue;
      }
      // collide with dragons
      for(let j=M.length-1; j>=0; j--){
        const d = M[j];
        if(d.kind!=="dragon" || d===m) continue;
        const dx = d.x-m.x, dy = d.y-m.y;
        if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (d.r+m.r)*(d.r+m.r)){
          d.hp -= 1;
          M.splice(i,1);
          if(d.hp<=0){
            M.splice(j,1);
            score++;
            if(score>=TARGET){ state="win"; }
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// ---- draw helpers ----
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function star(cx,cy,outer,inner,points,fill){
  ctx.beginPath();
  for(let i=0;i<points*2;i++){
    const r = i%2===0?outer:inner;
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*Math.PI/points;
    const x = cx+Math.cos(a)*r, y = cy+Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill();
}
function drawFlame(x,y,s,base){
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,s*1.5);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#fff7cf");
  g.addColorStop(0.5,base);
  g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,120,40,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,s*1.5,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#141a3a");
  g.addColorStop(0.55,"#2a2350");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#5a2f52");
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // moon
  const mx = W*0.78, my = H*0.22, mr = Math.min(W,H)*0.09;
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx,my,mr*0.5,mx,my,mr*2.4);
  glow.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,244,214,0.5)");
  glow.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,244,214,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glow; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx,my,mr*2.4,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe9b8"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx,my,mr,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(210,180,120,0.5)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx-mr*0.3,my-mr*0.2,mr*0.18,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx+mr*0.25,my+mr*0.3,mr*0.13,0,6.29); ctx.fill();

  // stars
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const x = (i*97.3 % W);
    const y = (i*53.7 % (H*0.55));
    const tw = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(time*2 + i);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,"+(0.3+0.5*tw)+")";
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }

  // far mountains
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2f5c";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,H*0.62);
  for(let i=0;i<=8;i++){
    const x = (i/8)*W;
    const y = H*0.62 - Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.3))*H*0.14;
    ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // near hills
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4a3560";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,H*0.74);
  for(let i=0;i<=6;i++){
    const x = (i/6)*W;
    const y = H*0.74 - Math.abs(Math.cos(i*1.7))*H*0.08;
    ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H*0.82,0,H);
  gg.addColorStop(0,"#241a34");
  gg.addColorStop(1,"#120c1e");
  ctx.fillStyle = gg; ctx.fillRect(0,H*0.82,W,H*0.18+2);
  // grass tufts
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,200,150,0.35)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
    const x = (i*137 % W);
    const y = H*0.85 + (i%5)*6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x-3,y-8); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x+3,y-8); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawCastle(){
  const cw = Math.min(W*0.24, 260);
  const cx = W/2 - cw/2;
  const topY = H - 150;
  const h = 150;
  // body
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,topY,0,H);
  bg.addColorStop(0,"#6b5a86"); bg.addColorStop(1,"#3d3350");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(cx,topY,cw,h);
  // crenellations
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7c6a99";
  const teeth = 6; const tw = cw/teeth;
  for(let i=0;i<teeth;i++){ if(i%2===0) ctx.fillRect(cx+i*tw, topY-14, tw*0.6, 14); }
  // tower
  const tW = cw*0.28, tH = 70, tX = W/2 - tW/2, tY = topY - tH;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8a78a8"; ctx.fillRect(tX,tY,tW,tH);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#6b5a86";
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ ctx.fillRect(tX+i*(tW/3), tY-12, tW/3*0.6, 12); }
  // flag
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2138"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W/2, tY-12); ctx.lineTo(W/2, tY-52); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcf4a";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W/2, tY-52); ctx.lineTo(W/2+34, tY-42); ctx.lineTo(W/2, tY-32); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // door
  ctx.fillStyle = "#241a30";
  roundRect(W/2 - 26, H-58, 52, 58, 18); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffcf4a"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; roundRect(W/2 - 26, H-58, 52, 58, 18); ctx.stroke();
  // windows
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd98a";
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ const wx = cx + cw*(0.22+ i*0.28); roundRect(wx-9, topY+40, 18, 26, 8); ctx.fill(); }
  // glow
  const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H-40,10,W/2,H-40,140);
  gl.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,210,140,0.25)"); gl.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,210,140,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gl; ctx.fillRect(W/2-160,H-180,320,220);
}

function drawDragon(m){
  const dir = m.vx>0 ? 1 : -1;
  const flap = Math.sin(m.wing);
  const c = m.color;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
  ctx.scale(dir,1);
  // tail
  ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 10; ctx.lineCap="round";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-26,2);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-52, 10+flap*6, -70, -2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // tail tip
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcf4a";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-70,-2); ctx.lineTo(-84,-10); ctx.lineTo(-80,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // far wing
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,-4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30,-30-flap*20, -60,-18-flap*26);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30,-6, -2,-4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // body
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-24,0,24);
  bg.addColorStop(0,c); bg.addColorStop(1,"#1e1a2e");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,34,22,0,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  // belly
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe3a6";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(6,8,24,12,0,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  // near wing
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,-6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-24,-40-flap*24, -58,-26-flap*30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30,-10, -2,-6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffe3a6"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6,-8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-30,-24-flap*20, -50,-20-flap*26); ctx.stroke();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(30,-8,20,16,0,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  // snout
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(44,-10); ctx.lineTo(66,-6); ctx.lineTo(44,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // horn
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe3a6";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(26,-22); ctx.lineTo(20,-40); ctx.lineTo(34,-24); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(34,-12,5,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(36,-12,2.4,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  // nostril
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a2e"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(58,-5,1.6,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  // hp pips
  if(m.hp>1){
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a5a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-4,-34,4,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFire(m){
  drawFlame(m.x, m.y, m.r*2.2, "#ff8a3a");
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff2c4";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r*0.7,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  // score
  ctx.font = "bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  roundRect(14,14,210,40,10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcf4a";
  ctx.fillText("Slain  "+score+" / "+TARGET, 26, 34);
  // lives
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  for(let i=0;i<TARGET;i++){
    const x = W-24 - i*30, y = 30;
    const on = i < lives;
    star(x, y, 12, 5, 5, on ? "#ff5a5a" : "rgba(255,90,90,0.25)");
  }
  // crosshair
  if(state==="playing"){
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 12, 0, 6.29); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x-18, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x-6, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x+6, mouse.y); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x+18, mouse.y);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y-18); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y-6);
    ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y+6); ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y+18);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawOverlay(kind){
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6,6,20,0.6)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
  if(kind==="start"){
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcf4a"; ctx.font = "bold "+Math.min(W*0.12,72)+"px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Dragonworld", cx, cy-70);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.font = "20px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Dragons are raiding the castle. Slay "+TARGET+" to win.", cx, cy-10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9fd6ff"; ctx.font = "17px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Move the mouse to aim. Click / tap / Space to fire.", cx, cy+24);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcf4a"; ctx.font = "bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";

}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawCastle();
  for(let i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
    const m = movers[i];

  }
  if(hurtCd>0){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,60,"+(hurtCd*0.35)+")";

  drawHUD();
  if(state==="start") drawOverlay("start");
  else if(state==="win") drawOverlay("win");
  else if(state==="lose") drawOverlay("lose");
}

// ---- loop ----
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt = (now-last)/1000; last = now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt = 0.05;

  draw();

resize();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Seastalker</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#02060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;overflow:hidden}
  #game{display:block;box-shadow:0 0 60px #053055,0 0 0 3px #0a2540;border-radius:4px;max-width:96vw;max-height:94vh}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var canvas=document.getElementById('game');
var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
var W=960,H=600;

var state='start';
var score=0, best=0;
var bullets=[], enemies=[], particles=[];
var player={x:W/2,y:H-70,vx:0,vy:0,r:15,fireCd:0};
var keys={};
var t=0, lastTime=0;

var G=220, JUMP=-460, MOVE=330, FIRE=170;

function reset(){
  state='play'; score=0;
  bullets=[]; enemies=[]; particles=[];
  player.x=W/2; player.y=H-70; player.vx=0; player.vy=0; player.fireCd=0;
}

function spawnParticles(x,y,color,count){
  for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
    var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s=40+Math.random()*140;
    particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5,max:1,color:color,r:2+Math.random()*3});
  }
}

function update(dt){
  t+=dt;
  if(state==='play'){
    if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA']) player.x-=MOVE*dt;
    if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD']) player.x+=MOVE*dt;
    if((keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']||keys['Space']) && player.y>H-70){
      player.vy=JUMP;
    }
    player.vy+=G*dt;
    player.y+=player.vy*dt;
    if(player.y>H-70){player.y=H-70;player.vy=0;}
    if(player.x<player.r) player.x=player.r;
    if(player.x>W-player.r) player.x=W-player.r;
    player.fireCd-=dt;
    if((keys['KeyJ']||keys['KeyK']||keys['Enter']) && player.fireCd<=0){
      bullets.push({x:player.x,y:player.y-20,vx:0,vy:-FIRE,r:5});
      player.fireCd=0.16;
    }
  }

  if(state!=='over'){
    if(state==='play' && Math.random()<0.028){
      var ex=40+Math.random()*(W-80);
      enemies.push({x:ex,y:-20,vx:0,vy:70+Math.random()*60,r:15});
    }
  }

  for(var i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var b=bullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    if(b.y<-20) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  for(var j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
    var e=enemies[j];
    e.x+=e.vx*dt; e.y+=e.vy*dt;
    if(e.x<e.r){e.x=e.r;e.vx=-e.vx;}
    if(e.x>W-e.r){e.x=W-e.r;e.vx=-e.vx;}
    if(e.y>H+30){enemies.splice(j,1);continue;}
    for(var k=bullets.length-1;k>=0;k--){
      var bl=bullets[k];
      var dx=e.x-bl.x, dy=e.y-bl.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (e.r+bl.r)*(e.r+bl.r)){
        enemies.splice(j,1);
        bullets.splice(k,1);
        score+=10;
        spawnParticles(e.x,e.y,'#ffcf5c',12);
        break;
      }
    }
    if(state==='play'){
      var px=player.x-e.x, py=player.y-e.y;
      if(px*px+py*py < (player.r+e.r)*(player.r+e.r)){
        state='over';
        if(score>best) best=score;
        spawnParticles(player.x,player.y,'#ff6b6b',30);
      }
    }
  }

  for(var p=particles.length-1;p>=0;p--){
    var pt=particles[p];
    pt.x+=pt.vx*dt; pt.y+=pt.vy*dt; pt.vy+=120*dt;
    pt.life-=dt;
    if(pt.life<=0) particles.splice(p,1);
  }
}

function draw(){
  var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a2540');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0e3a5c');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#051826');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  for(var i=0;i<6;i++){
    var x=(i*180+t*20)%(W+180)-90;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.06;
    ctx.fillStyle='#bfe6ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x+60,0); ctx.lineTo(x-120,H); ctx.lineTo(x-180,H);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(var q=0;q<25;q++){
    var bx=(q*97)%W;
    var by=(H-((q*53+t*30)%(H+40)));
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle='#cfefff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx,by,1+(q%3),0,7); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  ctx.fillStyle='#1c4a63';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,H-40);
  for(var xx=0;xx<=W;xx+=40) ctx.lineTo(xx,H-40-Math.sin(xx*0.05+t)*8);
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a6480';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,H-18);
  for(var xx2=0;xx2<=W;xx2+=40) ctx.lineTo(xx2,H-18-Math.sin(xx2*0.05+t+2)*6);
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  for(var b=0;b<bullets.length;b++){
    var bl=bullets[b];
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,180,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bl.x,bl.y+4,7,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff2c0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bl.x,bl.y,bl.r,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }

  for(var e=0;e<enemies.length;e++){
    var en=enemies[e];
    ctx.fillStyle='#3a1420';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(en.x,en.y-en.r);
    ctx.lineTo(en.x+en.r,en.y);
    ctx.lineTo(en.x,en.y+en.r);
    ctx.lineTo(en.x-en.r,en.y);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#7a2530';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(en.x,en.y,en.r*0.55,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23c';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(en.x-4,en.y-3,3,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(en.x+4,en.y-3,3,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }

  if(state!=='over'){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.fillStyle='#0f2c3f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,6,18,12,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#1f5f7a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,2,16,10,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2f89a8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-10,9,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#051826';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-10,5,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#7fe0ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(2,-11,1.6,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#1f5f7a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,4); ctx.lineTo(-26,10); ctx.lineTo(-14,12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(var p=0;p<particles.length;p++){
    var pt=particles[p];
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,pt.life/pt.max);
    ctx.fillStyle=pt.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.r,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,245,255,0.95)';
  ctx.font='24px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score,20,34);
  ctx.font='15px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(180,215,235,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('BEST  '+best,20,56);

  if(state==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(2,8,16,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fe3ff'; ctx.font='bold 64px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('SEASTALKER',W/2,210);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,235,255,0.85)'; ctx.font='20px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('A famous dive. Shoot the falling creatures. Don\'t get caught.',W/2,260);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a'; ctx.font='18px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('Move:  A / D  or  ← →',W/2,320);
    ctx.fillText('Jump:  W  or  ↑  or  Space',W/2,350);
    ctx.fillText('Fire:  J  or  K  or  Enter',W/2,380);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.95)'; ctx.font='bold 24px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press  ENTER  to begin',W/2,450);
  } else if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(2,8,16,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8a8a'; ctx.font='bold 56px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('LOST TO THE DEEP',W/2,250);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a'; ctx.font='28px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final score:  '+score,W/2,310);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'; ctx.font='22px Georgia,serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press  ENTER  to dive again',W/2,380);
  }
}

function loop(now){
  if(!lastTime) lastTime=now;
  var dt=(now-lastTime)/1000; lastTime=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.code==='Enter'){
    if(state==='start'||state==='over') reset();
  }
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space'].indexOf(e.code)>=0) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){
  keys[e.code]=false;
});

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ballyhoo</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b1020;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-family:'Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{display:block;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 0 6px #14203a}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

const GRAVITY = 0.42;
const BOUNCE = 0.62;
const BALL_R = 9;
const PADDLE_W = 120;
const PADDLE_H = 18;
const PADDLE_SPEED = 12;
const MAX_SPEED = 20;
const TARGET = 20;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let message = '';
let messageTimer = 0;
let mouseX = W / 2;
let keys = { left:false, right:false };

// All moving objects (ball, paddles, targets, stars, particles) live in ONE array.
let movers = [];

const ball = { x: W/2, y: H*0.35, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R, kind:'ball', active:false, trail:[] };
const paddle = { x: W/2, y: H-52, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H, kind:'paddle' };
const topPaddle = { x: W/2, y: 52, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H, kind:'topPaddle', speed: 2.2, dir: 1 };

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function inRect(b, r){ return b.x + b.r > r.x - r.w/2 && b.x - b.r < r.x + r.w/2 && b.y + b.r > r.y - r.h/2 && b.y - b.r < r.y + r.h/2; }

function addStars(n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    movers.push({ x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, vx:0, vy:0, r:Math.random()*1.6+0.6,
      kind:'star', phase:Math.random()*6.28, spd:Math.random()*0.05+0.02 });
  }
}

function addTarget(x, y, kind){
  movers.push({ x, y, vx:0, vy:0, r: kind==='big'?34:26, kind, hp: kind==='big'?2:1,
    phase:Math.random()*6.28, spin:0 });
}

function addParticles(x, y, color, n, spread){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.28;
    const sp = Math.random()*spread + 1;
    movers.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp - 1, r:Math.random()*3+2,
      kind:'particle', life:40, max:40, color });
  }
}

function launchBall(){
  const ang = (Math.random()*0.5 + 0.25) * (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1);
  const sp = 7;
  ball.vx = Math.sin(ang)*sp;
  ball.vy = -Math.cos(ang)*sp;
  ball.active = true;
}

function resetBall(){
  ball.x = W/2; ball.y = H*0.35; ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
  ball.active = false; ball.trail = [];
  state = 'aim';
}

function startGame(){
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  movers = [ ball, paddle, topPaddle ];
  addStars(60);
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const x = 150 + (W-300) * (i/4) + (Math.random()*40-20);
    const y = 150 + (Math.random()*260);
    addTarget(x, y, i===2 ? 'big' : 'small');
  }
  state = 'aim';
}

function loseLife(){
  lives--;
  if(lives <= 0){ state = 'over'; message = 'GAME OVER'; messageTimer = 999; }
  else { message = 'LIFE LOST'; messageTimer = 60; resetBall(); }
}

function checkWin(){
  if(movers.some(m => m.kind==='small' || m.kind==='big')) return false;
  state = 'win';
  message = 'YOU WIN!';
  messageTimer = 999;
  return true;
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
function setMouse(e){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', setMouse);
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); setMouse(e.touches[0]); }, { passive:false });

function primaryAction(){
  if(state === 'start') startGame();
  else if(state === 'aim') launchBall();
  else if(state === 'over' || state === 'win') state = 'start';
}
canvas.addEventListener('click', primaryAction);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); setMouse(e.touches[0]); primaryAction(); }, { passive:false });

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') keys.left = true;
  if(k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') keys.right = true;
  if(k === ' ' || k === 'enter'){ e.preventDefault(); primaryAction(); }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') keys.left = false;
  if(k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') keys.right = false;
});

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(){
  // player paddle follows input / mouse
  if(keys.left) paddle.x -= PADDLE_SPEED;
  if(keys.right) paddle.x += PADDLE_SPEED;
  if(!keys.left && !keys.right) paddle.x += (mouseX - paddle.x) * 0.35;
  paddle.x = Math.max(paddle.w/2, Math.min(W - paddle.w/2, paddle.x));

  // moving top paddle
  topPaddle.x += topPaddle.speed * topPaddle.dir;
  if(topPaddle.x > W - topPaddle.w/2){ topPaddle.x = W - topPaddle.w/2; topPaddle.dir = -1; }
  if(topPaddle.x < topPaddle.w/2){ topPaddle.x = topPaddle.w/2; topPaddle.dir = 1; }

  // animate targets
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.kind === 'small' || m.kind === 'big'){
      m.phase += 0.03;
      m.spin += (m.kind === 'big' ? 0.04 : 0.06);
    }
  }

  // ball physics
  if(ball.active){
    ball.vy += GRAVITY;
    const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    if(sp > MAX_SPEED){ ball.vx = ball.vx/sp*MAX_SPEED; ball.vy = ball.vy/sp*MAX_SPEED; }
    ball.x += ball.vx;
    ball.y += ball.vy;

    // trail
    ball.trail.push({ x:ball.x, y:ball.y });
    if(ball.trail.length > 12) ball.trail.shift();

    // walls
    if(ball.x - ball.r < 0){ ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if(ball.x + ball.r > W){ ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if(ball.y - ball.r < 0){ ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // bottom paddle
    if(inRect(ball, paddle) && ball.vy > 0){
      ball.y = paddle.y - paddle.h/2 - ball.r;
      const rel = (ball.x - paddle.x) / (paddle.w/2);
      const ang = rel * 0.9;
      const sp2 = Math.min(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) + 0.6, MAX_SPEED);
      ball.vx = Math.sin(ang)*sp2;
      ball.vy = -Math.abs(Math.cos(ang)*sp2);
      addParticles(ball.x, ball.y, '#7fe7ff', 8, 3);
    }

    // top paddle
    if(inRect(ball, topPaddle) && ball.vy < 0){
      ball.y = topPaddle.y + topPaddle.h/2 + ball.r;
      ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy) * BOUNCE;
      addParticles(ball.x, ball.y, '#ffd24a', 6, 2.5);
    }

    // targets
    for(const t of movers){
      if(t.kind === 'small' || t.kind === 'big'){
        const dx = ball.x - t.x, dy = ball.y - t.y;
        if(dx*dx + dy*dy < (t.r + ball.r)*(t.r + ball.r)){
          t.hp--;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
          ball.vx = ball.vx * 0.5 + (dx/d) * 4;
          ball.vy = ball.vy * 0.5 + (dy/d) * 4;
          addParticles(t.x, t.y, t.kind==='big'?'#ff6b9d':'#ffd24a', 14, 4);
          if(t.hp <= 0){
            score += (t.kind === 'big' ? 50 : 20);
            message = (t.kind === 'big' ? '+50' : '+20');
            messageTimer = 40;
            movers = movers.filter(m => m !== t);
            if(checkWin()) return;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // fell out the bottom
    if(ball.y - ball.r > H){
      addParticles(ball.x, H-10, '#ff5470', 18, 5);
      loseLife();
    }
  }

  // particles: gravity + fade, drop when done
  for(const p of movers){
    if(p.kind === 'particle'){
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.life--;
    }
  }
  movers = movers.filter(m => !(m.kind === 'particle' && m.life <= 0));

  // stars twinkle (no drop)
  for(const s of movers){ if(s.kind === 'star') s.phase += s.spd; }

  if(messageTimer > 0) messageTimer--;
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#141f45');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0f1a38');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0a1128');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // side glow
  const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.35,40,W/2,H*0.35,W*0.7);
  rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(80,120,220,0.18)');
  rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rg;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  for(const s of movers){
    if(s.kind !== 'star') continue;
    const a = 0.35 + 0.4*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.phase));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,235,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 6.283);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPaddle(p, color, glow){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, p.y-p.h/2, 0, p.y+p.h/2);
  g.addColorStop(0, color);
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0c1330');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const x = p.x - p.w/2, y = p.y - p.h/2;
  ctx.roundRect(x, y, p.w, p.h, 9);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(x+8, y+3, p.w-16, 3);
}

function drawTarget(t){
  const bob = Math.sin(t.phase)*4;
  const x = t.x, y = t.y + bob;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(t.spin);
  const big = t.kind === 'big';
  const r = t.r;
  // glow
  ctx.shadowColor = big ? 'rgba(255,107,157,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,210,74,0.8)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 22;
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = big ? '#ff6b9d' : '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0,0,r,0,6.283);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // ring
  ctx.fillStyle = big ? '#c93b72' : '#e0a52a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0,0,r*0.62,0,6.283);
  ctx.fill();
  // inner
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4d6';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0,0,r*0.34,0,6.283);
  ctx.fill();
  // hp pips for big
  if(big){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    for(let i=0;i<t.hp;i++){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-10 + i*20, -r-10, 4, 0, 6.283);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBall(){
  // trail
  for(let i=0;i<ball.trail.length;i++){
    const t = ball.trail[i];
    const a = (i/ball.trail.length)*0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(127,231,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, ball.r*(0.4 + 0.6*i/ball.trail.length), 0, 6.283);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(127,231,255,0.9)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x-3, ball.y-3, 1, ball.x, ball.y, ball.r);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#7fe7ff');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#2b8fd6');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, 6.283);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticle(p){
  const a = p.life/p.max;
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 6.283);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fe7ff';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 24, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b9d';
  ctx.fillText('TARGETS ' + TARGET, 24, 62);
  // hearts
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const x = W-40 - i*34, y = 34;
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? '#ff5470' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x-6, y-4, 7, 0, 6.283);
    ctx.arc(x+6, y-4, 7, 0, 6.283);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x-12, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y+14);
    ctx.lineTo(x+12, y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBanner(title, sub){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,10,25,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = 'bold 72px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fe7ff';
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(127,231,255,0.6)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.font = '24px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 34);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawPaddle(topPaddle, '#ffb347', 'rgba(255,179,71,0.8)');
  drawPaddle(paddle, '#4ade80', 'rgba(74,222,128,0.8)');
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.kind === 'small' || m.kind === 'big') drawTarget(m);
    else if(m.kind === 'particle') drawParticle(m);
  }
  drawBall();
  drawHUD();

  if(messageTimer > 0 && state !== 'over' && state !== 'win'){
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.fillText(message, W/2, H/2);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  if(state === 'start') drawBanner('BALLYHOO', 'Pop every target • Click / Space / Enter to play');
  else if(state === 'aim') {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4d6';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to launch', W/2, H/2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
  else if(state === 'over') drawBanner('GAME OVER', 'Score ' + score + ' • Click to try again');
  else if(state === 'win') drawBanner('YOU WIN!', 'Score ' + score + ' • Click to play again');
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(){
  if(state === 'start' || state === 'over' || state === 'win'){
    // idle: let stars drift
    for(const s of movers){ if(s.kind === 'star') s.phase += s.spd; }
  } else {
    update();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// init with a star field so the start screen has depth
movers = [ ball, paddle, topPaddle ];
addStars(60);
loop();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>VENTURE</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    height: 100%; width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0a0a12;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
  }
  #game { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ---------- Canvas setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 960;
  const H = 560;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  function fit() {
    const s = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H);
    canvas.style.width = (W * s) + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = (H * s) + 'px';
  }
  fit();
  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);

  // ---------- Shared constants ----------
  const GRAV = 0.5;
  const GROUND = H - 60;
  const PLAYER_W = 28;
  const PLAYER_H = 34;
  const MOVE = 4.2;
  const JUMP = 13;
  const COIN_VAL = 100;
  const WIN_SCORE = 500;

  // ---------- Game state ----------
  let state = 'start';   // 'start' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
  let score = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let frame = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  // ---------- Player ----------
  const player = {
    x: W / 2 - PLAYER_W / 2,
    y: GROUND - PLAYER_H,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    w: PLAYER_W,
    h: PLAYER_H,
    onGround: true,
    face: 1,
    anim: 0
  };

  // ---------- Movers (coins, hazards, particles) ----------
  const movers = [];
  const particles = [];

  // ---------- Background stars (static) ----------
  const stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * (GROUND - 40),
      r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.4,
      tw: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      sp: Math.random() * 0.04 + 0.01
    });
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = {};
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (['arrowleft','arrowright','arrowup','arrowdown',' '].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) e.preventDefault();

    if (state === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) {
      startGame();
    } else if ((state === 'won' || state === 'lost') && (k === 'enter' || k === 'r')) {
      startGame();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  function startGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = 3;
    frame = 0;
    shake = 0;
    movers.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    player.x = W / 2 - PLAYER_W / 2;
    player.y = GROUND - PLAYER_H;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.onGround = true;
    player.face = 1;
    player.anim = 0;
    state = 'playing';
    spawnWave();
  }

  // ---------- Spawners ----------
  function spawnCoin() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -30 : W + 30;
    const y = 60 + Math.random() * (GROUND - 120);
    movers.push({
      type: 'coin',
      x, y,
      vx: (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * (2 + Math.random() * 2),
      vy: 0,
      r: 12,
      spin: 0,
      life: 0
    });
  }

  function spawnHazard() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -30 : W + 30;
    const y = 80 + Math.random() * (GROUND - 160);
    movers.push({
      type: 'hazard',
      x, y,
      vx: (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * (3 + Math.random() * 3),
      vy: 0,
      r: 14,
      spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      life: 0
    });
  }

  function spawnWave() {
    const n = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (Math.random() < 0.6) spawnCoin(); else spawnHazard();
    }
  }

  function spawnBurst(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 2,
        r: Math.random() * 3 + 1.5,
        color,
        life: 1
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Collision helpers ----------
  function circleRect(cx, cy, r, rx, ry, rw, rh) {
    const nx = Math.max(rx, Math.min(cx, rx + rw));
    const ny = Math.max(ry, Math.min(cy, ry + rh));
    const dx = cx - nx;
    const dy = cy - ny;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r;
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update() {
    frame++;
    if (shake > 0) shake -= 0.5;

    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // --- Player movement ---
    player.vx = 0;
    if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) { player.vx = -MOVE; player.face = -1; }
    if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) { player.vx = MOVE; player.face = 1; }

    if ((keys['arrowup'] || keys['w'] || keys[' ']) && player.onGround) {
      player.vy = -JUMP;
      player.onGround = false;
      spawnBurst(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h, '#8fd3ff', 8);
    }

    // --- Physics ---
    player.vy += GRAV;
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // walls
    if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
    if (player.x + player.w > W) player.x = W - player.w;

    // ground
    if (player.y + player.h >= GROUND) {
      player.y = GROUND - player.h;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    } else {
      player.onGround = false;
    }

    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 && player.onGround) player.anim += 0.25;

    // --- Spawn timer ---
    if (frame % 90 === 0) spawnWave();

    // --- Movers: move, collide, drop ---
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      m.spin += 0.15;
      m.life++;

      // off-screen? drop
      if (m.x < -60 || m.x > W + 60) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }

      // collide with player
      if (circleRect(m.x, m.y, m.r, player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h)) {
        if (m.type === 'coin') {
          score += COIN_VAL;
          spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, '#ffd54a', 12);
          movers.splice(i, 1);
          if (score >= WIN_SCORE) {
            state = 'won';
            spawnBurst(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h/2, '#ffd54a', 40);
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'hazard') {
          lives--;
          shake = 12;
          spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, '#ff5a4a', 16);
          movers.splice(i, 1);
          if (lives <= 0) {
            state = 'lost';
            spawnBurst(player.x + player.w/2, player.y + player.h/2, '#ff5a4a', 30);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Particles: move, fade, drop ---
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.15;
      p.life -= 0.02;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw helpers ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // night sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b0b22');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1440');
    g.addColorStop(0.8, '#3a1e5c');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#5c2e6e');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      s.tw += s.sp;
      const a = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(s.tw);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(2) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // distant mountains
    ctx.fillStyle = '#241a4a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND);
    ctx.lineTo(0, GROUND - 90);
    ctx.lineTo(120, GROUND - 150);
    ctx.lineTo(240, GROUND - 80);
    ctx.lineTo(380, GROUND - 170);
    ctx.lineTo(520, GROUND - 90);
    ctx.lineTo(660, GROUND - 160);
    ctx.lineTo(800, GROUND - 70);
    ctx.lineTo(900, GROUND - 140);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND - 90);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // near hills
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f2258';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND);
    ctx.lineTo(0, GROUND - 40);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(150, GROUND - 90, 300, GROUND - 45);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(450, GROUND - 10, 600, GROUND - 55);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(750, GROUND - 100, W, GROUND - 40);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, '#3a2a6a');
    gg.addColorStop(1, '#1a1440');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);

    // ground glow line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,120,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const px = player.x;
    const py = player.y;
    const w = player.w;
    const h = player.h;
    const cx = px + w / 2;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, GROUND + 4, w * 0.7, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ec9ff';
    roundRect(px, py + 8, w, h - 8, 6);
    ctx.fill();

    // chest accent
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a88c8';
    roundRect(px + 4, py + 20, w - 8, h - 24, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd9a8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, py + 6, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // helmet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b6fd6';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, py + 4, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8ff';
    ctx.fillRect(cx + player.face * 2 - 3, py - 2, 6, 3);

    // legs (animated)
    const legOff = player.onGround ? Math.sin(player.anim) * 4 : 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a4a8a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - 5, py + h - 4);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - 5 + legOff, py + h + 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + 5, py + h - 4);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 5 - legOff, py + h + 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawMovers() {
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.type === 'coin') {
        const wobble = Math.sin(m.spin) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        const rw = m.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * wobble);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#b8860b';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(m.x, m.y, rw, m.r, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(m.x, m.y, rw * 0.75, m.r * 0.75, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2b0';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(m.x - rw * 0.2, m.y - m.r * 0.2, rw * 0.25, m.r * 0.25, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (m.type === 'hazard') {
        // spike ball
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a1a1a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a4a';
        const spikes = 8;
        for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
          const a = m.spin + (i / spikes) * Math.PI * 2;
          const sx = m.x + Math.cos(a) * (m.r + 4);
          const sy = m.y + Math.sin(a) * (m.r + 4);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(m.x + Math.cos(a) * m.r * 0.6, m.y + Math.sin(a) * m.r * 0.6);
          ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.cos(a) * 6, sy + Math.sin(a) * 6);
          ctx.lineTo(m.x + Math.cos(a + 0.4) * m.r * 0.6, m.y + Math.sin(a + 0.4) * m.r * 0.6);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a0808';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 20, 34);

    // progress bar
    const bw = 200;
    const bx = W - bw - 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    roundRect(bx, 18, bw, 14, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    const frac = Math.min(1, score / WIN_SCORE);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd54a';
    roundRect(bx, 18, bw * frac, 14, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '12px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GOAL ' + WIN_SCORE, bx + bw / 2, 48);

    // lives
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a5a';
    let hearts = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += '\u2665 ';
    ctx.fillText(hearts, 20, 62);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, color, sub) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,6,18,0.78)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 64px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd6ff';
    ctx.font = '20px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd3ff';
    ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  OR  SPACE  TO PLAY', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawMovers();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();

    ctx.restore();

    if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();
    else if (state === 'start') {
      drawHUD();
      drawOverlay('VENTURE', '#4ec9ff', 'Grab coins. Dodge the spike balls. Reach ' + WIN_SCORE + '.');
    }
    else if (state === 'won') {
      drawHUD();
      drawOverlay('YOU WIN', '#ffd54a', 'Final score: ' + score + '  \u2014  the venture is complete.');
    }
    else if (state === 'lost') {
      drawHUD();
      drawOverlay('GAME OVER', '#ff5a4a', 'You fell to the hazards. Score: ' + score + '.');
    }
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

JACKAL

Guide the jackal across the dark savanna. Dodge the fireflies, collect the glowing berries, and reach the golden den before the fire runs out.
