<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tron Disk Bounce</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
    background: #04050c;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif;
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none;
  }
  #game { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; cursor: crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---------- Canvas ----------
  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  var WIN = 10;
  var PLAYER_R = 20;
  var DISK_R = 9;
  var PLAYER_SPEED = 540;
  var DISK_SPEED = 300;
  var DISK_ACCEL = 18;
  var DISK_MAX = 540;
  var DISK_LIFE = 10;
  var GRAVITY = 0;
  var BOUNCE = 0.96;

  // ---------- State ----------
  var state = 'menu';   // 'menu' | 'playing' | 'won' | 'lost'
  var score = 0;
  var lives = 3;
  var time = 0;
  var shake = 0;
  var flash = 0;
  var lastMsg = '';
  var lastMsgTime = -10;
  var mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
  var keys = {};

  var player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: PLAYER_R, trail: [] };
  var disks = [];   // every mover: {x, y, vx, vy, r, life, hue, trail}
  var particles = [];
  var sparks = [];

  function resetPlayer() {
    player.x = W / 2; player.y = H * 0.72;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.trail.length = 0;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3;
    disks.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    sparks.length = 0;
    shake = 0; flash = 0;
    lastMsg = ''; lastMsgTime = -10;
    resetPlayer();
    state = 'playing';
  }

  function start() {
    if (state === 'menu') newGame();
    else if (state === 'won' || state === 'lost') newGame();
  }

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  function spawnDisk() {
    var fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    var x = fromLeft ? -DISK_R : W + DISK_R;
    var y = rand(H * 0.12, H * 0.55);
    var speed = DISK_SPEED + Math.min(score * 10, 120);
    var ang = rand(-0.5, 0.5);
    var dir = fromLeft ? 1 : -1;
    var d = {
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed * dir,
      vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
      r: DISK_R,
      life: DISK_LIFE,
      hue: rand(165, 210),
      trail: []
    };
    disks.push(d);
  }

  function addSparks(x, y, hue, n, power) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      var s = rand(40, power);
      sparks.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: rand(0.3, 0.8), hue: hue });
    }
  }

  function addRings(x, y, hue, n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      particles.push({ x: x, y: y, r: 2, max: rand(30, 70), life: rand(0.4, 0.9), maxLife: 0.9, hue: hue, type: 'ring' });
    }
  }

  function addDebris(x, y, hue, n) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      var s = rand(60, 260);
      particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: rand(0.5, 1.2), maxLife: 1.2, hue: hue, type: 'dot' });
    }
  }

  function showMsg(t) { lastMsg = t; lastMsgTime = time; }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function onMove(e) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = e.clientX - r.left;
    mouseY = e.clientY - r.top;
  }
  function onDown(e) {
    onMove(e);
    if (state === 'menu' || state === 'won' || state === 'lost') start();
  }
  function onKey(e) {
    var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state === 'menu' || state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
      if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') start();
    }
  }
  function onKeyUp(e) { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var t = e.touches[0]; onMove(t); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); var t = e.touches[0]; onMove(t); if (state === 'menu' || state === 'won' || state === 'lost') start(); }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    time += dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 3);

    if (state === 'playing') {
      // Player: follow mouse
      var tx = mouseX, ty = mouseY;
      player.x += (tx - player.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
      player.y += (ty - player.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 14);
      player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
      player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));

      // Keyboard nudge
      var kx = 0, ky = 0;
      if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) kx -= 1;
      if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) kx += 1;
      if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) ky -= 1;
      if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) ky += 1;
      if (kx || ky) {
        var m = Math.hypot(kx, ky) || 1;
        player.x += (kx / m) * PLAYER_SPEED * dt;
        player.y += (ky / m) * PLAYER_SPEED * dt;
        player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(W - player.r, player.x));
        player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(H - player.r, player.y));
      }
      player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y });
      if (player.trail.length > 24) player.trail.shift();

      // Spawn disks
      if (Math.random() < dt * (0.9 + score * 0.12)) spawnDisk();

      // Disks
      for (var i = disks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var d = disks[i];
        d.x += d.vx * dt;
        d.y += d.vy * dt;
        d.life -= dt;
        d.trail.push({ x: d.x, y: d.y });
        if (d.trail.length > 14) d.trail.shift();

        var removed = false;

        // Wall bounce
        if (d.x < d.r) { d.x = d.r; d.vx = Math.abs(d.vx) * BOUNCE; addSparks(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 4, 120); }
        else if (d.x > W - d.r) { d.x = W - d.r; d.vx = -Math.abs(d.vx) * BOUNCE; addSparks(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 4, 120); }
        if (d.y < d.r) { d.y = d.r; d.vy = Math.abs(d.vy) * BOUNCE; addSparks(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 4, 120); }
        else if (d.y > H - d.r) { d.y = H - d.r; d.vy = -Math.abs(d.vy) * BOUNCE; addSparks(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 4, 120); }

        // Speed ramp
        var sp = Math.hypot(d.vx, d.vy);
        if (sp > 1) {
          var target = Math.min(sp + DISK_ACCEL * dt, DISK_MAX);
          d.vx = (d.vx / sp) * target;
          d.vy = (d.vy / sp) * target;
        }

        // Player collision -> bounce
        var dx = d.x - player.x, dy = d.y - player.y;
        var dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        var minD = d.r + player.r;
        if (dist < minD && dist > 0.0001) {
          var nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist;
          // separate
          var overlap = minD - dist;
          d.x += nx * overlap; d.y += ny * overlap;
          // reflect velocity about normal
          var dot = d.vx * nx + d.vy * ny;
          d.vx = (d.vx - 2 * dot * nx) * BOUNCE;
          d.vy = (d.vy - 2 * dot * ny) * BOUNCE;
          // boost
          var s2 = Math.hypot(d.vx, d.vy) || 1;
          var boost = Math.min(s2 + 70, DISK_MAX);
          d.vx = (d.vx / s2) * boost;
          d.vy = (d.vy / s2) * boost;
          d.hue = rand(150, 200);
          score += 1;
          flash = 0.5;
          shake = Math.max(shake, 6);
          addSparks(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 14, 320);
          addRings(d.x, d.y, d.hue, 2);
          if (score >= WIN) { state = 'won'; showMsg('YOU WIN'); }
        }

        // Hit player? (only if it comes straight in fast) — instead, if a disk touches player and is not bounced (rare), it's a miss. We treat any contact as a bounce above. Miss = disk exits bottom.
        // Miss detection: disk leaves the bottom after bouncing (i.e. y > H + r)
        if (d.y > H + d.r + 4 || d.life <= 0) {
          removed = true;
          if (d.y > H + d.r + 4) {
            lives -= 1;
            shake = Math.max(shake, 12);
            flash = 0.7;
            showMsg('MISSED!');
            addDebris(d.x, Math.min(d.y, H), 0, 10);
            if (lives <= 0) { state = 'lost'; showMsg('GAME OVER'); }
          }
        }

        if (removed) disks.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // Particles
    for (var p = particles.length - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
      var pt = particles[p];
      pt.life -= dt;
      if (pt.type === 'ring') {
        pt.r += (pt.max - pt.r) * dt * 6;
      } else {
        pt.x += pt.vx * dt; pt.y += pt.vy * dt;
        pt.vx *= 0.96; pt.vy *= 0.96;
      }
      if (pt.life <= 0) particles.splice(p, 1);
    }
    // Sparks
    for (var s = sparks.length - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
      var sp = sparks[s];
      sp.life -= dt;
      sp.x += sp.vx * dt; sp.y += sp.vy * dt;
      sp.vx *= 0.94; sp.vy *= 0.94;
      if (sp.life <= 0) sparks.splice(s, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function drawGrid() {
    ctx.save();
    var cell = 46;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.05)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var x = 0; x <= W; x += cell) { ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); }
    for (var y = 0; y <= H; y += cell) { ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); }
    ctx.stroke();
    // brighter center lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.10)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 0); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H);
    ctx.moveTo(0, H / 2); ctx.lineTo(W, H / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    // trail
    ctx.save();
    for (var i = 0; i < player.trail.length; i++) {
      var t = player.trail[i];
      var a = (i / player.trail.length) * 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 220, 255,' + a + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, player.r * (0.4 + 0.6 * (i / player.trail.length)), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // glow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 230, 255, 0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 160, 220, 0.55)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // core
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(190, 250, 255, 0.95)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawDisks() {
    ctx.save();
    for (var i = 0; i < disks.length; i++) {
      var d = disks[i];
      // trail
      for (var j = 0; j < d.trail.length; j++) {
        var tt = d.trail[j];
        var a = (j / d.trail.length) * 0.4;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + d.hue + ', 90%, 60%, ' + a + ')';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(tt.x, tt.y, d.r * (0.3 + 0.7 * (j / d.trail.length)), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // glow
      ctx.shadowColor = 'hsla(' + d.hue + ', 95%, 60%, 0.9)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + d.hue + ', 90%, 55%, 0.85)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // core
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + d.hue + ', 90%, 85%, 0.95)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    ctx.save();
    for (var i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      var pt = particles[i];
      var a = Math.max(0, pt.life / pt.maxLife);
      if (pt.type === 'ring') {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + pt.hue + ', 90%, 70%, ' + a + ')';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3 * a;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + pt.hue + ', 90%, 70%, ' + a + ')';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSparks() {
    ctx.save();
    for (var i = 0; i < sparks.length; i++) {
      var sp = sparks[i];
      var a = Math.max(0, sp.life / 0.8);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + sp.hue + ', 95%, 75%, ' + a + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sp.x, sp.y);
      ctx.lineTo(sp.x - sp.vx * 0.03, sp.y - sp.vy * 0.03);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    // Score
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 230, 255, 0.95)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 230, 255, 0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score + ' / ' + WIN, 24, 20);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    // Lives
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 90, 130, 0.95)';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + lives, 24, 58);
    // Goal hint
    ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150, 200, 220, 0.6)';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
    ctx.fillText('Bounce every disk back up — don\'t let one fall out the bottom', 24, H - 16);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawMessage(text, sub) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 235, 255, 0.95)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 235, 255, 0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    if (sub) {
      ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180, 220, 235, 0.85)';
      ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // background
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.4, 40, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1430');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#060b1c');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#03040a');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // shake
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));

    drawGrid();

    if (state === 'playing' || state === 'won' || state === 'lost') {
      drawParticles();
      drawDisks();
      drawPlayer();
      drawSparks();
    }

    ctx.restore();

    // flash overlay
    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 220, 255,' + (flash * 0.18) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    if (state === 'playing') drawHUD();

    if (state === 'menu') {
      drawMessage('TRON DISK BOUNCE', 'Move with your mouse or WASD — bounce every disk up');
      drawMessage2('CLICK OR PRESS ENTER TO START');
    } else if (state === 'won') {
      drawMessage('YOU WIN', 'Final score: ' + score);
      drawMessage2('CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN');
    } else if (state === 'lost') {
      drawMessage('GAME OVER', 'You reached ' + score + ' / ' + WIN);
      drawMessage2('CLICK TO RETRY');
    }
  }

  function drawMessage2(text) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(140, 190, 210, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H / 2 + 66);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  var last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    var dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- Init ----------
  resize();
  resetPlayer();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Lemonade Stand: 60 Seconds</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#14213d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;}
  #game{display:block;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);border-radius:8px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
/* ============ STATE ============ */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const GROUND_Y = 430;

const state = {
  running: false,
  over: false,
  startMsg: 'Click to start',
  endMsg: '',
  time: 60,
  last: 0,
  money: 0,
  served: 0,
  lost: 0,
  lemonade: 100,
  lemonadeMax: 100,
  refillCd: 0,
  best: 0
};

const stand = { x: 150, y: GROUND_Y, w: 130, h: 120 };
const customerX = 660;

/* One array holds every mover. Each has x, y, vx, vy. */
let movers = [];
let particles = [];

/* ============ INPUT ============ */
function onDown(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  if(!state.running){
    if(!state.over){ startGame(); }
    else { resetGame(); }
  }
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(e.code === 'Space'){
    if(!state.running){
      if(!state.over){ startGame(); }
      else { resetGame(); }
    }
  }
});

function startGame(){
  state.running = true;
  state.over = false;
  state.time = 60;
  state.money = 0;
  state.served = 0;
  state.lost = 0;
  state.lemonade = state.lemonadeMax;
  state.refillCd = 0;
  state.last = performance.now();
  movers = [];
  particles = [];
}
function resetGame(){
  state.running = false;
  state.over = false;
  state.startMsg = 'Click to start';
  movers = [];
  particles = [];
}

/* ============ HELPERS ============ */
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function makeCustomer(){
  const speed = 55 + Math.random()*70;
  return {
    x: W+40, y: GROUND_Y,
    vx: -speed, vy: 0,
    type:'customer',
    patience: 3.5 + Math.random()*2.5,
    maxPatience: 0,
    shirt: '#e76f51',
    skin: '#f2c9a0',
    hair: '#5b3a29',
    scale: 0.9 + Math.random()*0.3,
    served: false
  };
}
function spawnCoin(x,y){
  particles.push({x:x, y:y, vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*30, vy:-150, type:'coin', life:0.9});
}
function spawnAngry(x,y){
  particles.push({x:x, y:y, vx:0, vy:-40, type:'angry', life:1.2});
}

/* ============ UPDATE ============ */
function update(dt){
  if(!state.running) return;

  state.time -= dt;
  if(state.time <= 0){
    state.time = 0;
    state.running = false;
    state.over = true;
    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.money);
    state.endMsg = 'Time up! You earned $' + state.money + ' and served ' + state.served + ' customers.';
    return;
  }

  if(state.refillCd > 0) state.refillCd -= dt;

  // spawn customers
  const spawnCd = 0.9 + Math.random()*1.6;
  if(Math.random() < dt / spawnCd){
    movers.push(makeCustomer());
  }

  // move every mover; drop the ones that are done
  for(let i = movers.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const c = movers[i];
    c.x += c.vx * dt;
    c.y += c.vy * dt;

    if(c.type === 'customer'){
      if(c.maxPatience === 0) c.maxPatience = c.patience;
      if(!c.served){
        // reach the counter?
        if(c.x <= customerX + 20){
          c.x = customerX;
          c.vx = 0;
        }
        if(c.x <= customerX + 20){
          c.patience -= dt;
          if(c.patience <= 0){
            // left in frustration
            c.served = true;
            state.lost++;
            spawnAngry(c.x, c.y - 70);
            c.vx = 90;
          }
        }
      }
      // off screen to the right => done
      if(c.x > W + 50) movers.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // move particles; drop finished ones
  for(let i = particles.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    if(p.type === 'coin') p.vy += 500 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if(p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

/* Serving (triggered by click while running) */
function tryServe(){
  if(!state.running) return;
  if(state.lemonade < 10){ return; } // out of lemonade
  // find nearest waiting customer
  let target = null;
  for(const c of movers){
    if(c.type === 'customer' && !c.served && c.x <= customerX + 25){
      if(!target || c.x < target.x) target = c;
    }
  }
  if(!target) return;
  // serve!
  target.served = true;
  target.vx = 100;
  state.lemonade -= 10;
  state.money += 3;
  state.served++;
  spawnCoin(target.x, target.y - 70);
  if(state.lemonade <= 0){
    state.lemonade = 0;
    state.refillCd = 1.5; // refill delay
  }
}
// hook serving into clicks
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', ()=>{ if(state.running) tryServe(); });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', ()=>{ if(state.running) tryServe(); }, {passive:false});
// refill when cooldown ends
function checkRefill(dt){
  if(state.lemonade <= 0 && state.refillCd > 0){
    state.refillCd -= dt;
    if(state.refillCd <= 0){
      state.lemonade = state.lemonadeMax;
    }

}

/* ============ DRAW ============ */
function drawBackground(){
  // sky
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GROUND_Y);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#8ecae6');
  sky.addColorStop(1,'#d6f0ff');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,GROUND_Y);

  // sun
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(790,90,46,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(790,90,62,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // clouds
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.9)';
  drawCloud(150,80,1);
  drawCloud(430,120,0.8);
  drawCloud(600,70,0.7);

  // distant hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fb069';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(180,330,360,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(560,320,760,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(840,340,W,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.lineTo(W,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // ground
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,GROUND_Y,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#a3d977');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#6fa84f');

  ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y,W,H-GROUND_Y);

  // sidewalk
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d9d2c5';
  ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND_Y-14,W,14);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)';

  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=60){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,GROUND_Y-14); ctx.lineTo(x,GROUND_Y); ctx.stroke(); }
}
function drawCloud(x,y,s){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,y,22*s,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x+26*s,y+6*s,18*s,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.arc(x-24*s,y+8*s,16*s,0,Math.PI*2);

}

function drawStand(){
  const x = stand.x, y = stand.y;
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8d5a2b';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y-stand.h, 12, stand.h);
  ctx.fillRect(x+stand.w-12, y-stand.h, 12, stand.h);

  // sign

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe45e';

function drawCustomer(c){
  const s = c.scale;
  const x = c.x, y = c.y;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.15)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, 22*s, 6*s, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2b2b';
  ctx.fillRect(x-10*s, y-30*s, 8*s, 30*s);
  ctx.fillRect(x+2*s, y-30*s, 8*s, 30*s);

  ctx.fillStyle = c.shirt;
  roundRect(x-16*s, y-64*s, 32*s, 36*s, 8*s); ctx.fill();
  // arms
  ctx.fillStyle = c.skin;
  ctx.fillRect(x-20*s, y-58*s, 6*s, 22*s);
  ctx.fillRect(x+14*s, y-58*s, 6*s, 22*s);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = c.skin;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y-78*s, 14*s, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // hair
  ctx.fillStyle = c.hair;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y-82*s, 14*s, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-5*s, y-78*s, 1.8*s, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+5*s, y-78*s, 1.8*s, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  if(!c.served){

    const bw = 34*s, bx = x-bw/2, by = y-104*s;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)';
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, 6, 3); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = p > .5 ? '#38b000' : (p > .25 ? '#ffd166' : '#e63946');
    roundRect(bx, by, bw*p, 6, 3); ctx.fill();
  }

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    if(p.type === 'coin'){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e0a800';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else if(p.type === 'angry'){
      const a = Math.min(1, p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(230,57,70,'+a+')';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('!', p.x, p.y);

}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  // top-left: time
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
  roundRect(16,16,180,54,10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('TIME', 30, 38);
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(state.time) + 's', 30, 62);
  // top-right: money
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
  roundRect(W-200,16,184,54,10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('MONEY', W-186, 38);
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('$' + state.money, W-186, 62);
  // bottom-left: lemonade gauge
  const gx = 16, gy = H-58, gw = 200, gh = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
  roundRect(gx-8, gy-24, gw+16, gh+34, 10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('LEMONADE', gx, gy-8);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)';
  roundRect(gx, gy, gw, gh, 6); ctx.fill();
  const frac = state.lemonade / state.lemonadeMax;
  ctx.fillStyle = frac > .3 ? '#ffe45e' : '#e63946';
  if(frac > 0){ roundRect(gx, gy, gw*frac, gh, 6); ctx.fill(); }
  if(state.lemonade <= 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('REFILLING...', gx, gy+gh+12);
  }
}

function drawOverlay(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,20,40,.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe45e';
  ctx.font = 'bold 46px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('LEMONADE STAND', W/2, H/2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  if(state.over){
    ctx.fillText(state.endMsg, W/2, H/2 + 8);
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
    ctx.fillText('Click to play again', W/2, H/2 + 56);
  } else {
    ctx.fillText('Click to start — you have 60 seconds', W/2, H/2 + 8);
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff';
    ctx.fillText('Customers walk up. Click (or press Space) to serve a glass.', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.fillText('Each glass costs 10 lemonade and earns $3. Refills are slow!', W/2, H/2 + 62);
  }
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawStand();
  for(const c of movers){ if(c.type === 'customer') drawCustomer(c); }
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  if(!state.running && (state.over || movers.length === 0 && state.time >= 60)){
    drawOverlay();
  } else if(!state.running){
    drawOverlay();
  }
}

/* ============ LOOP ============ */
function loop(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.last) / 1000);
  state.last = now;
  if(state.running){
    checkRefill(dt);
    update(dt);
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
state.last = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>

<title>Lily Pad Jump</title>
<style>
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#04141a; }
  #game { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let W = 0, H = 0;
  function resize(){
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  const GRAVITY = 2100;
  const JUMP_V = 1000;
  const JUMP_H = 470;
  const PAD_R = 52;
  const PAD_GAP = 108;
  const START_X = 150;

  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let frogs = [];
  let ripples = [];
  let pads = [];
  let nextPadX = 0;
  let t = 0;
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;
  let msg = '';
  let msgTimer = 0;

  const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

  function makeFrog(x, y, vx, vy){
    return { x, y, vx, vy, r: PAD_R, kind: 'frog', alive: true, done: false,
              rot: 0, spin: 0, squash: 0, trail: [] };
  }

  function makeRipple(x, y, big){
    return { x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: big ? 26 : 10, kind: 'ripple', alive: true,
              done: false, life: 1, max: big ? 1.4 : 0.9,
              hue: big ? 190 : 200 };
  }

  function makePad(x, y, hue, big){
    return { x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: PAD_R, kind: 'pad', alive: true, done: false,
              hue, big, bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
              notch: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  }

  function buildLevel(){
    pads = [];
    frogs = [];
    ripples = [];
    nextPadX = START_X;
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++){
      const y = rand(H * 0.30, H * 0.82);
      const hue = 150 + Math.random() * 40;
      const big = Math.random() < 0.12;
      pads.push(makePad(nextPadX, y, hue, big));
      nextPadX += PAD_GAP;
    }
    const f = makeFrog(START_X, H * 0.55, 0, 0);
    f.onPad = true;
    f.grounded = true;
    f.landed = true;
    frogs.push(f);
  }

  function frog(){ return frogs.find(f => f.kind === 'frog'); }

  function jump(){
    const f = frog();
    if (!f) return;
    if (state === 'start'){
      state = 'play';
      f.vy = -JUMP_V;
      f.grounded = false;
      f.landed = false;
      f.onPad = false;
      ripples.push(makeRipple(f.x, f.y, false));
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'play' && f.grounded){
      f.vy = -JUMP_V;
      f.vx = JUMP_H;
      f.grounded = false;
      f.landed = false;
      f.onPad = false;
      f.spin = rand(-6, 6);
      ripples.push(makeRipple(f.x, f.y, false));
    }
  }

  function land(f, pad){
    f.y = pad.y;
    f.vy = 0;
    f.grounded = true;
    f.landed = true;
    f.onPad = true;
    f.spin = 0;
    f.rot = 0;
    f.squash = 0.4;
    ripples.push(makeRipple(pad.x, pad.y, pad.big));
    score++;
    if (score > best) best = score;
    msg = '+' + score;
    msgTimer = 0.8;
    shake = 5;
  }

  function splash(x, y){
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++){
      ripples.push(makeRipple(x + rand(-14, 14), y + rand(-10, 10), false));
    }
    state = 'over';
    shake = 14;
    flash = 1;
  }

  function update(dt){
    t += dt;
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 40);
    if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2.5);
    if (msgTimer > 0) msgTimer -= dt;

    for (const f of frogs){
      if (f.kind === 'frog'){
        if (state === 'play'){
          f.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
          f.x += f.vx * dt;
          f.y += f.vy * dt;
          if (!f.grounded){
            f.rot += f.spin * dt;
            f.trail.push({ x: f.x, y: f.y, a: 1 });
            if (f.trail.length > 14) f.trail.shift();
          }
          if (f.grounded){
            const pad = pads.find(p => p.kind === 'pad' && Math.abs(p.x - f.x) < 4);
            if (pad) f.x = pad.x;
            else f.onPad = false;
          }
          if (f.landed && f.vy > 0){
            const pad = pads.find(p => p.kind === 'pad' &&
              Math.abs(p.x - f.x) < PAD_R * 0.95 &&
              (f.y - p.y) < PAD_R * 0.5);
            if (pad){
              land(f, pad);
              if (f.x + PAD_GAP * 1.6 > nextPadX){
                const y = rand(H * 0.30, H * 0.82);
                const hue = 150 + Math.random() * 40;
                const big = Math.random() < 0.12;
                pads.push(makePad(nextPadX, y, hue, big));
                nextPadX += PAD_GAP;
              }
            }
          }
          if (f.y > H + 120 && f.kind === 'frog') splash(f.x, H);
        } else {
          f.y = H * 0.55 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 6;
          f.x = START_X;
        }
        if (f.squash > 0) f.squash = Math.max(0, f.squash - dt * 3);
        for (const tr of f.trail) tr.a -= dt * 2;
        f.trail = f.trail.filter(tr => tr.a > 0);
      } else if (f.kind === 'ripple'){
        f.life -= dt;
        f.r += (f.max > 1 ? 90 : 55) * dt;
        if (f.life <= 0) f.done = true;
      }
    }
    frogs = frogs.filter(f => !f.done);
    ripples = ripples.filter(r => !r.done);
    pads = pads.filter(p => p.x < W + PAD_R * 2);
  }

  function drawBackground(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a2a35');
    g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0c3a44');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#062028');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun glow
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.78, H * 0.2, 10, W * 0.78, H * 0.2, H * 0.6);
    sg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,225,150,0.35)');
    sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,225,150,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // light streaks
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe9b0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 22;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++){
      const x = (i * 260 + t * 20) % (W + 300) - 150;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, -20);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 120, H + 20);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // floating particles
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,255,230,0.35)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++){
      const px = (i * 97 + t * 12) % W;
      const py = (Math.sin(t * 0.5 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5) * H;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, 1.5 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPad(p){
    const bob = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + p.bob) * 3;
    const y = p.y + bob;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, y);

    // shadow on water
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 10, p.r * 1.05, p.r * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // pad body
    const hue = p.hue;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,38%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, p.r, p.r * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // lighter top
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + (hue + 8) + ',60%,50%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-p.r * 0.15, -p.r * 0.12, p.r * 0.82, p.r * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // notch (lily pad cut)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,38%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.arc(0, 0, p.r, p.notch, p.notch + 0.5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // veins
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + (hue + 15) + ',60%,65%,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){
      const a = p.notch + 0.5 + i * (Math.PI * 2 / 6);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * p.r * 0.9, Math.sin(a) * p.r * 0.5 * 0.9);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawRipple(r){
    const a = Math.max(0, r.life / r.max);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(r.x, r.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + r.hue + ',80%,80%,' + (a * 0.7) + ')';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r.r, r.r * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawFrog(f){
    // trail
    for (const tr of f.trail){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,160,' + (tr.a * 0.15) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y, f.r * 0.4 * tr.a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(f.x, f.y);
    if (f.grounded){
      const sq = 1 - f.squash * 0.5;
      ctx.scale(1 + f.squash * 0.4, sq);
    } else {
      ctx.rotate(f.rot);
    }

    const R = f.r;
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f8f4e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-R * 0.75, R * 0.25, R * 0.35, R * 0.5, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(R * 0.75, R * 0.25, R * 0.35, R * 0.5, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3cb05e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, R * 0.85, R * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // belly
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a9e6b0';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, R * 0.15, R * 0.55, R * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3cb05e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -R * 0.35, R * 0.7, R * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-R * 0.35, -R * 0.6, R * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(R * 0.35, -R * 0.6, R * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#11202a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-R * 0.35, -R * 0.58, R * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(R * 0.35, -R * 0.58, R * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawUI(){
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,255,235,0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('Pads: ' + score, 24, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,210,190,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '14px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + best, 24, 62);

    if (msgTimer > 0 && state === 'play'){
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.font = 'bold 34px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + Math.min(1, msgTimer * 2) + ')';
      ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, H * 0.3);
    }

    if (state === 'start'){
      overlay('LILY PAD JUMP', 'Tap or press Space to hop across the lily pads.', 'Start');
    } else if (state === 'over'){
      overlay('SPLASH!', 'You landed on ' + score + ' lily pads.  Best: ' + best, 'Try again');
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, action){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,15,20,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eafff2';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(56, W * 0.09) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,240,220,0.85)';
    ctx.font = Math.min(20, W * 0.035) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H * 0.4 + 44);
    const pulse = 0.7 + Math.sin(t * 4) * 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,230,170,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(26, W * 0.04) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(action, W / 2, H * 0.4 + 96);
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0){
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    for (const p of pads) drawPad(p);
    for (const r of ripples) drawRipple(r);
    for (const f of frogs) if (f.kind === 'frog') drawFrog(f);
    ctx.restore();

    if (flash > 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (flash * 0.4) + ')';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    drawUI();
  }

  function startGame(){
    buildLevel();
    state = 'play';
    score = 0;
  }

  function onAction(){
    if (state === 'start'){
      startGame();
      const f = frog();
      if (f){ f.vy = -JUMP_V; f.grounded = false; f.landed = false; f.onPad = false; }
    } else if (state === 'play'){
      jump();
    } else if (state === 'over'){
      startGame();
      const f = frog();
      if (f){ f.vy = -JUMP_V; f.grounded = false; f.landed = false; f.onPad = false; }
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW'){
      e.preventDefault();
      onAction();
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); onAction(); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); onAction(); }, { passive: false });

  buildLevel();

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Baggage Claim Matcher</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#152438;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  canvas{display:block;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);max-width:96vw;max-height:96vh;touch-action:none;cursor:pointer;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ---------- canvas ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  const rand = (a,b)=> a + Math.random()*(b-a);
  const clamp = (v,a,b)=> v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);
  function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
    r = Math.min(r, w/2, h/2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- config ----------
  const bagColors = ['#f25c54','#3aa0e8','#43c17a','#f5b53d','#9b6ff2','#f27fb0'];
  const beltY = 400, beltH = 24, beltX1 = 30, beltX2 = W-30;
  const binY = 470, binH = 64, binW = 150, binGap = 20;
  const binX = [];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++) binX.push(120 + i*(binW + binGap));

  // ---------- state ----------
  const state = {
    phase:'start',
    score:0,
    win:0,
    lose:0,
    target:0,
    bagTimer:0,
    bagInterval:2.0,
    time:0,
    hint:0
  };
  let movers = [];      // every moving object lives here
  let particles = [];    // celebratory bits
  let flash = null;     // {color, t, max}

  // ---------- input ----------
  function getPos(e){
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    const cy = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
    return { x:(cx - r.left) * (W / r.width), y:(cy - r.top) * (H / r.height) };
  }
  function pickBin(x,y){
    if(y < binY || y > binY + binH + 6) return -1;
    for(let i=0;i<binX.length;i++)
      if(x >= binX[i] && x <= binX[i]+binW) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  function doMatch(x,y){
    const bi = pickBin(x,y);
    if(bi < 0) return;
    const c = bagColors[bi];
    let best = null, bd = 1e9;
    for(const m of movers){
      if(m.kind !== 'bag') continue;
      const d = (m.x - x)*(m.x - x) + (m.y - y)*(m.y - y);
      if(d < bd){ bd = d; best = m; }
    }
    if(best && bd < 150*150 && best.color === c){
      state.score++;
      spawnBurst(best.x, best.y, c);
      flash = { color:c, t:0.5, max:0.5 };
      movers = movers.filter(m => m !== best);
      if(state.score >= state.target) state.phase = 'win';
    } else {
      state.lose++;
      flash = { color:'#d94b4b', t:0.4, max:0.4 };
      if(state.lose >= 3) state.phase = 'lose';
    }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    const p = getPos(e);
    if(state.phase === 'start'){ state.phase = 'play'; return; }
    if(state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose'){
      state.phase = 'start';
      state.score = 0; state.lose = 0; state.target = 5;
      state.bagInterval = 2.0; state.bagTimer = 0.5;
      movers = []; particles = []; flash = null;
      return;
    }
    if(state.phase === 'play') doMatch(p.x, p.y);
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    const k = e.key;
    if(k === '1') doMatch(binX[0]+binW/2, binY+binH/2);
    else if(k === '2') doMatch(binX[1]+binW/2, binY+binH/2);
    else if(k === '3') doMatch(binX[2]+binW/2, binY+binH/2);
    else if(k === ' ' || k === 'Enter'){
      if(state.phase === 'start') state.phase = 'play';
      else if(state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose'){
        state.phase = 'start';
        state.score = 0; state.lose = 0; state.target = 5;
        state.bagInterval = 2.0; state.bagTimer = 0.5;
        movers = []; particles = []; flash = null;
      }
    }
  });

  // ---------- particles ----------
  function spawnBurst(x,y,color){
    for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI*2), s = rand(60, 220);
      particles.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s - 40, life:rand(0.5,1.0), max:1, color });
    }
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if(flash){ flash.t -= dt; if(flash.t <= 0) flash = null; }
    state.hint -= dt;

    // particles (a kind of mover)
    for(const p of particles){
      p.x += p.vx*dt;
      p.y += p.vy*dt;
      p.vy += 260*dt;
      p.life -= dt;
    }
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    if(state.phase === 'play'){
      state.time += dt;
      state.bagTimer -= dt;
      if(state.bagTimer <= 0){
        state.bagTimer = state.bagInterval;
        movers.push({ kind:'bag', x: beltX1 - 40, y: beltY - 24,
                      vx: 60 + Math.random()*25, vy: 0,
                      color: bagColors[(Math.random()*bagColors.length)|0] });
        state.bagInterval = Math.max(1.15, state.bagInterval - 0.06);
      }
      // move every mover, drop the ones that finished
      for(const m of movers){
        m.x += m.vx * dt;
        m.y += m.vy * dt;
      }
      movers = movers.filter(m => {
        if(m.kind === 'bag') return m.x < beltX2 + 60;
        return true;
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawBag(m){
    const x = m.x, y = m.y, c = m.color;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 30, 30, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // handle
    ctx.strokeStyle = shade(c, -30); ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -16, 12, Math.PI, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = c; rr(-30, -16, 60, 44, 10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = shade(c, -45); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    // straps
    ctx.strokeStyle = shade(c, -25); ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-16, -14); ctx.lineTo(-16, 26); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16, -14); ctx.lineTo(16, 26); ctx.stroke();
    // highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; rr(-24, -10, 12, 30, 6); ctx.fill();
    // tag
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; rr(14, 6, 14, 10, 3); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBin(i){
    const x = binX[i], y = binY, c = bagColors[i];
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f4358';
    ctx.fillRect(x+10, y+binH, 8, 20);
    ctx.fillRect(x+binW-18, y+binH, 8, 20);
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#38516b'; rr(x, y, binW, binH, 10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#223245'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    // colored front panel
    ctx.fillStyle = c; rr(x+10, y+8, binW-20, binH-16, 7); ctx.fill();
    // label
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; rr(x+10, y+8, binW-20, 18, 7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = 'bold 15px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('BIN ' + (i+1), x+binW/2, y+17);
    // little matching suitcase icon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; rr(x+binW/2-12, y+32, 24, 18, 4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+binW/2, y+32, 5, Math.PI, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawScene(){
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    sky.addColorStop(0,'#8fd0f2'); sky.addColorStop(0.55,'#cfeefb'); sky.addColorStop(1,'#e9f6fd');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe27a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120, 90, 46, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,226,122,0.35)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120, 90, 62, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    // clouds
    drawCloud(150, 80, 1); drawCloud(520, 60, 0.8); drawCloud(760, 150, 0.7);
    // floor
    const fl = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,360,0,H);
    fl.addColorStop(0,'#eef3f7'); fl.addColorStop(1,'#c8d3dc');
    ctx.fillStyle = fl; ctx.fillRect(0,360,W,H-360);
    // floor line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for(let x=0;x<W;x+=60){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,360); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
    // "Baggage Claim" sign
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f7d3a'; rr(W/2-150, 30, 300, 46, 10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('✈  BAGGAGE CLAIM  ✈', W/2, 53);
    // bins
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++) drawBin(i);
    // belt
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33475c'; rr(beltX1, beltY, beltX2-beltX1, beltH, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#22313f'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a6076'; rr(beltX1+6, beltY+4, beltX2-beltX1-12, 6, 3); ctx.fill();
    // posts
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3b4d';
    ctx.fillRect(beltX1+20, beltY+beltH, 14, H-(beltY+beltH));
    ctx.fillRect(beltX2-34, beltY+beltH, 14, H-(beltY+beltH));
    // movers
    for(const m of movers){ if(m.kind === 'bag') drawBag(m); }
    // particles
    for(const p of particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    // flash
    if(flash){
      ctx.globalAlpha = (flash.t/flash.max) * 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = flash.color; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawCloud(x,y,s){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(s,s);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0,0,22,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(26,-6,26,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(54,2,20,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(28,10,24,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
  }

  function shade(hex, amt){
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);
    let r=(n>>16)+amt, g=((n>>8)&255)+amt, b=(n&255)+amt;
    r=clamp(r,0,255); g=clamp(g,0,255); b=clamp(b,0,255);
    return 'rgb('+r+','+g+','+b+')';
  }

  function drawHud(){
    ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'; rr(16,16,180,40,10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1c2b3a'; ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score + ' / ' + state.target, 30, 43);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'; rr(210,16,150,40,10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1c2b3a'; ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Misses: ' + state.lose + ' / 3', 224, 43);
    if(state.hint > 0 && state.phase === 'play'){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; rr(W/2-260, H-44, 520, 30, 8); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '15px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText('Tap the bag that matches the bin color (or press 1, 2, 3)', W/2, H-29);
    }
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,25,40,0.62)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe27a'; ctx.font = '18px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Tap / click anywhere to start', W/2, H/2 + 52);
  }

  function draw(){
    drawScene();
    drawHud();
    if(state.phase === 'start') drawOverlay('Baggage Claim Matcher','Match each bag to its colored bin!','#57c2ff');
    else if(state.phase === 'win') drawOverlay('You Win! 🎉','All bags claimed. Great job!','#5fe08a');
    else if(state.phase === 'lose') drawOverlay('Game Over','Too many wrong bags. Try again!','#ff8080');
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pizza Party!</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #2b1a12;
    font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  #game { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ---------- setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- state ----------
  const GAME_TIME = 45;
  const state = {
    running: false,
    over: false,
    timeLeft: GAME_TIME,
    score: 0,
    combo: 0,
    best: 0,
    elapsed: 0
  };
  let mouse = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 };

  // the one array of movers
  let movers = [];
  let particles = [];
  let toasts = [];
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let shake = 0;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
  const pick = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- item types ----------
  const TYPES = [
    { name: 'Pepperoni', color: '#c0392b', edge: '#7d1f16', points: 10, speed: 1.0, r: 22, draw: drawPepperoni },
    { name: 'Mushroom',  color: '#e7dcc6', edge: '#a8977a', points: 10, speed: 1.15, r: 20, draw: drawMushroom },
    { name: 'Olive',     color: '#3a2410', edge: '#1e1206', points: 15, speed: 1.4, r: 16, draw: drawOlive },
    { name: 'Basil',     color: '#3f9d46', edge: '#246b2b', points: 15, speed: 1.55, r: 17, draw: drawBasil },
    { name: 'Star',      color: '#ffcf3f', edge: '#e0a200', points: 25, speed: 1.85, r: 18, draw: drawStar }
  ];

  function spawnItem() {
    const t = pick(TYPES);
    const x = rand(40, W - 40);
    const y = -30;
    movers.push({
      x, y,
      vx: rand(-20, 20),
      vy: rand(70, 120) * t.speed,
      type: t,
      r: t.r,
      rot: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      rotSpeed: rand(-2, 2),
      wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      wobbleAmp: rand(6, 16),
      done: false
    });
  }

  function burst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const sp = rand(40, 220);
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 40,
        life: rand(0.5, 1.0),
        max: 1.0,
        r: rand(3, 7),
        color
      });
    }
  }

  function toast(text, color, x, y) {
    toasts.push({ text, color, x, y, life: 1.0, max: 1.0 });
  }

  // ---------- item drawing (each a few shapes) ----------
  function drawPepperoni(m) {
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.edge;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r * 0.82, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.edge;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const a = (i / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(Math.cos(a) * m.r * 0.45, Math.sin(a) * m.r * 0.45, m.r * 0.08, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawMushroom(m) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f3ead6';
    roundRect(-m.r * 0.35, -m.r * 0.05, m.r * 0.7, m.r * 0.95, m.r * 0.3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -m.r * 0.25, m.r * 0.95, m.r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.edge;
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(i * m.r * 0.4, -m.r * 0.35, m.r * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawOlive(m) {
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.edge;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.35, m.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBasil(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, m.r * 0.85, m.r * 1.1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = m.type.edge; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -m.r * 0.9); ctx.lineTo(0, m.r * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-m.r * 0.5, -m.r * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(m.r * 0.5, m.r * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStar(m) {
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.edge;
    starPath(m.r * 1.05); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = m.type.color;
    starPath(m.r * 0.8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.2, -m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  function starPath(r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const rad = (i % 2 === 0) ? r : r * 0.45;
      const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      const x = Math.cos(a) * rad, y = Math.sin(a) * rad;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  function pointerPos(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
  }
  function handlePointer(e) {
    const p = pointerPos(e);
    mouse.x = p.x; mouse.y = p.y;
    if (!state.running || state.over) return;
    // catch nearest mover
    let best = null, bestD = 1e9;
    for (const m of movers) {
      const d = Math.hypot(m.x - p.x, m.y - p.y);
      if (d < m.r + 22 && d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = m; }
    }
    if (best) {
      best.done = true;
      state.score += best.type.points;
      state.combo++;
      const bonus = Math.min(state.combo - 1, 5) * 2;
      if (bonus > 0) state.score += bonus;
      burst(best.x, best.y, best.type.color, 14);
      toast('+' + best.type.points + (bonus ? '  x' + state.combo : ''), '#fff', best.x, best.y);
      shake = Math.min(shake + 4, 10);
    } else {
      state.combo = 0;
    }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', handlePointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handlePointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); handlePointer(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); handlePointer(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!state.running && !state.over) startGame();
    else if (state.over) startGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') {
      if (!state.running || state.over) startGame();
    }
  });

  function startGame() {
    movers = [];
    particles = [];
    toasts = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    shake = 0;
    state.running = true;
    state.over = false;
    state.timeLeft = GAME_TIME;
    state.score = 0;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.elapsed = 0;
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (!state.running) return;

    state.timeLeft -= dt;
    state.elapsed += dt;
    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 30);

    // spawn items faster as time runs out
    const rate = 0.9 - (state.elapsed / GAME_TIME) * 0.55;
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
      spawnItem();
      if (Math.random() < 0.35) spawnItem();
      spawnTimer = rate;
    }

    // move movers (one array of objects with x, y, vx, vy)
    for (const m of movers) {
      m.wobble += dt * 4;
      m.x += m.vx * dt + Math.sin(m.wobble) * m.wobbleAmp * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.rot += m.rotSpeed * dt;
      if (m.y - m.r > H) m.done = true;
    }

    // drop the ones that are done
    movers = movers.filter(m => !m.done);

    // particles
    for (const p of particles) {
      p.life -= dt;
      p.vy += 260 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    // toasts
    for (const t of toasts) { t.life -= dt; t.y -= 30 * dt; }
    toasts = toasts.filter(t => t.life > 0);
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // warm kitchen wall
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#3a2418');
    g.addColorStop(0.6, '#5a3a24');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#2b1a12');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft light glow at top
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, -H * 0.2, 50, W / 2, -H * 0.2, H * 0.9);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,150,0.25)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,150,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // hanging string lights
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 20);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W / 2, 70, W, 20);
    ctx.stroke();
    const lightColors = ['#ff6b6b', '#ffd93d', '#6bcbff', '#7bed8a', '#ff9ff3'];
    const n = Math.max(6, Math.floor(W / 90));
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const t = i / n;
      const x = t * W;
      const y = 20 + (1 - Math.pow(2 * t - 1, 2)) * 40;
      const c = lightColors[i % lightColors.length];
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.elapsed * 2 + i));
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y + 8, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawCounter() {
    const top = H - 70;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7a4a2b';
    ctx.fillRect(0, top, W, 70);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9c6238';
    ctx.fillRect(0, top, W, 14);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, top + 40, W, 30);
    // wooden plank lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 120) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, top + 14); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawPizzaBase() {
    // the big pizza on the counter
    const cx = W / 2;
    const cy = H - 40;
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 10, R, R * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // crust
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d99a4e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R, R * 0.52, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b5763a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R, R * 0.52, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // cheese
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c14e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R * 0.86, R * 0.44, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f7d273';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - R * 0.05, R * 0.7, R * 0.34, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // slice lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,70,20,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * R * 0.86, cy + Math.sin(a) * R * 0.44);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawMovers() {
    for (const m of movers) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
      ctx.rotate(m.rot);
      // soft shadow
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, m.r * 0.7, m.r * 0.9, m.r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // glow ring
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      m.type.draw(m);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawToasts() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px Trebuchet MS';
    for (const t of toasts) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(t.life / t.max, 0, 1);
      ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.strokeText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
      ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawCursor() {
    if (!state.running) return;
    // pizza-topping grabber
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(mouse.x, mouse.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // timer bar
    const frac = clamp(state.timeLeft / GAME_TIME, 0, 1);
    const barW = Math.min(W * 0.5, 420);
    const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
    const barY = 16;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    roundRect(barX - 6, barY - 6, barW + 12, 34, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2418';
    roundRect(barX, barY, barW, 22, 10); ctx.fill();
    const tc = frac > 0.34 ? '#7bed8a' : (frac > 0.17 ? '#ffd93d' : '#ff6b6b');
    ctx.fillStyle = tc;
    roundRect(barX, barY, barW * frac, 22, 10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 15px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(state.timeLeft) + 's', W / 2, barY + 16);

    // score
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    const scoreTxt = 'Score ' + state.score;
    ctx.strokeText(scoreTxt, 20, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
    ctx.fillText(scoreTxt, 20, 50);

    // combo
    if (state.combo > 1) {
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px Trebuchet MS';
      const comboTxt = 'Combo x' + state.combo;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.strokeText(comboTxt, W - 20, 50);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9ff3';
      ctx.fillText(comboTxt, W - 20, 50);
    }
  }

  function drawStart() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.12, 72) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.strokeText('PIZZA PARTY!', W / 2, H * 0.34);
    ctx.fillText('PIZZA PARTY!', W / 2, H * 0.34);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.045, 26) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.fillText('Catch the toppings before they fall off the pizza!', W / 2, H * 0.46);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9c2';
    ctx.font = Math.min(W * 0.04, 22) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.fillText('Move your mouse (or finger) and click / tap to grab.', W / 2, H * 0.53);

    const pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(state.elapsed * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.055, 34) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press SPACE to start', W / 2, H * 0.68);
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const title = state.score >= 200 ? 'PIZZA MASTER!' : (state.score >= 100 ? 'Great Job!' : 'Time is up!');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93d';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.1, 60) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.strokeText(title, W / 2, H * 0.36);
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.36);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.07, 42) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H * 0.5);

    if (state.score > state.best) {
      state.best = state.score;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7bed8a';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.045, 26) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
      ctx.fillText('New Best Score!', W / 2, H * 0.57);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9c2';
      ctx.font = Math.min(W * 0.04, 22) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
      ctx.fillText('Best: ' + state.best, W / 2, H * 0.57);
    }

    const pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(state.elapsed * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(W * 0.05, 30) + 'px Trebuchet MS';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press SPACE to play again', W / 2, H * 0.7);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    drawCounter();
    drawPizzaBase();
    drawMovers();
    drawParticles();
    drawToasts();
    drawCursor();
    ctx.restore();

    drawHUD();
    if (!state.running && !state.over) drawStart();
    if (state.over) drawOver();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;

    if (state.running && !state.over) {
      update(dt);
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        state.timeLeft = 0;
        state.running = false;
        state.over = true;
        movers = [];
      }
    } else {
      state.elapsed += dt; // keep menu animations alive
    }

    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
