"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

const POT={x:300,y:300,w:150,h:150};
const INLET={x:300,y:112};
const POUR_Y=150;
const GRAV=0.55;
const WIN=5;
const MAX=9;

const COL={
  red:'#e13b3b', blue:'#2f80d6', green:'#37b565', purple:'#9a4fd0',
  yellow:'#f2c14e', orange:'#ef8b3a', teal:'#2fb7a8', pink:'#e06ba0',
  brown:'#8a5a2b', gray:'#8a8a8a', dark:'#20143a', gold:'#ffd97a',
  glass:'#7fd0e0', glassDark:'#2a4a58', bgTop:'#1c1236', bgBot:'#0a0714'
};

const RECIPES=[
  {name:'SLEEP',mix:['red','blue'],result:COL.purple},
  {name:'STRENGTH',mix:['green','yellow'],result:COL.orange},
  {name:'INVISIBILITY',mix:['blue','yellow'],result:COL.teal},
  {name:'REGEN',mix:['red','green'],result:COL.brown},
  {name:'FLIGHT',mix:['yellow','blue'],result:COL.gold}
];

const state={
  phase:'menu', score:0, level:0,
  current:RECIPES[0],
  have1:null, have2:null,
  potColor:COL.dark,
  message:'', msgTimer:0,
  flash:0, flashColor:COL.gold,
  time:0
};
const movers=[];
const particles=[];

function makeDroplet(x,y,vx,vy,color){return{x,y,vx,vy,color};}
function makeSpark(x,y,vx,vy,life,color){return{x,y,vx,vy,life,color};}
function rand(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}

function startGame(){
  state.score=0; state.level=0;
  state.potColor=COL.dark;
  state.message=''; state.msgTimer=0;
  state.flash=0;
  movers.length=0; particles.length=0;
  startLevel();
}
function startLevel(){
  state.current=RECIPES[state.level];
  state.have1=null; state.have2=null;
  state.potColor=COL.dark;
  state.message=''; state.msgTimer=0;
  movers.length=0;
  spawnDroplet(state.current.mix[0]);
}
function spawnDroplet(color){
  movers.push(makeDroplet(INLET.x,INLET.y,0,0,color));
}
function pour(color){
  movers.push(makeDroplet(INLET.x,INLET.y,0,0,color));
}
function addIngredient(color){
  if(state.have1===null){state.have1=color; state.potColor=color; return;}
  if(state.have2===null){state.have2=color; return;}
}
function completePour(){
  if(state.have1===null){
    state.have1=state.current.mix[0];
    state.potColor=state.current.mix[0];
    return;
  }
  if(state.have2===null){
    state.have2=state.current.mix[1];
    const r=state.current.result;
    state.potColor=r;
    state.flash=1; state.flashColor=r;
    state.score+=10;
    for(let i=0;i<20;i++) particles.push(makeSpark(300,250,rand(-2.6,2.6),rand(-3.6,-0.2),rand(30,60),r));
    if(state.level+1<RECIPES.length){
      state.level++;
      state.message='MIXED! +10'; state.msgTimer=90;
      setTimeout(startLevel,1100);
    }else{
      state.phase='win';
      state.message='ALL POTIONS MIXED!';
    }
  }
}
function lose(){
  state.phase='lose';
  state.message='THE POTION EXPLoded!';
  state.flash=1; state.flashColor=COL.red;
  for(let i=0;i<34;i++) particles.push(makeSpark(300,250,rand(-4,4),rand(-5,-0.5),rand(30,70),COL.red));
}

function updateMovers(){
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const d=movers[i];
    d.vy+=GRAV;
    d.x+=d.vx;
    d.y+=d.vy;
    if(d.y>=POUR_Y){
      if(d.x>225 && d.x<375){
        completePour();
      }else{
        lose();
      }
      movers.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function updateParticles(){
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.vy+=0.12;
    p.x+=p.vx;
    p.y+=p.vy;
    p.life--;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}
function update(){
  state.time++;
  if(state.msgTimer>0) state.msgTimer--;
  if(state.flash>0) state.flash-=0.02;
  updateMovers();
  updateParticles();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,COL.bgTop);
  g.addColorStop(1,COL.bgBot);
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const x=(i*97+state.time*0.25)%W;
    const y=(i*53)%H;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,1.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawTable(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a2417'; ctx.fillRect(0,352,W,H-352);
  ctx.fillStyle='#5a3a24'; ctx.fillRect(0,352,W,8);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,360); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
}
function drawFlask(){
  const cx=300;
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.glassDark;
  ctx.fillRect(286,120,28,42);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.glass;
  ctx.fillRect(288,122,24,38);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.glassDark;
  ctx.fillRect(280,112,40,10);
  const topY=158, botY=348;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(286,158); ctx.lineTo(224,botY);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(220,352,230,352);
  ctx.lineTo(370,352);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(380,352,376,botY);
  ctx.lineTo(314,158);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,220,235,0.10)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(180,235,245,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.stroke();
  if(state.potColor!==COL.dark){
    const fill=state.potColor;
    const level=state.have2!==null?250:300;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(286,158); ctx.lineTo(224,botY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(220,352,230,352);
    ctx.lineTo(370,352);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(380,352,376,botY);
    ctx.lineTo(314,158);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle=fill;
    ctx.fillRect(210,level,180,352-level);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(210,level,180,5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(250,190); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(240,260,250,320); ctx.stroke();
}
function drawRecipe(){
  const r=state.current;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,6,20,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(20,18,250,80);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,217,122,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(20,18,250,80);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 13px Georgia'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('MIX:  '+r.name, 34, 40);
  const y=70;
  ctx.fillStyle=r.mix[0]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(50,y,11,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 16px Georgia'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillText('+',92,y+5);
  ctx.fillStyle=r.mix[1]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(134,y,11,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText('=',176,y+5);
  ctx.fillStyle=r.result; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(218,y,12,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'; ctx.font='14px Georgia'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+state.score, W-20, 34);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.font='12px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('POTION '+(state.level+1)+' / '+RECIPES.length, W-20, 54);
}
function drawMovers(){
  for(const d of movers){
    ctx.fillStyle=d.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x,d.y,9,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x-3,d.y-3,2.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/60);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawFlash(){
  if(state.flash>0){
    ctx.globalAlpha=state.flash*0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle=state.flashColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}
function drawMessage(){
  if(state.msgTimer>0 && state.message){
    ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 22px Georgia'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(state.message, W/2, 110);
  }
}
function drawMenu(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,6,20,0.78)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 40px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('POTION MIXING', W/2, 150);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'; ctx.font='18px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('A one-screen alchemy puzzle', W/2, 185);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'; ctx.font='15px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('Press 1 to pour the first ingredient', W/2, 230);
  ctx.fillText('Press 2 to pour the second ingredient', W/2, 255);
  ctx.fillText('Drop both into the flask to make the potion', W/2, 280);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  START', W/2, 335);
}
function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,6,20,0.8)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 38px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('YOU MASTERED THE CRAFT', W/2, 160);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'; ctx.font='22px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('Final Score:  '+state.score, W/2, 210);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  PLAY  AGAIN', W/2, 280);
}
function drawLose(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(30,6,10,0.82)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.red; ctx.font='bold 36px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('THE POTION EXPLoded!', W/2, 160);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'; ctx.font='18px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('You poured outside the flask.', W/2, 205);
  ctx.fillText('Score:  '+state.score, W/2, 235);
  ctx.fillStyle=COL.gold; ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  TO  RETRY', W/2, 290);
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawTable();
  drawFlask();
  drawMovers();
  drawParticles();
  drawFlash();
  drawRecipe();
  drawHUD();
  drawMessage();
  if(state.phase==='menu') drawMenu();
  else if(state.phase==='win') drawWin();
  else if(state.phase==='lose') drawLose();
}

function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function onKey(e){
  const k=e.key;
  if(state.phase==='menu'){
    if(k==='Enter'){ startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if(state.phase==='win' || state.phase==='lose'){
    if(k==='Enter'){ startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if(k==='1'){ pour(state.current.mix[0]); }
  if(k==='2'){ pour(state.current.mix[1]); }
}
window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

state.phase='menu';
loop();
</script>

//  CONSTANTS

const W = 900, H = 560;

const TOWER_X = W / 2;
const BOX_W = 56, BOX_H = 34;
const GRAV = 0.5;

  canvas.style.width  = (W * scale) + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
}

function newBox(x, y, color, accent, owner) {
  return { x, y, vx:0, vy:0, w:BOX_W, h:BOX_H, color, accent, owner,
           type:'box', state:'active', landed:false, landedY:0 };
}

function reset() {
  movers  = [];
  stacked = [];
  score   = 0;
  topBox  = null;
  shake   = 0;
  // P1 robot + P1 box
  movers.push({ x: 120, y: FLOOR - 44, vx:0, vy:0, w:52, h:44,
                color:P1.color, accent:P1.accent, owner:P1.name,
                type:'robot', state:'active', landed:false, landedY:0,
                facing: 1, armSwing: 0, bob: 0 });
  movers.push(newBox(120, FLOOR - 44 - BOX_H, P1.color, P1.accent, P1.name));
  // P2 robot + P2 box
  movers.push({ x: W - 120, y: FLOOR - 44, vx:0, vy:0, w:52, h:44,
                color:P2.color, accent:P2.accent, owner:P2.name,
                type:'robot', state:'active', landed:false, landedY:0,
                facing: -1, armSwing: 0, bob: 0 });
  movers.push(newBox(W - 120, FLOOR - 44 - BOX_H, P2.color, P2.accent, P2.name));
}

function topY() {
  return topBox ? topBox.y : FLOOR;
}

// ============================================================
//  INPUT
// ============================================================
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (['KeyA','KeyD','KeyW','KeyLeft','KeyRight','KeyUp','Space','Enter'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.repeat) return;
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (phase === 'start' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    reset();
    phase = 'play';
    return;
  }
  if (phase === 'over' && (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter')) {
    reset();
    phase = 'play';
    return;
  }
  if (phase !== 'play') return;
  // P1 drop
  if (e.code === P1.keyDrop) tryDrop(P1);
  // P2 drop
  if (e.code === P2.keyDrop) tryDrop(P2);
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// ============================================================
//  GAME LOGIC
// ============================================================
function findRobot(owner) {
  return movers.find(m => m.owner === owner && m.type === 'robot');
}

function tryDrop(owner) {
  const r = findRobot(owner);
  if (!r) return;
  const box = movers.find(m => m.owner === owner && m.type === 'box' && m.state === 'active');
  if (!box) return;
  // release the box: it starts at the robot's position, gets gravity
  box.state = 'falling';
  box.vx = 0;
  box.vy = 0;
  r.armSwing = 1;
}

function landBox(box) {
  // snap to tower
  const snapX = TOWER_X;
  const snapY = topY() - box.h;
  box.x = snapX;
  box.y = snapY;
  box.vx = 0;
  box.vy = 0;
  box.state = 'landed';
  box.landedY = snapY;
  // move from movers to stacked
  movers = movers.filter(m => m !== box);
  stacked.push(box);
  topBox = box;
  score++;
  if (score > best) best = score;
}

function checkMiss(box) {
  // box fell below floor → game over
  phase = 'over';
  overMsg = 'The box fell! Score: ' + score;
  shake = 14;
}

// ============================================================
//  UPDATE
// ============================================================
function update() {
  if (phase !== 'play') return;

  // --- move robots (horizontal) ---
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type !== 'robot') continue;
    let dir = 0;
    if (m.owner === P1.name) {
      if (keys[P1.keyL]) dir -= 1;
      if (keys[P1.keyR]) dir += 1;
    } else if (m.owner === P2.name) {
      if (keys[P2.keyL]) dir += 1;
      if (keys[P2.keyR]) dir -= 1;
    }
    m.vx = dir * 3.2;
    m.x += m.vx;
    // clamp to screen
    const margin = 30;
    if (m.x < margin) m.x = margin;
    if (m.x > W - margin) m.x = W - margin;
    m.facing = dir >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
    m.bob = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.004 + (m.owner === P1.name ? 0 : 1.5)) * 2;
    if (m.armSwing > 0) m.armSwing = Math.max(0, m.armSwing - 0.04);

    // --- attached box follows robot ---
    const box = movers.find(b => b.owner === m.owner && b.type === 'box' && b.state === 'active');
    if (box) {
      box.x = m.x;
      box.y = m.y - m.h / 2 - box.h + 2;
      box.vx = 0;
      box.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  // --- gravity for falling boxes ---
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type !== 'box' || m.state !== 'falling') continue;
    m.vy += GRAV;
    if (m.vy > MAX_DROP) m.vy = MAX_DROP;
    m.y += m.vy;

    // check if it reached the tower top
    const towerTop = topY();
    if (m.y + m.h >= towerTop) {
      // check horizontal alignment
      const dx = Math.abs(m.x - TOWER_X);
      if (dx < BOX_W * 0.55) {
        landBox(m);
      } else {
        // miss → keep falling
        if (m.y > FLOOR + 200) {
          checkMiss(m);
          movers = movers.filter(b => b !== m);
        }
      }
    }
    if (m.y > FLOOR + 200) {
      checkMiss(m);
      movers = movers.filter(b => b !== m);
    }
  }

  // --- shake decay ---
  if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.88;
}

// ============================================================
//  DRAW
// ============================================================
function drawBackground() {
  // sky gradient
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e1a');
  sky.addColorStop(0.5, '#111828');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#1a2238');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % W;
    const sy = (i * 89 + 20) % (H * 0.5);
    const sr = 0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, sr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // distant city silhouette
  ctx.fillStyle = '#151d30';
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const bx = i * 80 - 10;
    const bh = 40 + (i * 31) % 60;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, H - 120 - bh, 60, bh);
  }
  // city windows
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,80,0.25)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const bx = i * 80 - 10;
    const bh = 40 + (i * 31) % 60;
    for (let wy = 0; wy < bh - 10; wy += 14) {
      for (let wx = 8; wx < 52; wx += 14) {
        if ((i + wy + wx) % 3 === 0) ctx.fillRect(bx + wx, H - 120 - bh + wy + 6, 6, 8);
      }
    }
  }

  // ground
  const gnd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, FLOOR - 10, 0, H);
  gnd.addColorStop(0, '#252d45');
  gnd.addColorStop(1, '#1a2035');
  ctx.fillStyle = gnd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, FLOOR - 10, W, H - FLOOR + 10);

  // ground line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, FLOOR - 10);
  ctx.lineTo(W, FLOOR - 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  // grid lines on ground
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let gx = 0; gx < W; gx += 40) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx, FLOOR - 10);
    ctx.lineTo(gx, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawTowerGuide() {
  // vertical guide line at tower center
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(TOWER_X, 40);
  ctx.lineTo(TOWER_X, FLOOR);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // tower base platform
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3550';
  ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - BOX_W, FLOOR - 6, BOX_W * 2, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#354060';
  ctx.fillRect(TOWER_X - BOX_W + 4, FLOOR - 10, BOX_W * 2 - 8, 4);
}

function drawBox(b) {
  const x = b.x - b.w / 2;
  const y = b.y;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 3, b.w, b.h);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, b.w, b.h);
  // top highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = b.accent;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, b.w, 4);
  // bottom shade
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y + b.h - 5, b.w, 5);
  // cross straps
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + b.w * 0.3, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + b.w * 0.3, y + b.h);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + b.w * 0.7, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + b.w * 0.7, y + b.h);
  ctx.stroke();
  // label
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(b.owner, b.x, y + b.h / 2 + 4);
}

function drawRobot(r) {
  const x = r.x;
  const y = r.y + r.bob;
  const f = r.facing;
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3040';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 10, 10, 18);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 10, 10, 18);
  // feet
  ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y + 26, 14, 5);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 26, 14, 5);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#353d55';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y - 14, 32, 28);
  // chest light
  ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#404868';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 10, y - 30, 20, 16);
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = r.accent;
  ctx.fillRect(x + f * 2 - 4, y - 26, 4, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(x + f * 2 + 2, y - 26, 4, 4);
  // antenna
  ctx.strokeStyle = r.color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - 30);
  ctx.lineTo(x + f * 4, y - 38);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + f * 4, y - 38, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // arms
  const armAngle = r.armSwing * 0.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a5270';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  // left arm
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 16, y - 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 24, y + 4 + armAngle * 10);
  ctx.stroke();
  // right arm (the one that carries)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 16, y - 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 24, y - 4 - armAngle * 20);
  ctx.stroke();
  // hand
  ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 24, y - 4 - armAngle * 20, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, W / 2, 36);
  // best
  ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.fillText('Best: ' + best, W / 2, 56);

  // P1 label
  ctx.fillStyle = P1.color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('P1  [A][D] move  [W] drop', 20, 30);
  // P2 label
  ctx.fillStyle = P2.color;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('P2  [\u2190][\u2192] move  [\u2191] drop', W - 20, 30);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 42px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('ROBOT BOX STACKER', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
  ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('Two players. Stack boxes on the tower. Miss and it\u2019s over.', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = P1.color;
  ctx.fillText('P1:  A / D to move,  W to drop', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = P2.color;
  ctx.fillText('P2:  \u2190 / \u2192 to move,  \u2191 to drop', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 110);
}

function drawOverScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a5a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(overMsg, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
  ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0.5) {
    ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  }

  drawBackground();
  drawTowerGuide();

  // stacked boxes
  for (const b of stacked) drawBox(b);

  // movers (robots + active/falling boxes)
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m.type === 'robot') drawRobot(m);
    else if (m.type === 'box') drawBox(m);
  }

  drawHUD();
  ctx.restore();

  if (phase === 'start') drawStartScreen();
  if (phase === 'over') drawOverScreen();
}

// ============================================================
//  MAIN LOOP
// ============================================================
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let best = 0;
  let time = 0;

  const player = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 0, facing: 0, thrust: 0, spin: 0 };
  const movers = [];
  const bots = [];

  function spawnBot() {

    const r = RING.r * (0.75 + Math.random() * 0.2);

    const by = RING.y + Math.sin(ang) * r;
    const toCenter = Math.atan2(RING.y - by, RING.x - bx);

  function update(dt) {

    if (keys.right) { player.vx += Math.cos(player.facing) * accel * dt; player.vy += Math.sin(player.facing) * accel * dt; }
    if (keys.up) { player.vx += Math.cos(player.facing + Math.PI / 2) * accel * 0.5 * dt; player.vy += Math.sin(player.facing + Math.PI / 2) * accel * 0.5 * dt; }
    if (keys.down) { player.vx += Math.cos(player.facing - Math.PI / 2) * accel * 0.5 * dt; player.vy += Math.sin(player.facing - Math.PI / 2) * accel * 0.5 * dt; }

        b.x -= nx * over;
        b.y -= ny * over;
        const dot = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
        if (dot > 0) {
          b.vx -= nx * dot * 1.4;
          b.vy -= ny * dot * 1.4;
        }
      }

      const dx = player.x - b.x;
      const dy = player.y - b.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const minD = player.r + b.r;
      if (d < minD && d > 0.001) {
        const nx = dx / d;
        const ny = dy / d;
        const overlap = minD - d;
        player.x += nx * overlap * 0.5;
        player.y += ny * overlap * 0.5;
        b.x -= nx * overlap * 0.5;
        b.y -= ny * overlap * 0.5;

        const relVx = player.vx - b.vx;
        const relVy = player.vy - b.vy;
        const relDot = relVx * nx + relVy * ny;
        if (relDot < 0) {
          const impulse = -relDot * 1.2;
          player.vx += nx * impulse;
          player.vy += ny * impulse;
          b.vx -= nx * impulse * 0.6;
          b.vy -= ny * impulse * 0.6;
        }

        if (Math.abs(relDot) > 30) {
          const cx = (player.x + b.x) / 2;
          const cy = (player.y + b.y) / 2;
          spawnSparks(cx, cy, 6, 'rgba(255,220,100,0.9)');
          ringPulse = 1;
          score++;
          if (score > best) best = score;
        }
      }

      if (b.life > b.maxLife || bDist > RING.r + 50) {
        const cx = b.x;
        const cy = b.y;
        spawnSparks(cx, cy, 5, 'rgba(100,200,255,0.7)');
        bots.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= Math.pow(0.95, dt * 60);
      p.vy *= Math.pow(0.95, dt * 60);
    }
  }

  function drawRing() {
    const cx = RING.x;
    const cy = RING.y;
    const r = RING.r;

    const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r * 1.5);
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,60,90,0.3)');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(20,30,50,0.2)');
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    const ringGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r * 0.3, cx, cy, r);
    ringGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a3a55');
    ringGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#1e2d45');
    ringGrad.addColorStop(1, '#152035');
    ctx.fillStyle = ringGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,50,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.1, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.95, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.95);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, pr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a7aaa';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, pr * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#8ab4e8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pr * 0.3, 0, pr * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pr * 0.3, 0, pr * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, pr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

    const bx = b.x;
    const by = b.y;

    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',60%,35%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, br, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',70%,55%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, br * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',80%,75%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(br * 0.2, 0, br * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',60%,45%)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, br, 0, Math.PI * 2);

    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.9)';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,50,0.9)';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(24, Math.floor(W * 0.03)) + 'px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 20, 50);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,150,150,0.7)';
    ctx.font = Math.max(14, Math.floor(W * 0.015)) + 'px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('BEST: ' + best, 20, 80);

    if (state === 'start') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.9)';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(32, Math.floor(W * 0.04)) + 'px Courier New';

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
      ctx.font = Math.max(18, Math.floor(W * 0.02)) + 'px Courier New';

      ctx.fillText('Bump enemy robots to score. Stay in the ring!', W / 2, H * 0.66);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawRing();
    for (const b of bots) drawBot(b);
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
  }

  function loop(ts) {
    if (!loop.last) loop.last = ts;
    let dt = (ts - loop.last) / 1000;
    loop.last = ts;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;

    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function onKey(e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'a') keys.left = true;
    if (k === 'd') keys.right = true;
    if (k === 'w') keys.up = true;

    if (k === 'd') keys.right = false;
    if (k === 'w') keys.up = false;
    if (k === 's') keys.down = false;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'space') keys.thrust = false;

  function onMouseMove(e) {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
  }

  function onMouseDown(e) {
    mouseDown = true;
    if (state === 'start') {

    }
  }

  function onMouseUp() {
    mouseDown = false;
  }

  window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
  window.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  mouseY = H / 2;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  // ---- drawing helpers ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
    r = Math.min(r, w/2, h/2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w, y+h, x, y+h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y+h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x+w, y, r);

  function drawBackground(){
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#1b2138"); g.addColorStop(0.55, "#141826"); g.addColorStop(1, "#0c0f18");
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft stage glow
    var rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, 150, 20, W/2, 150, 520);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,205,120,0.10)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,205,120,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // faint drifting dust
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)";
    for (var i=0;i<26;i++){
      var px = (i*97 + time*8*(1 + (i%3)*0.3)) % W;
      var py = (i*53 + Math.sin(time*0.5 + i)*18) % (PIANO_TOP);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 1.2 + (i%3)*0.7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // floor
    var fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H-70, 0, H);
    fg.addColorStop(0, "#0a0d15"); fg.addColorStop(1, "#05070c");
    ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.fillRect(0, H-70, W, 70);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,205,120,0.12)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  function drawPiano(){

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b3145"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Survival of Sixty Seconds</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05070f;font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;}
  canvas{display:block;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:8px;background:#0a1020;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById("game");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

const state={
  mode:"start",
  timeLeft:60,
  score:0,
  player:{x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:16,inv:0},
  movers:[],
  shake:0,
  lastT:0
};

const keys={};
function keydown(e){ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if([" ","arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) e.preventDefault();
  if(e.key===" "){ if(state.mode==="start")startGame(); else if(state.mode==="over")startGame(); }
}
function keyup(e){ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; }
addEventListener("keydown",keydown);
addEventListener("keyup",keyup);

function startGame(){
  state.mode="playing";
  state.timeLeft=60;
  state.score=0;
  state.player={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:16,inv:0};
  state.movers=[];
  state.shake=0;
  spawnWave(10);
}

function spawnWave(n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
    let x,y,vx,vy;
    const sp=1.6+Math.random()*2.6;
    if(side===0){x=-20;y=Math.random()*H;vx=sp;vy=(Math.random()-.5)*1.2;}
    else if(side===1){x=W+20;y=Math.random()*H;vx=-sp;vy=(Math.random()-.5)*1.2;}
    else if(side===2){x=Math.random()*W;y=-20;vx=(Math.random()-.5)*1.2;vy=sp;}
    else {x=Math.random()*W;y=H+20;vx=(Math.random()-.5)*1.2;vy=-sp;}
    state.movers.push({x,y,vx,vy,r:11,type:"enemy"});
  }
}

function update(dt){
  if(state.mode!=="playing") return;
  const p=state.player;

  // input -> velocity
  const ax=(keys["d"]||keys["arrowright"]?1:0)-(keys["a"]||keys["arrowleft"]?1:0);
  const ay=(keys["s"]||keys["arrowdown"]?1:0)-(keys["w"]||keys["arrowup"]?1:0);
  const speed=260;
  p.vx=ax*speed; p.vy=ay*speed;
  p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt;
  p.x=Math.max(p.r,Math.min(W-p.r,p.x));
  p.y=Math.max(p.r,Math.min(H-p.r,p.y));
  if(p.inv>0) p.inv-=dt;

  // move every mover, drop the ones that are done
  for(let i=state.movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=state.movers[i];
    // home in on player
    const dx=p.x-m.x, dy=p.y-m.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    m.vx+=dx/d*40*dt; m.vy+=dy/d*40*dt;
    const spd=Math.hypot(m.vx,m.vy), max=220;
    if(spd>max){m.vx=m.vx/spd*max; m.vy=m.vy/spd*max;}
    m.x+=m.vx*dt; m.y+=m.vy*dt;

    // collide with player
    const cd=Math.hypot(p.x-m.x,p.y-m.y);
    if(p.inv<=0 && cd < p.r+m.r){
      state.score-=10; state.shake=12; p.inv=0.8;
      state.movers.splice(i,1);
      continue;
    }
    // done if it drifted far off screen
    if(m.x<-80||m.x>W+80||m.y<-80||m.y>H+80){
      state.movers.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // score for survivors each second
  if(state.timeLeft>0){
    const before=Math.ceil(state.timeLeft);
    state.timeLeft-=dt;
    const after=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(state.timeLeft));
    if(after<before){
      state.score+=state.movers.length;
      spawnWave(6+Math.floor((60-state.timeLeft)/12));
    }
  }
  if(state.shake>0) state.shake=Math.max(0,state.shake-dt*40);

  if(state.timeLeft<=0){ state.mode="over"; }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){ ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*state.shake,(Math.random()-.5)*state.shake); }

  // background
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0a1020"); g.addColorStop(1,"#131b34");
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(90,140,220,0.10)"; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for(let y=0;y<=H;y+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke(); }

  // safe zone ring around player
  const p=state.player;
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(90,220,160,0.25)"; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r+40,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

  // movers
  for(const m of state.movers){
    const ang=Math.atan2(m.vy,m.vx);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(m.x,m.y); ctx.rotate(ang);
    ctx.fillStyle="#e8455f";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(m.r,0); ctx.lineTo(-m.r*0.7,-m.r*0.8); ctx.lineTo(-m.r*0.7,m.r*0.8);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // player
  const blink = p.inv>0 && Math.floor(p.inv*10)%2===0;
  if(!blink){
    ctx.fillStyle="#39d0ff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#0a1020";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x-5,p.y-3,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x+5,p.y-3,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,44);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff"; ctx.font="bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.textAlign="left"; ctx.fillText("SCORE  "+state.score, 18, 22);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  const t=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(state.timeLeft));
  ctx.fillStyle = t<=10 ? "#ff5b5b" : "#ffd24a";
  ctx.fillText("TIME  "+t+"s", W/2, 22);
  ctx.textAlign="right"; ctx.fillStyle="#9fe6c0";
  ctx.fillText("HOSTILES  "+state.movers.length, W-18, 22);

  if(state.mode==="start") overlay("SURVIVAL OF SIXTY SECONDS","Dodge the hostiles. Every hostile still alive each second adds to your score. Space to start.","PRESS  SPACE  TO  START");
  if(state.mode==="over") overlay("TIME'S UP","You survived 60 seconds. Final score: "+state.score,"PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY");
}

function overlay(title,sub,btn){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(4,6,14,0.72)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillStyle="#39d0ff"; ctx.font="bold 44px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2-40);
  ctx.fillStyle="#e8ecf5"; ctx.font="18px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2+8);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a"; ctx.font="bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(btn, W/2, H/2+52);
}

function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-state.lastT)/1000)||0;
  state.lastT=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Card Pack Duel</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#120f1e;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;
    user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  #game{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;touch-action:none}

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

/* ---------- canvas ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const clamp = (v,a,b)=> v<a?a : v>b?b : v;
const rand  = (a,b)=> a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const pad   = (n)=> (n<10?'0':'')+n;
const hex2rgb = (h)=>{ h=h.replace('#',''); return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)]; };
const mix = (a,b,t)=>{ const A=hex2rgb(a),B=hex2rgb(b); return 'rgb('+Math.round(A[0]+(B[0]-A[0])*t)+','+Math.round(A[1]+(B[1]-A[1])*t)+','+Math.round(A[2]+(B[2]-A[2])*t)+')'; };
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  r = Math.min(r, w/2, h/2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function rr(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){
  roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);
  if(fill){ ctx.fillStyle=fill; ctx.fill(); }
  if(stroke){ ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeStyle=stroke; ctx.stroke(); }
}
function star(cx,cy,spikes,outer,inner,rot,fill){
  ctx.beginPath();
  for(let i=0;i<spikes*2;i++){
    const r = (i%2===0)?outer:inner;
    const a = rot + (Math.PI/spikes)*i;
    const px = cx + Math.cos(a)*r, py = cy + Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill();
}
function drawCard(x,y,w,h,theme){
  ctx.save();
  rr(x,y,w,h,Math.max(4,w*0.09), theme.face, theme.border);
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, w*0.02); ctx.strokeStyle = theme.border;
  roundRect(x+w*0.09, y+h*0.09, w*0.82, h*0.82, w*0.05); ctx.stroke();
  const s = Math.min(w,h);
  star(x+w*0.5, y+h*0.42, 5, s*0.22, s*0.09, -Math.PI/2, theme.gem);
  ctx.fillStyle = theme.gem;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+w*0.5, y+h*0.82, s*0.045, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- constants ---------- */
const CARD_W = 74, CARD_H = 104, CARD_GAP = 12, CARD_TOP = 30;
const P1 = {name:'AURA',  face:'#4b83ff', border:'#bcd4ff', gem:'#ffe27a'};
const P2 = {name:'EMBER', face:'#ff5a5a', border:'#ffc0c0', gem:'#ffd24d'};
const TARGET = 5;
const GRAV = 1500;
const START = 20;

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let state = 'menu';
let t = 0;
let shake = 0;
let score1 = 0, score2 = 0;
let banner = {text:'', until:0, color:'#fff'};
let lastTime = 0;
let mouse = {x:0, y:0, down:false};
const movers = [];
const particles = [];
const cards1 = [], cards2 = [];
const stars = [];
const keys = {};
let winner = 0;

/* ---------- build stars ---------- */
for(let i=0;i<110;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random(), y:Math.random(), r:rand(0.4,1.8), ph:rand(0,6.28), sp:rand(0.5,1.6)});

/* ---------- cards ---------- */
function buildCards(arr, side, theme){
  arr.length = 0;
  const n = 6;
  const total = n*CARD_W + (n-1)*CARD_GAP;
  const cx = side===1 ? W*0.22 : W*0.78;
  const x0 = cx - total/2;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    arr.push({x:x0+i*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP), y:0, vx:0, vy:0, rot:0, vr:0,
      phase:'ready', side:side, theme:theme, grab:0, grabY:0, wob:rand(0,6.28)});
  }
}
function initCards(){ buildCards(cards1,1,P1); buildCards(cards2,2,P2); }
function placeCards(){
  for(const c of cards1){
    const n = cards1.length; const total = n*CARD_W + (n-1)*CARD_GAP;
    const cx = W*0.22, x0 = cx - total/2;
    c.x = x0 + cards1.indexOf(c)*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP);
    c.y = CARD_TOP + Math.sin(t*2 + c.wob)*3;
    c.vx = 0; c.vy = 0; c.rot = 0; c.vr = 0; c.phase = 'ready';
  }
  for(const c of cards2){
    const n = cards2.length; const total = n*CARD_W + (n-1)*CARD_GAP;
    const cx = W*0.78, x0 = cx - total/2;
    c.x = x0 + cards2.indexOf(c)*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP);
    c.y = CARD_TOP + Math.sin(t*2 + c.wob)*3;
    c.vx = 0; c.vy = 0; c.rot = 0; c.vr = 0; c.phase = 'ready';
  }
}
function resetGame(){
  movers.length = 0; particles.length = 0;
  score1 = 0; score2 = 0;
  initCards(); placeCards();
  banner = {text:'STEAL 5 CARDS', until:t+2.4, color:'#fff'};
  shake = 0; winner = 0;
  state = 'play';
}

/* ---------- particles ---------- */
function spawnP(x,y,vx,vy,life,size,color,kind){
  if(particles.length > 520) return;
  particles.push({x,y,vx,vy,life,max:life,size,color,kind});
}
function burst(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp = rand(60,320);
    spawnP(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,rand(0.5,1.1),rand(2,5),color,'spark');
  }
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function screenPos(e){
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {x:e.clientX-r.left, y:e.clientY-r.top};
}
function pointerDown(e){
  const p = screenPos(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.down=true;
  if(state==='menu'){ resetGame(); return; }
  if(state==='over'){ resetGame(); return; }
  if(state!=='play') return;
  const side = (p.x < W/2) ? 1 : 2;
  const arr = side===1 ? cards1 : cards2;
  const top = arr[arr.length-1];
  if(!top) return;
  if(p.x >= top.x && p.x <= top.x+CARD_W && p.y >= top.y-24 && p.y <= top.y+CARD_H+24){
    top.phase='grab'; top.grab=1; top.grabY=p.y;
    top.vx = (p.x - (top.x+CARD_W/2))*6;
    top.vy = 0;
  }
}
function pointerMove(e){
  const p = screenPos(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y;
  if(state==='play'){
    for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]) for(const c of arr) if(c.phase==='grab') c.grabY=p.y;
  }
}
function pointerUp(e){
  mouse.down=false;
  if(state!=='play') return;
  for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]) for(const c of arr) if(c.phase==='grab') c.phase='fly';
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', pointerDown);
window.addEventListener('mousemove', pointerMove);
window.addEventListener('mouseup', pointerUp);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); const t0=e.changedTouches[0]; pointerDown(t0); }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove',  function(e){ e.preventDefault(); const t0=e.changedTouches[0]; pointerMove(t0); }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend',   function(e){ e.preventDefault(); pointerUp(e); }, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if((state==='menu'||state==='over') && (e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter')) resetGame();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[e.key]=false; });

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  t += dt;
  shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt);

  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    if(p.kind==='spark') p.vy += GRAV*0.35*dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  if(state==='play'){
    for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]) for(const c of arr){
      if(c.phase==='grab'){
        c.x += (mouse.x - CARD_W/2 - c.x)*Math.min(1, dt*14);
        c.y += (c.grabY - c.y)*Math.min(1, dt*14);
        c.vy = 0;
        c.vx *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
        c.rot += c.vr*dt; c.vr *= Math.pow(0.2, dt);
      }
    }
    const n = movers.length;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const c = movers[i];
      c.vy += GRAV*dt;
      c.x  += c.vx*dt;
      c.y  += c.vy*dt;
      c.rot += c.vr*dt;
      if(c.y > H + 200) c.done = true;
    }
    for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const c = movers[i];
      if(c.done){
        const cx = c.x + CARD_W/2, cy = c.y + CARD_H/2;
        if(c.side===1 && c.x + CARD_W/2 >= W/2){
          score1++;
          burst(cx,cy,P1.gem,18);
          banner = {text:'AURA STEALS A CARD', until:t+1.2, color:P1.face};
          shake = 8;
        } else if(c.side===2 && c.x + CARD_W/2 <= W/2){
          score2++;
          burst(cx,cy,P2.gem,18);
          banner = {text:'EMBER STEALS A CARD', until:t+1.2, color:P2.face};
          shake = 8;
        }
        movers.splice(i,1);
      }
    }
    if(score1 >= TARGET){ winner=1; state='over'; }
    else if(score2 >= TARGET){ winner=2; state='over'; }
  } else {
    for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]) for(const c of arr){
      c.y = CARD_TOP + Math.sin(t*2 + c.wob)*3;
      c.rot *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function draw(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#1a1436'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#241a45'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0e0a20');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  const rad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H*0.42, 20, W/2, H*0.42, Math.max(W,H)*0.7);
  rad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,90,200,0.28)'); rad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = rad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0.3) ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));

  for(const s of stars){
    const tw = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(t*s.sp + s.ph);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + tw*0.55;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd6ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x*W, s.y*H, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  const mid = W/2;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([10,14]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mid, 0); ctx.lineTo(mid, H); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '700 12px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('  THE LINE  ', mid, 22);

  for(const p of particles){
    const a = clamp(p.life/p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    if(p.kind==='spark'){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size*a+0.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  for(const c of movers){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(c.x+CARD_W/2, c.y+CARD_H/2); ctx.rotate(c.rot);
    drawCard(-CARD_W/2,-CARD_H/2,CARD_W,CARD_H,c.theme);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]){
    for(const c of arr){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(c.x+CARD_W/2, c.y+CARD_H/2); ctx.rotate(c.rot);
      drawCard(-CARD_W/2,-CARD_H/2,CARD_W,CARD_H,c.theme);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  for(const arr of [cards1,cards2]){
    const top = arr[arr.length-1];
    if(top && state==='play'){
      const cx = top.x + CARD_W/2, cy = top.y + CARD_H/2;
      const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(t*4)*0.06;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = top.theme.gem; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,(CARD_W/2+16)*pulse,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle = top.theme.gem;
      ctx.font = '700 13px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText('STEAL ME', cx, top.y + CARD_H + 22);
    }
  }

  drawHud();
  ctx.restore();

  if(state==='menu') drawMenu();
  if(state==='over') drawOver();
}

function drawHud(){
  ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillStyle=P1.face; ctx.font='800 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(P1.name, 24, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='800 44px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(String(score1), 24, 84);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.font='600 12px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('GOAL '+TARGET, 24, 102);

  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle=P2.face; ctx.font='800 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(P2.name, W-24, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='800 44px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(String(score2), W-24, 84);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.font='600 12px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('GOAL '+TARGET, W-24, 102);

  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'; ctx.font='700 14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('CARD PACK DUEL', W/2, 44);

  if(banner.text && t < banner.until){
    const a = clamp((banner.until - t)/1.2, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = banner.color;
    ctx.font='800 34px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(banner.text, W/2, H*0.42);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawMenu(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,5,20,0.62)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';

<title>Campfire</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#061018;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
  canvas{display:block;max-width:96vw;max-height:92vh;box-shadow:0 14px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:6px}
</style>

<canvas id="game" width="960" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// ---- State ----
const camp = {
  x: W * 0.5,
  y: H * 0.84,
  r: 24
};
const fire = { x: camp.x, y: camp.y, r: 9, heat: 0, flick: 0 };
const player = { x: camp.x, y: camp.y - 6, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 11, speed: 250 };
const movers = [];
const trees = [];
const tents = [];
const keys = {};
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let time = 0;
let winTime = 0;

// ---- Scene: build trees, tents, and the starting fire ----
function makeTree(x, y, s) {
  return { x, y, s, sway: Math.random() * 6.28 };
}
function makeTent(x, y, w, h, c1, c2) {
  return { x, y, w, h, c1, c2 };
}
function buildScene() {
  const cols = 5, rows = 3, gapX = 150, gapY = 120;
  const ox = (W - (cols - 1) * gapX) / 2;
  const oy = 92;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      trees.push(makeTree(ox + c * gapX, oy + r * gapY, 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.4));
    }
  }
  tents.push(makeTent(W * 0.16, H * 0.72, 120, 96, '#e07b52', '#c25a3a'));
  tents.push(makeTent(W * 0.84, H * 0.72, 120, 96, '#5aa0d6', '#3f7fb0'));
}
function spawnFire() {
  movers.push({
    x: fire.x + (Math.random() * 20 - 10),
    y: fire.y - 4,
    vx: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 18,
    vy: -55 - Math.random() * 35,
    r: 3.5 + Math.random() * 3.5,
    life: 0,
    max: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.7,
    hue: 18 + Math.random() * 24
  });
}
function spawnSmoke() {
  movers.push({
    x: fire.x + (Math.random() * 14 - 7),
    y: fire.y - 10,
    vx: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 12,
    vy: -22 - Math.random() * 20,
    r: 5 + Math.random() * 5,
    life: 0,
    max: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.9,
    hue: 210
  });
}
function startGame() {
  state = 'play';
  score = 0;
  time = 0;
  winTime = 0;
  movers.length = 0;
  fire.heat = 0;
  player.x = camp.x;
  player.y = camp.y - 6;
  player.vx = 0;
  player.vy = 0;
}

// ---- Input ----
addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (state !== 'play' && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    startGame();
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

// ---- Update ----
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  if (state === 'play') {
    let ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) ax -= 1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) ax += 1;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) ay -= 1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) ay += 1;
    const m = Math.hypot(ax, ay);
    if (m > 0) {
      player.vx = ax / m * player.speed;
      player.vy = ay / m * player.speed;
    } else {
      player.vx *= 0.8;
      player.vy *= 0.8;
    }
    player.x += player.vx * dt;
    player.y += player.vy * dt;
    player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H - 20, player.y));

    const dist = Math.hypot(player.x - fire.x, player.y - fire.y);
    fire.heat += (dist < 60 ? 1 : -0.7) * dt;
    fire.heat = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, fire.heat));
    fire.flick += dt;
    score += dt;

    const spawnRate = 0.03 + fire.heat * 0.0018;
    if (Math.random() < spawnRate * dt * 60) spawnFire();
    if (Math.random() < spawnRate * dt * 30) spawnSmoke();

    if (fire.heat >= 100) {
      state = 'win';
      winTime = 0;
    }
  } else if (state === 'win') {
    winTime += dt;
    if (Math.random() < 0.6) spawnFire();
    if (Math.random() < 0.3) spawnSmoke();
  }

  // Move every mover, drop the finished ones
  for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = movers[i];
    p.life += dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += (p.hue > 100 ? -8 : 22) * dt;
    p.vx *= 0.985;
    if (p.life >= p.max) movers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// ---- Draw helpers ----
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawTree(t) {
  const s = t.s;
  const sway = Math.sin(time * 1.2 + t.sway) * 3;
  const h = 78 * s;
  const topY = t.y - h;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a22';
  ctx.fillRect(t.x - 5 * s, t.y - 6, 10 * s, 12);
  const layers = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < layers; i++) {
    const ly = topY + (i / layers) * h * 0.8;
    const lw = (24 + i * 14) * s;
    const shade = 40 + i * 14;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + (115 + i * 6) + ',' + (48 - i * 6) + '%,' + shade + '%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(t.x + sway * (i + 1) * 0.3, ly);
    ctx.lineTo(t.x - lw, ly + 34 * s);
    ctx.lineTo(t.x + lw, ly + 34 * s);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawTent(t) {
  const { x, y, w, h, c1, c2 } = t;
  const apexX = x + w / 2;
  const apexY = y - h;
  ctx.fillStyle = c2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(apexX, apexY);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = c1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(apexX, apexY);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.45, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(apexX, apexY + 14);
  ctx.lineTo(apexX - 16, y);
  ctx.lineTo(apexX + 16, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}
function drawFire() {
  const heat = fire.heat;
  const flick = Math.sin(fire.flick * 12) * 2 + Math.sin(fire.flick * 23) * 1.5;
  const glow = 30 + heat * 0.6 + flick * 2;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(fire.x, fire.y, 2, fire.x, fire.y, glow);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,180,60,0.9)');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,120,30,0.4)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,90,20,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(fire.x, fire.y, glow, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const flames = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < flames; i++) {
    const off = (i - 1) * 7;
    const fh = 18 + heat * 0.25 + flick;
    ctx.fillStyle = i === 1 ? '#ffd34d' : (i === 0 ? '#ff8a2b' : '#ff5a1f');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fire.x + off, fire.y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fire.x + off - 8, fire.y - fh * 0.6, fire.x + off, fire.y - fh);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fire.x + off + 8, fire.y - fh * 0.6, fire.x + off, fire.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2416';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = (i / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(fire.x + Math.cos(a) * 16, fire.y + 6 + Math.sin(a) * 5, 4, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawMover(p) {
  const t = p.life / p.max;
  const isSmoke = p.hue > 100;
  const alpha = (1 - t) * (isSmoke ? 0.5 : 0.9);
  const r = p.r * (isSmoke ? (1 + t * 1.5) : (1 - t * 0.4));
  if (isSmoke) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(210,10%,' + (60 + t * 20) + '%,' + alpha + ')';
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + (p.hue - t * 10) + ',95%,' + (55 + t * 10) + '%,' + alpha + ')';
  }
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, Math.max(0.5, r), 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}
function drawPlayer() {
  const { x, y, r } = player;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y + r * 0.8, r, r * 0.4, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c98a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - r * 0.6, r * 0.7, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2f6fb0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - r * 0.4);
  ctx.lineTo(x - r, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}
function drawHUD() {
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Campfire', 22, 34);
  ctx.font = '14px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.fillText('Keep the fire going — warm it to 100 to win.  WASD / arrows to move.', 22, 54);
  const barW = 220, barH = 14, bx = 22, by = 66;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  roundRect(bx, by, barW, barH, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + barW, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ff5a1f');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#ffd34d');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(bx + 2, by + 2, Math.max(0, (barW - 4) * fire.heat / 100), barH - 4, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
  ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Heat ' + Math.round(fire.heat) + '%', bx, by + barH + 16);
}
function drawOverlay() {
  if (state === 'play') return;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,16,24,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd34d';
  ctx.font = 'bold 44px system-ui, sans-serif';
  const msg = state === 'win' ? 'The campfire is roaring!' : 'Campfire';
  ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
  const sub = state === 'win'
    ? 'You kept the fire burning. Time: ' + score.toFixed(1) + 's'
    : 'Walk close to the fire to warm it. Reach 100% to win.';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 14);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd0ff';
  ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(state === 'win' ? 'Press Enter to play again' : 'Press Enter to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
}

// ---- Draw ----
function draw() {
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#12233a');
  sky.addColorStop(0.5, '#274a63');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#3f6f86');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
    const sy = (i * 71.3) % (H * 0.4);
    const tw = 0.5 + Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.3;
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.15, tw);
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const ground = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.45, 0, H);
  ground.addColorStop(0, '#2f5d3a');
  ground.addColorStop(1, '#1f4028');
  ctx.fillStyle = ground;
  ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.45, W, H * 0.55);
  for (const t of trees) drawTree(t);
  for (const t of tents) drawTent(t);
  drawFire();
  for (const p of movers) drawMover(p);
  drawPlayer();
  drawHUD();
  drawOverlay();
}

// ---- Loop ----
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
buildScene();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

    phase: 'title',   // 'title' | 'play' | 'win' | 'lose'
    score: 0,
    thirst: 0,        // 0..100
    spawn: 0,
    t: 0
  };

  // single array of movers: each has x, y, vx, vy (plus extra fields)
  const movers = [];
  const bar = { x:0, y:0, w:0, h:0 };
  const key = { left:false, right:false, jump:false, jumpQ:false };

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    bar.w = Math.min(W * 0.82, 1040);
    bar.h = Math.max(54, H * 0.11);
    bar.x = (W - bar.w) / 2;
    bar.y = H * 0.42;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- input ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (state.phase === 'title') {
      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state.phase === 'win' || state.phase === 'lose') {
      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { state.phase = 'title'; movers.length = 0; }
      return;
    }
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'a' || k === 'A') key.left = true;
    if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd' || k === 'D') key.right = true;
    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === ' ' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') key.jumpQ = true;
    if ([' ','ArrowUp','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'a' || k === 'A') key.left = false;
    if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === 'd' || k === 'D') key.right = false;
    if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === ' ' || k === 'w' || k === 'W') key.jump = false;
  });

  function startGame() {
    movers.length = 0;
    state.phase = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.thirst = 0;
    state.spawn = 0;
  }

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function spawnDroplet() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -24 : W + 24;
    const vx = (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * (1.3 + Math.random() * 2.2);
    const y = H * (0.05 + Math.random() * 0.45);
    const vy = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8;
    movers.push({
      x, y, vx, vy,
      r: 12 + Math.random() * 8,
      spin: 0,
      spinV: (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.05 + Math.random() * 0.05),
      kind: 'drop',
      dead: false
    });
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state.phase !== 'play') return;

    // thirst drains; refill when you drink
    state.thirst -= dt * 5.0;
    if (state.thirst < 0) {
      state.thirst = 0;
      state.phase = 'lose';
      return;
    }

    // spawn droplets
    state.spawn += dt;
    const interval = Math.max(0.55, 1.35 - state.t * 0.01);
    if (state.spawn >= interval) {
      state.spawn = 0;
      spawnDroplet();
    }

    // move every mover
    for (const m of movers) {
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.spinV) m.spin += m.spinV * dt;
    }

    // collisions + drop the ones that are done
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      const hit =
        m.x + m.r > bar.x && m.x - m.r < bar.x + bar.w &&
        m.y + m.r > bar.y && m.y - m.r < bar.y + bar.h;
      if (hit) {
        state.thirst = Math.min(100, state.thirst + 14);
        state.score += 10;
        movers.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      if (m.x < -60 || m.x > W + 60 || m.y > H + 60) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    if (state.score >= 200) state.phase = 'win';
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function draw() {
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#123a5c');
    sky.addColorStop(0.55, '#1f6f93');
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#7fd3e0');
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    const sx = W * 0.82, sy = H * 0.16;
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 4, sx, sy, 130);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,244,190,0.95)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,244,190,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 130, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3c4';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 34, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

    // clouds
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    drawCloud(W * 0.18, H * 0.12, 1.0);
    drawCloud(W * 0.5, H * 0.2, 0.7);
    drawCloud(W * 0.35, H * 0.3, 0.5);

    // ground
    const ground = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.72, 0, H);
    ground.addColorStop(0, '#2f8f5b');
    ground.addColorStop(1, '#17603a');
    ctx.fillStyle = ground;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.72, W, H * 0.28);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.72, W, 4);

    // the thirst bar (the subject)
    drawBar();

    // droplets
    for (const m of movers) drawDrop(m);

    // overlay for title / win / lose
    if (state.phase !== 'play') drawOverlay();
  }

  function drawCloud(x, y, s) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 26, 0, 7);
    ctx.arc(30, -8, 30, 0, 7);
    ctx.arc(64, 2, 24, 0, 7);
    ctx.arc(34, 12, 26, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBar() {
    // frame
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0c2c3f';
    roundRect(bar.x - 8, bar.y - 8, bar.w + 16, bar.h + 16, 16);
    ctx.fill();
    // inner track
    ctx.fillStyle = '#123246';
    roundRect(bar.x, bar.y, bar.w, bar.h, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    // fill
    const fw = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.thirst / 100)) * bar.w;
    if (fw > 0) {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(bar.x, bar.y, bar.x, bar.y + bar.h);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#7fe0ff');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#22a6e0');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      roundRect(bar.x, bar.y, fw, bar.h, 10);
      ctx.fill();
      // shine
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
      roundRect(bar.x + 6, bar.y + 5, fw - 12, bar.h * 0.28, 8);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // tick marks
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
      const tx = bar.x + (bar.w * i) / 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx, bar.y + 4);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, bar.y + bar.h - 4);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // label
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eafaff';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(14, bar.h * 0.34) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('THIRST  ' + Math.round(state.thirst) + '%', bar.x + bar.w / 2, bar.y + bar.h / 2);
  }

  function drawDrop(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.spin || 0);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.3, 2, 0, 0, m.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#d6f6ff');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#57c6f0');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1f88c0');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -m.r * 1.3);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(m.r * 1.1, -m.r * 0.2, m.r * 0.9, m.r, 0, m.r);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-m.r * 0.9, m.r, -m.r * 1.1, -m.r * 0.2, 0, -m.r * 1.3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.25, m.r * 0.22, m.r * 0.32, -0.5, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,20,32,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
    let title = 'THIRST BAR', sub = 'Catch the water droplets to keep your bar full.',
      hint = 'Press ENTER or SPACE to start', big = '#7fe0ff';

    if (state.phase === 'win') {
      title = 'SIP SAVED!';
      sub = 'You reached 200 points and stayed hydrated.';
      hint = 'Press ENTER or SPACE to go to the title';
      big = '#8dff9e';
    } else if (state.phase === 'lose') {
      title = 'DROUGHT!';
      sub = 'Your thirst bar ran dry. Final score: ' + state.score;
      hint = 'Press ENTER or SPACE to go to the title';
      big = '#ff8a6b';
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = big;
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(34, H * 0.09) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, cx, cy - H * 0.08);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#dfeff5';
    ctx.font = Math.max(16, H * 0.032) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(sub, cx, cy + H * 0.02);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fd8ea';
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.max(14, H * 0.026) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(hint, cx, cy + H * 0.1);

    if (state.phase === 'title') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.font = Math.max(13, H * 0.022) + 'px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('Move the bar with ← → (or A / D)  •  jump it with ↑ / W / SPACE', cx, cy + H * 0.16);
    }
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    state.t += dt;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
