<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Substitution Cipher Duel</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; height:100%; background:#0e1526; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; }
  canvas { background:#12203a; border:4px solid #2a3f66; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="900" height="620"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

  // ---- constants ----
  var GOAL = 5;
  var FONT = 'Courier New, monospace';

  // ---- state ----
  var state = 'start';
  var scoreA = 0, scoreB = 0;
  var movers = [];
  var shake = 0;
  var flash = 0;
  var keys = {};

  // ---- player config ----
  var P = {
    A: { key:'a', color:'#3fd0ff', x:235, y:330, name:'BLUE' },
    B: { key:'b', color:'#ff8a4c', x:665, y:330, name:'ORANGE' }
  };

  // ---- cipher (substitution: map each letter to a random letter) ----
  var alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  var map = {};
  (function buildCipher(){
    var pool = alphabet.split('');
    for (var i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      var t = pool[i]; pool[i]=pool[j]; pool[j]=t;
    }
    for (var k=0;k<alphabet.length;k++){ map[alphabet[k]] = pool[k]; }
  })();

  function decode(word){
    var out='';
    for (var i=0;i<word.length;i++){
      var c = word[i].toUpperCase();
      out += (map[c] ? map[c] : c);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---- helpers ----
  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
  function dist(x1,y1,x2,y2){ return Math.hypot(x1-x2,y1-y2); }
  function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function spawnWord(){
    var words = ['KEY','LOCK','CODE','CIPHER','SECRET','SIGNAL','MAGIC','POWER','GHOST','NOVA','ORBIT','SPARK','DELTA','ALPHA','OMEGA'];
    var w = words[Math.floor(Math.random()*words.length)].split('');
    var n = w.length;
    var gap = 52;
    var total = n*gap;
    var x0 = W/2 - total/2 + gap/2;
    for (var i=0;i<n;i++){
      movers.push({
        type:'letter',
        x: x0 + i*gap,
        y: -20,
        vx: rand(-0.4,0.4),
        vy: rand(0.35,0.8),
        char: w[i],
        size: 44,
        bob: Math.random()*Math.PI*2
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnLetter(x,y,vy){
    movers.push({ type:'letter', x:x, y:y, vx:rand(-0.5,0.5), vy:vy, char:alphabet[Math.floor(Math.random()*26)], size:34, bob:Math.random()*Math.PI*2 });
  }

  function spawnConfetti(x,y,color){
    for (var i=0;i<26;i++){
      var a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      var sp = rand(2,7);
      movers.push({ type:'confetti', x:x, y:y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp - 2, life:rand(30,60), max:60, color:color, spin:rand(-0.3,0.3), rot:0, size:rand(4,9) });
    }
  }

  function spawnText(x,y,text,color,vy){
    movers.push({ type:'text', x:x, y:y, vx:0, vy:vy, text:text, color:color, size:26, life:70, max:70 });
  }

  function resetPositions(){
    movers = movers.filter(function(m){ return m.type==='bg'; });
    spawnWord();
  }

  function initBg(){
    for (var i=0;i<10;i++){
      movers.push({ type:'bg', x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,H), vx:rand(-0.2,0.2), vy:rand(-0.2,0.2), size:rand(40,120), alpha:rand(0.03,0.08) });
    }
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (state==='start' && (k===' '||k==='enter')){
      scoreA=0; scoreB=0; resetPositions(); state='play';
    } else if (state==='over' && (k===' '||k==='enter')){
      scoreA=0; scoreB=0; resetPositions(); state='play';
    }
    if (state==='play'){
      if (k==='a') tryMove(P.A);
      if (k==='b') tryMove(P.B);
    }
    if (k===' '||k==='arrowup'||k==='arrowdown'||k==='arrowleft'||k==='arrowright') e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  function tryMove(cfg){
    var px = cfg.x, py = cfg.y;
    var best = null, bd = 90;
    for (var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      var m = movers[i];
      if (m.type!=='letter') continue;
      var d = dist(px,py,m.x,m.y);
      if (d < bd){ bd = d; best = m; }
    }
    if (best){
      movers.splice(movers.indexOf(best),1);
      spawnText(best.x, best.y-10, 'DECODED', cfg.color, -1.2);
      spawnConfetti(best.x, best.y, cfg.color);
      if (cfg===P.A) scoreA++; else scoreB++;
      shake = 10; flash = 0.5;
      if (scoreA>=GOAL || scoreB>=GOAL){ state='over'; }
      else if (movers.filter(function(m){return m.type==='letter';}).length===0){ spawnWord(); }
    }
  }

  // ---- update ----
  function update(){
    if (state==='play'){
      if (keys['a']) P.A.x += 5.5;
      if (keys['d']) P.A.x -= 5.5;
      if (keys['w']) P.A.y += 5.5;
      if (keys['s']) P.A.y -= 5.5;
      if (keys['j']) P.B.x += 5.5;
      if (keys['l']) P.B.x -= 5.5;
      if (keys['i']) P.B.y += 5.5;
      if (keys['k']) P.B.y -= 5.5;
    }
    P.A.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W-20, P.A.x));
    P.A.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H-20, P.A.y));
    P.B.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W-20, P.B.x));
    P.B.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H-20, P.B.y));

    var alive = [];
    for (var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      var m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;

      if (m.type==='letter'){
        m.bob += 0.05;
        if (m.x < 20 || m.x > W-20) m.vx *= -1;
        if (m.y > H+40){
          if (state==='play'){ spawnLetter(rand(60,W-60), -20, rand(0.3,0.7)); }
          continue; // drop
        }
      } else if (m.type==='confetti'){
        m.vy += 0.15;
        m.rot += m.spin;
        m.life--;
        if (m.life<=0) continue; // drop
      } else if (m.type==='text'){
        m.life--;
        if (m.life<=0) continue; // drop
      } else if (m.type==='bg'){
        if (m.x < -130) m.x = W+130;
        if (m.x > W+130) m.x = -130;
        if (m.y < -130) m.y = H+130;
        if (m.y > H+130) m.y = -130;
      }
      alive.push(m);
    }
    movers = alive;

    if (shake>0) shake *= 0.85;
    if (flash>0) flash -= 0.05;
  }

  // ---- draw ----
  function drawPlayer(cfg){
    var x=cfg.x, y=cfg.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,34,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,22,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e1526';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px ' + FONT;
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(cfg.key.toUpperCase(), x, y+1);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if (shake>0.5) ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake), rand(-shake,shake));

    // background gradient
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#14243f');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#0d1526');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);

    // drifting glyph blobs
    for (var i=0;i<movers.length;i++){
      var m = movers[i];
      if (m.type!=='bg') continue;
      ctx.globalAlpha = m.alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3fd0ff';
      ctx.font = (m.size*2) + 'px ' + FONT;
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(alphabet[Math.floor((m.x*m.y)%26)], m.x, m.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // letters
    for (var j=0;j<movers.length;j++){
      var L = movers[j];
      if (L.type!=='letter') continue;
      var yy = L.y + Math.sin(L.bob)*4;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f7ff';
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + L.size + 'px ' + FONT;
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(L.char, L.x, yy);
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.strokeText(L.char, L.x, yy);
    }

    // confetti
    for (var c=0;c<movers.length;c++){
      var cf = movers[c];
      if (cf.type!=='confetti') continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cf.x,cf.y); ctx.rotate(cf.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, cf.life/cf.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = cf.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-cf.size/2,-cf.size/2,cf.size,cf.size);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // floating text
    for (var t=0;t<movers.length;t++){
      var tx = movers[t];
      if (tx.type!=='text') continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, tx.life/tx.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = tx.color;
      ctx.font = 'bold ' + tx.size + 'px ' + FONT;
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(tx.text, tx.x, tx.y);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    drawPlayer(P.A);
    drawPlayer(P.B);

    // flash
    if (flash>0){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(flash*0.4)+')'; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40); }

    // ---- HUD ----
    ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    ctx.fillStyle='#3fd0ff'; ctx.font='bold 22px '+FONT;
    ctx.fillText('BLUE  '+scoreA+' / '+GOAL, 24, 40);
    ctx.textAlign='right';
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8a4c';
    ctx.fillText('ORANGE  '+scoreB+' / '+GOAL, W-24, 40);
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#8aa0c8'; ctx.font='14px '+FONT;
    ctx.fillText('FIRST TO '+GOAL+' WINS', W/2, 34);

    // ---- overlays ----
    if (state==='start'){
      overlay();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='bold 40px '+FONT; ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText('SUBSTITUTION CIPHER DUEL', W/2, 200);
      ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4d8'; ctx.font='18px '+FONT;
      ctx.fillText('Letters fall down. Decode them before they escape!', W/2, 245);
      ctx.fillText('Move to a letter and press your key to decode it.', W/2, 275);
      ctx.fillStyle='#3fd0ff'; ctx.font='bold 20px '+FONT;
      ctx.fillText('BLUE  →  W A S D', W/2, 330);
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff8a4c';
      ctx.fillText('ORANGE  →  I J K L', W/2, 365);
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='bold 24px '+FONT;
      ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO START', W/2, 440);
    } else if (state==='over'){
      overlay();
      var winner = scoreA>scoreB ? 'BLUE WINS!' : (scoreB>scoreA ? 'ORANGE WINS!' : 'DRAW!');
      ctx.fillStyle = scoreA>scoreB ? '#3fd0ff' : (scoreB>scoreA ? '#ff8a4c' : '#ffffff');
      ctx.font='bold 48px '+FONT; ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText(winner, W/2, 250);
      ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4d8'; ctx.font='22px '+FONT;
      ctx.fillText('BLUE '+scoreA+'   •   ORANGE '+scoreB, W/2, 300);
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='bold 24px '+FONT;
      ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO PLAY AGAIN', W/2, 400);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function overlay(){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,12,24,.78)';
    ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function loop(){
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  initBg();
  spawnWord();
  loop();
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=no">
<title>Parry Window</title>
<style>
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#0a0e1a; }
  #game { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; cursor:crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  const state = {
    phase: 'start',
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    combo: 0,
    bestCombo: 0,
    time: 0,
    spawnTimer: 0,
    spawnInterval: 1.5,
    shake: 0,
    hitFlash: 0,
    hitX: 0,
    hitY: 0
  };

  const mouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  const parry = { active: false, cooldown: 0, radius: 60, duration: 0.18 };
  const movers = [];
  const particles = [];

  const sword = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    tipX: 0, tipY: 0,
    angle: 0,
    swing: 0,
    swingDir: 1
  };

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    sword.x = W * 0.5;
    sword.y = H * 0.82;
  }

  function spawnMover() {
    const type = Math.random() < 0.7 ? 'shard' : 'bolt';
    const x = W * (0.12 + Math.random() * 0.76);
    const y = -30;
    const speed = 150 + Math.random() * 120 + state.score * 3;
    const vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60;
    const vy = speed;
    movers.push({
      type: type,
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: vx, vy: vy,
      r: type === 'shard' ? 20 : 14,
      spin: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      hue: type === 'shard' ? 200 : 30,
      done: false
    });
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = 60 + Math.random() * 220;
      particles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * s,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40,
        life: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        maxLife: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        r: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        color: color
      });
    }
  }

  function doParry() {
    if (parry.cooldown > 0) return;
    parry.active = true;
    parry.cooldown = 0.35;
    parry.timer = parry.duration;
    sword.swing = 1;

    let hitAny = false;
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      const dx = m.x - mouse.x;
      const dy = m.y - mouse.y;
      const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d < parry.radius + m.r) {
        m.done = true;
        hitAny = true;
        state.combo++;
        if (state.combo > state.bestCombo) state.bestCombo = state.combo;
        state.score += (typeBonus(m.type) * (1 + state.combo * 0.5));
        state.hitX = m.x;
        state.hitY = m.y;
        state.hitFlash = 1;
        state.shake = 6;
        spawnParticles(m.x, m.y, m.hue === 200 ? '#5fd8ff' : '#ffd24a', 14);
      }
    }
    if (!hitAny) {
      state.combo = 0;
      spawnParticles(mouse.x, mouse.y, '#8899bb', 6);
    }
  }

  function typeBonus(type) {
    return type === 'shard' ? 10 : 20;
  }

  function onHit() {
    state.lives--;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.shake = 10;
    state.hitFlash = 1;
    if (state.lives <= 0) {
      state.phase = 'over';
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.phase = 'play';
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.combo = 0;
    state.bestCombo = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    state.spawnTimer = 0;
    state.spawnInterval = 1.5;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.hitFlash = 0;
    movers.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (state.phase !== 'play') return;

    state.time += dt;
    state.spawnInterval = Math.max(0.55, 1.5 - state.score * 0.004);

    if (parry.cooldown > 0) parry.cooldown -= dt;
    if (parry.timer > 0) {
      parry.timer -= dt;
      if (parry.timer <= 0) parry.active = false;
    }
    if (sword.swing > 0) sword.swing -= dt * 4;
    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake -= dt * 30;
    if (state.hitFlash > 0) state.hitFlash -= dt * 3;

    state.spawnTimer += dt;
    if (state.spawnTimer >= state.spawnInterval) {
      state.spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnMover();
    }

    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.rot += m.spin * dt;

      if (m.y > H + 40) {
        m.done = true;
        if (m.type === 'shard') {
          onHit();
        }
      }
      if (m.done) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 200 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e1a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#141b30');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1c2440');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const x = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const y = (i * 89.3) % H;
      const r = 1 + (i % 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.04;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const y = (i / 8) * H;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
    const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H, 0, W/2, H, W*0.6);
    grd.addColorStop(0, '#5fd8ff');
    grd.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(95,216,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = grd;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawMover(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.rot);

    if (m.type === 'shard') {
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-m.r, -m.r, m.r, m.r);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#bfeaff');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#3aa8e0');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a5a8a');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -m.r * 1.3);
      ctx.lineTo(m.r * 0.7, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, m.r * 1.3);
      ctx.lineTo(-m.r * 0.7, 0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(190,234,255,0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -m.r * 1.3);
      ctx.lineTo(0, m.r * 1.3);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.25, -m.r * 0.35, m.r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, m.r);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff2c0');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffb02e');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#c05a00');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,0.7)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-m.r * 0.6, -m.r * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(m.r * 0.6, m.r * 0.6);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSword() {
    const bx = sword.x;
    const by = sword.y;
    const len = 130;
    const swingAngle = (sword.swing > 0 ? sword.swing : 0) * 0.6 * sword.swingDir;
    const baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + swingAngle;
    sword.angle = baseAngle;
    sword.tipX = bx + Math.cos(baseAngle) * len;
    sword.tipY = by + Math.sin(baseAngle) * len;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bx, by);
    ctx.rotate(baseAngle + Math.PI / 2);

    const bladeGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-8, 0, 8, 0);
    bladeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c8d8e8');
    bladeGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#eef5ff');
    bladeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#9fb4c8');
    ctx.fillStyle = bladeGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -len);
    ctx.lineTo(7, -12);
    ctx.lineTo(7, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-7, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-7, -12);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(95,216,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -len);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 0);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3550';
    ctx.fillRect(-14, 0, 28, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.fillRect(-2, 6, 4, 14);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 22, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParryRing() {
    if (!parry.active) return;
    const t = parry.timer / parry.duration;
    const radius = parry.radius * (1 + (1 - t) * 0.3);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4 + t * 0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHitFlash() {
    if (state.hitFlash <= 0) return;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = state.hitFlash * 0.5;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(state.hitX, state.hitY, 0, state.hitX, state.hitY, 80);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(state.hitX - 80, state.hitY - 80, 160, 160);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,26,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(16, 16, 220, 92);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(95,216,255,0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(16, 16, 220, 92);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE', 30, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(String(Math.floor(state.score)), 30, 46);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('COMBO', 150, 28);
    ctx.fillStyle = state.combo > 0 ? '#ffd24a' : '#667788';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(String(state.combo), 150, 46);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', 30, 82);
    for (let i = 0; i < state.lives; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5f6d';
      ctx.beginPath();
      const hx = 95 + i * 22;
      const hy = 90;
      ctx.moveTo(hx, hy + 4);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx - 8, hy - 6, hx - 4, hy - 10, hx, hy - 4);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(hx + 4, hy - 10, hx + 8, hy - 6, hx, hy + 4);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStart() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,26,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fd8ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 54px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PARRY WINDOW', W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Shards and bolts fall from above.', W / 2, H * 0.42);
    ctx.fillText('Move your cursor to a falling object', W / 2, H * 0.47);
    ctx.fillText('and press SPACE (or click) to parry it.', W / 2, H * 0.52);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Chain hits to build your combo. Miss and you lose a life.', W / 2, H * 0.60);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,216,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H * 0.74);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,26,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5f6d';
    ctx.font = 'bold 54px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SHATTERED', W / 2, H * 0.32);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '26px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + Math.floor(state.score), W / 2, H * 0.46);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Best Combo: ' + state.bestCombo, W / 2, H * 0.54);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(95,216,255,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RESTART', W / 2, H * 0.70);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) {
      const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
      const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake;
      ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    drawBackground();

    for (const m of movers) drawMover(m);
    drawHitFlash();
    drawParticles();
    drawParryRing();
    drawSword();

    if (state.phase === 'play') drawHUD();
    if (state.phase === 'start') drawStart();
    if (state.phase === 'over') drawOver();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function onMove(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    mouse.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
  }

  function onParryAction() {
    if (state.phase === 'play') {
      doParry();
    } else if (state.phase === 'start') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state.phase === 'over') {
      startGame();
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onParryAction);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = t.clientX - rect.left;
    mouse.y = t.clientY - rect.top;
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = t.clientX - rect.left;
    mouse.y = t.clientY - rect.top;
    onParryAction();
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onParryAction();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  resize();
  mouse.x = W / 2;
  mouse.y = H / 2;

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    last = now;
    state.time += (state.phase === 'play' ? 0 : dt);
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Squat Counter</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #87ceeb, #b8e6f5 55%, #7ec850 55%, #5ba83c);
    font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Marker Felt", "Chalkboard SE", cursive, sans-serif;
  }
  #game {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: block;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  // ===== setup =====
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ===== state =====
  let state = "start";   // start | play | win | lose
  let score = 0;
  let target = 10;
  let timer = 30;
  let lastTs = 0;
  let phase = "up";      // up | down
  let phaseT = 0;
  const PHASE_TIME = 0.85;
  let shake = 0;
  let stars = [];
  let particles = [];

  // ===== input =====
  function startGame() {
    state = "play";
    score = 0;
    timer = 30;
    phase = "up";
    phaseT = 0;
    particles = [];
    shake = 0;
  }
  function press() {
    if (state === "start") { startGame(); return; }
    if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { state = "start"; return; }
    if (state !== "play") return;

    if (phase === "down") {
      score++;
      phase = "up";
      phaseT = 0;
      shake = 0.3;
      spawnBurst();
      if (score >= target) { state = "win"; }
    } else {
      // pressed too early
      shake = 0.5;
      phase = "down";
      phaseT = 0;
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      press();
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); press(); });

  // ===== particles (movers) =====
  function spawnBurst() {
    const cx = canvas.width / 2;
    const cy = canvas.height * 0.55;
    const colors = ["#ff5d8f", "#ffd23f", "#5cc8ff", "#a3e635"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 120 + Math.random() * 200;
      particles.push({
        x: cx, y: cy,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 80,
        r: 4 + Math.random() * 5,
        color: colors[i % colors.length],
        life: 0.9
      });
    }
  }
  function spawnStar() {
    const cx = canvas.width / 2;
    const cy = canvas.height * 0.5;
    const colors = ["#fff27a", "#ffe066", "#fff"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 60 + Math.random() * 120;
      particles.push({
        x: cx, y: cy,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        r: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
        color: colors[i % colors.length],
        life: 0.7
      });
    }
  }

  // ===== update =====
  function update(dt) {
    if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);

    if (state === "play") {
      timer -= dt;
      if (timer <= 0) { timer = 0; state = "lose"; return; }

      phaseT += dt;
      if (phaseT >= PHASE_TIME) {
        if (phase === "down") {
          // missed the squat
          shake = 0.5;
          spawnStar();
        }
        phase = (phase === "up") ? "down" : "up";
        phaseT = 0;
      }
    }

    // move particles and drop finished ones
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.vy += 400 * dt;          // gravity
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ===== draw helpers =====
  function drawBackground() {
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.55);
    sky.addColorStop(0, "#87ceeb");
    sky.addColorStop(1, "#cdeefb");
    ctx.fillStyle = sky;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.55);

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff27a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.82, H * 0.14, Math.min(W, H) * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff27a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = i / 8 * Math.PI * 2;
      const r1 = Math.min(W, H) * 0.06;
      const r2 = Math.min(W, H) * 0.09;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W * 0.82 + Math.cos(a) * r1, H * 0.14 + Math.sin(a) * r1);
      ctx.lineTo(W * 0.82 + Math.cos(a) * r2, H * 0.14 + Math.sin(a) * r2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // clouds
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    const clouds = [[0.15, 0.12, 1], [0.4, 0.2, 0.8], [0.6, 0.1, 0.7]];
    for (const c of clouds) {
      const cx = W * c[0], cy = H * c[1], s = Math.min(W, H) * 0.05 * c[2];
      for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx + i * s * 0.8, cy, s * (0.6 + Math.abs(i) * 0.15), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // ground
    const ground = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.55, 0, H);
    ground.addColorStop(0, "#7ec850");
    ground.addColorStop(1, "#5ba83c");
    ctx.fillStyle = ground;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H * 0.55, W, H * 0.45);

    // hills
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6bb845";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H * 0.55);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.25, H * 0.42, W * 0.5, H * 0.55);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.75, H * 0.42, W, H * 0.55);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H * 0.55);
    ctx.lineTo(0, H * 0.55);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // flowers
    const flowerColors = ["#ff5d8f", "#ffd23f", "#a3e635", "#5cc8ff"];
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const fx = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const fy = H * 0.62 + (i % 5) * (H * 0.05);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#3f8a2b";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(fx, fy);
      ctx.lineTo(fx, fy + 18);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = flowerColors[i % flowerColors.length];
      for (let p = 0; p < 5; p++) {
        const a = p / 5 * Math.PI * 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(fx + Math.cos(a) * 6, fy + Math.sin(a) * 6, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff27a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fx, fy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawCharacter() {
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    const cx = W / 2;
    const baseY = H * 0.82;

    // squat amount: 0 = standing, 1 = full squat
    let t;
    if (state === "play") {
      const prog = Math.min(phaseT / PHASE_TIME, 1);
      const ease = prog * prog * (3 - 2 * prog);
      t = (phase === "down") ? ease : (1 - ease);
    } else {
      t = 0.5; // gentle idle
    }

    const drop = t * (H * 0.16);
    const headY = baseY - H * 0.32 + drop * 0.55;
    const shoulderY = headY + H * 0.08;
    const hipY = baseY - H * 0.06 + drop;
    const headR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.055;

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, baseY + H * 0.02, headR * 1.6, headR * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // legs (squatting: knees out, feet flat)
    const kneeX = cx + headR * 0.9;
    const kneeY = hipY - H * 0.02;
    const footY = baseY + H * 0.02;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2d5aa0";
    ctx.lineWidth = headR * 0.55;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, hipY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(kneeX, kneeY, kneeX + headR * 0.3, footY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, hipY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-kneeX + cx * 2, kneeY, -kneeX + cx * 2 + headR * 0.3, footY);
    ctx.stroke();

    // body
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3f7fd6";
    ctx.lineWidth = headR * 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, shoulderY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, hipY);
    ctx.stroke();

    // arms (reach forward, bend at squat)
    const armReach = headR * 1.4 + t * headR * 0.6;
    const armY = shoulderY + headR * 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3f7fd6";
    ctx.lineWidth = headR * 0.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, shoulderY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + armReach, armY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, shoulderY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - armReach, armY);
    ctx.stroke();
    // hands
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9b3";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + armReach, armY, headR * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - armReach, armY, headR * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9b3";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, headY, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // hair
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a3a1e";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, headY - headR * 0.35, headR * 0.95, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = "#222";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - headR * 0.35, headY + headR * 0.05, headR * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + headR * 0.35, headY + headR * 0.05, headR * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // mouth (smile)
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#222";
    ctx.lineWidth = headR * 0.08;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, headY + headR * 0.25, headR * 0.3, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
    // blush
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,120,120,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - headR * 0.55, headY + headR * 0.3, headR * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + headR * 0.55, headY + headR * 0.3, headR * 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life / 0.9));
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    const font = Math.floor(Math.min(W, H) * 0.05);

    // score
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2d5aa0";
    ctx.lineWidth = font * 0.12;
    ctx.font = "bold " + font + "px 'Comic Sans MS', cursive";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    const scoreText = "Squats: " + score + " / " + target;
    ctx.strokeText(scoreText, font * 0.6, font * 1.3);
    ctx.fillText(scoreText, font * 0.6, font * 1.3);

    // timer
    const timerText = "Time: " + Math.ceil(timer) + "s";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.strokeText(timerText, W - font * 0.6, font * 1.3);
    ctx.fillText(timerText, W - font * 0.6, font * 1.3);

    // phase indicator
    const indY = H * 0.16;
    const indR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.04;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, indY, indR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = (state === "play" && phase === "down") ? "#a3e635" : "#ffd23f";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2d5aa0";
    ctx.lineWidth = indR * 0.15;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2d5aa0";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(indR * 0.9) + "px 'Comic Sans MS', cursive";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText((state === "play" && phase === "down") ? "SQUAT!" : "READY", W / 2, indY);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, color, sub) {
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const font = Math.floor(Math.min(W, H) * 0.08);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.lineWidth = font * 0.1;
    ctx.font = "bold " + font + "px 'Comic Sans MS', cursive";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.strokeText(title, W / 2, H * 0.42);
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H * 0.42);

    const subFont = Math.floor(font * 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = subFont + "px 'Comic Sans MS', cursive";
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H * 0.55);
  }

  // ===== draw =====
  function draw() {
    const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0) {
      const s = shake * Math.min(W, H) * 0.01;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * s, (Math.random() - 0.5) * s);
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawCharacter();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") {
      drawOverlay("SQUAT COUNTER", "#ffd23f",
        "Press SPACE / TAP when the circle turns green to squat!\nGet " + target + " squats before time runs out.");
    } else if (state === "win") {
      drawOverlay("YAY! YOU DID IT!", "#a3e635",
        "You counted " + score + " squats. Press SPACE to play again.");
    } else if (state === "lose") {
      drawOverlay("TIME'S UP!", "#ff5d8f",
        "You got " + score + " / " + target + ". Press SPACE to try again.");
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ===== loop =====
  function loop(ts) {
    if (!lastTs) lastTs = ts;
    let dt = (ts - lastTs) / 1000;
    lastTs = ts;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;

    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Split the Bill</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#12303a;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif;
    user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  #c{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- canvas + helpers ---------- */
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resize(){
  DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=window.innerWidth;H=window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width=Math.round(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.round(H*DPR);
  canvas.style.width=W+'px';canvas.style.height=H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
  r=Math.min(r,Math.abs(w)/2,Math.abs(h)/2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function money(n){return '$'+n.toFixed(2);}
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const state={
  phase:'start',
  t:0,
  target:0,
  paid:0,
  paidAt:0,
  shake:0,
  best:0,
  bestKey:'splitbill.best',
  bestLoaded:false,
  toast:null,
  toastT:0,
  toastMax:1
};
const players=[];
const movers=[];   // every moving object lives here: {x,y,vx,vy, ...}
const mouse={x:0,y:0};
const keys={};

function loadBest(){
  try{const v=localStorage.getItem(state.bestKey);
    if(v!==null){state.best=parseFloat(v)||0;state.bestLoaded=true;}}catch(e){}
}
function saveBest(){
  try{localStorage.setItem(state.bestKey,String(state.best));}catch(e){}
}

/* ---------- game control ---------- */
function newRound(){
  state.paid=0;
  movers.length=0;
  const n=clamp(Math.floor(Math.random()*4)+1,1,4);
  players.length=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++)players.push({
    name:'You',
    share:0,
    x:0,y:0,
    tx:0,ty:0,
    vx:0,vy:0,
    r:26,
    color:'#37c0c9',
    glow:'rgba(55,192,201,0.5)',
    phase:Math.random()*6.28,
    settled:false
  });
  const total=10+Math.floor(Math.random()*25)+Math.random();
  state.target=total;
  const base=total/n;
  const cents=Math.round((total-base*n)*100);
  let ci=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    players[i].share=base;
    if(cents>0){players[i].share+=0.01;cents--;ci++;}
  }
  if(cents>0)players[n-1].share+=cents*0.01;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++)players[i].share=Math.round(players[i].share*100)/100;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=-Math.PI/2+(i-(n-1)/2)*0.95;
    players[i].x=0;players[i].y=0;
    players[i].tx=W/2+Math.cos(a)*150;
    players[i].ty=H/2+Math.sin(a)*150;
  }
  state.paidAt=state.t;
}
function startGame(){
  loadBest();
  newRound();
  state.phase='play';
}
function nextRound(){
  newRound();
  state.phase='play';
}
function winRound(){
  state.phase='win';
  if(state.paid>state.best){state.best=Math.round(state.paid*100)/100;saveBest();}
  state.toast='Nice! Everyone paid their share.';
  state.toastT=0;state.toastMax=2.2;
}
function loseRound(){
  state.phase='lose';
  if(state.paid>state.best){state.best=Math.round(state.paid*100)/100;saveBest();}
  state.toast='Out of time!';
  state.toastT=0;state.toastMax=2.2;
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function toLocal(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top};
}
function updateMouse(e){const p=toLocal(e);mouse.x=p.x;mouse.y=p.y;}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',updateMouse);
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
  updateMouse(e);
  if(state.phase==='start')startGame();
  else if(state.phase==='win'||state.phase==='lose')nextRound();
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const t=e.changedTouches[0];
  updateMouse(t);
  if(state.phase==='start')startGame();
  else if(state.phase==='win'||state.phase==='lose')nextRound();
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  updateMouse(e.changedTouches[0]);
},{passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){
    if(state.phase==='start')startGame();
    else if(state.phase==='win'||state.phase==='lose')nextRound();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  state.t+=dt;
  state.shake*=Math.pow(0.001,dt);
  if(state.toastT>0)state.toastT+=dt;

  for(const p of players){
    const dx=p.tx-p.x, dy=p.ty-p.y;
    const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(d>1){
      const sp=520;
      p.vx=dx/d*sp;
      p.vy=dy/d*sp;
    }else{
      p.vx=0;p.vy=0;
    }
    p.x+=p.vx*dt;
    p.y+=p.vy*dt;
    if(!p.settled && d<3){
      p.settled=true;
      movers.push({
        x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:0,vy:0,
        type:'pop',r:p.r,age:0,life:0.55,
        color:p.color,glow:p.glow
      });
    }
  }

  // move every mover, drop the finished ones
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];
    m.age+=dt;
    m.x+=m.vx*dt;
    m.y+=m.vy*dt;
    if(m.type==='coin'){
      m.vy+=1400*dt;
      if(m.y>H+40)m.age=m.life;
    }
    if(m.age>=m.life)movers.splice(i,1);
  }

  if(state.phase==='play'){
    const elapsed=state.t-state.paidAt;
    const frac=Math.min(1,elapsed/3);
    const add=state.target*frac;
    const newPaid=Math.round(add*100)/100;
    if(newPaid>state.paid){
      const d=newPaid-state.paid;
      state.paid=newPaid;
      if(d>0.04){
        const p=players[(Math.random()*players.length)|0];
        const a=Math.random()*6.28, sp=120+Math.random()*140;
        movers.push({
          x:p.x,y:p.y,
          vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-160,
          type:'coin',r:10,age:0,life:3,
          color:'#ffd23f',glow:'rgba(255,210,63,0.5)',
          spin:Math.random()*6.28
        });
        state.shake=Math.max(state.shake,0.4);
      }
    }
    if(state.paid>=state.target-0.001)winRound();
  }
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#12303a');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0c2129');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.05;
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5fd0d8';
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  const gap=46;
  for(let x=-H;x<W;x+=gap){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x+H,H);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  const cx=W/2,cy=H/2;
  const rg=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,Math.max(W,H)*0.55);
  rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(95,208,216,0.10)');
  rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=rg;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}

function drawCenter(){
  const cx=W/2,cy=H/2;
  const frac=state.phase==='start'?0:Math.min(1,(state.t-state.paidAt)/3);
  const pct=state.target>0?frac:0;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,96,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth=10;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,96,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#37c0c9';
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,96,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+pct*Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 15px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('TOTAL',cx,cy-46);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.font='800 40px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(money(state.target),cx,cy-4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';
  ctx.font='800 26px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(money(state.paid),cx,cy+34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 14px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(Math.round(pct*100)+'% split',cx,cy+58);
}

function drawPlayer(p){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y+p.r*0.95,p.r*0.9,p.r*0.32,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  ctx.shadowColor=p.glow;ctx.shadowBlur=22;
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;

  ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.20)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r-3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.font='800 20px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('$',p.x,p.y+1);
  ctx.restore();

  // share label
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  const tx=p.x, ty=p.y+p.r+22;
  ctx.font='800 15px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  const txt=money(p.share);
  const tw=ctx.measureText(txt).width;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,30,36,0.85)';
  rr(tx-tw/2-9,ty-12,tw+18,24,12);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(txt,tx,ty+1);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMovers(){
  for(const m of movers){
    const k=m.age/m.life;
    if(m.type==='coin'){
      const a=1-k;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha=a;
      ctx.translate(m.x,m.y);
      ctx.rotate(m.spin+m.age*4);
      const w=Math.max(2,Math.cos(m.age*6)*m.r);
      ctx.fillStyle=m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,w,m.r,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle='#b8860b';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,w,m.r,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }else if(m.type==='pop'){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha=1-k;
      ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.strokeStyle=m.color;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r*(1+k*2),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 14px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('BEST  '+money(state.best),20,26);

  // timer bar
  const bw=Math.min(280,W-140);
  const bx=W-bw-20, by=18, bh=12;
  const frac=state.phase==='play'?clamp(1-(state.t-state.paidAt)/3,0,1):0;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  rr(bx,by,bw,bh,6);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=frac>0.3?'#37c0c9':'#ff5d6c';
  rr(bx,by,bw*frac,bh,6);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('TIME',bx,by+bh+13);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawToast(){
  if(state.toastT<=0||!state.toast)return;
  const k=state.toastT/state.toastMax;
  let a=1;
  if(k<0.15)a=k/0.15;
  else if(k>0.85)a=(1-k)/0.15;
  a=clamp(a,0,1);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha=a;
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.font='800 24px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  const tw=ctx.measureText(state.toast).width;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,30,36,0.85)';
  rr(W/2-tw/2-18,H*0.16-20,tw+36,40,20);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(state.toast,W/2,H*0.16);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,22,28,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.font='800 '+Math.min(56,W*0.09)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('SPLIT THE BILL',W/2,H*0.34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 '+Math.min(20,W*0.04)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Split the total among your friends before the timer runs out.',W/2,H*0.44);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';
  ctx.font='800 '+Math.min(26,W*0.05)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  const pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(state.t*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Click to play',W/2,H*0.56);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 15px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Best so far: '+money(state.best),W/2,H*0.64);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnd(win){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,22,28,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle=win?'#7ee787':'#ff5d6c';
  ctx.font='800 '+Math.min(52,W*0.085)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(win?'SPLIT!':'TIME!',W/2,H*0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
  ctx.font='700 '+Math.min(26,W*0.05)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('You split '+money(state.paid)+' of '+money(state.target),W/2,H*0.5);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';
  ctx.font='800 '+Math.min(24,W*0.045)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  const pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(state.t*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=pulse;
  ctx.fillText('Click for next round',W/2,H*0.6);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0d6';
  ctx.font='600 15px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Best: '+money(state.best),W/2,H*0.68);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0.01){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake*8,(Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake*8);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawCenter();
  for(const p of players)drawPlayer(p);
  drawMovers();
  drawHUD();
  drawToast();
  if(state.phase==='start')drawStart();
  else if(state.phase==='win')drawEnd(true);
  else if(state.phase==='lose')drawEnd(false);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000);
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

resize();
loadBest();
newRound();
state.phase='start';
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Shear the Sheep</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#14211b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif}
  #game{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = 900, H = 560;
canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;

const sheep = { x: 430, y: 352, r: 152, wool: 100 };
const goal = 0;
const WIN = 50, LOSE = 25;
let score = 0, sheared = 0, over = false;
let wind = 0, t = 0;
const particles = [];
const clouds = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  clouds.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: 40 + Math.random() * 120, s: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8 });
}

function toLocal(e) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * W / r.width, y: (e.clientY - r.top) * H / r.height };
}

function spawn(p, x, y, vx, vy, r, color, life) {
  particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, r: r, color: color, life: life, max: life });
}

function shearAt(x, y) {
  const dx = x - sheep.x, dy = y - sheep.y;
  const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (d > sheep.r || sheep.wool <= 0) return;
  const n = 10 + (Math.random() * 6 | 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const sp = 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.2;
    spawn(particles, x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22, y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 22,
      Math.cos(a) * sp, Math.sin(a) * sp - 0.6,
      3 + Math.random() * 4,
      Math.random() < 0.5 ? '#ffffff' : '#f2efe4',
      45 + Math.random() * 35);
  }
  sheep.wool = Math.max(0, sheep.wool - 1);
  sheared++;
  score += 1;
  if (sheep.wool <= WIN) over = true;
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
  if (over) return;
  const p = toLocal(e);
  shearAt(p.x, p.y);
});
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') {
    sheep.wool = 100;
    sheared = 0;
    score = 0;
    over = false;
    particles.length = 0;
  }
});

function update() {
  t++;
  wind = Math.sin(t * 0.03) * 0.5;
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vy += 0.06;
    p.vx += wind * 0.02;
    p.vx *= 0.99;
    p.life--;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  }
  for (const c of clouds) {
    c.x += 0.25 * c.s;
    if (c.x > W + 80) c.x = -80;
  }
}

function drawCloud(x, y, s) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 26 * s, 0, 7);
  ctx.arc(x + 30 * s, y + 6 * s, 20 * s, 0, 7);
  ctx.arc(x - 30 * s, y + 8 * s, 20 * s, 0, 7);
  ctx.arc(x + 6 * s, y - 14 * s, 18 * s, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}

function draw() {
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#8ec7ec');
  sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#c9e8f2');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#e9f4e4');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe08a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(760, 90, 46, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,224,138,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(760, 90, 74, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#bcd8a0';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 300);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(200, 250, 400, 300);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(600, 350, 900, 290);
  ctx.lineTo(900, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 330, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#8fcf6f');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#4f9e46');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 360);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(450, 320, 900, 360);
  ctx.lineTo(900, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  for (const c of clouds) drawCloud(c.x, c.y, c.s);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.10)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sheep.x, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.9, sheep.r * 0.95, sheep.r * 0.22, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

  const woolR = sheep.r * (0.35 + 0.65 * (sheep.wool / 100));
  const body = ctx.createRadialGradient(sheep.x - 30, sheep.y - 30, 20, sheep.x, sheep.y, woolR);
  body.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  body.addColorStop(1, '#d9d5c6');
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const bumps = 22;
  for (let i = 0; i <= bumps; i++) {
    const a = (i / bumps) * Math.PI * 2;
    const rr = woolR * (1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(a * 7 + 1));
    const px = sheep.x + Math.cos(a) * rr;
    const py = sheep.y + Math.sin(a) * rr;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
  }
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f6f3ec';
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const a = (i / 14) * Math.PI * 2;
    const rr = woolR * 0.92;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sheep.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, sheep.y + Math.sin(a) * rr, 10, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#f3f0e6';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.72, sheep.y - sheep.r * 0.05, sheep.r * 0.34, sheep.r * 0.30, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d8d3c4';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.60, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.22, sheep.r * 0.16, sheep.r * 0.13, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d8d3c4';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.82, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.20, sheep.r * 0.16, sheep.r * 0.13, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#2f2b28';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.92, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.02, sheep.r * 0.045, sheep.r * 0.045, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.78, sheep.y - sheep.r * 0.12, sheep.r * 0.045, sheep.r * 0.045, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.93, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.0, sheep.r * 0.015, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.79, sheep.y - sheep.r * 0.14, sheep.r * 0.015, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2f2b28'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.55, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.42, sheep.r * 0.06, sheep.r * 0.09, 0.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(sheep.x + sheep.r * 0.85, sheep.y + sheep.r * 0.40, sheep.r * 0.06, sheep.r * 0.09, -0.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();

  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,33,27,0.82)';
  ctx.fillRect(18, 18, 300, 96);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('SHEAR THE SHEEP', 34, 52);
  ctx.font = '16px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e9e4d6';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score + '    Wool: ' + sheep.wool + '%', 34, 78);
  ctx.fillText('Click the wool to shear. Win: get to 50% or less.', 34, 100);

  if (over) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,33,27,0.78)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SHEEP BARE!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.font = '24px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 24);
    ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press R to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 58);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Game constants ----------
  const GAME_SECONDS = 60;
  const SPAWN_EVERY = 0.6;      // seconds between new faces
  const BASE_LIFETIME = 4.2;    // seconds a face lives before fading
  const POP_LIFETIME = 0.5;     // seconds a hit-pop lasts
  const START_LIFETIME = 1.2;   // seconds the "GO!" text lasts

    { name: "happy",    color: "#FFD23F" },
    { name: "sad",      color: "#5AA9E6" },
    { name: "angry",    color: "#FF6B6B" },
    { name: "surprised",color: "#B388FF" },
    { name: "sleepy",   color: "#9BE7C4" }
  ];

  // ---------- State ----------
  const state = {
    running: false,
    started: false,
    over: false,
    timeLeft: GAME_SECONDS,
    score: 0,
    combo: 0,
    bestCombo: 0,
    lastMood: null,
    spawnTimer: 0,
    pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 }
  };

  // ---------- Movers (single array of {x, y, vx, vy}) ----------
  const movers = [];

  // ---------- Helpers ----------
  function rand(min, max) { return min + Math.random() * (max - min); }

  function spawnFace() {
    const mood = MOODS[(Math.random() * MOODS.length) | 0];
    const r = rand(26, 44);
    const x = rand(r + 20, W - r - 20);
    const y = H + r + 10;
    const vy = rand(-1.4, -2.4);
    const vx = rand(-0.5, 0.5);
    movers.push({
      kind: "face",
      x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy,
      r: r,
      mood: mood,
      life: BASE_LIFETIME,
      maxLife: BASE_LIFETIME,
      wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2)
    });
  }

  function spawnPop(x, y, color, text) {
    movers.push({
      kind: "pop",
      x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: -1.6,
      r: 0,
      color: color,
      text: text,
      life: POP_LIFETIME,
      maxLife: POP_LIFETIME
    });
  }

  function spawnStartText() {
    movers.push({
      kind: "text",
      x: W / 2, y: H * 0.42, vx: 0, vy: -0.4,
      r: 0,
      color: "#FFFFFF",
      text: GO_TEXT,
      life: START_LIFETIME,
      maxLife: START_LIFETIME
    });
  }

  function spawnOverText() {
    movers.push({
      kind: "text",
      x: W / 2, y: H * 0.34, vx: 0, vy: -0.25,
      r: 0,
      color: "#FFFFFF",
      text: OVER_TEXT,
      life: 3.0,
      maxLife: 3.0
    });
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function readPointer(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = (e.touches && e.touches.length) ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
    const cy = (e.touches && e.touches.length) ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
    state.pointer.x = cx - rect.left;
    state.pointer.y = cy - rect.top;
  }

  function handleClick(e) {
    readPointer(e);
    const px = state.pointer.x;
    const py = state.pointer.y;

    if (!state.started) {
      state.started = true;
      state.running = true;
      state.timeLeft = GAME_SECONDS;
      spawnStartText();
      return;
    }
    if (state.over) {
      // restart
      state.started = true;
      state.running = true;
      state.over = false;
      state.timeLeft = GAME_SECONDS;
      state.score = 0;
      state.combo = 0;
      state.bestCombo = 0;
      state.lastMood = null;
      state.spawnTimer = 0;
      movers.length = 0;
      spawnStartText();
      return;
    }

    // hit-test faces (topmost first)
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      if (m.kind !== "face") continue;
      const dx = px - m.x;
      const dy = py - m.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (m.r + 6) * (m.r + 6)) {
        let gained = 1;
        if (state.lastMood === m.mood.name) {
          state.combo++;
          gained = state.combo;
          if (state.combo > state.bestCombo) state.bestCombo = state.combo;
        } else {
          state.combo = 0;
        }
        state.lastMood = m.mood.name;
        state.score += gained;
        spawnPop(m.x, m.y, m.mood.color, "+" + gained);
        movers.splice(i, 1);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", readPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); handleClick(e); }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); readPointer(e); }, { passive: false });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (state.running && !state.over) {
      state.timeLeft -= dt;
      if (state.timeLeft <= 0) {
        state.timeLeft = 0;
        state.over = true;
        state.running = false;
        spawnOverText();
      }
    }

    // spawn new faces while running
    if (state.running && !state.over) {
      state.spawnTimer += dt;
      if (state.spawnTimer >= SPAWN_EVERY) {
        state.spawnTimer -= SPAWN_EVERY;
        spawnFace();
      }
    }

    // move every mover, drop the done ones
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt * 60;
      m.y += m.vy * dt * 60;
      m.life -= dt;

      if (m.kind === "face") {
        m.wobble += dt * 3;
        m.x += Math.sin(m.wobble) * 0.4;
      }

      const done = m.life <= 0 || m.y < -m.r - 30;
      if (done) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Drawing ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#241f4a");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#3a2f6b");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#5a3f86");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft glowing orbs for depth
    const orbs = [
      { x: W * 0.18, y: H * 0.28, r: 120, c: "rgba(255,210,63,0.10)" },
      { x: W * 0.82, y: H * 0.35, r: 150, c: "rgba(90,169,230,0.12)" },
      { x: W * 0.55, y: H * 0.72, r: 180, c: "rgba(179,136,255,0.10)" }
    ];
    for (const o of orbs) {
      const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r);
      rg.addColorStop(0, o.c);
      rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = rg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawFace(m) {
    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.life / (m.maxLife * 0.4)));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);

    // face circle
    ctx.fillStyle = m.mood.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // subtle rim
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.stroke();

    const e = m.r * 0.34; // eye offset
    const ey = -m.r * 0.18;
    const ex = m.r * 0.32;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2350";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b2350";
    ctx.lineWidth = m.r * 0.09;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";

    switch (m.mood.name) {
      case "happy":
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-ex, ey, e * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, m.r * 0.12, m.r * 0.42, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
        break;
      case "sad":
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-ex, ey, e * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, m.r * 0.72, m.r * 0.34, 1.15 * Math.PI, 1.85 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
        break;
      case "angry":
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-ex - e * 0.5, ey - e * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(-ex + e * 0.5, ey + e * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex + e * 0.5, ey - e * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(ex - e * 0.5, ey + e * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
        break;
      case "surprised":
        ctx.lineWidth = m.r * 0.07;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-ex, ey, e * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, m.r * 0.34, m.r * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        break;
      case "sleepy":
        ctx.lineWidth = m.r * 0.09;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-ex - e * 0.5, ey); ctx.lineTo(-ex + e * 0.5, ey); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ex - e * 0.5, ey); ctx.lineTo(ex + e * 0.5, ey); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, m.r * 0.4, m.r * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        break;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPop(m) {
    const t = 1 - (m.life / m.maxLife);
    const alpha = Math.max(0, m.life / m.maxLife);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
    ctx.strokeStyle = m.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const n = 8;
    const inner = 6 + t * 10;
    const outer = inner + 8 + t * 18;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * inner, Math.sin(a) * inner);
      ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * outer, Math.sin(a) * outer);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillText(m.text, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawText(m) {
    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.life / (m.maxLife * 0.5)));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.font = "bold 64px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.fillText(m.text, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // top bar
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,26,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 64);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    // score
    ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + state.score, 20, 32);

    // timer (center)
    const secs = Math.ceil(state.timeLeft);
    const urgent = state.timeLeft < 10 && !state.over;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = urgent ? "#FF6B6B" : "#FFD23F";
    ctx.fillText(secs + "s", W / 2, 32);

    // combo (right)
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9BE7C4";
    if (state.combo > 1) {
      ctx.fillText("COMBO x" + state.combo, W - 20, 32);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
      ctx.fillText("Mood Clicker", W - 20, 32);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStartOverlay() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,26,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD23F";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("MOOD CLICKER", W / 2, H * 0.34);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "22px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Tap the rising faces before they float away.", W / 2, H * 0.46);
    ctx.fillText("Chain the same mood in a row for bonus points.", W / 2, H * 0.52);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9BE7C4";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("You have 60 seconds. Click to start!", W / 2, H * 0.64);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawOverOverlay() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,8,26,0.7)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 46px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("TIME'S UP!", W / 2, H * 0.36);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFD23F";
    ctx.font = "bold 34px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Final Score: " + state.score, W / 2, H * 0.48);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9BE7C4";
    ctx.font = "24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Best combo: x" + Math.max(1, state.bestCombo), W / 2, H * 0.56);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#B388FF";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Click to play again", W / 2, H * 0.68);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.kind === "face") drawFace(m);
      else if (m.kind === "pop") drawPop(m);
      else if (m.kind === "text") drawText(m);
    }
    drawHUD();
    if (!state.started) drawStartOverlay();
    if (state.over) drawOverOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    let dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05; // clamp big gaps
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>
