<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Mirror Check</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#07131a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{max-width:96vw;max-height:96vh;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:14px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="420" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById("game");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

const LANE_W=104, ROAD_L=18, ROAD_R=W-18;
const laneX=i=>ROAD_L+LANE_W*(i+0.5);
const PLAYER_W=54, PLAYER_H=88;
const PLAYER_Y=H-150;
const playerTopY=PLAYER_Y-PLAYER_H/2;
const playerBottomY=PLAYER_Y+PLAYER_H/2;
const playerCenterY=PLAYER_Y;

const state={
  mode:"start",
  score:0,
  best:0,
  speed:3.0,
  spawnTimer:0,
  spawnGap:52,
  playerLane:1,
  playerX:laneX(1),
  shake:0,
  crashTimer:0,
  msgTimer:0,
  flash:0
};

let movers=[];
let mirror=[];
let particles=[];
let clouds=[];
for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
  clouds.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:20+Math.random()*120, r:26+Math.random()*30, s:0.15+Math.random()*0.25});
}

function reset(){
  state.mode="play";
  state.score=0;
  state.speed=3.0;
  state.spawnTimer=0;
  state.spawnGap=52;
  state.playerLane=1;
  state.playerX=laneX(1);
  state.shake=0;
  state.crashTimer=0;
  state.msgTimer=0;
  state.flash=0;
  movers=[];
  mirror=[];
  particles=[];
}

function spawnCar(lane){
  movers.push({
    x:laneX(lane),
    y:-70,
    vx:0,
    vy:state.speed
  });
}

function update(dt){
  for(const c of clouds){ c.x+=c.s; if(c.x>W+80) c.x=-80; }

  if(state.mode==="play"){
    state.speed=Math.min(7.5, state.speed+0.0016);
    state.score+=1;
    state.spawnGap=Math.max(30, state.spawnGap-0.02);

    state.playerX += (laneX(state.playerLane)-state.playerX)*0.3;

    state.spawnTimer-=1;
    if(state.spawnTimer<=0){
      const open=[];
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        let blocked=false;
        for(const m of movers){
          if(Math.abs(m.x-laneX(i))<30 && m.y<150){ blocked=true; break; }
        }
        if(!blocked) open.push(i);
      }
      if(open.length>0){
        spawnCar(open[Math.floor(Math.random()*open.length)]);
      }
      state.spawnTimer=state.spawnGap;
    }

    const px=state.playerX, pw=PLAYER_W/2;
    for(const m of movers){
      m.y+=m.vy;
      const ox=Math.abs(m.x-px);
      const oy=Math.abs(m.y-playerCenterY);
      if(ox < (pw+20)-4 && oy < (PLAYER_H/2+30)-4){
        state.mode="over";
        state.best=Math.max(state.best, state.score);
        state.crashTimer=0;
        state.shake=14;
        state.flash=1;
        for(let i=0;i<28;i++){
          const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sp=1+Math.random()*4;
          particles.push({x:px, y:playerCenterY, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-1, life:30+Math.random()*20,
            color: i%2 ? "#ff7a2e":"#ffd24a"});
        }
      }
    }
    movers=movers.filter(m=>m.y<H+90);
  } else if(state.mode==="over"){
    state.crashTimer++;
    for(const m of movers){ m.y+=m.vy*0.5; }
    movers=movers.filter(m=>m.y<H+90);
    if(state.crashTimer>150 && state.msgTimer===0){
      state.msgTimer=1;
      state.mode="start";
    }
  }

  const px=state.playerX, pw=PLAYER_W/2;
  mirror=[];
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.y < playerTopY-6 && m.y > -40 && Math.abs(m.x-px) < pw+26){
      const dist=playerTopY-m.y;
      const size=14+ (120/dist)*10;
      mirror.push({x:m.x, y:m.y, size:size});
    }
  }

  for(const p of particles){ p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy+=0.12; p.life--; }
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  state.shake*=0.9;
  state.flash*=0.92;
}

function drawCarShape(x,y,w,h,color,brake){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  const r=10;
  ctx.fillStyle="#11151b";
  for(const ty of [-h/2+10, h/2-22]){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2-4, ty, 8, 16, 3); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(w/2-4, ty, 8, 16, 3); ctx.fill();
  }
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-h/2,0,h/2);
  g.addColorStop(0, shade(color,25));
  g.addColorStop(1, shade(color,-25));
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2,-h/2,w,h,r); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(150,205,255,0.9)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2+6,-h/2+10,w-12,16,4); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2+6,h/2-22,w-12,12,4); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2+8,-h/2+2,w-16,5,3); ctx.fill();
  if(brake){
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff3b30";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-w/2+4,h/2-14,14,6,3); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(w/2-18,h/2-14,14,6,3); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function shade(hex,amt){
  const n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);
  let r=(n>>16)+amt, g=((n>>8)&255)+amt, b=(n&255)+amt;
  r=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,r)); g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,g)); b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,b));
  return "rgb("+r+","+g+","+b+")";
}

function drawBackground(){
  const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0,"#0c2530");
  sky.addColorStop(0.5,"#123a4a");
  sky.addColorStop(1,"#0a1f28");
  ctx.fillStyle=sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  for(const c of clouds){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(210,230,240,0.08)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(c.x,c.y,c.r,c.r*0.5,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(c.x+c.r*0.6,c.y+4,c.r*0.7,c.r*0.35,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle="#123b2c";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,ROAD_L,H);
  ctx.fillRect(ROAD_R,0,W-ROAD_R,H);
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const tx= i<3 ? (i* (ROAD_L/3)+ (ROAD_L/6)) : (ROAD_R + (i-3)*( (W-ROAD_R)/4 ) + ((W-ROAD_R)/8));
    ctx.fillStyle="#1c5a3a";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, 120+ (i%3)*150, 12, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#2f8a52";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, 120+ (i%3)*150, 7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle="#2b2f36";
  ctx.fillRect(ROAD_L,0,ROAD_R-ROAD_L,H);
  ctx.fillStyle="#3a4048";
  ctx.fillRect(ROAD_L,0,8,H);
  ctx.fillRect(ROAD_R-8,0,8,H);

  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)";
  ctx.lineWidth=4;
  ctx.setLineDash([26,22]);
  for(let i=1;i<3;i++){
    const lx=ROAD_L+LANE_W*i;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx,0); ctx.lineTo(lx,H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

function drawMirror(){
  const mx=W/2, my=64, mw=150, mh=104;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor="rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"; ctx.shadowBlur=14;
  ctx.fillStyle="#0a1a22";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(mx-mw/2-8,my-mh/2-8,mw+16,mh+16,14); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  const mg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,my-mh/2,0,my+mh/2);
  mg.addColorStop(0,"#0e2b38"); mg.addColorStop(1,"#081922");
  ctx.fillStyle=mg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(mx-mw/2,my-mh/2,mw,mh,10); ctx.fill();

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(mx-mw/2,my-mh/2,mw,mh,10); ctx.clip();
  ctx.fillStyle="#14181d";
  ctx.fillRect(mx-mw/2,my-mh/2,mw,mh);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.setLineDash([12,10]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx,my-mh/2); ctx.lineTo(mx,my+mh/2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
  for(const m of mirror){
    const sx=mx + (m.x-state.playerX)*0.5;
    const sy=my + (m.y-playerTopY)*0.5;
    const size=m.size*0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle="#c94f3d";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(sx-size/2, sy-size, size, size*1.4, size*0.25); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(150,205,255,0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(sx-size/2+2, sy-size+2, size-4, size*0.3, 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  const vg=ctx.createRadialGradient(mx,my,10,mx,my,mw*0.7);
  vg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0)"); vg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0.45)");
  ctx.fillStyle=vg; ctx.fillRect(mx-mw/2,my-mh/2,mw,mh);
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(120,220,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(mx-mw/2,my-mh/2,mw,mh,10); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(200,230,240,0.9)";
  ctx.font="600 12px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillText("MIRROR", mx, my-mh/2-14);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(state.shake>0.3){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
  }
  drawBackground();

  for(const m of movers){
    drawCarShape(m.x,m.y,40,60,"#c94f3d",false);
  }

  const px=state.playerX;
  if(state.mode!=="over"){
    drawCarShape(px,PLAYER_Y,PLAYER_W,PLAYER_H,"#37b6ff",false);
  } else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px,PLAYER_Y);
    ctx.fillStyle="#5a5f66";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-PLAYER_W/2,-PLAYER_H/2,PLAYER_W,PLAYER_H,10); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-PLAYER_W/2+8,-PLAYER_H/2+8,PLAYER_W-16,14,4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.life/30);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  drawMirror();

  ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(230,245,255,0.95)";
  ctx.font="700 20px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE", ROAD_L+14, H-40);
  ctx.font="800 34px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(String(state.score), ROAD_L+14, H-12);
  ctx.textAlign="right";
  ctx.font="600 13px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(180,210,225,0.8)";
  ctx.fillText("BEST "+state.best, ROAD_R-14, H-40);

  if(state.flash>0.02){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,60,40,"+(state.flash*0.4)+")";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  ctx.textAlign="center";
  if(state.mode==="start"){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(6,15,20,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf6ff";
    ctx.font="800 30px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("MIRROR CHECK", W/2, H/2-30);
    ctx.font="500 15px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(200,225,240,0.9)";
    ctx.fillText("Change lanes with  A  /  D  or  ←  /  →", W/2, H/2+6);
    ctx.fillText("Watch the mirror — cars behind you!", W/2, H/2+28);
    const pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(performance.now()/300);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,220,255,"+pulse+")";
    ctx.font="700 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  DRIVE", W/2, H/2+70);
  } else if(state.mode==="over"){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(6,15,20,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff6a5a";
    ctx.font="800 34px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("CRASH!", W/2, H/2-20);
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf6ff";
    ctx.font="600 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Score: "+state.score, W/2, H/2+14);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(180,210,225,0.85)";
    ctx.font="500 14px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Press  SPACE  to try again", W/2, H/2+44);
  }
}

window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  const k=e.key;
  if(k===" "||k==="Enter"){
    if(state.mode==="start"||state.mode==="over"){ reset(); }
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  if(state.mode!=="play") return;
  if(k==="a"||k==="A"||k==="ArrowLeft"){
    state.playerLane=Math.max(0,state.playerLane-1);
    e.preventDefault();
  } else if(k==="d"||k==="D"||k==="ArrowRight"){
    state.playerLane=Math.min(2,state.playerLane+1);
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("click", function(){
  if(state.mode==="start"||state.mode==="over") reset();
});

let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(50, now-last);
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Wind-Up Film</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #14101f;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  #game { display: block; margin: 0 auto; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0;

  // ---- state ----
  const state = {
    scene: 'start',
    score: 0,
    goal: 10,
    time: 0,
    shake: 0,
    flash: 0,
    flashColor: '#ffd24a',
    lastCatch: 0
  };
  const movers = [];
  const input = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    down: false,
    lastX: 0, lastY: 0,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    power: 0,
    lastMove: 0
  };
  const player = {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    r: 26,
    vx: 0, vy: 0
  };

  // ---- helpers ----
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) { const dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); }
  function circleHit(ax, ay, ar, bx, by, br) { const dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return dx * dx + dy * dy <= (ar + br) * (ar + br); }

  function makeMover(kind) {
    const m = {
      kind: kind,
      x: 0, y: 0,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      r: 12,
      done: false,
      life: 1,
      age: 0,
      spin: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      spinV: rand(-3, 3),
      phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      amp: rand(10, 26),
      freq: rand(0.8, 2.2),
      hue: 0,
      caught: false
    };
    if (kind === 'star') {
      m.r = rand(12, 19);
      m.hue = Math.floor(rand(0, 360));
      m.vx = rand(-1.4, 1.4);
      m.vy = rand(1.0, 2.4);
      m.spinV = rand(-2, 2);
    } else if (kind === 'bubble') {
      m.r = rand(14, 24);
      m.hue = rand(170, 205);
      m.vx = rand(-0.6, 0.6);
      m.vy = rand(-2.2, -1.4);
      m.spinV = rand(-1, 1);
    } else if (kind === 'bomb') {
      m.r = rand(13, 18);
      m.hue = 4;
      m.vx = rand(-1.2, 1.2);
      m.vy = rand(1.6, 3.0);
      m.spinV = rand(-4, 4);
    }
    return m;
  }

  function spawn(kind, x, y) {
    const m = makeMover(kind);
    m.x = x; m.y = y;
    movers.push(m);
    return m;
  }

  function reset() {
    movers.length = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    state.flash = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - 90;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    input.x = player.x; input.y = player.y;
    input.lastX = input.x; input.lastY = input.y;
    input.vx = 0; input.vy = 0; input.power = 0; input.lastMove = 0;
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.scene = 'play';
    reset();
  }

  function toWorld(cx, cy) {
    return { x: cx - W / 2, y: cy };
  }

  // ---- input ----
  function updateInput() {
    const now = state.time;
    const dx = input.x - input.lastX;
    const dy = input.y - input.lastY;
    input.lastX = input.x;
    input.lastY = input.y;
    const speed = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const k = 0.55;
    input.vx = input.vx * (1 - k) + dx * k;
    input.vy = input.vy * (1 - k) + dy * k;
    const power = Math.sqrt(input.vx * input.vx + input.vy * input.vy);
    if (power > 0.25) {
      input.power = clamp(input.power + power * 0.05, 0, 1);
      input.lastMove = now;
    }
    input.power = Math.max(0, input.power - 0.006);
  }

  function onPointer(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const cy = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const w = toWorld(cx, cy);
    input.x = w.x;
    input.y = w.y;
    if (state.scene === 'start') {
      if (cy < H * 0.62) startGame();
    } else if (state.scene === 'won') {
      if (cy > H * 0.6) startGame();
    } else if (state.scene === 'lost') {
      if (cy > H * 0.6) startGame();
    }
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    input.down = true;
    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
    onPointer(e);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { onPointer(e); });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { input.down = false; });
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () { input.down = false; });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (state.scene === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { startGame(); }
    else if (state.scene === 'won' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { startGame(); }
    else if (state.scene === 'lost' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { startGame(); }
  });

  // ---- update ----
  function update() {
    state.time += 0.016;
    state.shake *= 0.86;
    state.flash *= 0.86;

    if (state.scene === 'play') {
      updateInput();

      // player follows the pointer
      const target = { x: input.x, y: input.y };
      const follow = 0.25;
      player.x += (target.x - player.x) * follow;
      player.y += (target.y - player.y) * follow;
      player.x = clamp(player.x, -W / 2 + player.r, W / 2 - player.r);
      player.y = clamp(player.y, H * 0.28, H - player.r);
      player.vx = (target.x - player.x) * 0.2;
      player.vy = (target.y - player.y) * 0.2;

      // spawn
      if (state.time - state.lastCatch > 0.6) {
        const roll = Math.random();
        const kind = roll < 0.55 ? 'star' : (roll < 0.82 ? 'bubble' : 'bomb');
        spawn(kind, rand(-W / 2 + 40, W / 2 - 40), -30);
      }

      // movers
      for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const m = movers[i];
        m.age += 0.016;
        m.spin += m.spinV * 0.016;
        if (m.kind === 'bubble') {
          m.vx += Math.sin(m.age * m.freq + m.phase) * 0.03;
        }
        if (m.kind === 'star') {
          m.x += m.vx;
          m.y += m.vy;
        } else if (m.kind === 'bomb') {
          m.x += m.vx;
          m.y += m.vy;
        } else {
          m.x += m.vx + Math.sin(m.age * m.freq + m.phase) * m.amp * 0.02;
          m.y += m.vy;
        }
        if (circleHit(player.x, player.y, player.r, m.x, m.y, m.r)) {
          if (m.kind === 'bomb') {
            state.scene = 'lost';
            state.flash = 1;
            state.flashColor = '#ff5a5a';
            state.shake = 14;
            m.done = true;
          } else {
            state.score += (m.kind === 'bubble' ? 2 : 1);
            state.flash = 0.7;
            state.flashColor = m.kind === 'bubble' ? '#5fd0ff' : '#ffe07a';
            state.shake = 6;
            state.lastCatch = state.time;
            m.done = true;
            if (state.score >= state.goal) {
              state.scene = 'won';
            }
          }
        }
        if (m.y > H + 50 || m.y < -120 || m.x < -W / 2 - 80 || m.x > W / 2 + 80) {
          m.done = true;
        }
        if (m.done) movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- draw ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#241a45');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#3a2a6b');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#161028');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(-W / 2, 0, W, H);

    // soft glow
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, H * 0.35, 20, 0, H * 0.35, H * 0.7);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,90,200,0.35)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(-W / 2, 0, W, H);

    // film sprocket borders
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e0a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(-W / 2, 0, 46, H);
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 46, 0, 46, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2350';
    for (let y = 20; y < H; y += 44) {
      roundRect(-W / 2 + 10, y, 26, 26, 6); ctx.fill();
      roundRect(W / 2 - 36, y, 26, 26, 6); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawStar(m) {
    const c = 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',85%,62%)';
    const cc = 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',90%,80%)';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.spin);
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const spikes = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < spikes * 2; i++) {
      const rad = i % 2 === 0 ? m.r : m.r * 0.45;
      const a = (Math.PI / spikes) * i - Math.PI / 2;
      const px = Math.cos(a) * rad;
      const py = Math.sin(a) * rad;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = cc;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBubble(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsla(' + m.hue + ',70%,65%,0.35)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'hsla(' + m.hue + ',85%,80%,0.9)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.35, -m.r * 0.35, m.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBomb(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.spin);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2436';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4258';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-m.r * 0.3, -m.r * 0.3, m.r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a3448';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.r * 0.4, -m.r * 0.8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(m.r * 0.9, -m.r * 1.3, m.r * 0.5, -m.r * 1.5); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a3a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.r * 0.5, -m.r * 1.5, m.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawMover(m) {
    if (m.kind === 'star') drawStar(m);
    else if (m.kind === 'bubble') drawBubble(m);
    else drawBomb(m);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const x = player.x, y = player.y, r = player.r;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    const bob = Math.sin(state.time * 4) * 3;
    ctx.translate(0, bob);
    // wind-up key (behind)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9a441';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(r * 0.7, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(r * 1.4, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e7b85a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(r * 1.4, 0, r * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a5b';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffb27a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.3, -r * 0.3, r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a2e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.25, -r * 0.1, r * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r * 0.25, -r * 0.1, r * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.2, -r * 0.16, r * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r * 0.3, -r * 0.16, r * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // smile
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a1a2e';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, r * 0.15, r * 0.35, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // power ring
    if (input.power > 0.02 && state.scene === 'play') {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,210,80,' + (0.3 + input.power * 0.5) + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3 + input.power * 6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y + bob, r + 8 + input.power * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,14,32,0.55)';
    roundRect(-W / 2 + 54, 14, 190, 46, 12); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe07a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('STARS  ' + state.score + ' / ' + state.goal, -W / 2 + 70, 38);

    // goal progress bar
    const bx = -W / 2 + 54, by = 66, bw = 190, bh = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, bh, 5); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    roundRect(bx, by, bw * clamp(state.score / state.goal, 0, 1), bh, 5); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawCenterCard(title, subtitle, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,6,20,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(-W / 2, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.min(56, W * 0.09) + 'px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, 0, H * 0.34);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9def7';
    ctx.font = '20px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(subtitle, 0, H * 0.44);
    const by = H * 0.6;
    const bw = Math.min(240, W * 0.5), bh = 56;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8a5b';
    roundRect(-bw / 2, by, bw, bh, 14); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a2e';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('PLAY', 0, by + bh / 2);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(-W / 2, 0, W, H);
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0.4) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake, state.shake), rand(-state.shake, state.shake));
    }
    drawBackground();
    for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) drawMover(movers[i]);
    if (state.scene === 'play' || state.scene === 'lost' || state.scene === 'won') drawPlayer();
    if (state.scene === 'play') drawHUD();
    if (state.flash > 0.03) {
      ctx.fillStyle = state.flashColor;
      ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash * 0.25;
      ctx.fillRect(-W / 2, 0, W, H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    ctx.restore();

    if (state.scene === 'start') {
      drawCenterCard('WIND-UP FILM', 'Drag the little star to catch stars & bubbles. Avoid the bombs! Get ' + state.goal + ' stars to win.', '#ffe07a');
    } else if (state.scene === 'won') {
      drawCenterCard('YOU WIN!', 'You gathered ' + state.score + ' stars. Nice winding!', '#7dffb0');
    } else if (state.scene === 'lost') {
      drawCenterCard('BOOM!', 'You caught a bomb. You had ' + state.score + ' stars. Try again!', '#ff7a7a');
    }
  }

  // ---- loop ----
  function frame() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.translate(W / 2, 0);
    if (state.scene !== 'play') {
      player.x = 0; player.y = H - 90;
      input.x = player.x; input.y = player.y;
      input.lastX = input.x; input.lastY = input.y;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Costume Change Timer</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #241a4d;
    font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "Comic Sans MS", sans-serif;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #2a1f55;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 900;
  const H = 600;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  // ---------- State ----------
  let state = 'start';   // 'start' | 'play' | 'win' | 'lose'
  let timeLeft = 45;
  let score = 0;
  const targetScore = 5;
  const movers = [];     // one array of every moving object
  const star = { x: W / 2, y: 150, r: 22, spin: 0 };
  const flash = { x: 0, y: 0, t: 0 };

  const costumes = [
    { name: 'Ninja',   color: '#3b3b46', accent: '#ff5252', cap: 'headband', capColor: '#ff5252' },
    { name: 'Pirate',  color: '#7b4a2e', accent: '#f4c542', cap: 'hat',      capColor: '#2f2f33' },
    { name: 'Knight',  color: '#8fa2c9', accent: '#c9d6ff', cap: 'helmet',   capColor: '#aebfd8' },
    { name: 'Wizard',  color: '#6b4fb5', accent: '#ffd166', cap: 'point',    capColor: '#533a99' },
    { name: 'Astronaut',color: '#eef1f6', accent: '#54c8ff', cap: 'visor',   capColor: '#2f6fd6' },
    { name: 'Superhero',color: '#d64550', accent: '#ffd23f', cap: 'cape',    capColor: '#2f2f33' }
  ];

  function currentCostume() {
    return costumes[Math.min(costumes.length - 1, Math.floor(score))];
  }

  function makeMovers() {
    movers.length = 0;
    const n = 22;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = 40 + Math.random() * (W - 80);
      const y = -30 - Math.random() * 200;
      const vx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 1.4;
      const vy = 1.4 + Math.random() * 2.0;
      movers.push({
        x, y, vx, vy,
        size: 10 + Math.random() * 12,
        spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        spinSpeed: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15,
        type: Math.random() < 0.65 ? 'star' : 'confetti',
        color: pick(['#ffd166', '#54c8ff', '#ff5252', '#7be0a8', '#c792ff', '#ff9ecb'])
      });
    }
  }

  function pick(a) { return a[Math.floor(Math.random() * a.length)]; }

  function startGame() {
    state = 'play';
    timeLeft = 45;
    score = 0;
    makeMovers();
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  function pointerXY(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width),
      y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height)
    };
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    const p = pointerXY(e);
    if (state === 'start') {
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') {
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (state === 'play') {
      if (Math.hypot(p.x - star.x, p.y - star.y) < star.r + 18) {
        score += 1;
        flash.x = star.x;
        flash.y = star.y;
        flash.t = 1;
        star.spin += 0.9;
        if (score >= targetScore) {
          state = 'win';
        }
      }
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') startGame();
    }
  });

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    star.spin += 0.03;
    if (flash.t > 0) flash.t = Math.max(0, flash.t - dt * 3);

    if (state === 'play') {
      timeLeft -= dt;
      if (timeLeft <= 0) {
        timeLeft = 0;
        state = 'lose';
      }
    }

    // move every mover, drop the ones that are done
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx;
      m.y += m.vy;
      m.spin += m.spinSpeed;
      if (m.y > H + 40 || m.x < -60 || m.x > W + 60) {
        movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // keep a gentle stream of movers during play
    if (state === 'play' && movers.length < 16 && Math.random() < 0.25) {
      movers.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: -30,
        vx: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 1.2,
        vy: 1.4 + Math.random() * 1.8,
        size: 10 + Math.random() * 12,
        spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        spinSpeed: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15,
        type: Math.random() < 0.65 ? 'star' : 'confetti',
        color: pick(['#ffd166', '#54c8ff', '#ff5252', '#7be0a8', '#c792ff', '#ff9ecb'])
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw helpers ----------
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawStar(cx, cy, outer, inner, points, rot) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < points * 2; i++) {
      const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outer : inner;
      const a = rot + (i / (points * 2)) * Math.PI * 2;
      const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();

  function drawMover(m) {

    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.spin);
    if (m.type === 'star') {
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      drawStar(0, 0, m.size, m.size * 0.45, 5, 0);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-m.size / 2, -m.size / 3, m.size, m.size / 1.5);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();

    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffd166';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20 + glow * 20;

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff7df';

  function drawKid() {
    const c = currentCostume();

      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 40, baseY - 60);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 40, baseY - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2f66';

    roundRect(cx + 6, baseY + 30, 24, 60, 10); ctx.fill();

    // shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#241a4d';
    roundRect(cx - 34, baseY + 82, 30, 16, 8); ctx.fill();
    roundRect(cx + 4, baseY + 82, 30, 16, 8); ctx.fill();

    // body / costume
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
    roundRect(cx - 46, baseY - 60, 92, 100, 26); ctx.fill();

    // accent belt
    ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
    roundRect(cx - 46, baseY + 6, 92, 14, 6); ctx.fill();

    // arms
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
    roundRect(cx - 62, baseY - 44, 20, 58, 10); ctx.fill();
    roundRect(cx + 42, baseY - 44, 20, 58, 10); ctx.fill();
    // hands
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd9b0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - 52, baseY + 16, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + 52, baseY + 16, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd9b0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, baseY - 92, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2350';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - 12, baseY - 96, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + 12, baseY - 96, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // smile
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b2350';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, baseY - 84, 12, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();

    // cheeks
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,140,150,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - 20, baseY - 84, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + 20, baseY - 84, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    // costume headpiece
    drawHeadpiece(cx, baseY - 92, c);
  }

  function drawHeadpiece(cx, hy, c) {
    if (c.cap === 'headband') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.fillRect(cx - 34, hy - 14, 68, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.fillRect(cx + 30, hy - 16, 12, 16);
    } else if (c.cap === 'hat') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, hy - 14, 46, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 26, hy - 14);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, hy - 60, cx + 26, hy - 14);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, hy - 30, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else if (c.cap === 'helmet') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, hy - 4, 36, Math.PI, 0);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.fillRect(cx - 3, hy - 46, 6, 22);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, hy - 48, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else if (c.cap === 'point') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - 34, hy - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, hy - 70);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + 34, hy - 8);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, hy - 70, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else if (c.cap === 'visor') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.capColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, hy - 2, 26, 16, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx, hy - 2, 18, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (c.cap === 'cape') {
      ctx.fillStyle = c.accent;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, hy - 34, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#2a1f55');
    g.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b2a6e');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#5a3f86');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // soft moon

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,247,223,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W - 130, 110, 66, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,0.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 90, W, 6);

    // twinkling background dots
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      const x = (i * 97) % W;
      const y = (i * 53) % (H - 150);

  function drawHUD() {
    // timer bar
    const bw = 320;
    const bx = W / 2 - bw / 2;
    const by = 24;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    roundRect(bx, by, bw, 26, 13); ctx.fill();
    const frac = Math.max(0, timeLeft / 45);
    const barColor = frac > 0.4 ? '#7be0a8' : frac > 0.18 ? '#ffd166' : '#ff5252';
    ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
    if (frac > 0) { roundRect(bx + 3, by + 3, (bw - 6) * frac, 20, 10); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timeLeft) + 's', W / 2, by + 18);

    // score dots
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
    ctx.fillText('Costumes: ' + score + ' / ' + targetScore, 24, 40);
    for (let i = 0; i < targetScore; i++) {
      const dx = 24 + i * 30;
      const dy = 62;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx, dy, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = i < score ? '#ffd166' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
      ctx.fill();
      if (i < score) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3f86';
        drawStar(dx, dy, 6, 3, 5, 0); ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // current costume label
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Now: ' + currentCostume().name, W - 24, 40);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,14,45,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
    ctx.font = '18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Tap or press Space to ' + (state === 'start' ? 'play' : 'play again'), W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    for (let i = 0; i < movers.length; i++) drawMover(movers[i]);
    drawKid();
    drawStarBadge();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === 'start') {
      drawOverlay('Costume Change Timer', 'Grab the stars before time runs out!', '#ffd166');
    } else if (state === 'win') {
      drawOverlay('You did it! ' + score + ' costumes!', 'The show is a big hit. Bravo!', '#7be0a8');
    } else if (state === 'lose') {
      drawOverlay('Time is up!', 'You got ' + score + ' of ' + targetScore + ' costumes. Try again!', '#ff5252');
    }
  }

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>

<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#081019;overflow:hidden;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  var TAU=Math.PI*2;
  var canvas=document.getElementById('c');
  var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W=0,H=0,DPR=1;

  function resize(){
    DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
    W=window.innerWidth; H=window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width=W*DPR; canvas.height=H*DPR;
    canvas.style.width=W+'px'; canvas.style.height=H+'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
  resize();

  var audio=null, started=false, muted=false;
  var bpm=120, beatDur=60/bpm, tick=0, beatCount=0;
  var state='title', score=0, combo=0, best=0, lastTime=0, titleT=0, shake=0;
  var beatPulse=0, ring=0;
  var movers=[], particles=[], notes=[], flashes=[];
  var lanes=[], targets=[];
  var lastBeat=-1, lastLane=-1, lastTarget=-1, lastHitTime=-999;

  function ensureAudio(){
    if(!audio){ try{ audio=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){ audio=null; } }
    if(audio&&audio.state==='suspended') audio.resume();
  }
  function blip(freq,dur,type,vol){
    if(!audio||muted) return;
    var t=audio.currentTime;
    var o=audio.createOscillator(), g=audio.createGain();
    o.type=type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(audio.destination);
    o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }
  function beatSound(off){
    if(off) blip(200,0.12,'sawtooth',0.09); else blip(90,0.16,'sine',0.14);
  }
  function hitSound(){ blip(680,0.1,'triangle',0.12); blip(1020,0.07,'sine',0.05); }
  function missSound(){ blip(120,0.25,'sawtooth',0.08); }

  function layout(){
    var n=3, gap=26, laneW=Math.min(150,(W-200-gap*(n-1))/n);
    var totalW=n*laneW+(n-1)*gap, x0=(W-totalW)/2;
    lanes=[]; targets=[];
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      lanes.push({x:x0+i*(laneW+gap),w:laneW});
      targets.push({x:x0+i*(laneW+gap)+laneW/2, y:H*0.66, r:Math.min(laneW*0.34,52)});
    }
  }
  function spawnNote(lane,beat){
    var t=targets[lane];
    var x=t.x, y=t.y, r=t.r;
    var vx=(Math.random()*2-1)*1.6, vy=(Math.random()*2-1)*1.6;
    var a=Math.random()*TAU;
    notes.push({x:x,y:y,vx:vx,vy:vy,
      ox:x,oy:y,ox2:x,oy2:y,
      r:r, lane:lane, beat:beat, offbeat:(beat%2===1),
      t0:performance.now(), life:3.6,
      phase:Math.random()*TAU,
      col: beat%2===1 ? '#ff5f9e' : '#ffd24a'});
  }
  function spawnRing(x,y,col){
    movers.push({type:'ring',x:x,y:y,vx:0,vy:0,ox:x,oy:y,ox2:x,oy2:y,
      r:26,life:0.55,max:0.55,col:col});
  }
  function spawnBurst(x,y,col){
    for(var i=0;i<14;i++){
      var a=Math.random()*TAU, sp=1.5+Math.random()*4.5;
      particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-1.5,
        life:0.55+Math.random()*0.35,max:0.9,r:2+Math.random()*3,col:col});
    }
  }
  function hitNote(i){
    var n=notes[i];
    notes.splice(i,1);
    score++; combo++; if(score>best) best=score;
    spawnRing(n.x,n.y,n.col);
    spawnBurst(n.x,n.y,n.col);
    flashes.push({x:n.x,y:n.y,life:0.3,max:0.3,col:n.col});
    hitSound();
  }
  function missNote(i){
    var n=notes[i];
    notes.splice(i,1);
    combo=0;
    spawnBurst(n.x,n.y,'#7a8896');
    flashes.push({x:n.x,y:n.y,life:0.3,max:0.3,col:'#7a8896'});
    missSound();
  }
  function startGame(){
    ensureAudio();
    if(!started){ started=true; tick=0; beatCount=0; lastBeat=-1; lastLane=-1; lastTarget=-1; }
    state='play'; score=0; combo=0;
    notes.length=0; movers.length=0; particles.length=0; flashes.length=0;
    beatPulse=0; ring=0;
    lastTime=performance.now();

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    ensureAudio();
    if(state==='title'||state==='over'){ startGame(); return; }

    var x=e.clientX, y=e.clientY;
    for(var i=0;i<notes.length;i++){
      var n=notes[i];
      var dx=x-n.x, dy=y-n.y;

        if(age<1.2){ hitNote(i); } else { missNote(i); }
        return;

  function update(dt){
    if(state==='title'){ titleT+=dt; }
    if(state==='play'){
      tick+=dt;
      var b=Math.floor(tick/beatDur);
      if(b>beatCount){
        beatCount=b;
        var off=(b%2===1);
        beatPulse=1;
        if(off){
          var lane=Math.floor(Math.random()*lanes.length);
          var tgt=Math.floor(Math.random()*targets.length);
          if(tgt===lastTarget) tgt=(tgt+1)%targets.length;
          if(lane===lastLane&&tgt===lastTarget) lane=(lane+1)%lanes.length;
          lastLane=lane; lastTarget=tgt;
          spawnNote(lane,b);
        }
        if(lastBeat!==-1){
          for(var i=0;i<notes.length;i++){
            if(notes[i].beat===lastBeat){
              var age=(performance.now()-notes[i].t0)/1000;
              if(age>=1.2) missNote(i);
            }
          }
        }
        lastBeat=b;
        beatSound(off);
      }
      ring+=dt*2.4;
    }
    if(beatPulse>0) beatPulse=Math.max(0,beatPulse-dt*2.5);
    if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*20);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=no">
<title>Head, Shoulders, Knees & Toes</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0d1330;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none}
  #c{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const cv = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;

function resize(){

const TAU = Math.PI*2;

// ---- State ----

  {id:'should', name:'SHOULDERS', color:'#ff5d73', x:0,y:0},
  {id:'knees',  name:'KNEES',     color:'#35d0ba', x:0,y:0},
  {id:'toes',   name:'TOES',      color:'#c07bff', x:0,y:0}

const movers = [];
const stars = [];
let score=0, best=0, combo=0, state='start', lastTarget=0, elapsed=0, shake=0, hint=0, lastPart=-1, t=0;

  const cx=W/2, cy=H*0.52, R=Math.min(W,H)*0.34;
  const r=Math.min(W,H)*0.052;

  p[0].x=cx; p[0].y=cy-R;
  p[1].x=cx; p[1].y=cy-R*0.32;
  p[2].x=cx; p[2].y=cy+R*0.32;
  p[3].x=cx; p[3].y=cy+R;

}
function nextTarget(){
  let n;
  do{ n=(Math.random()*parts.length)|0; }while(n===lastPart && parts.length>1);
  lastPart=n; lastTarget=n;
}
function spawnMover(x,y,vx,vy,life,size,color){
  movers.push({x,y,vx,vy,life,max:life,size,color});
}
function spawnBurst(x,y,color){
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*TAU, s=110+Math.random()*240;
    spawnMover(x,y,Math.cos(a)*s,Math.sin(a)*s,0.5+Math.random()*0.3,3+Math.random()*4,color);
  }
}
function spawnText(x,y,txt,color,size){
  movers.push({x,y,vx:0,vy:-60,life:0.9,max:0.9,size:0,color,txt});
}
function init(){
  layout();
  movers.length=0;
  score=0; combo=0; elapsed=0; shake=0; hint=0;
  state='start';
  nextTarget();
  stars.length=0;
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:Math.random()*1.6+0.4,p:Math.random()*TAU,s:0.5+Math.random()*1.5});

// ---- Input ----
function onDown(e){

    combo++;
    spawnBurst(tp.x,tp.y,tp.color);
    spawnText(tp.x,tp.y-t.r*0.5,'+100','#ffffff',22);
    shake=6;

    combo=0;
    spawnText(x,y,'MISS','#ff6b6b',18);

// ---- Update ----
function update(dt){
  t+=dt;
  if(state==='play') elapsed+=dt;
  if(hint>0) hint-=dt;
  if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*30);
  for(const s of stars) s.p+=s.s*dt;
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=movers[i];

// ---- Draw ----
function drawPart(p, i){

    ctx.fillText('Click the glowing body part', W/2, H*0.55);

    ctx.font=Math.min(22,W*0.04)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';

    ctx.textAlign='right';

      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
      ctx.font='bold '+Math.min(40,W*0.07)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score, W/2, H*0.5);
      ctx.fillStyle='#35d0ba';
      ctx.font=Math.min(24,W*0.045)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';

      const bl=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*4);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(0.6+0.4*bl)+')';
      ctx.font='bold '+Math.min(30,W*0.055)+'px "Trebuchet MS",sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('TAP TO PLAY AGAIN', W/2, H*0.7);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- Loop ----
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
init();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pumpkin Carver</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#140d08;overflow:hidden;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}
  #c{display:block;margin:0 auto;touch-action:none;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// ---------- state ----------
const GAME = 60000;
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let startTime = 0;
let timeLeft = GAME;
let mouse = {x:0, y:0, down:false};

const W = 800, H = 600;
const CX = W/2, CY = H/2 + 20;
const RX = 150, RY = 118;
const TOP = CY - RY, BOTTOM = CY + RY;
const MOUTH_Y = CY + 50, MOUTH_HALF = 74;
const MOUTH_TOP = MOUTH_Y - 24, MOUTH_BOT = MOUTH_Y + 24;

let movers = [];
let features = [];
let stars = [];
let fireflies = [];
let carved = [];
let particles = [];

function inMouth(x,y){ return y >= MOUTH_TOP && y <= MOUTH_BOT && Math.abs(x-CX) <= MOUTH_HALF; }

// ---------- setup ----------
function makeFeatures(){
  features = [
    {type:'eye', x:0, y:-34, r:22, carved:false},
    {type:'eye', x:0, y:-34, r:22, carved:false},
    {type:'nose', x:0, y:2, r:15, carved:false},
    {type:'mouth', x:0, y:50, r:26, carved:false}
  ];
  features[0].x = -58; features[1].x = 58;
}
function makeStars(){
  stars = [];
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*(H*0.55), r:Math.random()*1.3+0.4, tw:Math.random()*6.28});
}
function makeFireflies(){
  fireflies = [];
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    let x = CX + (Math.random()*2-1)*260;
    let y = TOP - 20 + Math.random()*(BOTTOM-TOP+40);
    let a = Math.random()*6.28, s = 0.2+Math.random()*0.5;
    fireflies.push({x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, ph:Math.random()*6.28});
  }
}
function makeCarved(){
  carved = [];
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++) carved.push({x:CX+(Math.random()*2-1)*220, y:TOP-10+Math.random()*(BOTTOM-TOP+20), vx:(Math.random()*2-1)*0.3, vy:-0.4-Math.random()*0.7, rot:Math.random()*6.28, vr:(Math.random()*2-1)*0.06, s:0.7+Math.random()*0.7, life:1, max:1});
}
function makeParticles(){
  particles = [];
  for(let i=0;i<160;i++) particles.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, vx:(Math.random()*2-1)*0.3, vy:0.2+Math.random()*0.5, s:1+Math.random()*2.5, ph:Math.random()*6.28});
}
function init(){
  makeFeatures(); makeStars(); makeFireflies(); makeCarved(); makeParticles();
  movers = [];
}
function startGame(){
  state='playing'; score=0; timeLeft=GAME; startTime=performance.now();
  makeFeatures();
  movers = [];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++) spawnSeed(i/4);
}
function spawnSeed(t){
  movers.push({
    x: CX + (Math.random()*2-1)*40,
    y: TOP - 20,
    vx: (Math.random()*2-1)*1.5,
    vy: 1.2 + Math.random()*1.4,
    r: 3 + Math.random()*3,
    seed: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.5,
    life: 0,
    max: 220 + Math.random()*120
  });
}
function spawnCarve(x,y){
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    let a = Math.random()*6.28, sp = 1+Math.random()*2;
    movers.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(a)*sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a)*sp - 1.5,
      r: 2 + Math.random()*2.5,
      seed: 0.5,
      life: 0,
      max: 26 + Math.random()*14
    });
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
function canvasPos(e){
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x:(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width), y:(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height) };
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { const p=canvasPos(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { const p=canvasPos(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.down=true; handleClick(p.x,p.y); });
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => mouse.down=false);
canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => mouse.down=false);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); const t=e.touches[0]; const p=canvasPos(t); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.down=true; handleClick(p.x,p.y); }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); const t=e.touches[0]; const p=canvasPos(t); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; }, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => mouse.down=false);

function handleClick(x,y){
  if(state==='start'){ startGame(); return; }
  if(state==='over'){ state='start'; return; }
  if(state!=='playing') return;
  if(!inMouth(x,y)) return;
  let hit = false;
  for(const f of features){
    if(f.carved) continue;
    const dx = x-(CX+f.x), dy = y-(CY+f.y);
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy <= f.r*f.r){
      f.carved = true;
      hit = true;
      score += f.type==='mouth' ? 4 : (f.type==='eye' ? 3 : 2);
      spawnCarve(x,y);
      break;
    }
  }
  if(!hit) spawnCarve(x,y);
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(now){
  if(state==='playing'){
    timeLeft = GAME - (now - startTime);
    if(timeLeft <= 0){ timeLeft = 0; state='over'; if(score>best) best=score; }
  }

  // movers
  for(const m of movers){
    m.x += m.vx;
    m.y += m.vy;
    if(m.max > 100){ m.vy += 0.05; m.life++; } else { m.vy += 0.08; m.life++; }
  }
  movers = movers.filter(m => m.life < m.max && m.y < H + 40);
  if(state==='playing' && movers.length < 6 && Math.random() < 0.03) spawnSeed(Math.random());

  // fireflies
  for(const f of fireflies){
    f.x += f.vx; f.y += f.vy;
    if(f.x < CX-260) f.vx = Math.abs(f.vx);
    if(f.x > CX+260) f.vx = -Math.abs(f.vx);
    if(f.y < TOP-25) f.vy = Math.abs(f.vy);
    if(f.y > BOTTOM+25) f.vy = -Math.abs(f.vy);
    f.ph += 0.05;
  }

  // carved seeds
  for(const c of carved){
    c.x += c.vx; c.y += c.vy; c.vy += 0.02; c.rot += c.vr; c.life -= 0.005;
  }
  carved = carved.filter(c => c.life > 0 && c.y < H + 40);

  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.ph += 0.04;
    if(p.y > H){ p.y = 0; p.x = Math.random()*W; }
    if(p.x < 0) p.x = W; if(p.x > W) p.x = 0;
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawPumpkin(){
  // glow
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, CY, 30, CX, CY, 260);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,40,0.28)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,150,40,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stem
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4326';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(CX-14, TOP+18);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CX-20, TOP-26, CX-4, TOP-34);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CX+12, TOP-40, CX+16, TOP-24);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CX+18, TOP-6, CX+14, TOP+18);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6f5230';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(CX, TOP-24, 6, 12, 0.2, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();

  // body
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(CX, CY);
  ctx.scale(RX/100, RY/100);
  let bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-30,-40,20, 0,0,120);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#ff9f3e'); bg.addColorStop(0.55,'#e86f1f'); bg.addColorStop(1,'#b23f10');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,100,100,0,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(90,30,8,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth=6; ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,45,10,0.35)';
  for(const off of [-50,-17,17,50]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(off,0,26,96,0,0,6.2832); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.restore();

  // features
  for(const f of features){
    const fx = CX+f.x, fy = CY+f.y;
    if(f.carved){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,180,60,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(fx,fy,f.r*1.35,f.r*1.35,0,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff9d20';
      if(f.type==='eye'){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(fx, fy+f.r);
        ctx.lineTo(fx-f.r, fy-f.r*0.6);
        ctx.lineTo(fx, fy-f.r*1.05);
        ctx.lineTo(fx+f.r, fy-f.r*0.6);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      } else if(f.type==='nose'){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(fx, fy-f.r);
        ctx.lineTo(fx-f.r, fy+f.r);
        ctx.lineTo(fx+f.r, fy+f.r);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(fx-f.r, fy);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fx, fy+f.r*2.2, fx+f.r, fy);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(fx, fy-f.r*0.7, fx-f.r, fy);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,22,8,0.35)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(fx,fy,f.r,f.r,0,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawFireflies(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const f of fireflies){
    let a = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(f.ph));
    let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x,f.y,0,f.x,f.y,9);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,240,150,'+a+')');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,200,80,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,9,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCarved(){
  for(const c of carved){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, c.life));
    ctx.translate(c.x, c.y); ctx.rotate(c.rot); ctx.scale(c.s, c.s);
    ctx.fillStyle='#efe3c0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,7,4,0,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,90,40,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-1,0,3,1.5,0,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawMovers(){
  for(const m of movers){
    let a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - m.life/m.max));
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,'+(150+Math.floor(80*a))+',40,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    let a = 0.05 + 0.12*Math.abs(Math.sin(p.ph));
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,150,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawStars(){
  for(const s of stars){
    let a = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw + now*0.001));
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,240,200,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBackground(){
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#100a1e'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#241028'); g.addColorStop(1,'#160d12');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  let mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX, H*0.3, 20, CX, H*0.3, 220);
  mg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(220,200,255,0.22)'); mg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,200,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=mg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawStars();
  ctx.fillStyle='#0c0805';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(CX, H+20, 520, 90, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,14,10,0.9)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, H-30, W, 30);
}

function panel(x,y,w,h){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(15,8,4,0.82)';
  ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,150,60,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x,y,w,h);
}

function drawHUD(){
  panel(14,14,150,40);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a'; ctx.font='bold 22px Georgia,serif'; ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score, 26, 35);

  let tw = 190, tx = W-tw-14;
  panel(tx,14,tw,40);
  let frac = timeLeft/GAME;
  let col = frac>0.5 ? '#7fe07a' : (frac>0.25 ? '#ffd24a' : '#ff6a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(tx+14, 26, tw-28, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(tx+14, 26, (tw-28)*frac, 16);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.strokeRect(tx+14, 26, tw-28, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='12px Georgia,serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(timeLeft/1000)+'s', tx+tw/2, 24);

  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,160,0.7)'; ctx.font='13px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('Carve the face in the mouth  \u2022  click a feature to carve', CX, H-16);
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,5,3,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  panel(W/2-230, 120, 460, 360);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffb347'; ctx.font='bold 46px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillText('Pumpkin Carver', W/2, 175);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,160,0.85)'; ctx.font='16px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('You have 60 seconds to carve a jack-o-lantern face.', W/2, 220);
  ctx.fillText('Click the faint features inside the mouth to carve them.', W/2, 246);
  ctx.fillText('Eyes, nose, and mouth each score points. The mouth pays the most.', W/2, 272);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a'; ctx.font='bold 20px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('Click anywhere to start', W/2, 340);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.font='13px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('Best: '+best, W/2, 440);
}

function drawOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,5,3,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  panel(W/2-230, 150, 460, 300);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffb347'; ctx.font='bold 40px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillText('Time is up!', W/2, 205);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 26px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, W/2, 260);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a'; ctx.font='18px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillText('Best: '+best, W/2, 295);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,160,0.8)'; ctx.font='15px Georgia,serif';
  ctx.fillText('Click to carve again', W/2, 360);
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawPumpkin();
  drawCarved();
  drawMovers();
  drawFireflies();
  drawParticles();
  if(state==='playing') drawHUD();
  if(state==='start') drawStart();
  if(state==='over') drawOver();

  if(state==='playing'){
    if(inMouth(mouse.x, mouse.y)){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(mouse.x, mouse.y, 0, mouse.x, mouse.y, 34);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,220,120,0.5)'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,220,120,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 34, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 7, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

// ---------- resize ----------
function resize(){
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth/W, window.innerHeight/H);
  const cssW = W*scale, cssH = H*scale;

<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = Math.min(window.innerWidth, 520);
  const H = Math.min(window.innerHeight, 720);
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  const LANE_W = W / 4;
  const HIT_Y = H - 90;
  const SPAWN_Y = 40;

  const laneColors = ['#ff4d6d', '#ff9e00', '#2ecc71', '#3498db'];
  const laneGlow = ['#ff2244', '#ff7700', '#11aa55', '#2277cc'];
  const keyLabels = ['D', 'F', 'J', 'K'];

  let state = 'start';
  let score = 0;
  let combo = 0;
  let maxCombo = 0;
  let totalNotes = 0;
  let hitNotes = 0;
  let elapsed = 0;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let speed = 3.2;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 0.55;
  let shakeX = 0;
  let shakeY = 0;
  let shakePower = 0;
  let flashAlpha = 0;
  let flashColor = '#fff';

  const notes = [];
  const particles = [];
  const floatTexts = [];
  const bgDots = [];
  const bgRings = [];
  const bgTriangles = [];
  const lanePulses = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const laneFlashes = [0, 0, 0, 0];

  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    bgDots.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 2.5 + 0.5,
      a: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    bgRings.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 60 + 20,
      a: Math.random() * 0.06 + 0.02,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    bgTriangles.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      size: Math.random() * 15 + 5,
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
      color: laneColors[i % 4],
      a: Math.random() * 0.08 + 0.03
    });
  }

  const keysDown = {};

  function spawnNote() {
    const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    notes.push({
      x: lane * LANE_W + LANE_W / 2,
      y: SPAWN_Y,
      vx: 0,
      vy: speed,
      lane: lane,
      done: false,
      hit: false,
      missed: false,
      radius: 22,
      pulse: 0
    });
    totalNotes++;
  }

  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const spd = Math.random() * 4 + 1.5;
      particles.push({
        x: x,
        y: y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - 1,
        life: 1,
        decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.015,
        color: color,
        size: Math.random() * 5 + 2
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnFloatText(x, y, text, color) {
    floatTexts.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: 0,
      vy: -1.5,
      text: text,
      color: color,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.02
    });
  }

  function hitLane(lane) {
    lanePulses[lane] = 1;
    laneFlashes[lane] = 1;

    let bestNote = null;
    let bestDist = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      const n = notes[i];
      if (n.lane === lane && !n.done && !n.missed) {
        const d = Math.abs(n.y - HIT_Y);
        if (d < bestDist) {
          bestDist = d;
          bestNote = n;
        }
      }
    }

    if (bestNote && bestDist < 50) {
      bestNote.done = true;
      bestNote.hit = true;
      hitNotes++;

      let points = 0;
      let label = '';
      if (bestDist < 12) {
        points = 300;
        label = 'PERFECT';
        combo++;
        spawnParticles(bestNote.x, HIT_Y, '#ffffff', 18);
        spawnParticles(bestNote.x, HIT_Y, laneColors[lane], 12);
        flashColor = '#ffffff';
        flashAlpha = 0.15;
      } else if (bestDist < 28) {
        points = 150;
        label = 'GREAT';
        combo++;
        spawnParticles(bestNote.x, HIT_Y, laneColors[lane], 12);
      } else {
        points = 50;
        label = 'OK';
        combo++;
        spawnParticles(bestNote.x, HIT_Y, laneColors[lane], 6);
      }

      const comboMult = 1 + Math.floor(combo / 5) * 0.5;
      const total = Math.floor(points * comboMult);
      score += total;
      if (combo > maxCombo) maxCombo = combo;

      spawnFloatText(bestNote.x, HIT_Y - 30, label, '#ffffff');
      if (combo >= 5) {
        spawnFloatText(bestNote.x, HIT_Y - 55, combo + 'x COMBO', laneColors[lane]);
      }
    } else {
      combo = 0;
      spawnFloatText(lane * LANE_W + LANE_W / 2, HIT_Y - 20, 'MISS', '#888888');
    }
  }

  function resetGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    combo = 0;
    maxCombo = 0;
    totalNotes = 0;
    hitNotes = 0;
    elapsed = 0;
    speed = 3.2;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = 0.55;
    shakePower = 0;
    flashAlpha = 0;
    notes.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    floatTexts.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      lanePulses[i] = 0;
      laneFlashes[i] = 0;
    }
  }

  function endGame() {
    state = 'over';
    const accuracy = totalNotes > 0 ? Math.floor((hitNotes / totalNotes) * 100) : 0;
    shakePower = 8;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (state === 'start') {
      resetGame();
    } else if (state === 'over') {
      resetGame();
    }
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'over') {
      resetGame();
      return;
    }
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tx = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    const lane = Math.floor(tx / LANE_W);
    if (lane >= 0 && lane < 4) hitLane(lane);
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.repeat) return;
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'over') {
      if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') {
        resetGame();
        return;
      }
    }
    if (state === 'playing') {
      if (k === 'd') hitLane(0);
      else if (k === 'f') hitLane(1);
      else if (k === 'j') hitLane(2);
      else if (k === 'k') hitLane(3);
    }
    keysDown[k] = true;
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
    keysDown[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  });

  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== 'playing') {
      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        const p = particles[i];
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.1;
        p.life -= p.decay;
      }
      for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < floatTexts.length; i++) {
        const t = floatTexts[i];
        t.x += t.vx;
        t.y += t.vy;
        t.life -= t.decay;
      }
      for (let i = floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (floatTexts[i].life <= 0) floatTexts.splice(i, 1);
      }
      shakePower *= 0.9;
      shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakePower;
      shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakePower;
      flashAlpha *= 0.92;
      return;
    }

    elapsed += dt;
    speed = 3.2 + Math.floor(elapsed / 15) * 0.4;
    spawnInterval = Math.max(0.25, 0.55 - elapsed * 0.003);

    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnNote();
      if (elapsed > 30 && Math.random() < 0.3) {
        spawnNote();
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
      const n = notes[i];
      n.x += n.vx;
      n.y += n.vy;
      n.pulse += dt * 4;
      if (!n.done && n.y > HIT_Y + 50) {
        n.done = true;
        n.missed = true;
        combo = 0;
        spawnFloatText(n.x, HIT_Y, 'MISS', '#ff4444');
        shakePower = 4;
      }
    }
    for (let i = notes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (notes[i].done) notes.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.12;
      p.life -= p.decay;
    }
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < floatTexts.length; i++) {
      const t = floatTexts[i];
      t.x += t.vx;
      t.y += t.vy;
      t.life -= t.decay;
    }
    for (let i = floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (floatTexts[i].life <= 0) floatTexts.splice(i, 1);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      lanePulses[i] *= 0.9;
      laneFlashes[i] *= 0.92;
    }

    shakePower *= 0.88;
    shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakePower;
    shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakePower;
    flashAlpha *= 0.9;

    if (elapsed >= 45) {
      endGame();
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a0f2e');
    grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#2d1245');
    grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#3d1555');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0a28');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    for (let i = 0; i < bgRings.length; i++) {
      const r = bgRings[i];
      const pulse = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.5 + r.phase) * 0.5 + 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r + pulse * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 140, 0, ' + (r.a + pulse * 0.03) + ')';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < bgDots.length; i++) {
      const d = bgDots[i];
      const twinkle = Math.sin(elapsed * 1.5 + d.phase) * 0.5 + 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 100, ' + (d.a * twinkle) + ')';
      ctx.fill();
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < bgTriangles.length; i++) {
      const t = bgTriangles[i];
      t.rot += t.rotSpeed;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(t.x, t.y);
      ctx.rotate(t.rot);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -t.size);
      ctx.lineTo(t.size * 0.866, t.size * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(-t.size * 0.866, t.size * 0.5);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = t.a;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawLanes() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const x = i * LANE_W;
      const pulse = lanePulses[i];
      const flash = laneFlashes[i];

      const laneGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x, H);
      laneGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      laneGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)');
      laneGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
      ctx.fillStyle = laneGrad;
      ctx.fillRect(x, 0, LANE_W, H);

      if (flash > 0.05) {
        const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x, H);
        fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        fg.addColorStop(0.6, laneColors[i] + '00');
        fg.addColorStop(1, laneColors[i]);
        ctx.fillStyle = fg;
        ctx.globalAlpha = flash * 0.15;
        ctx.fillRect(x, 0, LANE_W, H);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(x, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.stroke();

    const hitGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, HIT_Y - 30, 0, HIT_Y + 30);
    hitGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    hitGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
    hitGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = hitGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, HIT_Y - 30, W, 60);

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, HIT_Y);
    ctx.lineTo(W, HIT_Y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const cx = i * LANE_W + LANE_W / 2;
      const pulse = lanePulses[i];
      const r = 28 + pulse * 8;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, HIT_Y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = laneColors[i];
      ctx.lineWidth = 3 + pulse * 3;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + pulse * 0.5;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, HIT_Y, r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = laneColors[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15 + pulse * 0.3;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      ctx.font = 'bold 18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.4 + pulse * 0.6) + ')';
      ctx.fillText(keyLabels[i], cx, HIT_Y);
    }
  }

  function drawNote(n) {
    const color = laneColors[n.lane];
    const glow = laneGlow[n.lane];
    const pulse = Math.sin(n.pulse) * 0.5 + 0.5;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12 + pulse * 8;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, n.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    const ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(n.x - 5, n.y - 5, 2, n.x, n.y, n.radius);
    ng.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    ng.addColorStop(0.3, color);
    ng.addColorStop(1, glow);
    ctx.fillStyle = ng;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, n.radius + 4 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 + pulse * 0.15;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
      const p = particles[i];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life * 0.8;
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawFloatTexts() {
    for (let i = 0; i < floatTexts.length; i++) {
      const t = floatTexts[i];
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = t.life;
      ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(score.toLocaleString(), W / 2, 10);

    ctx.font = '14px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)';
    ctx.fillText('Samba Feet', W / 2, 42);

    if (combo >= 3) {
      const comboColor = combo >= 10 ? '#ff4d6d' : combo >= 5 ? '#ff9e00' : '#2ecc71';
      ctx.font = 'bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';

      ctx.fillText(combo + 'x COMBO', 0, 0);
      ctx.restore();

    const timeLeft = Math.max(0, 45 - elapsed);
    ctx.font = '16px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(15, 15, 80, 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9e00';
    ctx.fillRect(15, 15, 80 * progress, 6);
  }

  function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 5, 25, 0.7)';

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9e00';
    ctx.fillText('Samba Feet', W / 2, H * 0.2);

    ctx.font = '18px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.fillText('A Rhythm of Fire and Dance', W / 2, H * 0.2 + 35);

    const instructions = [
      'Press D, F, J, K to hit the notes',
      'or tap the lanes on screen',
      'Hit notes as they reach the line below',
      'Build combos for higher scores',
      'Survive 45 seconds to finish the dance'
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
      ctx.font = '15px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,0.7)';
      ctx.fillText(instructions[i], W / 2, H * 0.42 + i * 28);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const kx = W / 2 + (i - 1.5) * 55;

      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      ctx.lineWidth = 2;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
