<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>SubRoc-3D (1982) — Wave 1</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; height:100%; background:#04060f; overflow:hidden; }
  body { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  canvas { display:block; background:#04060f; box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(0,150,255,0.18); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="720" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- canvas ---------- */
var canvas = document.getElementById('c');
var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
var SHIP_Y = H - 58;

/* ---------- game state ---------- */
var state = 'start';       // start | play | win | lose
var score = 0;
var lives = 3;
var wave = 1;
var waveTotal = 4;
var fireCd = 0;
var shipInvuln = 0;
var shipShake = 0;
var time = 0;
var msg = '';
var msgTimer = 0;
var msgColor = '#fff';
var last = performance.now();

/* ---------- actors (one array: {x,y,vx,vy, ...}) ---------- */
var aliens = [];
var bullets = [];   // player shots
var enemyFire = []; // alien shots
var particles = [];

var keys = {};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }
function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
function dist(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }

function addMsg(text, color, dur) { msg = text; msgColor = color; msgTimer = dur; }

function resetGame() {
  score = 0; lives = 3; wave = 1; fireCd = 0; shipInvuln = 0; shipShake = 0;
  aliens = []; bullets = []; enemyFire = []; particles = [];
  spawnWave();
}

function spawnWave() {
  aliens = [];
  var rows = 3, cols = 8;
  var sx = 70, sy = 84;
  for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      var a = {
        x: sx + c * (W - 2 * sx) / (cols - 1),
        y: sy + r * 42,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        baseX: sx + c * (W - 2 * sx) / (cols - 1),
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        alive: true,
        color: r === 0 ? '#ff5566' : (r === 1 ? '#ffaa33' : '#33d0ff'),
        hit: 0
      };
      aliens.push(a);
    }
  }
}

function explode(x, y, color, n, speed) {
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    var ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    var sp = rand(speed * 0.3, speed);
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(ang) * sp, vy: Math.sin(ang) * sp,
      life: rand(0.4, 0.9), max: 0.9,
      color: color, size: rand(1.5, 3.5)
    });
  }
}

function playerFire() {
  if (fireCd > 0) return;
  bullets.push({ x: W / 2, y: SHIP_Y - 20, vx: 0, vy: -560, alive: true, color: '#eaffff', size: 3 });
  fireCd = 0.22;
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space') {
    if (state === 'play') playerFire();
    else if (state === 'start') { state = 'play'; resetGame(); }
    else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') { state = 'play'; resetGame(); }
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  if (e.code === 'Enter') {
    if (state === 'start') { state = 'play'; resetGame(); }
    else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') { state = 'play'; resetGame(); }
  }
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { keys[e.code] = false; });

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt) {
  time += dt;
  if (fireCd > 0) fireCd -= dt;
  if (shipInvuln > 0) shipInvuln -= dt;
  if (shipShake > 0) shipShake -= dt;
  if (msgTimer > 0) msgTimer -= dt;

  // move player
  var shipX = W / 2;
  if (state === 'play') {
    var spd = 340;
    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) shipX -= spd * dt;
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) shipX += spd * dt;
    shipX = clamp(shipX, 34, W - 34);
  }

  // move aliens (sine wave + slow descent)
  if (state === 'play') {
    var descend = 18 + wave * 4;
    for (var i = 0; i < aliens.length; i++) {
      var a = aliens[i];
      if (!a.alive) continue;
      a.phase += dt * 2.2;
      a.y += descend * dt;
      a.x = a.baseX + Math.sin(a.phase) * 26;
      if (a.hit > 0) a.hit -= dt;
      // reached bottom -> lose
      if (a.y > SHIP_Y - 10) {
        state = 'lose';
        addMsg('WAVE BREACHED', '#ff5566', 999);
        explode(a.x, a.y, a.color, 24, 220);
      }
    }
    // alien fire
    for (var j = 0; j < aliens.length; j++) {
      var b = aliens[j];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      if (Math.random() < dt * 0.35) {
        enemyFire.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y + 12, vx: rand(-20, 20), vy: rand(150, 230), alive: true, color: '#ff7755', size: 3 });
      }
    }
  }

  // move player bullets
  for (var k = 0; k < bullets.length; k++) {
    var p = bullets[k];
    if (!p.alive) continue;
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    if (p.y < -10) p.alive = false;
    // hit alien
    for (var m = 0; m < aliens.length; m++) {
      var al = aliens[m];
      if (al.alive && dist(p, al) < 18) {
        al.alive = false; p.alive = false;
        score += 100;
        explode(al.x, al.y, al.color, 16, 180);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // move enemy fire
  for (var n = 0; n < enemyFire.length; n++) {
    var ef = enemyFire[n];
    if (!ef.alive) continue;
    ef.x += ef.vx * dt; ef.y += ef.vy * dt;
    if (ef.y > H + 10) ef.alive = false;
    if (state === 'play' && shipInvuln <= 0 && Math.abs(ef.x - shipX) < 16 && Math.abs(ef.y - SHIP_Y) < 18) {
      ef.alive = false;
      lives--;
      shipInvuln = 1.4;
      shipShake = 0.35;
      explode(shipX, SHIP_Y, '#88ddff', 22, 200);
      if (lives <= 0) { state = 'lose'; addMsg('SHIP DESTROYED', '#ff5566', 999); }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (var q = 0; q < particles.length; q++) {
    var pt = particles[q];
    pt.x += pt.vx * dt; pt.y += pt.vy * dt;
    pt.vy += 60 * dt;
    pt.life -= dt;
  }

  // cleanup
  aliens = aliens.filter(function (a) { return a.alive; });
  bullets = bullets.filter(function (a) { return a.alive; });
  enemyFire = enemyFire.filter(function (a) { return a.alive; });
  particles = particles.filter(function (a) { return a.life > 0; });

  // wave complete
  if (state === 'play' && aliens.length === 0) {
    if (wave >= waveTotal) {
      state = 'win';
      addMsg('SECTOR CLEARED', '#55ff99', 999);
    } else {
      wave++;
      spawnWave();
      addMsg('WAVE ' + wave, '#55ff99', 1.2);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  // deep gradient
  var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1230');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#081024');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#03060f');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,255,0.8)';
  for (var i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    var x = (i * 97) % W;
    var y = ((i * 61) + time * 20 * (i % 3 + 1)) % H;
    var s = (i % 3) + 0.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + (i % 5) * 0.12;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // distant nebula glow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,40,120,0.10)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W * 0.75, H * 0.3, 160, 90, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,90,120,0.10)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W * 0.25, H * 0.6, 140, 80, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

function drawShip(x) {
  var y = SHIP_Y;
  if (shipInvuln > 0 && Math.floor(time * 12) % 2 === 0) ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  // engine glow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.6)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 16, 8, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33d0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -22);
  ctx.lineTo(14, 8);
  ctx.lineTo(8, 14);
  ctx.lineTo(-8, 14);
  ctx.lineTo(-14, 8);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2233';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -6, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aef';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-1.5, -7.5, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // wing accents
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5566';
  ctx.fillRect(-14, 4, 4, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(10, 4, 4, 4);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawAlien(a) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
  var flash = a.hit > 0;
  // glow
  ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#ffffff' : a.color;
  ctx.globalAlpha = flash ? 1 : 0.9;
  // body
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 15, 11, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // tentacles
  ctx.strokeStyle = flash ? '#ffffff' : a.color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (var t = -1; t <= 1; t++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(t * 7, 8);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(t * 7 + Math.sin(time * 4 + t) * 3, 16, t * 7, 20);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#041018';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3355';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, -2, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5, -2, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  // shake
  var sx = 0, sy = 0;
  if (shipShake > 0) { sx = rand(-4, 4); sy = rand(-4, 4); }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);

  for (var i = 0; i < aliens.length; i++) drawAlien(aliens[i]);

  // player bullets
  for (var b = 0; b < bullets.length; b++) {
    var p = bullets[b];
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.shadowColor = p.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size * 2.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  // enemy fire
  for (var e = 0; e < enemyFire.length; e++) {
    var ef = enemyFire[e];
    ctx.fillStyle = ef.color;
    ctx.shadowColor = ef.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ef.x, ef.y, ef.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  // particles
  for (var q = 0; q < particles.length; q++) {
    var pt = particles[q];
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(pt.life / pt.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = pt.color;
    ctx.fillRect(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size, pt.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  if (state === 'play' || state === 'lose') drawShip(W / 2);

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Courier New", monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 16, 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8899';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + lives, 16, 50);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + wave + ' / ' + waveTotal, W - 16, 28);

  // message
  if (msgTimer > 0 && state === 'play') {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = msgColor;
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, 130);
  }

  // overlays
  if (state === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,6,15,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#33d0ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SUBROC-3D', W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe';
    ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('1982  ·  WAVE 1', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('← →  MOVE    SPACE  FIRE', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#55ff99';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
  } else if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,6,15,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#55ff99';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SECTOR CLEARED', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '22px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe';
    ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO PLAY AGAIN', W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
  } else if (state === 'lose') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,3,6,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5566';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '22px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8fe';
    ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY', W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
  }
}

/* ---------- main loop ---------- */
function loop(now) {
  var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Rompers 1989</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05030f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace}
  canvas{background:#05030f;box-shadow:0 0 40px #1a0a4a;border:2px solid #2a1a6a}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width,H=cv.height;
const G=0.12, shipW=34, shipH=22;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state='start';
let ship, bullets, enemies, shots, stars, parts;
let score=0, lives=3, wave=1, spawnT=0, waveGap=0, shake=0;
const keys={};
const mouse={x:W/2,down:false};

function newGame(){
  score=0; lives=3; wave=1; spawnT=0; waveGap=0; shake=0;
  ship={x:W/2,y:H-46,vx:0,vy:0};
  bullets=[]; enemies=[]; shots=[]; parts=[];
  stars=[];
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++) stars.push({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(0,H),s:rand(0.4,1.6),v:rand(0.2,0.9)});
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter'){
    if(state==='start') startGame();
    else if(state==='over') startGame();
    else if(e.key===' ') fire();
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});
cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);
});
cv.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
  if(state==='start'||state==='over'){startGame();return;}
  mouse.down=true; fire();
});
cv.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{mouse.down=false;});
function startGame(){ newGame(); state='play'; }

// ---------- ACTORS ----------
function fire(){
  if(state!=='play') return;
  bullets.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-shipH/2,vx:0,vy:-9,type:'bullet'});
}
function spawnEnemy(){
  const t=rand(0,3);
  const x=rand(40,W-40);
  enemies.push({x,y:-24,vx:rand(-0.7,0.7),vy:rand(0.6,1.2)+wave*0.05,
    type:'enemy',hp:1,r:16,t,fire:rand(1.5,3.5),
    c:['#ff5d8f','#4fd0ff','#b06bff','#5dff9e'][Math.floor(t)]});
}
function enemyFire(e){
  const dx=ship.x-e.x, dy=ship.y-e.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const sp=3.4;
  shots.push({x:e.x,y:e.y+e.r/2,vx:dx/d*sp,vy:dy/d*sp,type:'shot',r:5});
}
function boom(x,y,c,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2), s=rand(0.5,3);
    parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:rand(18,36),max:36,c});
  }
}
function hitEnemy(e){
  e.hp--;
  if(e.hp<=0){
    boom(e.x,e.y,e.c,14);
    score+=100;
    enemies.splice(enemies.indexOf(e),1);
  }
}
function hitShip(){
  if(state!=='play') return;
  lives--; shake=12;
  boom(ship.x,ship.y,'#ffe08a',26);
  if(lives<=0){ state='over'; }
  else { ship.x=W/2; ship.y=H-46; }
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(){
  if(state==='play'){
    // ship
    let ax=0;
    if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) ax-=1;
    if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) ax+=1;
    ship.vx=clamp(ship.vx+ax*0.9,-7,7);
    ship.x=clamp(ship.x+ship.vx, shipW/2, W-shipW/2);
    if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) ship.y=clamp(ship.y-4, H/2, H-shipH/2);
    if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) ship.y=clamp(ship.y+4, H/2, H-shipH/2);
    if(mouse.down) fire();
    // waves
    if(enemies.length===0){
      waveGap+=1/60;
      if(waveGap>1.6){ wave++; spawnT=0; waveGap=0; }
    } else {
      spawnT+=1/60;
      const cap=5+wave*2;
      const iv=Math.max(0.35, 1.1-wave*0.06);
      if(enemies.length<cap && spawnT>iv){ spawnEnemy(); spawnT=0; }
    }
  }
  // move bullets
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bullets[i]; b.x+=b.vx; b.y+=b.vy;
    if(b.y<-10) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }
  // move enemies
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=enemies[i];
    e.x+=e.vx; e.y+=e.vy;
    if(e.x<e.r){e.x=e.r;e.vx*=-1;}
    if(e.x>W-e.r){e.x=W-e.r;e.vx*=-1;}
    if(state==='play'){
      e.fire-=1/60;
      if(e.fire<=0 && e.y>0){ enemyFire(e); e.fire=rand(1.5,3.5); }
    }
    if(e.y>H+30){
      enemies.splice(i,1);
      if(state==='play') hitShip();
    }
  }
  // move shots
  for(let i=shots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const s=shots[i]; s.x+=s.vx; s.y+=s.vy;
    if(s.y>H+10||s.x<-10||s.x>W+10) shots.splice(i,1);
  }
  // move particles
  for(let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=parts[i]; p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy+=G*0.3; p.life--;
    if(p.life<=0) parts.splice(i,1);
  }
  // collisions
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bullets[i];
    for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const e=enemies[j];
      if(Math.hypot(b.x-e.x,b.y-e.y)<e.r){
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        hitEnemy(e);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if(state==='play'){
    for(let i=shots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const s=shots[i];
      if(Math.abs(s.x-ship.x)<shipW/2 && Math.abs(s.y-ship.y)<shipH/2){
        shots.splice(i,1); hitShip(); break;
      }
    }
  }
  // stars
  for(const st of stars){ st.y+=st.v; if(st.y>H){st.y=-2;st.x=rand(0,W);} }
  if(shake>0) shake*=0.85;
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBG(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0524'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#150a3a'); g.addColorStop(1,'#05030f');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(const st of stars){
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.4+st.s*0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle='#cfe6ff';
    ctx.fillRect(st.x,st.y,st.s,st.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawShip(){
  const x=ship.x,y=ship.y;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff7a2f'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-8,10); ctx.lineTo(0,22); ctx.lineTo(8,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-shipH/2); ctx.lineTo(shipW/2,shipH/2); ctx.lineTo(-shipW/2,shipH/2);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f7fe0'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-shipH/2+3); ctx.lineTo(shipW/2-4,shipH/2-3); ctx.lineTo(-shipW/2+4,shipH/2-3);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff2a8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-2,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawEnemy(e){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);
  ctx.fillStyle=e.c;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0524';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-6,-3,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(6,-3,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-6,-3,1.6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(6,-3,1.6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#0a0524'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-7,6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,11,7,6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawBullets(){
  for(const b of bullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff7c0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,120,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x-1.5,b.y,3,10);
  }
  for(const s of shots){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff4d6d';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd0d8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r*0.4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawParts(){
  for(const p of parts){
    ctx.globalAlpha=p.life/p.max;
    ctx.fillStyle=p.c;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,12,22);
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+wave,12,42);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES',W-12,22);
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W-14-i*18,28); ctx.lineTo(W-10-i*18,36); ctx.lineTo(W-18-i*18,36);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function center(txt,y,c){
  ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.font='bold 26px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(txt,W/2,y); ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0.5) ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake),rand(-shake,shake));
  drawBG();
  drawParts();
  for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  drawBullets();
  if(state==='play') drawShip();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,3,15,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    center('ROMPERS',H/2-40,'#eaf6ff');
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fb4ff'; ctx.font='14px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('1989',W/2,H/2-18);
    ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD  move',W/2,H/2+20);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE / CLICK  fire',W/2,H/2+40);
    ctx.fillStyle='#5dff9e';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE TO START',W/2,H/2+80);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,3,15,0.7)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    center('GAME OVER',H/2-20,'#ff5d8f');
    center('SCORE '+score,H/2+16,'#eaf6ff');
    center('PRESS SPACE TO RETRY',H/2+50,'#5dff9e');
  }
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
newGame();
function loop(){ update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<canvas id="game" width="720" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- State ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const state = {
    phase: "start",   // start | play | win | lose
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    message: ""
  };

  // ---------- Actors (single array of {x,y,vx,vy}) ----------
  const actors = [];   // will be populated by buildLevel()

  // Paddle / ball / brick metadata (separate from the array so we know what each actor is)
  const paddle = { x: W / 2, y: H - 40, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 90, h: 14, speed: 520 };
  const ball   = { x: W / 2, y: H - 70, vx: 0,   vy: 0,   r: 7 };

  // Bricks stored separately so we can track which are alive
  const brickRows = 5;
  const brickCols = 8;
  const brickW = 70;
  const brickH = 22;
  const brickGap = 6;
  const brickTop = 70;
  const bricks = [];

  const colors = {
    bg:        "#0b1a2a",
    paddle:    "#ff5a3c",
    ball:      "#ffd166",
    brick:     ["#e63946", "#f4a261", "#2a9d8f", "#4cc9f0", "#b5179e"],
    text:      "#ffffff",
    accent:    "#ffd166"
  };

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const keys = { left: false, right: false, space: false };

  function resetBall() {
    ball.x = paddle.x;
    ball.y = paddle.y - 20;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
  }

  function buildLevel() {
    actors.length = 0;
    bricks.length = 0;

    // Paddle and ball as actors
    actors.push(paddle);
    actors.push(ball);

    // Bricks
    const startX = (W - (brickCols * brickW + (brickCols - 1) * brickGap)) / 2;
    for (let r = 0; r < brickRows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < brickCols; c++) {
        const b = {
          x: startX + c * (brickW + brickGap),
          y: brickTop + r * (brickH + brickGap),
          vx: 0,
          vy: 0,
          w: brickW,
          h: brickH,
          alive: true,
          color: colors.brick[r % colors.brick.length]
        };
        bricks.push(b);
        actors.push(b);
      }
    }

    resetBall();
  }

  function startGame() {
    state.phase = "play";
    state.score = 0;
    state.lives = 3;
    state.message = "";
    buildLevel();
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function updatePaddle(dt) {
    if (keys.left)  paddle.x -= paddle.speed * dt;
    if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * dt;
    paddle.x = Math.max(paddle.w / 2, Math.min(W - paddle.w / 2, paddle.x));
  }

  function launchBall() {
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3) - Math.PI / 2; // slightly off vertical
    const speed = 380;
    ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
  }

  function reflectOffPaddle() {
    const rel = (ball.x - paddle.x) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
    const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel));
    const angle = clamped * (Math.PI / 3); // up to 60 deg
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    ball.y = paddle.y - paddle.h / 2 - ball.r;
  }

  function collideBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      // AABB vs circle (approx: treat ball as point at center)
      const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
      const dx = ball.x - cx;
      const dy = ball.y - cy;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < ball.r * ball.r) {
        b.alive = false;
        state.score += 10;
        // Reflect based on which side we hit
        const ballCenterInBrickX = ball.x > b.x + b.w / 2;
        const ballCenterInBrickY = ball.y > b.y + b.h / 2;
        if (Math.abs(ball.x - (b.x + b.w / 2)) / (b.w / 2) > Math.abs(ball.y - (b.y + b.h / 2)) / (b.h / 2)) {
          ball.vx = -ball.vx;
          ball.x = ballCenterInBrickX ? b.x + b.w + ball.r : b.x - ball.r;
        } else {
          ball.vy = -ball.vy;
          ball.y = ballCenterInBrickY ? b.y + b.h + ball.r : b.y - ball.r;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function updateBall(dt) {
    if (ball.vx === 0 && ball.vy === 0) {
      ball.x = paddle.x;
      ball.y = paddle.y - 20;
      return;
    }
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x < ball.r)        { ball.x = ball.r;        ball.vx =  Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x > W - ball.r)    { ball.x = W - ball.r;    ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y < ball.r)        { ball.y = ball.r;        ball.vy =  Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Paddle
    if (
      ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y - paddle.h / 2 &&
      ball.y + ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h / 2 + 10 &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - paddle.w / 2 - ball.r &&
      ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w / 2 + ball.r
    ) {
      reflectOffPaddle();
    }

    // Bricks
    collideBricks();

    // Bottom -> lose life
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      state.lives -= 1;
      if (state.lives <= 0) {
        state.phase = "lose";
        state.message = "Game Over";
      } else {
        resetBall();
      }
    }
  }

  function checkWin() {
    if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) {
      state.phase = "win";
      state.message = "You Cleared Every Brick!";
    }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (state.phase === "play") {
      updatePaddle(dt);
      updateBall(dt);
      checkWin();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Draw ----------
  function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#0b1a2a");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#1a2f45");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff55";
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const x = (i * 97) % W;
      const y = (i * 53) % (H * 0.5);
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);
    }

    // Bottom "wall"
    ctx.fillStyle = "#22384f";
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 24, W, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a3c";
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 24, W, 3);
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.paddle;
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x - paddle.w / 2, paddle.y - paddle.h / 2, paddle.w, paddle.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff44";
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x - paddle.w / 2 + 4, paddle.y - paddle.h / 2 + 2, paddle.w - 8, 3);
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.ball;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffffaa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x - ball.r * 0.3, ball.y - ball.r * 0.3, ball.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff22";
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#00000033";
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y + b.h - 4, b.w, 4);
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
    ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + state.score, 16, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText("LIVES  " + state.lives, W - 16, 30);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("OFF THE WALL", W / 2, 30);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state.phase === "start") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#000000aa";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
      ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("OFF THE WALL", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
      ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("Move:  ←  →   (or A / D)", W / 2, H / 2);
      ctx.fillText("Launch:  SPACE", W / 2, H / 2 + 26);
      ctx.fillText("Clear every brick to win", W / 2, H / 2 + 52);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
      ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to start", W / 2, H / 2 + 96);
    } else if (state.phase === "win") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#000000aa";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
      ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("YOU WIN!", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
      ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("Score: " + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
      ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to play again", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);
    } else if (state.phase === "lose") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#000000aa";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e63946";
      ctx.font = "bold 40px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.text;
      ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("Score: " + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = colors.accent;
      ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to try again", W / 2, H / 2 + 56);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawHUD();
    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- Input listeners ----------
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "a" || k === "A") keys.left = true;
    if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "d" || k === "D") keys.right = true;
    if (k === " ") {
      keys.space = true;
      if (state.phase === "start") {
        startGame();
      } else if (state.phase === "play") {
        if (ball.vx === 0 && ball.vy === 0) launchBall();
      } else if (state.phase === "win" || state.phase === "lose") {
        startGame();
      }
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "a" || k === "A") keys.left = false;
    if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "d" || k === "D") keys.right = false;
    if (k === " ") keys.space = false;
  });

  // ---------- Loop ----------
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // Initial level so the start screen has a scene behind it
  buildLevel();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Thunder Ball 1986</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;overflow:hidden}

<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
const ROWS=5,COLS=10,BW=64,BH=20,BX=20,BY=70;
const PADDLE_W=110,PADDLE_H=14,PSPEED=520;
const START={x:W/2,y:H-50,vx:150,vy:-230};
const START_PADDLE={x:W/2-PADDLE_W/2,y:H-28,vx:0,vy:0};

let state='start';
let actors=[];
let ball=null;
let paddle=null;
let bricks=[];
let score=0;
let flash=0;
let time=0;
let keys={left:false,right:false};

function resetGame(){
  state='start';
  actors=[];
  ball=null;paddle=null;bricks=[];
  score=0;flash=0;
}

function buildLevel(){
  const colors=['#ff5a5a','#ffb14d','#ffe14d','#5aff9c','#4dd2ff'];
  for(let r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<COLS;c++){
      bricks.push({x:BX+c*(BW+6),y:BY+r*(BH+6),vx:0,vy:0,alive:true,color:colors[r]});
    }
  }
  ball={x:START.x,y:START.y,vx:START.vx,vy:START.vy};
  paddle={x:START_PADDLE.x,y:START_PADDLE.y,vx:0,vy:0};
  actors=[ball,paddle,...bricks];
}

function win(){state='win';flash=1;}
function lose(){state='lose';flash=1;}

function update(dt){
  time+=dt;
  if(flash>0)flash-=dt*1.2;
  if(state==='start'){
    paddle.x+=(W/2-PADDLE_W/2)-paddle.x;
    return;
  }
  if(state==='playing'){
    const mv=(keys.right?1:0)-(keys.left?1:0);
    paddle.x+=mv*PSPEED*dt;
    paddle.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-PADDLE_W,paddle.x));
  }
  for(const a of actors){
    a.x+=a.vx*dt;
    a.y+=a.vy*dt;
  }
  if(state!=='playing')return;

  const b=ball;
  if(b.y-b.r<0){b.y=b.r;b.vy=Math.abs(b.vy);}
  if(b.y+b.r>H){b.y=H-b.r;b.vy=-Math.abs(b.vy);}
  if(b.x-b.r<0){b.x=b.r;b.vx=Math.abs(b.vx);}
  if(b.x+b.r>W){b.x=W-b.r;b.vx=-Math.abs(b.vx);}

  const px=paddle.x,py=paddle.y,pw=PADDLE_W,ph=PADDLE_H;
  if(b.vy>0&&b.y+b.r>=py&&b.y-b.r<=py+ph&&b.x>=px-b.r&&b.x<=px+pw+b.r){
    b.y=py-b.r;
    const rel=(b.x-(px+pw/2))/(pw/2);
    const ang=rel*(Math.PI/3);
    const sp=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);
    b.vx=sp*Math.sin(ang);
    b.vy=-sp*Math.cos(ang);
  }

  for(const k of bricks){
    if(!k.alive)continue;
    const cx=Math.max(k.x,Math.min(b.x,k.x+BW));
    const cy=Math.max(k.y,Math.min(b.y,k.y+BH));
    const dx=b.x-cx,dy=b.y-cy;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=b.r*b.r){
      k.alive=false;
      score++;
      const ox=Math.abs(b.x-(k.x+BW/2));
      const oy=Math.abs(b.y-(k.y+BH/2));
      if(ox>oy){b.vx=b.vx<0?-Math.abs(b.vx):Math.abs(b.vx);}
      else{b.vy=b.vy<0?-Math.abs(b.vy):Math.abs(b.vy);}
      if(!bricks.some(x=>x.alive))win();
    }
  }
}

function drawBricks(){
  for(const k of bricks){
    if(!k.alive)continue;
    ctx.fillStyle=k.color;
    ctx.fillRect(k.x,k.y,BW,BH);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(k.x,k.y,BW,5);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
    ctx.strokeRect(k.x+.5,k.y+.5,BW-1,BH-1);
  }
}

function drawPaddle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#cfd6ff';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x,paddle.y,PADDLE_W,PADDLE_H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#7f8cff';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x,paddle.y,PADDLE_W,4);
}

function drawBall(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,140,255,.5)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x-3,ball.y-3,ball.r*0.4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function draw(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0f2e');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#04061a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,150,255,.05)';
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    ctx.fillRect(0,(i*60+((time*20)%60))%H,W,2);
  }
  drawBricks();
  drawPaddle();
  drawBall();
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4ff';
  ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,16,34);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.font='bold 18px monospace';
  if(state==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.fillText('THUNDER BALL 1986',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4ff';
    ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to launch the ball',W/2,H/2+20);
  }
  if(state==='win'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#5aff9c';
    ctx.font='bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('YOU CLEARED THE FIELD!',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4ff';
    ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again',W/2,H/2+24);
  }
  if(state==='lose'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a5a';
    ctx.font='bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('THE BALL IS LOST',W/2,H/2-10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4ff';
    ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to try again',W/2,H/2+24);
  }
}

let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05);
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();

  if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d')keys.right=true;
  if(k===' '||k==='enter'){
    if(state==='start'){
      state='playing';
      ball.vx=START.vx;ball.vy=START.vy;
    }else if(state==='win'||state==='lose'){
      buildLevel();
      state='start';
    }
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; background: #0d1117; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; }
  canvas { display: block; background: #0d1117; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="640" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const actors = [];
const paddle = { x: W/2, y: H-40, w: 90, h: 16, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
const ball   = { x: W/2, y: H-80, w: 14, h: 14, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
let bricks = [];
let state = 'start';
let score = 0;
let ballSpeed = 5;

const brickColors = ['#e94560','#f5a623','#4ecdc4','#a06cd5','#3ec1d3'];

function buildBricks() {
  bricks = [];
  const rows = 5, cols = 10;
  const bw = 54, bh = 22, gap = 6;
  const totalW = cols * (bw + gap) - gap;
  const startX = (W - totalW) / 2;
  const startY = 60;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      bricks.push({
        x: startX + c * (bw + gap),
        y: startY + r * (bh + gap),
        w: bw, h: bh,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        color: brickColors[r % brickColors.length],
        alive: true
      });
    }
  }
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.h/2;
  ball.vx = 0;
  ball.vy = 0;
}

function launchBall() {
  const angle = -Math.PI/2 + (Math.random()*0.6 - 0.3);
  ball.vx = ballSpeed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.vy = ballSpeed * Math.sin(angle);
}

function resetGame() {
  score = 0;
  ballSpeed = 5;
  paddle.x = W/2;
  paddle.vx = 0;
  buildBricks();
  resetBall();
  state = 'playing';
}

function startGame() {
  resetGame();
}

function win() {
  state = 'win';
}

function lose() {
  state = 'lose';
}

function checkBrickCollision(b, brick) {
  if (!brick.alive) return false;
  const bx = b.x, by = b.y, bw = b.w, bh = b.h;
  const rx = brick.x, ry = brick.y, rw = brick.w, rh = brick.h;
  if (bx + bw < rx || bx > rx + rw || by + bh < ry || by > ry + rh) return false;
  const overlapX = Math.min(bx + bw, rx + rw) - Math.max(bx, rx);
  const overlapY = Math.min(by + bh, ry + rh) - Math.max(by, ry);
  if (overlapX < overlapY) {
    if (bx < rx) { b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx); }
    else { b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx); }
  } else {
    if (by < ry) { b.vy = -Math.abs(b.vy); }
    else { b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy); }
  }
  brick.alive = false;
  score += 10;
  return true;
}

function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  // paddle movement
  if (keys.left) paddle.vx = -8;
  else if (keys.right) paddle.vx = 8;
  else paddle.vx = 0;
  paddle.x += paddle.vx;
  paddle.x = Math.max(paddle.w/2, Math.min(W - paddle.w/2, paddle.x));

  if (ball.vx === 0 && ball.vy === 0) {
    ball.x = paddle.x;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.h/2;
    return;
  }

  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;

  // walls
  if (ball.x <= 0) { ball.x = 0; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + ball.w >= W) { ball.x = W - ball.w; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y <= 0) { ball.y = 0; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // floor -> lose
  if (ball.y + ball.h >= H) { lose(); return; }

  // paddle bounce
  const px = paddle.x - paddle.w/2, py = paddle.y;
  if (ball.y + ball.h >= py && ball.y <= py + paddle.h &&
      ball.x + ball.w >= px && ball.x <= px + paddle.w) {
    const hit = (ball.x + ball.w/2) - paddle.x;
    const angle = (hit / (paddle.w/2)) * (Math.PI/3);
    ball.vx = ballSpeed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -Math.abs(ballSpeed * Math.cos(angle));
    ball.y = py - ball.h;
  }

  // bricks
  for (const brick of bricks) {
    if (brick.alive) checkBrickCollision(ball, brick);
  }

  // win check
  if (!bricks.some(b => b.alive)) win();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1117';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // subtle grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke(); }

  // bricks
  for (const brick of bricks) {
    if (!brick.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = brick.color;
    ctx.fillRect(brick.x, brick.y, brick.w, brick.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(brick.x, brick.y, brick.w, 4);
  }

  // paddle
  const px = paddle.x - paddle.w/2;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.fillRect(px, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  ctx.fillRect(px, paddle.y, paddle.w, 4);

  // ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f5a623';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x + ball.w/2, ball.y + ball.h/2, ball.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 16, 30);

  const alive = bricks.filter(b => b.alive).length;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.fillText('BRICKS: ' + alive, W - 140, 30);

  if (state === 'start') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5a623';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('BRICK BREAKER', W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('← → or A D to move  |  SPACE to launch', W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to start', W/2, H/2 + 50);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5a623';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }

  if (state === 'lose') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e94560';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f5a623';
    ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to try again', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

const keys = { left: false, right: false };

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = true;
  if (e.key === ' ') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') startGame();
    else if (state === 'playing' && ball.vx === 0 && ball.vy === 0) launchBall();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = false;
});

// mouse control
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  paddle.x = Math.max(paddle.w/2, Math.min(W - paddle.w/2, e.clientX - rect.left));
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') startGame();
  else if (state === 'playing' && ball.vx === 0 && ball.vy === 0) launchBall();
});

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

buildBricks();
resetBall();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<canvas id="game" width="512" height="352"></canvas>
<script>
// ---------- Canvas & constants ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const TILE = 16;
const GRAV = 0.35;
const MAX_FALL = 7;
const AIR_ACC = 0.18;
const GROUND_ACC = 0.28;
const FRICTION = 0.85;
const MAX_RUN = 2.6;
const JUMP_V = -6.8;
const MAX_WALK = 1.6;
const CLIMB_SPEED = 0.9;

// ---------- State ----------
let actors = [];
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let gameState = 'start';
let exitReached = false;
let invuln = 0;
let frame = 0;

// ---------- Level (procedural, no tile map) ----------
// ground = {x,y,w,h}
// platforms = [{x,y,w}]
// ladders = [{x, yTop, yBottom}]
// coins = [{x,y}]
// enemies = [{x,y}]
// exit = {x,y}
const ground = { x:0, y:336, w:512, h:16 };
const platforms = [
  {x:160, y:256, w:64},
  {x:320, y:208, w:64},
  {x:448, y:160, w:48}
];
const ladders = [
  {x:200, yTop:256, yBottom:336},
  {x:360, yTop:208, yBottom:336}
];
const coins = [
  {x:192, y:232},
  {x:352, y:184},
  {x:472, y:136}
];
const enemyStarts = [
  {x:240, y:320},
  {x:400, y:320}
];
const exit = {x:480, y:96};

// ---------- Input ----------
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (gameState === 'start' && (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space')) {
    startGame();
  }
  if (gameState === 'over' && e.code === 'Enter') {
    resetGame();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// ---------- Helpers ----------
function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
  return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}
function pointInRect(px, py, r) {
  return px >= r.x && px <= r.x + r.w && py >= r.y && py <= r.y + r.h;
}

// ---------- Game init ----------
function resetGame() {
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  exitReached = false;
  invuln = 0;
  gameState = 'play';
  actors = [];
  // Mario
  actors.push({
    type: 'mario',
    x: 32, y: 304, w: 14, h: 32,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false,
    onLadder: false,
    facing: 1
  });
  // Enemies
  enemyStarts.forEach(e => {
    actors.push({
      type: 'goomba',
      x: e.x, y: e.y, w: 16, h: 16,
      vx: -0.4, vy: 0,
      onGround: false,
      dead: false,
      squash: 0
    });
  });
  // Coins
  coins.forEach(c => {
    actors.push({
      type: 'coin',
      x: c.x, y: c.y, w: 12, h: 12,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      onGround: false,
      collected: false,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  });
}

function startGame() {
  if (gameState === 'start') {
    resetGame();
  }
}

// ---------- Update ----------
function update() {
  frame++;
  if (gameState !== 'play') return;

  if (invuln > 0) invuln--;

  const mario = actors.find(a => a.type === 'mario');
  if (!mario) return;

  // --- Mario input ---
  const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
  const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
  const up = keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];
  const down = keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS'];
  const jump = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];

  // Determine if mario is on a ladder (centered within ladder x range)
  let onLadder = false;
  for (const lad of ladders) {
    const cx = mario.x + mario.w/2;
    if (cx >= lad.x - 4 && cx <= lad.x + 20 &&
        mario.y + mario.h >= lad.yTop && mario.y <= lad.yBottom) {
      onLadder = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  mario.onLadder = onLadder;

  // Horizontal movement
  if (onLadder) {
    mario.vx = 0;
    // Climb
    if (up) {
      mario.vy = -CLIMB_SPEED;
      mario.y += mario.vy;
      if (mario.y < lad.yTop) mario.y = lad.yTop;
      if (mario.y <= lad.yTop) onLadder = false;
    } else if (down) {
      mario.vy = CLIMB_SPEED;
      mario.y += mario.vy;
      if (mario.y + mario.h > lad.yBottom) mario.y = lad.yBottom - mario.h;
    } else {
      mario.vy = 0;
    }
  } else {
    if (left) { mario.vx -= (mario.onGround ? GROUND_ACC : AIR_ACC); mario.facing = -1; }
    if (right) { mario.vx += (mario.onGround ? GROUND_ACC : AIR_ACC); mario.facing = 1; }
    if (!left && !right) mario.vx *= FRICTION;
    const maxSpd = (keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight']) ? MAX_RUN : MAX_WALK;
    if (mario.vx > maxSpd) mario.vx = maxSpd;
    if (mario.vx < -maxSpd) mario.vx = -maxSpd;

    // Jump
    if (jump && mario.onGround) {
      mario.vy = JUMP_V;
      mario.onGround = false;
    }
    // Gravity
    mario.vy += GRAV;
    if (mario.vy > MAX_FALL) mario.vy = MAX_FALL;
  }

  // Apply velocity
  mario.x += mario.vx;
  if (!onLadder) mario.y += mario.vy;

  // Clamp to screen
  if (mario.x < 0) { mario.x = 0; mario.vx = 0; }
  if (mario.x + mario.w > W) { mario.x = W - mario.w; mario.vx = 0; }

  // --- Collision: ground ---
  mario.onGround = false;
  if (mario.y + mario.h >= ground.y && mario.vy >= 0) {
    mario.y = ground.y - mario.h;
    mario.vy = 0;
    mario.onGround = true;
  }

  // --- Collision: platforms (one-way, land on top only) ---
  for (const p of platforms) {
    const pr = { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.w, h: 8 };
    if (mario.vy >= 0 &&
        mario.x + mario.w > p.x && mario.x < p.x + p.w &&
        mario.y + mario.h >= p.y && mario.y + mario.h <= p.y + 12) {
      mario.y = p.y - mario.h;
      mario.vy = 0;
      mario.onGround = true;
    }
  }

  // --- Enemies update ---
  for (const e of actors) {
    if (e.type !== 'goomba') continue;
    if (e.dead) {
      e.squash++;
      continue;
    }
    // Gravity
    e.vy += GRAV;
    if (e.vy > MAX_FALL) e.vy = MAX_FALL;
    e.x += e.vx;
    e.y += e.vy;

    // Ground
    if (e.y + e.h >= ground.y && e.vy >= 0) {
      e.y = ground.y - e.h;
      e.vy = 0;
      e.onGround = true;
    } else {
      e.onGround = false;
    }

    // Wall / edge turn
    if (e.x < 0 || e.x + e.w > W) {
      e.vx *= -1;
      e.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - e.w, e.x));
    }
    // Edge detection: if on ground and next step would be off a platform, turn
    if (e.onGround) {
      const cx = e.x + e.w/2;
      const nextX = cx + e.vx * 2;
      let supported = nextX >= ground.x && nextX <= ground.x + ground.w;
      for (const p of platforms) {
        if (nextX >= p.x && nextX <= p.x + p.w && Math.abs(e.y + e.h - p.y) < 4) {
          supported = true;
        }
      }
      if (!supported) e.vx *= -1;
    }

    // Stomp check vs Mario
    if (rectsOverlap(mario, e) && !e.dead) {
      if (mario.vy > 0 && (mario.y + mario.h) - e.y < 12) {
        // Stomp
        e.dead = true;
        e.squash = 0;
        mario.vy = JUMP_V * 0.6;
        score += 100;
      } else if (invuln <= 0) {
        // Hit
        lives--;
        invuln = 90;
        if (lives <= 0) {
          gameState = 'over';
        } else {
          // Knockback
          mario.vx = (mario.x < e.x ? -3 : 3);
          mario.vy = -3;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Remove dead goombas after squash animation
  actors = actors.filter(a => !(a.type === 'goomba' && a.dead && a.squash > 30));

  // --- Coins ---
  for (const c of actors) {
    if (c.type !== 'coin') continue;
    if (c.collected) continue;
    c.phase += 0.1;
    if (rectsOverlap(mario, c)) {
      c.collected = true;
      score += 50;
    }
  }
  actors = actors.filter(a => !(a.type === 'coin' && a.collected));

  // --- Exit ---
  const exitRect = { x: exit.x - 12, y: exit.y, w: 24, h: 32 };
  if (rectsOverlap(mario, exitRect)) {
    exitReached = true;
    gameState = 'win';
  }
}

// ---------- Draw ----------
function drawBackground() {
  // Sky gradient
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#5c94fc');
  grad.addColorStop(0.6, '#7cb8ff');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#a8d4ff');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Clouds
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  const cloudY = 40;
  const cloudX = (frame * 0.2) % (W + 80) - 40;
  drawCloud(cloudX, cloudY);
  drawCloud(cloudX + 200, cloudY + 30);
  drawCloud(cloudX + 400, cloudY - 10);

  // Hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4caf50';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, ground.y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(80, ground.y - 60, 160, ground.y);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(200, ground.y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(300, ground.y - 40, 400, ground.y);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#66bb6a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(350, ground.y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(430, ground.y - 50, 512, ground.y);
  ctx.fill();

  // Bushes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2e7d32';
  drawBush(100, ground.y - 8);
  drawBush(280, ground.y - 8);
  drawBush(460, ground.y - 8);
}

function drawCloud(x, y) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 14, y - 4, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 28, y, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBush(x, y) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 10, y - 3, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(x + 20, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGround() {
  // Brown ground
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(ground.x, ground.y, ground.w, ground.h);
  // Top edge highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = '#D2691E';
  ctx.fillRect(ground.x, ground.y, ground.w, 3);
  // Brick pattern
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#6B3410';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < ground.w; i += TILE) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(i, ground.y);
    ctx.lineTo(i, ground.y + ground.h);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPlatforms() {
  for (const p of platforms) {
    // Platform body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#B8860B';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 8);
    // Top highlight
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, 3);
    // Bottom shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B6914';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y + 5, p.w, 3);
    // Side caps
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B6914';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - 2, p.y, 2, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x + p.w, p.y, 2, 8);
  }
}

function drawLadders() {
  for (const lad of ladders) {
    const h = lad.yBottom - lad.yTop;
    // Rails
    ctx.fillStyle = '#CD853F';
    ctx.fillRect(lad.x, lad.yTop, 3, h);
    ctx.fillRect(lad.x + 16, lad.yTop, 3, h);
    // Rungs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#DEB887';
    for (let y = lad.yTop + 4; y < lad.yBottom; y += 8) {
      ctx.fillRect(lad.x + 3, y, 13, 2);
    }
  }
}

function drawCoins() {
  for (const c of actors) {
    if (c.type !== 'coin') continue;
    if (c.collected) continue;
    const bob = Math.sin(c.phase) * 2;
    const cx = c.x + c.w/2;
    const cy = c.y + c.h/2 + bob;
    // Glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Coin
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA500';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 8px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('$', cx, cy);
  }
}

function drawGoombas() {
  for (const e of actors) {
    if (e.type !== 'goomba') continue;
    if (e.dead) {
      // Squashed
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x, e.y + e.h - 4, e.w, 4);
      continue;
    }
    const cx = e.x + e.w/2;
    const cy = e.y + e.h/2;
    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + 2, 8, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#A0522D';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy - 2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 3, cy - 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 3, cy - 3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 3, cy - 3, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cx + 3, cy - 3, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Feet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6B3410';
    const step = Math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 2;
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + 1, e.y + e.h - 3, 5, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(e.x + e.w - 6, e.y + e.h - 3 + step, 5, 3);
  }
}

function drawMario() {
  const m = actors.find(a => a.type === 'mario');
  if (!m) return;
  const cx = m.x + m.w/2;
  const cy = m.y + m.h/2;
  const facing = m.facing;

  // Blink during invulnerability
  if (invuln > 0 && Math.floor(invuln / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

  // Legs
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  const legOffset = Math.abs(m.vx) > 0.1 ? Math.sin(frame * 0.4) * 3 : 0;
  ctx.fillRect(m.x + 1, m.y + m.h - 8, 5, 8 + legOffset);
  ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w - 6, m.y + m.h - 8, 5, 8 - legOffset);

  // Body (overalls)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2255cc';
  ctx.fillRect(m.x, m.y + 14, m.w, 12);

  // Shirt
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  ctx.fillRect(m.x, m.y + 10, m.w, 6);

  // Arms
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  const armSwing = Math.abs(m.vx) > 0.1 ? Math.sin(frame * 0.4) * 4 : 0;
  ctx.fillRect(m.x - 2, m.y + 12 + armSwing, 4, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w - 2, m.y + 12 - armSwing, 4, 8);

  // Hands
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
  ctx.fillRect(m.x - 2, m.y + 18 + armSwing, 4, 3);
  ctx.fillRect(m.x + m.w - 2, m.y + 18 - armSwing, 4, 3);

  // Head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc99';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, m.y + 6, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Cap
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cc2222';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, m.y + 3, 7, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 7, m.y + 2, 14, 3);
  // Cap brim
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aa1111';
  if (facing > 0) {
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 2, m.y + 3, 8, 3);
  } else {
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 10, m.y + 3, 8, 3);
  }

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  if (facing > 0) {
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 1, m.y + 5, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 4, m.y + 5, 2, 2);
  } else {
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 3, m.y + 5, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 6, m.y + 5, 2, 2);
  }

  // Mustache
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  if (facing > 0) {
    ctx.fillRect(cx, m.y + 8, 6, 2);
  } else {
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 6, m.y + 8, 6, 2);
  }

  // Nose
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa77';
  if (facing > 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + 5, m.y + 7, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - 5, m.y + 7, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawExit() {
  const ex = exit.x, ey = exit.y;
  // Door frame
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
  ctx.fillRect(ex - 14, ey, 28, 36);
  // Door
  ctx.fillStyle = '#228B22';
  ctx.fillRect(ex - 10, ey + 2, 20, 32);
  // Door panels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a6b1a';
  ctx.fillRect(ex - 7, ey + 5, 7, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(ex + 1, ey + 5, 7, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(ex - 7, ey + 20, 7, 12);
  ctx.fillRect(ex + 1, ey + 20, 7, 12);
  // Knob
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ex + 6, ey + 18, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // "EXIT" sign
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 7px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('EXIT', ex, ey - 4);
  // Star above
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  drawStar(ex, ey - 12, 5);
}

function drawStar(cx, cy, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const angle = (i * 4 * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // Score
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, 8, 6);

  // Lives
  ctx.fillText('LIVES: ' + lives, 8, 22);

  // Level
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('1-1', W - 8, 6);

  // Title
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('THE LOST LEVELS', W/2, 6);
}

function drawStartScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER MARIO BROS.', W/2, H/2 - 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('THE LOST LEVELS', W/2, H/2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('1-1', W/2, H/2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('← → / A D  Move', W/2, H/2 + 30);
  ctx.fillText('↑ / W / Space  Jump', W/2, H/2 + 45);
  ctx.fillText('↑↓ / WS  Climb Ladder', W/2, H/2 + 60);
  ctx.fillText('Shift  Run', W/2, H/2 + 75);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO START', W/2, H/2 + 105);
}

function drawWinScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('COURSE CLEAR!', W/2, H/2 - 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, H/2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.font = '12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('1-1 COMPLETE', W/2, H/2 + 25);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO PLAY AGAIN', W/2, H/2 + 55);
}

function drawOverScreen() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '14px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RETRY', W/2, H/2 + 40);
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();
  drawGround();
  drawPlatforms();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Starglider 2</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0b0f1e;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace}
  canvas{background:#0b0f1e;box-shadow:0 0 40px #000;border:2px solid #223}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="900" height="560"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cvs.getContext('2d');
const W=cvs.width,H=cvs.height;
const GROUND=H-90;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state='title';
let score=0,lives=3,invuln=0;
let plane={x:140,y:GROUND-120,vx:0,vy:0};
let planeBullets=[],enemyBullets=[],targets=[],particles=[];
let groundX=0;
let spawnT=0,shootT=0;
let keys={};

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(state==='title'&&(e.code==='Space'||e.code==='Enter'))start();
  if(state==='over'&&(e.code==='Space'||e.code==='Enter'))start();
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});

function start(){
  score=0;lives=3;
  plane={x:140,y:GROUND-120,vx:0,vy:0};
  planeBullets=[];enemyBullets=[];targets=[];particles=[];
  spawnT=0;shootT=0;invuln=0;
  state='play';
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  if(state!=='play')return;
  groundX=(groundX-3.2*dt)%40;

  // plane movement
  const ax=0, ay=0;
  if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['KeyA'])plane.x-=260*dt;
  if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD'])plane.x+=260*dt;
  if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW'])plane.y-=220*dt;
  if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['KeyS'])plane.y+=220*dt;
  plane.x=Math.max(30,Math.min(W-30,plane.x));
  plane.y=Math.max(40,Math.min(GROUND-30,plane.y));

  // shooting
  shootT-=dt;
  if((keys['Space']||keys['KeyJ'])&&shootT<=0){
    planeBullets.push({x:plane.x+18,y:plane.y,vx:520,vy:0});
    shootT=0.18;
  }

  // spawn targets
  spawnT-=dt;
  if(spawnT<=0){
    const ty=60+Math.random()*(GROUND-140);
    targets.push({x:W+30,y:ty,vx:-(70+Math.random()*90),vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*40});
    spawnT=1.1+Math.random()*0.9;
  }

  moveArr(planeBullets,dt);
  moveArr(enemyBullets,dt);
  moveArr(targets,dt);
  moveArr(particles,dt);

  // target return fire
  for(const t of targets){
    if(t.x<plane.x&&Math.random()<0.02){
      const dx=plane.x-t.x,dy=plane.y-t.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      enemyBullets.push({x:t.x,y:t.y,vx:dx/d*220,vy:dy/d*220});
    }
  }

  // collisions: plane bullets vs targets
  for(let i=planeBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=planeBullets[i];
    for(let j=targets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const t=targets[j];
      if(Math.hypot(b.x-t.x,b.y-t.y)<22){
        explode(t.x,t.y);
        targets.splice(j,1);
        planeBullets.splice(i,1);
        score+=100;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets vs plane
  if(invuln>0)invuln-=dt;
  for(let i=enemyBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=enemyBullets[i];
    if(Math.hypot(b.x-plane.x,b.y-plane.y)<20&&invuln<=0){
      enemyBullets.splice(i,1);
      explode(plane.x,plane.y);
      lives--;
      invuln=1.6;
      if(lives<=0){state='over';}
    }
  }

  // cull
  cull(planeBullets);cull(enemyBullets);cull(targets);
}

function moveArr(a,dt){for(const o of a){o.x+=o.vx*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt;}}
function cull(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>=0;i--){const o=a[i];if(o.x<-40||o.x>W+40||o.y<-40||o.y>H+40)a.splice(i,1);}}

function explode(x,y){
  for(let k=0;k<14;k++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,s=60+Math.random()*160;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:0.6});
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  // sky
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#16213f');
  g.addColorStop(0.6,'#243a63');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#3a2f55');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const sx=(i*97+ (groundX*0.2))%W;
    const sy=(i*53)%GROUND;
    ctx.fillRect((sx+W)%W,sy,2,2);
  }

  // ground
  ctx.fillStyle='#243a2e';ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND);
  ctx.fillStyle='#31513f';
  for(let x=groundX-40;x<W;x+=40)ctx.fillRect(x,GROUND,20,10);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1a2e24';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let x=groundX-40;x<W;x+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,GROUND);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke();}

  if(state==='play'||state==='over'){
    drawTargets();
    drawBullets();
    drawPlane();
  }
  drawParticles();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f0ff';ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,14,24);
  ctx.fillText('LIVES '+lives,14,44);

  if(state==='title')overlay('STARGLIDER 2','Press SPACE to fly');
  if(state==='over')overlay('GAME OVER','Score '+score+' — Press SPACE to retry');
}

function drawPlane(){
  if(invuln>0&&Math.floor(invuln*12)%2===0)return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(plane.x,plane.y);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#cfd6e6';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-18,0);ctx.lineTo(20,-6);ctx.lineTo(20,6);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fa0c4';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-2,-2);ctx.lineTo(-14,-16);ctx.lineTo(2,-4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-2,2);ctx.lineTo(-14,16);ctx.lineTo(2,4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // tail
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fa0c4';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-18,-2);ctx.lineTo(-26,-10);ctx.lineTo(-14,-2);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a6ea5';ctx.fillRect(6,-4,8,8);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawTargets(){
  for(const t of targets){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(t.x,t.y);
    ctx.fillStyle='#d94b3a';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-14,0);ctx.lineTo(14,-6);ctx.lineTo(14,6);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f2c14e';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,4,0,7);ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawBullets(){
  for(const b of planeBullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066';ctx.fillRect(b.x-6,b.y-2,12,4);
  }
  for(const b of enemyBullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff6b6b';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,4,0,7);ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    const a=Math.max(0,p.life/0.6);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,'+Math.floor(120+135*a)+',80,'+a+')';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
    p.life-=1/60;
  }
}

function overlay(t1,t2){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066';ctx.font='bold 44px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(t1,W/2,H/2-10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f0ff';ctx.font='18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(t2,W/2,H/2+30);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000);
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

          if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (e.r+a.r)*(e.r+a.r)){
            e.hp -= 1; e.flash = 0.12;
            actors.splice(i,1);
            if(e.hp <= 0){ actors.splice(j,1); state.score += 10; }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } else if(a.kind==='ebullet'){
      const dx=plane.x-a.x, dy=plane.y-a.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (plane.r+a.r)*(plane.r+a.r)){
        state.mode = 'over'; state.shake = 1; state.msg = 'PLANE DOWN'; state.msgTime = 99;
        actors.splice(i,1);
      }
    }
  }

  for(let i=actors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a = actors[i];
    if(a.flash > 0) a.flash -= dt;
  }
}

function drawGround(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#4a6b35'); g.addColorStop(1,'#2f4723');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H-GROUND_Y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#7ba24d'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y); ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#35502a';
  for(let i=0;i<20;i++){ const x=(i*47+10)%W; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, GROUND_Y+18+(i%3)*7, 14, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
}

function drawSky(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GROUND_Y);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#274b7a'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#5b86b5'); g.addColorStop(1,'#c98a5a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,GROUND_Y);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9b0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120, GROUND_Y-30, 34, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
  const t = state.time;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const cx = ((i*160 + t*12) % (W+160)) - 80;
    const cy = 50 + (i%3)*30;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, 34, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx+24, cy+4, 26, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlane(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(plane.x, plane.y);
  ctx.rotate(plane.tilt);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2e6fb0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,22,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1f4f80';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,0); ctx.lineTo(-20,-14); ctx.lineTo(-14,0); ctx.lineTo(-20,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#bfe0ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(10,-3,7,4,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2e6fb0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,0); ctx.lineTo(-24,-6); ctx.lineTo(-20,0); ctx.lineTo(-24,6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(a){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
  ctx.scale(a.vx < 0 ? 1 : -1, 1);
  const body = a.flash > 0 ? '#ffd24a' : '#c0392b';
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,18,9,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7d2418';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,0); ctx.lineTo(-16,-12); ctx.lineTo(-11,0); ctx.lineTo(-16,12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(9,-3,6,3.5,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawActors(){
  for(const a of actors){
    if(a.kind==='enemy') drawEnemy(a);
    else if(a.kind==='bullet'){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2a8';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9d3c';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else if(a.kind==='ebullet'){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a5a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd0d0';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.45, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawHud(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.fillRect(10,10,220,30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + state.score, 22, 25);
}

function drawOverlay(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,10,22,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  if(state.mode === 'start'){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font = 'bold 54px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('FEUD', W/2, H/2 - 46);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e6eefb'; ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Fly the plane. Shoot the red jets. Dodge their fire.', W/2, H/2 + 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb4d8'; ctx.font = '15px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Move: W A S D  /  Space to shoot', W/2, H/2 + 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W/2, H/2 + 74);
  } else if(state.mode === 'over'){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b'; ctx.font = 'bold 50px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PLANE DOWN', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Final score: ' + state.score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe0ff'; ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to fly again', W/2, H/2 + 48);
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake > 0){
    const s = state.shake * 6;
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*s, (Math.random()-0.5)*s);
  }
  drawSky();
  drawGround();
  if(state.mode === 'play') drawPlane();
  drawActors();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHud();
  if(state.mode !== 'play') drawOverlay();
}

function loop(ts){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - (loop._l || ts)) / 1000);
  loop._l = ts;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if(k === ' ' || k === 'arrowup' || k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright') e.preventDefault();
  if(k === 'enter'){
    if(state.mode === 'start'){ reset(); state.mode = 'play'; }
    else if(state.mode === 'over'){ reset(); state.mode = 'play'; }
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
