<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Great Giana Sisters</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#10131c;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace}
  #c{background:#000;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);image-rendering:auto}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="900" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
const GROUND=H-96;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state='start';
let score=0, hi=0, lives=3, time=0;
let shake=0, hitFlash=0;

const plane={x:150,y:200,vx:0,vy:0,tilt:0,fireCd:0};
const playerBullets=[];
const enemies=[];
const enemyBullets=[];
const particles=[];

const keys={};
let mouse={x:0,y:0,down:false};
let scroll=0;

function resetGame(){
  score=0; lives=3; time=0;
  plane.x=150; plane.y=200; plane.vx=0; plane.vy=0; plane.tilt=0; plane.fireCd=0;
  playerBullets.length=0;
  enemies.length=0;
  enemyBullets.length=0;
  particles.length=0;
  scroll=0;
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(state==='start' && (e.code==='Enter'||e.code==='Space')){ resetGame(); state='play'; }
  else if(state==='over' && (e.code==='Enter'||e.code==='Space')){ resetGame(); state='play'; }
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

function toLocal(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {x:(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width), y:(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height)};
}
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{ const p=toLocal(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{ const p=toLocal(e); mouse.x=p.x; mouse.y=p.y; mouse.down=true;
  if(state==='start'||state==='over'){ resetGame(); state='play'; }
});
addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{ mouse.down=false; });

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function fire(){
  if(plane.fireCd>0) return;
  plane.fireCd=0.18;
  const a=Math.atan2(mouse.y-plane.y, mouse.x-plane.x);
  playerBullets.push({x:plane.x+Math.cos(a)*22, y:plane.y+Math.sin(a)*22, vx:Math.cos(a)*620, vy:Math.sin(a)*620, r:3});
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const s=(Math.random()-0.5)*120, sp=120+Math.random()*120;
    particles.push({x:plane.x+Math.cos(a)*22, y:plane.y+Math.sin(a)*22, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp+Math.cos(a+1.57)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp+Math.sin(a+1.57)*s, life:0.15, max:0.15, size:2+Math.random()*2, color:'#ffd24a'});
  }
}

function explode(x,y,color){
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sp=60+Math.random()*260;
    particles.push({x,y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp, life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5, max:1.0, size:2+Math.random()*3, color:Math.random()<0.5?color:'#ff8a3a'});
  }
  shake=Math.min(shake+10,16);
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  const type=Math.random();
  let x,y,vx,vy,r,fireCd,fireRate,color;
  if(type<0.55){ // top diver
    x=W*0.5+Math.random()*W*0.5; y=-30; vx=-120-Math.random()*80; vy=120+Math.random()*80;
    r=15; fireCd=0.8+Math.random(); fireRate=1.1+Math.random()*0.8; color='#e2574c';
  } else if(type<0.85){ // side bomber
    x=W+30; y=60+Math.random()*(GROUND-220); vx=-180-Math.random()*120; vy=0;
    r=17; fireCd=0.6+Math.random(); fireRate=0.9+Math.random()*0.6; color='#c94f6e';
  } else { // low fast
    x=W+30; y=GROUND-70-Math.random()*40; vx=-260-Math.random()*120; vy=0;
    r=13; fireCd=0.5+Math.random(); fireRate=0.7+Math.random()*0.5; color='#f0a53a';
  }
  enemies.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,fireCd,fireRate,rot:Math.random()*6,spin:(Math.random()-0.5)*4});
}

function enemyShoot(e){
  const a=Math.atan2(plane.y-e.y, plane.x-e.x);
  const sp=220+Math.random()*80;
  enemyBullets.push({x:e.x, y:e.y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp, r:3});
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  time+=dt;
  scroll+=dt*120;
  if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*40);
  if(hitFlash>0) hitFlash-=dt;

  if(state!=='play') return;

  // plane
  const ax=(keys.ArrowRight||keys.KeyD?1:0)-(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.KeyA?1:0);
  const ay=(keys.ArrowDown||keys.KeyS?1:0)-(keys.ArrowUp||keys.KeyW?1:0);
  plane.vx+=ax*1400*dt;
  plane.vy+=ay*1400*dt;
  plane.vx*=0.92; plane.vy*=0.92;
  plane.x+=plane.vx*dt;
  plane.y+=plane.vy*dt;
  plane.x=Math.max(24,Math.min(W-24,plane.x));
  plane.y=Math.max(24,Math.min(GROUND-24,plane.y));
  plane.tilt+=((plane.vy*0.0016)-plane.tilt)*0.2;
  if(plane.fireCd>0) plane.fireCd-=dt;
  if(keys.Space||mouse.down) fire();

  // player bullets
  for(let i=playerBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=playerBullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    if(b.x<-10||b.x>W+10||b.y<-10||b.y>H+10) playerBullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // enemies
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=enemies[i];
    e.x+=e.vx*dt; e.y+=e.vy*dt; e.rot+=e.spin*dt;
    e.fireCd-=dt;
    if(e.fireCd<=0){ enemyShoot(e); e.fireCd=e.fireRate; }
    if(e.x<-40||e.y>H+40||e.y<-60){ enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // collision with player bullets
    for(let j=playerBullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const b=playerBullets[j];
      const dx=b.x-e.x, dy=b.y-e.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy < (e.r+b.r)*(e.r+b.r)){
        score+=10; explode(e.x,e.y,e.color);
        enemies.splice(i,1);
        playerBullets.splice(j,1);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets
  for(let i=enemyBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=enemyBullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    if(b.x<-10||b.x>W+10||b.y<-10||b.y>H+10){ enemyBullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    const dx=b.x-plane.x, dy=b.y-plane.y;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy < 16*16){
      enemyBullets.splice(i,1);
      lives--; hitFlash=0.4; explode(plane.x,plane.y,'#ff4d4d');
      if(lives<=0){ hi=Math.max(hi,score); state='over'; }
      else { plane.x=150; plane.y=200; plane.vx=0; plane.vy=0; }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vx*=0.96; p.vy*=0.96; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // spawn
  const rate=Math.max(0.5, 1.6 - time*0.02);
  if(Math.random() < dt/rate) spawnEnemy();
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawCloud(x,y,s){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,y,18*s,0,7); ctx.arc(x+22*s,y+4*s,14*s,0,7); ctx.arc(x-20*s,y+6*s,13*s,0,7); ctx.arc(x+6*s,y-8*s,13*s,0,7);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlane(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(plane.x,plane.y);
  ctx.rotate(plane.tilt);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,10,20,6,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // tail
  ctx.fillStyle='#3b6ea5';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18,0); ctx.lineTo(-30,-14); ctx.lineTo(-24,0); ctx.lineTo(-30,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // fuselage
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f8f5b';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24,0); ctx.lineTo(-18,-9); ctx.lineTo(-18,9); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // wing
  ctx.fillStyle='#256b45';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(6,-2); ctx.lineTo(-12,-22); ctx.lineTo(-6,-2); ctx.lineTo(-12,22); ctx.lineTo(6,2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#bfe3ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(8,0,7,4,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  // prop
  ctx.strokeStyle='#f4d77a'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24,-9); ctx.lineTo(24,9); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x,e.y); ctx.rotate(e.rot);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,e.r*0.5,e.r,e.r*0.35,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=e.color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.r,0); ctx.lineTo(-e.r,-e.r*0.7); ctx.lineTo(-e.r*0.5,0); ctx.lineTo(-e.r,e.r*0.7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a2a35'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.2,0,e.r*0.3,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.r*0.28,-e.r*0.08,e.r*0.1,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake);

  // sky
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,GROUND);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#2b6fb0'); g.addColorStop(0.6,'#5aa0d6'); g.addColorStop(1,'#bcdff0');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,GROUND+20);

  // sun
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff2c2'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120,90,42,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,242,194,0.35)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120,90,62,0,7); ctx.fill();

  // clouds (parallax)
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const cx=((i*260 - scroll*0.3)%(W+300))-150;
    drawCloud(cx, 60+ (i%3)*50, 0.8+(i%2)*0.3);
  }

  // ground
  const gg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,GROUND,0,H);
  gg.addColorStop(0,'#5fae52'); gg.addColorStop(1,'#3f7d3a');
  ctx.fillStyle=gg; ctx.fillRect(-20,GROUND,W+40,H-GROUND+20);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f5c2c'; ctx.fillRect(-20,GROUND,W+40,6);
  // grass tufts
  ctx.strokeStyle='#2f5c2c'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let x=0;x<W+20;x+=26){
    const gx=((x - scroll)% (W+20));
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx,GROUND+10); ctx.lineTo(gx-3,GROUND+2); ctx.moveTo(gx,GROUND+10); ctx.lineTo(gx+3,GROUND+2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // bullets
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff2b0';
  for(const b of playerBullets){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,7); ctx.fill(); }
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a4a';
  for(const b of enemyBullets){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,7); ctx.fill(); }

  // enemies
  for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);

  // plane
  drawPlane();

  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,7); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  ctx.restore();

  // hit flash
  if(hitFlash>0){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,60,'+(hitFlash*0.5)+')'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.font='bold 18px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,14,18);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('BEST '+hi,W-14,18);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('♥'.repeat(Math.max(0,lives)),W/2,18);

  if(state==='start'){
    overlay('GREAT GIANA SISTERS','Fly over the ground. Shoot the planes. Dodge the return fire.',
      'MOVE  W A S D / ARROWS','SHOOT  hold SPACE or MOUSE','START  ENTER / SPACE / CLICK');
  } else if(state==='over'){
    overlay('GAME OVER','Final score: '+score,
      'BEST  '+hi,'','PLAY AGAIN  ENTER / SPACE / CLICK');
  }
}

function overlay(t,s, l1,l2,l3){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,12,20,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a'; ctx.font='bold 46px monospace'; ctx.fillText(t,W/2,H*0.32);
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf3ff'; ctx.font='18px monospace'; ctx.fillText(s,W/2,H*0.44);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fd0ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(l1,W/2,H*0.56);
  if(l2) ctx.fillText(l2,W/2,H*0.62);
  if(l3){ ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillText(l3,W/2,H*0.72); }
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Robot Tank</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#08090f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#0f1116;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;border:2px solid #223;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="600" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// ---- state ----
const state = { mode:'start', score:0, lives:3, msg:'Press ENTER to start', timer:0, shake:0 };
const player = { x:300, y:520, vx:0, vy:0, angle:0, cd:0 };
const enemies = [];
const bullets = [];
const particles = [];
const keys = {};
const TANK = 26, BULLET = 5;
const wallColor = '#4a5a7a';

// ---- level (built with a short loop) ----
const walls = [
  {x:150,y:150,w:140,h:20}, {x:310,y:150,w:140,h:20},
  {x:150,y:430,w:140,h:20}, {x:310,y:430,w:140,h:20},
  {x:290,y:280,w:20,h:120},
  {x:120,y:290,w:20,h:120}, {x:460,y:290,w:20,h:120}
];

// ---- helpers ----
function circleRect(cx,cy,r,rc){
  const nx=Math.max(rc.x,Math.min(cx,rc.x+rc.w));
  const ny=Math.max(rc.y,Math.min(cy,rc.y+rc.h));
  return (cx-nx)*(cx-nx)+(cy-ny)*(cy-ny) < r*r;
}
function spawnEnemy(){
  const spots=[[150,150],[450,150],[150,450],[450,450]];
  const s=spots[(Math.random()*spots.length)|0];
  enemies.push({x:s[0],y:s[1],vx:0,vy:0,angle:0,cd:0.5,fire:2+Math.random()*3});
}
function spawnBurst(x,y,dir,spd){
  bullets.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(dir)*spd,vy:Math.sin(dir)*spd,from:'enemy',life:2.2});
}
function spawnPlayerShot(){
  const d=player.angle;
  bullets.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(d)*20,y:player.y+Math.sin(d)*20,vx:Math.cos(d)*260,vy:Math.sin(d)*260,from:'player',life:2});
}
function explode(x,y){
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.28, s=40+Math.random()*120;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.4});
  }
  state.shake=8;
}

// ---- input ----
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); }
  if(e.key==='Enter' && state.mode==='start'){
    state.mode='play'; state.score=0; state.lives=3;
    enemies.length=0; bullets.length=0; particles.length=0;
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++) spawnEnemy();
  }
  if(e.key==='Enter' && (state.mode==='win'||state.mode==='lose')){
    state.mode='start'; state.msg='Press ENTER to start';
  }
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; });

// ---- update ----
function update(dt){
  if(state.mode!=='play') return;

  // player drive
  const spd=150;
  let dx=(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']?1:0)-(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']?1:0);
  let dy=(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']?1:0)-(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']?1:0);
  if(dx||dy){
    const l=Math.hypot(dx,dy); dx/=l; dy/=l;
    player.vx=dx*spd; player.vy=dy*spd;
    player.angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  } else { player.vx*=0.6; player.vy*=0.6; }

  const nx=player.x+player.vx*dt, ny=player.y+player.vy*dt;
  if(!circleRect(nx,player.y,TANK/2,{x:0,y:0,w:W,h:0}) && !circleRect(nx,player.y,TANK/2,{x:0,y:H,w:W,h:0})
     && !walls.some(w=>circleRect(nx,player.y,TANK/2,w))) player.x=nx;
  if(!circleRect(player.x,ny,TANK/2,{x:0,y:0,w:0,h:H}) && !circleRect(player.x,ny,TANK/2,{x:W,y:0,w:0,h:H})
     && !walls.some(w=>circleRect(player.x,ny,TANK/2,w))) player.y=ny;

  if(keys[' '] && player.cd<=0){ spawnPlayerShot(); player.cd=0.28; }
  player.cd-=dt;

  // enemies
  for(const e of enemies){
    const d=player.x-e.x, dy2=player.y-e.y, dist=Math.hypot(d,dy2);
    const a=Math.atan2(dy2,d);
    e.angle=a;
    e.vx=Math.cos(a)*60; e.vy=Math.sin(a)*60;
    const ex=e.x+e.vx*dt, ey=e.y+e.vy*dt;
    if(!circleRect(ex,e.y,TANK/2,{x:0,y:0,w:W,h:0}) && !circleRect(ex,e.y,TANK/2,{x:0,y:H,w:W,h:0})
       && !walls.some(w=>circleRect(ex,e.y,TANK/2,w))) e.x=ex;
    if(!circleRect(e.x,ey,TANK/2,{x:0,y:0,w:0,h:H}) && !circleRect(e.x,ey,TANK/2,{x:W,y:0,w:0,h:H})
       && !walls.some(w=>circleRect(e.x,ey,TANK/2,w))) e.y=ey;
    e.fire-=dt;
    if(e.fire<=0 && dist<260){ spawnBurst(e.x+Math.cos(a)*20,e.y+Math.sin(a)*20,a,150); e.fire=1.6+Math.random()*2; }
  }

  // bullets
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt; b.life-=dt;
    let dead=b.life<=0 || b.x<0||b.x>W||b.y<0||b.y>H || walls.some(w=>circleRect(b.x,b.y,BULLET/2,w));
    if(!dead){
      if(b.from==='player'){
        for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
          const e=enemies[j];
          if((b.x-e.x)**2+(b.y-e.y)**2 < (TANK/2+BULLET/2)**2){
            explode(e.x,e.y); enemies.splice(j,1); state.score+=100; dead=true;
          }
        }
      } else {
        if((b.x-player.x)**2+(b.y-player.y)**2 < (TANK/2+BULLET/2)**2){
          explode(player.x,player.y); state.lives--; dead=true;
          if(state.lives<=0) state.mode='lose';
        }
      }
    }
    if(dead) bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // respawn
  if(state.mode==='play' && enemies.length<3 && state.timer>0){
    state.timer-=dt;
    if(state.timer<=0){ spawnEnemy(); state.timer=2; }
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vy+=120*dt; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  state.shake=Math.max(0,state.shake-dt*40);
  if(enemies.length===0) state.mode='win';
}

// ---- draw ----
function drawTank(x,y,angle,color){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.rotate(angle);
  // tracks
  ctx.fillStyle='#222';
  ctx.fillRect(-14,-15,28,6);
  ctx.fillRect(-14,9,28,6);
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.fillRect(-13,-9,26,18);
  // turret
  ctx.fillStyle='#111';
  ctx.fillRect(-6,-6,12,12);
  // barrel
  ctx.fillStyle='#555';
  ctx.fillRect(6,-3,18,6);
  ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
  const sx=(Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, sy=(Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx,sy);
  // background
  ctx.fillStyle='#0f1116'; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
  // floor grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(70,90,140,0.15)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=W;i+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i,0); ctx.lineTo(i,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for(let i=0;i<=H;i+=40){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,i); ctx.lineTo(W,i); ctx.stroke(); }
  // walls
  for(const w of walls){
    ctx.fillStyle=wallColor; ctx.fillRect(w.x,w.y,w.w,w.h);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7a8fb5'; ctx.fillRect(w.x,w.y,w.w,4);
  }
  // enemies
  for(const e of enemies) drawTank(e.x,e.y,e.angle,'#c0392b');
  // player
  if(state.mode!=='lose') drawTank(player.x,player.y,player.angle,'#2ecc71');
  // bullets
  for(const b of bullets){
    ctx.fillStyle=b.from==='player'?'#ffe066':'#ff7b54';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,BULLET/2,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff9f43';
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#0b0d12'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2ecc71'; ctx.font='bold 18px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+state.score,14,17);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff7b54';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES '+state.lives,200,17);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8899bb';
  ctx.fillText('ENEMIES '+enemies.length,330,17);

  // overlays
  if(state.mode==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,6,10,0.75)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#2ecc71'; ctx.font='bold 44px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('ROBOT TANK',W/2,200);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8899bb'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrows to drive',W/2,270);
    ctx.fillText('SPACE to fire',W/2,295);
    ctx.fillText('Use the walls as cover',W/2,320);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.font='bold 22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(state.msg,W/2,400);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
  if(state.mode==='win'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,6,10,0.8)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#2ecc71'; ctx.font='bold 48px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('YOU WIN',W/2,270);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.font='22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: '+state.score,W/2,320);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8899bb'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to restart',W/2,370);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
  if(state.mode==='lose'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,5,5,0.8)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#c0392b'; ctx.font='bold 48px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,270);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe066'; ctx.font='22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Score: '+state.score,W/2,320);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8899bb'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to restart',W/2,370);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

// ---- loop ----
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Pro Tennis</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0e1a2b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#123c2e;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;border:4px solid #0a1420;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="720" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cvs.getContext('2d');
const W=cvs.width,H=cvs.height;

const state={
  phase:'start',
  scoreP:0,
  scoreC:0,
  winner:null,
  msg:'',
  msgT:0
};

const player={x:150,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,w:20,h:44};
const computer={x:W-150,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,w:20,h:44};
const ball={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:8,bounces:0,lastHit:null};

const actors=[player,computer,ball];
const keys={};

function resetRally(dir){
  ball.x=W/2; ball.y=H*0.55;
  ball.vx=dir*3.2; ball.vy=0;
  ball.bounces=0; ball.lastHit=null;
}

function startGame(){
  state.phase='play';
  state.scoreP=0; state.scoreC=0; state.winner=null;
  player.x=150; player.y=H/2; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
  computer.x=W-150; computer.y=H/2; computer.vx=0; computer.vy=0;
  resetRally(1);
}

function onPoint(who){
  if(who==='P') state.scoreP++; else state.scoreC++;
  if(state.scoreP>=5 || state.scoreC>=5){
    state.winner = state.scoreP>state.scoreC ? 'P' : 'C';
    state.phase='over';
    state.msg = state.winner==='P' ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'CPU WINS!';
  }else{
    state.phase='point';
    state.msg = who==='P' ? 'POINT YOU' : 'POINT CPU';
    state.msgT=60;
    resetRally(who==='P' ? -1 : 1);
  }
}

// input
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(state.phase==='start' && (k===' '||k==='enter')) startGame();
  else if(state.phase==='over' && (k===' '||k==='enter')) startGame();
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});
cvs.addEventListener('mousedown',()=>{
  if(state.phase==='start') startGame();
  else if(state.phase==='over') startGame();
});

function update(){
  // move all actors in the array
  for(const a of actors){
    a.x+=a.vx;
    a.y+=a.vy;
  }

  if(state.phase==='play'){
    // player control
    const sp=5;
    player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
    if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) player.vy=-sp;
    if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) player.vy=sp;
    if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) player.vx=-sp;
    if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) player.vx=sp;

    // player bounds
    player.x=Math.max(30,Math.min(W-30,player.x));
    player.y=Math.max(30,Math.min(H-30,player.y));

    // computer AI: track ball y, sit near its x when ball comes
    const targetY = ball.vx>0 ? ball.y : H/2;
    computer.vy = (targetY - computer.y)*0.09;
    const targetX = ball.vx>0 ? Math.min(W-70, ball.x+40) : W-150;
    computer.vx = (targetX - computer.x)*0.05;
    computer.x=Math.max(W/2+30,Math.min(W-30,computer.x));
    computer.y=Math.max(30,Math.min(H-30,computer.y));

    // ball walls
    if(ball.y<ball.r){ ball.y=ball.r; ball.vy=Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    if(ball.y>H-ball.r){ ball.y=H-ball.r; ball.vy=-Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // player hit
    if(ball.lastHit!=='P' &&
       ball.x-ball.r<player.x+player.w/2 &&
       ball.x+ball.r>player.x-player.w/2 &&
       Math.abs(ball.y-player.y)<player.h/2+ball.r){
      const dir=1;
      const rel=(ball.y-player.y)/(player.h/2);
      const power=5.2;
      ball.vx=power*dir;
      ball.vy=power*0.5*rel;
      ball.bounces=0;
      ball.lastHit='P';
    }
    // computer hit
    if(ball.lastHit!=='C' &&
       ball.x-ball.r<computer.x+computer.w/2 &&
       ball.x+ball.r>computer.x-computer.w/2 &&
       Math.abs(ball.y-computer.y)<computer.h/2+ball.r){
      const dir=-1;
      const rel=(ball.y-computer.y)/(computer.h/2);
      const power=5.2;
      ball.vx=power*dir;
      ball.vy=power*0.5*rel;
      ball.bounces=0;
      ball.lastHit='C';
    }

    // scoring: ball passes a player's side
    if(ball.x<0){ onPoint('C'); }
    else if(ball.x>W){ onPoint('P'); }
  }
  else if(state.phase==='point'){
    if(--state.msgT<=0) state.phase='play';
  }
}

function drawCourt(){
  // grass
  ctx.fillStyle='#123c2e';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // darker border
  ctx.fillStyle='#0f2f24';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,18); ctx.fillRect(0,H-18,W,18);
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,18,H); ctx.fillRect(W-18,0,18,H);
  // net
  ctx.strokeStyle='#e9e6df'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W/2,20); ctx.lineTo(W/2,H-20); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let y=24;y<H-20;y+=8){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W/2-4,y); ctx.lineTo(W/2+4,y); ctx.stroke(); }
  // service lines
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.28,20); ctx.lineTo(W*0.28,H-20); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.72,20); ctx.lineTo(W*0.72,H-20); ctx.stroke();
  // center line
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W*0.28,H/2); ctx.lineTo(W*0.72,H/2); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawActor(a,isPlayer){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(a.x,a.y);
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,a.h/2,16,6,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=isPlayer?'#2f6fed':'#e23b3b';
  ctx.fillRect(-a.w/2,-a.h/2,a.w,a.h);
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#f0c98f';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-a.h/2-8,9,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // cap
  ctx.fillStyle=isPlayer?'#1b3f9e':'#7a1414';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-a.h/2-10,9,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBall(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ball.x,ball.y+10,10,4,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe14d';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#e0a000'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r*0.55,0.6,3.6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawText(txt,x,y,size,color,align){
  ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.font='bold '+size+'px monospace'; ctx.textAlign=align||'center';
  ctx.fillText(txt,x,y);
}

function drawHUD(){
  drawText('PRO TENNIS',W/2,34,26,'#ffe14d');
  drawText('YOU  '+state.scoreP,150,34,20,'#7fb2ff','center');
  drawText('CPU  '+state.scoreC,W-150,34,20,'#ff8f8f','center');
  drawText('first to 5',W/2,H-30,14,'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)');
}

function drawOverlay(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,16,24,0.78)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(state.phase==='start'){
    drawText('PRO TENNIS',W/2,H/2-60,40,'#ffe14d');
    drawText('hit the ball past the CPU',W/2,H/2-10,18,'#fff');
    drawText('so it bounces twice on their side',W/2,H/2+16,18,'#fff');
    drawText('W A S D  /  arrow keys to move',W/2,H/2+52,16,'#9fd0ff');
    drawText('click or press SPACE to start',W/2,H/2+84,16,'#9fd0ff');
  }else if(state.phase==='over'){
    drawText(state.msg,W/2,H/2-40,40,state.winner==='P'?'#7fb2ff':'#ff8f8f');
    drawText('final  '+state.scoreP+' - '+state.scoreC,W/2,H/2+4,22,'#fff');
    drawText('click or press SPACE to play again',W/2,H/2+44,16,'#9fd0ff');
  }else if(state.phase==='point'){
    drawText(state.msg,W/2,H/2,30,'#ffe14d');
  }
}

function draw(){
  drawCourt();
  drawActor(player,true);
  drawActor(computer,false);
  drawBall();
  drawHUD();
  if(state.phase!=='play') drawOverlay();
}

function loop(){
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</html_file>

Give me a small one-screen version of Wayne Gretzky Hockey (1988): slide the puck past the goalie. Hard part: slide the puck past the goalie. Keep each actor in one array of {x, y, vx, vy}. Move that array in update, draw it, then end with </html> and </html_file>.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Gretzky 1988 — Puck vs. Goalie</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04121b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-family:"Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{display:block;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:3px solid #0a2233}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="640" height="420"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const canvas=document.getElementById("c");
const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

// --- constants ---
const RINK={left:34,right:W-34,top:26,bottom:H-26};
const GOAL={cx:W-58,cy:H/2,depth:20,half:64};
const PUCK_R=9;
const SKATER_R=13;
const GOALIE_R=15;
const FRICTION=0.985;
const WALL_BOUNCE=0.82;
const MAX_SPEED=15;
const SKATER_SPEED=4.2;
const GOALIE_SPEED=3.3;
const WIN_GOALS=3;

// --- state ---
let state="start";           // start | play | score | goal | gameover
let score=0;
let msg="";
let msgTimer=0;
let shake=0;
let t=0;
let particles=[];
let stars=[];

const puck={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:PUCK_R};
const skater={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:SKATER_R};
const goalie={x:GOAL.cx,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,r:GOALIE_R};

let keys={};
let mouse={x:W/2,y:H/2,down:false};

// pre-create stars
for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
  stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,s:Math.random()*1.6+0.4,ph:Math.random()*6.28});
}

// --- helpers ---
function clamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);}
function dist(a,b){const dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y;return Math.hypot(dx,dy);}
function addParticles(x,y,color,n,spd){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.28, s=Math.random()*spd+1;
    particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:1,color:color});
  }
}

// --- input ---
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  keys[e.key]=true;
  if(e.key===" "||e.key==="Enter"){
    if(state==="start"){startPlay();}
    else if(state==="gameover"){resetGame();}
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove",e=>{
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);
  mouse.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);
});
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{
  mouse.down=true;
  if(state==="start"){startPlay();}
  else if(state==="gameover"){resetGame();}
});
addEventListener("mouseup",()=>{mouse.down=false;});
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tt=e.touches[0];
  mouse.x=(tt.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);
  mouse.y=(tt.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);
  mouse.down=true;
  if(state==="start"){startPlay();}
  else if(state==="gameover"){resetGame();}
  e.preventDefault();
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tt=e.touches[0];
  mouse.x=(tt.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);
  mouse.y=(tt.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height);
  e.preventDefault();
},{passive:false});
addEventListener("touchend",()=>{mouse.down=false;});

// --- game flow ---
function resetGame(){
  score=0;
  msg="";msgTimer=0;shake=0;
  state="play";
  placePuckAndSkater();
}
function startPlay(){
  state="play";
  placePuckAndSkater();
}
function placePuckAndSkater(){
  puck.x=W/2;puck.y=H/2;puck.vx=0;puck.vy=0;
  skater.x=W/2;skater.y=H/2;
}

// --- update ---
function update(){
  t+=0.016;
  if(shake>0)shake*=0.85;
  updateParticles();

  if(state==="play"){
    moveSkater();
    moveGoalie();
    movePuck();
  }
}

function moveSkater(){
  let dx=0,dy=0;
  if(keys["w"]||keys["arrowup"])dy-=1;
  if(keys["s"]||keys["arrowdown"])dy+=1;
  if(keys["a"]||keys["arrowleft"])dx-=1;
  if(keys["d"]||keys["arrowright"])dx+=1;
  if(dx||dy){
    const m=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    skater.x+=dx/m*SKATER_SPEED;
    skater.y+=dy/m*SKATER_SPEED;
  }
  // keep inside rink
  skater.x=clamp(skater.x,RINK.left+skater.r,RINK.right-skater.r);
  skater.y=clamp(skater.y,RINK.top+skater.r,RINK.bottom-skater.r);
  // push puck on contact
  const d=dist(skater,puck);
  const minD=skater.r+puck.r;
  if(d<minD && d>0){
    const nx=(puck.x-skater.x)/d, ny=(puck.y-skater.y)/d;
    puck.x=skater.x+nx*minD;
    puck.y=skater.y+ny*minD;
    // impart velocity along normal + a bit of skater momentum
    const push=5.5;
    puck.vx=nx*push;
    puck.vy=ny*push;
    addParticles(puck.x,puck.y,"#e8eef2",6,3);
  }
}

function moveGoalie(){
  // track puck y, biased toward goal center
  const targetY=clamp(puck.y, GOAL.cy-GOAL.half, GOAL.cy+GOAL.half);
  const diff=targetY-goalie.y;
  const step=clamp(diff,-GOALIE_SPEED,GOALIE_SPEED);
  goalie.y+=step;
  goalie.y=clamp(goalie.y, GOAL.cy-GOAL.half, GOAL.cy+GOAL.half);
}

function movePuck(){
  puck.x+=puck.vx;
  puck.y+=puck.vy;
  puck.vx*=FRICTION;
  puck.vy*=FRICTION;
  const sp=Math.hypot(puck.vx,puck.vy);
  if(sp>MAX_SPEED){
    puck.vx=puck.vx/sp*MAX_SPEED;
    puck.vy=puck.vy/sp*MAX_SPEED;
  }
  // wall bounces
  if(puck.x<RINK.left+PUCK_R){puck.x=RINK.left+PUCK_R;puck.vx*=-WALL_BOUNCE;addParticles(puck.x,puck.y,"#7fd6ff",4,2);}
  if(puck.x>RINK.right-PUCK_R){puck.x=RINK.right-PUCK_R;puck.vx*=-WALL_BOUNCE;addParticles(puck.x,puck.y,"#7fd6ff",4,2);}
  if(puck.y<RINK.top+PUCK_R){puck.y=RINK.top+PUCK_R;puck.vy*=-WALL_BOUNCE;addParticles(puck.x,puck.y,"#7fd6ff",4,2);}
  if(puck.y>RINK.bottom-PUCK_R){puck.y=RINK.bottom-PUCK_R;puck.vy*=-WALL_BOUNCE;addParticles(puck.x,puck.y,"#7fd6ff",4,2);}

  // goal detection: puck fully past goal line within goal mouth
  if(puck.x>GOAL.cx &&
     Math.abs(puck.y-GOAL.cy)<GOAL.half &&
     puck.x+PUCK_R>GOAL.cx+GOAL.depth*0.4){
    onGoal();
  }
}

function onGoal(){
  score++;
  shake=14;
  addParticles(GOAL.cx,GOAL.cy,"#ffd23f",30,6);
  addParticles(GOAL.cx,GOAL.cy,"#ff5c39",20,5);
  if(score>=WIN_GOALS){
    state="gameover";
    msg="GAME OVER — YOU SCORED "+score+"!";
  }else{
    state="score";
    msg="GOAL!  ("+score+"/"+WIN_GOALS+")";
    msgTimer=90;
    placePuckAndSkater();
  }
}

function updateParticles(){
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
    p.vx*=0.92;p.vy*=0.92;
    p.life-=0.02;
    if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// --- draw ---
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0.5){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawRink();
  drawGoal();
  drawGoalie();
  drawSkater();
  drawPuck();
  drawParticles();
  drawHud();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0a1e30");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#04121b");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
  // arena crowd / stars
  for(const s of stars){
    const a=0.25+0.25*Math.sin(t*2+s.ph);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+a.toFixed(2)+")";
    ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.s,s.s);
  }
}

function drawRink(){
  // ice
  const ice=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,20,W/2,H/2,W*0.6);
  ice.addColorStop(0,"#eef7fb");
  ice.addColorStop(1,"#cfe6f0");
  ctx.fillStyle=ice;
  ctx.fillRect(RINK.left,RINK.top,RINK.right-RINK.left,RINK.bottom-RINK.top);

  // rink lines
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(20,90,150,0.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W/2,RINK.top);ctx.lineTo(W/2,RINK.bottom);
  ctx.stroke();
  // center circle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(W/2,H/2,52,0,6.28);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(20,90,150,0.10)";
  ctx.fill();

  // goal lines
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(200,40,40,0.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(GOAL.cx,RINK.top);ctx.lineTo(GOAL.cx,RINK.bottom);
  ctx.stroke();

  // boards
  ctx.strokeStyle="#0a2233";
  ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.strokeRect(RINK.left,RINK.top,RINK.right-RINK.left,RINK.bottom-RINK.top);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.strokeRect(RINK.left+3,RINK.top+3,RINK.right-RINK.left-6,RINK.bottom-RINK.top-6);
}

function drawGoal(){
  // net depth
  ctx.fillStyle="#0a2233";
  ctx.fillRect(GOAL.cx,GOAL.cy-GOAL.half,GOAL.depth,GOAL.half*2);
  // net mesh
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let y=GOAL.cy-GOAL.half;y<=GOAL.cy+GOAL.half;y+=10){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(GOAL.cx,y);ctx.lineTo(GOAL.cx+GOAL.depth,y);ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let x=GOAL.cx;x<=GOAL.cx+GOAL.depth;x+=10){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,GOAL.cy-GOAL.half);ctx.lineTo(x,GOAL.cy+GOAL.half);ctx.stroke();
  }
  // goal frame (red)
  ctx.strokeStyle="#e23b3b";
  ctx.lineWidth=5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(GOAL.cx,GOAL.cy-GOAL.half);
  ctx.lineTo(GOAL.cx+GOAL.depth,GOAL.cy-GOAL.half);
  ctx.lineTo(GOAL.cx+GOAL.depth,GOAL.cy+GOAL.half);
  ctx.lineTo(GOAL.cx,GOAL.cy+GOAL.half);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawGoalie(){
  const g=goalie;
  // pads
  ctx.fillStyle="#f4f7fa";
  ctx.strokeStyle="#2b3a48";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(g.x,g.y+6,16,10,0,0,6.28);
  ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle="#ff5c39";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(g.x,g.y-2,12,0,6.28);
  ctx.fill();
  // helmet
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(g.x,g.y-14,8,0,6.28);
  ctx.fill();
  // mask
  ctx.fillStyle="#2b3a48";
  ctx.fillRect(g.x-5,g.y-17,10,5);
}

function drawSkater(){
  const s=skater;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.15)";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(s.x,s.y+14,14,5,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // body (red jersey)
  ctx.fillStyle="#e23b3b";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y-2,12,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // white stripe
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
  ctx.fillRect(s.x-12,s.y-4,24,4);
  // number
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
  ctx.font="bold 12px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillText("99",s.x,s.y+2);
  // helmet
  ctx.fillStyle="#e23b3b";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y-14,7,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="#0a2233";
  ctx.fillRect(s.x-4,s.y-17,8,4);
  // stick
  ctx.strokeStyle="#8a5a2b";
  ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(s.x+8,s.y+2);
  ctx.lineTo(s.x+20,s.y+16);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawPuck(){
  const p=puck;
  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x,p.y+8,10,4,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // puck
  ctx.fillStyle="#111418";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,PUCK_R,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle="#2a2f36";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.stroke();
  // top highlight
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x-3,p.y-3,3,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawHud(){
  // score
  ctx.fillStyle="#04121b";
  ctx.fillRect(10,8,150,30);
  ctx.strokeStyle="#e23b3b";
  ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.strokeRect(10,8,150,30);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
  ctx.font="bold 18px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillText("GOALS  "+score+" / "+WIN_GOALS,20,30);

  // center message
  if(msg){
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.font="bold 30px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillText(msg,W/2+2,H/2+2);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
    ctx.fillText(msg,W/2,H/2);
  }

  if(state==="start"){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(W/2-230,H/2-70,460,150);
    ctx.strokeStyle="#e23b3b";ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.strokeRect(W/2-230,H/2-70,460,150);
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
    ctx.font="bold 34px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("GRETKY 1988",W/2,H/2-30);
    ctx.fillStyle="#eef7fb";
    ctx.font="16px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.fillText("Slide the puck past the goalie",W/2,H/2);
    ctx.fillText("WASD / arrows to move the skater",W/2,H/2+24);
    ctx.fillText("Score "+WIN_GOALS+" goals to win",W/2,H/2+48);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff5c39";
    ctx.font="bold 18px Trebuchet MS";

  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(state==="start"||state==="over"){ startGame(); return; }
    if(state==="play"){
      var p=toCanvas(e.touches[0]);
      player.x=Math.max(LEFT, Math.min(RIGHT, p.x));
      if(serving){ serving=false; serveTimer=0; ball.vx=serveDir*3.1; ball.vy=-9.2; }
    }
  }, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove",function(e){
    if(state!=="play") return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var p=toCanvas(e.touches[0]);
    player.x=Math.max(LEFT, Math.min(RIGHT, p.x));
  }, {passive:false});

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function spawnParticles(x,y,color,n){
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s=1+Math.random()*3;
      particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:1,color:color});
    }
  }
  function updateParticles(){
    for(var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var p=particles[i];
      p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy+=0.12; p.life-=0.025;
      if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  function hit(p, dir){
    ball.vy=-9.4;
    ball.vx=(ball.x-p.x)/PADDLE_W*4.6 + dir*1.1;
    ball.vx=Math.max(-6.5, Math.min(6.5, ball.vx));
    ball.y=p.y-20;
    bounceCount=0;
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, "#ffffff", 12);
    shake=5;
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if(state!=="play") return;
    elapsed+=dt;
    if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0, shake-dt*30);
    updateParticles();

    // player
    var sp=5.2;
    if(keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"]) player.x-=sp;
    if(keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"]) player.x+=sp;
    player.x=Math.max(LEFT, Math.min(RIGHT, player.x));

    // ai
    if(!serving && ball.y<NET_Y){
      var tx=ball.x + ball.vx*4;
      var d=tx-ai.x;
      ai.x+=Math.max(-3.0, Math.min(3.0, d*0.12));
    } else {
      ai.x+=(W/2-ai.x)*0.02;
    }
    ai.x=Math.max(LEFT, Math.min(RIGHT, ai.x));

    if(serving){
      serveTimer-=dt*60;
      ball.x=player.x; ball.y=player.y-22;
      if(serveTimer<=0) serving=false;
      return;
    }

    // ball physics
    ball.vy+=GRAV;
    ball.vx*=DRAG; ball.vy*=DRAG;
    ball.x+=ball.vx; ball.y+=ball.vy;

    // bounce on floor
    if(ball.vy>0 && ball.y+BALL_R>=H-8){
      ball.y=H-8-BALL_R;
      ball.vy=-ball.vy*BOUNCE;
      ball.vx*=0.98;
      spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, "#ffd24a", 6);
      if(ball.y>=NET_Y) bounceCount++;
      if(bounceCount>=2){
        if(bounceCount===2){
          score++; if(score>best) best=score;
          spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, "#7CFC00", 16);
        }
        state="over";
        return;
      }
    }
    // ceiling
    if(ball.vy<0 && ball.y-BALL_R<=0){
      ball.y=BALL_R; ball.vy=-ball.vy*0.5;
    }
    // out of bounds
    if(ball.x<0||ball.x>W||ball.y>H+40){
      state="over";
      return;
    }

    // hits
    if(ball.vy>0 && ball.y-BALL_R<=player.y && ball.y-BALL_R>=player.y-26 &&
       Math.abs(ball.x-player.x)<PADDLE_W/2+BALL_R){
      hit(player, ball.x<player.x?1:-1);
    }
    if(ball.vy<0 && ball.y+BALL_R>=ai.y && ball.y+BALL_R<=ai.y+26 &&
       Math.abs(ball.x-ai.x)<PADDLE_W/2+BALL_R){
      hit(ai, ball.x>ai.x?1:-1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function drawCourt(){
    // sky
    var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,"#0a1a30"); g.addColorStop(0.5,"#12385e"); g.addColorStop(1,"#0a1a30");
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    // crowd
    for(var i=0;i<120;i++){
      var cx=(i*53)%W, cy=18+(i*29)%60;
      var col=["#3b4a63","#4a3b52","#33514a","#52453b","#2f3f5a"][i%5];
      ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
    // court floor
    var fg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,TOP,0,BOT);
    fg.addColorStop(0,"#2f6f4f"); fg.addColorStop(1,"#245c42");
    ctx.fillStyle=fg; ctx.fillRect(LEFT-20,TOP,RIGHT-LEFT+40,BOT-TOP);
    // floor shadow
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.25)"; ctx.fillRect(LEFT-20,BOT,RIGHT-LEFT+40,20);
    // lines
    ctx.strokeStyle="#f2f2e6"; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.strokeRect(LEFT,TOP,RIGHT-LEFT,BOT-TOP);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(LEFT,NET_Y); ctx.lineTo(RIGHT,NET_Y);
    ctx.moveTo(W/2,TOP); ctx.lineTo(W/2,BOT);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(LEFT,NET_Y-40); ctx.lineTo(RIGHT,NET_Y-40);
    ctx.moveTo(LEFT,NET_Y+40); ctx.lineTo(RIGHT,NET_Y+40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // net
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.5)"; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var n=LEFT;n<=RIGHT;n+=14){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(n,NET_Y-14); ctx.lineTo(n,NET_Y+14); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.strokeStyle="#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(LEFT,NET_Y); ctx.lineTo(RIGHT,NET_Y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="#e8e8e8"; ctx.fillRect(LEFT-4,NET_Y-16,8,32); ctx.fillRect(RIGHT-4,NET_Y-16,8,32);
  }
  function drawBall(){
    if(!ball) return;
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.3)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ball.x, H-6, 10, 4, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
    var bg=ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x-3,ball.y-3,1,ball.x,ball.y,BALL_R);
    bg.addColorStop(0,"#fff7cf"); bg.addColorStop(1,"#f2c531");
    ctx.fillStyle=bg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BALL_R,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle="#fff2b0"; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BALL_R-2,0.4,2.4); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BALL_R-2,3.5,5.5); ctx.stroke();
  }
  function drawPaddle(p, color){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y+14, PADDLE_W/2, 5, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=color; roundRect(p.x-PADDLE_W/2, p.y-6, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H, 6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.35)"; roundRect(p.x-PADDLE_W/2+4, p.y-4, PADDLE_W-8, 3, 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  function drawParticles(){
    for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){
      var p=particles[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
      ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,3,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
  function drawText(t,x,y,size,color,align,font){
    ctx.font=(font||"bold ")+size+"px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign=align||"center"; ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.fillText(t,x,y);
  }
  function drawHUD(){
    drawText("JIMMY CONNORS TENNIS", W/2, 26, 20, "#ffe066", "center", "");
    drawText("1985", W/2, 48, 12, "#9fc0e0", "center", "");
    ctx.fillStyle="#07101c"; roundRect(W/2-150,60,300,34,8); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle="#3a5f86"; ctx.lineWidth=2; roundRect(W/2-150,60,300,34,8); ctx.stroke();
    drawText("SETS  "+score+"    BEST  "+best, W/2, 77, 16, "#ffffff", "center", "");
  }
  function drawStart(){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(4,10,20,.78)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    drawText("JIMMY CONNORS", W/2, 150, 46, "#ffe066", "center", "");
    drawText("TENNIS  •  1985", W/2, 195, 22, "#ffffff", "center", "");
    drawText("One-Screen Edition", W/2, 225, 15, "#9fc0e0", "center", "");
    drawText("Move your player and strike the ball past the opponent.", W/2, 285, 18, "#ffffff", "center", "");
    drawText("Land it so it bounces TWICE in the opponent's court to score a set.", W/2, 313, 18, "#7CFC00", "center", "");
    drawText("If it bounces twice on your side, you lose.", W/2, 341, 16, "#ff9d6b", "center", "");
    drawText("Move:  ← →  or  A / D  or  Mouse / Touch", W/2, 392, 16, "#ffffff", "center", "");
    drawText("Strike / Serve:  Space  or  Click / Tap", W/2, 418, 16, "#ffffff", "center", "");
    drawText("PRESS  SPACE  OR  CLICK  TO  START", W/2, 470, 22, "#ffe066", "center", "");
  }
  function drawOver(){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(4,10,20,.72)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    var win = score>0;
    drawText(win?"YOU WIN THE SET!":"GAME OVER", W/2, 200, 44, win?"#7CFC00":"#ff6b6b", "center", "");
    drawText("Sets won:  "+score+"      Best:  "+best, W/2, 255, 20, "#ffffff", "center", "");
    drawText("The ball bounced twice on your side.", W/2, 290, 16, "#9fc0e0", "center", "");
    drawText("PRESS  SPACE  OR  CLICK  TO  PLAY  AGAIN", W/2, 360, 20, "#ffe066", "center", "");
  }
  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);
    drawCourt();
    drawBall();
    drawPaddle(ai, "#d64545");
    drawPaddle(player, "#3f8fe0");
    drawParticles();
    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();
    if(state==="start") drawStart();
    if(state==="over") drawOver();
    if(state==="play" && serving){
      drawText("SPACE  /  CLICK  TO  SERVE", W/2, 430, 18, "#ffe066", "center", "");
    }
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(t){
    if(!last) last=t;
    var dt=(t-last)/1000; last=t;
    if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  resetAll();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pepper II — Pattern Match</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#141019;overflow:hidden;
    font-family:"Courier New",monospace;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;
    touch-action:none}
  #game{display:block;position:absolute;top:0;left:0}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
/* ---------- constants ---------- */
var COLS=5, ROWS=5, GAP=12, PAD=22;
var BOARD=260, CELL=(BOARD-GAP*(COLS-1))/COLS;
var CW=900, CH=640, ORIGINX=300, ORIGINY=150;
var N=COLS*ROWS;
var TYPES=[
  {name:"Pepper",   fill:"#e0392b", line:"#7a1408", hi:"#ff8a6a", seed:3},
  {name:"Bell",     fill:"#f2a51a", line:"#8a5a06", hi:"#ffd777", seed:11},
  {name:"Green",    fill:"#43a047", line:"#1c5e22", hi:"#8fe093", seed:19},
  {name:"Purple",   fill:"#7b4fb0", line:"#3d2266", hi:"#c39bf0", seed:27}
];
var TYPES_N=TYPES.length;
var SHAPES=["round","pointed","heart"];
var START_MOVES=12;
var S=1.0, TAU=Math.PI*2;

/* ---------- canvas ---------- */
var canvas=document.getElementById("game");
var ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
var dpr=Math.max(1,Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1));
canvas.width=CW*dpr; canvas.height=CH*dpr;
canvas.style.width=CW+"px"; canvas.style.height=CH+"px";

/* ---------- state ---------- */
var state="start";
var pieces=[];
var pattern=[];
var movesLeft=START_MOVES;
var movesUsed=0;
var sel=-1;
var hover=-1;
var won=false, lost=false;
var winTime=0, loseTime=0;
var particles=[];
var last=0, time=0, t=0;

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function cellCenter(i){
  var r=(i/COLS)|0, c=i%COLS;
  return {x:ORIGINX+PAD+c*(CELL+GAP)+CELL/2,
          y:ORIGINY+PAD+r*(CELL+GAP)+CELL/2};
}
function shuffle(a){
  for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}
  return a;
}
function isSolved(){
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++) if(pieces[i].type!==pattern[i]) return false;
  return true;
}
function buildPattern(){
  pattern=[];
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++) pattern[i]=(Math.random()*TYPES_N)|0;
}
function makePieces(){
  pieces=[];
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
    var t=cellCenter(i);
    pieces.push({home:i, x:t.x, y:t.y, vx:0, vy:0,
      type:pattern[i], shape:SHAPES[(Math.random()*SHAPES.length)|0],
      rot:0, targetRot:0, scale:1,
      wob:(Math.random()*TAU), wobAmp:2.4, wobSpeed:1.2+Math.random()*0.8});
  }
}
function swapPieces(a,b){
  var tp=pieces[a].type; pieces[a].type=pieces[b].type; pieces[b].type=tp;
  var ts=pieces[a].shape; pieces[a].shape=pieces[b].shape; pieces[b].shape=ts;
  pieces[a].wobAmp=7; pieces[a].wob=(Math.random()*TAU);
  pieces[b].wobAmp=7; pieces[b].wob=(Math.random()*TAU);
}
function matched(i){ return pieces[i].type===pattern[i]; }

function newGame(){
  buildPattern();
  makePieces();
  movesLeft=START_MOVES; movesUsed=0; sel=-1; hover=-1;
  won=false; lost=false; winTime=0; loseTime=0;
  particles=[];
  state="play";
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function toCanvas(e){
  var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {x:(e.clientX-r.left)*(CW/r.width), y:(e.clientY-r.top)*(CH/r.height)};
}
function pieceAt(p){
  var x=p.x-ORIGINX-PAD, y=p.y-ORIGINY-PAD;
  if(x<0||y<0) return -1;
  var c=(x/(CELL+GAP))|0, r=(y/(CELL+GAP))|0;
  if(c>=COLS||r>=ROWS) return -1;
  return r*COLS+c;
}
function burst(x,y,color,n){
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var a=Math.random()*TAU, sp=40+Math.random()*160;
    particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-30,
      life:0.6+Math.random()*0.5, max:1.1, size:2+Math.random()*3, color:color});
  }
}
function onDown(e){
  var p=toCanvas(e);
  if(state==="start"){ newGame(); return; }
  if(state==="won"||state==="lost"){ if(t-wonTime>0.5||t-loseTime>0.5) newGame(); return; }
  if(state!=="play") return;
  var idx=pieceAt(p);
  if(idx<0) return;
  if(sel<0){ sel=idx; }
  else if(sel===idx){ sel=-1; }
  else { swapPieces(sel,idx); sel=-1; movesLeft--; movesUsed++;
          if(isSolved()){ won=true; state="won"; winTime=t;
            for(var i=0;i<N;i++){var c=cellCenter(i); burst(c.x,c.y,TYPES[pattern[i]].fill,10);} }
          else if(movesLeft<=0){ lost=true; state="lost"; loseTime=t; } }
}
function onMove(e){
  var p=toCanvas(e);
  hover=(state==="play")?pieceAt(p):-1;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousedown",onDown);
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove",onMove);
window.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
  if(state==="start"){ if(e.key===" "||e.key==="Enter"){ newGame(); e.preventDefault(); } }
  else if(state==="won"||state==="lost"){ if(e.key===" "||e.key==="Enter") newGame(); }
});

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt){
  t+=dt;
  for(var i=0;i<pieces.length;i++){
    var p=pieces[i], hc=cellCenter(p.home);
    var tx=hc.x, ty=hc.y;
    if(state==="play" && p.home===sel){
      tx+=Math.sin(t*3+p.wob)*2.5; ty+=Math.cos(t*2.6+p.wob)*2.5;
      p.targetRot=Math.sin(t*1.4)*0.12;
    } else {
      p.targetRot=0;
      if(p.wobAmp>0.4) p.wobAmp*=Math.pow(0.02,dt);
      if(state==="play" && p.home===hover) p.wobAmp=Math.max(p.wobAmp,3.5);
      tx+=Math.sin(t*p.wobSpeed+p.wob)*p.wobAmp;
      ty+=Math.cos(t*p.wobSpeed*0.9+p.wob)*p.wobAmp;
    }
    p.x+=(tx-p.x)*Math.min(1,dt*13);
    p.y+=(ty-p.y)*Math.min(1,dt*13);
    p.rot+=(p.targetRot-p.rot)*Math.min(1,dt*6);
    p.scale+=((state==="play"&&p.home===sel)?1.14:1-p.scale)*Math.min(1,dt*10);
  }
  if(state==="won"){
    for(var i=0;i<pieces.length;i++){
      var p=pieces[i], hc=cellCenter(p.home);
      p.x+=(hc.x-p.x)*Math.min(1,dt*6);
      p.y+=(hc.y-p.y)*Math.min(1,dt*6);
      p.rot+=(0-p.rot)*Math.min(1,dt*5);
      p.wobAmp=2.2;
    }
  }
  if(state==="lost"){
    for(var i=0;i<pieces.length;i++){
      var p=pieces[i];
      p.wobAmp=Math.max(p.wobAmp,4.5);
      p.targetRot=Math.sin(t*1.5)*0.05;
    }
  }
  for(var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var q=particles[i]; q.life-=dt;
    if(q.life<=0){ particles.splice(i,1); continue; }
    q.vy+=340*dt; q.x+=q.vx*dt; q.y+=q.vy*dt;
  }
}

/* ---------- shape paths ---------- */
function roundPath(c){
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(0,-26);
  c.bezierCurveTo(15,-24,22,-12,20,2);
  c.bezierCurveTo(18,16,10,26,0,27);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-10,26,-18,16,-20,2);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-22,-12,-15,-24,0,-26);
  c.closePath();
}
function pointedPath(c){
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(0,-27);
  c.bezierCurveTo(13,-20,19,-7,15,7);
  c.bezierCurveTo(12,19,5,26,0,27);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-5,26,-12,19,-15,7);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-19,-7,-13,-20,0,-27);
  c.closePath();
}
function heartPath(c){
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(0,27);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-20,8,-25,-8,-14,-18);
  c.bezierCurveTo(-7,-25,0,-19,0,-13);
  c.bezierCurveTo(0,-19,7,-25,14,-18);
  c.bezierCurveTo(25,-8,20,8,0,27);
  c.closePath();
}
function drawShape(c,shape){
  if(shape==="pointed") pointedPath(c);
  else if(shape==="heart") heartPath(c);
  else roundPath(c);
}
function drawPiece(c,px,py,scale,rot,type,shape,glow,seed){
  var ty=TYPES[type];
  c.save();
  c.translate(px,py);
  c.scale(S*scale,S*scale);
  c.rotate(rot);
  c.lineJoin="round"; c.lineCap="round";
  if(glow){
    c.save(); c.shadowColor=ty.fill; c.shadowBlur=20;
    drawShape(c,shape); c.fillStyle=ty.fill; c.globalAlpha=0.55; c.fill();
    c.restore();
  }
  drawShape(c,shape);
  c.fillStyle=ty.fill; c.fill();
  c.lineWidth=3; c.strokeStyle=ty.line; c.stroke();
  c.save();
  drawShape(c,shape); c.clip();
  c.globalAlpha=0.22; c.fillStyle=ty.hi;
  c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(-7,-9,10,15,-0.5,0,TAU); c.fill();
  c.globalAlpha=0.95; c.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"; c.lineWidth=2;
  c.beginPath(); c.arc(0,0,2.5,0,TAU); c.stroke();
  var n=5;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var a=(i/n)*TAU+seed*0.5, rr=12.5;
    var x=Math.cos(a)*rr, y=Math.sin(a)*rr;
    c.fillStyle=ty.hi; c.beginPath(); c.arc(x,y,2.2,0,TAU); c.fill();
  }
  c.restore();
  c.restore();
}

/* ---------- background ---------- */
function drawBackground(){
  var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,CH);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#241b2e"); g.addColorStop(0.55,"#1a1424"); g.addColorStop(1,"#120d18");
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);
  var spots=[
    {x:120,y:120,r:200,c:"224,57,43"},
    {x:780,y:520,r:240,c:"67,160,71"},
    {x:820,y:140,r:180,c:"242,165,26"},
    {x:120,y:540,r:180,c:"123,79,176"}
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<spots.length;i++){
    var s=spots[i];
    var rg=ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x,s.y,0,s.x,s.y,s.r);
    rg.addColorStop(0,"rgba("+s.c+",0.16)");
    rg.addColorStop(1,"rgba("+s.c+",0)");
    ctx.fillStyle=rg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.02)";
  for(var x=0;x<CW;x+=28) for(var y=0;y<CH;y+=28) ctx.fillRect(x,y,1,1);
}
function drawTitle(){
  ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.font="bold 54px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="#f4f1ea";
  ctx.shadowColor="rgba(224,57,43,0.6)"; ctx.shadowBlur=18;
  ctx.fillText("PEPPER II",CW/2,84);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.font="16px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  ctx.fillText("a pattern-match puzzle  •  1982",CW/2,110);
}
function drawBoard(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.28)";
  ctx.fillRect(ORIGINX,ORIGINY,BOARD,BOARD);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.10)"; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.strokeRect(ORIGINX,ORIGINY,BOARD,BOARD);
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
    var c=cellCenter(i);
    ctx.strokeStyle=matched(i)?"rgba(120,255,150,0.35)":"rgba(255,255,255,0.07)";
    ctx.lineWidth=matched(i)?2:1;
    ctx.strokeRect(c.x-CELL/2,c.y-CELL/2,CELL,CELL);
  }
}
function drawPattern(){
  var x=ORIGINX, y=ORIGINY, s=CELL*0.52;
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
    var c=cellCenter(i);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(c.x,c.y); ctx.scale(s,s); ctx.rotate(0);
    drawShape(ctx,SHAPES[(i*3)%3]);
    ctx.fillStyle=TYPES[pattern[i]].fill; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
function drawPieces(){
  var order=[]; for(var i=0;i<N;i++) order.push(i);
  order.sort(function(a,b){ return pieces[a].y-pieces[b].y; });
  for(var k=0;k<order.length;k++){
    var i=order[k], p=pieces[i];
    var glow=(state==="play"&&p.home===sel)||
             (state==="won")||
             (state==="play"&&p.home===hover);
    drawPiece(ctx,p.x,p.y,p.scale,p.rot,p.type,p.shape,glow,p.type*7+p.home);
  }
}
function drawParticles(){
  for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){
    var q=particles[i];
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,q.life/q.max);
    ctx.fillStyle=q.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(q.x,q.y,q.size,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textAlign="left"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.font="bold 16px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  ctx.fillText("TARGET PATTERN",ORIGINX,ORIGINY-14);
  ctx.font="bold 13px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
  ctx.fillText("PICK TWO  →  SWAP",ORIGINX,ORIGINY-2);

  ctx.textAlign="right";
  ctx.font="bold 14px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  ctx.fillText("MOVES",CW-40,40);
  ctx.font="bold 44px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle=movesLeft<=3?"#e0392b":"#f4f1ea";
  ctx.fillText(String(movesLeft),CW-40,84);

  ctx.textAlign="left"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.font="13px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
  ctx.fillText("click / tap two peppers to swap them",40,CH-40);
  ctx.fillText("match the whole pattern before moves run out",40,CH-22);
}
function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(10,8,14,0.72)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);
  ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.font="bold 46px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="#f4f1ea";
  ctx.shadowColor="rgba(242,165,26,0.5)"; ctx.shadowBlur=16;
  ctx.fillText("PEPPER II",CW/2,150);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.font="15px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
  ctx.fillText("Match the target pattern by swapping peppers.",CW/2,190);
  ctx.fillText("You have "+START_MOVES+" moves.  Click or tap two peppers to swap.",CW/2,214);
  ctx.font="bold 20px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="#f2a51a";
  var pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(t*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=pulse;
  ctx.fillText("▶  CLICK TO START  ◀",CW/2,300);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.font="13px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
  ctx.fillText("or press  SPACE  /  ENTER",CW/2,330);
}
function drawEnd(){
  var wonNow=(state==="won");
  ctx.fillStyle=wonNow?"rgba(20,40,25,0.66)":"rgba(40,15,15,0.66)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,CW,CH);
  ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.font="bold 52px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle=wonNow?"#7ee08a":"#ff6a5a";
  ctx.shadowColor=wonNow?"rgba(120,255,150,0.5)":"rgba(255,90,70,0.5)"; ctx.shadowBlur=18;
  ctx.fillText(wonNow?"YOU MATCHED!":"OUT OF MOVES",CW/2,250);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.font="18px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  ctx.fillText("solved in "+movesUsed+" moves",CW/2,292);
  ctx.font="bold 20px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle="#f2a51a";
  var pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(t*4);
  ctx.globalAlpha=pulse;
  ctx.fillText("▶  CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN  ◀",CW/2,360);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  drawTitle();
  drawBoard();
  drawPattern();
  drawPieces();
  drawParticles();
  drawHUD();
  if(state==="start") drawStart();
  else if(state==="won") drawEnd();
  else if(state==="lost") drawEnd();
}

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
function frame(now){
  if(!last) last=now;
  var dt=(now-last)/1000; last=now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,CW,CH);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

/* ---------- init ---------- */
buildPattern();
makePieces();
state="start";
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Cosmic Ark</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,520px);height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #12305a;box-shadow:0 0 34px #0a1f3a;}

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
const W=cv.width, H=cv.height;

// ---- state ----
let state='start';
let score=0, wave=1, best=0;
let ship={x:W/2,y:H-44,vx:0,vy:0};
let bullets=[], enemies=[], ebullets=[], parts=[];
let shake=0, fireCd=0;
const keys={};

// ---- input ----
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  if(state==='start' && (k===' '||k==='enter')) startGame();
  else if(state==='gameover' && (k==='r'||k===' '||k==='enter')) startGame();
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{ if(state==='start'||state==='gameover') startGame(); });

function startGame(){
  score=0; wave=1;
  bullets=[]; enemies=[]; ebullets=[]; parts=[];
  ship.x=W/2; ship.y=H-44; ship.vx=0; ship.vy=0;
  fireCd=0; shake=0;
  spawnWave();
  state='playing';
}
function spawnWave(){
  const n=3+wave, cols=n, step=W/(n+1);
  for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){
    enemies.push({x:step*(i+1), y:60, vx:0, vy:0, t:Math.random()*6.28,
      hue:165+Math.floor((i/cols)*150), r:12, type:i%3});
  }
}

// ---- update ----
function update(dt){
  if(state!=='playing') { updateParts(dt); return; }

  const speed=280;
  ship.vx=(keys['arrowright']||keys['d']?1:0)-(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']?1:0);
  ship.vy=(keys['arrowdown']||keys['s']?1:0)-(keys['arrowup']||keys['w']?1:0);
  ship.x=Math.max(24,Math.min(W-24,ship.x+ship.vx*speed*dt));
  ship.y=Math.max(200,Math.min(H-24,ship.y+ship.vy*speed*dt));

  fireCd-=dt;
  if(keys[' '] && fireCd<=0){
    bullets.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-14,vx:0,vy:-520});
    fireCd=0.26;
  }

  for(const b of bullets) b.y+=b.vy*dt;
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>b.y>-14);

  const dir=Math.sin(wave*0.7)*1;
  for(const e of enemies){
    e.t+=dt*1.6;
    e.x+=Math.sin(e.t)*40*dt*dir;
    e.y+=Math.cos(e.t*0.5)*16*dt;
    e.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,e.x));
    if(e.y>H-110){ e.y=H-110; e.vy=-1; }
  }

  for(const e of enemies){
    const r=Math.abs(e.x-ship.x)+Math.abs(e.y-ship.y);
    if(r<18){ lose(); return; }
  }

  ebullets=ebullets.filter(b=>{
    b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    const r=Math.abs(b.x-ship.x)+Math.abs(b.y-ship.y);
    if(r<15){ lose(); return false; }
    return b.y<H+14;
  });

  for(const b of bullets){
    for(const e of enemies){
      if(e.alive===false) continue;
      if(Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<e.r+3 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<e.r+3){
        e.alive=false; b.alive=false;
        score+=100;
        explode(e.x,e.y,e.hue);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>!b.alive);
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>!e.alive);

  if(enemies.length===0){
    wave++;
    if(wave>5){ state='won'; best=Math.max(best,score); return; }
    spawnWave();
  }
  updateParts(dt);
}

function lose(){
  explode(ship.x,ship.y,20);
  shake=12;
  best=Math.max(best,score);
  state='gameover';
}

function explode(x,y,hue){
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.28, s=40+Math.random()*140;
    parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5,hue});
  }
}
function updateParts(dt){
  for(const p of parts){ p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt; }
  parts=parts.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*40);
}

// ---- draw ----
function draw(){
  const sx=(Math.random()-0.5)*shake, sy=(Math.random()-0.5)*shake;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx,sy);
  drawBG();
  for(const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  for(const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
  for(const b of ebullets) drawEBullet(b);
  for(const p of parts) drawPart(p);
  if(state==='playing'||state==='gameover') drawShip();
  ctx.restore();
  drawHUD();
  if(state!=='playing') drawOverlay();
}

function drawBG(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0e2a'); g.addColorStop(0.6,'#0a1430'); g.addColorStop(1,'#04060f');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
  // stars
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++){
    const x=(i*97.3)%W, y=(i*53.7+ (state==='playing'?0:0))%H;
    const tw=0.4+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.7+performance.now()/700));
    ctx.globalAlpha=tw*0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle=i%5===0?'#7fe3ff':'#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // distant nebula
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.12;
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a1a6a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(120,150,80,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a4a5a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(360,240,70,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawShip(){
  const x=ship.x, y=ship.y;
  // engine glow
  const fl=8+Math.sin(performance.now()/40)*3;
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff9a2e';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-8,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x,y+12+fl); ctx.lineTo(x+8,y+12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-4,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x,y+12+fl*0.6); ctx.lineTo(x+4,y+12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f7fe0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y-14); ctx.lineTo(x-18,y+10); ctx.lineTo(x-6,y+6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y-14); ctx.lineTo(x+18,y+10); ctx.lineTo(x+6,y+6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y-16); ctx.lineTo(x-9,y+8); ctx.lineTo(x+9,y+8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a2540';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-4,4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  const x=e.x, y=e.y, r=e.r;
  const h=e.hue;
  const col=`hsl(${h},80%,55%)`, dark=`hsl(${h},70%,32%)`, lite=`hsl(${h},90%,72%)`;
  // glow
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.25; ctx.fillStyle=lite;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r+6,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  if(e.type===0){
    // blob
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=dark;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r*0.55,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=lite;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-r*0.3,y-r*0.3,r*0.18,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  } else if(e.type===1){
    // saucer
    ctx.fillStyle=dark;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y+2,r,r*0.5,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y-2,r*0.8,r*0.4,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=lite;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-2,r*0.25,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  } else {
    // spiky
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
      const a=i/8*6.28, rr=i%2?r*0.5:r;
      const px=x+Math.cos(a)*rr, py=y+Math.sin(a)*rr;
      i?ctx.lineTo(px,py):ctx.moveTo(px,py);
    }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=dark;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r*0.35,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBullet(b){
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe27a';
  ctx.fillRect(b.x-2,b.y-6,4,10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff6cf';
  ctx.fillRect(b.x-1,b.y-6,2,4);
}
function drawEBullet(b){
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a7a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd0da';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,1.4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
}
function drawPart(p){
  ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
  ctx.fillStyle=`hsl(${p.hue},90%,65%)`;
  ctx.fillRect(p.x-1.5,p.y-1.5,3,3);
}
ctx.globalAlpha=1;

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,8,20,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff';
  ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+String(score).padStart(4,'0'),14,17);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+wave+' / 5',W/2,17);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle='#7fe3ff';
  ctx.fillText('BEST '+String(best).padStart(4,'0'),W-14,17);
}

function drawOverlay(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(3,5,14,0.72)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  const cx=W/2, cy=H/2;
  if(state==='start'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff'; ctx.font='bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('COSMIC ARK',cx,cy-70);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a'; ctx.font='14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('defend the ark · clear 5 waves',cx,cy-38);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='15px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('MOVE  ← → ↑ ↓  /  WASD',cx,cy+8);
    ctx.fillText('FIRE  SPACE',cx,cy+34);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7fe3ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  SPACE  TO  START',cx,cy+80);
  } else if(state==='gameover'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff5a7a'; ctx.font='bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('ARK  DESTROYED',cx,cy-50);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+score,cx,cy);
    ctx.fillText('REACHED  WAVE  '+wave,cx,cy+30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7fe3ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  R  TO  RETRY',cx,cy+80);
  } else if(state==='won'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7fe3ff'; ctx.font='bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('ARCK  SAVED',cx,cy-50);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd24a'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('FINAL  SCORE  '+score,cx,cy);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.font='14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('the ark drifts on, alive',cx,cy+30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7fe3ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  R  TO  PLAY  AGAIN',cx,cy+80);
  }
}

// ---- loop ----
let last=performance.now();
function frame(t){
  const dt=Math.min(0.05,(t-last)/1000);
  last=t;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Star Corsair</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04060f;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;
    color:#eaf2ff;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
  #game{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block}
</style>
