<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v,a,b)=> v<a?a : v>b?b : v;
const rand  = (a,b)=> a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const pick  = a => a[(Math.random()*a.length)|0];

const cv = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1;
function resize(){
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
  cv.style.width = W+'px'; cv.style.height = H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

/* ---------- STATE ---------- */
const state = {
  phase:'title',
  time:0,
  score:0,
  lives:3,
  wave:0,
  waveActive:false,
  spawnQueue:[],
  spawnTimer:0,
  spawnGap:0.55,
  message:'',
  messageTimer:0,
  shake:0,
  invuln:0,
  hitFlash:0,
  winTimer:0,
  nextTarget:200
};

const ship = { x:0, y:0, vx:0, vy:0, r:20, cooldown:0, tilt:0 };

// one array of {x,y,vx,vy, ...} for every actor
const actors = [];

function resetGame(){
  state.score=0; state.lives=3; state.wave=0; state.waveActive=false;
  state.spawnQueue=[]; state.spawnTimer=0; state.message=''; state.messageTimer=0;
  state.shake=0; state.invuln=0; state.hitFlash=0; state.winTimer=0;
  state.nextTarget = 200;
  actors.length=0;
  ship.x = W/2; ship.y = H - 90; ship.vx=0; ship.vy=0; ship.tilt=0; ship.cooldown=0;
  startWave(1);
}

function startWave(n){
  state.wave = n;
  state.waveActive = true;
  state.spawnGap = Math.max(0.32, 0.55 - (n-1)*0.03);
  const count = Math.min(26, 5 + (n-1)*2);
  const q = [];
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const type = (n>=4 && Math.random()<0.15) ? 'boss' : pick(['drone','cruiser','raider']);
    q.push({ type, delay: i * state.spawnGap + rand(0,0.35) });
  }
  state.spawnQueue = q;
  state.spawnTimer = 0;
  state.message = 'WAVE '+n;
  state.messageTimer = 2.2;
}

function spawnActor(type){
  const x = rand(40, W-40);
  const base = { x, y:-40, vx:0, vy:0, hp:1, r:16, spin:0, flash:0, dead:false, age:0, type };
  if(type==='drone'){
    base.vy = rand(70,115); base.vx = rand(-35,35); base.r=15; base.hp=1;
    base.color='#5fe0ff';
  } else if(type==='raider'){
    base.vy = rand(90,135); base.vx = rand(-75,75); base.r=18; base.hp=1;
    base.color='#ff7ac2';
  } else if(type==='cruiser'){
    base.vy = rand(45,70); base.vx = rand(-18,18); base.r=24; base.hp=3;
    base.color='#ffd15a';
  } else { // boss
    base.vy = rand(28,42); base.vx = rand(-10,10); base.r=34; base.hp=8;
    base.color='#ff5a6a';
  }
  actors.push(base);
}

function fireBullet(fromX, fromY, vx, vy, hostile, color, r){
  actors.push({ x:fromX, y:fromY, vx, vy, hostile, color, r, dead:false, flash:0, age:0, type:'bullet' });
}

function addExplosion(x,y,color,scale){
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*TAU, s = rand(40,190)*scale;
    actors.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, r:rand(2,4.5)*scale,
      life:rand(0.4,0.8), max:0.8, color, dead:false, flash:0, age:0, type:'spark' });
  }
}

function collide(a,b){
  const dx=a.x-b.x, dy=a.y-b.y, r=a.r+b.r;
  return dx*dx+dy*dy < r*r;
}

/* ---------- INPUT ---------- */
const keys = {};
let mouse = { x:W/2, y:H-90, down:false, active:false };
let pointerDown = false;

window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(state.phase==='title' && (k===' '||k==='enter')){ state.phase='playing'; resetGame(); }
  else if(state.phase==='over' && (k==='r'||k===' '||k==='enter')){ state.phase='playing'; resetGame(); }
  if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false; });

cv.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{
  mouse.x = e.clientX; mouse.y = e.clientY;
});
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
  mouse.x = e.clientX; mouse.y = e.clientY;
  mouse.down = true; pointerDown = true;
  if(state.phase==='title'){ state.phase='playing'; resetGame(); }
  else if(state.phase==='over'){ state.phase='playing'; resetGame(); }
});
window.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=>{ mouse.down=false; pointerDown=false; });
cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', e=> e.preventDefault());

/* ---------- UPDATE ---------- */
function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;
  if(state.messageTimer>0) state.messageTimer -= dt;
  if(state.shake>0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*60);
  if(state.hitFlash>0) state.hitFlash = Math.max(0, state.hitFlash - dt*2);
  if(state.invuln>0) state.invuln -= dt;

  // ship controls
  const sp = 430;
  let mx=0, my=0;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) mx-=1;
  if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) mx+=1;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) my-=1;
  if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) my+=1;
  if(mx||my){
    const l = Math.hypot(mx,my); mx/=l; my/=l;
    ship.vx += mx*sp*dt; ship.vy += my*sp*dt;
  }
  ship.vx *= Math.pow(0.0015, dt);
  ship.vy *= Math.pow(0.0015, dt);
  if(!mx) ship.tilt += (0 - ship.tilt)*Math.min(1,dt*10);
  else ship.tilt += (clamp(mx,-1,1)*0.35 - ship.tilt)*Math.min(1,dt*10);

  // mouse steering
  if(mouse.active || pointerDown){
    const tx = mouse.x, ty = Math.min(mouse.y, H-40);
    ship.x += (tx-ship.x)*Math.min(1,dt*12);
    ship.y += (ty-ship.y)*Math.min(1,dt*12);
    ship.tilt += (clamp((tx-ship.x)*0.02,-0.4,0.4) - ship.tilt)*Math.min(1,dt*8);
    mouse.active = true;
  }
  ship.x = clamp(ship.x, 30, W-30);
  ship.y = clamp(ship.y, H*0.42, H-40);

  // firing
  ship.cooldown -= dt;
  const wantFire = keys[' '] || mouse.down || pointerDown;
  if(wantFire && ship.cooldown<=0 && state.phase==='playing'){
    fireBullet(ship.x, ship.y-22, 0, -640, false, '#7ff0ff', 4);
    ship.cooldown = 0.13;
  }

  // spawning
  if(state.waveActive){
    state.spawnTimer += dt;
    while(state.spawnQueue.length && state.spawnQueue[0].delay <= state.spawnTimer){
      spawnActor(state.spawnQueue.shift().type);
    }
  }

  // update actors
  for(const a of actors){
    if(a.dead) continue;
    a.age += dt;
    if(a.flash>0) a.flash -= dt;
    if(a.type==='spark'){
      a.life -= dt;
      a.vx *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
      a.vy *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
      if(a.life<=0) a.dead=true;
      continue;
    }
    a.x += a.vx*dt;
    a.y += a.vy*dt;
    if(a.type==='drone') a.spin += dt*2;
    if(a.type==='raider') a.spin += dt*3;
    if(a.type==='boss')  a.spin += dt*0.6;

    // hostile fire
    if(a.hostile === undefined && (a.type==='drone'||a.type==='raider'||a.type==='cruiser'||a.type==='boss')){
      if(a.y>0 && a.y < ship.y - 30 && Math.random() < (a.type==='boss'?0.02 : 0.008)){
        const dx = ship.x - a.x, dy = ship.y - a.y, d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const s = a.type==='boss'?170:150;
        fireBullet(a.x, a.y, dx/d*s, dy/d*s, true, a.color, 4);
      }
    }

    // off-screen
    if(a.y > H+60 || a.y < -80 || a.x < -60 || a.x > W+60){
      if(a.type!=='bullet' && a.type!=='spark'){
        // alien escaped (no penalty, just remove)
        a.dead = true;
      } else {
        a.dead = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // collisions
  for(const a of actors){
    if(a.dead) continue;
    if(a.type==='bullet'){
      if(!a.hostile){
        for(const b of actors){
          if(b.dead || b===a || b.type==='bullet' || b.type==='spark') continue;
          if(collide(a,b)){
            b.hp -= 1; b.flash = 0.12; a.dead=true;
            addExplosion(a.x,a.y,'#aef',0.5);
            if(b.hp<=0){
              b.dead=true;
              const pts = b.type==='boss'?50 : b.type==='cruiser'?25 : b.type==='raider'?15 : 10;
              state.score += pts;
              addExplosion(b.x,b.y,b.color, b.type==='boss'?1.6:1);
              state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, b.type==='boss'?10:4);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      } else {
        if(state.invuln<=0 && collide(a, ship)){
          a.dead = true;
          loseLife();
        }
      }
    } else if(a.type==='spark'){
      // sparks pass through
    } else {
      // alien vs ship
      if(state.invuln<=0 && collide(a, ship)){
        a.dead = true;
        addExplosion(a.x,a.y,a.color,1);
        loseLife();
      }
    }
  }

  // cleanup
  for(let i=actors.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(actors[i].dead) actors.splice(i,1);

  // wave complete?
  if(state.phase==='playing' && state.waveActive && state.spawnQueue.length===0){
    const alive = actors.some(a=>!a.dead && a.type!=='bullet' && a.type!=='spark');
    if(!alive){
      state.waveActive = false;
      if(state.score >= 1000){
        state.phase='win'; state.winTimer=0;
      } else if(state.wave >= 5){
        state.waveActive = false;
        state.message='ALL WAVES CLEARED'; state.messageTimer=3;
        state.phase='win'; state.winTimer=0;
      } else {
        setTimeout(()=>{ if(state.phase==='playing') startWave(state.wave+1); }, 1200);
      }
    }
  }

  if(state.phase==='win') state.winTimer += dt;
}

function loseLife(){
  state.lives -= 1;
  state.invuln = 2.2;
  state.hitFlash = 1;
  state.shake = 14;
  addExplosion(ship.x, ship.y, '#8fe9ff', 1.3);
  if(state.lives<=0){
    state.phase='over';
  }
}

/* ---------- DRAW ---------- */
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1230');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0a0f24');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#05070f');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // nebula
  const neb = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.7,H*0.25,10, W*0.7,H*0.25,Math.max(W,H)*0.5);
  neb.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,60,180,0.28)');
  neb.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=neb; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const neb2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.2,H*0.7,10, W*0.2,H*0.7,Math.max(W,H)*0.45);
  neb2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(30,120,150,0.22)');
  neb2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=neb2; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars (deterministic)
  ctx.save();
  for(let i=0;i<140;i++){
    const sx = (i*137.5) % W;
    const sy = (i*89.3) % H;
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time*1.5 + i));
    const s = (i%7===0)?2.2:1.2;
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw*0.9;
    ctx.fillStyle = i%11===0 ? '#bfe6ff' : '#ffffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx,sy,s,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawShip(){
  const blink = state.invuln>0 && Math.floor(state.time*12)%2===0;
  if(blink) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
  ctx.rotate(ship.tilt);
  // engine glow
  const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,26,2,0,26,34);
  eg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,220,255,0.9)');
  eg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,220,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=eg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,26,34,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#2b4a7a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-30); ctx.lineTo(16,10); ctx.lineTo(24,24); ctx.lineTo(10,20);
  ctx.lineTo(0,30); ctx.lineTo(-10,20); ctx.lineTo(-24,24); ctx.lineTo(-16,10);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fb8ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-30); ctx.lineTo(8,4); ctx.lineTo(-8,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#dff6ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-8,5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  // wing accents
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5fe0ff'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-16,10); ctx.lineTo(-24,24); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16,10); ctx.lineTo(24,24); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawAlien(a){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(a.x,a.y);
  ctx.rotate(a.spin||0);
  const c = a.color;
  if(a.type==='drone'){
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ const ang=i/6*TAU; const x=Math.cos(ang)*a.r, y=Math.sin(ang)*a.r;
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#0a1230'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  } else if(a.type==='raider'){
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-a.r); ctx.lineTo(a.r,0); ctx.lineTo(0,a.r); ctx.lineTo(-a.r,0);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a0a20'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.35,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.15,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  } else if(a.type==='cruiser'){
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7a5a10'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.6,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2a2005'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.12,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  } else { // boss
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ const ang=i/8*TAU; const rr = i%2? a.r*0.7 : a.r;
      const x=Math.cos(ang)*rr, y=Math.sin(ang)*rr;
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#200510'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.22,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r*0.1,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  if(a.flash>0){ ctx.globalAlpha=0.7; ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,a.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha=1; }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawActor(a){
  if(a.type==='bullet'){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.5; ctx.fillStyle=a.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x - a.vx*0.02, a.y - a.vy*0.02, a.r*1.6,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1; ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  } else if(a.type==='spark'){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(a.life/a.max,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle=a.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  } else {
    drawAlien(a);
  }
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font='bold 20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf2ff'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+state.score, 20, 18);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb4d8';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE  '+state.wave, 20, 46);
  ctx.fillStyle='#7fe0ff';
  ctx.fillText('TARGET  1000', 20, 72);

  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const x = W-40 - i*34, y = 30;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(0.5,0.5);
    if(i<state.lives){
      ctx.fillStyle='#2b4a7a';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-30); ctx.lineTo(16,10); ctx.lineTo(24,24); ctx.lineTo(10,20);
      ctx.lineTo(0,30); ctx.lineTo(-10,20); ctx.lineTo(-24,24); ctx.lineTo(-16,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#8fb8ff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-30); ctx.lineTo(8,4); ctx.lineTo(-8,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.strokeStyle='#3a4a6a'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-30); ctx.lineTo(16,10); ctx.lineTo(24,24); ctx.lineTo(10,20);
      ctx.lineTo(0,30); ctx.lineTo(-10,20); ctx.lineTo(-24,24); ctx.lineTo(-16,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if(state.messageTimer>0){
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(state.messageTimer/2.2,0,1);
    ctx.font='bold 40px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle='#7ff0ff'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(state.message, W/2, H*0.3);
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPanel(title, lines, btn){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,8,20,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const px = Math.min(520, W-40), py = Math.min(360, H-40);
  const x = (W-px)/2, y=(H-py)/2;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,18,40,0.95)';
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5fe0ff'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.fillRect(x,y,px,py); ctx.strokeRect(x,y,px,py);
  ctx.fillStyle='#7ff0ff'; ctx.font='bold 44px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, y+70);
  ctx.fillStyle='#cfe0ff'; ctx.font='20px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  let yy = y+120;
  for(const ln of lines){ ctx.fillText(ln, W/2, yy); yy+=30; }
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a'; ctx.font='bold 22px Trebuchet MS, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(btn, W/2, y+py-34);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){
    ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake,state.shake), rand(-state.shake,state.shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  for(const a of actors) drawActor(a);
  if(state.phase!=='over') drawShip();

  if(state.hitFlash>0){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,80,90,'+(state.hitFlash*0.35)+')';
    ctx.fillRect(-30,-30,W+60,H+60);
  }
  ctx.restore();

  if(state.phase==='playing') drawHUD();
  else if(state.phase==='title'){
    drawPanel('STAR CORSAIR',
      ['Your ship holds the bottom of the screen.',
       'Fire on the alien waves above. Dodge their return fire.',
       'Reach 1000 points to win the sector.',
       ''],
      'Click or press SPACE to set sail');
  }
  else if(state.phase==='over'){
    drawPanel('SHIP LOST',
      ['The sector fell to the invaders.',
       'Final score:  '+state.score,
       'You reached wave  '+state.wave,
       ''],
      'Press R or SPACE to retry');
  }
  else if(state.phase==='win'){
    drawPanel('SECTOR CLEARED',
      ['The alien fleet is scattered.',
       'Final score:  '+state.score,
       'You held through wave  '+state.wave,
       ''],
      'Press R or SPACE to play again');
  }
}

/* ---------- LOOP ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt = (now-last)/1000; last = now;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  if(state.phase==='playing') update(dt);
  else { state.time += dt; if(state.messageTimer>0) state.messageTimer-=dt; }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Badlands Laser</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04121a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace}
  canvas{max-width:100%;max-height:100vh;box-shadow:0 0 40px #000}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="540"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state = 'start';      // start | play | win | lose
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let time = 0;
let flash = 0;

const player = { x: W/2, y: H-70 };
const targets = [];       // {x,y,vx,vy,r,kind,spin,rot}
const bullets = [];       // {x,y,vx,vy,r,life}
const sparks  = [];       // {x,y,vx,vy,life,max,col}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space') {
    if (state === 'start') startGame();
    else if (state === 'win' || state === 'lose') resetGame();
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  if (e.code === 'KeyR' && (state === 'play' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose')) resetGame();
});

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }

function startGame(){
  state = 'play';
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  targets.length = 0; bullets.length = 0; sparks.length = 0;
  spawnTimer = 0.6;
}
function resetGame(){ state = 'start'; targets.length=0; bullets.length=0; sparks.length=0; }

let spawnTimer = 0;
function spawnTarget(){
  const kind = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'disc' : 'ship';
  const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
  const y = rand(70, H-160);
  const speed = rand(70, 150);
  const r = kind === 'disc' ? 26 : 30;
  const vx = (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * speed;
  const vy = rand(-30, 30);
  targets.push({ x: fromLeft ? -40 : W+40, y, vx, vy, r, kind, spin: rand(0,6.28), rot:0 });
}

function fire(){
  const a = -Math.PI/2;
  bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y-20, vx: Math.cos(a)*620, vy: Math.sin(a)*620, r:4, life:1.4 });
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    sparks.push({ x:player.x, y:player.y-20, vx:rand(-60,60), vy:rand(-160,-40), life:rand(.2,.4), max:.4, col:'#9fe8ff' });
  }
}

function boom(x,y,col){
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const a = rand(0,6.28), s = rand(40,220);
    sparks.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*s, vy:Math.sin(a)*s, life:rand(.3,.7), max:.7, col });
  }
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  time += dt;
  if (flash > 0) flash -= dt*3;

  if (state === 'play'){
    // spawn
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    const difficulty = 1 + score*0.03;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0){
      spawnTarget();
      spawnTimer = Math.max(0.35, 1.1 - difficulty*0.05);
    }
    // fire on space (edge handled by holding check)
    if (keys.space) {
      if (fireCd <= 0){ fire(); fireCd = 0.28; }
    }
    fireCd -= dt;
  }
  // move targets
  for (let i = targets.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const t = targets[i];
    t.x += t.vx*dt; t.y += t.vy*dt;
    t.rot += t.spin*dt;
    if (state === 'play'){
      // reached the player line -> lose a life
      if (t.y > player.y - t.r){
        targets.splice(i,1);
        lives--; flash = 1;
        boom(t.x, player.y-10, '#ff5a5a');
        if (lives <= 0) state = 'lose';
        continue;
      }
      if (t.x < -80 || t.x > W+80) { targets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    } else {
      if (t.x < -80 || t.x > W+80) targets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  // move bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt; b.life -= dt;
    if (b.life <= 0 || b.y < -20) { bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // collide
    if (state === 'play'){
      for (let j = targets.length-1; j >= 0; j--){
        const t = targets[j];
        const dx = b.x-t.x, dy = b.y-t.y;
        if (dx*dx+dy*dy < (t.r+b.r)*(t.r+b.r)){
          targets.splice(j,1);
          bullets.splice(i,1);
          score++;
          boom(t.x, t.y, t.kind==='disc' ? '#ffd25a' : '#7dffd0');
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // sparks
  for (let i = sparks.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const s = sparks[i];
    s.x += s.vx*dt; s.y += s.vy*dt; s.vy += 300*dt; s.life -= dt;
    if (s.life <= 0) sparks.splice(i,1);
  }
}
let fireCd = 0;
const keys = { space:false };
addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code==='Space') keys.space = true; });
addEventListener('keyup',   e => { if (e.code==='Space') keys.space = false; });

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawBackground(){
  // sky
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a2233');
  g.addColorStop(0.6,'#123a52');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0e2a3a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  for (let i=0;i<40;i++){
    const x = (i*137)%W, y = (i*89)% (H*0.5);
    const tw = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(time*3 + i);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + tw*0.5;
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // ground / battlefield
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a4a4a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,H-70);
  for (let x=0;x<=W;x+=40){
    ctx.lineTo(x, H-70 + Math.sin(x*0.02)*8);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,H); ctx.lineTo(0,H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f3338';
  ctx.fillRect(0,H-24,W,24);
}

function drawTarget(t){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(t.x, t.y);
  if (t.kind === 'disc'){
    ctx.rotate(t.rot*0.3);
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,210,90,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,t.r+8,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c98a2e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,t.r,t.r*0.5,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf5a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-3,t.r*0.7,t.r*0.28,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7a4a12';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,4,t.r*0.5,t.r*0.18,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.rotate(t.rot*0.15);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(125,255,208,0.22)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,t.r+8,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    // saucer ship
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f6f6a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,t.r,t.r*0.55,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#59d6c4';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-6,t.r*0.55,t.r*0.3,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e2f2c';
    for (let k=-1;k<=1;k++){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(k*t.r*0.4, 2, 4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const p = player;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
  // turret glow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(159,232,255,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-10,34,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // base
  ctx.fillStyle = '#274b57';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-30,14); ctx.lineTo(30,14); ctx.lineTo(20,-6); ctx.lineTo(-20,-6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3f7d8c';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18,-6); ctx.lineTo(18,-6); ctx.lineTo(10,-24); ctx.lineTo(-10,-24); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // barrel
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe8ff';
  ctx.fillRect(-3,-40,6,20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e6fbff';
  ctx.fillRect(-2,-40,4,6);
  // dome
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd8ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-24,8,Math.PI,0); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullets(){
  for (const b of bullets){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(159,232,255,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r+4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eaffff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawSparks(){
  for (const s of sparks){
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, s.life/s.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = s.col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHud(){
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 20, 32);
  // lives
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('SHIELDS', W-20, 26);
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle = i < lives ? '#59d6c4' : '#22404a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-20 - i*24, 44, 8,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawOverlay(title, sub, color){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,18,26,0.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = 'bold 54px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 20);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfeef2';
  ctx.font = '20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 24);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe8ff';
  ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play   ·   SPACE to fire', W/2, H/2 + 60);
}

function draw(){
  drawBackground();
  for (const t of targets) drawTarget(t);
  if (state !== 'start') drawPlayer();
  drawBullets();
  drawSparks();
  if (state === 'play') drawHud();

  if (flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,60,'+(flash*0.35)+')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  if (state === 'start')    drawOverlay('BADLANDS LASER','Defend the base — shoot the raiders before they land','#7dffd0');
  if (state === 'win')      drawOverlay('VICTORY','You cleared the wave.  Score ' + score,'#ffd25a');
  if (state === 'lose')     drawOverlay('BASE DESTROYED','The raiders got through.  Score ' + score,'#ff6b6b');
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Defender II</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #0a0614;
    color: #cfe6ff;
    font-family: "Courier New", monospace;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    background: #000;
    border: 2px solid #2b2450;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px #1a1040, inset 0 0 20px #0a0620;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="640" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---------- STATE ----------
  let state = 'title';   // 'title' | 'play' | 'win' | 'lose'
  let score = 0;
  const GOAL = 10;
  const MAX_LIVES = 3;
  let lives = MAX_LIVES;
  let invuln = 0;
  let fireCooldown = 0;
  let time = 0;

  const player = { x: W/2, y: H - 50, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
  const targets = [];
  const bullets = [];
  const particles = [];
  const stars = [];
  const keys = {};
  let mouse = { x: W/2, y: H/2, down: false };
  let nextTarget = 0;

  // ---------- HELPERS ----------
  function rand(a, b){ return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
  function clamp(v, a, b){ return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
  function dist2(ax, ay, bx, by){ const dx = ax-bx, dy = ay-by; return dx*dx + dy*dy; }

  // ---------- INIT ----------
  function makeStars(){
    stars.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++){
      stars.push({ x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H, r: rand(0.4, 1.8), s: rand(0.02, 0.25), p: Math.random()*Math.PI*2 });
    }
  }

  function resetGame(){
    score = 0;
    lives = MAX_LIVES;
    invuln = 0;
    fireCooldown = 0;
    targets.length = 0;
    bullets.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    player.x = W/2;
    player.y = H - 50;
    player.vx = 0;
    player.vy = 0;
    nextTarget = 0;
    state = 'play';
  }

  // ---------- SPAWNING ----------
  function spawnTarget(){
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const y = rand(50, H - 130);
    const speed = rand(40, 95) + score * 1.5;
    const vx = (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * speed;
    const vy = rand(-25, 25);
    const x = fromLeft ? -25 : W + 25;
    const type = Math.random() < 0.25 ? 'big' : 'small';
    targets.push({ x, y, vx, vy, type, t: Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r: type==='big' ? 14 : 9 });
  }

  function spawnBurst(x, y, color, n){
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const sp = rand(20, 120);
      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a)*sp, vy: Math.sin(a)*sp, life: rand(0.4, 0.9), max: 0.9, color, r: rand(1, 3) });
    }
  }

  // ---------- INPUT ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    keys[k] = true;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'arrowup' || k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'arrowright') e.preventDefault();
    if ((state === 'title' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')){
      resetGame();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === 'title' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') resetGame();
  });
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouse.down = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    const t = e.touches[0]; const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
    mouse.down = true;
    if (state === 'title' || state === 'win' || state === 'lose') resetGame();
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    const t = e.touches[0]; const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { mouse.down = false; });

  // ---------- UPDATE ----------
  function update(dt){
    time += dt;

    // stars drift
    for (const s of stars){
      s.x -= s.s * dt * 30;
      if (s.x < 0) { s.x += W; }
    }

    if (state !== 'play'){
      // still animate particles
      updateParticles(dt);
      return;
    }

    // player movement (keyboard)
    const spd = 260;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft'])  player.vx = -spd; else if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) player.vx = spd; else player.vx = 0;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup'])    player.vy = -spd; else if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) player.vy = spd; else player.vy = 0;
    player.x = clamp(player.x + player.vx * dt, 20, W - 20);
    player.y = clamp(player.y + player.vy * dt, 60, H - 25);

    // shooting
    if (fireCooldown > 0) fireCooldown -= dt;
    if ((keys[' '] || mouse.down) && fireCooldown <= 0){
      const dx = mouse.x - player.x;
      const dy = mouse.y - player.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const bs = 520;
      bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 14, vx: dx/d * bs, vy: dy/d * bs, r: 3 });
      fireCooldown = 0.16;
    }

    // bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      if (b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10 || b.y < -10 || b.y > H + 10) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // spawn targets
    nextTarget -= dt;
    const maxTargets = 4 + Math.floor(score / 4);
    if (nextTarget <= 0 && targets.length < maxTargets){
      spawnTarget();
      nextTarget = rand(0.6, 1.4) - Math.min(0.5, score * 0.02);
    }

    // targets
    for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const t = targets[i];
      t.t += dt;
      t.x += t.vx * dt;
      t.y += t.vy * dt;
      if (t.y < 40 || t.y > H - 110) t.vy *= -1;

      // bullet collision
      let hit = false;
      for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--){
        const b = bullets[j];
        if (dist2(t.x, t.y, b.x, b.y) < (t.r + b.r + 3) ** 2){
          hit = true;
          bullets.splice(j, 1);
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hit){
        spawnBurst(t.x, t.y, t.type === 'big' ? '#ff5a5a' : '#ffd36b', t.type === 'big' ? 22 : 14);
        score += t.type === 'big' ? 2 : 1;
        targets.splice(i, 1);
        if (score >= GOAL){ state = 'win'; }
        continue;
      }

      // reached player
      if (invuln <= 0 && dist2(t.x, t.y, player.x, player.y) < (t.r + 16) ** 2){
        spawnBurst(player.x, player.y, '#7ad7ff', 30);
        targets.splice(i, 1);
        lives -= 1;
        invuln = 1.6;
        if (lives <= 0){ state = 'lose'; }
        continue;
      }

      // off screen (missed)
      if (t.x < -40 || t.x > W + 40){
        targets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    if (invuln > 0) invuln -= dt;

    updateParticles(dt);
  }

  function updateParticles(dt){
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vx *= 0.96;
      p.vy *= 0.96;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- DRAW ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    // sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0620');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#160a34');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#241040');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // nebula blobs
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a1f6e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W*0.25, H*0.3, 120, 70, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f4a6e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W*0.75, H*0.6, 150, 90, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // stars
    for (const s of stars){
      const tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 2 + s.p);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + tw * 0.7;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#dfe8ff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // planet
    const px = W*0.82, py = H*0.22, pr = 42;
    const pg = ctx.createRadialGradient(px - 12, py - 12, 4, px, py, pr);
    pg.addColorStop(0, '#8fd0ff');
    pg.addColorStop(0.6, '#2f6fb0');
    pg.addColorStop(1, '#12345e');
    ctx.fillStyle = pg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, pr, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,220,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py, pr + 14, pr*0.35, -0.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 60, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, '#1a0f30');
    gg.addColorStop(1, '#0c0720');
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 60, W, 60);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a2a6a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40){
      ctx.lineTo(x, H - 60 + Math.sin(x*0.05 + time)*3);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawPlayer(){
    const blink = invuln > 0 && Math.floor(time * 12) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink) return;
    const x = player.x, y = player.y;
    // aim line
    const dx = mouse.x - x, dy = mouse.y - (y - 14);
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y - 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x + dx/d * 60, y - 14 + dy/d * 60);
    ctx.stroke();

    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(90,200,255,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 24, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5fb8ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y - 20);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 10);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + 6);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 6, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x - 16, y + 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eaf6ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - 4, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // engine flames
    const f = 8 + Math.sin(time * 30) * 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9a3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 6, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + 14 + f);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 6, y + 14);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe07a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 3, y + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + 14 + f*0.6);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y + 14);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawTarget(t){
    const x = t.x, y = t.y, r = t.r;
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t.t * 3);
    const big = t.type === 'big';
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = big ? 'rgba(255,90,90,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,210,110,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r + 6 + pulse*3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = big ? '#ff5a5a' : '#ffd36b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){
      const a = t.t * 0.8 + i * (Math.PI*2/6);
      const rr = r * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(a*3));
      const px = x + Math.cos(a) * rr;
      const py = y + Math.sin(a) * rr;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // eye
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a10';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r*0.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - r*0.12, y - r*0.12, r*0.14, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBullet(b){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#bfe8ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,255,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r + 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawParticle(p){
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 34);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score + ' / ' + GOAL, 14, 22);

    // lives
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('SHIPS', W - 14, 22);
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++){
      const lx = W - 20 - i * 20;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#5fb8ff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(lx, 8);
      ctx.lineTo(lx + 6, 20);
      ctx.lineTo(lx - 6, 20);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, sub, color){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,4,20,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe6ff';
    ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2 + 20);
    const blink = Math.floor(time * 2) % 2 === 0;
    if (blink){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b';
      ctx.font = '16px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    }
  }

  function draw(){
    drawBackground();
    for (const t of targets) drawTarget(t);
    for (const b of bullets) drawBullet(b);
    if (state === 'play') drawPlayer();
    for (const p of particles) drawParticle(p);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    drawHUD();

    if (state === 'title') drawOverlay('DEFENDER II', 'Shoot the invaders before they reach you', '#5fb8ff');
    else if (state === 'win') drawOverlay('YOU WIN', 'Score ' + score + ' — all targets down', '#7ad7ff');
    else if (state === 'lose') drawOverlay('GAME OVER', 'Score ' + score + ' — the invaders got you', '#ff5a5a');
  }

  // ---------- LOOP ----------
  makeStars();
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bank Panic</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #0a0a12; }
  body {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
  }
  #game {
    display: block;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #1a1a2e, 0 0 40px rgba(255,180,0,0.25);
    cursor: crosshair;
    background: #000;
    max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ============ CANVAS ============
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = 900, H = 560;
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;

  // ============ CONSTANTS ============
  const GROUND_Y = 440;
  const PLAYER_X = 90;
  const PLAYER_Y = 470;
  const BULLET_SPEED = 9;
  const WIN_SCORE = 15;
  const START_LIVES = 3;
  const SPAWN_BASE = 1100;
  const SPAWN_MIN = 450;
  const SPAWN_DECAY = 35;

  // ============ STATE ============
  let state = "start";   // start | play | win | lose
  let score = 0;
  let lives = START_LIVES;
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = SPAWN_BASE;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let mouse = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 };
  let shake = 0;
  let flash = 0;

  // ============ ACTOR ARRAYS (all {x,y,vx,vy,...}) ============
  const targets = [];
  const bullets = [];
  const particles = [];
  const popups = [];

  // ============ HELPERS ============
  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  function spawnTarget() {
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -40 : W + 40;
    const y = rand(120, GROUND_Y - 30);
    const speed = rand(0.9, 1.6) + (score / WIN_SCORE) * 0.7;
    const vx = fromLeft ? speed : -speed;
    const type = Math.random() < 0.25 ? "heavy" : "normal";
    targets.push({ x, y, vx, vy: 0, type, r: type === "heavy" ? 26 : 20, hp: type === "heavy" ? 2 : 1, wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2) });
  }

  function shoot() {
    if (state !== "play") return;
    const dx = mouse.x - PLAYER_X;
    const dy = mouse.y - PLAYER_Y;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    bullets.push({ x: PLAYER_X, y: PLAYER_Y - 20, vx: (dx / len) * BULLET_SPEED, vy: (dy / len) * BULLET_SPEED, life: 0 });
  }

  function burst(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
      const s = rand(1, 5);
      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 1, life: rand(20, 45), color, size: rand(2, 5) });
    }
  }

  function popup(x, y, text, color) {
    popups.push({ x, y, vy: -1.2, life: 60, text, color });
  }

  function resetGame() {
    score = 0;
    lives = START_LIVES;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnInterval = SPAWN_BASE;
    targets.length = 0;
    bullets.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    popups.length = 0;
    shake = 0;
    flash = 0;
  }

  // ============ INPUT ============
  canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (e.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === "play") { shoot(); }
    else if (state === "start") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
    else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = e.touches[0];
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouse.x = (t.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
    mouse.y = (t.clientY - r.top) * (H / r.height);
    if (state === "play") { shoot(); }
    else if (state === "start") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
    else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
  }, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") {
      if (state === "start") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
      else if (state === "win" || state === "lose") { resetGame(); state = "play"; }
    }
  });

  // ============ UPDATE ============
  function update(dt) {
    if (state !== "play") {
      // still animate particles / popups in end states
      updateParticles(dt);
      updatePopups(dt);
      return;
    }

    // spawn
    spawnTimer += dt;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      spawnTarget();
      spawnInterval = Math.max(SPAWN_MIN, SPAWN_INTERVAL() - SPAWN_DECAY);
    }

    // move targets
    for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const t = targets[i];
      t.x += t.vx * dt;
      t.y += t.vy * dt;
      t.wobble += 0.1;
      // reached the bank (player side)
      if (t.x < 40 || t.x > W - 40) {
        if (t.x < 40 && t.vx < 0 || t.x > W - 40 && t.vx > 0) {
          // passed the screen edge on the player side
        }
      }
      // target reached the bank zone
      if (Math.abs(t.x - PLAYER_X) < 55 && t.y > PLAYER_Y - 120) {
        // it got to you
        targets.splice(i, 1);
        lives--;
        shake = 14;
        flash = 12;
        burst(PLAYER_X, PLAYER_Y, "#ff3b3b", 26);
        popup(PLAYER_X, PLAYER_Y - 40, "-1 LIFE", "#ff5555");
        if (lives <= 0) { state = "lose"; }
        continue;
      }
      // off screen the far side (escaped)
      if ((t.vx < 0 && t.x < -60) || (t.vx > 0 && t.x > W + 60)) {
        targets.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // move bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.life += dt;
      if (b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20 || b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20 || b.life > 120) {
        bullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      // collide with targets
      let hit = false;
      for (let j = targets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        const t = targets[j];
        const d = Math.hypot(b.x - t.x, b.y - t.y);
        if (d < t.r + 5) {
          t.hp--;
          burst(b.x, b.y, t.type === "heavy" ? "#ffd24a" : "#8ef0c0", 10);
          if (t.hp <= 0) {
            targets.splice(j, 1);
            const pts = t.type === "heavy" ? 3 : 1;
            score += pts;
            popup(t.x, t.y, "+" + pts, "#ffe27a");
            burst(t.x, t.y, t.type === "heavy" ? "#ffb020" : "#5fe0a0", 22);
            if (score >= WIN_SCORE) { state = "win"; }
          }
          hit = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hit) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    updateParticles(dt);
    updatePopups(dt);

    if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
    if (flash > 0) flash -= dt * 0.6;
  }

  function SPAWN_INTERVAL() { return spawnInterval; }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.vy += 0.12 * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function updatePopups(dt) {
    for (let i = popups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = popups[i];
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) popups.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ============ DRAW ============
  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawBank();
    drawPlayer();
    drawTargets();
    drawBullets();
    drawParticles();
    drawPopups();
    drawHUD();

    if (state === "start") drawStart();
    if (state === "win") drawEnd("BANK SAVED!", "#5fe0a0");
    if (state === "lose") drawEnd("BANK PLUNDERED", "#ff5555");

    if (flash > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,60," + Math.min(0.35, flash * 0.03) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // night sky gradient
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#101024");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#1c1c3a");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#2a2140");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 137.5) % W;
      const sy = (i * 71.3) % (GROUND_Y - 60);
      const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.7 + lastTime * 0.001));
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw * 0.8;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // moon
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f4e9c8";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 150, 90, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1c1c3a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 162, 82, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // distant skyline
    ctx.fillStyle = "#241f45";
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const bw = rand(40, 90);
      const bh = rand(40, 130);
      const bx = i * (W / 14) - 20;
      const by = GROUND_Y - bh;
      ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
      // windows
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,120,0.5)";
      for (let wy = by + 8; wy < GROUND_Y - 8; wy += 14) {
        for (let wx = bx + 6; wx < bx + bw - 6; wx += 12) {
          if ((wx * wy) % 3 === 0) ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 4, 6);
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#241f45";
    }

    // ground
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
    gg.addColorStop(0, "#3a2f55");
    gg.addColorStop(1, "#241d38");
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H - GROUND_Y);
    // road lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([18, 14]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y + 60);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y + 60);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  function drawBank() {
    const bx = 20, by = GROUND_Y - 150, bw = 150, bh = 150;
    // building
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5b4a7a";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
    // roof
    ctx.fillStyle = "#7a6699";
    ctx.fillRect(bx - 8, by - 14, bw + 16, 14);
    // columns
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8f7ab0";
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) ctx.fillRect(bx + 12 + i * 34, by + 20, 12, bh - 30);
    // door
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2140";
    ctx.fillRect(bx + bw / 2 - 20, by + bh - 60, 40, 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx + bw / 2 + 10, by + bh - 30, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // sign
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("BANK", bx + bw / 2, by + 14);
    // gold glow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,74,0.12)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const x = PLAYER_X, y = PLAYER_Y;
    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 34, 26, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // body (security guard)
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2e6df0";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 10, 28, 40);
    // head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f0c9a0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 22, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // cap
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a3a80";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 26, 12, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y - 27, 28, 5);
    // badge
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y + 4, 8, 8);
    // gun pointing toward mouse
    const ang = Math.atan2(mouse.y - (y - 20), mouse.x - x);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y - 20);
    ctx.rotate(ang);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(0, -4, 26, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#555";
    ctx.fillRect(22, -6, 8, 12);
    ctx.restore();
    // aim line
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.25)";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 8]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y - 20);
    ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  function drawTargets() {
    for (const t of targets) {
      const wob = Math.sin(t.wobble) * 3;
      const y = t.y + wob;
      const heavy = t.type === "heavy";
      // shadow
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(t.x, y + t.r + 4, t.r * 0.8, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // body
      ctx.fillStyle = heavy ? "#c98a2b" : "#7a4fb0";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, y, t.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // bandit mask
      ctx.fillStyle = "#15151f";
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - t.r * 0.7, y - 6, t.r * 1.4, 12);
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle = heavy ? "#ffe27a" : "#8ef0c0";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x - 7, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(t.x + 7, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // cap / top
      ctx.fillStyle = heavy ? "#8a5a15" : "#4a2f70";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, y - t.r * 0.5, t.r * 0.55, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // dollar sign
      ctx.fillStyle = heavy ? "#ffe27a" : "#8ef0c0";
      ctx.font = "bold " + (t.r) + "px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("$", t.x, y + t.r * 0.7);
      // hp pips for heavy
      if (heavy) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
        for (let k = 0; k < t.hp; k++) ctx.fillRect(t.x - 10 + k * 10, y - t.r - 8, 6, 4);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawBullets() {
    for (const b of bullets) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,120,0.5)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.lineTo(b.x - b.vx * 1.5, b.y - b.vy * 1.5);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / 45);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawPopups() {
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    for (const p of popups) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life / 30));
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 44);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score + " / " + WIN_SCORE, 18, 29);
    // progress bar
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(230, 14, 200, 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5fe0a0";
    ctx.fillRect(230, 14, 200 * Math.min(1, score / WIN_SCORE), 16);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#555";
    ctx.strokeRect(230, 14, 200, 16);
    // lives
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5555";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    let hearts = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < lives; i++) hearts += "\u2665 ";
    ctx.fillText("LIVES  " + hearts, W - 18, 29);
  }

  function drawStart() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd24a";
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("BANK PANIC", W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8ef0c0";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Stop the robbers before they reach the bank!", W / 2, 235);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9c9e0";
    ctx.font = "18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Move mouse to aim  •  Click to shoot", W / 2, 300);
    ctx.fillText("Score " + WIN_SCORE + " to save the bank. Lose " + START_LIVES + " lives and it's over.", W / 2, 330);
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(lastTime * 0.005);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,120," + pulse + ")";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("CLICK TO START", W / 2, 420);
  }

  function drawEnd(title, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.font = "bold 52px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, 220);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
    ctx.font = "bold 26px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Final score: " + score, W / 2, 280);
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(lastTime * 0.005);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,120," + pulse + ")";
    ctx.font = "bold 24px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, 380);
  }

  // ============ MAIN LOOP ============
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(2.5, (now - lastTime) / 16.67) || 1;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Déjà Vu 1985</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#0a0a12;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-family:'Courier New',monospace;overflow:hidden}
  #game{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;border:4px solid #3a2f52;
    box-shadow:0 0 40px #2a1f44,0 0 120px #1a1230;border-radius:4px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="960" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
/* ============ setup ============ */
const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height;
const FONT="'Courier New',monospace";

/* ============ helpers ============ */
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const pad=(n,w)=>{let s=String(n);while(s.length<w)s='0'+s;return s;};
const rr=(x,y,w,h,r)=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath();};
function wrapText(text,x,y,maxW,lh,font,fill){
  ctx.font=font;ctx.fillStyle=fill;
  let words=String(text).split(' '),line='';
  for(let i=0;i<words.length;i++){
    let test=line?line+' '+words[i]:words[i];
    if(ctx.measureText(test).width>maxW&&line){ctx.fillText(line,x,y);line=words[i];y+=lh;}
    else line=test;
  }
  if(line)ctx.fillText(line,x,y);
}
function shadowText(t,x,y,font,fill,sh,sw){
  ctx.font=font;ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillStyle=sh;ctx.fillText(t,x+sw,y+sw);
  ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fillText(t,x,y);
}
function star(x,y,r,col){
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.beginPath();
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const a=-Math.PI/2+i*2*Math.PI/5;
    const a2=a+Math.PI/5;
    ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+Math.sin(a)*r);
    ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(a2)*r*0.45,y+Math.sin(a2)*r*0.45);
  }
  ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}
function diamond(x,y,r,col){
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x,y-r);ctx.lineTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.lineTo(x-r,y);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}

/* ============ state ============ */
const state={
  scene:'title',
  t:0,
  score:0,
  moves:0,
  key:null,
  doorOpen:false,
  goal:false,
  win:false,
  lose:false,
  msg:null,
  msgTimer:0,
  shake:0,
  lastType:0
};
const KEY={x:330,y:150,vx:0,vy:0,kind:'key',bob:0};
const PLAYER={x:150,y:470,vx:0,vy:0,kind:'player',face:1,step:0};
const DOOR={x:690,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,kind:'door',open:0};
const GOAL={x:815,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,kind:'goal',pulse:0};
const ACTORS=[KEY,PLAYER,DOOR,GOAL];

/* ============ input ============ */
function startGame(){
  Object.assign(state,{scene:'play',score:0,moves:0,key:null,doorOpen:false,goal:false,win:false,lose:false,
    msg:null,msgTimer:0,shake:0});
  Object.assign(PLAYER,{x:150,y:470,vx:0,vy:0,face:1,step:0});
  Object.assign(KEY,{x:330,y:150,vx:0,vy:0,bob:0});
  Object.assign(DOOR,{x:690,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,open:0});
  Object.assign(GOAL,{x:815,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,pulse:0});
}
function failGame(){
  state.lose=true;
  state.msg='THE TIME MACHINE BREAKS!';
  state.msgTimer=3;
  state.shake=14;
  state.score=0;
}
function showMsg(m){state.msg=m;state.msgTimer=2.6;}
function doCommand(cmd){
  cmd=(cmd||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!cmd)return;
  state.moves++;
  const has=state.key==='key';
  if(cmd==='look'){
    showMsg('You stand in the 1985 time-lab. A golden key glints on the shelf. A heavy door blocks the way to the exit.');
  }else if(cmd==='take key'||cmd==='pickup key'||cmd==='get key'||cmd==='pick up key'){
    if(has){showMsg('You already hold the key.');}
    else{state.key='key';state.score+=10;showMsg('You take the golden key. (+10)');}
  }else if(cmd==='unlock door'||cmd==='open door'){
    if(state.doorOpen){showMsg('The door is already open.');}
    else if(has){state.doorOpen=true;state.score+=15;state.shake=5;showMsg('Click! The door unlocks. (+15)');}
    else{showMsg('The door is locked. You need the key.');}
  }else if(cmd==='go through door'||cmd==='go through'||cmd==='go to exit'||cmd==='exit'||cmd==='go to goal'){
    if(state.doorOpen){state.goal=true;state.score+=25;state.shake=6;showMsg('You step through to 2025! (+25)');}
    else{state.shake=6;showMsg('The door is locked. Unlock it first.');}
  }else if(cmd==='help'){
    showMsg('Type: LOOK · TAKE KEY · UNLOCK DOOR · GO THROUGH DOOR');
  }else if(cmd==='quit'){
    state.scene='title';
  }else{
    showMsg('??  I don\'t understand "'+(cmd.length>16?cmd.slice(0,16)+'…':cmd)+'". Type HELP.');
  }
}
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(state.scene==='title'){startGame();}
  else if(state.scene==='end'){state.scene='title';}
});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(state.scene==='title'){
    if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();startGame();}
    return;
  }
  if(state.scene==='end'){
    if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();state.scene='title';}
    return;
  }
  const k=e.key;
  if(k==='Enter'){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(state.input!=null){
      doCommand(state.input);
      state.input='';
    }
    return;
  }
  if(k==='Backspace'){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(state.input!=null&&state.input.length)state.input=state.input.slice(0,-1);
    return;
  }
  if(k.length===1&&/[a-z0-9 ,.!?'\-]/i.test(k)){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(state.input==null)state.input='';
    if(state.input.length<28)state.input+=k.toLowerCase();
    const now=performance.now();
    if(now-state.lastType>1200)state.input='';
    state.lastType=now;
  }
});
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{if(state.input!=null)state.input='';});

/* ============ update ============ */
function update(dt){
  state.t+=dt;
  if(state.shake>0)state.shake=Math.max(0,state.shake-dt*30);
  if(state.msgTimer>0){state.msgTimer-=dt;if(state.msgTimer<=0)state.msg=null;}
  const speed=150;
  if(state.scene==='play'){
    let moving=false;
    if(state.key==='key'){
      KEY.x+=KEY.vx*speed*dt;KEY.y+=KEY.vy*speed*dt;
      if(KEY.vx||KEY.vy)moving=true;
    }
    if(state.goal){
      PLAYER.x+=PLAYER.vx*speed*dt;PLAYER.y+=PLAYER.vy*speed*dt;
      if(PLAYER.vx||PLAYER.vy)moving=true;
      if(!state.win&&PLAYER.x>GOAL.x-18&&Math.abs(PLAYER.y-GOAL.y)<50){
        state.win=true;
        state.score+=50;
        state.msg='YOU WIN!  You reached 2025.  Total: '+state.score+' pts';
        state.msgTimer=999;
        setTimeout(()=>{state.scene='end';},1800);
      }
    }
    if(moving)PLAYER.step+=dt*12;
    DOOR.open+=(state.doorOpen?1:0-DOOR.open)*0; // no-op guard
    DOOR.open=clamp(DOOR.open+(state.doorOpen?1:-1)*dt*2.5,0,1);
    GOAL.pulse+=dt*3;
    KEY.bob+=dt*2;
  }
}

/* ============ draw ============ */
function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#141030');g.addColorStop(0.5,'#1a1440');g.addColorStop(1,'#241a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // stars
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++){
    const x=(i*97)%W, y=(i*53)%250, tw=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(state.t*2+i);
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.25+0.5*tw;
    ctx.fillStyle=i%3?'#cfd8ff':'#ffe9a8';
    ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // floor
  const fg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,360,0,560);
  fg.addColorStop(0,'#2a2150');fg.addColorStop(1,'#1c1636');
  ctx.fillStyle=fg;ctx.fillRect(0,360,W,200);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,100,200,0.25)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=10;i++){
    const x=100+i*80;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,360);ctx.lineTo(x+(x-480)*0.4,560);ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const y=360+i*40;

  gg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(80,255,190,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=gg;ctx.fillRect(GOAL.x-140,GOAL.y-140,280,280);
}
function drawKey(){
  if(state.key!=='key')return;
  const bob=Math.sin(KEY.bob)*4;
  const x=KEY.x,y=KEY.y+bob;
  const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,4,x,y,40);
  glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,215,80,0.5)');glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,215,80,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.fillRect(x-40,y-40,80,80);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-14,y,11,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-3,y);ctx.lineTo(x+26,y);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+16,y);ctx.lineTo(x+16,y+9);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+24,y);ctx.lineTo(x+24,y+7);ctx.stroke();
}
function drawDoor(){
  const x=DOOR.x,y=DOOR.y,w=120,h=170;
  ctx.fillStyle='#241a44';ctx.fillRect(x-14,y-14,w+28,h+28);
  ctx.fillStyle='#120d28';ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  const open=DOOR.open;
  const px=x+4,py=y+4,pw=w-8,ph=h-8;
  if(open>0){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,255,200,'+(0.15+0.2*open)+')';
    ctx.fillRect(px,py,pw,ph);
  }
  const doorW=pw*(1-open);
  const dg=ctx.createLinearGradient(x,0,x+w,0);
  dg.addColorStop(0,'#6b4f2a');dg.addColorStop(0.5,'#8a6a3a');dg.addColorStop(1,'#5a4022');
  ctx.fillStyle=dg;
  rr(x+2,y+2,doorW,h-4,4);ctx.fill();
  if(open<0.95){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#3a2a12';ctx.lineWidth=2;
    for(let i=1;i<4;i++){
      const ly=y+ (h/4)*i;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+2,ly);ctx.lineTo(x+2+doorW,ly);ctx.stroke();
    }
    const hx=x+doorW-16,hy=y+h/2;
    ctx.fillStyle='#e0c060';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(hx,hy,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }
  // frame
  ctx.strokeStyle='#3a2f52';ctx.lineWidth=4;
  ctx.strokeRect(x-14,y-14,w+28,h+28);
  // label
  ctx.font='10px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#8f86c0';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('EXIT 2025',x+w/2,y-22);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function drawGoal(){
  const x=GOAL.x,y=GOAL.y;
  const p=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(GOAL.pulse);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(90,255,200,'+(0.4+0.4*p)+')';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,26+p*6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,14,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#5affc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.font='11px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#8fffd8';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('2025',x,y-44);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function drawPlayer(){
  const x=PLAYER.x,y=PLAYER.y;
  const walk=state.scene==='play'&&(PLAYER.vx||PLAYER.vy);
  const bob=walk?Math.sin(PLAYER.step)*2:0;
  const f=PLAYER.face;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+34,18,6,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle='#2f2a4a';ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.lineCap='round';
  const lo=walk?Math.sin(PLAYER.step)*6:0;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-6,y+14+bob);ctx.lineTo(x-6-lo,y+34);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+6,y+14+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+6+lo,y+34);ctx.stroke();
  // body
  const bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(x-14,y-14,x+14,y+14);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#3f6fd0');bg.addColorStop(1,'#2a4a9a');
  ctx.fillStyle=bg;rr(x-14,y-14+bob,28,30,8);ctx.fill();
  // belt
  ctx.fillStyle='#22305a';ctx.fillRect(x-14,y+6+bob,28,4);
  // arm
  ctx.strokeStyle='#2a4a9a';ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+f*10,y-4+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+f*18,y+8+bob);ctx.stroke();
  if(state.key==='key'){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+f*20,y+8+bob,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+f*22,y+8+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+f*30,y+8+bob);ctx.stroke();
  }
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#f0c9a0';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-24+bob,11,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  // hair
  ctx.fillStyle='#3a2a1a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-26+bob,11,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle='#222';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+f*4,y-24+bob,1.6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
}
function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  // title
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  shadowText('DÉJÀ VU  1985',W/2,34,'bold 30px '+FONT,'#ffe9a8','#3a2f52',3);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  // score
  ctx.font='16px '+FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle='#8f86c0';ctx.fillText('SCORE',24,40);
  shadowText(String(state.score),120,40,'bold 22px '+FONT,'#5affc8','#0a0a12',2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8f86c0';ctx.fillText('MOVES',24,68);
  shadowText(String(state.moves),120,68,'bold 18px '+FONT,'#cfd8ff','#0a0a12',2);
  // objective
  let obj;
  if(state.win)obj='★  YOU WIN!  Welcome to 2025';
  else if(state.goal)obj='★  GOAL!  Walk into the 2025 portal  (arrows)';
  else if(state.doorOpen)obj='★  Door unlocked!  Type:  GO THROUGH DOOR';
  else if(state.key==='key')obj='★  You have the key.  Type:  UNLOCK DOOR';
  else obj='★  Find the key.  Type:  TAKE KEY';
  ctx.font='bold 15px '+FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a12';ctx.fillText(obj,26,104);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe9a8';ctx.fillText(obj,24,102);
  // input bar
  const bx=24,by=H-58,bw=W-48,bh=34;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,24,0.85)';rr(bx,by,bw,bh,8);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#3a2f52';ctx.lineWidth=2;rr(bx,by,bw,bh,8);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font='14px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#6f68a0';
  ctx.fillText('>',bx+12,by+bh/2);
  const txt=state.input!=null?state.input:'';
  const cursor=state.input!=null&&Math.floor(state.t*2)%2===0;
  ctx.font='bold 17px '+FONT;
  ctx.fillStyle='#e8f0ff';
  ctx.fillText(txt,bx+34,by+bh/2);
  if(cursor){
    const tw=ctx.measureText(txt).width;
    ctx.fillStyle='#5affc8';ctx.fillRect(bx+34+tw+2,by+8,2,bh-16);
  }
  ctx.font='12px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#6f68a0';
  ctx.fillText('ENTER to run  ·  HELP for commands',bx,by+bh+18);
  // message
  if(state.msg){
    ctx.font='bold 15px '+FONT;
    const mw=ctx.measureText(state.msg).width;
    const mx=clamp(W/2-mw/2,10,W-mw-10);
    const my=128;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,8,24,0.9)';rr(mx-10,my-14,mw+20,30,6);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#3a2f52';ctx.lineWidth=2;rr(mx-10,my-14,mw+20,30,6);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=state.lose?'#ff8f8f':'#ffe9a8';
    ctx.fillText(state.msg,mx,my);
  }
}
function drawTitle(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a12';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#1a1440');g.addColorStop(1,'#2a1f52');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(let i=0;i<80;i++){
    const x=(i*131)%W,y=(i*77)%H;
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+0.5*Math.sin(state.t*2+i);
    ctx.fillStyle=i%4?'#cfd8ff':'#ffe9a8';ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // time portal
  const cx=W/2,cy=300;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const r=40+i*22, rot=state.t*(i%2?0.4:-0.3);
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(90,255,200,'+(0.5-i*0.06)+')';ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,rot,rot+Math.PI*1.6);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='#5affc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,10,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  // key
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd23f';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.lineCap='round';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-90,cy+120,9,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-83,cy+120);ctx.lineTo(cx-52,cy+120);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-60,cy+120);ctx.lineTo(cx-60,cy+128);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-70,cy+120);ctx.lineTo(cx-70,cy+126);ctx.stroke();
  // title
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  shadowText('DÉJÀ VU',cx,150,'bold 64px '+FONT,'#ffe9a8','#2a1f52',5);
  shadowText('1 9 8 5',cx,205,'bold 30px '+FONT,'#8fffd8','#2a1f52',3);
  ctx.font='15px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#8f86c0';
  ctx.fillText('A one-screen time-travel adventure',cx,250);
  ctx.font='13px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#6f68a0';
  ctx.fillText('Take the key.  Unlock the door.  Step into 2025.',cx,470);
  const blink=Math.floor(state.t*2)%2===0;
  if(blink){
    ctx.fillStyle='#5affc8';ctx.font='bold 22px '+FONT;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  OR  CLICK  TO  START',cx,540);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function drawEnd(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a12';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0f2a24');g.addColorStop(1,'#1a1440');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(let i=0;i<50;i++){
    const x=(i*151)%W,y=(i*97)%H;
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+0.5*Math.sin(state.t*2+i);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fffd8';ctx.fillRect(x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  shadowText('★  YOU  WIN  ★',W/2,200,'bold 56px '+FONT,'#5affc8','#0a0a12',5);
  shadowText('You reached 2025',W/2,260,'bold 24px '+FONT,'#ffe9a8','#0a0a12',3);
  ctx.font='16px '+FONT;ctx.fillStyle='#8f86c0';
  ctx.fillText('Final score:  '+state.score+'  ·  commands:  '+state.moves,W/2,340);
  const blink=Math.floor(state.t*2)%2===0;
  if(blink){
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fffd8';ctx.font='bold 20px '+FONT;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS  ENTER  OR  CLICK  TO  PLAY  AGAIN',W/2,440);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}
function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){
    ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake,state.shake),rand(-state.shake,state.shake));
  }
  if(state.scene==='title'){drawTitle();}
  else if(state.scene==='end'){drawEnd();}
  else{
    drawBackground();
    drawKey();
    drawDoor();
    drawGoal();
    drawPlayer();
    drawHUD();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============ loop ============ */
let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000);
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
