<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Guerilla War</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,560px);height:min(92vh,760px);background:#000;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #143055,0 0 40px #0af2;touch-action:none;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="320" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
const W = cvs.width, H = cvs.height;

let state = 'start';
let score = 0, lives = 3, wave = 0;
let spawnTimer = 0, waveTimer = 0, shake = 0;
let last = 0;

const ship = { x: W/2, y: H-40, vx: 0, vy: 0, w: 26, h: 22, cooldown: 0, inv: 0 };
const bullets = [];
const enemies = [];
const ebullets = [];
const parts = [];
const stars = [];
for (let i=0;i<70;i++) stars.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, s:Math.random()*1.6+0.4, d:Math.random()*2+1});

const keys = {};
let fireHeld = false, touchFire = false, touchL = false, touchR = false;

function reset(){
  score=0; lives=3; wave=0;
  bullets.length=0; enemies.length=0; ebullets.length=0; parts.length=0;
  ship.x=W/2; ship.y=H-40; ship.vx=0; ship.vy=0; ship.cooldown=0; ship.inv=0;
  spawnTimer=0.5; waveTimer=0; shake=0;
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  const t = Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
  const speed = 40 + wave*6 + Math.random()*30;
  enemies.push({ x: Math.random()*(W-40)+20, y: -24, vx: 0, vy: speed,
    w:22, h:20, t: t, fire: Math.random()*1.5+0.6, hp: 1, ph: Math.random()*6.28 });
}

function boom(x,y,c,n){
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.28, sp = Math.random()*120+30;
    parts.push({x, y, vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp, life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5, max:1, c});
  }
}

function hitShip(){
  if (ship.inv>0) return;
  lives--; shake=12; boom(ship.x, ship.y, '#ff5533', 26);
  if (lives<=0){ state='over'; }
  else { ship.inv=1.6; }
}

function update(dt){
  for (const s of stars){ s.y += s.d*8*dt; if (s.y>H){ s.y=0; s.x=Math.random()*W; } }
  for (let i=parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const p=parts[i]; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vy+=60*dt; p.life-=dt; if(p.life<=0) parts.splice(i,1); }
  if (shake>0) shake -= dt*40;

  if (state==='start'){ return; }
  if (state==='over'){ return; }

  // ship
  let ax=0, ay=0;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']||touchL) ax=-1;
  if (keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']||touchR) ax=1;
  if (keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']) ay=-1;
  if (keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']) ay=1;
  ship.vx += ax*1400*dt; ship.vy += ay*1400*dt;
  ship.vx *= Math.pow(0.0009, dt); ship.vy *= Math.pow(0.0009, dt);
  ship.x += ship.vx*dt; ship.y += ship.vy*dt;
  ship.x = Math.max(16, Math.min(W-16, ship.x));
  ship.y = Math.max(40, Math.min(H-24, ship.y));
  if (ship.inv>0) ship.inv -= dt;
  ship.cooldown -= dt;
  if ((fireHeld||touchFire||keys[' ']) && ship.cooldown<=0){
    bullets.push({x:ship.x, y:ship.y-14, vx:0, vy:-420, w:4, h:12});
    ship.cooldown = 0.16;
  }

  // spawn
  spawnTimer -= dt;
  if (spawnTimer<=0 && enemies.length<14){ spawnEnemy(); spawnTimer = Math.max(0.35, 1.1 - wave*0.05); }
  waveTimer += dt;
  if (waveTimer>12){ wave++; waveTimer=0; }

  // bullets
  for (let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const b=bullets[i]; b.y+=b.vy*dt; if(b.y<-20) bullets.splice(i,1); }
  for (let i=ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const b=ebullets[i]; b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt; if(b.y>H+20||b.x<-20||b.x>W+20) ebullets.splice(i,1); }

  // enemies
  for (let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=enemies[i];
    e.y += e.vy*dt;
    e.x += Math.sin(e.y*0.05 + e.ph)*0.6;
    e.fire -= dt;
    if (e.fire<=0 && e.y>0 && e.y<H-60){
      e.fire = 1.4 + Math.random()*1.6;
      const dx = ship.x-e.x, dy = ship.y-e.y, d = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      const sp = 150 + wave*8;
      ebullets.push({x:e.x, y:e.y+10, vx:dx/d*sp, vy:dy/d*sp, w:6, h:6});
    }
    if (e.y>H+20){ enemies.splice(i,1); continue; }

    // bullet hits
    for (let j=bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const b=bullets[j];
      if (Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<e.w/2+2 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<e.h/2+6){
        bullets.splice(j,1); e.hp--;
        if (e.hp<=0){ enemies.splice(i,1); score += 10*(e.t===2?3:1); boom(e.x,e.y, e.t===2?'#ff8833':'#7CFC00', 18); }
        break;
      }
    }
    if (i>=enemies.length || enemies[i]!==e) continue;

    // hit ship
    if (ship.inv<=0 && Math.abs(e.x-ship.x)<(e.w+ship.w)/2 && Math.abs(e.y-ship.y)<(e.h+ship.h)/2){
      enemies.splice(i,1); boom(e.x,e.y,'#7CFC00',14); hitShip(); continue;
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets hit ship
  for (let i=ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=ebullets[i];
    if (ship.inv<=0 && Math.abs(b.x-ship.x)<(b.w+ship.w)/2 && Math.abs(b.y-ship.y)<(b.h+ship.h)/2){
      ebullets.splice(i,1); hitShip();
    }
  }
}

function drawShip(){
  const x=ship.x, y=ship.y;
  if (ship.inv>0 && Math.floor(ship.inv*20)%2===0) return;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.fillStyle='#20304a'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-14); ctx.lineTo(13,10); ctx.lineTo(7,14); ctx.lineTo(-7,14); ctx.lineTo(-13,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#5aa0ff'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-12); ctx.lineTo(9,9); ctx.lineTo(-9,9); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#dfefff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-2,3,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff7733'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6,14); ctx.lineTo(-9,20); ctx.lineTo(-3,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(6,14); ctx.lineTo(9,20); ctx.lineTo(3,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);
  const pulse = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(e.y*0.15+e.ph);
  if (e.t===0){
    ctx.fillStyle='#3f8f2f'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,11,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#7CFC00'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,7,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#04220a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-3,-1,2.5,0,6.28); ctx.arc(3,-1,2.5,0,6.28); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle='#8f2f3f'; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-12); ctx.lineTo(11,4); ctx.lineTo(0,12); ctx.lineTo(-11,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff4d4d'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,-8); ctx.lineTo(7,3); ctx.lineTo(0,8); ctx.lineTo(-7,3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe0e0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,2,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle='#3f3f8f'; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-12); ctx.lineTo(12,0); ctx.lineTo(0,12); ctx.lineTo(-12,0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8833'; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-7); ctx.lineTo(7,0); ctx.lineTo(0,7); ctx.lineTo(-7,0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  ctx.save();
  if (shake>0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);

  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#04122a'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0a1e3f'); g.addColorStop(1,'#123055');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);
  for (const s of stars){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,220,255,'+(0.3+s.s*0.3)+')'; ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.s,s.s); }

  for (const b of bullets){ ctx.fillStyle='#eaffc0'; ctx.fillRect(b.x-2,b.y-6,4,12); ctx.fillStyle='#8fdfff'; ctx.fillRect(b.x-1,b.y-6,2,12); }
  for (const b of ebullets){ ctx.fillStyle='#ff5533'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,4,0,6.28); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#ffd0a0'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,1.8,0,6.28); ctx.fill(); }

    ctx.fillText('ARROWS / WASD : MOVE', W/2, H/2+30);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Solar Quest</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04030f;overflow:hidden}
  body{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Courier New",monospace}
  canvas{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #12102a,0 0 55px rgba(0,200,255,.28),inset 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    border-radius:6px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

/* ---------- canvas ---------- */
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const GROUND = H - 52;

/* ---------- game state ---------- */
const state = {
  scene: "title",
  wave: 1,
  score: 0,
  lives: 3,
  shipX: W / 2,
  shipY: GROUND - 34,
  fireCd: 0,
  waveCd: 2,
  shake: 0,
  flash: 0,
  time: 0,
  msg: "",
  msgT: 0,
  msgC: "#ffe066"
};

/* ---------- actor arrays (all actors live in one array of {x,y,vx,vy}) ---------- */
const actors = [];
const bullets = [];
const particles = [];
const stars = [];
const keys = {};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v);
const dist2 = (a, b) => { const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y; return dx * dx + dy * dy; };

function spawn(x, y, vx, vy, kind, r, color, hp) {
  const a = { x, y, vx, vy, kind, r, color, hp, maxhp: hp, rot: rand(0, 6.28), rotv: rand(-1.5, 1.5), flash: 0, dead: false };
  actors.push(a);
  return a;
}

function spawnWave() {
  const n = Math.min(5 + state.wave, 10);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const x = 55 + (W - 110) * (i / Math.max(1, n - 1));
    const y = 70 + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * 22;
    const r = 16 + Math.random() * 6;
    const color = i % 3 === 0 ? "#ff7a3c" : (i % 3 === 1 ? "#8be04a" : "#46e6ff");
    const a = spawn(x, y, 0, 0, "alien", r, color, 2);
    a.baseX = x;
    a.t = rand(0, 6.28);
    a.spd = rand(0.5, 1.0);
    a.fireT = rand(0.6, 2.4);
  }
}

function fireBullet(x, y, vx, vy, color, r) {
  bullets.push({ x, y, vx, vy, color, r, dead: false });
}

function burst(x, y, color, n, spd) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = rand(0, 6.28), s = rand(spd * 0.3, spd);
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: rand(0.4, 0.9), max: 0.9, color, size: rand(1.5, 3.5) });
  }
}

function setMsg(t, c) { state.msg = t; state.msgC = c; state.msgT = 2.2; }

function startGame() {
  actors.length = 0;
  bullets.length = 0;
  particles.length = 0;
  state.wave = 1;
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = 3;
  state.shipX = W / 2;
  state.fireCd = 0;
  state.waveCd = 1.5;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.flash = 0;
  spawnWave();
  setMsg("WAVE 1", "#46e6ff");
  state.scene = "play";
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if (k === " " || k === "arrowup" || k === "arrowdown" || k === "arrowleft" || k === "arrowright") e.preventDefault();
  if (state.scene === "title" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) startGame();
  else if (state.scene === "over" && (k === " " || k === "enter")) startGame();
});
addEventListener("keyup", e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

/* ---------- update ---------- */
function update(dt) {
  state.time += dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 2);
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 1.5);
  if (state.msgT > 0) state.msgT -= dt;

  // particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += 30 * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
  }
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);

  if (state.scene !== "play") return;

  // ship movement
  const speed = 270;
  if (keys["arrowleft"] || keys["a"]) state.shipX -= speed * dt;
  if (keys["arrowright"] || keys["d"]) state.shipX += speed * dt;
  state.shipX = clamp(state.shipX, 28, W - 28);

  // firing
  state.fireCd -= dt;
  if ((keys[" "] || keys["arrowup"] || keys["w"]) && state.fireCd <= 0) {
    fireBullet(state.shipX, state.shipY - 14, 0, -520, "#ffe066", 4);
    state.fireCd = 0.18;
  }

  // bullets
  for (const b of bullets) { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; }
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = bullets[i];
    if (b.y < -20 || b.y > H + 20 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W + 20) bullets.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // aliens
  for (const a of actors) {
    if (a.dead) continue;
    a.t += dt * a.spd;
    a.x = a.baseX + Math.sin(a.t) * 62;
    a.y += Math.sin(a.t * 0.7) * 20 * dt;
    a.y += 9 * dt;
    a.x = clamp(a.x, a.r, W - a.r);
    a.y = clamp(a.y, a.r, GROUND - 14);
    a.rot += a.rotv * dt;
    if (a.flash > 0) a.flash -= dt;

    a.fireT -= dt;
    if (a.fireT <= 0) {
      const dx = state.shipX - a.x, dy = state.shipY - a.y;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = 150 + state.wave * 8;
      fireBullet(a.x, a.y, dx / d * sp, dy / d * sp, "#ff5c8a", 4);
      a.fireT = rand(1.6, 3.4) / (0.7 + state.wave * 0.12);
    }
  }

  // collisions: player bullets vs aliens
  for (const b of bullets) {
    if (b.dead) continue;
    for (const a of actors) {
      if (a.dead || b.dead) continue;
      if (dist2(a, b) < (a.r + b.r) * (a.r + b.r)) {
        a.hp -= 1;
        a.flash = 0.15;
        b.dead = true;
        burst(b.x, b.y, "#ffe066", 6, 120);
        if (a.hp <= 0) {
          a.dead = true;
          state.score += 100;
          state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 0.5);
          burst(a.x, a.y, a.color, 20, 200);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  for (let i = actors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (actors[i].dead) actors.splice(i, 1);

  // collisions: alien bullets vs ship
  for (const b of bullets) {
    if (b.dead) continue;
    if (dist2({ x: state.shipX, y: state.shipY }, b) < (18 + b.r) * (18 + b.r)) {
      b.dead = true;
      hitShip();
      break;
    }
  }

  // collisions: aliens vs ship
  for (const a of actors) {
    if (a.dead) continue;
    if (dist2(a, { x: state.shipX, y: state.shipY }) < (a.r + 16) * (a.r + 16)) {
      a.dead = true;
      burst(a.x, a.y, a.color, 18, 190);
      hitShip();
      break;
    }
  }
  for (let i = actors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (actors[i].dead) actors.splice(i, 1);
  for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (bullets[i].dead) bullets.splice(i, 1);

  // next wave
  if (actors.length === 0) {
    state.waveCd -= dt;
    if (state.waveCd <= 0) {
      state.wave += 1;
      spawnWave();
      state.waveCd = 2;
      setMsg("WAVE " + state.wave, "#46e6ff");
    }
  }
}

function hitShip() {
  state.lives -= 1;
  state.shake = 1;
  state.flash = 1;
  burst(state.shipX, state.shipY, "#ff5c8a", 26, 240);
  if (state.lives <= 0) {
    state.scene = "over";
    setMsg("GAME OVER", "#ff5c8a");
  } else {
    state.shipX = W / 2;
    state.fireCd = 0.6;
    setMsg("HULL BREACH!", "#ff5c8a");
  }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0a0620");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "#141033");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#050310");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // sun
  const sx = W * 0.72, sy = 96;
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 4, sx, sy, 120);
  glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,210,120,.9)");
  glow.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,150,70,.35)");
  glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,60,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 120, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe6a0";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 34, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff6d8";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx - 8, sy - 8, 14, 0, 7); ctx.fill();

  // stars
  for (const s of stars) {
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(state.time * s.tw + s.p));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
    ctx.fillStyle = s.c;
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // ground
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0, "#1c2547");
  gg.addColorStop(1, "#0a0e22");
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,230,255,.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND); ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,230,255,.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 24) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawShip() {
  const x = state.shipX, y = state.shipY;
  // thruster flame
  const f = 10 + Math.sin(state.time * 30) * 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,150,60,.8)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 7, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 7, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + 12 + f);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,230,150,.9)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 4, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + 12 + f * 0.6);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b7fd6";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 16, y + 10); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, y + 2); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, y + 12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 16, y + 10); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y + 2); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y + 12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#46e6ff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - 16);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 8, y + 10);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 8, y + 10);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#bff6ff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - 12); ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y + 4); ctx.lineTo(x - 3, y + 4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7a3c";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - 2, 3.4, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
}

function drawAlien(a) {
  const x = a.x, y = a.y, r = a.r;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(a.rot);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  // spikes
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.5)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const ang = i / 6 * 6.283;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(ang) * r, Math.sin(ang) * r);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang) * (r + 6), Math.sin(ang) * (r + 6));
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang + 0.3) * r, Math.sin(ang + 0.3) * r);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0620";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r * 0.42, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.12, -r * 0.12, r * 0.14, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  if (a.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullets() {
  for (const b of bullets) {
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 0.4, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#46e6ff";
  ctx.font = "bold 16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE " + state.score, 14, 26);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("WAVE " + state.wave, W / 2, 26);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("LIVES " + state.lives, W - 14, 26);
  if (state.msgT > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(state.msgT, 0, 1);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle = state.msgC;
    ctx.fillText(state.msg, W / 2, H * 0.42);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawTitle() {
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#46e6ff";
  ctx.font = "bold 44px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SOLAR", W / 2, 210);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff7a3c";
  ctx.fillText("QUEST", W / 2, 258);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8be04a";
  ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("A 1-SCREEN ARCADE", W / 2, 292);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "15px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("ARROWS / A D   MOVE", W / 2, 350);
  ctx.fillText("SPACE / W / UP  FIRE", W / 2, 374);
  ctx.fillText("BLAST ALIENS, DODGE THEIR FIRE", W / 2, 398);

  if (Math.sin(state.time * 4) > -0.3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe066";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  START", W / 2, 452);
  }
}

function drawOver() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,3,15,.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5c8a";
  ctx.font = "bold 42px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, 270);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("FINAL SCORE  " + state.score, W / 2, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#46e6ff";
  ctx.fillText("REACHED WAVE  " + state.wave, W / 2, 348);
  if (Math.sin(state.time * 4) > -0.3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe066";
    ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  RETRY", W / 2, 410);
  }
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0) ctx.translate(rand(-1, 1) * state.shake * 6, rand(-1, 1) * state.shake * 6);

  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  drawBullets();
  for (const a of actors) drawAlien(a);
  if (state.scene === "play") drawShip();

  if (state.flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,90," + (state.flash * 0.4) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();
  if (state.scene === "title") drawTitle();
  if (state.scene === "over") drawOver();
}

/* ---------- init stars ---------- */
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, GROUND),
    s: rand(1, 2.4),
    tw: rand(0.5, 2.5), p: rand(0, 6.28),
    c: Math.random() < 0.3 ? "#ffd9a0" : "#cfe8ff"
  });
}

/* ---------- main loop ---------- */
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Space Invaders</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #06070c;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    color: #9ff;
  }
  #game {
    background: #0a0f1f;
    border: 3px solid #1f4;
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px #0ff3, inset 0 0 60px #0008;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;

</style>

<canvas id="game" width="520" height="620"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  // ---------- state ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const keys = { left:false, right:false, fire:false };
  let ship = { x: W/2, y: H-50, w:46, h:22, alive:true, inv:0, score:0, lives:3 };
  let enemies = [];
  let enemyBullets = [];
  let playerBullets = [];
  let particles = [];
  let lastShot = 0;
  let lastEnemyShot = 0;
  let enemyDir = 1;
  let running = false;
  let gameOver = false;
  let win = false;
  let time = 0;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
  function inRect(b, x, y, w, h){
    return b.x - b.w/2 < x + w/2 && b.x + b.w/2 > x - w/2 &&
           b.y - b.h/2 < y + h/2 && b.y + b.h/2 > y - h/2;
  }

  function spawnWave(){
    enemies = [];
    const rows = 4, cols = 8;
    const startX = 90, startY = 80;
    const gapX = 44, gapY = 40;
    for (let r=0; r<rows; r++){
      for (let c=0; c<cols; c++){
        enemies.push({
          x: startX + c*gapX,
          y: startY + r*gapY,
          vx: 0,
          vy: 0,
          w: 26,
          h: 20,
          row: r,
          alive: true
        });
      }
    }
    enemyDir = 1;
  }

  function explode(x, y, color, n=14){
    for (let i=0; i<n; i++){
      const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      const s = rand(1,4);
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a)*s,
        vy: Math.sin(a)*s,
        life: rand(20,40),
        max: 40,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- input ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = true;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = true;
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') keys.fire = true;
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && !running){
      startGame();
    }
    if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false;
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') keys.fire = false;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!running) startGame(); });

  function startGame(){
    ship = { x: W/2, y: H-50, w:46, h:22, alive:true, inv:0, score:0, lives:3 };
    enemyBullets = [];
    playerBullets = [];
    particles = [];
    gameOver = false;
    win = false;
    running = true;
    spawnWave();
  }

  // ---------- update ----------
  function update(dt){
    if (!running) return;
    time += dt;

    // ship
    if (ship.alive){
      if (keys.left)  ship.x -= 280 * dt;
      if (keys.right) ship.x += 280 * dt;
      ship.x = Math.max(30, Math.min(W-30, ship.x));
      if (ship.inv > 0) ship.inv -= dt;

      // fire
      if (keys.fire && time - lastShot > 0.25){
        lastShot = time;
        playerBullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y - ship.h/2, vx:0, vy:-520, w:4, h:14 });
      }
    }

    // player bullets
    for (let i = playerBullets.length-1; i>=0; i--){
      const b = playerBullets[i];
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      if (b.y < -20) playerBullets.splice(i,1);
    }

    // enemies movement (block as one)
    if (enemies.length > 0){
      const speed = 40 + (1 - enemies.length/32) * 80;
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
      for (const e of enemies){
        if (e.x < minX) minX = e.x;
        if (e.x > maxX) maxX = e.x;
        if (e.y > maxY) maxY = e.y;
      }
      const step = speed * dt;
      const edge = 40;
      if ((enemyDir > 0 && maxX + step > W - edge) || (enemyDir < 0 && minX + step < edge)){
        enemyDir *= -1;
        for (const e of enemies) e.y += 16;
      } else {
        for (const e of enemies) e.x += enemyDir * step;
      }
      if (maxY + 10 >= ship.y - ship.h/2){
        // reached ship line — lose
        ship.alive = false;
        ship.lives = 0;
        explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#f44', 30);
        gameOver = true;
        running = false;
      }
    }

    // enemy fire
    if (time - lastEnemyShot > rand(0.4, 0.9) && enemies.length > 0){
      lastEnemyShot = time;
      const shooter = enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];
      enemyBullets.push({ x: shooter.x, y: shooter.y + shooter.h/2, vx: rand(-40,40), vy: 320, w:4, h:10 });
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for (let i = enemyBullets.length-1; i>=0; i--){
      const b = enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      if (b.y > H + 20) { enemyBullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      if (ship.alive && ship.inv <= 0 && inRect(b, ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h)){
        enemyBullets.splice(i,1);
        ship.alive = false;
        ship.lives -= 1;
        explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#f44', 30);
        if (ship.lives <= 0){
          gameOver = true;
          running = false;
        } else {
          ship.x = W/2;
          ship.inv = 2;
        }
      }
    }

    // collisions: player bullets vs enemies
    for (let i = playerBullets.length-1; i>=0; i--){
      const b = playerBullets[i];
      for (const e of enemies){
        if (inRect(b, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)){
          playerBullets.splice(i,1);
          e.alive = false;
          ship.score += 10 + (3 - e.row) * 5;
          explode(e.x, e.y, '#0ff', 18);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.alive);
    if (enemies.length === 0 && !gameOver){
      win = true;
      running = false;
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length-1; i>=0; i--){
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.1;
      p.life -= 1;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawBackground(){
    // gradient sky
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0a0f2a');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a1330');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#05060f');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // stars
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    for (let i=0; i<60; i++){
      const x = (i*97) % W;
      const y = (i*173) % H;
      const tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time*2 + i));
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // distant nebula
    const n = ctx.createRadialGradient(W*0.8, H*0.2, 10, W*0.8, H*0.2, 200);
    n.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,40,200,0.25)');
    n.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = n;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // ground line
    ctx.fillStyle = '#123';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H-12, W, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f4';
    for (let x=0; x<W; x+=20) ctx.fillRect(x, H-12, 10, 2);
  }

  function drawShip(){
    if (!ship.alive) return;
    const flicker = ship.inv > 0 && Math.floor(time*20)%2===0;
    if (flicker) return;
    const x = ship.x, y = ship.y;
    // glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 40, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y-18);
    ctx.lineTo(x+22, y+10);
    ctx.lineTo(x+10, y+10);
    ctx.lineTo(x+10, y+14);
    ctx.lineTo(x-10, y+14);
    ctx.lineTo(x-10, y+10);
    ctx.lineTo(x-22, y+10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
    ctx.fillRect(x-4, y-6, 8, 8);
    // engines
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
    ctx.fillRect(x-12, y+14, 6, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(x+6, y+14, 6, 4);
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    const x = e.x, y = e.y;
    const colors = ['#f66','#fa4','#fd6','#f8f'];
    const c = colors[e.row % colors.length];
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.fillRect(x-12, y-6, 24, 12);
    // head
    ctx.fillRect(x-8, y-12, 16, 6);
    // eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(x-6, y-10, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x+3, y-10, 3, 3);
    // legs
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.fillRect(x-10, y+6, 4, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(x+6, y+6, 4, 6);
    // antennae
    ctx.fillRect(x-4, y-14, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(x+2, y-14, 2, 2);
  }

  function drawBullet(b, color){
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - b.w/2, b.y - b.h/2, b.w, b.h);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - b.w/4, b.y - b.h/2, b.w/2, b.h/2);
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for (const p of particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x-2, p.y-2, 4, 4);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD(){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + ship.score, 14, 26);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f66';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + ship.lives, W-14, 26);
  }

  function drawOverlay(){
    if (running) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Courier New';
    if (!started){
      ctx.fillText('SPACE INVADERS', W/2, H/2 - 40);
      ctx.font = '18px Courier New';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillText('← → move    SPACE fire', W/2, H/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillText('press ENTER or click to start', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    } else if (win){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f8';
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + ship.score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillText('press ENTER to play again', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '20px Courier New';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + ship.score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
      ctx.fillText('press ENTER to try again', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    }
  }

  let started = false;
  function draw(){
    drawBackground();
    for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    for (const b of enemyBullets) drawBullet(b, '#f66');
    for (const b of playerBullets) drawBullet(b, '#0ff');
    drawShip();
    drawParticles();
    drawHUD();
    if (!started) started = true;
    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Lock 'n' Chase</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;}
  #game{width:min(96vw,520px);height:min(96vh,700px);border:2px solid #20304d;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(60,120,255,.25);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
// ---------- setup ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = 520, H = 700;
let dpr = 1;
function resize(){
  dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
  canvas.width = W*dpr; canvas.height = H*dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W+'px'; canvas.style.height = H+'px';
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// ---------- state ----------
const state = {
  mode: 'title',   // title | playing | over
  score: 0,
  hi: 0,
  wave: 0,
  lives: 3,
  time: 0,
  flash: 0,
  invuln: 0,
  message: '',
  messageTimer: 0,
  shake: 0,
  nextWaveIn: 0
};

// actors: one array of {x,y,vx,vy,kind,extra}
const actors = [];
const player = { x: W/2, y: H-70, vx: 0, vy: 0, alive: true, fireCd: 0 };
const keys = {};
let mouseX = W/2, mouseY = H/2, mouseDown = false, mouseMoved = false;

// ---------- input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); mouseDown = true; }
  if (e.key === 'Enter') startGame();
  if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'p') togglePause();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space') mouseDown = false;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
  mouseY = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * H;
  mouseMoved = true;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { mouseDown = true; if (state.mode !== 'playing') startGame(); });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => mouseDown = false);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
  const t = e.touches[0]; const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (t.clientX - r.left)/r.width*W; mouseY = (t.clientY - r.top)/r.height*H;
  mouseDown = true; mouseMoved = true;
  if (state.mode !== 'playing') startGame();
  e.preventDefault();
}, {passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  const t = e.touches[0]; const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouseX = (t.clientX - r.left)/r.width*W; mouseY = (t.clientY - r.top)/r.height*H;
  mouseMoved = true; e.preventDefault();
}, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('touchend', () => mouseDown = false);

function togglePause(){ if (state.mode === 'playing') state.mode = 'paused'; else if (state.mode === 'paused') state.mode = 'playing'; }
function startGame(){
  actors.length = 0;
  state.mode = 'playing'; state.score = 0; state.wave = 0; state.lives = 3;
  state.invuln = 1.2; state.flash = 0; state.shake = 0; state.nextWaveIn = 0;
  player.x = W/2; player.y = H-70; player.alive = true; player.fireCd = 0;
  spawnWave();
}

// ---------- helpers ----------
function spawnWave(){
  state.wave++;
  const count = Math.min(4 + state.wave, 12);
  const cols = Math.ceil(count/3);
  const spacing = Math.min(60, (W-80)/cols);
  const startX = W/2 - (cols-1)*spacing/2;
  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const row = Math.floor(i/cols), col = i%cols;
    const type = (state.wave + i) % 3; // 0=drifter,1=seeker,2=shooter
    actors.push({
      x: startX + col*spacing + (Math.random()*20-10),
      y: 60 + row*46,
      vx: 0, vy: 0,
      kind: 'alien',
      type: type,
      t: Math.random()*6,
      fireCd: 1 + Math.random()*2.5,
      hp: type===2?2:1,
      seed: Math.random()*10
    });
  }
}

function firePlayer(){
  if (player.fireCd > 0) return;
  player.fireCd = 0.18;
  const dx = mouseX - player.x, dy = mouseY - player.y;
  const m = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
  const spd = 620;
  actors.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y-14, vx: dx/m*spd, vy: dy/m*spd, kind:'pshot', life: 3 });
}

function fireAlien(a){
  const dx = player.x - a.x, dy = player.y - a.y;
  const m = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const spd = 190 + state.wave*6;
  actors.push({ x: a.x, y: a.y+10, vx: dx/m*spd, vy: dy/m*spd, kind:'eshot', life: 5 });
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash -= dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake -= dt*3;
  if (state.messageTimer > 0) state.messageTimer -= dt;
  if (state.invuln > 0) state.invuln -= dt;

  if (state.mode === 'playing'){
    // player movement
    const speed = 340;
    let ax = 0, ay = 0;
    if (keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) ax -= 1;
    if (keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) ax += 1;
    if (keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) ay -= 1;
    if (keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) ay += 1;
    if (ax||ay){
      const m = Math.hypot(ax,ay);
      player.x += ax/m*speed*dt;
      player.y += ay/m*speed*dt;
      mouseMoved = false;
    } else if (mouseMoved){
      // ease toward mouse
      player.x += (mouseX - player.x)*Math.min(1, dt*12);
      player.y += (mouseY - player.y)*Math.min(1, dt*12);
    }
    player.x = Math.max(24, Math.min(W-24, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(H*0.35, Math.min(H-30, player.y));

    if (player.fireCd > 0) player.fireCd -= dt;
    if (mouseDown) firePlayer();
  }

  // move actors
  for (let i=actors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a = actors[i];
    if (a.kind === 'alien'){
      a.t += dt;
      const drift = 20 + state.wave*3;
      if (a.type === 0){ // drifter: horizontal sine, slow descent
        a.x += Math.sin(a.t*1.4 + a.seed)*drift*dt;
        a.y += 12*dt;
      } else if (a.type === 1){ // seeker: drift toward player x
        const dir = Math.sign(player.x - a.x);
        a.x += dir*(30 + state.wave*4)*dt + Math.sin(a.t*2+a.seed)*10*dt;
        a.y += (22 + state.wave*2)*dt;
      } else { // shooter: hover, bob
        a.x += Math.sin(a.t*1.0 + a.seed)*14*dt;
        a.y += Math.cos(a.t*0.7)*8*dt;
        a.fireCd -= dt;
        if (a.fireCd <= 0 && state.mode==='playing'){ fireAlien(a); a.fireCd = 1.6 + Math.random()*2.2; }
      }
      if (a.y > H-40){ a.y = H-40; } // don't cross into player zone
      // collision with player
      if (state.mode==='playing' && state.invuln<=0){
        const d = Math.hypot(a.x-player.x, a.y-player.y);
        if (d < 26){ killPlayer(); }
      }
    } else {
      a.x += a.vx*dt; a.y += a.vy*dt;
      a.life -= dt;
      // bullet hits
      if (a.kind === 'pshot'){
        for (let j=actors.length-1;j>=0;j--){
          const b = actors[j];
          if (b.kind==='alien'){
            if (Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y) < 20){
              b.hp--;
              a.life = 0;
              if (b.hp <= 0){
                state.score += (b.type===2?30:20);
                state.flash = 0.12;
                actors.splice(j,1);
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (a.kind === 'eshot'){
        if (state.mode==='playing' && state.invuln<=0){
          if (Math.hypot(a.x-player.x, a.y-player.y) < 20){ killPlayer(); a.life = 0; }
        }
      }
      if (a.life <= 0 || a.x<-20 || a.x>W+20 || a.y<-20 || a.y>H+20) actors.splice(i,1);
    }
  }

  // wave clear
  if (state.mode==='playing'){
    const remaining = actors.filter(a=>a.kind==='alien').length;
    if (remaining === 0){
      state.message = 'WAVE ' + state.wave + ' CLEAR';
      state.messageTimer = 1.4;
      state.nextWaveIn = 1.2;
    }
    if (state.nextWaveIn > 0){
      state.nextWaveIn -= dt;
      if (state.nextWaveIn <= 0) spawnWave();
    }
  }
}

function killPlayer(){
  state.lives--;
  state.flash = 0.4; state.shake = 1;
  player.alive = false;
  if (state.lives <= 0){
    state.mode = 'over';
    if (state.score > state.hi) state.hi = state.score;
  } else {
    setTimeout(()=>{ player.alive = true; player.x = W/2; player.y = H-70; state.invuln = 1.5; }, 700);
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0f24'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#101a3a'); g.addColorStop(1,'#060915');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  ctx.save();
  for (let i=0;i<70;i++){
    const x = (i*97.3) % W;
    const y = ((i*53.7) + state.time*20*(1+(i%3))) % H;
    const s = (i%4)+1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + (i%5)*0.12;
    ctx.fillStyle = i%7 ? '#9fd0ff' : '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // grid floor
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,140,255,0.18)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const horizon = H*0.55;
  for (let i=0;i<=10;i++){
    const t = i/10;
    const y = horizon + (H-horizon)*t*t;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W/2 + i*20, horizon); ctx.lineTo(W/2 + i*160, H); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawAlien(a){
  const bob = Math.sin(a.t*3 + a.seed)*3;
  const x = a.x, y = a.y + bob;
  let body, accent, glow;
  if (a.type===0){ body='#ff5c5c'; accent='#ffd0d0'; glow='rgba(255,90,90,0.5)'; }
  else if (a.type===1){ body='#ffc24b'; accent='#fff0c0'; glow='rgba(255,190,70,0.5)'; }
  else { body='#5ce0c0'; accent='#d6fff5'; glow='rgba(90,225,190,0.5)'; }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = glow; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  // body (rounded dome)
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, 16, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = accent;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-6, y-1, 3.2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+6, y-1, 3.2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // pupils
  ctx.fillStyle = '#12203a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-6, y-1, 1.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x+6, y-1, 1.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // mouth / teeth
  ctx.strokeStyle = accent; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-6, y+6); ctx.lineTo(x+6, y+6); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  if (!player.alive) return;
  const x = player.x, y = player.y;
  const blink = state.invuln>0 && (Math.floor(state.time*12)%2===0);
  if (blink) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.8)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#39c7ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y-20);
  ctx.lineTo(x+16, y+12);
  ctx.lineTo(x+7, y+8);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y+14);
  ctx.lineTo(x-7, y+8);
  ctx.lineTo(x-16, y+12);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eaffff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y-4, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // engine glow
  const f = 6 + Math.sin(state.time*20)*3;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,60,0.9)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-5, y+12); ctx.lineTo(x+5, y+12); ctx.lineTo(x, y+12+f); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawShot(a){
  ctx.save();
  if (a.kind === 'pshot'){
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(140,230,255,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
    ctx.fillStyle='#dff6ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(a.x, a.y, 3, 7, Math.atan2(a.vy,a.vx)+Math.PI/2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,120,80,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffb08a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px ui-monospace,monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + state.score, 14, 26);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + state.wave, W-14, 26);
  // lives
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillStyle='#39c7ff';
  for (let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    const lx = 16 + i*22, ly = 44;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lx, ly-8); ctx.lineTo(lx+8, ly+5); ctx.lineTo(lx, ly+2); ctx.lineTo(lx-8, ly+5);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCenter(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  if (state.mode === 'title'){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7fe0ff'; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(90,200,255,0.7)'; ctx.shadowBlur=20;
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText("LOCK 'N' CHASE", W/2, H*0.34);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd27a'; ctx.font='16px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Repel the waves. Don\'t get shot.', W/2, H*0.42);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff';
    ctx.fillText('Move: mouse / WASD   •   Aim: mouse', W/2, H*0.50);
    ctx.fillText('Fire: hold click / Space', W/2, H*0.54);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe0ff'; ctx.font='bold 18px ui-monospace,monospace';
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time*4)*0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO START', W/2, H*0.64);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (state.hi>0){ ctx.fillStyle='#8fb6e0'; ctx.fillText('HI  '+state.hi, W/2, H*0.70); }
  } else if (state.mode === 'over'){
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7a7a'; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,90,90,0.7)'; ctx.shadowBlur=20;
    ctx.font='bold 40px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H*0.36);
    ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.fillStyle='#cfe8ff'; ctx.font='20px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE  '+state.score, W/2, H*0.46);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd27a'; ctx.fillText('HI  '+state.hi, W/2, H*0.52);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fe0ff'; ctx.font='bold 18px ui-monospace,monospace';
    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(state.time*4)*0.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha=pulse; ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR CLICK TO RETRY', W/2, H*0.62);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  } else if (state.mode === 'paused'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#cfe8ff'; ctx.font='bold 34px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PAUSED', W/2, H*0.4);
    ctx.font='16px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.fillText('press P to resume', W/2, H*0.46);
  }
  if (state.messageTimer > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffe08a'; ctx.font='bold 22px ui-monospace,monospace';
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, state.messageTimer);
    ctx.fillText(state.message, W/2, H*0.30);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  ctx.save();
  if (state.shake > 0){
    const s = state.shake*8;
    ctx.translate((Math.random()*2-1)*s, (Math.random()*2-1)*s);
  }
  drawBackground();

  for (const a of actors){
    if (a.kind === 'alien') drawAlien(a);
    else drawShot(a);
  }
  if (state.mode !== 'title') drawPlayer();

  if (state.flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (state.flash*0.6) + ')';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }
  ctx.restore();

  if (state.mode === 'playing' || state.mode === 'paused') drawHUD();
  drawCenter();
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000; last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  if (state.mode !== 'paused') update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Cloudy Mountain</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#05060f; overflow:hidden; height:100%; }
  canvas { display:block; margin:0 auto; background:#05060f; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="800" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const GROUND_Y = H - 52;
  const SHIP_Y = H - 92;
  const SHIP_W = 34, SHIP_H = 24;

  // --- state ---
  let state = "start";
  let score = 0;
  let hi = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let wave = 1;
  let waveClear = 0;
  let waveTimer = 0;
  let invuln = 0;
  let shipX = W/2, shipY = SHIP_Y;
  let keys = {};
  let bullets = [];
  let enemies = [];
  let enemyBullets = [];
  let stars = [];
  let t = 0;
  let last = performance.now();

  // --- helpers ---
  function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v); }

  // --- input ---
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code==="Enter" || e.code==="Space"){
      if (state==="start") state="play";
      else if (state==="over") startGame();
      if (e.code==="Space") e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (e.code==="ArrowUp"||e.code==="ArrowDown"||e.code==="ArrowLeft"||e.code==="ArrowRight"||e.code==="Space") e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keyup", function(e){ keys[e.code] = false; });

  function startGame(){
    score=0; lives=3; wave=1; waveClear=0; waveTimer=0; invuln=0;
    shipX=W/2; shipY=SHIP_Y;
    bullets=[]; enemies=[]; enemyBullets=[];
    spawnWave();
    state="play";
  }

  function spawnWave(){
    const cols = Math.min(4 + wave, 9);
    const rows = Math.min(2 + Math.floor(wave/2), 5);
    const spacingX = 56, spacingY = 40;
    const totalW = (cols-1)*spacingX;
    const startX = W/2 - totalW/2;
    const startY = 70;
    for (let r=0;r<rows;r++){
      for (let c=0;c<cols;c++){
        enemies.push({ x: startX + c*spacingX, y: startY + r*spacingY, vx:0, vy:0,
          phase: (r*0.7 + c*0.5) % 6.283, kind: (r+c)%3, alive:true,
          fire: 1.5 + Math.random()*3.5 });
      }
    }
  }

  function fire(){
    if (bullets.length >= 5) return;
    bullets.push({ x: shipX, y: shipY - SHIP_H/2, vx:0, vy:-520 });
  }

  function fireEnemy(x,y){
    enemyBullets.push({ x:x, y:y, vx:0, vy:230 });
  }

  function hitEnemy(b, e){
    b.dead = true; e.alive = false;
    score += 10;
  }

  function hitShip(b){
    if (invuln>0) return;
    lives--; invuln = 1.8;
    if (lives <= 0){
      state="over";
      if (score>hi) hi=score;
    }
  }

  function update(dt){
    if (state!=="play") return;

    // ship
    const speed = 320;
    if (keys["ArrowLeft"]||keys["KeyA"]) shipX -= speed*dt;
    if (keys["ArrowRight"]||keys["KeyD"]) shipX += speed*dt;
    shipX = clamp(shipX, SHIP_W/2+8, W-SHIP_W/2-8);
    if (keys["Space"]||keys["KeyW"]||keys["ArrowUp"]) fire();

    // bullets
    for (const b of bullets){ b.y += b.vy*dt; if (b.y < -20) b.dead=true; }

    // enemies
    const dir = 1;
    let minx=1e9, maxx=-1e9, miny=1e9;
    let alive=0;
    for (const e of enemies){
      if (!e.alive) continue;
      alive++;
      const bob = Math.sin(t*1.2 + e.phase)*10;
      const x = e.x + dir*26*dt + Math.cos(t*0.8+e.phase)*14;
      const y = e.y + waveClear*2.4 + bob;
      e.x = x; e.y = y;
      if (x<minx) minx=x; if (x>maxx) maxx=x; if (y<miny) miny=y;
      e.fire -= dt;
      if (e.fire<=0){ e.fire = 2 + Math.random()*3.5; fireEnemy(e.x, e.y); }
    }
    if (minx < 40 || maxx > W-40) waveClear += dt;
    if (miny > GROUND_Y-24){
      lives--; invuln=1.8;
      if (lives<=0){ state="over"; if(score>hi) hi=score; }
      else { waveClear=0; spawnWave(); }
    }
    if (alive===0){
      waveTimer += dt;
      if (waveTimer>1.0){
        wave++; waveTimer=0; waveClear=0;
        spawnWave();
      }
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for (const b of enemyBullets){ b.y += b.vy*dt; if (b.y > H+20) b.dead=true; }

    // collisions
    for (const b of bullets){
      if (b.dead) continue;
      for (const e of enemies){
        if (!e.alive) continue;
        if (Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<20 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<18){ hitEnemy(b,e); break; }
      }
    }
    for (const b of enemyBullets){
      if (b.dead) continue;
      if (Math.abs(b.x-shipX)<SHIP_W/2 && Math.abs(b.y-shipY)<SHIP_H/2){ b.dead=true; hitShip(b); }
    }

    if (invuln>0) invuln -= dt;

    bullets = bullets.filter(b=>!b.dead);
    enemyBullets = enemyBullets.filter(b=>!b.dead);
    enemies = enemies.filter(e=>e.alive);
  }

  // --- draw ---
  function drawCloud(x,y,s){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(150,170,200,0.12)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x,y,60*s,22*s,0,0,7);
    ctx.ellipse(x+45*s,y-10*s,40*s,18*s,0,0,7);
    ctx.ellipse(x-45*s,y-6*s,38*s,16*s,0,0,7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawMountains(){
    const layers = [
      { col:"#1b2740", base:GROUND_Y, amp:60, off:0, sp:130 },
      { col:"#26354f", base:GROUND_Y, amp:42, off:30, sp:90 },
      { col:"#33456a", base:GROUND_Y, amp:28, off:60, sp:64 }
    ];
    for (const L of layers){
      ctx.fillStyle = L.col;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND_Y);
      for (let x=0; x<=W; x+=10){
        const y = L.base - (L.amp*(0.55+0.45*Math.sin((x+L.off)/L.sp*Math.PI*2))) - 20;
        ctx.lineTo(x,y);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND_Y);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawGround(){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0,"#201a2e"); g.addColorStop(1,"#0c0912");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y, W, H-GROUND_Y);
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(120,150,200,0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND_Y); ctx.lineTo(W,GROUND_Y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawShip(){
    const blink = invuln>0 && (Math.floor(t*10)%2===0);
    if (blink) return;
    const x=shipX, y=shipY;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x,y);
    // body
    ctx.fillStyle="#dfe6ff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-SHIP_H/2);
    ctx.lineTo(SHIP_W/2, SHIP_H/2);
    ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_W/2, SHIP_H/2);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // wings
    ctx.fillStyle="#5b78c9";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-SHIP_W/2,SHIP_H/2); ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_W/2-10,SHIP_H/2+6); ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_W/2+4,SHIP_H/2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(SHIP_W/2,SHIP_H/2); ctx.lineTo(SHIP_W/2+10,SHIP_H/2+6); ctx.lineTo(SHIP_W/2-4,SHIP_H/2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle="#35e0ff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-2,6,9,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    const x=e.x, y=e.y;
    const cols = ["#ff5a7a","#ffd15a","#5affb0"];
    const col = cols[e.kind];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x,y);
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,16,10,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#101018";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-5,-1,3,4,0,0,7); ctx.ellipse(5,-1,3,4,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,8); ctx.lineTo(-20,16); ctx.moveTo(14,8); ctx.lineTo(20,16); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    // sky
    const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    sky.addColorStop(0,"#0a0e24");
    sky.addColorStop(0.6,"#141a38");
    sky.addColorStop(1,"#1c2547");
    ctx.fillStyle=sky; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    // stars
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
    for (const s of stars){
      const tw = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*2+s.tw);
      ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
      ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    // clouds
    drawCloud(150+Math.sin(t*0.2)*20, 90, 1.1);
    drawCloud(560+Math.cos(t*0.15)*25, 150, 0.9);
    drawCloud(380+Math.sin(t*0.12)*30, 230, 1.3);

    drawMountains();
    drawGround();

    // bullets
    ctx.fillStyle="#aef2ff";
    for (const b of bullets){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(b.x,b.y,3,8,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff8a5a";
    for (const b of enemyBullets){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(b.x,b.y,3,7,0,0,7); ctx.fill();
    }

    for (const e of enemies) drawEnemy(e);
    drawShip();

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf1ff";
    ctx.font="bold 16px monospace";
    ctx.textBaseline="top";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE "+score, 16, 12);
    ctx.fillText("WAVE "+wave, W/2-40, 12);
    ctx.fillText("LIVES "+lives, W-110, 12);

    if (state==="start"){
      overlay("CLOUDY MOUNTAIN", "1982", "Arrows / A D  move", "Space  fire", "Press ENTER to start");
    } else if (state==="over"){
      overlay("GAME OVER", "", "Score "+score+"   Best "+hi, "", "Press ENTER to retry");
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, l1, l2, l3){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(5,8,20,0.72)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillStyle="#5affb0";
    ctx.font="bold 44px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2-70);
    if (sub){ ctx.fillStyle="#ffd15a"; ctx.font="bold 18px monospace"; ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H/2-30); }
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf1ff"; ctx.font="18px monospace";
    let y = H/2 + (sub?10:20);
    if (l1){ ctx.fillText(l1, W/2, y); y+=28; }
    if (l2){ ctx.fillText(l2, W/2, y); y+=28; }
    if (l3){ ctx.fillStyle="#aef2ff"; ctx.fillText(l3, W/2, y); }
    ctx.textAlign="left";
  }

  function loop(now){
    let dt = (now-last)/1000; last=now;
    if (dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
    t += dt;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // init stars
  for (let i=0;i<70;i++){
    stars.push({ x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*(GROUND_Y-40), r:Math.random()<0.3?2:1, tw:Math.random()*6.28 });
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Sewer Sam</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05070f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,520px);height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #2a3a55;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="720"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const rand = (a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a);
const clamp = (v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v;

const state = {
  mode:'start',
  score:0,
  wave:1,
  lives:3,
  waveClear:0,
  shake:0,
  spawn:0,
  toSpawn:0,
  t:0,
  fireCd:0,
  invuln:0
};

const ship = {x:W/2, y:H-64, vx:0, vy:0, r:16, alive:true};
const enemies = [];
const ebullets = [];
const pbullets = [];
const particles = [];
const stars = [];
const keys = {};

const ENEMY = [
  {color:'#39d353', r:15, hp:1, score:10, fire:0.9, speed:34, sway:26, swaySpd:1.2, kind:'bug'},
  {color:'#ff8b2d', r:18, hp:2, score:25, fire:1.5, speed:26, sway:40, swaySpd:0.8, kind:'crab'},
  {color:'#ff3b52', r:22, hp:3, score:60, fire:2.2, speed:20, sway:55, swaySpd:0.6, kind:'boss'}
];

function reset(){
  state.score=0; state.wave=1; state.lives=3; state.waveClear=0; state.shake=0;
  state.spawn=0; state.toSpawn=0; state.t=0; state.fireCd=0; state.invuln=0;
  ship.x=W/2; ship.y=H-64; ship.vx=0; ship.vy=0; ship.alive=true;
  enemies.length=0; ebullets.length=0; pbullets.length=0; particles.length=0;
  startWave(1);
}

function startWave(n){
  state.wave=n;
  state.toSpawn = 4 + Math.floor(n*1.4);
  state.spawn = 0.4;
  const idx = n>=4 ? 2 : (n>=2 ? (Math.random()<0.5?1:0) : 0);
  const e = ENEMY[idx];
  for(let i=0;i<state.toSpawn;i++){
    enemies.push({
      x:rand(40,W-40), y:-30-i*44,
      vx:0, vy:e.speed,
      r:e.r, hp:e.hp, color:e.color, score:e.score,
      fire:e.fire, fireT:rand(0.4,2.2),
      sway:e.sway, swaySpd:e.swaySpd, phase:rand(0,TAU),
      baseX:0, kind:e.kind
    });
    enemies[i].baseX = enemies[i].x;
  }
}

function spawnExplosion(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rand(0,TAU), sp=rand(40,240);
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:rand(0.35,0.9),max:0.9,color,r:rand(1.5,3.5)});
  }
}

function drawBug(x,y,r,color,phase,kind){
  const wob = Math.sin(phase)*3;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y+wob);
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,r,r*0.72,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,r*0.25,r*0.7,r*0.4,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0f18';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r*0.4,-r*0.15,r*0.16,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r*0.4,-r*0.15,r*0.16,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff4d6d';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r*0.4,-r*0.15,r*0.07,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r*0.4,-r*0.15,r*0.07,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-r*0.2,-r*0.5); ctx.lineTo(-r*0.35,-r*0.95); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(r*0.2,-r*0.5); ctx.lineTo(r*0.35,-r*0.95); ctx.stroke();
  if(kind==='boss'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-r*0.5,r*0.4); ctx.lineTo(-r*0.2,r*0.15); ctx.lineTo(0,r*0.4); ctx.lineTo(r*0.2,r*0.15); ctx.lineTo(r*0.5,r*0.4); ctx.lineTo(r*0.3,r*0.6); ctx.lineTo(-r*0.3,r*0.6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawShip(x,y,alive){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y);
  if(!alive){
    ctx.fillStyle='#556';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,6); ctx.lineTo(-4,-8); ctx.lineTo(6,4); ctx.lineTo(16,-4); ctx.lineTo(10,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff8b2d';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-2,-2,5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore(); return;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='#3aa0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-22); ctx.lineTo(12,4); ctx.lineTo(20,16); ctx.lineTo(8,12);
  ctx.lineTo(0,20); ctx.lineTo(-8,12); ctx.lineTo(-20,16); ctx.lineTo(-12,4);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#0e2b4a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,4); ctx.lineTo(12,4); ctx.lineTo(8,14); ctx.lineTo(-8,14); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,-6,4.5,7,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,220,255,0.9)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-3,20); ctx.lineTo(3,20); ctx.lineTo(0,30+Math.random()*4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1024'); g.addColorStop(0.55,'#101a33'); g.addColorStop(1,'#1c2a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d1730';
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    const x=(i*140 + state.t*8)% (W+140) -70;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,H+40,120,60,0,Math.PI,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(90,140,220,0.5)';
  for(const s of stars){
    const y=(s.y + state.t*s.v) % H;
    ctx.globalAlpha=s.a;
    ctx.fillRect(s.x,y,2,2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function update(dt){
  state.t += dt;
  if(state.mode!=='play') return;

  const acc=1500, fr=0.85;
  if(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']) ship.vx-=acc*dt;
  if(keys['arrowright']||keys['d']) ship.vx+=acc*dt;
  if(keys['arrowup']||keys['w']) ship.vy-=acc*dt;
  if(keys['arrowdown']||keys['s']) ship.vy+=acc*dt;
  ship.vx*=Math.pow(fr,dt*60); ship.vy*=Math.pow(fr,dt*60);
  ship.x=clamp(ship.x+ship.vx*dt,24,W-24);
  ship.y=clamp(ship.y+ship.vy*dt,H*0.45,H-30);

  if((keys[' ']||keys['z']) && state.fireCd<=0){
    pbullets.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-20,vx:0,vy:-560,r:3,life:2});
    state.fireCd=0.16;
  }
  state.fireCd-=dt;
  state.invuln-=dt;

  if(state.toSpawn>0){
    state.spawn-=dt;
    if(state.spawn<=0){
      state.spawn=Math.max(0.25,0.7-state.wave*0.03);
      state.toSpawn--;
      const idx = state.wave>=4 ? 2 : (state.wave>=2 ? (Math.random()<0.4?1:0) : 0);
      const e=ENEMY[idx];
      const x=rand(40,W-40);
      enemies.push({x, y:-30, vx:0, vy:e.speed, r:e.r, hp:e.hp, color:e.color, score:e.score, fire:e.fire, fireT:rand(0.5,2), sway:e.sway, swaySpd:e.swaySpd, phase:rand(0,TAU), baseX:x, kind:e.kind});
    }
  }

  for(const e of enemies){
    e.phase+=e.swaySpd*dt;
    e.y+=e.vy*dt;
    e.x=clamp(e.baseX+Math.sin(e.phase)*e.sway,20,W-20);
    if(e.y>120 && e.y<H*0.55){
      e.fireT-=dt;
      if(e.fireT<=0){
        e.fireT=e.fire*(0.7+Math.random()*0.6);
        const dx=ship.x-e.x, dy=ship.y-e.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const sp=200+state.wave*6;
        ebullets.push({x:e.x,y:e.y+e.r,vx:dx/d*sp,vy:dy/d*sp,r:4,life:6});
      }
    }
  }
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(enemies[i].y>H+40) enemies.splice(i,1);
  }

  for(let i=pbullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=pbullets[i]; b.y+=b.vy*dt; b.life-=dt;
    if(b.y<-20||b.life<=0){ pbullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const e=enemies[j];
      if(Math.hypot(b.x-e.x,b.y-e.y) < e.r+b.r){
        e.hp--; pbullets.splice(i,1);
        spawnExplosion(b.x,b.y,'#8fd0ff',4);
        if(e.hp<=0){
          state.score+=e.score; state.shake=Math.min(8,state.shake+3);
          spawnExplosion(e.x,e.y,e.color,16);
          enemies.splice(j,1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  for(let i=ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=ebullets[i]; b.x+=b.vx*dt; b.y+=b.vy*dt; b.life-=dt;
    if(b.x<-20||b.x>W+20||b.y>H+20||b.y<-20||b.life<=0){ ebullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(ship.alive && state.invuln<=0 && Math.hypot(b.x-ship.x,b.y-ship.y) < ship.r+b.r){
      ebullets.splice(i,1);
      hitShip();
    }
  }

  if(ship.alive && state.invuln<=0){
    for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const e=enemies[j];
      if(Math.hypot(e.x-ship.x,e.y-ship.y) < e.r+ship.r){
        e.hp=0;
        spawnExplosion(e.x,e.y,e.color,16);
        enemies.splice(j,1);
        hitShip();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i]; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vy+=300*dt; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  state.shake*=Math.pow(0.85,dt*60);

  if(state.waveClear>0){ state.waveClear-=dt; if(state.waveClear<=0) startWave(state.wave+1); }
  else if(state.toSpawn===0 && enemies.length===0){ state.waveClear=2; }
}

function hitShip(){
  state.lives--;
  state.shake=10;
  spawnExplosion(ship.x,ship.y,'#ff8b2d',24);
  if(state.lives<=0){
    ship.alive=false;
    state.mode='over';
  } else {
    state.invuln=1.6;
    ship.x=W/2; ship.y=H-64; ship.vx=0; ship.vy=0;
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0.3) ctx.translate(rand(-state.shake,state.shake),rand(-state.shake,state.shake));
  drawBackground();

  for(const b of pbullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(b.x,b.y,3,8,0,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y-4,2,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  for(const b of ebullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff3b52';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd0d8';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r*0.45,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  for(const e of enemies) drawBug(e.x,e.y,e.r,e.color,e.phase,e.kind);
  if(state.mode==='play' || state.mode==='over'){
    if(state.invuln>0 && Math.floor(state.t*12)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.4;
    drawShip(ship.x,ship.y,ship.alive);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();
  if(state.mode==='start') drawStart();
  if(state.mode==='over') drawOver();
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff';
  ctx.font='bold 20px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+state.score,14,28);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+state.wave,W/2,28);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES '+state.lives,W-14,28);
  ctx.fillStyle='#3aa0ff';
  for(let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W-14-i*22,40); ctx.lineTo(W-14-i*22+6,52); ctx.lineTo(W-14-i*22-6,52); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,8,18,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#39d353'; ctx.font='bold 46px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SEWER SAM',W/2,H*0.34);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Defend the base. Blast the alien waves.',W/2,H*0.42);
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff'; ctx.font='15px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('MOVE  ← → ↑ ↓  (or WASD)',W/2,H*0.52);
  ctx.fillText('FIRE  SPACE  (or Z)',W/2,H*0.56);
  if(Math.floor(state.t*2)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f'; ctx.font='bold 22px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START',W/2,H*0.66);
  }
}

function drawOver(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,8,18,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff3b52'; ctx.font='bold 46px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H*0.38);
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf6ff'; ctx.font='20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+state.score,W/2,H*0.48);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8fd0ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('You reached wave '+state.wave,W/2,H*0.53);
  if(Math.floor(state.t*2)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23f'; ctx.font='bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RESTART',W/2,H*0.64);

}

let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  const dt=Math.min(0.033,(now-last)/1000); last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  if(k==='enter'){
    if(state.mode==='start'){ reset(); state.mode='play'; }
    else if(state.mode==='over'){ reset(); state.mode='play'; }
  }
