<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Tropical Trouble</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#03222b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  canvas{background:#000;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:6px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="520" height="700"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const G = {
  state:'start',
  score:0,
  wave:1,
  waveCount:0,
  waveTotal:0,
  spawnQueue:0,
  spawnTimer:0,
  spawnInterval:0.3,
  lives:3,
  invuln:0,
  msg:'Press SPACE to start',
  msgTimer:0,
  time:0,
  shake:0
};

const player = {x:W/2, y:H-56, w:36, h:22, speed:340, cooldown:0, fireRate:0.28, fireCd:0.28, alive:true};
const keys = {};
let mouseDown = false;

const aliens = [];
const bullets = [];
const enemyBullets = [];
const particles = [];

const colors = {
  alien:['#3ddc84','#f4d03f','#ff7043','#38bdf8','#c084fc'],
  bullet:'#ffe066',
  eBullet:'#ff5a5a',
  player:'#bfe9ff',
  playerGlow:'#38bdf8'
};

function resetGame(){
  G.state='play';
  G.score=0; G.wave=1; G.lives=3; G.invuln=0; G.shake=0;
  G.msg=''; G.msgTimer=0;
  player.x=W/2; player.y=H-56; player.alive=true; player.cooldown=0;
  aliens.length=0; bullets.length=0; enemyBullets.length=0; particles.length=0;
  startWave();
}

function startWave(){
  G.waveCount=0;
  G.waveTotal=6 + G.wave*3;
  G.spawnQueue=G.waveTotal;
  G.spawnTimer=0.5;
  G.spawnInterval=Math.max(0.14, 0.42 - G.wave*0.03);
}

function spawnAlien(){
  const cols = 6;
  const idx = G.waveCount % cols;
  const row = Math.floor(G.waveCount / cols);
  const margin = 50;
  const gap = (W - margin*2) / (cols-1);
  const x = margin + idx*gap;
  const y = 50 + row*44;
  const base = 30 + G.wave*6;
  const vx = (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1) * (base + Math.random()*20);
  const vy = 0;
  aliens.push({x, y, vx, vy, w:30, h:24, color:colors.alien[idx % colors.alien.length], fireTimer:1+Math.random()*3, phase:Math.random()*6.28, hp:1});
}

function update(dt){
  G.time += dt;
  if(G.msgTimer>0){ G.msgTimer-=dt; if(G.msgTimer<=0) G.msg=''; }
  if(G.shake>0) G.shake=Math.max(0,G.shake-dt*40);
  if(G.invuln>0) G.invuln-=dt;

  if(G.state==='play'){
    // player
    if(player.alive){
      if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed*dt;
      if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']) player.x += player.speed*dt;
      player.x = Math.max(24, Math.min(W-24, player.x));
      player.cooldown -= dt;
      if((keys[' ']||keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']||mouseDown) && player.cooldown<=0){
        bullets.push({x:player.x, y:player.y-14, vx:0, vy:-520, w:4, h:12});
        player.cooldown = player.fireCd;
      }
    }

    // spawn
    if(G.spawnQueue>0){
      G.spawnTimer -= dt;
      if(G.spawnTimer<=0){
        spawnAlien();
        G.spawnQueue--;
        G.waveCount++;
        G.spawnTimer = G.spawnInterval;
      }
    } else if(aliens.length===0){
      G.wave++;
      G.score += G.wave*25;
      G.msg='WAVE '+G.wave; G.msgTimer=1.4;
      startWave();
    }

    // aliens
    for(let i=aliens.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const a=aliens[i];
      a.x += a.vx*dt;
      a.y += a.vy*dt + Math.sin(G.time*2 + a.phase)*0.4;
      if(a.x < 24){ a.x=24; a.vx=Math.abs(a.vx); }
      if(a.x > W-24){ a.x=W-24; a.vx=-Math.abs(a.vx); }
      if(a.y > H-110){
        a.y = H-110;
        a.vy = 26 + G.wave*3;
      }
      a.fireTimer -= dt;
      if(a.fireTimer<=0 && player.alive && a.y < H-120){
        const dx = player.x - a.x, dy = player.y - a.y;
        const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const sp = 150 + G.wave*10;
        enemyBullets.push({x:a.x, y:a.y+12, vx:dx/len*sp, vy:dy/len*sp, w:6, h:6});
        a.fireTimer = 1.6 + Math.random()*3.5 - Math.min(1, G.wave*0.05);
      }
    }

    // bullets
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
      if(b.y < -20){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      for(let j=aliens.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const a=aliens[j];
        if(Math.abs(b.x-a.x)<(a.w/2+b.w/2) && Math.abs(b.y-a.y)<(a.h/2+b.h/2)){
          a.hp--;
          bullets.splice(i,1);
          if(a.hp<=0){
            G.score += 10 + G.wave*2;
            explode(a.x,a.y,a.color);
            aliens.splice(j,1);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for(let i=enemyBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
      if(b.y>H+20||b.x<-20||b.x>W+20){ enemyBullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      if(player.alive && G.invuln<=0 &&
         Math.abs(b.x-player.x)<(player.w/2) && Math.abs(b.y-player.y)<(player.h/2+4)){
        enemyBullets.splice(i,1);
        hitPlayer();
      }
    }

    // alien collision with player
    if(player.alive && G.invuln<=0){
      for(let i=aliens.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const a=aliens[i];
        if(Math.abs(a.x-player.x)<(a.w/2+player.w/2) && Math.abs(a.y-player.y)<(a.h/2+player.h/2)){
          explode(a.x,a.y,a.color);
          aliens.splice(i,1);
          hitPlayer();
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vy+=120*dt; p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function hitPlayer(){
  G.lives--;
  G.invuln=2;
  G.shake=12;
  explode(player.x, player.y, colors.playerGlow);
  if(G.lives<=0){
    player.alive=false;
    G.state='over';
    G.msg='GAME OVER'; G.msgTimer=999;
  }
}

function explode(x,y,color){
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.28, s=40+Math.random()*160;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s-40,life:0.4+Math.random()*0.5,color});
  }
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(G.shake>0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*G.shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*G.shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  for(const a of aliens) drawAlien(a);
  for(const b of bullets) drawBullet(b, colors.bullet);
  for(const b of enemyBullets) drawEnemyBullet(b);
  drawPlayer();
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/0.9);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  drawHud();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBackground(){
  // sky
  const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.55);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#0b2f45');
  sky.addColorStop(1,'#1f6f8a');
  ctx.fillStyle=sky; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H*0.55);
  // sun
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd36b';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.78, H*0.16, 34,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,211,107,.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W*0.78, H*0.16, 52,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // clouds
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.18)';
  cloud(W*0.2, H*0.12, 40); cloud(W*0.5, H*0.2, 30); cloud(W*0.85, H*0.3, 34);
  // sea
  const sea=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,H*0.5,0,H);
  sea.addColorStop(0,'#0a5f74');
  sea.addColorStop(1,'#04303d');
  ctx.fillStyle=sea; ctx.fillRect(0,H*0.5,W,H*0.5);
  // waves
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,220,235,.35)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
    const y=H*0.55 + k*36 + Math.sin(G.time*1.5+k)*4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
      const yy=y + Math.sin(x*0.05 + G.time*2 + k)*4;
      if(x===0) ctx.moveTo(x,yy); else ctx.lineTo(x,yy);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // island
  drawIsland(W*0.18, H*0.5);
}

function cloud(x,y,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,6.28);
  ctx.arc(x+r,y+4,r*0.8,0,6.28);
  ctx.arc(x-r,y+6,r*0.7,0,6.28);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawIsland(x,baseY){
  ctx.fillStyle='#2f8f5b';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x-70,baseY+10);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,baseY-46,x+70,baseY+10);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#e9d9a6';
  ctx.fillRect(x-74,baseY+8,148,10);
  // palm
  ctx.strokeStyle='#7a4a2b'; ctx.lineWidth=5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,baseY+4); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+14,baseY-40,x+26,baseY-58); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#2f9e57'; ctx.lineWidth=4;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const a=-1.2 + i*0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+26,baseY-58);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+26+Math.cos(a)*34, baseY-58+Math.sin(a)*20-10, x+26+Math.cos(a)*52, baseY-58+Math.sin(a)*26);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawAlien(a){
  const x=a.x, y=a.y;
  ctx.fillStyle=a.color;
  // body
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x,y,14,11,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-9,9,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // antennae
  ctx.strokeStyle=a.color; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-5,y-15); ctx.lineTo(x-9,y-24); ctx.moveTo(x+5,y-15); ctx.lineTo(x+9,y-24); ctx.stroke();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle='#08222b';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-4,y-10,2.4,0,6.28); ctx.arc(x+4,y-10,2.4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle=a.color; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x-8,y+8); ctx.lineTo(x-12,y+15);
  ctx.moveTo(x+8,y+8); ctx.lineTo(x+12,y+15);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawBullet(b,color){
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.fillRect(b.x-b.w/2, b.y-b.h/2, b.w, b.h);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(b.x-1, b.y-b.h/2, 2, b.h);
}

function drawEnemyBullet(b){
  ctx.fillStyle=colors.eBullet;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,4,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,120,120,.4)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,7,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  if(!player.alive) return;
  const x=player.x, y=player.y;
  const blink = G.invuln>0 && Math.floor(G.time*12)%2===0;
  if(blink) ctx.globalAlpha=0.4;
  // glow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(56,189,248,.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,26,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle=colors.player;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x,y-14);
  ctx.lineTo(x+18,y+8);
  ctx.lineTo(x+10,y+12);
  ctx.lineTo(x-10,y+12);
  ctx.lineTo(x-18,y+8);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a3a55';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y-2,6,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle='#5fc7ff';
  ctx.fillRect(x-20,y+4,7,7); ctx.fillRect(x+13,y+4,7,7);
  // engine flame
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffb347';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x-5,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x+5,y+12); ctx.lineTo(x,y+20+Math.random()*4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawHud(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#eafcff';
  ctx.font='bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+G.score, 14, 12);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+G.wave, W/2, 12);
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', W-14, 12);
  for(let i=0;i<G.lives;i++){
    const lx=W-14-i*20, ly=34;
    ctx.fillStyle=colors.player;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lx,ly-6); ctx.lineTo(lx+8,ly+5); ctx.lineTo(lx-8,ly+5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  if(G.msg){
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
    ctx.font='bold '+(G.state==='start'?34:26)+'px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(G.msg, W/2, H*0.42);
    if(G.state==='start'){
      ctx.font='16px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle='#bfe9ff';
      ctx.fillText('← → or A D to move   SPACE to shoot', W/2, H*0.42+44);
    }
    if(G.state==='over'){
      ctx.font='16px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle='#bfe9ff';
      ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to play again', W/2, H*0.42+44);
    }
  }
}

function loop(t){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (t - (loop._last||t))/1000);
  loop._last = t;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function start(){
  if(G.state!=='play') resetGame();
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  const k=e.key;
  if([' ','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(k===' '){
    if(G.state==='start'||G.state==='over') start();
  }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[e.key]=false; });
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(){ mouseDown=true; if(G.state==='start'||G.state==='over') start(); });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', function(){ mouseDown=false; });
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); mouseDown=true; if(G.state==='start'||G.state==='over') start(); }, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('touchend', function(){ mouseDown=false; });

requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Time Pilot</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05030f;overflow:hidden}
  body{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Courier New",monospace}
  canvas{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #241a55,0 0 55px #7a3cff88}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="420"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ---------- canvas ----------
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

// ---------- palette ----------
const COL = {
  bg1:"#05030f", bg2:"#100a33",
  grid:"#241a55",
  ship:"#39e6ff", shipGlow:"#b7f3ff",
  alien:"#ff4d6d", alienCore:"#ffd23f",
  alienB:"#ff8f3c",
  bullet:"#ffe9a8",
  ebullet:"#ff5c8a",
  hud:"#9fe8ff",
  danger:"#ff5c8a"
};

// ---------- helpers ----------
function rr(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function line(a,b,c,d){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a,b); ctx.lineTo(c,d); ctx.stroke(); }

// ---------- state ----------
const state = {
  phase:"start", score:0, lives:3,
  wave:1, spawnTimer:0,
  ship:{x:W/2,y:H-46,vx:0,vy:0},
  fireCd:0,
  bullets:[],
  enemies:[],
  ebullets:[],
  parts:[],
  stars:[],
  shake:0,
  msg:""
};

// prefill stars
for(let i=0;i<64;i++){
  state.stars.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, s:Math.random()*1.4+0.3, sp:Math.random()*0.5+0.15});
}

// ---------- input ----------
const keys = {};
addEventListener("keydown", e=>{
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k] = true;
  if([" ","arrowup","arrowdown","arrowleft","arrowright"].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();

  if(state.phase === "start"){
    if(k===" "||k==="enter") startGame();
    return;
  }
  if(state.phase === "over"){
    if(k===" "||k==="enter") startGame();
    return;
  }
  if(state.phase === "play"){
    if(k===" "||k==="enter") tryFire();
  }
});
addEventListener("keyup", e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startGame(){
  state.phase = "play";
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = 3;
  state.wave = 1;
  state.spawnTimer = 0;
  state.bullets.length = 0;
  state.enemies.length = 0;
  state.ebullets.length = 0;
  state.parts.length = 0;
  state.ship.x = W/2; state.ship.y = H-46; state.ship.vx = 0; state.ship.vy = 0;
  state.fireCd = 0;
  state.shake = 0;
  state.msg = "WAVE 1";
}

// ---------- actions ----------
function tryFire(){
  if(state.phase !== "play" || state.fireCd > 0) return;
  state.fireCd = 0.26;
  state.bullets.push({x:state.ship.x, y:state.ship.y-16, vx:0, vy:-380});
  state.bullets.push({x:state.ship.x-8, y:state.ship.y-12, vx:-24, vy:-360});
  state.bullets.push({x:state.ship.x+8, y:state.ship.y-12, vx:24, vy:-360});
}

function spawnEnemy(){
  const x = 30 + Math.random()*(W-60);
  const y = -20;
  const speed = 45 + state.wave*6 + Math.random()*25;
  state.enemies.push({x, y, vx:0, vy:speed, t:0, ph:Math.random()*6.28,
    fire:1.2 + Math.random()*2.2, kind:Math.random()<0.5?1:2});
}

function enemyFire(e){
  const s = state.ship;
  const dx = s.x - e.x, dy = s.y - e.y;
  const d = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
  const sp = 130 + state.wave*9;
  state.ebullets.push({x:e.x, y:e.y+8, vx:dx/d*sp, vy:dy/d*sp});
}

function explode(x,y,color,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*6.28, sp = Math.random()*130+40;
    state.parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp, vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life:0.5+Math.random()*0.5, max:1, color, s:Math.random()*2.4+1.2});
  }
}

function hitEnemy(e, i){
  state.enemies.splice(i,1);
  state.score += e.kind===2 ? 25 : 15;
  explode(e.x, e.y, e.kind===2?COL.alienB:COL.alien, 14);
  state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3);
}

function hitShip(){
  state.lives--;
  explode(state.ship.x, state.ship.y, COL.ship, 22);
  state.shake = 8;
  if(state.lives <= 0){
    state.phase = "over";
    state.msg = "GAME OVER";
  } else {
    state.ship.x = W/2; state.ship.y = H-46;
    state.fireCd = 0.6;
    state.msg = "";
  }
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  // stars always drift
  for(const st of state.stars){
    st.y += st.sp;
    if(st.y > H){ st.y = -2; st.x = Math.random()*W; }
  }
  if(state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt*22);

  if(state.phase === "play"){
    const s = state.ship;
    const ax = (keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"]?1:0) - (keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"]?1:0);
    const ay = (keys["arrowdown"]||keys["s"]?1:0) - (keys["arrowup"]||keys["w"]?1:0);
    const acc = 1500;
    s.vx += ax*acc*dt; s.vy += ay*acc*dt;
    s.vx *= 0.86; s.vy *= 0.86;
    s.x += s.vx*dt; s.y += s.vy*dt;
    s.x = Math.max(16, Math.min(W-16, s.x));
    s.y = Math.max(70, Math.min(H-24, s.y));

    state.fireCd = Math.max(0, state.fireCd - dt);

    // spawn
    state.spawnTimer -= dt;
    const maxE = Math.min(14, 3 + state.wave);
    if(state.spawnTimer <= 0 && state.enemies.length < maxE){
      spawnEnemy();
      state.spawnTimer = Math.max(0.5, 1.5 - state.wave*0.08);
    }

    // enemies
    for(let i=state.enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const e = state.enemies[i];
      e.t += dt;
      e.x += Math.sin(e.t*1.3 + e.ph)*30*dt;
      e.y += e.vy*dt;
      e.fire -= dt;
      if(e.fire <= 0 && e.y > 10){ enemyFire(e); e.fire = 1.4 + Math.random()*2.4; }
      if(e.y > H+24){
        state.enemies.splice(i,1);
        state.wave++;
        state.msg = "WAVE "+state.wave;
      }
    }

    // bullets
    for(let i=state.bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b = state.bullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
      if(b.y < -12){ state.bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      let hit = false;
      for(let j=state.enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const e = state.enemies[j];
        if(Math.abs(b.x-e.x) < 12 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y) < 12){
          hitEnemy(e, j); hit = true; break;
        }
      }
      if(hit) state.bullets.splice(i,1);
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for(let i=state.ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b = state.ebullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
      if(b.y > H+12 || b.y < -12 || b.x < -12 || b.x > W+12){ state.ebullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      if(Math.abs(b.x-s.x) < 9 && Math.abs(b.y-s.y) < 9){
        state.ebullets.splice(i,1);
        hitShip();
        if(state.phase !== "play") break;
      }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=state.parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = state.parts[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.vy += 60*dt; p.life -= dt;
    if(p.life <= 0) state.parts.splice(i,1);
  }
}

// ---------- drawing ----------
function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0, COL.bg1);
  g.addColorStop(0.55, COL.bg2);
  g.addColorStop(1, "#160c3a");
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = COL.grid; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const horizon = H*0.52;
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const t = i/6;
    const y = horizon + t*t*(H-horizon);
    line(0,y,W,y);
  }
  for(let i=-6;i<=6;i++){
    line(W/2 + i*10, horizon, W/2 + i*46, H);
  }

  // stars
  for(const st of state.stars){
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4 + st.s/3;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cfe8ff";
    ctx.fillRect(st.x, st.y, st.s, st.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawShip(){
  const s = state.ship;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
  ctx.shadowColor = COL.ship; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.ship;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-16); ctx.lineTo(11,10); ctx.lineTo(0,4); ctx.lineTo(-11,10);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.shipGlow;
  ctx.fillRect(-2,-10,4,7);
  // engine flicker
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-5,10); ctx.lineTo(5,10); ctx.lineTo(0,16+Math.random()*4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
  const pulse = 0.7 + Math.sin(e.t*6 + e.ph)*0.3;
  ctx.shadowColor = e.kind===2 ? COL.alienB : COL.alien;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10*pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = e.kind===2 ? COL.alienB : COL.alien;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0,0,11,7,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle = e.kind===2 ? "#ffb066" : "#ff8098";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-11,-1); ctx.lineTo(-16,4); ctx.lineTo(-9,3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(11,-1); ctx.lineTo(16,4); ctx.lineTo(9,3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.alienCore;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-4,-1,2,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4,-1,2,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullets(){
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.bullet;
  for(const b of state.bullets){
    ctx.fillRect(b.x-1.5, b.y-6, 3, 9);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff6d6";
    ctx.fillRect(b.x-1, b.y-6, 2, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.bullet;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.ebullet;
  ctx.shadowColor = COL.ebullet; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  for(const b of state.ebullets){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3.4, 0, 6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of state.parts){
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life/p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-p.s/2, p.y-p.s/2, p.s, p.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.hud;
  ctx.font = "bold 13px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+String(state.score).padStart(4,"0"), 8, 18);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("WAVE "+state.wave, W-8, 18);
  // lives as little ships
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  for(let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.ship;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12+i*16, 30); ctx.lineTo(18+i*16, 38); ctx.lineTo(12+i*16, 35);
    ctx.lineTo(6+i*16, 38); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawCenter(msg, sub, accent){
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,3,15,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = accent || COL.ship;
  ctx.shadowColor = accent || COL.ship; ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  ctx.font = "bold 30px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillText(msg, W/2, H*0.42);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = COL.hud;
  ctx.font = "13px 'Courier New',monospace";
  ctx.fillText(sub, W/2, H*0.42 + 26);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake > 0){
    ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*state.shake);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawParticles();
  for(const e of state.enemies) drawEnemy(e);
  drawBullets();
  if(state.phase === "play" || state.phase === "over") drawShip();
  ctx.restore();

  drawHUD();
  if(state.phase === "start"){
    drawCenter("TIME PILOT", "Arrows / WASD to move", COL.ship);
    ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.fillStyle="#ffd23f";
    ctx.font="12px 'Courier New',monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SPACE to fire  -  dodge the swarm", W/2, H*0.55);
    ctx.fillStyle = COL.hud;
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE TO START", W/2, H*0.62);
  } else if(state.phase === "over"){
    drawCenter("GAME OVER", "FINAL SCORE  "+state.score, COL.danger);
    ctx.textAlign="center"; ctx.fillStyle = COL.hud;
    ctx.font="12px 'Courier New',monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE TO RESTART", W/2, H*0.55);
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt = (now - last)/1000; last = now;
  if(dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Penguin Adventure</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#070b18;box-shadow:0 0 30px #000;border:2px solid #12203a;}

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
const W = cvs.width, H = cvs.height;

// ---------- state ----------
let state = 'start';
let score = 0, lives = 3, wave = 1, waveCleared = 0, scoreMax = 1200;
const ship = { x: W/2, y: H-70, vx:0, vy:0 };
const bullets = [];      // {x,y,vx,vy,kind}
const aliens  = [];      // {x,y,vx,vy,kind,phase}
const particles = [];     // {x,y,vx,vy,life,max,color,size}
let invuln = 0, shake = 0, last = 0, startT = 0;

// ---------- input ----------
const keys = {};
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'p') state = (state === 'play') ? 'pause' : (state === 'pause' ? 'play' : state);
  if (k === 'r') reset();
  if (state === 'start' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { state = 'play'; }
  if (state === 'over' && (k === 'enter' || k === ' ')) { reset(); state = 'play'; }
  if (['arrowleft','arrowright','arrowup','arrowdown',' '].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function reset(){
  score = 0; lives = 3; wave = 1; waveCleared = 0;
  bullets.length = 0; aliens.length = 0; particles.length = 0;
  ship.x = W/2; ship.y = H-70; ship.vx = 0; ship.vy = 0;
  invuln = 0; shake = 0;
  spawnWave();
}

// ---------- helpers ----------
function dist(ax,ay,bx,by){ return Math.hypot(ax-bx, ay-by); }
function spawnWave(){
  const rows = 5, cols = 9, gapX = 40, gapY = 34;
  const startX = (W - (cols-1)*gapX)/2;
  const startY = 60;
  for (let r=0; r<rows; r++){
    for (let c=0; c<cols; c++){
      const kind = r < 2 ? 0 : (r < 4 ? 1 : 2);
      aliens.push({ x: startX + c*gapX, y: startY + r*gapY,
                    vx: 0, vy: 0, kind, phase: (r*cols+c) * 0.5 });
    }
  }
}
function boom(x,y,color,n){
  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s = 40+Math.random()*160;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a)*s, vy: Math.sin(a)*s,
      life: 0.5+Math.random()*0.4, max: 0.9, color, size: 2+Math.random()*3 });
  }
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  const t = performance.now()/1000;

  // ship
  const sp = 300;
  ship.vx = 0; ship.vy = 0;
  if (keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']) ship.vx -= sp;
  if (keys['arrowright']||keys['d']) ship.vx += sp;
  if (keys['arrowup']||keys['w']) ship.vy -= sp;
  if (keys['arrowdown']||keys['s']) ship.vy += sp;
  ship.x += ship.vx*dt; ship.y += ship.vy*dt;
  ship.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W-20, ship.x));
  ship.y = Math.max(120, Math.min(H-30, ship.y));

  // shoot
  if (keys[' '] && Math.random() < 0.9) {
    bullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y-14, vx:0, vy:-520, kind:'player' });
  }

  // aliens: wave sweep
  const speed = 20 + wave*4;
  const drift = Math.sin(t*0.6 + waveCleared*0.3) * 0.5;
  let minX = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, maxY = -1e9;
  for (const a of aliens){
    a.phase += dt;
    a.x += (drift*speed) * dt * 3;
    a.y += Math.sin(a.phase*1.5) * 8 * dt;
    minX = Math.min(minX, a.x); maxX = Math.max(maxX, a.x); maxY = Math.max(maxY, a.y);
  }
  if (aliens.length){
    if (minX < 24 || maxX > W-24){
      const dir = (minX < 24) ? 1 : -1;
      for (const a of aliens){ a.x += dir*14; a.y += 16; }
    }
    // alien fire
    if (Math.random() < 0.02 * wave){
      const a = aliens[Math.floor(Math.random()*aliens.length)];
      if (a) bullets.push({ x: a.x, y: a.y+8, vx:(ship.x-a.x)*0.2, vy:220, kind:'enemy' });
    }
    // reached ship line
    if (maxY > ship.y-10) { lives = 0; state='over'; boom(ship.x,ship.y,'#ff5555',40); shake=18; }
  } else {
    wave++; waveCleared++;
    if (score >= scoreMax){ state='win'; }
    else spawnWave();
  }

  // bullets
  for (let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
    if (b.y < -20 || b.y > H+20 || b.x < -20 || b.x > W+20){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if (b.kind === 'player'){
      for (let j=aliens.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        const a = aliens[j];
        if (dist(b.x,b.y,a.x,a.y) < 15){
          score += (a.kind===0?50: a.kind===1?30:20);
          boom(a.x,a.y, a.kind===0?'#ff8844':a.kind===1?'#ff4477':'#88ccff', 14);
          aliens.splice(j,1); bullets.splice(i,1); shake = Math.max(shake,4);
          break;
        }
      }
    } else {
      if (invuln <= 0 && dist(b.x,b.y,ship.x,ship.y) < 14){
        lives--; invuln = 1.2; shake = 14;
        boom(ship.x,ship.y,'#ff6666',24);
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        if (lives <= 0) state='over';
      }
    }
  }

  // particles
  for (let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt; p.vy += 120*dt; p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  if (invuln > 0) invuln -= dt;
  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt*40);
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function draw(){
  const t = performance.now()/1000;
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake, (Math.random()-0.5)*shake);

  // background
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a1030'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0c1836'); g.addColorStop(1,'#04060f');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (let i=0;i<70;i++){
    const x = (i*97 + Math.floor(t*10)) % W;
    const y = (i*53) % H;
    const s = (i%5===0)?2:1;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4 + 0.4*Math.sin(t*2 + i);
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // distant planet
  ctx.fillStyle = '#20305a';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-70, 90, 40, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2c4070';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-80, 80, 14, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // particles
  for (const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life/p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // aliens
  for (const a of aliens){
    const c = a.kind===0 ? '#ff8844' : a.kind===1 ? '#ff4477' : '#88ccff';
    const bob = Math.sin(a.phase*2)*2;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(a.x, a.y+bob);
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,12,8,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e20';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-4,-1,2.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(4,-1,2.2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = c;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-6,4); ctx.lineTo(-2,8); ctx.lineTo(2,8); ctx.lineTo(6,4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // bullets
  for (const b of bullets){
    if (b.kind === 'player'){
      ctx.fillStyle = '#7fff7f';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x-2, b.y-8, 4, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x-1, b.y-8, 2, 4);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd0d0';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,1.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ship
  const blink = invuln > 0 && Math.floor(t*12)%2===0;
  if (!blink){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2fd6ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-18); ctx.lineTo(14,10); ctx.lineTo(0,4); ctx.lineTo(-14,10); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2a44';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-4,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7fff7f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-2,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,255,180,'+(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(t*20))+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,14,6,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score, 12, 10);
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+wave, W-110, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fff7f';
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(16 + i*20, 34, 7, 0, Math.PI*2);
    if (i < lives) ctx.fill(); else { ctx.strokeStyle='#334'; ctx.stroke(); }
  }

  // overlays
  if (state === 'start'){
    overlay('PENGUIN ADVENTURE', ['Move:  Arrow keys / WASD', 'Fire:  Space', 'P: Pause   R: Restart', ''], 'Press ENTER or SPACE to start');
  } else if (state === 'over'){
    overlay('GAME OVER', ['Final score: '+score, 'Wave reached: '+wave, ''], 'Press ENTER or SPACE to retry');
  } else if (state === 'win'){
    overlay('YOU WIN!', ['Score: '+score, 'All waves cleared', ''], 'Press ENTER or SPACE to play again');
  } else if (state === 'pause'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.font='28px monospace'; ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('PAUSED', W/2, H/2); ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

function overlay(title, lines, hint){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,15,0.78)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fff7f'; ctx.font='30px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(title, W/2, H/2-70);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#cfe8ff'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
  let y = H/2-30;
  for (const l of lines){ if (l){ ctx.fillText(l, W/2, y); y+=24; } }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a'; ctx.font='16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(hint, W/2, H/2+40);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

// ---------- loop ----------
function loop(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last)/1000 || 0); last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Alien Wave</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #070812;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    color: #fff;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border: 2px solid #2a2f4a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #05060f;
  }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

// ===== CANVAS =====
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// ===== GAME STATE =====
let ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 0, vy: 0, hp: 3, cooldown: 0 };
let playerBullets = [];
let alienBullets = [];
let aliens = [];
let stars = [];
let score = 0;
let wave = 1;
let waveTimer = 0;
let gameOver = false;
let startScreen = true;
let keys = {};

// ===== INIT STARS =====
for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  stars.push({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.8,
    size: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5
  });
}

// ===== INPUT =====
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (startScreen && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
    startScreen = false;
    spawnWave();
  }
  if (gameOver && (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter")) {
    resetGame();
  }
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  keys[e.key] = false;
});

function resetGame() {
  ship.x = W / 2;
  ship.y = H - 60;
  ship.hp = 3;
  ship.cooldown = 0;
  playerBullets = [];
  alienBullets = [];
  aliens = [];
  score = 0;
  wave = 1;
  waveTimer = 0;
  gameOver = false;
  startScreen = false;
  spawnWave();
}

// ===== SPAWN WAVE =====
function spawnWave() {
  const count = 4 + wave * 2;
  const cols = Math.min(count, 8);
  const rows = Math.ceil(count / cols);
  const spacingX = W / (cols + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
    const col = i % cols;
    const x = spacingX * (col + 1) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
    const y = 40 + row * 40;
    const type = Math.random() < 0.3 ? "fast" : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? "tough" : "normal");
    aliens.push({
      x: x,
      y: y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
      vy: 0.3 + wave * 0.08 + (type === "fast" ? 0.5 : 0),
      type: type,
      hp: type === "tough" ? 3 : (type === "fast" ? 1 : 2),
      maxHp: type === "tough" ? 3 : (type === "fast" ? 1 : 2),
      shootTimer: Math.random() * 120,
      alive: true
    });
  }
}

// ===== UPDATE =====
function update() {
  if (startScreen || gameOver) return;

  // Ship movement
  const speed = 4;
  if (keys["ArrowLeft"] || keys["a"] || keys["A"]) ship.x -= speed;
  if (keys["ArrowRight"] || keys["d"] || keys["D"]) ship.x += speed;
  ship.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, ship.x));

  // Shooting
  ship.cooldown--;
  if ((keys[" "] || keys["w"] || keys["W"] || keys["ArrowUp"]) && ship.cooldown <= 0) {
    playerBullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y - 15, vx: 0, vy: -7 });
    playerBullets.push({ x: ship.x - 8, y: ship.y - 10, vx: -0.5, vy: -6.5 });
    playerBullets.push({ x: ship.x + 8, y: ship.y - 10, vx: 0.5, vy: -6.5 });
    ship.cooldown = 10;
  }

  // Update player bullets
  for (let i = playerBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = playerBullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.y < -10 || b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10) {
      playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Update aliens
  for (let i = aliens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const a = aliens[i];
    if (!a.alive) continue;
    a.x += a.vx;
    a.y += a.vy;
    if (a.x < 15 || a.x > W - 15) a.vx *= -1;
    // Shoot
    a.shootTimer--;
    if (a.shootTimer <= 0 && a.y < H - 100) {
      const dx = ship.x - a.x;
      const dy = ship.y - a.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      const bulletSpeed = 2.5 + wave * 0.15;
      alienBullets.push({
        x: a.x,
        y: a.y + 10,
        vx: (dx / dist) * bulletSpeed,
        vy: (dy / dist) * bulletSpeed
      });
      a.shootTimer = 60 + Math.random() * 90;
    }
    // Reached bottom
    if (a.y > H - 30) {
      ship.hp--;
      a.alive = false;
      aliens.splice(i, 1);
      if (ship.hp <= 0) gameOver = true;
    }
  }

  // Update alien bullets
  for (let i = alienBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = alienBullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.y > H + 10 || b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10) {
      alienBullets.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    // Hit ship
    const dx = b.x - ship.x;
    const dy = b.y - ship.y;
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 14 && Math.abs(dy) < 14) {
      ship.hp--;
      alienBullets.splice(i, 1);
      if (ship.hp <= 0) gameOver = true;
    }
  }

  // Player bullets vs aliens
  for (let i = playerBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = playerBullets[i];
    for (let j = aliens.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const a = aliens[j];
      if (!a.alive) continue;
      if (Math.abs(b.x - a.x) < 16 && Math.abs(b.y - a.y) < 14) {
        a.hp--;
        playerBullets.splice(i, 1);
        if (a.hp <= 0) {
          a.alive = false;
          score += a.type === "tough" ? 30 : (a.type === "fast" ? 20 : 15);
          aliens.splice(j, 1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Wave complete
  if (aliens.length === 0) {
    waveTimer++;
    if (waveTimer > 60) {
      wave++;
      waveTimer = 0;
      spawnWave();
    }
  }

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
    const s = stars[i];
    s.y += s.speed;
    if (s.y > H) {
      s.y = 0;
      s.x = Math.random() * W;
    }
  }
}

// ===== DRAW =====
function draw() {
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = "#05060f";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Stars
  for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
    const s = stars[i];
    const brightness = 0.3 + (s.speed / 1.0) * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${brightness})`;
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
  }

  // Start screen
  if (startScreen) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0c1e";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
    ctx.font = "bold 28px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("ALIEN WAVE", W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#44ff88";
    ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("A Vampire Killer Homage", W / 2, 215);
    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = "#aabbdd";
    ctx.font = "14px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("← → or A/D to move", W / 2, 300);
    ctx.fillText("SPACE / W / ↑ to shoot", W / 2, 325);
    ctx.fillText("Dodge alien fire, destroy all waves!", W / 2, 350);
    // Blinking start prompt
    if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.font = "bold 18px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE TO START", W / 2, 450);
    }
    // Draw a decorative alien
    drawAlien(W / 2, 500, "normal", 1.5);
    return;
  }

  // Game over screen
  if (gameOver) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
    ctx.font = "bold 32px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, 220);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "20px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, 270);
    ctx.fillText("Wave: " + wave, W / 2, 300);
    if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 500) % 2 === 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#44ff88";
      ctx.font = "16px 'Courier New', monospace";
      ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE TO RESTART", W / 2, 400);
    }
    return;
  }

  // HUD
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 14px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE: " + score, 12, 22);
  ctx.fillText("WAVE: " + wave, 12, 40);
  // HP
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
  for (let i = 0; i < ship.hp; i++) {
    ctx.fillRect(W - 20 - i * 18, 12, 12, 12);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff4466";
  ctx.font = "10px 'Courier New', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("HP", W - 8, 32);

  // Player bullets
  ctx.fillStyle = "#44ffcc";
  for (let i = 0; i < playerBullets.length; i++) {
    const b = playerBullets[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#88ffdd";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#44ffcc";
  }

  // Alien bullets
  for (let i = 0; i < alienBullets.length; i++) {
    const b = alienBullets[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6644";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa66";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Aliens
  for (let i = 0; i < aliens.length; i++) {
    const a = aliens[i];
    if (!a.alive) continue;
    drawAlien(a.x, a.y, a.type, 1);
  }

  // Ship
  drawShip(ship.x, ship.y);
}

function drawShip(x, y) {
  // Body
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4488ff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - 18);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 14, y + 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 8, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 8, y + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 14, y + 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // Cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#aaddff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y - 4, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Wings
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2266dd";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 14, y + 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 22, y + 14);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 10, y + 12);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + 14, y + 8);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 22, y + 14);
  ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 12);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // Engine glow
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffaa44";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 5, y + 14, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 5, y + 14, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawAlien(x, y, type, scale) {
  const s = scale;
  // Body color by type
  let bodyColor, eyeColor;
  if (type === "fast") { bodyColor = "#ff8844"; eyeColor = "#ffff44"; }
  else if (type === "tough") { bodyColor = "#8844ff"; eyeColor = "#ff44ff"; }
  else { bodyColor = "#44cc88"; eyeColor = "#ffff66"; }

  // Body (oval)
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, 14 * s, 10 * s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Head (smaller oval on top)
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y - 8 * s, 8 * s, 6 * s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = eyeColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 4 * s, y - 9 * s, 2.5 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x + 4 * s, y - 9 * s, 2.5 * s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Tentacles
  ctx.strokeStyle = bodyColor;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2 * s;
  for (let t = -2; t <= 2; t++) {
    const tx = x + t * 5 * s;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(tx, y + 8 * s);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(tx + t * 2 * s, y + 14 * s, tx + t * 3 * s, y + 18 * s);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // HP bar for tough
  if (type === "tough") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#333";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12 * s, y - 20 * s, 24 * s, 3 * s);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff44ff";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12 * s, y - 20 * s, 24 * s * (1.0), 3 * s);
  }
}

// ===== GAME LOOP =====
function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

  "#e0503a", "#3a8ad4", "#e0c83a",
  "#3ac87a", "#c85ac8", "#c88a3a",
  "#4ac8c8", "#c84a6a", "#7ac84a"
];
const PIECE_GLYPHS = ["○","●","△","▲","□","■","◇","★","✦"];

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const pieces = [];          // {x,y,vx,vy,w,h,color,glyph,settled,flash}
let nextPiece = null;
let score = 0;
let linesMade = 0;
let gameOver = false;
let win = false;
let shake = 0;
let startFlash = 0;
let bgHue = 220;

function makePiece(col, row, color, glyph){
  return {
    x: boardX() + col * CELL,
    y: boardY() + row * CELL,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: CELL - 8, h: CELL - 8,
    color: color, glyph: glyph,
    settled: false, flash: 0
  };
}

function spawnNext(){
  const c = Math.floor(rand(0, COLS));
  const colorIdx = Math.floor(rand(0, PIECE_COLORS.length));
  nextPiece = {
    x: boardX() + c * CELL,
    y: -CELL,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    w: CELL - 8, h: CELL - 8,
    color: PIECE_COLORS[colorIdx],
    glyph: PIECE_GLYPHS[colorIdx],
    settled: false, flash: 0
  };
}

function startGame(){
  pieces.length = 0;
  score = 0;
  linesMade = 0;
  gameOver = false;
  win = false;
  shake = 0;
  startFlash = 1;
  spawnNext();
}
startGame();

/* ---------- line detection ---------- */
function cellOf(p){
  const bx = boardX(), by = boardY();
  return {
    c: Math.round((p.x - bx) / CELL),
    r: Math.round((p.y - by) / CELL)
  };
}

function findLinePieces(){
  const map = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++){
    if (!pieces[i].settled) continue;
    const {c, r} = cellOf(pieces[i]);
    const key = c + "," + r;
    if (!map[key]) map[key] = pieces[i];
  }
  const inLine = [];
  const dirs = [[1,0],[0,1],[1,1],[1,-1]];
  for (const key in map){
    const p = map[key];
    const [c, r] = key.split(",").map(Number);
    for (const [dc, dr] of dirs){
      const k1 = (c+dc) + "," + (r+dr);
      const k2 = (c+2*dc) + "," + (r+2*dr);
      if (map[k1] && map[k2]){
        if (p.color === map[k1].color && p.color === map[k2].color){
          if (!inLine.includes(p))   inLine.push(p);
          if (!inLine.includes(map[k1])) inLine.push(map[k1]);
          if (!inLine.includes(map[k2])) inLine.push(map[k2]);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return inLine;
}

function removePieces(list){
  for (let i = pieces.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
    if (list.includes(pieces[i])) pieces.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ---------- input ---------- */
function pointerX(e){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX) - rect.left;
}
function pointerY(e){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY) - rect.top;
}

function tryDrop(){
  if (!nextPiece || gameOver) return;
  const p = nextPiece;
  const {c, r} = cellOf(p);
  if (c < 0 || c >= COLS) { shake = 8; return; }
  // find lowest empty row in this column
  let targetRow = -1;
  for (let row = ROWS - 1; row >= 0; row--){
    const key = c + "," + row;
    let occupied = false;
    for (const q of pieces){
      if (q.settled){
        const qc = cellOf(q);
        if (qc.c === c && qc.r === row){ occupied = true; break; }
      }
    }
    if (!occupied){ targetRow = row; break; }
  }
  if (targetRow < 0){
    // column full — game over
    shake = 12;
    gameOver = true;
    win = false;
    return;
  }
  p.y = boardY() + targetRow * CELL;
  p.x = boardX() + c * CELL;
  p.vy = 0;
  p.vx = 0;
  p.settled = true;
  p.flash = 1;
  pieces.push(p);
  nextPiece = null;

  // check lines
  const linePieces = findLinePieces();
  if (linePieces.length >= 3){
    const pts = linePieces.length * 25;
    score += pts;
    linesMade += 1;
    removePieces(linePieces);
    shake = 6;
    // win condition: cleared everything
    if (pieces.length === 0){
      win = true;
      gameOver = true;
    }
  }
  spawnNext();
}

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  if (nextPiece && !gameOver){
    const x = pointerX(e);
    const col = clamp(Math.floor((x - boardX()) / CELL), 0, COLS - 1);
    nextPiece.x = boardX() + col * CELL;
    nextPiece.y = -CELL;
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (!gameOver && nextPiece){
    const x = pointerX(e);
    const col = clamp(Math.floor((x - boardX()) / CELL), 0, COLS - 1);
    nextPiece.x = boardX() + col * CELL;
    tryDrop();
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!gameOver && nextPiece){
    const x = pointerX(e);
    const col = clamp(Math.floor((x - boardX()) / CELL), 0, COLS - 1);
    nextPiece.x = boardX() + col * CELL;
    tryDrop();
  }
}, {passive:false});

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter"){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (gameOver){ startGame(); }
    else if (nextPiece){ tryDrop(); }
  }
});

/* ---------- update ---------- */
const GRAVITY = 0.35;
function update(){
  bgHue = (bgHue + 0.15) % 360;
  if (shake > 0) shake *= 0.85;
  if (startFlash > 0) startFlash -= 0.02;

  // falling next piece
  if (nextPiece && !gameOver){
    // next piece stays at top; no gravity on it
  }

  // flash decay
  for (const p of pieces){
    if (p.flash > 0) p.flash -= 0.05;
  }
}

/* ---------- draw ---------- */
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0d0a14");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a1028");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#0d0a14");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // subtle vignette
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, H*0.3, W/2, H/2, H);
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawBoard(){
  const bx = boardX(), by = boardY();
  // board background
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,14,30,0.85)";
  roundRect(bx - 14, by - 14, GW + 28, GH + 28, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,100,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let c = 0; c <= COLS; c++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(bx + c * CELL, by);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + c * CELL, by + GH);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let r = 0; r <= ROWS; r++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(bx, by + r * CELL);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + GW, by + r * CELL);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // column highlight for next piece
  if (nextPiece){
    const {c} = cellOf(nextPiece);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,100,0.07)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx + c * CELL, by, CELL, GH);
    // drop indicator
    let targetRow = -1;
    for (let row = ROWS - 1; row >= 0; row--){
      let occupied = false;
      for (const q of pieces){
        if (q.settled){
          const qc = cellOf(q);
          if (qc.c === c && qc.r === row){ occupied = true; break; }
        }
      }
      if (!occupied){ targetRow = row; break; }
    }
    if (targetRow >= 0){
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,100,0.2)";
      roundRect(bx + c * CELL + 4, by + targetRow * CELL + 4, CELL - 8, CELL - 8, 8);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawPiece(p, alpha){
  const x = p.x + 4, y = p.y + 4;
  const w = p.w, h = p.h;
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
  roundRect(x + 3, y + 3, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();

  // body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
  g.addColorStop(0, p.color);
  g.addColorStop(1, shadeColor(p.color, -30));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();

  // border
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // inner highlight
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";
  roundRect(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h / 3, 4);
  ctx.fill();

  // glyph
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(p.glyph, x + w / 2, y + h / 2);

  // flash
  if (p.flash > 0){
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (p.flash * 0.5) + ")";
    roundRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function shadeColor(hex, amt){
  let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3), 16);
  let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5), 16);
  let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7), 16);
  r = clamp(r + amt, 0, 255);
  g = clamp(g + amt, 0, 255);
  b = clamp(b + amt, 0, 255);
  return "#" + r.toString(16).padStart(2,"0") + g.toString(16).padStart(2,"0") + b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0");
}

function drawNextPiece(){
  if (!nextPiece) return;
  const x = nextPiece.x + 4;
  const y = nextPiece.y + 4;
  const w = nextPiece.w, h = nextPiece.h;

  // glow
  ctx.shadowColor = nextPiece.color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 15;

  // body
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + h);
  g.addColorStop(0, nextPiece.color);
  g.addColorStop(1, shadeColor(nextPiece.color, -30));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  roundRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "bold 22px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(nextPiece.glyph, x + w / 2, y + h / 2);
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,100,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "bold 18px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, 20, 16);
  ctx.fillText("LINES  " + linesMade, 20, 40);

  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  ctx.font = "14px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("MOVE + CLICK / SPACE TO DROP", W - 20, 16);
}

function drawGameOver(){
  if (!gameOver) return;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  if (win){
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4ac84a";
    ctx.font = "bold 48px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("BOARD CLEARED!", W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "24px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score + "   Lines: " + linesMade, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.font = "18px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to play again", W/2, H/2 + 50);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e0503a";
    ctx.font = "bold 48px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("STACK OVERFLOW", W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "24px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Score: " + score + "   Lines: " + linesMade, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.font = "18px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Press SPACE or ENTER to try again", W/2, H/2 + 50);
  }
}

function drawStartFlash(){
  if (startFlash <= 0) return;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (startFlash * 0.3) + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0.5){
    ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake), rand(-shake, shake));
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawBoard();
  for (const p of pieces) drawPiece(p, 1);
  drawNextPiece();
  drawHUD();
  drawStartFlash();
  drawGameOver();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- loop ---------- */
let lastTime = 0;
function loop(t){
  const dt = Math.min((t - lastTime) / 16.667, 3);
  lastTime = t;
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Smithereens</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#05060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,520px);height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #1b2f55;box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(40,90,220,.35);}
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="320" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const cvs=document.getElementById("game");
const ctx=cvs.getContext("2d");
const W=cvs.width,H=cvs.height;

// ---------- STATE ----------
const state={
  mode:"start",
  score:0,
  wave:0,
  lives:3,
  time:0,
  msg:""
};
const ship={x:W/2,y:H-46,vx:0,vy:0};
const bullets=[];
const enemies=[];
const ebullets=[];
const particles=[];
const stars=[];
const keys={};
let fireCd=0;

for(let i=0;i<64;i++){
  stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,s:Math.random()*1.5+0.3,tw:Math.random()*6.28,sp:Math.random()*0.5+0.15});
}

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a);}
function burst(x,y,color,n,spd){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*6.283,s=rand(0.5,spd);
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:rand(0.4,0.9),max:0.9,color});
  }
}
function startWave(){
  state.wave++;
  const count=4+state.wave*2;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const row=Math.floor(i/6);
    const col=i%6;
    enemies.push({
      x:34+col*((W-68)/5),
      y:54+row*34,
      vx:0,vy:0,
      hp:1,
      t:Math.random()*6.283,
      kind:Math.random()<0.25?"big":"small"
    });
  }
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  keys[k]=true;
  if(k===" "||k==="arrowup"||k==="arrowdown"||k==="arrowleft"||k==="arrowright")e.preventDefault();
  if(state.mode==="start"&&(k===" "||k==="enter")){
    state.mode="play";state.score=0;state.lives=3;state.wave=0;
    bullets.length=0;enemies.length=0;ebullets.length=0;
    ship.x=W/2;ship.y=H-46;
    startWave();
  }
  if(state.mode==="over"&&(k===" "||k==="enter")){
    state.mode="start";
  }
});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(dt){
  state.time+=dt;
  fireCd-=dt;
  if(state.mode!=="play")return;

  // ship
  const sp=230;
  ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0;
  if(keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"])ship.vx=-sp;
  if(keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"])ship.vx=sp;
  if(keys["arrowup"]||keys["w"])ship.vy=-sp;
  if(keys["arrowdown"]||keys["s"])ship.vy=sp;
  ship.x+=ship.vx*dt;
  ship.y+=ship.vy*dt;
  ship.x=Math.max(16,Math.min(W-16,ship.x));
  ship.y=Math.max(120,Math.min(H-24,ship.y));

  // fire
  if((keys[" "]||keys["j"]||keys["f"])&&fireCd<=0){
    bullets.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-14,vx:0,vy:-430});
    fireCd=0.22;
  }

  // bullets
  for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    if(b.y<-10)bullets.splice(i,1);
  }

  // enemies
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=enemies[i];
    e.t+=dt;
    e.x+=Math.sin(e.t*1.4+e.y*0.02)*22*dt;
    e.y+=12*dt;
    if(e.y>H+20){
      enemies.splice(i,1);
      state.lives--;
      state.msg="";
      if(state.lives<=0){state.mode="over";state.msg="GAME OVER";}
    }
    // enemy fire
    if(Math.random()<0.006){
      ebullets.push({x:e.x,y:e.y+10,vx:rand(-12,12),vy:150});
    }
    // hit by player bullet
    for(let j=bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const b=bullets[j];
      if(Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<14&&Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<14){
        bullets.splice(j,1);
        e.hp--;
        if(e.hp<=0){
          enemies.splice(i,1);
          state.score+=e.kind==="big"?50:25;
          burst(e.x,e.y,e.kind==="big"?"#ff9a3c":"#7ef0d0",14,3);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // enemy bullets
  for(let i=ebullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=ebullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;
    if(b.y>H+10||b.x<-10||b.x>W+10){ebullets.splice(i,1);continue;}
    if(Math.abs(b.x-ship.x)<12&&Math.abs(b.y-ship.y)<12){
      ebullets.splice(i,1);
      state.lives--;
      burst(ship.x,ship.y,"#ff5a7a",20,4);
      if(state.lives<=0){state.mode="over";state.msg="GAME OVER";}
    }
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=0.05;p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // wave cleared
  if(enemies.length===0){
    startWave();
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function drawShip(x,y){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  // glow
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(90,200,255,0.18)";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,18,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  // wings
  ctx.fillStyle="#3aa0ff";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-14,4);ctx.lineTo(-6,-2);ctx.lineTo(-6,10);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(14,4);ctx.lineTo(6,-2);ctx.lineTo(6,10);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle="#e8f6ff";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-14);ctx.lineTo(7,6);ctx.lineTo(-7,6);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="#2f6fd6";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-14);ctx.lineTo(3,2);ctx.lineTo(-3,2);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle="#0b1e46";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-3,2.4,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  // engine
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-4,7);ctx.lineTo(4,7);ctx.lineTo(0,16+Math.random()*3);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);
  const big=e.kind==="big";
  const body=big?"#ff9a3c":"#7ef0d0";
  const dark=big?"#c45a10":"#1f8f7d";
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=body;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,big?13:9,big?9:7,0,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  // dome
  ctx.fillStyle=dark;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-4,big?9:6,big?5:4,0,3.14,6.283);ctx.fill();
  // eye
  ctx.fillStyle="#0a0f24";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-1,big?3.2:2.2,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-1,-2,big?1:0.7,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle=dark;ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-6,6);ctx.lineTo(-9,12);
  ctx.moveTo(6,6);ctx.lineTo(9,12);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  // background
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0a0f2a");
  g.addColorStop(0.6,"#141a3d");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#241436");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // nebula blobs
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.16;
  ctx.fillStyle="#5a2f8f";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*0.7,H*0.25,70,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle="#2f6f9f";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*0.25,H*0.5,60,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  // stars
  for(const s of stars){
    const a=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(state.time*s.sp+s.tw);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+(0.3+a*0.6).toFixed(2)+")";
    ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.s,s.s);
  }

  // grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(80,120,220,0.10)";
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let y=H-40;y<H;y+=10){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=24){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,H-40);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(state.mode==="play"||state.mode==="over"){
    for(const e of enemies)drawEnemy(e);
    ctx.fillStyle="#cfeaff";
    for(const b of bullets)ctx.fillRect(b.x-1.5,b.y-6,3,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff6a8a";
    for(const b of ebullets){
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,3,0,6.283);ctx.fill();
    }
    for(const p of particles){
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);
      ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x-1.5,p.y-1.5,3,3);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    if(state.mode==="play")drawShip(ship.x,ship.y);
  }

  // HUD
  ctx.textBaseline="top";
  ctx.fillStyle="#eaf2ff";
  ctx.font="bold 13px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+state.score,8,8);
  ctx.textAlign="right";
  ctx.fillText("WAVE "+state.wave,W-8,8);
  ctx.textAlign="left";
  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle="#3aa0ff";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(8+i*16,28);ctx.lineTo(14+i*16,34);ctx.lineTo(2+i*16,34);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  }

  // overlays
  if(state.mode==="start"){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(5,8,20,0.62)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffd24a";
    ctx.font="bold 28px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SMITHEREENS",W/2,150);
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf2ff";
    ctx.font="13px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("Defend the ship. Blast the alien waves.",W/2,196);
    ctx.fillStyle="#9fb4e6";
    ctx.fillText("← →  ↑ ↓  (or WASD)  to move",W/2,236);
    ctx.fillText("SPACE  to fire",W/2,256);
    const blink=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(state.time*4);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(126,240,208,"+blink.toFixed(2)+")";
    ctx.font="bold 15px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  START",W/2,300);
    ctx.textAlign="left";
  }
  if(state.mode==="over"){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(5,8,20,0.66)";
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff5a7a";
    ctx.font="bold 30px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("GAME OVER",W/2,180);
    ctx.fillStyle="#eaf2ff";
    ctx.font="15px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("FINAL SCORE  "+state.score,W/2,224);
    const blink=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(state.time*4);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(126,240,208,"+blink.toFixed(2)+")";
    ctx.font="bold 14px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("PRESS  ENTER  TO  RESTART",W/2,270);
    ctx.textAlign="left";
  }
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000;
  last=now;
  if(dt>0.05)dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');

const GROUND = H - 46;
const SHIPW = 46, SHIPH = 26;
const BULLET_SPEED = 460;
const ALIEN_SPEED = 120;
const FIRE_SPEED = 230;

addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startGame(){

function spawnAlien(){
  const x = 30 + Math.random()*(W-60);
  aliens.push({ x, y: 20, vx: 0, vy: ALIEN_SPEED, hp: 2, seed: Math.random()*6 });
}

function fire(){
  if (fireCd <= 0){
    bullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y - SHIPH/2, vx: 0, vy: -BULLET_SPEED, hp: 1 });
    fireCd = 0.18;
  }
}

function explode(x, y, color){
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++){
    const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s = 60 + Math.random()*120;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a)*s, vy: Math.sin(a)*s, life: 0.5, max: 0.5, color });
  }
}

function update(dt){
  time += dt;
  if (state !== 'play') return;

  // Ship movement
  const sp = 340;
  let ax = 0;
  if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ax -= 1;
  if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ax += 1;
  ship.x += ax * sp * dt;
  ship.x = Math.max(SHIPW/2, Math.min(W - SHIPW/2, ship.x));

  if (keys[' '] || keys['w']) fire();
  fireCd -= dt;

  // Spawn aliens
  if (aliens.length < MAX_ALIENS && Math.random() < dt * 2.2) spawnAlien();

  // Move bullets
  for (let i = bullets.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const b = bullets[i];
    b.x += b.vx*dt; b.y += b.vy*dt;
    if (b.y < -20){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    // hit aliens
    for (let j = aliens.length-1; j >= 0; j--){
      const a = aliens[j];
      if (Math.abs(b.x - a.x) < 16 && Math.abs(b.y - a.y) < 16){
        a.hp -= 1;
        bullets.splice(i,1);
        if (a.hp <= 0){
          explode(a.x, a.y, '#ff5b6a');
          aliens.splice(j,1);
          score += 10;
        } else {
          explode(a.x, a.y, '#ffd24a');
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Move aliens + fire
  for (let i = aliens.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const a = aliens[i];
    a.y += a.vy*dt;
    // fire at ship
    if (Math.random() < dt * 0.9){
      const dx = ship.x - a.x, dy = (ship.y - 10) - a.y;
      const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1;
      shots.push({ x: a.x, y: a.y + 12, vx: dx/len*FIRE_SPEED, vy: dy/len*FIRE_SPEED, hp: 1 });
    }
    if (a.y > GROUND - 8){
      explode(a.x, GROUND-8, '#ff5b6a');
      aliens.splice(i,1);
      score -= 5;
    }
  }

  // Move shots
  for (let i = shots.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const s = shots[i];
    s.x += s.vx*dt; s.y += s.vy*dt;
    if (s.y > H + 20 || s.x < -20 || s.x > W+20){ shots.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if (Math.abs(s.x - ship.x) < SHIPW/2 && Math.abs(s.y - ship.y) < SHIPH/2){
      shots.splice(i,1);
      shipHP -= 1;
      explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#7fd4ff');
      if (shipHP <= 0){ state = 'over'; best = Math.max(best, score); }
    }
  }

  // Particles
  for (let i = particles.length-1; i >= 0; i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    p.vy += 300*dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function drawShip(){
  const x = ship.x, y = ship.y;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd4ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -SHIPH/2);
  ctx.lineTo(SHIPW/2, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-SHIPW/2, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // cockpit
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f22';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -2, 6, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  // engines
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-10, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.lineTo(-4, SHIPH/2 + 8 + Math.random()*6);
  ctx.lineTo(0, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(10, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.lineTo(4, SHIPH/2 + 8 + Math.random()*6);
  ctx.lineTo(0, SHIPH/2);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawAlien(a){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
  const wob = Math.sin(time*6 + a.seed) * 3;
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 14, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  // dome
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c0303f';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, -6, 10, 6, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0f22';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5, 0, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd4ff';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, 0, 1.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5, 0, 1.4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff5b6a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-8, 10); ctx.lineTo(-12, 18 + wob);
  ctx.moveTo(8, 10); ctx.lineTo(12, 18 - wob);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw(){
  // sky
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0f22');
  g.addColorStop(0.6,'#101a35');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#1a2440');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++){
    const sx = (i*97) % W;
    const sy = (i*53) % (GROUND-40);
    const tw = 0.4 + 0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(time*2 + i));
    ctx.globalAlpha = tw;
    ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // ground
  ctx.fillStyle = '#243a2a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H-GROUND);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3a5a3a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, 6);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2e4a34'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 24){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i, GROUND); ctx.lineTo(i, H); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // bullets
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  for (const b of bullets){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3c0';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
  }

  // aliens
  for (const a of aliens) drawAlien(a);

  // shots
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
  for (const s of shots){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // particles
  for (const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-2, p.y-2, 4, 4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // ship
  drawShip();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 14, 26);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('BEST ' + best, W-14, 26);

  // hearts
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  for (let i = 0; i < shipHP; i++){
    const hx = 14 + i*22, hy = 44;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(hx-4, hy, 5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(hx+4, hy, 5, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(hx-9, hy+2);
    ctx.lineTo(hx, hy+14);
    ctx.lineTo(hx+9, hy+2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // overlays
  if (state === 'start'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,15,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd4ff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 34px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('COMPUTER GOLF', W/2, H/2 - 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('1978 — shoot the aliens, dodge their fire', W/2, H/2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.fillText('← → move    SPACE fire', W/2, H/2 + 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO START', W/2, H/2 + 70);
  } else if (state === 'over'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,15,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b6a';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 40px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '20px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd24a';
    ctx.fillText('BEST ' + best, W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7fd4ff';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER TO RESTART', W/2, H/2 + 80);
  }
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
