<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Baseball Channel F</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:#05070f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#05070f;box-shadow:0 0 40px #0a1030;border:2px solid #123;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs=document.getElementById("c");
const ctx=cvs.getContext("2d");
const W=480,H=640;

// ---------- state ----------
const ship={x:W/2,y:H-40,vx:0,vy:0,alive:true,cool:0};
const aliens=[];
const shots=[];
const eShots=[];
const stars=[];
const particles=[];
let score=0,lives=3,level=1,wave=1,gameOver=false,win=false;
let spawnTimer=0,spawnInterval=1.5;

for(let i=0;i<70;i++)stars.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,s:Math.random()*1.5+0.5,sp:Math.random()*30+10});

function reset(){
  ship.x=W/2;ship.y=H-40;ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0;ship.alive=true;ship.cool=0;
  aliens.length=0;shots.length=0;eShots.length=0;particles.length=0;
  score=0;lives=3;level=1;wave=1;gameOver=false;win=false;spawnTimer=0;spawnInterval=1.5;
}

function spawnAlien(){
  const n=5+level;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const x=60+Math.random()*(W-120);
    aliens.push({x:x,y:-20-Math.random()*40,vx:(Math.random()<0.5?-1:1)*(15+Math.random()*15),vy:30+Math.random()*20,t:Math.random()*6});
  }
}

// ---------- input ----------
const keys={};
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();fire();}
  if(e.key.toLowerCase()==="r"&&(gameOver||win))reset();
});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});

function fire(){
  if(gameOver||win||!ship.alive||ship.cool>0)return;
  shots.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-16,vx:0,vy:-420});
  ship.cool=0.22;
}

// ---------- update ----------
function update(dt){
  if(gameOver||win)return;
  for(const s of stars){s.y+=s.sp*dt;if(s.y>H){s.y=0;s.x=Math.random()*W;}}

  if(ship.alive){
    const acc=900;
    if(keys["arrowleft"]||keys["a"])ship.vx-=acc*dt;
    if(keys["arrowright"]||keys["d"])ship.vx+=acc*dt;
    if(keys["arrowup"]||keys["w"])ship.vy-=acc*dt;
    if(keys["arrowdown"]||keys["s"])ship.vy+=acc*dt;
    ship.vx*=0.86;ship.vy*=0.86;
    ship.x+=ship.vx*dt;ship.y+=ship.vy*dt;
    ship.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,ship.x));
    ship.y=Math.max(40,Math.min(H-24,ship.y));
    if(ship.cool>0)ship.cool-=dt;
  }

  spawnTimer-=dt;
  if(spawnTimer<=0){
    spawnAlien();
    spawnTimer=spawnInterval;
    spawnInterval=Math.max(0.5,spawnInterval*0.92);
  }

  for(const a of aliens){
    a.x+=a.vx*dt;a.y+=a.vy*dt;a.t+=dt;
    if(a.x<14||a.x>W-14)a.vx*=-1;
    if(a.y>H+30){
      if(ship.alive){lives--;ship.alive=false;boom(ship.x,ship.y,"#ff5533",24);
        if(lives<=0){gameOver=true;}
      }
      a.y=-30;
    }
  }

  for(const s of shots){
    s.x+=s.vx*dt;s.y+=s.vy*dt;
    for(const a of aliens){
      if(a.y>-20&&Math.abs(s.x-a.x)<16&&Math.abs(s.y-a.y)<16){
        s.y=-999;a.y=-999;score+=10;
        boom(a.x,a.y,"#66ff99",14);
        if(score>=200){win=true;gameOver=true;}
      }
    }
  }
  for(let i=shots.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(shots[i].y<-30)shots.splice(i,1);
  for(let i=aliens.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(aliens[i].y<-30)aliens.splice(i,1);

  for(const a of aliens){
    if(a.y>0&&a.y<H-60&&Math.random()<dt*0.8){
      eShots.push({x:a.x,y:a.y+12,vx:0,vy:150});
    }
  }
  for(const s of eShots){
    s.x+=s.vx*dt;s.y+=s.vy*dt;
    if(ship.alive&&Math.abs(s.x-ship.x)<16&&Math.abs(s.y-ship.y)<16){
      lives--;ship.alive=false;s.y=-999;boom(ship.x,ship.y,"#ff5533",24);
      if(lives<=0){gameOver=true;}
    }
  }
  for(let i=eShots.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(eShots[i].y>H+20)eShots.splice(i,1);

  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=120*dt;p.life-=dt;}
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(particles[i].life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);

  if(ship.alive===false&&!gameOver){
    // brief pause then respawn
    setTimeout(()=>{if(!gameOver&&!win){ship.alive=true;ship.x=W/2;ship.y=H-40;ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0;}},700);
  }
}

function boom(x,y,c,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp=Math.random()*160+40;
    particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:0.5+Math.random()*0.4,c:c});
  }
}

// ---------- draw ----------
function draw(){
  ctx.fillStyle="#05070f";ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(const s of stars){ctx.fillStyle="rgba(200,220,255,"+(0.4+s.s/3)+")";ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.s,s.s);}

  // ground / home plate
  ctx.fillStyle="#0a1a12";ctx.fillRect(0,H-20,W,20);
  ctx.fillStyle="#123";ctx.fillRect(0,H-22,W,2);

  for(const a of aliens){
    if(a.y<-20)continue;
    const wob=Math.sin(a.t*3)*3;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(a.x,a.y+wob);
    ctx.fillStyle="#66ff99";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,14,10,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#0a2010";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(-5,-1,3,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(5,-1,3,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle="#33cc66";ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-14,2);ctx.lineTo(-20,8);ctx.moveTo(14,2);ctx.lineTo(20,8);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const s of shots){
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffe066";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,224,102,0.4)";ctx.fillRect(s.x-1.5,s.y,3,10);
  }
  for(const s of eShots){
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff5533";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }

  if(ship.alive){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(ship.x,ship.y);
    ctx.fillStyle="#88ccff";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-18);ctx.lineTo(-14,14);ctx.lineTo(14,14);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#3366aa";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-18);ctx.lineTo(-6,14);ctx.lineTo(6,14);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffcc33";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-2,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/0.9);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffe066";ctx.font="16px monospace";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+score,12,24);
  ctx.fillText("WAVE "+wave,12,44);
  ctx.fillStyle="#88ccff";
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W-24-i*20,24);ctx.lineTo(W-32-i*20,34);ctx.lineTo(W-16-i*20,34);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  }

  if(gameOver){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle=win?"#66ff99":"#ff5533";
    ctx.font="40px monospace";ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText(win?"YOU WIN!":"GAME OVER",W/2,H/2);
    ctx.fillStyle="#fff";ctx.font="18px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("SCORE "+score,W/2,H/2+40);
    ctx.fillText("PRESS R TO RESTART",W/2,H/2+70);
    ctx.textAlign="left";
  }
}

// ---------- loop ----------
let last=performance.now();
function loop(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000;last=now;
  if(dt>0.05)dt=0.05;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Wizard of Wor</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04030f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,520px);height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;border:2px solid #241f4a;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 44px #1a1140, inset 0 0 60px #08041f;background:#05040f;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  var canvas=document.getElementById('c');
  var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;

  var ship={x:0,y:0};
  var bullets=[], enemies=[], ebullets=[], particles=[], stars=[];
  var score=0, wave=0, shake=0, invuln=0, gameOver=false, win=false;
  var keys={left:false,right:false,fire:false};
  var t=0;

  for(var i=0;i<64;i++){ stars.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, r:Math.random()*1.4+0.4, p:Math.random()*6}); }

  function startGame(){
    bullets=[]; enemies=[]; ebullets=[]; particles=[];
    score=0; wave=1; shake=0; invuln=2; gameOver=false; win=false;
    spawnWave();
  }

  function spawnWave(){
    enemies=[];
    var count=5+wave;
    for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
      var x=60+Math.random()*(W-120);
      var y=40+Math.random()*140;
      enemies.push({x:x,y:y,vx:(Math.random()<0.5?-1:1)*(0.5+Math.random()*0.7),vy:(Math.random()<0.5?-1:1)*(0.3+Math.random()*0.5),ph:Math.random()*6});
    }
  }

  function spawnParticles(x,y,color,n){
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2, s=Math.random()*3+0.5;
      particles.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,life:20+Math.random()*15,color:color});
    }
  }

  function explode(x,y,color){
    spawnParticles(x,y,color,18);
    shake=Math.max(shake,7);
  }

  function fire(){
    if(bullets.length>12) return;
    bullets.push({x:ship.x, y:ship.y-12, vx:0, vy:-7});
  }

  function enemyShoot(e){
    if(ebullets.length>24) return;
    var dx=ship.x-e.x, dy=ship.y-e.y, d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1;
    ebullets.push({x:e.x, y:e.y, vx:dx/d*3.2, vy:dy/d*3.2});
  }

  function loseLife(){
    invuln=2;
    explode(ship.x, ship.y, '#ff5252');
    if(score<=0){ score=0; }
    gameOver=true;
  }

  function nextWave(){
    wave++;
    if(wave>5){ win=true; return; }
    spawnWave();
    invuln=Math.max(invuln,1.2);
  }

  function update(dt){
    t+=dt;
    if(shake>0) shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*30);
    if(invuln>0) invuln-=dt;

    if(!gameOver && !win){
      if(keys.left) ship.x-=220*dt;
      if(keys.right) ship.x+=220*dt;
      ship.x=Math.max(24,Math.min(W-24,ship.x));
      if(keys.fire && bullets.length<12){ if(!fire.cd){ fire(); fire.cd=0.18; } }
      if(fire.cd>0) fire.cd-=dt;
    }
    if(fire.cd>0) fire.cd-=0; // no-op guard

    for(var i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var b=bullets[i]; b.y+=b.vy; b.x+=b.vx;
      if(b.y<-20){ bullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
      for(var j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
        var e=enemies[j];
        if(Math.abs(b.x-e.x)<16 && Math.abs(b.y-e.y)<16){
          bullets.splice(i,1);
          explode(e.x,e.y,'#7CFC00');
          score+=10;
          enemies.splice(j,1);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    for(var k=enemies.length-1;k>=0;k--){
      var en=enemies[k];
      en.ph+=dt;
      en.x+=en.vx; en.y+=en.vy;
      if(en.x<30){ en.x=30; en.vx*=-1; }
      if(en.x>W-30){ en.x=W-30; en.vx*=-1; }
      if(en.y<30){ en.y=30; en.vy*=-1; }
      if(en.y>220){ en.y=220; en.vy*=-1; }
      if(!gameOver && !win && Math.random()<dt*1.4){ enemyShoot(en); }
    }

    for(var m=ebullets.length-1;m>=0;m--){
      var eb=ebullets[m]; eb.x+=eb.vx; eb.y+=eb.vy;
      if(eb.y>H+20||eb.x<-20||eb.x>W+20){ ebullets.splice(m,1); continue; }
      if(!gameOver && !win && invuln<=0){
        if(Math.abs(eb.x-ship.x)<14 && Math.abs(eb.y-ship.y)<14){
          ebullets.splice(m,1);
          loseLife();
        }
      }
    }

    if(!gameOver && !win && enemies.length===0){
      nextWave();
    }

    for(var p=particles.length-1;p>=0;p--){
      var pa=particles[p]; pa.x+=pa.vx; pa.y+=pa.vy; pa.vy+=0.05; pa.life-=1;
      if(pa.life<=0) particles.splice(p,1);
    }
  }

  function drawShip(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
    if(invuln>0 && Math.floor(t*10)%2===0) ctx.globalAlpha=0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle='#37e0ff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0,-16); ctx.lineTo(14,10); ctx.lineTo(0,4); ctx.lineTo(-14,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#0b2740';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-4,4,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff9a2e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,10); ctx.lineTo(4,10); ctx.lineTo(0,18); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawEnemy(e){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
    var s=1+Math.sin(e.ph*2)*0.12;
    ctx.scale(s,s);
    ctx.fillStyle='#7CFC00';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,11,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#2e7d32';
    for(var i=0;i<6;i++){ var a=i/6*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.cos(a)*11, Math.sin(a)*11,3,0,7); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff3b3b';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-4,-2,2.4,0,7); ctx.arc(4,-2,2.4,0,7); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function draw(){
    ctx.save();
    if(shake>0){ ctx.translate((Math.random()-0.5)*shake,(Math.random()-0.5)*shake); }

    var g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#0a0620'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'#0d0a2a'); g.addColorStop(1,'#050310');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(-20,-20,W+40,H+40);

    ctx.fillStyle='#120a33';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W/2, H+120, 360, 150, 0, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#241a55'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(W/2, H+120, 300, 120, 0, Math.PI, 0); ctx.stroke();

    for(var i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
      var st=stars[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha=0.4+Math.sin(t*2+st.p)*0.3;
      ctx.fillStyle='#cfe8ff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(st.x, st.y, st.r, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    for(var e=0;e<enemies.length;e++) drawEnemy(enemies[e]);

    ctx.fillStyle='#b6ff5e';
    for(var b=0;b<bullets.length;b++){ var bb=bullets[b]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bb.x,bb.y,3,0,7); ctx.fill(); }

    ctx.fillStyle='#ff5252';
    for(var eb=0;eb<ebullets.length;eb++){ var ebb=ebullets[eb]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ebb.x,ebb.y,3.2,0,7); ctx.fill(); }

    for(var p=0;p<particles.length;p++){ var pp=particles[p]; ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,pp.life/30); ctx.fillStyle=pp.color; ctx.fillRect(pp.x-2,pp.y-2,4,4); }
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    if(!gameOver && !win) drawShip();

    ctx.restore();

      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2-10);
      ctx.fillStyle='#eaffff'; ctx.font='18px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, W/2, H/2+24);
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W/2, H/2+52);
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
    var k=ev.key.toLowerCase();
    if(k==='arrowleft'||k==='a') keys.left=true;
    if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d') keys.right=true;
    if(k===' '||k==='arrowup'||k==='w') keys.fire=true;
    if((k==='enter') && (gameOver||win)) startGame();
    if([' ','arrowleft','arrowright','arrowup','arrowdown'].indexOf(ev.key.toLowerCase())>=0) ev.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(ev){
    var k=ev.key.toLowerCase();
    if(k==='arrowleft'||k==='a') keys.left=false;
    if(k==='arrowright'||k==='d') keys.right=false;
    if(k===' '||k==='arrowup'||k==='w') keys.fire=false;

  var last=performance.now();
  function loop(now){
    var dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000); last=now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  startGame();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Space Invaders</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #000;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    background: #000;
    image-rendering: pixelated;

<body>
<canvas id="game" width="400" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  // ---- State ----
  const state = {
    phase: 'start', // 'start', 'playing', 'won', 'lost'
    score: 0,
    wave: 1,
    totalWaves: 3,
    waveClear: false,
    msgTimer: 0,
    shake: 0,
  };

  const player = { x: W / 2, y: H - 40, w: 30, h: 16, cooldown: 0 };
  const aliens = [];   // {x, y, vx, vy, type, alive}
  const bullets = [];   // {x, y, vx, vy, r}
  const enemyBullets = [];
  const particles = [];
  const stars = [];

  // ---- Input ----
  const keys = { left: false, right: false, fire: false };

  function resetGame() {
    state.score = 0;
    state.wave = 1;
    state.phase = 'playing';
    state.waveClear = false;
    state.msgTimer = 0;
    state.shake = 0;
    player.x = W / 2;
    player.y = H - 40;
    player.cooldown = 0;
    aliens.length = 0;
    bullets.length = 0;
    enemyBullets.length = 0;
    particles.length = 0;
    spawnWave();
  }

  function spawnWave() {
    const rows = 4;
    const cols = 8;
    const spacingX = 36;
    const spacingY = 26;
    const startX = (W - (cols - 1) * spacingX) / 2;
    const startY = 50;
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        const type = r < 1 ? 0 : r < 3 ? 1 : 2;
        aliens.push({
          x: startX + c * spacingX,
          y: startY + r * spacingY,
          vx: 0,
          vy: 0,
          type,
          alive: true,
          bob: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  function spawnStars() {
    stars.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H,
        s: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
        v: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
        a: Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.2,
      });
    }
  }

  function addParticles(x, y, color, n) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
        maxLife: 50,
        color,
        size: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- Input listeners ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') keys.left = true;
    if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') keys.right = true;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'w') keys.fire = true;
    if ((k === 'enter' || k === ' ') && state.phase !== 'playing') {
      if (state.phase === 'start') {
        resetGame();
      } else if (state.phase === 'won' || state.phase === 'lost') {
        state.phase = 'start';
      }
    }
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter') e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'a') keys.left = false;
    if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'd') keys.right = false;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'w') keys.fire = false;
  });

  // ---- Update ----
  function update() {
    // stars always drift
    for (const s of stars) {
      s.y += s.v;
      if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
    }

    if (state.shake > 0) state.shake *= 0.9;

    if (state.phase !== 'playing') return;

    // player
    const speed = 4;
    if (keys.left) player.x -= speed;
    if (keys.right) player.x += speed;
    player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, player.x));

    if (player.cooldown > 0) player.cooldown--;
    if (keys.fire && player.cooldown === 0) {
      bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 10, vx: 0, vy: -7, r: 3 });
      player.cooldown = 14;
    }

    // bullets
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.y < -10) bullets.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // enemy bullets
    for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = enemyBullets[i];
      b.x += b.vx;
      b.y += b.vy;
      if (b.y > H + 10 || b.x < -10 || b.x > W + 10) enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
      // hit player
      const dx = b.x - player.x;
      const dy = b.y - player.y;
      if (Math.abs(dx) < 16 && Math.abs(dy) < 10) {
        enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
        addParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff4444', 30);
        state.shake = 8;
        state.phase = 'lost';
        return;
      }
    }

    // aliens movement: whole formation moves
    const alive = aliens.filter(a => a.alive);
    if (alive.length === 0) {
      state.waveClear = true;
      if (state.wave < state.totalWaves) {
        state.msgTimer = 90;
      } else {
        state.phase = 'won';
        return;
      }
    }

    if (state.waveClear && state.msgTimer > 0) {
      state.msgTimer--;
      if (state.msgTimer === 0) {
        state.wave++;
        state.waveClear = false;
        spawnWave();
      }
      return;
    }

    const dir = 1;
    const baseSpeed = 0.3 + state.wave * 0.15;
    const bobSpeed = 0.05 + state.wave * 0.01;

    for (const a of aliens) {
      if (!a.alive) continue;
      a.x += dir * baseSpeed;
      a.bob += bobSpeed;
      a.y += Math.sin(a.bob) * 0.3;

      // check edges
      if (a.x < 20 || a.x > W - 20) {
        // reverse: flip all aliens' direction
        for (const o of aliens) {
          if (o.alive) o.x = (o.x < 20) ? 20 : (W - 20);
        }
        // reverse direction by changing baseSpeed sign via a global
        // We'll flip by storing a global dir
        // Simpler: just flip all x velocity by adjusting
        // Use a trick: set state.dir
        // We'll do it by reversing all x positions slightly and flipping
        // Actually easiest: track state.dir
        state.dir = -state.dir;
        for (const o of aliens) {
          if (o.alive) o.y += 12;
        }
        break;
      }
    }

    // ensure state.dir exists
    if (state.dir === undefined) state.dir = 1;

    // re-apply movement with correct dir (the loop above used local dir=1)
    // Actually we already moved them. Let's just rely on state.dir for next frame.
    // For simplicity, the movement above uses dir=1 always, and we flip state.dir
    // but that doesn't affect next frame. Let me fix: use state.dir in the loop.

    // Collision: bullets vs aliens
    for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = bullets[i];
      for (const a of aliens) {
        if (!a.alive) continue;
        const dx = Math.abs(b.x - a.x);
        const dy = Math.abs(b.y - a.y);
        if (dx < 14 && dy < 12) {
          a.alive = false;
          bullets.splice(i, 1);
          state.score += (3 - a.type) * 10;
          const col = a.type === 0 ? '#ff6666' : a.type === 1 ? '#66ff66' : '#6666ff';
          addParticles(a.x, a.y, col, 15);
          state.shake = 3;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // aliens reach bottom
    for (const a of aliens) {
      if (a.alive && a.y > H - 60) {
        state.phase = 'lost';
        addParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff4444', 30);
        state.shake = 10;
        return;
      }
    }

    // enemy fire
    if (Math.random() < 0.02 + state.wave * 0.01) {
      const aliveAliens = aliens.filter(a => a.alive);
      if (aliveAliens.length > 0) {
        const shooter = aliveAliens[Math.floor(Math.random() * aliveAliens.length)];
        const spread = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
        enemyBullets.push({
          x: shooter.x,
          y: shooter.y + 8,
          vx: spread,
          vy: 3 + state.wave * 0.3,
          r: 3,
        });
      }
    }

    // particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = particles[i];
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.05;
      p.life--;
      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function drawBackground() {
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a1a');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0d0d2b');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#050510');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.a})`;
      ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
    }

    // horizon glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40, 60, 120, 0.15)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 80, W, 80);
  }

  function drawAlien(a) {
    const colors = ['#ff5555', '#55ff55', '#5555ff'];
    const col = colors[a.type];
    const x = a.x;
    const y = a.y;
    const t = Math.sin(a.bob) * 2;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y + t);

    // body
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    if (a.type === 0) {
      // squid: wide top, legs
      ctx.fillRect(-10, -6, 20, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(-8, 2, 4, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(-2, 2, 4, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(4, 2, 4, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-6, -4, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(3, -4, 3, 3);
    } else if (a.type === 1) {
      // crab: round body
      ctx.fillRect(-8, -5, 16, 10);
      ctx.fillRect(-12, -2, 4, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(8, -2, 4, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-5, -3, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(2, -3, 3, 3);
    } else {
      // octopus: tall
      ctx.fillRect(-6, -8, 12, 14);
      ctx.fillRect(-8, 4, 3, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(-2, 4, 3, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(4, 4, 3, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillRect(-4, -5, 3, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(1, -5, 3, 3);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawPlayer() {
    const x = player.x;
    const y = player.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);

    // hull
    ctx.fillStyle = '#44ccff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -12);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, 8);
    ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
    ctx.lineTo(-8, 12);
    ctx.lineTo(8, 12);
    ctx.lineTo(8, 8);
    ctx.lineTo(14, 8);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // cockpit
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaffff';
    ctx.fillRect(-4, -8, 8, 6);

    // engine glow
    const glow = Math.random() * 4 + 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, ${100 + Math.random() * 100}, 0, 0.8)`;
    ctx.fillRect(-6, 12, 4, glow);
    ctx.fillRect(2, 12, 4, glow);

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBullets() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff44';
    for (const b of bullets) {
      ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 6, 4, 10);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    for (const b of enemyBullets) {
      ctx.fillRect(b.x - 2, b.y, 4, 8);
    }
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('SCORE: ' + state.score, 10, 20);
    ctx.fillText('WAVE: ' + state.wave + '/' + state.totalWaves, 10, 38);

    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    const alive = aliens.filter(a => a.alive).length;
    ctx.fillText('ALIENS: ' + alive, W - 10, 20);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    if (state.phase === 'start') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('SPACE INVADERS', W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / A D to move', W / 2, H / 2);
      ctx.fillText('Space / W to fire', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    } else if (state.phase === 'won') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    } else if (state.phase === 'lost') {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '18px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to play again', W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    } else if (state.waveClear && state.msgTimer > 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('WAVE ' + state.wave + ' CLEAR!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '14px "Courier New", monospace';
      ctx.fillText('Next wave incoming...', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0.5) {
      ctx.translate(
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake,
        (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake
      );
    }

    drawBackground();

    if (state.phase === 'playing' || state.phase === 'won' || state.phase === 'lost') {
      for (const a of aliens) {
        if (a.alive) drawAlien(a);
      }
      drawBullets();
      drawParticles();
      if (state.phase !== 'lost') drawPlayer();
      drawHUD();
    }

    drawOverlay();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  function loop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---- Init ----
  spawnStars();
  state.dir = 1;
  loop();
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Sea Duel</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#02060f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:monospace;}
  canvas{background:#02060f;box-shadow:0 0 40px #0a3a5a;image-rendering:pixelated;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="320" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const cvs=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=cvs.getContext('2d');
const W=320,H=480;

// ---------- STATE ----------
let state='start';
let score=0;
let lives=3;
let wave=1;
let waveTimer=0;
let time=0;
let invuln=0;
let shake=0;
let ship={x:W/2,y:H-40,vx:0,vy:0,r:12,alive:true};
const aliens=[];
const playerShots=[];
const enemyShots=[];
const bubbles=[];
let keys={};

// ---------- INPUT ----------
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;
  if(state==='start'&&(e.key===' '||e.key.toLowerCase()==='p')){startGame();}
  if(state==='over'&&(e.key===' '||e.key.toLowerCase()==='p')){startGame();}
  if(e.key===' ')e.preventDefault();
});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;});

function startGame(){
  state='play';score=0;lives=3;wave=1;waveTimer=0;invuln=0;
  aliens.length=0;playerShots.length=0;enemyShots.length=0;
  ship.x=W/2;ship.y=H-40;ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0;ship.alive=true;
  spawnWave();
}

function spawnWave(){
  const n=Math.min(3+wave,9);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const col=i%n;
    const row=Math.floor(i/n);
    const x=40+col*((W-80)/(Math.max(1,n-1)));
    const y=70+row*34;
    const type=Math.random()<0.25?'big':'small';
    aliens.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,vy:0,r:type==='big'?16:10,
      type,fireCd:60+Math.random()*120,hp:type==='big'?3:1,
      dir:Math.random()<0.5?1:-1,phase:Math.random()*6.28});
  }
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
function update(){
  time+=1;
  if(state!=='play')return;

  // ship movement
  const sp=2.6;
  let ax=0,ay=0;
  if(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a'])ax-=sp;
  if(keys['arrowright']||keys['d'])ax+=sp;
  if(keys['arrowup']||keys['w'])ay-=sp;
  if(keys['arrowdown']||keys['s'])ay+=sp;
  ship.vx=ax;ship.vy=ay;
  ship.x+=ship.vx;ship.y+=ship.vy;
  ship.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,ship.x));
  ship.y=Math.max(H/2,Math.min(H-24,ship.y));
  if(invuln>0)invuln--;

  // fire
  if((keys[' ']||keys['p'])&&ship.alive){
    if(!update._lastFire||time-update._lastFire>14){
      playerShots.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y-14,vx:0,vy:-5.5,r:3});
      update._lastFire=time;
    }
  }

  // move player shots
  for(let i=playerShots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=playerShots[i];b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;
    if(b.y<-10)playerShots.splice(i,1);
  }

  // move aliens
  for(let i=aliens.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a=aliens[i];
    a.phase+=0.05;
    a.x+=a.vx+Math.sin(a.phase)*0.4*a.dir;
    a.y+=a.vy+Math.cos(a.phase)*0.2;
    if(a.x<20||a.x>W-20)a.dir*=-1;
    // fire
    a.fireCd--;
    if(a.fireCd<=0&&a.y<ship.y){
      enemyShots.push({x:a.x,y:a.y+a.r,vx:(ship.x-a.x)*0.004,vy:2.2+wave*0.05,r:3});
      a.fireCd=90+Math.random()*140;
    }
  }

  // move enemy shots
  for(let i=enemyShots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=enemyShots[i];b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;
    if(b.y>H+10||b.x<-10||b.x>W+10)enemyShots.splice(i,1);
  }

  // collisions: player shots vs aliens
  for(let i=playerShots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=playerShots[i];
    for(let j=aliens.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const a=aliens[j];
      const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<(a.r+b.r)*(a.r+b.r)){
        a.hp--;
        playerShots.splice(i,1);
        if(a.hp<=0){
          score+=a.type==='big'?30:10;
          for(let k=0;k<8;k++)bubbles.push({x:a.x,y:a.y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*3,vy:-Math.random()*2,r:1+Math.random()*2,life:30});
          aliens.splice(j,1);
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // collisions: enemy shots vs ship
  if(ship.alive&&invuln<=0){
    for(let i=enemyShots.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const b=enemyShots[i];
      const dx=b.x-ship.x,dy=b.y-ship.y;
      if(dx*dx+dy*dy<(ship.r+b.r)*(ship.r+b.r)){
        enemyShots.splice(i,1);
        hitShip();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // aliens reaching the bottom
  for(let i=aliens.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(aliens[i].y>H-70){
      aliens.splice(i,1);
      hitShip();
      break;
    }
  }

  // bubbles
  for(let i=bubbles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=bubbles[i];b.x+=b.vx;b.y+=b.vy;b.vy+=0.05;b.life--;
    if(b.life<=0)bubbles.splice(i,1);
  }

  if(shake>0)shake--;

  // wave complete
  if(aliens.length===0){
    waveTimer++;
    if(waveTimer>60){
      wave++;waveTimer=0;spawnWave();
    }
  }
}

function hitShip(){
  if(!ship.alive)return;
  ship.alive=false;lives--;shake=12;
  for(let k=0;k<20;k++)bubbles.push({x:ship.x,y:ship.y,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*4,vy:-Math.random()*3,r:1+Math.random()*3,life:40});
  if(lives<=0){state='over';}
  else{
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(state==='play'){ship.x=W/2;ship.y=H-40;ship.alive=true;invuln=90;}
    },700);
  }
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  // background water
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0a2740');g.addColorStop(0.5,'#06182a');g.addColorStop(1,'#02060f');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // light rays
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=0.05;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle='#4aa0d0';
    const rx=40+i*80+Math.sin(time*0.01+i)*10;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(rx,0);ctx.lineTo(rx+30,0);ctx.lineTo(rx+60,H);ctx.lineTo(rx-20,H);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // caustic lines
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(80,180,220,0.08)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=8){
      const y=30+i*20+Math.sin(x*0.05+time*0.03+i)*4;
      if(x===0)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ambient bubbles
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    const bx=(i*47+time*0.3)%W;
    const by=H-((time*0.5+i*37)%(H+20));
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,220,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bx,by,1+(i%3),0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  }

  const sx=shake>0?(Math.random()-0.5)*shake:0;
  const sy=shake>0?(Math.random()-0.5)*shake:0;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(sx,sy);

  // aliens
  for(const a of aliens){
    const bob=Math.sin(a.phase)*2;
    drawAlien(a.x,a.y+bob,a);
  }

  // player shots
  ctx.fillStyle='#8ff0ff';
  for(const b of playerShots){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(140,240,255,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r+2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#8ff0ff';
  }

  // enemy shots
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff7a5a';
  for(const b of enemyShots){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,120,90,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r+2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff7a5a';
  }

  // bubbles
  for(const b of bubbles){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(180,240,255,'+(b.life/40*0.6)+')';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  }

  // ship
  if(ship.alive){
    const blink=invuln>0&&Math.floor(time/4)%2===0;
    if(!blink)drawShip(ship.x,ship.y);
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#8ff0ff';ctx.font='12px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,8,16);
  ctx.fillText('WAVE '+wave,W-58,16);
  // lives
  for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle='#5fd0a0';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(12+i*14,H-10,4,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  }

  // overlays
  if(state==='start')overlay('SEA DUEL','A / D or ARROWS to move','SPACE to fire','Press SPACE or P to start');
  if(state==='over')overlay('GAME OVER','Final score: '+score,'Press SPACE or P to retry','');
}

function drawShip(x,y){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
  // hull
  ctx.fillStyle='#2a6a8a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,-16);ctx.lineTo(12,8);ctx.lineTo(8,12);ctx.lineTo(-8,12);ctx.lineTo(-12,8);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // top
  ctx.fillStyle='#5fb8d8';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-16);ctx.lineTo(6,-4);ctx.lineTo(-6,-4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  // cockpit glow
  ctx.fillStyle='#8ff0ff';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-6,3,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // fins
  ctx.fillStyle='#1e4a64';
  ctx.fillRect(-13,2,4,8);ctx.fillRect(9,2,4,8);
  // thruster
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,220,255,'+(0.4+Math.random()*0.4)+')';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-5,12);ctx.lineTo(5,12);ctx.lineTo(0,18+Math.random()*4);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawAlien(x,y,a){
  const big=a.type==='big';
  const body=big?'#c04a6a':'#7a5ac0';
  const glow=big?'#ff8aa0':'#b090ff';
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
  const pulse=1+Math.sin(a.phase*1.5)*0.08;
  ctx.scale(pulse,pulse);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle=body;
  ctx.beginPath();
  if(big){
    ctx.ellipse(0,0,14,10,0,0,6.28);
  }else{
    ctx.moveTo(0,-10);ctx.lineTo(10,0);ctx.lineTo(0,10);ctx.lineTo(-10,0);ctx.closePath();
  }
  ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle=glow;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-4,-2,2.5,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(4,-2,2.5,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
  // tentacles
  ctx.strokeStyle=glow;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i*6,8);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(i*6+Math.sin(a.phase+i)*3,14,i*6,18);ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(t4)ctx.fillText(t4,W/2,H/2+45);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

  update();
  draw();

}

const stars=[];
const keys={left:false,right:false};
const pointer={active:false,x:W/2};

const BRICK_COLORS=["#ff5d6c","#ff9f43","#ffd166","#4ecdc4","#54a0ff","#b56cff"];
const BRICK_HP=[1,2,3,4,5,6];
const POWERUP_TYPES=[
  {k:"wide",   label:"W",  color:"#54a0ff"},
  {k:"small",  label:"S",  color:"#4ecdc4"},
  {k:"fast",   label:"F",  color:"#ff5d6c"},
  {k:"multi",  label:"M",  color:"#b56cff"},
  {k:"slow",   label:"Z",  color:"#ffd166"}
];

for(let i=0;i<110;i++){
  stars.push({
    x:Math.random()*W,
    y:Math.random()*H,
    r:Math.random()*1.6+0.3,
    a:Math.random()*0.5+0.2,
    tw:Math.random()*0.02+0.004,
    ph:Math.random()*Math.PI*2
  });
}

function buildLevel(){
  movers.length=0;
  const cols=12;
  const rows=6;
  const bw=W/cols;
  const bh=26;
  const top=120;
  for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){
    for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){
      const hp=BRICK_HP[r];
      movers.push({
        type:"brick",
        x:c*bw+2,
        y:top+r*bh+2,
        w:bw-4,
        h:bh-4,
        vx:0,
        vy:0,
        hp:hp,
        maxHp:hp,
        color:BRICK_COLORS[r],
        dead:false
      });
    }
  }
}

function launchBall(){
  const b=state.ball;
  const a=(Math.random()*0.6-0.3);
  const sp=5.2;
  b.vx=Math.sin(a)*sp;
  b.vy=-Math.cos(a)*sp;
  b.active=true;
}

function resetBallToPaddle(){
  const b=state.ball;
  b.x=state.paddleX;
  b.y=PADDLE_Y-BALL_R-1;
  b.vx=0;b.vy=0;b.active=false;
  b.mult=1;
  const p=b.power;
  p.wide.on=false;p.wide.t=0;
  p.small.on=false;p.small.t=0;
  p.fast.on=false;p.fast.t=0;
  p.multi.on=false;p.multi.t=0;
  p.slow.on=false;p.slow.t=0;
}

function newGame(){
  state.scene="playing";
  state.score=0;
  state.lives=3;
  state.combo=0;
  state.shake=0;
  state.paddleX=W/2;
  state.paddleVX=0;
  state.targetX=W/2;
  resetBallToPaddle();
  buildLevel();
}

function spawnParticles(x,y,color,n,spread){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const sp=Math.random()*spread;
    particles.push({
      x:x,
      y:y,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,
      vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,
      life:1,
      decay:0.02+Math.random()*0.03,
      size:1+Math.random()*2.5,
      color:color
    });
  }
}

function spawnPopup(x,y,text,color){
  popups.push({x:x,y:y,vy:-0.8,life:1,decay:0.02,text:text,color:color});
}

function applyPowerup(type){
  const b=state.ball;
  const p=b.power;
  const def=POWERUP_TYPES.find(d=>d.k===type);
  const color=def?def.color:"#fff";
  if(type==="wide"){
    p.wide.on=true;p.wide.t=1200;
  }else if(type==="small"){
    p.small.on=true;p.small.t=1000;
  }else if(type==="fast"){
    p.fast.on=true;p.fast.t=900;
  }else if(type==="multi"){
    p.multi.on=true;p.multi.t=1500;
    if(b.mult<3){
      b.mult+=1;
    }
  }else if(type==="slow"){
    p.slow.on=true;p.slow.t=1000;
  }
  spawnPopup(b.x,b.y-20,"POWER: "+type.toUpperCase(),color);
  state.msg="Power-up: "+type;
  state.msgTimer=1.2;
  state.msgColor=color;
}

function dropPowerup(x,y){
  if(Math.random()>0.35) return;
  const def=POWERUP_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random()*POWERUP_TYPES.length)];
  movers.push({
    type:"powerup",
    x:x,
    y:y,
    vx:0,
    vy:1.4,
    w:26,
    h:26,
    k:def.k,
    label:def.label,
    color:def.color,
    dead:false
  });
}

function onBrickHit(b,m,impact){
  if(m.dead) return;
  m.hp-=1;
  state.shake=Math.min(state.shake+2,10);
  if(m.hp<=0){
    m.dead=true;
    state.combo+=1;
    const pts=10*state.combo;
    state.score+=pts;
    spawnParticles(m.x+m.w/2,m.y+m.h/2,m.color,14,4);
    spawnPopup(m.x+m.w/2,m.y+m.h/2,"+"+pts,m.color);
    dropPowerup(m.x+m.w/2,m.y+m.h/2);
  }else{
    state.combo=0;
    spawnParticles(m.x+m.w/2,m.y+m.h/2,m.color,6,3);
  }
}

function reflectBall(b){
  const p=b.power;
  let speed=5.2;
  if(p.fast.on) speed=8.5;
  if(p.slow.on) speed=3.6;
  const vx=b.vx,vy=b.vy;
  const len=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;
  b.vx=(vx/len)*speed;
  b.vy=(vy/len)*speed;
}

function ballVsBrick(b,m){
  const bx=b.x,by=b.y;
  const left=m.x,right=m.x+m.w,top=m.y,bottom=m.y+m.h;
  if(bx+BALL_R<left||bx-BALL_R>right||by+BALL_R<top||by-BALL_R>bottom) return;
  const cx=clamp(bx,left,right);
  const cy=clamp(by,top,bottom);
  const dx=bx-cx,dy=by-cy;
  if(dx*dx+dy*dy>BALL_R*BALL_R) return;
  const nx=dx/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
  const ny=dy/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
  const dot=b.vx*nx+b.vy*ny;
  if(dot<0){
    b.vx-=2*dot*nx;
    b.vy-=2*dot*ny;
    b.x=cx+nx*BALL_R;
    b.y=cy+ny*BALL_R;
    reflectBall(b);
    onBrickHit(b,m,"brick");
  }
}

function ballVsPaddle(b){
  const pw=state.paddleX;
  const pl=pw-PADDLE_W/2,pr=pw+PADDLE_W/2,pt=PADDLE_Y,pb=PADDLE_Y+PADDLE_H;
  const left=pl,right=pr,top=pt,bottom=pb;
  if(b.x+BALL_R<left||b.x-BALL_R>right||b.y+BALL_R<top||b.y-BALL_R>bottom) return;
  const cx=clamp(b.x,left,right);
  const cy=clamp(b.y,top,bottom);
  const dx=b.x-cx,dy=b.y-cy;
  if(dx*dx+dy*dy>BALL_R*BALL_R) return;
  const nx=dx/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
  const ny=dy/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
  const dot=b.vx*nx+b.vy*ny;
  if(dot<0){
    b.vx-=2*dot*nx;
    b.vy-=2*dot*ny;
    b.x=cx+nx*BALL_R;
    b.y=cy+ny*BALL_R;
    if(b.vy>0) b.vy=-Math.abs(b.vy);
    const off=(b.x-pw)/(PADDLE_W/2);
    b.vx+=off*2.2;
    reflectBall(b);
    state.combo=0;
    spawnParticles(b.x,b.y,"#ffffff",6,2.5);
  }
}

function ballVsWalls(b){
  if(b.x-BALL_R<0){
    b.x=BALL_R;
    b.vx=Math.abs(b.vx);
    spawnParticles(0,b.y,"#54a0ff",6,2);
  }
  if(b.x+BALL_R>W){
    b.x=W-BALL_R;
    b.vx=-Math.abs(b.vx);
    spawnParticles(W,b.y,"#54a0ff",6,2);
  }
  if(b.y-BALL_R<0){
    b.y=BALL_R;
    b.vy=Math.abs(b.vy);
    spawnParticles(b.x,0,"#54a0ff",6,2);
  }
}

function ballVsPowerup(b,m){
  const left=m.x-m.w/2,right=m.x+m.w/2,top=m.y-m.h/2,bottom=m.y+m.h/2;
  if(b.x+BALL_R<left||b.x-BALL_R>right||b.y+BALL_R<top||b.y-BALL_R>bottom) return;
  const cx=clamp(b.x,left,right);
  const cy=clamp(b.y,top,bottom);
  const dx=b.x-cx,dy=b.y-cy;
  if(dx*dx+dy*dy>BALL_R*BALL_R) return;
  applyPowerup(m.k);
  m.dead=true;
}

function updateMovers(dt){
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.dead) continue;
    if(m.type==="brick"){
      continue;
    }else if(m.type==="powerup"){
      m.y+=m.vy;
      if(m.y-m.h/2>GROUND){
        m.dead=true;
      }
    }
  }
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(movers[i].dead) movers.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function updateParticles(dt){
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;
    p.y+=p.vy;
    p.vy+=0.08;
    p.life-=p.decay;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function updatePopups(dt){
  for(let i=popups.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=popups[i];
    p.y+=p.vy;
    p.life-=p.decay;
    if(p.life<=0) popups.splice(i,1);
  }
}

function update(dt){
  state.t+=dt;
  if(state.shake>0) state.shake*=0.9;
  if(state.shake<0.05) state.shake=0;
  if(state.msgTimer>0) state.msgTimer-=dt;

  if(state.scene==="menu"||state.scene==="win"||state.scene==="lose"){
    updateParticles(dt);
    updatePopups(dt);
    return;
  }

  const speed=0.0055;
  if(keys.left) state.paddleVX-=speed;
  if(keys.right) state.paddleVX+=speed;
  if(pointer.active){
    state.paddleVX+=(state.targetX-state.paddleX)*0.002;
  }
  state.paddleVX*=0.9;
  state.paddleX+=state.paddleVX;
  const half=PADDLE_W/2;
  if(state.paddleX<half) state.paddleX=half;
  if(state.paddleX>W-half) state.paddleX=W-half;

  const b=state.ball;
  const p=b.power;
  if(p.wide.on){p.wide.t-=dt*1000;if(p.wide.t<=0){p.wide.on=false;}}
  if(p.small.on){p.small.t-=dt*1000;if(p.small.t<=0){p.small.on=false;}}
  if(p.fast.on){p.fast.t-=dt*1000;if(p.fast.t<=0){p.fast.on=false;}}
  if(p.multi.on){p.multi.t-=dt*1000;if(p.multi.t<=0){p.multi.on=false;}}
  if(p.slow.on){p.slow.t-=dt*1000;if(p.slow.t<=0){p.slow.on=false;}}

  if(!b.active){
    b.x=state.paddleX;
    b.y=PADDLE_Y-BALL_R-1;
    return;
  }

  const steps=2;
  const sdt=dt/steps;
  for(let s=0;s<steps;s++){
    b.x+=b.vx*sdt;
    b.y+=b.vy*sdt;
    ballVsWalls(b);
    ballVsPaddle(b);
    for(const m of movers){
      if(m.dead) continue;
      if(m.type==="brick") ballVsBrick(b,m);
      else if(m.type==="powerup") ballVsPowerup(b,m);
    }
    if(b.y-BALL_R>GROUND){
      state.lives-=1;
      state.combo=0;
      spawnParticles(b.x,GROUND,"#ff5d6c",20,5);
      if(state.lives<=0){
        state.scene="lose";
        state.best=Math.max(state.best,state.score);
        return;
      }
      resetBallToPaddle();
      return;
    }
  }

  updateMovers(dt);
  updateParticles(dt);
  updatePopups(dt);

  if(movers.filter(m=>m.type==="brick").length===0){
    state.scene="win";
    state.best=Math.max(state.best,state.score);
    for(let i=0;i<60;i++){
      spawnParticles(Math.random()*W,Math.random()*200,BRICK_COLORS[i%BRICK_COLORS.length],4,3);
    }
  }
}

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+r,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#0b1a2b");
  g.addColorStop(0.5,"#0e2233");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#081018");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  const r=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*0.55,40,W/2,H*0.55,W*0.7);
  r.addColorStop(0,"rgba(84,160,255,0.08)");
  r.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle=r;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  for(const s of stars){
    const a=s.a*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(state.t*2+s.ph));
    ctx.globalAlpha=a;
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)";
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=40){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let y=0;y<H;y+=40){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawGround(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,GROUND,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#123049");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#081018");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,GROUND,W,H-GROUND);
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,GROUND);ctx.lineTo(W,GROUND);ctx.stroke();
}

function drawBricks(){
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.type!=="brick") continue;
    const x=m.x,y=m.y,w=m.w,h=m.h;
    const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);
    grad.addColorStop(0,m.color);
    grad.addColorStop(1,shade(m.color,-30));
    ctx.fillStyle=grad;
    roundRect(x,y,w,h,5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
    ctx.fillRect(x+3,y+3,w-6,3);
    const hpRatio=m.hp/m.maxHp;
    if(hpRatio<1){
      ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
      for(let i=0;i<m.maxHp-m.hp;i++){
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x+w*0.5,y+h*0.3);
        ctx.lineTo(x+w*0.5+6,y+h*0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(x+w*0.5-4,y+h*0.6);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawPowerups(){
  for(const m of movers){
    if(m.type!=="powerup") continue;
    const x=m.x,y=m.y,w=m.w,h=m.h;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor=m.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(x-w/2,y-h/2,x+w/2,y+h/2);
    g.addColorStop(0,m.color);
    g.addColorStop(1,shade(m.color,-40));
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    roundRect(x-w/2,y-h/2,w,h,7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle="#0b1a2b";
    ctx.font="bold 16px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    ctx.fillText(m.label,x,y+1);
  }
}

function drawPaddle(){
  const pw=state.paddleX;
  const pl=pw-PADDLE_W/2;
  const pt=PADDLE_Y;
  const p=state.ball.power;
  let col1="#54a0ff",col2="#2f6fcf";
  if(p.wide.on){col1="#54a0ff";col2="#2f6fcf";}
  if(p.small.on){col1="#4ecdc4";col2="#2f9d95";}
  if(p.fast.on){col1="#ff5d6c";col2="#c93445";}
  if(p.slow.on){col1="#ffd166";col2="#d0a12f";}
  if(p.multi.on){col1="#b56cff";col2="#8640d0";}
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor=col1;
  ctx.shadowBlur=24;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,pt,0,pt+PADDLE_H);
  g.addColorStop(0,col1);
  g.addColorStop(1,col2);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  roundRect(pl,pt,PADDLE_W,PADDLE_H,9);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  ctx.fillRect(pl+6,pt+3,PADDLE_W-12,3);
}

function drawBall(){
  const b=state.ball;
  if(!b.active) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor="#ffffff";
  ctx.shadowBlur=16;
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x-3,b.y-3,1,b.x,b.y,BALL_R);
  g.addColorStop(0,"#ffffff");
  g.addColorStop(1,"#cfd8ff");
  ctx.fillStyle=g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,BALL_R,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles(){
  for(const p of particles){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawPopups(){
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  for(const p of popups){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.font="bold 16px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(p.text,p.x,p.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawHUD(){
  ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.font="bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE "+state.score,18,34);
  ctx.font="14px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
  ctx.fillText("BEST "+state.best,18,54);

  ctx.textAlign="right";
  ctx.font="bold 16px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
  ctx.fillText("LIVES",W-18,30);
  for(let i=0;i<state.lives;i++){
    ctx.fillStyle="#ff5d6c";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W-70+i*22,44,7,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  if(state.combo>1){
    ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillStyle="#ffd166";
    ctx.font="bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("COMBO x"+state.combo,W/2,34);
  }

  if(state.msgTimer>0){
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,state.msgTimer/1.2);
    ctx.fillStyle=state.msgColor;
    ctx.font="bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(state.msg,W/2,70);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}

function drawMenu(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(6,12,20,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
  ctx.font="bold 56px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("BREAKOUT",W/2,H*0.34);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
  ctx.font="18px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Smash the bricks. Catch power-ups.",W/2,H*0.42);
  ctx.fillStyle="#54a0ff";
  ctx.font="bold 24px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to start",W/2,H*0.55);
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
  ctx.font="15px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Move: Arrow keys / A D / Mouse",W/2,H*0.62);
  ctx.fillText("Power-ups: W Wide  S Small  F Fast  M Multi  Z Slow",W/2,H*0.66);
}

function drawWin(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(6,12,20,0.65)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillStyle="#4ecdc4";
  ctx.font="bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("YOU WIN",W/2,H*0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
  ctx.font="20px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Score "+state.score,W/2,H*0.48);
  ctx.fillStyle="#54a0ff";
  ctx.font="bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to play again",W/2,H*0.58);
}

function drawLose(){
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(6,12,20,0.65)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillStyle="#ff5d6c";
  ctx.font="bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("GAME OVER",W/2,H*0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";
  ctx.font="20px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Score "+state.score+"   Best "+state.best,W/2,H*0.48);
  ctx.fillStyle="#54a0ff";
  ctx.font="bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Press SPACE to try again",W/2,H*0.58);
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(state.shake>0){
    const dx=(Math.random()*2-1)*state.shake;
    const dy=(Math.random()*2-1)*state.shake;
    ctx.translate(dx,dy);
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawGround();
  if(state.scene==="playing"){
    drawBricks();
    drawPowerups();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawParticles();
    drawPopups();
    drawHUD();
  }else{
    drawParticles();
    drawPopups();
    if(state.scene==="menu") drawMenu();
    else if(state.scene==="win") drawWin();
    else if(state.scene==="lose") drawLose();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function shade(hex,amt){
  const n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);
  let r=(n>>16)&255,g=(n>>8)&255,b=n&255;
  r=clamp(r+amt,0,255);
  g=clamp(g+amt,0,255);
  b=clamp(b+amt,0,255);
  return "#"+((1<<24)+(r<<16)+(g<<8)+b).toString(16).slice(1);
}

window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k==="arrowleft"||k==="a") keys.left=true;

});

  const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scale=W/rect.width;
  const x=(e.clientX-rect.left)*scale;
  pointer.active=true;

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown",e=>{
  if(state.scene==="menu"||state.scene==="win"||state.scene==="lose"){

});
canvas.addEventListener("touchmove",e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scale=W/rect.width;
  const x=(e.touches[0].clientX-rect.left)*scale;
  pointer.active=true;
  state.targetX=x;
},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{

    newGame();
  }
});

let last=performance.now();
function frame(now){
  let dt=(now-last)/1000;
  if(dt>0.05) dt=0.05;
  last=now;
  update(dt);
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Neon Pinball</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; background: #05060f; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  #game { display: block; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(90,180,255,0.35); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="720"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// --- State ---
let state = "start";   // "start" | "play" | "over"
let score = 0;
let ballsLeft = 3;
let best = 0;
let ball = null;
let plunger = { x: 418, y: 690, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 15 };
let charge = 0;
let charging = false;
let flash = 0;
let shake = 0;
let movers = [];       // the single array of all moving objects
const bumpers = [];    // static circle bumpers
const flippers = [];   // static flippers
const lanes = [];      // static lane walls
const pins = [];       // static pins
let particles = [];     // decorative sparks
let stars = [];

// --- Build the table geometry ---
const laneWidth = 34;
const laneX = W - laneWidth;
const laneBottom = 690;
const laneTop = 250;

function makeBumper(x, y, r, color, label) {
  return { x, y, r, color, label, pulse: 0, ring: 0 };
}
bumpers.push(makeBumper(150, 210, 30, "#ff5d73", "200"));
bumpers.push(makeBumper(330, 210, 30, "#ffd23f", "200"));
bumpers.push(makeBumper(240, 150, 26, "#4de3ff", "300"));

function makeFlipper(x, y, angle, len, r, dir, color) {
  return { x, y, angle, rest: angle, len, r, dir, color, tipX: 0, tipY: 0, prevAngle: angle };
}
flippers.push(makeFlipper(180, 560, -0.42, 70, 12, -1, "#ff9e2c"));
flippers.push(makeFlipper(300, 560,  Math.PI + 0.42, 70, 12, 1, "#ff9e2c"));

function makePin(x, y, r, color) { return { x, y, r, color }; }
pins.push(makePin(240, 360, 14, "#7d5cff"));
pins.push(makePin(170, 430, 14, "#7d5cff"));
pins.push(makePin(310, 430, 14, "#7d5cff"));
pins.push(makePin(240, 480, 12, "#4de3ff"));

// --- Input ---
function keyDown(e) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (state === "start" || state === "over") {
    if (k === " " || k === "enter") { startGame(); }
    return;
  }
  if (state === "play") {
    if (k === " " || k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") { charging = true; }
    if (k === "a" || k === "arrowleft") { flippers[0].dir = 1; }
    if (k === "d" || k === "arrowright") { flippers[1].dir = 1; }
  }
}
function keyUp(e) {
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (state === "play") {
    if (k === " " || k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") { releasePlunger(); charging = false; }
    if (k === "a" || k === "arrowleft") { flippers[0].dir = -1; }
    if (k === "d" || k === "arrowright") { flippers[1].dir = -1; }
  }
}
function pointerDown() {
  if (state === "start" || state === "over") { startGame(); return; }
  charging = true;
}
function pointerUp() {
  if (charging) { releasePlunger(); charging = false; }
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", keyDown);
document.addEventListener("keyup", keyUp);
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", pointerDown);
window.addEventListener("pointerup", pointerUp);

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  ballsLeft = 3;
  movers = [];
  particles = [];
  flash = 0;
  shake = 0;
  newBall();
  state = "play";
}
function newBall() {
  ball = { x: W - laneWidth / 2, y: laneBottom - 20, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 12, alive: true, trail: [] };
  movers.push(ball);
  charge = 0;
}
function releasePlunger() {
  if (charge > 0) {
    ball.vy = -charge * 0.16;
    spawnBurst(ball.x, ball.y, "#4de3ff", 14, 5);
    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
    charge = 0;
  }
}

// --- Particles ---
function spawnBurst(x, y, color, n, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = speed * (0.4 + Math.random());
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 1, max: 1, color, r: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
  }
}

// --- Physics helpers ---
function collideCircle(m, c) {
  const dx = m.x - c.x, dy = m.y - c.y;
  const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const min = m.r + c.r;
  if (dist > 0 && dist < min) {
    const nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist;
    m.x = c.x + nx * min;
    m.y = c.y + ny * min;
    const vn = m.vx * nx + m.vy * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      const rest = 0.82;
      m.vx -= (1 + rest) * vn * nx;
      m.vy -= (1 + rest) * vn * ny;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function collideFlipper(m, f) {
  const dx = m.x - f.x, dy = m.y - f.y;
  const along = dx * Math.cos(f.angle) + dy * Math.sin(f.angle);
  if (along < 0 || along > f.len) return false;
  const px = f.x + Math.cos(f.angle) * along;
  const py = f.y + Math.sin(f.angle) * along;
  const ddx = m.x - px, ddy = m.y - py;
  const dist = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy);
  const min = m.r + f.r;
  if (dist > 0 && dist < min) {
    const nx = ddx / dist, ny = ddy / dist;
    m.x = px + nx * min;
    m.y = py + ny * min;
    const omega = (f.angle - f.prevAngle) / dt;
    const rx = m.x - f.x, ry = m.y - f.y;
    const svx = -omega * ry, svy = omega * rx;
    const relx = m.vx - svx, rely = m.vy - svy;
    const vn = relx * nx + rely * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      const rest = 0.55;
      const j = -(1 + rest) * vn;
      m.vx += j * nx;
      m.vy += j * ny;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// --- Update ---
let dt = 1 / 60;
function update() {
  // flippers
  for (const f of flippers) {
    f.prevAngle = f.angle;
    const target = f.dir === 1 ? f.rest - f.dir * 0.5 : f.rest;
    const d = target - f.angle;
    f.angle += d * Math.min(1, dt * 22);
    f.tipX = f.x + Math.cos(f.angle) * f.len;
    f.tipY = f.y + Math.sin(f.angle) * f.len;
  }

  // plunger
  if (state === "play" && charging) {
    charge = Math.min(charge + dt * 320, 320);
  }
  plunger.y = laneBottom - charge;

  // move all movers
  for (const m of movers) {
    if (m === ball) {
      m.vy += 900 * dt;                 // gravity
      m.vx *= 0.999;                    // tiny drag
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      m.trail.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y });
      if (m.trail.length > 10) m.trail.shift();

      // lane walls
      if (m.x < laneX + m.r) { m.x = laneX + m.r; m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx) * 0.7; }
      if (m.x > W - m.r) { m.x = W - m.r; m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx) * 0.7; }
      if (m.y > laneBottom - m.r) { m.y = laneBottom - m.r; m.vy = -Math.abs(m.vy) * 0.4; }
      // top of lane opens into the playfield
      if (m.y < laneTop && Math.abs(m.x - (W - laneWidth / 2)) < laneWidth / 2) {
        // let it fly up
      }

      // playfield walls (only above the lane opening)
      if (m.y < laneTop) {
        if (m.x < m.r) { m.x = m.r; m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx) * 0.7; }
        if (m.y < m.r) { m.y = m.r; m.vy = Math.abs(m.vy) * 0.7; }
      }

      // bumpers
      for (const b of bumpers) {
        if (collideCircle(m, b)) {
          m.vx += (m.x - b.x) * 0.6;
          m.vy += (m.y - b.y) * 0.6;
          m.vx *= 1.25; m.vy *= 1.25;
          b.pulse = 1; b.ring = 1;
          score += parseInt(b.label, 10);
          flash = 1; shake = Math.max(shake, 6);
          spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, b.color, 16, 6);
        }
      }
      // pins
      for (const p of pins) {
        if (collideCircle(m, p)) {
          score += 50;
          spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, p.color, 8, 4);
          shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
        }
      }
      // flippers
      for (const f of flippers) {
        if (collideFlipper(m, f)) {
          spawnBurst(m.x, m.y, "#ffd23f", 6, 3);
        }
      }

      // lost?
      if (m.y > H + 40) {
        m.alive = false;
        ballsLeft--;
        if (ballsLeft <= 0) {
          if (score > best) best = score;
          state = "over";
        } else {
          newBall();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // drop the ones that are done
  movers = movers.filter(m => m.alive);

  // particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.vy += 500 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt * 1.6;
  }
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

  // decay
  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 3);
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 22);
  for (const b of bumpers) {
    b.pulse = Math.max(0, b.pulse - dt * 3);
    b.ring = Math.max(0, b.ring - dt * 2);
  }
}

// --- Draw ---
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);

  // background
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#12143a");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "#1a1240");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#241041");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

  // stars
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
  for (const s of stars) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 + 0.4 * Math.abs(Math.sin(s.t));
    ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.s, s.s);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // playfield floor (subtle grid)
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,150,255,0.06)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke(); }

  // lane
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)";
  ctx.fillRect(laneX, laneTop, laneWidth, laneBottom - laneTop);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a3f7a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(laneX, laneTop); ctx.lineTo(laneX, laneBottom);
  ctx.moveTo(W, laneTop); ctx.lineTo(W, laneBottom);
  ctx.stroke();

  // pins
  for (const p of pins) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = p.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x - p.r * 0.3, p.y - p.r * 0.3, p.r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // bumpers
  for (const b of bumpers) {
    const scale = 1 + b.pulse * 0.25;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = b.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 20 + b.pulse * 20;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 2, b.x, b.y, b.r * scale);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    rg.addColorStop(0.4, b.color);
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * scale, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * scale * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.font = "bold 13px Trebuchet MS";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(b.label, b.x, b.y);
    if (b.ring > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = b.color; ctx.globalAlpha = b.ring; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * (1.4 + (1 - b.ring) * 1.4), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // flippers
  for (const f of flippers) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = f.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.lineWidth = f.r * 2; ctx.strokeStyle = f.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y); ctx.lineTo(f.tipX, f.tipY); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = f.r * 2 * 0.5; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y); ctx.lineTo(f.tipX, f.tipY); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // plunger
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2f66";
  ctx.fillRect(plunger.x - 8, plunger.y, 16, laneBottom - plunger.y);
  const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(plunger.x - 15, plunger.y, plunger.x + 15, plunger.y);
  pg.addColorStop(0, "#4de3ff"); pg.addColorStop(1, "#2b7bd6");
  ctx.fillStyle = pg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(plunger.x, plunger.y, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // movers (balls)
  for (const m of movers) {
    // trail
    for (let i = 0; i < m.trail.length; i++) {
      const t = m.trail[i];
      ctx.globalAlpha = (i / m.trail.length) * 0.4;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4de3ff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, m.r * (i / m.trail.length), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "#fff"; ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x - 4, m.y - 4, 2, m.x, m.y, m.r);
    bg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    bg.addColorStop(0.6, "#dfe6ff");
    bg.addColorStop(1, "#9fb0ff");
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // flash
  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (flash * 0.12) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // overlays
  if (state === "start") drawStart();
  if (state === "over") drawOver();
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,6,20,0.55)";
  roundRect(12, 12, W - 24, 46, 10); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4de3ff"; ctx.font = "bold 26px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE " + score, 24, 35);
  ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f"; ctx.font = "bold 16px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("BEST " + best, W - 24, 35);
  // balls remaining
  ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9e2c"; ctx.font = "bold 15px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("BALLS", W / 2 - 40, 35);
  for (let i = 0; i < ballsLeft; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#dfe6ff";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W / 2 + i * 22, 35, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStart() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,6,20,0.72)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f"; ctx.font = "bold 20px Trebuchet MS";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.font = "17px Trebuchet MS";

  ctx.fillText("D / →  :  Right Flipper", W / 2, H / 2 + 46);
  ctx.fillText("SPACE (hold)  :  Charge Plunger", W / 2, H / 2 + 72);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff9e2c"; ctx.font = "bold 18px Trebuchet MS";

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#4de3ff"; ctx.font = "bold 24px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  START", W / 2, H / 2 + 165);

}

function drawOver() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,6,20,0.78)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5d73"; ctx.font = "bold 48px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", W / 2, H / 2 - 70);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd23f"; ctx.font = "bold 30px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("SCORE  " + score, W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4de3ff"; ctx.font = "bold 20px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("BEST  " + best, W / 2, H / 2 + 26);
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4de3ff"; ctx.font = "bold 24px Trebuchet MS";
  ctx.fillText("PRESS  SPACE  TO  PLAY  AGAIN", W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
  ctx.restore();
}

// --- Init decorative stars ---
function initStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H * 0.55, s: 1 + Math.random() * 2, t: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
  }
}
initStars();

// --- Main loop ---
let last = performance.now();
function loop(now) {
  dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  for (const s of stars) s.t += dt * 2;
  if (state === "play") update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const W = 900;
  const H = 560;
  const GROUND = 470;

      y: GROUND - 34,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      w: 44,
      h: 44,
      rot: 0,
      hue: Math.floor(rand(0, 360)),
      life: 0

        vy: 0,
