    const acc = 720;
    const max = 320;
    if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) drone.vx -= acc * dt;
    if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) drone.vx += acc * dt;
    if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) drone.vy -= acc * dt;
    if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) drone.vy += acc * dt;

    // friction
    drone.vx *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    drone.vy *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);

    drone.vx = Math.max(-max, Math.min(max, drone.vx));
    drone.vy = Math.max(-max, Math.min(max, drone.vy));

    drone.x += drone.vx * dt;
    drone.y += drone.vy * dt;

    drone.tilt = drone.vx / max * 0.35;

    // clamp to screen
    drone.x = Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, drone.x));
    drone.y = Math.max(30, Math.min(GROUND - 20, drone.y));

    // update movers
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.life += dt;

      if (m.kind === 'drop') {
        // gravity
        m.vy += 900 * dt;
        m.x += m.vx * dt;
        m.y += m.vy * dt;
        m.rot += dt * 4;
        if (m.y + m.h / 2 >= GROUND) {
          m.y = GROUND - m.h / 2;
          m.vy = 0;
          m.vx = 0;
          // landed: score it
          score += 100;
          deliveries += 1;
          showMsg('Delivered! ' + deliveries + '/' + target, 1.6);
          movers.splice(i, 1);
          if (deliveries >= target) {
            state = 'over';
          } else {
            spawnPackage();
          }
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (m.kind === 'package') {
        // gentle bob
        m.y = GROUND - 22 + Math.sin(time * 2 + m.x * 0.05) * 4;
        // drone pickup
        const dx = drone.x - m.x;
        const dy = drone.y - (m.y - 8);
        if (drone.carrying === null && Math.abs(dx) < 40 && Math.abs(dy) < 34) {
          drone.carrying = { w: m.w, h: m.h, hue: m.hue };
          movers.splice(i, 1);
          showMsg('Package loaded!', 1.2);
          continue;
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (m.kind === 'obstacle') {
        m.rot += dt * 1.2;
        // drone collision
        const dx = drone.x - m.x;
        const dy = drone.y - m.y;
        const r = (drone.w + m.w) / 2 * 0.8;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r) {
          state = 'over';
          showMsg('Crashed into an obstacle!', 2);
        }
        continue;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- draw ----------
  function drawSky() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#2b3a63');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#3f5a86');
    g.addColorStop(0.85, '#6f8cb0');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#9fb6d1');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sun
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,238,190,0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 130, 90, 46, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,238,190,0.25)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 130, 90, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawMountains() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#42567f';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 300);
    ctx.lineTo(150, 200);
    ctx.lineTo(300, 300);
    ctx.lineTo(450, 180);
    ctx.lineTo(600, 300);
    ctx.lineTo(750, 220);
    ctx.lineTo(W, 300);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a7099';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 340);
    ctx.lineTo(200, 270);
    ctx.lineTo(400, 340);
    ctx.lineTo(600, 260);
    ctx.lineTo(800, 340);
    ctx.lineTo(W, 300);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawClouds() {
    cloud += 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const cx = ((i * 260 + cloud) % (W + 200)) - 100;
      const cy = 80 + (i % 2) * 40;
      drawCloud(cx, cy);
    }
  }

  function drawCloud(x, y) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 24, y - 8, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 50, y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(x + 26, y + 10, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawGround() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#4f7a3f');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#345a2c');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);

    // road
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3f4a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND + 20, W, 50);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.setLineDash([24, 22]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, GROUND + 45);
    ctx.lineTo(W, GROUND + 45);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // grass tufts
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const x = (i * 47) % W;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, GROUND + 4);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, GROUND - 6);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawMovers() {
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.kind === 'package') {
        drawPackage(m);
      } else if (m.kind === 'obstacle') {
        drawObstacle(m);
      } else if (m.kind === 'drop') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
        ctx.rotate(m.rot);
        drawBoxShape(m.w, m.h, m.hue);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawPackage(m) {
    // hover glow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,120,0.18)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(m.x, GROUND, 40, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    drawBoxShape(m.w, m.h, m.hue);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBoxShape(w, h, hue) {
    // body
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-w / 2, -h / 2, w / 2, h / 2);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,62%)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,42%)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h, 6);
    ctx.fill();

    // top face
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ',55%,72%)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-w / 2, -h / 2);
    ctx.lineTo(-w / 2 + 8, -h / 2 - 8);
    ctx.lineTo(w / 2 + 8, -h / 2 - 8);
    ctx.lineTo(w / 2, -h / 2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // tape
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.fillRect(-2, -h / 2 - 8, 4, h + 8);
    ctx.fillRect(-w / 2, -2, w, 4);
  }

  function drawObstacle(m) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(m.x, m.y);
    ctx.rotate(m.rot);
    // warning sign
    const s = m.w;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + m.hue + ',70%,55%)';
    roundRect(-s / 2, -s / 2, s, s, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    roundRect(-s / 2, -s / 2, s, s, 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    // hazard stripes
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    for (let i = -2; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-s / 2 + i * 14, s / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(-s / 2 + i * 14 + 8, -s / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(-s / 2 + i * 14 + 16, -s / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(-s / 2 + i * 14 + 8, s / 2);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawDrone() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(drone.x, drone.y);
    ctx.rotate(drone.tilt);

    // shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, GROUND - drone.y + 6, 30, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2f3543';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-drone.w / 2, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(drone.w / 2, 0);
    ctx.stroke();

    // rotors
    const rotorY = -10;
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const rx = side * drone.w / 2;
      // motor
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3b4252';
      ctx.fillRect(rx - 6, rotorY - 4, 12, 10);
      // spinning blade
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(rx, rotorY);
      ctx.rotate(drone.spin * side);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,230,255,0.85)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 22, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // body
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -12, 0, 12);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#e85d5d');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#b32f2f');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(-18, -12, 36, 24, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    roundRect(-14, -10, 28, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // light
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,120,' + (0.5 + Math.sin(time * 8) * 0.5) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 8, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // carried package
    if (drone.carrying) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(0, 20);
      drawBoxShape(drone.carrying.w, drone.carrying.h, drone.carrying.hue);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    // panel
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,28,44,0.85)';
    roundRect(16, 14, 260, 70, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(16, 14, 260, 70, 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd45e';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 30, 44);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '16px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Delivered: ' + deliveries + ' / ' + target, 30, 70);

    // control hint
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.font = '14px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Arrows / WASD to fly   ·   Space to drop', W - 16, H - 16);
  }

  function drawMessage() {
    if (msgTimer <= 0 || !msg) return;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,28,44,0.7)';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(msg).width;
    roundRect(W / 2 - tw / 2 - 20, 120, tw + 40, 44, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, 150);
  }

  function drawTitle() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,22,38,0.72)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd45e';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('DRONE DELIVERY', W / 2, 200);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8f0ff';
    ctx.font = '20px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Fly your drone, grab packages, and drop them on the ground.', W / 2, 260);
    ctx.fillText('Deliver ' + target + ' packages to win. Avoid the obstacles!', W / 2, 292);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '16px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Arrows / WASD to fly  ·  Space to pick up / drop', W / 2, 340);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,212,94,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to start', W / 2, 410);
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,22,38,0.78)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const won = deliveries >= target;
    ctx.fillStyle = won ? '#7be08a' : '#ff7a7a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 54px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(won ? 'DELIVERY COMPLETE!' : 'MISSION FAILED', W / 2, 230);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8f0ff';
    ctx.font = '24px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, W / 2, 290);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fe0ff';
    ctx.font = '18px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Packages delivered: ' + deliveries + ' / ' + target, W / 2, 325);

    const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.4;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,212,94,' + pulse + ')';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Segoe UI, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER to play again', W / 2, 400);
  }

  function draw() {
    drawSky();
    drawMountains();
    drawClouds();
    drawGround();
    drawMovers();
    drawDrone();
    drawHUD();
    drawMessage();
    if (state === 'title') drawTitle();
    if (state === 'over') drawOver();
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>R4: Ridge Racer Type 4</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#04060c;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Arial Black','Segoe UI',sans-serif;}
  #game{width:100vmin;height:100vmin;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;image-rendering:auto;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,200,255,.35);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="800"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
const CX = W/2, ROAD_TOP = 340;

const ROAD = {
  start: 0.55,
  far: 0.14,
  player: 0.95,
  near: 1.35
};

// ---------- STATE ----------
const state = {
  status: 'start',
  score: 0,
  time: 0,
  last: 0
};

const player = {
  x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
  lane: 0,
  speed: 0,
  topSpeed: 34,
  accel: 26,
  friction: 20,
  steer: 2.4,
  turn: 0
};

const cam = {
  x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
  shake: 0
};

const movers = [];
const particles = [];
const stars = [];
const clouds = [];
const clouds2 = [];
const roadLines = [];
const speedLines = [];
const finish = {
  x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
  active: false
};

// ---------- HELPERS ----------
function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
function clamp(v,a,b){ return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v); }
function lerp(a,b,t){ return a+(b-a)*t; }

function roadHalfWidth(z){
  const t = clamp((z - ROAD.far)/(ROAD.start - ROAD.far),0,1);
  return 34 + (ROAD.start - t)*(0); // placeholder
}
// real half width
function halfWidth(z){
  const t = clamp((z - ROAD.far)/(ROAD.start - ROAD.far),0,1);
  return 34 + (1-t)*260;
}

function roadY(z){
  const t = clamp((z - ROAD.far)/(ROAD.start - ROAD.far),0,1);
  return lerp(ROAD_TOP, H, t*t);
}

function worldToScreen(z, lane){
  const t = clamp((z - ROAD.far)/(ROAD.start - ROAD.far),0,1);
  const y = lerp(ROAD_TOP, H, t*t);
  const hw = halfWidth(z);
  const x = CX + lane*hw + cam.x*0.0;
  return { x, y, hw, t };
}

// ---------- INIT ----------
function makeStars(){
  stars.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<70;i++){
    stars.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,ROAD_TOP-20), r:rand(.5,1.8), tw:rand(0,6.28)});
  }
}
function makeClouds(){
  clouds.length = 0; clouds2.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ clouds.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(40,150), s:rand(40,80), sp:rand(4,10)}); }
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ clouds2.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(150,230), s:rand(50,90), sp:rand(10,18)}); }
}
function makeRoadLines(){
  roadLines.length = 0;
  for(let z=ROAD.far; z<=ROAD.player; z+=0.02){ roadLines.push({z}); }
}
function makeSpeedLines(){
  speedLines.length = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){ speedLines.push({x:rand(0,W), y:rand(0,H), len:rand(20,70), sp:rand(300,900)}); }
}

function reset(){
  player.x = 0; player.y = 0; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
  player.lane = 0; player.speed = 0; player.turn = 0;
  cam.x = 0; cam.y = 0; cam.vx = 0; cam.vy = 0; cam.shake = 0;
  movers.length = 0; particles.length = 0;
  finish.x = 0; finish.y = 0; finish.vx = 0; finish.vy = 0; finish.active = false;
  state.score = 0; state.time = 0;
}

function init(){
  makeStars(); makeClouds(); makeRoadLines(); makeSpeedLines();
  reset();
}

// ---------- INPUT ----------
const keys = {};
addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' '].includes(e.key.toLowerCase())) e.preventDefault();
  if(state.status==='start' && (e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')) startGame();
  else if((state.status==='win'||state.status==='lose') && (e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')) startGame();
});
addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });

function startGame(){ reset(); state.status='playing'; }

// ---------- SPAWN ----------
function spawnRival(){
  const lane = rand(-0.7,0.7);
  const m = {
    x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    z: ROAD.player + rand(0.05,0.25),
    lane: lane,
    speed: rand(22,30),
    hue: rand(0,360),
    kind:'rival',
    alive:true
  };
  movers.push(m);
}

function spawnFinish(){
  const f = {
    x:0,y:0,vx:0,vy:0,
    z: ROAD.player + rand(0.02,0.06),
    lane: 0,
    speed: 0,
    kind:'finish',
    alive:true
  };
  movers.push(f);
  finish.active = true;
}

// ---------- UPDATE ----------
let spawnTimer = 0;
let finishSpawned = false;

function update(dt){
  state.time += dt;

  if(state.status==='playing'){
    // player speed
    let want = 0;
    if(keys['arrowup']||keys['w']) want = 1;
    if(keys['arrowdown']||keys['s']) want = -1;
    if(want>0) player.speed += player.accel*dt;
    else if(want<0) player.speed -= player.accel*1.4*dt;
    else player.speed -= player.friction*dt;
    player.speed = clamp(player.speed, -8, player.topSpeed);

    // steering
    let steer = 0;
    if(keys['arrowleft']||keys['a']) steer = -1;
    if(keys['arrowright']||keys['d']) steer = 1;
    player.turn = lerp(player.turn, steer, clamp(dt*6,0,1));
    player.lane += player.turn * player.steer * (0.4 + Math.abs(player.speed)/player.topSpeed*0.6) * dt;
    player.lane = clamp(player.lane, -1.15, 1.15);

    // off road
    if(Math.abs(player.lane) > 0.98){
      player.speed -= player.speed*0.9*dt;
      cam.shake = Math.max(cam.shake, 4);
      if(Math.random()<0.5) spawnDust(CX+player.lane*halfWidth(ROAD.player), roadY(ROAD.player), 1);
    }

    // camera
    cam.x = lerp(cam.x, player.lane*30, clamp(dt*5,0,1));
    cam.y = lerp(cam.y, 0, clamp(dt*5,0,1));
    cam.shake *= Math.pow(0.001, dt);

    // spawn
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if(spawnTimer<=0 && movers.length < 7){
      spawnRival();
      spawnTimer = rand(0.7,1.4);
    }
    if(!finishSpawned && state.time > 18){
      spawnFinish();
      finishSpawned = true;
    }

    // score
    state.score += Math.max(0,player.speed)*dt*3;

    // win condition
    if(player.speed < -2 && state.time > 3) state.status='lose';
  }

  // update movers
  for(let i=movers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m = movers[i];
    if(m.kind==='rival'){
      m.z -= (player.speed - m.speed)*dt;
      // mild lane drift
      m.lane += Math.sin(state.time*1.5 + m.hue)*0.15*dt;
      m.lane = clamp(m.lane,-1,1);
      // collision
      if(m.z < ROAD.player + 0.02 && m.z > ROAD.player - 0.02){
        if(Math.abs(m.lane - player.lane) < 0.28){
          state.score -= 30;
          cam.shake = 12;
          spawnDust(CX+(m.lane)*halfWidth(ROAD.player), roadY(ROAD.player), 3);
          m.alive = false;
        }
      }
      if(m.z < ROAD.far) m.alive = false;
    } else if(m.kind==='finish'){
      m.z -= player.speed*dt;
      if(m.z <= ROAD.player - 0.02){
        state.status='win';
        cam.shake = 8;
        for(let k=0;k<40;k++) spawnConfetti();
      }
      if(m.z < ROAD.far) m.alive = false;
    }
    if(!m.alive) movers.splice(i,1);
  }

  // particles
  for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx*dt; p.y += p.vy*dt;
    if(p.grav) p.vy += p.grav*dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1);
  }

  // clouds
  for(const c of clouds){ c.x += c.sp*dt; if(c.x > W+c.s) c.x = -c.s; }
  for(const c of clouds2){ c.x += c.sp*dt; if(c.x > W+c.s) c.x = -c.s; }

  // speed lines
  const spd = Math.abs(player.speed);
  for(const s of speedLines){
    s.y += s.sp*dt*(0.3 + spd/player.topSpeed);
    if(s.y > H) { s.y = -s.len; s.x = rand(0,W); }
  }
}

function spawnDust(x,y,n){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: rand(-40,40), vy: rand(-60,-10),
      life: rand(.3,.7), max:.7,
      size: rand(3,7), color: '220,180,120', grav: 120
    });
  }
}
function spawnConfetti(){
  particles.push({
    x: CX+rand(-60,60), y: roadY(ROAD.player)-20,
    vx: rand(-120,120), vy: rand(-260,-80),
    life: rand(1.2,2.2), max:2.2,
    size: rand(4,8), color: Math.floor(rand(0,5)).toString(), grav: 320
  });
}

// ---------- DRAW ----------
function draw(){
  // sky
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ROAD_TOP);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#0a1230');
  sky.addColorStop(0.5,'#123a6b');
  sky.addColorStop(0.85,'#2a6ea0');
  sky.addColorStop(1,'#7fb6d8');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,ROAD_TOP);

  // stars
  for(const s of stars){
    const a = 0.4 + Math.sin(state.time*2 + s.tw)*0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+clamp(a,0,1)+')';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }

  // moon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff4d0';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120,90,34,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,244,208,.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W-120,90,48,0,6.28); ctx.fill();

  // clouds
  drawClouds(clouds,'rgba(210,230,255,.5)');
  drawClouds(clouds2,'rgba(180,205,235,.35)');

  // mountains (parallax by cam.x)
  drawMountainRange(W/2 - cam.x*0.05, ROAD_TOP, 150, '#12324a', 5, 120);
  drawMountainRange(W/2 - cam.x*0.1, ROAD_TOP, 100, '#1c4a6b', 6, 80);

  // ground / desert
  const gnd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,ROAD_TOP,0,H);
  gnd.addColorStop(0,'#c9a86a');
  gnd.addColorStop(0.5,'#b8935a');
  gnd.addColorStop(1,'#8a6a3e');
  ctx.fillStyle = gnd;
  ctx.fillRect(0,ROAD_TOP,W,H-ROAD_TOP);

  // road
  drawRoad();

  // speed lines (subtle, above road)
  const spd = Math.abs(player.speed)/player.topSpeed;
  if(spd>0.35){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,'+(spd*0.25)+')';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for(const s of speedLines){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s.x,s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x,s.y+s.len); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // movers (far to near)
  const sorted = movers.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.z-a.z);
  for(const m of sorted){
    const p = worldToScreen(m.z, m.lane);
    if(m.kind==='rival') drawCar(p.x, p.y, p.hw, m.hue, m.lane, 0.9);
    else if(m.kind==='finish') drawFinish(p.x, p.y, p.hw, p.t);
  }

  // player car
  const pp = worldToScreen(ROAD.player, player.lane);
  drawCar(pp.x, pp.y, pp.hw, 190, player.lane, 1.15, true);

  // particles
  for(const p of particles){
    if(p.color==='220,180,120'){
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba('+p.color+','+clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1)+')';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.size,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      const conf = ['255,60,90','60,200,255','255,220,60','120,255,120','255,120,255'];
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba('+conf[+p.color]+',1)';
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.life*10);
      ctx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // HUD
  drawHUD();

  // overlays
  if(state.status==='start') drawStart();
  if(state.status==='win') drawEnd(true);
  if(state.status==='lose') drawEnd(false);
}

function drawClouds(arr,color){
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  for(const c of arr){
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(c.x,c.y,c.s*0.5,0,6.28);
    ctx.arc(c.x+c.s*0.5,c.y+4,c.s*0.4,0,6.28);
    ctx.arc(c.x-c.s*0.5,c.y+6,c.s*0.35,0,6.28);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawMountainRange(cx, baseY, h, color, peaks, spread){
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0,baseY);
  for(let i=0;i<=peaks;i++){
    const x = (i/(peaks-1))*W;
    const y = baseY - h*(0.4+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.7)));
    ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(W,baseY);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawRoad(){
  // road body
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2b2b33';
  ctx.beginPath();
  const top = worldToScreen(ROAD.far,0);
  const bot = worldToScreen(ROAD.player,0);
  ctx.moveTo(top.x-top.hw, top.y);
  ctx.lineTo(top.x+top.hw, top.y);
  ctx.lineTo(bot.x+bot.hw, bot.y);
  ctx.lineTo(bot.x-bot.hw, bot.y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // side rumble strips
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    ctx.fillStyle = side<0 ? '#d33' : '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    const t1 = worldToScreen(ROAD.far, side*1.0);
    const t2 = worldToScreen(ROAD.far, side*1.12);
    const b1 = worldToScreen(ROAD.player, side*1.0);
    const b2 = worldToScreen(ROAD.player, side*1.12);
    ctx.moveTo(t1.x,t1.y); ctx.lineTo(t2.x,t2.y); ctx.lineTo(b2.x,b2.y); ctx.lineTo(b1.x,b1.y);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }

  // center dashed line
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe14a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  for(let z=ROAD.far; z<=ROAD.player; z+=0.05){
    const a = worldToScreen(z,0);
    const b = worldToScreen(z+0.025,0);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // lane lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for(const ln of [-0.5,0.5]){
    for(let z=ROAD.far; z<=ROAD.player; z+=0.06){
      const a = worldToScreen(z,ln);
      const b = worldToScreen(z+0.03,ln);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawCar(x,y,hw,hue,lane,scale,isPlayer){
  const w = hw*0.5*scale;
  const h = w*0.7;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.rotate(lane*0.15);

  // shadow
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,h*0.4,w*1.1,h*0.35,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();

  // body
  const body = 'hsl('+hue+',70%,'+(isPlayer?55:45)+'%)';
  ctx.fillStyle = body;
  roundRect(-w*0.5,-h*0.5,w,h,6); ctx.fill();

  // roof
  ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl('+hue+',60%,'+(isPlayer?70:60)+'%)';
  roundRect(-w*0.32,-h*0.42,w*0.64,h*0.5,5); ctx.fill();

  // windshield
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,.85)';
  roundRect(-w*0.28,-h*0.32,w*0.56,h*0.22,3); ctx.fill();

  // rear window
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,190,230,.7)';
  roundRect(-w*0.24,h*0.05,w*0.48,h*0.2,3); ctx.fill();

  // wheels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
  for(const wx of [-1,1]){
    for(const wy of [-1,1]){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(wx*w*0.5, wy*h*0.35, w*0.12, h*0.16,0,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // spoiler
  ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl('+hue+',80%,35%)';
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.45,-h*0.55,w*0.9,h*0.08);

  // headlight glow for player
  if(isPlayer){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,220,.9)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-w*0.35,h*0.45,w*0.08,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(w*0.35,h*0.45,w*0.08,0,6.28); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFinish(x,y,hw,t){
  const w = hw*1.0;
  const h = hw*0.5;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  // posts
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.5,-h,4,h);
  ctx.fillRect(w*0.5-4,-h,4,h);
  // banner
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
  ctx.fillRect(-w*0.5,-h,w,h*0.5);
  // checkers
  const n = 8;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
      ctx.fillStyle = (i+j)%2 ? '#fff' : '#111';
      ctx.fillRect(-w*0.5 + i*(w/n), -h + j*(h*0.25), w/n, h*0.25);
    }
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23a';
  ctx.font = 'bold '+(h*0.22)+'px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('FINISH',0,-h*0.55);
  ctx.restore();
}

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawHUD(){
  // speed
  const spd = Math.round(Math.max(0,player.speed)/player.topSpeed*320);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(20,H-90,150,70);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(spd, 30, H-45);
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd';
  ctx.fillText('KM/H', 30, H-25);

  // score
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(W-230,20,210,50);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+Math.floor(state.score), W-30, 52);

  // time
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('TIME '+state.time.toFixed(1)+'s', CX, 40);

  // finish hint
  if(!finishSpawned && state.status==='playing'){
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.6)';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Reach the finish line', CX, 62);
  }
}

function drawStart(){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 64px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('R4', CX, 240);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 26px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('RIDGE RACER TYPE 4', CX, 285);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Dodge rivals. Hit the FINISH line to win.', CX, 360);
  ctx.fillText('If you stop dead, you lose.', CX, 390);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('↑ / W  accelerate      ↓ / S  brake', CX, 450);
  ctx.fillText('← → / A D  steer', CX, 475);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23a';
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
  const blink = Math.floor(state.time*2)%2===0;
  if(blink) ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO START', CX, 560);
}

function drawEnd(win){
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.75)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle = win ? '#5dff8f' : '#ff5566';
  ctx.font = 'bold 56px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(win ? 'YOU WIN!' : 'GAME OVER', CX, 320);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('FINAL SCORE  '+Math.floor(state.score), CX, 380);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd';
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
  ctx.fillText(win ? 'You reached the finish line.' : 'You ran out of speed.', CX, 420);
  const blink = Math.floor(state.time*2)%2===0;
  if(blink){ ctx.fillStyle='#ffd23a'; ctx.font='bold 22px Arial'; ctx.fillText('PRESS ENTER OR SPACE TO RESTART', CX, 500); }
}

// ---------- LOOP ----------
function loop(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - state.last)/1000 || 0);
  state.last = now;
  update(dt);
  // camera shake
  let sx=0, sy=0;
  if(cam.shake>0.2){ sx=rand(-cam.shake,cam.shake); sy=rand(-cam.shake,cam.shake); }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(sx,sy);
  draw();
  ctx.restore();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

init();
state.last = performance.now();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;

<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
  "use strict";

  /* ---------------- Canvas & sizing ---------------- */
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1;

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  /* ---------------- Tunables ---------------- */
  const WIN = 15;
  const START = 3;
  const MAX_B = 26;
  const SPAWN_MS = 1400;
  const POP_MS = 420;
  const BUBBLE_MS = 900;
  const R_MIN = 18, R_MAX = 34;
  const P1 = { name: "P1", color: "#ff5d8f", score: 0, x: 0, y: 0, r: 30, hitCd: 0, ready: true, bubbles: [] };
  const P2 = { name: "P2", color: "#37d6e6", score: 0, x: 0, y: 0, r: 30, hitCd: 0, ready: true, bubbles: [] };

  /* ---------------- State ---------------- */
  let state = "start";
  let time = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let winner = null;
  const movers = [];
  const clouds = [];
  const stars = [];

  /* ---------------- Helpers ---------------- */
  const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
  const dist2 = (ax, ay, bx, by) => { const dx = ax - bx, dy = ay - by; return dx * dx + dy * dy; };
  const hexToRgb = (h) => { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]; };

  function shade(h, amt) {
    const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(h);
    const f = (c) => clamp(Math.round(amt > 0 ? c + (255 - c) * amt : c * (1 + amt)), 0, 255);
    return "rgb(" + f(r) + "," + f(g) + "," + f(b) + ")";
  }

  function setupPositions() {
    P1.x = W * 0.32; P1.y = H * 0.55;
    P2.x = W * 0.68; P2.y = H * 0.55;
  }

  function resetGame() {
    P1.score = 0; P2.score = 0;
    P1.x = W * 0.32; P1.y = H * 0.55;
    P2.x = W * 0.68; P2.y = H * 0.55;
    P1.bubbles.length = 0; P2.bubbles.length = 0;
    P1.hitCd = 0; P2.hitCd = 0;
    P1.ready = true; P2.ready = true;
    winner = null;
    movers.length = 0;
    spawnTimer = 0;
    state = "count";
    time = START;
  }

  function makeBalloon() {
    const r = rand(R_MIN, R_MAX);
    const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const x = fromLeft ? -r - 10 : W + r + 10;
    const y = rand(H * 0.14, H * 0.7);
    const vx = (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * rand(28, 60);
    const vy = rand(-24, 24);
    const hue = rand(0, 360);
    return { x, y, vx, vy, r, type: "balloon", hue, wob: rand(0, 6.28) };
  }

  function makePop(x, y, hue) {
    const parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, 6.28), sp = rand(60, 200);
      parts.push({ x: 0, y: 0, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp });
    }
    return { x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: 0, type: "pop", hue, life: POP_MS, parts };
  }

  function makeBubble(x, y, r) {
    return { x, y, vx: rand(-16, 16), vy: rand(-30, -6), r, type: "bubble", life: BUBBLE_MS };
  }

  function spawnBalloon() {
    if (movers.length >= MAX_B) return;
    movers.push(makeBalloon());
  }

  function addBubbles(p, x, y, r) {
    const n = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = rand(0, 6.28), d = r * 0.5;
      p.bubbles.push(makeBubble(x + Math.cos(a) * d, y + Math.sin(a) * d, rand(4, 8)));
    }
  }

  function startGame() {
    resetGame();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnBalloon();
  }

  /* ---------------- Input ---------------- */
  function pointerPos(e) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
  }

  function movePlayer(p, x, y) {
    p.x = clamp(x, p.r, W - p.r);
    p.y = clamp(y, p.r, H - p.r);
  }

  function updatePlayers(dt) {
    if (P1.ready) movePlayer(P1, P1.x, P1.y);
    if (P2.ready) movePlayer(P2, P2.x, P2.y);
    P1.hitCd -= dt; P2.hitCd -= dt;
  }

  function updateBubbles(p, dt) {
    for (let i = p.bubbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = p.bubbles[i];
      b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.vy += 30 * dt;
      b.life -= dt;
      if (b.life <= 0) p.bubbles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function collide() {
    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      if (m.type !== "balloon") continue;
      const rr = m.r + 2;
      if (dist2(m.x, m.y, P1.x, P1.y) <= rr * rr) {
        if (P1.hitCd <= 0) {
          P1.score++; P1.hitCd = 0.16;
          movers[i] = makePop(m.x, m.y, m.hue);
          addBubbles(P1, m.x, m.y, m.r);
        }
      } else if (dist2(m.x, m.y, P2.x, P2.y) <= rr * rr) {
        if (P2.hitCd <= 0) {
          P2.score++; P2.hitCd = 0.16;
          movers[i] = makePop(m.x, m.y, m.hue);
          addBubbles(P2, m.x, m.y, m.r);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function checkWin() {
    if (P1.score >= WIN) { winner = P1; state = "over"; }
    else if (P2.score >= WIN) { winner = P2; state = "over"; }
  }

  /* ---------------- Update ---------------- */
  function update(dt) {
    spawnTimer -= dt;
    if (spawnTimer <= 0) { spawnBalloon(); spawnTimer = SPAWN_MS; }

    for (let i = movers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const m = movers[i];
      m.x += m.vx * dt;
      m.y += m.vy * dt;
      if (m.type === "balloon") {
        m.wob += dt * 3;
        m.vy += Math.sin(m.wob) * 22 * dt;
        if (m.x < -m.r - 40 || m.x > W + m.r + 40 || m.y < -m.r - 60 || m.y > H + m.r + 60) movers.splice(i, 1);
      } else if (m.type === "pop") {
        m.life -= dt;
        for (const p of m.parts) { p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 200 * dt; }
        if (m.life <= 0) movers.splice(i, 1);
      } else if (m.type === "bubble") {
        m.life -= dt;
        if (m.life <= 0) movers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    updatePlayers(dt);
    updateBubbles(P1, dt);
    updateBubbles(P2, dt);
    collide();
    checkWin();
  }

  function updateCount() {
    time -= (performance.now() - last) / 1000;
    if (time <= 0) { time = 0; state = "play"; spawnTimer = 0; }
  }

  /* ---------------- Drawing ---------------- */
  function drawBackground() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#22457e");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#3f6fb0");
    g.addColorStop(0.8, "#7fa8d8");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#c6d8ef");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.82, H * 0.16, 10, W * 0.82, H * 0.16, 220);
    sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,244,200,0.9)");
    sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,244,200,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = sun;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W * 0.82, H * 0.16, 220, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();

    for (const s of stars) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 + 0.35 * Math.sin(time * 2 + s.ph);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.s, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    for (const c of clouds) {
      const x = ((c.x + time * c.spd) % (W + 260)) - 130;
      const y = c.y;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.82)";
      const puffs = [[0, 0, 34], [-30, 8, 26], [30, 6, 28], [0, -14, 24], [-14, 14, 22]];
      for (const p of puffs) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + p[0], y + p[1], p[2], 0, 6.283); ctx.fill(); }
    }
  }

  function drawBalloon(m) {
    const cx = m.x, cy = m.y, r = m.r;
    const base = "hsl(" + m.hue + ",82%,60%)";
    const dark = "hsl(" + m.hue + ",70%,44%)";

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + r * 0.9);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + 5, cy + r * 1.4, cx, cy + r * 1.9);
    ctx.stroke();

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.35, cy - r * 0.4, r * 0.1, cx, cy, r * 1.1);
    g.addColorStop(0, shade(base, 0.5));
    g.addColorStop(0.55, base);
    g.addColorStop(1, dark);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r * 0.9, r, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = dark;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - r * 0.16, cy + r * 0.92);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + r * 0.16, cy + r * 0.92);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + r * 1.16);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx - r * 0.3, cy - r * 0.35, r * 0.22, r * 0.34, -0.5, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawPop(m) {
    const a = clamp(m.life / POP_MS, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.fillStyle = "hsl(" + m.hue + ",85%,62%)";
    for (const p of m.parts) {
      const s = 3 + 5 * a;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x + p.x, m.y + p.y, s, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawBubble(m) {
    const a = clamp(m.life / BUBBLE_MS, 0, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawPlayer(p) {
    const x = p.x, y = p.y, r = p.r;

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + r * 1.05, r * 0.9, r * 0.3, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, x, y, r * 1.1);

    g.addColorStop(0.6, p.color);
    g.addColorStop(1, shade(p.color, -0.25));
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();

    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
    const eyeY = y - r * 0.1, eyeDx = r * 0.34, eyeR = r * 0.14;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - eyeDx, eyeY, eyeR, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + eyeDx, eyeY, eyeR, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - eyeDx - eyeR * 0.3, eyeY - eyeR * 0.3, eyeR * 0.35, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + eyeDx - eyeR * 0.3, eyeY - eyeR * 0.3, eyeR * 0.35, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y + r * 0.15, r * 0.4, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(r * 0.55) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(p.name, x, y + r * 1.5);
  }

  function drawPlayerBubbles(p) {
    for (const b of p.bubbles) {
      const a = clamp(b.life / BUBBLE_MS, 0, 1);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.8;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  function drawMovers() {
    for (const m of movers) {
      if (m.type === "balloon") drawBalloon(m);
      else if (m.type === "pop") drawPop(m);
      else if (m.type === "bubble") drawBubble(m);
    }
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = P1.color;
    ctx.fillText("P1", 18, 30);
    ctx.font = "bold 40px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(String(P1.score), 18, 72);
    ctx.font = "14px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.fillText("first to " + WIN, 18, 100);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = P2.color;
    ctx.fillText("P2", W - 18, 30);
    ctx.font = "bold 40px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(String(P2.score), W - 18, 72);
    ctx.font = "14px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
    ctx.fillText("first to " + WIN, W - 18, 100);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.fillText("BALLOON POP DUEL", W / 2, 30);
  }

  function drawCountdown() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const n = Math.ceil(time);
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.3) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(n > 0 ? String(n) : "GO!", W / 2, H / 2);
  }

  function drawStart() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,8,20,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.1) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BALLOON POP DUEL", W / 2, H * 0.3);

    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.035) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = P1.color;
    ctx.fillText("P1 — click / tap / drag on the left", W / 2, H * 0.45);
    ctx.fillStyle = P2.color;
    ctx.fillText("P2 — click / tap / drag on the right", W / 2, H * 0.52);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
    ctx.fillText("Steer your orb to pop the drifting balloons.", W / 2, H * 0.6);
    ctx.fillText("First to " + WIN + " pops wins!", W / 2, H * 0.66);

    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.05) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.fillText("CLICK / TAP TO START", W / 2, H * 0.8);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,8,20,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = winner.color;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.12) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(winner.name + " WINS!", W / 2, H * 0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = Math.floor(H * 0.05) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(P1.score + "  -  " + P2.score, W / 2, H * 0.52);
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe08a";
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(H * 0.045) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("CLICK / TAP TO PLAY AGAIN", W / 2, H * 0.66);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function draw() {
    drawBackground();
    drawMovers();
    drawPlayerBubbles(P1);
    drawPlayerBubbles(P2);
    drawPlayer(P1);
    drawPlayer(P2);
    drawHUD();
    if (state === "count") drawCountdown();
    else if (state === "start") drawStart();
    else if (state === "over") drawOver();
  }

  /* ---------------- Loop ---------------- */
  function frame(now) {
    let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    if (state === "play") update(dt);
    else if (state === "count") updateCount();

  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {

  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
